===== FILE: source\assets\assetregistry.cpp =====
#include "assetregistry.h"
#include <algorithm>
#include <fstream>
#include <random>
#include <cctype>
#ifdef _WIN32
#include <windows.h>
#endif

AssetHandle GenerateAssetHandle()
{
    static std::mt19937_64 generator(std::random_device{}());
    AssetHandle handle = 0;
    while (handle == 0)
    {
        handle = generator();
    }
    return handle;
}

AssetRegistry::AssetRegistry(const std::filesystem::path& root) : m_RootSpec(root) {}

const std::filesystem::path& AssetRegistry::Root() const
{
    std::error_code error;
    const auto base = std::filesystem::current_path(error);
    if (m_Root.empty() || base != m_RootBase)
    {
        m_RootBase = base;
        const auto absolute = m_RootSpec.is_absolute() ? m_RootSpec : base / m_RootSpec;
        std::error_code canonicalError;
        m_Root = std::filesystem::weakly_canonical(absolute, canonicalError);
        if (canonicalError || m_Root.empty())
        {
            m_Root = absolute.lexically_normal();
        }
    }
    return m_Root;
}

std::filesystem::path AssetRegistry::ValidationCacheRoot()
{
    std::error_code error;
    const auto base = std::filesystem::current_path(error);
    return (base / "Data" / "Cache" / "Validation").lexically_normal();
}

bool AssetRegistry::Contains(const std::filesystem::path& path) const
{
    std::error_code error;
    const auto canonical = std::filesystem::weakly_canonical(path, error);
    if (error)
    {
        return false;
    }
    auto inside = [&canonical](const std::filesystem::path& root) {
#ifdef _WIN32
        // Windows file identities are case-insensitive even when path strings differ.
        auto child = canonical.begin();
        for (const auto& component : root)
        {
            if (child == canonical.end() ||
                CompareStringOrdinal(child->c_str(), -1, component.c_str(), -1, TRUE) != CSTR_EQUAL)
            {
                return false;
            }
            ++child;
        }
        return child != canonical.end();
#else
        const auto relative = canonical.lexically_relative(root);
        return !relative.empty() && *relative.begin() != ".." && *relative.begin() != ".";
#endif
    };
    if (inside(Root()))
    {
        return true;
    }
    std::error_code cacheError;
    const auto cache = std::filesystem::weakly_canonical(ValidationCacheRoot(), cacheError);
    return !cacheError && inside(cache);
}

AssetType AssetRegistry::Classify(const std::filesystem::path& path)
{
    std::string extension = path.extension().string();
    std::transform(extension.begin(), extension.end(), extension.begin(), [](unsigned char letter) {
        return static_cast<char>(std::tolower(letter));
    });
    if (extension == ".noise")
    {
        return AssetType::Noise;
    }
    if (extension == ".material")
    {
        return AssetType::Material;
    }
    for (const char* texture : {".png", ".jpg", ".jpeg", ".dds", ".tga", ".bmp", ".tif", ".tiff", ".hdr"})
    {
        if (extension == texture)
        {
            return AssetType::Texture;
        }
    }
    for (const char* mesh : {".obj", ".fbx", ".gltf", ".glb", ".vgmesh", ".vgp2"})
    {
        if (extension == mesh)
        {
            return AssetType::Mesh;
        }
    }
    return AssetType::Unknown;
}

AssetHandle AssetRegistry::Register(const std::filesystem::path& path, AssetType type, std::string& error)
{
    error.clear();
    const auto absolute = std::filesystem::absolute(path).lexically_normal();
    std::error_code filesystemError;
    if (!Contains(absolute) || !std::filesystem::is_regular_file(absolute, filesystemError) ||
        type == AssetType::Unknown || Classify(absolute) != type)
    {
        error = "Asset must be a supported file inside the project asset directory";
        return 0;
    }
    const auto metadata = std::filesystem::path(absolute.wstring() + L".meta");
    AssetHandle handle = 0;
    if (std::filesystem::exists(metadata, filesystemError))
    {
        std::string reference;
        std::ifstream stream(metadata);
        stream >> reference;
        handle = ParseAssetHandle(reference);
        if (handle == 0)
        {
            error = "Invalid asset metadata: " + metadata.generic_string();
            return 0;
        }
    }
    else
    {
        do
        {
            handle = GenerateAssetHandle();
        } while (handle == 0 || m_Entries.contains(handle) || m_Collisions.contains(handle));
        if (!WriteAssetFile(metadata, FormatAssetHandle(handle) + "\n", error))
        {
            return 0;
        }
    }
    const auto existing = m_Entries.find(handle);
    bool differentFile = false;
    if (existing != m_Entries.end() && existing->second.Path != absolute)
    {
        std::error_code identityError;
        const bool sameFile = std::filesystem::equivalent(existing->second.Path, absolute, identityError);
        differentFile = identityError || !sameFile;
    }
    if (m_Collisions.contains(handle) || differentFile)
    {
        m_Entries.erase(handle);
        m_Collisions.insert(handle);
        error = "Duplicate asset GUID: " + FormatAssetHandle(handle);
        return 0;
    }
    m_Entries[handle] = {absolute, type};
    return handle;
}

std::filesystem::path AssetRegistry::Resolve(AssetHandle handle) const
{
    const auto found = m_Entries.find(handle);
    std::error_code error;
    if (found == m_Entries.end() || !std::filesystem::is_regular_file(found->second.Path, error))
    {
        return {};
    }
    return found->second.Path;
}

AssetType AssetRegistry::TypeOf(AssetHandle handle) const
{
    const auto found = m_Entries.find(handle);
    if (found == m_Entries.end())
    {
        return AssetType::Unknown;
    }
    return found->second.Type;
}

bool AssetRegistry::Refresh(std::string& error)
{
    m_Entries.clear();
    m_Collisions.clear();
    error.clear();
    std::error_code filesystemError;
    auto scan = [&](const std::filesystem::path& root) {
        std::filesystem::recursive_directory_iterator iterator(root, filesystemError);
        for (const auto end = std::filesystem::recursive_directory_iterator(); iterator != end && !filesystemError;
             iterator.increment(filesystemError))
        {
            const auto type = Classify(iterator->path());
            if (type == AssetType::Unknown || !iterator->is_regular_file(filesystemError))
            {
                continue;
            }
            // テクスチャ ID は使用時やドラッグ時に割り当てる。プロジェクト走査では、
            // どのマテリアルも参照しないインポート済みテクスチャのメタデータを作らない。
            if ((type == AssetType::Texture || type == AssetType::Mesh) &&
                !std::filesystem::exists(iterator->path().wstring() + L".meta", filesystemError))
            {
                continue;
            }
            std::string assetError;
            if (!Register(iterator->path(), type, assetError))
            {
                error += assetError + "\n";
            }
        }
    };
    scan(Root());
    // 検証フィクスチャ（Data/Cache/Validation）は存在する場合のみ走査する。
    std::error_code cacheError;
    const auto cache = ValidationCacheRoot();
    if (!filesystemError && std::filesystem::is_directory(cache, cacheError))
    {
        scan(cache);
    }
    if (filesystemError)
    {
        error += filesystemError.message();
    }
    return error.empty();
}

bool AssetRegistry::Move(AssetHandle handle, const std::filesystem::path& destination, std::string& error)
{
    error.clear();
    const auto source = Resolve(handle);
    const auto target = std::filesystem::absolute(destination).lexically_normal();
    std::error_code filesystemError;
    if (source.empty() || !Contains(target) || Classify(target) != TypeOf(handle) ||
        std::filesystem::exists(target, filesystemError) ||
        std::filesystem::exists(target.wstring() + L".meta", filesystemError))
    {
        error = "Invalid or occupied asset destination";
        return false;
    }
    std::filesystem::create_directories(target.parent_path(), filesystemError);
    if (!filesystemError)
    {
        std::filesystem::rename(source, target, filesystemError);
    }
    if (filesystemError)
    {
        error = filesystemError.message();
        return false;
    }
    std::filesystem::rename(source.wstring() + L".meta", target.wstring() + L".meta", filesystemError);
    if (filesystemError)
    {
        error = filesystemError.message();
        std::error_code rollbackError;
        std::filesystem::rename(target, source, rollbackError);
        return false;
    }
    m_Entries.at(handle).Path = target;
    return true;
}

AssetHandle AssetRegistry::Duplicate(AssetHandle handle, const std::filesystem::path& destination, std::string& error)
{
    error.clear();
    const auto source = Resolve(handle);
    const auto target = std::filesystem::absolute(destination).lexically_normal();
    const auto type = TypeOf(handle);
    std::error_code filesystemError;
    if (source.empty() || !Contains(target) || Classify(target) != type ||
        std::filesystem::exists(target.wstring() + L".meta", filesystemError))
    {
        error = "Invalid duplicate destination";
        return 0;
    }
    if (!std::filesystem::copy_file(source, target, std::filesystem::copy_options::none, filesystemError))
    {
        error = filesystemError.message();
        return 0;
    }
    const auto copy = Register(target, type, error);
    if (!copy)
    {
        std::filesystem::remove(target, filesystemError);
    }
    return copy;
}


===== FILE: source\assets\assetregistry.h =====
#pragma once
#include "materialasset.h"
#include <unordered_map>
#include <unordered_set>

class AssetRegistry
{
  public:
    struct Entry
    {
        std::filesystem::path Path;
        AssetType Type = AssetType::Unknown;
    };

    explicit AssetRegistry(const std::filesystem::path& root = "asset");
    AssetHandle Register(const std::filesystem::path& path, AssetType type, std::string& error);
    std::filesystem::path Resolve(AssetHandle handle) const;
    AssetType TypeOf(AssetHandle handle) const;
    bool Refresh(std::string& error);
    bool Move(AssetHandle handle, const std::filesystem::path& destination, std::string& error);
    AssetHandle Duplicate(AssetHandle handle, const std::filesystem::path& destination, std::string& error);
    static AssetType Classify(const std::filesystem::path& path);
    // ルート（asset フォルダ）の絶対パス。作業フォルダが変わったら取り直す。
    const std::filesystem::path& Root() const;
    // 検証（--validate 系）の一時フィクスチャ置き場（<作業フォルダ>/Data/Cache/Validation）。
    // asset 以下に作らないことで、アセットブラウザや保存ダイアログに現れないようにする。
    // レジストリはこの下のファイルもアセットとして登録できる。
    static std::filesystem::path ValidationCacheRoot();

  private:
    // グローバル変数として WinMain より前に構築されるため、構築時点の作業フォルダで
    // ルートを固定すると、main.cpp の SetCurrentDirectoryW 後に別フォルダを指してしまう。
    // 指定値だけ保持し、絶対パスは使用時に解決する。
    std::filesystem::path m_RootSpec;
    mutable std::filesystem::path m_Root;
    mutable std::filesystem::path m_RootBase;
    std::unordered_map<AssetHandle, Entry> m_Entries;
    std::unordered_set<AssetHandle> m_Collisions;
    bool Contains(const std::filesystem::path& path) const;
};


===== FILE: source\assets\iesprofile.h =====
#pragma once
#include <algorithm>
#include <cmath>
#include <cstdint>
#include <filesystem>
#include <fstream>
#include <istream>
#include <limits>
#include <locale>
#include <sstream>
#include <string>
#include <utility>
#include <vector>

namespace IesProfiles
{
    struct Profile
    {
        int PhotometricType = 1;
        std::vector<float> VerticalAngles;
        std::vector<float> HorizontalAngles;
        std::vector<float> Candela;
        float PeakCandela = 0;
    };

    namespace Detail
    {
        inline std::string Trim(const std::string& text)
        {
            const auto first = text.find_first_not_of(" \t\r\n");
            if (first == std::string::npos)
            {
                return {};
            }
            return text.substr(first, text.find_last_not_of(" \t\r\n") - first + 1);
        }

        inline bool ReadNumber(std::istream& stream, double& value)
        {
            return static_cast<bool>(stream >> value) && std::isfinite(value);
        }

        inline bool ReadAngles(std::istream& stream, std::vector<float>& angles, float maximum)
        {
            double previous = -1;
            for (float& angle : angles)
            {
                double value = 0;
                if (!ReadNumber(stream, value) || value < 0 || value > maximum || value <= previous)
                {
                    return false;
                }
                angle = static_cast<float>(value);
                if (previous >= 0 && angle <= static_cast<float>(previous))
                {
                    return false;
                }
                previous = value;
            }
            return true;
        }

        struct Interval
        {
            size_t First = 0;
            size_t Second = 0;
            float Weight = 0;
        };

        inline Interval FindInterval(const std::vector<float>& angles, float degrees)
        {
            const auto upper = std::upper_bound(angles.begin(), angles.end(), degrees);
            if (upper == angles.end())
            {
                return { angles.size() - 1, angles.size() - 1, 0 };
            }
            if (upper == angles.begin())
            {
                return {};
            }
            const size_t second = static_cast<size_t>(upper - angles.begin());
            const size_t first = second - 1;
            return { first, second, (degrees - angles[first]) / (angles[second] - angles[first]) };
        }
    }

    // Type C LM-63 data only. Photometric angles are in degrees; candela rows
    // are horizontal-major. Metadata, ballast factors and lumens do not change
    // the normalized angular mask used by this renderer.
    inline bool Parse(std::istream& input, Profile& output, std::string& error)
    {
        error.clear();
        const auto fail = [&error](const std::string& message)
        {
            error = message;
            return false;
        };

        constexpr size_t maximumTextBytes = 32 * 1024 * 1024;
        size_t textBytes = 0;
        bool foundTilt = false;
        std::string line;
        while (std::getline(input, line))
        {
            textBytes += line.size();
            if (textBytes > maximumTextBytes)
            {
                return fail("IES file exceeds the 32 MiB limit.");
            }
            const std::string trimmed = Detail::Trim(line);
            if (trimmed.rfind("TILT=", 0) == 0)
            {
                if (trimmed != "TILT=NONE")
                {
                    return fail("Unsupported IES TILT data. Only TILT=NONE is supported.");
                }
                foundTilt = true;
                break;
            }
        }
        if (!foundTilt)
        {
            return fail("IES file is missing TILT=NONE.");
        }

        std::string numericText;
        while (std::getline(input, line))
        {
            textBytes += line.size() + 1;
            if (textBytes > maximumTextBytes)
            {
                return fail("IES file exceeds the 32 MiB limit.");
            }
            numericText += line;
            numericText += '\n';
        }
        if (input.bad())
        {
            return fail("Unable to read IES file.");
        }
        std::replace(numericText.begin(), numericText.end(), ',', ' ');
        std::istringstream numbers(numericText);
        numbers.imbue(std::locale::classic());

        double header[13] = {};
        for (double& field : header)
        {
            if (!Detail::ReadNumber(numbers, field))
            {
                return fail("IES numeric header is truncated or contains invalid numbers.");
            }
        }
        const double verticalCount = header[3];
        const double horizontalCount = header[4];
        const auto validCount = [](double count)
        {
            return count >= 1 && count <= 65536 && std::floor(count) == count;
        };
        if (!validCount(verticalCount) || !validCount(horizontalCount)
            || verticalCount < 2 || verticalCount * horizontalCount > 4 * 1024 * 1024)
        {
            return fail("IES angle counts are invalid or exceed the supported size.");
        }
        if (header[5] != 1)
        {
            return fail("Unsupported IES photometric type. Only Type C (1) is supported; A/B are not supported.");
        }
        if (header[0] < 1 || std::floor(header[0]) != header[0]
            || (header[1] < 0 && header[1] != -1) || header[2] < 0
            || header[2] > std::numeric_limits<float>::max()
            || (header[6] != 1 && header[6] != 2)
            || header[10] < 0 || header[11] < 0 || header[12] < 0)
        {
            return fail("IES header has an invalid lamp count, multiplier, units or electrical value.");
        }

        Profile profile;
        profile.VerticalAngles.resize(static_cast<size_t>(verticalCount));
        profile.HorizontalAngles.resize(static_cast<size_t>(horizontalCount));
        if (!Detail::ReadAngles(numbers, profile.VerticalAngles, 180)
            || !Detail::ReadAngles(numbers, profile.HorizontalAngles, 360))
        {
            return fail("IES angles must be finite, strictly increasing and within their angular limits.");
        }
        const float horizontalEnd = profile.HorizontalAngles.back();
        const bool rotational = profile.HorizontalAngles.size() == 1 && horizontalEnd == 0;
        const bool supportedSymmetry = horizontalEnd == 90 || horizontalEnd == 180 || horizontalEnd == 360;
        if (profile.HorizontalAngles.front() != 0 || (!rotational && !supportedSymmetry))
        {
            return fail("Unsupported Type C horizontal range. Expected 0 alone, 0..90, 0..180 or 0..360 degrees.");
        }

        profile.Candela.resize(profile.VerticalAngles.size() * profile.HorizontalAngles.size());
        for (float& candela : profile.Candela)
        {
            double value = 0;
            if (!Detail::ReadNumber(numbers, value) || value < 0
                || value * header[2] > std::numeric_limits<float>::max())
            {
                return fail("IES candela table is truncated or has a negative, nonfinite or overflowing value.");
            }
            candela = static_cast<float>(value * header[2]);
            profile.PeakCandela = (std::max)(profile.PeakCandela, candela);
        }
        numbers >> std::ws;
        if (!numbers.eof())
        {
            return fail("IES file contains unexpected trailing data after the candela table.");
        }
        output = std::move(profile);
        return true;
    }

    inline bool Load(const std::filesystem::path& path, Profile& profile, std::string& error)
    {
        std::ifstream stream(path, std::ios::binary);
        if (!stream)
        {
            error = "Unable to open IES profile file.";
            return false;
        }
        return Parse(stream, profile, error);
    }

    inline float Evaluate(const Profile& profile, float verticalDegrees, float horizontalDegrees)
    {
        if (profile.PhotometricType != 1 || profile.PeakCandela <= 0
            || !std::isfinite(profile.PeakCandela) || !std::isfinite(verticalDegrees)
            || !std::isfinite(horizontalDegrees) || profile.VerticalAngles.empty()
            || profile.HorizontalAngles.empty()
            || profile.Candela.size() / profile.VerticalAngles.size() != profile.HorizontalAngles.size()
            || profile.Candela.size() % profile.VerticalAngles.size() != 0)
        {
            return 0;
        }
        if (verticalDegrees < profile.VerticalAngles.front() || verticalDegrees > profile.VerticalAngles.back())
        {
            return 0;
        }

        float azimuth = std::fmod(horizontalDegrees, 360.0f);
        if (azimuth < 0)
        {
            azimuth += 360;
        }
        const float horizontalEnd = profile.HorizontalAngles.back();
        if (horizontalEnd == 0)
        {
            azimuth = 0;
        }
        else if (horizontalEnd <= 180)
        {
            if (azimuth > 180)
            {
                azimuth = 360 - azimuth;
            }
            if (horizontalEnd == 90 && azimuth > 90)
            {
                azimuth = 180 - azimuth;
            }
        }

        const auto vertical = Detail::FindInterval(profile.VerticalAngles, verticalDegrees);
        const auto horizontal = Detail::FindInterval(profile.HorizontalAngles, azimuth);
        const size_t rowSize = profile.VerticalAngles.size();
        const auto sampleRow = [&](size_t row)
        {
            const float first = profile.Candela[row * rowSize + vertical.First];
            const float second = profile.Candela[row * rowSize + vertical.Second];
            return first + (second - first) * vertical.Weight;
        };
        const float first = sampleRow(horizontal.First);
        const float second = sampleRow(horizontal.Second);
        const float normalized = (first + (second - first) * horizontal.Weight) / profile.PeakCandela;
        if (!std::isfinite(normalized))
        {
            return 0;
        }
        return (std::clamp)(normalized, 0.0f, 1.0f);
    }

    // Equirectangular mask: x is azimuth [0,360), y is polar [0,180].
    // Use horizontal wrap and vertical clamp when sampling the GPU texture.
    inline std::vector<float> Bake(const Profile& profile, unsigned width = 256, unsigned height = 128)
    {
        if (width == 0 || height == 0 || static_cast<uint64_t>(width) * height > 4 * 1024 * 1024)
        {
            return {};
        }
        std::vector<float> pixels(static_cast<size_t>(width) * height);
        for (unsigned row = 0; row < height; ++row)
        {
            const float vertical = (static_cast<float>(row) + 0.5f) * 180.0f / height;
            for (unsigned column = 0; column < width; ++column)
            {
                const float horizontal = (static_cast<float>(column) + 0.5f) * 360.0f / width;
                pixels[static_cast<size_t>(row) * width + column] = Evaluate(profile, vertical, horizontal);
            }
        }
        return pixels;
    }
}

===== FILE: source\assets\materialasset.cpp =====
#include "materialasset.h"
#include <json/json.h>
#include <charconv>
#include <cmath>
#include <fstream>
#include <iomanip>
#include <sstream>
#ifdef _WIN32
#include <windows.h>
#endif

std::string FormatAssetHandle(AssetHandle handle)
{
    std::ostringstream output;
    output << "guid:" << std::hex << std::setw(16) << std::setfill('0') << handle;
    return output.str();
}

AssetHandle ParseAssetHandle(const std::string& text)
{
    if (text.size() != 21 || text.substr(0, 5) != "guid:")
    {
        return 0;
    }
    AssetHandle handle = 0;
    const auto result = std::from_chars(text.data() + 5, text.data() + text.size(), handle, 16);
    if (result.ec != std::errc{} || result.ptr != text.data() + text.size())
    {
        return 0;
    }
    return handle;
}

bool WriteAssetFile(const std::filesystem::path& path, const std::string& contents, std::string& error)
{
    error.clear();
    auto temporary = path;
    temporary += ".tmp";
    {
        std::ofstream stream(temporary, std::ios::binary | std::ios::trunc);
        stream.write(contents.data(), static_cast<std::streamsize>(contents.size()));
        stream.flush();
        if (!stream)
        {
            error = "Failed to write " + path.generic_string();
            return false;
        }
    }
#ifdef _WIN32
    if (!MoveFileExW(temporary.c_str(), path.c_str(), MOVEFILE_REPLACE_EXISTING | MOVEFILE_WRITE_THROUGH))
    {
        error = "Failed to replace " + path.generic_string() + " (" + std::to_string(GetLastError()) + ")";
        std::error_code ignored;
        std::filesystem::remove(temporary, ignored);
        return false;
    }
#else
    std::error_code filesystemError;
    std::filesystem::rename(temporary, path, filesystemError);
    if (filesystemError)
    {
        error = "Failed to replace " + path.generic_string() + ": " + filesystemError.message();
        std::error_code ignored;
        std::filesystem::remove(temporary, ignored);
        return false;
    }
#endif
    return true;
}

bool MaterialSerializer::Validate(const MaterialAssetData& material, std::string& error)
{
    error.clear();
    auto range = [&](float value, float minimum, float maximum, const char* property) {
        if (!std::isfinite(value) || value < minimum || value > maximum)
        {
            error = std::string("Invalid ") + property;
            return false;
        }
        return true;
    };
    for (float channel : material.BaseColor)
    {
        if (!range(channel, 0, 1, "baseColor"))
        {
            return false;
        }
    }
    for (float channel : material.EmissiveColor)
    {
        if (!range(channel, 0, 65504, "emissiveColor"))
        {
            return false;
        }
    }
    if (!range(material.Metallic, 0, 1, "metallic") || !range(material.Roughness, 0, 1, "roughness") ||
        !range(material.ParallaxDepth, 0, 0.2f, "parallaxDepth") ||
        !range(material.ParallaxSteps, 8, 1024, "parallaxSteps") || !range(material.NormalScale, 0, 8, "normalScale") ||
        !range(material.AOStrength, 0, 1, "aoStrength") ||
        !range(material.EmissiveIntensity, 0, 65504, "emissiveIntensity") ||
        !range(material.AlphaCutoff, 0, 1, "alphaCutoff") || !range(material.ShadowCutoff, 0, 1, "shadowCutoff") ||
        !range(material.IOR, 1, 10, "ior") || !range(material.Transmission, 0, 1, "transmission") ||
        !range(material.TransmissionRoughness, 0, 1, "transmissionRoughness") ||
        !range(material.Thickness, 0, 65504, "thickness") || !range(material.ShadingStrength, 0, 1, "shadingStrength"))
    {
        return false;
    }
    for (float channel : material.AbsorptionCoefficient)
    {
        if (!range(channel, 0, 65504, "absorptionCoefficient"))
        {
            return false;
        }
    }
    if (material.Surface > MaterialSurface::Transparent || material.Cull > MaterialCull::Front ||
        material.ShadowMode > MaterialShadowMode::Auto)
    {
        error = "Unsupported render state";
        return false;
    }
    return true;
}

namespace
{
    constexpr const char* textureNames[] = {"baseColor", "normal", "metallicRoughness", "ao", "emissive", "height"};

    bool ReadFloat(const Json::Value& object, const char* name, float& value, std::string& error)
    {
        if (!object.isMember(name))
        {
            return true;
        }
        if (!object[name].isNumeric())
        {
            error = std::string("Invalid ") + name + " property";
            return false;
        }
        value = object[name].asFloat();
        return true;
    }

    template <size_t Count>
    bool ReadColor(const Json::Value& object, const char* name, std::array<float, Count>& color, std::string& error)
    {
        if (!object.isMember(name))
        {
            return true;
        }
        const auto& array = object[name];
        if (!array.isArray() || array.size() != Count)
        {
            error = std::string("Invalid ") + name + " array";
            return false;
        }
        for (Json::ArrayIndex i = 0; i < Count; ++i)
        {
            if (!array[i].isNumeric())
            {
                error = std::string("Invalid ") + name + " channel";
                return false;
            }
            color[i] = array[i].asFloat();
        }
        return true;
    }
}

bool MaterialSerializer::Load(const std::filesystem::path& path, MaterialAssetData& material, std::string& error)
{
    error.clear();
    std::ifstream stream(path, std::ios::binary);
    if (!stream)
    {
        error = "Failed to open " + path.generic_string();
        return false;
    }
    Json::Value root;
    Json::CharReaderBuilder reader;
    reader["rejectDupKeys"] = true;
    reader["failIfExtra"] = true;
    if (!Json::parseFromStream(reader, stream, &root, &error))
    {
        return false;
    }
    if (!root.isObject() || !root["version"].isInt() || root["version"].asInt() != 1)
    {
        error = "Unsupported material version (expected 1)";
        return false;
    }
    if (root.isMember("shader") && root["shader"] != "PBR")
    {
        error = "Only the PBR shader is supported";
        return false;
    }
    MaterialAssetData result;
    const auto& parameters = root["parameters"];
    const auto& renderState = root["renderState"];
    const auto& textures = root["textures"];
    for (const char* object : {"parameters", "renderState", "textures"})
    {
        if (root.isMember(object) && !root[object].isObject())
        {
            error = std::string("Invalid ") + object + " object";
            return false;
        }
    }
    if (!ReadColor(parameters, "baseColor", result.BaseColor, error) ||
        !ReadColor(parameters, "emissiveColor", result.EmissiveColor, error) ||
        !ReadFloat(parameters, "metallic", result.Metallic, error) ||
        !ReadFloat(parameters, "roughness", result.Roughness, error) ||
        !ReadFloat(parameters, "parallaxDepth", result.ParallaxDepth, error) ||
        !ReadFloat(parameters, "parallaxSteps", result.ParallaxSteps, error) ||
        !ReadFloat(parameters, "normalScale", result.NormalScale, error) ||
        !ReadFloat(parameters, "aoStrength", result.AOStrength, error) ||
        !ReadFloat(parameters, "emissiveIntensity", result.EmissiveIntensity, error) ||
        !ReadFloat(renderState, "alphaCutoff", result.AlphaCutoff, error) ||
        !ReadFloat(renderState, "shadowCutoff", result.ShadowCutoff, error) ||
        !ReadFloat(parameters, "ior", result.IOR, error) ||
        !ReadFloat(parameters, "transmission", result.Transmission, error) ||
        !ReadFloat(parameters, "transmissionRoughness", result.TransmissionRoughness, error) ||
        !ReadFloat(parameters, "thickness", result.Thickness, error) ||
        !ReadFloat(parameters, "shadingStrength", result.ShadingStrength, error) ||
        !ReadColor(parameters, "absorptionCoefficient", result.AbsorptionCoefficient, error))
    {
        return false;
    }
    if (parameters.isMember("shadingModel"))
    {
        if (!parameters["shadingModel"].isUInt() || parameters["shadingModel"].asUInt() > 5u)
        {
            error = "Invalid shadingModel property";
            return false;
        }
        result.ShadingModel = parameters["shadingModel"].asUInt();
    }
    if (root.isMember("surfaceType"))
    {
        const auto& surface = root["surfaceType"];
        if (surface == "Masked")
        {
            result.Surface = MaterialSurface::Masked;
        }
        else if (surface == "Transparent")
        {
            result.Surface = MaterialSurface::Transparent;
        }
        else if (surface != "Opaque")
        {
            error = "Unsupported surfaceType";
            return false;
        }
    }
    if (renderState.isMember("shadowMode"))
    {
        const auto& mode = renderState["shadowMode"];
        if (mode == "None")
        {
            result.ShadowMode = MaterialShadowMode::None;
        }
        else if (mode == "AlphaTest")
        {
            result.ShadowMode = MaterialShadowMode::AlphaTest;
        }
        else if (mode == "Opaque")
        {
            result.ShadowMode = MaterialShadowMode::Opaque;
        }
        else if (mode == "Transmittance")
        {
            result.ShadowMode = MaterialShadowMode::Transmittance;
        }
        else if (mode != "Auto")
        {
            error = "Invalid shadowMode";
            return false;
        }
    }
    else if (result.Surface == MaterialSurface::Masked)
    {
        result.ShadowMode = MaterialShadowMode::AlphaTest;
        result.ShadowCutoff = result.AlphaCutoff;
    }
    if (renderState.isMember("cullMode"))
    {
        const auto& cull = renderState["cullMode"];
        if (cull == "None")
        {
            result.Cull = MaterialCull::None;
        }
        else if (cull == "Front")
        {
            result.Cull = MaterialCull::Front;
        }
        else if (cull != "Back")
        {
            error = "Invalid cullMode";
            return false;
        }
    }
    if (renderState.isMember("depthWrite"))
    {
        if (!renderState["depthWrite"].isBool())
        {
            error = "Invalid depthWrite";
            return false;
        }
        result.DepthWrite = renderState["depthWrite"].asBool();
    }
    for (size_t slot = 0; slot < result.Textures.size(); ++slot)
    {
        const auto& reference = textures[textureNames[slot]];
        if (reference.isNull())
        {
            continue;
        }
        if (!reference.isString())
        {
            error = std::string("Invalid texture reference: ") + textureNames[slot];
            return false;
        }
        const auto text = reference.asString();
        result.Textures[slot] = ParseAssetHandle(text);
        if (result.Textures[slot] == 0 && text != FormatAssetHandle(0) && !text.empty())
        {
            error = std::string("Invalid texture GUID: ") + textureNames[slot];
            return false;
        }
    }
    if (!Validate(result, error))
    {
        return false;
    }
    material = result;
    return true;
}

bool MaterialSerializer::Save(const std::filesystem::path& path, const MaterialAssetData& material, std::string& error)
{
    if (!Validate(material, error))
    {
        return false;
    }
    Json::Value root(Json::objectValue);
    root["version"] = 1;
    root["shader"] = "PBR";
    root["surfaceType"] = "Opaque";
    if (material.Surface == MaterialSurface::Masked)
    {
        root["surfaceType"] = "Masked";
    }
    else if (material.Surface == MaterialSurface::Transparent)
    {
        root["surfaceType"] = "Transparent";
    }
    const char* cullNames[] = {"Back", "None", "Front"};
    auto& state = root["renderState"];
    state["cullMode"] = cullNames[static_cast<size_t>(material.Cull)];
    state["depthWrite"] = material.DepthWrite;
    state["alphaCutoff"] = material.AlphaCutoff;
    const char* shadowNames[] = {"None", "Opaque", "AlphaTest", "Transmittance", "Auto"};
    state["shadowMode"] = shadowNames[static_cast<size_t>(material.ShadowMode)];
    state["shadowCutoff"] = material.ShadowCutoff;
    auto& parameters = root["parameters"];
    for (float value : material.BaseColor)
    {
        parameters["baseColor"].append(value);
    }
    for (float value : material.EmissiveColor)
    {
        parameters["emissiveColor"].append(value);
    }
    parameters["metallic"] = material.Metallic;
    parameters["ior"] = material.IOR;
    parameters["transmission"] = material.Transmission;
    parameters["transmissionRoughness"] = material.TransmissionRoughness;
    parameters["thickness"] = material.Thickness;
    parameters["shadingModel"] = material.ShadingModel;
    parameters["shadingStrength"] = material.ShadingStrength;
    for (float value : material.AbsorptionCoefficient)
    {
        parameters["absorptionCoefficient"].append(value);
    }
    parameters["roughness"] = material.Roughness;
    parameters["parallaxDepth"] = material.ParallaxDepth;
    parameters["parallaxSteps"] = material.ParallaxSteps;
    parameters["normalScale"] = material.NormalScale;
    parameters["aoStrength"] = material.AOStrength;
    parameters["emissiveIntensity"] = material.EmissiveIntensity;
    for (size_t slot = 0; slot < material.Textures.size(); ++slot)
    {
        root["textures"][textureNames[slot]] = FormatAssetHandle(material.Textures[slot]);
    }
    Json::StreamWriterBuilder writer;
    writer["indentation"] = "  ";
    return WriteAssetFile(path, Json::writeString(writer, root), error);
}

#pragma once
#include <array>
#include <cstdint>
#include <filesystem>
#include <string>

using AssetHandle = uint64_t;
enum class AssetType : uint32_t
{
    Unknown,
    Material,
    Texture,
    Mesh,
    Noise
};

struct AssetDragPayload
{
    AssetHandle Handle = 0;
    AssetType Type = AssetType::Unknown;
};

inline constexpr char AssetPayloadType[] = "ASSET_HANDLE";
std::string FormatAssetHandle(AssetHandle handle);
AssetHandle GenerateAssetHandle();
AssetHandle ParseAssetHandle(const std::string& text);
bool SceneHasMaterialAssets();

enum class MaterialSurface : uint32_t
{
    Opaque,
    Masked,
    Transparent
};
enum class MaterialShadowMode : uint32_t
{
    None,
    Opaque,
    AlphaTest,
    Transmittance,
    Auto
};
enum class MaterialCull : uint32_t
{
    Back,
    None,
    Front
};
enum class MaterialTextureSlot : uint32_t
{
    BaseColor,
    Normal,
    MetallicRoughness,
    AO,
    Emissive,
    Height,
    Count
};

struct MaterialAssetData
{
    std::array<float, 4> BaseColor{1, 1, 1, 1};
    float Metallic = 0.0f;
    float Roughness = 0.5f;
    float NormalScale = 1.0f;
    float AOStrength = 1.0f;
    std::array<float, 3> EmissiveColor{0, 0, 0};
    float EmissiveIntensity = 0.0f;
    float ParallaxDepth = 0.0f; // UV units; zero disables POM.
    float ParallaxSteps = 32.0f;
    std::array<AssetHandle, static_cast<size_t>(MaterialTextureSlot::Count)> Textures{};
    MaterialSurface Surface = MaterialSurface::Opaque;
    MaterialCull Cull = MaterialCull::Back;
    bool DepthWrite = true;
    float AlphaCutoff = 0.5f;
    MaterialShadowMode ShadowMode = MaterialShadowMode::Auto;
    float ShadowCutoff = 0.5f;
    float IOR = 1.5f;
    float Transmission = 0.0f;
    float TransmissionRoughness = 0.02f;
    float Thickness = 0.1f;
    std::array<float, 3> AbsorptionCoefficient{0, 0, 0};
    // 拡張シェーディングモデル: 0 標準、1 クリアコート、2 布の光沢、3 肌、4 髪、5 異方性。
    uint32_t ShadingModel = 0;
    float ShadingStrength = 1.0f;
    bool operator==(const MaterialAssetData&) const = default;
};

class MaterialSerializer
{
  public:
    static bool Validate(const MaterialAssetData& material, std::string& error);
    static bool Load(const std::filesystem::path& path, MaterialAssetData& material, std::string& error);
    static bool Save(const std::filesystem::path& path, const MaterialAssetData& material, std::string& error);
};

// 同じディレクトリ内でファイルをアトミックに置換する。書き込み失敗時は置換先を保持する。
bool WriteAssetFile(const std::filesystem::path& path, const std::string& contents, std::string& error);
