                code = MaterialGraphMath::BinaryHlsl(node.Kind, inputs[0].Code, inputs[1].Code);
            }
            if (constant)
            {
                Float4 folded{};
                for (int i = 0; i < static_cast<int>(type); ++i)
                {
                    const float x = (*inputs[0].Constant)[i];
                    float value = 0.0f;
                    if (MaterialGraphMath::IsUnary(node.Kind))
                    {
                        value = MaterialGraphMath::Unary(node.Kind, x);
                    }
                    else if (biasScale)
                    {
                        value = (x + (*inputs[1].Constant)[0]) * (*inputs[2].Constant)[0];
                    }
                    else
                    {
                        const float y = node.Kind == Kind::Power ? (*inputs[1].Constant)[0] : (*inputs[1].Constant)[i];
                        value = MaterialGraphMath::Binary(node.Kind, x, y);
                    }
                    if (!std::isfinite(value))
                    {
                        return {code, type, {}};
                    }
                    folded[i] = value;
                }
                return Literal(folded, type);
            }
            return {code, type, {}};
        }

        Expression Visit(const MaterialGraphNode& node)
        {
            if (const auto found = m_Expressions.find(node.Id); found != m_Expressions.end())
            {
                return found->second;
            }
            Expression expression;
            if (node.Kind == Kind::Reroute || node.Kind == Kind::BreakVector)
            {
                // 中継ノードは式をそのまま通す
                expression = Input(node, 0);
                m_Expressions[node.Id] = expression;
                return expression;
            }
            if (MaterialGraphMath::IsConstantNode(node.Kind))
            {
                const auto index = m_Program.Parameters.size();
                m_Program.Parameters.push_back(node.Value);
                m_Program.ParameterNodes.push_back(node.Id);
                if (m_Runtime)
                {
                    expression.Code = "MG_Parameter(context," + std::to_string(index) + "u)";
                }
                else
                {
                    expression.Code = "GraphParameters[" + std::to_string(index) + "]";
                }
                expression.ValueType = MaterialGraph::Definition(node.Kind).OutputType;
                if (expression.ValueType == Type::Scalar)
                {
                    expression.Code += ".x";
                }
                if (expression.ValueType == Type::Vector3)
                {
                    expression.Code += ".xyz";
                }
                if (expression.ValueType == Type::Vector2)
                {
                    expression.Code += ".xy";
                }
            }
            else if (MaterialGraphMath::IsUnary(node.Kind) || MaterialGraphMath::IsBinary(node.Kind) ||
                     node.Kind == Kind::ConstantBiasScale)
            {
                expression = ExtendedMath(node);
            }
            else if (node.Kind == Kind::TextureCoordinate)
            {
                expression = {"(context.UV*float2(" + Float(node.Value[0]) + "," + Float(node.Value[1]) + "))",
                              Type::Vector2,
                              {}};
            }
            else if (node.Kind == Kind::Panner)
            {
                const auto coordinate = Promote(Input(node, 0), Type::Vector2);
                const auto time = Promote(Input(node, 1), Type::Scalar);
                const auto speed = Promote(Input(node, 2), Type::Vector2);
                expression = {"(" + coordinate.Code + "+" + speed.Code + "*" + time.Code + ")", Type::Vector2, {}};
            }
            else if (node.Kind == Kind::Rotator)
            {
                const auto coordinate = Promote(Input(node, 0), Type::Vector2);
                const auto time = Promote(Input(node, 1), Type::Scalar);
                const auto speed = Promote(Input(node, 2), Type::Scalar);
                const auto center = Promote(Input(node, 3), Type::Vector2);
                expression = {"MG_Rotate(" + coordinate.Code + "," + center.Code + "," + time.Code + "*" + speed.Code +
                                  ")",
                              Type::Vector2,
                              {}};
            }
            else if (node.Kind == Kind::CrossProduct)
            {
                const auto a = Promote(Input(node, 0), Type::Vector3);
                const auto b = Promote(Input(node, 1), Type::Vector3);
                expression = {"cross(" + a.Code + "," + b.Code + ")", Type::Vector3, {}};
            }
            else if (node.Kind == Kind::Distance)
            {
                const auto a = Promote(Input(node, 0), Type::Vector3);
                const auto b = Promote(Input(node, 1), Type::Vector3);
                expression = {"distance(" + a.Code + "," + b.Code + ")", Type::Scalar, {}};
            }
            else if (node.Kind == Kind::Length)
            {
                const auto input = Input(node, 0);
                expression = {"length(" + input.Code + ")", Type::Scalar, {}};
            }
            else if (node.Kind == Kind::AppendVector)
            {
                auto a = Input(node, 0);
                auto b = Input(node, 1);
                const auto dims = [](Type type) {
                    return type == Type::Numeric ? 1 : static_cast<int>(type);
                };
                const int count = dims(a.ValueType) + dims(b.ValueType);
                if (count > 4)
                {
                    m_Program.Error = "Append node " + std::to_string(node.Id) + " exceeds 4 components.";
                    expression = Literal({}, Type::Scalar);
                }
                else
                {
                    const auto type = static_cast<Type>(count);
                    expression = {HlslType(type) + "(" + a.Code + "," + b.Code + ")", type, {}};
                }
            }
            else if (node.Kind == Kind::ComponentMask)
            {
                const auto input = Input(node, 0);
                const int available = input.ValueType == Type::Numeric ? 1 : static_cast<int>(input.ValueType);
                std::string swizzle;
                for (int i = 0; i < 4; ++i)
                {
                    if (node.Value[i] > 0.5f)
                    {
                        swizzle += "xyzw"[(std::min)(i, available - 1)];
                    }
                }
                if (swizzle.empty())
                {
                    swizzle = "x";
                }
                std::string code = input.Code;
                if (available == 1)
                {
                    code = "((float)" + code + ")";
                }
                expression = {"(" + code + ")." + swizzle, static_cast<Type>(swizzle.size()), {}};
            }
            else if (node.Kind == Kind::ReflectionVector)
            {
                expression = {"reflect(-normalize(context.CameraVector),normalize(context.WorldNormal))", Type::Vector3,
                              {}};
            }
            else if (node.Kind == Kind::Desaturation)
            {
                const auto color = Promote(Input(node, 0), Type::Vector3);
                const auto fraction = Promote(Input(node, 1), Type::Scalar);
                expression = {"lerp(" + color.Code + ",dot(" + color.Code + ",float3(0.3,0.59,0.11)).xxx," +
                                  fraction.Code + ")",
                              Type::Vector3,
                              {}};
            }
            else if (node.Kind == Kind::If)
            {
                const auto a = Promote(Input(node, 0), Type::Scalar);
                const auto b = Promote(Input(node, 1), Type::Scalar);
                Expression branches[3] = {Input(node, 2), Input(node, 3), Input(node, 4)};
                Type type = Type::Scalar;
                for (const auto& branch : branches)
                {
                    type = static_cast<Type>((std::max)(static_cast<int>(type), static_cast<int>(branch.ValueType)));
                }
                for (auto& branch : branches)
                {
                    branch = Promote(std::move(branch), type);
                }
                expression = {"((" + a.Code + ">" + b.Code + ")?" + branches[0].Code + ":((" + a.Code + "==" + b.Code +
                                  ")?" + branches[1].Code + ":" + branches[2].Code + "))",
                              type,
                              {}};
            }
            else if (node.Kind == Kind::SphereMask)
            {
                const auto a = Promote(Input(node, 0), Type::Vector3);
                const auto b = Promote(Input(node, 1), Type::Vector3);
                const auto radius = Promote(Input(node, 2), Type::Scalar);
                const auto hardness = Promote(Input(node, 3), Type::Scalar);
                expression = {"MG_SphereMask(" + a.Code + "," + b.Code + "," + radius.Code + "," + hardness.Code + ")",
                              Type::Scalar,
                              {}};
            }
            else if (node.Kind == Kind::CheapContrast)
            {
                const auto input = Promote(Input(node, 0), Type::Scalar);
                const auto contrast = Promote(Input(node, 1), Type::Scalar);
                expression = {"saturate(lerp(0-" + contrast.Code + ",1+" + contrast.Code + "," + input.Code + "))",
                              Type::Scalar,
                              {}};
            }
            else if (node.Kind == Kind::Noise)
            {
                const auto position = Promote(Input(node, 0), Type::Vector3);
                const auto scale = Promote(Input(node, 1), Type::Scalar);
                expression = {"MG_Noise(" + position.Code + "*" + scale.Code + ")", Type::Scalar, {}};
            }
            else if (node.Kind >= Kind::Add && node.Kind <= Kind::Smoothstep)
            {
                expression = Arithmetic(node);
            }
            // ---------------------------------------------------------------- 2026-11 追加ノード
            else if (node.Kind == Kind::StaticSwitch)
            {
                // 静的分岐：選ばれた側だけを生成する（UE の Static Switch Parameter と同じ）
                expression = Input(node, node.Value[0] > 0.5f ? 0 : 1);
                m_Expressions[node.Id] = expression;
                return expression;
            }
            else if (node.Kind == Kind::Pi)
            {
                expression = Literal({3.14159265f * node.Value[0]}, Type::Scalar);
            }
            else if (node.Kind == Kind::RemapValueRange)
            {
                const auto input = Input(node, 0);
                const auto inLow = Promote(Input(node, 1), Type::Scalar);
                const auto inHigh = Promote(Input(node, 2), Type::Scalar);
                const auto outLow = Promote(Input(node, 3), Type::Scalar);
                const auto outHigh = Promote(Input(node, 4), Type::Scalar);
                expression = {"(" + outLow.Code + "+(" + outHigh.Code + "-" + outLow.Code + ")*((" + input.Code + "-" +
                                  inLow.Code + ")/(" + inHigh.Code + "-" + inLow.Code + ")))",
                              input.ValueType == Type::Numeric ? Type::Scalar : input.ValueType,
                              {}};
            }
            else if (node.Kind == Kind::Posterize)
            {
                const auto input = Input(node, 0);
                const auto steps = Promote(Input(node, 1), Type::Scalar);
                expression = {"(floor((" + input.Code + ")*max(" + steps.Code + ",1))/max(" + steps.Code + ",1))",
                              input.ValueType == Type::Numeric ? Type::Scalar : input.ValueType,
                              {}};
            }
            else if (node.Kind == Kind::HueShift)
            {
                const auto color = Promote(Input(node, 0), Type::Vector3);
                const auto shift = Promote(Input(node, 1), Type::Scalar);
                expression = {"MG_HueShift(" + color.Code + "," + shift.Code + ")", Type::Vector3, {}};
            }
            else if (node.Kind == Kind::Blend)
            {
                const auto base = Promote(Input(node, 0), Type::Vector3);
                const auto blend = Promote(Input(node, 1), Type::Vector3);
                const auto opacity = Promote(Input(node, 2), Type::Scalar);
                expression = {"(" + base.Code + "+(MG_Blend(" + std::to_string(static_cast<int>(node.Value[0])) + "," +
                                  base.Code + "," + blend.Code + ")-" + base.Code + ")*" + opacity.Code + ")",
                              Type::Vector3,
                              {}};
            }
            else if (node.Kind == Kind::LinearGradient)
            {
                const auto uv = Promote(Input(node, 0), Type::Vector2);
                expression = {"saturate((" + uv.Code + ")." + (node.Value[0] > 0.5f ? "y" : "x") + ")", Type::Scalar, {}};
            }
            else if (node.Kind == Kind::RadialGradient)
            {
                const auto uv = Promote(Input(node, 0), Type::Vector2);
                const auto center = Promote(Input(node, 1), Type::Vector2);
                const auto radius = Promote(Input(node, 2), Type::Scalar);
                const auto density = Promote(Input(node, 3), Type::Scalar);
                expression = {"pow(saturate(1-distance(" + uv.Code + "," + center.Code + ")/max(" + radius.Code +
                                  ",1e-5)),max(" + density.Code + ",0))",
                              Type::Scalar,
                              {}};
            }
            else if (node.Kind == Kind::ProceduralNoise || node.Kind == Kind::FractalNoise)
            {
                // CPU（ProcStudio::FractalNoise）と同じ計算。基底 / フラクタル / シードはノードの値（静的）
                m_UsesProceduralNoise = true;
                const bool fractal = node.Kind == Kind::FractalNoise;
                const auto uv = Promote(Input(node, 0), Type::Vector2);
                const auto z = Promote(Input(node, 1), Type::Scalar);
                const auto frequency = Promote(Input(node, 2), Type::Scalar);
                const int basis = std::clamp(static_cast<int>(node.Value[0]), 0, MaterialGraphMath::kNoiseBasisCount - 1);
                const int fractalType =
                    fractal ? std::clamp(static_cast<int>(node.Value[1]), 0, MaterialGraphMath::kNoiseFractalCount - 1) : 6;
                const uint32_t seed = static_cast<uint32_t>((std::max)(node.Value[fractal ? 2 : 1], 0.0f));
                const bool tileable = node.Value[fractal ? 3 : 2] > 0.5f;
                std::string tail;
                if (fractal)
                {
                    tail = Promote(Input(node, 3), Type::Scalar).Code + "," + Promote(Input(node, 4), Type::Scalar).Code + "," +
                           Promote(Input(node, 5), Type::Scalar).Code + "," + Promote(Input(node, 6), Type::Scalar).Code + "," +
                           Promote(Input(node, 7), Type::Scalar).Code + ",0,4,2,0";
                }
                else
                {
                    tail = "1,2,0.5,0.6,1," + Promote(Input(node, 3), Type::Scalar).Code + "," +
                           Promote(Input(node, 4), Type::Scalar).Code + "," + Promote(Input(node, 5), Type::Scalar).Code +
                           "," + Promote(Input(node, 6), Type::Scalar).Code;
                }
                expression = {"MG_ProcNoise(float3(" + uv.Code + "," + z.Code + ")," + std::to_string(basis) + "u," +
                                  std::to_string(fractalType) + "u," + std::to_string(seed) + "u," + (tileable ? "1u," : "0u,") +
                                  frequency.Code + "," + tail + ")",
                              Type::Scalar,
                              {}};
            }
            else if (IsConvertTextureNode(node.Kind))
            {
                if (node.Texture == 0)
                {
                    m_Program.Error = "Convert To Normal / Height node " + std::to_string(node.Id) + " has no texture.";
                }
                const auto uv = Promote(Input(node, 0), Type::Vector2);
                const auto contrast = Promote(Input(node, 1), Type::Scalar);
                const auto bias = Promote(Input(node, 2), Type::Scalar);
                // 格納値で計算するので Linear として登録する（Texture Sample の Linear と同じ）
                const auto sampler = MaterialSamplerType::Linear;
                size_t index = 0;
                for (; index < m_Program.Textures.size(); ++index)
                {
                    if (m_Program.Textures[index] == node.Texture && m_Program.TextureSamplers[index] == sampler)
                    {
                        break;
                    }
                }
                if (index == m_Program.Textures.size())
                {
                    m_Program.Textures.push_back(node.Texture);
                    m_Program.TextureSamplers.push_back(sampler);
                }
                const std::string texture = m_Runtime ? "MG_GraphTexture(context," + std::to_string(index) + "u)"
                                                      : "GraphTextures[" + std::to_string(index) + "]";
                const std::string common = std::to_string(std::clamp(static_cast<int>(node.Value[1]), 0, MaterialGraphMath::kConvertChannelCount - 1)) +
                                           "," + (node.Value[2] > 0.5f ? "1" : "0") + "," + contrast.Code + "," + bias.Code;
                const bool normal = node.Kind == Kind::ConvertToNormal ||
                                    (node.Kind == Kind::ConvertToNormalHeight && node.Value[0] > 0.5f);
                if (normal)
                {
                    const auto strength = Promote(Input(node, 3), Type::Scalar);
                    const auto radius = Promote(Input(node, 4), Type::Scalar);
                    expression = {"MG_ConvertNormal(" + texture + ",GraphSampler," + uv.Code + "," + common + "," +
                                      strength.Code + "," + radius.Code + "," + (node.Value[3] > 0.5f ? "1" : "0") + ")",
                                  Type::Vector3,
                                  {}};
                }
                else
                {
                    expression = {"MG_ConvertTap(" + texture + ",GraphSampler," + uv.Code + "," + common + ")", Type::Scalar, {}};
                }
            }
            else if (node.Kind == Kind::SolidCoordinate)
            {
                const bool raw = m_Graph.InputLink(node.InputPins[0]) != nullptr;
                auto position = Promote(Input(node, 0), Type::Vector3);
                const auto scale = Promote(Input(node, 1), Type::Scalar);
                const auto offset = Promote(Input(node, 2), Type::Vector3);
                const std::string base = raw ? position.Code : "(" + position.Code + "*0.5+0.5)";
                expression = {"(" + base + "*" + scale.Code + "+" + offset.Code + ")", Type::Vector3, {}};
            }
            else if (node.Kind == Kind::SolidTexture || node.Kind == Kind::SolidPattern)
            {
                m_UsesProceduralNoise = true;
                const bool raw = m_Graph.InputLink(node.InputPins[0]) != nullptr;
                const auto position = Promote(Input(node, 0), Type::Vector3);
                const int kind = std::clamp(static_cast<int>(node.Value[0]), 0, static_cast<int>(MaterialSolidKind::Count) - 1);
                const int basis = std::clamp(static_cast<int>(node.Value[1]), 0, MaterialGraphMath::kNoiseBasisCount - 1);
                const int fractal = std::clamp(static_cast<int>(node.Value[2]), 0, MaterialGraphMath::kNoiseFractalCount - 1);
                const uint32_t seed = static_cast<uint32_t>((std::max)(node.Value[3], 0.0f));
                std::string code = "MG_SolidScalar(" + (raw ? position.Code : "(" + position.Code + "*0.5+0.5)") + "," +
                                   std::to_string(kind) + "," + std::to_string(basis) + "u," + std::to_string(fractal) +
                                   "u," + std::to_string(seed) + "u";
                for (size_t pin = 1; pin <= 12; ++pin)
                {
                    code += "," + Promote(Input(node, pin), Type::Scalar).Code;
                }
                code += ")";
                if (node.Kind == Kind::SolidPattern)
                {
                    expression = {code, Type::Scalar, {}};
                }
                else
                {
                    expression = {"MG_SolidColor(" + code + "," + std::to_string(kind) + "," +
                                      Promote(Input(node, 13), Type::Vector3).Code + "," +
                                      Promote(Input(node, 14), Type::Vector3).Code + "," +
                                      Promote(Input(node, 15), Type::Vector3).Code + ")",
                                  Type::Vector3,
                                  {}};
                }
            }
            else if (node.Kind == Kind::ConvertToSolid && node.Texture == 0)
            {
                expression = Promote(Input(node, 0), Type::Vector4); // 元画像なし：入力をそのまま通す
            }
            else if (node.Kind == Kind::ConvertToSolid)
            {
                m_UsesProceduralNoise = true; // TextureNoise::Hash / Unit（スタジオと同じハッシュ）
                const auto sampler = static_cast<int>(node.Value[1]) == static_cast<int>(MaterialSamplerType::Color)
                                         ? MaterialSamplerType::Color
                                         : MaterialSamplerType::Linear;
                size_t index = 0;
                for (; index < m_Program.Textures.size(); ++index)
                {
                    if (m_Program.Textures[index] == node.Texture && m_Program.TextureSamplers[index] == sampler)
                    {
                        break;
                    }
                }
                if (index == m_Program.Textures.size())
                {
                    m_Program.Textures.push_back(node.Texture);
                    m_Program.TextureSamplers.push_back(sampler);
                }
                const std::string texture = m_Runtime ? "MG_GraphTexture(context," + std::to_string(index) + "u)"
                                                      : "GraphTextures[" + std::to_string(index) + "]";
                const bool raw = m_Graph.InputLink(node.InputPins[1]) != nullptr;
                const auto position = Promote(Input(node, 1), Type::Vector3);
                const auto scale = Promote(Input(node, 2), Type::Scalar);
                const std::string p = "(" + (raw ? position.Code : "(" + position.Code + "*0.5+0.5)") + "*" + scale.Code + ")";
                std::string code;
                if (static_cast<int>(node.Value[0]) == static_cast<int>(MaterialSolidConvertMethod::Triplanar))
                {
                    code = "MG_SolidTriplanar(" + texture + ",GraphSampler," + p + ",normalize(context.WorldNormal)," +
                           Promote(Input(node, 5), Type::Scalar).Code + ")";
                }
                else
                {
                    const uint32_t seed = static_cast<uint32_t>((std::max)(node.Value[2], 0.0f));
                    code = "MG_SolidVolume(" + texture + ",GraphSampler," + p + "," +
                           Promote(Input(node, 3), Type::Scalar).Code + "," + Promote(Input(node, 4), Type::Scalar).Code +
                           "," + std::to_string(seed) + "u)";
                }
                if (node.Value[3] > 0.5f)
                {
                    code = "MG_Gray(" + code + ")";
                }
                expression = {code, Type::Vector4, {}};
            }
            else if (node.Kind == Kind::ThreeColorRamp)
            {
                expression = {"MG_ThreeColorRamp(" + Promote(Input(node, 0), Type::Scalar).Code + "," +
                                  Promote(Input(node, 1), Type::Vector3).Code + "," +
                                  Promote(Input(node, 2), Type::Vector3).Code + "," +
                                  Promote(Input(node, 3), Type::Vector3).Code + ")",
                              Type::Vector3,
                              {}};
            }
            else if (node.Kind == Kind::NoiseCombine)
            {
                const auto a = Promote(Input(node, 0), Type::Scalar);
                const auto b = Promote(Input(node, 1), Type::Scalar);
                const auto factor = Promote(Input(node, 2), Type::Scalar);
                const int mode = std::clamp(static_cast<int>(node.Value[0]), 0, static_cast<int>(MaterialNoiseCombineMode::Count) - 1);
                expression = {"MG_NoiseCombine(" + std::to_string(mode) + "," + a.Code + "," + b.Code + "," + factor.Code + "," +
                                  (node.Value[1] > 0.5f ? "1" : "0") + ")",
                              Type::Scalar,
                              {}};
            }
            else if (node.Kind == Kind::NoiseLayers)
            {
                // 繋がっている層だけを重み付き平均（重み 0 以下は無視）
                std::string sum = "0";
                std::string weights = "0";
                for (size_t layer = 0; layer < 4; ++layer)
                {
                    const size_t pin = layer * 2;
                    if (pin + 1 >= node.InputPins.size() || !m_Graph.InputLink(node.InputPins[pin]))
                    {
                        continue;
                    }
                    const auto value = Promote(Input(node, pin), Type::Scalar);
                    const auto weight = Promote(Input(node, pin + 1), Type::Scalar);
                    const std::string w = "max(" + weight.Code + ",0)";
                    sum += "+" + value.Code + "*" + w;
                    weights += "+" + w;
                }
                expression = {"((" + weights + ")>0?(" + sum + ")/(" + weights + "):0)", Type::Scalar, {}};
            }
            else if (node.Kind == Kind::Voronoi)
            {
                const auto uv = Promote(Input(node, 0), Type::Vector2);
                const auto scale = Promote(Input(node, 1), Type::Scalar);
                const auto jitter = Promote(Input(node, 2), Type::Scalar);
                expression = {"MG_Voronoi(" + uv.Code + "*" + scale.Code + "," + jitter.Code + "," +
                                  (node.Value[0] > 0.5f ? "1" : "0") + ")",
                              Type::Scalar,
                              {}};
            }
            else if (node.Kind == Kind::NormalFromHeight)
            {
                const auto height = Promote(Input(node, 0), Type::Scalar);
                const auto strength = Promote(Input(node, 1), Type::Scalar);
                expression = {"MG_NormalFromHeight(" + height.Code + ",context.UV," + strength.Code + ")", Type::Vector3,
                              {}};
            }
            else if (node.Kind == Kind::BlendAngleCorrectedNormals)
            {
                const auto base = Promote(Input(node, 0), Type::Vector3);
                const auto detail = Promote(Input(node, 1), Type::Vector3);
                expression = {"MG_BlendAngleCorrectedNormals(" + base.Code + "," + detail.Code + ")", Type::Vector3, {}};
            }
            else if (node.Kind == Kind::FlattenNormal)
            {
                const auto normal = Promote(Input(node, 0), Type::Vector3);
                const auto flatness = Promote(Input(node, 1), Type::Scalar);
                expression = {"normalize(" + normal.Code + "+(float3(0,0,1)-" + normal.Code + ")*" + flatness.Code + ")",
                              Type::Vector3,
                              {}};
            }
            else if (node.Kind == Kind::BumpOffset)
            {
                const auto height = Promote(Input(node, 0), Type::Scalar);
                const auto ratio = Promote(Input(node, 1), Type::Scalar);
                const auto reference = Promote(Input(node, 2), Type::Scalar);
                const auto coordinate = Promote(Input(node, 3), Type::Vector2);
                expression = {"(" + coordinate.Code + "+float2(dot(context.CameraVector,context.Tangent),dot(context.CameraVector,context.Bitangent))*((" +
                                  height.Code + "-" + reference.Code + ")*" + ratio.Code + "))",
                              Type::Vector2,
                              {}};
            }
            else if (node.Kind == Kind::RotateAboutAxis)
            {
                const auto axis = Promote(Input(node, 0), Type::Vector3);
                const auto angle = Promote(Input(node, 1), Type::Scalar);
                const auto pivot = Promote(Input(node, 2), Type::Vector3);
                const auto position = Promote(Input(node, 3), Type::Vector3);
                expression = {"MG_RotateAboutAxis(" + axis.Code + "," + angle.Code + "," + pivot.Code + "," +
                                  position.Code + ")",
                              Type::Vector3,
                              {}};
            }
            else if (node.Kind == Kind::BlackBody)
            {
                const auto temperature = Promote(Input(node, 0), Type::Scalar);
                expression = {"MG_BlackBody(" + temperature.Code + ")", Type::Vector3, {}};
            }
            else if (node.Kind == Kind::ConvertToTexture && node.Texture == 0)
            {
                expression = Promote(Input(node, 0), Type::Vector4); // 未変換：入力をそのまま通す
            }
            else if (node.Kind == Kind::TextureSample || node.Kind == Kind::ConvertToTexture)
            {
                if (node.Texture == 0)
                {
                    m_Program.Error = "Texture Sample node " + std::to_string(node.Id) + " has no texture.";
                }
                const auto uv = Promote(Input(node, node.Kind == Kind::ConvertToTexture ? 1 : 0), Type::Vector2);
                const auto sampler = static_cast<MaterialSamplerType>(std::clamp(static_cast<int>(node.Value[0]), 0, 2));
                size_t index = 0;
                for (; index < m_Program.Textures.size(); ++index)
                {
                    if (m_Program.Textures[index] == node.Texture && m_Program.TextureSamplers[index] == sampler)
                    {
                        break;
                    }
                }
                if (index == m_Program.Textures.size())
                {
                    m_Program.Textures.push_back(node.Texture);
                    m_Program.TextureSamplers.push_back(sampler);
                }
                std::string texture = "GraphTextures[" + std::to_string(index) + "]";
                if (m_Runtime)
                {
                    texture = "MG_GraphTexture(context," + std::to_string(index) + "u)";
                }
                std::string sample = texture + ".Sample(GraphSampler," + uv.Code + ")";
                if (static_cast<int>(node.Value[0]) == static_cast<int>(MaterialSamplerType::Normal))
                {
                    sample = "MG_UnpackNormal(" + sample + ")";
                }
                expression = {sample, Type::Vector4, {}};
            }
            else if (node.Kind == Kind::Normalize)
            {
                const auto input = Promote(Input(node, 0), Type::Vector3);
                expression = {"normalize(" + input.Code + ")", Type::Vector3, {}};
            }
            else if (node.Kind == Kind::Dot)
            {
                const auto a = Promote(Input(node, 0), Type::Vector3);
                const auto b = Promote(Input(node, 1), Type::Vector3);
                expression = {"dot(" + a.Code + "," + b.Code + ")", Type::Scalar, {}};
            }
            else if (node.Kind == Kind::Fresnel)
            {
                const auto power = Input(node, 0);
                expression = {"pow(1-saturate(dot(normalize(context.WorldNormal),normalize(context.CameraVector)))," +
                                  power.Code + ")",
                              Type::Scalar,
                              {}};
            }
            else if (node.Kind == Kind::UV)
            {
                expression = {"context.UV", Type::Vector2, {}};
            }
            else if (node.Kind == Kind::WorldPosition)
            {
                expression = {"context.WorldPosition", Type::Vector3, {}};
            }
            else if (node.Kind == Kind::WorldNormal)
            {
                expression = {"context.WorldNormal", Type::Vector3, {}};
            }
            else if (node.Kind == Kind::CameraVector)
            {
                expression = {"context.CameraVector", Type::Vector3, {}};
            }
            else if (node.Kind == Kind::Time)
            {
                expression = {"context.Time", Type::Scalar, {}};
                m_Program.Animated = true;
            }
            else
            {
                m_Program.Error = "Unsupported value node: " + std::to_string(node.Id);
                expression = Literal({}, Type::Scalar);
            }
            m_Program.DependencyOrder.push_back(node.Id);
            const std::string file = "material_node_" + std::to_string(node.Id);
            const auto shared = m_CommonExpressions.find(expression.Code);
            if (shared != m_CommonExpressions.end())
            {
                expression.Code = shared->second;
            }
            else if (!expression.Constant)
            {
                const std::string variable = "node_" + std::to_string(node.Id);
                const auto line = 1 + static_cast<size_t>(std::count(m_Body.begin(), m_Body.end(), '\n'));
                m_Program.Sources.push_back({node.Id, file, line});
                m_Body += "#line 1 \"" + file + "\"\n" + HlslType(expression.ValueType) + " " + variable + " = " +
                          expression.Code + ";\n";
                m_CommonExpressions[expression.Code] = variable;
                expression.Code = variable;
            }
            m_Expressions[node.Id] = expression;
            return expression;
        }

        const MaterialGraph& m_Graph;
        bool m_Runtime = false;
        bool m_UsesProceduralNoise = false;
        MaterialGraphProgram m_Program;
        std::string m_Body;
        std::unordered_map<uint64_t, Expression> m_Expressions;
        std::unordered_map<std::string, std::string> m_CommonExpressions;
    };
}

MaterialGraphProgram MaterialGraphCompiler::Generate(const MaterialGraph& graph, uint64_t targetNode)
{
    return Generator(graph).Run(targetNode);
}

MaterialGraphProgram MaterialGraphCompiler::GenerateRuntime(const MaterialGraph& graph, uint64_t targetNode)
{
    return Generator(graph, true).Run(targetNode);
}




===== FILE: source\assets\materialgraphcompiler.h =====
#pragma once
#include "materialgraph.h"
#include <unordered_map>

struct MaterialGraphSourceLocation
{
    uint64_t Node = 0;
    std::string File;
    size_t Line = 0;
};

struct MaterialGraphProgram
{
    bool Success = false;
    bool Animated = false;
    bool MaterialOutput = false;
    std::string Hlsl;
    std::string Error;
    uint64_t ShaderHash = 0;
    std::vector<std::array<float, 4>> Parameters;
    std::vector<uint64_t> ParameterNodes;
    std::vector<AssetHandle> Textures;
    std::vector<MaterialSamplerType> TextureSamplers;
    std::vector<MaterialGraphSourceLocation> Sources;
    std::vector<uint64_t> DependencyOrder;
};

class MaterialGraphCompiler
{
  public:
    // targetNode==0 compiles Material Output; preview compilation visits only the chosen node's inputs.
    static MaterialGraphProgram Generate(const MaterialGraph& graph, uint64_t targetNode = 0);
    // Production shaders supply parameter/texture descriptors through the material texture heap.
    static MaterialGraphProgram GenerateRuntime(const MaterialGraph& graph, uint64_t targetNode = 0);
};

===== FILE: source\assets\materialgraphevaluator.cpp =====
#include "pch.h"
#include "materialgraphevaluator.h"
#include "materialgraphmath.h"
#include "procedural/noise.h"
#include "procedural/proceduralstudio.h"
#include <algorithm>
#include <cmath>
#include <functional>

namespace MaterialGraphEval
{
    namespace
    {
        using Kind = MaterialNodeKind;
        namespace GraphMath = MaterialGraphMath;
        constexpr float kPi = 3.14159265f;
        constexpr int kMaxChildLevel = 4; // 差分のネスト（DDX の中の DDX など）の上限

        Value Make(const float* v, int count)
        {
            Value value;
            for (int i = 0; i < count; ++i)
            {
                value.V[i] = v[i];
            }
            value.N = count;
            return value;
        }

        Value Make3(float x, float y, float z)
        {
            const float v[3] = {x, y, z};
            return Make(v, 3);
        }

        float SafeDivide(float a, float b)
        {
            return fabsf(b) < 1e-8f ? 0.0f : a / b;
        }

        float Dot3(const float* a, const float* b)
        {
            return a[0] * b[0] + a[1] * b[1] + a[2] * b[2];
        }

        void Normalize3(float* v, const float* fallback)
        {
            const float length = sqrtf(Dot3(v, v));
            if (length < 1e-8f)
            {
                v[0] = fallback[0];
                v[1] = fallback[1];
                v[2] = fallback[2];
                return;
            }
            v[0] /= length;
            v[1] /= length;
            v[2] /= length;
        }
    } // namespace

    float LinearToSrgb(float v)
    {
        v = std::clamp(std::isfinite(v) ? v : 0.0f, 0.0f, 1.0f);
        return v <= 0.0031308f ? v * 12.92f : 1.055f * powf(v, 1.0f / 2.4f) - 0.055f;
    }

    float SrgbToLinear(float v)
    {
        v = std::clamp(std::isfinite(v) ? v : 0.0f, 0.0f, 1.0f);
        return v <= 0.04045f ? v / 12.92f : powf((v + 0.055f) / 1.055f, 2.4f);
    }

    Value Promote(Value value, int count)
    {
        if (value.N == count)
        {
            return value;
        }
        if (value.N == 1)
        {
            value.V[1] = value.V[2] = value.V[3] = value.V[0];
        }
        else
        {
            const bool opaqueAlpha = value.N == 3 && count == 4;
            for (int i = value.N; i < 4; ++i)
            {
                value.V[i] = 0.0f;
            }
            if (opaqueAlpha)
            {
                value.V[3] = 1.0f;
            }
        }
        value.N = count;
        return value;
    }

    const MaterialGraphNode* ResolveSource(const MaterialGraph& graph, const MaterialGraphNode& node, size_t input)
    {
        if (input >= node.InputPins.size())
        {
            return nullptr;
        }
        const MaterialGraphNode* source = nullptr;
        if (const auto* link = graph.InputLink(node.InputPins[input]))
        {
            source = graph.FindPinNode(link->SourcePin);
        }
        for (int guard = 0; source && source->Kind == Kind::Reroute && guard < 256; ++guard)
        {
            const auto* link = graph.InputLink(source->InputPins[0]);
            source = link ? graph.FindPinNode(link->SourcePin) : nullptr;
        }
        return source;
    }

    void BuildTopology(const MaterialGraph& graph, Topology& topology)
    {
        topology.Index.clear();
        topology.Index.reserve(graph.Nodes.size());
        for (size_t i = 0; i < graph.Nodes.size(); ++i)
        {
            topology.Index[graph.Nodes[i].Id] = i;
        }
        // bit0: 空間（法線・位置・カメラ）依存、bit1: 時間依存、bit2: カメラ方向依存
        std::vector<uint8_t> flags(graph.Nodes.size(), 0);
        std::vector<uint8_t> state(graph.Nodes.size(), 0);
        std::function<uint8_t(size_t, int)> visit = [&](size_t index, int depth) -> uint8_t {
            if (state[index] == 1 || depth > 256)
            {
                return flags[index];
            }
            if (state[index] == 2)
            {
                return 0;
            }
            state[index] = 2;
            const auto& node = graph.Nodes[index];
            uint8_t value = 0;
            switch (node.Kind)
            {
                case Kind::WorldPosition:
                case Kind::WorldNormal:
                    value |= 1;
                    break;
                case Kind::SolidCoordinate:
                case Kind::SolidTexture:
                case Kind::SolidPattern:
                    value |= 1; // Position 未接続でも位置を使う
                    break;
                case Kind::ConvertToSolid:
                    value |= node.Texture != 0 ? 1 : 0; // 位置 / 法線を使う
                    break;
                case Kind::CameraVector:
                case Kind::Fresnel:
                case Kind::ReflectionVector:
                case Kind::BumpOffset:
                    value |= 1 | 4;
                    break;
                case Kind::Time:
                    value |= 2;
                    break;
                default:
                    break;
            }
            for (size_t i = 0; i < node.InputPins.size(); ++i)
            {
                // テクスチャに変換済みの Convert To Texture は入力（時間 / 位置）に依存しない
                if ((node.Kind == Kind::ConvertToTexture || node.Kind == Kind::ConvertToSolid) && node.Texture != 0 &&
                    i == 0)
                {
                    continue;
                }
                if (node.Kind == Kind::StaticSwitch)
                {
                    const size_t selected = node.Value[0] > 0.5f ? 0 : 1;
                    if (i != selected)
                    {
                        continue;
                    }
                }
                const auto* link = graph.InputLink(node.InputPins[i]);
                const auto* source = link ? graph.FindPinNode(link->SourcePin) : nullptr;
                if (source)
                {
                    const auto found = topology.Index.find(source->Id);
                    if (found != topology.Index.end())
                    {
                        value |= visit(found->second, depth + 1);
                    }
                }
                else
                {
                    const auto special = GraphMath::DefaultInput(node.Kind, i);
                    value |= special == GraphMath::SpecialInput::WorldPosition ? 1 : 0;
                    value |= special == GraphMath::SpecialInput::Time ? 2 : 0;
                }
            }
            flags[index] = value;
            state[index] = 1;
            return value;
        };
        topology.Spatial.assign(graph.Nodes.size(), 0);
        topology.TimeDependent.assign(graph.Nodes.size(), 0);
        topology.ViewDependent.assign(graph.Nodes.size(), 0);
        topology.Animated = false;
        for (size_t i = 0; i < graph.Nodes.size(); ++i)
        {
            const uint8_t value = visit(i, 0);
            topology.Spatial[i] = value & 1;
            topology.TimeDependent[i] = (value & 2) ? 1 : 0;
            topology.ViewDependent[i] = (value & 4) ? 1 : 0;
            topology.Animated |= (value & 2) != 0;
        }
    }

    Evaluator::Evaluator(const MaterialGraph& graph, const Topology& topology, TextureSampler sampler)
        : m_Graph(graph), m_Topology(topology), m_Sampler(std::move(sampler))
    {
        m_Memo.resize(graph.Nodes.size());
        m_Done.resize(graph.Nodes.size());
    }

    Evaluator::~Evaluator() = default;

    void Evaluator::Reset(const Context& context)
    {
        m_Context = context;
        std::fill(m_Done.begin(), m_Done.end(), uint8_t{0});
    }

    Value Evaluator::Node(size_t index, int depth)
    {
        if (index >= m_Done.size())
        {
            return {};
        }
        if (m_Done[index] == 1)
        {
            return m_Memo[index];
        }
        if (m_Done[index] == 2 || depth > 256)
        {
            return {}; // 循環（通常は Connect で防がれる）
        }
        m_Done[index] = 2;
        Value result = Compute(m_Graph.Nodes[index], depth);
        for (float& v : result.V)
        {
            if (!std::isfinite(v))
            {
                v = 0.0f;
            }
        }
        m_Memo[index] = result;
        m_Done[index] = 1;
        return result;
    }

    Value Evaluator::Input(const MaterialGraphNode& node, size_t input, int depth)
    {
        if (input < node.InputPins.size())
        {
            if (const auto* link = m_Graph.InputLink(node.InputPins[input]))
            {
                size_t outputIndex = 0;
                if (const auto* source = m_Graph.FindPinNode(link->SourcePin, nullptr, &outputIndex))
                {
                    const auto found = m_Topology.Index.find(source->Id);
                    if (found != m_Topology.Index.end())
                    {
                        Value value = Node(found->second, depth + 1);
                        if (outputIndex > 0)
                        {
                            // 分割した出力（X / Y / Z / W）：成分を取り出す。無い成分は 0（スカラーは全成分同じ）
                            const int component = static_cast<int>(outputIndex) - 1;
                            const float scalar = value.N == 1 ? value.V[0]
                                                 : component < value.N ? value.V[component]
                                                                       : 0.0f;
                            value = Value{};
                            value.V[0] = scalar;
                            value.N = 1;
                        }
                        return value;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        switch (GraphMath::DefaultInput(node.Kind, input))
        {
            case GraphMath::SpecialInput::UV:
                return Make(m_Context.UV, 2);
            case GraphMath::SpecialInput::Time:
                return Make(&m_Context.Time, 1);
            case GraphMath::SpecialInput::WorldPosition:
                return Make(m_Context.Position, 3);
            default:
                break;
        }
        const auto& definition = MaterialGraph::Definition(node.Kind);
        Value value;
        if (input < definition.Inputs.size())
        {
            const auto& pin = definition.Inputs[input];
            value.N = std::clamp(pin.Type == MaterialGraphType::Numeric ? 1 : static_cast<int>(pin.Type), 1, 4);
            const auto defaults = MaterialGraph::UnconnectedInputValue(node, input); // ピン横のボックスの値
            for (int i = 0; i < 4; ++i)
            {
                value.V[i] = defaults[i];
            }
        }
        return value;
    }

    Value Evaluator::InputAt(const MaterialGraphNode& node, size_t input, float u, float v)
    {
        Context context = m_Context;
        context.UV[0] = u;
        context.UV[1] = v;
        Reset(context);
        return Input(node, input, 0);
    }

    // UV を 1 画素（axis 0 = U、1 = V）ずらした位置で入力を評価する（前進差分用）
    Value Evaluator::Shifted(const MaterialGraphNode& node, size_t input, int axis, int depth)
    {
        if (m_Level >= kMaxChildLevel)
        {
            return Input(node, input, depth);
        }
        if (!m_Child)
        {
            m_Child = std::make_unique<Evaluator>(m_Graph, m_Topology, m_Sampler);
            m_Child->m_Level = m_Level + 1;
        }
        Context context = m_Context;
        const float step = (std::max)(context.PixelSize, 1e-5f);
        context.UV[axis] += step;
        // 位置も UV の向き（T / B）へ同じだけ動かす（World Position を使う式の差分）
        const float* direction = axis == 0 ? context.Tangent : context.Bitangent;
        for (int i = 0; i < 3; ++i)
        {
            context.Position[i] += direction[i] * step * 2.0f;
        }
        m_Child->Reset(context);
        return m_Child->Input(node, input, depth);
    }

    int Evaluator::Gather(const MaterialGraphNode& node, int depth, Value* inputs, size_t count, size_t promoteCount)
    {
        int width = 1;
        for (size_t i = 0; i < count; ++i)
        {
            inputs[i] = Input(node, i, depth);
            if (i < promoteCount)
            {
                width = (std::max)(width, inputs[i].N);
            }
        }
        for (size_t i = 0; i < promoteCount; ++i)
        {
            inputs[i] = Promote(inputs[i], width);
        }
        return width;
    }

    Value Evaluator::Compute(const MaterialGraphNode& node, int depth)
    {
        Value result;
        const Kind kind = node.Kind;
        if (GraphMath::IsConstantNode(kind))
        {
            const auto type = MaterialGraph::Definition(kind).OutputType;
            return Make(node.Value.data(), type == MaterialGraphType::Numeric ? 1 : static_cast<int>(type));
        }
        if (kind == Kind::DDX || kind == Kind::DDY)
        {
            // 1 画素ずらした位置との差（GPU の ddx / ddy と同じく「隣の画素 - 自分」）
            const Value here = Input(node, 0, depth);
            const Value there = Shifted(node, 0, kind == Kind::DDX ? 0 : 1, depth);
            result.N = here.N;
            for (int c = 0; c < here.N; ++c)
            {
                result.V[c] = there.V[c] - here.V[c];
            }
            return result;
        }
        if (GraphMath::IsUnary(kind))
        {
            result = Input(node, 0, depth);
            for (int c = 0; c < result.N; ++c)
            {
                result.V[c] = GraphMath::Unary(kind, result.V[c]);
            }
            return result;
        }
        if (GraphMath::IsBinary(kind))
        {
            Value inputs[2];
            const bool power = kind == Kind::Power;
            const int width = Gather(node, depth, inputs, 2, power ? 1 : 2);
            result.N = width;
            for (int c = 0; c < width; ++c)
            {
                result.V[c] = GraphMath::Binary(kind, inputs[0].V[c], power ? inputs[1].V[0] : inputs[1].V[c]);
            }
            return result;
        }
        switch (kind)
        {
            case Kind::Reroute:
            case Kind::BreakVector: // 成分の取り出しは接続先の Input で行う
                return Input(node, 0, depth);
            case Kind::ConvertToTexture:
                if (node.Texture == 0)
                {
                    return Promote(Input(node, 0, depth), 4); // 未変換：入力をそのまま通す
                }
                [[fallthrough]];
            case Kind::TextureSample: {
                const Value uv = Promote(Input(node, node.Kind == Kind::ConvertToTexture ? 1 : 0, depth), 2);
                const auto sampler = static_cast<MaterialSamplerType>(std::clamp(static_cast<int>(node.Value[0]), 0, 2));
                result.N = 4;
                if (node.Texture != 0 && m_Sampler &&
                    m_Sampler(node.Texture, uv.V[0], uv.V[1], sampler != MaterialSamplerType::Color, result.V))
                {
                    if (sampler == MaterialSamplerType::Normal)
                    {
                        float n[3] = {result.V[0] * 2.0f - 1.0f, result.V[1] * 2.0f - 1.0f, result.V[2] * 2.0f - 1.0f};
                        if (result.V[2] <= 0.0f) // BC5（2ch）の法線は Z を再構成する
                        {
                            n[2] = sqrtf(std::clamp(1.0f - n[0] * n[0] - n[1] * n[1], 0.0f, 1.0f));
                        }
                        result.V[0] = n[0];
                        result.V[1] = n[1];
                        result.V[2] = n[2];
                        result.V[3] = 1.0f;
                    }
                    return result;
                }
                // 読み込み中 / 未設定はチェッカー（法線サンプラーは平らな法線）
                if (sampler == MaterialSamplerType::Normal)
                {
                    result.V[0] = result.V[1] = 0.0f;
                    result.V[2] = result.V[3] = 1.0f;
                    return result;
                }
                const int cx = static_cast<int>(floorf(uv.V[0] * 8.0f));
                const int cy = static_cast<int>(floorf(uv.V[1] * 8.0f));
                const float c = ((cx + cy) & 1) ? 0.45f : 0.12f;
                result.V[0] = result.V[1] = result.V[2] = c;
                result.V[3] = 1.0f;
                return result;
            }
            case Kind::Add:
            case Kind::Subtract:
            case Kind::Multiply:
            case Kind::Divide:
            case Kind::Lerp:
            case Kind::Clamp:
            case Kind::Smoothstep: {
                Value inputs[3];
                const size_t count = (std::min)(node.InputPins.size(), size_t{3});
                // Lerp の Alpha はスカラー入力
                const int width = Gather(node, depth, inputs, count, kind == Kind::Lerp ? 2 : count);
                if (kind == Kind::Lerp)
                {
                    inputs[2] = Promote(inputs[2], width);
                }
                result.N = width;
                for (int c = 0; c < 4; ++c)
                {
                    const float a = inputs[0].V[c];
                    const float b = inputs[1].V[c];
                    const float z = inputs[2].V[c];
                    float v = 0.0f;
                    switch (kind)
                    {
                        case Kind::Add:
                            v = a + b;
                            break;
                        case Kind::Subtract:
                            v = a - b;
                            break;
                        case Kind::Multiply:
                            v = a * b;
                            break;
                        case Kind::Divide:
                            v = SafeDivide(a, b);
                            break;
                        case Kind::Lerp:
                            v = a + (b - a) * z;
                            break;
                        case Kind::Clamp:
                            v = (std::min)((std::max)(a, b), z);
                            break;
                        default: {
                            const float t = GraphMath::Saturate(SafeDivide(z - a, b - a));
                            v = t * t * (3.0f - 2.0f * t);
                            break;
                        }
                    }
                    result.V[c] = v;
                }
                return result;
            }
            case Kind::ConstantBiasScale: {
                result = Input(node, 0, depth);
                const float bias = Input(node, 1, depth).V[0];
                const float scale = Input(node, 2, depth).V[0];
                for (int c = 0; c < result.N; ++c)
                {
                    result.V[c] = (result.V[c] + bias) * scale;
                }
                return result;
            }
            case Kind::Normalize: {
                result = Promote(Input(node, 0, depth), 3);
                const float length = sqrtf(Dot3(result.V, result.V));
                for (int i = 0; i < 3; ++i)
                {
                    result.V[i] = SafeDivide(result.V[i], length);
                }
                return result;
            }
            case Kind::Dot: {
                const Value a = Promote(Input(node, 0, depth), 3);
                const Value b = Promote(Input(node, 1, depth), 3);
                result.V[0] = Dot3(a.V, b.V);
                return result;
            }
            case Kind::CrossProduct: {
                const Value a = Promote(Input(node, 0, depth), 3);
                const Value b = Promote(Input(node, 1, depth), 3);
                return Make3(a.V[1] * b.V[2] - a.V[2] * b.V[1], a.V[2] * b.V[0] - a.V[0] * b.V[2],
                             a.V[0] * b.V[1] - a.V[1] * b.V[0]);
            }
            case Kind::Distance: {
                const Value a = Promote(Input(node, 0, depth), 3);
                const Value b = Promote(Input(node, 1, depth), 3);
                const float d[3] = {a.V[0] - b.V[0], a.V[1] - b.V[1], a.V[2] - b.V[2]};
                result.V[0] = sqrtf(Dot3(d, d));
                return result;
            }
            case Kind::Length: {
                const Value a = Input(node, 0, depth);
                float sum = 0.0f;
                for (int c = 0; c < a.N; ++c)
                {
                    sum += a.V[c] * a.V[c];
                }
                result.V[0] = sqrtf(sum);
                return result;
            }
            case Kind::AppendVector: {
                const Value a = Input(node, 0, depth);
                const Value b = Input(node, 1, depth);
                int n = 0;
                for (int c = 0; c < a.N && n < 4; ++c)
                {
                    result.V[n++] = a.V[c];
                }
                for (int c = 0; c < b.N && n < 4; ++c)
                {
                    result.V[n++] = b.V[c];
                }
                result.N = (std::max)(n, 1);
                return result;
            }
            case Kind::ComponentMask: {
                const Value a = Input(node, 0, depth);
                int n = 0;
                for (int c = 0; c < 4; ++c)
                {
                    if (node.Value[c] > 0.5f)
                    {
                        result.V[n++] = a.V[(std::min)(c, a.N - 1)];
                    }
                }
                if (n == 0)
                {
                    result.V[n++] = a.V[0];
                }
                result.N = n;
                return result;
            }
            case Kind::Fresnel: {
                const float exponent = (std::max)(Input(node, 0, depth).V[0], 0.0f);
                const float d = GraphMath::Saturate(Dot3(m_Context.Normal, m_Context.Camera));
                result.V[0] = powf((std::max)(1.0f - d, 0.0f), exponent);
                return result;
            }
            case Kind::UV:
                return Make(m_Context.UV, 2);
            case Kind::TextureCoordinate: {
                const float uv[2] = {m_Context.UV[0] * node.Value[0], m_Context.UV[1] * node.Value[1]};
                return Make(uv, 2);
            }
            case Kind::Panner: {
                const Value coordinate = Promote(Input(node, 0, depth), 2);
                const float time = Input(node, 1, depth).V[0];
                const Value speed = Promote(Input(node, 2, depth), 2);
                const float uv[2] = {coordinate.V[0] + speed.V[0] * time, coordinate.V[1] + speed.V[1] * time};
                return Make(uv, 2);
            }
            case Kind::Rotator: {
                const Value coordinate = Promote(Input(node, 0, depth), 2);
                const float angle = Input(node, 1, depth).V[0] * Input(node, 2, depth).V[0];
                const Value center = Promote(Input(node, 3, depth), 2);
                const float s = sinf(angle), c = cosf(angle);
                const float dx = coordinate.V[0] - center.V[0], dy = coordinate.V[1] - center.V[1];
                const float uv[2] = {center.V[0] + dx * c - dy * s, center.V[1] + dx * s + dy * c};
                return Make(uv, 2);
            }
            case Kind::WorldPosition:
                return Make(m_Context.Position, 3);
            // ---------------------------------------------------------------- ソリッドテクスチャ
            case Kind::SolidCoordinate: {
                const Value position = Promote(Input(node, 0, depth), 3);
                const float scale = Input(node, 1, depth).V[0];
                const Value offset = Promote(Input(node, 2, depth), 3);
                const bool raw = m_Graph.InputLink(node.InputPins[0]) != nullptr; // 繋いだ座標はそのまま
                float p[3];
                for (int i = 0; i < 3; ++i)
                {
                    const float base = raw ? position.V[i] : position.V[i] * 0.5f + 0.5f;
                    p[i] = base * scale + offset.V[i];
                }
                return Make(p, 3);
            }
            case Kind::SolidTexture:
            case Kind::SolidPattern: {
                // プロシージャルスタジオの立体テクスチャ（TextureScalar / TextureColor, solid = true）と同じ計算
                static const ProcStudio::TextureKind kinds[] = {
                    ProcStudio::TextureKind::FractalNoise, ProcStudio::TextureKind::Marble,
                    ProcStudio::TextureKind::Wood,         ProcStudio::TextureKind::Granite,
                    ProcStudio::TextureKind::Voronoi,      ProcStudio::TextureKind::FractalCloud};
                Value position = Promote(Input(node, 0, depth), 3);
                if (!m_Graph.InputLink(node.InputPins[0]))
                {
                    for (int i = 0; i < 3; ++i)
                    {
                        position.V[i] = position.V[i] * 0.5f + 0.5f; // スタジオと同じ 0〜1 の座標
                    }
                }
                ProcStudio::TextureParams params;
                params.Kind = kinds[std::clamp(static_cast<int>(node.Value[0]), 0,
                                               static_cast<int>(MaterialSolidKind::Count) - 1)];
                params.Noise.BasisType = static_cast<ProcStudio::Basis>(
                    std::clamp(static_cast<int>(node.Value[1]), 0, GraphMath::kNoiseBasisCount - 1));
                params.Noise.Fractal = static_cast<ProcStudio::FractalType>(
                    std::clamp(static_cast<int>(node.Value[2]), 0, GraphMath::kNoiseFractalCount - 1));
                params.Noise.Seed = static_cast<uint32_t>((std::max)(node.Value[3], 0.0f));
                params.Noise.Frequency = Input(node, 1, depth).V[0];
                params.Noise.Octaves = std::clamp(static_cast<int>(Input(node, 2, depth).V[0]), 1, 12);
                params.Noise.Lacunarity = Input(node, 3, depth).V[0];
                params.Noise.Gain = Input(node, 4, depth).V[0];
                params.Noise.WarpStrength = Input(node, 5, depth).V[0];
                params.Noise.RidgeOffset = Input(node, 6, depth).V[0];
                params.Turbulence = Input(node, 7, depth).V[0];
                params.RingCount = Input(node, 8, depth).V[0];
                params.Coverage = Input(node, 9, depth).V[0];
                params.Softness = Input(node, 10, depth).V[0];
                params.Contrast = Input(node, 11, depth).V[0];
                params.Bias = Input(node, 12, depth).V[0];
                params.Tileable = false;
                float p[3];
                for (int i = 0; i < 3; ++i)
                {
                    p[i] = std::isfinite(position.V[i]) ? std::clamp(position.V[i], -10000.0f, 10000.0f) : 0.0f;
                }
                if (node.Kind == Kind::SolidPattern)
                {
                    result.V[0] = ProcStudio::TextureScalar(params, p[0], p[1], p[2], true);
                    return result;
                }
                for (int color = 0; color < 3; ++color)
                {
                    const Value c = Promote(Input(node, 13 + color, depth), 3);
                    auto& target = color == 0 ? params.ColorA : color == 1 ? params.ColorB : params.ColorC;
                    target = {c.V[0], c.V[1], c.V[2]};
                }
                const ProcStudio::Float3 c = ProcStudio::TextureColor(params, p[0], p[1], p[2], true);
                return Make3(c.X, c.Y, c.Z);
            }
            case Kind::ConvertToSolid: {
                if (node.Texture == 0)
                {
                    return Promote(Input(node, 0, depth), 4); // 元画像なし：入力をそのまま通す
                }
                Value position = Promote(Input(node, 1, depth), 3);
                const bool raw = m_Graph.InputLink(node.InputPins[1]) != nullptr;
                const float scale = Input(node, 2, depth).V[0];
                float p[3];
                for (int i = 0; i < 3; ++i)
                {
                    const float base = raw ? position.V[i] : position.V[i] * 0.5f + 0.5f;
                    const float v = base * scale;
                    p[i] = std::isfinite(v) ? std::clamp(v, -10000.0f, 10000.0f) : 0.0f;
                }
                const bool linear = static_cast<int>(node.Value[1]) != static_cast<int>(MaterialSamplerType::Color);
                const auto sample = [&](float u, float v, float* out) {
                    if (!m_Sampler || !m_Sampler(node.Texture, u, v, linear, out))
                    {
                        out[0] = out[1] = out[2] = 0.5f;
                        out[3] = 1.0f;
                    }
                };
                result.N = 4;
                if (static_cast<int>(node.Value[0]) == static_cast<int>(MaterialSolidConvertMethod::Triplanar))
                {
                    const float sharpness = (std::max)(Input(node, 5, depth).V[0], 0.01f);
                    float w[3];
                    float total = 0.0f;
                    for (int i = 0; i < 3; ++i)
                    {
                        w[i] = powf(fabsf(m_Context.Normal[i]) + 1e-5f, sharpness);
                        total += w[i];
                    }
                    float a[4], b[4], c[4];
                    sample(p[1], p[2], a);
                    sample(p[0], p[2], b);
                    sample(p[0], p[1], c);
                    for (int i = 0; i < 4; ++i)
                    {
                        result.V[i] = (a[i] * w[0] + b[i] * w[1] + c[i] * w[2]) / total;
                    }
                }
                else
                {
                    // ProcStudio::VolumeFromImage と同じ：x / z の平面を y でずらしながら、オクターブで重ねる
                    using ProcStudio::NoiseDetail::Hash;
                    using ProcStudio::NoiseDetail::Unit;
                    const int octaves = std::clamp(static_cast<int>(Input(node, 3, depth).V[0]), 1, 6);
                    const float variation = Input(node, 4, depth).V[0];
                    const uint32_t seed = static_cast<uint32_t>((std::max)(node.Value[2], 0.0f));
                    float sum[4]{};
                    float norm = 0.0f;
                    float amplitude = 1.0f;
                    for (int o = 0; o < octaves; ++o)
                    {
                        const float octaveScale = static_cast<float>(1 << o);
                        const uint32_t h = Hash(seed + static_cast<uint32_t>(o) * 977u);
                        const float angle = p[1] * 2.0f * kPi;
                        const float swing = std::round(variation * 2.0f) * 0.5f / octaveScale;
                        const float ox = swing * cosf(angle) + Unit(h);
                        const float oz = swing * sinf(angle) + Unit(Hash(h));
                        float a[4], b[4];
                        sample(p[0] * octaveScale + ox, p[2] * octaveScale + oz, a);
                        sample(p[2] * octaveScale - oz + 0.37f, p[1] * octaveScale + ox, b);
                        for (int i = 0; i < 4; ++i)
                        {
                            sum[i] += (a[i] * 0.7f + b[i] * 0.3f) * amplitude;
                        }
                        norm += amplitude;
                        amplitude *= 0.5f;
                    }
                    for (int i = 0; i < 4; ++i)
                    {
                        result.V[i] = sum[i] / norm;
                    }
                }
                if (node.Value[3] > 0.5f) // グレースケール（スタジオのボリュームと同じ RGB 平均）
                {
                    const float gray = (result.V[0] + result.V[1] + result.V[2]) / 3.0f;
                    result.V[0] = result.V[1] = result.V[2] = gray;
                }
                return result;
            }
            case Kind::ThreeColorRamp: {
                const float t = Input(node, 0, depth).V[0];
                const Value a = Promote(Input(node, 1, depth), 3);
                const Value b = Promote(Input(node, 2, depth), 3);
                const Value c = Promote(Input(node, 3, depth), 3);
                float out[3];
                GraphMath::ThreeColorRamp(t, a.V, b.V, c.V, out);
                return Make(out, 3);
            }
            case Kind::WorldNormal:
                return Make(m_Context.Normal, 3);
            case Kind::CameraVector:
                return Make(m_Context.Camera, 3);
            case Kind::ReflectionVector: {
                // reflect(-V, N) = -V + 2 * dot(V, N) * N
                const float* n = m_Context.Normal;
                const float* v = m_Context.Camera;
                const float d = Dot3(v, n);
                return Make3(-v[0] + 2.0f * d * n[0], -v[1] + 2.0f * d * n[1], -v[2] + 2.0f * d * n[2]);
            }
            case Kind::Time:
                return Make(&m_Context.Time, 1);
            case Kind::Desaturation: {
                const Value color = Promote(Input(node, 0, depth), 3);
                const float fraction = Input(node, 1, depth).V[0];
                const float luminance = color.V[0] * 0.3f + color.V[1] * 0.59f + color.V[2] * 0.11f;
                result.N = 3;
                for (int c = 0; c < 3; ++c)
                {
                    result.V[c] = color.V[c] + (luminance - color.V[c]) * fraction;
                }
                return result;
            }
            case Kind::If: {
                const float a = Input(node, 0, depth).V[0];
                const float b = Input(node, 1, depth).V[0];
                Value branches[3] = {Input(node, 2, depth), Input(node, 3, depth), Input(node, 4, depth)};
                int width = 1;
                for (const auto& branch : branches)
                {
                    width = (std::max)(width, branch.N);
                }
                return Promote(a > b ? branches[0] : (a == b ? branches[1] : branches[2]), width);
            }
            case Kind::SphereMask: {
                const Value a = Promote(Input(node, 0, depth), 3);
                const Value b = Promote(Input(node, 1, depth), 3);
                const float d[3] = {a.V[0] - b.V[0], a.V[1] - b.V[1], a.V[2] - b.V[2]};
                result.V[0] =
                    GraphMath::SphereMask(sqrtf(Dot3(d, d)), Input(node, 2, depth).V[0], Input(node, 3, depth).V[0]);
                return result;
            }
            case Kind::CheapContrast: {
                const float in = Input(node, 0, depth).V[0];
                const float contrast = Input(node, 1, depth).V[0];
                result.V[0] = GraphMath::Saturate(-contrast + (1.0f + 2.0f * contrast) * in);
                return result;
            }
            case Kind::Noise: {
                const Value position = Promote(Input(node, 0, depth), 3);
                const float scale = Input(node, 1, depth).V[0];
                result.V[0] = GraphMath::Noise(position.V[0] * scale, position.V[1] * scale, position.V[2] * scale);
                return result;
            }
            // ---------------------------------------------------------------- 2026-11 追加ノード
            case Kind::StaticSwitch: {
                // 選ばれなかった側は評価しない（UE の Static Switch と同じくコンパイル時に分岐）
                Value chosen = Input(node, node.Value[0] > 0.5f ? 0 : 1, depth);
                return chosen;
            }
            case Kind::Pi:
                result.V[0] = kPi * node.Value[0];
                return result;
            case Kind::RemapValueRange: {
                result = Input(node, 0, depth);
                const float inLow = Input(node, 1, depth).V[0];
                const float inHigh = Input(node, 2, depth).V[0];
                const float outLow = Input(node, 3, depth).V[0];
                const float outHigh = Input(node, 4, depth).V[0];
                for (int c = 0; c < result.N; ++c)
                {
                    const float t = SafeDivide(result.V[c] - inLow, inHigh - inLow);
                    result.V[c] = outLow + (outHigh - outLow) * t;
                }
                return result;
            }
            case Kind::Posterize: {
                result = Input(node, 0, depth);
                const float steps = (std::max)(Input(node, 1, depth).V[0], 1.0f);
                for (int c = 0; c < result.N; ++c)
                {
                    result.V[c] = floorf(result.V[c] * steps) / steps;
                }
                return result;
            }
            case Kind::HueShift: {
                const Value color = Promote(Input(node, 0, depth), 3);
                const float shift = Input(node, 1, depth).V[0];
                float hsv[3];
                GraphMath::RgbToHsv(color.V, hsv);
                hsv[0] = GraphMath::Frac(hsv[0] + shift);
                result.N = 3;
                GraphMath::HsvToRgb(hsv, result.V);
                return result;
            }
            case Kind::Blend: {
                const Value base = Promote(Input(node, 0, depth), 3);
                const Value blend = Promote(Input(node, 1, depth), 3);
                const float opacity = Input(node, 2, depth).V[0];
                const int mode = static_cast<int>(node.Value[0]);
                result.N = 3;
                for (int c = 0; c < 3; ++c)
                {
                    const float blended = GraphMath::BlendChannel(mode, base.V[c], blend.V[c]);
                    result.V[c] = base.V[c] + (blended - base.V[c]) * opacity;
                }
                return result;
            }
            case Kind::LinearGradient: {
                const Value uv = Promote(Input(node, 0, depth), 2);
                result.V[0] = GraphMath::Saturate(uv.V[node.Value[0] > 0.5f ? 1 : 0]);
                return result;
            }
            case Kind::RadialGradient: {
                const Value uv = Promote(Input(node, 0, depth), 2);
                const Value center = Promote(Input(node, 1, depth), 2);
                const float radius = (std::max)(Input(node, 2, depth).V[0], 1e-5f);
                const float density = Input(node, 3, depth).V[0];
                const float dx = uv.V[0] - center.V[0], dy = uv.V[1] - center.V[1];
                const float t = GraphMath::Saturate(1.0f - sqrtf(dx * dx + dy * dy) / radius);
                result.V[0] = powf(t, (std::max)(density, 0.0f));
                return result;
            }
            // ---------------------------------------------------------------- プロシージャルスタジオのノイズ
            case Kind::ProceduralNoise:
            case Kind::FractalNoise: {
                const bool fractal = node.Kind == Kind::FractalNoise;
                const Value uv = Promote(Input(node, 0, depth), 2);
                const float z = Input(node, 1, depth).V[0];
                ProcStudio::NoiseParams params;
                params.BasisType = static_cast<ProcStudio::Basis>(
                    std::clamp(static_cast<int>(node.Value[0]), 0, GraphMath::kNoiseBasisCount - 1));
                params.Fractal = fractal ? static_cast<ProcStudio::FractalType>(std::clamp(
                                               static_cast<int>(node.Value[1]), 0, GraphMath::kNoiseFractalCount - 1))
                                         : ProcStudio::FractalType::None;
                params.Seed = static_cast<uint32_t>((std::max)(node.Value[fractal ? 2 : 1], 0.0f));
                const bool tileable = node.Value[fractal ? 3 : 2] > 0.5f;
                params.Frequency = (std::max)(Input(node, 2, depth).V[0], 0.001f);
                if (fractal)
                {
                    params.Octaves = std::clamp(static_cast<int>(Input(node, 3, depth).V[0]), 1, 12);
                    params.Lacunarity = Input(node, 4, depth).V[0];
                    params.Gain = Input(node, 5, depth).V[0];
                    params.WarpStrength = Input(node, 6, depth).V[0];
                    params.RidgeOffset = Input(node, 7, depth).V[0];
                }
                else
                {
                    params.Direction = Input(node, 3, depth).V[0];
                    params.Anisotropy = std::clamp(Input(node, 4, depth).V[0], 1.0f, 8.0f);
                    params.KernelFrequency = Input(node, 5, depth).V[0];
                    params.Phase = Input(node, 6, depth).V[0];
                }
                const float x = std::isfinite(uv.V[0]) ? std::clamp(uv.V[0], -10000.0f, 10000.0f) : 0.0f;
                const float y = std::isfinite(uv.V[1]) ? std::clamp(uv.V[1], -10000.0f, 10000.0f) : 0.0f;
                const float w = std::isfinite(z) ? std::clamp(z, -10000.0f, 10000.0f) : 0.0f;
                result.V[0] = ProcStudio::FractalNoise(params, x, y, w, tileable);
                return result;
            }
            case Kind::ConvertToNormalHeight:
            case Kind::ConvertToHeight:
            case Kind::ConvertToNormal: {
                // 色画像 → 高さ / 法線（格納値で計算。スタジオの「画像から高さ・法線」と同じ式）
                const Value uv = Promote(Input(node, 0, depth), 2);
                const float contrast = Input(node, 1, depth).V[0];
                const float bias = Input(node, 2, depth).V[0];
                const int channel = std::clamp(static_cast<int>(node.Value[1]), 0, GraphMath::kConvertChannelCount - 1);
                const bool invert = node.Value[2] > 0.5f;
                const bool normal = node.Kind == Kind::ConvertToNormal ||
                                    (node.Kind == Kind::ConvertToNormalHeight && node.Value[0] > 0.5f);
                const auto tap = [&](float du, float dv, float& height) {
                    float texel[4]{};
                    if (node.Texture == 0 || !m_Sampler || !m_Sampler(node.Texture, uv.V[0] + du, uv.V[1] + dv, true, texel))
                    {
                        return false;
                    }
                    height = GraphMath::ConvertHeight(texel, channel, invert, contrast, bias);
                    return true;
                };
                if (!normal)
                {
                    float h = 0.5f;
                    tap(0.0f, 0.0f, h);
                    result.V[0] = h;
                    return result;
                }
                const float strength = Input(node, 3, depth).V[0];
                const float r = (std::max)(Input(node, 4, depth).V[0], 1e-5f);
                float l = 0, rr = 0, u = 0, d = 0;
                if (!tap(-r, 0, l) || !tap(r, 0, rr) || !tap(0, -r, u) || !tap(0, r, d))
                {
                    return Make3(0.0f, 0.0f, 1.0f); // 読み込み中 / 未設定は平らな法線
                }
                float dx = rr - l;
                float dy = d - u;
                if (node.Value[3] > 0.5f) // Sobel（中央差分と同じスケール）
                {
                    float lu = 0, ru = 0, ld = 0, rd = 0;
                    tap(-r, -r, lu);
                    tap(r, -r, ru);
                    tap(-r, r, ld);
                    tap(r, r, rd);
                    dx = ((ru - lu) + dx * 2.0f + (rd - ld)) * 0.25f;
                    dy = ((ld - lu) + dy * 2.0f + (rd - ru)) * 0.25f;
                }
                float n[3] = {-dx * strength, -dy * strength, 1.0f};
                const float up[3] = {0.0f, 0.0f, 1.0f};
                Normalize3(n, up);
                return Make(n, 3);
            }
            case Kind::NoiseCombine: {
                const float a = Input(node, 0, depth).V[0];
                const float b = Input(node, 1, depth).V[0];
                const float factor = Input(node, 2, depth).V[0];
                result.V[0] = GraphMath::NoiseCombine(static_cast<int>(node.Value[0]), a, b, factor, node.Value[1] > 0.5f);
                return result;
            }
            case Kind::NoiseLayers: {
                // 繋がっている層だけを、重み（0 以下は無視）で平均する（スタジオの Composite と同じ）
                float total = 0.0f;
                float weightSum = 0.0f;
                for (size_t layer = 0; layer < 4; ++layer)
                {
                    const size_t pin = layer * 2;
                    if (pin + 1 >= node.InputPins.size() || !m_Graph.InputLink(node.InputPins[pin]))
                    {
                        continue;
                    }
                    const float weight = Input(node, pin + 1, depth).V[0];
