                    if (!std::isfinite(weight) || weight <= 0.0f)
                    {
                        continue;
                    }
                    total += Input(node, pin, depth).V[0] * weight;
                    weightSum += weight;
                }
                result.V[0] = weightSum > 0.0f ? total / weightSum : 0.0f;
                return result;
            }
            case Kind::Voronoi: {
                const Value uv = Promote(Input(node, 0, depth), 2);
                const float scale = Input(node, 1, depth).V[0];
                const float jitter = Input(node, 2, depth).V[0];
                result.V[0] = GraphMath::Voronoi(uv.V[0] * scale, uv.V[1] * scale, jitter, node.Value[0] > 0.5f);
                return result;
            }
            case Kind::NormalFromHeight: {
                // エンジンの ApplyAssetHeightNormal と同じ向き：(-dh/du, -dh/dv, 1) * 強さ
                const float step = (std::max)(m_Context.PixelSize, 1e-5f);
                const float h = Input(node, 0, depth).V[0];
                const float strength = Input(node, 1, depth).V[0];
                const float hu = Shifted(node, 0, 0, depth).V[0];
                const float hv = Shifted(node, 0, 1, depth).V[0];
                float n[3] = {-(hu - h) / step * strength, -(hv - h) / step * strength, 1.0f};
                const float up[3] = {0.0f, 0.0f, 1.0f};
                Normalize3(n, up);
                return Make(n, 3);
            }
            case Kind::BlendAngleCorrectedNormals: {
                const Value base = Promote(Input(node, 0, depth), 3);
                const Value detail = Promote(Input(node, 1, depth), 3);
                const float t[3] = {base.V[0], base.V[1], base.V[2] + 1.0f};
                const float u[3] = {-detail.V[0], -detail.V[1], detail.V[2]};
                const float k = Dot3(t, u) / (std::max)(t[2], 1e-5f);
                float n[3] = {t[0] * k - u[0], t[1] * k - u[1], t[2] * k - u[2]};
                const float up[3] = {0.0f, 0.0f, 1.0f};
                Normalize3(n, up);
                return Make(n, 3);
            }
            case Kind::FlattenNormal: {
                const Value normal = Promote(Input(node, 0, depth), 3);
                const float flatness = Input(node, 1, depth).V[0];
                float n[3] = {normal.V[0] * (1.0f - flatness), normal.V[1] * (1.0f - flatness),
                              normal.V[2] + (1.0f - normal.V[2]) * flatness};
                const float up[3] = {0.0f, 0.0f, 1.0f};
                Normalize3(n, up);
                return Make(n, 3);
            }
            case Kind::BumpOffset: {
                const float height = Input(node, 0, depth).V[0];
                const float ratio = Input(node, 1, depth).V[0];
                const float reference = Input(node, 2, depth).V[0];
                const Value coordinate = Promote(Input(node, 3, depth), 2);
                // カメラ方向を接空間へ（ベイクでは正面から見るのでずれは 0）
                const float cu = Dot3(m_Context.Camera, m_Context.Tangent);
                const float cv = Dot3(m_Context.Camera, m_Context.Bitangent);
                const float offset = (height - reference) * ratio;
                const float uv[2] = {coordinate.V[0] + cu * offset, coordinate.V[1] + cv * offset};
                return Make(uv, 2);
            }
            case Kind::RotateAboutAxis: {
                Value axis = Promote(Input(node, 0, depth), 3);
                const float up[3] = {0.0f, 0.0f, 1.0f};
                Normalize3(axis.V, up);
                const float angle = Input(node, 1, depth).V[0] * 2.0f * kPi;
                const Value pivot = Promote(Input(node, 2, depth), 3);
                const Value position = Promote(Input(node, 3, depth), 3);
                const float d[3] = {position.V[0] - pivot.V[0], position.V[1] - pivot.V[1], position.V[2] - pivot.V[2]};
                const float along = Dot3(axis.V, d);
                const float closest[3] = {pivot.V[0] + axis.V[0] * along, pivot.V[1] + axis.V[1] * along,
                                          pivot.V[2] + axis.V[2] * along};
                const float u[3] = {position.V[0] - closest[0], position.V[1] - closest[1], position.V[2] - closest[2]};
                const float v[3] = {axis.V[1] * u[2] - axis.V[2] * u[1], axis.V[2] * u[0] - axis.V[0] * u[2],
                                    axis.V[0] * u[1] - axis.V[1] * u[0]};
                const float c = cosf(angle), s = sinf(angle);
                return Make3(closest[0] + u[0] * c + v[0] * s - position.V[0],
                             closest[1] + u[1] * c + v[1] * s - position.V[1],
                             closest[2] + u[2] * c + v[2] * s - position.V[2]);
            }
            case Kind::BlackBody: {
                result.N = 3;
                GraphMath::BlackBody(Input(node, 0, depth).V[0], result.V);
                return result;
            }
            default:
                return result;
        }
    }
} // namespace MaterialGraphEval



===== FILE: source\assets\materialgraphevaluator.h =====
#pragma once
// ============================================================================
// MaterialGraphEvaluator：マテリアルグラフの CPU 評価器（ImGui / D3D12 に依存しない）
//  ・ノードプレビュー（MaterialGraphPreview）とエンジン用テクスチャベイク（MaterialGraphBake）で共有する
//  ・全ノード対応。DDX / DDY / Normal From Height は UV を 1 画素ずらして上流を再評価する差分で求める
//  ・Texture Sample はサンプラー関数経由（プレビューは縮小キャッシュ、ベイクはフル解像度）
// ============================================================================
#include "materialgraph.h"
#include <cstdint>
#include <functional>
#include <memory>
#include <unordered_map>
#include <vector>

namespace MaterialGraphEval
{
    struct Value
    {
        float V[4]{};
        int N = 1; // 成分数（1〜4）
    };

    // 評価コンテキスト。接空間は T = +U、B = +V（エンジンの ApplyNormalMapCommon と同じ向き）
    struct Context
    {
        float UV[2]{};
        float Position[3]{};
        float Normal[3]{0.0f, 0.0f, -1.0f};
        float Camera[3]{0.0f, 0.0f, -1.0f}; // 表面 → カメラ
        float Tangent[3]{1.0f, 0.0f, 0.0f};
        float Bitangent[3]{0.0f, -1.0f, 0.0f};
        float Time = 0.0f;
        float PixelSize = 1.0f / 64.0f; // UV 上の 1 画素（DDX / DDY / Normal From Height の差分幅）
    };

    // raw = true なら格納値（8 ビット画像の sRGB 線形化をしない値）を返す。未読み込みなら false
    using TextureSampler = std::function<bool(AssetHandle texture, float u, float v, bool raw, float out[4])>;

    struct Topology
    {
        std::unordered_map<uint64_t, size_t> Index; // ノード ID → Nodes の添字
        std::vector<uint8_t> Spatial;               // 法線・位置・カメラに依存する
        std::vector<uint8_t> TimeDependent;         // Time に依存する
        std::vector<uint8_t> ViewDependent;         // カメラ方向に依存する（ベイクでは正面から見た値になる）
        bool Animated = false;
    };

    void BuildTopology(const MaterialGraph& graph, Topology& topology);

    // 中継ノードを飛ばして、入力ピンに実際に繋がっているノードを返す
    const MaterialGraphNode* ResolveSource(const MaterialGraph& graph, const MaterialGraphNode& node, size_t input);

    float LinearToSrgb(float v);
    float SrgbToLinear(float v);

    class Evaluator
    {
      public:
        Evaluator(const MaterialGraph& graph, const Topology& topology, TextureSampler sampler);
        ~Evaluator();
        Evaluator(const Evaluator&) = delete;
        Evaluator& operator=(const Evaluator&) = delete;

        void Reset(const Context& context);
        Value Node(size_t index, int depth = 0);
        Value Input(const MaterialGraphNode& node, size_t input, int depth = 0);
        const Context& Ctx() const
        {
            return m_Context;
        }

        // Material Output の入力を、指定の UV で評価する（POM / 高さの差分用）。コンテキストは元に戻らない
        Value InputAt(const MaterialGraphNode& node, size_t input, float u, float v);

      private:
        Value Compute(const MaterialGraphNode& node, int depth);
        Value Shifted(const MaterialGraphNode& node, size_t input, int axis, int depth);
        int Gather(const MaterialGraphNode& node, int depth, Value* inputs, size_t count, size_t promoteCount);

        const MaterialGraph& m_Graph;
        const Topology& m_Topology;
        TextureSampler m_Sampler;
        Context m_Context;
        std::vector<Value> m_Memo;
        std::vector<uint8_t> m_Done;
        std::unique_ptr<Evaluator> m_Child; // 差分用（UV をずらした評価）。必要になったときだけ作る
        int m_Level = 0;
    };

    // 値ユーティリティ
    Value Promote(Value value, int count);
} // namespace MaterialGraphEval

===== FILE: source\assets\materialgraphmath.h =====
#pragma once
// ============================================================================
// マテリアルグラフの演算定義（HLSL 生成と CPU プレビューで共有する）
//  ・単項 / 二項演算の CPU 実装と HLSL 関数名
//  ・入力ピンが未接続のときの特別な既定値（UV / Time / World Position）
//  ・Noise / Rotator / Sphere Mask の HLSL ヘルパー
// ============================================================================
#include "materialgraph.h"
#include <algorithm>
#include <cmath>
#include <string>

namespace MaterialGraphMath
{
    using Kind = MaterialNodeKind;

    inline bool IsUnary(Kind kind)
    {
        return kind >= Kind::Abs && kind <= Kind::DDY;
    }

    inline bool IsBinary(Kind kind)
    {
        return kind >= Kind::Power && kind <= Kind::Arctangent2;
    }

    inline bool IsConstantNode(Kind kind)
    {
        return kind == Kind::Constant || kind == Kind::ScalarParameter || kind == Kind::VectorParameter ||
               kind == Kind::ColorParameter || kind == Kind::Constant2Vector || kind == Kind::Constant3Vector ||
               kind == Kind::Constant4Vector;
    }

    enum class SpecialInput
    {
        None,
        UV,
        Time,
        WorldPosition
    };

    // 未接続の入力が「定数」ではなく、ピクセル / 時間の値を使うピン（UE と同じ挙動）
    inline SpecialInput DefaultInput(Kind kind, size_t input)
    {
        if ((kind == Kind::TextureSample || kind == Kind::Panner || kind == Kind::Rotator) && input == 0)
        {
            return SpecialInput::UV;
        }
        if ((kind == Kind::Panner || kind == Kind::Rotator) && input == 1)
        {
            return SpecialInput::Time;
        }
        if (kind == Kind::Noise && input == 0)
        {
            return SpecialInput::WorldPosition;
        }
        if ((kind == Kind::LinearGradient || kind == Kind::RadialGradient || kind == Kind::Voronoi ||
             kind == Kind::ProceduralNoise || kind == Kind::FractalNoise || IsConvertTextureNode(kind)) &&
            input == 0)
        {
            return SpecialInput::UV;
        }
        // 立体テクスチャの Position（未接続 = 位置を 0〜1 にしたもの。ノード側で * 0.5 + 0.5 する）
        if ((kind == Kind::SolidTexture || kind == Kind::SolidPattern || kind == Kind::SolidCoordinate) && input == 0)
        {
            return SpecialInput::WorldPosition;
        }
        if (kind == Kind::ConvertToSolid && input == 0)
        {
            return SpecialInput::UV; // 未変換：UV で評価した入力（= テクスチャに作る 2D の値）
        }
        if (kind == Kind::ConvertToSolid && input == 1)
        {
            return SpecialInput::WorldPosition;
        }
        if (kind == Kind::ConvertToTexture && input == 1)
        {
            return SpecialInput::UV;
        }
        if (kind == Kind::BumpOffset && input == 3)
        {
            return SpecialInput::UV;
        }
        if (kind == Kind::RotateAboutAxis && input == 3)
        {
            return SpecialInput::WorldPosition;
        }
        return SpecialInput::None;
    }

    // ---- プロシージャルスタジオのノイズ（名前は ProcStudio::Basis / FractalType の並び）
    inline constexpr int kNoiseBasisCount = 22;
    inline constexpr int kNoiseFractalCount = 9;
    inline const char* NoiseBasisName(int index)
    {
        static const char* names[kNoiseBasisCount] = {
            "Perlin",  "Value",          "Worley",     "Cell Edge",   "White",          "Simplex",
            "Voronoi", "Cell",           "Gabor",      "Wavelet",     "Curl",           "Value Gradient",
            "Sparse Convolution",        "Spot",       "Local Random", "Chevron",       "Lattice Free",
            "Phasor",  "Anisotropic Gabor",            "Harmonic",    "Flow",           "Ridged"};
        return names[std::clamp(index, 0, kNoiseBasisCount - 1)];
    }
    inline const char* NoiseFractalName(int index)
    {
        static const char* names[kNoiseFractalCount] = {"fBm",         "Ridged",      "Billow",
                                                        "Turbulence",  "Hybrid Multifractal", "Domain Warp",
                                                        "None",        "Multifractal", "Heterogeneous Multifractal"};
        return names[std::clamp(index, 0, kNoiseFractalCount - 1)];
    }
    inline const char* NoiseCombineModeName(int index)
    {
        static const char* names[] = {"Mix",    "Add", "Subtract", "Multiply",   "Screen",
                                      "Overlay", "Min", "Max",      "Difference", "Height Blend"};
        static_assert(sizeof(names) / sizeof(names[0]) == static_cast<size_t>(MaterialNoiseCombineMode::Count));
        return names[std::clamp(index, 0, static_cast<int>(MaterialNoiseCombineMode::Count) - 1)];
    }

    // Noise Combine（HLSL 側の MG_NoiseCombine と同じ計算）
    //  Mix 以外は「A に B を合成した結果」へ Factor（不透明度）で寄せる。Height Blend は Factor = 境界の幅
    inline float NoiseCombine(int mode, float a, float b, float factor, bool clampResult)
    {
        const auto saturate = [](float v) { return std::clamp(v, 0.0f, 1.0f); };
        float result = a;
        switch (static_cast<MaterialNoiseCombineMode>(mode))
        {
            case MaterialNoiseCombineMode::Mix:
                result = a + (b - a) * factor;
                break;
            case MaterialNoiseCombineMode::HeightBlend: {
                const float width = (std::max)(factor, 1e-4f);
                float t = saturate((b - a) / width * 0.5f + 0.5f);
                t = t * t * (3.0f - 2.0f * t);
                result = a + (b - a) * t;
                break;
            }
            default: {
                float op = a;
                switch (static_cast<MaterialNoiseCombineMode>(mode))
                {
                    case MaterialNoiseCombineMode::Add:
                        op = a + b;
                        break;
                    case MaterialNoiseCombineMode::Subtract:
                        op = a - b;
                        break;
                    case MaterialNoiseCombineMode::Multiply:
                        op = a * b;
                        break;
                    case MaterialNoiseCombineMode::Screen:
                        op = 1.0f - (1.0f - a) * (1.0f - b);
                        break;
                    case MaterialNoiseCombineMode::Overlay:
                        op = a < 0.5f ? 2.0f * a * b : 1.0f - 2.0f * (1.0f - a) * (1.0f - b);
                        break;
                    case MaterialNoiseCombineMode::Min:
                        op = (std::min)(a, b);
                        break;
                    case MaterialNoiseCombineMode::Max:
                        op = (std::max)(a, b);
                        break;
                    case MaterialNoiseCombineMode::Difference:
                        op = std::fabs(a - b);
                        break;
                    default:
                        break;
                }
                result = a + (op - a) * factor;
                break;
            }
        }
        return clampResult ? saturate(result) : result;
    }

    // ---- Convert To Normal / Height（プロシージャルスタジオ ImageMaps と同じ式）
    inline constexpr int kConvertChannelCount = 7;
    inline const char* ConvertChannelName(int index)
    {
        static const char* names[kConvertChannelCount] = {"輝度", "平均", "R", "G", "B", "A", "最大"};
        return names[std::clamp(index, 0, kConvertChannelCount - 1)];
    }
    // 格納値（8 ビット画像なら sRGB 値）からチャンネルを取り出す
    inline float ConvertChannel(const float* c, int channel)
    {
        switch (channel)
        {
            case 1:
                return (c[0] + c[1] + c[2]) / 3.0f;
            case 2:
                return c[0];
            case 3:
                return c[1];
            case 4:
                return c[2];
            case 5:
                return c[3];
            case 6:
                return (std::max)({c[0], c[1], c[2]});
            default:
                return 0.2126f * c[0] + 0.7152f * c[1] + 0.0722f * c[2];
        }
    }
    // 高さ：反転 → (v - 0.5) * Contrast + 0.5 + Bias → 0..1
    inline float ConvertHeight(const float* c, int channel, bool invert, float contrast, float bias)
    {
        float v = std::clamp(ConvertChannel(c, channel), 0.0f, 1.0f);
        v = invert ? 1.0f - v : v;
        return std::clamp((v - 0.5f) * contrast + 0.5f + bias, 0.0f, 1.0f);
    }

    // ---- ソリッドテクスチャ
    inline const char* SolidKindName(int index)
    {
        static const char* names[] = {"フラクタルノイズ", "大理石 (Marble)", "木目 (Wood)", "御影石 (Granite)",
                                      "ボロノイ",         "フラクタル雲"};
        static_assert(sizeof(names) / sizeof(names[0]) == static_cast<size_t>(MaterialSolidKind::Count));
        return names[std::clamp(index, 0, static_cast<int>(MaterialSolidKind::Count) - 1)];
    }
    // 3 色ランプ（スタジオの TextureColor の既定配色）
    inline void ThreeColorRamp(float t, const float* a, const float* b, const float* c, float* out)
    {
        for (int i = 0; i < 3; ++i)
        {
            out[i] = t < 0.5f ? a[i] + (b[i] - a[i]) * (t * 2.0f) : b[i] + (c[i] - b[i]) * ((t - 0.5f) * 2.0f);
        }
    }

    inline const char* SolidConvertMethodName(int index)
    {
        static const char* names[] = {"ボリューム（スタジオ方式）", "トライプラナー"};
        static_assert(sizeof(names) / sizeof(names[0]) == static_cast<size_t>(MaterialSolidConvertMethod::Count));
        return names[std::clamp(index, 0, static_cast<int>(MaterialSolidConvertMethod::Count) - 1)];
    }

    inline float Unary(Kind kind, float x)
    {
        switch (kind)
        {
            case Kind::Abs:
                return fabsf(x);
            case Kind::Ceil:
                return ceilf(x);
            case Kind::Floor:
                return floorf(x);
            case Kind::Frac:
                return x - floorf(x);
            case Kind::Round:
                return roundf(x);
            case Kind::Truncate:
                return truncf(x);
            case Kind::Sign:
                return x > 0.0f ? 1.0f : (x < 0.0f ? -1.0f : 0.0f);
            case Kind::OneMinus:
                return 1.0f - x;
            case Kind::Saturate:
                return std::clamp(x, 0.0f, 1.0f);
            case Kind::SquareRoot:
                return sqrtf(x);
            case Kind::Sine:
                return sinf(x);
            case Kind::Cosine:
                return cosf(x);
            case Kind::Tangent:
                return tanf(x);
            case Kind::Arcsine:
                return asinf(x);
            case Kind::Arccosine:
                return acosf(x);
            case Kind::Arctangent:
                return atanf(x);
            case Kind::Exponential:
                return expf(x);
            case Kind::Logarithm2:
                return log2f(x);
            default: // DDX / DDY は CPU では 0
                return 0.0f;
        }
    }

    inline float Binary(Kind kind, float a, float b)
    {
        switch (kind)
        {
            case Kind::Power:
                return powf(a, b);
            case Kind::Min:
                return (std::min)(a, b);
            case Kind::Max:
                return (std::max)(a, b);
            case Kind::Fmod:
                return b == 0.0f ? 0.0f : fmodf(a, b);
            case Kind::Step: // UE の Step(Y, X) = X >= Y ? 1 : 0（HLSL の step(y, x) と同じ）
                return b >= a ? 1.0f : 0.0f;
            case Kind::Arctangent2:
                return atan2f(a, b);
            default:
                return 0.0f;
        }
    }

    inline std::string UnaryHlsl(Kind kind, const std::string& x)
    {
        switch (kind)
        {
            case Kind::Abs:
                return "abs(" + x + ")";
            case Kind::Ceil:
                return "ceil(" + x + ")";
            case Kind::Floor:
                return "floor(" + x + ")";
            case Kind::Frac:
                return "frac(" + x + ")";
            case Kind::Round:
                return "round(" + x + ")";
            case Kind::Truncate:
                return "trunc(" + x + ")";
            case Kind::Sign:
                return "sign(" + x + ")";
            case Kind::OneMinus:
                return "(1-(" + x + "))";
            case Kind::Saturate:
                return "saturate(" + x + ")";
            case Kind::SquareRoot:
                return "sqrt(" + x + ")";
            case Kind::Sine:
                return "sin(" + x + ")";
            case Kind::Cosine:
                return "cos(" + x + ")";
            case Kind::Tangent:
                return "tan(" + x + ")";
            case Kind::Arcsine:
                return "asin(" + x + ")";
            case Kind::Arccosine:
                return "acos(" + x + ")";
            case Kind::Arctangent:
                return "atan(" + x + ")";
            case Kind::Exponential:
                return "exp(" + x + ")";
            case Kind::Logarithm2:
                return "log2(" + x + ")";
            case Kind::DDX:
                return "ddx(" + x + ")";
            case Kind::DDY:
                return "ddy(" + x + ")";
            default:
                return x;
        }
    }

    inline std::string BinaryHlsl(Kind kind, const std::string& a, const std::string& b)
    {
        switch (kind)
        {
            case Kind::Power:
                return "pow(" + a + "," + b + ")";
            case Kind::Min:
                return "min(" + a + "," + b + ")";
            case Kind::Max:
                return "max(" + a + "," + b + ")";
            case Kind::Fmod:
                return "fmod(" + a + "," + b + ")";
            case Kind::Step:
                return "step(" + a + "," + b + ")";
            case Kind::Arctangent2:
                return "atan2(" + a + "," + b + ")";
            default:
                return a;
        }
    }

    // ---- Noise（値ノイズ）。HLSL 側の MG_Noise と同じ計算
    inline float Hash(float x, float y, float z)
    {
        auto frac = [](float v) {
            return v - floorf(v);
        };
        x = frac(x * 0.3183099f + 0.1f) * 17.0f;
        y = frac(y * 0.3183099f + 0.1f) * 17.0f;
        z = frac(z * 0.3183099f + 0.1f) * 17.0f;
        return frac(x * y * z * (x + y + z));
    }

    inline float Noise(float x, float y, float z)
    {
        const float ix = floorf(x), iy = floorf(y), iz = floorf(z);
        float fx = x - ix, fy = y - iy, fz = z - iz;
        fx = fx * fx * (3.0f - 2.0f * fx);
        fy = fy * fy * (3.0f - 2.0f * fy);
        fz = fz * fz * (3.0f - 2.0f * fz);
        auto lerp = [](float a, float b, float t) {
            return a + (b - a) * t;
        };
        auto h = [&](float dx, float dy, float dz) {
            return Hash(ix + dx, iy + dy, iz + dz);
        };
        return lerp(lerp(lerp(h(0, 0, 0), h(1, 0, 0), fx), lerp(h(0, 1, 0), h(1, 1, 0), fx), fy),
                    lerp(lerp(h(0, 0, 1), h(1, 0, 1), fx), lerp(h(0, 1, 1), h(1, 1, 1), fx), fy), fz);
    }

    inline float SphereMask(float distance, float radius, float hardness)
    {
        const float d = distance / (std::max)(radius, 1e-5f);
        return std::clamp((1.0f - d) / (std::max)(1.0f - hardness, 1e-5f), 0.0f, 1.0f);
    }

    // ---- 2026-11 追加ノードの CPU 実装（HLSL 側の MG_* と同じ計算）
    inline float Frac(float v)
    {
        return v - floorf(v);
    }

    inline float Saturate(float v)
    {
        return std::clamp(v, 0.0f, 1.0f);
    }

    // Blend（Photoshop 系の描画モード）。a = Base, b = Blend（各成分 0〜1 想定）
    inline float BlendChannel(int mode, float a, float b)
    {
        switch (static_cast<MaterialBlendMode>(mode))
        {
            case MaterialBlendMode::Multiply:
                return a * b;
            case MaterialBlendMode::Screen:
                return 1.0f - (1.0f - a) * (1.0f - b);
            case MaterialBlendMode::Overlay:
                return a < 0.5f ? 2.0f * a * b : 1.0f - 2.0f * (1.0f - a) * (1.0f - b);
            case MaterialBlendMode::SoftLight:
                return b < 0.5f ? 2.0f * a * b + a * a * (1.0f - 2.0f * b)
                                : sqrtf((std::max)(a, 0.0f)) * (2.0f * b - 1.0f) + 2.0f * a * (1.0f - b);
            case MaterialBlendMode::HardLight:
                return b < 0.5f ? 2.0f * a * b : 1.0f - 2.0f * (1.0f - a) * (1.0f - b);
            case MaterialBlendMode::ColorDodge:
                return (std::min)(a / (std::max)(1.0f - b, 1e-5f), 1.0f);
            case MaterialBlendMode::ColorBurn:
                return 1.0f - (std::min)((1.0f - a) / (std::max)(b, 1e-5f), 1.0f);
            case MaterialBlendMode::LinearDodge:
                return a + b;
            case MaterialBlendMode::LinearBurn:
                return a + b - 1.0f;
            case MaterialBlendMode::Difference:
                return fabsf(a - b);
            case MaterialBlendMode::Darken:
                return (std::min)(a, b);
            case MaterialBlendMode::Lighten:
                return (std::max)(a, b);
            case MaterialBlendMode::Subtract:
                return a - b;
            default: // Normal
                return b;
        }
    }

    inline const char* BlendModeName(int mode)
    {
        static const char* names[] = {"Normal",      "Multiply",    "Screen",      "Overlay",    "Soft Light",
                                      "Hard Light",  "Color Dodge", "Color Burn",  "Linear Dodge", "Linear Burn",
                                      "Difference",  "Darken",      "Lighten",     "Subtract"};
        return mode >= 0 && mode < static_cast<int>(MaterialBlendMode::Count) ? names[mode] : names[0];
    }

    inline void RgbToHsv(const float* rgb, float* hsv)
    {
        const float maxValue = (std::max)({rgb[0], rgb[1], rgb[2]});
        const float minValue = (std::min)({rgb[0], rgb[1], rgb[2]});
        const float delta = maxValue - minValue;
        float hue = 0.0f;
        if (delta > 1e-6f)
        {
            if (maxValue == rgb[0])
            {
                hue = (rgb[1] - rgb[2]) / delta;
            }
            else if (maxValue == rgb[1])
            {
                hue = 2.0f + (rgb[2] - rgb[0]) / delta;
            }
            else
            {
                hue = 4.0f + (rgb[0] - rgb[1]) / delta;
            }
            hue = Frac(hue / 6.0f);
        }
        hsv[0] = hue;
        hsv[1] = maxValue > 1e-6f ? delta / maxValue : 0.0f;
        hsv[2] = maxValue;
    }

    inline void HsvToRgb(const float* hsv, float* rgb)
    {
        for (int i = 0; i < 3; ++i)
        {
            const float k = Frac(hsv[0] + (3.0f - static_cast<float>(i)) / 3.0f) * 6.0f; // r:k=h+1, g:h+2/3, b:h+1/3
            const float p = Saturate(fabsf(k - 3.0f) - 1.0f);
            rgb[i] = hsv[2] * (1.0f + (p - 1.0f) * hsv[1]);
        }
    }

    inline float HashCell(float x, float y, float k)
    {
        return Hash(x, y, k + 0.5f);
    }

    // Voronoi（F1 距離 / セル値）。uv はスケール済みの座標
    inline float Voronoi(float u, float v, float jitter, bool cellValue)
    {
        const float cx = floorf(u), cy = floorf(v);
        float best = 1e9f;
        float bestValue = 0.0f;
        for (int j = -1; j <= 1; ++j)
        {
            for (int i = -1; i <= 1; ++i)
            {
                const float gx = cx + static_cast<float>(i), gy = cy + static_cast<float>(j);
                const float px = gx + 0.5f + (HashCell(gx, gy, 1.0f) - 0.5f) * jitter;
                const float py = gy + 0.5f + (HashCell(gx, gy, 2.0f) - 0.5f) * jitter;
                const float dx = px - u, dy = py - v;
                const float d = dx * dx + dy * dy;
                if (d < best)
                {
                    best = d;
                    bestValue = HashCell(gx, gy, 3.0f);
                }
            }
        }
        return cellValue ? bestValue : sqrtf(best);
    }

    // 黒体放射の色（線形 RGB、Tanner Helland の近似を線形化）
    inline void BlackBody(float kelvin, float* rgb)
    {
        const float t = std::clamp(kelvin, 1000.0f, 40000.0f) / 100.0f;
        float r, g, b;
        if (t <= 66.0f)
        {
            r = 255.0f;
            g = 99.4708025861f * logf(t) - 161.1195681661f;
            b = t <= 19.0f ? 0.0f : 138.5177312231f * logf(t - 10.0f) - 305.0447927307f;
        }
        else
        {
            r = 329.698727446f * powf(t - 60.0f, -0.1332047592f);
            g = 288.1221695283f * powf(t - 60.0f, -0.0755148492f);
            b = 255.0f;
        }
        const float srgb[3] = {Saturate(r / 255.0f), Saturate(g / 255.0f), Saturate(b / 255.0f)};
        for (int i = 0; i < 3; ++i)
        {
            rgb[i] = srgb[i] <= 0.04045f ? srgb[i] / 12.92f : powf((srgb[i] + 0.055f) / 1.055f, 2.4f);
        }
    }

    inline const char* HlslHelpers()
    {
        return "float MG_Hash(float3 p) { p = frac(p * 0.3183099 + 0.1) * 17.0; return frac(p.x * p.y * p.z * (p.x + "
               "p.y + p.z)); }\n"
               "float MG_Noise(float3 x) { float3 i = floor(x); float3 f = frac(x); f = f * f * (3.0 - 2.0 * f);\n"
               "  return lerp(lerp(lerp(MG_Hash(i), MG_Hash(i + float3(1,0,0)), f.x), lerp(MG_Hash(i + float3(0,1,0)), "
               "MG_Hash(i + float3(1,1,0)), f.x), f.y),\n"
               "              lerp(lerp(MG_Hash(i + float3(0,0,1)), MG_Hash(i + float3(1,0,1)), f.x), lerp(MG_Hash(i + "
               "float3(0,1,1)), MG_Hash(i + float3(1,1,1)), f.x), f.y), f.z); }\n"
               "float2 MG_Rotate(float2 uv, float2 center, float angle) { float s = sin(angle); float c = cos(angle); "
               "float2 d = uv - center; return center + float2(d.x * c - d.y * s, d.x * s + d.y * c); }\n"
               "float MG_SphereMask(float3 a, float3 b, float radius, float hardness) { float d = distance(a, b) / "
               "max(radius, 1e-5); return saturate((1.0 - d) / max(1.0 - hardness, 1e-5)); }\n"
               // ---- 2026-11 追加ノード
               "float3 MG_Blend(int mode, float3 a, float3 b) {\n"
               "  float3 screen2 = 1-2*(1-a)*(1-b); float3 overlay = lerp(2*a*b, screen2, step(0.5, a)); float3 hard = lerp(2*a*b, screen2, step(0.5, b));\n"
               "  float3 soft = lerp(2*a*b + a*a*(1-2*b), sqrt(max(a,0))*(2*b-1) + 2*a*(1-b), step(0.5, b));\n"
               "  float3 dodge = min(a / max(1-b,1e-5), 1); float3 burn = 1 - min((1-a) / max(b,1e-5), 1);\n"
               "  switch (mode) { case 1: return a*b; case 2: return 1-(1-a)*(1-b); case 3: return overlay; case 4: return soft;\n"
               "    case 5: return hard; case 6: return dodge; case 7: return burn; case 8: return a+b; case 9: return a+b-1;\n"
               "    case 10: return abs(a-b); case 11: return min(a,b); case 12: return max(a,b); case 13: return a-b; default: return b; } }\n"
               "float3 MG_RgbToHsv(float3 c) { float mx = max(c.r,max(c.g,c.b)); float mn = min(c.r,min(c.g,c.b)); float d = mx-mn; float h = 0;\n"
               "  if (d > 1e-6) { h = mx == c.r ? (c.g-c.b)/d : (mx == c.g ? 2+(c.b-c.r)/d : 4+(c.r-c.g)/d); h = frac(h/6); }\n"
               "  return float3(h, mx > 1e-6 ? d/mx : 0, mx); }\n"
               "float3 MG_HsvToRgb(float3 c) { float3 k = frac(c.x + float3(1.0, 2.0/3.0, 1.0/3.0)) * 6; float3 p = saturate(abs(k-3)-1);\n"
               "  return c.z * (1 + (p-1) * c.y); }\n"
               "float3 MG_HueShift(float3 c, float shift) { float3 hsv = MG_RgbToHsv(c); hsv.x = frac(hsv.x + shift); return MG_HsvToRgb(hsv); }\n"
               "float MG_HashCell(float2 c, float k) { return MG_Hash(float3(c, k + 0.5)); }\n"
               "float MG_Voronoi(float2 uv, float jitter, int cellValue) { float2 c = floor(uv); float best = 1e9; float value = 0;\n"
               "  [unroll] for (int j = -1; j <= 1; ++j) [unroll] for (int i = -1; i <= 1; ++i) { float2 g = c + float2(i,j);\n"
               "    float2 p = g + 0.5 + (float2(MG_HashCell(g,1), MG_HashCell(g,2)) - 0.5) * jitter; float2 d = p - uv; float dd = dot(d,d);\n"
               "    if (dd < best) { best = dd; value = MG_HashCell(g,3); } }\n"
               "  return cellValue != 0 ? value : sqrt(best); }\n"
               "float3 MG_NormalFromHeight(float h, float2 uv, float strength) { float2 dh = float2(ddx(h), ddy(h)); float2 dx = ddx(uv); float2 dy = ddy(uv);\n"
               "  float det = dx.x*dy.y - dx.y*dy.x; if (abs(det) < 1e-12) return float3(0,0,1);\n"
               "  float dhdu = (dh.x*dy.y - dh.y*dx.y) / det; float dhdv = (dh.y*dx.x - dh.x*dy.x) / det;\n"
               "  return normalize(float3(-dhdu*strength, -dhdv*strength, 1)); }\n"
               "float3 MG_BlendAngleCorrectedNormals(float3 base, float3 detail) { float3 t = base + float3(0,0,1); float3 u = detail * float3(-1,-1,1);\n"
               "  return normalize(t * dot(t,u) / max(t.z,1e-5) - u); }\n"
               "float3 MG_RotateAboutAxis(float3 axis, float angle, float3 pivot, float3 position) { axis = normalize(axis);\n"
               "  float3 closest = pivot + axis * dot(axis, position - pivot); float3 u = position - closest; float3 v = cross(axis, u);\n"
               "  float a = angle * 6.28318531; return closest + u * cos(a) + v * sin(a) - position; }\n"
               "float MG_NoiseCombine(int mode, float a, float b, float factor, int clampResult) { float result = a;\n"
               "  if (mode == 0) { result = lerp(a, b, factor); }\n"
               "  else if (mode == 9) { float t = saturate((b - a) / max(factor, 1e-4) * 0.5 + 0.5); t = t * t * (3 - 2 * t); result = lerp(a, b, t); }\n"
               "  else { float op = a; if (mode == 1) op = a + b; else if (mode == 2) op = a - b; else if (mode == 3) op = a * b;\n"
               "    else if (mode == 4) op = 1 - (1 - a) * (1 - b); else if (mode == 5) op = a < 0.5 ? 2 * a * b : 1 - 2 * (1 - a) * (1 - b);\n"
               "    else if (mode == 6) op = min(a, b); else if (mode == 7) op = max(a, b); else if (mode == 8) op = abs(a - b);\n"
               "    result = lerp(a, op, factor); }\n"
               "  return clampResult != 0 ? saturate(result) : result; }\n"
               "float MG_ConvertHeight(float4 c, int channel, int invert, float contrast, float bias) {\n"
               "  float v = channel == 1 ? (c.r + c.g + c.b) / 3 : channel == 2 ? c.r : channel == 3 ? c.g : channel == 4 ? c.b :\n"
               "            channel == 5 ? c.a : channel == 6 ? max(c.r, max(c.g, c.b)) : dot(c.rgb, float3(0.2126, 0.7152, 0.0722));\n"
               "  v = saturate(v); v = invert != 0 ? 1 - v : v; return saturate((v - 0.5) * contrast + 0.5 + bias); }\n"
               "float MG_ConvertTap(Texture2D<float4> t, SamplerState s, float2 uv, int channel, int invert, float contrast, float bias) {\n"
               "  return MG_ConvertHeight(t.SampleLevel(s, uv, 0), channel, invert, contrast, bias); }\n"
               "float3 MG_ConvertNormal(Texture2D<float4> t, SamplerState s, float2 uv, int channel, int invert, float contrast, float bias,\n"
               "  float strength, float radius, int sobel) { float r = max(radius, 1e-5); float dx, dy;\n"
               "  float l = MG_ConvertTap(t, s, uv + float2(-r, 0), channel, invert, contrast, bias); float rr = MG_ConvertTap(t, s, uv + float2(r, 0), channel, invert, contrast, bias);\n"
               "  float u = MG_ConvertTap(t, s, uv + float2(0, -r), channel, invert, contrast, bias); float d = MG_ConvertTap(t, s, uv + float2(0, r), channel, invert, contrast, bias);\n"
               "  if (sobel != 0) {\n"
               "    float lu = MG_ConvertTap(t, s, uv + float2(-r, -r), channel, invert, contrast, bias); float ru = MG_ConvertTap(t, s, uv + float2(r, -r), channel, invert, contrast, bias);\n"
               "    float ld = MG_ConvertTap(t, s, uv + float2(-r, r), channel, invert, contrast, bias); float rd = MG_ConvertTap(t, s, uv + float2(r, r), channel, invert, contrast, bias);\n"
               "    dx = ((ru - lu) + (rr - l) * 2 + (rd - ld)) * 0.25; dy = ((ld - lu) + (d - u) * 2 + (rd - ru)) * 0.25; }\n"
               "  else { dx = rr - l; dy = d - u; }\n"
               "  return normalize(float3(-dx * strength, -dy * strength, 1)); }\n"
               "float3 MG_ThreeColorRamp(float t, float3 a, float3 b, float3 c) { return t < 0.5 ? lerp(a, b, t * 2) : lerp(b, c, (t - 0.5) * 2); }\n"
               "float4 MG_SolidTriplanar(Texture2D<float4> t, SamplerState s, float3 p, float3 n, float sharpness) {\n"
               "  float3 w = pow(abs(n) + 1e-5, max(sharpness, 0.01)); w /= dot(w, 1);\n"
               "  return t.Sample(s, p.yz) * w.x + t.Sample(s, p.xz) * w.y + t.Sample(s, p.xy) * w.z; }\n"
               "float3 MG_BlackBody(float kelvin) { float t = clamp(kelvin, 1000, 40000) / 100; float3 c;\n"
               "  if (t <= 66) c = float3(255, 99.4708025861*log(t) - 161.1195681661, t <= 19 ? 0 : 138.5177312231*log(t-10) - 305.0447927307);\n"
               "  else c = float3(329.698727446*pow(t-60,-0.1332047592), 288.1221695283*pow(t-60,-0.0755148492), 255);\n"
               "  c = saturate(c / 255); return lerp(pow((c + 0.055) / 1.055, 2.4), c / 12.92, step(c, 0.04045)); }\n"
               "float4 MG_UnpackNormal(float4 v) { float3 n = v.xyz * 2 - 1; if (v.z <= 0) n.z = sqrt(saturate(1 - dot(n.xy,n.xy))); return float4(n, 1); }\n";
    }
} // namespace MaterialGraphMath

#include "pch.h"
#include "materialmanager.h"
#include "assetthumbnailmanager.h"
#include "texturemanager.h"
#include "noiseasset.h"
#include <cstring>
#include "modelmanager.h"
#include "world.h"
#include "materialsystem.h"
#include "graphicslog.h"
#include "gpuscene/gpuscenechanges.h"
#include <json/json.h>
#include <fstream>

namespace
{
    unordered_map<AssetHandle, unique_ptr<MaterialRuntime>> runtimes;
    AssetRegistry registry;
    bool sceneHasAssets = false;
}

bool SceneHasMaterialAssets()
{
    return sceneHasAssets;
}

AssetRegistry& MaterialManager::Registry()
{
    return registry;
}

void MaterialManager::Init()
{
    Refresh();
}

void MaterialManager::Shutdown()
{
    runtimes.clear();
    sceneHasAssets = false;
}

void MaterialManager::Refresh()
{
    string error;
    const bool refreshed = registry.Refresh(error);
    WriteGraphicsLog("Asset registry: root=%s, refreshed=%d\n", registry.Root().generic_string().c_str(), refreshed);
    if (!error.empty())
    {
        WriteGraphicsLog("Asset registry: %s\n", error.c_str());
    }
    for (auto& [handle, runtime] : runtimes)
    {
        const bool missing = registry.Resolve(handle).empty();
        if (missing != runtime->Missing)
        {
            runtime->Missing = missing;
            if (missing)
            {
                runtime->Error = "Missing material: " + FormatAssetHandle(handle);
                UpdateBinding(*runtime, MaterialAssetData{});
            }
            else
            {
                Revert(handle);
            }
        }
        // テクスチャの削除や移動では、保存済み GUID を変更せずにバインドを更新する。
        if (!missing)
        {
            UpdateBinding(*runtime, runtime->Editing);
        }
    }
}

MaterialRuntime& MaterialManager::GetRuntime(AssetHandle handle)
{
    const auto found = runtimes.find(handle);
    if (found != runtimes.end())
    {
        return *found->second;
    }
    auto runtime = make_unique<MaterialRuntime>();
    runtime->Handle = handle;
    const auto path = registry.Resolve(handle);
    if (handle != 0 && !path.empty() && registry.TypeOf(handle) == AssetType::Material)
    {
        MaterialSerializer::Load(path, runtime->Saved, runtime->Error);
    }
    else if (handle != 0)
    {
        runtime->Missing = true;
        runtime->Error = "Missing material: " + FormatAssetHandle(handle);
    }
    runtime->Editing = runtime->Saved;
    UpdateBinding(*runtime, runtime->Editing);
    auto& result = *runtime;
    runtimes.emplace(handle, move(runtime));
    return result;
}

const MaterialRuntime* MaterialManager::FindRuntime(AssetHandle handle)
{
    const auto found = runtimes.find(handle);
    return found == runtimes.end() ? nullptr : found->second.get();
}

MaterialComponent MaterialManager::BuildPreviewBinding(
    const MaterialAssetData& material, const array<int, static_cast<size_t>(MaterialTextureSlot::Count)>& descriptors)
{
    MaterialComponent binding;
    binding.ShaderClassMode = MaterialMode::Manual;
    binding.ShaderClass = ShaderClass::PBR;
    binding.BaseColor = XMFLOAT4(material.BaseColor.data());
    binding.Metallic = material.Metallic;
    binding.Roughness = material.Roughness;
    binding.ParallaxDepth = material.ParallaxDepth;
    binding.ParallaxSteps = material.ParallaxSteps;
    binding.NormalScale = material.NormalScale;
    binding.AOStrength = material.AOStrength;
    binding.EmissiveColor = XMFLOAT3(material.EmissiveColor.data());
    binding.EmissiveIntensity = material.EmissiveIntensity;
    // 旧アセットが Opaque を保存していても、光学的な透過があれば透明描画経路を選ぶ。
    // アルファ値は独立した被覆率として扱う。
    const bool opticalTransmission = material.Transmission > 0.0f;
    binding.AssetSurface = opticalTransmission ? MaterialSurface::Transparent : material.Surface;
    binding.IsTransparent = binding.AssetSurface == MaterialSurface::Transparent;
    binding.AssetCull = material.Cull;
    binding.AssetDepthWrite = binding.IsTransparent ? false : material.DepthWrite;
    binding.AlphaCutoff = material.AlphaCutoff;
    binding.ShadowMode = material.ShadowMode;
    binding.ShadowCutoff = material.ShadowCutoff;
    binding.IOR = material.IOR;
    binding.Transmission = material.Transmission;
    binding.TransmissionRoughness = material.TransmissionRoughness;
    const float dielectric = (material.IOR - 1.0f) / (material.IOR + 1.0f);
    binding.Fresnel = dielectric * dielectric;
    binding.Thickness = material.Thickness;
    binding.ShadingModel = material.ShadingModel;
    binding.ShadingStrength = material.ShadingStrength;
    binding.AbsorptionCoefficient = {material.AbsorptionCoefficient[0], material.AbsorptionCoefficient[1],
                                     material.AbsorptionCoefficient[2]};
    binding.DoubleSided = material.Cull == MaterialCull::None;
    binding.BaseSaturation = 1.0f;
    binding.TextureID = descriptors[0];
    binding.UseTexture = binding.TextureID >= 0;
    binding.NormalMapID = descriptors[1];
    binding.MetallicRoughnessID = descriptors[2];
    binding.AOTextureID = descriptors[3];
    binding.EmissiveTextureID = descriptors[4];
    binding.HeightTextureID = descriptors[5];
    return binding;
}

void MaterialManager::UpdateBinding(MaterialRuntime& runtime, const MaterialAssetData& material)
{
    array<int, static_cast<size_t>(MaterialTextureSlot::Count)> descriptors;
    descriptors.fill(-1);
    string sourceError;
    const auto noise = runtime.NoiseSources.Update(registry, material, sourceError);
    for (size_t slot = 0; slot < descriptors.size(); ++slot)
    {
        const auto path = registry.Resolve(material.Textures[slot]);
        if (!path.empty() && registry.TypeOf(material.Textures[slot]) == AssetType::Texture)
        {
            const auto previousHandle = runtime.BoundData.Textures[slot];
            const auto previousPath = runtime.TexturePaths[slot];
            if (previousHandle == material.Textures[slot] && previousPath == path &&
                runtime.TextureDescriptors[slot] >= 0)
            {
                descriptors[slot] = runtime.TextureDescriptors[slot];
            }
            else if (slot == static_cast<size_t>(MaterialTextureSlot::Normal))
            {
                descriptors[slot] = TextureManager::LoadNormalTexture(path.generic_string().c_str());
            }
            else
            {
                // シェーダーが参照するチャンネルに合わせて BC 形式を選ぶ。
                // MetallicRoughness は .rg（BC5）、AO と高さは .r（BC4）、ベースカラーとエミッシブは BC7。
                TextureUsage usage = TextureUsage::Color;
                if (slot == static_cast<size_t>(MaterialTextureSlot::MetallicRoughness))
                {
                    usage = TextureUsage::TwoChannel;
                }
                else if (slot == static_cast<size_t>(MaterialTextureSlot::AO) ||
                         slot == static_cast<size_t>(MaterialTextureSlot::Height))
                {
                    usage = TextureUsage::SingleChannel;
                }
                descriptors[slot] = TextureManager::LoadTexture(path, usage);
            }
            runtime.TexturePaths[slot] = path;
        }
        else
        {
            runtime.TexturePaths[slot].clear();
        }
    }
    auto binding = BuildPreviewBinding(material, descriptors);
    binding.RuntimeHandle = runtime.Handle;
    binding.Noise = noise;
    runtime.SourceError = sourceError;
    // リビジョン変更時は、共有マテリアルレコードとそのフレーム定数バッファだけを無効化する。
    if (runtime.Revision == 0 || runtime.Binding.BaseColor.x != binding.BaseColor.x || runtime.BoundData != material ||
        runtime.TextureDescriptors != descriptors ||
        std::memcmp(runtime.Binding.Noise.data(), noise.data(), sizeof(noise)) != 0)
    {
        if (runtime.Revision == 0 || runtime.BoundData.Cull != material.Cull ||
            runtime.BoundData.Surface != material.Surface || runtime.BoundData.DepthWrite != material.DepthWrite ||
            runtime.Binding.IsTransparent != binding.IsTransparent ||
            (material.Surface == MaterialSurface::Masked && (runtime.BoundData.AlphaCutoff != material.AlphaCutoff ||
                                                             runtime.BoundData.BaseColor[3] != material.BaseColor[3] ||
                                                             runtime.BoundData.Textures[0] != material.Textures[0] ||
                                                             runtime.TextureDescriptors[0] != descriptors[0])))
        {
            ++runtime.PipelineRevision;
        }
        runtime.Binding = move(binding);
        runtime.BoundData = material;
        runtime.TextureDescriptors = descriptors;
        ++runtime.Revision;
    }
}

AssetHandle MaterialManager::SlotHandle(const MaterialComponent& material, size_t slot)
{
    if (slot >= material.MaterialSlots.size())
    {
        return 0;
    }
    return material.MaterialSlots[slot];
}

const MaterialComponent& MaterialManager::Resolve(const MaterialComponent& legacy, size_t slot)
{
    const auto handle = SlotHandle(legacy, slot);
    if (handle == 0)
    {
        return legacy;
    }
    return GetRuntime(handle).Binding;
}

bool MaterialManager::SetEditing(AssetHandle handle, const MaterialAssetData& editing)
{
    auto& runtime = GetRuntime(handle);
    if (!MaterialSerializer::Validate(editing, runtime.Error) || runtime.Missing)
    {
        return false;
    }
    UpdateBinding(runtime, editing);
    runtime.Editing = editing;
    runtime.Dirty = runtime.Editing != runtime.Saved;
    AssetThumbnailManager::MarkDirty(handle);
    return true;
}

bool MaterialManager::Save(AssetHandle handle)
{
    auto& runtime = GetRuntime(handle);
    const auto path = registry.Resolve(handle);
    if (path.empty())
    {
        runtime.Error = "Cannot save a missing material";
        return false;
    }
    if (!MaterialSerializer::Save(path, runtime.Editing, runtime.Error))
    {
        return false;
    }
    runtime.Saved = runtime.Editing;
    runtime.Dirty = false;
    AssetThumbnailManager::MarkDirty(handle);
    return true;
}

bool MaterialManager::Revert(AssetHandle handle)
{
    auto& runtime = GetRuntime(handle);
    MaterialAssetData loaded;
    if (!MaterialSerializer::Load(registry.Resolve(handle), loaded, runtime.Error))
    {
        return false;
    }
    runtime.Saved = loaded;
    runtime.Missing = false;
    return SetEditing(handle, loaded);
}

bool MaterialManager::IsRenderable(EntityID entity)
{
    return ::Registry::IsAlive(entity) && ComponentManager::HasComponent<MaterialComponent>(entity) &&
           (ComponentManager::HasComponent<StaticModelComponent>(entity) ||
            ComponentManager::HasComponent<AnimationModelComponent>(entity) ||
            ComponentManager::HasComponent<MeshComponent>(entity) ||
            (ComponentManager::HasComponent<SpriteComponent>(entity) &&
             ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<SpriteComponent>(entity).Is3D));
}

void MaterialManager::Discard(AssetHandle handle)
{
    auto& runtime = GetRuntime(handle);
    runtime.Editing = runtime.Saved;
    runtime.Dirty = false;
    if (!runtime.Missing)
    {
        UpdateBinding(runtime, runtime.Saved);
    }
}

bool MaterialManager::HasSurfaceForPass(EntityID entity, bool transparent)
{
    if (!ComponentManager::HasComponent<MaterialComponent>(entity))
    {
        return !transparent;
    }
    const auto& source = ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<MaterialComponent>(entity);
    const auto count = max<size_t>(1, SlotCount(entity));
    for (size_t slot = 0; slot < count; ++slot)
    {
        if (MaterialSystem::IsTransparentMaterial(Resolve(source, slot)) == transparent)
        {
            return true;
        }
    }
    return false;
}

size_t MaterialManager::SlotCount(EntityID entity)
{
    if (!IsRenderable(entity))
    {
        return 0;
    }
    if (ComponentManager::HasComponent<StaticModelComponent>(entity))
    {
        const auto* model =
            ModelManager::GetStaticModel(ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<StaticModelComponent>(entity).ModelId);
        if (model)
        {
            return model->GetMeshCount();
        }
    }
    if (ComponentManager::HasComponent<AnimationModelComponent>(entity))
    {
        const auto* model = ModelManager::GetAnimModel(
            ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<AnimationModelComponent>(entity).ModelId);
        if (model)
        {
            return model->GetMeshCount();
        }
    }
    return 1;
}

bool MaterialManager::Assign(EntityID entity, size_t slot, AssetHandle handle)
{
    if (!IsRenderable(entity) || slot >= SlotCount(entity) ||
        (handle != 0 && registry.TypeOf(handle) != AssetType::Material))
    {
        return false;
    }
    auto& component = ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<MaterialComponent>(entity);
    component.MaterialSlots.resize(SlotCount(entity));
    component.MaterialSlots[slot] = handle;
    if (all_of(component.MaterialSlots.begin(), component.MaterialSlots.end(), [](AssetHandle assigned) {
            return assigned == 0;
        }))
    {
        component.MaterialSlots.clear();
    }
    NotifyAssignmentsChanged();
    GpuSceneChanges::Notify(entity, GpuSceneDirtyFlags::Material);
    return true;
}

void MaterialManager::NotifyAssignmentsChanged()
{
    sceneHasAssets = false;
    for (EntityID entity : World::GetView<MaterialComponent>())
    {
        const auto& slots = ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<MaterialComponent>(entity).MaterialSlots;
        if (any_of(slots.begin(), slots.end(), [](AssetHandle handle) {
                return handle != 0;
            }))
        {
            sceneHasAssets = true;
            return;
        }
    }
}

===== FILE: source\assets\materialmanager.h =====
#pragma once
#include "assetregistry.h"
#include "noiseasset.h"
#include "componentmanager.h"
#include <functional>

struct MaterialRuntime
{
    AssetHandle Handle = 0;
    MaterialAssetData Saved;
    MaterialAssetData Editing;
    MaterialAssetData BoundData;
    array<filesystem::path, static_cast<size_t>(MaterialTextureSlot::Count)> TexturePaths;
    array<int, static_cast<size_t>(MaterialTextureSlot::Count)> TextureDescriptors{-1, -1, -1, -1, -1, -1};
    MaterialNoiseSources NoiseSources;
    MaterialComponent Binding;
    uint64_t Revision = 0;
    uint64_t PipelineRevision = 0;
    bool Dirty = false;
    bool Missing = false;
    string Error;
    string SourceError;
    // グラフィックスのフェンス完了後、終了処理まで生存させる。
    ComPtr<ID3D12Resource> Constants;
    uint8_t* MappedConstants = nullptr;
    array<uint64_t, 3> UploadedRevision{};
};

class MaterialManager
{
  public:
    static AssetRegistry& Registry();
    static void Init();
    static void Shutdown();
    static void Refresh();
    static MaterialRuntime& GetRuntime(AssetHandle handle);
    static const MaterialRuntime* FindRuntime(AssetHandle handle);
    static MaterialComponent BuildPreviewBinding(
        const MaterialAssetData& material,
        const array<int, static_cast<size_t>(MaterialTextureSlot::Count)>& descriptors);
    static const MaterialComponent& Resolve(const MaterialComponent& legacy, size_t slot = 0);
    static AssetHandle SlotHandle(const MaterialComponent& material, size_t slot);
    static bool SetEditing(AssetHandle handle, const MaterialAssetData& editing);
    static bool Save(AssetHandle handle);
    static bool Revert(AssetHandle handle);
    static void Discard(AssetHandle handle);
    static bool HasSurfaceForPass(EntityID entity, bool transparent);
    static size_t SlotCount(EntityID entity);
    static bool IsRenderable(EntityID entity);
    static bool Assign(EntityID entity, size_t slot, AssetHandle handle);
    static void NotifyAssignmentsChanged();
    static bool SaveSceneReferences(const filesystem::path& path, string& error);
    static bool LoadSceneReferences(const filesystem::path& path, string& error);

  private:
    static void UpdateBinding(MaterialRuntime& runtime, const MaterialAssetData& material);
};

===== FILE: source\assets\materialscenereferences.cpp =====
#include "pch.h"
#include "materialmanager.h"
#include "modelmanager.h"
#include "primitivegeometry.h"
#include "world.h"
#include "gpuscene/gpuscenechanges.h"
#include <json/json.h>
#include <fstream>
#include <cmath>

namespace
{
    Json::Value WriteVector(const XMFLOAT3& vector)
    {
        Json::Value result(Json::arrayValue);
        result.append(vector.x);
        result.append(vector.y);
        result.append(vector.z);
        return result;
    }

    bool IsFiniteArray(const Json::Value& array, Json::ArrayIndex length)
    {
        if (!array.isArray() || array.size() != length)
        {
            return false;
        }
        for (const auto& value : array)
        {
            if (!value.isNumeric() || !isfinite(value.asFloat()))
            {
                return false;
            }
        }
        return true;
    }

    XMFLOAT3 ReadVector(const Json::Value& vector)
    {
        return {vector[0].asFloat(), vector[1].asFloat(), vector[2].asFloat()};
    }

    bool ValidHandle(const Json::Value& reference)
    {
        return reference.isString() &&
               (ParseAssetHandle(reference.asString()) != 0 || reference.asString() == FormatAssetHandle(0));
    }

    bool ValidateRecord(const Json::Value& record)
    {
        if (!record.isObject() || !record["entity"].isUInt() || !record["materialSlots"].isArray() ||
            record["materialSlots"].size() > 4096 || (record.isMember("name") && !record["name"].isString()))
        {
            return false;
        }
        for (const auto& reference : record["materialSlots"])
        {
            if (!ValidHandle(reference))
            {
                return false;
            }
        }
        if (record.isMember("identity") && !ValidHandle(record["identity"]))
        {
            return false;
        }
        if (record.isMember("transform"))
        {
            for (const char* property : {"position", "rotation", "scale"})
            {
                if (!IsFiniteArray(record["transform"][property], 3))
                {
                    return false;
                }
            }
        }
        if (record.isMember("modelPath") &&
            (!record["modelPath"].isString() || !record["animated"].isBool() || !record["convert"].isBool()))
        {
            return false;
        }
        if (record.isMember("vertices"))
        {
            if (!record["vertices"].isArray() || record["vertices"].size() > 1000000)
            {
                return false;
            }
            for (const auto& vertex : record["vertices"])
            {
                if (!IsFiniteArray(vertex, 12))
                {
                    return false;
                }
            }
        }
        return true;
    }

    bool MatchesSavedSource(const Json::Value& record, EntityID entity)
    {
        if (!MaterialManager::IsRenderable(entity) || !record["name"].isString() ||
            !ComponentManager::HasComponent<NameComponent>(entity) ||
            ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<NameComponent>(entity).Name != record["name"].asString())
        {
            return false;
        }
        if (record["modelPath"].isString())
        {
            if (record["animated"].asBool())
            {
                return ComponentManager::HasComponent<AnimationModelComponent>(entity) &&
                       ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<AnimationModelComponent>(entity).ModelPath ==
                           record["modelPath"].asString();
            }
            return ComponentManager::HasComponent<StaticModelComponent>(entity) &&
                   ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<StaticModelComponent>(entity).ModelPath ==
                       record["modelPath"].asString();
        }
        if (!record["meshSignature"].isString() || !ComponentManager::HasComponent<MeshComponent>(entity))
        {
            return false;
        }
        return FormatAssetHandle(ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<MeshComponent>(entity).GeometryHash) ==
               record["meshSignature"].asString();
    }
}

bool MaterialManager::SaveSceneReferences(const filesystem::path& path, string& error)
{
    Json::Value root;
    root["version"] = 1;
    root["entities"] = Json::Value(Json::arrayValue);
    for (EntityID entity : World::GetView<MaterialComponent>())
    {
        auto& component = ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<MaterialComponent>(entity);
        if (component.MaterialSlots.empty())
        {
            continue;
        }
        if (component.MaterialSceneIdentity == 0)
        {
            component.MaterialSceneIdentity = GenerateAssetHandle();
        }
        Json::Value record;
        record["entity"] = entity;
        record["identity"] = FormatAssetHandle(component.MaterialSceneIdentity);
        if (ComponentManager::HasComponent<NameComponent>(entity))
        {
            record["name"] = ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<NameComponent>(entity).Name;
        }
        if (ComponentManager::HasComponent<TransformComponent>(entity))
        {
            const auto& transform = ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<TransformComponent>(entity);
            record["transform"]["position"] = WriteVector(transform.Position);
            record["transform"]["rotation"] = WriteVector(transform.Rotation);
            record["transform"]["scale"] = WriteVector(transform.Scale);
        }
        if (ComponentManager::HasComponent<StaticModelComponent>(entity))
        {
            const auto& model = ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<StaticModelComponent>(entity);
            record["modelPath"] = model.ModelPath;
            record["animated"] = false;
            record["convert"] = model.IsConvert;
        }
        else if (ComponentManager::HasComponent<AnimationModelComponent>(entity))
        {
            const auto& model = ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<AnimationModelComponent>(entity);
            record["modelPath"] = model.ModelPath;
            record["animated"] = true;
            record["convert"] = model.IsConvert;
        }
        else if (ComponentManager::HasComponent<MeshComponent>(entity))
        {
            const auto& mesh = ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<MeshComponent>(entity);
            record["meshSignature"] = FormatAssetHandle(mesh.GeometryHash);
            if (mesh.NaniteMesh)
            {
                record["vertices"] = Json::Value(Json::arrayValue);
                for (const auto& vertex : mesh.NaniteMesh->CpuVertices)
                {
                    Json::Value encoded(Json::arrayValue);
                    for (float number : {vertex.Position.x, vertex.Position.y, vertex.Position.z, vertex.Normal.x,
                                         vertex.Normal.y, vertex.Normal.z, vertex.TexCoord.x, vertex.TexCoord.y,
                                         vertex.Diffuse.x, vertex.Diffuse.y, vertex.Diffuse.z, vertex.Diffuse.w})
                    {
                        encoded.append(number);
                    }
                    record["vertices"].append(encoded);
                }
            }
        }
        record["materialSlots"] = Json::Value(Json::arrayValue);
        for (const auto handle : component.MaterialSlots)
        {
            record["materialSlots"].append(FormatAssetHandle(handle));
        }
        root["entities"].append(record);
    }
    Json::StreamWriterBuilder writer;
    return WriteAssetFile(path, Json::writeString(writer, root), error);
}

bool MaterialManager::LoadSceneReferences(const filesystem::path& path, string& error)
{
    error.clear();
    ifstream stream(path);
    if (!stream)
    {
        return true;
    }
    Json::Value root;
    Json::CharReaderBuilder reader;
    reader["rejectDupKeys"] = true;
    if (!Json::parseFromStream(reader, stream, &root, &error) || root["version"] != 1 || !root["entities"].isArray() ||
        root["entities"].size() > g_kMAX_ENTITIES)
    {
        error = "Invalid scene material reference file: " + error;
        return false;
    }
    // エンティティを変更する前にドキュメント全体を検証する。
    for (const auto& record : root["entities"])
    {
        if (!ValidateRecord(record))
        {
            error = "Invalid scene material record";
            return false;
        }
    }
    for (const auto& record : root["entities"])
    {
        EntityID entity = g_kINVALID_ENTITY;
        const auto identity = ParseAssetHandle(record["identity"].asString());
        if (identity != 0)
        {
            for (EntityID candidate : World::GetView<MaterialComponent>())
            {
                if (ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<MaterialComponent>(candidate).MaterialSceneIdentity ==
                    identity)
                {
                    entity = candidate;
                    break;
                }
            }
        }
        if (entity == g_kINVALID_ENTITY)
        {
            EntityID match = g_kINVALID_ENTITY;
            bool ambiguous = false;
            for (EntityID candidate : World::GetView<MaterialComponent>())
            {
                const auto& existing = ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<MaterialComponent>(candidate);
                if (existing.MaterialSceneIdentity == 0 && MatchesSavedSource(record, candidate))
                {
                    if (match != g_kINVALID_ENTITY)
                    {
                        ambiguous = true;
                    }
                    match = candidate;
                }
            }
            if (!ambiguous)
            {
                entity = match;
            }
        }
        if (entity == g_kINVALID_ENTITY)
        {
            auto restored =
                World::CreateEntity().Add<TransformComponent>().Add<MaterialComponent>().Add<NameComponent>();
            if (!restored.IsValid())
            {
                error = "Scene entity capacity exceeded";
                return false;
            }
            entity = restored.GetID();
            if (record.isMember("modelPath") && !record["modelPath"].asString().empty())
            {
                const auto modelPath = record["modelPath"].asString();
                const bool convert = record["convert"].asBool();
                if (record["animated"].asBool())
                {
                    restored.Add<AnimationModelComponent>();
                    auto& model = restored.Get<AnimationModelComponent>();
                    model.ModelId = ModelManager::LoadAnimModel(modelPath.c_str(), convert);
                    model.ModelPath = modelPath;
                    model.IsConvert = convert;
                }
                else
                {
                    restored.Add<StaticModelComponent>();
                    auto& model = restored.Get<StaticModelComponent>();
                    model.ModelId = ModelManager::LoadStaticModel(modelPath.c_str(), convert);
                    model.ModelPath = modelPath;
                    model.IsConvert = convert;
                }
            }
            else if (record.isMember("vertices") && !record["vertices"].empty())
            {
                restored.Add<MeshComponent>();
                vector<Vertex> vertices;
                for (const auto& encoded : record["vertices"])
                {
                    vertices.push_back(
                        {{encoded[0].asFloat(), encoded[1].asFloat(), encoded[2].asFloat()},
                         {encoded[3].asFloat(), encoded[4].asFloat(), encoded[5].asFloat()},
                         {encoded[6].asFloat(), encoded[7].asFloat()},
                         {encoded[8].asFloat(), encoded[9].asFloat(), encoded[10].asFloat(), encoded[11].asFloat()}});
                }
                if (!PrimitiveGeometry::UploadVertices(entity, vertices))
                {
                    error = "Failed to restore scene mesh";
                    World::DestroyEntity(restored);
                    return false;
                }
            }
            else
            {
                World::DestroyEntity(restored);
                error = "Scene material entity is missing its mesh source";
                return false;
            }
        }
        if (record.isMember("name") && ComponentManager::HasComponent<NameComponent>(entity))
        {
            ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<NameComponent>(entity).Name = record["name"].asString();
        }
        if (record.isMember("transform") && ComponentManager::HasComponent<TransformComponent>(entity))
        {
            auto& transform = ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<TransformComponent>(entity);
            transform.Position = ReadVector(record["transform"]["position"]);
            transform.Rotation = ReadVector(record["transform"]["rotation"]);
            transform.Scale = ReadVector(record["transform"]["scale"]);
            transform.IsDirty = true;
        }
        auto& component = ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<MaterialComponent>(entity);
        component.MaterialSceneIdentity = identity;
        component.MaterialSlots.clear();
        for (const auto& reference : record["materialSlots"])
        {
            component.MaterialSlots.push_back(ParseAssetHandle(reference.asString()));
        }
        GpuSceneChanges::Notify(entity, GpuSceneDirtyFlags::All);
    }
    NotifyAssignmentsChanged();
    return true;
}

===== FILE: source\assets\noiseasset.cpp =====
#include "noiseasset.h"
#include "materialasset.h"
#include <json/json.h>
#include <cmath>
#include <fstream>
#include <limits>
#include <type_traits>

namespace
{
    template <class T> bool Read(const Json::Value& object, const char* key, T& out, std::string& error)
    {
        if (!object.isMember(key))
        {
            return true;
        }
        const auto& value = object[key];
        bool valid = false;
        if constexpr (std::is_enum_v<T>)
        {
            valid = value.isInt();
            if (valid)
            {
                out = static_cast<T>(value.asInt());
            }
        }
        else if constexpr (std::is_same_v<T, bool>)
        {
            valid = value.isBool();
            if (valid)
            {
                out = value.asBool();
            }
        }
        else if constexpr (std::is_same_v<T, uint32_t>)
        {
            valid = value.isUInt();
            if (valid)
            {
                out = value.asUInt();
            }
        }
        else if constexpr (std::is_integral_v<T>)
        {
            valid = value.isInt();
            if (valid)
            {
                out = value.asInt();
            }
        }
        else
        {
            valid = value.isNumeric() && std::isfinite(value.asDouble()) &&
                    std::abs(value.asDouble()) <= std::numeric_limits<float>::max();
            if (valid)
            {
                out = value.asFloat();
            }
        }
        if (!valid)
        {
            error = std::string("Invalid .noise property: ") + key;
        }
        return valid;
    }

    bool ReadColor(const Json::Value& root, const char* key, std::array<float, 3>& color, std::string& error)
    {
        if (!root.isMember(key))
        {
            return true;
        }
        const auto& value = root[key];
        if (!value.isArray() || value.size() != 3)
        {
            error = std::string("Invalid .noise color: ") + key;
            return false;
        }
        for (Json::ArrayIndex i = 0; i < 3; ++i)
        {
            if (!value[i].isNumeric() || !std::isfinite(value[i].asDouble()) || value[i].asDouble() < 0 ||
                value[i].asDouble() > 1)
            {
                error = std::string("Invalid .noise color channel: ") + key;
                return false;
            }
            color[i] = value[i].asFloat();
        }
        return true;
    }
}

bool NoiseSerializer::Validate(const ProcStudio::TextureParams& p, std::string& error)
{
    using namespace ProcStudio;
    error.clear();
    const auto range = [&](double value, double low, double high, const char* name) {
        if (!std::isfinite(value) || value < low || value > high)
        {
            error = std::string("Invalid .noise parameter: ") + name;
            return false;
        }
        return true;
    };
    if (p.Kind == TextureKind::Mandelbrot || p.Kind == TextureKind::Julia)
    {
        error = "Mandelbrot / Julia require CPU image export; .noise supports GPU procedural patterns.";
        return false;
    }
    if (!range(static_cast<int>(p.Kind), 0, static_cast<int>(TextureKind::Count) - 1, "Kind"))
    {
        return false;
    }
    if (!range(static_cast<int>(p.Output), 0, static_cast<int>(TextureOutput::Count) - 1, "Output"))
    {
        return false;
    }
    if (!range(static_cast<int>(p.Pattern), 0, static_cast<int>(GeometricPattern::Count) - 1, "Pattern"))
    {
        return false;
    }
    if (!range(static_cast<int>(p.Noise.BasisType), 0, static_cast<int>(Basis::Count) - 1, "Noise.BasisType"))
    {
        return false;
    }
    if (!range(static_cast<int>(p.Noise.Fractal), 0, static_cast<int>(FractalType::Count) - 1, "Noise.Fractal"))
    {
        return false;
    }
    if (!range(p.Noise.Frequency, 0.001, 64, "Noise.Frequency"))
    {
        return false;
    }
    if (!range(p.Noise.Octaves, 1, 10, "Noise.Octaves"))
    {
        return false;
    }
    if (!range(p.Noise.Lacunarity, 1, 4, "Noise.Lacunarity"))
    {
        return false;
    }
    if (!range(p.Noise.Gain, 0, 1, "Noise.Gain"))
    {
        return false;
    }
    if (!range(p.Noise.WarpStrength, 0, 4, "Noise.WarpStrength"))
    {
        return false;
    }
    if (!range(p.Noise.RidgeOffset, 0, 2, "Noise.RidgeOffset"))
    {
        return false;
    }
    if (!range(p.Noise.Direction, -10000, 10000, "Noise.Direction"))
    {
        return false;
    }
    if (!range(p.Noise.Phase, -10000, 10000, "Noise.Phase"))
    {
        return false;
    }
    if (!range(p.Noise.Anisotropy, 1, 8, "Noise.Anisotropy"))
    {
        return false;
    }
    if (!range(p.Noise.KernelFrequency, 0.01, 8, "Noise.KernelFrequency"))
    {
        return false;
    }
    if (!range(p.Contrast, 0, 10, "Contrast"))
    {
        return false;
    }
    if (!range(p.Bias, -1, 1, "Bias"))
    {
        return false;
    }
    if (!range(p.Turbulence, 0, 20, "Turbulence"))
    {
        return false;
    }
    if (!range(p.RingCount, 1, 64, "RingCount"))
    {
        return false;
    }
    if (!range(p.BricksX, 1, 128, "BricksX"))
    {
        return false;
    }
    if (!range(p.BricksY, 1, 128, "BricksY"))
    {
        return false;
    }
    if (!range(p.RepeatX, 1, 128, "RepeatX"))
    {
        return false;
    }
    if (!range(p.RepeatY, 1, 128, "RepeatY"))
    {
        return false;
    }
    if (!range(p.Mortar, 0, 0.5, "Mortar"))
    {
        return false;
    }
    if (!range(p.PatternSize, 0.01, 1, "PatternSize"))
    {
        return false;
    }
    if (!range(p.PatternSoftness, 1e-05, 1, "PatternSoftness"))
    {
        return false;
    }
    if (!range(p.Time, -1000000.0, 1000000.0, "Time"))
    {
        return false;
    }
    if (!range(p.Choppiness, 0, 1, "Choppiness"))
    {
        return false;
    }
    if (!range(p.Coverage, 0, 1, "Coverage"))
    {
        return false;
    }
    if (!range(p.Softness, 1e-05, 1, "Softness"))
    {
        return false;
    }
    if (!range(p.NormalStrength, 0, 64, "NormalStrength"))
    {
        return false;
    }
    if (!range(p.CenterX, -10000000000.0, 10000000000.0, "CenterX"))
    {
        return false;
    }
    if (!range(p.CenterY, -10000000000.0, 10000000000.0, "CenterY"))
    {
        return false;
    }
    if (!range(p.Zoom, 1e-06, 10000000000.0, "Zoom"))
    {
        return false;
    }
    if (!range(p.JuliaX, -100, 100, "JuliaX"))
    {
        return false;
    }
    if (!range(p.JuliaY, -100, 100, "JuliaY"))
    {
        return false;
    }
    if (!range(p.Iterations, 1, 10000, "Iterations"))
    {
        return false;
    }
    for (const auto& color : {p.ColorA, p.ColorB, p.ColorC})
    {
        for (float channel : color)
        {
            if (!range(channel, 0, 1, "color"))
            {
                return false;
            }
        }
    }
    return true;
}

std::string NoiseSerializer::Encode(const ProcStudio::TextureParams& p)
{
    Json::Value root(Json::objectValue);
    root["version"] = 1;
    root["kind"] = static_cast<int>(p.Kind);
    root["output"] = static_cast<int>(p.Output);
    root["tileable"] = p.Tileable;
    root["contrast"] = p.Contrast;
    root["bias"] = p.Bias;
    root["turbulence"] = p.Turbulence;
    root["ringCount"] = p.RingCount;
    root["mortar"] = p.Mortar;
    root["patternSize"] = p.PatternSize;
    root["patternSoftness"] = p.PatternSoftness;
    root["time"] = p.Time;
    root["choppiness"] = p.Choppiness;
    root["coverage"] = p.Coverage;
    root["softness"] = p.Softness;
    root["centerX"] = p.CenterX;
    root["centerY"] = p.CenterY;
    root["zoom"] = p.Zoom;
    root["juliaX"] = p.JuliaX;
    root["juliaY"] = p.JuliaY;
    root["normalStrength"] = p.NormalStrength;
    root["bricksX"] = p.BricksX;
    root["bricksY"] = p.BricksY;
    root["repeatX"] = p.RepeatX;
    root["repeatY"] = p.RepeatY;
    root["iterations"] = p.Iterations;
    root["pattern"] = static_cast<int>(p.Pattern);
    root["noise"]["basis"] = static_cast<int>(p.Noise.BasisType);
    root["noise"]["fractal"] = static_cast<int>(p.Noise.Fractal);
    root["noise"]["seed"] = p.Noise.Seed;
    root["noise"]["octaves"] = p.Noise.Octaves;
    root["noise"]["frequency"] = p.Noise.Frequency;
    root["noise"]["lacunarity"] = p.Noise.Lacunarity;
    root["noise"]["gain"] = p.Noise.Gain;
    root["noise"]["warpStrength"] = p.Noise.WarpStrength;
    root["noise"]["ridgeOffset"] = p.Noise.RidgeOffset;
    root["noise"]["direction"] = p.Noise.Direction;
    root["noise"]["anisotropy"] = p.Noise.Anisotropy;
    root["noise"]["kernelFrequency"] = p.Noise.KernelFrequency;
    root["noise"]["phase"] = p.Noise.Phase;
    for (float channel : p.ColorA)
    {
        root["colorA"].append(channel);
    }
    for (float channel : p.ColorB)
    {
        root["colorB"].append(channel);
    }
    for (float channel : p.ColorC)
    {
        root["colorC"].append(channel);
    }
    Json::StreamWriterBuilder writer;
    writer["indentation"] = "  ";
    writer["precision"] = 9;
    return Json::writeString(writer, root) + "\n";
}

bool NoiseSerializer::Load(const std::filesystem::path& path, ProcStudio::TextureParams& params, std::string& error)
{
    error.clear();
    std::error_code sizeError;
    const auto bytes = std::filesystem::file_size(path, sizeError);
    if (sizeError || bytes > 65536)
    {
        error = "Missing or oversized .noise definition: " + path.generic_string();
        return false;
    }
    std::ifstream stream(path, std::ios::binary);
    Json::Value root;
    Json::CharReaderBuilder reader;
    reader["rejectDupKeys"] = true;
    reader["failIfExtra"] = true;
    if (!Json::parseFromStream(reader, stream, &root, &error))
    {
        return false;
    }
    if (!root.isObject() || !root["version"].isInt() || root["version"].asInt() != 1)
    {
        error = "Unsupported .noise version (expected 1)";
        return false;
    }
    ProcStudio::TextureParams loaded;
    if (!Read(root, "kind", loaded.Kind, error))
    {
        return false;
    }
    if (!Read(root, "output", loaded.Output, error))
    {
        return false;
    }
    if (!Read(root, "tileable", loaded.Tileable, error))
    {
        return false;

        return false;

        return false;

    if (!Read(root, "turbulence", loaded.Turbulence, error))
    {
        return false;
    }
    if (!Read(root, "ringCount", loaded.RingCount, error))
    {
        return false;
    }
    if (!Read(root, "mortar", loaded.Mortar, error))
    {
        return false;
    }
    if (!Read(root, "patternSize", loaded.PatternSize, error))
    {
        return false;
    }
    if (!Read(root, "patternSoftness", loaded.PatternSoftness, error))
    {
        return false;
    }
    if (!Read(root, "time", loaded.Time, error))
    {
        return false;
    }
    if (!Read(root, "choppiness", loaded.Choppiness, error))

        return false;

    if (!Read(root, "coverage", loaded.Coverage, error))

    if (!Read(root, "softness", loaded.Softness, error))

    if (!Read(root, "centerX", loaded.CenterX, error))
    {
        return false;
    }
    if (!Read(root, "centerY", loaded.CenterY, error))
    {
        return false;
    }
    if (!Read(root, "zoom", loaded.Zoom, error))
    {
        return false;
    }
    if (!Read(root, "juliaX", loaded.JuliaX, error))
    {
        return false;
    }
    if (!Read(root, "juliaY", loaded.JuliaY, error))
    {
        return false;
    }
    if (!Read(root, "normalStrength", loaded.NormalStrength, error))
    {
        return false;
    }
    if (!Read(root, "bricksX", loaded.BricksX, error))
    {
        return false;
    }
    if (!Read(root, "bricksY", loaded.BricksY, error))
    {
        return false;

    if (!Read(root, "repeatX", loaded.RepeatX, error))
    {
        return false;
    }
    if (!Read(root, "repeatY", loaded.RepeatY, error))
    {
        return false;
    }
    if (!Read(root, "iterations", loaded.Iterations, error))
    {
        return false;
    }
    if (!Read(root, "pattern", loaded.Pattern, error))
    {
        return false;
    }
    if (root.isMember("noise") && !root["noise"].isObject())
    {
        error = "Invalid .noise settings object";
        return false;

    {

    {
        return false;

    if (!Read(noise, "lacunarity", loaded.Noise.Lacunarity, error))
    {
        return false;
    }
    if (!Read(noise, "gain", loaded.Noise.Gain, error))
    {
        return false;
    }
    if (!Read(noise, "warpStrength", loaded.Noise.WarpStrength, error))
    {
        return false;
    }
    if (!Read(noise, "ridgeOffset", loaded.Noise.RidgeOffset, error))
    {
        return false;
    }
    if (!Read(noise, "direction", loaded.Noise.Direction, error))
    {
        return false;
    }
    if (!Read(noise, "anisotropy", loaded.Noise.Anisotropy, error))
    {
