    }
    if (!Read(noise, "kernelFrequency", loaded.Noise.KernelFrequency, error))

        return false;
    }
    if (!Read(noise, "phase", loaded.Noise.Phase, error))
    {
        return false;
    }
    if (!ReadColor(root, "colorA", loaded.ColorA, error))
    {
        return false;
    }
    if (!ReadColor(root, "colorB", loaded.ColorB, error))
    {
        return false;
    }
    if (!ReadColor(root, "colorC", loaded.ColorC, error))
    {
        return false;
    }
    if (!Validate(loaded, error))
    {
        return false;
    }
    params = loaded;
    return true;
}

bool NoiseSerializer::Save(const std::filesystem::path& path, const ProcStudio::TextureParams& params,
                           std::string& error)
{
    return Validate(params, error) && WriteAssetFile(path, Encode(params), error);
}

std::array<ProcStudio::TextureGpuParams, 3> MaterialNoiseSources::Update(const AssetRegistry& registry,
                                                                         const MaterialAssetData& material,
                                                                         std::string& error)
{
    error.clear();
    std::array<ProcStudio::TextureGpuParams, 3> result{};
    constexpr size_t slots[] = {0, 1, 5};
    for (size_t channel = 0; channel < 3; ++channel)
    {
        auto& cached = m_Sources[channel];
        const auto handle = material.Textures[slots[channel]];
        if (handle && registry.TypeOf(handle) == AssetType::Unknown)
        {
            cached = {};
            error += "Missing material source: " + FormatAssetHandle(handle) + "\n";
            continue;
        }
        if (!handle || registry.TypeOf(handle) != AssetType::Noise)
        {
            cached = {};
            continue;
        }
        const auto path = registry.Resolve(handle);
        std::error_code timeError;
        const auto time = std::filesystem::last_write_time(path, timeError);
        if (timeError || path.empty())
        {
            cached = {};
            error += "Missing .noise definition: " + FormatAssetHandle(handle) + "\n";
            continue;
        }
        if (cached.Handle == handle && cached.Path == path && cached.Time == time && cached.Parameters.Width)
        {
            result[channel] = cached.Parameters;
            continue;
        }
        ProcStudio::TextureParams definition;
        std::string loadError;
        if (!NoiseSerializer::Load(path, definition, loadError))
        {
            cached = {};
            error += path.filename().generic_string() + ": " + loadError + "\n";
            continue;
        }
        auto parameters = ProcStudio::MakeTextureGpuParams(definition);
        parameters.Width = 1; // Material enable flag; never an image resolution.
        cached = {handle, path, time, parameters};
        result[channel] = parameters;
    }
    for (size_t slot : {size_t{2}, size_t{3}, size_t{4}})
    {
        if (registry.TypeOf(material.Textures[slot]) == AssetType::Noise)
        {
            error += ".noise is supported only in Base Color, Normal and Height (POM).\n";
        }
    }
    return result;
}

===== FILE: source\assets\texturecachecodec.h =====
#pragma once
#include "../../External/zstd/zstd.h"
#include <array>
#include <cstdint>
#include <new>
#include <vector>

namespace TextureCacheCodec
{
    constexpr uint64_t Magic = 0x003154535A534444ull; // DDSZST1 + NUL, little-endian.
    constexpr uint64_t MinDdsBytes = 136;
    constexpr uint64_t MaxDdsBytes = 256ull * 1024 * 1024;
    constexpr uint64_t HeaderBytes = 32;

    struct Header
    {
        uint64_t rawBytes = 0, storedBytes = 0, checksum = 0;
    };
    enum class DecodeResult
    {
        Success,
        Invalid,
        AllocationFailure
    };

    inline uint64_t Hash(const void* data, size_t size)
    {
        uint64_t hash = 14695981039346656037ull;
        const auto* bytes = static_cast<const uint8_t*>(data);
        for (size_t index = 0; index < size; ++index)
        {
            hash ^= bytes[index];
            hash *= 1099511628211ull;
        }
        return hash;
    }

    inline bool ValidSizes(const Header& header)
    {
        return header.rawBytes >= MinDdsBytes && header.rawBytes <= MaxDdsBytes && header.storedBytes > 0 &&
               header.storedBytes <= header.rawBytes;
    }

    inline bool ParseHeader(const std::array<uint64_t, 4>& words, uint64_t fileBytes, Header& header)
    {
        header = {};
        const Header candidate{words[1], words[2], words[3]};
        if (words[0] != Magic || !ValidSizes(candidate) || fileBytes != HeaderBytes + candidate.storedBytes)
        {
            return false;
        }
        header = candidate;
        return true;
    }

    inline bool TryEncode(const uint8_t* dds, size_t size, std::vector<uint8_t>& payload, Header& header)
    {
        payload.clear();
        header = {};
        if (!dds || size < MinDdsBytes || size > MaxDdsBytes)
        {
            return false;
        }
        try
        {
            payload.resize(ZSTD_compressBound(size));
            const size_t stored = ZSTD_compress(payload.data(), payload.size(), dds, size, 3);
            if (ZSTD_isError(stored) || stored + HeaderBytes >= size)
            {
                payload.clear();
                return false;
            }
            payload.resize(stored);
            header = {size, stored, Hash(dds, size)};
            return true;
        }
        catch (const std::bad_alloc&)
        {
            payload.clear();
            return false;
        }
    }

    inline DecodeResult Decode(const Header& header, const std::vector<uint8_t>& payload, std::vector<uint8_t>& dds)
    {
        dds.clear();
        if (!ValidSizes(header) || payload.size() != header.storedBytes)
        {
            return DecodeResult::Invalid;
        }
        const auto contentBytes = ZSTD_getFrameContentSize(payload.data(), payload.size());
        const size_t frameBytes = ZSTD_findFrameCompressedSize(payload.data(), payload.size());
        if (contentBytes != header.rawBytes || ZSTD_isError(frameBytes) || frameBytes != payload.size())
        {
            return DecodeResult::Invalid;
        }
        try
        {
            std::vector<uint8_t> candidate(static_cast<size_t>(header.rawBytes));
            const size_t restored = ZSTD_decompress(candidate.data(), candidate.size(), payload.data(), payload.size());
            if (ZSTD_getErrorCode(restored) == ZSTD_error_memory_allocation)
            {
                return DecodeResult::AllocationFailure;
            }
            if (ZSTD_isError(restored) || restored != candidate.size() ||
                Hash(candidate.data(), candidate.size()) != header.checksum)
            {
                return DecodeResult::Invalid;
            }
            dds.swap(candidate);
            return DecodeResult::Success;
        }
        catch (const std::bad_alloc&)
        {
            return DecodeResult::AllocationFailure;
        }
    }
}

===== FILE: source\assets\texturecachestorage.h =====
#pragma once
#include <windows.h>
#include "DirectXTex.h"
#include "texturecachecodec.h"
#include "../cachecompressionpolicy.h"
#include <filesystem>
#include <fstream>
#include <string>

namespace TextureCacheStorage
{
    inline std::filesystem::path CompressedPath(const std::filesystem::path& rawPath)
    {
        return rawPath.wstring() + L".zst";
    }

    inline std::wstring TemporaryPath(const std::filesystem::path& target)
    {
        return target.wstring() + L"." + std::to_wstring(GetCurrentProcessId()) + L"." +
               std::to_wstring(GetCurrentThreadId()) + L".tmp";
    }

    inline bool StoreCompressed(const std::filesystem::path& rawPath, const DirectX::ScratchImage& image)
    {
        // Avoid allocating a DDS staging copy for targets that will use legacy storage.
        if (image.GetPixelsSize() > TextureCacheCodec::MaxDdsBytes - 148)
        {
            return false;
        }
        DirectX::Blob dds;
        if (FAILED(DirectX::SaveToDDSMemory(image.GetImages(), image.GetImageCount(), image.GetMetadata(),
                                            DirectX::DDS_FLAGS_NONE, dds)))
        {
            return false;
        }
        std::vector<uint8_t> payload;
        TextureCacheCodec::Header header;
        if (!TextureCacheCodec::TryEncode(dds.GetBufferPointer(), dds.GetBufferSize(), payload, header))
        {
            return false;
        }
        const auto target = CompressedPath(rawPath);
        const auto temporary = TemporaryPath(target);
        std::error_code error;
        {
            std::ofstream stream(temporary, std::ios::binary | std::ios::trunc);
            const uint64_t words[] = {TextureCacheCodec::Magic, header.rawBytes, header.storedBytes, header.checksum};
            stream.write(reinterpret_cast<const char*>(words), sizeof(words));
            stream.write(reinterpret_cast<const char*>(payload.data()), static_cast<std::streamsize>(payload.size()));
            stream.close();
            if (stream.fail())
            {
                std::filesystem::remove(temporary, error);
                return false;
            }
        }
        if (!MoveFileExW(temporary.c_str(), target.c_str(), MOVEFILE_REPLACE_EXISTING))
        {
            std::filesystem::remove(temporary, error);
            return false;
        }
        return true;
    }

    inline bool StoreImpl(const std::filesystem::path& rawPath, const DirectX::ScratchImage& image)
    {
        if (rawPath.empty() || image.GetImageCount() == 0)
        {
            return false;
        }
        std::error_code error;
        if (!rawPath.parent_path().empty())
        {
            std::filesystem::create_directories(rawPath.parent_path(), error);
        }
        if (error)
        {
            return false;
        }
        try
        {
            if (CacheCompressionPolicy::PreferSmallerFiles() && StoreCompressed(rawPath, image))
            {
                return true;
            }
        }
        catch (const std::bad_alloc&)
        { /* The legacy file writer does not need a DDS staging copy. */
        }
        const auto temporary = TemporaryPath(rawPath);
        if (FAILED(DirectX::SaveToDDSFile(image.GetImages(), image.GetImageCount(), image.GetMetadata(),
                                          DirectX::DDS_FLAGS_NONE, temporary.c_str())) ||
            !MoveFileExW(temporary.c_str(), rawPath.c_str(), MOVEFILE_REPLACE_EXISTING))
        {
            std::filesystem::remove(temporary, error);
            return false;
        }
        // A sidecar from a prior capacity-oriented save must not shadow the replacement DDS.
        std::filesystem::remove(CompressedPath(rawPath), error);
        return !error;
    }

    enum class ReadResult
    {
        Success,
        Missing,
        Corrupt,
        ResourceFailure
    };

    inline ReadResult ReadCompressedDds(const std::filesystem::path& path, std::vector<uint8_t>& dds)
    {
        dds.clear();
        try
        {
            std::ifstream stream(path, std::ios::binary | std::ios::ate);
            if (!stream)
            {
                return ReadResult::Missing;
            }
            const std::streamoff fileBytes = stream.tellg();
            if (fileBytes < static_cast<std::streamoff>(TextureCacheCodec::HeaderBytes) ||
                fileBytes >
                    static_cast<std::streamoff>(TextureCacheCodec::MaxDdsBytes + TextureCacheCodec::HeaderBytes))
            {
                return ReadResult::Corrupt;
            }
            std::array<uint64_t, 4> words{};
            stream.seekg(0);
            stream.read(reinterpret_cast<char*>(words.data()), sizeof(words));
            TextureCacheCodec::Header header;
            if (!stream || !TextureCacheCodec::ParseHeader(words, static_cast<uint64_t>(fileBytes), header))
            {
                return ReadResult::Corrupt;
            }
            std::vector<uint8_t> payload(static_cast<size_t>(header.storedBytes));
            stream.read(reinterpret_cast<char*>(payload.data()), static_cast<std::streamsize>(payload.size()));
            if (!stream)
            {
                return ReadResult::ResourceFailure;
            }
            switch (TextureCacheCodec::Decode(header, payload, dds))
            {
                case TextureCacheCodec::DecodeResult::Success:
                    return ReadResult::Success;
                case TextureCacheCodec::DecodeResult::AllocationFailure:
                    return ReadResult::ResourceFailure;
                default:
                    return ReadResult::Corrupt;
            }
        }
        catch (const std::bad_alloc&)
        {
            return ReadResult::ResourceFailure;
        }
    }

    inline bool LoadImpl(const std::filesystem::path& rawPath, DirectX::TexMetadata& metadata,
                         DirectX::ScratchImage& image)
    {
        if (rawPath.empty())
        {
            return false;
        }
        DirectX::TexMetadata candidateMetadata{};
        DirectX::ScratchImage candidate;
        std::error_code error;
        try
        {
            const auto sidecar = CompressedPath(rawPath);
            std::vector<uint8_t> dds;
            ReadResult result = ReadCompressedDds(sidecar, dds);
            // The encoded payload is released by ReadCompressedDds before the DDS/ScratchImage overlap.
            if (result == ReadResult::Success)
            {
                const HRESULT loaded = DirectX::LoadFromDDSMemory(dds.data(), dds.size(), DirectX::DDS_FLAGS_NONE,
                                                                  &candidateMetadata, candidate);
                if (SUCCEEDED(loaded) && DirectX::IsCompressed(candidateMetadata.format))
                {
                    metadata = candidateMetadata;
                    image = std::move(candidate);
                    return true;
                }
                result = loaded == E_OUTOFMEMORY ? ReadResult::ResourceFailure : ReadResult::Corrupt;
            }
            if (result == ReadResult::Corrupt)
            {
                std::filesystem::remove(sidecar, error);
            }
        }
        catch (const std::bad_alloc&)
        { /* Try the existing DDS without a decode buffer. */
        }
        if (!std::filesystem::exists(rawPath, error))
        {
            return false;
        }
        const HRESULT loaded =
            DirectX::LoadFromDDSFile(rawPath.c_str(), DirectX::DDS_FLAGS_NONE, &candidateMetadata, candidate);
        if (FAILED(loaded) || !DirectX::IsCompressed(candidateMetadata.format))
        {
            if (loaded != E_OUTOFMEMORY)
            {
                std::filesystem::remove(rawPath, error);
            }
            return false;
        }
        metadata = candidateMetadata;
        image = std::move(candidate);
        return true;
    }

    inline bool Store(const std::filesystem::path& rawPath, const DirectX::ScratchImage& image)
    {
        try
        {
            return StoreImpl(rawPath, image);
        }
        catch (const std::bad_alloc&)
        {
            return false;
        }
    }

    inline bool Load(const std::filesystem::path& rawPath, DirectX::TexMetadata& metadata, DirectX::ScratchImage& image)
    {
        try
        {
            return LoadImpl(rawPath, metadata, image);
        }
        catch (const std::bad_alloc&)
        {
            return false;
        }
    }
}

===== FILE: source\assets\texturecompression.h =====
#pragma once

// テクスチャ取り込み時の BC 圧縮とディスクキャッシュ。
//   Color       : BC7（sRGB 入力は BC7_UNORM_SRGB）   ベースカラー / エミッシブ / モデル埋め込み
//   Normal      : BC5（RG のみ保持。Z はシェーダーで再構成: NormalMapDecode.hlsli）
//   TwoChannel  : BC5（R=Metallic, G=Roughness。シェーダーは .rg のみ参照）
//   SingleChannel: BC4（AO / 高さ。シェーダーは .r のみ参照）
// 圧縮結果は <作業ディレクトリ>/Data/Cache/Textures/<hash>.dds に保存し、ソースのパス・サイズ・更新時刻・
// 用途・エンコーダー版が一致すれば再利用する。

#include <cstdint>
#include <filesystem>
#include <string>

namespace DirectX
{
    struct TexMetadata;
    class ScratchImage;
} // namespace DirectX

enum class TextureUsage : uint32_t
{
    Color = 0,
    Normal = 1,
    TwoChannel = 2,
    SingleChannel = 3,
};

namespace TextureCompression
{
    struct Settings
    {
        bool Enabled = true;
        // 未キャッシュのテクスチャはその場では圧縮せず非圧縮で使い、バックグラウンドでキャッシュを作る
        // （次回読み込みから BC）。偽にすると読み込み時に圧縮する（初回の読み込みが遅くなる）。
        bool BackgroundForSynchronousLoads = true;
    };

    struct Statistics
    {
        uint32_t CacheHits = 0;
        uint32_t Compressed = 0;
        uint32_t Skipped = 0;
        uint32_t BackgroundPending = 0;
        uint64_t SourceBytes = 0;
        uint64_t CompressedBytes = 0;
    };

    Settings& GetSettings();
    Statistics GetStatistics();

    const char* UsageName(TextureUsage usage);
    // m_Textures のキーへ付ける接尾辞（Color は空 = 従来キーのまま）。
    std::string KeySuffix(TextureUsage usage);
    // キーから接尾辞を取り除いたパス部分。
    std::string StripKeySuffix(const std::string& key);

    std::filesystem::path CacheDirectory();
    // ソースファイル用キャッシュキー（パス・サイズ・更新時刻・用途・エンコーダー版）。0 は失敗。
    uint64_t FileCacheKey(const std::filesystem::path& source, TextureUsage usage);
    // メモリ上の画像（モデル埋め込み）用キャッシュキー（内容・用途・エンコーダー版）。
    uint64_t MemoryCacheKey(const void* data, size_t size, TextureUsage usage);

    // キャッシュ済み BC テクスチャを読み込む。
    bool TryLoadCached(uint64_t cacheKey, DirectX::TexMetadata& metadata, DirectX::ScratchImage& image);
    // BC 圧縮の対象になる画像か（4 の倍数サイズの 2D・非 HDR・未圧縮）。
    bool IsCompressible(const DirectX::TexMetadata& metadata);
    // ミップ生成済みの画像をその場で BC 圧縮し、キャッシュへ保存する。圧縮対象外なら false（画像は不変）。
    bool CompressAndCache(uint64_t cacheKey, TextureUsage usage, DirectX::TexMetadata& metadata,
                          DirectX::ScratchImage& image);
    // バックグラウンドでソースファイルを読み込み・ミップ生成・圧縮・キャッシュ保存する。
    void CompressFileInBackground(uint64_t cacheKey, TextureUsage usage, const std::filesystem::path& source);
    void CompressMemoryInBackground(uint64_t cacheKey, TextureUsage usage, const void* data, size_t size);

===== FILE: source\assets\texturecompression.inl =====
// texturemanager.cpp の末尾から取り込まれる実装（プロジェクトへのファイル追加を不要にするため .inl）。
#include "DirectXTex.h"
#include "texturecompression.h"
#include "texturecachestorage.h"
#include <atomic>
#include <condition_variable>
#include <deque>
#include <mutex>
#include <thread>
#include <unordered_set>
#include <cwctype>

// texturemanager.cpp の LoadImageFromFile / LoadImageFromMemory / EnsureMipChain をそのまま使い、
// 通常読み込みと同じ画像からキャッシュを作る。

namespace TextureCompressionDetail
{
    // エンコーダーや判定規則を変えたら上げる（古いキャッシュを自動的に無効化）。
    constexpr uint64_t kEncoderVersion = 1;

    TextureCompression::Settings g_Settings;

    struct Counters
    {
        std::atomic<uint32_t> CacheHits{0};
        std::atomic<uint32_t> Compressed{0};
        std::atomic<uint32_t> Skipped{0};
        std::atomic<uint32_t> BackgroundPending{0};
        std::atomic<uint64_t> SourceBytes{0};
        std::atomic<uint64_t> CompressedBytes{0};
    };

    Counters& GetCounters()
    {
        static Counters* counters = new Counters();
        return *counters;
    }

    // BC 圧縮は内部で並列化されるため、同時に 1 枚だけ圧縮して CPU の過剰な取り合いを避ける。
    std::mutex& CompressionGate()
    {
        static std::mutex* gate = new std::mutex();
        return *gate;
    }

    uint64_t Fnv(const void* data, size_t size, uint64_t hash = 14695981039346656037ull)
    {
        const auto* bytes = static_cast<const unsigned char*>(data);
        for (size_t index = 0; index < size; ++index)
        {
            hash ^= bytes[index];
            hash *= 1099511628211ull;
        }
        return hash;
    }

    bool IsFloatFormat(DXGI_FORMAT format)
    {
        switch (format)
        {
            case DXGI_FORMAT_R32G32B32A32_FLOAT:
            case DXGI_FORMAT_R32G32B32_FLOAT:
            case DXGI_FORMAT_R16G16B16A16_FLOAT:
            case DXGI_FORMAT_R32G32_FLOAT:
            case DXGI_FORMAT_R11G11B10_FLOAT:
            case DXGI_FORMAT_R16G16_FLOAT:
            case DXGI_FORMAT_R32_FLOAT:
            case DXGI_FORMAT_R16_FLOAT:
            case DXGI_FORMAT_R9G9B9E5_SHAREDEXP:
                return true;
            default:
                return false;
        }
    }

    DXGI_FORMAT TargetFormat(TextureUsage usage, DXGI_FORMAT source)
    {
        switch (usage)
        {
            case TextureUsage::Normal:
            case TextureUsage::TwoChannel:
                return DXGI_FORMAT_BC5_UNORM;
            case TextureUsage::SingleChannel:
                return DXGI_FORMAT_BC4_UNORM;
            case TextureUsage::Color:
            default:
                return IsSRGB(source) ? DXGI_FORMAT_BC7_UNORM_SRGB : DXGI_FORMAT_BC7_UNORM;
        }
    }

    std::filesystem::path CacheFile(uint64_t cacheKey)
    {
        char name[32]{};
        sprintf_s(name, "%016llx.dds", static_cast<unsigned long long>(cacheKey));
        return TextureCompression::CacheDirectory() / name;
    }

    void SaveCache(uint64_t cacheKey, const ScratchImage& image)
    {
        if (cacheKey == 0)
        {
            return;
        }
        TextureCacheStorage::Store(CacheFile(cacheKey), image);
    }

    // バックグラウンド圧縮用の単一ワーカー。終了時に破棄しないようにヒープへ置き、スレッドは切り離す。
    struct BackgroundQueue
    {
        std::mutex Mutex;
        std::condition_variable Ready;
        std::deque<std::function<void()>> Jobs;
        std::unordered_set<uint64_t> Queued;
        bool Started = false;
    };

    BackgroundQueue& GetQueue()
    {
        static BackgroundQueue* queue = new BackgroundQueue();
        return *queue;
    }

    void Enqueue(uint64_t cacheKey, std::function<void()> job)
    {
        auto& queue = GetQueue();
        {
            std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(queue.Mutex);
            if (cacheKey == 0 || !queue.Queued.insert(cacheKey).second)
            {
                return;
            }
            ++GetCounters().BackgroundPending;
            queue.Jobs.push_back([cacheKey, job = std::move(job)]() {
                job();
                auto& owner = GetQueue();
                std::lock_guard<std::mutex> done(owner.Mutex);
                owner.Queued.erase(cacheKey);
                --GetCounters().BackgroundPending;
            });
            if (!queue.Started)
            {
                queue.Started = true;
                std::thread([] {
                    auto& owner = GetQueue();
                    for (;;)
                    {
                        std::function<void()> next;
                        {
                            std::unique_lock<std::mutex> lock(owner.Mutex);
                            owner.Ready.wait(lock, [&owner] {
                                return !owner.Jobs.empty();
                            });
                            next = std::move(owner.Jobs.front());
                            owner.Jobs.pop_front();
                        }
                        // ワーカーは描画より優先度を下げる。
                        SetThreadPriority(GetCurrentThread(), THREAD_PRIORITY_BELOW_NORMAL);
                        next();
                    }
                }).detach();
            }
        }
        queue.Ready.notify_one();
    }
} // namespace TextureCompressionDetail

namespace TextureCompression
{
    using namespace TextureCompressionDetail;

    Settings& GetSettings()
    {
        return g_Settings;
    }

    Statistics GetStatistics()
    {
        const auto& counters = GetCounters();
        Statistics statistics;
        statistics.CacheHits = counters.CacheHits.load();
        statistics.Compressed = counters.Compressed.load();
        statistics.Skipped = counters.Skipped.load();
        statistics.BackgroundPending = counters.BackgroundPending.load();
        statistics.SourceBytes = counters.SourceBytes.load();
        statistics.CompressedBytes = counters.CompressedBytes.load();
        return statistics;
    }

    const char* UsageName(TextureUsage usage)
    {
        switch (usage)
        {
            case TextureUsage::Normal:
                return "BC5 (法線)";
            case TextureUsage::TwoChannel:
                return "BC5 (2ch)";
            case TextureUsage::SingleChannel:
                return "BC4 (1ch)";
            case TextureUsage::Color:
            default:
                return "BC7 (カラー)";
        }
    }

    std::string KeySuffix(TextureUsage usage)
    {
        switch (usage)
        {
            case TextureUsage::Normal:
                return "#tc:normal";
            case TextureUsage::TwoChannel:
                return "#tc:rg";
            case TextureUsage::SingleChannel:
                return "#tc:r";
            case TextureUsage::Color:
            default:
                return {};
        }
    }

    std::string StripKeySuffix(const std::string& key)
    {
        const auto position = key.rfind("#tc:");
        return position == std::string::npos ? key : key.substr(0, position);
    }

    std::filesystem::path CacheDirectory()
    {
        std::error_code error;
        const auto directory = (std::filesystem::current_path(error) / "Data" / "Cache" / "Textures").lexically_normal();
        static std::once_flag cleaned;
        std::call_once(cleaned, [&directory] {
            // 前回の異常終了で残った書きかけファイルを掃除する。
            std::error_code iterateError;
            for (std::filesystem::directory_iterator it(directory, iterateError), end; !iterateError && it != end;
                 it.increment(iterateError))
            {
                if (it->path().extension() == ".tmp")
                {
                    std::error_code removeError;
                    std::filesystem::remove(it->path(), removeError);
                }
            }
        });
        return directory;
    }

    uint64_t FileCacheKey(const std::filesystem::path& source, TextureUsage usage)
    {
        std::error_code error;
        auto absolute = std::filesystem::absolute(source, error);
        if (error)
        {
            absolute = source;
        }
        std::wstring path = absolute.lexically_normal().wstring();
        for (auto& letter : path)
        {
            letter = static_cast<wchar_t>(towlower(letter));
        }
        const auto size = std::filesystem::file_size(source, error);
        if (error)
        {
            return 0;
        }
        const auto modified = std::filesystem::last_write_time(source, error);
        if (error)
        {
            return 0;
        }
        const int64_t time = modified.time_since_epoch().count();
        const uint32_t usageValue = static_cast<uint32_t>(usage);
        uint64_t hash = Fnv(&kEncoderVersion, sizeof(kEncoderVersion));
        hash = Fnv(path.data(), path.size() * sizeof(wchar_t), hash);
        hash = Fnv(&size, sizeof(size), hash);
        hash = Fnv(&time, sizeof(time), hash);
        hash = Fnv(&usageValue, sizeof(usageValue), hash);
        return hash ? hash : 1;
    }

    uint64_t MemoryCacheKey(const void* data, size_t size, TextureUsage usage)
    {
        if (!data || size == 0)
        {
            return 0;
        }
        const uint32_t usageValue = static_cast<uint32_t>(usage);
        const uint64_t marker = 0x4d454d5458ull; // "MEMTX"
        uint64_t hash = Fnv(&kEncoderVersion, sizeof(kEncoderVersion));
        hash = Fnv(&marker, sizeof(marker), hash);
        hash = Fnv(data, size, hash);
        hash = Fnv(&size, sizeof(size), hash);
        hash = Fnv(&usageValue, sizeof(usageValue), hash);
        return hash ? hash : 1;
    }

    bool TryLoadCached(uint64_t cacheKey, TexMetadata& metadata, ScratchImage& image)
    {
        if (!g_Settings.Enabled || cacheKey == 0)
        {
            return false;
        }
        ScratchImage cached;
        TexMetadata cachedMetadata{};
        if (!TextureCacheStorage::Load(CacheFile(cacheKey), cachedMetadata, cached))
        {
            return false;
        }
        metadata = cachedMetadata;
        image = std::move(cached);
        ++GetCounters().CacheHits;
        return true;
    }

    bool IsCompressible(const TexMetadata& metadata)
    {
        // BC は 4x4 ブロック単位。最上位ミップが 4 の倍数でないものと、HDR（BC6H 対象外）・配列・3D は対象外。
        return !IsCompressed(metadata.format) && !IsFloatFormat(metadata.format) && !IsPlanar(metadata.format) &&
               !IsPalettized(metadata.format) && !IsVideo(metadata.format) &&
               metadata.dimension == TEX_DIMENSION_TEXTURE2D && metadata.arraySize == 1 && metadata.depth == 1 &&
               !metadata.IsCubemap() && (metadata.width % 4) == 0 && (metadata.height % 4) == 0 &&
               metadata.width >= 4 && metadata.height >= 4;
    }

    bool CompressAndCache(uint64_t cacheKey, TextureUsage usage, TexMetadata& metadata, ScratchImage& image)
    {
        if (!g_Settings.Enabled)
        {
            return false;
        }
        if (!IsCompressible(metadata))
        {
            ++GetCounters().Skipped;
            return false;
        }
        const DXGI_FORMAT target = TargetFormat(usage, metadata.format);
        // DirectXTex の版によってはフラグ型に |= が無いため、整数で組み立てる。
        unsigned long flagBits = TEX_COMPRESS_PARALLEL;
        if (target == DXGI_FORMAT_BC7_UNORM || target == DXGI_FORMAT_BC7_UNORM_SRGB)
        {
            // モード 6 中心の高速エンコード（初回のみのコスト。結果はキャッシュされる）。
            flagBits |= TEX_COMPRESS_BC7_QUICK;
        }
        else if (IsSRGB(metadata.format))
        {
            // sRGB ソースを非 sRGB の BC4/BC5 にする場合、従来ハードウェアが行っていた sRGB→線形変換を
            // 事前に適用し、サンプリング結果を一致させる。
            flagBits |= TEX_COMPRESS_SRGB_IN;
        }
        const auto flags = static_cast<TEX_COMPRESS_FLAGS>(flagBits);
        ScratchImage compressed;
        HRESULT result = E_FAIL;
        {
            std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(CompressionGate());
            result = Compress(image.GetImages(), image.GetImageCount(), image.GetMetadata(), target, flags,
                              TEX_THRESHOLD_DEFAULT, compressed);
        }
        if (FAILED(result))
        {
            Debug::Log("TextureCompression: Compress to %s failed (0x%08X)\n", UsageName(usage),
                       static_cast<unsigned>(result));
            ++GetCounters().Skipped;
            return false;
        }
        GetCounters().SourceBytes += image.GetPixelsSize();
        GetCounters().CompressedBytes += compressed.GetPixelsSize();
        ++GetCounters().Compressed;
        SaveCache(cacheKey, compressed);
        metadata = compressed.GetMetadata();
        image = std::move(compressed);
        return true;
    }

    void CompressFileInBackground(uint64_t cacheKey, TextureUsage usage, const std::filesystem::path& source)
    {
        if (!g_Settings.Enabled || cacheKey == 0)
        {
            return;
        }
        Enqueue(cacheKey, [cacheKey, usage, source]() {
            TexMetadata metadata{};
            ScratchImage image;
            if (FAILED(LoadImageFromFile(source.c_str(), metadata, image)))
            {
                return;
            }
            EnsureMipChain(metadata, image);
            CompressAndCache(cacheKey, usage, metadata, image);
        });
    }

    void CompressMemoryInBackground(uint64_t cacheKey, TextureUsage usage, const void* data, size_t size)
    {
        if (!g_Settings.Enabled || cacheKey == 0 || !data || size == 0)
        {
            return;
        }
        auto copy = std::make_shared<std::vector<uint8_t>>(static_cast<const uint8_t*>(data),
                                                           static_cast<const uint8_t*>(data) + size);
        Enqueue(cacheKey, [cacheKey, usage, copy]() {
            TexMetadata metadata{};
            ScratchImage image;
            if (FAILED(LoadImageFromMemory(copy->data(), copy->size(), metadata, image)))
            {
                return;
            }
            EnsureMipChain(metadata, image);
            CompressAndCache(cacheKey, usage, metadata, image);
        });
    }
} // namespace TextureCompression

// A borrowed reserved resource (thumbnails, ray descriptor caches) must keep its
// backing heaps alive even after the texture manager publishes a BC replacement.
class TextureHeapLifetime final : public IUnknown
{
  public:
    explicit TextureHeapLifetime(shared_ptr<TextureStreamingState> state) : m_State(move(state)) {}

    HRESULT STDMETHODCALLTYPE QueryInterface(REFIID iid, void** output) override
    {
        if (!output)
        {
            return E_POINTER;
        }
        *output = nullptr;
        if (iid != __uuidof(IUnknown))
        {
            return E_NOINTERFACE;
        }
        *output = static_cast<IUnknown*>(this);
        AddRef();
        return S_OK;
    }

    ULONG STDMETHODCALLTYPE AddRef() override
    {
        return ++m_References;
    }

    ULONG STDMETHODCALLTYPE Release() override
    {
        const ULONG references = --m_References;
        if (references == 0)
        {
            delete this;
        }
        return references;
    }

  private:
    atomic<ULONG> m_References{1};
    shared_ptr<TextureStreamingState> m_State;
};
