    void PrepareParallaxFrame(uint64_t frame)
    {
        if (frame == 1)
        {
            auto editing = MaterialManager::GetRuntime(copyHandle).Editing;
            editing.Surface = MaterialSurface::Opaque;
            editing.Transmission = 0;
            editing.BaseColor = {1, 1, 1, 1};
            editing.Textures[0] = normalTextureHandle;
            editing.Textures[5] = normalTextureHandle;
            editing.ParallaxDepth = 0;
            MaterialManager::SetEditing(copyHandle, editing);
            for (EntityID entity : World::GetView<MaterialComponent>())
            {
                if (MaterialManager::SlotCount(entity) > 0)
                {
                    MaterialManager::Assign(entity, 0, copyHandle);
                }
            }
            auto& cameraTransform =
                ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<TransformComponent>(Camera::GetCameraEntity());
            cameraTransform.Position = {3, 2, -7};
            cameraTransform.IsDirty = true;
        }
        if (frame == 3 || frame == 7 || frame == 9)
        {
            auto editing = MaterialManager::GetRuntime(copyHandle).Editing;
            editing.ParallaxDepth = frame == 9 ? 0.0f : 0.12f;
            editing.Textures[5] = frame == 7 ? 0 : normalTextureHandle;
            MaterialManager::SetEditing(copyHandle, editing);
        }
        if (frame == 5)
        {
            GPUDrivenRenderer::SetEnabled(true);
            GPUVisibility::GetSettings().LOD = true;
            GPUVisibility::GetSettings().ForceLOD = 0;
        }
        if (frame == 7)
        {
            GPUDrivenRenderer::SetEnabled(false);
        }
    }

    void CheckParallaxFrame(uint64_t frame)
    {
        if (frame != 2 && frame != 4 && frame != 6 && frame != 8 && frame != 10)
        {
            return;
        }
        RenderCapture::TextureData color;
        Check(RenderCapture::ReadTexture(RenderTargets::GetGBufferResource(GBufferType::BASE_COLOR), color),
              "capture POM production GBuffer");
        if (frame == 2)
        {
            parallaxDisabled = color;
            RenderCapture::SaveScenePng(L"build/material-tests/pom-disabled.png");
        }
        else if (frame == 4)
        {
            parallaxEnabled = color;
            Check(!EqualPixels(parallaxDisabled, color, 4), "POM changes texture coordinates at oblique view");
            RenderCapture::SaveScenePng(L"build/material-tests/pom-enabled.png");
            RenderCapture::SaveTexturePng(RenderTargets::GetGBufferResource(GBufferType::BASE_COLOR),
                                          L"build/material-tests/pom-cpu-gbuffer.png");
        }
        else if (frame == 6)
        {
            Check(GPUDrivenRenderer::HandlesEntity(first), "POM fixture uses GPU-driven rendering");
            UINT maxDifference = 0;
            UINT differentChannels = 0;
            Check(color.Format == DXGI_FORMAT_R8G8B8A8_UNORM && color.Width == parallaxEnabled.Width &&
                      color.Height == parallaxEnabled.Height,
                  "POM parity capture format and size");
            for (UINT y = 0; y < color.Height; ++y)
            {
                for (UINT channel = 0; channel < color.Width * 4; ++channel)
                {
                    const int difference = abs(int(color.Bytes[y * color.RowPitch + channel]) -
                                               int(parallaxEnabled.Bytes[y * parallaxEnabled.RowPitch + channel]));
                    maxDifference = max(maxDifference, static_cast<UINT>(difference));
                    differentChannels += difference != 0;
                }
            }
            WriteGraphicsLog("POM parity: max channel difference = %u / 255, differing channels = %u\n", maxDifference,
                             differentChannels);
            RenderCapture::SaveTexturePng(RenderTargets::GetGBufferResource(GBufferType::BASE_COLOR),
                                          L"build/material-tests/pom-gpu-gbuffer.png");
            Check(EqualPixels(parallaxEnabled, color, 4), "POM CPU/GPU-driven GBuffer parity");
        }
        else
        {
            Check(EqualPixels(parallaxDisabled, color, 4), "POM missing height or zero depth preserves original UVs");
        }
    }

    void Check(bool passed, const char* message)
    {
        WriteGraphicsLog("Material validation: %s %s\n", passed ? "PASS" : "FAIL", message);
        if (!passed)
        {
            ++failures;
        }
    }

    EntityID MakeCube(float x)
    {
        auto entity = World::CreateEntity()
                          .Add<TransformComponent>()
                          .Add<MeshComponent>()
                          .Add<MaterialComponent>()
                          .Add<NameComponent>()
                          .Add<LODComponent>();
        entity.SetName("Material fixture");
        auto& transform = entity.Get<TransformComponent>();
        transform.Position = {x, 0, 0};
        transform.Scale = {0.8f, 0.8f, 0.8f};
        transform.IsDirty = true;
        VertexResource geometry;
        geometry.entityid = entity.GetID();
        geometry.objectType = ObjectType::CUBE;
        geometry.color = Color::WHITE;
        PrimitiveGeometry::CreateObjectVertex(geometry);
        entity.Get<LODComponent>().UseLOD = true;
        return entity.GetID();
    }

    void MakeNormalTexture(const filesystem::path& path)
    {
        array<uint8_t, 18> header{};
        header[2] = 2;
        header[12] = 16;
        header[14] = 16;
        header[16] = 32;
        header[17] = 0x20;
        ofstream stream(path, ios::binary);
        stream.write(reinterpret_cast<const char*>(header.data()), header.size());
        for (int y = 0; y < 16; ++y)
        {
            for (int x = 0; x < 16; ++x)
            {
                const uint8_t pixel[] = {220, static_cast<uint8_t>(80 + y * 6), static_cast<uint8_t>(70 + x * 7), 255};
                stream.write(reinterpret_cast<const char*>(pixel), 4);
            }
        }
    }

    void MakeSurfaceTexture(const filesystem::path& path)
    {
        array<uint8_t, 18> header{};
        header[2] = 2;
        header[12] = 4;
        header[14] = 4;
        header[16] = 32;
        header[17] = 0x20;
        ofstream stream(path, ios::binary);
        stream.write(reinterpret_cast<const char*>(header.data()), header.size());
        const uint8_t pixel[] = {200, 128, 64, 255};
        for (int texel = 0; texel < 16; ++texel)
        {
            stream.write(reinterpret_cast<const char*>(pixel), sizeof(pixel));
        }
    }

    bool EqualPixels(const RenderCapture::TextureData& left, const RenderCapture::TextureData& right, UINT pixelBytes)
    {
        if (left.Width != right.Width || left.Height != right.Height || left.Format != right.Format)
        {
            return false;
        }
        for (UINT row = 0; row < left.Height; ++row)
        {
            if (memcmp(left.Bytes.data() + row * left.RowPitch, right.Bytes.data() + row * right.RowPitch,
                       left.Width * pixelBytes) != 0)
            {
                return false;
            }
        }
        return true;
    }

    void PrepareTransparencyFrame(uint64_t frame)
    {
        if (frame == 24)
        {
            RenderConfiguration::SetHdr(true);
            vector<EntityID> remove;
            for (uint32_t entity = 0; entity < Registry::GetEntities().size(); ++entity)
            {
                if (Registry::IsAlive(entity) && !ComponentManager::HasComponent<CameraComponent>(entity))
                {
                    remove.push_back(entity);
                }
            }
            for (EntityID entity : remove)
            {
                World::DestroyEntity(Entity(entity));
            }
            GPUDrivenRenderer::SetEnabled(false);
            RendererSettings::SetComputeGBufferEnabled(false);
            Atmosphere::GetMutableParameters().Enabled = false;
            Atmosphere::GetMutableParameters().PhysicalSky = false;
            CloudRenderer::GetSettings().Enabled = false;
            transparencyFixture = MakeCube(0);
            MaterialManager::Assign(transparencyFixture, 0, copyHandle);
            auto editing = MaterialManager::GetRuntime(copyHandle).Editing;
            editing.Surface = MaterialSurface::Opaque;
            editing.ShadowMode = MaterialShadowMode::None;
            editing.BaseColor = {0.4f, 0.6f, 0.8f, 1};
            editing.Metallic = 0.35f;
            editing.Roughness = 0.35f;
            editing.Textures.fill(0);
            editing.EmissiveIntensity = 0.0f;
            MaterialManager::SetEditing(copyHandle, editing);
            for (int index = 0; index < 3; ++index)
            {
                auto entity = World::CreateEntity().Add<TransformComponent>().Add<LightComponent>();
                auto& light = entity.Get<LightComponent>();
                light.Type = static_cast<LightType>(index);
                light.Direction = {-0.4f, 0.7f, -1.0f};
                light.Position = {static_cast<float>(index - 1) * 2, 2, -3};
                entity.Get<TransformComponent>().Position = light.Position;
                light.Range = 12.0f;
                light.Intensity = 2.0f;
                light.InnerAngle = 0.4f;
                light.OuterAngle = 0.8f;
                light.Color = {1, 0.9f, 0.8f, 1};
            }
        }
        if (frame == 26)
        {
            auto editing = MaterialManager::GetRuntime(copyHandle).Editing;
            editing.Surface = MaterialSurface::Transparent;
            MaterialManager::SetEditing(copyHandle, editing);
        }
        if (frame == 28)
        {
            auto editing = MaterialManager::GetRuntime(copyHandle).Editing;
            editing.BaseColor[3] = 0;
            editing.EmissiveIntensity = 10;
            editing.ShadowMode = MaterialShadowMode::Opaque;
            MaterialManager::SetEditing(copyHandle, editing);
            Check(!MaterialSystem::CastsShadow(MaterialManager::GetRuntime(copyHandle).Binding),
                  "opacity zero suppresses opaque shadow casting");
        }
        if (frame == 30)
        {
            World::DestroyEntity(Entity(transparencyFixture));
        }
        if (frame == 32)
        {
            RendererSettings::SetShadowMapMethod(ShadowMapMethod::ShadowMap);
            transparencyFixture = MakeCube(0);
            MaterialManager::Assign(transparencyFixture, 0, copyHandle);
            auto editing = MaterialManager::GetRuntime(copyHandle).Editing;
            editing.BaseColor[3] = 0.5f;
            editing.EmissiveIntensity = 0;
            editing.ShadowMode = MaterialShadowMode::Opaque;
            MaterialManager::SetEditing(copyHandle, editing);
            for (EntityID entity : World::GetView<LightComponent>())
            {
                auto& light = ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<LightComponent>(entity);
                light.CastShadow = light.Type == LightType::Directional;
            }
        }
        if (frame == 34 || frame == 36 || frame == 38 || frame == 40)
        {
            auto editing = MaterialManager::GetRuntime(copyHandle).Editing;
            if (frame == 34)
            {
                editing.ShadowMode = MaterialShadowMode::None;
            }
            else if (frame == 40)
            {
                editing.ShadowMode = MaterialShadowMode::Opaque;
                editing.BaseColor[3] = 0;
            }
            else
            {
                editing.ShadowMode = MaterialShadowMode::AlphaTest;
                editing.ShadowCutoff = frame == 36 ? 0.25f : 0.75f;
            }
            MaterialManager::SetEditing(copyHandle, editing);
        }
        if (frame == 42)
        {
            auto editing = MaterialManager::GetRuntime(copyHandle).Editing;
            editing.BaseColor[3] = 0.5f;
            editing.ShadowMode = MaterialShadowMode::Opaque;
            MaterialManager::SetEditing(copyHandle, editing);
            auto receiver = MakeCube(0);
            transmissionReceiver = receiver;
            auto& transform = ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<TransformComponent>(receiver);
            transform.Position = {0, -1, 0};
            transform.Scale = {4, 0.1f, 4};
            transform.IsDirty = true;
            auto& material = ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<MaterialComponent>(receiver);
            material.ShaderClassMode = MaterialMode::Manual;
            material.ShaderClass = ShaderClass::PBR;
            material.IsTransparent = true;
            material.Alpha = 0.75f;
            material.ShadowMode = MaterialShadowMode::None;
        }
        if (frame == 44)
        {
            for (EntityID entity : World::GetView<LightComponent>())
            {
                ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<LightComponent>(entity).CastShadow = false;
            }
        }
    }

    void PrepareTransmissionFrame(uint64_t frame)
    {
        if (frame < 46 || (frame & 1) != 0)
        {
            return;
        }
        auto editing = MaterialManager::GetRuntime(copyHandle).Editing;
        if (frame == 46)
        {
            editing.Surface = MaterialSurface::Transparent;
            editing.ShadowMode = MaterialShadowMode::Auto;
            editing.BaseColor = {1, 1, 1, 0.5f};
            editing.Transmission = 0;
            editing.Metallic = 0;
            editing.Thickness = 0.5f;
            editing.AbsorptionCoefficient = {0, 0, 0};
            editing.IOR = 1.5f;
            for (EntityID entity : World::GetView<LightComponent>())
            {
                auto& light = ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<LightComponent>(entity);
                light.CastShadow = light.Type == LightType::Directional;
                light.Direction = {0, 1, 0};
            }
        }
        if (frame == 48)
        {
            editing.Transmission = 1;
        }
        if (frame == 50)
        {
            editing.AbsorptionCoefficient = {2, 0.5f, 0};
        }
        if (frame == 52)
        {
            editing.Thickness = 1;
        }
        if (frame == 54)
        {
            secondTransmissionCaster = MakeCube(0);
            auto& transform = ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<TransformComponent>(secondTransmissionCaster);
            transform.Position = {0, 1.5f, 0};
            transform.IsDirty = true;
            MaterialManager::Assign(secondTransmissionCaster, 0, copyHandle);
        }
        if (frame == 56)
        {
            editing.BaseColor[3] = 0;
        }
        if (frame == 58 || frame == 62)
        {
            if (frame == 58)
            {
                World::DestroyEntity(Entity(secondTransmissionCaster));
            }
            editing.BaseColor[3] = 1;
            editing.Transmission = 1;
            editing.ShadowMode = MaterialShadowMode::Transmittance;
            auto& transform = ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<TransformComponent>(transmissionReceiver);
            transform.Position.y = frame == 58 ? 0.9f : -1.0f;
            transform.IsDirty = true;
            auto& receiver = ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<MaterialComponent>(transmissionReceiver);
            receiver.Alpha = 1;
            receiver.IsTransparent = false;
        }
        if (frame == 60 || frame == 64)
        {
            editing.ShadowMode = MaterialShadowMode::None;
        }
        if (frame == 66)
        {
            editing.ShadowMode = MaterialShadowMode::Transmittance;
            RendererSettings::SetShadowMapMethod(ShadowMapMethod::VirtualShadowMap);
        }
        if (frame == 68)
        {
            editing.AbsorptionCoefficient = {0, 0, 0};
        }
        if (frame == 70 || frame == 72)
        {
            editing.Thickness = 0;
            editing.BaseColor = {0.05f, 1, 1, 1};
            if (frame == 72)
            {
                editing.BaseColor = {1, 0.05f, 1, 1};
            }
        }
        if (frame == 74)
        {
            RendererSettings::SetShadowMapMethod(ShadowMapMethod::ShadowMap);
        }
        MaterialManager::SetEditing(copyHandle, editing);
    }

    void PrepareIesFrame(uint64_t frame)
    {
        if (frame < 76 || (frame & 1) != 0)
        {
            return;
        }
        if (frame == 76)
        {
            MegaLights::GetSettings().Enabled = false;
            for (EntityID entity : World::GetView<LightComponent, TransformComponent>())
            {
                auto& light = ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<LightComponent>(entity);
                light.IsActive = iesFixtureLight == g_kINVALID_ENTITY;
                if (!light.IsActive)
                {
                    continue;
                }
                iesFixtureLight = entity;
                light.Type = LightType::Point;
                light.Intensity = 8;
                light.Range = 12;
                light.Color = {1, 1, 1, 1};
                light.CastShadow = false;
                light.Direction = {0, -1, 0};
                light.IesProfilePath = "asset/Lighting/IES/NarrowBeam.ies";
                auto& transform = ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<TransformComponent>(entity);
                transform.Position = {3, 4, 0};
                transform.IsDirty = true;
            }
            RendererSettings::SetIesProfilesEnabled(false);
        }
        if (iesFixtureLight == g_kINVALID_ENTITY)
        {
            Check(false, "IES fixture has a local light");
            return;
        }
        auto& light = ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<LightComponent>(iesFixtureLight);
        if (frame == 76)
        {
            Json::Value node;
            auto original = light;
            original.IesRotationDegrees = 37;
            SceneFile::Archive write(SceneFile::Mode::Write, node);
            SceneFile::Visit(write, original);
            LightComponent restored;
            SceneFile::Archive read(SceneFile::Mode::Read, node);
            SceneFile::Visit(read, restored);
            Check(restored.IesProfilePath == original.IesProfilePath && restored.IesRotationDegrees == 37,
                  "scene serialization preserves IES path and rotation");
            Json::Value legacy(Json::objectValue);
            LightComponent defaults;
            SceneFile::Archive legacyRead(SceneFile::Mode::Read, legacy);
            SceneFile::Visit(legacyRead, defaults);
            Check(defaults.IesProfilePath.empty() && defaults.IesRotationDegrees == 0,
                  "legacy scenes without IES fields retain conventional lighting");
        }
        if (frame == 78 || frame == 82)
        {
            RendererSettings::SetIesProfilesEnabled(true);
        }
        if (frame == 80)
        {
            RendererSettings::SetIesProfilesEnabled(false);
        }
        if (frame == 82)
        {
            light.IesProfilePath = "asset/Lighting/IES/__missing_validation.ies";
        }
        if (frame == 84)
        {
            light.IesProfilePath.clear();
        }
        if (frame == 86)
        {
            light.IesProfilePath = "asset/Lighting/IES/Asymmetric.ies";
            light.IesRotationDegrees = 0;
        }
        if (frame == 88)
        {
            light.IesRotationDegrees = 180;
        }
        if (frame == 90)
        {
            light.AllowMegaLights = true;
            MegaLights::GetSettings().Enabled = true;
            MegaLights::GetSettings().EvaluationMode = static_cast<int>(MegaLights::Mode::Deterministic);
            MegaLights::GetSettings().Denoise = false;
        }
        if (frame == 92)
        {
            AdvancedEffects::GetSettings().FroxelFog = true;
            light.AffectsVolumetrics = true;
            light.VolumeDensity = 0.2f;
        }
        if (frame == 94)
        {
            MegaLights::GetSettings().Enabled = false;
        }
        if (frame == 96)
        {
            AdvancedEffects::GetSettings().FroxelFog = false;
            RenderConfiguration::SetRenderMode(RenderMode::FORWARD);
        }
    }

    XMFLOAT3 ReadReceiverLight()
    {
        RenderCapture::TextureData scene;
        if (!RenderCapture::ReadTexture(RenderTargets::GetSceneResource(), scene))
        {
            Check(false, "read receiver HDR radiance");
            return {};
        }
        XMMATRIX view, projection;
        Camera::GetCameraMatrices(Camera::GetCameraEntity(), view, projection);
        auto position = ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<TransformComponent>(transmissionReceiver).Position;
        position.y += 0.05f;
        XMFLOAT3 pixel;
        XMStoreFloat3(&pixel,
                      XMVector3Project(XMLoadFloat3(&position), 0, 0, static_cast<float>(scene.Width),
                                       static_cast<float>(scene.Height), 0, 1, projection, view, XMMatrixIdentity()));
        if (pixel.x < 0 || pixel.x >= scene.Width || pixel.y < 0 || pixel.y >= scene.Height)
        {
            Check(false, "receiver sample is in view");
            return {};
        }
        const auto* rgb = reinterpret_cast<const uint16_t*>(
            scene.Bytes.data() + static_cast<UINT>(pixel.y) * scene.RowPitch + static_cast<UINT>(pixel.x) * 8);
        return {RenderCapture::HalfToFloat(rgb[0]), RenderCapture::HalfToFloat(rgb[1]),
                RenderCapture::HalfToFloat(rgb[2])};
    }

    void CheckTransparencyFrame(uint64_t frame)
    {
        if (frame == 33 || frame == 35 || frame == 37 || frame == 39 || frame == 41)
        {
            CheckShadowDepth(frame == 33 || frame == 37);
        }
        if (frame == 43)
        {
            Check(RenderCapture::ReadTexture(RenderTargets::GetSceneResource(), shadowedReceiver),
                  "capture transparent receiver with material shadow");
            RenderCapture::SaveTexturePng(RenderTargets::GetSceneResource(),
                                          L"build/material-tests/transparency-shadow.png");
        }
        if (frame == 45)
        {
            RenderCapture::TextureData unshadowed;
            Check(RenderCapture::ReadTexture(RenderTargets::GetSceneResource(), unshadowed) &&
                      !EqualPixels(shadowedReceiver, unshadowed, 8),
                  "Forward transparent receiver responds to shared shadow visibility");
        }
        if (frame == 25)
        {
            Check(RenderCapture::ReadTexture(RenderTargets::GetSceneResource(), opaqueLighting),
                  "capture Deferred PBR reference");
            RenderCapture::SaveTexturePng(RenderTargets::GetSceneResource(),
                                          L"build/material-tests/transparency-deferred.png");
        }
        if (frame == 27)
        {
            RenderCapture::TextureData forward;
            bool captured = RenderCapture::ReadTexture(RenderTargets::GetSceneResource(), forward);
            Check(captured && forward.Format == DXGI_FORMAT_R16G16B16A16_FLOAT &&
                      forward.Width == opaqueLighting.Width && forward.Height == opaqueLighting.Height,
                  "capture Forward opacity-one HDR result");
            if (captured && forward.Format == DXGI_FORMAT_R16G16B16A16_FLOAT && forward.Width == opaqueLighting.Width &&
                forward.Height == opaqueLighting.Height)
            {
                double errorSum = 0;
                double referenceSum = 0;
                for (UINT row = 0; row < forward.Height; ++row)
                {
                    for (UINT column = 0; column < forward.Width; ++column)
                    {
                        auto* expected = reinterpret_cast<const uint16_t*>(opaqueLighting.Bytes.data() +
                                                                           row * opaqueLighting.RowPitch + column * 8);
                        auto* actual = reinterpret_cast<const uint16_t*>(forward.Bytes.data() + row * forward.RowPitch +
                                                                         column * 8);
                        for (UINT channel = 0; channel < 3; ++channel)
                        {
                            const float referenceValue = RenderCapture::HalfToFloat(expected[channel]);
                            errorSum += fabs(RenderCapture::HalfToFloat(actual[channel]) - referenceValue);
                            referenceSum += fabs(referenceValue);
                        }
                    }
                }
                const double relativeError = errorSum / max(referenceSum, 0.000001);
                WriteGraphicsLog("Transparency relative HDR lighting error = %.6f\n", relativeError);
                Check(relativeError < 0.02, "Deferred / Forward HDR lighting agrees within two percent");
            }
            RenderCapture::SaveTexturePng(RenderTargets::GetSceneResource(),
                                          L"build/material-tests/transparency-forward.png");
        }
        if (frame == 29)
        {
            Check(RenderCapture::ReadTexture(RenderTargets::GetSceneResource(), invisibleLighting),
                  "capture zero-opacity with emission");
        }
        if (frame == 31)
        {
            RenderCapture::TextureData absent;
            Check(RenderCapture::ReadTexture(RenderTargets::GetSceneResource(), absent) &&
                      EqualPixels(invisibleLighting, absent, 8),
                  "opacity zero equals no draw pixel-for-pixel");
            Check(!EqualPixels(opaqueLighting, absent, 8), "lighting comparison contains a visible material fixture");
        }
        if (frame == 47)
        {
            const auto t = MinimumTransmission(0);
            Check(fabs(t.x - 0.5f) < 0.002f && fabs(t.y - 0.5f) < 0.002f,
                  "half coverage transmits half the source light");
            CheckShadowDepth(false);
            Check(!Raytracing::UsesRaytracedShadows(), "transparent casters use material-aware raster shadows");
        }
        if (frame == 49)
        {
            const auto t = MinimumTransmission(0);
            Check(fabs(t.x - 0.96153846f) < 0.002f, "dielectric slab includes Fresnel exit and internal reflections");
        }
        if (frame == 51)
        {
            thinTransmission = MinimumTransmission(0);
            Check(thinTransmission.x < thinTransmission.y && thinTransmission.y < thinTransmission.z,
                  "RGB absorption produces colored transmissive shadows");
        }
        if (frame == 53)
        {
            const auto t = MinimumTransmission(0);
            Check(t.x < thinTransmission.x && t.y < thinTransmission.y && fabs(t.z - thinTransmission.z) < 0.002f,
                  "increasing thickness absorbs more light without changing nonabsorbing wavelengths");
        }
        if (frame == 55)
        {
            const auto firstLayer = MinimumTransmission(0);
            const auto secondLayer = MinimumTransmission(1);
            const auto emptyLayer = MinimumTransmission(2);
            Check(firstLayer.x < 0.9f && secondLayer.x < 0.9f && emptyLayer.x == 1,
                  "depth peeling captures two entries without double-counting exits");
            Check(RenderCapture::SaveScenePng(L"build/material-tests/transmission-overlap.png"),
                  "capture colored transparent shadow scene");
        }
        if (frame == 57)
        {
            Check(!TransmittanceShadows::HasCasters(), "zero opacity bypasses transmissive shadow rendering");
        }
        if (frame == 59)
        {
            receiverBeforeCaster = ReadReceiverLight();
        }
        if (frame == 61)
        {
            const auto unshadowed = ReadReceiverLight();
            Check(receiverBeforeCaster.x > 0 && fabs(receiverBeforeCaster.x - unshadowed.x) < 0.002f &&
                      fabs(receiverBeforeCaster.y - unshadowed.y) < 0.002f,
                  "objects behind a receiver do not attenuate its light");
        }
        if (frame == 63)
        {
            receiverBehindCaster = ReadReceiverLight();
        }
        if (frame == 65)
        {
            const auto unshadowed = ReadReceiverLight();
            Check(unshadowed.x > receiverBehindCaster.x + 0.01f && unshadowed.y > receiverBehindCaster.y + 0.01f,
                  "Deferred receiver radiance includes optical shadow transmission");
            Check(fabs(unshadowed.z - receiverBehindCaster.z) < max(0.01f, unshadowed.z * 0.15f),
                  "nonabsorbing blue light remains transmitted apart from Fresnel reflection");
        }
        if (frame == 67)
        {
            Check(MinimumTransmission(0).x < 0.9f, "virtual shadow pages contain RGB transmission");
        }
        if (frame == 69)
        {
            Check(MinimumTransmission(0).x > 0.9f, "optical parameter edits invalidate virtual shadow pages");
        }
        if (frame == 71)
        {
            const auto t = MinimumTransmission(0);
            Check(t.x < 0.1f && t.y > 0.9f && t.z > 0.9f,
                  "zero thickness cyan glass tints virtual shadow transmission");
            Check(RenderCapture::SaveScenePng(L"build/material-tests/transmission-cyan.png"),
                  "capture zero thickness cyan glass shadow");
        }
        if (frame == 73 || frame == 75)
        {
            const auto t = MinimumTransmission(0);
            Check(t.x > 0.9f && t.y < 0.1f && t.z > 0.9f,
                  "base color edits tint zero thickness glass shadows in VSM and conventional maps");
        }
        if (frame == 77)
        {
            iesDisabledLight = ReadReceiverLight();
            Check(iesDisabledLight.x > 0.01f, "IES fixture receiver is illuminated");
            Check(RenderCapture::SaveScenePng(L"build/material-tests/ies-disabled.png"), "capture conventional lighting");
        }
        if (frame == 79)
        {
            iesNarrowLight = ReadReceiverLight();
            Check(iesNarrowLight.x + 0.01f < iesDisabledLight.x,
                  "IES narrow beam changes receiver radiance outside its beam");
            Check(RenderCapture::SaveScenePng(L"build/material-tests/ies-enabled.png"), "capture IES lighting");
        }
        if (frame == 81 || frame == 83 || frame == 85)
        {
            const auto radiance = ReadReceiverLight();
            Check(fabs(radiance.x - iesDisabledLight.x) < max(0.003f, iesDisabledLight.x * 0.03f),
                  "IES disabled, missing and empty profiles preserve conventional lighting");
        }
        if (frame == 87)
        {
            iesNarrowLight = ReadReceiverLight();
        }
        if (frame == 89)
        {
            iesRotatedLight = ReadReceiverLight();
            Check(iesRotatedLight.x > iesNarrowLight.x + 0.01f,
                  "rotating an asymmetric IES profile rotates the illuminated direction");
        }
        if (frame == 91)
        {
            const auto radiance = ReadReceiverLight();
            Check(MegaLights::GetStats().SubmittedLights > 0, "IES fixture uses the MegaLights grid");
            Check(fabs(radiance.x - iesRotatedLight.x) < max(0.005f, iesRotatedLight.x * 0.1f),
                  "MegaLights and conventional lighting agree on IES orientation and radiance");
        }
        if (frame == 93 || frame == 95)
        {
            Check(AdvancedEffects::IsFroxelFogActive(), "IES profiles are exercised by froxel fog compute shaders");
            for (const auto& texture : TextureManager::GetLoadedTextureInfos())
            {
                Check(texture.Path.rfind("IES:", 0) != 0,
                      "generated IES data is separate from image-file texture listings");
            }
        }
        if (frame == 97)
        {
            const auto radiance = ReadReceiverLight();
            Check(fabs(radiance.x - iesRotatedLight.x) < max(0.005f, iesRotatedLight.x * 0.1f),
                  "Forward and Deferred lighting agree on IES orientation and radiance");
        }
    }
}

bool MaterialValidation::Enabled()
{
    if (GiValidation::Enabled())
    {
        return true;
    }
    char value[8]{};
    return GetEnvironmentVariableA("DX12_MATERIAL_ASSET_TEST", value, sizeof(value)) > 0 && atoi(value) != 0;
}

void MaterialValidation::BeforeFrame(uint64_t frame)
{
    if (GiValidation::Enabled())
    {
        ImGuiManager::m_ProjectSettingsLoaded = true;
        ImGuiManager::m_ShowAdjustmentPanel = false;
        GiValidation::BeforeFrame(frame);
        return;
    }
    frames = frame + 1;
    if (ParallaxValidationEnabled() && frame > 0)
    {
        ImGuiManager::m_ShowMaterialEditorWindow = false;
        PrepareParallaxFrame(frame);
        return;
    }
    // 透明描画のテストがシーンとマテリアルを置き換える前に、エディター入力テストを終える。
    if (frame >= 33)
    {
        PrepareTransparencyFrame(frame - 9);
        PrepareTransmissionFrame(frame - 9);
        PrepareIesFrame(frame - 9);
        if (frame == 85)
        {
            std::ostringstream settings;
            ImGuiManager::PersistentSettings(&settings);
            Check(settings.str().find("ies_profiles_enabled=0\n") != string::npos,
                  "environment settings persist the IES switch");
            ImGuiManager::PersistentSettings(nullptr, "ies_profiles_enabled", "1");
            Check(RendererSettings::GetIesProfilesEnabled(), "environment settings restore IES enabled");
            ImGuiManager::PersistentSettings(nullptr, "ies_profiles_enabled", "0");
            Check(!RendererSettings::GetIesProfilesEnabled(), "environment settings restore IES disabled");
        }
    }
    if (frame == 0)
    {
        RenderProfiler::SetWindowVisible(false);
        ImGuiManager::m_ShowAdjustmentPanel = false;
        ImGuiManager::m_ProjectSettingsLoaded = true;
        vector<EntityID> remove;
        for (uint32_t entity = 0; entity < Registry::GetEntities().size(); ++entity)
        {
            if (Registry::IsAlive(entity) && !ComponentManager::HasComponent<CameraComponent>(entity))
            {
                remove.push_back(entity);
            }
        }
        for (EntityID entity : remove)
        {
            World::DestroyEntity(Entity(entity));
        }
        fixtureRoot = AssetRegistry::ValidationCacheRoot() / ("__material_validation_" + to_string(GetCurrentProcessId()));
        filesystem::create_directories(fixtureRoot);
        filesystem::create_directories("build/material-tests");
        const auto normal = fixtureRoot / "Normal.tga";
        MakeNormalTexture(normal);
        ownedFiles.push_back(normal);
        ownedFiles.emplace_back(normal.wstring() + L".meta");
        string error;
        const auto normalHandle = MaterialManager::Registry().Register(normal, AssetType::Texture, error);
        normalTextureHandle = normalHandle;
        Check(normalHandle != 0, "register texture GUID");
        const auto surface = fixtureRoot / "Surface.tga";
        MakeSurfaceTexture(surface);
        ownedFiles.push_back(surface);
        ownedFiles.emplace_back(surface.wstring() + L".meta");
        surfaceTextureHandle = MaterialManager::Registry().Register(surface, AssetType::Texture, error);
        MaterialAssetData authored;
        authored.BaseColor = {0.7f, 0.25f, 0.13f, 1};
        authored.Roughness = 0.7f;
        authored.Metallic = 0.6f;
        authored.AOStrength = 0.8f;
        authored.Textures = {surfaceTextureHandle, normalHandle, surfaceTextureHandle, surfaceTextureHandle,
                             surfaceTextureHandle};
        authored.Textures[1] = normalHandle;
        authored.EmissiveColor = {0.2f, 0.1f, 0.02f};
        authored.EmissiveIntensity = 0.4f;
        const auto path = fixtureRoot / "Brick.material";
        Check(MaterialSerializer::Save(path, authored, error), "create material file");
        ownedFiles.push_back(path);
        ownedFiles.emplace_back(path.wstring() + L".meta");
        handle = MaterialManager::Registry().Register(path, AssetType::Material, error);
        ImGuiManager::OpenMaterialAsset(handle);
        MaterialPreview::SetLightIntensity(0.0f);
        first = MakeCube(-1.2f);
        second = MakeCube(1.2f);
        Check(MaterialManager::Assign(first, 0, handle) && MaterialManager::Assign(second, 0, handle),
              "assign shared material slots");
        const auto& left = MaterialManager::Resolve(ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<MaterialComponent>(first));
        const auto& right =
            MaterialManager::Resolve(ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<MaterialComponent>(second));
        Check(&left == &right && left.NormalMapID >= 0, "one shared runtime and resolved normal descriptor");
        Check(!MaterialManager::Assign(Camera::GetCameraEntity(), 0, handle), "reject camera material drop");
        Check(!MaterialManager::Assign(first, 1, handle), "reject out-of-range material slot");
        auto sprite = World::CreateEntity().Add<TransformComponent>().Add<SpriteComponent>().Add<MaterialComponent>();
        sprite.Get<SpriteComponent>().Is3D = true;
        VertexResource spriteGeometry{};
        spriteGeometry.entityid = sprite.GetID();
        spriteGeometry.shapetype = ShapeType::QUAD;
        spriteGeometry.radius = .5f;
        spriteGeometry.color = Color::WHITE;
        PrimitiveGeometry::CreateSpriteVertex(spriteGeometry);
        Check(MaterialManager::SlotCount(sprite.GetID()) == 1 && MaterialManager::Assign(sprite.GetID(), 0, handle),
              "legacy world-space sprite accepts material asset");
        const auto& spriteMaterial = MaterialManager::Resolve(sprite.Get<MaterialComponent>());
        Check(spriteMaterial.RuntimeHandle == handle && spriteMaterial.NormalMapID == left.NormalMapID,
              "world-space sprite resolves shared textures and normal map");
        Check(!MaterialManager::Assign(sprite.GetID(), 1, handle), "sprite rejects extra material slots");
        sprite.Get<SpriteComponent>().Is3D = false;
        Check(!MaterialManager::IsRenderable(sprite.GetID()) && !MaterialManager::Assign(sprite.GetID(), 0, handle),
              "screen-space sprite keeps separate material policy");
        World::DestroyEntity(sprite);
        const auto copy = fixtureRoot / "Brick_Copy.material";
        copyHandle = MaterialManager::Registry().Duplicate(handle, copy, error);
        ownedFiles.push_back(copy);
        ownedFiles.emplace_back(copy.wstring() + L".meta");
        Check(copyHandle != 0 && copyHandle != handle, "duplicate material has independent identity");
        ImGuiManager::AssignMaterialAsset(first, 0, copyHandle);
        ImGuiManager::Undo();
        Check(MaterialManager::SlotHandle(ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<MaterialComponent>(first), 0) ==
                  handle,
              "Undo restores assignment");
        ImGuiManager::Redo();
        Check(MaterialManager::SlotHandle(ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<MaterialComponent>(first), 0) ==
                  copyHandle,
              "Redo reapplies assignment");
        MaterialManager::Assign(first, 0, handle);
        Check(MaterialManager::SaveSceneReferences("build/material-tests/scene.json", error), "scene references saved");
        MaterialManager::Assign(second, 0, copyHandle);
        Check(MaterialManager::LoadSceneReferences("build/material-tests/scene.json", error) &&
                  MaterialManager::SlotHandle(ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<MaterialComponent>(second), 0) ==
                      handle,
              "scene GUID reference roundtrip");
        const auto moved = fixtureRoot / "Wall.material";
        Check(MaterialManager::Registry().Move(handle, moved, error), "rename/move preserves material GUID");
        ownedFiles.push_back(moved);
        ownedFiles.emplace_back(moved.wstring() + L".meta");
        Check(
            MaterialManager::Resolve(ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<MaterialComponent>(first)).RuntimeHandle ==
                handle,
            "scene reference survives rename");
        const auto meshPath = fixtureRoot / "sections.obj";
        const auto mtlPath = fixtureRoot / "sections.mtl";
        ofstream(meshPath)
            << "mtllib sections.mtl\nv -1 -1 0\nv 0 1 0\nv 1 -1 0\nv 2 -1 0\nv 3 1 0\nv 4 -1 0\nusemtl One\nf 1 2 3\nusemtl Two\nf 4 5 6\n";
        ofstream(mtlPath) << "newmtl One\nKd 1 1 1\nnewmtl Two\nKd 0.5 1 1\n";
        ownedFiles.push_back(meshPath);
        ownedFiles.push_back(mtlPath);
        auto entity =
            World::CreateEntity().Add<TransformComponent>().Add<StaticModelComponent>().Add<MaterialComponent>();
        multi = entity.GetID();
        entity.Get<StaticModelComponent>().ModelId =
            ModelManager::LoadStaticModel(meshPath.generic_string().c_str(), false);
        entity.Get<TransformComponent>().Position = {0, 100, 0};
        Check(MaterialManager::SlotCount(multi) == 2, "multi-submesh exposes two slots");
        MaterialManager::Assign(multi, 0, handle);
        MaterialManager::Assign(multi, 1, copyHandle);
        Check(MaterialManager::SlotHandle(entity.Get<MaterialComponent>(), 0) == handle &&
                  MaterialManager::SlotHandle(entity.Get<MaterialComponent>(), 1) == copyHandle,
              "slot assignment is isolated");
        auto baseline = World::CreateEntity().Add<TransformComponent>().Add<StaticModelComponent>();
        baseline.Get<StaticModelComponent>().ModelId = entity.Get<StaticModelComponent>().ModelId;
        baseline.Get<TransformComponent>().Position = {0, 200, 0};
        Check(MaterialManager::HasSurfaceForPass(baseline.GetID(), false),
              "model without MaterialComponent keeps its default material");
        MaterialManager::Assign(multi, 1, 0);
        entity.Get<MaterialComponent>().IsTransparent = true;
        entity.Get<MaterialComponent>().Alpha = 0.4f;
        Check(MaterialManager::HasSurfaceForPass(multi, false) && MaterialManager::HasSurfaceForPass(multi, true),
              "mixed opaque asset and transparent legacy slots route to both passes");
        Check(!GPUDrivenRenderer::SupportsEntity(multi), "mixed transparent model uses per-section CPU fallback");
        Raytracing::GetSettings().Enabled = false;
        DayNightCycle::GetSettings().Running = false;
        RenderConfiguration::SetRenderMode(RenderMode::DEFERRED);
        RendererSettings::SetComputeGBufferEnabled(false);
        RendererSettings::SetMeshShadersEnabled(false);
        RendererSettings::SetSsaoEnabled(false);
        RendererSettings::SetSsgiEnabled(false);
        GPUVisibility::GetSettings().Occlusion = false;
        GPUVisibility::GetSettings().LOD = false;
        GPUDrivenRenderer::SetEnabled(false);
        auto& camera = ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<CameraComponent>(Camera::GetCameraEntity());
        auto& transform = ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<TransformComponent>(Camera::GetCameraEntity());
        transform.Position = {0, 0, -7};
        transform.IsDirty = true;
        camera.Target = {0, 0, 0};
        camera.AllowUserControl = false;
        camera.LockOnTarget = g_kINVALID_ENTITY;
    }
    if (frame == 2)
    {
        MaterialPreview::SetLightIntensity(5.0f);
        auto editing = MaterialManager::GetRuntime(handle).Editing;
        const auto before = MaterialManager::GetRuntime(handle).Revision;
        editing.Roughness = 0.27f;
        Check(MaterialManager::SetEditing(handle, editing), "real-time parameter edit");
        Check(MaterialManager::GetRuntime(handle).Revision == before + 1 && MaterialManager::GetRuntime(handle).Dirty,
              "dirty state and runtime revision");
        Check(MaterialManager::Resolve(ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<MaterialComponent>(second)).Roughness ==
                  0.27f,
              "edit reflected in every shared entity");
        Check(MaterialManager::GetRuntime(copyHandle).Editing.Roughness == 0.7f, "duplicate remains independent");
        Check(MaterialManager::Save(handle) && !MaterialManager::GetRuntime(handle).Dirty, "Save clears dirty state");
        editing.Roughness = 0.9f;
        MaterialManager::SetEditing(handle, editing);
        Check(MaterialManager::Revert(handle) && MaterialManager::GetRuntime(handle).Editing.Roughness == 0.27f,
              "Revert restores disk state and shared runtime");
    }
    if (frame == 4)
    {
        MaterialPreview::SetMesh(MaterialPreview::Mesh::Cube);
        GPUDrivenRenderer::SetEnabled(true);
        GPUVisibility::GetSettings().LOD = true;
        GPUVisibility::GetSettings().ForceLOD = 0;
    }
    if (frame == 6)
    {
        MaterialPreview::SetMesh(MaterialPreview::Mesh::Plane);
        auto editing = MaterialManager::GetRuntime(handle).Editing;
        editing.NormalScale = 0;
        MaterialManager::SetEditing(handle, editing);
    }
    if (frame == 8)
    {
        error_code ignored;
        filesystem::remove(MaterialManager::Registry().Resolve(handle), ignored);
        MaterialManager::Refresh();
        const auto& fallback =
            MaterialManager::Resolve(ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<MaterialComponent>(first));
        Check(fallback.Roughness == 0.5f && fallback.NormalMapID < 0, "missing material uses default runtime");
        MaterialManager::Discard(handle);
        Check(!MaterialManager::GetRuntime(handle).Dirty, "missing dirty material can be discarded");
    }
    if (frame == 9)
    {
        ImGuiManager::m_ShowMaterialEditorWindow = false;
        const auto identity = ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<MaterialComponent>(first).MaterialSceneIdentity;
        World::DestroyEntity(Entity(first));
        auto unrelated = World::CreateEntity()
                             .Add<TransformComponent>()
                             .Add<MeshComponent>()
                             .Add<MaterialComponent>()
                             .Add<NameComponent>();
        unrelated.SetName("Unrelated fixture");
        unrelated.Get<TransformComponent>().Position = {0, 300, 0};
        VertexResource unrelatedMesh;
        unrelatedMesh.entityid = unrelated.GetID();
        unrelatedMesh.objectType = ObjectType::SPHERE;
        unrelatedMesh.color = Color::WHITE;
        PrimitiveGeometry::CreateObjectVertex(unrelatedMesh);
        string error;
        Check(MaterialManager::LoadSceneReferences("build/material-tests/scene.json", error),
              "restore scene references after entity destruction");
        bool restored = false;
        for (EntityID entity : World::GetView<MaterialComponent>())
        {
            const auto& component = ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<MaterialComponent>(entity);
            if (component.MaterialSceneIdentity == identity)
            {
                restored = MaterialManager::IsRenderable(entity) && MaterialManager::SlotHandle(component, 0) == handle;
            }
        }
        Check(restored, "saved primitive geometry and stable material reference recreate an entity");
        Check(unrelated.Get<NameComponent>().Name == "Unrelated fixture" &&
                  unrelated.Get<MaterialComponent>().MaterialSlots.empty(),
              "scene restore never overwrites an unrelated reused entity ID");
        ofstream("build/material-tests/bad-scene.json")
            << "{\"version\":1,\"entities\":[{\"entity\":0,\"materialSlots\":[\"bad-guid\"]}]}";
        Check(!MaterialManager::LoadSceneReferences("build/material-tests/bad-scene.json", error) &&
                  MaterialManager::SlotHandle(ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<MaterialComponent>(second), 0) ==
                      handle,
              "invalid scene GUID is rejected before altering assignments");
    }
    if (frame == 11)
    {
        ImGuiManager::m_SelectedEntity = second;
    }
    if (frame == 12)
    {
        ImGuiManager::m_SelectedEntity = second;
        MaterialManager::Assign(second, 0, 0);
    }
    if (frame == 15)
    {
        ImGuiManager::OpenMaterialAsset(copyHandle);
        auto editing = MaterialManager::GetRuntime(copyHandle).Editing;
        editing.Textures[1] = 0;
        MaterialManager::SetEditing(copyHandle, editing);
    }
    if (frame == 18)
    {
        error_code ignored;
        filesystem::remove(MaterialManager::Registry().Resolve(surfaceTextureHandle), ignored);
        MaterialManager::Refresh();
        const auto& binding = MaterialManager::GetRuntime(copyHandle).Binding;
        Check(!binding.UseTexture && binding.MetallicRoughnessID < 0 && binding.AOTextureID < 0 &&
                  binding.EmissiveTextureID < 0,
              "missing textures safely use all slot fallbacks");
        auto editing = MaterialManager::GetRuntime(copyHandle).Editing;
        editing.Roughness = 0.42f;
        MaterialManager::SetEditing(copyHandle, editing);
    }
    if (frame == 20)
    {
        auto editing = MaterialManager::GetRuntime(copyHandle).Editing;
        editing.Roughness = 0.82f;
        MaterialManager::SetEditing(copyHandle, editing);
    }
    if (frame == 31)
    {
        ImGuiManager::MaterialEditorUndo(false);
    }
    if (frame == 32)
    {
        ImGuiManager::MaterialEditorUndo(true);
    }
}

void MaterialValidation::AfterFrame(uint64_t frame)
{
    if (ParallaxValidationEnabled())
    {
        CheckParallaxFrame(frame);
        return;
    }
    if (GiValidation::Enabled())
    {
        GiValidation::AfterFrame(frame);
        return;
    }
    if (frame >= 33)
    {
        CheckTransparencyFrame(frame - 9);
    }
    const auto* firstInstance = GpuScene::GetInstance(GpuScene::GetEntityInstance(first));
    const auto* secondInstance = GpuScene::GetInstance(GpuScene::GetEntityInstance(second));
    if (frame == 1)
    {
        Check(firstInstance && secondInstance && firstInstance->MaterialIndex == secondInstance->MaterialIndex,
              "shared GPU material index");
        if (firstInstance)
        {
            gpuIndex = firstInstance->MaterialIndex;
        }
    }
    if (frame == 1)
    {
        constantEditPipelineCreations = PsoManager::GraphicsPipelineCreations();
        unlitPreviewBrightness = PreviewBrightness();
        RenderCapture::SaveTexturePng(MaterialPreview::GetTarget(), L"build/material-tests/preview-unlit.png");
    }
    if (frame == 3)
    {
        const float litPreviewBrightness = PreviewBrightness();
        RenderCapture::SaveTexturePng(MaterialPreview::GetTarget(), L"build/material-tests/preview-lit.png");
        WriteGraphicsLog("Preview lighting brightness: unlit=%.6f lit=%.6f\n", unlitPreviewBrightness,
                         litPreviewBrightness);
        Check(litPreviewBrightness > unlitPreviewBrightness + 0.015f,
              "preview studio light increases rendered surface brightness");
        Check(firstInstance && firstInstance->MaterialIndex == gpuIndex, "constant edit updates GPU record in place");
        vector<uint8_t> records;
        Check(RenderCapture::ReadBuffer(GpuScene::MaterialBuffer(), D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_NON_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE,
                                        uint64_t(GpuScene::Statistics().Materials) * sizeof(GPUMaterialData), records),
              "read shared GPU material");
        if (gpuIndex != UINT32_MAX && records.size() >= (uint64_t(gpuIndex) + 1) * sizeof(GPUMaterialData))
        {
            GPUMaterialData material;
            memcpy(&material, records.data() + gpuIndex * sizeof(GPUMaterialData), sizeof(material));
            Check(material.Surface.y == 0.27f && material.NormalTextureIndex != UINT32_MAX,
                  "GPU record contains updated roughness and normal");
        }
        for (uint32_t target = 0; target < reference.size(); ++target)
        {
            Check(RenderCapture::ReadTexture(RenderTargets::GetGBufferResource(static_cast<GBufferType>(target)),
                                             reference[target]),
                  "capture CPU GBuffer");
        }
        Check(PsoManager::GraphicsPipelineCreations() == constantEditPipelineCreations,
              "constant edit does not create graphics pipelines");
        Check(GpuScene::Statistics().InstanceUploadedBytes == 0, "shared constant edit uploads no entity instances");
        withNormal = reference[1];
        bool verifiedSurfaceChannels = false;
        const auto& materialTexture = reference[3];
        const auto& emissionTexture = reference[5];
        for (UINT row = 0; row < materialTexture.Height && !verifiedSurfaceChannels; ++row)
        {
            for (UINT column = 0; column < materialTexture.Width; ++column)
            {
                const auto* materialPixel = reinterpret_cast<const uint16_t*>(
                    materialTexture.Bytes.data() + row * materialTexture.RowPitch + column * 8);
                if (RenderCapture::HalfToFloat(materialPixel[3]) == static_cast<float>(ShaderClass::PBR))
                {
                    const auto* emissionPixel = reinterpret_cast<const uint16_t*>(
                        emissionTexture.Bytes.data() + row * emissionTexture.RowPitch + column * 8);
                    const float expectedMetallic = 0.6f * (64.0f / 255.0f);
                    const float expectedRoughness = 0.27f * (128.0f / 255.0f);
                    const float expectedAO = 0.2f + 0.8f * (64.0f / 255.0f);
                    Check(abs(RenderCapture::HalfToFloat(materialPixel[0]) - expectedMetallic) < 0.001f &&
                              abs(RenderCapture::HalfToFloat(materialPixel[1]) - expectedRoughness) < 0.001f,
                          "metallic R and roughness G channels modulate scalar parameters");
                    Check(abs(RenderCapture::HalfToFloat(emissionPixel[3]) - expectedAO) < 0.001f &&
                              RenderCapture::HalfToFloat(emissionPixel[0]) > 0.015f,
                          "AO strength and textured emission reach production GBuffer");
                    verifiedSurfaceChannels = true;
                    break;
                }
            }
        }
        Check(verifiedSurfaceChannels, "material texture validation covers rendered pixels");
        RenderCapture::SaveScenePng(L"build/material-tests/cpu.png");
        Check(MaterialPreview::GetTarget() &&
                  RenderCapture::SaveTexturePng(MaterialPreview::GetTarget(), L"build/material-tests/preview.png"),
              "production material preview renders");
    }
    if (frame == 5)
    {
        Check(GPUDrivenRenderer::HandlesEntity(first), "GPULOD owns material asset entity");
        for (uint32_t target = 0; target < reference.size(); ++target)
        {
            RenderCapture::TextureData gpu;
            Check(RenderCapture::ReadTexture(RenderTargets::GetGBufferResource(static_cast<GBufferType>(target)), gpu),
                  "capture GPU GBuffer");
            UINT pixelBytes = 4;
            if (target == 3 || target == 5)
            {
                pixelBytes = 8;
            }
            Check(EqualPixels(reference[target], gpu, pixelBytes), "GPULOD ON/OFF material GBuffer parity");
        }
        RenderCapture::SaveScenePng(L"build/material-tests/gpulod.png");
        Check(RenderCapture::SaveTexturePng(MaterialPreview::GetTarget(), L"build/material-tests/preview-cube.png"),
              "preview Cube uses production material");
    }
    if (frame == 7)
    {
        Check(RenderCapture::SaveTexturePng(MaterialPreview::GetTarget(), L"build/material-tests/preview-plane.png"),
              "preview Plane uses production material");
        RenderCapture::TextureData flat;
        Check(RenderCapture::ReadTexture(RenderTargets::GetGBufferResource(GBufferType::NORMAL), flat) &&
                  !EqualPixels(withNormal, flat, 4),
              "normal texture visibly changes GBuffer normals");
    }
    if (frame == 11)
    {
        Check(MaterialManager::SlotHandle(ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<MaterialComponent>(second), 0) ==
                  copyHandle,
              "Viewport UI accepts material drag/drop on picked entity");
    }
    if (frame == 14)
    {
        Check(MaterialManager::SlotHandle(ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<MaterialComponent>(second), 0) ==
                  copyHandle,
              "Inspector UI accepts material drag/drop on selected slot");
    }
    if (frame == 17)
    {
        Check(MaterialManager::GetRuntime(copyHandle).Editing.Textures[1] == normalTextureHandle,
              "Material Editor UI accepts texture drag/drop");
    }
    if (frame == 19)
    {
        MaterialAssetData saved;
        string error;
        Check(!MaterialManager::GetRuntime(copyHandle).Dirty &&
                  MaterialSerializer::Load(MaterialManager::Registry().Resolve(copyHandle), saved, error) &&
                  saved.Roughness == 0.42f,
              "Ctrl+S saves the focused material editor to disk");
    }
    if (frame == 23)
    {
        Check(!MaterialManager::GetRuntime(copyHandle).Dirty &&
                  MaterialManager::GetRuntime(copyHandle).Editing.Roughness == 0.42f,
              "Revert toolbar discards unsaved changes");
        if (const auto* window = ImGui::FindWindowByID(previewWindowId))
        {
            previewWindowPosition = window->Pos;
        }
    }
    if (frame == 24)
    {
        Check(RenderCapture::ReadTexture(MaterialPreview::GetTarget(), beforeOrbit),
              "capture preview before orbit drag");
    }
    if (frame == 26)
    {
        const auto* window = ImGui::FindWindowByID(previewWindowId);
        Check(window && window->Pos.x == previewWindowPosition.x && window->Pos.y == previewWindowPosition.y,
              "orbit drag keeps material editor window stationary");
        RenderCapture::TextureData afterOrbit;
        Check(RenderCapture::ReadTexture(MaterialPreview::GetTarget(), afterOrbit) &&
                  !EqualPixels(beforeOrbit, afterOrbit, 4),
              "orbit drag changes preview viewing angle");
    }
    if (frame == 28)
    {
        const auto& editing = MaterialManager::GetRuntime(copyHandle).Editing;
        savedPreviewAlpha = editing.BaseColor[3];
        Check(savedPreviewAlpha > 0.0f && savedPreviewAlpha < 1.0f && editing.Surface == MaterialSurface::Transparent &&
                  !editing.DepthWrite,
              "transparency slider edits alpha and enables transparent rendering");
        Check(RenderCapture::SaveTexturePng(MaterialPreview::GetTarget(),
                                            L"build/material-tests/preview-transparent.png"),
              "capture transparent preview");
    }
    if (frame == 30)
    {
        MaterialAssetData saved;
        string error;
        Check(MaterialSerializer::Load(MaterialManager::Registry().Resolve(copyHandle), saved, error) &&
                  saved.BaseColor[3] == savedPreviewAlpha && saved.Surface == MaterialSurface::Transparent,
              "Ctrl+S persists transparency from editor slider");
    }
    if (frame == 31)
    {
        Check(MaterialManager::GetRuntime(copyHandle).Editing.BaseColor[3] == 1.0f,
              "Undo restores transparency slider edit");
    }
    if (frame == 32)
    {
        Check(MaterialManager::GetRuntime(copyHandle).Editing.BaseColor[3] == savedPreviewAlpha,
              "Redo restores transparency slider edit");
    }
}

void MaterialValidation::CaptureDropTarget(const char* name, float left, float top, float right, float bottom)
{
    if (!Enabled())
    {
        return;
    }
    const XMFLOAT2 center{(left + right) * 0.5f, (top + bottom) * 0.5f};
    if (strcmp(name, "Inspector") == 0)
    {
        inspectorDrop = center;
        inspectorWindowId = ImGui::GetCurrentWindow()->RootWindow->ID;
        if (frames <= 14)
        {
            ImGui::SetScrollHereY(0.5f);
        }
    }
    else if (strcmp(name, "Normal") == 0)
    {
        normalDrop = center;
        if (frames <= 16)
        {
            ImGui::SetScrollHereY(0.5f);
        }
    }
    else if (strcmp(name, "Revert") == 0)
    {
        revertButton = center;
    }
    else if (strcmp(name, "Preview") == 0)
    {
        previewImage = center;
        previewWindowId = ImGui::GetCurrentWindow()->RootWindow->ID;
    }
    else if (strcmp(name, "Transparency") == 0)
    {
        // Slider item bounds include the label; the navigation rectangle is the clickable track.
        const ImRect track = ImGui::GetCurrentContext()->LastItemData.NavRect;
        transparencySlider = {(track.Min.x + track.Max.x) * 0.5f, (track.Min.y + track.Max.y) * 0.5f};
        if (frames == 23 || frames == 24)
        {
            ImGui::SetScrollHereY(0.5f);
        }
    }
}

void MaterialValidation::BeforeEditorFrame()
{
    if (ParallaxValidationEnabled())
    {
        return;
    }
    if (GiValidation::Enabled())
    {
        return;
    }
    if (!Enabled())
    {
        return;
    }
    injectDrag = false;
    const auto frame = frames - 1;
    if (frame == 12)
    {
        // Bring the target area forward before dragging, as a user would with floating panels.
        if (ImGuiWindow* window = ImGui::FindWindowByID(inspectorWindowId))
        {
            ImGui::FocusWindow(window);
        }
    }
    if (frame >= 24 && frame <= 28)
    {
        auto mouse = previewImage;
        if (frame == 25 || frame == 26)
        {
            mouse.x += 40.0f;
            mouse.y += 20.0f;
        }
        if (frame >= 27)
        {
            mouse = transparencySlider;
        }
        auto& input = ImGui::GetIO();
        input.AddMousePosEvent(mouse.x, mouse.y);
        input.AddMouseButtonEvent(ImGuiMouseButton_Left, frame == 24 || frame == 25 || frame == 27);
        return;
    }
    if (frame == 29 || frame == 30)
    {
        ImGui::GetIO().AddKeyEvent(ImGuiMod_Ctrl, frame == 29);
        ImGui::GetIO().AddKeyEvent(ImGuiKey_S, frame == 29);
        return;
    }
    if (frame == 18 || frame == 19)
    {
        ImGui::GetIO().AddKeyEvent(ImGuiMod_Ctrl, frame == 18);
        ImGui::GetIO().AddKeyEvent(ImGuiKey_S, frame == 18);
        return;
    }
    if (frame == 21 || frame == 22)
    {
        ImGui::GetIO().AddMousePosEvent(revertButton.x, revertButton.y);
        ImGui::GetIO().AddMouseButtonEvent(ImGuiMouseButton_Left, frame == 21);
        return;
    }
    XMFLOAT2 mouse{};
    if (frame == 10 || frame == 11)
    {
        XMMATRIX view;
        XMMATRIX projection;
        Camera::GetCameraMatrices(Camera::GetCameraEntity(), view, projection);
        const auto& position = ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<TransformComponent>(second).Position;
        XMFLOAT3 projected;
        XMStoreFloat3(&projected,
                      XMVector3Project(XMLoadFloat3(&position), ImGuiManager::m_SceneViewPos.x,
                                       ImGuiManager::m_SceneViewPos.y, ImGuiManager::m_SceneViewSize.x,
                                       ImGuiManager::m_SceneViewSize.y, 0, 1, projection, view, XMMatrixIdentity()));
        mouse = {projected.x, projected.y};
        uiPayload = {copyHandle, AssetType::Material};
    }
    else if (frame == 13 || frame == 14)
    {
        mouse = inspectorDrop;
        uiPayload = {copyHandle, AssetType::Material};
    }
    else if (frame == 16 || frame == 17)
    {
        mouse = normalDrop;
        uiPayload = {normalTextureHandle, AssetType::Texture};
    }
    else
    {
        return;
    }
    const bool held = frame == 10 || frame == 13 || frame == 16;
    auto& input = ImGui::GetIO();
    input.AddMousePosEvent(mouse.x, mouse.y);
    input.AddMouseButtonEvent(ImGuiMouseButton_Left, held);
    injectDrag = held;
    WriteGraphicsLog("Material UI trace: frame=%llu mouse=%.1f,%.1f held=%d type=%u\n", frame, mouse.x, mouse.y, held,
                     static_cast<unsigned>(uiPayload.Type));
}

void MaterialValidation::InjectDragPayload()
{
    if (GiValidation::Enabled())
    {
        return;
    }
    if (Enabled() && injectDrag && ImGui::BeginDragDropSource(ImGuiDragDropFlags_SourceExtern))
    {
        ImGui::SetDragDropPayload(AssetPayloadType, &uiPayload, sizeof(uiPayload));
        ImGui::TextUnformatted("Material validation drag source");
        ImGui::EndDragDropSource();
    }
}

bool MaterialValidation::Finish()
{
    if (GiValidation::Enabled())
    {
        return GiValidation::Finish();
    }
    GraphicsDevice::WaitForGpuIdle();
    Check(frames >= (ParallaxValidationEnabled() ? 11u : 33u), "complete material validation sequence");
    failures += RenderCapture::ReportGraphicsErrors();
    for (const auto& path : ownedFiles)
    {
        error_code ignored;
        filesystem::remove(path, ignored);
    }
    error_code ignored;
    if (!fixtureRoot.empty())
    {
        filesystem::remove_all(fixtureRoot, ignored); // .meta など個別管理外のファイルも残さない
    }
    WriteGraphicsLog("Material validation failures = %u\n", failures);
    return failures == 0;
}

#include "pch.h"
#include "renderbenchmark.h"
