                if (reference.Bytes.size() != optimized.Bytes.size() || reference.Bytes.empty())
                {
                    Check(false, "shadow comparison has equal nonempty dimensions");
                    continue;
                }
                for (UINT y = 0; y < reference.Height; ++y)
                {
                    for (UINT x = 0; x < reference.Width; ++x)
                    {
                        float a;
                        float b;
                        memcpy(&a, reference.Bytes.data() + y * reference.RowPitch + x * sizeof(float), sizeof(float));
                        memcpy(&b, optimized.Bytes.data() + y * optimized.RowPitch + x * sizeof(float), sizeof(float));
                        populated += a < 1.0f;
                        const float error = abs(a - b);
                        maximumError = max(maximumError, error);
                        changed += error > 0.00001f;
                    }
                }
                WriteGraphicsLog(
                    "Play shadow comparison frame=%llu layer=%u populated=%llu changed=%llu maxError=%.8f\n", frame,
                    layer, populated, changed, maximumError);
                Check(changed == 0, "merged and reference shadow depths match within 1e-5");
            }
        }
        return;
    }
    if (ThumbnailValidation::Enabled())
    {
        ThumbnailValidation::AfterFrame(frame);
        return;
    }
    if (MaterialValidation::Enabled())
    {
        MaterialValidation::AfterFrame(frame);
        return;
    }
    if (CloudValidation::Enabled())
    {
        CloudValidation::AfterFrame(frame);
        return;
    }
    if (SunLightingTestEnabled())
    {
        AfterSunLightingFrame(frame);
        return;
    }
    if (VirtualGeometryStreamingValidation::Enabled())
    {
        VirtualGeometryStreamingValidation::AfterFrame(frame);
        return;
    }
    if (VirtualGeometryValidation::Enabled())
    {
        VirtualGeometryValidation::AfterFrame(frame);
        return;
    }
    if (MeshletValidation::Enabled())
    {
        MeshletValidation::AfterFrame(frame);
        return;
    }
    if (GPUVisibilityValidation::Enabled())
    {
        GPUVisibilityValidation::AfterFrame(frame);
        return;
    }
    if (GPUDrivenValidation::Enabled())
    {
        GPUDrivenValidation::AfterFrame(frame);
        return;
    }
    GpuSceneValidation::AfterFrame(frame);
    if (!IsEnabled())
    {
        return;
    }
    ValidateProfilerFaults();
    if (frame == 5 || frame == 13)
    {
        ValidateRayTelemetry(frame == 13);
    }
    if (frame == 53)
    {
        Check(g_ProfilerFaultMask == 7, "profiler resolves all three injected GPU fault fixtures");
    }
    if (frame == 15)
    {
        Check(ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<ProceduralMotionComponent>(g_Mover).Time > 0.0,
              "Play advances motion");
        ValidateRayTexture();
        if (Raytracing::IsAvailable())
        {
            Check(Raytracing::AreReflectionsActive(), "scene raytracing reflection dispatch");
            if (NrdDenoiser::IsCompiled())
            {
                Check(RayReflections::GetDenoiserDispatchCount() > 0,
                      "actual NVIDIA NRD REBLUR_SPECULAR dispatch sequence");
                Check(Raytracing::GetAmbientDenoiserDispatchCount() > 0,
                      "actual NVIDIA NRD REBLUR_DIFFUSE_OCCLUSION dispatch sequence");
            }
            RenderCapture::TextureData reflection;
            const bool read = RenderCapture::ReadTexture(RayReflections::GetResultResource(), reflection);
            Check(read, "read scene reflection radiance");
            if (read)
            {
                UINT hits = 0, offscreenHits = 0, bright = 0;
                bool finite = true;
                for (UINT y = 0; y < reflection.Height; ++y)
                {
                    const auto* pixels =
                        reinterpret_cast<const uint16_t*>(reflection.Bytes.data() + y * reflection.RowPitch);
                    for (UINT x = 0; x < reflection.Width; ++x)
                    {
                        const float distance = RenderCapture::HalfToFloat(pixels[x * 4 + 3]);
                        hits += abs(distance) > 0.01f;
                        offscreenHits += distance < -0.01f;
                        for (UINT c = 0; c < 3; ++c)
                        {
                            const float value = RenderCapture::HalfToFloat(pixels[x * 4 + c]);
                            finite &= isfinite(value) && value >= 0;
                            bright += value > 0.005f;
                        }
                    }
                }
                Check(finite && hits > 0 && bright > 0, "finite reflected radiance with actual scene intersections");
                Check(offscreenHits > 0, "reflection rays intersect geometry outside the camera image");
                WriteGraphicsLog("Validation reflection: hits=%u offscreenHits=%u brightChannels=%u extent=%ux%u\n",
                                 hits, offscreenHits, bright, reflection.Width, reflection.Height);
                ValidateReflectionDenoising(reflection);
            }
        }
        if (Raytracing::IsAvailable() && NrdDenoiser::IsCompiled())
        {
            Check(Raytracing::GetDenoiserDispatchCount() > 0, "actual NVIDIA NRD SIGMA dispatch sequence");
        }
        ValidateSkyBrightness(false);
    }
    if (frame == 31)
    {
        ValidateSkyBrightness(true);
        if (RenderProfiler::IsEnabled())
        {
            ValidateProfilerIntervals();
        }
    }
    if ((frame == 12 || frame == 13) && Raytracing::IsAvailable())
    {
        Check(Raytracing::AreReflectionsActive(), "reflection-only mode remains active");
        Check(!Raytracing::UsesRaytracedShadows() && !Raytracing::UsesRaytracedAmbientOcclusion(),
              "reflection-only mode uses raster shadows and disables ray AO");
        if (frame == 13 && NrdDenoiser::IsCompiled())
        {
            Check(!RayReflections::DidRestartHistory(), "reflection-only mode accumulates temporal history");
        }
        Check(LightingResources::GetShadowLightCount() > 0, "reflection-only mode has raster shadow passes");
        RenderCapture::TextureData shadowDepth;
        bool hasRasterShadow = RenderCapture::ReadTexture(RenderTargets::GetShadowDepthResource(), shadowDepth);
        UINT writtenDepth = 0;
        if (hasRasterShadow)
        {
            for (UINT y = 0; y < shadowDepth.Height; ++y)
            {
                const auto* values =
                    reinterpret_cast<const float*>(shadowDepth.Bytes.data() + y * shadowDepth.RowPitch);
                for (UINT x = 0; x < shadowDepth.Width; ++x)
                {
                    writtenDepth += isfinite(values[x]) && values[x] > 0.0f && values[x] < 1.0f;
                }
            }
        }
        Check(hasRasterShadow && writtenDepth > 0, frame == 12
                                                       ? "reflection-only ShadowMap writes geometry depth"
                                                       : "reflection-only Virtual ShadowMap writes geometry depth");
        RenderCapture::TextureData visibility;
        bool unshadowed = RenderCapture::ReadTexture(Raytracing::GetResultResource(), visibility);
        if (unshadowed)
        {
            for (UINT y = 0; y < visibility.Height; ++y)
            {
                const auto* pixels =
                    reinterpret_cast<const uint16_t*>(visibility.Bytes.data() + y * visibility.RowPitch);
                for (UINT x = 0; x < visibility.Width; ++x)
                {
                    unshadowed &= RenderCapture::HalfToFloat(pixels[x * 2]) >= 0.999f;
                }
            }
        }
        Check(unshadowed, "disabled ray shadows produce unshadowed visibility");
    }
    if (frame == 19 && Raytracing::IsAvailable() && NrdDenoiser::IsCompiled())
    {
        Check(RayReflections::DidRestartHistory(), "reflection re-enable restarts stale temporal history");
    }
    if (frame == 25 && Raytracing::IsAvailable())
    {
        Check(!Raytracing::AreReflectionsActive() && Raytracing::IsActive(),
              "reflection switch leaves raytracing shadows active");
    }
    if (frame == 23 || frame == 29 || frame == 37)
    {
        ValidateVertexDeformation();
    }
    if ((frame == 23 || frame == 31) && MeshShaderPipeline::IsSupported())
    {
        const auto& stats = MeshShaderPipeline::GetStatistics();
        Check(stats.Draws > 0 && stats.Meshlets > 0 && stats.MaxGroupsPerPage <= 65535,
              frame == 23 ? "mesh shader renders procedural vertices into MRT GBuffer"
                          : "mesh shader renders large procedural terrain into visibility GBuffer");
        WriteGraphicsLog("Validation mesh shaders: draws=%u meshlets=%u pages=%u maximumGroups=%u\n", stats.Draws,
                         stats.Meshlets, stats.Pages, stats.MaxGroupsPerPage);
        if (frame == 31)
        {
            Check(stats.Pages > stats.Draws, "GPU executes multiple mesh pages with a nonzero meshlet base");
        }
    }
    if (frame == 39)
    {
        VertexDeformationView view;
        Check(!VertexDeformation::TryResolveMesh(g_Mover, view), "disabled vertex motion restores base geometry");
    }
    if (frame == 17)
    {
        Check(ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<ProceduralMotionComponent>(g_Mover).Time == g_PausedTime,
              "Pause freezes motion");
    }
    if (frame == 19)
    {
        Check(ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<ProceduralMotionComponent>(g_Mover).Time > g_PausedTime,
              "resume advances motion");
    }
    if (frame == 20)
    {
        const auto& motion = ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<ProceduralMotionComponent>(g_Mover);
        const auto& transform = ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<TransformComponent>(g_Mover);
        Check(motion.Time == 0.0 && transform.Position.y == motion.Origin.y, "Stop restores motion origin and time");
    }
    if (frame == 29)
    {
        Check(GraphicsDevice::GetWidth() == 960 && GraphicsDevice::GetHeight() == 640, "resize render targets");
    }
    if (frame == 33)
    {
        Check(!Raytracing::IsActive(), "DXR off uses raster fallback");
        Check(TemporalUpscaler::HasValidHistory(), "Custom TSR renders with 20% input");
    }
    if (frame >= 33 && frame <= 35)
    {
        Check(RendererState::m_TaaFrameIndex == g_TsrJitterBeforeDraw + 1,
              frame == 33 ? "TSR jitter advances without TAA history"
                          : "input TAA plus TSR advances jitter exactly once");
        Check(TemporalUpscaler::HasValidHistory(), "TSR history survives input-TAA mode switch");
    }
    if (frame == 37 && Raytracing::IsAvailable())
    {
        Check(Raytracing::IsActive(), "DXR on rebuilds active frame");
    }
    if (frame == 41)
    {
        Check(!Raytracing::IsActive() && Raytracing::GetInstanceCount() == 0, "empty acceleration structure fallback");
    }
    if (frame == 47 && Raytracing::IsAvailable())
    {
        Check(Raytracing::IsActive(), "DXR resumes after geometry recreation");
    }
    if (frame == 5 || frame == 53 || frame == 61 || frame == 69 || frame == 71 || frame == 73 || frame == 75 ||
        frame == 78 || frame == 81 || frame == 83)
    {
        if (frame == 5 && RendererSettings::GetUpscaleMode() != UpscaleMode::Dlss)
        {
            return;
        }
        if (DlssUpscaler::IsAvailable())
        {
            Check(DlssUpscaler::IsActive(), "DLSS evaluates after resize/toggle/format change");
        }
        else
        {
            char disabled[8]{};
            const bool forcedDisabled =
                GetEnvironmentVariableA("DX12_DISABLE_DLSS", disabled, sizeof(disabled)) > 0 && atoi(disabled) != 0;
            Check(!DlssUpscaler::IsActive(), "unsupported DLSS uses raster upscale fallback");
            // 対応デバイスでは、評価中に DLSS が理由なく無効になってはならない。
            Check(forcedDisabled || string(DlssUpscaler::GetStatus()).find("failed") == string::npos,
                  "DLSS availability does not hide evaluation failure");
        }
        const auto& timing = RenderProfiler::GetLatest();
        for (const auto& pass : timing.Passes)
        {
            if (pass.Name == "DXR Shadows / AO" || pass.Name == "DLSS Super Resolution")
            {
                WriteGraphicsLog("Validation timing: %s GPU %.3f ms CPU %.3f ms\n", pass.Name.c_str(), pass.GpuMs,
                                 pass.CpuMs);
            }
        }
    }
    if (frame == 65)
    {
        Check(!DlssUpscaler::IsActive(), "DLSS off uses Bilateral");
    }
    if (frame == 55)
    {
        Check(RenderCapture::SaveScenePng(L"bin/validation/dlss.png"), "capture DLSS output");
    }
    if (frame < 32 && (frame % 8) == 7)
    {
        const wchar_t* paths[] = {L"bin/validation/morning.png", L"bin/validation/noon.png",
                                  L"bin/validation/evening.png", L"bin/validation/night.png"};
        Check(RenderCapture::SaveScenePng(paths[frame / 8]), "capture day period");
    }
}

bool RenderingValidation::Finish()
{
    if (GeometricAaValidation::Enabled()) return GeometricAaValidation::Finish();
    if (!VmdCameraTestPath().empty())
    {
        Check(g_VmdCameraTest.Completed, "complete VMD GameCamera play/pause/stop sequence");
        Check(g_VmdCameraTest.SawOrthographic && g_VmdCameraTest.SawPerspective,
              "VMD runtime renders both projection modes in one clip");
        g_Failures += RenderCapture::ReportGraphicsErrors();
        WriteGraphicsLog("VMD camera failures = %u\n", g_Failures);
        return g_Failures == 0;
    }
    if (VirtualGeometryProduction::ValidationEnabled())
    {
        return VirtualGeometryProduction::Finish();
    }
    if (PlayRenderTestEnabled())
    {
        if (ShadowBenchmarkEnabled())
        {
            const char* names[] = {"edit", "reference-play", "optimized-play"};
            for (size_t i = 0; i < g_ShadowBenchmark.size(); ++i)
            {
                const auto& sample = g_ShadowBenchmark[i];
                Check(sample.Count >= (i == 0 ? 8u : 40u), "collect enough VSM benchmark samples");
                if (sample.Count)
                {
                    WriteGraphicsLog(
                        "VSM benchmark %s: samples=%llu IA=%.0f maxIA=%llu draws=%.1f GPU=%.3f CPU=%.3f shadowGPU=%.3f frameMs=%.3f FPS=%.1f\n",
                        names[i], sample.Count, double(sample.Vertices) / sample.Count, sample.MaxVertices,
                        double(sample.Draws) / sample.Count, sample.Gpu / sample.Count, sample.Cpu / sample.Count,
                        sample.ShadowGpu / sample.Count, sample.FrameMs / sample.Count,
                        sample.FrameMs > 0 ? 1000.0 * sample.Count / sample.FrameMs : 0);
                }
                Check(sample.GpuSamples == sample.Count, "benchmark has valid GPU timestamps for every sample");
                for (const auto& pass : sample.PassTotals)
                {
                    WriteGraphicsLog("Render benchmark %s pass [%s]: samples=%llu GPU=%.4f CPU=%.4f draws=%.2f\n",
                                     names[i], pass.Name.c_str(), sample.GpuSamples, pass.GpuMs / sample.GpuSamples,
                                     pass.CpuMs / sample.GpuSamples, double(pass.DrawCalls) / sample.GpuSamples);
                }
            }
            const auto& reference = g_ShadowBenchmark[1];
            const auto& optimized = g_ShadowBenchmark[2];
            Check(reference.Count && optimized.Count &&
                      double(optimized.Vertices) / optimized.Count <
                          double(reference.Vertices) / reference.Count * 0.75,
                  "VSM live play reduces average IA vertex work by at least 25 percent");
        }
        g_Failures += RenderCapture::ReportGraphicsErrors();
        WriteGraphicsLog("Play render failures = %u\n", g_Failures);
        return g_Failures == 0;
    }
    if (ThumbnailValidation::Enabled())
    {
        return ThumbnailValidation::Finish();
    }
    if (MaterialValidation::Enabled())
    {
        return MaterialValidation::Finish();
    }
    if (CloudValidation::Enabled())
    {
        return CloudValidation::Finish();
    }
    if (VirtualGeometryStreamingValidation::Enabled())
    {
        return VirtualGeometryStreamingValidation::Finish();
    }
    if (VirtualGeometryValidation::Enabled())
    {
        return VirtualGeometryValidation::Finish();
    }
    if (MeshletValidation::Enabled())
    {
        return MeshletValidation::Finish();
    }
    if (GPUVisibilityValidation::Enabled())
    {
        return GPUVisibilityValidation::Finish();
    }
    if (GPUDrivenValidation::Enabled())
    {
        return GPUDrivenValidation::Finish();
    }
    if (!IsEnabled())
    {
        return true;
    }
    GraphicsDevice::WaitForGpuIdle();
    Check(g_FrameCount >= 84, "complete feature smoke sequence");
    g_Failures += GpuSceneValidation::Failures();
    g_Failures += RenderCapture::ReportGraphicsErrors();
    WriteGraphicsLog("Validation: feature smoke failures = %u\n", g_Failures);
    return g_Failures == 0;
}

===== FILE: source\core\renderingvalidation.h =====
#pragma once
#include <cstdint>

class RenderingValidation
{
  public:
    static bool IsEnabled();
    static void BeforeFrame(uint64_t frame);
    static void AfterFrame(uint64_t frame);
    static bool Finish();
};

===== FILE: source\core\temporallightingvalidation.cpp =====
#include "pch.h"
#include "temporallightingvalidation.h"
#include "world.h"
#include "camera.h"
#include "sun.h"
#include "daynightcycle.h"
#include "primitivegeometry.h"
#include "materialmanager.h"
#include "renderconfiguration.h"
#include "renderersettings.h"
#include "performancegovernor.h"
#include "renderquality.h"
#include "advancedeffects.h"
#include "raytracing.h"
#include "rayreflections.h"
#include "rendertargets.h"
#include "rendercapture.h"
#include "renderprofiler.h"
#include "graphicsdevice.h"
#include "graphicslog.h"
#include "gpudriven/gpudrivenrenderer.h"
#include "cloud/cloudrenderer.h"
#include "imguimanager.h"
#include "temporalupscaler.h"
#include <fstream>
#include <iomanip>

namespace
{
    constexpr UINT Grid = 17, CaseCount = 4;
    UINT FramesPerCase = 128, Warmup = 96;
    constexpr float ReceiverHeight = -.95f;
    UINT failures = 0;
    uint64_t lastFrame = 0;
    filesystem::path directory, materials;
    ofstream hashes;

    struct Moments
    {
        double Sum = 0;
        double Square = 0;
        UINT Count = 0;

        void Add(double value)
        {
            Sum += value;
            Square += value * value;
            ++Count;
        }
    };

    struct Measurement
    {
        array<Moments, Grid * Grid> Gi, Shadow, Output, RawGi;
        Moments RawMean;
        UINT Frames = 0, InputWidth = 0, InputHeight = 0;
        double GpuMs = 0;
        double CpuMs = 0;
        UINT TimingFrames = 0;
    };

    array<Measurement, CaseCount> measurements;
    array<UINT, 448 * CaseCount + 16> serialToFrame{};
    uint64_t firstSerial = 0;
    uint64_t lastTimingSerial = 0;

    void Check(bool valid, const char* message)
    {
        if (!valid)
        {
            ++failures;
        }
        WriteGraphicsLog("Temporal lighting: %s %s\n", valid ? "PASS" : "FAIL", message);
    }

    bool Flag(const char* name)
    {
        char value[16]{};
        return GetEnvironmentVariableA(name, value, sizeof(value)) && atoi(value) != 0;
    }

    AssetHandle Material(const char* name, XMFLOAT4 base, XMFLOAT3 emission)
    {
        MaterialAssetData data;
        data.BaseColor = {base.x, base.y, base.z, base.w};
        data.Roughness = 1;
        data.EmissiveColor = {emission.x, emission.y, emission.z};
        data.EmissiveIntensity = 6;
        string error;
        const auto path = materials / name;
        Check(MaterialSerializer::Save(path, data, error), "create fixture material");
        return MaterialManager::Registry().Register(path, AssetType::Material, error);
    }

    void Cube(XMFLOAT3 position, XMFLOAT3 scale, AssetHandle material)
    {
        auto entity = World::CreateEntity()
                          .Add<TransformComponent>()
                          .Add<MeshComponent>()
                          .Add<MaterialComponent>()
                          .Add<NameComponent>();
        entity.SetName("Temporal lighting fixture");
        auto& transform = entity.Get<TransformComponent>();
        transform.Position = position;
        transform.Scale = scale;
        transform.IsDirty = true;
        VertexResource mesh;
        mesh.entityid = entity.GetID();
        mesh.objectType = ObjectType::CUBE;
        mesh.color = Color::WHITE;
        PrimitiveGeometry::CreateObjectVertex(mesh);
        Check(MaterialManager::Assign(entity.GetID(), 0, material), "assign fixture material");
    }

    void Initialize()
    {
        char run[96]{};
        GetEnvironmentVariableA("DX12_TEMPORAL_RUN", run, sizeof(run));
        directory = filesystem::path("build/temporal-lighting") / (run[0] ? run : "manual");
        filesystem::create_directories(directory);
        materials = AssetRegistry::ValidationCacheRoot() / ("__temporal_lighting_" + to_string(GetCurrentProcessId()));
        filesystem::create_directories(materials);
        hashes.open(directory / "hashes.csv");
        hashes << "case,frame,gi,shadow,output,raw_gi\n";
        vector<EntityID> entities;
        for (EntityID entity : World::GetView<TransformComponent>())
        {
            if (!ComponentManager::HasComponent<CameraComponent>(entity))
            {
                entities.push_back(entity);
            }
        }
        for (auto entity : entities)
        {
            World::DestroyEntity(Entity(entity));
        }
        const auto white = Material("White.material", {.7f, .7f, .7f, 1}, {});
        const bool flow = Flag("DX12_TEMPORAL_FLOW");
        if (flow)
        {
            FramesPerCase = 448;
            Warmup = 384;
        }
        const auto red = Material("Red.material", {.6f, .1f, .1f, 1}, flow ? XMFLOAT3{} : XMFLOAT3{1, 0, 0});
        const auto green = Material("Green.material", {.1f, .6f, .1f, 1}, flow ? XMFLOAT3{} : XMFLOAT3{0, 1, 0});
        Cube({0, -1, 0}, {4, .1f, 4}, white);
        Cube({-.4f, -.1f, .3f}, {.15f, .8f, .15f}, white);
        Cube({.8f, -.35f, 1.1f}, {.12f, .55f, .12f}, white);
        Cube({flow ? -2.1f : -2.5f, .8f, flow ? 0.f : .8f}, {flow ? .2f : .05f, flow ? 3.6f : 1.6f, flow ? 4.4f : 2.f},
             red);
        Cube({flow ? 2.1f : 2.5f, .8f, flow ? 0.f : .8f}, {flow ? .2f : .05f, flow ? 3.6f : 1.6f, flow ? 4.4f : 2.f},
             green);
        const auto sun = Sun::CreateDefault();
        if (flow)
        {
            ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<LightComponent>(sun).IsActive = false;
            // 色付き面への解析的ライトでは、GI は反射輝度をサンプリングする必要がある。
            // 別途サンプリングした発光ライトの簡易経路で代替しない。
            auto lamp = World::CreateEntity().Add<TransformComponent>().Add<LightComponent>();
            lamp.Get<TransformComponent>().Position = {0, 1.2f, .8f};
            auto& light = lamp.Get<LightComponent>();
            light.Type = LightType::Point;
            light.Position = {0, 1.2f, .8f};
            light.Intensity = .5f;
            light.Range = 12;
            light.CastShadow = true;
            Cube({0, 2.5f, 0}, {6, .1f, 6}, white);
            Cube({0, .8f, -2.1f}, {4.4f, 3.6f, .2f}, white);
            Cube({0, .8f, 2.1f}, {4.4f, 3.6f, .2f}, white);
        }
        RenderConfiguration::Resize(1280, 720);
    }

    float Channel(const RenderCapture::TextureData& image, int x, int y, bool redOnly)
    {
        const auto* row = image.Bytes.data() + UINT(y) * image.RowPitch;
        if (image.Format == DXGI_FORMAT_R16G16_FLOAT)
        {
            return RenderCapture::HalfToFloat(reinterpret_cast<const uint16_t*>(row)[UINT(x) * 2]);
        }
        if (image.Format == DXGI_FORMAT_R16G16B16A16_FLOAT)
        {
            const auto* pixel = reinterpret_cast<const uint16_t*>(row) + UINT(x) * 4;
            const float r = RenderCapture::HalfToFloat(pixel[0]);
            if (redOnly)
            {
                return r;
            }
            return .2126f * r + .7152f * RenderCapture::HalfToFloat(pixel[1]) +
                   .0722f * RenderCapture::HalfToFloat(pixel[2]);
        }
        if (image.Format == DXGI_FORMAT_R8G8B8A8_UNORM || image.Format == DXGI_FORMAT_R8G8B8A8_UNORM_SRGB)
        {
            const auto* pixel = row + UINT(x) * 4;
            return (.2126f * pixel[0] + .7152f * pixel[1] + .0722f * pixel[2]) / 255;
        }
        Check(false, "supported readback format");
        return 0;
    }

    float Sample(const RenderCapture::TextureData& image, float u, float v, bool redOnly = false)
    {
        const float px = u * image.Width - .5f;
        const float py = v * image.Height - .5f;
        const int x = int(floor(px));
        const int y = int(floor(py));
        const float fx = px - x;
        const float fy = py - y;
        float sum = 0;
        for (int dy = 0; dy < 2; ++dy)
        {
            for (int dx = 0; dx < 2; ++dx)
            {
                sum += Channel(image, clamp(x + dx, 0, int(image.Width) - 1), clamp(y + dy, 0, int(image.Height) - 1),
                               redOnly) *
                       (dx ? fx : 1 - fx) * (dy ? fy : 1 - fy);
            }
        }
        return sum;
    }

    uint64_t Hash(const RenderCapture::TextureData& image, UINT validWidth = 0)
    {
        uint64_t hash = 14695981039346656037ull;
        const UINT bytesPerPixel = image.Format == DXGI_FORMAT_R16G16B16A16_FLOAT ? 8 : 4;
        for (UINT y = 0; y < image.Height; ++y)
        {
            for (UINT x = 0; x < (validWidth ? validWidth : image.Width) * bytesPerPixel; ++x)
            {
                hash ^= image.Bytes[y * image.RowPitch + x];
                hash *= 1099511628211ull;
            }
        }
        return hash;
    }

    pair<double, double> Noise(const array<Moments, Grid * Grid>& values)
    {
        double variance = 0;
        double mean = 0;
        UINT pixels = 0;
        for (const auto& value : values)
        {
            if (value.Count < 24)
            {
                continue;
            }
            const double average = value.Sum / value.Count;
            variance += (std::max)(0., value.Square / value.Count - average * average);
            mean += average;
            ++pixels;
        }
        Check(pixels >= 100, "sufficient stable receiver samples");
        return {mean / (std::max)(pixels, 1u), sqrt(variance / (std::max)(pixels, 1u))};
    }
}

bool TemporalLightingValidation::Enabled()
{
    char mode[16]{};
    return GetEnvironmentVariableA("DX12_GI_TEST", mode, sizeof(mode)) && atoi(mode) == 4;
}

void TemporalLightingValidation::BeforeFrame(uint64_t frame)
{
    lastFrame = frame;
    if (frame == 0)
    {
        Initialize();
    }
    if (frame >= FramesPerCase * CaseCount)
    {
        return;
    }
    const UINT phase = UINT(frame / FramesPerCase);
    PerformanceGovernor::GetOptions().Enabled = false;
    World::SetVSyncEnabled(false);
    World::SetFixedFrameRateEnabled(false);
    RenderConfiguration::SetResolutionScale(.29f);
    RendererSettings::SetUpscaleQuality(UpscaleQuality::Custom);
    RendererSettings::SetUpscaleMode(phase < 2 ? UpscaleMode::Tsr : UpscaleMode::Nis);
    RendererState::m_AntiAliasingMode = AntiAliasingMode::TAA;
    RendererSettings::SetGiMode(GlobalIlluminationMode::Realtime);
    RendererSettings::SetRealtimeGiIntensity(1);
    RendererSettings::SetGiRadianceCacheEnabled(Flag("DX12_TEMPORAL_CACHE"));
    if (Flag("DX12_TEMPORAL_FLOW"))
    {
        RendererSettings::SetGiRadianceCacheCellSize(1);
        RendererSettings::SetGiRadianceCacheHistory(4);
    }
    RendererSettings::SetMeshShadersEnabled(false);
    GPUDrivenRenderer::SetEnabled(false);
    RendererSettings::SetSsaoEnabled(false);
    RenderQuality::Get() = {};
    RenderQuality::Get().ReSTIRGI = Flag("DX12_TEMPORAL_RESTIR");
    AdvancedEffects::GetSettings() = {};
    CloudRenderer::GetSettings().Enabled = false;
    DayNightCycle::GetSettings().Running = false;
    DayNightCycle::SetTime(9);
    DayNightCycle::GetSettings().DayOfYear = 81;
    auto& rays = Raytracing::GetSettings();
    rays.Enabled = rays.Denoise = rays.Shadows = true;
    if (Flag("DX12_TEMPORAL_NO_NRD"))
    {
        rays.Denoise = false;
    }
    rays.RenderMode = Raytracing::Mode::Full;
    rays.Reflections = rays.AmbientOcclusion = false;
    rays.RadianceDenoiser = Raytracing::DenoiserType::Nrd;
    rays.StableNrdProfile = Flag("DX12_TEMPORAL_STABLE_NRD");
    rays.StableSampling = Flag("DX12_TEMPORAL_STABLE_SAMPLING");
    TemporalUpscaler::SetPlanarDepthEnabled(Flag("DX12_TEMPORAL_PLANAR_DEPTH"));
    if (frame % FramesPerCase == 0)
    {
        auto& transform = ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<TransformComponent>(Camera::GetCameraEntity());
        auto& camera = ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<CameraComponent>(Camera::GetCameraEntity());
        transform.Position = Flag("DX12_TEMPORAL_FLOW") ? XMFLOAT3{0, phase % 2 ? -.1f : 1.5f, -1.8f}
                                                        : XMFLOAT3{0, phase % 2 ? -.1f : 3.f, -7};
        transform.IsDirty = true;
        camera.Target = {0, ReceiverHeight, 0};
        camera.AllowUserControl = false;
        camera.LockOnTarget = g_kINVALID_ENTITY;
        RendererState::m_TaaFrameIndex = 0;
        Camera::NotifyCut();
    }
}

void TemporalLightingValidation::AfterFrame(uint64_t frame)
{
    if (frame >= FramesPerCase * CaseCount)
    {
        return;
    }
    const uint64_t serial = RenderProfiler::GetFrameSerial();
    if (!firstSerial)
    {
        firstSerial = serial;
    }
    if (serial >= firstSerial && serial - firstSerial < serialToFrame.size())
    {
        serialToFrame[serial - firstSerial] = UINT(frame);
    }
    const auto& timing = RenderProfiler::GetLatest();
    if (timing.Serial != lastTimingSerial && timing.Serial >= firstSerial &&
        timing.Serial - firstSerial < serialToFrame.size())
    {
        lastTimingSerial = timing.Serial;
        const UINT recordedFrame = serialToFrame[timing.Serial - firstSerial];
        if (recordedFrame % FramesPerCase >= Warmup && timing.GpuTimingValid)
        {
            auto& measured = measurements[recordedFrame / FramesPerCase];
            measured.GpuMs += timing.GpuRenderMs;
            measured.CpuMs += timing.CpuFrameMs;
            ++measured.TimingFrames;
        }
    }
    if (frame % FramesPerCase < Warmup)
    {
        return;
    }
    const UINT phase = UINT(frame / FramesPerCase);
    auto& measured = measurements[phase];
    RenderCapture::TextureData gi, shadow, output, depth, rawGi;
    if (!RenderCapture::ReadTexture(RayReflections::GetGiResource(), gi) ||
        !RenderCapture::ReadTexture(Raytracing::GetResultResource(), shadow) ||
        !RenderCapture::ReadTexture(RenderTargets::GetEditorSceneResource(), output) ||
        !RenderCapture::ReadTexture(RenderTargets::GetGBufferResource(GBufferType::DEPTH), depth) ||
        !RenderCapture::ReadTexture(RayReflections::GetGiNoisyResource(), rawGi))
    {
        Check(false, "read temporal signals");
        return;
    }

    measured.InputWidth = gi.Width;
    measured.InputHeight = gi.Height;
    ++measured.Frames;
    const bool checkerboard = Raytracing::GetSettings().Denoise && NrdDenoiser::IsCompiled();
    hashes << phase << ',' << frame % FramesPerCase << ',' << Hash(gi) << ',' << Hash(shadow) << ',' << Hash(output)
           << ',' << Hash(rawGi, checkerboard ? (rawGi.Width + 1) / 2 : rawGi.Width) << '\n';
    XMMATRIX view, projection;
    Camera::GetCameraMatrices(Camera::GetCameraEntity(), view, projection);
    XMFLOAT4X4 jitteredProjection;
    XMStoreFloat4x4(&jitteredProjection, projection);
    const float jitterU = jitteredProjection._31 * .5f;
    const float jitterV = -jitteredProjection._32 * .5f;
    double rawMean = 0;
    UINT rawCount = 0;
    for (UINT z = 0; z < Grid; ++z)
    {
        for (UINT x = 0; x < Grid; ++x)
        {
            const auto world = XMVectorSet((float(x) - 8) * .2f, ReceiverHeight, (float(z) - 8) * .2f, 1);
            XMFLOAT3 pixel;
            XMStoreFloat3(&pixel, XMVector3Project(world, 0, 0, float(gi.Width), float(gi.Height), 0, 1, projection,
                                                   view, XMMatrixIdentity()));
            const float u = pixel.x / gi.Width;
            const float v = pixel.y / gi.Height;
            if (u < .01f || u > .99f || v < .01f || v > .99f)
            {
                continue;
            }
            const UINT px = UINT(pixel.x), py = UINT(pixel.y);
            const float actualDepth = reinterpret_cast<const float*>(depth.Bytes.data() + py * depth.RowPitch)[px];
            // 受光面をワールド空間で検証する。浅い角度の平面では入力 1 ピクセル内の
            // 深度勾配が大きくなるため、投影した点の深度は適さない。
            const auto surface =
                XMVector3Unproject(XMVectorSet(float(px) + .5f, float(py) + .5f, actualDepth, 1), 0, 0, float(gi.Width),
                                   float(gi.Height), 0, 1, projection, view, XMMatrixIdentity());
            if (abs(XMVectorGetY(surface) - ReceiverHeight) > .015f)
            {
                continue;
            }
            const UINT index = z * Grid + x;
            measured.Gi[index].Add(Sample(gi, u, v, true));
            // REBLUR は YCoCg を保存する。赤 = Y + Co - Cg。NRD SDK がない場合は RGB 信号。
            const UINT rawX = checkerboard ? px >> 1 : px;
            const auto* rawPixel =
                reinterpret_cast<const uint16_t*>(rawGi.Bytes.data() + py * rawGi.RowPitch) + rawX * 4;
            double rawRed = RenderCapture::HalfToFloat(rawPixel[0]);
            if (NrdDenoiser::IsCompiled())
            {
                rawRed += RenderCapture::HalfToFloat(rawPixel[1]) - RenderCapture::HalfToFloat(rawPixel[2]);
            }
            measured.RawGi[index].Add(rawRed);
            rawMean += rawRed;
            ++rawCount;
            measured.Shadow[index].Add(Sample(shadow, u, v));
            measured.Output[index].Add(Sample(output, phase < 2 ? u - jitterU : u, phase < 2 ? v - jitterV : v));
        }
    }
    if (rawCount)
    {
        measured.RawMean.Add(rawMean / rawCount);
    }
    if (frame % FramesPerCase == FramesPerCase - 1)
    {
        RenderCapture::SaveScenePng((directory / (to_string(phase) + ".png")).c_str());
    }
}

bool TemporalLightingValidation::Finish()
{
    ofstream report(directory / "summary.csv");
    report
        << "case,mode,angle,input_width,input_height,frames,gi_mean,gi_rms,shadow_mean,shadow_rms,output_mean,output_rms,gpu_ms,cpu_ms,timing_frames,raw_mean,raw_rms,raw_coherent_rms\n";
    report << setprecision(10);
    for (UINT phase = 0; phase < CaseCount; ++phase)
    {
        const auto& measured = measurements[phase];
        Check(measured.Frames == FramesPerCase - Warmup, "complete temporal sample window");
        const auto gi = Noise(measured.Gi), shadow = Noise(measured.Shadow), output = Noise(measured.Output);
        if (Flag("DX12_TEMPORAL_FLOW"))
        {
            Check(output.first > .005 && output.first < .5,
                  "flow receiver remains measurable without output saturation");
        }
        const auto raw = Noise(measured.RawGi);
        const double coherentMean = measured.RawMean.Sum / (std::max)(measured.RawMean.Count, 1u);
        const double coherentVariance =
            measured.RawMean.Square / (std::max)(measured.RawMean.Count, 1u) - coherentMean * coherentMean;
        report << phase << ',' << (phase < 2 ? "TSR" : "NIS_TAA") << ',' << (phase % 2 ? "grazing" : "normal") << ','
               << measured.InputWidth << ',' << measured.InputHeight << ',' << measured.Frames << ',' << gi.first << ','
               << gi.second << ',' << shadow.first << ',' << shadow.second << ',' << output.first << ','
               << output.second << ',' << measured.GpuMs / (std::max)(measured.TimingFrames, 1u) << ','
               << measured.CpuMs / (std::max)(measured.TimingFrames, 1u) << ',' << measured.TimingFrames << ','
               << raw.first << ',' << raw.second << ',' << sqrt((std::max)(0., coherentVariance)) << '\n';
    }
    Check(lastFrame >= FramesPerCase * CaseCount - 1, "complete all angles and upscalers");
    failures += RenderCapture::ReportGraphicsErrors();
    for (const char* name : {"White.material", "Red.material", "Green.material"})
    {
        error_code error;
        filesystem::remove(materials / name, error);
        filesystem::remove(materials / (string(name) + ".meta"), error);
    }
    error_code error;
    if (!materials.empty())
    {
        filesystem::remove_all(materials, error);
    }
    WriteGraphicsLog("GI validation failures = %u\n", failures);
    return failures == 0;
}

===== FILE: source\core\thumbnailvalidation.cpp =====
#include "pch.h"
#include "thumbnailvalidation.h"
#include "assetthumbnailmanager.h"
#include "materialmanager.h"
#include "rendercapture.h"
#include "graphicslog.h"
#include "graphicsdevice.h"
#include "world.h"
#include "imguimanager.h"
#include "renderprofiler.h"
#include "texturemanager.h"
#include "assets/thumbnailmanifest.h"
#include <DirectXTex.h>
#include <fstream>

namespace
{
    std::filesystem::path root;
    std::vector<std::filesystem::path> files;
    std::vector<AssetHandle> handles;
    MaterialAssetData material;
    AssetHandle surface = 0, texture = 0, mesh = 0, broken = 0;
    uint64_t materialRevision = 0;
    uint64_t colorHash = 0;
    uint64_t cacheHits = 0;
    unsigned int stage = 0, failures = 0;
    bool complete = false;
    size_t entityCount = 0;
    UINT renderedBuffer = 0;
    XMFLOAT2 surfaceCell{};
    bool surfaceSelected = false;
    UINT inputStep = 0, visibleCells = 0, maximumVisibleCells = 0;
    ComPtr<ID3D12Resource> existingTexture;
    int existingTextureIndex = -1;
    std::future<ThumbnailPrepared> meshCacheCheck;
    bool meshCacheChecked = false;
    std::vector<AssetHandle> rootHandles;
    unsigned int rootFrames = 0;
    bool rootCellSeen = false;
    double rootMaximumFrameMs = 0.0;
    double initialMaximumFrameMs = 0.0;
    unsigned int initialFrames = 0;
    std::chrono::steady_clock::time_point frameStart;

    void Check(bool condition, const char* name)
    {
        WriteGraphicsLog("Thumbnail validation: %s %s\n", condition ? "PASS" : "FAIL", name);
        if (!condition)
        {
            ++failures;
        }
    }

    bool MakeImage(const std::filesystem::path& path, UINT width, UINT height, uint32_t color)
    {
        DirectX::ScratchImage image;
        if (FAILED(image.Initialize2D(DXGI_FORMAT_R8G8B8A8_UNORM, width, height, 1, 1)))
        {
            return false;
        }
        const auto* pixels = image.GetImage(0, 0, 0);
        for (UINT row = 0; row < height; ++row)
        {
            auto* line = reinterpret_cast<uint32_t*>(pixels->pixels + row * pixels->rowPitch);
            for (UINT column = 0; column < width; ++column)
            {
                line[column] = color;
            }
        }
        if (path.extension() == ".dds")
        {
            return SUCCEEDED(DirectX::SaveToDDSFile(*pixels, DirectX::DDS_FLAGS_NONE, path.c_str()));
        }
        if (path.extension() == ".tga")
        {
            return SUCCEEDED(DirectX::SaveToTGAFile(*pixels, path.c_str()));
        }
        return SUCCEEDED(DirectX::SaveToWICFile(
            *pixels, DirectX::WIC_FLAGS_NONE,
            DirectX::GetWICCodec(path.extension() == ".jpg" ? DirectX::WIC_CODEC_JPEG : DirectX::WIC_CODEC_PNG),
            path.c_str()));
    }

    AssetHandle Register(const std::filesystem::path& path)
    {
        std::string error;
        const auto handle = MaterialManager::Registry().Register(path, AssetRegistry::Classify(path), error);
        Check(handle != 0, "fixture GUID registration");
        handles.push_back(handle);
        files.push_back(path);
        files.emplace_back(path.wstring() + L".meta");
        return handle;
    }

    uint64_t HashImage(const ThumbnailHandle& thumbnail)
    {
        RenderCapture::TextureData pixels;
        if (!thumbnail.Image || !RenderCapture::ReadTexture(thumbnail.Image->Resource.Get(), pixels))
        {
            return 0;
        }
        uint64_t hash = 1469598103934665603ull;
        for (auto byte : pixels.Bytes)
        {
            hash = (hash ^ byte) * 1099511628211ull;
        }
        return hash;
    }

    void CaptureBrowser()
    {
        RenderCapture::TextureData pixels;
        auto* resource = GraphicsDevice::GetBackBuffer(renderedBuffer);
        if (!resource || !RenderCapture::ReadTextureMip(resource, pixels, 0, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_PRESENT))
        {
            return;
        }
        DirectX::ScratchImage image;
        if (FAILED(image.Initialize2D(pixels.Format, pixels.Width, pixels.Height, 1, 1)))
        {
            return;
        }
        const auto* destination = image.GetImage(0, 0, 0);
        for (UINT row = 0; row < pixels.Height; ++row)
        {
            memcpy(destination->pixels + row * destination->rowPitch, pixels.Bytes.data() + row * pixels.RowPitch,
                   destination->rowPitch);
        }
        Check(SUCCEEDED(DirectX::SaveToWICFile(*destination, DirectX::WIC_FLAGS_NONE,
                                               DirectX::GetWICCodec(DirectX::WIC_CODEC_PNG),
                                               L"build/thumbnail-tests/browser.png")),
              "capture browser grid");
    }
}

bool ThumbnailValidation::Enabled()
{
    char value[8]{};
    return GetEnvironmentVariableA("DX12_THUMBNAIL_TEST", value, sizeof(value)) > 0 && atoi(value) != 0;
}

bool ThumbnailValidation::IsComplete()
{
    return complete;
}

void ThumbnailValidation::BeforeFrame(uint64_t frame)
{
    frameStart = std::chrono::steady_clock::now();
    renderedBuffer = GraphicsDevice::GetFrameIndex();
    if (frame != 0)
    {
        if (stage == 0)
        {
            // Keep the reuse fixture resident while asynchronous driver work is pending.
            TextureManager::TouchTexture(existingTextureIndex);
        }
        return;
    }
    root = AssetRegistry::ValidationCacheRoot() / ("__thumbnail_validation_" + std::to_string(GetCurrentProcessId()));
    std::filesystem::create_directories(root);
    std::filesystem::create_directories("build/thumbnail-tests");
    entityCount = Registry::GetEntities().size();
    for (const auto& name : {"Wide.png", "Square.jpg", "Square.dds", "Tall.tga"})
    {
        const auto path = root / name;
        Check(MakeImage(path, name == std::string("Tall.tga") ? 64 : 192,
                        name == std::string("Tall.tga")   ? 192
                        : name == std::string("Wide.png") ? 108
                                                          : 192,
                        0xff3030e0),
              "write image fixture");
        const auto handle = Register(path);
        if (name == std::string("Wide.png"))
        {
            texture = handle;
        }
    }
    material.Textures[0] = texture;
    // 準備中に同期プリロードされる場合があるため、サムネイルの Request/Generate はそのリソースを再利用する。
    existingTextureIndex = TextureManager::LoadTexture(root / "Wide.png");
    existingTexture = TextureManager::GetTextureResource(existingTextureIndex);
    material.Roughness = 0.25f;
    material.Metallic = 0.5f;
    std::string error;
    Check(MaterialSerializer::Save(root / "Surface.material", material, error), "write material fixture");
    surface = Register(root / "Surface.material");
    std::ofstream model(root / "Offset.obj");
    model
        << "mtllib Shared.mtl\nv 99 -1 0\nv 101 -1 0\nv 100 1 0\nv 100 0 2\nusemtl Red\nf 1 3 2\nf 1 2 4\nusemtl Blue\nf 2 3 4\nf 3 1 4\n";
    model.close();
    std::ofstream(root / "Shared.mtl") << "newmtl Red\nKd 0.9 0.1 0.1\nnewmtl Blue\nKd 0.1 0.1 0.9\n";
    files.push_back(root / "Shared.mtl");
    mesh = Register(root / "Offset.obj");
    std::ofstream(root / "Broken.png") << "invalid image";
    broken = Register(root / "Broken.png");
    RenderProfiler::SetWindowVisible(false);
    ImGuiManager::SetAssetBrowserDirectory(root, true);
    // 行のクリッピングと大きなディレクトリの列挙も検証する。
    for (UINT index = 0; index < 1000; ++index)
    {
        const auto path = root / ("Unused_" + std::to_string(index) + ".txt");
        std::ofstream(path) << "unsupported fallback";
        files.push_back(path);
    }
}

void ThumbnailValidation::AfterFrame(uint64_t frame)
{
    if (complete)
    {
        return;
    }
    const auto thumbnail = AssetThumbnailManager::Request(surface, ThumbnailPriority::Selected);
    if (stage == 0)
    {
        // Exclude fixture setup, but include the first uncached thumbnail preparations.
        if (frame > 0)
        {
            ++initialFrames;
            initialMaximumFrameMs = std::max(
                initialMaximumFrameMs,
                std::chrono::duration<double, std::milli>(std::chrono::steady_clock::now() - frameStart).count());
        }
        bool ready = true;
        for (auto handle : handles)
        {
            const auto item = AssetThumbnailManager::Request(handle);
            if (handle == broken)
            {
                ready = ready && item.State == ThumbnailState::Failed;
            }
            else
            {
                ready = ready && item.State == ThumbnailState::Ready;
            }
        }
        if (!ready)
        {
            return;
        }
        WriteGraphicsLog("Thumbnail initial frames=%u maximum CPU frame=%.3f ms\n", initialFrames,
                         initialMaximumFrameMs);
        Check(initialFrames > 0 && initialMaximumFrameMs < 1000.0, "uncached thumbnails avoid second-long UI stalls");
        Check(HashImage(thumbnail) != 0, "material sphere renders");
        const auto wide = AssetThumbnailManager::Request(texture);
        Check(wide.Image->Width * 9 == wide.Image->Height * 16, "wide texture keeps aspect ratio");
        // Background BC compression may replace the resident resource while preparation runs.
        const auto residentTexture = TextureManager::GetTextureResource(existingTextureIndex);
        Check((wide.Image->Resource == existingTexture || wide.Image->Resource == residentTexture) &&
                  !wide.Image->Descriptor,
              "loaded texture resource and SRV reused");
        const auto meshThumbnail = AssetThumbnailManager::Request(mesh);
        Check(HashImage(meshThumbnail) != 0, "offset mesh renders with camera fit");
        RenderCapture::SaveTexturePng(thumbnail.Image->Resource.Get(), L"build/thumbnail-tests/material.png");
        RenderCapture::SaveTexturePng(meshThumbnail.Image->Resource.Get(), L"build/thumbnail-tests/mesh.png");
        CaptureBrowser();
        colorHash = HashImage(thumbnail);
        materialRevision = thumbnail.Revision;
        material.BaseColor = {0.2f, 0.9f, 0.3f, 1.0f};
        std::string error;
        Check(MaterialSerializer::Save(root / "Surface.material", material, error), "save changed material");
        AssetThumbnailManager::MarkDirty(surface);
        ++stage;
    }
    else if (stage == 1 && thumbnail.State == ThumbnailState::Ready && thumbnail.Revision != materialRevision)
    {
        Check(HashImage(thumbnail) != colorHash, "material edit updates thumbnail");
        colorHash = HashImage(thumbnail);
        materialRevision = thumbnail.Revision;
        Check(MakeImage(root / "Wide.png", 192, 108, 0xff30e030), "replace source texture");
        AssetThumbnailManager::MarkDirty(texture);
        ++stage;
    }
    else if (stage == 2 && thumbnail.State == ThumbnailState::Ready && thumbnail.Revision != materialRevision &&
             AssetThumbnailManager::Request(texture).State == ThumbnailState::Ready)
    {
        Check(HashImage(thumbnail) != colorHash, "texture dependency updates material");
        const auto before = AssetThumbnailManager::Request(texture);
        std::string error;
        Check(MaterialManager::Registry().Move(texture, root / "Renamed.png", error), "rename/move keeps GUID");
        files.push_back(root / "Renamed.png");
        files.emplace_back((root / "Renamed.png").wstring() + L".meta");
        Check(AssetThumbnailManager::Request(texture).Image == before.Image, "rename preserves thumbnail identity");
        cacheHits = AssetThumbnailManager::CacheHits();
        ++stage;
    }
    else if (stage == 3)
    {
        uint64_t savedKey = 0;
        std::ifstream manifest(ThumbnailRenderer::CachePath(surface).string() + ".key");
        if (!(manifest >> savedKey) || savedKey != AssetThumbnailManager::LastCacheKey(surface))
        {
            return;
        }
        AssetThumbnailManager::Remove(surface);
        AssetThumbnailManager::Request(surface);
        ++stage;
    }
    else if (stage == 4 && thumbnail.State == ThumbnailState::Ready)
    {
        if (!meshCacheChecked)
        {
            if (!meshCacheCheck.valid())
            {
                std::ifstream stream(ThumbnailRenderer::CachePath(mesh).wstring() + L".key");
                ThumbnailManifest manifest;
                if (!manifest.Read(stream))
                {
                    return;
                }
                ThumbnailPrepared input;
                input.Handle = mesh;
                input.Type = AssetType::Mesh;
                input.SourcePath = MaterialManager::Registry().Resolve(mesh);
                input.Size = AssetThumbnailManager::Settings().Size;
                input.Key = ThumbnailRenderer::SourceRevision(input.SourcePath) ^
                            ThumbnailRenderer::SourceRevision(input.SourcePath.wstring() + L".meta") ^
                            ThumbnailRenderer::SourceRevision("shader/hlsl/build/modelshaderVS.cso") ^
                            ThumbnailRenderer::SourceRevision("shader/hlsl/build/modelshaderPS.cso") ^
                            ThumbnailRenderer::SourceRevision("shader/hlsl/ProceduralTexture.hlsli");
                meshCacheCheck = std::async(std::launch::async, [input = std::move(input)]() mutable {
                    return ThumbnailRenderer::Prepare(std::move(input));
                });
                return;
            }
            if (meshCacheCheck.wait_for(std::chrono::seconds(0)) != std::future_status::ready)
            {
                return;
            }
            const auto cached = meshCacheCheck.get();
            Check(cached.Cached && cached.Geometry.empty() && cached.MeshParts.empty() &&
                      !cached.SourceDependencies.empty(),
                  "mesh disk cache bypasses model import and preserves dependencies");
            meshCacheChecked = true;
        }
        Check(AssetThumbnailManager::CacheHits() > cacheHits, "disk cache reused after eviction");
        Check(Registry::GetEntities().size() == entityCount, "preview adds no world entities");
        Check(AssetThumbnailManager::MemoryBytes() <= AssetThumbnailManager::Settings().MemoryBudget,
              "memory remains inside budget");
        const auto model = AssetThumbnailManager::Request(mesh);
        if (model.State != ThumbnailState::Ready)
        {
            return;
        }
        colorHash = HashImage(model);
        materialRevision = model.Revision;
        std::ofstream(root / "Shared.mtl") << "newmtl Red\nKd 0.1 0.9 0.1\nnewmtl Blue\nKd 0.9 0.8 0.1\n";
        ++stage;
    }
    else if (stage == 5)
    {
        const auto model = AssetThumbnailManager::Request(mesh);
        if (model.State != ThumbnailState::Ready || model.Revision == materialRevision)
        {
            return;
        }
        Check(HashImage(model) != colorHash, "actual external MTL change invalidates mesh");
        ++stage;
    }
    else if (stage == 6 && inputStep >= 2 && surfaceSelected)
    {
        Check(true, "thumbnail cell selects material");
        inputStep = 0;
        ++stage;
    }
    else if (stage == 7 && inputStep >= 16)
    {
        Check(maximumVisibleCells > 0 && maximumVisibleCells < 64, "1000 asset scroll clips offscreen UI");
        AssetThumbnailManager::Settings().Size = 64;
        ++stage;
    }
    else if (stage == 8 && thumbnail.State == ThumbnailState::Ready && thumbnail.Image->Width == 64)
    {
        Check(true, "thumbnail size setting regenerates preview");
        AssetThumbnailManager::Settings().Size = 128;
        ++stage;
    }
    else if (stage == 9 && thumbnail.State == ThumbnailState::Ready && thumbnail.Image->Width == 128)
    {
#ifdef _DEBUG
        Check(RenderCapture::ReportGraphicsErrors() == 0, "DX12 debug layer has no errors");
#else
        WriteGraphicsLog("Thumbnail validation: Release debug layer disabled; debug-layer checks run in Debug\n");
#endif
        const auto directory = MaterialManager::Registry().Root();
        std::error_code error;
        for (const auto& entry : std::filesystem::directory_iterator(directory, error))
        {
            const auto type = AssetRegistry::Classify(entry.path());
            if (type != AssetType::Unknown && entry.is_regular_file(error))
            {
                std::string registrationError;
                const auto handle = MaterialManager::Registry().Register(entry.path(), type, registrationError);
                if (handle)
                {
                    rootHandles.push_back(handle);
                }
            }
        }
        ImGuiManager::SetAssetBrowserDirectory(directory, true);
        ++stage;
    }
    else if (stage == 10)
    {
        rootMaximumFrameMs =
            std::max(rootMaximumFrameMs,
                     std::chrono::duration<double, std::milli>(std::chrono::steady_clock::now() - frameStart).count());
        ++rootFrames;
        bool ready = true;
        for (const auto handle : rootHandles)
        {
            const auto item = AssetThumbnailManager::Request(handle);
            ready = ready && (item.State == ThumbnailState::Ready || item.State == ThumbnailState::Failed);
        }
        if (rootFrames >= 60 && rootCellSeen && ready)
        {
            Check(true, "project root remains responsive while thumbnails finish");
            WriteGraphicsLog("Thumbnail root frames=%u maximum CPU frame=%.3f ms assets=%zu\n", rootFrames,
                             rootMaximumFrameMs, rootHandles.size());
            CaptureBrowser();
            complete = true;
        }
    }
}

void ThumbnailValidation::BeforeEditorFrame()
{
    if (!Enabled())
    {
        return;
    }
    visibleCells = 0;
    // Saved editor settings can be restored after BeforeFrame initializes the fixture.
    if (stage == 0)
    {
        ImGuiManager::SetAssetBrowserDirectory(root, true);
    }
    if (stage == 6 && inputStep < 2)
    {
        auto& input = ImGui::GetIO();
        input.AddMousePosEvent(surfaceCell.x, surfaceCell.y);
        input.AddMouseButtonEvent(ImGuiMouseButton_Left, inputStep == 0);
        ++inputStep;
    }
    else if (stage == 7 && inputStep < 16)
    {
        auto& input = ImGui::GetIO();
        input.AddMousePosEvent(surfaceCell.x, surfaceCell.y);
        input.AddMouseWheelEvent(0, inputStep < 8 ? -8.0f : 8.0f);
        ++inputStep;
    }
}

void ThumbnailValidation::CaptureAssetCell(const char* fileName, float x, float y, bool selected)
{
    if (!Enabled())
    {
        return;
    }
    maximumVisibleCells = std::max(maximumVisibleCells, ++visibleCells);
    if (stage == 10)
    {
        rootCellSeen = true;
    }
    if (std::string(fileName) == "Surface.material")
    {
        surfaceCell = {x + 48, y + 48};
        surfaceSelected = selected;
    }
}

bool ThumbnailValidation::Finish()
{
    if (!complete)
    {
        WriteGraphicsLog("Thumbnail validation incomplete: stage=%u\n", stage);
        for (const auto handle : handles)
        {
            const auto thumbnail = AssetThumbnailManager::Request(handle);
            WriteGraphicsLog("Thumbnail validation pending: %s state=%u\n", FormatAssetHandle(handle).c_str(),
                             static_cast<unsigned int>(thumbnail.State));
        }
    }
    Check(complete, "all thumbnail stages completed");
    WriteGraphicsLog("Thumbnail validation failures = %u\n", failures);
    for (auto handle : handles)
    {
        AssetThumbnailManager::Remove(handle);
    }
    existingTexture.Reset();
    std::error_code error;
    for (const auto& file : files)
    {
        std::filesystem::remove(file, error);
    }
    if (!root.empty())
    {
        std::filesystem::remove_all(root, error);
    }
    MaterialManager::Refresh();
    return complete && failures == 0;
}

===== FILE: source\core\vector.h =====
#pragma once
#include <cmath>

class Vector3
{
  public:
    float x;
    float y;
    float z;

    Vector3() = default;
    Vector3(const Vector3& a) : x(a.x), y(a.y), z(a.z) {};

    Vector3(float nx, float ny, float nz) : x(nx), y(ny), z(nz) {};

    Vector3& operator=(const Vector3& a)
    {
        x = a.x;
        y = a.y;
        z = a.z;
        return *this;
    }

    Vector3& operator=(float a)
    {
        x = a;
        y = a;
        z = a;
        return *this;
    }

    Vector3& operator=(XMFLOAT3 a)
    {
        x = a.x;
        y = a.y;
        z = a.z;
        return *this;
    }

    operator DirectX::XMFLOAT3() const
    {
        return DirectX::XMFLOAT3(x, y, z);
    }

    bool operator==(const Vector3& a) const
    {
        return x == a.x && y == a.y && z == a.z;
    }

    bool operator!=(const Vector3& a) const
    {
        return x != a.x || y != a.y || z != a.z;
    }

    Vector3 operator-() const
    {
        return Vector3(-x, -y, -z);
    }

    Vector3 operator+(const Vector3& a) const
    {
        return Vector3(x + a.x, y + a.y, z + a.z);
    }

    Vector3 operator+(const float& a) const
    {
        return Vector3(x + a, y + a, z + a);
    }

    Vector3 operator-(const Vector3& a) const
    {
        return Vector3(x - a.x, y - a.y, z - a.z);
    }

    Vector3 operator*(float a) const
    {
        return Vector3(x * a, y * a, z * a);
    }

    Vector3 operator/(float a) const
    {
        float OneOverA = 1.f / a;
        return Vector3(x * OneOverA, y * OneOverA, z * OneOverA);
    }

    Vector3 operator/(Vector3& a) const
    {
        return Vector3(x / a.x, y / a.y, z / a.z);
    }

    Vector3 operator+=(const Vector3& a)
    {
        x += a.x;
        y += a.y;
        z += a.z;
        return *this;
    }

    Vector3 operator+=(float a)
    {
        x += a;
        y += a;
        z += a;
        return *this;
    }

    Vector3 operator-=(const Vector3& a)
    {
        x -= a.x;
        y -= a.y;
        z -= a.z;
        return *this;
    }

    Vector3 operator*=(const Vector3& a)
    {
        x *= a.x;
        y *= a.y;
        z *= a.z;
        return *this;
    }

    Vector3 operator*=(const float& a)
    {
        return Vector3(x *= a, y *= a, z *= a);
    }

    Vector3 operator/=(const Vector3& a)
    {
        x /= a.x;
        y /= a.y;
        z /= a.z;
        return *this;
    }

    void Normalize()
    {
        float magsq = x * x + y * y + z * z;
        if (magsq > 0.f)
        {
            float oneOverMag = 1.f / sqrtf(magsq);
            x *= oneOverMag;
            y *= oneOverMag;
            z *= oneOverMag;
        }
    }

    float Length() const
    {
        return sqrtf(x * x + y * y + z * z);
    }

    float operator*(const Vector3& a)
    {
        return x * a.x + y * a.y + z * a.z;
    }

    Vector3 Lerp(const Vector3& a, const Vector3& b, float t)
    {
        return a * (1.0f - t) + b * t;
    }

    static float dot(const Vector3& a, const Vector3& b)
    {
        return a.x * b.x + a.y * b.y + a.z * b.z;
    }

    static Vector3 cross(const Vector3& a, const Vector3& b)
    {
        Vector3 ret{};
        ret.x = a.y * b.z - a.z * b.y;
        ret.y = a.z * b.x - a.x * b.z;
        ret.z = a.x * b.y - a.y * b.x;
        return ret;
    }

    static float Distance(const Vector3& a, const Vector3& b)
    {
        float dx = a.x - b.x;
        float dy = a.y - b.y;
        float dz = a.z - b.z;
        return sqrtf(dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz);
    }

    static float DistanceSquared(const Vector3& a, const Vector3& b)
    {
        float dx = a.x - b.x;
        float dy = a.y - b.y;
        float dz = a.z - b.z;
        return dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz;
    }

    static const Vector3 Up()
    {
        return Vector3(0.f, 1.f, 0.f);
    }

    static const Vector3 Down()
    {
        return Vector3(0.f, -1.f, 0.f);
    }

    static const Vector3 Left()
    {
        return Vector3(-1.f, 0.f, 0.f);
    }

    static const Vector3 Right()
    {
        return Vector3(1.f, 0.f, 0.f);
    }

    static const Vector3 Forward()
    {
        return Vector3(0.f, 0.f, 1.f);
    }

    static const Vector3 Backward()
    {
        return Vector3(0.f, 0.f, -1.f);
    }

    static const Vector3 One()
    {
        return Vector3(1.f, 1.f, 1.f);
    }

    static const Vector3 Zero()
    {
        return Vector3(0.f, 0.f, 0.f);
    }
};

===== FILE: source\core\viewportinputgate.h =====
#pragma once
// ============================================================================
// ViewportInputGate：エディターカメラの右クリック操作（視点回転 + WASD/QE 移動）を
// 「3D ビューポート上で右ボタンを押し始めたとき」だけに限定する。
//  ・ImGuiManager::Update がビューポートのホバー状態を見て毎フレーム更新する
//  ・押し始めた後はボタンを離すまで継続（ドラッグ中にビューポート外へ出ても止まらない。UE と同じ）
//  ・エディター UI が無い実行形態（検証 / ランタイムのみ）では従来どおり右ボタンの状態をそのまま使う
// ============================================================================
#include "input.h"

namespace ViewportInputGate
{
    inline bool g_EditorDrivesInput = false; // エディターが毎フレーム状態を更新しているか
    inline bool g_RightLookActive = false;   // ビューポートで右ボタンを押し始め、まだ離していない

    inline bool CameraLookActive()
    {
        return g_EditorDrivesInput ? g_RightLookActive : Input::IsKeyHeld(VK_RBUTTON);
    }

    // rightDown: 右ボタンが押されているか / rightPressedInViewport: このフレームにビューポート上で押されたか
    inline void Update(bool rightDown, bool rightPressedInViewport)
    {
        g_EditorDrivesInput = true;
        if (!rightDown)
        {
            g_RightLookActive = false;
        }
        else if (rightPressedInViewport)
        {
            g_RightLookActive = true;
        }
    }
} // namespace ViewportInputGate

#include "pch.h"
#include "world.h"
#include "renderbenchmark.h"
#include "renderingvalidation.h"

float World::m_DeltaTime = 0.0f;
float World::m_RawDeltaTime = 0.0f;
float World::m_SmoothedDeltaTime = 0.0f;
float World::m_FrameRate = 0.0f;
float World::m_FrameTimeMs = 0.0f;
double World::m_FrameStatsAccumulator = 0.0;
int World::m_FrameStatsCount = 0;
long long World::m_LastTime = 0;
long long World::m_Frequency = 0;
bool World::m_VSyncEnabled = false;
bool World::m_FixedFrameRateEnabled = true;
int World::m_TargetFrameRate = 120;
unordered_map<string, EntityID> World::m_NameMap;
unordered_map<EntityID, string> World::m_IdToNameMap;

void World::RegisterName(EntityID entity, const string& name)
{
    if (entity >= g_kMAX_ENTITIES || name.empty())
    {
        return;
    }

    auto oldIt = m_IdToNameMap.find(entity);
    if (oldIt != m_IdToNameMap.end())
    {
        m_NameMap.erase(oldIt->second);
    }

    auto sameNameIt = m_NameMap.find(name);
    if (sameNameIt != m_NameMap.end())
    {
        m_IdToNameMap.erase(sameNameIt->second);
    }

    m_NameMap[name] = entity;
    m_IdToNameMap[entity] = name;
}

void World::UnregisterName(EntityID entity)
{
    auto it = m_IdToNameMap.find(entity);
    if (it == m_IdToNameMap.end())
    {
        return;
    }

    m_NameMap.erase(it->second);
    m_IdToNameMap.erase(it);
}

void World::Update()
{
    constexpr float kMaxDeltaTime = 0.1f;
    constexpr float kSmoothingResetDelta = 1.0f / 20.0f;
    constexpr float kFastFrameDelta = 1.0f / 120.0f;

    if (m_Frequency == 0)
    {
        LARGE_INTEGER li;
        QueryPerformanceFrequency(&li);
        m_Frequency = li.QuadPart;
        QueryPerformanceCounter(&li);
        m_LastTime = li.QuadPart;
        m_DeltaTime = 1.0f / 60.0f;
        m_RawDeltaTime = m_DeltaTime;
        m_SmoothedDeltaTime = m_DeltaTime;
        m_FrameTimeMs = m_DeltaTime * 1000.0f;
        return;
    }

    LARGE_INTEGER li;
    QueryPerformanceCounter(&li);
    long long currentTime = li.QuadPart;
    m_RawDeltaTime = static_cast<float>(currentTime - m_LastTime) / m_Frequency;
    m_LastTime = currentTime;

    if (m_RawDeltaTime > kMaxDeltaTime)
    {
        m_RawDeltaTime = kMaxDeltaTime;
    }
    else if (m_RawDeltaTime < 0.0f)
    {
        m_RawDeltaTime = 0.0f;
    }

    if (m_SmoothedDeltaTime <= 0.0f || m_RawDeltaTime >= kSmoothingResetDelta)
    {
        m_SmoothedDeltaTime = m_RawDeltaTime;
    }
    else
    {
        float smoothRate;
        if ((m_RawDeltaTime <= kFastFrameDelta))
        {
            smoothRate = 0.18f;
        }
        else
        {
            smoothRate = 0.32f;
        }
        m_SmoothedDeltaTime += (m_RawDeltaTime - m_SmoothedDeltaTime) * smoothRate;
    }

    m_DeltaTime = m_SmoothedDeltaTime;
    m_FrameTimeMs = m_RawDeltaTime * 1000.0f;
    m_FrameStatsAccumulator += m_RawDeltaTime;
    m_FrameStatsCount++;
    if (m_FrameStatsAccumulator >= 0.5)
    {
        if (m_FrameStatsAccumulator > 0.0)
        {
            m_FrameRate = static_cast<float>(m_FrameStatsCount / m_FrameStatsAccumulator);
        }
        else
        {
            m_FrameRate = 0.0f;
        }
        m_FrameStatsAccumulator = 0.0;
        m_FrameStatsCount = 0;
    }
}

void World::WaitForFrameLimit()
{
    // 目標フレームレートに合わせて待機する。
    // ・締め切りを前回の締め切りから積み上げるので、誤差が蓄積しない（120fpsで8.333ms刻みを維持）
    // ・高精度ウェイタブルタイマーで大部分を眠り、最後の0.6msだけスピンする（Sleepの15.6ms粒度を回避）
    // ・大きく遅れたフレームでは締め切りを現在時刻に合わせ直し、追いつこうとして連続で詰めない
    static HANDLE s_Timer = nullptr;
    static bool s_TimerCreated = false;
    static long long s_NextDeadline = 0;
    if (!m_FixedFrameRateEnabled || m_TargetFrameRate <= 0 || m_Frequency == 0)
    {
        s_NextDeadline = 0;
        return;
    }
    if (!s_TimerCreated)
    {
        s_TimerCreated = true;
#ifdef CREATE_WAITABLE_TIMER_HIGH_RESOLUTION
        s_Timer = CreateWaitableTimerExW(nullptr, nullptr, CREATE_WAITABLE_TIMER_HIGH_RESOLUTION, TIMER_ALL_ACCESS);
#endif
        if (!s_Timer)
        {
            s_Timer = CreateWaitableTimerExW(nullptr, nullptr, 0, TIMER_ALL_ACCESS);
        }
    }

    const long long period =
        static_cast<long long>(static_cast<double>(m_Frequency) / static_cast<double>(m_TargetFrameRate));
    LARGE_INTEGER now;
    QueryPerformanceCounter(&now);
    if (s_NextDeadline == 0 || now.QuadPart - s_NextDeadline > period)
    {
        // 初回、または1フレーム以上遅れた場合は基準を取り直す。
        s_NextDeadline = now.QuadPart + period;
        if (m_LastTime > 0 && m_LastTime + period > now.QuadPart)
        {
            s_NextDeadline = m_LastTime + period;
        }
    }

    const long long spinTicks = m_Frequency * 6 / 10000; // 処理時間の基準値：0.6ミリ秒
    for (;;)
    {
        QueryPerformanceCounter(&now);
        const long long remaining = s_NextDeadline - now.QuadPart;
        if (remaining <= 0)
        {
            break;
        }
        if (remaining > spinTicks && s_Timer)
        {
            const long long sleepTicks = remaining - spinTicks;
            LARGE_INTEGER due;
            due.QuadPart = -static_cast<long long>(static_cast<double>(sleepTicks) * 10000000.0 /
                                                   static_cast<double>(m_Frequency));
            if (due.QuadPart < 0 && SetWaitableTimer(s_Timer, &due, 0, nullptr, nullptr, FALSE))
            {
                WaitForSingleObject(s_Timer, 1000);
                continue;
            }
        }
        if (remaining > spinTicks)
        {
            Sleep(remaining > spinTicks * 4 ? 1 : 0);
        }
        else
        {
            YieldProcessor();
        }
    }
    s_NextDeadline += period;
}

float World::GetDeltaTime()
{
    // Smoke captures must advance animation by frame count, independent of shader compilation or GPU waits.
    if (RenderBenchmark::IsEnabled() || RenderingValidation::IsEnabled())
    {
        return 1.0f / 60.0f;
    }
    return m_DeltaTime;
}

float World::GetRawDeltaTime()
{
    if (RenderBenchmark::IsEnabled() || RenderingValidation::IsEnabled())
    {
        return 1.0f / 60.0f;
    }
    return m_RawDeltaTime;
}

#pragma once
#include "componentmanager.h"
#include <type_traits>

class Entity
{
  private:
    EntityID m_Id;

  public:
    Entity(EntityID id) : m_Id(id) {}

    EntityID GetID() const
    {
        return m_Id;
    }

    uint32_t GetGPUInstanceID() const;

    bool IsValid() const
    {
        return m_Id < g_kMAX_ENTITIES && Registry::IsAlive(m_Id);
    }

    template <typename T> Entity& Add()
    {
        ComponentManager::AddComponent(m_Id, ComponentTypeTraits<T>::value());
        return *this;
    }

    template <typename T> T& Get()
    {
        return ComponentManager::GetComponent<T>(m_Id);
    }

    template <typename T> const T& Get() const
    {
        return ComponentManager::GetComponent<T>(m_Id);
    }

    template <typename T> bool Has() const
    {
        return ComponentManager::HasComponent(m_Id, ComponentTypeTraits<T>::value());
    }

    Entity& SetName(const string& name);

    bool operator==(const Entity& other) const
    {
        return m_Id == other.m_Id;
    }

    bool operator!=(const Entity& other) const
    {
        return m_Id != other.m_Id;
    }
};

class World
{
  private:
    static float m_DeltaTime;
    static float m_RawDeltaTime;
    static float m_SmoothedDeltaTime;
    static float m_FrameRate;
    static float m_FrameTimeMs;
    static double m_FrameStatsAccumulator;
