void ImGuiManager::DrawPerformanceWindow()
{
    ImGui::SetNextWindowSize(ImVec2(260.0f, 150.0f), ImGuiCond_FirstUseEver);
    if (!EditorWindowRegistry::BeginEditorWindow("パフォーマンス", &m_ShowPerformanceWindow, ImGuiWindowFlags_AlwaysAutoResize))
    {
        ImGui::End();
        return;
    }

    ImGui::Text("FPS: %.1f", World::GetFrameRate());
    DrawFpsMeter();
    ImGui::Text("Frame: %.2f ms", World::GetFrameTimeMs());
    ImGui::Separator();
    const LightingResources::LightGridStats& lightStats = LightingResources::GetLightGridStats();
    ImGui::Text("Lights: authored %u / screen %u / GPU %u", lightStats.AuthoredLights, lightStats.OnScreenLights,
                lightStats.GpuVisibleLights);
    ImGui::Text("Physical %u / Decal %u", lightStats.GpuPhysicalLights, lightStats.GpuDecalLights);
    ImGui::Text("Tiles: %ux%u / overlap %u of %u", lightStats.TileCountX, lightStats.TileCountY,
                lightStats.MaxLightsPerTile,
                RendererSettings::GetTileLightBudget() + RendererSettings::GetDecalTileLightBudget());
    ImGui::Text("Geometry GBuffer: %u bit/pixel", RendererState::g_kGEOMETRY_GBUFFER_BITS_PER_PIXEL);
    ImGui::Text("Volumetric %u / shadowed %u / overflow %u", lightStats.VolumetricLights, lightStats.ShadowedLights,
                lightStats.OverflowedTileAssignments);
    if (lightStats.OverflowedTileAssignments > 0)
    {
        ImGui::TextColored(ImVec4(1.0f, 0.45f, 0.20f, 1.0f), "ライト重複予算を超過しています");
    }
    ImGui::Separator();

    bool vsyncEnabled = World::IsVSyncEnabled();
    if (ImGui::Checkbox("垂直同期", &vsyncEnabled))
    {
        World::SetVSyncEnabled(vsyncEnabled);
    }

    bool fixedFrameRateEnabled = World::IsFixedFrameRateEnabled();
    if (ImGui::Checkbox("FPS固定", &fixedFrameRateEnabled))
    {
        World::SetFixedFrameRateEnabled(fixedFrameRateEnabled);
    }

    int targetFrameRate = World::GetTargetFrameRate();
    ImGui::BeginDisabled(!fixedFrameRateEnabled);
    ImGui::SetNextItemWidth(120.0f);
    if (ImGui::SliderInt("目標FPS", &targetFrameRate, 15, 360))
    {
        World::SetTargetFrameRate(targetFrameRate);
    }
    ImGui::EndDisabled();

    ImGui::End();
}

void ImGuiManager::DrawRenderDebuggerWindow()
{
    ImGui::SetNextWindowSize(ImVec2(420.0f, 360.0f), ImGuiCond_FirstUseEver);
    if (!EditorWindowRegistry::BeginEditorWindow("描画概要", &m_ShowRenderDebugger))
    {
        ImGui::End();
        return;
    }

    const char* statusText;
    if (RenderConfiguration::GetRenderMode() == RenderMode::DEFERRED)
    {
        statusText = "ディファード";
    }
    else
    {
        statusText = "フォワード";
    }
    ImGui::Text("描画モード: %s", statusText);
    ImGui::Text("画面: %u x %u", GraphicsDevice::GetSceneWidth(), GraphicsDevice::GetSceneHeight());
    const auto& caps = GraphicsDevice::GetFeatureCapabilities();
    ImGui::Separator();
    ImGui::TextUnformatted("Hardware capabilities (runtime readiness is feature specific)");
    ImGui::Text("Mesh shaders: %s", caps.MeshShader ? "supported" : "unavailable");
    ImGui::Text("DXR 1.1: %s", caps.Raytracing ? "supported" : "unavailable");
    ImGui::Text("Sampler feedback: %s", caps.SamplerFeedback ? "supported" : "unavailable");
    ImGui::Text("Reserved texture tiles: %s", caps.ReservedResources ? "supported" : "unavailable");
    ImGui::End();
}

void ImGuiManager::DrawRenderFeatureWindows()
{
    const struct FeatureWindow
    {
        const char* Id;
        const char* Title;
        bool* IsOpen;
        void (*DrawContent)();
    } windows[] = {
        {"gpu_scene", "GPU Scene", &m_ShowGpuSceneWindow, GpuScene::DrawDebug},
        {"gpu_driven", "GPU Driven Rendering", &m_ShowGpuDrivenWindow, GPUDrivenRenderer::DrawDebug},
        {"visibility", "Visibility", &m_ShowVisibilityWindow, GPUVisibility::DrawDebug},
        {"mesh_shader", "Mesh Shader", &m_ShowMeshShaderWindow, MeshShaderRenderer::DrawDebug},
        {"virtual_geometry", "Nanite / LOD", &m_ShowVirtualGeometryWindow, VirtualGeometryDebug::DrawControls},
        {"clouds", "プロシージャルクラウド", &m_ShowCloudWindow, CloudRenderer::DrawDebugUI},
        {"textures", "テクスチャ一覧", &m_ShowTextureListWindow, DrawTextureListContent},
    };

    for (const auto& window : windows)
    {
        if (!*window.IsOpen || !EditorWorkspaceManager::Get().IsAreaDrawn(window.Id))
        {
            continue;
        }
        ImGui::SetNextWindowSize(ImVec2(520.0f, 560.0f), ImGuiCond_FirstUseEver);
        if (ImGui::Begin(window.Title, window.IsOpen))
        {
            window.DrawContent();
        }
        ImGui::End();
    }
}

void ImGuiManager::DrawTextureListContent()
{
    vector<TextureManager::TextureInfo> textures = TextureManager::GetLoadedTextureInfos();
    ImGuiListClipper clipper;
    clipper.Begin(static_cast<int>(textures.size()));
    while (clipper.Step())
    {
        for (int i = clipper.DisplayStart; i < clipper.DisplayEnd; ++i)
        {
            const auto& tex = textures[i];
            ImGui::Text("#%d %ux%u %s", tex.SrvIndex, tex.Width, tex.Height, tex.Path.c_str());
        }
    }
}

void ImGuiManager::DrawGBufferWindow()
{
    ImGui::SetNextWindowSize(ImVec2(700.0f, 560.0f), ImGuiCond_FirstUseEver);
    if (!EditorWindowRegistry::BeginEditorWindow("Gバッファ", &m_ShowGBufferWindow))
    {
        ImGui::End();
        return;
    }

    if (RenderMode::DEFERRED != RenderConfiguration::GetRenderMode())
    {
        ImGui::TextUnformatted("ディファードモードのみ");
        ImGui::End();
        return;
    }

    ImGui::BeginChild("GBufferPreview", ImVec2(0, 0), true);

    const float cellSpacing = 12.0f;
    const int columns = 2;
    const float previewWidth = max(1.0f, (ImGui::GetContentRegionAvail().x - cellSpacing) / columns);
    const float aspect =
        float(max(1u, GraphicsDevice::GetSceneHeight())) / float(max(1u, GraphicsDevice::GetSceneWidth()));
    const ImVec2 previewSize(previewWidth, previewWidth * aspect);

    const struct
    {
        const char* Label;
        GBufferType Type;
        const char* Description;
        bool Alpha = false;
    } cells[] = {
        {"ベースカラー", GBufferType::BASE_COLOR, "RGB: ベースカラー"},
        {"法線", GBufferType::NORMAL, "RGB: ワールド法線（0～1） / α: POM変位"},
        {"深度", GBufferType::DEPTH, "逆Zを強調表示（明るいほど近い）"},
        {"マテリアル", GBufferType::MATERIAL, "RGB: メタリック / ラフネス / フレネル"},
        {"影パラメーター", GBufferType::SHADOW, "RGB: 影のしきい値 / 柔らかさ / 強さ"},
        {"大気", GBufferType::ATMOSPHERE, "HDR圧縮表示。有効な散乱がない場合は黒です"},
        {"ベロシティ", GBufferType::VELOCITY, "RG: 移動方向と大きさ（静止時は灰色）"},
        {"ブルーム", GBufferType::BLOOM, "HDR圧縮表示。発光がない場合は黒です"},
        {"発光", GBufferType::EMISSION_AO, "RGB: 発光をHDR圧縮表示"},
        {"AO", GBufferType::EMISSION_AO, "α: マテリアルAO（白=遮蔽なし）", true},
    };

    const int cellCount = int(size(cells));
    const int rowCount = (cellCount + columns - 1) / columns;
    for (int row = 0; row < rowCount; ++row)
    {
        for (int col = 0; col < columns; ++col)
        {
            const int index = row * columns + col;
            if (index >= cellCount)
            {
                break;
            }

            ImGui::BeginGroup();
            ImGui::TextUnformatted(cells[index].Label);
            const UINT previewType = cells[index].Alpha ? UINT(GBufferType::COUNT) : UINT(cells[index].Type);
            auto texture = RenderTargets::GetGBufferSrvHandle(cells[index].Type);
            if (cells[index].Type == GBufferType::BLOOM)
            {
                texture = GBufferPreview::BloomTexture(GraphicsDevice::GetDevice(),
                                                       AdvancedEffects::GetBloomPreviewResource(), texture);
            }
            GBufferPreview::Image(texture, previewSize, previewType);
            if (ImGui::IsItemHovered())
            {
                ImGui::SetTooltip("%s", cells[index].Description);
            }
            ImGui::EndGroup();

            if (col < columns - 1 && index + 1 < cellCount)
            {
                ImGui::SameLine(0.0f, cellSpacing);
            }
        }

        if (row < rowCount - 1)
        {
            ImGui::Dummy(ImVec2(0.0f, cellSpacing));
        }
    }

    ImGui::EndChild();
    ImGui::End();
}

void ImGuiManager::DrawAtmosphereWindow()
{
    ImGui::SetNextWindowSize(ImVec2(470.0f, 680.0f), ImGuiCond_FirstUseEver);
    if (!EditorWindowRegistry::BeginEditorWindow("大気シミュレーション", &m_ShowAtmosphereWindow))
    {
        ImGui::End();
        return;
    }

    AtmosphereParameters& atmosphere = Atmosphere::GetMutableParameters();
    ImGui::Checkbox("有効", &atmosphere.Enabled);
    ImGui::Checkbox("太陽の位置から空を描画", &atmosphere.PhysicalSky);
    ImGui::SeparatorText("時間帯と太陽");
    auto& cycle = DayNightCycle::GetSettings();
    bool cycleChanged = ImGui::Checkbox("時刻から太陽の位置を計算", &cycle.TimeDriven);
    cycleChanged |= ImGui::SliderFloat("太陽時", &cycle.Hours, 0.0f, 24.0f, "%.2f 時");
    ImGui::Checkbox("時間を進める", &cycle.Running);
    ImGui::Checkbox("編集画面でも時間を進める", &cycle.PreviewInEditor);
    cycleChanged |= ImGui::SliderFloat("1日の長さ", &cycle.DayDurationSeconds, 10.0f, 1200.0f, "%.0f 秒");
    cycleChanged |= ImGui::SliderFloat("緯度", &cycle.Latitude, -89.0f, 89.0f, "%.1f 度");
    cycleChanged |= ImGui::SliderInt("年の何日目", &cycle.DayOfYear, 1, 365);
    cycleChanged |= ImGui::Checkbox("太陽の色と明るさを自動調整", &cycle.AutomaticLighting);
    cycleChanged |= ImGui::SliderFloat("昼の太陽強度", &cycle.DayIntensity, 0.0f, 20.0f);
    ImGui::SliderFloat("空の強度", &cycle.SkyIntensity, 0.0f, 30.0f);
    ImGui::SliderFloat("星の明るさ", &cycle.StarBrightness, 0.0f, 1.0f);
    const char* presets[] = {"朝", "昼", "夕方", "夜"};
    const float hours[] = {6.0f, 12.0f, 18.0f, 0.0f};
    for (int preset = 0; preset < 4; ++preset)
    {
        if (preset > 0)
        {
            ImGui::SameLine();
        }
        if (ImGui::Button(presets[preset]))
        {
            DayNightCycle::SetTime(hours[preset]);
            cycleChanged = true;
        }
    }
    if (cycleChanged)
    {
        DayNightCycle::Update(0.0f);
    }
    ImGui::Text("太陽高度: %.1f 度 / 昼光: %.2f",
                asinf(clamp(DayNightCycle::GetSunDirection().y, -1.0f, 1.0f)) * 180.0f / SolarCycle::Pi,
                DayNightCycle::GetDaylight());
    ImGui::TextWrapped("太陽時は太陽の位置を基準とする時刻です。時刻制御をオフにすると Sun を直接配置できます。");
    ImGui::SeparatorText("散乱");
    ImGui::SliderFloat("Rayleigh強度", &atmosphere.RayleighStrength, 0.0f, 4.0f, "%.3f");
    ImGui::SliderFloat("Mie強度", &atmosphere.MieStrength, 0.0f, 2.0f, "%.3f");
    ImGui::SliderFloat("大気密度", &atmosphere.Density, 0.0f, 3.0f, "%.3f");
    ImGui::SliderFloat("高度減衰", &atmosphere.HeightFalloff, 0.0f, 1.0f, "%.3f");
    ImGui::SliderFloat("消散", &atmosphere.Extinction, 0.0f, 2.0f, "%.3f");
    ImGui::SliderFloat("Mie g", &atmosphere.MieG, -0.95f, 0.95f, "%.3f");
    ImGui::SliderFloat("距離スケール", &atmosphere.DistanceScale, 0.001f, 0.25f, "%.3f");
    ImGui::SliderFloat("ライトシャフト強度", &atmosphere.LightShaftStrength, 0.0f, 4.0f, "%.3f");
    ImGui::SliderFloat("ライトシャフトぼかし", &atmosphere.LightShaftBlur, 0.0f, 1.0f, "%.3f");
    ImGui::SliderFloat("環境散乱", &atmosphere.AmbientStrength, 0.0f, 1.0f, "%.3f");

    ImGui::SeparatorText("色");
    ImGui::ColorEdit3("Rayleigh色", &atmosphere.RayleighColor.x);
    ImGui::ColorEdit3("Mie色", &atmosphere.MieColor.x);

    ImGui::SeparatorText("Sun");
    EntityID firstSun = g_kINVALID_ENTITY;
    for (EntityID entity : World::GetView<SunComponent>())
    {
        firstSun = entity;
        break;
    }

    if (firstSun == g_kINVALID_ENTITY)
    {
        if (ImGui::Button("Sunを作成"))
        {
            m_SelectedEntity = Sun::CreateDefault();
        }
    }
    else
    {
        auto& sun = ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<SunComponent>(firstSun);
        auto& transform = ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<TransformComponent>(firstSun);
        EntitySnapshot before = CaptureEntity(firstSun);
        bool sunChanged = false;
        ImGui::Text("Sun Entity: %s", GetEntityDisplayName(firstSun));
        if (DrawAxisFloat3("位置", transform.Position, 0.1f))
        {
            transform.IsDirty = true;
            sunChanged = true;
        }
        sunChanged |= DrawAxisFloat3("注視点", sun.Target, 0.1f);
        sunChanged |= ImGui::Checkbox("Directional同期", &sun.SyncDirectionalLight);
        if (sunChanged)
        {
            BeginUndoCapture(firstSun, before);
            Sun::Sync(firstSun);
        }
        if (ImGui::Button("Sunを選択"))
        {
            m_SelectedEntity = firstSun;
        }
    }

    ImGui::SeparatorText("レンズフレア（太陽）");
    {
        auto& rq = RenderQuality::Get();
        ImGui::Checkbox("太陽のレンズフレア", &rq.SunFlare);
        ImGui::SetItemTooltip("Sun の位置から、グレア・光芒・ゴースト・ハローを描きます。\n"
                              "建物や木で太陽が隠れると自動で消えます（深度で判定）。");
        ImGui::BeginDisabled(!rq.SunFlare);
        ImGui::SliderFloat("全体の強さ##SunFlare", &rq.SunFlareIntensity, 0.0f, 3.0f, "%.2f");
        ImGui::SliderFloat("グレア（にじみ）", &rq.SunFlareGlare, 0.0f, 3.0f, "%.2f");
        ImGui::SliderFloat("光芒", &rq.SunFlareStarburst, 0.0f, 3.0f, "%.2f");
        ImGui::SliderFloat("ゴースト", &rq.SunFlareGhosts, 0.0f, 3.0f, "%.2f");
        ImGui::SliderFloat("虹色のハロー", &rq.SunFlareHalo, 0.0f, 3.0f, "%.2f");
        ImGui::SliderFloat("横長ストリーク", &rq.SunFlareAnamorphic, 0.0f, 3.0f, "%.2f");
        ImGui::SliderInt("絞り羽根の枚数", &rq.SunFlareBlades, 4, 12);
        ImGui::SetItemTooltip("ゴーストの多角形の形と、光芒の本数（枚数 × 2）が変わります");
        ImGui::EndDisabled();
    }

    if (ImGui::Button("大気をリセット"))
    {
        Atmosphere::Reset();
    }

    ImGui::End();
}

void ImGuiManager::DrawLogWindow()
{
    // UE の Output Log / Blender の Info エディター風：重要度フィルター、時刻、重複のまとめ表示、コピー
    static ImGuiTextFilter logFilter;
    static bool showLevel[4] = {true, true, true, true};
    static vector<int> visibleLogs;
    static uint64_t cachedRevision = ~0ull;
    static string cachedFilter;
    static int cachedMask = -1;
    ImGui::SetNextWindowSize(ImVec2(620.0f, 220.0f), ImGuiCond_FirstUseEver);
    if (!EditorWindowRegistry::BeginEditorWindow("ログ", &m_ShowLogWindow))
    {
        ImGui::End();
        return;
    }

    std::lock_guard<std::recursive_mutex> lock(m_LogMutex);
    if (ImGui::Button("クリア"))
    {
        m_Logs.clear();
        for (auto& count : m_LogCounts)
        {
            count = 0;
        }
        ++m_LogRevision;
    }
    ImGui::SameLine();
    struct LevelToggle
    {
        EditorShell::LogLevel Level;
        const char* Name;
    };
    const LevelToggle toggles[] = {{EditorShell::LogLevel::Info, "情報"},
                                   {EditorShell::LogLevel::Success, "成功"},
                                   {EditorShell::LogLevel::Warning, "警告"},
                                   {EditorShell::LogLevel::Error, "エラー"}};
    for (const auto& toggle : toggles)
    {
        const int index = static_cast<int>(toggle.Level);
        char label[64];
        snprintf(label, sizeof(label), "%s %s %u##LogLevel%d", EditorShell::LogLevelIcon(toggle.Level), toggle.Name,
                 m_LogCounts[index], index);
        const ImVec4 color = EditorShell::LogLevelColor(toggle.Level);
        ImGui::PushStyleColor(ImGuiCol_Text, showLevel[index] ? color : ImGui::GetStyleColorVec4(ImGuiCol_TextDisabled));
        ImGui::PushStyleColor(ImGuiCol_Button, showLevel[index] ? ImGui::GetStyleColorVec4(ImGuiCol_FrameBg)
                                                                : ImVec4(0, 0, 0, 0));
        if (ImGui::SmallButton(label))
        {
            showLevel[index] = !showLevel[index];
        }
        ImGui::PopStyleColor(2);
        ImGui::SameLine();
    }
    ImGui::Checkbox("末尾を追従", &m_LogAutoScroll);
    ImGui::SameLine();
    const bool copyRequested = ImGui::SmallButton("コピー");
    ImGui::SetItemTooltip("表示中のログをクリップボードにコピー（各行は右クリックでコピー）");
    DrawSearchField("LogSearch", "ログを検索...", logFilter);
    ImGui::Separator();

    // 最適化：フィルター結果はログ追加・フィルター変更時だけ作り直す（以前は毎フレーム全件走査）
    int mask = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < 4; ++i)
    {
        mask |= showLevel[i] ? (1 << i) : 0;
    }
    if (cachedRevision != m_LogRevision || cachedMask != mask || cachedFilter != logFilter.InputBuf)
    {
        cachedRevision = m_LogRevision;
        cachedMask = mask;
        cachedFilter = logFilter.InputBuf;
        visibleLogs.clear();
        visibleLogs.reserve(m_Logs.size());
        for (int i = 0; i < static_cast<int>(m_Logs.size()); ++i)
        {
            const auto& entry = m_Logs[i];
            if ((mask & (1 << (entry.Level & 3))) && logFilter.PassFilter(entry.Text.c_str()))
            {
                visibleLogs.push_back(i);
            }
        }
    }
    if (copyRequested)
    {
        string text;
        for (int index : visibleLogs)
        {
            const auto& entry = m_Logs[index];
            text += "[";
            text += entry.Clock;
            text += "] ";
            text += entry.Text;
            if (entry.Repeat > 1)
            {
                text += " (x" + to_string(entry.Repeat) + ")";
            }
            text += "\n";
        }
        ImGui::SetClipboardText(text.c_str());
    }

    ImGui::TextDisabled("%d / %d 件", static_cast<int>(visibleLogs.size()), static_cast<int>(m_Logs.size()));
    ImGui::BeginChild("LogScroll", ImVec2(0, 0), ImGuiChildFlags_Borders, ImGuiWindowFlags_HorizontalScrollbar);
    const bool wasAtBottom = ImGui::GetScrollY() >= ImGui::GetScrollMaxY() - 4.0f;
    if (visibleLogs.empty())
    {
        ImGui::TextUnformatted("表示するログがありません。");
    }
    const ImVec4 dim = ImGui::GetStyleColorVec4(ImGuiCol_TextDisabled);
    ImGuiListClipper clipper;
    clipper.Begin(static_cast<int>(visibleLogs.size()));
    while (clipper.Step())
    {
        for (int i = clipper.DisplayStart; i < clipper.DisplayEnd; ++i)
        {
            const auto& entry = m_Logs[visibleLogs[i]];
            const auto level = static_cast<EditorShell::LogLevel>(entry.Level & 3);
            ImGui::PushID(i);
            ImGui::TextColored(dim, "%s", entry.Clock);
            ImGui::SameLine();
            ImGui::TextColored(EditorShell::LogLevelColor(level), "%s", EditorShell::LogLevelIcon(level));
            ImGui::SameLine();
            if (level == EditorShell::LogLevel::Warning || level == EditorShell::LogLevel::Error)
            {
                ImGui::PushStyleColor(ImGuiCol_Text, EditorShell::LogLevelColor(level));
                ImGui::TextUnformatted(entry.Text.c_str());
                ImGui::PopStyleColor();
            }
            else
            {
                ImGui::TextUnformatted(entry.Text.c_str());
            }
            if (ImGui::IsItemClicked(ImGuiMouseButton_Right))
            {
                ImGui::SetClipboardText(entry.Text.c_str());
            }
            if (entry.Repeat > 1)
            {
                ImGui::SameLine();
                ImGui::TextColored(EditorShell::LogLevelColor(EditorShell::LogLevel::Warning), "×%u", entry.Repeat);
            }
            ImGui::PopID();
        }
    }
    if (m_LogAutoScroll && wasAtBottom)
    {
        ImGui::SetScrollHereY(1.0f);
    }
    ImGui::EndChild();
    ImGui::End();
}

void ImGuiManager::DrawMeshOutlineWindow()
{
    ImGui::SetNextWindowSize(ImVec2(760.0f, 420.0f), ImGuiCond_FirstUseEver);
    if (!EditorWindowRegistry::BeginEditorWindow("メッシュ単位のアウトライン", &m_ShowMeshOutlineWindow))

        ImGui::End();
        return;
    }

    DrawToonMeshOutlineInspector(m_SelectedEntity, false);
    ImGui::End();
}

#include "pch.h"

namespace
{
    void PublishHistoryChange(bool lightChanged, bool lodChanged)
    {
        TemporalHistory::Context::NotifySceneChanged();
        if (lightChanged)
        {
            TemporalHistory::Context::NotifyLightingChanged();
        }
        if (lodChanged)
        {
            TemporalHistory::Context::NotifyLodChanged();
        }
    }

    template <typename T> void RestoreSnapshotComponent(EntityID entity, const T& component)
    {
        if (!ComponentManager::HasComponent<T>(entity))
        {
            ComponentManager::AddComponent(entity, ComponentTypeTraits<T>::value());
        }
        ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<T>(entity) = component;
        GpuSceneChanges::Notify(entity);
    }

}

ImGuiManager::EntitySnapshot ImGuiManager::CaptureEntity(EntityID entity)
{
    EntitySnapshot snapshot{};
    snapshot.Entity = entity;
    if (entity == g_kINVALID_ENTITY || !Registry::IsAlive(entity))
    {
        return snapshot;
    }
    snapshot.WasAlive = true;
    if (ComponentManager::HasComponent<NameComponent>(entity))
    {
        snapshot.HasName = true;
        snapshot.Name = ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<NameComponent>(entity);
    }

    if (ComponentManager::HasComponent<TransformComponent>(entity))
    {
        snapshot.HasTransform = true;
        snapshot.Transform = ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<TransformComponent>(entity);
    }

    if (ComponentManager::HasComponent<ShaderComponent>(entity))
    {
        snapshot.HasShader = true;
        snapshot.Shader = ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<ShaderComponent>(entity);
    }

    if (ComponentManager::HasComponent<StaticModelComponent>(entity))
    {
        snapshot.HasStaticModel = true;
        snapshot.StaticModel = ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<StaticModelComponent>(entity);
    }

    if (ComponentManager::HasComponent<AnimationModelComponent>(entity))
    {
        snapshot.HasAnimationModel = true;
        snapshot.AnimationModel = ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<AnimationModelComponent>(entity);
    }

    if (ComponentManager::HasComponent<LightComponent>(entity))
    {
        snapshot.HasLight = true;
        snapshot.Light = ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<LightComponent>(entity);
    }

    if (ComponentManager::HasComponent<SunComponent>(entity))
    {
        snapshot.HasSun = true;
        snapshot.Sun = ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<SunComponent>(entity);
    }
    if (ComponentManager::HasComponent<ProceduralTerrainComponent>(entity))
    {
        snapshot.HasProceduralTerrain = true;
        snapshot.ProceduralTerrain = ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<ProceduralTerrainComponent>(entity);
    }
    if (ComponentManager::HasComponent<ProceduralMotionComponent>(entity))
    {
        snapshot.HasProceduralMotion = true;
        snapshot.ProceduralMotion = ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<ProceduralMotionComponent>(entity);
    }

    if (ComponentManager::HasComponent<MaterialComponent>(entity))
    {
        snapshot.HasMaterial = true;
        snapshot.Material = ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<MaterialComponent>(entity);
    }

    if (ComponentManager::HasComponent<AABBComponent>(entity))
    {
        snapshot.HasAabb = true;
        snapshot.Aabb = ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<AABBComponent>(entity);
    }

    if (ComponentManager::HasComponent<SpriteComponent>(entity))
    {
        snapshot.HasSprite = true;
        snapshot.Sprite = ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<SpriteComponent>(entity);
    }

    if (ComponentManager::HasComponent<MeshComponent>(entity))
    {
        snapshot.HasMesh = true;
        snapshot.Mesh = ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<MeshComponent>(entity);
    }

    if (ComponentManager::HasComponent<CameraComponent>(entity))
    {
        snapshot.HasCamera = true;
        snapshot.Camera = ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<CameraComponent>(entity);
    }

    if (ComponentManager::HasComponent<PostProcessComponent>(entity))
    {
        snapshot.HasPostProcess = true;
        snapshot.PostProcess = ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<PostProcessComponent>(entity);
    }

    if (ComponentManager::HasComponent<InputComponent>(entity))
    {
        snapshot.HasInput = true;
        snapshot.Input = ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<InputComponent>(entity);
    }

    if (ComponentManager::HasComponent<MoveComponent>(entity))
    {
        snapshot.HasMove = true;
        snapshot.Move = ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<MoveComponent>(entity);
    }

    if (ComponentManager::HasComponent<PhysicsComponent>(entity))
    {
        snapshot.HasPhysics = true;
        snapshot.Physics = ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<PhysicsComponent>(entity);
    }
    if (ComponentManager::HasComponent<TimelineComponent>(entity))
    {
        snapshot.HasTimeline = true;
        snapshot.Timeline = ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<TimelineComponent>(entity);
    }

    if (ComponentManager::HasComponent<OBBComponent>(entity))
    {
        snapshot.HasObb = true;
        snapshot.Obb = ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<OBBComponent>(entity);
    }

    if (ComponentManager::HasComponent<LODComponent>(entity))
    {
        snapshot.HasLod = true;
        snapshot.Lod = ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<LODComponent>(entity);
    }

    return snapshot;
}

void ImGuiManager::ApplySnapshot(const EntitySnapshot& snapshot)
{
    if (!GraphicsDevice::WaitForGpuIdle())
    {
        return;
    }
    PublishHistoryChange(snapshot.HasLight, snapshot.HasLod);
    if (snapshot.Entity == g_kINVALID_ENTITY)
    {
        return;
    }
    if (!snapshot.WasAlive)
    {
        if (Registry::IsAlive(snapshot.Entity))
        {
            World::DestroyEntity(Entity(snapshot.Entity));
        }
        return;
    }

    if (!Registry::IsAlive(snapshot.Entity) && !Registry::RestoreEntity(snapshot.Entity))
    {
        return;
    }

    if (snapshot.HasName)
    {
        RestoreSnapshotComponent(snapshot.Entity, snapshot.Name);
        World::RegisterName(snapshot.Entity, snapshot.Name.Name);
    }
    if (snapshot.HasTransform)
    {
        RestoreSnapshotComponent(snapshot.Entity, snapshot.Transform);
        ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<TransformComponent>(snapshot.Entity).IsDirty = true;
    }
    if (snapshot.HasShader)
    {
        RestoreSnapshotComponent(snapshot.Entity, snapshot.Shader);
    }
    if (snapshot.HasStaticModel)
    {
        RestoreSnapshotComponent(snapshot.Entity, snapshot.StaticModel);
    }
    if (snapshot.HasAnimationModel)
    {
        RestoreSnapshotComponent(snapshot.Entity, snapshot.AnimationModel);
    }
    if (snapshot.HasLight)
    {
        RestoreSnapshotComponent(snapshot.Entity, snapshot.Light);
        ApplyLightEntityToRuntime(snapshot.Entity);
    }
    if (snapshot.HasSun)
    {
        RestoreSnapshotComponent(snapshot.Entity, snapshot.Sun);
        Sun::Sync(snapshot.Entity);
    }
    if (snapshot.HasMaterial)
    {
        RestoreSnapshotComponent(snapshot.Entity, snapshot.Material);
    }
    if (snapshot.HasAabb)
    {
        RestoreSnapshotComponent(snapshot.Entity, snapshot.Aabb);
    }
    if (snapshot.HasSprite)
    {
        RestoreSnapshotComponent(snapshot.Entity, snapshot.Sprite);
    }
    if (snapshot.HasMesh)
    {
        RestoreSnapshotComponent(snapshot.Entity, snapshot.Mesh);
    }
    if (snapshot.HasProceduralTerrain)
    {
        RestoreSnapshotComponent(snapshot.Entity, snapshot.ProceduralTerrain);
    }
    if (snapshot.HasProceduralMotion)
    {
        RestoreSnapshotComponent(snapshot.Entity, snapshot.ProceduralMotion);
    }
    if (!snapshot.HasProceduralMotion && ComponentManager::HasComponent<ProceduralMotionComponent>(snapshot.Entity))
    {
        ComponentManager::RemoveComponent(snapshot.Entity, ComponentType::PROCEDURAL_MOTION);
    }
    if (snapshot.HasCamera)
    {
        RestoreSnapshotComponent(snapshot.Entity, snapshot.Camera);
    }
    if (snapshot.HasPostProcess)
    {
        RestoreSnapshotComponent(snapshot.Entity, snapshot.PostProcess);
    }
    if (snapshot.HasInput)
    {
        RestoreSnapshotComponent(snapshot.Entity, snapshot.Input);
    }
    if (snapshot.HasMove)
    {
        RestoreSnapshotComponent(snapshot.Entity, snapshot.Move);
    }
    if (snapshot.HasPhysics)
    {
        RestoreSnapshotComponent(snapshot.Entity, snapshot.Physics);
    }
    else if (ComponentManager::HasComponent<PhysicsComponent>(snapshot.Entity))
    {
        ComponentManager::RemoveComponent(snapshot.Entity, ComponentType::PHYSICS);
    }
    if (snapshot.HasTimeline)
    {
        RestoreSnapshotComponent(snapshot.Entity, snapshot.Timeline);
    }
    else if (ComponentManager::HasComponent<TimelineComponent>(snapshot.Entity))
    {
        ComponentManager::RemoveComponent(snapshot.Entity, ComponentType::TIMELINE);
    }
    if (snapshot.HasObb)
    {
        RestoreSnapshotComponent(snapshot.Entity, snapshot.Obb);
    }
    if (snapshot.HasLod)
    {
        RestoreSnapshotComponent(snapshot.Entity, snapshot.Lod);
    }
    else if (ComponentManager::HasComponent<LODComponent>(snapshot.Entity))
    {
        ComponentManager::RemoveComponent(snapshot.Entity, ComponentType::LOD);
    }
}

void ImGuiManager::BeginUndoCapture(EntityID entity, const EntitySnapshot& before)
{
    if (entity == g_kINVALID_ENTITY || !Registry::IsAlive(entity))
    {
        return;
    }
    // 明示的な編集操作では履歴を無効化する。シミュレーションによる移動は
    // このトランザクション経路を通らず、通常の再投影を継続する。
    PublishHistoryChange(before.HasLight, before.HasLod);
    GpuSceneChanges::Notify(entity);
    ++m_EditRevision;
    auto append = [&](const EntitySnapshot& snapshot) {
        for (const auto& existing : m_PendingUndo)
        {
            if (existing.Entity == snapshot.Entity)
            {
                return;
            }
        }
        m_PendingUndo.push_back(snapshot);
    };
    append(before);
    for (EntityID child :
         EntityHierarchy::WithDescendants({entity}, SceneHierarchy::Entities(), SceneHierarchy::Parent))
    {
        const bool alreadyCaptured =
            any_of(m_PendingUndo.begin(), m_PendingUndo.end(), [&](const EntitySnapshot& snapshot) {
                return snapshot.Entity == child;
            });
        if (!alreadyCaptured)
        {
            append(CaptureEntity(child));
        }
    }
    m_HasPendingUndo = true;
}

void ImGuiManager::FinalizeUndoCaptureIfIdle(bool force)
{
    if (!m_HasPendingUndo || (!force && (ImGui::IsAnyItemActive() || ImGuizmo::IsUsingAny())))
    {
        return;
    }
    PushUndoGroup(m_PendingUndo);
    m_HasPendingUndo = false;
    m_PendingUndo = {};
}

void ImGuiManager::PushUndoSnapshot(const EntitySnapshot& snapshot)
{
    PushUndoGroup({snapshot});
}

void ImGuiManager::PushUndoGroup(const vector<EntitySnapshot>& snapshots)
{
    if (snapshots.empty())
    {
        return;
    }
    for (const auto& snapshot : snapshots)
    {
        PublishHistoryChange(snapshot.HasLight, snapshot.HasLod);
    }
    ++m_EditRevision;
    m_UndoStack.push_back(snapshots);
    // 上限はエディター設定（既定 30、以前は 10 固定）
    const size_t limit = static_cast<size_t>((std::max)(EditorPreferences::Get().UndoLimit, 1));
    if (m_UndoStack.size() > limit)
    {
        m_UndoStack.erase(m_UndoStack.begin(), m_UndoStack.begin() + (m_UndoStack.size() - limit));
    }
    m_RedoStack.clear();
}

void ImGuiManager::RestoreHistoryGroup(const vector<EntitySnapshot>& snapshots)
{
    for (const auto& snapshot : snapshots)
    {
        if (snapshot.WasAlive && Registry::IsAlive(snapshot.Entity))
        {
            if (!snapshot.HasName && ComponentManager::HasComponent<NameComponent>(snapshot.Entity))
            {
                World::UnregisterName(snapshot.Entity);
                ComponentManager::RemoveComponent(snapshot.Entity, ComponentTypeTraits<NameComponent>::value());
            }
            if (!snapshot.HasTransform && ComponentManager::HasComponent<TransformComponent>(snapshot.Entity))
            {
                ComponentManager::RemoveComponent(snapshot.Entity, ComponentTypeTraits<TransformComponent>::value());
            }
            if (!snapshot.HasShader && ComponentManager::HasComponent<ShaderComponent>(snapshot.Entity))
            {
                ComponentManager::RemoveComponent(snapshot.Entity, ComponentTypeTraits<ShaderComponent>::value());
            }
            if (!snapshot.HasStaticModel && ComponentManager::HasComponent<StaticModelComponent>(snapshot.Entity))
            {
                ComponentManager::RemoveComponent(snapshot.Entity, ComponentTypeTraits<StaticModelComponent>::value());
            }
            if (!snapshot.HasAnimationModel && ComponentManager::HasComponent<AnimationModelComponent>(snapshot.Entity))
            {
                ComponentManager::RemoveComponent(snapshot.Entity,
                                                  ComponentTypeTraits<AnimationModelComponent>::value());
            }
            if (!snapshot.HasLight && ComponentManager::HasComponent<LightComponent>(snapshot.Entity))
            {
                ComponentManager::RemoveComponent(snapshot.Entity, ComponentTypeTraits<LightComponent>::value());
            }
            if (!snapshot.HasSun && ComponentManager::HasComponent<SunComponent>(snapshot.Entity))
            {
                ComponentManager::RemoveComponent(snapshot.Entity, ComponentTypeTraits<SunComponent>::value());
            }
            if (!snapshot.HasProceduralTerrain &&
                ComponentManager::HasComponent<ProceduralTerrainComponent>(snapshot.Entity))
            {
                ComponentManager::RemoveComponent(snapshot.Entity,
                                                  ComponentTypeTraits<ProceduralTerrainComponent>::value());
            }
            if (!snapshot.HasProceduralMotion &&
                ComponentManager::HasComponent<ProceduralMotionComponent>(snapshot.Entity))
            {
                ComponentManager::RemoveComponent(snapshot.Entity,
                                                  ComponentTypeTraits<ProceduralMotionComponent>::value());
            }
            if (!snapshot.HasMaterial && ComponentManager::HasComponent<MaterialComponent>(snapshot.Entity))
            {
                ComponentManager::RemoveComponent(snapshot.Entity, ComponentTypeTraits<MaterialComponent>::value());
            }
            if (!snapshot.HasAabb && ComponentManager::HasComponent<AABBComponent>(snapshot.Entity))
            {
                ComponentManager::RemoveComponent(snapshot.Entity, ComponentTypeTraits<AABBComponent>::value());
            }
            if (!snapshot.HasSprite && ComponentManager::HasComponent<SpriteComponent>(snapshot.Entity))
            {
                ComponentManager::RemoveComponent(snapshot.Entity, ComponentTypeTraits<SpriteComponent>::value());
            }
            if (!snapshot.HasMesh && ComponentManager::HasComponent<MeshComponent>(snapshot.Entity))
            {
                ComponentManager::RemoveComponent(snapshot.Entity, ComponentTypeTraits<MeshComponent>::value());
            }
            if (!snapshot.HasCamera && ComponentManager::HasComponent<CameraComponent>(snapshot.Entity))
            {
                ComponentManager::RemoveComponent(snapshot.Entity, ComponentTypeTraits<CameraComponent>::value());
            }
            if (!snapshot.HasPostProcess && ComponentManager::HasComponent<PostProcessComponent>(snapshot.Entity))
            {
                ComponentManager::RemoveComponent(snapshot.Entity, ComponentTypeTraits<PostProcessComponent>::value());
            }
            if (!snapshot.HasInput && ComponentManager::HasComponent<InputComponent>(snapshot.Entity))
            {
                ComponentManager::RemoveComponent(snapshot.Entity, ComponentTypeTraits<InputComponent>::value());
            }
            if (!snapshot.HasMove && ComponentManager::HasComponent<MoveComponent>(snapshot.Entity))
            {
                ComponentManager::RemoveComponent(snapshot.Entity, ComponentTypeTraits<MoveComponent>::value());
            }
            if (!snapshot.HasPhysics && ComponentManager::HasComponent<PhysicsComponent>(snapshot.Entity))
            {
                ComponentManager::RemoveComponent(snapshot.Entity, ComponentTypeTraits<PhysicsComponent>::value());
            }
            if (!snapshot.HasTimeline && ComponentManager::HasComponent<TimelineComponent>(snapshot.Entity))
            {
                ComponentManager::RemoveComponent(snapshot.Entity, ComponentTypeTraits<TimelineComponent>::value());
            }
            if (!snapshot.HasObb && ComponentManager::HasComponent<OBBComponent>(snapshot.Entity))
            {
                ComponentManager::RemoveComponent(snapshot.Entity, ComponentTypeTraits<OBBComponent>::value());
            }
            if (!snapshot.HasLod && ComponentManager::HasComponent<LODComponent>(snapshot.Entity))
            {
                ComponentManager::RemoveComponent(snapshot.Entity, ComponentTypeTraits<LODComponent>::value());
            }
        }
        ApplySnapshot(snapshot);
    }
    // Restoring both parent and child must not apply the parent's delta a second time.
    for (EntityID entity : SceneHierarchy::Entities())
    {
        SceneHierarchy::ResetParentFrame(entity);
    }
    SceneHierarchy::Update();
    m_SelectedEntities.clear();
    for (const auto& snapshot : snapshots)
    {
        if (snapshot.WasAlive && Registry::IsAlive(snapshot.Entity))
        {
            m_SelectedEntities.push_back(snapshot.Entity);
        }
    }
    m_SelectedEntity = g_kINVALID_ENTITY;
    if (!m_SelectedEntities.empty())
    {
        m_SelectedEntity = m_SelectedEntities.front();
    }
    MaterialManager::NotifyAssignmentsChanged();
}

void ImGuiManager::Undo()
{
    FinalizeUndoCaptureIfIdle();
    if (m_UndoStack.empty())
    {
        return;
    }
    const auto snapshots = m_UndoStack.back();
    m_UndoStack.pop_back();
    vector<EntitySnapshot> inverse;
    for (const auto& snapshot : snapshots)
    {
        inverse.push_back(CaptureEntity(snapshot.Entity));
    }
    m_RedoStack.push_back(move(inverse));
    ++m_EditRevision;
    RestoreHistoryGroup(snapshots);
}

void ImGuiManager::Redo()
{
    FinalizeUndoCaptureIfIdle();
    if (m_RedoStack.empty())
    {
        return;
    }
    const auto snapshots = m_RedoStack.back();
    m_RedoStack.pop_back();
    vector<EntitySnapshot> inverse;
    for (const auto& snapshot : snapshots)
    {
        inverse.push_back(CaptureEntity(snapshot.Entity));
    }
    m_UndoStack.push_back(move(inverse));
    ++m_EditRevision;
    RestoreHistoryGroup(snapshots);
}

bool ImGuiManager::AppendTimelineAnimations(TimelineTrackData& track, const vector<filesystem::path>& paths)
{
    bool changed = false;
    for (const auto& path : paths)
    {
        string extension = path.extension().string();
        transform(extension.begin(), extension.end(), extension.begin(), [](unsigned char letter) {
            return static_cast<char>(tolower(letter));
        });
        if (extension != ".vmd")
        {
            AddLog("Timeline: 身体・表情の同時再生にはVMDファイルを指定してください。");
            continue;
        }
        const string relative = MakeRelativeAssetPath(path);
        if (find(track.AnimationPaths.begin(), track.AnimationPaths.end(), relative) == track.AnimationPaths.end())
        {
            track.AnimationPaths.push_back(relative);
            changed = true;
        }
    }
    if (changed)
    {
        track.LoadedAnimationModelId = -1;
        TimeLineSystem::PrepareTrackAnimations(track);
    }
    return changed;
}

bool ImGuiManager::AcceptTimelineAnimationFileDrop(const DroppedFile& file)
{
    if (!m_ShowInspectorWindow || !file.HasPoint)
    {
        return false;
    }
    for (const auto& target : m_TimelineAnimationDropTargets)
    {
        if (ImGui::GetFrameCount() - target.Frame > 2 || target.Entity != m_SelectedEntity ||
            file.Point.x < target.Min.x || file.Point.x >= target.Max.x || file.Point.y < target.Min.y ||
            file.Point.y >= target.Max.y || !ComponentManager::HasComponent<TimelineComponent>(target.Entity))
        {
            continue;
        }
        auto& timeline = ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<TimelineComponent>(target.Entity);
        if (target.TrackIndex >= timeline.Tracks.size())
        {
            return true;
        }
        const auto before = CaptureEntity(target.Entity);
        if (AppendTimelineAnimations(timeline.Tracks[target.TrackIndex], {filesystem::path(file.Path)}))
        {
            BeginUndoCapture(target.Entity, before);
            if (!ProjectManager::IsSimulationRunning())
            {
                TimeLineSystem::EvaluateComponent(timeline);
            }
        }
        return true;
    }
    return false;
}

bool ImGuiManager::DrawTimelineAnimations(EntityID entity, size_t trackIndex, TimelineTrackData& track)
{
    bool changed = false;
    ImGui::TextWrapped(
        "VMDを追加すると同時再生します。身体 → 表情の順に登録してください。空欄では対象モデルの再生設定を使います。");
    if (ImGui::Button("アニメーション (.vmd) をここにドロップ\nクリックしてファイルを選択", ImVec2(-1, 54)))
    {
        filesystem::path path;
        if (ProceduralIO::OpenFileDialog(L"VMD (*.vmd)\0*.vmd\0", path))
        {
            changed |= AppendTimelineAnimations(track, {path});
        }
    }
    if (ImGui::IsItemVisible())
    {
        const auto window = ImGui::GetWindowPos();
        const auto size = ImGui::GetWindowSize();
        const auto minimum = ImGui::GetItemRectMin();
        const auto maximum = ImGui::GetItemRectMax();
        m_TimelineAnimationDropTargets.push_back(
            {entity,
             trackIndex,
             {max(minimum.x, window.x), max(minimum.y, window.y)},
             {min(maximum.x, window.x + size.x), min(maximum.y, window.y + size.y)},
             ImGui::GetFrameCount()});
    }
    if (ImGui::BeginDragDropTarget())
    {
        if (const auto* payload = ImGui::AcceptDragDropPayload("ASSET_PATH"))
        {
            if (payload->Data && payload->DataSize > 0)
            {
                const string path(static_cast<const char*>(payload->Data),
                                  strnlen_s(static_cast<const char*>(payload->Data), payload->DataSize));
                changed |= AppendTimelineAnimations(track, {filesystem::u8path(path)});
            }
        }
        else if (ImGui::AcceptDragDropPayload("ASSET_MULTI"))
        {
            changed |= AppendTimelineAnimations(track, m_DraggedAssetPaths);
        }
        ImGui::EndDragDropTarget();
    }
    for (size_t index = 0; index < track.AnimationPaths.size();)
    {
        ImGui::PushID(static_cast<int>(index));
        ImGui::TextWrapped("%zu: %s", index + 1, track.AnimationPaths[index].c_str());
        const bool remove = ImGui::SmallButton("削除");
        ImGui::SameLine();
        if (ImGui::SmallButton("上へ") && index > 0)
        {
            swap(track.AnimationPaths[index - 1], track.AnimationPaths[index]);
            changed = true;
        }
        ImGui::PopID();
        if (remove)
        {
            track.AnimationPaths.erase(track.AnimationPaths.begin() + index);
            changed = true;
        }
        else
        {
            ++index;
        }
    }
    if (!track.AnimationError.empty())
    {
        ImGui::TextWrapped("%s", track.AnimationError.c_str());
        if (ImGui::SmallButton("読み込みを再試行"))
        {
            track.LoadedAnimationModelId = -1;
            TimeLineSystem::PrepareTrackAnimations(track);
            changed = true;
        }
    }
    return changed;
}

bool ImGuiManager::AppendLiveMonitorImages(LiveMonitorBinding& monitor, const vector<filesystem::path>& sources)
{
    vector<filesystem::path> images;
    for (const auto& source : sources)
    {
        error_code error;
        if (filesystem::is_directory(source, error))
        {
            vector<filesystem::path> sequence;
            for (filesystem::directory_iterator file(source, error), end; !error && file != end; file.increment(error))
            {
                if (IsTextureFile(file->path()) && file->is_regular_file(error))
                {
                    sequence.push_back(file->path());
                }
            }
            if (!error)
            {
                sort(sequence.begin(), sequence.end());
                images.insert(images.end(), sequence.begin(), sequence.end());
            }
        }
        else if (!error && IsTextureFile(source) && filesystem::is_regular_file(source, error))
        {
            images.push_back(source);
        }
    }
    for (const auto& image : images)
    {
        monitor.Frames.push_back(MakeRelativeAssetPath(image));
    }
    if (images.empty())
    {
        AddLog("LEDモニター: 読み込める画像がありません。PNG / JPG / JPEG / BMP / TGA / DDSを指定してください。");
    }
    return !images.empty();
}

bool ImGuiManager::AcceptLiveMonitorFileDrop(const DroppedFile& file)
{
    if (!m_ShowInspectorWindow || !file.HasPoint)
    {
        return false;
    }
    for (const auto& target : m_LiveMonitorDropTargets)
    {
        if (ImGui::GetFrameCount() - target.Frame > 2 || target.Entity != m_SelectedEntity ||
            file.Point.x < target.Min.x || file.Point.x >= target.Max.x ||
            file.Point.y < target.Min.y || file.Point.y >= target.Max.y ||
            !ComponentManager::HasComponent<TimelineComponent>(target.Entity))
        {
            continue;
        }
        auto& timeline = ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<TimelineComponent>(target.Entity);
        if (target.MonitorIndex >= timeline.Monitors.size())
        {
            return true;
        }
        const auto before = CaptureEntity(target.Entity);
        // OSドロップのパスはDragQueryFileA由来のため、Windowsのコードページで変換する。
        if (AppendLiveMonitorImages(timeline.Monitors[target.MonitorIndex], {filesystem::path(file.Path)}))
        {
            BeginUndoCapture(target.Entity, before);
            if (!ProjectManager::IsSimulationRunning())
            {
                TimeLineSystem::EvaluateComponent(timeline);
            }
            FinalizeUndoCaptureIfIdle(true);
        }
        return true;
    }
    return false;
}

bool ImGuiManager::DrawLiveMonitorFrames(EntityID entity, size_t monitorIndex, LiveMonitorBinding& monitor)
{
    struct FrameDrag
    {
        EntityID Entity;
        size_t Monitor, Frame;
    };
    constexpr const char* framePayloadType = "LIVE_MONITOR_FRAME";
    bool changed = false;
    ImGui::TextWrapped("画像を追加すると末尾に並びます。サムネイルをドラッグして表示順を変更できます。");
    if (ImGui::Button("画像をここにドロップ\nクリックして画像を選択", ImVec2(-1, 54)))
    {
        filesystem::path image;
        if (ProceduralIO::OpenFileDialog(
                L"画像 (*.png;*.jpg;*.jpeg;*.bmp;*.tga;*.dds;*.ktx2)\0*.png;*.jpg;*.jpeg;*.bmp;*.tga;*.dds;*.ktx2\0",
                image))
        {
            changed |= AppendLiveMonitorImages(monitor, {image});
        }
    }
    if (ImGui::IsItemVisible())
    {
        const auto window = ImGui::GetWindowPos();
        const auto size = ImGui::GetWindowSize();
        const auto min = ImGui::GetItemRectMin();
        const auto max = ImGui::GetItemRectMax();
        m_LiveMonitorDropTargets.push_back({entity, monitorIndex,
            {std::max(min.x, window.x), std::max(min.y, window.y)},
            {std::min(max.x, window.x + size.x), std::min(max.y, window.y + size.y)}, ImGui::GetFrameCount()});
    }
    if (ImGui::BeginDragDropTarget())
    {
        vector<filesystem::path> sources;
        if (const auto* payload = ImGui::AcceptDragDropPayload(AssetPayloadType))
        {
            if (payload->DataSize == sizeof(AssetDragPayload))
            {
                const auto& asset = *static_cast<const AssetDragPayload*>(payload->Data);
                if (asset.Type == AssetType::Texture)
                {
                    sources.push_back(MaterialManager::Registry().Resolve(asset.Handle));
                }
            }
        }
        else if (const auto* payload = ImGui::AcceptDragDropPayload("ASSET_PATH"))
        {
            sources.push_back(filesystem::u8path(static_cast<const char*>(payload->Data)));
        }
        else if (const auto* payload = ImGui::AcceptDragDropPayload("ASSET_DIR"))
        {
            sources.push_back(filesystem::path(static_cast<const wchar_t*>(payload->Data)));
        }
        else if (ImGui::AcceptDragDropPayload("ASSET_MULTI"))
        {
            sources = m_DraggedAssetPaths;
            sort(sources.begin(), sources.end());
        }
        if (!sources.empty())
        {
            changed |= AppendLiveMonitorImages(monitor, sources);
        }
        ImGui::EndDragDropTarget();
    }
    ImGui::Text("登録画像: %zu 枚", monitor.Frames.size());
    int remove = -1, moveFrom = -1, moveTo = -1;
    constexpr float cellWidth = 104.0f;
    constexpr float imageSize = 88.0f;
    const int columns = std::max(1, static_cast<int>(ImGui::GetContentRegionAvail().x / cellWidth));
    const float height = std::min(290.0f, 154.0f * static_cast<float>((monitor.Frames.size() + columns - 1) / columns));
    if (!monitor.Frames.empty() && ImGui::BeginChild("Frames", ImVec2(0, height), ImGuiChildFlags_Borders))
    {
        if (ImGui::BeginTable("FrameGrid", columns, ImGuiTableFlags_SizingFixedSame))
        {
            ImGuiListClipper clipper;
            clipper.Begin(static_cast<int>((monitor.Frames.size() + columns - 1) / columns), 150.0f);
            while (clipper.Step())
            {
                for (int row = clipper.DisplayStart; row < clipper.DisplayEnd; ++row)
                {
                    ImGui::TableNextRow(0, 150.0f);
                    for (int column = 0; column < columns; ++column)
                    {
                        const size_t index = static_cast<size_t>(row * columns + column);
                        if (index >= monitor.Frames.size())
                        {
                            break;
                        }
                        ImGui::TableSetColumnIndex(column);
                        ImGui::PushID(static_cast<int>(index));
                        const auto path = filesystem::u8path(monitor.Frames[index]);
                        const auto origin = ImGui::GetCursorScreenPos();
                        ImGui::InvisibleButton("Image", ImVec2(imageSize, imageSize));
                        static unordered_map<string, AssetHandle> handles;
                        auto [cached, inserted] = handles.try_emplace(monitor.Frames[index], 0);
                        if (inserted)
                        {
                            string error;
                            cached->second = MaterialManager::Registry().Register(path, AssetType::Texture, error);
                        }
                        const auto thumbnail = AssetThumbnailManager::Request(cached->second);
                        if (thumbnail.State == ThumbnailState::Ready && thumbnail.Image)
                        {
                            const float scale = imageSize / static_cast<float>(std::max(thumbnail.Image->Width, thumbnail.Image->Height));
                            const ImVec2 size(thumbnail.Image->Width * scale, thumbnail.Image->Height * scale);
                            const ImVec2 top(origin.x + (imageSize - size.x) * 0.5f, origin.y + (imageSize - size.y) * 0.5f);
                            ImGui::GetWindowDrawList()->AddImage(static_cast<ImTextureID>(thumbnail.GetImGuiTextureID().ptr),
                                top, ImVec2(top.x + size.x, top.y + size.y));
                        }
                        else
                        {
                            ImGui::GetWindowDrawList()->AddRect(origin, ImVec2(origin.x + imageSize, origin.y + imageSize),
                                ImGui::GetColorU32(ImGuiCol_Border));
                            ImGui::GetWindowDrawList()->AddText(ImVec2(origin.x + 4, origin.y + 34),
                                ImGui::GetColorU32(ImGuiCol_TextDisabled), thumbnail.State == ThumbnailState::Failed ? "読込失敗" : "準備中");
                        }
                        if (ImGui::IsItemHovered())
                        {
                            ImGui::SetTooltip("%s", monitor.Frames[index].c_str());
                        }
                        if (ImGui::BeginDragDropSource())
                        {
                            const FrameDrag drag{entity, monitorIndex, index};
                            ImGui::SetDragDropPayload(framePayloadType, &drag, sizeof(drag));
                            ImGui::Text("画像 %zu", index + 1);
                            ImGui::EndDragDropSource();
                        }
                        if (ImGui::BeginDragDropTarget())
                        {
                            if (const auto* payload = ImGui::AcceptDragDropPayload(framePayloadType))
                            {
                                if (payload->DataSize == sizeof(FrameDrag))
                                {
                                    const auto& drag = *static_cast<const FrameDrag*>(payload->Data);
                                    if (drag.Entity == entity && drag.Monitor == monitorIndex && drag.Frame < monitor.Frames.size())
                                    {
                                        moveFrom = static_cast<int>(drag.Frame);
                                        moveTo = static_cast<int>(index);
                                    }
                                }
                            }
                            ImGui::EndDragDropTarget();
                        }
                        const auto name = path.filename().u8string();
                        ImGui::Text("%zu", index + 1);
                        ImGui::TextUnformatted(string(name.begin(), name.end()).c_str());
                        if (ImGui::SmallButton("削除"))
                        {
                            remove = static_cast<int>(index);
                        }
                        ImGui::PopID();
                    }
                }
            }
            ImGui::EndTable();
        }
    }
    if (!monitor.Frames.empty())
    {
        ImGui::EndChild();
    }
    if (remove >= 0)
    {
        monitor.Frames.erase(monitor.Frames.begin() + remove);
        changed = true;
    }
    else if (moveFrom >= 0 && moveTo >= 0 && moveFrom != moveTo)
    {
        string frame = move(monitor.Frames[moveFrom]);
        monitor.Frames.erase(monitor.Frames.begin() + moveFrom);
        monitor.Frames.insert(monitor.Frames.begin() + moveTo, move(frame));
        changed = true;
    }
    return changed;
}

void ImGuiManager::DrawInspectorWindow()
{
    m_LiveMonitorDropTargets.clear();
    m_TimelineAnimationDropTargets.clear();
    SyncEntitySelection();
    ImGui::SetNextWindowSize(ImVec2(312.0f, 520.0f), ImGuiCond_FirstUseEver);
    if (!EditorWindowRegistry::BeginEditorWindow("インスペクター", &m_ShowInspectorWindow))
    {
        ImGui::End();
        return;
    }

    if (ImGui::Button("選択対象を変更"))
    {
        ImGui::OpenPopup("InspectorSelection");
    }
    if (ImGui::BeginPopup("InspectorSelection"))
    {
        if (ImGui::Button("すべて選択"))
        {
            FinalizeUndoCaptureIfIdle(true);
            m_SelectedEntities.clear();
            for (EntityID entity : World::GetView<TransformComponent>())
            {
                if (IsEditableEntity(entity))
                {
                    m_SelectedEntities.push_back(entity);
                    m_SelectedEntity = entity;
                }
            }
        }
        ImGui::SameLine();
        if (ImGui::Button("選択解除"))
        {
            SelectEntity(g_kINVALID_ENTITY);
        }
        ImGui::BeginChild("SelectionList", ImVec2(280.0f, 260.0f));
        for (EntityID entity : World::GetView<TransformComponent>())
        {
            if (!IsEditableEntity(entity))
            {
                continue;
            }
            ImGui::PushID(static_cast<int>(entity));
            bool selected = IsEntitySelected(entity);
            if (ImGui::Checkbox(GetEntityDisplayName(entity), &selected))
            {
                SelectEntity(entity, true);
            }
            ImGui::PopID();
        }
        ImGui::EndChild();
        ImGui::EndPopup();
    }
    if (m_SelectedEntity == g_kINVALID_ENTITY || !Registry::IsAlive(m_SelectedEntity))
    {
        ImGui::SeparatorText("オブジェクト未選択");
        ImGui::TextWrapped(
            "ヒエラルキーまたはシーンビューでオブジェクトを選択すると、ここでプロパティを編集できます。");
        ImGui::End();
        return;
    }

    if (m_SelectedEntities.size() > 1)
    {
        ImGui::Text("%zu 個のオブジェクトを選択中", m_SelectedEntities.size());
        ImGui::TextWrapped("位置・回転・スケールは、最後に選んだオブジェクトを基準にまとめて変更します。");
        if (ImGui::TreeNode("選択オブジェクト"))
        {
            for (EntityID entity : m_SelectedEntities)
            {
                ImGui::BulletText("%s (#%u)", GetEntityDisplayName(entity), entity);
            }
            ImGui::TreePop();
        }
    }
    if (m_RenamingEntity == m_SelectedEntity)
    {
        DrawRenameInput(m_SelectedEntity);
    }
    else
    {
        if (GetPrefabRoot(m_SelectedEntity) != g_kINVALID_ENTITY)
        {
            ImGui::PushStyleColor(ImGuiCol_Text, kPrefabColor);
        }
        ImGui::TextWrapped("%s", GetEntityDisplayName(m_SelectedEntity));
        if (GetPrefabRoot(m_SelectedEntity) != g_kINVALID_ENTITY)
        {
            ImGui::PopStyleColor();
        }
        ImGui::TextDisabled("Entity #%u", m_SelectedEntity);
    }
    ImGui::Separator();

    if (ImGui::BeginPopupContextWindow("InspectorEntityContext", ImGuiPopupFlags_MouseButtonRight))
    {
        if (ImGui::MenuItem("名前を変更", "F2", false,
                            m_SelectedEntities.size() == 1 &&
                                ComponentManager::HasComponent<NameComponent>(m_SelectedEntity)))
        {
            BeginRename(m_SelectedEntity);
        }
        if (ImGui::MenuItem("削除"))
        {
            DeleteSelectedEntity();
            ImGui::EndPopup();
            ImGui::End();
            return;
        }
        ImGui::EndPopup();
    }

    if (m_SelectedEntities.size() == 1 && DrawPrefabInspector())
    {
        ImGui::End();
        return;
    }
    DrawParentSelector();
    if (ImGui::Button("選択を削除（子も含む）"))
    {
        DeleteSelectedEntity();
        ImGui::End();
        return;
    }
    if (ImGui::IsWindowFocused(ImGuiFocusedFlags_RootAndChildWindows) && !ImGui::GetIO().WantTextInput &&
        !ImGui::IsAnyItemActive() && ImGui::IsKeyPressed(ImGuiKey_Delete, false))
    {
        DeleteSelectedEntity();
        ImGui::End();
        return;
    }
    if (ComponentManager::HasComponent<TransformComponent>(m_SelectedEntity) &&
        ImGui::CollapsingHeader("トランスフォーム", ImGuiTreeNodeFlags_DefaultOpen))
    {
        const auto before = ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<TransformComponent>(m_SelectedEntity);
        auto transform = before;
        ImGui::TextDisabled("ワールド座標 / 最後に選択したオブジェクトが基準");
        float rotationDeg[3] = {transform.Rotation.x * kRadToDeg, transform.Rotation.y * kRadToDeg,
                                transform.Rotation.z * kRadToDeg};
        bool changed = DrawAxisFloat3("位置", transform.Position, 0.01f);
        if (DrawAxisFloat3("回転", rotationDeg, 0.1f))
        {
            transform.Rotation = {rotationDeg[0] * kDegToRad, rotationDeg[1] * kDegToRad, rotationDeg[2] * kDegToRad};
            changed = true;
        }
        changed |= DrawScaleAxisFloat3("スケール", transform.Scale, 0.01f, 0.001f, 100.0f);
        if (changed)
        {
            ApplySelectionTransform(before, transform);
        }
    }
    if (m_SelectedEntities.size() > 1)
    {
        ImGui::End();
        return;
    }

    if (ComponentManager::HasComponent<AABBComponent>(m_SelectedEntity) &&
        ImGui::CollapsingHeader("AABB", ImGuiTreeNodeFlags_DefaultOpen))
    {
        auto& aabb = ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<AABBComponent>(m_SelectedEntity);
        EntitySnapshot before = CaptureEntity(m_SelectedEntity);
        bool changed = false;
        changed |= ImGui::Checkbox("デバッグ描画", &aabb.DrawDebug);
        changed |= ImGui::DragFloat3("AABB中心", &aabb.Center.x, 0.01f);
        changed |= ImGui::DragFloat3("AABBサイズ", &aabb.Extents.x, 0.01f, 0.001f, 100.0f);
        if (changed)
        {
            BeginUndoCapture(m_SelectedEntity, before);
        }
    }

    if (ComponentManager::HasComponent<LightComponent>(m_SelectedEntity))
    {
        DrawLightInspector(m_SelectedEntity);
    }
    DrawMaterialAssetSlots(m_SelectedEntity);
    DrawComponentInspector(m_SelectedEntity);

    ImGui::TextUnformatted("右クリック: カメラ / 左クリック: 選択");
    ImGui::End();
}

void ImGuiManager::DrawLegacyMaterialEditorWindow()
{
    ImGui::SetNextWindowSize(ImVec2(380.0f, 560.0f), ImGuiCond_FirstUseEver);
    if (!EditorWindowRegistry::BeginEditorWindow("マテリアルエディター", &m_ShowMaterialEditorWindow))
    {
        ImGui::End();
        return;
    }

    if (m_SelectedEntity == g_kINVALID_ENTITY || !Registry::IsAlive(m_SelectedEntity))
    {
        ImGui::TextUnformatted("マテリアルを持つオブジェクトを選択してください");
        ImGui::End();
        return;
    }

    ImGui::Text("選択中: %s", GetEntityDisplayName(m_SelectedEntity));
    ImGui::Separator();

    if (!ComponentManager::HasComponent<MaterialComponent>(m_SelectedEntity))
    {
        ImGui::TextUnformatted("選択中のオブジェクトにマテリアルがありません");
        ImGui::End();
        return;
    }

    DrawMaterialInspector(m_SelectedEntity);
    ImGui::End();
}

// テクスチャのパス入力（UTF-8）。エクスプローラーからパスを貼り付けて Enter で確定。
static bool DrawLiveToonPathInput(const char* label, string& path)
{
    // 入力中の文字列はフレームをまたいで保持し、編集中でないときだけパスから同期する。
    static std::unordered_map<ImGuiID, std::array<char, 512>> buffers;
    auto& buffer = buffers[ImGui::GetID(label)];
    bool changed = false;
    const bool committed =
        ImGui::InputText(label, buffer.data(), buffer.size(), ImGuiInputTextFlags_EnterReturnsTrue);
    if (!ImGui::IsItemActive() && !committed)
    {
        strncpy_s(buffer.data(), buffer.size(), path.c_str(), _TRUNCATE);
    }
    if (committed)
    {
        string value = buffer.data();
        // 「パスのコピー」で付く引用符を外す
        if (value.size() >= 2 && value.front() == '"' && value.back() == '"')
        {
            value = value.substr(1, value.size() - 2);
        }
        path = value;
        changed = true;
    }
    if (!path.empty())
    {
        ImGui::SameLine();
        ImGui::PushID(label);
        if (ImGui::SmallButton("×"))
        {
            path.clear();
            changed = true;
        }
        ImGui::PopID();
        if (LiveToonTextures::ResolveDescriptor(path) < 0)
        {
            ImGui::TextColored(ImVec4(1.0f, 0.45f, 0.35f, 1.0f), "読み込めません: %s", path.c_str());
        }
    }
    return changed;
}

// ライブ用トゥーンスタイル（シーン全体）。Forward / Deferred 共通で LightParams に入る。
static void DrawLiveToonStyleControls()
{
    auto& s = LiveToonStyle::Get();

    ImGui::SliderFloat("ライブスタイル適用", &s.Blend, 0.0f, 1.0f);
    ImGui::SeparatorText("メインライト（平行光源）");
    ImGui::ColorEdit3("影の乗算色", &s.ShadowTint.x, ImGuiColorEditFlags_Float);
    ImGui::SliderFloat("乗算色の効き", &s.ShadowTintStrength, 0.0f, 1.0f);
    ImGui::SliderFloat("肌の血色", &s.SkinWarmth, 0.0f, 1.0f);
    ImGui::SliderFloat("落ち影の濃さ", &s.CastShadowDensity, 0.0f, 1.0f);
    ImGui::SeparatorText("加算ライト（点 / スポット / 矩形）");
    ImGui::SliderFloat("回り込み", &s.AdditiveSoftness, 0.0f, 1.0f);
    ImGui::SliderFloat("加算ライト強度", &s.AdditiveGain, 0.0f, 3.0f);
    ImGui::SeparatorText("リム");
    ImGui::SliderFloat("ソフトリム", &s.RimSoft, 0.0f, 2.0f);
    ImGui::SliderFloat("ハードリム", &s.RimHard, 0.0f, 2.0f);
    ImGui::SliderFloat("リム幅", &s.RimWidth, 0.02f, 1.0f);
    ImGui::SliderFloat("リムのライト色", &s.RimLightTint, 0.0f, 1.0f);
    ImGui::SeparatorText("スペキュラ");
    ImGui::SliderFloat("ランプスペキュラ", &s.RampSpecular, 0.0f, 2.0f);
    ImGui::SliderFloat("天使の輪（髪）", &s.HairAngelRing, 0.0f, 2.0f);
    ImGui::SliderFloat("環境スペキュラ", &s.EnvSpecular, 0.0f, 2.0f);
    ImGui::SeparatorText("陰影ランプ（シーン全体）");
    ImGui::TextWrapped("横軸 = 影（左）→ 光（右）。上半分 = 肌、下半分 = 肌以外。パスを貼り付けて Enter。");
    DrawLiveToonPathInput("陰影ランプ画像", s.ShadowRampPath);
    ImGui::SliderFloat("陰影ランプの強さ", &s.ShadowRampStrength, 0.0f, 1.0f);
    if (ImGui::Button("ライブスタイルを標準値に戻す"))
    {
        LiveToonStyle::Reset();
    }
}

void ImGuiManager::DrawRimSettingsWindow()
{
    ImGui::SetNextWindowSize(ImVec2(420.0f, 560.0f), ImGuiCond_FirstUseEver);
    if (!EditorWindowRegistry::BeginEditorWindow("リム設定", &m_ShowRimSettingsWindow))
    {
        ImGui::End();
        return;
    }

    if (m_SelectedEntity == g_kINVALID_ENTITY || !Registry::IsAlive(m_SelectedEntity) ||
        !ComponentManager::HasComponent<MaterialComponent>(m_SelectedEntity))
    {
        ImGui::TextUnformatted("リムを設定するマテリアル付きオブジェクトを選択してください");
        ImGui::Separator();
        DrawLiveToonStyleControls();
        ImGui::End();
        return;
    }

    auto& material = ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<MaterialComponent>(m_SelectedEntity);
    EntitySnapshot before = CaptureEntity(m_SelectedEntity);
    bool changed = false;

    ImGui::Text("選択中: %s", GetEntityDisplayName(m_SelectedEntity));
    ImGui::Separator();

    if (ImGui::BeginTabBar("RimSettingsTabs"))
    {
        if (ImGui::BeginTabItem("全体"))
        {
            changed |= ImGui::SliderFloat("リム強度", &material.RimStrength, 0.0f, 3.0f);
            changed |= ImGui::SliderFloat("リムしきい値", &material.RimThreshold, 0.0f, 1.0f);
            changed |= ImGui::SliderFloat("リムぼかし", &material.RimSoftness, 0.001f, 0.50f, "%.3f");
            changed |= ImGui::SliderFloat("リムカーブ", &material.RimPower, 0.05f, 6.0f, "%.2f");
            changed |= ImGui::ColorEdit3("リム色", &material.RimColor.x, ImGuiColorEditFlags_Float);
            changed |= ImGui::SliderFloat("ベース色混合", &material.RimAlbedoBlend, 0.0f, 1.0f);
            changed |= ImGui::SliderFloat("ライト色混合", &material.RimLightBlend, 0.0f, 1.0f);
            if (ImGui::Button("リムを標準値に戻す"))
            {
                material.RimStrength = 0.45f;
                material.RimThreshold = 0.70f;
                material.RimSoftness = 0.055f;
                material.RimPower = 1.0f;
                material.RimColor = {0.38f, 0.48f, 0.80f};
                material.RimAlbedoBlend = 0.20f;
                material.RimLightBlend = 0.35f;
                changed = true;
            }
            ImGui::EndTabItem();
        }

        if (ImGui::BeginTabItem("部位別"))
        {
            const char* partNames[] = {"透明",
                                       "髪",
                                       "服",
                                       "肌",
                                       "トゥーン",
                                       "影",
                                       "メタリック",
                                       "セルフシャドウ",
                                       "ライティング",
                                       "目",
                                       "非ライティング",
                                       "PBR",
                                       "BRDF",
                                       "BTDF",
                                       "BSDF"};
            const int partValues[] = {
                static_cast<int>(ShaderClass::Transparent), static_cast<int>(ShaderClass::Hair),
                static_cast<int>(ShaderClass::Cloth),       static_cast<int>(ShaderClass::Skin),
                static_cast<int>(ShaderClass::Toon),        static_cast<int>(ShaderClass::Shadow),
                static_cast<int>(ShaderClass::Metallic),    static_cast<int>(ShaderClass::SelfShadow),
                static_cast<int>(ShaderClass::Lit),         static_cast<int>(ShaderClass::Eye),
                static_cast<int>(ShaderClass::Unlit),       static_cast<int>(ShaderClass::PBR),
                static_cast<int>(ShaderClass::BRDF),        static_cast<int>(ShaderClass::BTDF),
                static_cast<int>(ShaderClass::BSDF),
            };

            for (int i = 0; i < IM_ARRAYSIZE(partValues); ++i)
            {
                const int part = partValues[i];
                if (part < 0 || part >= kMaterialPartParamCount)
                {
                    continue;
                }

                ImGui::PushID(part);
                if (ImGui::TreeNode(partNames[i]))
                {
                    auto& params = material.PartParams[part];
                    changed |= ImGui::SliderFloat("リム強度", &params.RimStrength, 0.0f, 3.0f);
                    changed |= ImGui::SliderFloat("リムしきい値", &params.RimThreshold, 0.0f, 1.0f);
                    changed |= ImGui::SliderFloat("リムぼかし", &params.RimSoftness, 0.001f, 0.50f, "%.3f");
                    changed |= ImGui::SliderFloat("リムカーブ", &params.RimPower, 0.05f, 6.0f, "%.2f");
                    changed |= ImGui::ColorEdit3("リム色", &params.RimColor.x, ImGuiColorEditFlags_Float);
                    changed |= ImGui::SliderFloat("ベース色混合", &params.RimAlbedoBlend, 0.0f, 1.0f);
                    changed |= ImGui::SliderFloat("ライト色混合", &params.RimLightBlend, 0.0f, 1.0f);
                    ImGui::TreePop();
                }
                ImGui::PopID();
            }
            ImGui::EndTabItem();
        }
        if (ImGui::BeginTabItem("ライブトゥーン"))
        {
            DrawLiveToonStyleControls();
            ImGui::EndTabItem();
        }
        ImGui::EndTabBar();
    }

    if (changed)
    {
        BeginUndoCapture(m_SelectedEntity, before);
    }
    ImGui::End();
}

void ImGuiManager::DrawMaterialInspector(EntityID entity)
{
    if (ComponentManager::HasComponent<MaterialComponent>(entity) &&
        !ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<MaterialComponent>(entity).MaterialSlots.empty())
    {
        ImGui::TextWrapped("共有マテリアルはMaterials欄からアセットを開いて編集してください。");
        return;
    }

    if (!ComponentManager::HasComponent<MaterialComponent>(entity))
    {
        return;
    }

    if (!ImGui::CollapsingHeader("マテリアル", ImGuiTreeNodeFlags_DefaultOpen))
    {
        return;
    }

    auto& material = ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<MaterialComponent>(entity);
    EntitySnapshot before = CaptureEntity(entity);
    bool changed = false;

    const char* shaderModes[] = {"自動", "手動"};
    int shaderClassMode = static_cast<int>(material.ShaderClassMode);
    if (ImGui::Combo("シェーダークラスモード", &shaderClassMode, shaderModes, IM_ARRAYSIZE(shaderModes)))
    {
        material.ShaderClassMode = static_cast<MaterialMode>(shaderClassMode);
        changed = true;
    }
    const bool isManualMode = material.ShaderClassMode == MaterialMode::Manual;

    const char* shaderClasses[] = {"Transparent", "Hair", "Cloth", "Skin", "Toon", "Unlit", "Metallic",
                                   "Lit",         "Eye",  "PBR",   "BRDF", "BTDF", "BSDF"};
    const int shaderClassValues[] = {static_cast<int>(ShaderClass::Transparent), static_cast<int>(ShaderClass::Hair),
                                     static_cast<int>(ShaderClass::Cloth),       static_cast<int>(ShaderClass::Skin),
                                     static_cast<int>(ShaderClass::Toon),        static_cast<int>(ShaderClass::Unlit),
                                     static_cast<int>(ShaderClass::Metallic),    static_cast<int>(ShaderClass::Lit),
                                     static_cast<int>(ShaderClass::Eye),         static_cast<int>(ShaderClass::PBR),
                                     static_cast<int>(ShaderClass::BRDF),        static_cast<int>(ShaderClass::BTDF),
                                     static_cast<int>(ShaderClass::BSDF)};
    int shaderClassIndex = 5;
    for (int idx = 0; idx < IM_ARRAYSIZE(shaderClassValues); ++idx)
    {
        if (static_cast<int>(material.ShaderClass) == shaderClassValues[idx])
        {
            shaderClassIndex = idx;
            break;
        }
    }
    if (isManualMode)
    {
        if (ImGui::Combo("シェーダークラス", &shaderClassIndex, shaderClasses, IM_ARRAYSIZE(shaderClasses)))
        {
            const ShaderClass newShaderClass = static_cast<ShaderClass>(shaderClassValues[shaderClassIndex]);
            material.ShaderClass = newShaderClass;
            if (material.Alpha >= 0.999f)
            {
                if (newShaderClass == ShaderClass::BTDF)
                {
                    material.Alpha = 0.45f;
                }
                else if (newShaderClass == ShaderClass::BSDF)
                {
                    material.Alpha = 0.65f;
                }
                else if (newShaderClass == ShaderClass::Transparent)
                {
                    material.Alpha = 0.5f;
                }
            }
            changed = true;
        }
        changed |= ImGui::SliderFloat("Metallic", &material.Metallic, 0.0f, 1.0f);
        changed |= ImGui::SliderFloat("Roughness", &material.Roughness, 0.0f, 1.0f);
        changed |= ImGui::SliderFloat("Fresnel", &material.Fresnel, 0.0f, 1.0f);
    }
    changed |= ImGui::SliderFloat("Alpha", &material.Alpha, 0.0f, 1.0f);
    int shadowMode = static_cast<int>(material.ShadowMode);
    if (ImGui::Combo("Shadow Mode", &shadowMode, "None\0Opaque\0AlphaTest\0Transmittance\0Auto\0"))
    {
        material.ShadowMode = static_cast<MaterialShadowMode>(shadowMode);
        changed = true;
    }
    if (material.ShadowMode == MaterialShadowMode::AlphaTest)
    {
        changed |= ImGui::SliderFloat("Shadow Cutoff", &material.ShadowCutoff, 0.0f, 1.0f);
    }
    const bool opticsChanged =
        MaterialOpticsUI::Draw(material.IOR, material.Transmission, material.Roughness, material.TransmissionRoughness,
                               material.Thickness, &material.AbsorptionCoefficient.x);
    changed |= opticsChanged;
    if (opticsChanged)
    {
        const float ratio = (material.IOR - 1.0f) / (material.IOR + 1.0f);
        material.Fresnel = ratio * ratio;
    }
    if (opticsChanged && material.Transmission > 0.0f)
    {
        material.IsTransparent = true;
        material.AssetSurface = MaterialSurface::Transparent;
        material.AssetDepthWrite = false;
        material.ShaderClassMode = MaterialMode::Manual;
        material.ShaderClass = ShaderClass::PBR;
    }

    ImGui::SeparatorText("セクション");
    const char* outlineModes[] = {"押し出し", "TEO", "MIX"};
    int outlineMode = static_cast<int>(material.ToonOutlineRenderMode);
    if (ImGui::Combo("アウトラインモード", &outlineMode, outlineModes, IM_ARRAYSIZE(outlineModes)))
    {
        material.ToonOutlineRenderMode = static_cast<ToonOutlineMode>(outlineMode);
        changed = true;
    }
    const char* teoModes[] = {"バランス", "境界", "ハードエッジ", "クリーン"};
    int teoMode = static_cast<int>(material.ToonTeoRenderMode);
    if (ImGui::Combo("TEOモード", &teoMode, teoModes, IM_ARRAYSIZE(teoModes)))
    {
        material.ToonTeoRenderMode = static_cast<ToonTeoMode>(teoMode);
        changed = true;
    }
    const char* outlineWidthModes[] = {"ワールド単位", "スクリーンピクセル"};
    int outlineWidthMode = static_cast<int>(material.ToonOutlineWidthModeSetting);
    if (ImGui::Combo("幅モード", &outlineWidthMode, outlineWidthModes, IM_ARRAYSIZE(outlineWidthModes)))
    {
        material.ToonOutlineWidthModeSetting = static_cast<ToonOutlineWidthMode>(outlineWidthMode);
        changed = true;
    }
    changed |= ImGui::SliderFloat("アウトライン幅", &material.ToonOutlineWidth, 0.0f, 0.20f);
    changed |= ImGui::SliderFloat("スクリーン幅px", &material.ToonOutlineScreenWidth, 0.0f, 24.0f, "%.1f");
    changed |= ImGui::SliderFloat("TEO幅スケール", &material.ToonOutlineTeoWidthScale, 0.0f, 3.0f);

    if (IsModelMaterialEntity(entity))
    {
        ImGui::SeparatorText("メカクレ（前髪越しの目）");
        changed |= ImGui::Checkbox("メカクレ有効", &material.MekakureEnabled);
        ImGui::BeginDisabled(!material.MekakureEnabled);
        // 透け具合〜フェードはパーツ別のみ。古いシーンの共通設定は初回表示時に各パーツへ移す
        for (MekakurePartParams& part : material.MekakureParts)
        {
            if (!part.Initialized)
            {
                part.Opacity = material.MekakureOpacity;
                part.Depth = material.MekakureDepth;
                part.FadeStart = material.MekakureFadeStart;
                part.FadeEnd = material.MekakureFadeEnd;
                part.Initialized = true;
                changed = true;
            }
        }

        // ---- パーツ別 ----
        struct PartItem
        {
            const char* Label;
            uint32_t Bit; // 0 = 対象マスクのビットなし（追加対象名）
        };
        static_assert(MekakurePart_Count == 6, "PartItem と MekakurePart の並びを合わせる");
        const PartItem partItems[MekakurePart_Count] = {{"目", MeshSemantic_Eye},
                                                        {"目ハイライト", MeshSemantic_EyeHighlight},
                                                        {"眉", MeshSemantic_Brow},
                                                        {"まつ毛", MeshSemantic_Lash},
                                                        {"顔", MeshSemantic_Face},
                                                        {"追加対象名", 0u}};
        ImGui::SeparatorText("パーツ別");
        for (int i = 0; i < MekakurePart_Count; ++i)
        {
            const PartItem& item = partItems[i];
            MekakurePartParams& part = material.MekakureParts[i];
            ImGui::PushID(i);
            if (item.Bit != 0)
            {
                bool on = (static_cast<uint32_t>(material.MekakureTargetMask) & item.Bit) != 0;
                if (ImGui::Checkbox("##target", &on))
                {
                    uint32_t mask = static_cast<uint32_t>(material.MekakureTargetMask);
                    mask = on ? (mask | item.Bit) : (mask & ~item.Bit);
                    material.MekakureTargetMask = static_cast<int>(mask);
                    changed = true;
                }
                ImGui::SetItemTooltip("このパーツを透過の対象にする");
                ImGui::SameLine();
            }
            const bool open = ImGui::TreeNodeEx(item.Label, ImGuiTreeNodeFlags_SpanAvailWidth, "%s  透け %.2f",
                                                item.Label, part.Opacity);
            if (open)
            {
                changed |= ImGui::SliderFloat("透け具合", &part.Opacity, 0.0f, 1.0f);
                changed |= ImGui::SliderFloat("透過する奥行き", &part.Depth, 0.0f, 0.5f, "%.3f");
                ImGui::SetItemTooltip("目の手前この距離（ワールド単位）以内の遮蔽物だけ透けます。後頭部越しには透けません。");
                changed |= ImGui::SliderFloat("フェード開始 N・V", &part.FadeStart, 0.0f, 1.0f);
                changed |= ImGui::SliderFloat("フェード終了 N・V", &part.FadeEnd, -1.0f, 1.0f);
                changed |= ImGui::SliderFloat("マスクの効き", &part.MaskStrength, 0.0f, 1.0f);
                ImGui::SetItemTooltip("共通の「マスクの効き」に乗算（透過マスクが「なし」のときは無効）");
                changed |= ImGui::Checkbox("皮膚で隠す", &part.SkinOcclusion);
                ImGui::SetItemTooltip("目より手前にある瞼・頬などの皮膚越しには透かさない");
                ImGui::TreePop();
            }
            ImGui::PopID();
        }
        char includeBuffer[256]{};
        char excludeBuffer[256]{};
        strncpy_s(includeBuffer, material.MekakureIncludeNames.c_str(), _TRUNCATE);
        strncpy_s(excludeBuffer, material.MekakureExcludeNames.c_str(), _TRUNCATE);
        if (ImGui::InputText("追加対象名", includeBuffer, IM_ARRAYSIZE(includeBuffer)))
        {
            material.MekakureIncludeNames = includeBuffer;
            changed = true;
        }
        ImGui::SetItemTooltip("メッシュ名 / マテリアル名の部分一致。カンマ区切り（例: eye_L, 瞳）");
        if (ImGui::InputText("除外名", excludeBuffer, IM_ARRAYSIZE(excludeBuffer)))
        {
            material.MekakureExcludeNames = excludeBuffer;
            changed = true;
        }
        const char* maskSources[] = {"なし（奥行きだけで判定）", "髪テクスチャのアルファ", "専用マスク画像（R）"};
        changed |= ImGui::Combo("透過マスク", &material.MekakureMaskSource, maskSources, IM_ARRAYSIZE(maskSources));
        ImGui::SetItemTooltip("前髪のどこから・どれだけ目を透かすか。白 = 透かす、黒 = 透かさない（髪の UV 空間）。");
        if (material.MekakureMaskSource == 2)
        {
            changed |= DrawLiveToonPathInput("マスク画像", material.MekakureMaskPath);
        }
        if (material.MekakureMaskSource != 0)
        {
            changed |= ImGui::SliderFloat("マスクの効き", &material.MekakureMaskStrength, 0.0f, 1.0f);
