                statusText10 = "CPUメッシュ頂点がないためCollider SizeのBoxにフォールバックします。";
            }
            ImGui::TextWrapped(statusText10);
            if (physics.BodyType == PhysicsBodyType::Dynamic)
            {
                ImGui::TextColored(ImVec4(0.95f, 0.75f, 0.25f, 1.0f), "動的Meshは凸形状として扱われます。");
            }
        }
        changed |= ImGui::DragFloat3("Collider Center", &physics.ColliderCenter.x, 0.01f);
        changed |= ImGui::DragFloat3("Collider Size", &physics.ColliderSize.x, 0.01f, 0.001f, 10000.0f);
        if (physics.Shape == PhysicsShape::Sphere)
        {
            changed |= ImGui::DragFloat("Sphere Radius", &physics.SphereRadius, 0.01f, 0.001f, 10000.0f);
        }
        if (physics.Shape == PhysicsShape::Capsule)
        {
            changed |= ImGui::DragFloat("Capsule Radius", &physics.CapsuleRadius, 0.01f, 0.001f, 10000.0f);
            changed |= ImGui::DragFloat("Capsule Height", &physics.CapsuleHeight, 0.01f, 0.001f, 10000.0f);
        }
        changed |= ImGui::DragFloat3("初速", &physics.Velocity.x, 0.01f);
        changed |= ImGui::DragFloat3("初期角速度", &physics.AngularVelocity.x, 0.01f);
        changed |= ImGui::DragFloat("質量", &physics.Mass, 0.01f, 0.0001f, 100000.0f);
        changed |= ImGui::SliderFloat("摩擦", &physics.Friction, 0.0f, 2.0f);
        changed |= ImGui::SliderFloat("反発", &physics.Restitution, 0.0f, 1.0f);
        changed |= ImGui::SliderFloat("線形減衰", &physics.LinearDamping, 0.0f, 1.0f);
        changed |= ImGui::SliderFloat("角減衰", &physics.AngularDamping, 0.0f, 1.0f);
        changed |= ImGui::Checkbox("重力を使用", &physics.UseGravity);
        ImGui::BeginDisabled(!physics.UseGravity);
        changed |= ImGui::DragFloat("重力倍率", &physics.GravityFactor, 0.01f, -10.0f, 10.0f);
        ImGui::EndDisabled();
        changed |= ImGui::Checkbox("Continuous Collision Detection", &physics.EnableContinuousCollision);
        changed |= ImGui::Checkbox("Sleepを許可", &physics.AllowSleeping);

        if (hasAnimationModel)
        {
            ImGui::SeparatorText("PMXボーン");
            changed |= ImGui::DragFloat("PMX 質量倍率", &physics.PmxMassScale, 0.01f, 0.001f, 100.0f);
            changed |= ImGui::DragFloat("PMX 減衰倍率", &physics.PmxDampingScale, 0.01f, 0.0f, 100.0f);
            changed |= ImGui::DragFloat("PMX バネ倍率", &physics.PmxStiffnessScale, 0.01f, 0.0f, 100.0f);
            changed |= ImGui::DragFloat("PMX Collider倍率", &physics.PmxColliderScale, 0.01f, 0.001f, 100.0f);
        }

        int collisionLayer = physics.CollisionLayer;
        int collisionMask = physics.CollisionMask;
        ImGui::SeparatorText("Collision Filter");
        if (ImGui::InputInt("Collision Layer", &collisionLayer))
        {
            physics.CollisionLayer = static_cast<uint16_t>(clamp(collisionLayer, 0, 15));
            changed = true;
        }
        if (ImGui::InputInt("Collision Mask", &collisionMask))
        {
            physics.CollisionMask = static_cast<uint16_t>(clamp(collisionMask, 0, 65535));
            changed = true;
        }

        if (changed)
        {
            ++physics.SettingsRevision;
            BeginUndoCapture(entity, before);
        }
    }

    if (ComponentManager::HasComponent<LODComponent>(entity) &&
        ImGui::CollapsingHeader("LOD", ImGuiTreeNodeFlags_DefaultOpen))
    {
        const EntitySnapshot before = CaptureEntity(entity);
        auto& lod = ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<LODComponent>(entity);
        bool changed = ImGui::Checkbox("GPU LODを使用", &lod.UseLOD);
        changed |= ImGui::DragFloat("LOD1距離", &lod.Lod1Distance, 0.25f, 0.0f, 100000.0f, "%.2f");
        changed |= ImGui::DragFloat("LOD2距離", &lod.Lod2Distance, 0.25f, 0.0f, 100000.0f, "%.2f");
        lod.Lod1Distance = max(0.0f, lod.Lod1Distance);
        lod.Lod2Distance = max(lod.Lod1Distance, lod.Lod2Distance);
        if (ComponentManager::HasComponent<StaticModelComponent>(entity))
        {
            ImGui::SeparatorText("インポスター");
            changed |= ImGui::Checkbox("インポスターを使用", &lod.UseImpostor);
            ImGui::SameLine();
            ImGui::TextDisabled("(?)");
            if (ImGui::IsItemHovered())
            {
                ImGui::SetTooltip("切替距離より遠いとき、多視点で焼いた板1枚で描きます。\n"
                                  "影・レイトレーシングは実メッシュのままです。\n"
                                  "有効にすると GPU Driven ではなく CPU インスタンス描画経路になります。");
            }
            ImGui::BeginDisabled(!lod.UseImpostor);
            changed |= ImGui::DragFloat("切替距離", &lod.ImpostorDistance, 0.5f, 0.0f, 100000.0f, "%.1f m");
            lod.ImpostorDistance = max(0.0f, lod.ImpostorDistance);
            int framesIndex = lod.ImpostorFrames <= 4 ? 0 : (lod.ImpostorFrames <= 8 ? 1 : 2);
            if (ImGui::Combo("視点数", &framesIndex,
                             "4 x 4 (軽量)\0"
                             "8 x 8 (標準)\0"
                             "16 x 16 (高品質)\0"))
            {
                lod.ImpostorFrames = framesIndex == 0 ? 4u : (framesIndex == 1 ? 8u : 16u);
                changed = true;
            }
            int resolutionIndex = lod.ImpostorResolution <= 512 ? 0 : (lod.ImpostorResolution <= 1024 ? 1 : 2);
            if (ImGui::Combo("アトラス解像度", &resolutionIndex,
                             "512 (約 2.7 MB)\0"
                             "1024 (約 11 MB)\0"
                             "2048 (約 43 MB)\0"))
            {
                lod.ImpostorResolution = resolutionIndex == 0 ? 512u : (resolutionIndex == 1 ? 1024u : 2048u);
                changed = true;
            }
            changed |= ImGui::Checkbox("上半球のみ (地面に立つ物)", &lod.ImpostorHemisphere);
            const char* stateText = "未生成（切替距離を超えると生成）";
            switch (ImpostorRenderer::QueryState(entity))
            {
                case ImpostorRenderer::AtlasState::Pending:
                    stateText = "生成待ち";
                    break;
                case ImpostorRenderer::AtlasState::Ready:
                    stateText = "生成済み";
                    break;
                case ImpostorRenderer::AtlasState::Failed:
                    stateText = "生成失敗（メッシュで描画）";
                    break;
                default:
                    break;
            }
            ImGui::Text("状態: %s", stateText);
            if (ImGui::Button("再ベイク"))
            {
                if (StaticModelResource* impostorModel = ModelManager::GetStaticModel(
                        ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<StaticModelComponent>(entity).ModelId))
                {
                    ImpostorRenderer::InvalidateModel(impostorModel);
                }
            }
            ImGui::EndDisabled();

            auto& impostorSettings = ImpostorRenderer::GetSettings();
            if (ImGui::TreeNode("インポスター全体設定"))
            {
                ImGui::Checkbox("インポスター描画を有効化", &impostorSettings.Enabled);
                ImGui::SliderFloat("被覆率しきい値", &impostorSettings.AlphaCutoff, 0.05f, 0.95f, "%.2f");
                ImGui::SliderFloat("Mip バイアス", &impostorSettings.MipBias, -1.0f, 2.0f, "%.2f");
                const auto stats = ImpostorRenderer::GetStatistics();
                ImGui::Text("アトラス: %u 生成済み / %u 待ち / %u 失敗", stats.ReadyAtlases, stats.PendingAtlases,
                            stats.FailedAtlases);
                ImGui::Text("VRAM: %.1f MB", static_cast<double>(stats.AtlasBytes) / (1024.0 * 1024.0));
                ImGui::Text("描画: %u インスタンス / %u ドローコール", stats.DrawnInstances, stats.DrawCalls);
                if (ImGui::Button("全アトラスを再生成"))
                {
                    ImpostorRenderer::InvalidateAll();
                }
                ImGui::TreePop();
            }
        }
        changed |= ImGui::Checkbox("Use asset LOD metadata", &lod.UseAssetSettings);
        StaticModelResource* lodModel =
            ComponentManager::HasComponent<StaticModelComponent>(entity)
                ? ModelManager::GetStaticModel(
                      ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<StaticModelComponent>(entity).ModelId)
                : nullptr;
        if (lod.UseAssetSettings && lodModel)
        {
            lod.ScreenLOD = lodModel->GetLODMetadata();
        }
        bool screenChanged = false;
        int lodCount = int(lod.ScreenLOD.Count);
        if (ImGui::SliderInt("LOD Count", &lodCount, 1, 8))
        {
            lod.ScreenLOD.Count = uint32_t(lodCount);
            screenChanged = true;
        }
        screenChanged |= ImGui::SliderFloat("LOD Hysteresis", &lod.ScreenLOD.Hysteresis, 0, 0.5f);
        for (uint32_t level = 0; level < lod.ScreenLOD.Count; ++level)
        {
            ImGui::PushID(int(level));
            ImGui::Text("LOD%u", level);
            const float maximum = level == 0 ? 1.0f : lod.ScreenLOD.Thresholds[level - 1];
            if (lod.ScreenLOD.Thresholds[level] > maximum)
            {
                lod.ScreenLOD.Thresholds[level] = maximum;
                screenChanged = true;
            }
            screenChanged |=
                ImGui::SliderFloat("Screen Height Threshold", &lod.ScreenLOD.Thresholds[level], 0, maximum);
            if (level > 0)
            {
                char path[260]{};
                strncpy_s(path, lod.ScreenLOD.MeshPaths[level].c_str(), _TRUNCATE);
                if (ImGui::InputText("Mesh asset (Enter to apply)", path, sizeof(path),
                                     ImGuiInputTextFlags_EnterReturnsTrue))
                {
                    lod.ScreenLOD.MeshPaths[level] = path;
                    screenChanged = true;
                }
            }
            ImGui::PopID();
        }
        if (screenChanged)
        {
            lod.UseAssetSettings = false;
            changed = true;
        }
        if (lodModel)
        {
            auto notifyAssetUsers = [&]() {
                for (uint32_t id = 0; id < Registry::GetEntities().size(); ++id)
                {
                    if (Registry::IsAlive(id) && ComponentManager::HasComponent<StaticModelComponent>(id) &&
                        ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<StaticModelComponent>(id).ModelId ==
                            ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<StaticModelComponent>(entity).ModelId)
                    {
                        GpuSceneChanges::Notify(id);
                    }
                }
            };
            if (ImGui::Button("Save LOD asset metadata") && Visibility::ValidLOD(lod.ScreenLOD))
            {
                ofstream file(lodModel->GetSourcePath() + ".lod");
                if (Visibility::SaveLOD(file, lod.ScreenLOD))
                {
                    lodModel->SetLODMetadata(lod.ScreenLOD);
                    lod.UseAssetSettings = true;
                    changed = true;
                    notifyAssetUsers();
                }
                else
                {
                    Debug::Log("LOD metadata save failed\n");
                }
            }
            ImGui::SameLine();
            if (ImGui::Button("Reload LOD asset metadata"))
            {
                ifstream file(lodModel->GetSourcePath() + ".lod");
                if (Visibility::LoadLOD(file, lod.ScreenLOD))
                {
                    lodModel->SetLODMetadata(lod.ScreenLOD);
                    lod.UseAssetSettings = true;
                    changed = true;
                    notifyAssetUsers();
                }
            }
            ImGui::TextDisabled("Metadata: %s.lod", lodModel->GetSourcePath().c_str());
        }
        if (changed)
        {
            GpuSceneChanges::Notify(entity);
            BeginUndoCapture(entity, before);
        }
    }

    if (ComponentManager::HasComponent<SpriteComponent>(entity) && ImGui::CollapsingHeader("スプライト"))
    {
        auto& sprite = ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<SpriteComponent>(entity);
        ImGui::Checkbox("3D", &sprite.Is3D);
        ImGui::Checkbox("UV変換", &sprite.UseUvTransform);
        ImGui::DragFloat2("UVオフセット", &sprite.UvOffset.x, 0.001f);
        ImGui::DragFloat2("UVスケール", &sprite.UvScale.x, 0.001f);
        ImGui::Checkbox("ポストプロセス使用", &sprite.UsePostProcess);
    }
}





===== FILE: source\editor\editormaterialassets.cpp =====
#include "pch.h"
#include "editorworkspace.h"
#include "imguimanager.h"
#include "materialmanager.h"
#include "materialopticsui.h"
#include "materialpreview.h"
#include "materialgrapheditor.h"
#include "materialvalidation.h"
#include "graphicslog.h"
#include <imgui_internal.h>
#include "editorwidgets.h"
#include "world.h"
#include "camera.h"
#include <DirectXCollision.h>

namespace
{
    struct MaterialEdit
    {
        AssetHandle Handle = 0;
        MaterialAssetData Before;
    };

    AssetHandle openMaterial = 0;
    AssetHandle requestedMaterial = 0;
    bool closeRequested = false;
    bool promptRequested = false;
    bool editorFocused = false;
    bool showMaterialGraph = true;
    bool focusEditorRequested = false;
    bool pendingEdit = false;
    MaterialEdit editStart;
    unordered_map<AssetHandle, vector<MaterialAssetData>> materialUndo;
    unordered_map<AssetHandle, vector<MaterialAssetData>> materialRedo;
    EntityID dropEntity = g_kINVALID_ENTITY;
    AssetHandle dropMaterial = 0;

    const AssetDragPayload* ReadPayload(const ImGuiPayload* payload, AssetType expected)
    {
        if (!payload || payload->DataSize != sizeof(AssetDragPayload))
        {
            return nullptr;
        }
        const auto* asset = static_cast<const AssetDragPayload*>(payload->Data);
        if (asset->Type != expected || MaterialManager::Registry().TypeOf(asset->Handle) != expected)
        {
            return nullptr;
        }
        return asset;
    }

    string AssetName(AssetHandle handle, const char* empty)
    {
        if (handle == 0)
        {
            return empty;
        }
        const auto path = MaterialManager::Registry().Resolve(handle);
        if (path.empty())
        {
            return "Missing: " + FormatAssetHandle(handle);
        }
        return path.filename().generic_string();
    }

    bool DrawTextureSlot(const char* label, AssetHandle& handle, bool allowNoise = false)
    {
        ImGui::PushID(label);
        const auto name = AssetName(handle, "未設定");
        ImGui::Button(name.c_str(), ImVec2(-40, 0));
        if (allowNoise)
        {
            ImGui::SetItemTooltip("通常のテクスチャ、または .noise をドロップ。ノイズは描画時に計算します。");
        }
        const auto textureMinimum = ImGui::GetItemRectMin();
        const auto textureMaximum = ImGui::GetItemRectMax();
        MaterialValidation::CaptureDropTarget(label, textureMinimum.x, textureMinimum.y, textureMaximum.x,
                                              textureMaximum.y);
        if (MaterialValidation::Enabled() && strcmp(label, "Normal") == 0 && ImGui::GetDragDropPayload())
        {
            WriteGraphicsLog("Material UI trace: Normal rect=%.1f,%.1f..%.1f,%.1f hovered=%d mouse=%.1f,%.1f\n",
                             textureMinimum.x, textureMinimum.y, textureMaximum.x, textureMaximum.y,
                             ImGui::IsItemHovered(ImGuiHoveredFlags_AllowWhenBlockedByActiveItem),
                             ImGui::GetIO().MousePos.x, ImGui::GetIO().MousePos.y);
        }
        bool changed = false;
        if (ImGui::BeginDragDropTarget())
        {
            const auto* payload = ImGui::AcceptDragDropPayload(AssetPayloadType);
            const auto* asset = ReadPayload(payload, AssetType::Texture);
            if (!asset && allowNoise)
            {
                asset = ReadPayload(payload, AssetType::Noise);
            }
            if (MaterialValidation::Enabled())
            {
                WriteGraphicsLog("Material UI trace: Texture target accepted=%d\n", asset != nullptr);
            }
            if (asset)
            {
                handle = asset->Handle;
                changed = true;
            }
            ImGui::EndDragDropTarget();
        }
        ImGui::SameLine();
        if (ImGui::SmallButton("X"))
        {
            handle = 0;
            changed = true;
        }
        ImGui::PopID();
        return changed;
    }

    void FinishMaterialEdit()
    {
        if (pendingEdit)
        {
            if (MaterialManager::GetRuntime(editStart.Handle).Editing != editStart.Before)
            {
                materialUndo[editStart.Handle].push_back(editStart.Before);
                materialRedo[editStart.Handle].clear();
            }
            pendingEdit = false;
        }
    }
}

void ImGuiManager::OpenMaterialAsset(AssetHandle handle)
{
    if (handle == 0 || MaterialManager::Registry().TypeOf(handle) != AssetType::Material)
    {
        return;
    }
    // Opening an asset can happen before the first editor update (startup and validation).
    // Register areas before posting a request, otherwise workspace initialization drops it.
    InitializeWorkspaces();
    FinishMaterialEdit();
    if (openMaterial != 0 && openMaterial != handle && (MaterialManager::GetRuntime(openMaterial).Dirty ||
        MaterialGraphEditor::HasUnsavedChanges(openMaterial)))
    {
        requestedMaterial = handle;
        closeRequested = false;
        promptRequested = true;
        return;
    }
    openMaterial = handle;
    if (MaterialValidation::Enabled())
    {
        // The material asset UI validation exercises the Properties controls.
        showMaterialGraph = false;
    }
    EditorWorkspaceManager::Get().Registry().ShowEditorType("material");
    m_ShowMaterialEditorWindow = true;
    focusEditorRequested = true;
}

bool ImGuiManager::MaterialEditorHasFocus()
{
    return editorFocused && openMaterial != 0 &&
           EditorWorkspaceManager::Get().Registry().IsTypeVisible("material");
}

void ImGuiManager::BeginMaterialEditorFrame()
{
    editorFocused = false;
    MaterialGraphEditor::BeginFrame();
}

void ImGuiManager::MaterialEditorUndo(bool redo)
{
    if (MaterialGraphEditor::HasFocus())
    {
        MaterialGraphEditor::Undo(redo);
        return;
    }
    FinishMaterialEdit();
    if (openMaterial == 0)
    {
        return;
    }
    auto* source = &materialUndo[openMaterial];
    auto* destination = &materialRedo[openMaterial];
    if (redo)
    {
        swap(source, destination);
    }
    if (source->empty())
    {
        return;
    }
    const auto editing = source->back();
    auto& runtime = MaterialManager::GetRuntime(openMaterial);
    const auto current = runtime.Editing;
    if (MaterialManager::SetEditing(openMaterial, editing))
    {
        source->pop_back();
        destination->push_back(current);
    }
}

void ImGuiManager::DrawMaterialEditorWindow()
{
    if (openMaterial == 0)
    {
        DrawLegacyMaterialEditorWindow();
        return;
    }
    auto& runtime = MaterialManager::GetRuntime(openMaterial);
    const auto name = AssetName(openMaterial, "Default");
    string title = "Material: " + name;
    if (runtime.Dirty || MaterialGraphEditor::HasUnsavedChanges(openMaterial))
    {
        title += " *";
    }
    title += "###MaterialAssetEditor";
    bool visible = true;
    ImGui::SetNextWindowSize(ImVec2(840, 560), ImGuiCond_FirstUseEver);
    if (focusEditorRequested)
    {
        ImGui::SetNextWindowFocus();
    }
    const bool expanded = EditorWindowRegistry::BeginEditorWindow(title.c_str(), &visible);
    editorFocused |= ImGui::IsWindowFocused(ImGuiFocusedFlags_RootAndChildWindows);
    if (expanded && ImGui::IsWindowFocused(ImGuiFocusedFlags_RootAndChildWindows) && !ImGui::IsWindowAppearing())
    {
        // Initial docking resolves tab selection after the first submission.
        focusEditorRequested = false;
    }
    if (!visible)
    {
        FinishMaterialEdit();
        closeRequested = true;
        requestedMaterial = 0;
        promptRequested = true;
    }
    if (!expanded)
    {
        ImGui::End();
        return;
    }
    if (ImGui::Button("Save"))
    {
        FinishMaterialEdit();
        if (MaterialGraphEditor::Save(openMaterial))
        {
            MaterialManager::Save(openMaterial);
        }
    }
    ImGui::SameLine();
    if (ImGui::Button("Revert"))
    {
        FinishMaterialEdit();
        const auto before = runtime.Editing;
        MaterialGraphEditor::Revert(openMaterial);
        if (MaterialManager::Revert(openMaterial) && before != runtime.Editing)
        {
            materialUndo[openMaterial].push_back(before);
            materialRedo[openMaterial].clear();
        }
    }
    const auto revertMinimum = ImGui::GetItemRectMin();
    const auto revertMaximum = ImGui::GetItemRectMax();
    MaterialValidation::CaptureDropTarget("Revert", revertMinimum.x, revertMinimum.y, revertMaximum.x, revertMaximum.y);
    ImGui::SameLine();
    if (ImGui::Button("Close Material"))
    {
        FinishMaterialEdit();
        closeRequested = true;
        requestedMaterial = 0;
        promptRequested = true;
    }

    if (editorFocused && ImGui::GetIO().KeyCtrl && ImGui::IsKeyPressed(ImGuiKey_S, false))
    {
        FinishMaterialEdit();
        if (MaterialGraphEditor::Save(openMaterial))
        {
            MaterialManager::Save(openMaterial);
        }
    }
    ImGui::SameLine();
    if (ImGui::Selectable("Graph", showMaterialGraph, 0, ImVec2(64, ImGui::GetFrameHeight())))
    {
        showMaterialGraph = true;
    }
    ImGui::SameLine();
    if (ImGui::Selectable("Properties", !showMaterialGraph, 0, ImVec2(96, ImGui::GetFrameHeight())))
    {
        showMaterialGraph = false;
    }
    if (showMaterialGraph)
    {
        ImGui::Separator();
        // UE のマテリアルエディターと同じく、左にプレビュー、右にグラフ。境界はドラッグで幅を変更できる
        static float previewWidth = 300.0f;
        const float total = ImGui::GetContentRegionAvail().x;
        previewWidth = clamp(previewWidth, 160.0f, (std::max)(160.0f, total - 240.0f));
        ImGui::BeginChild("GraphPreviewPane", ImVec2(previewWidth, 0), ImGuiChildFlags_Borders);
        MaterialGraphEditor::DrawPreviewPanel(openMaterial);
        ImGui::EndChild();
        ImGui::SameLine(0.0f, 0.0f);
        ImGui::InvisibleButton("##GraphPreviewSplitter", ImVec2(6.0f, (std::max)(ImGui::GetContentRegionAvail().y, 1.0f)));
        if (ImGui::IsItemHovered() || ImGui::IsItemActive())
        {
            ImGui::SetMouseCursor(ImGuiMouseCursor_ResizeEW);
        }
        if (ImGui::IsItemActive())
        {
            previewWidth += ImGui::GetIO().MouseDelta.x;
        }
        ImGui::SameLine(0.0f, 0.0f);
        ImGui::BeginChild("GraphCanvasPane", ImVec2(0, 0));
        MaterialGraphEditor::Draw(openMaterial);
        ImGui::EndChild();
        ImGui::End();
        return;
    }
    ImGui::SameLine();
    MaterialPreview::DrawControls();
    ImGui::Separator();
    const float width = ImGui::GetContentRegionAvail().x;
    ImGui::BeginChild("MaterialPreview", ImVec2(width * 0.54f, -ImGui::GetTextLineHeightWithSpacing()), true);
    MaterialPreview::DrawImage(openMaterial);
    ImGui::EndChild();
    ImGui::SameLine();
    ImGui::BeginChild("Properties", ImVec2(0, -ImGui::GetTextLineHeightWithSpacing()));
    MaterialAssetData editing = runtime.Editing;
    bool changed = false;
    if (ImGui::CollapsingHeader("Surface", ImGuiTreeNodeFlags_DefaultOpen))
    {
        ImGui::TextUnformatted("Shader: PBR");
        int surface = static_cast<int>(editing.Surface);
        if (ImGui::Combo("Surface Type", &surface, "Opaque\0Masked\0Transparent\0"))
        {
            editing.Surface = static_cast<MaterialSurface>(surface);
            if (editing.Surface == MaterialSurface::Transparent)
            {
                editing.DepthWrite = false;
            }
            changed = true;
        }
    }
    if (ImGui::CollapsingHeader("Base Color", ImGuiTreeNodeFlags_DefaultOpen))
    {
        changed |= ImGui::ColorEdit3("Color", editing.BaseColor.data());
        float transparency = 1.0f - editing.BaseColor[3];
        if (ImGui::SliderFloat("Coverage Transparency", &transparency, 0, 1))
        {
            editing.BaseColor[3] = 1.0f - transparency;
            if (transparency > 0.0f)
            {
                editing.Surface = MaterialSurface::Transparent;
                editing.DepthWrite = false;
            }
            changed = true;
        }
        ImGui::SetItemTooltip(
            "Coverage transparency, not optical transmission. For glass use Transmission=1 and Transparency=0.");
        const auto transparencyMinimum = ImGui::GetItemRectMin();
        const auto transparencyMaximum = ImGui::GetItemRectMax();
        MaterialValidation::CaptureDropTarget("Transparency", transparencyMinimum.x, transparencyMinimum.y,
                                              transparencyMaximum.x, transparencyMaximum.y);
        changed |= DrawTextureSlot("Base Color", editing.Textures[0], true);
    }
    if (ImGui::CollapsingHeader("Metallic / Roughness", ImGuiTreeNodeFlags_DefaultOpen))
    {
        changed |= ImGui::SliderFloat("Metallic", &editing.Metallic, 0, 1);
        changed |= ImGui::SliderFloat("Roughness", &editing.Roughness, 0, 1);
        ImGui::TextDisabled("Texture: R = Metallic / G = Roughness");
        changed |= DrawTextureSlot("Metallic Roughness", editing.Textures[2]);
    }
    if (ImGui::CollapsingHeader("Normal", ImGuiTreeNodeFlags_DefaultOpen))
    {
        changed |= DrawTextureSlot("Normal", editing.Textures[1], true);
        changed |= ImGui::SliderFloat("Strength", &editing.NormalScale, 0, 8);
    }
    if (ImGui::CollapsingHeader("Parallax Occlusion Mapping"))
    {
        changed |= DrawTextureSlot("Height (POM)", editing.Textures[5], true);
        changed |= ImGui::SliderFloat("Parallax Depth", &editing.ParallaxDepth, 0.0f, 0.2f, "%.3f");
        changed |= ImGui::SliderFloat("Parallax Steps", &editing.ParallaxSteps, 8, 1024, "%.0f",
                                      ImGuiSliderFlags_Logarithmic | ImGuiSliderFlags_AlwaysClamp);
        ImGui::TextDisabled("Height: white = top, black = recessed. Depth 0 disables POM.");
        ImGui::TextDisabled("Supported on opaque PBR materials.");
        if (editing.Textures[5] != 0)
        {
            if (editing.Surface != MaterialSurface::Opaque || editing.Transmission > 0.0f)
            {
                ImGui::TextColored(ImVec4(1.0f, 0.7f, 0.3f, 1.0f), "Surface が Opaque 以外のため POM は無効です。");
            }
            else if (editing.ParallaxDepth <= 0.0f)
            {
                ImGui::TextColored(ImVec4(1.0f, 0.7f, 0.3f, 1.0f), "Parallax Depth が 0 のため POM は無効です。");
            }
            else if (editing.Textures[1] == 0)
            {
                ImGui::TextDisabled("Normal 未設定: 高さマップから法線を自動生成します。");
            }
        }
    }
    if (ImGui::CollapsingHeader("Ambient Occlusion"))
    {
        changed |= DrawTextureSlot("AO", editing.Textures[3]);
        changed |= ImGui::SliderFloat("AO Strength", &editing.AOStrength, 0, 1);
    }
    if (ImGui::CollapsingHeader("Emission"))
    {
        changed |= ImGui::ColorEdit3("Emission Color", editing.EmissiveColor.data(),
                                     ImGuiColorEditFlags_HDR | ImGuiColorEditFlags_Float);
        changed |= ImGui::SliderFloat("Intensity", &editing.EmissiveIntensity, 0, 30);
        changed |= DrawTextureSlot("Emission", editing.Textures[4]);
    }
    if (ImGui::CollapsingHeader("Shading Model", ImGuiTreeNodeFlags_DefaultOpen))
    {
        int model = static_cast<int>(editing.ShadingModel);
        if (ImGui::Combo("Model", &model, "Standard\0Clear Coat\0Sheen (Cloth)\0Skin\0Hair\0Anisotropic\0"))
        {
            editing.ShadingModel = static_cast<uint32_t>(model);
            changed = true;
        }
        ImGui::BeginDisabled(editing.ShadingModel == 0);
        changed |= ImGui::SliderFloat("Model Strength", &editing.ShadingStrength, 0, 1);
        ImGui::EndDisabled();
        ImGui::TextDisabled(
            "ClearCoat=塗装の層 / Sheen=布の光沢 / Skin=肌の散乱 / Hair=髪のハイライト / Anisotropic=ヘアライン金属");
    }
    if (ImGui::CollapsingHeader("Advanced"))
    {
        int cull = static_cast<int>(editing.Cull);
        if (ImGui::Combo("Cull Mode", &cull, "Back\0None\0Front\0"))
        {
            editing.Cull = static_cast<MaterialCull>(cull);
            changed = true;
        }
        changed |= ImGui::Checkbox("Depth Write", &editing.DepthWrite);
        changed |= ImGui::SliderFloat("Alpha Cutoff", &editing.AlphaCutoff, 0, 1);
        int shadowMode = static_cast<int>(editing.ShadowMode);
        if (ImGui::Combo("Shadow Mode", &shadowMode, "None\0Opaque\0AlphaTest\0Transmittance\0Auto\0"))
        {
            editing.ShadowMode = static_cast<MaterialShadowMode>(shadowMode);
            changed = true;
        }
        if (editing.ShadowMode == MaterialShadowMode::AlphaTest)
        {
            changed |= ImGui::SliderFloat("Shadow Cutoff", &editing.ShadowCutoff, 0, 1);
        }
        ImGui::Text("Handle: %s", FormatAssetHandle(openMaterial).c_str());
        ImGui::Text("Runtime revision: %llu", runtime.Revision);
    }
    const bool opticsChanged =
        MaterialOpticsUI::Draw(editing.IOR, editing.Transmission, editing.Roughness, editing.TransmissionRoughness,
                               editing.Thickness, editing.AbsorptionCoefficient.data());
    changed |= opticsChanged;
    if (editing.Transmission > 0.0f)
    {
        // 描画経路だけを変更し、設定済みの色・粗さ・IOR は上書きしない。
        if (editing.Surface != MaterialSurface::Transparent || editing.DepthWrite)
        {
            editing.Surface = MaterialSurface::Transparent;
            editing.DepthWrite = false;
            changed = true;
        }
        ImGui::TextDisabled("Optical transmission: Transparent path, depth write disabled.");
    }
    if (changed)
    {
        if (!pendingEdit)
        {
            editStart = {openMaterial, runtime.Editing};
            pendingEdit = true;
        }
        MaterialManager::SetEditing(openMaterial, editing);
    }
    if (!ImGui::IsAnyItemActive())
    {
        FinishMaterialEdit();
    }
    ImGui::EndChild();
    if (!runtime.SourceError.empty())
    {
        ImGui::TextColored(ImVec4(1, 0.35f, 0.25f, 1), "%s", runtime.SourceError.c_str());
    }
    if (!runtime.Error.empty())
    {
        ImGui::TextColored(ImVec4(1, 0.35f, 0.25f, 1), "%s", runtime.Error.c_str());
    }
    else
    {
        ImGui::TextDisabled("%s", MaterialManager::Registry().Resolve(openMaterial).generic_string().c_str());
    }
    ImGui::End();
}

void ImGuiManager::DrawMaterialAssetClosePrompt()
{
    if (promptRequested)
    {
        promptRequested = false;
        if (openMaterial != 0 && (MaterialManager::GetRuntime(openMaterial).Dirty ||
            MaterialGraphEditor::HasUnsavedChanges(openMaterial)))
        {
            ImGui::OpenPopup("Material has unsaved changes");
        }
        else
        {
            openMaterial = requestedMaterial;
            if (openMaterial != 0)
            {
                EditorWorkspaceManager::Get().Registry().ShowEditorType("material");
            }
        }
    }
    if (ImGui::BeginPopupModal("Material has unsaved changes", nullptr, ImGuiWindowFlags_AlwaysAutoResize))
    {
        ImGui::TextUnformatted("Material has unsaved changes.");
        if (!MaterialManager::GetRuntime(openMaterial).Error.empty())
        {
            ImGui::TextWrapped("%s", MaterialManager::GetRuntime(openMaterial).Error.c_str());
        }
        const char* graphError = MaterialGraphEditor::LastError(openMaterial);
        if (graphError[0] != '\0')
        {
            ImGui::TextWrapped("%s", graphError);
        }
        bool finish = false;
        if (ImGui::Button("Save"))
        {
            finish = MaterialGraphEditor::Save(openMaterial) && MaterialManager::Save(openMaterial);
        }
        ImGui::SameLine();
        if (ImGui::Button("Discard"))
        {
            MaterialManager::Discard(openMaterial);
            MaterialGraphEditor::Revert(openMaterial);
            finish = true;
        }
        ImGui::SameLine();
        if (ImGui::Button("Cancel"))
        {
            closeRequested = false;
            requestedMaterial = 0;
            ImGui::CloseCurrentPopup();
        }
        if (finish)
        {
            openMaterial = requestedMaterial;
            if (openMaterial != 0)
            {
                EditorWorkspaceManager::Get().Registry().ShowEditorType("material");
            }
            focusEditorRequested = !closeRequested;
            ImGui::CloseCurrentPopup();
        }
        ImGui::EndPopup();
    }
}

void ImGuiManager::AssignMaterialAsset(EntityID entity, size_t slot, AssetHandle handle)
{
    const auto before = CaptureEntity(entity);
    if (MaterialManager::Assign(entity, slot, handle))
    {
        PushUndoSnapshot(before);
        AddLog("Material assigned: %s / Slot %zu", AssetName(handle, "Legacy").c_str(), slot);
    }
}

void ImGuiManager::DrawMaterialAssetSlots(EntityID entity)
{
    if (!MaterialManager::IsRenderable(entity) || !ImGui::CollapsingHeader("Materials", ImGuiTreeNodeFlags_DefaultOpen))
    {
        return;
    }
    const auto& component = ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<MaterialComponent>(entity);
    const size_t slotCount = MaterialManager::SlotCount(entity);
    for (size_t slot = 0; slot < slotCount; ++slot)
    {
        ImGui::PushID(static_cast<int>(slot));
        const auto handle = MaterialManager::SlotHandle(component, slot);
        ImGui::Text("Element %zu", slot);
        if (ImGui::Button(AssetName(handle, "Legacy / Imported").c_str(), ImVec2(-40, 0)) && handle != 0)
        {
            OpenMaterialAsset(handle);
        }
        const auto slotMinimum = ImGui::GetItemRectMin();
        const auto slotMaximum = ImGui::GetItemRectMax();
        MaterialValidation::CaptureDropTarget("Inspector", slotMinimum.x, slotMinimum.y, slotMaximum.x, slotMaximum.y);
        if (ImGui::BeginDragDropTarget())
        {
            const auto* asset = ReadPayload(ImGui::AcceptDragDropPayload(AssetPayloadType), AssetType::Material);
            if (asset)
            {
                AssignMaterialAsset(entity, slot, asset->Handle);
            }
            ImGui::EndDragDropTarget();
        }
        ImGui::SameLine();
        if (ImGui::SmallButton("X"))
        {
            AssignMaterialAsset(entity, slot, 0);
        }
        ImGui::PopID();
    }
}

void ImGuiManager::DrawMaterialDropTarget()
{
    if (MaterialValidation::Enabled() && ImGui::GetDragDropPayload())
    {
        WriteGraphicsLog("Material UI trace: Scene hovered=%d mouse=%.1f,%.1f\n",
                         ImGui::IsItemHovered(ImGuiHoveredFlags_AllowWhenBlockedByActiveItem),
                         ImGui::GetIO().MousePos.x, ImGui::GetIO().MousePos.y);
        const auto& context = *ImGui::GetCurrentContext();
        WriteGraphicsLog("Material UI trace: hoveredWindow=%s sceneRect=%.1f,%.1f..%.1f,%.1f\n",
                         context.HoveredWindow ? context.HoveredWindow->Name : "none", context.LastItemData.Rect.Min.x,
                         context.LastItemData.Rect.Min.y, context.LastItemData.Rect.Max.x,
                         context.LastItemData.Rect.Max.y);
    }
    if (ImGui::BeginDragDropTarget())
    {
        const auto* payload = ImGui::AcceptDragDropPayload(AssetPayloadType, ImGuiDragDropFlags_AcceptBeforeDelivery);
        const auto* asset = ReadPayload(payload, AssetType::Material);
        const auto* texture = ReadPayload(payload, AssetType::Texture);
        if (texture && payload->IsDelivery())
        {
            ImVec2 mouse = ImGui::GetIO().MousePos;
            mouse.x -= m_SceneViewPos.x;
            mouse.y -= m_SceneViewPos.y;
            PlaceAssetInScene(MaterialManager::Registry().Resolve(texture->Handle), mouse);
        }

        if (asset)
        {
            ImVec2 mouse = ImGui::GetIO().MousePos;
            mouse.x -= m_SceneViewPos.x;
            mouse.y -= m_SceneViewPos.y;
            XMVECTOR origin;
            XMVECTOR direction;
            EntityID target = g_kINVALID_ENTITY;
            float nearest = FLT_MAX;
            if (GetSceneViewRay(mouse, origin, direction))
            {
                for (EntityID entity : World::GetView<TransformComponent>())
                {
                    XMFLOAT3 center;
                    XMFLOAT3 extents;
                    if (!EditorWidgets::GetLocalAabb(entity, center, extents))
                    {
                        continue;
                    }
                    BoundingOrientedBox local(center, extents, XMFLOAT4(0, 0, 0, 1));
                    BoundingOrientedBox world;
                    local.Transform(world, EditorWidgets::BuildWorldMatrix(
                                               ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<TransformComponent>(entity)));
                    float distance;
                    if (world.Intersects(origin, direction, distance) && distance < nearest)
                    {
                        target = entity;
                        nearest = distance;
                    }
                }
            }
            if (MaterialValidation::Enabled())
            {
                WriteGraphicsLog("Material UI trace: picked=%u renderable=%d delivery=%d\n", target,
                                 MaterialManager::IsRenderable(target), payload->IsDelivery());
            }
            if (MaterialManager::IsRenderable(target))
            {
                ImGui::SetTooltip("%s: Materialを適用", GetEntityDisplayName(target));
                // 対象の実際の境界を投影し、ホバー中のエンティティにハイライトを追従させる。
                XMFLOAT3 center;
                XMFLOAT3 extents;
                if (EditorWidgets::GetLocalAabb(target, center, extents))
                {
                    XMMATRIX view;
                    XMMATRIX projection;
                    Camera::GetCameraMatrices(Camera::GetCameraEntity(), view, projection);
                    const auto world = EditorWidgets::BuildWorldMatrix(
                        ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<TransformComponent>(target));
                    ImVec2 minimum(FLT_MAX, FLT_MAX);
                    ImVec2 maximum(-FLT_MAX, -FLT_MAX);
                    for (int corner = 0; corner < 8; ++corner)
                    {
                        const float x = center.x + ((corner & 1) ? extents.x : -extents.x);
                        const float y = center.y + ((corner & 2) ? extents.y : -extents.y);
                        const float z = center.z + ((corner & 4) ? extents.z : -extents.z);
                        XMFLOAT3 screen;
                        XMStoreFloat3(&screen, XMVector3Project(XMVectorSet(x, y, z, 1), m_SceneViewPos.x,
                                                                m_SceneViewPos.y, m_SceneViewSize.x, m_SceneViewSize.y,
                                                                0, 1, projection, view, world));
                        minimum.x = min(minimum.x, screen.x);
                        minimum.y = min(minimum.y, screen.y);
                        maximum.x = max(maximum.x, screen.x);
                        maximum.y = max(maximum.y, screen.y);
                    }
                    ImGui::GetWindowDrawList()->AddRect(minimum, maximum, IM_COL32(70, 210, 255, 255), 3, 0, 2);
                }
                if (payload->IsDelivery())
                {
                    if (MaterialManager::SlotCount(target) == 1)
                    {
                        AssignMaterialAsset(target, 0, asset->Handle);
                    }
                    else
                    {
                        dropEntity = target;
                        dropMaterial = asset->Handle;
                        ImGui::OpenPopup("Material Slotを選択");
                    }
                }
            }
            else
            {
                ImGui::SetTooltip("Material cannot be assigned to this entity.");
                if (payload->IsDelivery())
                {
                    AddLog("Material cannot be assigned to this entity.");
                }
            }
        }
        ImGui::EndDragDropTarget();
    }
    if (ImGui::BeginPopup("Material Slotを選択"))
    {
        const size_t slotCount = MaterialManager::SlotCount(dropEntity);
        for (size_t slot = 0; slot < slotCount; ++slot)
        {
            if (ImGui::Selectable(("Element " + to_string(slot)).c_str()))
            {
                AssignMaterialAsset(dropEntity, slot, dropMaterial);
            }
        }
        ImGui::EndPopup();
    }
}

===== FILE: source\editor\editorpreferences.cpp =====
#include "pch.h"
#include "editorpreferences.h"
#include <imgui_internal.h>
#include <filesystem>
#include <fstream>
#include <sstream>
#include <algorithm>
#include <cmath>

namespace EditorPreferences
{
    namespace
    {
        constexpr const char* kPreferencesPath = "Save/editor_preferences.cfg";

        Settings g_Settings;
        bool g_StyleDirty = true;
        std::string g_LastSaved;

        struct Palette
        {
            ImVec4 Menu;        // メニューバー / タイトル / 非選択タブ
            ImVec4 Window;      // パネル背景
            ImVec4 Child;       // 子領域
            ImVec4 Popup;       // ポップアップ
            ImVec4 Frame;       // 入力欄
            ImVec4 FrameHover;  // 入力欄（ホバー）
            ImVec4 Button;      // ボタン
            ImVec4 ButtonHover; // ボタン（ホバー）
            ImVec4 RowHover;    // 行のホバー
            ImVec4 Border;
            ImVec4 Text;
            ImVec4 TextDim;
            ImVec4 Accent;
            ImVec4 DockEmpty;
            float Rounding = 3.0f;
        };

        ImVec4 Rgb(int r, int g, int b, float a = 1.0f)
        {
            return ImVec4(r / 255.0f, g / 255.0f, b / 255.0f, a);
        }

        ImVec4 Lerp(const ImVec4& a, const ImVec4& b, float t)
        {
            return ImVec4(a.x + (b.x - a.x) * t, a.y + (b.y - a.y) * t, a.z + (b.z - a.z) * t, a.w + (b.w - a.w) * t);
        }

        ImVec4 WithAlpha(ImVec4 color, float alpha)
        {
            color.w = alpha;
            return color;
        }

        Palette MakePalette(ThemePreset preset)
        {
            Palette p;
            switch (preset)
            {
                case ThemePreset::Blender:
                    p.Menu = Rgb(35, 35, 35);
                    p.Window = Rgb(48, 48, 48);
                    p.Child = Rgb(42, 42, 42);
                    p.Popup = Rgb(24, 24, 24, 0.98f);
                    p.Frame = Rgb(72, 72, 72);
                    p.FrameHover = Rgb(88, 88, 88);
                    p.Button = Rgb(84, 84, 84);
                    p.ButtonHover = Rgb(101, 101, 101);
                    p.RowHover = Rgb(64, 64, 64);
                    p.Border = Rgb(26, 26, 26);
                    p.Text = Rgb(230, 230, 230);
                    p.TextDim = Rgb(140, 140, 140);
                    p.Accent = Rgb(71, 114, 179);
                    p.DockEmpty = Rgb(29, 29, 29);
                    p.Rounding = 4.0f;
                    break;
                case ThemePreset::Unity:
                    p.Menu = Rgb(25, 25, 25);
                    p.Window = Rgb(56, 56, 56);
                    p.Child = Rgb(56, 56, 56);
                    p.Popup = Rgb(51, 51, 51, 0.98f);

        Palette g_Palette = MakePalette(ThemePreset::Unreal);

        const char* FontPath(FontChoice font, int& faceIndex)
        {
            faceIndex = 0;
            switch (font)
            {
                case FontChoice::YuGothic:
                    return "C:\\Windows\\Fonts\\YuGothM.ttc";
                case FontChoice::Meiryo:
                    return "C:\\Windows\\Fonts\\meiryo.ttc";
                case FontChoice::MsGothic:
                    return "C:\\Windows\\Fonts\\msgothic.ttc";
                default:
                    return nullptr;
            }
        }

        std::string Serialize()
        {
            const auto& s = g_Settings;
            std::ostringstream out;
            out << "theme=" << static_cast<int>(s.Theme) << "\n";
            out << "custom_accent=" << (s.CustomAccent ? 1 : 0) << "\n";
            out << "accent=" << s.Accent.x << "," << s.Accent.y << "," << s.Accent.z << "\n";
            out << "ui_scale=" << s.UiScale << "\n";
            out << "rounding=" << s.Rounding << "\n";
            out << "compact=" << (s.Compact ? 1 : 0) << "\n";
            out << "font=" << static_cast<int>(s.Font) << "\n";
            out << "font_size=" << s.FontSize << "\n";
            out << "toolbar=" << (s.ShowToolbar ? 1 : 0) << "\n";
            out << "statusbar=" << (s.ShowStatusBar ? 1 : 0) << "\n";
            out << "area_headers=" << (s.ShowAreaHeaders ? 1 : 0) << "\n";
            out << "toasts=" << (s.ShowToasts ? 1 : 0) << "\n";
            out << "toast_success=" << (s.ToastOnSuccess ? 1 : 0) << "\n";
            out << "nav_gizmo=" << (s.ShowNavigationGizmo ? 1 : 0) << "\n";
            out << "viewport_stats=" << (s.ShowViewportStats ? 1 : 0) << "\n";
            out << "outliner_type=" << (s.ShowOutlinerTypeColumn ? 1 : 0) << "\n";
            out << "undo_limit=" << s.UndoLimit << "\n";
            out << "snap_t=" << (s.Snap.Translate ? 1 : 0) << "\n";
            out << "snap_r=" << (s.Snap.Rotate ? 1 : 0) << "\n";
            out << "snap_s=" << (s.Snap.Scale ? 1 : 0) << "\n";
            out << "snap_t_step=" << s.Snap.TranslateStep << "\n";
            out << "snap_r_step=" << s.Snap.RotateStep << "\n";
            out << "snap_s_step=" << s.Snap.ScaleStep << "\n";
            return out.str();
        }

        float ParseFloat(const std::string& value, float fallback)
        {
            char* end = nullptr;
            const float parsed = strtof(value.c_str(), &end);
            return (end != value.c_str() && std::isfinite(parsed)) ? parsed : fallback;
        }

        bool ParseBool(const std::string& value)
        {
            return value == "1" || value == "true";
        }

        void Sanitize()
        {
            auto& s = g_Settings;
            if (static_cast<int>(s.Theme) < 0 || s.Theme >= ThemePreset::Count)
            {
                s.Theme = ThemePreset::Unreal;
            }
            if (static_cast<int>(s.Font) < 0 || s.Font >= FontChoice::Count)
            {
                s.Font = FontChoice::Auto;
            }
            s.UiScale = std::clamp(s.UiScale, 0.75f, 2.0f);
            s.Rounding = std::clamp(s.Rounding, 0.0f, 8.0f);
            s.FontSize = std::clamp(s.FontSize, 12.0f, 24.0f);
            s.UndoLimit = std::clamp(s.UndoLimit, 5, 200);
            s.Snap.TranslateStep = std::clamp(s.Snap.TranslateStep, 0.001f, 1000.0f);
            s.Snap.RotateStep = std::clamp(s.Snap.RotateStep, 0.1f, 180.0f);
            s.Snap.ScaleStep = std::clamp(s.Snap.ScaleStep, 0.001f, 10.0f);
            for (float* channel : {&s.Accent.x, &s.Accent.y, &s.Accent.z})
            {
                *channel = std::clamp(*channel, 0.0f, 1.0f);
            }
            s.Accent.w = 1.0f;
        }

        bool SnapStepCombo(const char* label, float& value, const float* steps, int count, const char* format)
        {
            char preview[32];
            snprintf(preview, sizeof(preview), format, value);
            bool changed = false;
            if (ImGui::BeginCombo(label, preview))
            {
                for (int i = 0; i < count; ++i)
                {
                    char item[32];
                    snprintf(item, sizeof(item), format, steps[i]);
                    if (ImGui::Selectable(item, fabsf(steps[i] - value) < 1e-5f))
                    {
                        value = steps[i];
                        changed = true;
                    }
                }
                ImGui::EndCombo();
            }
            return changed;
        }
    } // namespace

    Settings& Get()
    {
        return g_Settings;
    }

    const char* ThemeName(ThemePreset preset)
    {
        switch (preset)
        {
            case ThemePreset::Unreal:
                return "Unreal（UE5 ダーク）";
            case ThemePreset::Blender:
                return "Blender（4.x ダーク）";
            case ThemePreset::Unity:
                return "Unity（Pro スキン）";
            case ThemePreset::Midnight:
                return "Midnight（シアン）";
            default:
                return "?";
        }
    }

    const char* FontName(FontChoice font)
    {
        switch (font)
        {
            case FontChoice::Auto:
                return "自動（游ゴシック → メイリオ → MS ゴシック）";
            case FontChoice::YuGothic:
                return "游ゴシック";
            case FontChoice::Meiryo:
                return "メイリオ";
            case FontChoice::MsGothic:
                return "MS ゴシック";
            default:
                return "?";
        }
    }

    void Load()
    {
        g_Settings = {};
        std::ifstream input(kPreferencesPath);
        if (input)
        {
            std::string line;
            auto& s = g_Settings;
            while (std::getline(input, line))
            {
                const auto separator = line.find('=');
                if (separator == std::string::npos)
                {
                    continue;
                }
                const std::string key = line.substr(0, separator);
                const std::string value = line.substr(separator + 1);
                if (key == "theme")
                    s.Theme = static_cast<ThemePreset>(atoi(value.c_str()));
                else if (key == "custom_accent")
                    s.CustomAccent = ParseBool(value);
                else if (key == "accent")
                {
                    float r = s.Accent.x, g = s.Accent.y, b = s.Accent.z;
                    if (sscanf_s(value.c_str(), "%f,%f,%f", &r, &g, &b) == 3)
                    {
                        s.Accent = ImVec4(r, g, b, 1.0f);
                    }
                }
                else if (key == "ui_scale")
                    s.UiScale = ParseFloat(value, s.UiScale);
                else if (key == "rounding")
                    s.Rounding = ParseFloat(value, s.Rounding);
                else if (key == "compact")
                    s.Compact = ParseBool(value);
                else if (key == "font")
                    s.Font = static_cast<FontChoice>(atoi(value.c_str()));
                else if (key == "font_size")
                    s.FontSize = ParseFloat(value, s.FontSize);
                else if (key == "toolbar")
                    s.ShowToolbar = ParseBool(value);
                else if (key == "statusbar")
                    s.ShowStatusBar = ParseBool(value);
                else if (key == "area_headers")
                    s.ShowAreaHeaders = ParseBool(value);
                else if (key == "toasts")
                    s.ShowToasts = ParseBool(value);
                else if (key == "toast_success")
                    s.ToastOnSuccess = ParseBool(value);
                else if (key == "nav_gizmo")
                    s.ShowNavigationGizmo = ParseBool(value);
                else if (key == "viewport_stats")
                    s.ShowViewportStats = ParseBool(value);
                else if (key == "outliner_type")
                    s.ShowOutlinerTypeColumn = ParseBool(value);
                else if (key == "undo_limit")
                    s.UndoLimit = atoi(value.c_str());
                else if (key == "snap_t")
                    s.Snap.Translate = ParseBool(value);
                else if (key == "snap_r")
                    s.Snap.Rotate = ParseBool(value);
                else if (key == "snap_s")
                    s.Snap.Scale = ParseBool(value);
                else if (key == "snap_t_step")
                    s.Snap.TranslateStep = ParseFloat(value, s.Snap.TranslateStep);
                else if (key == "snap_r_step")
                    s.Snap.RotateStep = ParseFloat(value, s.Snap.RotateStep);
                else if (key == "snap_s_step")
                    s.Snap.ScaleStep = ParseFloat(value, s.Snap.ScaleStep);
            }
        }
        Sanitize();
        g_LastSaved = Serialize();
        g_StyleDirty = true;
    }

    void LoadFonts()
    {
        ImGuiIO& io = ImGui::GetIO();
        const float size = g_Settings.FontSize;
        std::error_code error;

        const FontChoice order[] = {FontChoice::YuGothic, FontChoice::Meiryo, FontChoice::MsGothic};
        ImFont* primary = nullptr;
        auto tryLoad = [&](FontChoice choice) {
            int faceIndex = 0;
            const char* path = FontPath(choice, faceIndex);
            if (!path || !std::filesystem::exists(path, error))
            {
                return false;
            }
            ImFontConfig config;
            config.FontNo = faceIndex;
            config.PixelSnapH = true;
            primary = io.Fonts->AddFontFromFileTTF(path, size, &config, io.Fonts->GetGlyphRangesJapanese());
            return primary != nullptr;
        };
        if (g_Settings.Font != FontChoice::Auto)
        {
            tryLoad(g_Settings.Font);
        }
        for (FontChoice choice : order)
        {
            if (primary)
            {
                break;
            }
            tryLoad(choice);
        }
        if (!primary)
        {
            io.Fonts->AddFontDefault();
        }

        // アイコン用のグリフ（矢印 / 図形 / 記号）を Segoe UI Symbol から補完する。
        // ImGui 1.92 以降は不足グリフを動的に読み込むため範囲指定は従来版のためのもの。
        static const ImWchar kSymbolRanges[] = {
            0x2000, 0x206F, // 一般句読点
            0x2190, 0x21FF, // 矢印
            0x2200, 0x22FF, // 数学記号
            0x2300, 0x23FF, // その他の技術記号（⏸ ⏹ ⏭ ⌕）
            0x2460, 0x24FF, // 囲み英数字
            0x2500, 0x257F, // 罫線
            0x25A0, 0x25FF, // 幾何学模様（▶ ■ ● ◆）
            0x2600, 0x26FF, // その他の記号（☀ ⚙）
            0x2700, 0x27BF, // 装飾記号（✓ ✕ ✥）
            0x2900, 0x297F, // 補助矢印（⤢）
            0,
        };
        const char* symbolPath = "C:\\Windows\\Fonts\\seguisym.ttf";
        if (primary && std::filesystem::exists(symbolPath, error))
        {
            ImFontConfig symbols;
            symbols.MergeMode = true;
            symbols.PixelSnapH = true;
            io.Fonts->AddFontFromFileTTF(symbolPath, size, &symbols, kSymbolRanges);
        }
    }

    void MarkStyleDirty()
    {
        g_StyleDirty = true;
    }

    void ApplyPending()
    {
        if (g_StyleDirty)
        {
            ApplyNow();
        }
    }

    void ApplyNow()
    {

        Sanitize();
        const auto& s = g_Settings;
        g_Palette = MakePalette(s.Theme);
        if (s.CustomAccent)
        {
            g_Palette.Accent = s.Accent;
        }
        const Palette& p = g_Palette;

        ImGuiStyle& style = ImGui::GetStyle();
        style = ImGuiStyle();
        ImVec4* c = style.Colors;
        const ImVec4 accent = p.Accent;
        const ImVec4 accentHover = Lerp(accent, ImVec4(1, 1, 1, 1), 0.15f);
        const ImVec4 accentActive = Lerp(accent, ImVec4(0, 0, 0, 1), 0.15f);

    void Save()
    {
        const std::string contents = Serialize();
        std::error_code error;
        std::filesystem::create_directories("Save", error);
        const std::string temporary = std::string(kPreferencesPath) + ".tmp";
        {
            std::ofstream output(temporary, std::ios::binary | std::ios::trunc);
            if (!output)
            {
                return;
            }
            output << contents;
            if (!output)
            {
                return;
            }
        }
        std::filesystem::rename(temporary, kPreferencesPath, error);
        if (error)
        {
            std::filesystem::remove(kPreferencesPath, error);
            std::filesystem::rename(temporary, kPreferencesPath, error);
        }
        if (!error)
        {
            g_LastSaved = contents;
        }
    }

    void SaveIfChanged()
    {
        if (Serialize() != g_LastSaved)
        {
            Save();
        }
    }
