===== FILE: source\editor\editorworkspace.cpp =====
#include "pch.h"
#include "editorworkspace.h"
#include "materialasset.h"
#include "editorpreferences.h"
#include <imgui_internal.h>
#include <json/json.h>
#include <fstream>
#include <sstream>
#include <unordered_set>

namespace
{
    constexpr const char* WorkspacePath = "Save/editor_workspaces.json";
    constexpr size_t MaxWorkspaces = 64;

    bool Contains(const std::vector<std::string>& values, const std::string& value)
    {
        return std::find(values.begin(), values.end(), value) != values.end();
    }
}

void EditorWindowRegistry::RegisterWindow(EditorWindowDefinition definition)
{
    if (definition.Id.empty() || !definition.Visible)
    {
        return;
    }
    for (auto& window : m_Windows)
    {
        if (window.Id == definition.Id)
        {
            window = std::move(definition);
            return;
        }
    }
    m_Windows.push_back(std::move(definition));
}

void EditorWindowRegistry::UnregisterWindow(const std::string& id)
{
    std::erase_if(m_Windows, [&](const auto& window) {
        return window.Id == id;
    });
}

void EditorWindowRegistry::ShowWindow(const std::string& id)
{
    for (const auto& window : m_Windows)
    {
        if (window.Id == id)
        {
            *window.Visible = true;
        }
    }
}

void EditorWindowRegistry::HideWindow(const std::string& id)
{
    for (const auto& window : m_Windows)
    {
        if (window.Id == id)
        {
            *window.Visible = false;
        }
    }
}

void EditorWindowRegistry::ShowEditorType(const std::string& id)
{
    auto& workspaces = EditorWorkspaceManager::Get();
    if (!workspaces.IsAreaDrawn(id))
    {
        workspaces.RequestMaximize(id);
    }
    if (IsTypeVisible(id))
    {
        return;
    }
    ShowWindow(id);
    m_PendingTypes[id] = id;
}

void EditorWindowRegistry::DrawVisibleWindows()
{
    for (const auto& area : m_Windows)
    {
        if (!*area.Visible || !area.Draw || !EditorWorkspaceManager::Get().IsAreaDrawn(area.Id))
        {
            continue;
        }
        const auto selected = m_AreaTypes.find(area.Id);
        const auto& typeId = selected == m_AreaTypes.end() ? area.Id : selected->second;
        const auto renderer = std::find_if(m_Windows.begin(), m_Windows.end(), [&](const auto& type) {
            return type.Id == typeId && type.Draw;
        });
        m_DrawingArea = &area;
        if (renderer != m_Windows.end())
        {
            const bool sourceVisible = *renderer->Visible;
            *renderer->Visible = true;
            renderer->Draw();
            if (renderer->Visible != area.Visible)
            {
                *renderer->Visible = sourceVisible;
            }
        }
        else
        {
            area.Draw();
        }
        m_DrawingArea = nullptr;
    }
}

std::string EditorWindowRegistry::AreaTitle(const EditorWindowDefinition& area) const
{
    const auto selected = m_AreaTypes.find(area.Id);
    const auto& typeId = selected == m_AreaTypes.end() ? area.Id : selected->second;
    const auto type = std::find_if(m_Windows.begin(), m_Windows.end(), [&](const auto& window) {
        return window.Id == typeId;
    });
    return (type == m_Windows.end() ? area.Label : type->Label) + "###EditorArea_" + area.Id;
}

void EditorWindowRegistry::RestoreAreaTypes(const std::unordered_map<std::string, std::string>& types)
{
    m_AreaTypes.clear();
    m_PendingTypes.clear();
    for (const auto& [area, type] : types)
    {
        const auto known = std::find_if(m_Windows.begin(), m_Windows.end(), [&](const auto& window) {
            return window.Id == type && window.Draw;
        });
        if (known != m_Windows.end())
        {
            m_AreaTypes.emplace(area, type);
        }
    }
}

void EditorWindowRegistry::ApplyPendingTypes()
{
    for (const auto& [area, type] : m_PendingTypes)
    {
        m_AreaTypes[area] = type;
    }
    m_PendingTypes.clear();
}

bool EditorWindowRegistry::IsTypeVisible(const std::string& id) const
{
    for (const auto& area : m_Windows)
    {
        const auto selected = m_AreaTypes.find(area.Id);
        if (*area.Visible && EditorWorkspaceManager::Get().IsAreaDrawn(area.Id) &&
            (selected == m_AreaTypes.end() ? area.Id : selected->second) == id)
        {
            return true;
        }
    }
    return false;
}

bool EditorWindowRegistry::BeginEditorWindow(const char* title, bool* open, ImGuiWindowFlags flags)
{
    auto& registry = EditorWorkspaceManager::Get().Registry();
    const auto* area = registry.m_DrawingArea;
    if (!area)
    {
        return ImGui::Begin(title, open, flags);
    }
    auto& workspaces = EditorWorkspaceManager::Get();
    if (workspaces.IsMaximized(area->Id))
    {
        ImGui::SetNextWindowDockID(0, ImGuiCond_Always);
        ImGui::SetNextWindowPos(workspaces.AreaWorkPosition());
        ImGui::SetNextWindowSize(workspaces.AreaWorkSize());
        flags &= ~ImGuiWindowFlags_AlwaysAutoResize;
        flags |= ImGuiWindowFlags_NoDocking | ImGuiWindowFlags_NoMove | ImGuiWindowFlags_NoResize;
    }
    const auto label = registry.AreaTitle(*area);
    // Area owns visibility. Changing editor type does not close its source editor's other areas.
    const bool expanded = ImGui::Begin(label.c_str(), area->Visible, flags);
    if (!*area->Visible && workspaces.IsMaximized(area->Id))
    {
        workspaces.RequestMaximize(area->Id);
    }
    if (!expanded)
    {
        return false;
    }
    ImGuiWindow* window = ImGui::GetCurrentWindow();
    if (window->DockId == 0 && !workspaces.IsMaximized(area->Id))
    {
        const ImGuiViewport* viewport = ImGui::GetMainViewport();
        const ImVec2 available = viewport->WorkSize;
        const ImVec2 size(ImMin(window->Size.x, available.x), ImMin(window->Size.y, available.y));
        const ImVec2 maximum(viewport->WorkPos.x + available.x - size.x, viewport->WorkPos.y + available.y - size.y);
        const ImVec2 position(ImClamp(window->Pos.x, viewport->WorkPos.x, maximum.x),
                              ImClamp(window->Pos.y, viewport->WorkPos.y, maximum.y));
        if (size.x != window->Size.x || size.y != window->Size.y)
        {
            ImGui::SetWindowSize(size);
        }
        if (position.x != window->Pos.x || position.y != window->Pos.y)
        {
            ImGui::SetWindowPos(position);
        }
    }
    const bool ctrlSpace = ImGui::IsWindowFocused(ImGuiFocusedFlags_RootAndChildWindows) &&
                           !ImGui::GetIO().WantTextInput && ImGui::GetIO().KeyCtrl &&
                           ImGui::IsKeyPressed(ImGuiKey_Space, false);
    if (ctrlSpace)
    {
        workspaces.RequestMaximize(area->Id);
    }
    if (!EditorPreferences::Get().ShowAreaHeaders && !workspaces.IsMaximized(area->Id))
    {
        // ヘッダー非表示（設定）時は最大化している領域以外ではヘッダー行を省略する。Ctrl+Space は有効
        return true;
    }
    // Blender のエリアヘッダーのように、1 行・小さめのフレームで表示する
    const float uiScale = EditorPreferences::Get().UiScale;
    ImGui::PushStyleVar(ImGuiStyleVar_FramePadding, ImVec2(6.0f * uiScale, 1.0f * uiScale));
    const bool maximized = workspaces.IsMaximized(area->Id);
    const char* maximizeLabel = maximized ? "⤡##AreaMaximize" : "⤢##AreaMaximize";
    const float availableWidth = ImGui::GetContentRegionAvail().x;
    const float maximizeWidth =
        ImGui::CalcTextSize(maximizeLabel, nullptr, true).x + ImGui::GetStyle().FramePadding.x * 2.0f;
    const bool controlsFitOnOneRow = availableWidth >= 80.0f + maximizeWidth + ImGui::GetStyle().ItemSpacing.x;
    float selectorWidth = availableWidth;
    if (controlsFitOnOneRow)
    {
        selectorWidth -= maximizeWidth + ImGui::GetStyle().ItemSpacing.x;
    }
    ImGui::SetNextItemWidth((std::max)(1.0f, (std::min)(200.0f * uiScale, selectorWidth)));
    const auto selected = registry.m_AreaTypes.find(area->Id);
    const auto& typeId = selected == registry.m_AreaTypes.end() ? area->Id : selected->second;
    if (ImGui::BeginCombo("##EditorType", label.substr(0, label.find("###")).c_str(), ImGuiComboFlags_HeightLarge))
    {
        for (const auto& type : registry.m_Windows)
        {
            if (!type.Draw)
            {
                continue;
            }
            if (ImGui::Selectable(type.Label.c_str(), type.Id == typeId))
            {
                registry.m_PendingTypes[area->Id] = type.Id;
            }
        }
        ImGui::EndCombo();
    }
    ImGui::SetItemTooltip("Editor Type: 配置とサイズを維持して、この領域の機能を切り替えます");
    if (controlsFitOnOneRow)
    {
        ImGui::SameLine(ImGui::GetCursorPosX() + availableWidth - maximizeWidth);
    }
    if (ImGui::SmallButton(maximizeLabel))
    {
        workspaces.RequestMaximize(area->Id);
    }
    ImGui::SetItemTooltip(maximized ? "元の配置に戻す (Ctrl+Space)" : "この領域を最大化 (Ctrl+Space)");
    ImGui::PopStyleVar();
    ImGui::Separator();
    return true;
}

void EditorWindowRegistry::DrawWindowMenu()
{
    for (const auto& window : m_Windows)
    {
        ImGui::PushID(window.Id.c_str());
        std::string label = window.Label;
        const auto selected = m_AreaTypes.find(window.Id);
        if (selected != m_AreaTypes.end() && selected->second != window.Id)
        {
            const auto type = std::find_if(m_Windows.begin(), m_Windows.end(), [&](const auto& candidate) {
                return candidate.Id == selected->second;
            });
            if (type != m_Windows.end())
            {
                label += " / " + type->Label;
            }
        }
        ImGui::MenuItem(label.c_str(), nullptr, window.Visible);
        ImGui::PopID();
    }
}

EditorWorkspaceManager& EditorWorkspaceManager::Get()
{
    static EditorWorkspaceManager manager;
    return manager;
}

EditorWorkspaceManager::Workspace EditorWorkspaceManager::MakeWorkspace(const std::string& name,
                                                                        const std::string& preset)
{
    Workspace workspace;
    do
    {
        workspace.Id = "workspace_" + std::to_string(m_NextId++);
    } while (std::any_of(m_Workspaces.begin(), m_Workspaces.end(), [&](const auto& existing) {
        return existing.Id == workspace.Id;
    }));
    workspace.Name = name;
    workspace.Preset = preset;
    if (preset == "Shading")
    {
        workspace.VisibleWindows = {"scene", "material", "inspector", "assets", "console"};
    }
    else if (preset == "Animation")
    {
        workspace.VisibleWindows = {"scene", "hierarchy", "inspector", "animation", "sequencer"};
    }
    else if (preset == "Sequencer")
    {
        workspace.VisibleWindows = {"scene", "hierarchy", "inspector", "sequencer", "assets"};
    }
    else if (preset == "Rendering")
    {
        workspace.VisibleWindows = {"scene", "render_debug", "performance", "gbuffer", "render_settings"};
    }
    else if (preset == "Procedural")
    {
        workspace.VisibleWindows = {"procedural_studio", "procedural", "textures", "console"};
    }
    else
    {
        workspace.VisibleWindows = {"scene", "hierarchy", "inspector", "assets", "console"};
    }
    return workspace;
}

void EditorWorkspaceManager::Initialize(bool persistent)
{
    if (m_Initialized)
    {
        return;
    }
    m_Initialized = true;
    m_Persistent = persistent;
    ImGui::GetIO().IniFilename = nullptr;
    if (persistent && Load())
    {
        ApplyActive();
        return;
    }
    for (const char* preset : {"Layout", "Shading", "Animation", "Sequencer", "Rendering", "Procedural"})
    {
        m_Workspaces.push_back(MakeWorkspace(preset, preset));
    }

    // Import the old layout only once. Existing project visibility preferences are kept.
    if (persistent)
    {
        std::ifstream legacy("Save/editor_layout.cfg", std::ios::binary);
        if (legacy)
        {
            std::ostringstream contents;
            contents << legacy.rdbuf();
            m_Workspaces.front().Layout = contents.str();
        }
        if (m_Workspaces.front().Layout.empty())
        {
            size_t length = 0;
            const char* layout = ImGui::SaveIniSettingsToMemory(&length);
            m_Workspaces.front().Layout.assign(layout, length);
        }
        m_Workspaces.front().VisibleWindows.clear();
        for (const auto& window : m_Registry.Windows())
        {
            if (*window.Visible)
            {
                m_Workspaces.front().VisibleWindows.push_back(window.Id);
            }
        }
    }
    ApplyActive();
}

void EditorWorkspaceManager::CaptureActive()
{
    auto& workspace = m_Workspaces[m_Active];
    size_t length = 0;
    if (m_MaximizedArea.empty())
    {
        const char* layout = ImGui::SaveIniSettingsToMemory(&length);
        workspace.Layout.assign(layout, length);
    }
    else
    {
        workspace.Layout = m_MaximizedLayout;
    }
    workspace.VisibleWindows.clear();
    workspace.AreaTypes = m_Registry.AreaTypes();
    for (const auto& window : m_Registry.Windows())
    {
        if (*window.Visible)
        {
            workspace.VisibleWindows.push_back(window.Id);
        }
    }
}

void EditorWorkspaceManager::ApplyActive()
{
    const auto& workspace = m_Workspaces[m_Active];
    m_Registry.RestoreAreaTypes(workspace.AreaTypes);
    ImGui::ClearIniSettings();
    if (!workspace.Layout.empty())
    {
        // Migrate legacy display-name keys to stable area identities without changing their DockId/geometry.
        std::string layout = workspace.Layout;
        for (const auto& window : m_Registry.Windows())
        {
            if (!window.Draw)
            {
                continue;
            }
            const auto oldHeader = "[Window][" + window.DockTitle + "]";
            const auto newHeader = "[Window][###EditorArea_" + window.Id + "]";
            const auto position = layout.find(oldHeader);
            if (position != std::string::npos)
            {
                layout.replace(position, oldHeader.size(), newHeader);
            }
        }
        const std::string oldMaterial = "[Window][###MaterialAssetEditor]";
        const auto materialPosition = layout.find(oldMaterial);
        if (materialPosition != std::string::npos)
        {
            layout.replace(materialPosition, oldMaterial.size(), "[Window][###EditorArea_material]");
        }
        ImGui::LoadIniSettingsFromMemory(layout.data(), layout.size());
    }
    for (const auto& window : m_Registry.Windows())
    {
        *window.Visible = Contains(workspace.VisibleWindows, window.Id);
    }
    m_BuildLayout = workspace.Layout.empty();
}

void EditorWorkspaceManager::Queue(Action action, const std::string& id)
{
    m_Action = action;
    m_ActionId = id;
}

void EditorWorkspaceManager::BeginFrame()
{
    m_Registry.ApplyPendingTypes();
    if (!m_Initialized || m_Action == Action::None)
    {
        return;
    }
    CaptureActive();
    if (m_Action == Action::Maximize)
    {
        if (m_MaximizedArea.empty())
        {
            m_MaximizedLayout = m_Workspaces[m_Active].Layout;
            m_MaximizedArea = m_ActionId;
        }
        else
        {
            m_MaximizedArea.clear();
            m_MaximizedLayout.clear();
            ApplyActive();
        }
        m_Action = Action::None;
        m_ActionId.clear();
        return;
    }
    // Switching workspaces or changing their structure always exits the temporary full-area view.
    if (!m_MaximizedArea.empty())
    {
        m_MaximizedArea.clear();
        m_MaximizedLayout.clear();
        ApplyActive();
    }
    const auto found = std::find_if(m_Workspaces.begin(), m_Workspaces.end(), [&](const auto& workspace) {
        return workspace.Id == m_ActionId;
    });
    const size_t target = static_cast<size_t>(found - m_Workspaces.begin());
    const std::string activeId = m_Workspaces[m_Active].Id;
    bool apply = false;
    if (m_Action == Action::Add && m_Workspaces.size() < MaxWorkspaces)
    {
        m_Workspaces.push_back(MakeWorkspace("Workspace", "Layout"));
        m_Active = m_Workspaces.size() - 1;
        apply = true;
    }
    else if (target < m_Workspaces.size())
    {
        switch (m_Action)
        {
            case Action::Switch:
                m_Active = target;
                apply = true;
                break;
            case Action::Duplicate:
                if (m_Workspaces.size() < MaxWorkspaces)
                {
                    Workspace copy = m_Workspaces[target];
                    copy.Id = MakeWorkspace(copy.Name, copy.Preset).Id;
                    copy.Name += " Copy";
                    m_Workspaces.insert(m_Workspaces.begin() + target + 1, std::move(copy));
                    m_Active = target + 1;
                    apply = true;
                }
                break;
            case Action::Delete:
                if (m_Workspaces.size() > 1)
                {
                    const bool deletedActive = target == m_Active;
                    m_Workspaces.erase(m_Workspaces.begin() + target);
                    if (deletedActive)
                    {
                        m_Active = (std::min)(target, m_Workspaces.size() - 1);
                        apply = true;
                    }
                    else if (target < m_Active)
                    {
                        --m_Active;
                    }
                }
                break;
            case Action::MoveLeft:
            case Action::MoveRight: {
                const size_t other = m_Action == Action::MoveLeft ? (target == 0 ? 0 : target - 1)
                                                                  : (std::min)(target + 1, m_Workspaces.size() - 1);
                std::swap(m_Workspaces[target], m_Workspaces[other]);
                for (size_t i = 0; i < m_Workspaces.size(); ++i)
                {
                    if (m_Workspaces[i].Id == activeId)
                    {
                        m_Active = i;
                    }
                }
                break;
            }
            case Action::Reset: {
                const auto preset = MakeWorkspace(m_Workspaces[target].Name, m_Workspaces[target].Preset);
                m_Workspaces[target].VisibleWindows = preset.VisibleWindows;
                m_Workspaces[target].AreaTypes.clear();
                m_Workspaces[target].Layout.clear();
                apply = target == m_Active;
                break;
            }
            default:
                break;
        }
    }
    m_Action = Action::None;
    m_ActionId.clear();
    if (apply)
    {
        ApplyActive();
    }
    Save();
}

void EditorWorkspaceManager::DrawTabBar()
{
    if (!m_Initialized || m_Workspaces.empty())
    {
        return;
    }
    // ツールバーと同じくビューポートの作業領域から差し引くので、ドックスペースはこの下から始まる
    const float uiScale = EditorPreferences::Get().UiScale;
    ImGuiViewport* viewport = ImGui::GetMainViewport();
    const float padding = 3.0f * uiScale;
    const float height = ImGui::GetFrameHeight() + padding * 2.0f;
    ImGui::PushStyleVar(ImGuiStyleVar_WindowPadding, ImVec2(8.0f * uiScale, padding));
    ImGui::PushStyleVar(ImGuiStyleVar_WindowBorderSize, 0.0f);
    ImGui::PushStyleColor(ImGuiCol_WindowBg, EditorPreferences::PanelDark());
    const ImGuiWindowFlags flags = ImGuiWindowFlags_NoScrollbar | ImGuiWindowFlags_NoSavedSettings |
                                   ImGuiWindowFlags_NoScrollWithMouse | ImGuiWindowFlags_NoNavFocus;
    const bool open = ImGui::BeginViewportSideBar("##EditorWorkspaceBar", viewport, ImGuiDir_Up, height, flags);
    ImGui::PopStyleColor();
    ImGui::PopStyleVar(2);
    if (open)
    {
        DrawTabs(0.0f);
        // ドック領域との境界線
        const ImVec2 min = ImGui::GetWindowPos();
        const ImVec2 size = ImGui::GetWindowSize();
        ImGui::GetWindowDrawList()->AddLine(ImVec2(min.x, min.y + size.y - 1.0f), ImVec2(min.x + size.x, min.y + size.y - 1.0f),
                                            ImGui::GetColorU32(ImGuiCol_Border));
    }
    ImGui::End();
}

void EditorWorkspaceManager::DrawTabs(float reserveRight)
{
    // DrawTabBar（ツールバー下の専用バー）から呼ぶ。
    const float uiScale = EditorPreferences::Get().UiScale;
    const ImVec4 accent = EditorPreferences::Accent();
    ImGui::PushStyleVar(ImGuiStyleVar_ItemSpacing, ImVec2(2.0f * uiScale, ImGui::GetStyle().ItemSpacing.y));
    ImGui::PushStyleVar(ImGuiStyleVar_SelectableTextAlign, ImVec2(0.5f, 0.5f));
    size_t overflowFrom = m_Workspaces.size();
    for (size_t i = 0; i < m_Workspaces.size(); ++i)
    {
        auto& workspace = m_Workspaces[i];
        const float width = ImGui::CalcTextSize(workspace.Name.c_str()).x + 22.0f * uiScale;
        if (i != 0)
        {
            ImGui::SameLine();
        }
        if (i != 0 && ImGui::GetContentRegionAvail().x - width < reserveRight + ImGui::GetFrameHeight())
        {
            overflowFrom = i;
            break;
        }
        ImGui::PushID(workspace.Id.c_str());
        const bool active = i == m_Active;
        const ImVec2 start = ImGui::GetCursorScreenPos();
        if (active)
        {
            ImGui::PushStyleColor(ImGuiCol_Header, ImGui::GetStyleColorVec4(ImGuiCol_WindowBg));
            ImGui::PushStyleColor(ImGuiCol_Text, ImVec4(1.0f, 1.0f, 1.0f, 1.0f));
        }
        if (ImGui::Selectable((workspace.Name + "###WorkspaceTab").c_str(), active, 0,
                              ImVec2(width, ImGui::GetFrameHeight())))
        {
            Queue(Action::Switch, workspace.Id);
        }
        if (active)
        {
            ImGui::PopStyleColor(2);
            ImGui::GetWindowDrawList()->AddRectFilled(
                ImVec2(start.x, start.y + ImGui::GetFrameHeight() - 2.0f * uiScale),
                ImVec2(start.x + width, start.y + ImGui::GetFrameHeight()), ImGui::GetColorU32(accent));
        }
        ImGui::SetItemTooltip("Workspace: %s\n右クリック: 名前変更 / 複製 / 移動 / 削除", workspace.Name.c_str());
        if (ImGui::BeginPopupContextItem("WorkspaceMenu"))
        {
            if (ImGui::IsWindowAppearing())
            {
                snprintf(m_Rename, sizeof(m_Rename), "%s", workspace.Name.c_str());
            }
            ImGui::TextUnformatted("Workspace");
            ImGui::SetNextItemWidth(220.0f);
            if (ImGui::InputText("名前", m_Rename, sizeof(m_Rename), ImGuiInputTextFlags_EnterReturnsTrue) &&
                m_Rename[0] != '\0')
            {
                workspace.Name = m_Rename;
                m_ForceSave = true;
                ImGui::CloseCurrentPopup();
            }
            if (ImGui::MenuItem("複製", nullptr, false, m_Workspaces.size() < MaxWorkspaces))
            {
                Queue(Action::Duplicate, workspace.Id);
            }
            if (ImGui::MenuItem("左へ移動", nullptr, false, i > 0))
            {
                Queue(Action::MoveLeft, workspace.Id);
            }
            if (ImGui::MenuItem("右へ移動", nullptr, false, i + 1 < m_Workspaces.size()))
            {
                Queue(Action::MoveRight, workspace.Id);
            }
            ImGui::Separator();
            if (ImGui::MenuItem("初期レイアウトに戻す"))
            {
                Queue(Action::Reset, workspace.Id);
            }
            if (ImGui::MenuItem("Workspaceを削除", nullptr, false, m_Workspaces.size() > 1))
            {
                Queue(Action::Delete, workspace.Id);
            }
            ImGui::EndPopup();
        }
        ImGui::PopID();
    }
    if (overflowFrom < m_Workspaces.size())
    {
        // 入りきらない Workspace はドロップダウンにまとめる
        if (ImGui::BeginMenu("»##WorkspaceOverflow"))
        {
            for (size_t i = overflowFrom; i < m_Workspaces.size(); ++i)
            {
                if (ImGui::MenuItem(m_Workspaces[i].Name.c_str(), nullptr, i == m_Active))
                {
                    Queue(Action::Switch, m_Workspaces[i].Id);
                }
            }
            ImGui::EndMenu();
        }
    }
    ImGui::SameLine();
    ImGui::BeginDisabled(m_Workspaces.size() >= MaxWorkspaces);
    if (ImGui::Selectable("+##AddWorkspace", false, 0, ImVec2(ImGui::GetFrameHeight(), ImGui::GetFrameHeight())))
    {
        Queue(Action::Add, {});
    }
    ImGui::SetItemTooltip("Workspace を追加");
    ImGui::EndDisabled();
    ImGui::PopStyleVar(2);
    if (!m_SaveError.empty())
    {
        ImGui::SameLine();
        ImGui::TextColored(ImVec4(1, 0.55f, 0.25f, 1), "レイアウト保存エラー");
        ImGui::SetItemTooltip("%s", m_SaveError.c_str());
    }
}

void EditorWorkspaceManager::RequestSwitch(size_t index)
{
    if (m_Initialized && index < m_Workspaces.size())
    {
        Queue(Action::Switch, m_Workspaces[index].Id);
    }
}

uint64_t EditorWorkspaceManager::VisibilitySignature() const
{
    // FNV-1a。表示中のウィンドウとエリアタイプの組み合わせが変わったかだけを検出する
    uint64_t hash = 1469598103934665603ull;
    auto mix = [&hash](const std::string& text) {
        for (unsigned char c : text)
        {
            hash = (hash ^ c) * 1099511628211ull;
        }
        hash = (hash ^ 0xFFu) * 1099511628211ull;
    };
    for (const auto& window : m_Registry.Windows())
    {
        if (*window.Visible)
        {
            mix(window.Id);
        }
    }
    for (const auto& [area, type] : m_Registry.AreaTypes())
    {
        mix(area);
        mix(type);
    }
    mix(std::to_string(m_Active));
    return hash;
}

ImGuiID EditorWorkspaceManager::DockspaceId() const
{
    // Same runtime IDs are safe: switches clear and restore the entire settings snapshot.
    // Retaining the original root also permits importing editor_layout.cfg without data loss.
    return ImGui::GetID("MainEditorDockSpace");
}

void EditorWorkspaceManager::DrawDockSpace()
{
    m_AreaWorkPosition = ImGui::GetCursorScreenPos();
    m_AreaWorkSize = ImGui::GetContentRegionAvail();
    const ImGuiID root = DockspaceId();
    if (m_BuildLayout || !ImGui::DockBuilderGetNode(root))
    {
        ImGui::DockBuilderRemoveNode(root);
        ImGui::DockBuilderAddNode(root, ImGuiDockNodeFlags_DockSpace);
        ImGui::DockBuilderSetNodeSize(root, ImGui::GetContentRegionAvail());
        ImGuiID center = root;
        const ImGuiID bottom = ImGui::DockBuilderSplitNode(center, ImGuiDir_Down, 0.27f, nullptr, &center);
        const ImGuiID left = ImGui::DockBuilderSplitNode(center, ImGuiDir_Left, 0.20f, nullptr, &center);
        const ImGuiID right = ImGui::DockBuilderSplitNode(center, ImGuiDir_Right, 0.30f, nullptr, &center);
        const auto& preset = m_Workspaces[m_Active].Preset;
        for (const auto& window : m_Registry.Windows())
        {
            if (!*window.Visible || window.DockTitle.empty())
            {
                continue;
            }
            ImGuiID node = right;
            if (window.Id == "scene" || (preset == "Shading" && window.Id == "material") ||
                (preset == "Procedural" && window.Id == "procedural_studio"))
            {
                node = center;
            }
            else if (window.Id == "hierarchy" || window.Id == "render_debug" || window.Id == "textures")
            {
                node = left;
            }
            else if (window.Id == "assets" || window.Id == "console" || window.Id == "sequencer" ||
                     window.Id == "performance")
            {
                node = bottom;
            }
            if (preset == "Shading" && window.Id == "scene")
            {
                node = left;
            }
            const auto title = window.Draw ? m_Registry.AreaTitle(window) : window.DockTitle;
            ImGui::DockBuilderDockWindow(title.c_str(), node);
        }
        ImGui::DockBuilderFinish(root);
        m_BuildLayout = false;
    }
    ImGui::DockSpace(root, ImVec2(0, 0));
}

void EditorWorkspaceManager::RequestReset()
{
    if (m_Initialized)
    {
        Queue(Action::Reset, m_Workspaces[m_Active].Id);
    }
}

void EditorWorkspaceManager::RequestMaximize(const std::string& area)
{
    Queue(Action::Maximize, area);
}

bool EditorWorkspaceManager::IsAreaDrawn(const std::string& area) const
{
    return m_MaximizedArea.empty() || m_MaximizedArea == area;
}

bool EditorWorkspaceManager::IsMaximized(const std::string& area) const
{
    return m_MaximizedArea == area;
}

bool EditorWorkspaceManager::Load()
{
    std::ifstream input(WorkspacePath, std::ios::binary);
    if (!input)
    {
        return false;
    }
    std::error_code error;
    if (std::filesystem::file_size(WorkspacePath, error) > 32 * 1024 * 1024 || error)
    {
        return false;
    }
    Json::Value document;
    Json::CharReaderBuilder reader;
    std::string parseError;
    if (!Json::parseFromStream(reader, input, &document, &parseError) || !document.isObject() ||
        !document["version"].isInt() || document["version"].asInt() != 1 || !document["active"].isString() ||
        !document["workspaces"].isArray() || document["workspaces"].empty() ||
        document["workspaces"].size() > MaxWorkspaces)
    {
        return false;
    }
    std::vector<Workspace> loaded;
    std::unordered_set<std::string> ids;
    for (const auto& value : document["workspaces"])
    {
        if (!value.isObject() || !value["id"].isString() || !value["name"].isString() || !value["preset"].isString() ||
            !value["layout"].isString() || !value["visible"].isArray())
        {
            return false;
        }
        Workspace workspace;
        workspace.Id = value["id"].asString();
        workspace.Name = value["name"].asString();
        workspace.Preset = value["preset"].asString();
        workspace.Layout = value["layout"].asString();
        if (value["types"].isObject())
        {
            for (const auto& area : value["types"].getMemberNames())
            {
                if (value["types"][area].isString())
                {
                    workspace.AreaTypes[area] = value["types"][area].asString();
                }
            }
        }
        if (workspace.Id.empty() || workspace.Name.empty() || !ids.insert(workspace.Id).second)
        {
            return false;
        }
        for (const auto& visible : value["visible"])
        {
            if (visible.isString())
            {
                workspace.VisibleWindows.push_back(visible.asString());
            }
        }
        loaded.push_back(std::move(workspace));
    }
    m_Workspaces = std::move(loaded);
    // Never trust a persisted counter to keep IDs unique after hand editing or old versions.
    m_NextId = 1;
    while (ids.contains("workspace_" + std::to_string(m_NextId)))
    {
        ++m_NextId;
    }
    const auto active = document.get("active", "").asString();
    for (size_t i = 0; i < m_Workspaces.size(); ++i)
    {
        if (m_Workspaces[i].Id == active)
        {
            m_Active = i;
        }
    }
    return true;
}

void EditorWorkspaceManager::Save()
{
    if (!m_Persistent || !m_Initialized)
    {
        return;
    }
    Json::Value document(Json::objectValue);
    document["version"] = 1;
    document["active"] = m_Workspaces[m_Active].Id;
    document["workspaces"] = Json::Value(Json::arrayValue);
    for (const auto& workspace : m_Workspaces)
    {
        Json::Value value(Json::objectValue);
        value["id"] = workspace.Id;
        value["name"] = workspace.Name;
        value["preset"] = workspace.Preset;
        value["layout"] = workspace.Layout;
        value["visible"] = Json::Value(Json::arrayValue);
        value["types"] = Json::Value(Json::objectValue);
        for (const auto& [area, type] : workspace.AreaTypes)
        {
            value["types"][area] = type;
        }
        for (const auto& id : workspace.VisibleWindows)
        {
            value["visible"].append(id);
        }
        document["workspaces"].append(std::move(value));
    }
    Json::StreamWriterBuilder writer;
    writer["indentation"] = "  ";
    const std::string contents = Json::writeString(writer, document);
    if (contents == m_LastSaved)
    {
        return;
    }
    std::error_code directoryError;
    std::filesystem::create_directories("Save", directoryError);
    if (directoryError)
    {
        m_SaveError = directoryError.message();
        return;
    }
    if (WriteAssetFile(WorkspacePath, contents, m_SaveError))
    {
        m_LastSaved = contents;
        m_SaveError.clear();
    }
}

void EditorWorkspaceManager::AutoSave()
{
    if (!m_Initialized || ImGui::GetTime() < m_NextSave || ImGui::IsAnyItemActive() ||
        ImGui::IsMouseDown(ImGuiMouseButton_Left))
    {
        return;
    }
    m_NextSave = ImGui::GetTime() + 2.0;
    // 最適化：ドッキング配置（ImGui の ini）も表示ウィンドウも変わっていなければ、
    // 2 秒ごとの SaveIniSettingsToMemory と JSON 生成を丸ごと省く。
    ImGuiIO& io = ImGui::GetIO();
    const uint64_t signature = VisibilitySignature();
    if (!m_ForceSave && !io.WantSaveIniSettings && signature == m_LastVisibilitySignature)
    {
        return;
    }
    io.WantSaveIniSettings = false;
    m_LastVisibilitySignature = signature;
    m_ForceSave = false;
    CaptureActive();
    Save();
}

void EditorWorkspaceManager::Shutdown()
{
    if (!m_Initialized)
    {
        return;
    }
    CaptureActive();
    Save();
    m_Workspaces.clear();
    m_Registry = {};
    m_Initialized = false;
    m_Active = 0;
    m_Action = Action::None;
    m_MaximizedArea.clear();
    m_MaximizedLayout.clear();
    m_LastSaved.clear();

===== FILE: source\editor\gbufferpreview.h =====
#pragma once

#include "gbufferpreviewshader.h"
#include "imguishadercompiler.h"

// An ImGui draw callback keeps data textures out of the regular alpha-blended image shader.
namespace GBufferPreview
{
    inline ComPtr<ID3D12RootSignature> RootSignature;
    inline ComPtr<ID3D12PipelineState> Pipeline;
    inline D3D12_CPU_DESCRIPTOR_HANDLE BloomCpu{};
    inline D3D12_GPU_DESCRIPTOR_HANDLE BloomGpu{};
    inline ComPtr<ID3D12Resource> BloomResource;

    inline void Shutdown()
    {
        Pipeline.Reset();
        RootSignature.Reset();
        BloomCpu = {};
        BloomGpu = {};
        BloomResource.Reset();
    }

    inline bool Initialize(ID3D12Device* device, DXGI_FORMAT targetFormat, DXGI_FORMAT depthFormat)
    {
        CD3DX12_DESCRIPTOR_RANGE textureRange;
        textureRange.Init(D3D12_DESCRIPTOR_RANGE_TYPE_SRV, 1, 0);
        CD3DX12_ROOT_PARAMETER parameters[3];
        parameters[0].InitAsConstants(16, 0, 0, D3D12_SHADER_VISIBILITY_VERTEX);
        parameters[1].InitAsDescriptorTable(1, &textureRange, D3D12_SHADER_VISIBILITY_PIXEL);
        parameters[2].InitAsConstants(1, 1, 0, D3D12_SHADER_VISIBILITY_PIXEL);
        CD3DX12_ROOT_SIGNATURE_DESC rootDesc;
        rootDesc.Init(3, parameters, 0, nullptr, D3D12_ROOT_SIGNATURE_FLAG_ALLOW_INPUT_ASSEMBLER_INPUT_LAYOUT);
        ComPtr<ID3DBlob> serialized, errors;
        if (FAILED(D3D12SerializeRootSignature(&rootDesc, D3D_ROOT_SIGNATURE_VERSION_1, &serialized, &errors)) ||
            FAILED(device->CreateRootSignature(0, serialized->GetBufferPointer(), serialized->GetBufferSize(),
                                               IID_PPV_ARGS(&RootSignature))))
        {
            return false;
        }
        ComPtr<ID3DBlob> vertex, pixel;
        if (FAILED(ImGuiShaderCompiler::Compile(GBufferPreviewShader::Vertex, L"vs_6_0", &vertex)) ||
            FAILED(ImGuiShaderCompiler::Compile(GBufferPreviewShader::Pixel, L"ps_6_0", &pixel)))
        {
            Shutdown();
            return false;
        }
        const D3D12_INPUT_ELEMENT_DESC layout[] = {
            {"POSITION", 0, DXGI_FORMAT_R32G32_FLOAT, 0, UINT(offsetof(ImDrawVert, pos)),
             D3D12_INPUT_CLASSIFICATION_PER_VERTEX_DATA, 0},
            {"TEXCOORD", 0, DXGI_FORMAT_R32G32_FLOAT, 0, UINT(offsetof(ImDrawVert, uv)),
             D3D12_INPUT_CLASSIFICATION_PER_VERTEX_DATA, 0},
            {"COLOR", 0, DXGI_FORMAT_R8G8B8A8_UNORM, 0, UINT(offsetof(ImDrawVert, col)),
             D3D12_INPUT_CLASSIFICATION_PER_VERTEX_DATA, 0},
        };
        D3D12_GRAPHICS_PIPELINE_STATE_DESC desc{};
        desc.pRootSignature = RootSignature.Get();
        desc.VS = {vertex->GetBufferPointer(), vertex->GetBufferSize()};
        desc.PS = {pixel->GetBufferPointer(), pixel->GetBufferSize()};
        desc.InputLayout = {layout, UINT(std::size(layout))};
        desc.BlendState = CD3DX12_BLEND_DESC(D3D12_DEFAULT);
        desc.RasterizerState = CD3DX12_RASTERIZER_DESC(D3D12_DEFAULT);
        desc.RasterizerState.CullMode = D3D12_CULL_MODE_NONE;
        desc.DepthStencilState = CD3DX12_DEPTH_STENCIL_DESC(D3D12_DEFAULT);
        desc.DepthStencilState.DepthEnable = false;
        desc.DepthStencilState.StencilEnable = false;
        desc.SampleMask = UINT_MAX;
        desc.PrimitiveTopologyType = D3D12_PRIMITIVE_TOPOLOGY_TYPE_TRIANGLE;
        desc.NumRenderTargets = 1;
        desc.RTVFormats[0] = targetFormat;
        desc.DSVFormat = depthFormat;
        desc.SampleDesc.Count = 1;
        if (FAILED(device->CreateGraphicsPipelineState(&desc, IID_PPV_ARGS(&Pipeline))))
        {
            Shutdown();
            return false;
        }
        return true;
    }

    inline void SetRenderState(const ImDrawList*, const ImDrawCmd* command)
    {
        auto* state = static_cast<ImGui_ImplDX12_RenderState*>(ImGui::GetPlatformIO().Renderer_RenderState);
        auto* commands = state->CommandList;
        const ImDrawData* drawData = ImGui::GetDrawData();
        const float left = drawData->DisplayPos.x;
        const float right = left + drawData->DisplaySize.x;
        const float top = drawData->DisplayPos.y;
        const float bottom = top + drawData->DisplaySize.y;
        const float projection[4][4] = {
            {2.0f / (right - left), 0, 0, 0},
            {0, 2.0f / (top - bottom), 0, 0},
            {0, 0, 0.5f, 0},
            {(right + left) / (left - right), (top + bottom) / (bottom - top), 0.5f, 1},
        };
        commands->SetPipelineState(Pipeline.Get());
        commands->SetGraphicsRootSignature(RootSignature.Get());
        commands->SetGraphicsRoot32BitConstants(0, 16, projection, 0);
        commands->SetGraphicsRoot32BitConstants(2, 1, command->UserCallbackData, 0);
    }

    inline void Image(D3D12_GPU_DESCRIPTOR_HANDLE texture, ImVec2 size, UINT type)
    {
        if (!Pipeline || !texture.ptr)
        {
            ImGui::TextUnformatted("プレビューを利用できません");
            return;
        }
        ImDrawList* drawList = ImGui::GetWindowDrawList();
        drawList->AddCallback(SetRenderState, &type, sizeof(type));
        ImGui::Image(ImTextureID(texture.ptr), size);
        drawList->AddCallback(ImDrawCallback_ResetRenderState, nullptr);
    }

    inline D3D12_GPU_DESCRIPTOR_HANDLE BloomTexture(ID3D12Device* device, ID3D12Resource* resource,
                                                    D3D12_GPU_DESCRIPTOR_HANDLE fallback)
    {
        if (!resource || !BloomCpu.ptr)
        {
            return fallback;
        }
        // Bloom textures are recreated with the scene targets after the GPU has been drained.
        if (resource != BloomResource.Get())
        {
            D3D12_SHADER_RESOURCE_VIEW_DESC view{};
            view.Format = resource->GetDesc().Format;
            view.ViewDimension = D3D12_SRV_DIMENSION_TEXTURE2D;
            view.Shader4ComponentMapping = D3D12_DEFAULT_SHADER_4_COMPONENT_MAPPING;
            view.Texture2D.MipLevels = 1;
            device->CreateShaderResourceView(resource, &view, BloomCpu);
            BloomResource = resource;
        }
        return BloomGpu;
    }
}

===== FILE: source\editor\gbufferpreviewshader.h =====
#pragma once

namespace GBufferPreviewShader
{
    inline constexpr const char* Pixel = R"hlsl(
cbuffer PreviewSettings : register(b1) { uint PreviewType; };
Texture2D<float4> PreviewTexture : register(t0);
struct PixelInput
{
    float4 Position : SV_POSITION;
    float4 Color : COLOR0;
    float2 Uv : TEXCOORD0;
};
float4 main(PixelInput input) : SV_Target
{
    uint width, height;
    PreviewTexture.GetDimensions(width, height);
    uint2 pixel = min(uint2(saturate(input.Uv) * float2(width, height)), uint2(width - 1, height - 1));
    float4 value = PreviewTexture.Load(int3(pixel, 0));
    float3 color = value.rgb;
    // Types follow GBufferType; 10 is the separate emission alpha (material AO) view.
    if (PreviewType == 2)
    {
        // Keep reverse-Z ordering and background zero, while revealing small far-depth values.
        color = pow(saturate(value.r), 0.2f).xxx;
    }
    else if (PreviewType == 5 || PreviewType == 6 || PreviewType == 9)
    {
        color = max(color, 0.0f);
        color = color / (1.0f + color);
    }
    else if (PreviewType == 7)
    {
        // RG already contains the renderer's signed, amplified display velocity; BA is raw motion.
        color = float3(value.rg, 0.5f);
    }
    else if (PreviewType == 10)
    {
        color = saturate(value.a).xxx;
    }
    // GBuffer alpha carries data (POM displacement, material ID, motion), never UI opacity.
    return float4(color, 1.0f);
}
)hlsl";
    inline constexpr const char* Vertex = R"hlsl(
cbuffer VertexSettings : register(b0) { float4x4 ProjectionMatrix; };
struct VertexInput { float2 Position : POSITION; float4 Color : COLOR0; float2 Uv : TEXCOORD0; };
struct VertexOutput { float4 Position : SV_POSITION; float4 Color : COLOR0; float2 Uv : TEXCOORD0; };
VertexOutput main(VertexInput input)
{
    VertexOutput output;
    output.Position = mul(ProjectionMatrix, float4(input.Position, 0, 1));
    output.Color = input.Color;
    output.Uv = input.Uv;
    return output;
}
)hlsl";
}

#include <imgui_internal.h> // DockBuilder は同梱の docking ブランチで提供される。

using namespace EditorWidgets;

extern IMGUI_IMPL_API LRESULT ImGui_ImplWin32_WndProcHandler(HWND hWnd, UINT msg, WPARAM wParam, LPARAM lParam);

namespace
{
    // ImGui 1.92 はフォントアトラスの拡張中に複数のアトラステクスチャを保持する場合がある。
    struct ImGuiSrvPool
    {
        D3D12_CPU_DESCRIPTOR_HANDLE CpuStart{};
        D3D12_GPU_DESCRIPTOR_HANDLE GpuStart{};
        UINT Increment = 0;
        array<bool, ImGuiManager::kSrvDescriptorCount> Used{};
    };

    ImGuiSrvPool g_ImGuiSrvPool;
}

bool ImGuiManager::Init(HWND hwnd, ID3D12Device* device, ID3D12CommandQueue* commandQueue, int numFrames,
                        DXGI_FORMAT rtvFormat, ID3D12DescriptorHeap* cbvHeap, D3D12_CPU_DESCRIPTOR_HANDLE cpuHandle,
                        D3D12_GPU_DESCRIPTOR_HANDLE gpuHandle)
{
    WriteGraphicsLog("ImGui: check version\n");
    IMGUI_CHECKVERSION();
    WriteGraphicsLog("ImGui: create context\n");
    ImGui::CreateContext();
    // シーケンサーの表示設定（[RPSequencer]）を editor_layout.cfg から読めるよう、読み込み前に登録する
    SequencerEditorBridge::RegisterSettings();
    ImGuizmo::SetImGuiContext(ImGui::GetCurrentContext());
    ImGuiIO& io = ImGui::GetIO();
    char validationMode[8]{};
    if (GetEnvironmentVariableA("DX12_VALIDATION_MODE", validationMode, sizeof(validationMode)) > 0 &&
        atoi(validationMode) != 0)
    {
        io.IniFilename = nullptr;
    }
    else
    {
        error_code error;
        filesystem::create_directories("Save", error);
        io.IniFilename = "Save/editor_layout.cfg";
        if (!filesystem::exists(io.IniFilename, error) && filesystem::exists("imgui.ini", error))
        {
            ImGui::LoadIniSettingsFromDisk("imgui.ini");
        }
    }
    io.ConfigFlags |= ImGuiConfigFlags_NavEnableKeyboard;
    io.ConfigFlags |= ImGuiConfigFlags_DockingEnable;
    io.ConfigDockingWithShift = false;

    WriteGraphicsLog("ImGui: style\n");
    EditorPreferences::Load(); // テーマ / UI スケール / フォント / スナップ設定
    StyleModernSlim();

    WriteGraphicsLog("ImGui: load font\n");
    // 游ゴシック → メイリオ → MS ゴシックの順に探し、アイコン用に Segoe UI Symbol を合成する
    EditorPreferences::LoadFonts();

    WriteGraphicsLog("ImGui: Win32 backend\n");
    if (!ImGui_ImplWin32_Init(hwnd))
    {
        return false;
    }

    ImGui_ImplDX12_InitInfo initInfo{};
    initInfo.Device = device;
    initInfo.CommandQueue = commandQueue;
    initInfo.NumFramesInFlight = numFrames;
    initInfo.RTVFormat = rtvFormat;
    initInfo.DSVFormat = DXGI_FORMAT_D32_FLOAT;
    initInfo.SrvDescriptorHeap = cbvHeap;
    g_ImGuiSrvPool = {};
    g_ImGuiSrvPool.CpuStart = cpuHandle;
    g_ImGuiSrvPool.GpuStart = gpuHandle;
    g_ImGuiSrvPool.Increment = device->GetDescriptorHandleIncrementSize(D3D12_DESCRIPTOR_HEAP_TYPE_CBV_SRV_UAV);
    initInfo.UserData = &g_ImGuiSrvPool;
    initInfo.SrvDescriptorAllocFn = [](ImGui_ImplDX12_InitInfo* info, D3D12_CPU_DESCRIPTOR_HANDLE* out_cpu,
                                       D3D12_GPU_DESCRIPTOR_HANDLE* out_gpu) {
        auto& pool = *static_cast<ImGuiSrvPool*>(info->UserData);
        for (UINT i = 0; i < pool.Used.size(); ++i)
        {
            if (pool.Used[i])
            {
                continue;
            }
            pool.Used[i] = true;
            *out_cpu = CD3DX12_CPU_DESCRIPTOR_HANDLE(pool.CpuStart, i, pool.Increment);
            *out_gpu = CD3DX12_GPU_DESCRIPTOR_HANDLE(pool.GpuStart, i, pool.Increment);
            return;
        }
        WriteGraphicsLog("ERROR: ImGui SRV descriptor pool exhausted\n");
        // バックエンドには確保失敗を返す経路がないため、使用中の SRV を上書きしない。
        abort();
    };
    initInfo.SrvDescriptorFreeFn = [](ImGui_ImplDX12_InitInfo* info, D3D12_CPU_DESCRIPTOR_HANDLE cpu,
                                      D3D12_GPU_DESCRIPTOR_HANDLE gpu) {
        auto& pool = *static_cast<ImGuiSrvPool*>(info->UserData);
        const SIZE_T offset = cpu.ptr - pool.CpuStart.ptr;
        const SIZE_T index = offset / pool.Increment;
        const bool valid = offset % pool.Increment == 0 && index < pool.Used.size() &&
                           gpu.ptr == pool.GpuStart.ptr + index * pool.Increment;
        IM_ASSERT(valid && "Invalid ImGui SRV descriptor");
        if (valid)
        {
            IM_ASSERT(pool.Used[index] && "ImGui SRV descriptor already freed");
            pool.Used[index] = false;
        }
    };

    WriteGraphicsLog("ImGui: DX12 backend\n");
    if (!ImGui_ImplDX12_Init(&initInfo))
    {
        return false;
    }
    if (!GBufferPreview::Initialize(device, rtvFormat, initInfo.DSVFormat))
    {
        WriteGraphicsLog("ERROR: GBuffer preview initialization failed\n");
    }
    else
    {
        initInfo.SrvDescriptorAllocFn(&initInfo, &GBufferPreview::BloomCpu, &GBufferPreview::BloomGpu);
    }
    WriteGraphicsLog("ImGui: initialization complete\n");

    return true;
}

void ImGuiManager::Uninit()
{
    MaterialGraphEditor::Shutdown();
    EditorWorkspaceManager::Get().Shutdown();
    SequencerEditorBridge::Shutdown();
    GBufferPreview::Shutdown();
    ImGui_ImplDX12_Shutdown();
    ImGui_ImplWin32_Shutdown();
    ImGui::DestroyContext();
}

void ImGuiManager::Update()
{
    if (IsFeatureSmokeTestEnabled())
    {
        m_ShowGBufferWindow = true;
        m_ShowProceduralWindow = true;
        m_ShowRaytracingWindow = true;
        m_ShowAtmosphereWindow = true;
        m_ShowRenderDebugger = true;
        m_ShowGpuSceneWindow = true;
        m_ShowGpuDrivenWindow = true;
        m_ShowVisibilityWindow = true;
        m_ShowMeshShaderWindow = true;
        m_ShowVirtualGeometryWindow = true;
        m_ShowCloudWindow = true;
        m_ShowTextureListWindow = true;
    }
    if (!m_ProjectSettingsLoaded)
    {
        if (!RenderingValidation::IsEnabled())
        {
            LoadProjectSettings(); // cfg に scene= があれば、ここでそのシーンを開く
        }
        m_ProjectSettingsLoaded = true;
        if (!m_SceneTracking)
        {
            // 起動時の既定シーン（Untitled）。モデルの非同期読み込みが落ち着くまで基準を更新する
            BeginSceneBaseline(5.0);
        }
    }
    // シーンの切り替え・新規作成・終了は、描画前のこの位置でまとめて実行する
    ProcessSceneAction();

    InitializeWorkspaces();
    EditorWorkspaceManager::Get().BeginFrame();
    // テーマ / UI スケールの変更は NewFrame の前にまとめて反映する（フレーム途中でサイズが変わらないように）
    EditorPreferences::ApplyPending();
    ImGui_ImplDX12_NewFrame();
    ImGui_ImplWin32_NewFrame();
    MaterialValidation::BeforeEditorFrame();
    ThumbnailValidation::BeforeEditorFrame();
    ImGui::NewFrame();
    ValidateEditorObjects();
    MaterialValidation::InjectDragPayload();
    ImGuizmo::BeginFrame();
    DebugSystem::SetShowLightDebug(m_ShowLightDebug);

    ImGuiIO& io = ImGui::GetIO();
    if (!io.WantTextInput && io.KeyCtrl && ImGui::IsKeyPressed(ImGuiKey_Z, false))
    {
        if (io.KeyShift && MaterialEditorHasFocus())
        {
            MaterialEditorUndo(true);
        }
        else if (io.KeyShift)
        {
            Redo();
        }
        else if (MaterialEditorHasFocus())
        {
            MaterialEditorUndo(false);
        }
        else
        {
            Undo();
        }
    }
    if (!io.WantTextInput && io.KeyCtrl && ImGui::IsKeyPressed(ImGuiKey_Y, false))
    {
        if (MaterialEditorHasFocus())
        {
            MaterialEditorUndo(true);
        }
        else
        {
            Redo();
        }
    }

    MaterialPreview::SetVisible(false);
    // Ctrl+S：シーンを保存（未保存の新規シーンなら名前を付けて保存）、Ctrl+Shift+S：名前を付けて保存、Ctrl+N：新規シーン
    if (!io.WantTextInput && io.KeyCtrl && ImGui::IsKeyPressed(ImGuiKey_S, false) && !MaterialEditorHasFocus())
    {
        SaveCurrentScene(io.KeyShift);
        string error;
        filesystem::create_directories("Save");
        if (!MaterialManager::SaveSceneReferences("Save/scene_materials.json", error))
        {
            AddLog("Scene save failed: %s", error.c_str());
        }
    }
    if (!io.WantTextInput && io.KeyCtrl && !io.KeyShift && ImGui::IsKeyPressed(ImGuiKey_N, false))
    {
        RequestNewScene();
    }
    ProcessDroppedFiles();
    EditorShell::HandleGlobalShortcuts(); // F1 ショートカット一覧 / F3 コマンド検索 / Ctrl+, 設定
    // マテリアルグラフ操作中の Q / W / E / R（整列・配置キー）でギズモが切り替わらないようにする
    const bool canSwitchGizmo = !io.WantTextInput && !ImGui::IsAnyItemActive() &&
                                !ImGui::IsMouseDown(ImGuiMouseButton_Right) && !ImGuizmo::IsUsingAny() &&
                                !MaterialGraphEditor::HasFocus();
    if (canSwitchGizmo)
    {
        // Unityと同じ割り当て
        if (!io.KeyCtrl && !io.KeyAlt)
        {
            if (ImGui::IsKeyPressed(ImGuiKey_Q, false))
            {
                m_GizmoOperation = 3;
            }
            if (ImGui::IsKeyPressed(ImGuiKey_W, false))
            {
                m_GizmoOperation = 0;
            }
            if (ImGui::IsKeyPressed(ImGuiKey_E, false))
            {
                m_GizmoOperation = 1;
            }
            if (ImGui::IsKeyPressed(ImGuiKey_R, false))
            {
                m_GizmoOperation = 2;
            }
            if (ImGui::IsKeyPressed(ImGuiKey_X, false))
            {
                m_GizmoLocalSpace = !m_GizmoLocalSpace;
            }
        }
    }
    // Ctrl+D：複製（Unityと同じ）。入力中・ギズモ操作中・カメラ飛行中・マテリアルエディター操作中は無効
    if (!io.WantTextInput && io.KeyCtrl && !io.KeyShift && !io.KeyAlt && !ImGui::IsAnyItemActive() &&
        !ImGuizmo::IsUsingAny() && !ImGui::IsMouseDown(ImGuiMouseButton_Right) && !MaterialEditorHasFocus() &&
        !m_AssetBrowserFocused && // アセットブラウザでの Ctrl+D はアセットの複製
        ImGui::IsKeyPressed(ImGuiKey_D, false))
    {
        DuplicateSelectedEntity();
    }
    // Ctrl+P：再生/停止、Ctrl+Shift+P：一時停止（Unityと同じ）
    if (!io.WantTextInput && io.KeyCtrl && ImGui::IsKeyPressed(ImGuiKey_P, false))
    {
        if (io.KeyShift)
        {
            if (ProjectManager::IsPlaying())
            {
                ProjectManager::TogglePause();
            }
        }
        else
        {
            ProjectManager::TogglePlay();
        }
    }
    if (canSwitchGizmo && !io.KeyCtrl && !io.KeyAlt && m_SelectedEntity != g_kINVALID_ENTITY &&
        Registry::IsAlive(m_SelectedEntity) && ComponentManager::HasComponent<NameComponent>(m_SelectedEntity) &&
        !m_AssetBrowserFocused && // アセットブラウザにフォーカスがある間の F2 はアセットのリネーム
        ImGui::IsKeyPressed(ImGuiKey_F2, false))
    {
        BeginRename(m_SelectedEntity);
    }
    if (m_RenamingEntity != g_kINVALID_ENTITY && ImGui::IsKeyPressed(ImGuiKey_Escape, false))
    {
        CancelRename();
    }
    DrawEditorMainMenu();
    // メインツールバー / ステータスバーはドックスペースより先に作り、作業領域から差し引く
    EditorShell::DrawToolbar();
    // Workspace タブはツールバーの下（ドッキング領域の直上）に専用バーとして置く
    EditorWorkspaceManager::Get().DrawTabBar();
    EditorShell::DrawStatusBar();
    DrawDockSpace();
    m_IsSceneViewHovered = false;
    m_SceneGizmoCapturesMouse = false;
    m_AssetBrowserFocused = false;
    BeginMaterialEditorFrame();
    AnimationPreviewWindow::BeginFrame();
    EditorWorkspaceManager::Get().Registry().DrawVisibleWindows();
    // パイメニュー / Shift+A / テンキー視点 / 視点アニメーション（ピッキングより前に入力を確保する）
    EditorShell::UpdateViewportInteractions();
    // 右クリックでの視点回転 / WASD 移動は、3D ビューポート上で押し始めたときだけ有効にする
    ViewportInputGate::Update(ImGui::IsMouseDown(ImGuiMouseButton_Right),
                              ImGui::IsMouseClicked(ImGuiMouseButton_Right) && m_IsSceneViewHovered &&
                                  !EditorShell::IsPieOpen());
    if (ViewportInputGate::g_RightLookActive)
    {
        ImGui::SetMouseCursor(ImGuiMouseCursor_None); // フライ中はカーソルを隠す（UE と同じ）
    }
    UpdateSceneNavigation();
    if (m_IsSceneViewHovered)
        PickEntityFromMouse();
    DrawPrimitiveSettingsWindow();
    DrawRenderFeatureWindows();
    DrawMaterialAssetClosePrompt();

    MaterialGraphEditor::SaveRecovery();
    EditorWorkspaceManager::Get().AutoSave();
    DrawScenePopups();
    EditorShell::DrawOverlays(); // コマンド検索 / 追加メニュー / ショートカット一覧 / 通知トースト
    FinalizeUndoCaptureIfIdle();
    UpdateSceneTracking();
    static double nextSettingsSave = 0.0;
    if (m_ProjectSettingsLoaded && !ProjectManager::IsPlaying() && !ImGui::IsAnyItemActive() &&
        ImGui::GetTime() >= nextSettingsSave)
    {
        SaveProjectSettings();
        if (!RenderingValidation::IsEnabled())
        {
            EditorPreferences::SaveIfChanged();
        }
        nextSettingsSave = ImGui::GetTime() + 2.0;
    }
}

void ImGuiManager::DrawDockSpace()
{
    ImGuiViewport* viewport = ImGui::GetMainViewport();
    ImGui::SetNextWindowPos(viewport->WorkPos);
    ImGui::SetNextWindowSize(viewport->WorkSize);
    ImGui::SetNextWindowViewport(viewport->ID);
    ImGuiWindowFlags hostFlags = ImGuiWindowFlags_NoTitleBar | ImGuiWindowFlags_NoCollapse | ImGuiWindowFlags_NoResize |
                                 ImGuiWindowFlags_NoMove | ImGuiWindowFlags_NoDocking |
                                 ImGuiWindowFlags_NoBringToFrontOnFocus | ImGuiWindowFlags_NoNavFocus |
                                 ImGuiWindowFlags_NoBackground;

    ImGui::PushStyleVar(ImGuiStyleVar_WindowRounding, 0.0f);
    ImGui::PushStyleVar(ImGuiStyleVar_WindowBorderSize, 0.0f);
    ImGui::PushStyleVar(ImGuiStyleVar_WindowPadding, ImVec2(0.0f, 0.0f));
    ImGui::Begin("EditorDockSpace", nullptr, hostFlags);
    ImGui::PopStyleVar(3);

    // Workspace タブはツールバー下の専用バー（EditorWorkspaceManager::DrawTabBar）に描く
    auto& workspaces = EditorWorkspaceManager::Get();
    if (m_ResetEditorLayout)
    {
        workspaces.RequestReset();
        m_ResetEditorLayout = false;
    }
    workspaces.DrawDockSpace();
    ImGui::End();
}

void ImGuiManager::DrawEditorMainMenu()
{
    if (!ImGui::BeginMainMenuBar())
    {
        return;
    }
    auto& preferences = EditorPreferences::Get();
    ImGui::TextColored(EditorPreferences::Accent(), "◆");
    ImGui::SetItemTooltip("RenderingProject Editor");

    if (ImGui::BeginMenu("ファイル"))
    {
        DrawSceneFileMenu();
        ImGui::Separator();
        if (ImGui::MenuItem("シーンのマテリアル参照を保存"))
        {
            string error;
            filesystem::create_directories("Save");
            if (!MaterialManager::SaveSceneReferences("Save/scene_materials.json", error))
            {
                AddLog("Scene save failed: %s", error.c_str());
            }
        }
        ImGui::Separator();
        if (ImGui::MenuItem("終了", "Alt+F4"))
        {
            RequestQuit();
        }
        ImGui::EndMenu();
    }
    if (ImGui::BeginMenu("編集"))
    {
        if (ImGui::MenuItem("元に戻す", "Ctrl+Z", false, !m_UndoStack.empty() || m_HasPendingUndo))
        {
            Undo();
        }
        if (ImGui::MenuItem("やり直し", "Ctrl+Y", false, !m_RedoStack.empty()))
        {
            Redo();
        }
        ImGui::Separator();
        const bool hasSelection = m_SelectedEntity != g_kINVALID_ENTITY && Registry::IsAlive(m_SelectedEntity);
        if (ImGui::MenuItem("複製", "Ctrl+D", false, hasSelection))
        {
            DuplicateSelectedEntity();
        }
        if (ImGui::MenuItem("削除", "Delete", false, hasSelection))
        {
            DeleteSelectedEntity();
        }
        if (ImGui::MenuItem("選択解除", nullptr, false, hasSelection))
        {
            SelectEntity(g_kINVALID_ENTITY);
        }
        ImGui::Separator();
        if (ImGui::MenuItem("Undo History"))
        {
            EditorWorkspaceManager::Get().Registry().ShowEditorType("history");
        }
        if (ImGui::MenuItem("エディター設定", "Ctrl+,"))
        {
            EditorWorkspaceManager::Get().Registry().ShowEditorType("preferences");
        }
        ImGui::EndMenu();
    }
    if (ImGui::BeginMenu("作成"))
    {
        EditorShell::DrawAddMenuItems();
        ImGui::EndMenu();
    }
    if (ImGui::BeginMenu("表示"))
    {
        EditorShell::DrawViewMenuItems();
        ImGui::Separator();
        ImGui::MenuItem("メインツールバー", nullptr, &preferences.ShowToolbar);
        ImGui::MenuItem("ステータスバー", nullptr, &preferences.ShowStatusBar);
        ImGui::MenuItem("パネルヘッダー", nullptr, &preferences.ShowAreaHeaders);
        ImGui::MenuItem("通知トースト", nullptr, &preferences.ShowToasts);
        ImGui::EndMenu();
    }
    if (ImGui::BeginMenu("ウィンドウ"))
    {
        EditorWorkspaceManager::Get().Registry().DrawWindowMenu();
        ImGui::Separator();
        if (ImGui::BeginMenu("Workspace"))
        {
            auto& workspaces = EditorWorkspaceManager::Get();
            for (size_t i = 0; i < workspaces.WorkspaceCount(); ++i)
            {
                if (ImGui::MenuItem(workspaces.WorkspaceName(i).c_str(), nullptr, i == workspaces.ActiveWorkspace()))
                {
                    workspaces.RequestSwitch(i);
                }
            }
            ImGui::EndMenu();
        }
        if (ImGui::MenuItem("Workspaceの初期レイアウトに戻す"))
            EditorWorkspaceManager::Get().RequestReset();
        ImGui::EndMenu();
    }
    if (ImGui::BeginMenu("ヘルプ"))
    {
        if (ImGui::MenuItem("ショートカット一覧", "F1"))
        {
            EditorShell::ToggleShortcutHelp();
        }
        if (ImGui::MenuItem("コマンド検索", "F3"))
        {
            EditorShell::OpenCommandPalette();
        }
        ImGui::EndMenu();
    }

    // Workspace タブはメニューバーから、ツールバー下の専用バー（DrawTabBar）へ移動した
    if (!preferences.ShowToolbar)
    {
        // ツールバー非表示時の再生ボタン
        ImGui::SameLine(0.0f, 12.0f * preferences.UiScale);
        if (ImGui::SmallButton(ProjectManager::IsPlaying() ? "■ 停止##MenuPlay" : "▶ 再生##MenuPlay"))
        {
            ProjectManager::TogglePlay();
        }
    }
    ImGui::SameLine();
    EditorShell::DrawMainMenuRightSide();
    ImGui::EndMainMenuBar();
}

void ImGuiManager::Draw(ID3D12GraphicsCommandList* commandList)
{
    ImGui::Render();
    ImGui_ImplDX12_RenderDrawData(ImGui::GetDrawData(), commandList);
}

bool ImGuiManager::HandleWndProc(HWND hWnd, UINT msg, WPARAM wParam, LPARAM lParam)
{
    if (ImGui::GetCurrentContext() == nullptr)
    {
        return false;
    }
    return ImGui_ImplWin32_WndProcHandler(hWnd, msg, wParam, lParam) != 0;
}

void ImGuiManager::HandleDroppedFile(const char* path, bool hasPoint, float x, float y)
{
    if (path && path[0] != '\0')
    {
        m_DroppedFiles.push_back({path, hasPoint, ImVec2(x, y)});
    }
}

void ImGuiManager::AddLog(const char* fmt, ...)
{
    char buffer[1024]{};
    va_list args;
    va_start(args, fmt);
    vsnprintf(buffer, sizeof(buffer), fmt, args);
    va_end(args);

    const EditorShell::LogLevel level = EditorShell::ClassifyLog(buffer);
    {
        // 修正：ワーカースレッド（非同期の読み込み / 保存）からの AddLog と描画の競合を防ぐ
        std::lock_guard<std::recursive_mutex> lock(m_LogMutex);
        if (!m_Logs.empty() && m_Logs.back().Text == buffer)
        {
            // 同じメッセージの連続は 1 行にまとめる（UE の Message Log と同じ）
            ++m_Logs.back().Repeat;
        }
        else
        {
            LogEntry entry;
            entry.Text = buffer;
            entry.Level = static_cast<uint8_t>(level);
            entry.Time = static_cast<double>(GetTickCount64()) / 1000.0;
            SYSTEMTIME now{};
            GetLocalTime(&now);
            snprintf(entry.Clock, sizeof(entry.Clock), "%02u:%02u:%02u", static_cast<unsigned>(now.wHour),
                     static_cast<unsigned>(now.wMinute), static_cast<unsigned>(now.wSecond));
            m_Logs.push_back(std::move(entry));
            ++m_LogCounts[static_cast<size_t>(level) & 3];
            // 最適化：vector::erase(begin) の O(n) をやめ、deque の pop_front（O(1)）にする
            while (m_Logs.size() > kMaxLogEntries)
            {
                --m_LogCounts[m_Logs.front().Level & 3];
                m_Logs.pop_front();
            }
        }
        ++m_LogRevision;
    }
    EditorShell::PushToast(level, buffer);
    Debug::Log("%s\n", buffer);
}

void ImGuiManager::StyleModernSlim()
{
    // 配色・余白・角丸はエディター設定（Unreal / Blender / Unity / Midnight）から生成する
    EditorPreferences::ApplyNow();
}

void ImGuiManager::DrawAdjustmentPanel()
{
    if (m_ShowAdjustmentPanel)
    {
        ImGui::SetNextWindowSize(ImVec2(360.0f, 520.0f), ImGuiCond_FirstUseEver);
        if (EditorWindowRegistry::BeginEditorWindow("レンダーコントロール", &m_ShowAdjustmentPanel))
        {
            const float fps = World::GetFrameRate();
            ImVec4 healthyColor;
            if (fps >= 55.0f)
            {
                healthyColor = ImVec4(0.34f, 0.86f, 0.62f, 1.0f);
            }
            else
            {
                ImVec4 statusColor;
                if (fps >= 30.0f)
                {
                    statusColor = ImVec4(0.96f, 0.72f, 0.28f, 1.0f);
                }
                else
                {
                    statusColor = ImVec4(0.96f, 0.38f, 0.38f, 1.0f);
                }
                healthyColor = (statusColor);
            }
            ImGui::TextColored(ImVec4(0.28f, 0.78f, 0.92f, 1.0f), "DIRECTX 12  /  DEFERRED");
            ImGui::SameLine();
            ImGui::TextColored(healthyColor, "%.1f FPS", fps);
            ImGui::TextDisabled("%u x %u  |  internal %u x %u  |  %.2f ms", GraphicsDevice::GetWidth(),
                                GraphicsDevice::GetHeight(), GraphicsDevice::GetSceneWidth(),
                                GraphicsDevice::GetSceneHeight(), World::GetFrameTimeMs());

            ImGui::Spacing();
            ImGui::SeparatorText("映像パイプライン");
            m_cameraPostProcess = static_cast<int>(Camera::GetCameraPostProcess());
            if (m_cameraPostProcess < 0 || m_cameraPostProcess >= static_cast<int>(PostProcessType::COUNT))
            {
                m_cameraPostProcess = 0;
            }
            ImGui::SetNextItemWidth(-1.0f);
            if (ImGui::Combo("##CameraPostProcess", &m_cameraPostProcess, m_cameraPostProcessModeItems,
                             IM_ARRAYSIZE(m_cameraPostProcessModeItems)))
            {
                Camera::SetCameraPostProcess(static_cast<PostProcessType>(m_cameraPostProcess));
            }

            m_antiAliasingMode = static_cast<int>(RendererState::m_AntiAliasingMode);
            ImGui::SetNextItemWidth(-1.0f);
            if (ImGui::Combo("アンチエイリアシング", &m_antiAliasingMode, m_antiAliasingModeItems,
                             IM_ARRAYSIZE(m_antiAliasingModeItems)))
            {
                RendererState::m_AntiAliasingMode = static_cast<AntiAliasingMode>(m_antiAliasingMode);
                RendererState::m_TaaFrameIndex = 0;
            }

            DrawUpscaleControls();

            ImGui::Spacing();
            ImGui::SeparatorText("カラー");
            if (ImGui::Checkbox("HDR シーンカラー", &m_HdrEnabled))
            {
                RenderConfiguration::SetHdr(m_HdrEnabled);
            }
            ImGui::SameLine();
            ImGui::Checkbox("ACES", &m_ToneMapEnabled);
            ImGui::SetNextItemWidth(-1.0f);
            ImGui::SliderFloat("露光", &m_Exposure, 0.01f, 10.0f, "%.2f", ImGuiSliderFlags_Logarithmic);

            float postProcessIntensity = Camera::GetCameraPostProcessIntensity();
            const PostProcessType activePostProcess = Camera::GetCameraPostProcess();
            ImGui::BeginDisabled(activePostProcess == PostProcessType::NONE);
            ImGui::SetNextItemWidth(-1.0f);
            float maxPostProcessIntensity;
            if (activePostProcess == PostProcessType::BLOOM)
            {
                maxPostProcessIntensity = 5.0f;
            }
            else
            {
                maxPostProcessIntensity = 1.0f;
            }
            if (ImGui::SliderFloat("エフェクト強度", &postProcessIntensity, 0.0f, maxPostProcessIntensity, "%.2f"))
            {
                Camera::SetCameraPostProcessIntensity(postProcessIntensity);
            }
            if (activePostProcess == PostProcessType::BLOOM)
            {
                float bloomThreshold = Camera::GetCameraBloomThreshold();
                float bloomSoftKnee = Camera::GetCameraBloomSoftKnee();
                float bloomRadius = Camera::GetCameraBloomRadius();
                ImGui::SetNextItemWidth(-1.0f);
                if (ImGui::SliderFloat("Bloom しきい値", &bloomThreshold, 0.0f, 16.0f, "%.2f"))
                {
                    Camera::SetCameraBloomThreshold(bloomThreshold);
                }
                ImGui::SetNextItemWidth(-1.0f);
                if (ImGui::SliderFloat("Bloom Soft Knee", &bloomSoftKnee, 0.0f, 1.0f, "%.2f"))
                {
                    Camera::SetCameraBloomSoftKnee(bloomSoftKnee);
                }
                ImGui::SetNextItemWidth(-1.0f);
                if (ImGui::SliderFloat("Bloom 半径", &bloomRadius, 0.25f, 4.0f, "%.2f"))
                {
                    Camera::SetCameraBloomRadius(bloomRadius);
                }
            }
            ImGui::EndDisabled();

            ImGui::Spacing();
            ImGui::SeparatorText("フレーム制御");
            DrawFpsMeter();
            bool vsyncEnabled = World::IsVSyncEnabled();
            if (ImGui::Checkbox("垂直同期", &vsyncEnabled))
            {
                World::SetVSyncEnabled(vsyncEnabled);
            }
            ImGui::SameLine();
            bool fixedFrameRateEnabled = World::IsFixedFrameRateEnabled();
            if (ImGui::Checkbox("FPS 固定", &fixedFrameRateEnabled))
            {
                World::SetFixedFrameRateEnabled(fixedFrameRateEnabled);
            }
            int targetFrameRate = World::GetTargetFrameRate();
            ImGui::BeginDisabled(!fixedFrameRateEnabled);
            ImGui::SetNextItemWidth(-1.0f);
            if (ImGui::SliderInt("目標 FPS", &targetFrameRate, 15, 360))
            {
                World::SetTargetFrameRate(targetFrameRate);
            }
            ImGui::EndDisabled();

            ImGui::Spacing();
            if (ImGui::Button("GBuffer を表示", ImVec2(-1.0f, 0.0f)))
            {
                m_ShowGBufferWindow = true;
            }
        }
        ImGui::End();
    }
}

#pragma once

struct ID3D12Device;
struct ID3D12CommandQueue;

struct ID3D12DescriptorHeap;

namespace Json
{
    class Value;
}

class ImGuiManager
{
    friend class RenderingValidation;
    friend class MaterialValidation;
    friend class AnimationPreviewWindow;
    friend class SequencerEditorBridgeImpl;
    friend class EditorShell;

  private:
    inline static bool m_IsClosing = false;
    inline static int m_renderMode = -1;
    inline static int m_cameraPostProcess = -1;
    inline static const char* m_renderModeItems[] = {"フォワード", "ディファード"};
    inline static const char* m_cameraPostProcessModeItems[] = {"なし",           "ブラー", "セピア",
                                                                "グレースケール", "反転",   "ブルーム"};
    inline static int m_antiAliasingMode = 0;
    inline static const char* m_antiAliasingModeItems[] = {"なし", "FXAA", "TAA"};
    inline static EntityID m_SelectedEntity = g_kINVALID_ENTITY;
    inline static bool m_ShowSceneViewWindow = true;
    inline static bool m_ShowHierarchyWindow = true;
    inline static bool m_ShowInspectorWindow = true;
    inline static bool m_ResetEditorLayout = false;
    inline static bool m_RenameNeedsFocus = false;
