#pragma once
#include <imgui.h>
#include <cmath>

namespace MaterialOpticsUI
{
    // プリセットの適用や、無関係なマテリアルプロパティの上書きは行わない。
    inline bool Draw(float& ior, float& transmission, float& reflectionRoughness, float& transmissionRoughness,
                     float& thickness, float* absorption)
    {
        if (!ImGui::CollapsingHeader("光学 / 反射・屈折・吸収", ImGuiTreeNodeFlags_DefaultOpen))
        {
            return false;
        }
        bool changed = false;
        changed |= ImGui::DragFloat("屈折率 (IOR)", &ior, 0.005f, 1.0f, 10.0f, "%.3f", ImGuiSliderFlags_AlwaysClamp);
        ImGui::SetItemTooltip("屈折方向とFresnel反射率を同時に変更します。1.0で空気と同じ屈折率。");
        const float ratio = (ior - 1.0f) / (ior + 1.0f);
        ImGui::Text("垂直入射反射率 F0: %.2f %%", ratio * ratio * 100.0f);
        changed |= ImGui::SliderFloat("光学透過率", &transmission, 0.0f, 1.0f, "%.3f", ImGuiSliderFlags_AlwaysClamp);
        ImGui::SetItemTooltip("0 = 不透明の反射・拡散、1 = 透過。アルファとは別の物理パラメータです。");
        changed |=
            ImGui::SliderFloat("反射ラフネス", &reflectionRoughness, 0.0f, 1.0f, "%.3f", ImGuiSliderFlags_AlwaysClamp);
        changed |= ImGui::SliderFloat("透過ラフネス", &transmissionRoughness, 0.0f, 1.0f, "%.3f",
                                      ImGuiSliderFlags_AlwaysClamp);
        ImGui::SetItemTooltip("透過背景のぼけ。反射のRoughnessと独立して編集できます。");
        changed |= ImGui::DragFloat("基準厚み / world unit", &thickness, 0.001f, 0.0f, 65504.0f, "%.4f",
                                    ImGuiSliderFlags_AlwaysClamp);
        ImGui::SetItemTooltip(
            "DXRでは実形状から光路長を求めます。この値はBase Colorの透過色の基準距離と、画面空間近似の厚みです。");
        changed |= ImGui::DragFloat3("吸収係数 RGB / world unit", absorption, 0.01f, 0.0f, 65504.0f, "%.4f",
                                     ImGuiSliderFlags_AlwaysClamp);
        ImGui::SetItemTooltip("Beer-Lambert吸収。赤の係数を上げると赤い光が減衰します。発光色ではありません。");
        // 保存する吸収係数は同じまま、色として編集できるようにする。
        const float referenceDistance = thickness > 0.0001f ? thickness : 0.0001f;
        float attenuation[3];
        for (int i = 0; i < 3; ++i)
        {
            attenuation[i] = std::exp(-absorption[i] * referenceDistance);
        }
        if (ImGui::ColorEdit3("吸収後の透過色（基準厚み）", attenuation, ImGuiColorEditFlags_Float))
        {
            for (int i = 0; i < 3; ++i)
            {
                const float channel =
                    attenuation[i] < 0.0001f ? 0.0001f : (attenuation[i] > 1.0f ? 1.0f : attenuation[i]);
                const float coefficient = -std::log(channel) / referenceDistance;
                absorption[i] = coefficient < 65504.0f ? coefficient : 65504.0f;
            }
            changed = true;
        }
        ImGui::SetItemTooltip("吸収係数と同じ値を色で編集します。白は吸収なし。Base Colorの透過色とは乗算されます。");
        ImGui::TextWrapped(
            "ガラスでもカバレッジは1のままです。Base Colorで透過色、Roughnessで反射のぼけを調整します。");
        return changed;
    }
} // 名前空間 MaterialOpticsUI の終わり。

===== FILE: source\editor\modelmeshtable.h =====
#pragma once
#include "models/modelresourcemap.h"
#include "imgui.h"
#include <limits>

// Call inside BeginTable/EndTable. Names with line breaks may have variable row
// heights, so preserve the full traversal rather than estimating their height.
template<class Visitor> void ForEachVisibleModelMesh(const ModelResourceMap* map, uint32_t meshCount, Visitor&& visit)
{
    if (!map || map->HasMultilineNames(ModelResourceMap::Meshes) ||
        map->HasMultilineNames(ModelResourceMap::Materials) || meshCount > static_cast<uint32_t>((std::numeric_limits<int>::max)()))
    {
        for (uint32_t i = 0; i < meshCount; ++i) visit(i);
        return;
    }
    ImGuiListClipper clipper;
    clipper.Begin(static_cast<int>(meshCount));
    while (clipper.Step())
    {
        for (int i = clipper.DisplayStart; i < clipper.DisplayEnd; ++i) visit(static_cast<uint32_t>(i));
    }
}

===== FILE: source\editor\prefabformat.h =====
#pragma once
#include "ecs/entityhierarchy.h"
#include <json/json.h>
#include <string>
#include <unordered_map>

namespace PrefabFormat
{
    inline bool Validate(const Json::Value& prefab, std::string& error)
    {
        using PrefabEntity = EntityHierarchy::Entity;
        constexpr auto None = EntityHierarchy::None;
        if (!prefab.isObject() || !prefab["format"].isString() || prefab["format"].asString() != "DX12Prefab" ||
            !prefab["version"].isInt() || prefab["version"].asInt() != 1 || !prefab["root"].isUInt() ||
            !prefab["entities"].isArray() || prefab["entities"].empty())
        {
            error = "プレハブの形式またはバージョンが不正です";
            return false;
        }
        std::unordered_map<PrefabEntity, PrefabEntity> parents;
        for (const auto& record : prefab["entities"])
        {
            if (!record.isObject() || !record["id"].isUInt() || record["id"].asUInt() == None ||
                !record["transform"].isObject() ||
                !(record["transform"]["parent"].isUInt() ||
                  (record["transform"]["parent"].isInt() && record["transform"]["parent"].asInt() == -1)))
            {
                error = "プレハブのオブジェクト情報が不正です";
                return false;
            }
            const auto& parentValue = record["transform"]["parent"];
            PrefabEntity parentId = None;
            if (parentValue.isUInt())
            {
                parentId = parentValue.asUInt();
            }
            if (!parents.emplace(record["id"].asUInt(), parentId).second)
            {
                error = "プレハブ内の ID が重複しています";
                return false;
            }
        }
        const PrefabEntity root = prefab["root"].asUInt();
        if (!parents.count(root) || parents.at(root) != None)
        {
            error = "プレハブのルートが不正です";
            return false;
        }
        const auto parent = [&](PrefabEntity entity) {
            const auto found = parents.find(entity);
            if (found == parents.end())
            {
                return None;
            }
            return found->second;
        };
        for (const auto& [entity, ancestor] : parents)
        {
            if (entity != root &&
                (!parents.count(ancestor) || !EntityHierarchy::CanReparent(entity, ancestor, parent) ||
                 !EntityHierarchy::IsDescendant(entity, root, parent)))
            {
                error = "プレハブの親子関係が不正です";
                return false;
            }
        }
        return true;
    }
}

===== FILE: source\editor\proceduralio.cpp =====
#include "pch.h"
#include "proceduralio.h"
#include <DirectXTex.h>
#include <commdlg.h>
#include <shobjidl.h>
#include <shlobj.h>
#include <cmath>
#pragma comment(lib, "comdlg32.lib")
#pragma comment(lib, "shell32.lib")
#pragma comment(lib, "ole32.lib")

namespace ProceduralIO
{
    namespace
    {
        uint8_t ToByte(float value)
        {
            return static_cast<uint8_t>(std::clamp(value, 0.0f, 1.0f) * 255.0f + 0.5f);
        }

        float LinearToSrgb(float value)
        {
            value = std::clamp(value, 0.0f, 1.0f);
            return value <= 0.0031308f ? value * 12.92f : 1.055f * std::pow(value, 1 / 2.4f) - 0.055f;
        }

        float SrgbToLinear(float value)
        {
            return value <= 0.04045f ? value / 12.92f : std::pow((value + 0.055f) / 1.055f, 2.4f);
        }

        wstring Lower(wstring text)
        {
            for (auto& c : text)
            {
                c = static_cast<wchar_t>(towlower(c));
            }
            return text;
        }

        // プロシージャル用の保存・読み込みダイアログは、常にプロジェクトルート
        // （エディターを実行する Render フォルダ）から開き、Windows が記憶した直前のフォルダに依存させない。
        filesystem::path DialogRoot()
        {
            static const filesystem::path root = [] {
                error_code error;
                auto path = filesystem::current_path(error);
                return error ? filesystem::path() : path;
            }();
            return root;
        }

        vector<COMDLG_FILTERSPEC> ParseFilter(const wchar_t* filter, vector<wstring>& storage)
        {
            storage.clear();
            for (const wchar_t* cursor = filter; cursor && *cursor; cursor += wcslen(cursor) + 1)
            {
                storage.emplace_back(cursor);
            }
            vector<COMDLG_FILTERSPEC> specs;
            for (size_t i = 0; i + 1 < storage.size(); i += 2)
            {
                specs.push_back({storage[i].c_str(), storage[i + 1].c_str()});
            }
            return specs;
        }

        // Common Item Dialog の SetFolder で開始フォルダを固定する。GetSaveFileName の lpstrInitialDir は、
        // 2 回目以降、Windows のアプリ別 MRU に上書きされる。
        // 戻り値は 1 が確定、0 がキャンセル、-1 が利用不可（呼び出し元で旧ダイアログへ切り替える）。
        int RunItemDialog(bool save, const wchar_t* filter, const wchar_t* extension, const wstring& name,
                          filesystem::path& result)
        {
            const HRESULT apartment = CoInitializeEx(nullptr, COINIT_APARTMENTTHREADED | COINIT_DISABLE_OLE1DDE);
            const bool uninitialize = SUCCEEDED(apartment);

            struct Scope
            {
                bool Active;

                ~Scope()
                {
                    if (Active)
                    {
                        CoUninitialize();
                    }
                }
            } scope{uninitialize};

            ComPtr<IFileDialog> dialog;
            if (FAILED(CoCreateInstance(save ? CLSID_FileSaveDialog : CLSID_FileOpenDialog, nullptr,
                                        CLSCTX_INPROC_SERVER, IID_PPV_ARGS(&dialog))))
            {
                return -1;
            }
            vector<wstring> storage;
            const auto specs = ParseFilter(filter, storage);
            if (!specs.empty())
            {
                dialog->SetFileTypes(static_cast<UINT>(specs.size()), specs.data());
                dialog->SetFileTypeIndex(1);
            }
            if (extension)
            {
                dialog->SetDefaultExtension(extension);
            }
            if (!name.empty())
            {
                dialog->SetFileName(name.c_str());
            }
            FILEOPENDIALOGOPTIONS options = 0;
            dialog->GetOptions(&options);
            options |= FOS_NOCHANGEDIR | FOS_FORCEFILESYSTEM | FOS_PATHMUSTEXIST;
            options |= save ? FOS_OVERWRITEPROMPT : FOS_FILEMUSTEXIST;
            dialog->SetOptions(options);
            const auto root = DialogRoot();
            ComPtr<IShellItem> folder;
            if (!root.empty() && SUCCEEDED(SHCreateItemFromParsingName(root.c_str(), nullptr, IID_PPV_ARGS(&folder))))
            {
                dialog->SetFolder(folder.Get());
            }
            const HRESULT shown = dialog->Show(GetActiveWindow());
            if (shown == HRESULT_FROM_WIN32(ERROR_CANCELLED))
            {
                return 0;
            }
            ComPtr<IShellItem> item;
            PWSTR path = nullptr;
            if (FAILED(shown) || FAILED(dialog->GetResult(&item)) ||
                FAILED(item->GetDisplayName(SIGDN_FILESYSPATH, &path)))
            {
                return FAILED(shown) ? -1 : 0;
            }
            result = path;
            CoTaskMemFree(path);
            // 保存ダイアログは、種類フィルターが一致するときだけ既定の拡張子を付ける。
            if (save && extension && result.extension().empty())
            {
                result += L".";
                result += extension;
            }
            return 1;
        }

        bool Run(bool save, const wchar_t* filter, const wchar_t* extension, const wstring& name,
                 filesystem::path& result)
        {
            const int modern = RunItemDialog(save, filter, extension, name, result);
            if (modern >= 0)
            {
                return modern == 1;
            }
            // 旧ダイアログでは、lpstrFile に絶対パスを指定する方法だけが開始フォルダを確実に選べる。
            const auto root = DialogRoot();
            wstring initial = save && !name.empty() && !root.empty() ? (root / name).wstring() : name;
            wchar_t buffer[MAX_PATH * 4] = {};
            if (!initial.empty())
            {
                wcsncpy_s(buffer, initial.c_str(), _TRUNCATE);
            }
            const wstring rootText = root.wstring();
            OPENFILENAMEW dialog{};
            dialog.lStructSize = sizeof(dialog);
            dialog.hwndOwner = GetActiveWindow();
            dialog.lpstrFilter = filter;
            dialog.lpstrFile = buffer;
            dialog.nMaxFile = static_cast<DWORD>(size(buffer));
            dialog.lpstrDefExt = extension;
            dialog.lpstrInitialDir = rootText.empty() ? nullptr : rootText.c_str();
            // NOCHANGEDIR: エンジンは作業ディレクトリを基準にアセットを解決する。
            dialog.Flags = OFN_NOCHANGEDIR | OFN_EXPLORER |
                           (save ? OFN_OVERWRITEPROMPT | OFN_PATHMUSTEXIST : OFN_FILEMUSTEXIST | OFN_PATHMUSTEXIST);
            const BOOL accepted = save ? GetSaveFileNameW(&dialog) : GetOpenFileNameW(&dialog);
            if (!accepted)
            {
                return false;
            }
            result = buffer;
            return true;
        }
    }

    bool SaveFileDialog(const wchar_t* filter, const wchar_t* defaultExtension, const wstring& defaultName,
                        filesystem::path& result)
    {
        return Run(true, filter, defaultExtension, defaultName, result);
    }

    bool OpenFileDialog(const wchar_t* filter, filesystem::path& result)
    {
        return Run(false, filter, nullptr, L"", result);
    }

    string ToUtf8(const filesystem::path& path)
    {
        const auto text = path.u8string();
        return string(text.begin(), text.end());
    }

    bool SaveImageFile(const filesystem::path& path, const ProcStudio::Image& image, Encoding encoding, string& error)
    {
        const wstring extension = Lower(path.extension().wstring());
        const bool sixteen = encoding == Encoding::Height && (extension == L".png" || extension == L".dds" ||
                                                              extension == L".tif" || extension == L".tiff");
        ScratchImage scratch;
        const DXGI_FORMAT format = sixteen ? DXGI_FORMAT_R16_UNORM : DXGI_FORMAT_R8G8B8A8_UNORM;
        if (FAILED(scratch.Initialize2D(format, image.Width, image.Height, 1, 1)))
        {
            error = "画像バッファを確保できません";
            return false;
        }
        const auto* target = scratch.GetImage(0, 0, 0);
        for (int y = 0; y < image.Height; ++y)
        {
            uint8_t* row = target->pixels + static_cast<size_t>(y) * target->rowPitch;
            for (int x = 0; x < image.Width; ++x)
            {
                const auto& p = image.Pixels[static_cast<size_t>(y) * image.Width + x];
                if (sixteen)
                {
                    reinterpret_cast<uint16_t*>(row)[x] =
                        static_cast<uint16_t>(std::clamp(p.X, 0.0f, 1.0f) * 65535.0f + 0.5f);
                    continue;
                }
                const bool gamma = encoding == Encoding::Color;
                row[x * 4 + 0] = ToByte(gamma ? LinearToSrgb(p.X) : p.X);
                row[x * 4 + 1] = ToByte(gamma ? LinearToSrgb(p.Y) : p.Y);
                row[x * 4 + 2] = ToByte(gamma ? LinearToSrgb(p.Z) : p.Z);
                row[x * 4 + 3] = ToByte(p.W);
            }
        }
        HRESULT result = E_FAIL;
        if (extension == L".dds")
        {
            result = SaveToDDSFile(*target, DDS_FLAGS_NONE, path.c_str());
        }
        else if (extension == L".tga")
        {
            result = SaveToTGAFile(*target, path.c_str());
        }
        else
        {
            const auto codec = extension == L".jpg" || extension == L".jpeg"   ? WIC_CODEC_JPEG
                               : extension == L".bmp"                          ? WIC_CODEC_BMP
                               : extension == L".tif" || extension == L".tiff" ? WIC_CODEC_TIFF
                                                                               : WIC_CODEC_PNG;
            result = SaveToWICFile(*target, WIC_FLAGS_NONE, GetWICCodec(codec), path.c_str());
        }
        if (FAILED(result))
        {
            error = "画像の保存に失敗しました (HRESULT 0x" + [&] {
                char text[16];
                snprintf(text, sizeof(text), "%08X", static_cast<unsigned>(result));
                return string(text);
            }() + ")";
            return false;
        }
        return true;
    }

    namespace
    {
        bool LoadScratch(const filesystem::path& path, ScratchImage& converted, TexMetadata& metadata, string& error)
        {
            const wstring extension = Lower(path.extension().wstring());
            ScratchImage loaded;
            HRESULT result = E_FAIL;
            if (extension == L".dds")
            {
                result = LoadFromDDSFile(path.c_str(), DDS_FLAGS_NONE, &metadata, loaded);
            }
            else if (extension == L".tga")
            {
                result = LoadFromTGAFile(path.c_str(), &metadata, loaded);
            }
            else if (extension == L".hdr")
            {
                result = LoadFromHDRFile(path.c_str(), &metadata, loaded);
            }
            else
            {
                result = LoadFromWICFile(path.c_str(), WIC_FLAGS_NONE, &metadata, loaded);
            }
            if (FAILED(result))
            {
                error = "画像を読み込めません";
                return false;
            }
            const DXGI_FORMAT target = DXGI_FORMAT_R32G32B32A32_FLOAT;
            if (IsCompressed(metadata.format))
            {
                result = Decompress(loaded.GetImages(), loaded.GetImageCount(), metadata, target, converted);
            }
            else if (metadata.format != target)
            {
                result = Convert(loaded.GetImages(), loaded.GetImageCount(), metadata, target, TEX_FILTER_DEFAULT,
                                 TEX_THRESHOLD_DEFAULT, converted);
            }
            else
            {
                converted = std::move(loaded);
                result = S_OK;
            }
            if (FAILED(result))
            {
                error = "画像フォーマットを変換できません";
                return false;
            }
            return true;
        }
    }

    bool LoadImageFile(const filesystem::path& path, ProcStudio::Image& image, string& error, bool* srgbEncoded)
    {
        ScratchImage converted;
        TexMetadata metadata{};
        if (!LoadScratch(path, converted, metadata, error))
        {
            return false;
        }
        const bool srgb =
            IsSRGB(metadata.format) || (!IsCompressed(metadata.format) && BitsPerColor(metadata.format) <= 8 &&
                                        Lower(path.extension().wstring()) != L".hdr");
        if (srgbEncoded)
        {
            *srgbEncoded = srgb;
        }
        const auto* source = converted.GetImage(0, 0, 0);
        image.Width = static_cast<int>(source->width);
        image.Height = static_cast<int>(source->height);
        image.Pixels.resize(static_cast<size_t>(image.Width) * image.Height);
        for (int y = 0; y < image.Height; ++y)
        {
            const auto* row =
                reinterpret_cast<const float*>(source->pixels + static_cast<size_t>(y) * source->rowPitch);
            for (int x = 0; x < image.Width; ++x)
            {
                const float* p = row + x * 4;
                image.Pixels[static_cast<size_t>(y) * image.Width + x] = {srgb ? SrgbToLinear(p[0]) : p[0],
                                                                          srgb ? SrgbToLinear(p[1]) : p[1],
                                                                          srgb ? SrgbToLinear(p[2]) : p[2], p[3]};
            }
        }
        return true;
    }

    bool SaveDensityVolume(const filesystem::path& path, const ProcStudio::Volume& volume, string& error)
    {
        ScratchImage scratch;
        const size_t n = static_cast<size_t>(volume.Extent);
        if (FAILED(scratch.Initialize3D(DXGI_FORMAT_R8_UNORM, n, n, n, 1)))
        {
            error = "ボリュームを確保できません";
            return false;
        }
        for (size_t z = 0; z < n; ++z)
        {
            const auto* slice = scratch.GetImage(0, 0, z);
            for (size_t y = 0; y < n; ++y)
            {
                for (size_t x = 0; x < n; ++x)
                {
                    slice->pixels[y * slice->rowPitch + x] = ToByte(volume.Density[(z * n + y) * n + x]);
                }
            }
        }
        if (FAILED(SaveToDDSFile(scratch.GetImages(), scratch.GetImageCount(), scratch.GetMetadata(), DDS_FLAGS_NONE,
                                 path.c_str())))
        {
            error = "DDS の保存に失敗しました";
            return false;
        }
        return true;
    }

    bool SaveColorVolume(const filesystem::path& path, const vector<ProcStudio::Float4>& voxels, int extent,
                         string& error)
    {
        ScratchImage scratch;
        const size_t n = static_cast<size_t>(extent);
        if (voxels.size() != n * n * n || FAILED(scratch.Initialize3D(DXGI_FORMAT_R8G8B8A8_UNORM_SRGB, n, n, n, 1)))
        {
            error = "ボリュームを確保できません";
            return false;
        }
        for (size_t z = 0; z < n; ++z)
        {
            const auto* slice = scratch.GetImage(0, 0, z);
            for (size_t y = 0; y < n; ++y)
            {
                for (size_t x = 0; x < n; ++x)
                {
                    const auto& v = voxels[(z * n + y) * n + x];
                    uint8_t* p = slice->pixels + y * slice->rowPitch + x * 4;
                    p[0] = ToByte(LinearToSrgb(v.X));
                    p[1] = ToByte(LinearToSrgb(v.Y));
                    p[2] = ToByte(LinearToSrgb(v.Z));
                    p[3] = ToByte(v.W);
                }
            }
        }
        if (FAILED(SaveToDDSFile(scratch.GetImages(), scratch.GetImageCount(), scratch.GetMetadata(), DDS_FLAGS_NONE,
                                 path.c_str())))
        {
            error = "DDS の保存に失敗しました";
            return false;
        }
        return true;
    }

    bool LoadVolume(const filesystem::path& path, ProcStudio::Volume& volume, string& error)
    {
        if (Lower(path.extension().wstring()) != L".dds")
        {
            return false;
        }
        TexMetadata header{};
        if (FAILED(GetMetadataFromDDSFile(path.c_str(), DDS_FLAGS_NONE, header)) ||
            header.dimension != TEX_DIMENSION_TEXTURE3D)
        {
            return false;
        }
        ScratchImage converted;
        TexMetadata metadata{};
        if (!LoadScratch(path, converted, metadata, error))
        {
            return false;
        }
        ProcStudio::Volume source;
        const size_t w = metadata.width;
        const size_t h = metadata.height;
        const size_t d = metadata.depth;
        // 立方体でないボリュームは、最長辺の立方体を中間データとして再サンプリングする。
        const size_t n = (std::max)({w, h, d});
        source.Extent = static_cast<int>(n);
        source.Density.resize(n * n * n);
        for (size_t z = 0; z < n; ++z)
        {
            const auto* slice = converted.GetImage(0, 0, (std::min)(z * d / n, d - 1));
            for (size_t y = 0; y < n; ++y)
            {
                const auto* row =
                    reinterpret_cast<const float*>(slice->pixels + (std::min)(y * h / n, h - 1) * slice->rowPitch);
                for (size_t x = 0; x < n; ++x)
                {
                    const float* p = row + (std::min)(x * w / n, w - 1) * 4;
                    // 単一チャンネルのボリュームは R を複製し、カラーの場合は輝度を使う。
                    const bool single =
                        (header.format == DXGI_FORMAT_R8_UNORM || header.format == DXGI_FORMAT_R16_UNORM ||
                         header.format == DXGI_FORMAT_R16_FLOAT || header.format == DXGI_FORMAT_R32_FLOAT ||
                         header.format == DXGI_FORMAT_BC4_UNORM);
                    source.Density[(z * n + y) * n + x] =
                        std::clamp(single ? p[0] : p[0] * 0.2126f + p[1] * 0.7152f + p[2] * 0.0722f, 0.0f, 1.0f);
                }
            }
        }
        volume = std::move(source);
        return true;
    }

    ProcStudio::Volume Resample(const ProcStudio::Volume& volume, int extent)
    {
        if (volume.Extent == extent || volume.Extent <= 0)
        {
            return volume;
        }
        ProcStudio::Volume result;
        result.Extent = extent;
        const size_t n = static_cast<size_t>(extent);
        const size_t m = static_cast<size_t>(volume.Extent);
        result.Density.resize(n * n * n);
        auto at = [&](long long x, long long y, long long z) {
            const long long e = static_cast<long long>(m);
            x = ((x % e) + e) % e;
            y = ((y % e) + e) % e;
            z = ((z % e) + e) % e;
            return volume.Density[(static_cast<size_t>(z) * m + static_cast<size_t>(y)) * m + static_cast<size_t>(x)];
        };
        for (size_t z = 0; z < n; ++z)
        {
            for (size_t y = 0; y < n; ++y)
            {
                for (size_t x = 0; x < n; ++x)
                {
                    const float fx = (x + 0.5f) * m / n - 0.5f;
                    const float fy = (y + 0.5f) * m / n - 0.5f;
                    const float fz = (z + 0.5f) * m / n - 0.5f;
                    const long long x0 = static_cast<long long>(std::floor(fx));
                    const long long y0 = static_cast<long long>(std::floor(fy));
                    const long long z0 = static_cast<long long>(std::floor(fz));
                    const float tx = fx - x0;
                    const float ty = fy - y0;
                    const float tz = fz - z0;
                    auto lerp = [](float a, float b, float t) {
                        return a + (b - a) * t;
                    };
                    const float c00 = lerp(at(x0, y0, z0), at(x0 + 1, y0, z0), tx);
                    const float c10 = lerp(at(x0, y0 + 1, z0), at(x0 + 1, y0 + 1, z0), tx);
                    const float c01 = lerp(at(x0, y0, z0 + 1), at(x0 + 1, y0, z0 + 1), tx);
                    const float c11 = lerp(at(x0, y0 + 1, z0 + 1), at(x0 + 1, y0 + 1, z0 + 1), tx);
                    result.Density[(z * n + y) * n + x] = lerp(lerp(c00, c10, ty), lerp(c01, c11, ty), tz);
                }
            }
        }
        return result;
    }
} // 名前空間 ProceduralIO の終わり。

#pragma once
#include "proceduralstudio.h"
#include <filesystem>
#include <string>

// プロシージャルツール用の Windows ファイルダイアログと DirectXTex による画像・ボリューム入出力。
namespace ProceduralIO
{
    // filter は '\0' 区切りの組。例: L"PNG (*.png)\0*.png\0"。キャンセル時は false。
    bool SaveFileDialog(const wchar_t* filter, const wchar_t* defaultExtension, const std::wstring& defaultName,
                        std::filesystem::path& result);
    bool OpenFileDialog(const wchar_t* filter, std::filesystem::path& result);

    enum class Encoding
    {
        Color,  // 線形値を sRGB の 8 ビット値で書き込む。
        Linear, // 法線マップなどのデータはガンマ変換せず 8 ビットで書き込む。
        Height  // 単一チャンネル。格納形式が対応する場合は 16 ビット。
    };
    bool SaveImageFile(const std::filesystem::path& path, const ProcStudio::Image& image, Encoding encoding,
                       std::string& error);
    // WIC / DDS / TGA / HDR 画像に対応。3D DDS は先頭スライスを返す（ボリュームには LoadVolume を使う）。
    // srgbEncoded: 非 null なら、ファイルの値を sRGB とみなして線形化したかを返す
    // （8 ビット以下の非 HDR 画像は true）。格納値そのものが必要な処理（高さの抽出など）で使う。
    bool LoadImageFile(const std::filesystem::path& path, ProcStudio::Image& image, std::string& error,
                       bool* srgbEncoded = nullptr);
    bool SaveDensityVolume(const std::filesystem::path& path, const ProcStudio::Volume& volume, std::string& error);
    bool SaveColorVolume(const std::filesystem::path& path, const std::vector<ProcStudio::Float4>& voxels, int extent,
                         std::string& error);
    // 3D テクスチャでない場合はエラーにせず false を返す。
    bool LoadVolume(const std::filesystem::path& path, ProcStudio::Volume& volume, std::string& error);
    // 折り返しと三線形補間を使って立方体サイズへ再サンプリングする。
    ProcStudio::Volume Resample(const ProcStudio::Volume& volume, int extent);
    std::string ToUtf8(const std::filesystem::path& path);
} // 名前空間 ProceduralIO の終わり。


===== FILE: source\editor\proceduralmodelexport.cpp =====
#include "proceduralmodelexport.h"
#include <Exporter.hpp>
#include <cexport.h>
#include <material.h>
#include <scene.h>
#include <algorithm>
#include <cwctype>
#include <fstream>
#include <limits>

namespace ProceduralIO
{
    namespace
    {
        bool ValidateMesh(const ProcStudio::Mesh& mesh, bool vertexColors, std::string& error)
        {
            const size_t vertexCount = mesh.Positions.size();
            if (vertexCount == 0 || vertexCount > std::numeric_limits<unsigned int>::max() || mesh.Indices.empty() ||
                mesh.Indices.size() % 3 != 0 || mesh.Indices.size() / 3 > std::numeric_limits<unsigned int>::max() ||
                mesh.Normals.size() != vertexCount || mesh.UVs.size() != vertexCount ||
                (vertexColors && mesh.Colors.size() != vertexCount))
            {
                error = "モデルの頂点・法線・UV・三角形の数が不正です";
                return false;
            }
            if (std::any_of(mesh.Indices.begin(), mesh.Indices.end(), [vertexCount](uint32_t index) {
                    return index >= vertexCount;
                }))
            {
                error = "モデルに範囲外の頂点インデックスがあります";
                return false;
            }
            return true;
        }

        bool WriteFbx(const std::filesystem::path& path, const ProcStudio::Mesh& mesh, bool vertexColors,
                      const std::string& diffuseTexture, std::string& error)
        {
            // aiScene がノード・メッシュ・マテリアルと配列の所有権を持つ。
            aiScene scene;
            scene.mRootNode = new aiNode("Procedural Studio");
            scene.mRootNode->mNumMeshes = 1;
            scene.mRootNode->mMeshes = new unsigned int[1]{0};
            scene.mNumMaterials = 1;
            scene.mMaterials = new aiMaterial*[1]{new aiMaterial()};
            aiMaterial& material = *scene.mMaterials[0];
            const aiString materialName("procedural");
            const aiColor3D white(1, 1, 1);
            material.AddProperty(&materialName, AI_MATKEY_NAME);
            material.AddProperty(&white, 1, AI_MATKEY_COLOR_DIFFUSE);
            if (!diffuseTexture.empty())
            {
                const aiString texture(diffuseTexture);
                material.AddProperty(&texture, AI_MATKEY_TEXTURE_DIFFUSE(0));
            }

            scene.mNumMeshes = 1;
            scene.mMeshes = new aiMesh*[1]{new aiMesh()};
            aiMesh& target = *scene.mMeshes[0];
            target.mName = aiString("procedural");
            target.mPrimitiveTypes = aiPrimitiveType_TRIANGLE;
            target.mMaterialIndex = 0;
            target.mNumVertices = static_cast<unsigned int>(mesh.Positions.size());
            target.mVertices = new aiVector3D[target.mNumVertices];
            target.mNormals = new aiVector3D[target.mNumVertices];
            target.mTextureCoords[0] = new aiVector3D[target.mNumVertices];
            target.mNumUVComponents[0] = 2;
            if (vertexColors)
            {
                target.mColors[0] = new aiColor4D[target.mNumVertices];
            }
            for (unsigned int i = 0; i < target.mNumVertices; ++i)
            {
                const auto& position = mesh.Positions[i];
                const auto& normal = mesh.Normals[i];
                const auto& uv = mesh.UVs[i];
                target.mVertices[i] = {position.X, position.Y, position.Z};
                target.mNormals[i] = {normal.X, normal.Y, normal.Z};
                // OBJ と同じ UV 原点で外部ツールへ渡す。
                target.mTextureCoords[0][i] = {uv.X, 1 - uv.Y, 0};
                if (vertexColors)
                {
                    const auto& color = mesh.Colors[i];
                    target.mColors[0][i] = {color.X, color.Y, color.Z, 1};
                }
            }
            target.mNumFaces = static_cast<unsigned int>(mesh.Indices.size() / 3);
            target.mFaces = new aiFace[target.mNumFaces];
            for (unsigned int i = 0; i < target.mNumFaces; ++i)
            {
                aiFace& face = target.mFaces[i];
                const size_t first = static_cast<size_t>(i) * 3;
                face.mNumIndices = 3;
                face.mIndices =
                    new unsigned int[3]{mesh.Indices[first], mesh.Indices[first + 1], mesh.Indices[first + 2]};
            }

            // メモリへ出力してから filesystem::path で保存し、日本語の保存先にも対応する。
            Assimp::Exporter exporter;
            // 同梱 Assimp で再読込を確認できた ASCII FBX を出力する。
            const aiExportDataBlob* blob = exporter.ExportToBlob(&scene, "fbxa");
            if (!blob || !blob->data || blob->size == 0)
            {
                error = std::string("FBX の生成に失敗しました: ") + exporter.GetErrorString();
                return false;
            }
            std::ofstream output(path, std::ios::binary | std::ios::trunc);
            output.write(static_cast<const char*>(blob->data), static_cast<std::streamsize>(blob->size));
            output.close();
            if (!output)
            {
                error = "FBX を書き込めません";
                return false;
            }
            return true;
        }
    }

    bool SaveModelFile(const std::filesystem::path& path, const ProcStudio::Mesh& mesh, bool vertexColors,
                       const std::string& diffuseTexture, std::string& error)
    {
        error.clear();
        auto extension = path.extension().wstring();
        std::transform(extension.begin(), extension.end(), extension.begin(), [](wchar_t character) {
            return static_cast<wchar_t>(std::towlower(character));
        });
        if (extension != L".obj" && extension != L".fbx")
        {
            error = "モデルの保存形式は OBJ または FBX を選んでください";
            return false;
        }
        if (!ValidateMesh(mesh, vertexColors, error))
        {
            return false;
        }
        if (extension == L".obj")
        {
            return ProcStudio::WriteObj(path, mesh, vertexColors, diffuseTexture, error);
        }
        return WriteFbx(path, mesh, vertexColors, diffuseTexture, error);
    }
}

    bool SaveModelFile(const std::filesystem::path& path, const ProcStudio::Mesh& mesh, bool vertexColors,

===== FILE: source\editor\proceduralstudiowindow.cpp =====

// 名前付き名前空間と using 宣言を使う。エンジンのプリコンパイル済みヘッダーは
// DirectX:: と std:: をグローバルへ導入するため、Image / Mesh などの短い名前を漏らさない。
namespace ProcStudioEditorDetail
{
    using ProcStudio::Basis;
    using ProcStudio::Float2;
    using ProcStudio::Float3;
    using ProcStudio::Float4;

    constexpr int kPreviewSize = 512;
    constexpr int kTexturePreview = 256;
    constexpr int kSolidPreview = 48;
    constexpr UINT kUploads = RendererState::g_kFRAME_COUNT;

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    // GPU 側はエディターのディスクリプターで表示する RGBA8 テクスチャ 1 枚。アップロードリングで更新する。
    struct GpuPreview
    {
        ComPtr<ID3D12Resource> Texture;
        array<ComPtr<ID3D12Resource>, kUploads> Uploads;
        array<UINT64, kUploads> Fences{};
        UINT Next = 0;
        shared_ptr<EditorDescriptorLease> Lease;
        string Error;

        bool Ensure()
        {
            if (Texture && Lease)
            {
                return true;
            }
            auto* device = GraphicsDevice::GetDevice();
            if (!device)
            {
                return false;
            }
            Lease = EditorDescriptors::Allocate();
            if (!Lease)
            {
                Error = "プレビュー用のディスクリプタが不足しています";
                return false;
            }
            const auto heap = CD3DX12_HEAP_PROPERTIES(D3D12_HEAP_TYPE_DEFAULT);
            const auto desc =
                CD3DX12_RESOURCE_DESC::Tex2D(DXGI_FORMAT_R8G8B8A8_UNORM, kPreviewSize, kPreviewSize, 1, 1);
            if (FAILED(device->CreateCommittedResource(&heap, D3D12_HEAP_FLAG_NONE, &desc,
                                                       D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE, nullptr,
                                                       IID_PPV_ARGS(&Texture))))
            {
                Error = "プレビューテクスチャを作成できません";
                Lease.reset();
                return false;
            }
            Texture->SetName(L"Procedural Studio Preview");
            const UINT64 bytes = GetRequiredIntermediateSize(Texture.Get(), 0, 1);
            const auto uploadHeap = CD3DX12_HEAP_PROPERTIES(D3D12_HEAP_TYPE_UPLOAD);
            const auto uploadDesc = CD3DX12_RESOURCE_DESC::Buffer(bytes);
            for (auto& upload : Uploads)
            {
                if (FAILED(device->CreateCommittedResource(&uploadHeap, D3D12_HEAP_FLAG_NONE, &uploadDesc,
                                                           D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_GENERIC_READ, nullptr,
                                                           IID_PPV_ARGS(&upload))))
                {
                    Error = "プレビューのアップロードバッファを作成できません";
                    Release();
                    return false;
                }
            }
            D3D12_SHADER_RESOURCE_VIEW_DESC srv{};
            srv.Format = DXGI_FORMAT_R8G8B8A8_UNORM;
            srv.ViewDimension = D3D12_SRV_DIMENSION_TEXTURE2D;
            srv.Shader4ComponentMapping = D3D12_DEFAULT_SHADER_4_COMPONENT_MAPPING;
            srv.Texture2D.MipLevels = 1;
            device->CreateShaderResourceView(Texture.Get(), &srv, Lease->Cpu);
            return true;
        }

        // 全アップロードバッファが使用中なら false を返し、呼び出し元が次フレームで再試行する。
        bool Upload(const vector<uint32_t>& pixels)
        {
            if (!Ensure())
            {
                return false;
            }
            const UINT slot = Next % kUploads;
            if (GraphicsDevice::GetCompletedFence() < Fences[slot])
            {
                return false;
            }
            auto* commands = GraphicsDevice::GetCommandList();
            D3D12_SUBRESOURCE_DATA data{};
            data.pData = pixels.data();
            data.RowPitch = kPreviewSize * 4;
            data.SlicePitch = data.RowPitch * kPreviewSize;
            auto before = CD3DX12_RESOURCE_BARRIER::Transition(
                Texture.Get(), D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_COPY_DEST);
            commands->ResourceBarrier(1, &before);
            UpdateSubresources(commands, Texture.Get(), Uploads[slot].Get(), 0, 0, 1, &data);
            auto after = CD3DX12_RESOURCE_BARRIER::Transition(Texture.Get(), D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_COPY_DEST,
                                                              D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE);
            commands->ResourceBarrier(1, &after);
            Fences[slot] = GraphicsDevice::GetPendingSubmissionFence();
            ++Next;
            return true;
        }

        bool CopyGpuPixels(ID3D12Resource* packed)
        {
            if (!packed || !Ensure())
            {
                return false;
            }
            auto* commands = GraphicsDevice::GetCommandList();
            const auto before = CD3DX12_RESOURCE_BARRIER::Transition(
                Texture.Get(), D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_COPY_DEST);
            commands->ResourceBarrier(1, &before);
            D3D12_TEXTURE_COPY_LOCATION source{};
            source.pResource = packed;
            source.Type = D3D12_TEXTURE_COPY_TYPE_PLACED_FOOTPRINT;
            source.PlacedFootprint.Footprint = {DXGI_FORMAT_R8G8B8A8_UNORM, kPreviewSize, kPreviewSize, 1,
                                                kPreviewSize * 4};
            const CD3DX12_TEXTURE_COPY_LOCATION target(Texture.Get(), 0);
            commands->CopyTextureRegion(&target, 0, 0, 0, &source, nullptr);
            const auto after = CD3DX12_RESOURCE_BARRIER::Transition(Texture.Get(), D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_COPY_DEST,
                                                                    D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE);
            commands->ResourceBarrier(1, &after);
            return true;
        }

        void Release()
        {
            // ディスクリプタープールは未完了フェンスまで再利用を遅延し、リソースはアイドルまで保持する。
            if (Texture || Lease)
            {
                GraphicsDevice::WaitForGpuIdle();
            }
            Texture.Reset();
            for (auto& upload : Uploads)
            {
                upload.Reset();
            }
            Fences = {};
            Lease.reset();
        }
    };

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    // シーンレンダラーとその状態に依存しない、プレビュー用ソフトウェアラスタライザー。
    enum class Shading
    {
        VertexColor,
        Texture,
        Solid,
        Water
    };

    struct OrbitCamera
    {
        float Yaw = 0.7f;
        float Pitch = 0.35f;
        float Distance = 3.2f;
    };

    struct RenderInput
    {
        const Mesh* Geometry = nullptr;
        Shading Mode = Shading::VertexColor;
        const Image* Texture = nullptr;
        // 接空間法線マップ（0〜1 エンコード）。UV から三角形ごとに接線を求めて適用する。
        const Image* NormalMap = nullptr;
        bool NormalFlipY = false; // true: DirectX 規約 (-Y)。
        float UvScale = 1.0f;
        const vector<Float4>* Solid = nullptr;
        int SolidExtent = 0;
        float SolidScale = 1.0f;
        float TerrainGridSize = 0.0f;
        OrbitCamera View;
    };

    float Clamp01(float v)
    {
        return std::clamp(v, 0.0f, 1.0f);
    }

    Float3 operator+(Float3 a, Float3 b)
    {
        return {a.X + b.X, a.Y + b.Y, a.Z + b.Z};
    }

    Float3 operator-(Float3 a, Float3 b)
    {
        return {a.X - b.X, a.Y - b.Y, a.Z - b.Z};
    }

    Float3 operator*(Float3 a, float s)
    {
        return {a.X * s, a.Y * s, a.Z * s};
    }

    Float3 operator*(Float3 a, Float3 b)
    {
        return {a.X * b.X, a.Y * b.Y, a.Z * b.Z};
    }

    float Dot(Float3 a, Float3 b)
    {
        return a.X * b.X + a.Y * b.Y + a.Z * b.Z;
    }

    Float3 Cross(Float3 a, Float3 b)
    {
        return {a.Y * b.Z - a.Z * b.Y, a.Z * b.X - a.X * b.Z, a.X * b.Y - a.Y * b.X};
    }

    Float3 Normalize(Float3 a)
    {
        const float l = sqrtf(Dot(a, a));
        return l > 1e-12f ? a * (1 / l) : Float3{0, 1, 0};
    }

    Float3 Mix(Float3 a, Float3 b, float t)
    {
        return a + (b - a) * t;
    }

    float ToSrgb(float v)
    {
        v = Clamp01(v);
        return v <= 0.0031308f ? v * 12.92f : 1.055f * powf(v, 1 / 2.4f) - 0.055f;
    }

    uint32_t Pack(Float3 c, bool gamma)
    {
        const auto byte = [&](float v) {
            return static_cast<uint32_t>(Clamp01(gamma ? ToSrgb(v) : v) * 255.0f + 0.5f);
        };
        return byte(c.X) | (byte(c.Y) << 8) | (byte(c.Z) << 16) | 0xff000000u;
    }

    Float3 Tonemap(Float3 c)
    {
        // ACES の近似式（Narkowicz）。
        const auto f = [](float x) {
            return Clamp01((x * (2.51f * x + 0.03f)) / (x * (2.43f * x + 0.59f) + 0.14f));
        };
        return {f(c.X), f(c.Y), f(c.Z)};
    }

    Float3 Sky(Float3 direction)
    {
        const float t = Clamp01(direction.Y * 0.5f + 0.5f);
        return Mix(Float3{0.32f, 0.3f, 0.28f},
                   Mix(Float3{0.75f, 0.82f, 0.92f}, Float3{0.3f, 0.5f, 0.85f}, Clamp01(direction.Y)),
                   t > 0.5f ? 1.0f : t * 2);
    }

    Float3 SampleSolid(const RenderInput& input, Float3 p)
    {
        const int n = input.SolidExtent;
        if (!input.Solid || n <= 0)
        {
            return {1, 1, 1};
        }
        const auto wrap = [&](float v) {
            const float scaled = v * input.SolidScale * n - 0.5f;
            return scaled;
        };
        const float fx = wrap(p.X);
        const float fy = wrap(p.Y);
        const float fz = wrap(p.Z);
        const int x0 = static_cast<int>(floorf(fx));
        const int y0 = static_cast<int>(floorf(fy));
        const int z0 = static_cast<int>(floorf(fz));
        const float tx = fx - x0;
        const float ty = fy - y0;
        const float tz = fz - z0;
        const auto at = [&](int x, int y, int z) {
            x = ((x % n) + n) % n;
            y = ((y % n) + n) % n;
            z = ((z % n) + n) % n;
            const auto& v = (*input.Solid)[(static_cast<size_t>(z) * n + y) * n + x];
            return Float3{v.X, v.Y, v.Z};
        };
        const Float3 c00 = Mix(at(x0, y0, z0), at(x0 + 1, y0, z0), tx);
        const Float3 c10 = Mix(at(x0, y0 + 1, z0), at(x0 + 1, y0 + 1, z0), tx);
        const Float3 c01 = Mix(at(x0, y0, z0 + 1), at(x0 + 1, y0, z0 + 1), tx);
        const Float3 c11 = Mix(at(x0, y0 + 1, z0 + 1), at(x0 + 1, y0 + 1, z0 + 1), tx);
        return Mix(Mix(c00, c10, ty), Mix(c01, c11, ty), tz);
    }

    void Rasterize(const RenderInput& input, vector<uint32_t>& out)
    {
        const int size = kPreviewSize;
        out.assign(static_cast<size_t>(size) * size, 0);
        vector<float> depth(out.size(), 0.0f);
        for (int y = 0; y < size; ++y)
        {
            const float t = static_cast<float>(y) / size;
            const Float3 background = Mix(Float3{0.16f, 0.17f, 0.2f}, Float3{0.06f, 0.06f, 0.07f}, t);
            for (int x = 0; x < size; ++x)
            {
                out[static_cast<size_t>(y) * size + x] = Pack(background, false);
            }
        }
        if (!input.Geometry || input.Geometry->Indices.empty())
        {
            return;
        }
        const Mesh& mesh = *input.Geometry;
        Float3 minimum;
        Float3 maximum;
        mesh.Bounds(minimum, maximum);
        const Float3 center = (minimum + maximum) * 0.5f;
        const float radius = (std::max)(sqrtf(Dot(maximum - minimum, maximum - minimum)) * 0.5f, 1e-3f);
        const float extent = (std::max)({maximum.X - minimum.X, maximum.Y - minimum.Y, maximum.Z - minimum.Z, 1e-4f});
        const Float3 offset{cosf(input.View.Pitch) * sinf(input.View.Yaw), sinf(input.View.Pitch),
                            cosf(input.View.Pitch) * cosf(input.View.Yaw)};
        const Float3 eye = center + offset * (radius * input.View.Distance);
        const Float3 forward = Normalize(center - eye);
        const Float3 right = Normalize(Cross(forward, Float3{0, 1, 0}));
        const Float3 up = Cross(right, forward);
        const float focal = 1.0f / tanf(20.0f * 3.14159265f / 180.0f);
        const float nearPlane = radius * 0.01f;

        struct Projected
        {
            float X;
            float Y;
            float InvZ;
            bool Valid;
        };

        vector<Projected> projected(mesh.Positions.size());
        for (size_t i = 0; i < mesh.Positions.size(); ++i)
        {
            const Float3 v = mesh.Positions[i] - eye;
            const float z = Dot(v, forward);
            if (z < nearPlane)
            {
                projected[i] = {0, 0, 0, false};
                continue;
            }
            const float invZ = 1 / z;
            projected[i] = {size * 0.5f + Dot(v, right) * invZ * focal * size * 0.5f,
                            size * 0.5f - Dot(v, up) * invZ * focal * size * 0.5f, invZ, true};
        }
        const Float3 keyLight = Normalize({-0.45f, 0.8f, 0.4f});
        const Float3 fillLight = Normalize({0.6f, 0.25f, -0.6f});
        const bool hasUv = mesh.UVs.size() == mesh.Positions.size();
        const bool hasColor = mesh.Colors.size() == mesh.Positions.size();
        const bool hasNormal = mesh.Normals.size() == mesh.Positions.size();
        for (size_t t = 0; t + 2 < mesh.Indices.size(); t += 3)
        {
            const uint32_t i0 = mesh.Indices[t];
            const uint32_t i1 = mesh.Indices[t + 1];
            const uint32_t i2 = mesh.Indices[t + 2];
            const Projected &a = projected[i0], &b = projected[i1], &c = projected[i2];
            if (!a.Valid || !b.Valid || !c.Valid)
            {
                continue;
            }
            const float area = (b.X - a.X) * (c.Y - a.Y) - (b.Y - a.Y) * (c.X - a.X);
            if (fabsf(area) < 1e-6f)
            {
                continue;
            }
            const int minX = (std::max)(0, static_cast<int>(floorf((std::min)({a.X, b.X, c.X}))));
            const int maxX = (std::min)(size - 1, static_cast<int>(ceilf((std::max)({a.X, b.X, c.X}))));
            const int minY = (std::max)(0, static_cast<int>(floorf((std::min)({a.Y, b.Y, c.Y}))));
            const int maxY = (std::min)(size - 1, static_cast<int>(ceilf((std::max)({a.Y, b.Y, c.Y}))));
            if (minX > maxX || minY > maxY)
            {
                continue;
            }
            const float inverseArea = 1 / area;
            // 法線マップ用の接線・従接線（UV の +u / +v 方向）。三角形ごとに一定。
            Float3 triangleTangent{};
            Float3 triangleBitangent{};
            bool hasTangent = false;
            if (input.NormalMap && hasUv)
            {
                const Float3 e1 = mesh.Positions[i1] - mesh.Positions[i0];
                const Float3 e2 = mesh.Positions[i2] - mesh.Positions[i0];
                const float du1 = mesh.UVs[i1].X - mesh.UVs[i0].X;
                const float dv1 = mesh.UVs[i1].Y - mesh.UVs[i0].Y;
                const float du2 = mesh.UVs[i2].X - mesh.UVs[i0].X;
                const float dv2 = mesh.UVs[i2].Y - mesh.UVs[i0].Y;
                const float det = du1 * dv2 - du2 * dv1;
                if (fabsf(det) > 1e-12f)
                {
                    const float r = 1 / det;
                    triangleTangent = (e1 * dv2 - e2 * dv1) * r;
                    triangleBitangent = (e2 * du1 - e1 * du2) * r;
                    hasTangent = true;
                }
            }
            for (int y = minY; y <= maxY; ++y)
            {
                const float py = y + 0.5f;
                for (int x = minX; x <= maxX; ++x)
                {
                    const float px = x + 0.5f;
                    const float w0 = ((b.X - px) * (c.Y - py) - (b.Y - py) * (c.X - px)) * inverseArea;
                    const float w1 = ((c.X - px) * (a.Y - py) - (c.Y - py) * (a.X - px)) * inverseArea;
                    const float w2 = 1 - w0 - w1;
                    if (w0 < 0 || w1 < 0 || w2 < 0)
                    {
                        continue;
                    }
                    const float invZ = w0 * a.InvZ + w1 * b.InvZ + w2 * c.InvZ;
                    const size_t pixel = static_cast<size_t>(y) * size + x;
                    if (invZ <= depth[pixel])
                    {
                        continue;
                    }
                    depth[pixel] = invZ;
                    // 透視補正済みの重み。
                    const float p0 = w0 * a.InvZ / invZ;
                    const float p1 = w1 * b.InvZ / invZ;
                    const float p2 = w2 * c.InvZ / invZ;
                    const auto interpolate3 = [&](const vector<Float3>& values) {
                        return values[i0] * p0 + values[i1] * p1 + values[i2] * p2;
                    };
                    const Float3 position = interpolate3(mesh.Positions);
                    Float3 normal = hasNormal ? Normalize(interpolate3(mesh.Normals))
                                              : Normalize(Cross(mesh.Positions[i1] - mesh.Positions[i0],
                                                                mesh.Positions[i2] - mesh.Positions[i0]));
                    const Float3 view = Normalize(eye - position);
                    const bool backFacing = Dot(normal, view) < 0;
                    const float u = hasUv ? mesh.UVs[i0].X * p0 + mesh.UVs[i1].X * p1 + mesh.UVs[i2].X * p2 : 0.0f;
                    const float v = hasUv ? mesh.UVs[i0].Y * p0 + mesh.UVs[i1].Y * p1 + mesh.UVs[i2].Y * p2 : 0.0f;
                    if (hasTangent)
                    {
                        // 接空間法線は OpenGL 規約（+Y = 画像の上 = -v）。FlipY なら DirectX 規約から変換する。
                        const Float4 encoded = input.NormalMap->Sample(u * input.UvScale, v * input.UvScale);
                        const float tx = encoded.X * 2 - 1;
                        const float ty = (encoded.Y * 2 - 1) * (input.NormalFlipY ? -1.0f : 1.0f);
                        const float tz = encoded.Z * 2 - 1;
                        const Float3 tangent = Normalize(triangleTangent - normal * Dot(normal, triangleTangent));
                        Float3 bitangent = triangleBitangent - normal * Dot(normal, triangleBitangent);
                        bitangent = Normalize(bitangent - tangent * Dot(tangent, bitangent));
                        normal = Normalize(tangent * tx + bitangent * -ty + normal * tz);
                    }
                    if (backFacing)
                    {
                        normal = normal * -1.0f;
                    }
                    Float3 albedo = hasColor ? interpolate3(mesh.Colors) : Float3{0.8f, 0.8f, 0.8f};
                    if (input.Mode == Shading::Texture && input.Texture && hasUv)
                    {
                        const Float4 texel = input.Texture->Sample(u * input.UvScale, v * input.UvScale);
                        albedo = albedo * Float3{texel.X, texel.Y, texel.Z};
                    }
                    else if (input.Mode == Shading::Solid)
                    {
                        albedo = SampleSolid(input, (position - minimum) * (1 / extent));
                    }
                    const float key = (std::max)(Dot(normal, keyLight), 0.0f);
                    const float fill = (std::max)(Dot(normal, fillLight), 0.0f);
                    const Float3 ambient =
                        Mix(Float3{0.22f, 0.2f, 0.18f}, Float3{0.45f, 0.52f, 0.62f}, normal.Y * 0.5f + 0.5f);
                    const Float3 halfVector = Normalize(keyLight + view);
                    const float nDotH = (std::max)(Dot(normal, halfVector), 0.0f);
                    Float3 color;
                    if (input.Mode == Shading::Water)
                    {
                        const float nDotV = Clamp01(Dot(normal, view));
                        const float fresnel = 0.02f + 0.98f * powf(1 - nDotV, 5);
                        const Float3 reflected = normal * (2 * Dot(normal, view)) - view;
                        const Float3 body = albedo * (ambient * 0.6f + Float3{1, 0.95f, 0.85f} * (key * 0.5f));
                        color = Mix(body, Sky(reflected) * 1.2f, fresnel) +
                                Float3{1, 0.95f, 0.85f} * (powf(nDotH, 180) * 4);
                    }
                    else
                    {
                        color = albedo * (ambient * 0.55f + Float3{1.0f, 0.95f, 0.88f} * (key * 1.15f) +
                                          Float3{0.55f, 0.65f, 0.8f} * (fill * 0.35f)) +
                                Float3{1, 1, 1} * (powf(nDotH, 48) * 0.12f * key);
                    }
                    Float3 displayColor = Tonemap(color * 0.95f);
                    if (input.TerrainGridSize > 0)
                    {
                        const float gridX = (position.X - minimum.X) / input.TerrainGridSize;
                        const float gridZ = (position.Z - minimum.Z) / input.TerrainGridSize;
                        const float distance = (std::min)(fabsf(gridX - roundf(gridX)), fabsf(gridZ - roundf(gridZ))) *
                                               input.TerrainGridSize;
                        const float pixelWidth = 2.0f / (invZ * focal * size);
                        const float coverage = Clamp01(1.0f - distance / pixelWidth);
                        displayColor = Mix(displayColor, Float3{1.0f, 0.7f, 0.15f}, coverage * 0.85f);
                    }
                    out[pixel] = Pack(displayColor, true);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    void BlitImage(const Image& image, bool gamma, int tiles, vector<uint32_t>& out)
    {
        out.resize(static_cast<size_t>(kPreviewSize) * kPreviewSize);
        for (int y = 0; y < kPreviewSize; ++y)
        {
            for (int x = 0; x < kPreviewSize; ++x)
            {
                const float u = (x + 0.5f) / kPreviewSize * tiles;
                const float v = (y + 0.5f) / kPreviewSize * tiles;
                const Float4 c = image.Sample(u, v);
                out[static_cast<size_t>(y) * kPreviewSize + x] = Pack({c.X, c.Y, c.Z}, gamma);
            }
        }
    }

    void BlitVolumeSlice(const vector<Float4>* colors, const Volume* density, int extent, float slice,
                         vector<uint32_t>& out)
    {
        out.resize(static_cast<size_t>(kPreviewSize) * kPreviewSize);
        if (extent <= 0)
        {
            return;
        }
        const int z = std::clamp(static_cast<int>(slice * extent), 0, extent - 1);
        for (int y = 0; y < kPreviewSize; ++y)
        {
            for (int x = 0; x < kPreviewSize; ++x)
            {
                const int vx = x * extent / kPreviewSize;
                const int vy = y * extent / kPreviewSize;
                const size_t index = (static_cast<size_t>(z) * extent + vy) * extent + vx;
                Float3 c{0, 0, 0};
                if (colors)
                {
                    c = {(*colors)[index].X, (*colors)[index].Y, (*colors)[index].Z};
                }
                else if (density)
                {
                    const float d = density->Density[index];
                    c = {d, d, d};
                }
                out[static_cast<size_t>(y) * kPreviewSize + x] = Pack(c, colors != nullptr);
            }
        }
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    // 画像から生成する高さ・法線マップのプレビュー。
    enum class ImageView
    {
        Source, // 元画像
        Height,
        Normal,
        Lit // 法線マップで陰影を付けた平面
    };

    struct ImagePreviewInput
    {
        shared_ptr<const Image> Source;
        shared_ptr<const ProcStudio::ImageMaps> Maps;
        ImageView View = ImageView::Normal;
        bool FlipY = false;
        bool SourceColor = true; // 陰影表示で元画像の色を使う。false ならグレー。
        float LightAzimuth = 0.785f;
        float LightElevation = 0.6f;
        int Tiles = 1;
    };

    // 縦横比を保って正方形のプレビューへ収める。余白は背景色。
    void BlitImageMaps(const ImagePreviewInput& input, vector<uint32_t>& out)
    {
        out.assign(static_cast<size_t>(kPreviewSize) * kPreviewSize, Pack(Float3{0.08f, 0.08f, 0.09f}, false));
        const Image* image = input.View == ImageView::Source   ? input.Source.get()
                             : input.View == ImageView::Height ? (input.Maps ? &input.Maps->Height : nullptr)
                                                               : (input.Maps ? &input.Maps->Normal : nullptr);
        if (!image || image->Width <= 0 || image->Height <= 0)
        {
            return;
        }
        const float aspect = static_cast<float>(image->Width) / image->Height;
        const float drawW = aspect >= 1 ? kPreviewSize : kPreviewSize * aspect;
        const float drawH = aspect >= 1 ? kPreviewSize / aspect : kPreviewSize;
        const float originX = (kPreviewSize - drawW) * 0.5f;
        const float originY = (kPreviewSize - drawH) * 0.5f;
        const float cosE = cosf(input.LightElevation);
        // 接空間の光の向き（+X = 右、+Y = 画像の上、+Z = 手前）。
        const Float3 light = Normalize({cosE * cosf(input.LightAzimuth), cosE * sinf(input.LightAzimuth),
                                        sinf(input.LightElevation)});
        for (int y = 0; y < kPreviewSize; ++y)
        {
            const float fy = (y + 0.5f - originY) / drawH;
            if (fy < 0 || fy >= 1)
            {
                continue;
            }
            for (int x = 0; x < kPreviewSize; ++x)
            {
                const float fx = (x + 0.5f - originX) / drawW;
                if (fx < 0 || fx >= 1)
                {
                    continue;
                }
                const float u = fx * input.Tiles;
                const float v = fy * input.Tiles;
                const Float4 c = image->Sample(u, v);
                uint32_t& pixel = out[static_cast<size_t>(y) * kPreviewSize + x];
                if (input.View == ImageView::Lit)
                {
                    const float ny = (c.Y * 2 - 1) * (input.FlipY ? -1.0f : 1.0f);
                    const Float3 n = Normalize({c.X * 2 - 1, ny, c.Z * 2 - 1});
                    Float3 albedo{0.72f, 0.72f, 0.72f};
                    if (input.SourceColor && input.Source)
                    {
                        const Float4 a = input.Source->Sample(u, v);
                        albedo = {a.X, a.Y, a.Z};
                    }
                    const float diffuse = (std::max)(Dot(n, light), 0.0f);
                    const Float3 halfVector = Normalize(light + Float3{0, 0, 1});
                    const float specular = powf((std::max)(n.Z > 0 ? Dot(n, halfVector) : 0.0f, 0.0f), 40) * 0.15f;
                    pixel = Pack(albedo * (0.18f + diffuse * 1.0f) + Float3{1, 1, 1} * specular, true);
                }
                else
                {
                    // 高さ・法線は保存されるファイルと同じ値をそのまま表示する。
                    pixel = Pack({c.X, c.Y, c.Z}, input.View == ImageView::Source);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    // ウィンドウの状態。
    enum class Category
    {
        Texture,
        Solid,
        Model
    };
    enum class Surface
    {
        VertexColor,
        Texture,
        Solid
    };
    enum class ViewMode
    {
        Model3D,
        Flat2D,
        VolumeSlice
    };

    template <typename T> struct Job
    {
        future<T> Result;
        bool Running = false;
        bool Dirty = true;

        template <typename F> void Start(F work)
        {
            Result = async(launch::async, std::move(work));
            Running = true;
            Dirty = false;
        }

        bool Poll(T& value)
        {
            if (!Running || Result.wait_for(chrono::seconds(0)) != future_status::ready)
            {
                return false;
            }
            Running = false;
            value = Result.get();
            return true;
        }
    };

    enum class TextureSource
    {
        Procedural,
        Image
    };

    // 画像から生成する高さ・法線マップの元。プレビューは長辺 kImageProcessMax に縮小して処理し、
    // 保存時は元ファイルを読み直して元の解像度で処理する（巨大画像を常駐させないため）。
    constexpr int kImageProcessMax = 1024;

    {
        filesystem::path Path;

        filesystem::path PendingPath;  // 読み込み中に次のドロップがあった場合の予約
        shared_ptr<const ProcStudio::ImageMaps> Maps;
        // エクスプローラーからのドロップを受け付ける矩形（クライアント座標）と、記録したフレーム。
        vector<ImVec4> DropRects;
        int DropFrame = -100;
    };

        Image TextureImage;

        bool ReadbackPending = false;
