===== FILE: source\editor\projectmanager.cpp =====
#include "pch.h"
#include "projectmanager.h"
#include "modelmanager.h"
#include "world.h"
#include "animator.h"
#include "camera.h"
#include "timelinesystem.h"
#include "gpuscene/gpuscenechanges.h"

void ProjectManager::Init()
{
    s_State = ProjectPlayState::Edit;
    s_RuntimeSnapshots.clear();
    s_PlaySession = 0;
}

void ProjectManager::Uninit()
{
    s_RuntimeSnapshots.clear();
    s_State = ProjectPlayState::Edit;
}

void ProjectManager::CaptureRuntimeState()
{
    s_EditorDayNight = DayNightCycle::GetSettings();
    s_EditorFog = LocalHeightFog::GetVolumes();
    s_RuntimeSnapshots.clear();
    const auto& entities = Registry::GetEntities();
    for (EntityID entity = 0; entity < static_cast<EntityID>(entities.size()); ++entity)
    {
        if (!entities[entity].IsAlive)
        {
            continue;
        }

        RuntimeSnapshot snapshot{};
        snapshot.Entity = entity;
        snapshot.HasTransform = ComponentManager::HasComponent<TransformComponent>(entity);
        if (snapshot.HasTransform)
        {
            snapshot.Transform = ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<TransformComponent>(entity);
        }
        snapshot.HasAnimation = ComponentManager::HasComponent<AnimationModelComponent>(entity);
        if (snapshot.HasAnimation)
        {
            snapshot.Animation = ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<AnimationModelComponent>(entity);
        }
        snapshot.HasCamera = ComponentManager::HasComponent<CameraComponent>(entity);
        if (snapshot.HasCamera)
        {
            snapshot.Camera = ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<CameraComponent>(entity);
        }
        snapshot.HasPostProcess = ComponentManager::HasComponent<PostProcessComponent>(entity);
        if (snapshot.HasPostProcess)
        {
            snapshot.PostProcess = ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<PostProcessComponent>(entity);
        }
        snapshot.HasTimeline = ComponentManager::HasComponent<TimelineComponent>(entity);
        if (snapshot.HasTimeline)
        {
            snapshot.Timeline = ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<TimelineComponent>(entity);
        }
        snapshot.HasProceduralMotion = ComponentManager::HasComponent<ProceduralMotionComponent>(entity);
        if (snapshot.HasProceduralMotion)
        {
            snapshot.ProceduralMotion = ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<ProceduralMotionComponent>(entity);
        }
        snapshot.HasLight = ComponentManager::HasComponent<LightComponent>(entity);
        if (snapshot.HasLight)
        {
            snapshot.Light = ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<LightComponent>(entity);
        }
        snapshot.HasMaterial = ComponentManager::HasComponent<MaterialComponent>(entity);
        if (snapshot.HasMaterial)
        {
            snapshot.Material = ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<MaterialComponent>(entity);
        }
        s_RuntimeSnapshots.push_back(move(snapshot));
    }
}

void ProjectManager::RestoreRuntimeState()
{
    DayNightCycle::GetSettings() = s_EditorDayNight;
    LocalHeightFog::GetMutableVolumes() = s_EditorFog;
    for (const RuntimeSnapshot& snapshot : s_RuntimeSnapshots)
    {
        if (!Registry::IsAlive(snapshot.Entity))
        {
            continue;
        }
        if (snapshot.HasTransform && ComponentManager::HasComponent<TransformComponent>(snapshot.Entity))
        {
            auto restored = snapshot.Transform;
            restored.IsDirty = true;
            ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<TransformComponent>(snapshot.Entity) = restored;
        }
        if (snapshot.HasProceduralMotion && ComponentManager::HasComponent<ProceduralMotionComponent>(snapshot.Entity))
        {
            ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<ProceduralMotionComponent>(snapshot.Entity) =
                snapshot.ProceduralMotion;
        }
        else if (!snapshot.HasProceduralMotion &&
                 ComponentManager::HasComponent<ProceduralMotionComponent>(snapshot.Entity))
        {
            ComponentManager::RemoveComponent(snapshot.Entity, ComponentType::PROCEDURAL_MOTION);
        }
        if (snapshot.HasLight && ComponentManager::HasComponent<LightComponent>(snapshot.Entity))
        {
            ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<LightComponent>(snapshot.Entity) = snapshot.Light;
        }
        if (snapshot.HasMaterial && ComponentManager::HasComponent<MaterialComponent>(snapshot.Entity))
        {
            ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<MaterialComponent>(snapshot.Entity) = snapshot.Material;
            GpuSceneChanges::Notify(snapshot.Entity, GpuSceneDirtyFlags::Material);
        }
        if (snapshot.HasAnimation && ComponentManager::HasComponent<AnimationModelComponent>(snapshot.Entity))
        {
            ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<AnimationModelComponent>(snapshot.Entity) = snapshot.Animation;
            AnimationModelResource* model = ModelManager::GetAnimModel(snapshot.Animation.ModelId);
            if (!model)
            {
                continue;
            }

            model->InvalidateAnimationPoseCache();
            if (!snapshot.Animation.ActiveAnimationLayers.empty())
            {
                model->UpdateBoneMatrices(snapshot.Animation.ActiveAnimationLayers);
            }
            else if (!snapshot.Animation.CurrentAnimation.empty())
            {
                const string* nextAnimationSelection = nullptr;
                if (snapshot.Animation.NextAnimation.empty())
                {
                    nextAnimationSelection = &(snapshot.Animation.CurrentAnimation);
                }
                else
                {
                    nextAnimationSelection = &(snapshot.Animation.NextAnimation);
                }
                const string& nextAnimation = *nextAnimationSelection;
                float nextTime;
                if (snapshot.Animation.NextAnimation.empty())
                {
                    nextTime = snapshot.Animation.CurrentTime;
                }
                else
                {
                    nextTime = snapshot.Animation.NextTime;
                }
                model->UpdateBoneMatrices(snapshot.Animation.CurrentAnimation.c_str(), snapshot.Animation.CurrentTime,
                                          nextAnimation.c_str(), nextTime, snapshot.Animation.BlendRate);
            }
            else
            {
                model->ResetBoneMatricesToBindPose();
            }
        }
        if (snapshot.HasCamera && ComponentManager::HasComponent<CameraComponent>(snapshot.Entity))
        {
            ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<CameraComponent>(snapshot.Entity) = snapshot.Camera;
        }
        if (snapshot.HasPostProcess && ComponentManager::HasComponent<PostProcessComponent>(snapshot.Entity))
        {
            ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<PostProcessComponent>(snapshot.Entity) = snapshot.PostProcess;
        }
        if (snapshot.HasTimeline && ComponentManager::HasComponent<TimelineComponent>(snapshot.Entity))
        {
            ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<TimelineComponent>(snapshot.Entity) = snapshot.Timeline;
        }
    }
    s_RuntimeSnapshots.clear();
}

void ProjectManager::Play()
{
    if (s_State != ProjectPlayState::Edit)
    {
        return;
    }
    CaptureRuntimeState();
    ++s_PlaySession;
    if (s_PlaySession == 0)
    {
        s_PlaySession = 1;
    }
    s_State = ProjectPlayState::Playing;
    const EntityID gameCamera = Camera::GetGameCameraEntity();
    if (ComponentManager::HasComponent<CameraComponent>(gameCamera) &&
        ComponentManager::HasComponent<TransformComponent>(gameCamera))
    {
        auto& camera = ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<CameraComponent>(gameCamera);
        if (camera.Animation.PlayOnStart && !camera.Animation.Path.empty() && Animator::Play(camera))
        {
            auto& transform = ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<TransformComponent>(gameCamera);
            Animator::Update(camera, transform, 0.0f);
        }
    }
}

void ProjectManager::Stop()
{
    TimeLineSystem::SuspendAudio(true);
    if (s_State == ProjectPlayState::Edit)
    {
        return;
    }
    RestoreRuntimeState();
    Camera::NotifyCut();
    s_State = ProjectPlayState::Edit;
}

void ProjectManager::TogglePlay()
{
    if (s_State == ProjectPlayState::Edit)
    {
        Play();
    }
    else
    {
        Stop();
    }
}

void ProjectManager::TogglePause()
{
    if (s_State == ProjectPlayState::Playing)
    {
        TimeLineSystem::SuspendAudio();
        s_State = ProjectPlayState::Paused;
    }
    else if (s_State == ProjectPlayState::Paused)
    {
        s_State = ProjectPlayState::Playing;
    }
}

===== FILE: source\editor\projectmanager.h =====
#pragma once

#include "ecs.h"
#include "componentmanager.h"
#include "daynightcycle.h"
#include "localheightfog.h"
#include <vector>

enum class ProjectPlayState : int
{
    Edit = 0,
    Playing = 1,
    Paused = 2,
};

class ProjectManager final
{
    struct RuntimeSnapshot
    {
        EntityID Entity = g_kINVALID_ENTITY;
        bool HasTransform = false;
        TransformComponent Transform{};
        bool HasAnimation = false;
        AnimationModelComponent Animation{};
        bool HasCamera = false;
        CameraComponent Camera{};
        bool HasPostProcess = false;
        PostProcessComponent PostProcess{};
        bool HasTimeline = false;
        TimelineComponent Timeline{};
        bool HasProceduralMotion = false;
        ProceduralMotionComponent ProceduralMotion{};
        bool HasLight = false;
        LightComponent Light{};
        bool HasMaterial = false;
        MaterialComponent Material{};
    };

    inline static ProjectPlayState s_State = ProjectPlayState::Edit;
    inline static vector<RuntimeSnapshot> s_RuntimeSnapshots{};
    inline static uint64_t s_PlaySession = 0;
    inline static DayNightCycle::Settings s_EditorDayNight{};
    inline static vector<LocalHeightFogVolume> s_EditorFog{};

    static void CaptureRuntimeState();
    static void RestoreRuntimeState();

  public:
    static void Init();
    static void Uninit();

    static void Play();
    static void Stop();
    static void TogglePlay();
    static void TogglePause();

    static ProjectPlayState GetPlayState()
    {
        return s_State;
    }

    static bool IsPlaying()
    {
        return s_State != ProjectPlayState::Edit;
    }

    static bool IsPaused()
    {
        return s_State == ProjectPlayState::Paused;
    }

    static bool IsSimulationRunning()
    {
        return s_State == ProjectPlayState::Playing;
    }

    static uint64_t GetPlaySession()
    {
        return s_PlaySession;
    }
};

===== FILE: source\editor\sequencerbackend.h =====
#pragma once
// ============================================================================
// ISequencerBackend : Sequencer UI（sequencerwindow.cpp）がエンジンへアクセスする唯一の窓口。
//
//  ・UI は TimelineComponent のデータ編集と ImGui 描画だけを行い、ECS / 再生 / Undo / 描画テクスチャは
//    すべてこのインターフェース経由で扱う（UI 表示処理と Timeline 評価処理の分離）。
//  ・エンジン実装は sequencerbridge.cpp（SequencerEditorBridge）。
//  ・tests/sequencer では偽実装を使い、実際の ImGui でヘッドレスに UI 操作を検証する。
// ============================================================================
#include "timelinecomponent.h"
#include <cstdint>
#include <string>
#include <vector>

enum class SequencerEntityKind : uint8_t
{
    Object,
    Character, // AnimationModelComponent
    Camera,    // CameraComponent
    Light,     // LightComponent
};

class ISequencerBackend
{
  public:
    virtual ~ISequencerBackend() = default;

    // ---- シーン参照
    virtual void CollectDirectors(std::vector<EntityID>& out) = 0;             // TimelineComponent を持つ Entity
    virtual void CollectTrackableEntities(std::vector<EntityID>& out) = 0;     // トラック追加の候補
    virtual void CollectCameras(std::vector<EntityID>& out) = 0;               // カメラカットの候補
    virtual TimelineComponent* GetTimeline(EntityID director) = 0;
    virtual bool IsAlive(EntityID entity) = 0;
    virtual const char* GetEntityName(EntityID entity) = 0;
    virtual SequencerEntityKind GetEntityKind(EntityID entity) = 0;
    virtual EntityID GetEditorSelection() = 0;
    virtual void SetEditorSelection(EntityID entity) = 0;
    virtual bool ReadProperty(EntityID target, TimelineProperty property, int fogVolume,
                              DirectX::XMFLOAT4& value) = 0;
    virtual bool IsSpotLight(EntityID entity) = 0;
    virtual bool IsPhysicallyBasedLight(EntityID entity) = 0;

    // ---- 再生・評価（既存の TimeLineSystem をそのまま使う）
    virtual bool IsSimulationRunning() = 0; // TimeLineSystem::Update が毎フレーム評価している
    virtual bool IsProjectPlaying() = 0;    // Play / 一時停止中
    virtual float GetDeltaTime() = 0;
    virtual float GetProjectFrameRate() = 0;
    virtual void Evaluate(EntityID director, TimelineComponent& timeline, bool cameraCut) = 0;
    virtual void Advance(EntityID director, TimelineComponent& timeline, float deltaTime) = 0;

    // ---- Undo / Redo（既存のエディター履歴に積む）
    // ドラッグ等の操作：変更する直前に BeginEdit、操作終了で CommitEdit。
    virtual void BeginEdit(EntityID director) = 0;  // 編集前の状態を記録（既に記録中なら何もしない）
    virtual void CommitEdit(bool changed) = 0;      // changed なら履歴に 1 段積む
    // インスペクターのウィジェット：描画前に CaptureFrameState、値が変わったら BeginEditFromFrameState。
    virtual void CaptureFrameState(EntityID director) = 0;
    virtual void BeginEditFromFrameState() = 0;
    virtual uint64_t GetHistoryRevision() = 0; // Undo / Redo / 他ウィンドウの編集で変わる

    // ---- 既存エディター UI の再利用
    virtual bool DrawAnimationLayers(EntityID director, size_t trackIndex, TimelineTrackData& track) = 0;
    virtual bool AppendAnimation(TimelineTrackData& track, const std::string& path) = 0;
    virtual bool DrawMonitorFrames(EntityID director, size_t monitorIndex, LiveMonitorBinding& monitor) = 0;
    // 既存のシーン描画結果（追加の GPU パスなし）を現在のカーソル位置に描く。
    virtual float GetPreviewAspect() = 0;
    virtual bool DrawPreviewImage(float width, float height) = 0;
    virtual const char* GetPreviewLabel() = 0;
    virtual std::string MakeAssetRelativePath(const std::string& path) = 0;
    virtual void Log(const char* message) = 0;
};

===== FILE: source\editor\sequencerbridge.cpp =====
#include "pch.h" // プロジェクトのプリコンパイル済みヘッダー（テストでは空のスタブ）
#ifdef min
#undef min
#endif
#ifdef max
#undef max
#endif
#include "sequencerbridge.h"
#include "sequencerwindow.h"
#include "sequencerwaveform.h"
#include "imguimanager.h"
#include "componentmanager.h"
#include "timelinesystem.h"
#include "projectmanager.h"
#include "camera.h"
#include "world.h"
#include "rendertargets.h"
#include "graphicsdevice.h"
#include <filesystem>
#include <memory>

// ImGuiManager の既存機能（選択・Undo 履歴・VMD / 連番 UI）を ISequencerBackend として公開する。
class SequencerEditorBridgeImpl final : public ISequencerBackend
{
  public:
    static SequencerEditorBridgeImpl& Instance()
    {
        static SequencerEditorBridgeImpl bridge;
        return bridge;
    }

    SequencerWindow& Window()
    {
        if (!m_Window)
        {
            m_Window = std::make_unique<SequencerWindow>(*this);
        }
        return *m_Window;
    }

    void Reset()
    {
        m_Window.reset();
        SequencerWaveform::Clear();
    }

    // ---- シーン参照
    void CollectDirectors(std::vector<EntityID>& out) override
    {
        ComponentManager::ForEachComponent<TimelineComponent>([&](EntityID entity, TimelineComponent&) {
            out.push_back(entity);
        });
    }

    void CollectTrackableEntities(std::vector<EntityID>& out) override
    {
        const auto entities = ImGuiManager::CollectSceneEntities();
        out.insert(out.end(), entities.begin(), entities.end());
    }

    void CollectCameras(std::vector<EntityID>& out) override
    {
        const EntityID editorCamera = Camera::GetEditorCameraEntity();
        for (EntityID entity : World::GetView<CameraComponent>())
        {
            if (entity != editorCamera)
            {
                out.push_back(entity);
            }
        }
    }

    TimelineComponent* GetTimeline(EntityID director) override
    {
        if (director == g_kINVALID_ENTITY || !Registry::IsAlive(director) ||
            !ComponentManager::HasComponent<TimelineComponent>(director))
        {
            return nullptr;
        }
        return &ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<TimelineComponent>(director);
    }

    bool IsAlive(EntityID entity) override
    {
        return entity != g_kINVALID_ENTITY && Registry::IsAlive(entity);
    }

    const char* GetEntityName(EntityID entity) override
    {
        if (!IsAlive(entity))
        {
            return "(なし)";
        }
        return ImGuiManager::GetEntityDisplayName(entity);
    }

    SequencerEntityKind GetEntityKind(EntityID entity) override
    {
        if (!IsAlive(entity))
        {
            return SequencerEntityKind::Object;
        }
        if (ComponentManager::HasComponent<AnimationModelComponent>(entity))
        {
            return SequencerEntityKind::Character;
        }
        if (ComponentManager::HasComponent<CameraComponent>(entity))
        {
            return SequencerEntityKind::Camera;
        }
        if (ComponentManager::HasComponent<LightComponent>(entity))
        {
            return SequencerEntityKind::Light;
        }
        return SequencerEntityKind::Object;
    }

    EntityID GetEditorSelection() override
    {
        return ImGuiManager::m_SelectedEntity;
    }

        if (IsAlive(entity))

            ImGuiManager::SelectEntity(entity);
        }
    }

    bool ReadProperty(EntityID target, TimelineProperty property, int fogVolume, DirectX::XMFLOAT4& value) override
    {
        bool valid = false;
        value = TimeLineSystem::ReadProperty(target, property, &valid, fogVolume);
        return valid;
    }

    bool IsSpotLight(EntityID entity) override

               ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<LightComponent>(entity).Type == LightType::Spot;
    }

               ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<LightComponent>(entity).PhysicallyBased;

    // ---- Undo / Redo（ImGuiManager の履歴に統合）
    void BeginEdit(EntityID director) override
    {
        if (!m_EditOpen && IsAlive(director))
        {
            m_EditOpen = true;
            m_EditDirector = director;
            m_Before = ImGuiManager::CaptureEntity(director);
        }
    }

    void CommitEdit(bool changed) override
    {
        if (!m_EditOpen)
        {
            return;
        }
        m_EditOpen = false;
        if (changed && IsAlive(m_EditDirector))
        {
            ImGuiManager::BeginUndoCapture(m_EditDirector, m_Before);
            ImGuiManager::FinalizeUndoCaptureIfIdle(true);
        }
        m_Before = {};
    }

    void CaptureFrameState(EntityID director) override
    {
        // ウィジェット操作中は再取得しない（操作開始時の状態を Undo に使う）
        if (!m_EditOpen && IsAlive(director) && (!ImGui::IsAnyItemActive() || m_FrameDirector != director))
        {
            m_FrameDirector = director;
            m_FrameState = ImGuiManager::CaptureEntity(director);
        }
    }

    void BeginEditFromFrameState() override
    {
        if (!m_EditOpen && IsAlive(m_FrameDirector))
        {
            m_EditOpen = true;
            m_EditDirector = m_FrameDirector;
            m_Before = m_FrameState;
        }
    }

    uint64_t GetHistoryRevision() override
    {
        return ImGuiManager::m_EditRevision;
    }

    // ---- 既存 UI の再利用
    bool DrawAnimationLayers(EntityID director, size_t trackIndex, TimelineTrackData& track) override
    {
        if (!ComponentManager::HasComponent<AnimationModelComponent>(track.Target))
        {
            ImGui::TextWrapped("対象 Entity にアニメーションモデルがありません。");
            return false;
        }
        return ImGuiManager::DrawTimelineAnimations(director, trackIndex, track);
    }

        return ImGuiManager::AppendTimelineAnimations(track, {filesystem::u8path(path)});
    }

    bool DrawMonitorFrames(EntityID director, size_t monitorIndex, LiveMonitorBinding& monitor) override
    {
        bool changed = false;
        auto editEntity = [&](const char* label, EntityID& target) {
            int id = target == g_kINVALID_ENTITY ? -1 : static_cast<int>(target);
            if (ImGui::InputInt(label, &id))
            {
                target = id < 0 ? g_kINVALID_ENTITY : static_cast<EntityID>(id);
                changed = true;
            }
        };
        editEntity("発光メッシュ Entity", monitor.Target);
        editEntity("周辺照明 Rect Entity", monitor.SurroundLight);
        changed |= ImGuiManager::DrawLiveMonitorFrames(director, monitorIndex, monitor);
        return changed;
    }

    float GetPreviewAspect() override
    {
        return GraphicsDevice::GetSceneAspectRatio();
    }

    bool DrawPreviewImage(float width, float height) override
    {
        // シーンビューと同じ描画結果を表示する（追加の描画パス・GPU 同期なし）
        const D3D12_GPU_DESCRIPTOR_HANDLE handle = RenderTargets::GetEditorSceneSrvHandle();
        if (handle.ptr == 0)
        {
            return false;
        }
        // ImTextureData* にキャストすると ImGui 1.92 では「管理テクスチャ」として扱われ、
        // GPU ディスクリプタのアドレスを CPU ポインタとして参照してしまう。ImTextureID で渡す。
        ImGui::Image(static_cast<ImTextureID>(handle.ptr), ImVec2(width, height));
        return true;
    }

    const char* GetPreviewLabel() override
    {
        return ProjectManager::IsPlaying() ? "Game Camera" : "Editor Camera（シーンビュー）";
    }

    std::string MakeAssetRelativePath(const std::string& path) override
    {

    }

    void Log(const char* message) override
    {
        ImGuiManager::AddLog("%s", message);
    }

  private:
    std::unique_ptr<SequencerWindow> m_Window;
    bool m_EditOpen = false;
    EntityID m_EditDirector = g_kINVALID_ENTITY;
    EntityID m_FrameDirector = g_kINVALID_ENTITY;
    ImGuiManager::EntitySnapshot m_Before{};
    ImGuiManager::EntitySnapshot m_FrameState{};
};

===== FILE: source\editor\sequencerwaveform.cpp =====
#include "pch.h" // プロジェクトのプリコンパイル済みヘッダー（テストでは空のスタブ）
#ifdef min
#undef min
#endif
#ifdef max
#undef max
#endif
#include "sequencerwaveform.h"
#include <algorithm>
#include <cmath>
#include <cstring>
#include <filesystem>
#include <fstream>
#include <mutex>
#include <thread>
#include <unordered_map>

namespace SequencerWaveform
{
    namespace
    {
        struct Entry
        {
            State Status = State::None;
            std::shared_ptr<const Peaks> Result;
            std::filesystem::file_time_type WriteTime{};
            uintmax_t Size = 0;
        };

        // ワーカースレッドが終了処理と競合しないよう、意図的に破棄しない。
        std::mutex& g_Mutex = *new std::mutex;
        std::unordered_map<std::string, Entry>& g_Cache = *new std::unordered_map<std::string, Entry>;

        bool ReadExact(std::ifstream& input, void* data, size_t size)
        {
            return static_cast<bool>(input.read(static_cast<char*>(data), static_cast<std::streamsize>(size)));
        }
    }

    bool Analyze(const std::string& utf8Path, Peaks& peaks, std::string* error)
    {
        auto fail = [&](const char* message) {
            if (error)
            {
                *error = message;
            }
            return false;
        };
#if defined(__cpp_char8_t)
        const std::filesystem::path path(reinterpret_cast<const char8_t*>(utf8Path.c_str()));
#else
        const std::filesystem::path path = std::filesystem::u8path(utf8Path);
#endif
        std::ifstream input(path, std::ios::binary);
        if (!input)
        {
            return fail("cannot open");
        }
        char riff[4]{}, wave[4]{};
        uint32_t fileBytes = 0;
        if (!ReadExact(input, riff, 4) || std::memcmp(riff, "RIFF", 4) != 0 || !ReadExact(input, &fileBytes, 4) ||
            !ReadExact(input, wave, 4) || std::memcmp(wave, "WAVE", 4) != 0)
        {
            return fail("not a RIFF/WAVE file");
        }
        uint16_t formatTag = 0, channels = 0, bits = 0, blockAlign = 0;
        uint32_t sampleRate = 0;
        bool gotFormat = false;
        uint64_t dataBytes = 0;
        bool gotData = false;
        while (input && !gotData)
        {
            char id[4]{};
            uint32_t length = 0;
            if (!ReadExact(input, id, 4) || !ReadExact(input, &length, 4))
            {
                break;
            }
            if (std::memcmp(id, "fmt ", 4) == 0 && length >= 16)
            {
                uint8_t bytes[16]{};
                if (!ReadExact(input, bytes, 16))
                {
                    return fail("broken fmt chunk");
                }
                std::memcpy(&formatTag, bytes + 0, 2);
                std::memcpy(&channels, bytes + 2, 2);
                std::memcpy(&sampleRate, bytes + 4, 4);
                std::memcpy(&blockAlign, bytes + 12, 2);
                std::memcpy(&bits, bytes + 14, 2);
                input.seekg(static_cast<std::streamoff>(length - 16 + (length & 1u)), std::ios::cur);
                gotFormat = true;
            }
            else if (std::memcmp(id, "data", 4) == 0)
            {
                dataBytes = length;
                gotData = true;
            }
            else
            {
                input.seekg(static_cast<std::streamoff>(length + (length & 1u)), std::ios::cur);
            }
        }
        if (!gotFormat || !gotData)
        {
            return fail("missing fmt/data chunk");
        }
        const bool pcm16 = formatTag == 1 && bits == 16;
        const bool float32 = formatTag == 3 && bits == 32;
        if ((!pcm16 && !float32) || channels == 0 || sampleRate == 0 ||
            blockAlign != channels * (bits / 8))
        {
            return fail("unsupported WAV format (PCM16 / float32 only)");
        }
        const uint64_t frames = dataBytes / blockAlign;
        peaks = {};
        peaks.SampleRate = static_cast<int>(sampleRate);
        peaks.Channels = channels;
        peaks.Duration = static_cast<float>(static_cast<double>(frames) / sampleRate);
        const double framesPerBucket = static_cast<double>(sampleRate) / kBucketsPerSecond;
        const size_t buckets = static_cast<size_t>(std::ceil(frames / framesPerBucket));
        peaks.Min.assign(buckets, 0.0f);
        peaks.Max.assign(buckets, 0.0f);

        // 1 MB 単位で読み、フレームごとに全チャンネルの平均をピークに積む。
        std::vector<uint8_t> chunk(static_cast<size_t>(blockAlign) * 65536);
        uint64_t frame = 0;
        while (frame < frames && input)
        {
            const uint64_t count = std::min<uint64_t>(frames - frame, 65536);
            if (!ReadExact(input, chunk.data(), static_cast<size_t>(count * blockAlign)))
            {
                break;
            }
            for (uint64_t local = 0; local < count; ++local)
            {
                const uint8_t* sample = chunk.data() + local * blockAlign;
                float mixed = 0.0f;
                for (uint16_t channel = 0; channel < channels; ++channel)
                {
                    if (pcm16)
                    {
                        int16_t value;
                        std::memcpy(&value, sample + channel * 2, 2);
                        mixed += value / 32768.0f;
                    }
                    else
                    {
                        float value;
                        std::memcpy(&value, sample + channel * 4, 4);
                        mixed += std::isfinite(value) ? value : 0.0f;
                    }
                }
                mixed /= channels;
                const size_t bucket =
                    std::min(buckets - 1, static_cast<size_t>((frame + local) / framesPerBucket));
                peaks.Min[bucket] = std::min(peaks.Min[bucket], mixed);
                peaks.Max[bucket] = std::max(peaks.Max[bucket], mixed);
            }
            frame += count;
        }
        return true;
    }

    State Request(const std::string& utf8Path, std::shared_ptr<const Peaks>& peaks)
    {
        if (utf8Path.empty())
        {
            return State::None;
        }
        std::error_code error;
#if defined(__cpp_char8_t)
        const std::filesystem::path path(reinterpret_cast<const char8_t*>(utf8Path.c_str()));
#else
        const std::filesystem::path path = std::filesystem::u8path(utf8Path);
#endif
        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(g_Mutex);
        auto& entry = g_Cache[utf8Path];
        if (entry.Status == State::Loading)
        {
            return State::Loading;
        }
        // 状態確認は数フレームに 1 回で十分だが、stat は安価なので毎回行う。
        const auto writeTime = std::filesystem::last_write_time(path, error);
        const uintmax_t size = error ? 0 : std::filesystem::file_size(path, error);
        if (error)
        {
            entry.Status = State::Failed;
            entry.Result.reset();
            return State::Failed;
        }
        if (entry.Status != State::None && entry.WriteTime == writeTime && entry.Size == size)
        {
            peaks = entry.Result;
            return entry.Status;
        }
        entry.Status = State::Loading;
        entry.WriteTime = writeTime;
        entry.Size = size;
        std::thread([utf8Path]() {
            auto result = std::make_shared<Peaks>();
            const bool ok = Analyze(utf8Path, *result);
            std::lock_guard<std::mutex> workerLock(g_Mutex);
            auto found = g_Cache.find(utf8Path);
            if (found == g_Cache.end())
            {
                return;
            }
            found->second.Status = ok ? State::Ready : State::Failed;
            found->second.Result = ok ? std::shared_ptr<const Peaks>(std::move(result)) : nullptr;
        }).detach();
        return State::Loading;
    }

    bool Range(const Peaks& peaks, float t0, float t1, float& minimum, float& maximum)
    {
        if (peaks.Min.empty() || t1 <= 0.0f || t0 >= peaks.Duration)
        {
            return false;
        }
        const long long last = static_cast<long long>(peaks.Min.size()) - 1;
        long long begin = static_cast<long long>(std::floor(std::max(0.0f, t0) * kBucketsPerSecond));
        long long end = static_cast<long long>(std::ceil(std::max(0.0f, t1) * kBucketsPerSecond));
        begin = std::clamp(begin, 0ll, last);
        end = std::clamp(std::max(end, begin + 1), 1ll, last + 1);
        minimum = 0.0f;
        maximum = 0.0f;
        for (long long bucket = begin; bucket < end; ++bucket)
        {
            minimum = std::min(minimum, peaks.Min[static_cast<size_t>(bucket)]);
            maximum = std::max(maximum, peaks.Max[static_cast<size_t>(bucket)]);
        }
        return true;
    }

    void Clear()
    {
        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(g_Mutex);
        // 解析中のエントリは残す（ワーカーが結果を書き込む先）。
        for (auto it = g_Cache.begin(); it != g_Cache.end();)
        {
            it = it->second.Status == State::Loading ? std::next(it) : g_Cache.erase(it);
        }
    }
}

===== FILE: source\editor\sequencerwaveform.h =====
#pragma once
// ============================================================================
// SequencerWaveform : Sequencer の音声クリップに表示する波形のピーク（min / max）キャッシュ。
//
//  ・WAV（PCM16 / float32、XAudioMusicPlayer と同じ対応形式）をワーカースレッドで 1 回だけ解析し、
//    kBucketsPerSecond 単位のピークに縮約して保持する。UI スレッドは完成済みの配列を参照するだけ。
//  ・ファイルの更新時刻・サイズが変わったら作り直す。
// ============================================================================
#include <cstdint>
#include <memory>
#include <string>
#include <vector>

namespace SequencerWaveform
{
    inline constexpr int kBucketsPerSecond = 400;

    struct Peaks
    {
        float Duration = 0.0f;
        int SampleRate = 0;
        int Channels = 0;
        std::vector<float> Min; // kBucketsPerSecond / 秒、モノラルに縮約済み（-1..1）
        std::vector<float> Max;
    };

    enum class State
    {
        None,
        Loading,
        Ready,
        Failed,
    };

    // 未解析なら解析を開始し、現在の状態を返す。Ready のとき peaks に結果が入る（所有権は共有）。
    State Request(const std::string& utf8Path, std::shared_ptr<const Peaks>& peaks);

    // 同期解析（テスト・ワーカー用）。
    bool Analyze(const std::string& utf8Path, Peaks& peaks, std::string* error = nullptr);

    // 画面の 1 区間 [t0, t1) のピーク。データなしは false。
    bool Range(const Peaks& peaks, float t0, float t1, float& minimum, float& maximum);

    void Clear();
}

    {
        const ImU32 a = static_cast<ImU32>(std::clamp(alpha, 0.0f, 1.0f) * ((color >> IM_COL32_A_SHIFT) & 0xFF));

    }

        value.y = std::min(1.0f, value.y * factor);
        value.z = std::min(1.0f, value.z * factor);

    }

    constexpr TimelineProperty kAllProperties[] = {

        TimelineProperty::CameraFarClip,       TimelineProperty::CameraLockOnOffset,
        TimelineProperty::LightIntensity,      TimelineProperty::LightColor,
        TimelineProperty::LightDirection,      TimelineProperty::LightRange,
        TimelineProperty::LightInnerAngle,     TimelineProperty::LightOuterAngle,
        TimelineProperty::LightBeamDensity,    TimelineProperty::EmissiveIntensity,
        TimelineProperty::EmissiveColor,       TimelineProperty::PostProcessIntensity,
        TimelineProperty::BloomThreshold,      TimelineProperty::BloomSoftKnee,
        TimelineProperty::BloomRadius,
    };

    int InterpolationIndex(TimelineInterpolation interpolation)
    {
        const int value = static_cast<int>(interpolation);
        return value < 0 ? 0 : (value > 5 ? 5 : value);
    }

    const char* kInterpolationNames[] = {"Constant / Step", "Linear", "Ease In", "Ease Out", "Ease In Out",
                                         "Cubic Bezier"};

    bool IsTransformProperty(TimelineProperty property)
    {
        return property == TimelineProperty::TransformPosition || property == TimelineProperty::TransformRotation ||
               property == TimelineProperty::TransformScale;
    }

    bool HasChannelRows(TimelineProperty property)
    {
        return TimelineCurve::ValueDimension(property) == 3 && !TimelineCurve::IsColorProperty(property);
    }

    float DisplayScale(TimelineProperty property)
    {
        return TimelineCurve::IsRadianProperty(property) ? kRadToDeg : 1.0f;
    }

    // ---------------------------------------------------------------- ベクターアイコン
    enum Icon : int
    {
        IconPlay,
        IconPause,
        IconStop,
        IconToStart,
        IconToEnd,
        IconPrevKey,
        IconNextKey,
        IconLoop,
        IconRange,
        IconMagnet,
        IconPreview,
        IconInspector,
        IconPlus,
        IconCurve,
        IconPosition,
        IconRotation,
        IconScale,
        IconLight,
        IconCamera,
        IconFov,
        IconAnimation,
        IconVideo,
        IconAudio,
        IconCut,
        IconCharacter,
        IconTransform,
        IconDot,
        IconKey,
    };

    void DrawDiamond(ImDrawList* drawList, ImVec2 center, float radius, ImU32 fill, ImU32 outline, float thickness)
    {
        const ImVec2 points[4] = {{center.x, center.y - radius},
                                  {center.x + radius, center.y},
                                  {center.x, center.y + radius},
                                  {center.x - radius, center.y}};
        drawList->AddConvexPolyFilled(points, 4, fill);
        if (outline)
        {
            drawList->AddPolyline(points, 4, outline, ImDrawFlags_Closed, thickness);
        }
    }

    void DrawGlyph(ImDrawList* drawList, ImVec2 c, float r, int icon, ImU32 color)
    {
        const float t = std::max(1.0f, r * 0.18f);
        switch (icon)
        {
            case IconPlay:
                drawList->AddTriangleFilled({c.x - r * 0.55f, c.y - r * 0.7f}, {c.x + r * 0.7f, c.y},
                                            {c.x - r * 0.55f, c.y + r * 0.7f}, color);
                break;
            case IconPause:
                drawList->AddRectFilled({c.x - r * 0.6f, c.y - r * 0.65f}, {c.x - r * 0.15f, c.y + r * 0.65f}, color);
                drawList->AddRectFilled({c.x + r * 0.15f, c.y - r * 0.65f}, {c.x + r * 0.6f, c.y + r * 0.65f}, color);
                break;
            case IconStop:
                drawList->AddRectFilled({c.x - r * 0.55f, c.y - r * 0.55f}, {c.x + r * 0.55f, c.y + r * 0.55f}, color,
                                        1.5f);
                break;
            case IconToStart:
                drawList->AddRectFilled({c.x - r * 0.7f, c.y - r * 0.6f}, {c.x - r * 0.45f, c.y + r * 0.6f}, color);
                drawList->AddTriangleFilled({c.x + r * 0.6f, c.y - r * 0.6f}, {c.x - r * 0.4f, c.y},
                                            {c.x + r * 0.6f, c.y + r * 0.6f}, color);
                break;
            case IconToEnd:
                drawList->AddRectFilled({c.x + r * 0.45f, c.y - r * 0.6f}, {c.x + r * 0.7f, c.y + r * 0.6f}, color);
                drawList->AddTriangleFilled({c.x - r * 0.6f, c.y - r * 0.6f}, {c.x + r * 0.4f, c.y},
                                            {c.x - r * 0.6f, c.y + r * 0.6f}, color);
                break;
            case IconPrevKey:
                drawList->AddTriangleFilled({c.x - r * 0.15f, c.y - r * 0.55f}, {c.x - r * 0.8f, c.y},
                                            {c.x - r * 0.15f, c.y + r * 0.55f}, color);
                DrawDiamond(drawList, {c.x + r * 0.35f, c.y}, r * 0.45f, color, 0, 1.0f);
                break;
            case IconNextKey:
                drawList->AddTriangleFilled({c.x + r * 0.15f, c.y - r * 0.55f}, {c.x + r * 0.8f, c.y},
                                            {c.x + r * 0.15f, c.y + r * 0.55f}, color);
                DrawDiamond(drawList, {c.x - r * 0.35f, c.y}, r * 0.45f, color, 0, 1.0f);
                break;
            case IconLoop:
                drawList->PathArcTo(c, r * 0.6f, 0.6f, 5.6f, 16);
                drawList->PathStroke(color, 0, t);
                drawList->AddTriangleFilled({c.x + r * 0.55f, c.y - r * 0.05f}, {c.x + r * 0.95f, c.y - r * 0.45f},
                                            {c.x + r * 0.2f, c.y - r * 0.5f}, color);
                break;
            case IconRange:
                drawList->AddLine({c.x - r * 0.7f, c.y - r * 0.6f}, {c.x - r * 0.7f, c.y + r * 0.6f}, color, t);
                drawList->AddLine({c.x - r * 0.7f, c.y - r * 0.6f}, {c.x - r * 0.35f, c.y - r * 0.6f}, color, t);
                drawList->AddLine({c.x - r * 0.7f, c.y + r * 0.6f}, {c.x - r * 0.35f, c.y + r * 0.6f}, color, t);
                drawList->AddLine({c.x + r * 0.7f, c.y - r * 0.6f}, {c.x + r * 0.7f, c.y + r * 0.6f}, color, t);
                drawList->AddLine({c.x + r * 0.7f, c.y - r * 0.6f}, {c.x + r * 0.35f, c.y - r * 0.6f}, color, t);
                drawList->AddLine({c.x + r * 0.7f, c.y + r * 0.6f}, {c.x + r * 0.35f, c.y + r * 0.6f}, color, t);
                drawList->AddRectFilled({c.x - r * 0.25f, c.y - r * 0.2f}, {c.x + r * 0.25f, c.y + r * 0.2f}, color);
                break;
            case IconMagnet:
                drawList->PathArcTo({c.x, c.y}, r * 0.55f, 0.0f, 3.1416f, 12);
                drawList->PathStroke(color, 0, t * 1.6f);
                drawList->AddLine({c.x - r * 0.55f, c.y}, {c.x - r * 0.55f, c.y - r * 0.6f}, color, t * 1.6f);
                drawList->AddLine({c.x + r * 0.55f, c.y}, {c.x + r * 0.55f, c.y - r * 0.6f}, color, t * 1.6f);
                break;
            case IconPreview:
            case IconCamera:
                drawList->AddRectFilled({c.x - r * 0.75f, c.y - r * 0.45f}, {c.x + r * 0.3f, c.y + r * 0.45f}, color,
                                        2.0f);
                drawList->AddTriangleFilled({c.x + r * 0.3f, c.y}, {c.x + r * 0.8f, c.y - r * 0.4f},
                                            {c.x + r * 0.8f, c.y + r * 0.4f}, color);
                break;
            case IconInspector:
                drawList->AddRect({c.x - r * 0.7f, c.y - r * 0.6f}, {c.x + r * 0.7f, c.y + r * 0.6f}, color, 1.5f, 0,
                                  t);
                drawList->AddRectFilled({c.x + r * 0.1f, c.y - r * 0.6f}, {c.x + r * 0.7f, c.y + r * 0.6f}, color);
                break;
            case IconPlus:
                drawList->AddLine({c.x - r * 0.6f, c.y}, {c.x + r * 0.6f, c.y}, color, t * 1.4f);
                drawList->AddLine({c.x, c.y - r * 0.6f}, {c.x, c.y + r * 0.6f}, color, t * 1.4f);
                break;
            case IconCurve:
                drawList->AddBezierCubic({c.x - r * 0.75f, c.y + r * 0.55f}, {c.x - r * 0.1f, c.y + r * 0.55f},
                                         {c.x + r * 0.1f, c.y - r * 0.55f}, {c.x + r * 0.75f, c.y - r * 0.55f}, color,
                                         t * 1.3f, 12);
                break;
            case IconPosition:
                drawList->AddLine({c.x - r * 0.7f, c.y}, {c.x + r * 0.7f, c.y}, color, t);
                drawList->AddLine({c.x, c.y - r * 0.7f}, {c.x, c.y + r * 0.7f}, color, t);
                drawList->AddTriangleFilled({c.x + r * 0.8f, c.y}, {c.x + r * 0.45f, c.y - r * 0.25f},
                                            {c.x + r * 0.45f, c.y + r * 0.25f}, color);
                drawList->AddTriangleFilled({c.x - r * 0.8f, c.y}, {c.x - r * 0.45f, c.y + r * 0.25f},
                                            {c.x - r * 0.45f, c.y - r * 0.25f}, color);
                drawList->AddTriangleFilled({c.x, c.y - r * 0.8f}, {c.x + r * 0.25f, c.y - r * 0.45f},
                                            {c.x - r * 0.25f, c.y - r * 0.45f}, color);
                drawList->AddTriangleFilled({c.x, c.y + r * 0.8f}, {c.x - r * 0.25f, c.y + r * 0.45f},
                                            {c.x + r * 0.25f, c.y + r * 0.45f}, color);
                break;
            case IconRotation:
                drawList->PathArcTo(c, r * 0.6f, -2.6f, 2.0f, 16);
                drawList->PathStroke(color, 0, t * 1.3f);
                drawList->AddTriangleFilled({c.x - r * 0.15f, c.y + r * 0.35f}, {c.x - r * 0.75f, c.y + r * 0.6f},
                                            {c.x - r * 0.25f, c.y + r * 0.95f}, color);
                break;
            case IconScale:
                drawList->AddRect({c.x - r * 0.7f, c.y - r * 0.1f}, {c.x + r * 0.1f, c.y + r * 0.7f}, color, 0.0f, 0, t);
                drawList->AddLine({c.x - r * 0.1f, c.y + r * 0.1f}, {c.x + r * 0.7f, c.y - r * 0.7f}, color, t);
                drawList->AddTriangleFilled({c.x + r * 0.75f, c.y - r * 0.75f}, {c.x + r * 0.2f, c.y - r * 0.65f},
                                            {c.x + r * 0.65f, c.y - r * 0.2f}, color);
                break;
            case IconLight:
                drawList->AddCircleFilled({c.x, c.y - r * 0.1f}, r * 0.42f, color, 16);
                drawList->AddRectFilled({c.x - r * 0.22f, c.y + r * 0.35f}, {c.x + r * 0.22f, c.y + r * 0.7f}, color);
                for (int ray = 0; ray < 5; ++ray)
                {
                    const float angle = -3.1416f + ray * 0.785f;
                    drawList->AddLine({c.x + std::cos(angle) * r * 0.6f, c.y - r * 0.1f + std::sin(angle) * r * 0.6f},
                                      {c.x + std::cos(angle) * r * 0.9f, c.y - r * 0.1f + std::sin(angle) * r * 0.9f},
                                      color, t);
                }
                break;
            case IconFov:
                drawList->AddLine({c.x - r * 0.7f, c.y}, {c.x + r * 0.7f, c.y - r * 0.6f}, color, t);
                drawList->AddLine({c.x - r * 0.7f, c.y}, {c.x + r * 0.7f, c.y + r * 0.6f}, color, t);
                drawList->PathArcTo({c.x - r * 0.7f, c.y}, r * 0.9f, -0.5f, 0.5f, 8);
                drawList->PathStroke(color, 0, t);
                break;
            case IconAnimation:
            case IconCharacter:
                drawList->AddCircleFilled({c.x, c.y - r * 0.5f}, r * 0.28f, color, 12);
                drawList->AddLine({c.x, c.y - r * 0.2f}, {c.x, c.y + r * 0.3f}, color, t * 1.3f);
                drawList->AddLine({c.x - r * 0.55f, c.y - r * 0.05f}, {c.x + r * 0.55f, c.y - r * 0.05f}, color, t);
                drawList->AddLine({c.x, c.y + r * 0.3f}, {c.x - r * 0.4f, c.y + r * 0.85f}, color, t);
                drawList->AddLine({c.x, c.y + r * 0.3f}, {c.x + r * 0.4f, c.y + r * 0.85f}, color, t);
                break;
            case IconVideo:
                drawList->AddRect({c.x - r * 0.8f, c.y - r * 0.55f}, {c.x + r * 0.8f, c.y + r * 0.55f}, color, 1.5f, 0,
                                  t);
                drawList->AddTriangleFilled({c.x - r * 0.2f, c.y - r * 0.3f}, {c.x + r * 0.35f, c.y},
                                            {c.x - r * 0.2f, c.y + r * 0.3f}, color);
                break;
            case IconAudio:
                for (int bar = 0; bar < 5; ++bar)
                {
                    static const float heights[5] = {0.35f, 0.7f, 0.95f, 0.55f, 0.3f};
                    const float x = c.x - r * 0.7f + bar * r * 0.35f;
                    drawList->AddLine({x, c.y - r * heights[bar] * 0.8f}, {x, c.y + r * heights[bar] * 0.8f}, color,
                                      t * 1.3f);
                }
                break;
            case IconCut:
                drawList->AddLine({c.x - r * 0.6f, c.y - r * 0.7f}, {c.x + r * 0.4f, c.y + r * 0.4f}, color, t);
                drawList->AddLine({c.x + r * 0.6f, c.y - r * 0.7f}, {c.x - r * 0.4f, c.y + r * 0.4f}, color, t);
                drawList->AddCircle({c.x - r * 0.5f, c.y + r * 0.55f}, r * 0.22f, color, 10, t);
                drawList->AddCircle({c.x + r * 0.5f, c.y + r * 0.55f}, r * 0.22f, color, 10, t);
                break;
            case IconTransform:
                drawList->AddRect({c.x - r * 0.6f, c.y - r * 0.6f}, {c.x + r * 0.6f, c.y + r * 0.6f}, color, 2.0f, 0, t);
                drawList->AddLine({c.x - r * 0.25f, c.y}, {c.x + r * 0.25f, c.y}, color, t);
                drawList->AddLine({c.x, c.y - r * 0.25f}, {c.x, c.y + r * 0.25f}, color, t);
                break;
            case IconKey:
                DrawDiamond(drawList, c, r * 0.6f, color, 0, 1.0f);
                break;
            case IconDot:
            default:
                drawList->AddCircleFilled(c, r * 0.3f, color, 10);
                break;
        }
    }

    int CategoryIcon(SequencerWindow::Category category)
    {
        using C = SequencerWindow::Category;
        switch (category)
        {
            case C::Position:
                return IconPosition;
            case C::Rotation:
                return IconRotation;
            case C::Scale:
                return IconScale;
            case C::Light:
                return IconLight;
            case C::CameraFov:
                return IconFov;
            case C::Camera:
                return IconCamera;
            case C::Animation:
                return IconAnimation;
            case C::Video:
                return IconVideo;
            case C::Audio:
                return IconAudio;
            case C::CameraCut:
                return IconCut;
            case C::Character:
                return IconCharacter;
            case C::Transform:
                return IconTransform;
            default:
                return IconDot;
        }
    }

    // ---------------------------------------------------------------- 表示設定の保存（ImGui .cfg）
    SequencerWindow::ViewSettings g_PersistedSettings;
    bool g_PersistedLoaded = false;

    void* SettingsReadOpen(ImGuiContext*, ImGuiSettingsHandler*, const char* name)
    {
        return std::strcmp(name, "Main") == 0 ? static_cast<void*>(&g_PersistedSettings) : nullptr;
    }

    void SettingsReadLine(ImGuiContext*, ImGuiSettingsHandler*, void* entry, const char* line)
    {
        auto& s = *static_cast<SequencerWindow::ViewSettings*>(entry);
        float f = 0.0f;
        int i = 0;
        int a = 0, b = 0, c = 0, d = 0;
        g_PersistedLoaded = true;
        if (std::sscanf(line, "PixelsPerSecond=%f", &f) == 1)
        {
            s.PixelsPerSecond = std::clamp(f, 1.0f, 5000.0f);
        }
        else if (std::sscanf(line, "ViewStart=%f", &f) == 1)
        {
            s.ViewStart = f;
        }
        else if (std::sscanf(line, "TreeWidth=%f", &f) == 1)
        {
            s.TreeWidth = std::clamp(f, 120.0f, 900.0f);
        }
        else if (std::sscanf(line, "InspectorWidth=%f", &f) == 1)
        {
            s.InspectorWidth = std::clamp(f, 180.0f, 900.0f);
        }
        else if (std::sscanf(line, "RowHeight=%f", &f) == 1)
        {
            s.RowHeight = std::clamp(f, 16.0f, 64.0f);
        }
        else if (std::sscanf(line, "PreviewHeight=%f", &f) == 1)
        {
            s.PreviewHeight = std::clamp(f, 60.0f, 600.0f);
        }
        else if (std::sscanf(line, "Mode=%d", &i) == 1)
        {
            s.ModeValue = std::clamp(i, 0, 2);
        }
        else if (std::sscanf(line, "TimeFormat=%d", &i) == 1)
        {
            s.TimeFormatValue = std::clamp(i, 0, 3);
        }
        else if (std::sscanf(line, "Snap=%d", &i) == 1)
        {
            s.SnapValue = std::clamp(i, 0, 4);
        }
        else if (std::sscanf(line, "ShowPreview=%d", &i) == 1)
        {
            s.ShowPreview = i != 0;
        }
        else if (std::sscanf(line, "ShowInspector=%d", &i) == 1)
        {
            s.ShowInspector = i != 0;
        }
        else if (std::sscanf(line, "Magnet=%d", &i) == 1)
        {
            s.Magnet = i != 0;
        }
        else if (std::sscanf(line, "InlineCurves=%d", &i) == 1)
        {
            s.InlineCurves = i != 0;
        }
        else if (std::sscanf(line, "Range=%d,%f", &i, &f) == 2)
        {
            s.RangeEnabled = i != 0;
            s.RangeIn = f;
        }
        else if (std::sscanf(line, "RangeOut=%f", &f) == 1)
        {
            s.RangeOut = f;
        }
        else if (std::sscanf(line, "CurveChannels=%d,%d,%d,%d", &a, &b, &c, &d) == 4)
        {
            s.CurveChannels[0] = a != 0;
            s.CurveChannels[1] = b != 0;
            s.CurveChannels[2] = c != 0;
            s.CurveChannels[3] = d != 0;
        }
    }

    void SettingsWriteAll(ImGuiContext*, ImGuiSettingsHandler* handler, ImGuiTextBuffer* buffer)
    {
        const auto& s = g_PersistedSettings;
        buffer->appendf("[%s][Main]\n", handler->TypeName);
        buffer->appendf("PixelsPerSecond=%.3f\nViewStart=%.4f\nTreeWidth=%.1f\nInspectorWidth=%.1f\n", s.PixelsPerSecond,
                        s.ViewStart, s.TreeWidth, s.InspectorWidth);
        buffer->appendf("RowHeight=%.1f\nPreviewHeight=%.1f\nMode=%d\nTimeFormat=%d\nSnap=%d\n", s.RowHeight,
                        s.PreviewHeight, s.ModeValue, s.TimeFormatValue, s.SnapValue);
        buffer->appendf("ShowPreview=%d\nShowInspector=%d\nMagnet=%d\nInlineCurves=%d\n", s.ShowPreview ? 1 : 0,
                        s.ShowInspector ? 1 : 0, s.Magnet ? 1 : 0, s.InlineCurves ? 1 : 0);
        buffer->appendf("Range=%d,%.4f\nRangeOut=%.4f\nCurveChannels=%d,%d,%d,%d\n\n", s.RangeEnabled ? 1 : 0,
                        s.RangeIn, s.RangeOut, s.CurveChannels[0] ? 1 : 0, s.CurveChannels[1] ? 1 : 0,
                        s.CurveChannels[2] ? 1 : 0, s.CurveChannels[3] ? 1 : 0);
    }

    bool SameSettings(const SequencerWindow::ViewSettings& a, const SequencerWindow::ViewSettings& b)
    {
        return std::memcmp(&a, &b, sizeof(a)) == 0;
    }

    ImGuiID HashRow(EntityID entity, int kind, int a, int b)
    {
        const int data[4] = {static_cast<int>(entity), kind, a, b};
        return ImHashData(data, sizeof(data));
    }
} // namespace

// ============================================================================
// 構築・設定
// ============================================================================
SequencerWindow::SequencerWindow(ISequencerBackend& backend) : m_Backend(backend)
{
    m_Settings = g_PersistedSettings;
    m_SavedSettings = m_Settings;
    m_Rows.reserve(256);
    m_VisibleRows.reserve(256);
    m_ScratchTimes.reserve(256);
    m_ScratchPoints.reserve(1024);
}

SequencerWindow::~SequencerWindow() = default;

void SequencerWindow::RegisterSettingsHandler()
{
    ImGuiContext* context = ImGui::GetCurrentContext();
    if (!context || ImGui::FindSettingsHandler("RPSequencer"))
    {
        return;
    }
    ImGuiSettingsHandler handler;
    handler.TypeName = "RPSequencer";
    handler.TypeHash = ImHashStr("RPSequencer");
    handler.ReadOpenFn = SettingsReadOpen;
    handler.ReadLineFn = SettingsReadLine;
    handler.WriteAllFn = SettingsWriteAll;
    ImGui::AddSettingsHandler(&handler);
}

void SequencerWindow::SetDirector(EntityID director)
{
    if (director != m_Director)
    {
        m_Director = director;
        m_SelectedKeys.clear();
        m_SelectedClips.clear();
        m_SelectedRows.clear();
        m_ActiveRow = 0;
        m_Drag = Drag::None;
        m_LastChecksum = 0;
    }
    m_DirectorPinned = director != g_kINVALID_ENTITY;
}

float SequencerWindow::GetFrameRate() const
{
    const TimelineComponent* timeline =
        m_Director != g_kINVALID_ENTITY ? const_cast<ISequencerBackend&>(m_Backend).GetTimeline(m_Director) : nullptr;
    if (timeline && timeline->FrameRate > 0.0f)
    {
        return timeline->FrameRate;
    }
    const float project = const_cast<ISequencerBackend&>(m_Backend).GetProjectFrameRate();
    return project > 0.0f ? project : 60.0f;
}

float SequencerWindow::TimeToX(float time) const
{
    return m_TimelineMin.x + (time - m_Settings.ViewStart) * m_Settings.PixelsPerSecond;
}

float SequencerWindow::XToTime(float x) const
{
    return m_Settings.ViewStart + (x - m_TimelineMin.x) / m_Settings.PixelsPerSecond;
}

ImU32 SequencerWindow::CategoryColor(Category category, float alpha) const
{
    ImU32 color;
    switch (category)
    {
        case Category::Position:
            color = IM_COL32(72, 140, 255, 255); // 青
            break;
        case Category::Rotation:
            color = IM_COL32(170, 100, 255, 255); // 紫
            break;
        case Category::Scale:
            color = IM_COL32(80, 205, 110, 255); // 緑
            break;
        case Category::Light:
            color = IM_COL32(255, 152, 48, 255); // オレンジ
            break;
        case Category::CameraFov:
            color = IM_COL32(250, 214, 60, 255); // 黄色
            break;
        case Category::Animation:
        case Category::Character:
            color = IM_COL32(255, 110, 180, 255); // ピンク
            break;
        case Category::Video:
            color = IM_COL32(125, 100, 255, 255); // 青紫
            break;
        case Category::Audio:
            color = IM_COL32(40, 200, 150, 255); // エメラルドグリーン
            break;
        case Category::Camera:
            color = IM_COL32(230, 205, 90, 255);
            break;
        case Category::CameraCut:
            color = IM_COL32(90, 200, 230, 255);
            break;
        case Category::Transform:
            color = IM_COL32(150, 170, 210, 255);
            break;
        default:
            color = IM_COL32(150, 160, 180, 255);
            break;
    }
    return WithAlpha(color, alpha);
}

void SequencerWindow::FormatTime(float time, char* buffer, size_t size) const
{
    const TimelineComponent* timeline =
        m_Director != g_kINVALID_ENTITY ? const_cast<ISequencerBackend&>(m_Backend).GetTimeline(m_Director) : nullptr;
    const float fps = GetFrameRate();
    switch (static_cast<TimeFormat>(m_Settings.TimeFormatValue))
    {
        case TimeFormat::Frames:
            std::snprintf(buffer, size, "%d f", static_cast<int>(std::lround(time * fps)));
            break;
        case TimeFormat::Timecode:
        {
            const bool negative = time < 0.0f;
            const long long frames = std::llround(std::fabs(time) * fps);
            const long long perSecond = std::max(1ll, static_cast<long long>(std::lround(fps)));
            const long long seconds = frames / perSecond;
            std::snprintf(buffer, size, "%s%02lld:%02lld:%02lld", negative ? "-" : "", seconds / 60, seconds % 60,
                          frames % perSecond);
            break;
        }
        case TimeFormat::Beats:
        {
            const float bpm = timeline ? std::max(1.0f, timeline->BeatsPerMinute) : 120.0f;
            const int perBar = timeline ? std::max(1, timeline->BeatsPerBar) : 4;
            const double beat = (time - (timeline ? timeline->BeatOffset : 0.0f)) * bpm / 60.0;
            const double whole = std::floor(beat + 1.0e-6);
            const long long beatIndex = static_cast<long long>(whole);
            long long bar = beatIndex >= 0 ? beatIndex / perBar : -((-beatIndex + perBar - 1) / perBar);
            const long long inBar = beatIndex - bar * perBar;
            const int sub = static_cast<int>(std::floor((beat - whole) * 100.0 + 1.0e-4));
            std::snprintf(buffer, size, "%lld.%lld.%02d", bar + 1, inBar + 1, std::clamp(sub, 0, 99));
            break;
        }
        case TimeFormat::Seconds:
        default:
            std::snprintf(buffer, size, "%.3fs", time);
            break;
    }
}

void SequencerWindow::ComputeTickSteps(float& major, float& minor, float& origin) const
{
    const TimelineComponent* timeline =
        m_Director != g_kINVALID_ENTITY ? const_cast<ISequencerBackend&>(m_Backend).GetTimeline(m_Director) : nullptr;
    const float pps = m_Settings.PixelsPerSecond;
    const float minimumLabel = 72.0f;
    const float minimumTick = 7.0f;
    float steps[24];
    int count = 0;
    origin = 0.0f;
    const float fps = GetFrameRate();
    switch (static_cast<TimeFormat>(m_Settings.TimeFormatValue))
    {
        case TimeFormat::Frames:
        case TimeFormat::Timecode:
        {
            const float frames[] = {1, 2, 5, 10};
            for (float f : frames)
            {
                if (f / fps < 1.0f)
                {
                    steps[count++] = f / fps;
                }
            }
            const float seconds[] = {1, 2, 5, 10, 15, 30, 60, 120, 300, 600, 1800};
            for (float s : seconds)
            {
                steps[count++] = s;
            }
            break;
        }
        case TimeFormat::Beats:
        {
            const float bpm = timeline ? std::max(1.0f, timeline->BeatsPerMinute) : 120.0f;
            const float beat = 60.0f / bpm;
            const float bar = beat * (timeline ? std::max(1, timeline->BeatsPerBar) : 4);
            origin = timeline ? timeline->BeatOffset : 0.0f;
            const float beats[] = {0.25f, 0.5f, 1.0f};
            for (float b : beats)
            {
                steps[count++] = beat * b;
            }
            const float bars[] = {1, 2, 4, 8, 16, 32, 64, 128};
            for (float b : bars)
            {
                steps[count++] = bar * b;
            }
            break;
        }
        case TimeFormat::Seconds:
        default:
        {
            const float seconds[] = {0.01f, 0.02f, 0.05f, 0.1f, 0.2f, 0.5f, 1, 2, 5, 10, 15, 30, 60, 120, 300, 600, 1800};
            for (float s : seconds)
            {
                steps[count++] = s;
            }
            break;
        }
    }
    major = steps[count - 1];
    int majorIndex = count - 1;
    for (int index = 0; index < count; ++index)
    {
        if (steps[index] * pps >= minimumLabel)
        {
            major = steps[index];
            majorIndex = index;
            break;
        }
    }
    minor = major;
    for (int index = majorIndex - 1; index >= 0; --index)
    {
        if (steps[index] * pps >= minimumTick)
        {
            minor = steps[index];
        }
        else
        {
            break;
        }
    }
    if (minor == major)
    {
        minor = major * 0.5f;
    }
}

float SequencerWindow::SnapTime(float time, bool allowMagnet) const
{
    const TimelineComponent* timeline =
        m_Director != g_kINVALID_ENTITY ? const_cast<ISequencerBackend&>(m_Backend).GetTimeline(m_Director) : nullptr;
    m_SnapLine = -1.0f;
    if (ImGui::GetCurrentContext() && ImGui::GetIO().KeyAlt)
    {
        return time; // Alt：一時的にスナップ無効
    }
    float snapped = time;
    bool hasGrid = true;
    const float fps = GetFrameRate();
    switch (static_cast<SnapMode>(m_Settings.SnapValue))
    {
        case SnapMode::Frame:
            snapped = std::round(time * fps) / fps;
            break;
        case SnapMode::Beat:
        case SnapMode::Bar:
        {
            const float bpm = timeline ? std::max(1.0f, timeline->BeatsPerMinute) : 120.0f;
            float step = 60.0f / bpm;
            if (static_cast<SnapMode>(m_Settings.SnapValue) == SnapMode::Bar)
            {
                step *= timeline ? std::max(1, timeline->BeatsPerBar) : 4;
            }
            const float origin = timeline ? timeline->BeatOffset : 0.0f;
            snapped = origin + std::round((time - origin) / step) * step;
            break;
        }
        case SnapMode::Tenth:
            snapped = std::round(time * 10.0f) / 10.0f;
            break;
        case SnapMode::Off:
        default:
            hasGrid = false;
            break;
    }
    if (allowMagnet && m_Settings.Magnet && !m_SnapTargets.empty())
    {
        const float tolerance = kMagnetPixels / m_Settings.PixelsPerSecond;
        const auto it = std::lower_bound(m_SnapTargets.begin(), m_SnapTargets.end(), time);
        float best = FLT_MAX;
        float bestTime = time;
        if (it != m_SnapTargets.end())
        {
            best = std::fabs(*it - time);
            bestTime = *it;
        }
        if (it != m_SnapTargets.begin() && std::fabs(*(it - 1) - time) < best)
        {
            best = std::fabs(*(it - 1) - time);
            bestTime = *(it - 1);
        }
        if (best <= tolerance && (!hasGrid || best <= std::fabs(snapped - time)))
        {
            m_SnapLine = bestTime;
            return bestTime;
        }
    }
    if (hasGrid)
    {
        m_SnapLine = snapped;
    }
    return snapped;
}

// ============================================================================
// フレーム処理
// ============================================================================
TimelineComponent* SequencerWindow::ResolveTimeline()
{
    if (m_Director != g_kINVALID_ENTITY && m_Backend.IsAlive(m_Director))
    {
        if (TimelineComponent* timeline = m_Backend.GetTimeline(m_Director))
        {
            // 固定していなければ、エディターで選択した LiveDirector に追従する
            const EntityID selected = m_Backend.GetEditorSelection();
            if (!m_DirectorPinned && selected != m_Director && selected != g_kINVALID_ENTITY &&
                m_Backend.GetTimeline(selected))
            {
                SetDirector(selected);
                m_DirectorPinned = false;
                return m_Backend.GetTimeline(selected);
            }
            return timeline;
        }
    }
    const EntityID selected = m_Backend.GetEditorSelection();
    if (selected != g_kINVALID_ENTITY && m_Backend.GetTimeline(selected))
    {
        SetDirector(selected);
        m_DirectorPinned = false;
        return m_Backend.GetTimeline(selected);
    }
    std::vector<EntityID>& directors = m_Objects; // 一時利用（BuildRows で作り直す）
    directors.clear();
    m_Backend.CollectDirectors(directors);
    if (!directors.empty())
    {
        SetDirector(directors.front());
        m_DirectorPinned = false;
        return m_Backend.GetTimeline(directors.front());
    }
    if (m_Director != g_kINVALID_ENTITY)
    {
        SetDirector(g_kINVALID_ENTITY);
    }
    return nullptr;
}

void SequencerWindow::SyncExternalChanges(TimelineComponent& timeline)
{
    // Undo / Redo やインスペクターでの変更を検知して、シーンを現在時刻で再評価する。
    const uint64_t checksum = TimelineCurve::ComputeChecksum(timeline);
    const uint64_t revision = m_Backend.GetHistoryRevision();
    if (checksum != m_LastChecksum || revision != m_LastHistoryRevision)
    {
        const bool external = m_LastChecksum != 0 && m_Drag == Drag::None && !m_EditOpen;
        m_LastChecksum = checksum;
        m_LastHistoryRevision = revision;
        ValidateSelection(timeline);
        if (external && !m_Backend.IsSimulationRunning())
        {
            m_Backend.Evaluate(m_Director, timeline, false);
        }
    }
}

void SequencerWindow::ValidateSelection(const TimelineComponent& timeline)
{
    m_SelectedKeys.erase(std::remove_if(m_SelectedKeys.begin(), m_SelectedKeys.end(),
                                        [&](const KeyRef& ref) { return !TimelineCurve::IsValid(timeline, ref); }),
                         m_SelectedKeys.end());
    m_SelectedClips.erase(std::remove_if(m_SelectedClips.begin(), m_SelectedClips.end(),
                                         [&](const ClipRef& ref) {
                                             switch (ref.Kind)
                                             {
                                                 case ClipRef::Type::Track:
                                                     return ref.Track < 0 ||
                                                            ref.Track >= static_cast<int>(timeline.Tracks.size()) ||
                                                            ref.Clip < 0 ||
                                                            ref.Clip >= static_cast<int>(
                                                                            timeline.Tracks[ref.Track].Clips.size());
                                                 case ClipRef::Type::Video:
                                                     return ref.Track < 0 ||
                                                            ref.Track >= static_cast<int>(timeline.Monitors.size());
                                                 case ClipRef::Type::Audio:
                                                 default:
                                                     return timeline.MusicPath.empty();
                                             }
                                         }),
                          m_SelectedClips.end());
}

void SequencerWindow::SetTime(TimelineComponent& timeline, float time, bool cut)
{
    time = std::clamp(time, 0.0f, std::max(0.0f, timeline.Duration));
    if (std::fabs(time - timeline.CurrentTime) < 1.0e-7f && m_LastEvaluatedTime == time)
    {
        return;
    }
    timeline.CurrentTime = time;
    timeline.SeekRequested = true; // 曲がある場合は TimeLineSystem が曲の再生位置を合わせる
    m_LastEvaluatedTime = time;
    // Play 中は TimeLineSystem::Update が評価する。編集中・一時停止中はここで評価する。
    if (!m_Backend.IsSimulationRunning())
    {
        m_Backend.Evaluate(m_Director, timeline, cut);
    }
}

void SequencerWindow::SetPlaying(TimelineComponent& timeline, bool playing)
{
    if (playing)
    {
        const float end = timeline.MusicDuration > 0.0f
                              ? std::min(timeline.Duration, std::max(0.0f, timeline.MusicDuration - timeline.MusicOffset))
                              : timeline.Duration;
        if (m_Settings.RangeEnabled &&
            (timeline.CurrentTime < m_Settings.RangeIn || timeline.CurrentTime >= m_Settings.RangeOut))
        {
            SetTime(timeline, m_Settings.RangeIn, true);
        }
        else if (timeline.CurrentTime >= end - 1.0e-4f)
        {
            SetTime(timeline, 0.0f, true);
        }
    }
    timeline.IsPlaying = playing;
    if (!m_Backend.IsSimulationRunning())
    {
        // 編集中のプレビュー再生：曲の再生 / 停止を同期する
        m_Backend.Advance(m_Director, timeline, 0.0f);
    }
}

void SequencerWindow::TickPlayback(TimelineComponent& timeline)
{
    if (m_LastPlaybackFrame == ImGui::GetFrameCount())
    {
        return;
    }
    m_LastPlaybackFrame = ImGui::GetFrameCount();
    if (!m_Backend.IsSimulationRunning() && (timeline.IsPlaying || m_WasPlaying))
    {
        // TimeLineSystem は Play 中しか更新されないため、編集中のプレビュー再生はここで同じ処理を進める。
        m_Backend.Advance(m_Director, timeline, timeline.IsPlaying ? m_Backend.GetDeltaTime() : 0.0f);
        m_LastEvaluatedTime = timeline.CurrentTime;
    }
    if (timeline.IsPlaying && m_Settings.RangeEnabled && m_Settings.RangeOut > m_Settings.RangeIn &&
        timeline.CurrentTime >= m_Settings.RangeOut)
    {
        if (timeline.Loop)
        {
            SetTime(timeline, m_Settings.RangeIn, true);
        }
        else
        {
            SetTime(timeline, m_Settings.RangeOut, false);
            SetPlaying(timeline, false);
        }
    }
    m_WasPlaying = timeline.IsPlaying;
    // 再生中は再生ヘッドを表示範囲内に保つ
    if (timeline.IsPlaying && m_Drag == Drag::None && m_TimelineMax.x > m_TimelineMin.x)
    {
        const float visible = (m_TimelineMax.x - m_TimelineMin.x) / m_Settings.PixelsPerSecond;
        if (timeline.CurrentTime > m_Settings.ViewStart + visible * 0.95f ||
            timeline.CurrentTime < m_Settings.ViewStart)
        {
            m_Settings.ViewStart = std::max(0.0f, timeline.CurrentTime - visible * 0.1f);
        }
    }
}

void SequencerWindow::StepToKey(TimelineComponent& timeline, int direction)
{
    float best = direction > 0 ? FLT_MAX : -FLT_MAX;
    const float now = timeline.CurrentTime;
    const float epsilon = 0.5f / GetFrameRate();
    for (const auto& track : timeline.Tracks)
    {
        for (const auto& clip : track.Clips)
        {
            auto consider = [&](float time) {
                if (direction > 0 && time > now + epsilon && time < best)
                {
                    best = time;
                }
                if (direction < 0 && time < now - epsilon && time > best)
                {
                    best = time;
                }
            };
            if (clip.Keys.empty())
            {
                consider(clip.StartTime);
                consider(clip.StartTime + clip.Duration);
            }
            for (const auto& key : clip.Keys)
            {
                consider(clip.StartTime + key.Time);
            }
        }
    }
    if (best != FLT_MAX && best != -FLT_MAX)
    {
        SetTime(timeline, best, true);
    }
}

void SequencerWindow::HandleShortcuts(TimelineComponent& timeline)
{
    ImGuiIO& io = ImGui::GetIO();
    if (!m_WindowFocused || io.WantTextInput || ImGui::IsAnyItemActive() || m_Drag != Drag::None)
    {
        return;
    }
    const bool ctrl = io.KeyCtrl;
    if (!ctrl && ImGui::IsKeyPressed(ImGuiKey_Space, false))
    {
        SetPlaying(timeline, !timeline.IsPlaying);
    }
    if (!ctrl && ImGui::IsKeyPressed(ImGuiKey_Home, false))
    {
        SetTime(timeline, m_Settings.RangeEnabled ? m_Settings.RangeIn : 0.0f, true);
    }
    if (!ctrl && ImGui::IsKeyPressed(ImGuiKey_End, false))
    {
        SetTime(timeline, m_Settings.RangeEnabled ? m_Settings.RangeOut : timeline.Duration, true);
    }
    if (!ctrl && ImGui::IsKeyPressed(ImGuiKey_LeftArrow, true))
    {
        SetTime(timeline, timeline.CurrentTime - 1.0f / GetFrameRate(), false);
    }
    if (!ctrl && ImGui::IsKeyPressed(ImGuiKey_RightArrow, true))
    {
        SetTime(timeline, timeline.CurrentTime + 1.0f / GetFrameRate(), false);
    }
    if (!ctrl && ImGui::IsKeyPressed(ImGuiKey_UpArrow, false))
    {
        StepToKey(timeline, -1);
    }
    if (!ctrl && ImGui::IsKeyPressed(ImGuiKey_DownArrow, false))
    {
        StepToKey(timeline, 1);
    }
    if (ImGui::IsKeyPressed(ImGuiKey_Delete, false) || ImGui::IsKeyPressed(ImGuiKey_Backspace, false))
    {
        DeleteSelection(timeline);
    }
    if (ctrl && ImGui::IsKeyPressed(ImGuiKey_C, false))
    {
        CopySelection(timeline);
    }
    if (ctrl && ImGui::IsKeyPressed(ImGuiKey_V, false))
    {
        Paste(timeline);
    }
    if (ctrl && ImGui::IsKeyPressed(ImGuiKey_A, false))
    {
        m_SelectedKeys.clear();
        for (int track = 0; track < static_cast<int>(timeline.Tracks.size()); ++track)
        {
            for (int clip = 0; clip < static_cast<int>(timeline.Tracks[track].Clips.size()); ++clip)
            {
                for (int key = 0; key < static_cast<int>(timeline.Tracks[track].Clips[clip].Keys.size()); ++key)
                {
                    m_SelectedKeys.push_back({track, clip, key});
                }
            }
        }
    }
    if (!ctrl && ImGui::IsKeyPressed(ImGuiKey_I, false))
    {
        for (int index = 0; index < static_cast<int>(m_Rows.size()); ++index)
        {
            if (m_Rows[index].Id == m_ActiveRow)
            {
                AddKeyAtRow(timeline, index, timeline.CurrentTime, true);
                break;
            }
        }
    }
    if (!ctrl && ImGui::IsKeyPressed(ImGuiKey_F, false))
    {
        if (static_cast<Mode>(m_Settings.ModeValue) == Mode::Curve)
        {
            m_CurveAutoFit = true;
        }
        FrameAll(timeline);
    }
}

// ============================================================================
// 行ツリー（TimelineComponent から毎フレーム構築。ヒープ確保は容量拡張時のみ）
// ============================================================================
void SequencerWindow::BuildRows(TimelineComponent& timeline)
{
    m_Rows.clear();
    m_Objects.clear();
    for (const auto& track : timeline.Tracks)
    {
        if (track.Target != g_kINVALID_ENTITY &&
            std::find(m_Objects.begin(), m_Objects.end(), track.Target) == m_Objects.end())
        {
            m_Objects.push_back(track.Target);
        }
    }
    auto push = [&](RowKind kind, Category category, int depth, int parent, EntityID entity, int track, int channel,
                    int a, const char* label) -> int {
        Row row;
        row.Kind = kind;
        row.Cat = category;
        row.Depth = static_cast<uint8_t>(depth);
        row.Parent = parent;
        row.Entity = entity;
        row.Track = track;
        row.Channel = channel;
        if (kind == RowKind::Video || kind == RowKind::VideoClip)
        {
            row.Monitor = a;
        }
        if (kind == RowKind::AnimLayer)
        {
            row.Layer = a;
        }
        row.Id = HashRow(entity, static_cast<int>(kind), track * 64 + channel + 1, a);
        std::snprintf(row.Label, sizeof(row.Label), "%s", label);
        m_Rows.push_back(row);
        if (parent >= 0)
        {
            m_Rows[parent].HasChildren = true;
        }
        return static_cast<int>(m_Rows.size()) - 1;
    };
    char label[96];
    for (EntityID entity : m_Objects)
    {
        const SequencerEntityKind kind = m_Backend.GetEntityKind(entity);
        const char* kindName = "Object";
        Category category = Category::Generic;
        switch (kind)
        {
            case SequencerEntityKind::Character:
                kindName = "Character";
                category = Category::Character;
                break;
            case SequencerEntityKind::Camera:
                kindName = "Camera";
                category = Category::Camera;
                break;
            case SequencerEntityKind::Light:
                kindName = "Light";
                category = Category::Light;
                break;
            default:
                break;
        }
        const bool alive = m_Backend.IsAlive(entity);
        std::snprintf(label, sizeof(label), "%s : %s%s", kindName, alive ? m_Backend.GetEntityName(entity) : "(削除済み)",
                      alive ? "" : "");
        const int object = push(RowKind::Object, category, 0, -1, entity, -1, -1, 0, label);

        // Transform（Position / Rotation / Scale、ライトは Direction も同じグループ）
        int transform = -1;
        for (int index = 0; index < static_cast<int>(timeline.Tracks.size()); ++index)
        {
            const auto& track = timeline.Tracks[index];
            const bool lightDirection = track.Property == TimelineProperty::LightDirection;
            if (track.Target != entity || (!IsTransformProperty(track.Property) && !lightDirection))
            {
                continue;
            }
            if (transform < 0)
            {
                transform = push(RowKind::Group, Category::Transform, 1, object, entity, -1, -1, 1, "Transform");
            }
            Category propertyCategory = Category::Generic;
            switch (track.Property)
            {
                case TimelineProperty::TransformPosition:
                    propertyCategory = Category::Position;
                    break;
                case TimelineProperty::TransformRotation:
                case TimelineProperty::LightDirection:
                    propertyCategory = Category::Rotation;
                    break;
                default:
                    propertyCategory = Category::Scale;
                    break;
            }
            std::snprintf(label, sizeof(label), "%s", PropertyLabel(track.Property));
            const int property = push(RowKind::Property, propertyCategory, 2, transform, entity, index, -1, 0, label);
            for (int channel = 0; channel < 3; ++channel)
            {
                push(RowKind::Channel, propertyCategory, 3, property, entity, index, channel, 0,
                     ChannelName(channel, false));
            }
        }
        // Animation（AnimationTime トラック、VMD レイヤー）
        int animation = -1;
        for (int index = 0; index < static_cast<int>(timeline.Tracks.size()); ++index)
        {
            const auto& track = timeline.Tracks[index];
            if (track.Target != entity || track.Property != TimelineProperty::AnimationTime)
            {
                continue;
            }
            if (animation < 0)
            {
                animation = push(RowKind::Group, Category::Animation, 1, object, entity, -1, -1, 2, "Animation");
            }
            std::snprintf(label, sizeof(label), "%s", track.Name.empty() ? "Animation Time" : track.Name.c_str());
            const int property = push(RowKind::Property, Category::Animation, 2, animation, entity, index, -1, 0, label);
            for (int layer = 0; layer < static_cast<int>(track.AnimationPaths.size()); ++layer)
            {
                const std::string& path = track.AnimationPaths[layer];
                const size_t slash = path.find_last_of("/\\");
                const char* file = path.c_str() + (slash == std::string::npos ? 0 : slash + 1);
                const char* role = layer == 0 ? "Body" : (layer == 1 ? "Face" : "Layer");
                std::snprintf(label, sizeof(label), "%s : %s", role, file);
                push(RowKind::AnimLayer, Category::Animation, 3, property, entity, index, -1, layer, label);
            }
        }
        // その他のプロパティ（FOV / Intensity / Color / Range / Spot Angle ...）とカメラカット
        for (int index = 0; index < static_cast<int>(timeline.Tracks.size()); ++index)
        {
            const auto& track = timeline.Tracks[index];
            if (track.Target != entity || IsTransformProperty(track.Property) ||
                track.Property == TimelineProperty::LightDirection || track.Property == TimelineProperty::AnimationTime)
            {
                continue;
            }
            Category propertyCategory = Category::Generic;
            if (track.Property == TimelineProperty::CameraFov)
            {
                propertyCategory = Category::CameraFov;
            }
            else if (track.Property >= TimelineProperty::CameraTarget &&
                     track.Property <= TimelineProperty::CameraLockOnOffset)
            {
                propertyCategory = Category::Camera;
            }
            else if ((track.Property >= TimelineProperty::LightIntensity &&
                      track.Property <= TimelineProperty::LightBeamDensity) ||
                     track.Property == TimelineProperty::LightInnerAngle ||
                     track.Property == TimelineProperty::LightOuterAngle)
            {
                propertyCategory = Category::Light;
            }
            if (track.Property == TimelineProperty::CameraCut)
            {
                push(RowKind::CameraCut, Category::CameraCut, 1, object, entity, index, -1, 0, "Camera Cut");
                continue;
            }
            std::snprintf(label, sizeof(label), "%s", PropertyLabel(track.Property));
