    float SphereRadius = 0.5f;
    float CapsuleRadius = 0.5f;
    float CapsuleHeight = 1.0f;

    DirectX::XMFLOAT3 Velocity = {0.0f, 0.0f, 0.0f};
    DirectX::XMFLOAT3 AngularVelocity = {0.0f, 0.0f, 0.0f};
    float Mass = 1.0f;
    float Friction = 0.5f;
    float Restitution = 0.0f;
    float LinearDamping = 0.05f;
    float AngularDamping = 0.05f;
    float GravityFactor = 1.0f;
    bool UseGravity = true;
    bool EnableContinuousCollision = false;
    bool AllowSleeping = true;

    float PmxMassScale = 1.0f;
    float PmxDampingScale = 1.0f;
    float PmxStiffnessScale = 1.0f;
    float PmxColliderScale = 1.0f;

    uint16_t CollisionLayer = 0;
    uint16_t CollisionMask = 0xffff;

    uint64_t SettingsRevision = 1;
};

===== FILE: source\physics\physxphysicsbackend.cpp =====
#include "pch.h"
#include "physicsbackend.h"

#include <PxPhysicsAPI.h>
#include <thread>
#include <unordered_map>

using namespace physx;

PxVec3 ToPx(const XMFLOAT3& value)
{
    return PxVec3(value.x, value.y, value.z);
}

PxQuat ToPx(const XMFLOAT4& value)
{
    PxQuat result(value.x, value.y, value.z, value.w);
    return result.getNormalized();
}

PxTransform ToPx(const PhysicsTransform& value)
{
    return PxTransform(ToPx(value.Position), ToPx(value.Rotation));
}

PhysicsTransform FromPx(const PxTransform& value)
{
    return {{value.p.x, value.p.y, value.p.z}, {value.q.x, value.q.y, value.q.z, value.q.w}};
}

PxFilterFlags PhysicsFilterShader(PxFilterObjectAttributes attributes0, PxFilterData filterData0,
                                  PxFilterObjectAttributes attributes1, PxFilterData filterData1,
                                  PxPairFlags& pairFlags, const void*, PxU32)
{
    if (PxFilterObjectIsTrigger(attributes0) || PxFilterObjectIsTrigger(attributes1))
    {
        pairFlags = PxPairFlag::eTRIGGER_DEFAULT;
        return PxFilterFlag::eDEFAULT;
    }
    if ((filterData0.word0 & filterData1.word1) == 0 || (filterData1.word0 & filterData0.word1) == 0)
    {
        return PxFilterFlag::eSUPPRESS;
    }
    pairFlags = PxPairFlag::eCONTACT_DEFAULT | PxPairFlag::eDETECT_CCD_CONTACT;
    return PxFilterFlag::eDEFAULT;
}

class PhysXPhysicsBackend final : public IPhysicsBackend
{
    struct BodyRecord
    {
        PxRigidActor* Actor = nullptr;
        float GravityFactor = 1.0f;
    };

    PxDefaultAllocator m_Allocator{};
    PxDefaultErrorCallback m_ErrorCallback{};
    PxFoundation* m_Foundation = nullptr;
    PxPhysics* m_Physics = nullptr;
    PxDefaultCpuDispatcher* m_Dispatcher = nullptr;
    PxScene* m_Scene = nullptr;
    PxMaterial* m_DefaultMaterial = nullptr;
    unordered_map<PhysicsBodyHandle, BodyRecord> m_Bodies{};
    unordered_map<PhysicsJointHandle, PxD6Joint*> m_Joints{};
    PhysicsBodyHandle m_NextBody = 1;
    PhysicsJointHandle m_NextJoint = 1;
    XMFLOAT3 m_Gravity = {0.0f, -9.81f, 0.0f};

  public:
    const char* GetName() const override
    {
        return "PhysX";
    }

    bool Init() override
    {
        m_Foundation = PxCreateFoundation(PX_PHYSICS_VERSION, m_Allocator, m_ErrorCallback);
        if (!m_Foundation)
        {
            return false;
        }
        PxTolerancesScale scale{};
        m_Physics = PxCreatePhysics(PX_PHYSICS_VERSION, *m_Foundation, scale, true, nullptr);
        if (!m_Physics)
        {
            Shutdown();
            return false;
        }

        PxSceneDesc sceneDesc(scale);
        sceneDesc.gravity = ToPx(m_Gravity);
        m_Dispatcher = PxDefaultCpuDispatcherCreate(max(1u, thread::hardware_concurrency() / 2u));
        sceneDesc.cpuDispatcher = m_Dispatcher;
        sceneDesc.filterShader = PhysicsFilterShader;
        sceneDesc.flags |= PxSceneFlag::eENABLE_CCD;
        m_Scene = m_Physics->createScene(sceneDesc);
        m_DefaultMaterial = m_Physics->createMaterial(0.5f, 0.5f, 0.0f);
        if (!m_Scene || !m_DefaultMaterial)
        {
            Shutdown();
            return false;
        }
        return true;
    }

    void Shutdown() override
    {
        for (auto& [handle, joint] : m_Joints)
        {
            joint->release();
        }
        m_Joints.clear();
        for (auto& [handle, record] : m_Bodies)
        {
            record.Actor->release();
        }
        m_Bodies.clear();
        if (m_DefaultMaterial)
        {
            m_DefaultMaterial->release();
        }
        if (m_Scene)
        {
            m_Scene->release();
        }
        if (m_Dispatcher)
        {
            m_Dispatcher->release();
        }
        if (m_Physics)
        {
            m_Physics->release();
        }
        if (m_Foundation)
        {
            m_Foundation->release();
        }
        m_DefaultMaterial = nullptr;
        m_Scene = nullptr;
        m_Dispatcher = nullptr;
        m_Physics = nullptr;
        m_Foundation = nullptr;
        m_NextBody = 1;
        m_NextJoint = 1;
    }

    bool IsAvailable() const override
    {
        return m_Scene != nullptr;
    }

    void SetGravity(const XMFLOAT3& gravity) override
    {
        m_Gravity = gravity;
        if (m_Scene)
        {
            m_Scene->setGravity(ToPx(gravity));
        }
    }

    void Step(float fixedDeltaTime) override
    {
        if (!m_Scene || fixedDeltaTime <= 0.0f)
        {
            return;
        }
        for (const auto& [handle, record] : m_Bodies)
        {
            if (record.GravityFactor == 1.0f)
            {
                continue;
            }
            PxRigidDynamic* dynamic = record.Actor->is<PxRigidDynamic>();
            if (!dynamic || dynamic->getRigidBodyFlags().isSet(PxRigidBodyFlag::eKINEMATIC) ||
                dynamic->getActorFlags().isSet(PxActorFlag::eDISABLE_GRAVITY))
            {
                continue;
            }
            const float adjustment = record.GravityFactor - 1.0f;
            dynamic->addForce(ToPx(m_Gravity) * adjustment, PxForceMode::eACCELERATION);
        }
        m_Scene->simulate(fixedDeltaTime);
        m_Scene->fetchResults(true);
    }

    PhysicsBodyHandle CreateBody(const PhysicsBodyDesc& desc) override
    {
        if (!m_Physics || !m_Scene || !m_DefaultMaterial)
        {
            return kInvalidPhysicsBody;
        }

        PxMaterial* material = m_Physics->createMaterial(max(desc.Friction, 0.0f), max(desc.Friction, 0.0f),
                                                         clamp(desc.Restitution, 0.0f, 1.0f));
        if (!material)
        {
            return kInvalidPhysicsBody;
        }
        PxShape* shape = nullptr;
        switch (desc.Shape)
        {
            case PhysicsShape::Sphere:
                shape = m_Physics->createShape(PxSphereGeometry(max(desc.Radius, 0.001f)), *material, true);
                break;
            case PhysicsShape::Capsule:
                shape = m_Physics->createShape(
                    PxCapsuleGeometry(max(desc.Radius, 0.001f), max(desc.Height * 0.5f, 0.001f)), *material, true);
                break;
            case PhysicsShape::Box:
            default:
                shape =
                    m_Physics->createShape(PxBoxGeometry(max(desc.HalfExtent.x, 0.001f), max(desc.HalfExtent.y, 0.001f),
                                                         max(desc.HalfExtent.z, 0.001f)),
                                           *material, true);
                break;
        }
        if (!shape)
        {
            material->release();
            return kInvalidPhysicsBody;
        }
        if (desc.Shape == PhysicsShape::Capsule)
        {

            shape->setLocalPose(PxTransform(PxQuat(PxHalfPi, PxVec3(0.0f, 0.0f, 1.0f))));
        }
        material->release();
        shape->setContactOffset(max(0.02f, desc.Radius * 0.02f));
        PxFilterData filter{};
        filter.word0 = 1u << (desc.CollisionLayer & 15u);
        filter.word1 = desc.CollisionMask;
        shape->setSimulationFilterData(filter);

        PxRigidActor* actor = nullptr;
        if (desc.BodyType == PhysicsBodyType::Static)
        {
            actor = m_Physics->createRigidStatic(ToPx(desc.Transform));
        }
        else
        {
            PxRigidDynamic* dynamic = m_Physics->createRigidDynamic(ToPx(desc.Transform));
            if (dynamic)
            {
                dynamic->setLinearDamping(max(desc.LinearDamping, 0.0f));
                dynamic->setAngularDamping(max(desc.AngularDamping, 0.0f));
                dynamic->setRigidBodyFlag(PxRigidBodyFlag::eENABLE_CCD, desc.ContinuousCollision);
                dynamic->setRigidBodyFlag(PxRigidBodyFlag::eKINEMATIC, desc.BodyType == PhysicsBodyType::Kinematic);
                float shaderValue;
                if (desc.AllowSleeping)
                {
                    shaderValue = 0.005f;
                }
                else
                {
                    shaderValue = 0.0f;
                }
                dynamic->setSleepThreshold(shaderValue);
                actor = dynamic;
            }
        }
        if (!actor)
        {
            shape->release();
            return kInvalidPhysicsBody;
        }
        actor->attachShape(*shape);
        shape->release();
        actor->userData = reinterpret_cast<void*>(static_cast<uintptr_t>(desc.UserData));
        if (PxRigidDynamic* dynamic = actor->is<PxRigidDynamic>())
        {
            if (desc.BodyType == PhysicsBodyType::Dynamic)
            {
                PxRigidBodyExt::setMassAndUpdateInertia(*dynamic, max(desc.Mass, 0.0001f));
            }
            if (desc.GravityFactor == 0.0f)
            {
                dynamic->setActorFlag(PxActorFlag::eDISABLE_GRAVITY, true);
            }
        }
        m_Scene->addActor(*actor);
        const PhysicsBodyHandle handle = m_NextBody++;
        m_Bodies.emplace(handle, BodyRecord{actor, desc.GravityFactor});
        return handle;
    }

    void DestroyBody(PhysicsBodyHandle body) override
    {
        auto it = m_Bodies.find(body);
        if (it == m_Bodies.end())
        {
            return;
        }
        it->second.Actor->release();
        m_Bodies.erase(it);
    }

    bool GetBodyTransform(PhysicsBodyHandle body, PhysicsTransform& transform) const override
    {
        auto it = m_Bodies.find(body);
        if (it == m_Bodies.end())
        {
            return false;
        }
        transform = FromPx(it->second.Actor->getGlobalPose());
        return true;
    }

    void SetBodyTransform(PhysicsBodyHandle body, const PhysicsTransform& transform, bool activate) override
    {
        auto it = m_Bodies.find(body);
        if (it == m_Bodies.end())
        {
            return;
        }
        it->second.Actor->setGlobalPose(ToPx(transform), activate);
        if (activate)
        {
            if (PxRigidDynamic* dynamic = it->second.Actor->is<PxRigidDynamic>())
            {
                dynamic->wakeUp();
            }
        }
    }

    void SetBodyVelocity(PhysicsBodyHandle body, const XMFLOAT3& linearVelocity,
                         const XMFLOAT3& angularVelocity) override
    {
        auto it = m_Bodies.find(body);
        if (it == m_Bodies.end())
        {
            return;
        }
        if (PxRigidDynamic* dynamic = it->second.Actor->is<PxRigidDynamic>())
        {
            if (!dynamic->getRigidBodyFlags().isSet(PxRigidBodyFlag::eKINEMATIC))
            {
                dynamic->setLinearVelocity(ToPx(linearVelocity));
                dynamic->setAngularVelocity(ToPx(angularVelocity));
                dynamic->wakeUp();
            }
        }
    }

    PhysicsJointHandle CreateJoint(const PhysicsJointDesc& desc) override
    {
        auto bodyA = m_Bodies.find(desc.BodyA);
        auto bodyB = m_Bodies.find(desc.BodyB);
        if (!m_Physics || bodyA == m_Bodies.end() || bodyB == m_Bodies.end())
        {
            return kInvalidPhysicsJoint;
        }
        const PxTransform worldFrame = ToPx(desc.Frame);
        const PxTransform localA = bodyA->second.Actor->getGlobalPose().getInverse() * worldFrame;
        const PxTransform localB = bodyB->second.Actor->getGlobalPose().getInverse() * worldFrame;
        PxD6Joint* joint = PxD6JointCreate(*m_Physics, bodyA->second.Actor, localA, bodyB->second.Actor, localB);
        if (!joint)
        {
            return kInvalidPhysicsJoint;
        }

        const float linearMin[3] = {desc.LinearLimitMin.x, desc.LinearLimitMin.y, desc.LinearLimitMin.z};
        const float linearMax[3] = {desc.LinearLimitMax.x, desc.LinearLimitMax.y, desc.LinearLimitMax.z};
        const float linearSpring[3] = {desc.LinearSpring.x, desc.LinearSpring.y, desc.LinearSpring.z};
        const PxD6Axis::Enum linearAxes[3] = {PxD6Axis::eX, PxD6Axis::eY, PxD6Axis::eZ};
        for (int axis = 0; axis < 3; ++axis)
        {
            PxD6Motion::Enum motion;
            if (linearMax[axis] > linearMin[axis])
            {
                motion = PxD6Motion::eLIMITED;
            }
            else
            {
                motion = PxD6Motion::eLOCKED;
            }
            joint->setMotion(linearAxes[axis], motion);
            if (linearMax[axis] > linearMin[axis])
            {
                PxJointLinearLimitPair limit(linearMin[axis], linearMax[axis],
                                             PxSpring(max(linearSpring[axis], 0.0f), 0.0f));
                joint->setLinearLimit(linearAxes[axis], limit);
            }
        }

        PxD6Motion::Enum motionValue;
        if (desc.AngularLimitMax.x > desc.AngularLimitMin.x)
        {
            motionValue = PxD6Motion::eLIMITED;
        }
        else
        {
            motionValue = PxD6Motion::eLOCKED;
        }
        joint->setMotion(PxD6Axis::eTWIST, motionValue);
        if (desc.AngularLimitMax.x > desc.AngularLimitMin.x)
        {
            joint->setTwistLimit(PxJointAngularLimitPair(desc.AngularLimitMin.x, desc.AngularLimitMax.x,
                                                         PxSpring(max(desc.AngularSpring.x, 0.0f), 0.0f)));
        }
        const bool swingY = desc.AngularLimitMax.y > desc.AngularLimitMin.y;
        const bool swingZ = desc.AngularLimitMax.z > desc.AngularLimitMin.z;
        PxD6Motion::Enum motion3;
        if (swingY)
        {
            motion3 = PxD6Motion::eLIMITED;
        }
        else
        {
            motion3 = PxD6Motion::eLOCKED;
        }
        joint->setMotion(PxD6Axis::eSWING1, motion3);
        PxD6Motion::Enum motion4;
        if (swingZ)
        {
            motion4 = PxD6Motion::eLIMITED;
        }
        else
        {
            motion4 = PxD6Motion::eLOCKED;
        }
        joint->setMotion(PxD6Axis::eSWING2, motion4);
        if (swingY || swingZ)
        {
            float shader3;
            if (swingY)
            {
                shader3 = desc.AngularLimitMin.y;
            }
            else
            {
                shader3 = 0.0f;
            }
            float shader4;
            if (swingY)
            {
                shader4 = desc.AngularLimitMax.y;
            }
            else
            {
                shader4 = 0.0f;
            }
            float shader5;
            if (swingZ)
            {
                shader5 = desc.AngularLimitMin.z;
            }
            else
            {
                shader5 = 0.0f;
            }
            float shader6;
            if (swingZ)
            {
                shader6 = desc.AngularLimitMax.z;
            }
            else
            {
                shader6 = 0.0f;
            }
            joint->setPyramidSwingLimit(PxJointLimitPyramid(
                shader3, shader4, shader5, shader6, PxSpring(max(desc.AngularSpring.y, desc.AngularSpring.z), 0.0f)));
        }
        joint->setAngularDriveConfig(PxD6AngularDriveConfig::eSWING_TWIST);
        if (desc.AngularSpring.x > 0.0f)
        {
            joint->setDrive(PxD6Drive::eTWIST, PxD6JointDrive(desc.AngularSpring.x, 0.0f, PX_MAX_F32));
        }
        if (desc.AngularSpring.y > 0.0f)
        {
            joint->setDrive(PxD6Drive::eSWING1, PxD6JointDrive(desc.AngularSpring.y, 0.0f, PX_MAX_F32));
        }
        if (desc.AngularSpring.z > 0.0f)
        {
            joint->setDrive(PxD6Drive::eSWING2, PxD6JointDrive(desc.AngularSpring.z, 0.0f, PX_MAX_F32));
        }

        const PhysicsJointHandle handle = m_NextJoint++;
        m_Joints.emplace(handle, joint);
        return handle;
    }

    void DestroyJoint(PhysicsJointHandle joint) override
    {
        auto it = m_Joints.find(joint);
        if (it == m_Joints.end())
        {
            return;
        }
        it->second->release();
        m_Joints.erase(it);
    }
};

unique_ptr<IPhysicsBackend> CreatePhysXPhysicsBackend()
{
    return make_unique<PhysXPhysicsBackend>();
}

===== FILE: source\procedural\imagemaps.h =====
#pragma once
// 画像から高さマップ・法線マップを作る CPU 処理。D3D に依存しない。
// ヘッダーのみで完結させ、プロジェクトへの .cpp 追加を不要にしている。
// エンジンのプリコンパイル済みヘッダーは std / DirectX をグローバルへ導入するため、
// ここでは修飾名だけを使い、短い名前を外へ漏らさない。
#include "proceduralstudio.h"
#include <algorithm>
#include <cmath>
#include <cstdint>
#include <functional>
#include <thread>
#include <vector>

namespace ProcStudio
{
    // 高さの元にするチャンネル。値はファイルに格納された値（8 ビット画像なら sRGB 値）を使う。
    enum class HeightChannel
    {
        Luminance, // Rec.709 輝度
        Average,
        Red,
        Green,
        Blue,
        Alpha,
        Max,
        Count
    };

    enum class NormalFilter
    {
        CentralDifference, // 隣接 2 画素。最も鋭い。
        Sobel,             // 3x3。ノイズに強い。
        Scharr,            // 3x3。回転に対する誤差が小さい。
        Count
    };

    struct ImageMapParams
    {
        // 高さ。
        HeightChannel Channel = HeightChannel::Luminance;
        bool Invert = false;
        float BlurRadius = 0.0f;     // 元画像のピクセル単位（ガウスの σ 相当）。0 で無効。
        float HighPassRadius = 0.0f; // 元画像のピクセル単位。0 で無効。照明ムラなど大きな明暗を除去する。
        bool AutoLevels = false;     // 最小値〜最大値を 0〜1 へ引き伸ばす。
        float Contrast = 1.0f;       // プロシージャルと同じ式: (v - 0.5) * Contrast + 0.5 + Bias
        float Bias = 0.0f;
        float Gamma = 1.0f;          // 最後に v^Gamma。
        // 法線。
        float NormalStrength = 8.0f; // 元画像の隣接画素差に掛ける係数。
        NormalFilter Filter = NormalFilter::Sobel;
        bool FlipY = false;          // false: OpenGL (+Y)。プロシージャルの法線出力と同じ規約。true: DirectX (-Y)。
        bool Tileable = true;        // 端を折り返して参照する。false なら端をクランプ。
    };

    struct ImageMaps
    {
        Image Height; // RGB に同じ高さ、A = 1。
        Image Normal; // 接空間法線を 0〜1 にエンコード。
    };

    namespace ImageMapDetail
    {
        inline void ParallelRows(int count, const std::function<void(int)>& body)
        {
            const int workers = std::clamp(static_cast<int>(std::thread::hardware_concurrency()), 1, 32);
            if (count < 16 || workers == 1)
            {
                for (int i = 0; i < count; ++i)
                {
                    body(i);
                }
                return;
            }
            std::vector<std::thread> threads;
            threads.reserve(workers);
            for (int w = 0; w < workers; ++w)
            {
                threads.emplace_back([&, w] {
                    for (int i = w; i < count; i += workers)
                    {
                        body(i);
                    }
                });
            }
            for (auto& thread : threads)
            {
                thread.join();
            }
        }

        inline int Index(int i, int n, bool wrap)
        {
            if (wrap)
            {
                const int r = i % n;
                return r < 0 ? r + n : r;
            }
            return std::clamp(i, 0, n - 1);
        }

        inline float LinearToSrgb(float v)
        {
            v = std::clamp(v, 0.0f, 1.0f);
            return v <= 0.0031308f ? v * 12.92f : 1.055f * std::pow(v, 1.0f / 2.4f) - 0.055f;
        }

        // 1 方向の箱型ぼかし（累積和、O(n)）。stride で行・列を切り替える。
        inline void BoxLine(const float* src, float* dst, int n, int stride, int radius, bool wrap)
        {
            const float inv = 1.0f / static_cast<float>(radius * 2 + 1);
            float sum = 0.0f;
            for (int k = -radius; k <= radius; ++k)
            {
                sum += src[static_cast<size_t>(Index(k, n, wrap)) * stride];
            }
            for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i)
            {
                dst[static_cast<size_t>(i) * stride] = sum * inv;
                sum += src[static_cast<size_t>(Index(i + radius + 1, n, wrap)) * stride];
                sum -= src[static_cast<size_t>(Index(i - radius, n, wrap)) * stride];
            }
        }

        // 3 回の箱型ぼかしでガウスぼかしを近似する。sigma はピクセル単位。
        inline void GaussianBlur(std::vector<float>& h, int width, int height, float sigma, bool wrap)
        {
            if (sigma < 0.5f || width <= 0 || height <= 0)
            {
                return;
            }
            // n 回の幅 w の箱: 分散 = n (w^2 - 1) / 12。n = 3 → w = sqrt(4σ^2 + 1)。
            const float boxWidth = std::sqrt(4.0f * sigma * sigma + 1.0f);
            const int radius = (std::max)(1, static_cast<int>(std::lround((boxWidth - 1.0f) * 0.5f)));
            std::vector<float> temp(h.size());
            for (int pass = 0; pass < 3; ++pass)
            {
                ParallelRows(height, [&](int y) {
                    const size_t row = static_cast<size_t>(y) * width;
                    BoxLine(h.data() + row, temp.data() + row, width, 1, (std::min)(radius, width), wrap);
                });
                ParallelRows(width, [&](int x) {
                    BoxLine(temp.data() + x, h.data() + x, height, width, (std::min)(radius, height), wrap);
                });
            }
        }

        inline float ChannelValue(const Float4& p, HeightChannel channel, bool srgbEncoded)
        {
            const auto enc = [&](float v) {
                return srgbEncoded ? LinearToSrgb(v) : v;
            };
            switch (channel)
            {
                case HeightChannel::Average:
                    return (enc(p.X) + enc(p.Y) + enc(p.Z)) / 3.0f;
                case HeightChannel::Red:
                    return enc(p.X);
                case HeightChannel::Green:
                    return enc(p.Y);
                case HeightChannel::Blue:
                    return enc(p.Z);
                case HeightChannel::Alpha:
                    return p.W;
                case HeightChannel::Max:
                    return (std::max)({enc(p.X), enc(p.Y), enc(p.Z)});
                case HeightChannel::Luminance:
                default:
                    // 線形空間で輝度を求めてから格納値の空間へ戻す。
                    return enc(0.2126f * p.X + 0.7152f * p.Y + 0.0722f * p.Z);
            }
        }
    } // namespace ImageMapDetail

    inline const char* HeightChannelName(HeightChannel channel)
    {
        static const char* names[] = {"輝度", "RGB 平均", "R", "G", "B", "A (アルファ)", "RGB 最大"};
        return names[std::clamp(static_cast<int>(channel), 0, static_cast<int>(HeightChannel::Count) - 1)];
    }

    // 面積平均で縮小する（長辺を maxSide 以下に）。縮小不要ならそのまま複製。
    inline Image DownsampleImage(const Image& source, int maxSide)
    {
        if (source.Width <= 0 || source.Height <= 0)
        {
            return {};
        }
        const int longest = (std::max)(source.Width, source.Height);
        if (longest <= maxSide)
        {
            return source;
        }
        const double scale = static_cast<double>(maxSide) / longest;
        Image result;
        result.Width = (std::max)(1, static_cast<int>(std::lround(source.Width * scale)));
        result.Height = (std::max)(1, static_cast<int>(std::lround(source.Height * scale)));
        result.Pixels.resize(static_cast<size_t>(result.Width) * result.Height);
        ImageMapDetail::ParallelRows(result.Height, [&](int y) {
            const int y0 = static_cast<int>(static_cast<int64_t>(y) * source.Height / result.Height);
            const int y1 = (std::max)(y0 + 1, static_cast<int>(static_cast<int64_t>(y + 1) * source.Height / result.Height));
            for (int x = 0; x < result.Width; ++x)
            {
                const int x0 = static_cast<int>(static_cast<int64_t>(x) * source.Width / result.Width);
                const int x1 =
                    (std::max)(x0 + 1, static_cast<int>(static_cast<int64_t>(x + 1) * source.Width / result.Width));
                Float4 sum{0, 0, 0, 0};
                for (int sy = y0; sy < y1; ++sy)
                {
                    const Float4* row = source.Pixels.data() + static_cast<size_t>(sy) * source.Width;
                    for (int sx = x0; sx < x1; ++sx)
                    {
                        sum.X += row[sx].X;
                        sum.Y += row[sx].Y;
                        sum.Z += row[sx].Z;
                        sum.W += row[sx].W;
                    }
                }
                const float inv = 1.0f / static_cast<float>((y1 - y0) * (x1 - x0));
                result.Pixels[static_cast<size_t>(y) * result.Width + x] = {sum.X * inv, sum.Y * inv, sum.Z * inv,
                                                                            sum.W * inv};
            }
        });
        return result;
    }

    // pixelScale = 処理する画像の幅 / 元画像の幅。縮小プレビューでも書き出しと同じ見た目になるよう、
    // ぼかし半径と法線の傾きをこの比率で補正する。
    inline std::vector<float> ComputeHeight(const Image& source, const ImageMapParams& p, bool srgbEncoded,
                                            float pixelScale)
    {
        using namespace ImageMapDetail;
        const int width = source.Width;
        const int height = source.Height;
        std::vector<float> h(static_cast<size_t>(width) * height);
        ParallelRows(height, [&](int y) {
            for (int x = 0; x < width; ++x)
            {
                const size_t i = static_cast<size_t>(y) * width + x;
                const float v = std::clamp(ChannelValue(source.Pixels[i], p.Channel, srgbEncoded), 0.0f, 1.0f);
                h[i] = p.Invert ? 1.0f - v : v;
            }
        });
        GaussianBlur(h, width, height, p.BlurRadius * pixelScale, p.Tileable);
        if (p.HighPassRadius > 0.0f)
        {
            std::vector<float> low = h;
            GaussianBlur(low, width, height, p.HighPassRadius * pixelScale, p.Tileable);
            for (size_t i = 0; i < h.size(); ++i)
            {
                h[i] = h[i] - low[i] + 0.5f;
            }
        }
        float lo = 0.0f;
        float hi = 1.0f;
        if (p.AutoLevels && !h.empty())
        {
            const auto [mn, mx] = std::minmax_element(h.begin(), h.end());
            if (*mx - *mn > 1e-6f)
            {
                lo = *mn;
                hi = *mx;
            }
        }
        const float range = 1.0f / (hi - lo);
        const float gamma = (std::max)(p.Gamma, 0.01f);
        for (float& v : h)
        {
            float t = (v - lo) * range;
            t = std::clamp((t - 0.5f) * p.Contrast + 0.5f + p.Bias, 0.0f, 1.0f);
            v = gamma == 1.0f ? t : std::pow(t, gamma);
        }
        return h;
    }

    inline Image HeightToNormal(const std::vector<float>& h, int width, int height, const ImageMapParams& p,
                                float pixelScale)
    {
        using namespace ImageMapDetail;
        Image out;
        out.Width = width;
        out.Height = height;
        out.Pixels.resize(h.size());
        // 縮小画像では隣接画素の差が 1/pixelScale 倍に大きくなるため、pixelScale を掛けて打ち消す。
        const float strength = p.NormalStrength * pixelScale;
        ParallelRows(height, [&](int y) {
            const auto at = [&](int px, int py) {
                return h[static_cast<size_t>(Index(py, height, p.Tileable)) * width + Index(px, width, p.Tileable)];
            };
            for (int x = 0; x < width; ++x)
            {
                float dx = 0.0f;
                float dy = 0.0f;
                if (p.Filter == NormalFilter::CentralDifference)
                {
                    dx = at(x + 1, y) - at(x - 1, y);
                    dy = at(x, y + 1) - at(x, y - 1);
                }
                else
                {
                    // 中央差分と同じスケールになるよう重みの合計で割る。
                    const float side = p.Filter == NormalFilter::Sobel ? 1.0f : 3.0f;
                    const float center = p.Filter == NormalFilter::Sobel ? 2.0f : 10.0f;
                    const float norm = 1.0f / (side * 2.0f + center);
                    dx = ((at(x + 1, y - 1) - at(x - 1, y - 1)) * side + (at(x + 1, y) - at(x - 1, y)) * center +
                          (at(x + 1, y + 1) - at(x - 1, y + 1)) * side) *
                         norm;
                    dy = ((at(x - 1, y + 1) - at(x - 1, y - 1)) * side + (at(x, y + 1) - at(x, y - 1)) * center +
                          (at(x + 1, y + 1) - at(x + 1, y - 1)) * side) *
                         norm;
                }
                dx *= strength;
                dy *= strength;
                // プロシージャルの法線出力（GenerateTexture）と同じ (-dx, dy, 1)。FlipY で DirectX 規約。
                float nx = -dx;
                float ny = p.FlipY ? -dy : dy;
                float nz = 1.0f;
                const float inv = 1.0f / std::sqrt(nx * nx + ny * ny + nz * nz);
                nx *= inv;
                ny *= inv;
                nz *= inv;
                out.Pixels[static_cast<size_t>(y) * width + x] = {nx * 0.5f + 0.5f, ny * 0.5f + 0.5f,
                                                                  nz * 0.5f + 0.5f, 1.0f};
            }
        });
        return out;
    }

    inline ImageMaps BuildImageMaps(const Image& source, const ImageMapParams& p, bool srgbEncoded, float pixelScale)
    {
        ImageMaps maps;
        if (source.Width <= 0 || source.Height <= 0)
        {
            return maps;
        }
        const auto h = ComputeHeight(source, p, srgbEncoded, pixelScale);
        maps.Height.Width = source.Width;
        maps.Height.Height = source.Height;
        maps.Height.Pixels.resize(h.size());
        for (size_t i = 0; i < h.size(); ++i)
        {
            maps.Height.Pixels[i] = {h[i], h[i], h[i], 1.0f};
        }
        maps.Normal = HeightToNormal(h, source.Width, source.Height, p, pixelScale);
        return maps;
    }
} // namespace ProcStudio

===== FILE: source\procedural\noise.h =====
#pragma once

// CPU noise shared by terrain, deformation and Procedural Studio.
#include <algorithm>
#include <array>
#include <cmath>
#include <cstdint>
#include <limits>

namespace Procedural
{
    enum class NoiseMethod
    {
        Perlin,
        Value,
        Worley,
        Fractal,
        Ridged,
        DomainWarp,
        Composite
    };

    struct BasicNoiseSettings
    {
        NoiseMethod Method = NoiseMethod::Fractal;
        uint32_t Seed = 42;
        float Frequency = 0.08f;
        int Octaves = 5;
        float Persistence = 0.5f;
        float Lacunarity = 2.0f;
        float WarpStrength = 1.5f;
    };

    struct NoiseLayer
    {
        BasicNoiseSettings Noise;
        float Weight = 1.0f;
    };

    struct NoiseSettings : BasicNoiseSettings
    {
        int LayerCount = 2;
        std::array<NoiseLayer, 5> Layers;
    };

    namespace NoiseDetail
    {
        inline uint32_t Hash(int x, int y, uint32_t seed)
        {
            uint32_t value = static_cast<uint32_t>(x) * 0x9e3779b9u;
            value ^= static_cast<uint32_t>(y) * 0x85ebca6bu;
            value ^= seed;
            value ^= value >> 16;
            value *= 0x7feb352du;
            value ^= value >> 15;
            value *= 0x846ca68bu;
            return value ^ (value >> 16);
        }

        inline float Random01(int x, int y, uint32_t seed)
        {
            return static_cast<float>(Hash(x, y, seed) >> 8) / 16777216.0f;
        }

        inline float Fade(float value)
        {
            return value * value * value * (value * (value * 6.0f - 15.0f) + 10.0f);
        }

        inline float Lerp(float first, float second, float weight)
        {
            return first + (second - first) * weight;
        }

        inline float Gradient(int x, int y, float offsetX, float offsetY, uint32_t seed)
        {
            const float diagonal = 0.70710678118f;
            switch (Hash(x, y, seed) & 7u)
            {
                case 0:
                    return offsetX;
                case 1:
                    return -offsetX;
                case 2:
                    return offsetY;
                case 3:
                    return -offsetY;
                case 4:
                    return (offsetX + offsetY) * diagonal;
                case 5:
                    return (offsetX - offsetY) * diagonal;
                case 6:
                    return (-offsetX + offsetY) * diagonal;
                default:
                    return (-offsetX - offsetY) * diagonal;
            }
        }

        inline float LatticeNoise(float x, float y, uint32_t seed, bool useGradient)
        {
            const int cellX = static_cast<int>(std::floor(x));
            const int cellY = static_cast<int>(std::floor(y));
            const float localX = x - cellX;
            const float localY = y - cellY;
            float corners[4]{};
            for (int row = 0; row < 2; ++row)
            {
                for (int column = 0; column < 2; ++column)
                {
                    if (useGradient)
                    {
                        corners[row * 2 + column] =
                            Gradient(cellX + column, cellY + row, localX - column, localY - row, seed) * 1.41421356237f;
                    }
                    else
                    {
                        corners[row * 2 + column] = Random01(cellX + column, cellY + row, seed) * 2.0f - 1.0f;
                    }
                }
            }
            const float lower = Lerp(corners[0], corners[1], Fade(localX));
            const float upper = Lerp(corners[2], corners[3], Fade(localX));
            return Lerp(lower, upper, Fade(localY));
        }

        inline float CellularNoise(float x, float y, uint32_t seed)
        {
            const int cellX = static_cast<int>(std::floor(x));
            const int cellY = static_cast<int>(std::floor(y));
            float nearestSquared = (std::numeric_limits<float>::max)();
            for (int row = -1; row <= 1; ++row)
            {
                for (int column = -1; column <= 1; ++column)
                {
                    const int sampleX = cellX + column;
                    const int sampleY = cellY + row;
                    const float deltaX = sampleX + Random01(sampleX, sampleY, seed) - x;
                    const float deltaY = sampleY + Random01(sampleX, sampleY, seed ^ 0xa511e9b3u) - y;
                    nearestSquared = (std::min)(nearestSquared, deltaX * deltaX + deltaY * deltaY);
                }
            }
            return 1.0f - 2.0f * std::clamp(std::sqrt(nearestSquared), 0.0f, 1.0f);
        }

        inline float FractalNoise(float x, float y, const BasicNoiseSettings& settings, bool ridged)
        {
            float total = 0.0f;
            float amplitude = 1.0f;
            float amplitudeSum = 0.0f;
            const int octaves = std::clamp(settings.Octaves, 1, 8);
            for (int octave = 0; octave < octaves; ++octave)
            {
                float sample = LatticeNoise(x, y, settings.Seed + static_cast<uint32_t>(octave) * 1013u, true);
                if (ridged)
                {
                    sample = 1.0f - std::abs(sample);
                    sample = sample * sample * 2.0f - 1.0f;
                }
                total += sample * amplitude;
                amplitudeSum += amplitude;
                amplitude *= std::clamp(settings.Persistence, 0.0f, 1.0f);
                x *= std::clamp(settings.Lacunarity, 1.0f, 4.0f);
                y *= std::clamp(settings.Lacunarity, 1.0f, 4.0f);
            }
            return total / amplitudeSum;
        }
    }

    inline float SampleSingleNoise(float x, float y, const BasicNoiseSettings& settings)
    {
        if (!std::isfinite(x) || !std::isfinite(y) || !std::isfinite(settings.Frequency))
        {
            return 0.0f;
        }
        x *= std::clamp(settings.Frequency, 0.0001f, 2.0f);
        y *= std::clamp(settings.Frequency, 0.0001f, 2.0f);
        // 最大オクターブでも整数セルへの変換が定義範囲内に収まるようにする。
        x = std::clamp(x, -10000.0f, 10000.0f);
        y = std::clamp(y, -10000.0f, 10000.0f);
        float result = 0.0f;
        switch (settings.Method)
        {
            case NoiseMethod::Perlin:
                result = NoiseDetail::LatticeNoise(x, y, settings.Seed, true);
                break;
            case NoiseMethod::Value:
                result = NoiseDetail::LatticeNoise(x, y, settings.Seed, false);
                break;
            case NoiseMethod::Worley:
                result = NoiseDetail::CellularNoise(x, y, settings.Seed);
                break;
            case NoiseMethod::Fractal:
                result = NoiseDetail::FractalNoise(x, y, settings, false);
                break;
            case NoiseMethod::Ridged:
                result = NoiseDetail::FractalNoise(x, y, settings, true);
                break;
            case NoiseMethod::DomainWarp: {
                const float warp = std::clamp(settings.WarpStrength, 0.0f, 10.0f);
                const float warpedX = x + NoiseDetail::LatticeNoise(x + 17.3f, y + 9.2f, settings.Seed, true) * warp;
                const float warpedY =
                    y + NoiseDetail::LatticeNoise(x - 7.1f, y + 31.7f, settings.Seed ^ 239u, true) * warp;
                result = NoiseDetail::FractalNoise(warpedX, warpedY, settings, false);
                break;
            }
            default:
                break;
        }
        return std::clamp(result, -1.0f, 1.0f);
    }

    inline float SampleNoise(float x, float y, const NoiseSettings& settings)
    {
        if (settings.Method != NoiseMethod::Composite)
        {
            return SampleSingleNoise(x, y, settings);
        }

        double total = 0.0;
        double weightSum = 0.0;
        const int count = std::clamp(settings.LayerCount, 2, 5);
        for (int index = 0; index < count; ++index)
        {
            const auto& layer = settings.Layers[index];
            if (!std::isfinite(layer.Weight) || layer.Weight <= 0.0f)
            {
                continue;
            }
            total += SampleSingleNoise(x, y, layer.Noise) * static_cast<double>(layer.Weight);
            weightSum += layer.Weight;
        }
        return weightSum > 0.0 ? static_cast<float>(total / weightSum) : 0.0f;
    }

}

namespace ProcStudio
{
    enum class Basis
    {
        Perlin,
        Value,
        Worley,
        CellEdge, // Worleyノイズの距離差（F2 - F1）
        White,
        Simplex,
        Voronoi,
        Cell,
        Gabor,
        Wavelet,
        Curl,
        ValueGradient,
        SparseConvolution,
        Spot,
        LocalRandom,
        Chevron,
        LatticeFree,
        Phasor,
        AnisotropicGabor,
        Harmonic,
        Flow,
        Ridged, // Single-octave ridge; FractalType::Ridged is the feedback multifractal.
        Count
    };
    enum class FractalType
    {
        FBm,
        Ridged,
        Billow,
        Turbulence,
        HybridMultifractal,
        DomainWarp,
        None,
        Multifractal,
        HeterogeneousMultifractal,
        Count
    };

    struct NoiseParams
    {
        Basis BasisType = Basis::Perlin;
        FractalType Fractal = FractalType::FBm;
        uint32_t Seed = 1337;
        float Frequency = 4.0f; // テクスチャ全体のセル数。立体テクスチャではワールド空間 1 単位あたりのセル数。
        int Octaves = 5;
        float Lacunarity = 2.0f;
        float Gain = 0.5f;
        float WarpStrength = 0.6f;
        float RidgeOffset = 1.0f;
        float Direction = 0.0f;       // Radians in the XY plane for directional kernels.
        float Anisotropy = 4.0f;      // Transverse kernel compression, [1, 8].
        float KernelFrequency = 2.0f; // Oscillations per kernel radius.
        float Phase = 0.0f;           // Radians; flow rotates lattice gradients continuously.
    };

    namespace NoiseDetail
    {
        inline uint32_t Hash(uint32_t value)
        {
            value ^= value >> 16;
            value *= 0x7feb352du;
            value ^= value >> 15;
            value *= 0x846ca68bu;
            return value ^ (value >> 16);
        }

        inline uint32_t Hash3(int x, int y, int z, uint32_t seed)
        {
            return Hash(
                static_cast<uint32_t>(x) * 0x8da6b343u ^
                Hash(static_cast<uint32_t>(y) * 0xd8163841u ^ Hash(static_cast<uint32_t>(z) * 0xcb1ab31fu ^ seed)));
        }

        inline float Unit(uint32_t h)
        {
            return static_cast<float>(h >> 8) / 16777216.0f;
        }

        inline float Fade(float t)
        {
            return t * t * t * (t * (t * 6 - 15) + 10);
        }

        inline float Lerp(float a, float b, float t)
        {
            return a + (b - a) * t;
        }

        inline float Saturate(float v)
        {
            return std::clamp(v, 0.0f, 1.0f);
        }

        inline float Smooth(float a, float b, float v)
        {
            const float t = Saturate((v - a) / (std::max)(b - a, 1e-6f));
            return t * t * (3 - 2 * t);
        }

        inline int Wrap(int value, int period)
        {
            if (period <= 0)
            {
                return value;
            }
            const int m = value % period;
            return m < 0 ? m + period : m;
        }

        inline float GradientDot(uint32_t h, float x, float y, float z)
        {
            // 立方体の辺方向に沿う 12 個の勾配
            switch (h % 12u)
            {
                case 0:
                    return x + y;
                case 1:
                    return -x + y;
                case 2:
                    return x - y;
                case 3:
                    return -x - y;
                case 4:
                    return x + z;
                case 5:
                    return -x + z;
                case 6:
                    return x - z;
                case 7:
                    return -x - z;
                case 8:
                    return y + z;
                case 9:
                    return -y + z;
                case 10:
                    return y - z;
                default:
                    return -y - z;
            }
        }

        inline float Perlin(float x, float y, float z, uint32_t seed, int period)
        {
            const int ix = static_cast<int>(std::floor(x));
            const int iy = static_cast<int>(std::floor(y));
            const int iz = static_cast<int>(std::floor(z));
            const float fx = x - ix;
            const float fy = y - iy;
            const float fz = z - iz;
            const float u = Fade(fx);
            const float v = Fade(fy);
            const float w = Fade(fz);
            auto corner = [&](int dx, int dy, int dz) {
                const uint32_t h = Hash3(Wrap(ix + dx, period), Wrap(iy + dy, period), Wrap(iz + dz, period), seed);
                return GradientDot(h, fx - dx, fy - dy, fz - dz);
            };
            const float x00 = Lerp(corner(0, 0, 0), corner(1, 0, 0), u);
            const float x10 = Lerp(corner(0, 1, 0), corner(1, 1, 0), u);
            const float x01 = Lerp(corner(0, 0, 1), corner(1, 0, 1), u);
            const float x11 = Lerp(corner(0, 1, 1), corner(1, 1, 1), u);
            return std::clamp(Lerp(Lerp(x00, x10, v), Lerp(x01, x11, v), w) * 0.95f, -1.0f, 1.0f);
        }

        inline float ValueNoise(float x, float y, float z, uint32_t seed, int period)
        {
            const int ix = static_cast<int>(std::floor(x));
            const int iy = static_cast<int>(std::floor(y));
            const int iz = static_cast<int>(std::floor(z));
            const float u = Fade(x - ix);
            const float v = Fade(y - iy);
            const float w = Fade(z - iz);
            auto corner = [&](int dx, int dy, int dz) {
                return Unit(Hash3(Wrap(ix + dx, period), Wrap(iy + dy, period), Wrap(iz + dz, period), seed)) * 2 - 1;
            };
            const float x00 = Lerp(corner(0, 0, 0), corner(1, 0, 0), u);
            const float x10 = Lerp(corner(0, 1, 0), corner(1, 1, 0), u);
            const float x01 = Lerp(corner(0, 0, 1), corner(1, 0, 1), u);
            const float x11 = Lerp(corner(0, 1, 1), corner(1, 1, 1), u);
            return Lerp(Lerp(x00, x10, v), Lerp(x01, x11, v), w);
        }

        inline void Worley(float x, float y, float z, uint32_t seed, int period, float& f1, float& f2)
        {
            const int ix = static_cast<int>(std::floor(x));
            const int iy = static_cast<int>(std::floor(y));
            const int iz = static_cast<int>(std::floor(z));
            f1 = f2 = 1e9f;
            for (int dz = -1; dz <= 1; ++dz)
            {
                for (int dy = -1; dy <= 1; ++dy)
                {
                    for (int dx = -1; dx <= 1; ++dx)
                    {
                        const uint32_t h =
                            Hash3(Wrap(ix + dx, period), Wrap(iy + dy, period), Wrap(iz + dz, period), seed);
                        const float px = ix + dx + Unit(h);
                        const float py = iy + dy + Unit(Hash(h ^ 0x68bc21ebu));
                        const float pz = iz + dz + Unit(Hash(h ^ 0x02e5be93u));
                        const float d = (px - x) * (px - x) + (py - y) * (py - y) + (pz - z) * (pz - z);
                        if (d < f1)
                        {
                            f2 = f1;
                            f1 = d;
                        }
                        else if (d < f2)
                        {
                            f2 = d;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            f1 = std::sqrt(f1);
            f2 = std::sqrt(f2);
        }

        // Compact kernels share a bounded neighborhood and wrapped *hashes*, not wrapped
        // offsets: this is essential to preserve both continuity and tileability.
        inline float SimplexRaw(float x, float y, float z, uint32_t seed)
        {
            const float skew = (x + y + z) / 3.0f;
            const int i = static_cast<int>(std::floor(x + skew));
            const int j = static_cast<int>(std::floor(y + skew));
            const int k = static_cast<int>(std::floor(z + skew));
            const float unskew = (i + j + k) / 6.0f;
            const float a = x - (i - unskew), b = y - (j - unskew), c = z - (k - unskew);
            const int ix = a >= b && a >= c ? 1 : 0;
            const int iy = b > a && b >= c ? 1 : 0;
            const int iz = c > a && c > b ? 1 : 0;
            const int jx = a >= b || a >= c ? 1 : 0;
            const int jy = b > a || b >= c ? 1 : 0;
            const int jz = c > a || c > b ? 1 : 0;
            float sum = 0;
            for (int corner = 0; corner < 4; ++corner)
            {
                const int dx = corner == 0 ? 0 : (corner == 1 ? ix : (corner == 2 ? jx : 1));
                const int dy = corner == 0 ? 0 : (corner == 1 ? iy : (corner == 2 ? jy : 1));
                const int dz = corner == 0 ? 0 : (corner == 1 ? iz : (corner == 2 ? jz : 1));
                const float px = a - dx + corner / 6.0f;
                const float py = b - dy + corner / 6.0f;
                const float pz = c - dz + corner / 6.0f;
                const float t = (std::max)(0.0f, 0.6f - px * px - py * py - pz * pz);
                sum += t * t * t * t * GradientDot(Hash3(i + dx, j + dy, k + dz, seed), px, py, pz);
            }
            return std::clamp(32.0f * sum, -1.0f, 1.0f);
        }

        inline float Simplex(float x, float y, float z, uint32_t seed, int period)
        {
            if (period <= 0)
            {
                return SimplexRaw(x, y, z, seed);
            }
            // Blend translated simplex fields with quintic weights. Skewed simplex
            // lattice coordinates cannot be wrapped as Cartesian lattice cells.
            const float px = x - std::floor(x / period) * period;
            const float py = y - std::floor(y / period) * period;
            const float pz = z - std::floor(z / period) * period;
            const float u = Fade(px / period), v = Fade(py / period), w = Fade(pz / period);
            float sum = 0;
            for (int dz = 0; dz < 2; ++dz)
            {
                for (int dy = 0; dy < 2; ++dy)
                {
                    for (int dx = 0; dx < 2; ++dx)
                    {
                        sum += SimplexRaw(px - dx * period, py - dy * period, pz - dz * period, seed) *
                               (dx == 0 ? 1 - u : u) * (dy == 0 ? 1 - v : v) * (dz == 0 ? 1 - w : w);
                    }
                }
            }
            return sum;
        }

        inline float VoronoiCell(float x, float y, float z, uint32_t seed, int period)
        {
            const int ix = static_cast<int>(std::floor(x)), iy = static_cast<int>(std::floor(y));
            const int iz = static_cast<int>(std::floor(z));
            float nearest = 1e9f;
            uint32_t nearestHash = 0;
            // Radius two ensures the nearest feature is found even near cell corners.
            for (int dz = -2; dz <= 2; ++dz)
            {
                for (int dy = -2; dy <= 2; ++dy)
                {
                    for (int dx = -2; dx <= 2; ++dx)
                    {
                        const uint32_t h =
                            Hash3(Wrap(ix + dx, period), Wrap(iy + dy, period), Wrap(iz + dz, period), seed);
                        const float a = ix + dx + Unit(h) - x;
                        const float b = iy + dy + Unit(Hash(h ^ 0x68bc21ebu)) - y;
                        const float c = iz + dz + Unit(Hash(h ^ 0x02e5be93u)) - z;
                        const float d = a * a + b * b + c * c;
                        if (d < nearest)
                        {
                            nearest = d;
                            nearestHash = h;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            return Unit(Hash(nearestHash ^ 0xb5297a4du)) * 2 - 1;
        }

        inline float Flow(float x, float y, float z, uint32_t seed, int period, float phase)
        {
            const int ix = static_cast<int>(std::floor(x)), iy = static_cast<int>(std::floor(y));
            const int iz = static_cast<int>(std::floor(z));
            const float a = x - ix, b = y - iy, c = z - iz;
            const float u = Fade(a), v = Fade(b), w = Fade(c);
            const float co = std::cos(phase), si = std::sin(phase);
            float sum = 0;
            for (int dz = 0; dz < 2; ++dz)
            {
                for (int dy = 0; dy < 2; ++dy)
                {
                    for (int dx = 0; dx < 2; ++dx)
                    {
                        const uint32_t h =
                            Hash3(Wrap(ix + dx, period), Wrap(iy + dy, period), Wrap(iz + dz, period), seed);
                        // Rotate each lattice gradient, rather than translating the field.
                        const float px = a - dx, py = b - dy, pz = c - dz;
                        const float g = GradientDot(h, co * px + si * py, -si * px + co * py, pz);
                        sum += g * (dx == 0 ? 1 - u : u) * (dy == 0 ? 1 - v : v) * (dz == 0 ? 1 - w : w);
                    }
                }
            }
            return std::clamp(sum * 0.95f, -1.0f, 1.0f);
        }

        inline std::array<float, 3> CurlVector(float x, float y, float z, uint32_t seed, int period)
        {
            // Curl of three independent scalar potentials; do not normalize the
            // vector, since doing so would destroy its divergence-free property.
            const float e = 0.002f;
            const uint32_t sy = seed ^ 0x68bc21ebu, sz = seed ^ 0x02e5be93u;
            const float cx = (Perlin(x, y + e, z, sz, period) - Perlin(x, y - e, z, sz, period) -
                              Perlin(x, y, z + e, sy, period) + Perlin(x, y, z - e, sy, period)) /
                             (2 * e);
            const float cy = (Perlin(x, y, z + e, seed, period) - Perlin(x, y, z - e, seed, period) -
                              Perlin(x + e, y, z, sz, period) + Perlin(x - e, y, z, sz, period)) /
                             (2 * e);
            const float cz = (Perlin(x + e, y, z, sy, period) - Perlin(x - e, y, z, sy, period) -
                              Perlin(x, y + e, z, seed, period) + Perlin(x, y - e, z, seed, period)) /
                             (2 * e);
            return {cx, cy, cz};
        }

        inline float Spectral(float x, float y, float z, uint32_t seed, int period, bool harmonic)
        {
            const float tau = 6.28318530718f;
            float sum = 0, norm = 0;
            // No spatial lattice. Integer wavevectors for periodic synthesis, random
            // continuous wavevectors otherwise. Harmonic uses one fundamental + overtones.
            const uint32_t fundamental = Hash(seed);
            for (int wave = 0; wave < 16; ++wave)
            {
                const uint32_t h = harmonic ? fundamental : Hash(seed + static_cast<uint32_t>(wave) * 1013u);
                float a = Unit(h) * 2 - 1;
                float b = Unit(Hash(h ^ 0x68bc21ebu)) * 2 - 1;
                float c = Unit(Hash(h ^ 0x02e5be93u)) * 2 - 1;
                if (period > 0)
                {
                    a = std::floor(a * period + 0.5f) / period;
                    b = std::floor(b * period + 0.5f) / period;
                    c = std::floor(c * period + 0.5f) / period;
                    if (a == 0 && b == 0 && c == 0)
                    {
                        a = 1.0f / period;
                    }
                }
                const float multiple = harmonic ? static_cast<float>(wave + 1) : 1.0f;
                const float amplitude = harmonic ? 1.0f / (multiple * multiple) : 1.0f;
                const float phase = tau * Unit(Hash(seed + static_cast<uint32_t>(wave) * 7919u));
                sum += std::sin(tau * multiple * (a * x + b * y + c * z) + phase) * amplitude;
                norm += amplitude;
            }
            return sum / norm;
        }

        inline float CompactWavelet(float r2)
        {
            // Laplacian of the compact radial bump (1-r^2)^5 in 3D, rescaled.
            // Its integral is zero; both value and slope vanish at the support boundary.
            const float t = (std::max)(0.0f, 1.0f - r2);
            return t * t * t * (1.0f - (11.0f / 3.0f) * r2);
        }

        inline float KernelNoise(Basis basis, float x, float y, float z, uint32_t seed, int period, float direction,
                                 float anisotropy, float kernelFrequency, float phase)
        {
            const float tau = 6.28318530718f;
            const int ix = static_cast<int>(std::floor(x)), iy = static_cast<int>(std::floor(y));
            const int iz = static_cast<int>(std::floor(z));
            float real = 0, imaginary = 0, spots = 0;
            const float stretch = std::clamp(anisotropy, 1.0f, 8.0f);
            const float frequency = std::clamp(kernelFrequency, 0.25f, 8.0f);
            for (int dz = -1; dz <= 1; ++dz)
            {
                for (int dy = -1; dy <= 1; ++dy)
                {
                    for (int dx = -1; dx <= 1; ++dx)
                    {
                        const uint32_t cellHash =
                            Hash3(Wrap(ix + dx, period), Wrap(iy + dy, period), Wrap(iz + dz, period), seed);
                        // Two stratified random impulses per cell: bounded work and no empty support holes.
                        for (int impulse = 0; impulse < 2; ++impulse)
                        {
                            const uint32_t h = Hash(cellHash + static_cast<uint32_t>(impulse) * 0x9e3779b9u);
                            const float a = x - (ix + dx + Unit(h));
                            const float b = y - (iy + dy + Unit(Hash(h ^ 0x68bc21ebu)));
                            const float c = z - (iz + dz + Unit(Hash(h ^ 0x02e5be93u)));
                            const float r2 = a * a + b * b + c * c;
                            if (r2 >= 1.0f)
                            {
                                continue;
                            }
                            const float t = 1 - r2;
                            const float weight = Unit(Hash(h ^ 0xb5297a4du)) * 2 - 1;
                            if (basis == Basis::Wavelet)
                            {
                                real += weight * CompactWavelet(r2);
                                continue;
                            }
                            if (basis == Basis::SparseConvolution)
                            {
                                real += weight * t * t * t;
                                continue;
                            }
                            if (basis == Basis::Spot)
                            {
                                const float radius = 0.2f + 0.35f * Unit(Hash(h ^ 0x1b56c4e9u));
                                spots = (std::max)(spots, 1.0f - Smooth(radius * 0.6f, radius, std::sqrt(r2)));
                                continue;
                            }
                            const bool directed = basis == Basis::AnisotropicGabor || basis == Basis::Phasor;
                            const float angle = directed ? direction : tau * Unit(Hash(h ^ 0x1b56c4e9u));
                            const float along = a * std::cos(angle) + b * std::sin(angle);
                            const float across = -a * std::sin(angle) + b * std::cos(angle);
                            const float envelope =
                                std::exp(-4.0f *
                                         (along * along + across * across * (directed ? stretch : 1.0f) + c * c)) *
                                t * t;
                            const float theta = tau * frequency * along + phase + tau * Unit(Hash(h ^ 0x967a889bu));
                            if (basis == Basis::LocalRandom)
                            {
                                // Local random-phase synthesis with multiple independent frequencies.
                                real += envelope * (std::cos(theta) + 0.5f * std::cos(theta * 1.93f + h % 17u));
                            }
                            else
                            {
                                real += envelope * std::cos(theta);
                                imaginary += envelope * std::sin(theta);
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            if (basis == Basis::Spot)
            {
                return spots * 2 - 1;
            }
            if (basis == Basis::Phasor)
            {
                return real / std::sqrt((std::max)(real * real + imaginary * imaginary, 1e-12f));
            }
            return real / (1.0f + std::fabs(real));
        }
    }

    inline float BasisNoiseConfigured(Basis basis, float x, float y, float z, uint32_t seed, int period,
                                      float direction, float anisotropy, float kernelFrequency, float phase)
    {
        switch (basis)
        {
            case Basis::Value:
                return NoiseDetail::ValueNoise(x, y, z, seed, period);
            case Basis::Worley:
            case Basis::CellEdge: {
                float f1;
                float f2;
                NoiseDetail::Worley(x, y, z, seed, period, f1, f2);
                // 各ノイズ基底をフラクタル合成で同じように扱えるよう、[-1, 1] に変換する。
                const float value =
                    basis == Basis::Worley ? NoiseDetail::Saturate(f1 * 1.2f) : NoiseDetail::Saturate((f2 - f1) * 2.0f);
                return value * 2 - 1;
            }
            case Basis::White: {
                const int ix = static_cast<int>(std::floor(x)), iy = static_cast<int>(std::floor(y));
                const int iz = static_cast<int>(std::floor(z));
                const uint32_t cell = NoiseDetail::Hash3(NoiseDetail::Wrap(ix, period), NoiseDetail::Wrap(iy, period),
                                                         NoiseDetail::Wrap(iz, period), seed);
                return NoiseDetail::Unit(NoiseDetail::Hash3(static_cast<int>((x - ix) * 256),
                                                            static_cast<int>((y - iy) * 256),
                                                            static_cast<int>((z - iz) * 256), cell)) *
                           2 -
                       1;
            }
            case Basis::Simplex:
                return NoiseDetail::Simplex(x, y, z, seed, period);
            case Basis::Voronoi:
                return NoiseDetail::VoronoiCell(x, y, z, seed, period);
            case Basis::Cell:
                return NoiseDetail::Unit(NoiseDetail::Hash3(NoiseDetail::Wrap(static_cast<int>(std::floor(x)), period),
                                                            NoiseDetail::Wrap(static_cast<int>(std::floor(y)), period),
                                                            NoiseDetail::Wrap(static_cast<int>(std::floor(z)), period),
                                                            seed)) *
                           2 -
                       1;
            case Basis::Gabor:
            case Basis::AnisotropicGabor:
            case Basis::Wavelet:
            case Basis::SparseConvolution:
            case Basis::Spot:
            case Basis::LocalRandom:
            case Basis::Phasor:
                return NoiseDetail::KernelNoise(basis, x, y, z, seed, period, direction, anisotropy, kernelFrequency,
                                                phase);
            case Basis::Curl: {
                const auto curl = NoiseDetail::CurlVector(x, y, z, seed, period);
                return curl[2] / (1.0f + std::fabs(curl[2]));
            }
            case Basis::ValueGradient:
                return 0.5f *
                       (NoiseDetail::ValueNoise(x, y, z, seed, period) + NoiseDetail::Perlin(x, y, z, seed, period));
            case Basis::Chevron: {
                const float tau = 6.28318530718f;
                const float offset = NoiseDetail::Unit(NoiseDetail::Hash(seed));
                const float v = y + offset;
                const float triangle = std::fabs((v - std::floor(v)) * 2 - 1);
                return std::sin(tau * (x + triangle + offset + phase / tau));
            }
            case Basis::LatticeFree:
            case Basis::Harmonic:
                return NoiseDetail::Spectral(x, y, z, seed, period, basis == Basis::Harmonic);
            case Basis::Flow:
                return NoiseDetail::Flow(x, y, z, seed, period, phase);
            case Basis::Ridged:
                return 1.0f - 2.0f * std::fabs(NoiseDetail::Perlin(x, y, z, seed, period));
            default:
                return NoiseDetail::Perlin(x, y, z, seed, period);
        }
    }

    inline float BasisNoise(Basis basis, float x, float y, float z, uint32_t seed, int period)
    {
        return BasisNoiseConfigured(basis, x, y, z, seed, period, 0.0f, 4.0f, 2.0f, 0.0f);
    }

    inline float FractalNoise(const NoiseParams& params, float x, float y, float z, bool tileable)
    {
        const int octaves = std::clamp(params.Octaves, 1, 12);
        float frequency = (std::max)(params.Frequency, 0.001f);
        if (params.Fractal == FractalType::None)
        {
            const int period = tileable ? (std::max)(1, static_cast<int>(std::round(frequency))) : 0;
            const float scale = tileable ? static_cast<float>(period) : frequency;
            const float value =
                BasisNoiseConfigured(params.BasisType, x * scale, y * scale, z * scale, NoiseDetail::Hash(params.Seed),
                                     period, params.Direction, params.Anisotropy, params.KernelFrequency, params.Phase);
            return NoiseDetail::Saturate(value * 0.5f + 0.5f);
        }
        const float lacunarity = tileable ? (std::max)(1.0f, std::round(params.Lacunarity)) : params.Lacunarity;
        if (params.Fractal == FractalType::DomainWarp)
        {
            NoiseParams inner = params;
            inner.Fractal = FractalType::FBm;
            // 相関を抑えた 2 つの fBm 場で変形する。オフセットを周期の整数倍にしてタイル性を保つ。
            const float wx = FractalNoise(inner, x + 5.2f, y + 1.3f, z + 2.7f, tileable) * 2 - 1;
            NoiseParams second = inner;
            second.Seed = params.Seed ^ 0x9e3779b9u;
            const float wy = FractalNoise(second, x + 1.7f, y + 9.2f, z + 4.1f, tileable) * 2 - 1;
            const float s = params.WarpStrength / (std::max)(params.Frequency, 0.001f);
            return FractalNoise(inner, x + wx * s, y + wy * s, z + (wx - wy) * s * 0.5f, tileable);
        }
        float amplitude = 1;
        float sum = 0;
        float norm = 0;
        float weight = 1;
        for (int o = 0; o < octaves; ++o)
        {
            const int period = tileable ? (std::max)(1, static_cast<int>(std::round(frequency))) : 0;
            const float f = tileable ? static_cast<float>(period) : frequency;
            const uint32_t seed = NoiseDetail::Hash(params.Seed + static_cast<uint32_t>(o) * 1013u);
            float n = BasisNoiseConfigured(params.BasisType, x * f, y * f, z * f, seed, period, params.Direction,
                                           params.Anisotropy, params.KernelFrequency, params.Phase);
            switch (params.Fractal)
            {
                case FractalType::Ridged: {
                    n = params.RidgeOffset - std::fabs(n);
                    n *= n * weight;
                    weight = NoiseDetail::Saturate(n * 2);
                    sum += n * amplitude;
                    break;
                }
                case FractalType::Multifractal: {
                    // Product of offset signals; subtract the unit DC term after normalization.
                    weight *= 1.0f + n * amplitude;
                    sum = weight - 1.0f;
                    break;
                }
                case FractalType::HeterogeneousMultifractal: {
                    // Higher elevations receive more detail; valleys remain smooth.
                    const float signal = (n + params.RidgeOffset) * amplitude;
                    sum += o == 0 ? signal : signal * sum;
                    break;
                }
                case FractalType::Billow:
                    sum += (std::fabs(n) * 2 - 1) * amplitude;
                    break;
                case FractalType::Turbulence:
                    sum += std::fabs(n) * amplitude;
                    break;
                case FractalType::HybridMultifractal: {
                    const float signal = (n + params.RidgeOffset * 0.7f) * amplitude;
                    sum += o == 0 ? signal : signal * (std::min)(weight, 1.0f);
                    weight = (std::min)(weight * signal * 2, 1.0f);
                    break;
                }
                default:
                    sum += n * amplitude;
                    break;
            }
            norm += amplitude;
            amplitude *= params.Gain;
            frequency *= lacunarity;
        }
        float value = sum / (std::max)(norm, 1e-5f);
        switch (params.Fractal)
        {
            case FractalType::Ridged:
                return NoiseDetail::Saturate(value / (std::max)(params.RidgeOffset * params.RidgeOffset, 0.25f));
            case FractalType::Turbulence:
                return NoiseDetail::Saturate(value * 1.6f);
            case FractalType::HybridMultifractal:
                return NoiseDetail::Saturate(value * 0.8f);
            case FractalType::Multifractal:
                return NoiseDetail::Saturate(0.5f + 0.5f * sum / (1.0f + std::fabs(sum)));
            case FractalType::HeterogeneousMultifractal:
                return NoiseDetail::Saturate(sum / (1.0f + std::fabs(sum)));
            default:
                return NoiseDetail::Saturate(value * 0.8f + 0.5f);
        }
    }

}

#include "proceduralmath.h"
#include <algorithm>
#include <cmath>
#include <limits>
#include <istream>
#include <ostream>
#include <iomanip>
#include <string>

namespace Procedural
{
    namespace
    {
        constexpr float kPi = 3.14159265358979323846f;
    }

    void ApplyCommonNoiseParameters(NoiseSettings& settings)
    {
        for (auto& layer : settings.Layers)
        {
            const auto method = layer.Noise.Method;
            layer.Noise = settings;
            layer.Noise.Method = method;
        }
    }

    std::vector<float> BuildHeightMap(const TerrainSettings& settings)
    {
        const int resolution = std::clamp(settings.Resolution, 4, 256);
        const int side = resolution + 1;
        const float size = std::clamp(settings.Size, 1.0f, 500.0f);
        const float height = std::clamp(settings.Height, 0.0f, 100.0f);
        std::vector<float> heights(static_cast<size_t>(side) * side);
        for (int row = 0; row < side; ++row)
        {
            for (int column = 0; column < side; ++column)
            {
                const float x = size * (static_cast<float>(column) / resolution - 0.5f);
                const float z = size * (static_cast<float>(row) / resolution - 0.5f);
                heights[row * side + column] = settings.BaseHeight + SampleNoise(x, z, settings.Noise) * height;
            }
        }
        return heights;
    }

    Vector3 SampleMotion(MotionMethod method, double time, float speed, const Vector3& amplitude, uint32_t seed)
    {
        if (!std::isfinite(time) || !std::isfinite(speed))
        {
            return {};
        }
        const double cycles = time * speed;
        const float phase = static_cast<float>(std::remainder(cycles, 1.0) * 2.0 * kPi);
        switch (method)
        {
            case MotionMethod::Wave:
                return {amplitude.X * std::sin(phase), amplitude.Y * std::sin(phase), amplitude.Z * std::sin(phase)};
            case MotionMethod::Orbit:
                return {amplitude.X * (std::cos(phase) - 1.0f), amplitude.Y * std::sin(phase),
                        amplitude.Z * std::sin(phase)};
            case MotionMethod::Noise: {
                NoiseSettings settings;
                settings.Method = NoiseMethod::Perlin;
                settings.Seed = seed;
                settings.Frequency = 1.0f;
                const float coordinate = static_cast<float>(std::remainder(cycles, 8192.0));
                return {amplitude.X * (SampleNoise(coordinate, 11.2f, settings) - SampleNoise(0.0f, 11.2f, settings)),
                        amplitude.Y * (SampleNoise(coordinate, 37.9f, settings) - SampleNoise(0.0f, 37.9f, settings)),
                        amplitude.Z * (SampleNoise(coordinate, 93.1f, settings) - SampleNoise(0.0f, 93.1f, settings))};
            }
            default:
                return {};
        }
    }

    bool TerrainSettingsEqual(const TerrainSettings& first, const TerrainSettings& second)
    {
        if (first.Noise.LayerCount != second.Noise.LayerCount)
        {
            return false;
        }
        for (size_t index = 0; index < first.Noise.Layers.size(); ++index)
        {
            const auto& a = first.Noise.Layers[index];
            const auto& b = second.Noise.Layers[index];
            if (a.Weight != b.Weight || a.Noise.Method != b.Noise.Method || a.Noise.Seed != b.Noise.Seed ||
                a.Noise.Frequency != b.Noise.Frequency || a.Noise.Octaves != b.Noise.Octaves ||
                a.Noise.Persistence != b.Noise.Persistence || a.Noise.Lacunarity != b.Noise.Lacunarity ||
                a.Noise.WarpStrength != b.Noise.WarpStrength)
            {
                return false;
            }
        }
        return first.Resolution == second.Resolution && first.Size == second.Size && first.Height == second.Height &&
               first.BaseHeight == second.BaseHeight && first.Noise.Method == second.Noise.Method &&
               first.Noise.Seed == second.Noise.Seed && first.Noise.Frequency == second.Noise.Frequency &&
               first.Noise.Octaves == second.Noise.Octaves && first.Noise.Persistence == second.Noise.Persistence &&
               first.Noise.Lacunarity == second.Noise.Lacunarity &&
               first.Noise.WarpStrength == second.Noise.WarpStrength;
    }

    bool WriteTerrainPreset(std::ostream& stream, const TerrainSettings& settings)
    {
        const auto writeNoise = [&stream](const BasicNoiseSettings& noise) {
            stream << static_cast<int>(noise.Method) << ' ' << noise.Seed << ' ' << noise.Frequency << ' '
                   << noise.Octaves << ' ' << noise.Persistence << ' ' << noise.Lacunarity << ' ' << noise.WarpStrength
                   << '\n';
        };
        stream << "PROCEDURAL_TERRAIN 2\n" << std::setprecision(9);
        writeNoise(settings.Noise);
        stream << settings.Resolution << ' ' << settings.Size << ' ' << settings.Height << ' ' << settings.BaseHeight
               << '\n';
        stream << settings.Noise.LayerCount << '\n';
        for (const auto& layer : settings.Noise.Layers)
        {
            writeNoise(layer.Noise);
            stream << layer.Weight << '\n';
        }
        return static_cast<bool>(stream);
    }

    bool ReadTerrainPreset(std::istream& stream, TerrainSettings& settings)
    {
        std::string signature;
        int version = 0;
        TerrainSettings loaded;
        const auto readNoise = [&stream](BasicNoiseSettings& noise, int maximumMethod) {
            int method = 0;
            if (!(stream >> method >> noise.Seed >> noise.Frequency >> noise.Octaves >> noise.Persistence >>
                  noise.Lacunarity >> noise.WarpStrength) ||
                method < 0 || method > maximumMethod || !std::isfinite(noise.Frequency) || noise.Frequency < 0.0001f ||
                noise.Frequency > 2.0f || noise.Octaves < 1 || noise.Octaves > 8 || !std::isfinite(noise.Persistence) ||
                noise.Persistence < 0.0f || noise.Persistence > 1.0f || !std::isfinite(noise.Lacunarity) ||
                noise.Lacunarity < 1.0f || noise.Lacunarity > 4.0f || !std::isfinite(noise.WarpStrength) ||
                noise.WarpStrength < 0.0f || noise.WarpStrength > 10.0f)
            {
                return false;
            }
            noise.Method = static_cast<NoiseMethod>(method);
            return true;
        };
        if (!(stream >> signature >> version) || signature != "PROCEDURAL_TERRAIN" || (version != 1 && version != 2) ||
            !readNoise(loaded.Noise, version == 1 ? 5 : 6) ||
            !(stream >> loaded.Resolution >> loaded.Size >> loaded.Height >> loaded.BaseHeight) ||
            loaded.Resolution < 4 || loaded.Resolution > 256 || !std::isfinite(loaded.Size) || loaded.Size < 1.0f ||
            loaded.Size > 500.0f || !std::isfinite(loaded.Height) || loaded.Height < 0.0f || loaded.Height > 100.0f ||
            !std::isfinite(loaded.BaseHeight) || std::abs(loaded.BaseHeight) > 1000.0f)
        {
            return false;
        }
        if (version == 2)
        {
            if (!(stream >> loaded.Noise.LayerCount) || loaded.Noise.LayerCount < 2 || loaded.Noise.LayerCount > 5)
            {
                return false;
            }
            for (auto& layer : loaded.Noise.Layers)
            {
                if (!readNoise(layer.Noise, 5) || !(stream >> layer.Weight) || !std::isfinite(layer.Weight) ||
                    layer.Weight < 0.0f || layer.Weight > 5.0f)
                {
                    return false;
                }
            }
        }
        else
        {
            ApplyCommonNoiseParameters(loaded.Noise);
        }
        settings = loaded;
        return true;
    }
} // 名前空間 Procedural の終わり。
