===== FILE: source\procedural\proceduraltexturegpu.cpp =====
#include "pch.h"
#include "proceduraltexturegpu.h"
#include "proceduraltextureparams.h"
#include <cstring>
#include <chrono>
#include <thread>

namespace ProcStudio
{
    namespace
    {
        using Constants = TextureGpuParams;
        static_assert(sizeof(Constants) / 4 + 6 <= 64);

        void Transition(ID3D12GraphicsCommandList* commands, ID3D12Resource* resource, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATES before,
                        D3D12_RESOURCE_STATES after)
        {
            const auto barrier = CD3DX12_RESOURCE_BARRIER::Transition(resource, before, after);
            commands->ResourceBarrier(1, &barrier);
        }

        bool CreateBuffer(ID3D12Device* device, UINT64 bytes, D3D12_HEAP_TYPE heapType, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATES state,
                          ComPtr<ID3D12Resource>& output, std::string& error)
        {
            const auto heap = CD3DX12_HEAP_PROPERTIES(heapType);
            auto description = CD3DX12_RESOURCE_DESC::Buffer(bytes);
            if (heapType == D3D12_HEAP_TYPE_DEFAULT)
            {
                description.Flags = D3D12_RESOURCE_FLAG_ALLOW_UNORDERED_ACCESS;
            }
            if (FAILED(device->CreateCommittedResource(&heap, D3D12_HEAP_FLAG_NONE, &description, state, nullptr,
                                                       IID_PPV_ARGS(&output))))
            {
                error = "GPU texture buffer allocation failed";
                return false;
            }
            return true;
        }
    }

    struct TextureGpu::Impl
    {
        ComPtr<ID3D12Device> Device;
        ComPtr<ID3D12RootSignature> Root;
        ComPtr<ID3D12PipelineState> GeneratePipeline, PreviewPipeline, NormalPipeline;
        ComPtr<ID3D12Resource> Pixels, Heights, PackedPreview, ReadbackBuffer;
        Constants Params{};
        int PreviewExtent = 0;

        void Bind(ID3D12GraphicsCommandList* commands, ID3D12PipelineState* pipeline)
        {
            commands->SetComputeRootSignature(Root.Get());
            commands->SetPipelineState(pipeline);
            commands->SetComputeRoot32BitConstants(0, sizeof(Constants) / 4, &Params, 0);
        }
    };

    TextureGpu::TextureGpu() : m_Impl(std::make_unique<Impl>()) {}

    TextureGpu::~TextureGpu() = default;

    void TextureGpu::Release()
    {
        m_Impl = std::make_unique<Impl>();
    }

    bool TextureGpu::Supports(const TextureParams& params)
    {
        const int kind = static_cast<int>(params.Kind);
        return kind >= 0 && kind < static_cast<int>(TextureKind::Count) && params.Kind != TextureKind::Mandelbrot &&
               params.Kind != TextureKind::Julia;
    }

    bool TextureGpu::Initialize(ID3D12Device* device, std::string& error)
    {
        auto& impl = *m_Impl;
        if (impl.GeneratePipeline && impl.PreviewPipeline && impl.NormalPipeline && impl.Device.Get() == device)
        {
            return true;
        }
        if (!device)
        {
            error = "GPU device is unavailable";
            return false;
        }
        impl.Device = device;
        CD3DX12_ROOT_PARAMETER parameters[4];
        parameters[0].InitAsConstants(sizeof(Constants) / 4, 0);
        parameters[1].InitAsUnorderedAccessView(0);
        parameters[2].InitAsShaderResourceView(0);
        parameters[3].InitAsUnorderedAccessView(1);
        const CD3DX12_ROOT_SIGNATURE_DESC description(4, parameters);
        ComPtr<ID3DBlob> signature, diagnostics;
        if (FAILED(D3D12SerializeRootSignature(&description, D3D_ROOT_SIGNATURE_VERSION_1, &signature, &diagnostics)) ||
            FAILED(device->CreateRootSignature(0, signature->GetBufferPointer(), signature->GetBufferSize(),
                                               IID_PPV_ARGS(&impl.Root))))
        {
            error = "GPU texture root signature creation failed";
            return false;
        }
        const auto compile = [&](const char* entry, ComPtr<ID3D12PipelineState>& pipeline) {
            ComPtr<ID3DBlob> shader;
            diagnostics.Reset();
            // The project's DXC compatibility layer promotes this profile to SM6 at runtime.
            if (FAILED(D3DCompileFromFile(
                    L"shader/hlsl/ProceduralTextureCS.hlsl", nullptr, D3D_COMPILE_STANDARD_FILE_INCLUDE, entry,
                    "cs_5_1", D3DCOMPILE_OPTIMIZATION_LEVEL3 | D3DCOMPILE_IEEE_STRICTNESS, 0, &shader, &diagnostics)))
            {
                error = diagnostics ? static_cast<const char*>(diagnostics->GetBufferPointer())
                                    : "GPU texture shader compilation failed";
                return false;
            }
            D3D12_COMPUTE_PIPELINE_STATE_DESC pipelineDescription{};
            pipelineDescription.pRootSignature = impl.Root.Get();
            pipelineDescription.CS = CD3DX12_SHADER_BYTECODE(shader.Get());
            if (FAILED(device->CreateComputePipelineState(&pipelineDescription, IID_PPV_ARGS(&pipeline))))
            {
                error = "GPU texture pipeline creation failed";
                return false;
            }
            return true;
        };
        return compile("Generate", impl.GeneratePipeline) && compile("Preview", impl.PreviewPipeline) &&
               compile("Normals", impl.NormalPipeline);
    }

    bool TextureGpu::Generate(ID3D12GraphicsCommandList* commands, const TextureParams& params, int width, int height,
                              std::string& error)
    {
        auto& impl = *m_Impl;
        if (!commands || !impl.GeneratePipeline || !Supports(params))
        {
            error = "Texture requires CPU generation or GPU initialization";
            return false;
        }
        width = std::clamp(width, 1, 8192);
        height = std::clamp(height, 1, 8192);
        if (!impl.Pixels || impl.Params.Width != static_cast<uint32_t>(width) ||
            impl.Params.Height != static_cast<uint32_t>(height))
        {
            ComPtr<ID3D12Resource> pixels;
            if (!CreateBuffer(impl.Device.Get(), UINT64(width) * height * sizeof(Float4), D3D12_HEAP_TYPE_DEFAULT,
                              D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_NON_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE, pixels, error))
            {
                return false;
            }
            impl.Pixels = std::move(pixels);
            impl.ReadbackBuffer.Reset();
            impl.Heights.Reset();
        }
        const bool normalOutput = params.Output == TextureOutput::Normal;
        if (normalOutput && !impl.Heights &&
            !CreateBuffer(impl.Device.Get(), UINT64(width) * height * sizeof(Float4), D3D12_HEAP_TYPE_DEFAULT,
                          D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_NON_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE, impl.Heights, error))
        {
            return false;
        }
        impl.Params = MakeTextureGpuParams(params);
        impl.Params.Width = static_cast<uint32_t>(width);
        impl.Params.Height = static_cast<uint32_t>(height);
        auto* generated = normalOutput ? impl.Heights.Get() : impl.Pixels.Get();
        Transition(commands, generated, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_NON_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE,
                   D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_UNORDERED_ACCESS);
        impl.Bind(commands, impl.GeneratePipeline.Get());
        commands->SetComputeRootUnorderedAccessView(1, generated->GetGPUVirtualAddress());
        commands->Dispatch((width + 7) / 8, (height + 7) / 8, 1);
        Transition(commands, generated, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_UNORDERED_ACCESS,
                   D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_NON_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE);
        if (normalOutput)
        {
            Transition(commands, impl.Pixels.Get(), D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_NON_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE,
                       D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_UNORDERED_ACCESS);
            impl.Bind(commands, impl.NormalPipeline.Get());
            commands->SetComputeRootShaderResourceView(2, impl.Heights->GetGPUVirtualAddress());
            commands->SetComputeRootUnorderedAccessView(1, impl.Pixels->GetGPUVirtualAddress());
            commands->Dispatch((width + 7) / 8, (height + 7) / 8, 1);
            Transition(commands, impl.Pixels.Get(), D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_UNORDERED_ACCESS,
                       D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_NON_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE);
        }
        return true;
    }

    ID3D12Resource* TextureGpu::Preview(ID3D12GraphicsCommandList* commands, int size, int tiles, std::string& error)
    {
        auto& impl = *m_Impl;
        if (!commands || !impl.Pixels || size < 1 || size > 8192)
        {
            error = "GPU preview has no generated image or invalid dimensions";
            return nullptr;
        }
        if (!impl.PackedPreview || impl.PreviewExtent != size)
        {
            const UINT64 rowPitch = (UINT64(size) * 4 + 255) & ~UINT64(255);
            if (!CreateBuffer(impl.Device.Get(), rowPitch * size, D3D12_HEAP_TYPE_DEFAULT,
                              D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_COPY_SOURCE, impl.PackedPreview, error))
            {
                return nullptr;
            }
            impl.PreviewExtent = size;
        }
        impl.Params.PreviewSize = size;
        impl.Params.Tiles = std::clamp(tiles, 1, 4);
        Transition(commands, impl.PackedPreview.Get(), D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_COPY_SOURCE,
                   D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_UNORDERED_ACCESS);
        impl.Bind(commands, impl.PreviewPipeline.Get());
        commands->SetComputeRootShaderResourceView(2, impl.Pixels->GetGPUVirtualAddress());
        commands->SetComputeRootUnorderedAccessView(3, impl.PackedPreview->GetGPUVirtualAddress());
        commands->Dispatch((size + 7) / 8, (size + 7) / 8, 1);
        Transition(commands, impl.PackedPreview.Get(), D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_UNORDERED_ACCESS,
                   D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_COPY_SOURCE);
        return impl.PackedPreview.Get();
    }

    bool TextureGpu::CopyToReadback(ID3D12GraphicsCommandList* commands, std::string& error)
    {
        auto& impl = *m_Impl;
        if (!commands || !impl.Pixels)
        {
            error = "GPU readback has no generated image";
            return false;
        }
        const UINT64 bytes = UINT64(impl.Params.Width) * impl.Params.Height * sizeof(Float4);
        if (!impl.ReadbackBuffer && !CreateBuffer(impl.Device.Get(), bytes, D3D12_HEAP_TYPE_READBACK,
                                                  D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_COPY_DEST, impl.ReadbackBuffer, error))
        {
            return false;
        }
        Transition(commands, impl.Pixels.Get(), D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_NON_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE,
                   D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_COPY_SOURCE);
        commands->CopyBufferRegion(impl.ReadbackBuffer.Get(), 0, impl.Pixels.Get(), 0, bytes);
        Transition(commands, impl.Pixels.Get(), D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_COPY_SOURCE,
                   D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_NON_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE);
        return true;
    }

    bool TextureGpu::Readback(Image& image, std::string& error) const
    {
        const auto& impl = *m_Impl;
        if (!impl.ReadbackBuffer)
        {
            error = "GPU readback was not requested";
            return false;
        }
        const size_t count = size_t(impl.Params.Width) * impl.Params.Height;
        const D3D12_RANGE range{0, count * sizeof(Float4)};
        void* mapped = nullptr;
        if (FAILED(impl.ReadbackBuffer->Map(0, &range, &mapped)))
        {
            error = "GPU texture readback mapping failed";
            return false;
        }
        image.Width = impl.Params.Width;
        image.Height = impl.Params.Height;
        image.Pixels.resize(count);
        std::memcpy(image.Pixels.data(), mapped, range.End);
        const D3D12_RANGE written{0, 0};
        impl.ReadbackBuffer->Unmap(0, &written);
        return true;
    }

    bool GenerateTextureGpu(ID3D12Device* device, const TextureParams& params, int width, int height, Image& image,
                            std::string& error)
    {
        TextureGpu generator;
        if (!TextureGpu::Supports(params) || !generator.Initialize(device, error))
        {
            return false;
        }
        ComPtr<ID3D12CommandQueue> queue;
        ComPtr<ID3D12CommandAllocator> allocator;
        ComPtr<ID3D12GraphicsCommandList> commands;
        ComPtr<ID3D12Fence> fence;
        D3D12_COMMAND_QUEUE_DESC queueDescription{};
        queueDescription.Type = D3D12_COMMAND_LIST_TYPE_DIRECT;
        if (FAILED(device->CreateCommandQueue(&queueDescription, IID_PPV_ARGS(&queue))) ||
            FAILED(device->CreateCommandAllocator(D3D12_COMMAND_LIST_TYPE_DIRECT, IID_PPV_ARGS(&allocator))) ||
            FAILED(device->CreateCommandList(0, D3D12_COMMAND_LIST_TYPE_DIRECT, allocator.Get(), nullptr,
                                             IID_PPV_ARGS(&commands))) ||
            FAILED(device->CreateFence(0, D3D12_FENCE_FLAG_NONE, IID_PPV_ARGS(&fence))))
        {
            error = "GPU texture export queue creation failed";
            return false;
        }
        if (!generator.Generate(commands.Get(), params, width, height, error) ||
            !generator.CopyToReadback(commands.Get(), error) || FAILED(commands->Close()))
        {
            return false;
        }
        // Create the completion event before submission so an allocation failure cannot release live resources.
        HANDLE completion = CreateEvent(nullptr, FALSE, FALSE, nullptr);
        if (!completion)
        {
            error = "GPU texture completion event creation failed";
            return false;
        }
        ID3D12CommandList* lists[] = {commands.Get()};
        queue->ExecuteCommandLists(1, lists);
        HRESULT signal = queue->Signal(fence.Get(), 1);
        // A transient signaling failure must not release resources already submitted.
        while (FAILED(signal) && SUCCEEDED(device->GetDeviceRemovedReason()))
        {
            std::this_thread::sleep_for(std::chrono::milliseconds(1));
            signal = queue->Signal(fence.Get(), 1);
        }
        if (SUCCEEDED(signal))
        {
            const HRESULT notify = fence->SetEventOnCompletion(1, completion);
            const bool notified = SUCCEEDED(notify) && WaitForSingleObject(completion, INFINITE) == WAIT_OBJECT_0;
            if (!notified)
            {
                // Notification allocation can fail even when GPU submission succeeds.
                // Keep every resource alive until the fence completes or the device is removed.
                while (fence->GetCompletedValue() < 1 && SUCCEEDED(device->GetDeviceRemovedReason()))
                {
                    std::this_thread::sleep_for(std::chrono::milliseconds(1));
                }
            }
        }
        CloseHandle(completion);
        if (FAILED(signal) || FAILED(device->GetDeviceRemovedReason()) || fence->GetCompletedValue() == UINT64_MAX)
        {
            error = "GPU device was removed during texture export";
            return false;
        }
        return generator.Readback(image, error);
    }
}

#pragma once

namespace ProcStudio

    // Records on the caller's queue. Keep this object alive until its last submission completes.
    // Dimensions may change only after the caller has completed previous submissions.
    class TextureGpu
    {
      public:
        TextureGpu();
        ~TextureGpu();
        TextureGpu(const TextureGpu&) = delete;
        TextureGpu& operator=(const TextureGpu&) = delete;

        // Caller must complete all recorded submissions before releasing.
        void Release();

        static bool Supports(const TextureParams& params);
        bool Initialize(ID3D12Device* device, std::string& error);
        bool Generate(ID3D12GraphicsCommandList* commands, const TextureParams& params, int width, int height,
                      std::string& error);
        // RGBA8 rows, 256-byte aligned; suitable for CopyTextureRegion without CPU access.
        ID3D12Resource* Preview(ID3D12GraphicsCommandList* commands, int size, int tiles, std::string& error);
        bool CopyToReadback(ID3D12GraphicsCommandList* commands, std::string& error);
        // Call only after the fence for CopyToReadback has completed.
        bool Readback(Image& image, std::string& error) const;

      private:
        struct Impl;
        std::unique_ptr<Impl> m_Impl;
    };

    // Export worker: owns a separate queue and waits only for its own compute submission.
    bool GenerateTextureGpu(ID3D12Device* device, const TextureParams& params, int width, int height, Image& image,
                            std::string& error);

#pragma once
#include "proceduralstudio.h"
#include <cstddef>

namespace ProcStudio
{
    struct TextureGpuParams
    {
        uint32_t Width, Height, Kind, Output;
        uint32_t BasisType, Fractal, Seed, Tileable;
        float Frequency;
        int Octaves;
        float Lacunarity, Gain;
        float WarpStrength, RidgeOffset, Contrast, Bias;
        Float4 ColorA, ColorB, ColorC;
        float Turbulence, RingCount, Mortar, Time;
        int BricksX, BricksY, Pattern, RepeatX;
        int RepeatY;
        float PatternSize, PatternSoftness, NormalStrength;
        float Choppiness, Coverage, CloudSoftness, Padding = 0;
        uint32_t PreviewSize = 0, Tiles = 1, Padding1 = 0, Padding2 = 0;
        float Direction = 0, Anisotropy = 4, KernelFrequency = 2, Phase = 0;
    };

    static_assert(sizeof(TextureGpuParams) == 208);
    static_assert(offsetof(TextureGpuParams, Direction) == 192);

    inline TextureGpuParams MakeTextureGpuParams(const TextureParams& params)
    {
        TextureGpuParams result{};
        const auto& n = params.Noise;
        result = {0,
                  0,
                  static_cast<uint32_t>(params.Kind),
                  static_cast<uint32_t>(params.Output),
                  static_cast<uint32_t>(n.BasisType),
                  static_cast<uint32_t>(n.Fractal),
                  n.Seed,
                  params.Tileable ? 1u : 0u,
                  n.Frequency,
                  n.Octaves,
                  n.Lacunarity,
                  n.Gain,
                  n.WarpStrength,
                  n.RidgeOffset,
                  params.Contrast,
                  params.Bias,
                  {params.ColorA[0], params.ColorA[1], params.ColorA[2], 1},
                  {params.ColorB[0], params.ColorB[1], params.ColorB[2], 1},
                  {params.ColorC[0], params.ColorC[1], params.ColorC[2], 1},
                  params.Turbulence,
                  params.RingCount,
                  params.Mortar,
                  params.Time,
                  params.BricksX,
                  params.BricksY,
                  static_cast<int>(params.Pattern),
                  params.RepeatX,
                  params.RepeatY,
                  params.PatternSize,
                  params.PatternSoftness,
                  params.NormalStrength,
                  params.Choppiness,
                  params.Coverage,
                  params.Softness};
        result.Direction = n.Direction;
        result.Anisotropy = n.Anisotropy;
        result.KernelFrequency = n.KernelFrequency;
        result.Phase = n.Phase;
        // The material-only cache identity includes every definition field. These
        // spare words do not change the persisted asset or the shared GPU layout.
        uint64_t identity = 14695981039346656037ull;
        const auto* bytes = reinterpret_cast<const unsigned char*>(&result);
        for (size_t index = 0; index < sizeof(result); ++index)
        {
            identity ^= bytes[index];
            identity *= 1099511628211ull;
        }
        result.Padding1 = static_cast<uint32_t>(identity) | 1u;
        result.Padding2 = static_cast<uint32_t>(identity >> 32);
        return result;
    }
}

===== FILE: source\procedural\terrainediting.cpp =====
#include "terrainediting.h"

namespace Procedural
{
    bool TerrainEditState::SynchronizeSelection(uint32_t target, const TerrainSettings* appliedSettings)
    {
        const bool selectionChanged = target != m_Target;
        const bool settingsChangedExternally =
            appliedSettings && !TerrainSettingsEqual(*appliedSettings, m_AppliedSettings);
        if (!selectionChanged && !settingsChangedExternally)
        {
            return false;
        }
        m_Target = target;
        m_PendingChanges = false;
        m_NextApplyTime = 0.0;
        if (appliedSettings)
        {
            m_Settings = *appliedSettings;
            m_AppliedSettings = *appliedSettings;
        }
        return true;
    }

    void TerrainEditState::SetSettings(const TerrainSettings& settings)
    {
        m_Settings = settings;
        m_PendingChanges = m_Target != InvalidTarget && !TerrainSettingsEqual(m_Settings, m_AppliedSettings);
    }

    bool TerrainEditState::ShouldApply(double now, bool editingControl) const
    {
        return m_PendingChanges && (!editingControl || now >= m_NextApplyTime);
    }

    void TerrainEditState::MarkApplied(double now)
    {
        m_AppliedSettings = m_Settings;
        m_PendingChanges = false;
        double interval = 0.1;
        if (m_Settings.Resolution > 128)
        {
            interval = 0.25;
        }
        m_NextApplyTime = now + interval;
    }
} // 名前空間 Procedural の終わり。

namespace Procedural

===== FILE: source\procedural\vertexdeformation.cpp =====
#include "pch.h"
#include "vertexdeformation.h"
#include "vertexdeformationmath.h"
#include "componentmanager.h"
#include "graphicsdevice.h"
#include "modelmanager.h"
#include "world.h"
#include "renderprofiler.h"
#include <map>
#include <set>
#include <tuple>
#include <cmath>

namespace
{
    using GeometryKey = tuple<EntityID, UINT, int>;
    constexpr UINT kPrimitiveMesh = UINT_MAX;
    constexpr UINT kFrameCount = 3;
    constexpr UINT kConstantSize = 256;

    struct MotionConstants
    {
        XMFLOAT4 AmplitudeAndPhase{};
        XMFLOAT4 Parameters{}; // 空間周波数、ノイズ時刻、方式、シードのビット列。
    };

    struct Constants
    {
        MotionConstants Current;
        MotionConstants Previous;
        XMUINT4 Geometry{};
    };

    static_assert(sizeof(Constants) <= kConstantSize);

    struct FrameGeometry
    {
        ComPtr<ID3D12Resource> Base;
        ComPtr<ID3D12Resource> Current;
        ComPtr<ID3D12Resource> Previous;
        ComPtr<ID3D12Resource> ConstantBuffer;
        D3D12_VERTEX_BUFFER_VIEW View{};
        UINT64 Revision = 0;
    };

    struct History
    {
        UINT64 BaseAddress = 0;
        MotionConstants Motion{};
        double Time = 0;
        bool Valid = false;
    };

    array<map<GeometryKey, FrameGeometry>, kFrameCount> g_Frames;
    map<GeometryKey, History> g_History;
    ComPtr<ID3D12RootSignature> g_Root;
    ComPtr<ID3D12PipelineState> g_Pipeline;
    UINT g_FrameIndex = 0;
    UINT g_Dispatches = 0;
    UINT64 g_Revision = 0;

    bool Initialize()
    {
        if (g_Pipeline)
        {
            return true;
        }
        ID3D12Device* device = GraphicsDevice::GetDevice();
        if (!device)
        {
            return false;
        }
        CD3DX12_ROOT_PARAMETER parameters[4];
        parameters[0].InitAsShaderResourceView(0);
        parameters[1].InitAsUnorderedAccessView(0);
        parameters[2].InitAsUnorderedAccessView(1);
        parameters[3].InitAsConstantBufferView(0);
        const CD3DX12_ROOT_SIGNATURE_DESC description(4, parameters);
        ComPtr<ID3DBlob> serialized, errors;
        if (FAILED(D3D12SerializeRootSignature(&description, D3D_ROOT_SIGNATURE_VERSION_1, &serialized, &errors)) ||
            FAILED(device->CreateRootSignature(0, serialized->GetBufferPointer(), serialized->GetBufferSize(),
                                               IID_PPV_ARGS(&g_Root))))
        {
            return false;
        }
        ComPtr<ID3DBlob> shader;
        if (FAILED(D3DCompileFromFile(L"shader/hlsl/VertexDeformationCS.hlsl", nullptr,
                                      D3D_COMPILE_STANDARD_FILE_INCLUDE, "main", "cs_6_0",
                                      D3DCOMPILE_OPTIMIZATION_LEVEL3, 0, &shader, &errors)))
        {
            if (errors)
            {
                Debug::Log("Vertex deformation: %s\n", static_cast<const char*>(errors->GetBufferPointer()));
            }
            return false;
        }
        D3D12_COMPUTE_PIPELINE_STATE_DESC pipeline{};
        pipeline.pRootSignature = g_Root.Get();
        pipeline.CS = CD3DX12_SHADER_BYTECODE(shader.Get());
        return SUCCEEDED(device->CreateComputePipelineState(&pipeline, IID_PPV_ARGS(&g_Pipeline)));
    }

    bool Allocate(FrameGeometry& geometry, ID3D12Resource* base, const D3D12_VERTEX_BUFFER_VIEW& view)
    {
        if (geometry.Base.Get() == base && geometry.View.SizeInBytes == view.SizeInBytes && geometry.Current)
        {
            return true;
        }
        FrameGeometry created;
        created.Base = base;
        created.View = view;
        const auto defaultHeap = CD3DX12_HEAP_PROPERTIES(D3D12_HEAP_TYPE_DEFAULT);
        const auto vertexDescription =
            CD3DX12_RESOURCE_DESC::Buffer(view.SizeInBytes, D3D12_RESOURCE_FLAG_ALLOW_UNORDERED_ACCESS);
        auto* device = GraphicsDevice::GetDevice();
        const array<ComPtr<ID3D12Resource>*, 2> outputs = {addressof(created.Current), addressof(created.Previous)};
        for (auto* output : outputs)
        {
            if (FAILED(device->CreateCommittedResource(&defaultHeap, D3D12_HEAP_FLAG_NONE, &vertexDescription,
                                                       D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_VERTEX_AND_CONSTANT_BUFFER, nullptr,
                                                       IID_PPV_ARGS(output->ReleaseAndGetAddressOf()))))
            {
                return false;
            }
        }
        created.Current->SetName(L"Procedural Current Vertices");
        created.Previous->SetName(L"Procedural Previous Vertices");
        const auto uploadHeap = CD3DX12_HEAP_PROPERTIES(D3D12_HEAP_TYPE_UPLOAD);
        const auto constantDescription = CD3DX12_RESOURCE_DESC::Buffer(kConstantSize);
        if (FAILED(device->CreateCommittedResource(&uploadHeap, D3D12_HEAP_FLAG_NONE, &constantDescription,
                                                   D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_GENERIC_READ, nullptr,
                                                   IID_PPV_ARGS(&created.ConstantBuffer))))
        {
            return false;
        }
        geometry = move(created);
        return true;
    }

    MotionConstants PackMotion(const ProceduralMotionComponent& motion)
    {
        MotionConstants result;
        const double cycles = motion.Time * motion.Speed;
        const float phase = isfinite(cycles) ? static_cast<float>(remainder(cycles, 1.0) * XM_2PI) : 0;
        const float noiseTime = isfinite(cycles) ? static_cast<float>(remainder(cycles, 8192.0)) : 0;
        const auto amplitude = [](float value) {
            return isfinite(value) ? clamp(value, -100.0f, 100.0f) : 0.0f;
        };
        result.AmplitudeAndPhase = {amplitude(motion.Amplitude.x), amplitude(motion.Amplitude.y),
                                    amplitude(motion.Amplitude.z), phase};
        float seedBits;
        memcpy(&seedBits, &motion.Seed, sizeof(seedBits));
        result.Parameters = {isfinite(motion.SpatialFrequency) ? clamp(motion.SpatialFrequency, 0.001f, 4.0f) : 0.3f,
                             noiseTime, static_cast<float>(motion.Method), seedBits};
        return result;
    }

    void DispatchGeometry(ID3D12GraphicsCommandList* commandList, const GeometryKey& key, ID3D12Resource* base,
                          const D3D12_VERTEX_BUFFER_VIEW& view, const ProceduralMotionComponent& motion)
    {
        if (!base || view.StrideInBytes != sizeof(Vertex) || view.SizeInBytes == 0)
        {
            return;
        }
        FrameGeometry& geometry = g_Frames[g_FrameIndex][key];
        if (!Allocate(geometry, base, view))
        {
            return;
        }
        History& history = g_History[key];
        Constants constants;
        constants.Current = PackMotion(motion);
        const bool reset = !history.Valid || history.BaseAddress != view.BufferLocation || motion.Time < history.Time;
        constants.Previous = reset ? constants.Current : history.Motion;
        constants.Geometry = {view.SizeInBytes / view.StrideInBytes, view.StrideInBytes, 0, 0};
        void* mapped = nullptr;
        const CD3DX12_RANGE noRead(0, 0);
        if (FAILED(geometry.ConstantBuffer->Map(0, &noRead, &mapped)))
        {
            return;
        }
        memcpy(mapped, &constants, sizeof(constants));
        geometry.ConstantBuffer->Unmap(0, nullptr);

        D3D12_HEAP_PROPERTIES heapProperties{};
        base->GetHeapProperties(&heapProperties, nullptr);
        const bool uploadBase = heapProperties.Type == D3D12_HEAP_TYPE_UPLOAD;
        vector<D3D12_RESOURCE_BARRIER> barriers;
        if (!uploadBase)
        {
            barriers.push_back(CD3DX12_RESOURCE_BARRIER::Transition(
                base, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_VERTEX_AND_CONSTANT_BUFFER, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_NON_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE));
        }
        barriers.push_back(CD3DX12_RESOURCE_BARRIER::Transition(geometry.Current.Get(),
                                                                D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_VERTEX_AND_CONSTANT_BUFFER,
                                                                D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_UNORDERED_ACCESS));
        barriers.push_back(CD3DX12_RESOURCE_BARRIER::Transition(geometry.Previous.Get(),
                                                                D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_VERTEX_AND_CONSTANT_BUFFER,
                                                                D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_UNORDERED_ACCESS));
        commandList->ResourceBarrier(static_cast<UINT>(barriers.size()), barriers.data());
        commandList->SetComputeRootSignature(g_Root.Get());
        commandList->SetPipelineState(g_Pipeline.Get());
        commandList->SetComputeRootShaderResourceView(0, view.BufferLocation);
        commandList->SetComputeRootUnorderedAccessView(1, geometry.Current->GetGPUVirtualAddress());
        commandList->SetComputeRootUnorderedAccessView(2, geometry.Previous->GetGPUVirtualAddress());
        commandList->SetComputeRootConstantBufferView(3, geometry.ConstantBuffer->GetGPUVirtualAddress());
        const UINT groups = (constants.Geometry.x + 63u) / 64u;
        commandList->Dispatch((min)(groups, 65535u), (groups + 65534u) / 65535u, 1);
        for (auto& barrier : barriers)
        {
            swap(barrier.Transition.StateBefore, barrier.Transition.StateAfter);
        }
        commandList->ResourceBarrier(static_cast<UINT>(barriers.size()), barriers.data());
        history = {view.BufferLocation, constants.Current, motion.Time, true};
        geometry.Revision = g_Revision;
        ++g_Dispatches;
    }

    bool Resolve(const GeometryKey& key, VertexDeformationView& output)
    {
        if (!VertexDeformation::IsRequested(get<0>(key)))
        {
            return false;
        }
        const auto found = g_Frames[g_FrameIndex].find(key);
        if (found == g_Frames[g_FrameIndex].end() || found->second.Revision != g_Revision)
        {
            return false;
        }
        const auto& geometry = found->second;
        output.CurrentResource = geometry.Current.Get();
        output.PreviousResource = geometry.Previous.Get();
        output.CurrentView = geometry.View;
        output.PreviousView = geometry.View;
        output.CurrentView.BufferLocation = geometry.Current->GetGPUVirtualAddress();
        output.PreviousView.BufferLocation = geometry.Previous->GetGPUVirtualAddress();
        output.GeometryRevision = geometry.Revision;
        return true;
    }
}

bool VertexDeformation::IsRequested(EntityID entity)
{
    if (!Registry::IsAlive(entity) || !ComponentManager::HasComponent<ProceduralMotionComponent>(entity) ||
        ComponentManager::HasComponent<AnimationModelComponent>(entity))
    {
        return false;
    }
    const auto& motion = ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<ProceduralMotionComponent>(entity);
    return motion.Enabled && motion.Target == Procedural::MotionTarget::MeshVertices;
}

void VertexDeformation::PrepareFrame(ID3D12GraphicsCommandList* commandList, UINT frameIndex)
{
    g_FrameIndex = frameIndex % kFrameCount;
    g_Dispatches = 0;
    ++g_Revision;
    if (!commandList || !Initialize())
    {
        return;
    }
    RenderProfiler::ScopedEvent profile("Procedural Vertices", commandList);
    set<GeometryKey> live;
    for (EntityID entity : World::GetView<ProceduralMotionComponent>())
    {
        if (!IsRequested(entity))
        {
            continue;
        }
        const auto& motion = ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<ProceduralMotionComponent>(entity);
        if (ComponentManager::HasComponent<StaticModelComponent>(entity))
        {
            const auto& modelComponent = ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<StaticModelComponent>(entity);
            const auto* model = ModelManager::GetStaticModel(modelComponent.ModelId);
            if (!model)
            {
                continue;
            }
            for (UINT meshIndex = 0; meshIndex < model->GetMeshCount(); ++meshIndex)
            {
                const auto& mesh = model->GetMeshData(meshIndex);
                GeometryKey key(entity, meshIndex, -1);
                live.insert(key);
                DispatchGeometry(commandList, key, mesh.VertexBuffer.Get(), mesh.VertexBufferView, motion);
                for (int outlineMode = 0; outlineMode < kToonOutlineModeCount; ++outlineMode)
                {
                    if (!mesh.TeoVertexBuffers[outlineMode])
                    {
                        continue;
                    }
                    key = {entity, meshIndex, outlineMode};
                    live.insert(key);
                    DispatchGeometry(commandList, key, mesh.TeoVertexBuffers[outlineMode].Get(),
                                     mesh.TeoVertexBufferViews[outlineMode], motion);
                }
            }
        }
        else if (ComponentManager::HasComponent<MeshComponent>(entity))
        {
            const auto& mesh = ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<MeshComponent>(entity);
            const GeometryKey key(entity, kPrimitiveMesh, -1);
            live.insert(key);
            DispatchGeometry(commandList, key, mesh.VertexBuffer.Get(), mesh.VertexBufferView, motion);
        }
    }
    // フェンスが完了したのは現在のフレームスロットだけ。他のスロットは安全になるまで旧バッファを保持する。
    for (auto it = g_Frames[g_FrameIndex].begin(); it != g_Frames[g_FrameIndex].end();)
    {
        if (!live.count(it->first))
        {
            it = g_Frames[g_FrameIndex].erase(it);
        }
        else
        {
            ++it;
        }
    }
    for (auto it = g_History.begin(); it != g_History.end();)
    {
        if (!live.count(it->first))
        {
            it = g_History.erase(it);
        }
        else
        {
            ++it;
        }
    }
}

bool VertexDeformation::TryResolveMesh(EntityID entity, VertexDeformationView& output)
{
    return Resolve({entity, kPrimitiveMesh, -1}, output);
}

bool VertexDeformation::TryResolveStaticMesh(EntityID entity, UINT meshIndex, VertexDeformationView& output,
                                             int outlineMode)
{
    return Resolve({entity, meshIndex, outlineMode}, output);
}

bool VertexDeformation::TryGetLocalBounds(EntityID entity, XMFLOAT3& center, XMFLOAT3& extents)
{
    if (!IsRequested(entity))
    {
        return false;
    }
    if (ComponentManager::HasComponent<StaticModelComponent>(entity))
    {
        const auto* model =
            ModelManager::GetStaticModel(ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<StaticModelComponent>(entity).ModelId);
        if (!model)
        {
            return false;
        }
        center = model->GetAabbCenter();
        extents = model->GetAabbExtents();
    }
    else if (ComponentManager::HasComponent<MeshComponent>(entity))
    {
        const auto& mesh = ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<MeshComponent>(entity);
        if (!mesh.HasLocalBounds)
        {
            return false;
        }
        center = mesh.LocalBoundsCenter;
        extents = mesh.LocalBoundsExtents;
    }
    else
    {
        return false;
    }
    const auto& motion = ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<ProceduralMotionComponent>(entity);
    const auto padding =
        Procedural::GetDeformationBoundsPadding({motion.Method,
                                                 {motion.Amplitude.x, motion.Amplitude.y, motion.Amplitude.z},
                                                 motion.Speed,
                                                 motion.SpatialFrequency,
                                                 motion.Seed});
    extents.x += padding.X;
    extents.y += padding.Y;
    extents.z += padding.Z;
    return true;
}

void VertexDeformation::ResetHistory(EntityID entity)
{
    for (auto& [key, history] : g_History)
    {
        if (get<0>(key) == entity)
        {
            history.Valid = false;
        }
    }
}

void VertexDeformation::Shutdown()
{
    g_Frames = {};
    g_History.clear();
    g_Pipeline.Reset();
    g_Root.Reset();
    g_Dispatches = 0;
    g_Revision = 0;
}

UINT VertexDeformation::GetDispatchCount()
{
    return g_Dispatches;
}

  public:

===== FILE: source\procedural\vertexdeformationmath.cpp =====
#include "vertexdeformationmath.h"
#include <algorithm>
#include <cmath>

namespace Procedural
{
    namespace
    {
        constexpr double kTwoPi = 6.28318530717958647692;

        Vector3 Subtract(const Vector3& first, const Vector3& second)
        {
            return {first.X - second.X, first.Y - second.Y, first.Z - second.Z};
        }

        Vector3 AddScaled(const Vector3& position, const Vector3& direction, float distance)
        {
            return {position.X + direction.X * distance, position.Y + direction.Y * distance,
                    position.Z + direction.Z * distance};
        }

        Vector3 Cross(const Vector3& first, const Vector3& second)
        {
            return {first.Y * second.Z - first.Z * second.Y, first.Z * second.X - first.X * second.Z,
                    first.X * second.Y - first.Y * second.X};
        }

        Vector3 Normalize(const Vector3& normal, const Vector3& fallback)
        {
            const float lengthSquared = normal.X * normal.X + normal.Y * normal.Y + normal.Z * normal.Z;
            if (!std::isfinite(lengthSquared) || lengthSquared <= 1e-16f)
            {
                return fallback;
            }
            const float inverseLength = 1.0f / std::sqrt(lengthSquared);
            return {normal.X * inverseLength, normal.Y * inverseLength, normal.Z * inverseLength};
        }

        float FiniteAmplitude(float amplitude)
        {
            if (!std::isfinite(amplitude))
            {
                return 0.0f;
            }
            return std::clamp(amplitude, -100.0f, 100.0f);
        }

        float SpatialFrequency(const VertexMotionSettings& settings)
        {
            if (!std::isfinite(settings.SpatialFrequency))
            {
                return 0.3f;
            }
            return std::clamp(settings.SpatialFrequency, 0.001f, 4.0f);
        }

        Vector3 SampleSpatialOffset(const Vector3& position, const VertexMotionSettings& settings, double time)
        {
            const double cycles = time * settings.Speed;
            if (!std::isfinite(cycles))
            {
                return {};
            }
            const double phase = std::remainder(cycles, 1.0) * kTwoPi;
            const double frequency = SpatialFrequency(settings);
            const double phaseX = (position.Y * 0.73 + position.Z) * frequency;
            const double phaseY = (position.X + position.Z * 0.61) * frequency;
            const double phaseZ = (position.X * 0.83 + position.Y) * frequency;
            switch (settings.Method)
            {
                case MotionMethod::Wave:
                    return {static_cast<float>(std::sin(phaseX + phase)), static_cast<float>(std::sin(phaseY + phase)),
                            static_cast<float>(std::sin(phaseZ + phase))};
                case MotionMethod::Orbit:
                    return {static_cast<float>(std::cos(phaseY + phase)), static_cast<float>(std::sin(phaseX + phase)),
                            static_cast<float>(std::sin(phaseZ + phase))};
                case MotionMethod::Noise: {
                    NoiseSettings noise;
                    noise.Method = NoiseMethod::Perlin;
                    noise.Seed = settings.Seed;
                    noise.Frequency = static_cast<float>(frequency);
                    const float coordinate = static_cast<float>(std::remainder(cycles, 8192.0));
                    return {SampleNoise(position.Y + coordinate, position.Z + 11.2f, noise),
                            SampleNoise(position.X + coordinate, position.Z + 37.9f, noise),
                            SampleNoise(position.X + 93.1f, position.Y + coordinate, noise)};
                }
                default:
                    return {};
            }
        }
    }

    Vector3 DeformPosition(const Vector3& basePosition, const VertexMotionSettings& settings, double time)
    {
        if (!std::isfinite(time) || !std::isfinite(settings.Speed))
        {
            return basePosition;
        }
        // 空間上の基準場を差し引き、時刻 0 ですべての元の頂点位置を正確に復元する。
        const Vector3 currentOffset = SampleSpatialOffset(basePosition, settings, time);
        const Vector3 restOffset = SampleSpatialOffset(basePosition, settings, 0.0);
        return {basePosition.X + FiniteAmplitude(settings.Amplitude.X) * (currentOffset.X - restOffset.X),
                basePosition.Y + FiniteAmplitude(settings.Amplitude.Y) * (currentOffset.Y - restOffset.Y),
                basePosition.Z + FiniteAmplitude(settings.Amplitude.Z) * (currentOffset.Z - restOffset.Z)};
    }

    Vector3 DeformNormal(const Vector3& basePosition, const Vector3& baseNormal, const VertexMotionSettings& settings,
                         double time)
    {
        const Vector3 unitNormal = Normalize(baseNormal, {0.0f, 1.0f, 0.0f});
        Vector3 reference = {0.0f, 1.0f, 0.0f};
        if (std::abs(unitNormal.Y) > 0.9f)
        {
            reference = {1.0f, 0.0f, 0.0f};
        }
        const Vector3 tangent = Normalize(Cross(reference, unitNormal), {0.0f, 0.0f, 1.0f});
        const Vector3 bitangent = Cross(unitNormal, tangent);
        // 両側のサンプリングで変形のヤコビ行列を近似し、元の滑らかな法線を保持する。
        const float sampleDistance = 0.001f / (std::max)(1.0f, SpatialFrequency(settings));
        const Vector3 deformedTangent =
            Subtract(DeformPosition(AddScaled(basePosition, tangent, sampleDistance), settings, time),
                     DeformPosition(AddScaled(basePosition, tangent, -sampleDistance), settings, time));
        const Vector3 deformedBitangent =
            Subtract(DeformPosition(AddScaled(basePosition, bitangent, sampleDistance), settings, time),
                     DeformPosition(AddScaled(basePosition, bitangent, -sampleDistance), settings, time));
        return Normalize(Cross(deformedTangent, deformedBitangent), unitNormal);
    }

    Vector3 GetDeformationBoundsPadding(const VertexMotionSettings& settings)
    {
        // 場のサンプルはすべて [-1, 1] なので、基準サンプルとの差の絶対値は 2 以下になる。
        return {std::abs(FiniteAmplitude(settings.Amplitude.X)) * 2.0f,
                std::abs(FiniteAmplitude(settings.Amplitude.Y)) * 2.0f,
                std::abs(FiniteAmplitude(settings.Amplitude.Z)) * 2.0f};
    }

    bool VertexMotionSettingsEqual(const VertexMotionSettings& first, const VertexMotionSettings& second)
    {
        return first.Method == second.Method && first.Amplitude.X == second.Amplitude.X &&
               first.Amplitude.Y == second.Amplitude.Y && first.Amplitude.Z == second.Amplitude.Z &&
               first.Speed == second.Speed && first.SpatialFrequency == second.SpatialFrequency &&
               first.Seed == second.Seed;
    }
} // 名前空間 Procedural の終わり。

===== FILE: source\procedural\vertexdeformationmath.h =====
#pragma once

namespace Procedural

    struct VertexMotionSettings
    {
        MotionMethod Method = MotionMethod::Wave;
        Vector3 Amplitude = {0.0f, 2.0f, 0.0f};
        float Speed = 0.2f;
        float SpatialFrequency = 0.3f;
        uint32_t Seed = 42;
    };

    Vector3 DeformPosition(const Vector3& basePosition, const VertexMotionSettings& settings, double time);
    Vector3 DeformNormal(const Vector3& basePosition, const Vector3& baseNormal, const VertexMotionSettings& settings,

#pragma once
// =============================================================================================
// 高度な画面効果（AdvancedEffects）
//   ・フロクセル（3Dグリッド）方式のボリュームフォグ（大気 + 局所フォグ + ライトシャフト）
//   ・ヒストグラム方式の自動露出（Eye Adaptation）
//   ・モーションブラー
//   ・被写界深度（DOF）
//   線形HDRシーン（ブルーム・トーンマップ前）に対して実行する。
//   ヘッダーのみで完結（.vcxproj への追加不要）。シェーダーは実行時に DXC でコンパイルする。
// =============================================================================================
#include "pch.h"
#include "rendergraph.h"
#include "envflags.h"
#include "gpumemorybudget.h"
#include "rendererstate.h"
#include "renderprofiler.h"
#include "raytracing.h"
#include "shader16bit.h"
#include "camera.h"
#include "world.h"
#include "atmosphere.h"
#include "daynightcycle.h"
#include "localheightfog.h"
#include "graphicslog.h"

#include "componentmanager.h"
#include "light.h"
#include "sun.h"
