            const auto* depths = reinterpret_cast<const float*>(depth.Bytes.data() + y * depth.RowPitch);
            const auto* materials = reinterpret_cast<const uint16_t*>(material.Bytes.data() + y * material.RowPitch);
            for (UINT x = 0; x < depth.Width; ++x)
            {
                if (RenderCapture::HalfToFloat(materials[x * 4 + 3]) < -0.5f || depths[x] <= 0.0f)
                {
                    continue;
                }
                const float uvX = (x + 0.5f) / depth.Width;
                const float uvY = (y + 0.5f) / depth.Height;
                const float worldY =
                    XMVectorGetY(XMVector3TransformCoord(XMVectorSet(uvX * 2 - 1, 1 - uvY * 2, depths[x], 1), inverse));
                g_ForegroundMask[y * depth.Width + x] = worldY < settings.BottomHeight - 0.01f;
            }
        }
    }

    void ValidateCompositeForeground()
    {
        RenderCapture::TextureData clearHdr;
        const bool read = RenderCapture::ReadTexture(RenderTargets::GetSceneResource(), clearHdr);
        const bool compatible = read && clearHdr.Width == g_CloudHdr.Width && clearHdr.Height == g_CloudHdr.Height &&
                                clearHdr.Format == DXGI_FORMAT_R16G16B16A16_FLOAT &&
                                g_CloudHdr.Format == clearHdr.Format &&
                                g_ForegroundMask.size() == static_cast<size_t>(clearHdr.Width) * clearHdr.Height &&
                                !clearHdr.Bytes.empty() && !g_CloudHdr.Bytes.empty();
        Check(compatible, "read HDR reference without cloud shadows");
        if (!compatible)
        {
            return;
        }
        UINT tested = 0;
        bool attenuated = true;
        UINT shadowed = 0;
        for (UINT y = 0; y < clearHdr.Height; ++y)
        {
            const auto* actual = reinterpret_cast<const uint16_t*>(g_CloudHdr.Bytes.data() + y * g_CloudHdr.RowPitch);
            const auto* reference = reinterpret_cast<const uint16_t*>(clearHdr.Bytes.data() + y * clearHdr.RowPitch);
            for (UINT x = 0; x < clearHdr.Width; ++x)
            {
                if (g_ForegroundMask[y * clearHdr.Width + x])
                {
                    ++tested;
                    for (UINT channel = 0; channel < 3; ++channel)
                    {
                        const float lit = RenderCapture::HalfToFloat(reference[x * 4 + channel]);
                        const float shaded = RenderCapture::HalfToFloat(actual[x * 4 + channel]);
                        attenuated &= shaded <= lit + 0.002f;
                        if (lit - shaded > 0.005f)
                        {
                            ++shadowed;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        Check(tested > 100 && attenuated, "cloud shadow only attenuates foreground illumination");
        Check(shadowed > 100, "clouds cast measurable shadows on foreground receivers");
    }
} // 名前空間

bool CloudValidation::Enabled()
{
    char value[8]{};
    return GetEnvironmentVariableA("DX12_CLOUD_TEST", value, sizeof(value)) && atoi(value) != 0;
}

void CloudValidation::BeforeFrame(uint64_t frame)
{
    g_LastFrame = static_cast<UINT>(frame);
    g_RecordedFrameIndex = GraphicsDevice::GetFrameIndex();
    if (frame == 52)
    {
        RenderConfiguration::Resize(1920, 1080);
    }
    if (frame == 64)
    {
        RenderConfiguration::Resize(1200, 600);
    }
    if (frame == 84)
    {
        RenderConfiguration::Resize(1920, 1080);
    }
    // リサイズでスワップチェーンのインデックスが変わる可能性がある。
    g_RecordedFrameIndex = GraphicsDevice::GetFrameIndex();
    RenderConfiguration::SetHdr(true);
    RenderConfiguration::SetRenderMode(RenderMode::DEFERRED);
    RenderConfiguration::SetResolutionScale(frame >= 76 && frame < 80 ? 0.67f : 1.0f);
    Raytracing::GetSettings().Enabled = false;
    RendererState::m_AntiAliasingMode = AntiAliasingMode::NONE;
    auto& settings = CloudRenderer::GetSettings();
    settings = CloudSettings{};
    settings.Enabled = true;
    settings.WindSpeed = 0;
    settings.Coverage = 0.55f;
    if (frame == 0)
    {
        for (auto id : World::GetView<MeshComponent>())
        {
            if (ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<MeshComponent>(id).IsEnvironment)
            {
                continue;
            }
            auto& tower = ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<TransformComponent>(id);
            tower.Position = {0, 18, 30};
            tower.Scale = {6, 35, 6};
            tower.IsDirty = true;
        }
    }
    const auto camera = Camera::GetCameraEntity();
    auto& transform = ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<TransformComponent>(camera);
    auto& view = ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<CameraComponent>(camera);
    transform.Position = {0, 3, -8};
    view.Target = {0, 12, 40};
    view.AllowUserControl = false;
    transform.IsDirty = true;
    // 選択した太陽光が昼を照らし、共通の仮想的な月が夜を照らす。
    for (auto id : World::GetView<LightComponent>())
    {
        auto& light = ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<LightComponent>(id);
        light.IsActive = true;
        light.Intensity = 3.0f;
        if (frame >= 44 && frame < 48)
        {
            light.Intensity = 0.0f;
        }
        else if (frame >= 48 && frame < 52)
        {
            light.Intensity = 100.0f;
        }
        light.Color = {1, 0.9f, 0.75f, 1};
        auto& sun = ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<TransformComponent>(id);
        sun.Position = frame >= 48 && frame < 52 ? XMFLOAT3{0, 1, -8} : XMFLOAT3{0, 8, -8};
        sun.IsDirty = true;
    }
    const UINT scenario = static_cast<UINT>(frame / 4);
    switch (scenario)
    {
        case 1:
            settings.Coverage = 0;
            break;
        case 2:
            settings.Density = 0;
            break;
        case 3:
            transform.Position.y = 30;
            view.Target.y = 31;
            break;
        case 4:
            transform.Position.y = 60;
            view.Target.y = 0;
            break;
        case 5:
            view.Target.y = transform.Position.y;
            break;
        case 6:
            transform.Position.y = 30;
            view.Target.y = 30;
            break;
        case 7:
            view.Target = {0.001f, 50, -8};
            break;
        case 8:
            view.Target = {0.001f, -50, -8};
            break;
        case 9:
            settings.TopHeight = settings.BottomHeight + 0.01f;
            break;
        case 10:
            settings.TopHeight = 400;
            settings.Density = 10;
            settings.Coverage = 1;
            break;
        case 13:
            settings.ApplyQuality(CloudQuality::Low);
            break;
        case 14:
            settings.ApplyQuality(CloudQuality::Medium);
            break;
        case 15:
            settings.ApplyQuality(CloudQuality::High);
            break;
        case 16:
            settings.ResolutionScale = 1;
            break;
        case 17:
            settings.Seed = 1338;
            break;
        case 20:
            settings.WindSpeed = 1000;
            break;
        default:
            break;
    }
    if (frame == 72)
    {
        CloudRenderer::GenerateNoise(1337);
    }
    if (frame >= 84 && frame < 144)
    {
        settings.ApplyQuality(CloudQuality::Low);
    }
    if (frame >= 204 && frame < 264)
    {
        settings.ApplyQuality(CloudQuality::High);
    }
    if (frame >= 264 && frame < 292)
    {
        settings.Debug = static_cast<CloudDebug>(1 + (frame - 264) / 4);
    }
    if (frame >= 292)
    {
        settings.Debug = CloudDebug::Normal;
        settings.CastShadows = frame < 296;
        if (frame == 300)
        {
            Light::CreateDesc desc;
            desc.Name = "Cloud unrelated directional regression";
            desc.Direction = {0, 1, 0};
            desc.Color = {1, 0, 1, 1};
            desc.Intensity = 100;
            desc.Priority = 100;
            g_UnrelatedDirectional = Light::Create(desc);
        }
        if (Registry::IsAlive(g_UnrelatedDirectional))
        {
            auto& unrelated = ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<LightComponent>(g_UnrelatedDirectional);
            unrelated.Intensity = 100;
            unrelated.Color = {1, 0, 1, 1};
        }
        if (frame >= 304)
        {
            for (auto id : World::GetView<SunComponent, LightComponent>())
            {
                ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<LightComponent>(id).IsActive = false;
            }
        }
    }
    if (frame >= 316)
    {
        // これらのビューは決定的に保ち、天体照明の検証ケースから独立させる。
        DayNightCycle::GetSettings().AutomaticLighting = false;
        DayNightCycle::GetSettings().TimeDriven = false;
        for (auto id : World::GetView<SunComponent, LightComponent>())
        {
            ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<LightComponent>(id).IsActive = true;
        }
        if (Registry::IsAlive(g_UnrelatedDirectional))
        {
            ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<LightComponent>(g_UnrelatedDirectional).IsActive = false;
        }
        settings.LayerCount = 2;
        settings.BottomHeight = 10;
        settings.TopHeight = 30;
        settings.Coverage = 1;
        settings.Density = 0.6f;
        settings.DetailStrength = 0;
        settings.JitterStrength = 0;
        auto& upper = settings.Layer(1);
        upper.BottomHeight = 40;
        upper.TopHeight = 50;
        upper.Coverage = 1;
        upper.Density = 0.4f;
        upper.DetailStrength = 0;
        view.Target = {0.001f, 100, -8};
        const UINT layerScenario = static_cast<UINT>((frame - 316) / 4);
        if (layerScenario == 0)
        {
            upper.LayerEnabled = false;
        }
        else if (layerScenario == 1)
        {
            settings.LayerEnabled = false;
        }
        else if (layerScenario == 3)
        {
            settings.LayerEnabled = false;
            upper.LayerEnabled = false;
        }
        else if (layerScenario == 4)
        {
            transform.Position.y = 35;
            view.Target = {0, 35, 40};
        }
        else if (layerScenario == 5)
        {
            transform.Position.y = 60;
            view.Target = {0.001f, 0, -8};
            // 高さの順を逆にし、下向きレイでの並べ替えを検証する。
            std::swap(settings.Layer(0), settings.Layer(1));
        }
        else if (layerScenario == 6)
        {
            upper.TopHeight = upper.BottomHeight + 0.01f;
            upper.Density = 10;
            settings.LayerEnabled = false;
        }
        else if (layerScenario == 7)
        {
            settings.LayerCount = 4;
            settings.Layer(2) = upper;
            settings.Layer(2).BottomHeight = 20;
            settings.Layer(2).TopHeight = 45;
            settings.Layer(3) = upper;
            settings.Layer(3).BottomHeight = 70;
            settings.Layer(3).TopHeight = 80;
        }
        else if (layerScenario >= 8)
        {
            settings.LayerEnabled = false;
            upper.Density = 4;
            settings.Extinction = 0.3f;
            settings.CastShadows = layerScenario == 8;
            view.Target = {0, 12, 40};
        }
    }
    if (frame == 0)
    {
        Check(CloudRenderer::IsAvailable(), "cloud pipelines initialize");
    }
    if (frame >= 308 && frame < 316)
    {
        auto& cycle = DayNightCycle::GetSettings();
        cycle.Running = false;
        cycle.AutomaticLighting = true;
        for (auto id : World::GetView<SunComponent, LightComponent>())
        {
            ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<LightComponent>(id).IsActive = true;
        }
        if (Registry::IsAlive(g_UnrelatedDirectional))
        {
            ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<LightComponent>(g_UnrelatedDirectional).IsActive = false;
        }
        DayNightCycle::SetTime(frame < 312 ? 17.15f : 0.0f);
        const auto direction = DayNightCycle::GetSunDirection();
        const float sign = frame < 312 ? 1.0f : -1.0f;
        view.Target = {transform.Position.x + direction.x * sign * 100,
                       transform.Position.y + (max)(direction.y * sign, 0.15f) * 100,
                       transform.Position.z + direction.z * sign * 100};
    }
    if (frame >= 356)
    {
        settings = CloudSettings{};
        settings.Enabled = true;
        settings.WindSpeed = 0;
        settings.CastShadows = frame < 360;
        settings.BottomHeight = 30;
        settings.TopHeight = 42;
        settings.BaseScale = 0.035f;
        settings.Coverage = 0.65f;
        settings.Extinction = 0.45f;
        Atmosphere::Reset();
        auto& air = Atmosphere::GetMutableParameters();
        air.HeightFalloff = 0.025f;
        air.LightShaftStrength = 2.0f;
        air.MieG = 0.65f;
        auto& effects = AdvancedEffects::GetSettings();
        effects.FroxelFog = true;
        effects.FogHistoryWeight = 0;
        effects.AutoExposure = false;
        effects.FogScattering = 1;
        transform.Position = {0, 3, -8};
        DayNightCycle::GetSettings().AutomaticLighting = true;
        DayNightCycle::SetTime(16.0f);
        const auto direction = DayNightCycle::GetSunDirection();
        view.Target = {transform.Position.x + direction.x * 100, transform.Position.y + 20,
                       transform.Position.z + direction.z * 100};
    }
    g_Configurations.push_back({static_cast<UINT>(ceilf(GraphicsDevice::GetWidth() * settings.ResolutionScale)),
                                static_cast<UINT>(ceilf(GraphicsDevice::GetHeight() * settings.ResolutionScale)),
                                settings.ViewSteps, settings.LightSteps});
}

void CloudValidation::AfterFrame(uint64_t frame)
{
    if (auto* rendered = CloudRenderer::GetCloudResource(g_RecordedFrameIndex))
    {
        const auto desc = rendered->GetDesc();
        g_Configurations.back().Width = static_cast<UINT>(desc.Width);
        g_Configurations.back().Height = desc.Height;
    }
    const auto& timing = RenderProfiler::GetLatest();
    if (timing.Serial && timing.Serial != g_LastTimingSerial && timing.Serial <= g_Configurations.size())
    {
        g_LastTimingSerial = timing.Serial;
        const auto& config = g_Configurations[timing.Serial - 1];
        for (const auto& pass : timing.Passes)
        {
            if (pass.Name == "Cloud Total" || pass.Name == "Cloud Raymarch" || pass.Name == "Cloud Composite")
            {
                g_SawGpuTiming |= pass.GpuMs > 0;
                WriteGraphicsLog("Cloud profiling: serial=%llu %s %.3f ms resolution=%ux%u steps=%d/%d\n",
                                 timing.Serial, pass.Name.c_str(), pass.GpuMs, config.Width, config.Height,
                                 config.ViewSteps, config.LightSteps);
                if (timing.Serial >= 85 && timing.Serial <= 264 && config.Width == 960 && config.Height == 540 &&
                    pass.Name == "Cloud Total" && pass.GpuMs > 0)
                {
                    const uint64_t benchmarkFrame = timing.Serial - 85;
                    const UINT quality = static_cast<UINT>(benchmarkFrame / 60);
                    if (benchmarkFrame % 60 >= 10)
                    {
                        g_BenchmarkMs[quality].push_back(pass.GpuMs);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
    if (frame >= 84 && frame < 264)
    {
        return;
    }
    if (frame % 4 != 3)
    {
        return;
    }
    if (frame >= 356)
    {
        RenderCapture::TextureData scene;
        RenderCapture::TextureData depth;
        const bool read = RenderCapture::ReadTexture(RenderTargets::GetSceneResource(), scene) &&
                          RenderCapture::ReadTexture(RenderTargets::GetGBufferResource(GBufferType::DEPTH), depth);
        const bool compatible = read && scene.Format == DXGI_FORMAT_R16G16B16A16_FLOAT &&
                                depth.Format == DXGI_FORMAT_R32_FLOAT && scene.Width == depth.Width &&
                                scene.Height == depth.Height;
        Check(compatible, "read HDR sky for cloud shaft comparison");
        if (!compatible)
        {
            return;
        }
        if (frame == 359)
        {
            g_ShaftReference = scene;
        }
        else if (g_ShaftReference.Width == scene.Width && g_ShaftReference.Height == scene.Height)
        {
            double skyDifference = 0;
            UINT skyPixels = 0;
            bool finite = true;
            for (UINT y = 0; y < scene.Height; ++y)
            {
                const auto* pixels = reinterpret_cast<const uint16_t*>(scene.Bytes.data() + y * scene.RowPitch);
                const auto* reference =
                    reinterpret_cast<const uint16_t*>(g_ShaftReference.Bytes.data() + y * g_ShaftReference.RowPitch);
                const auto* depths = reinterpret_cast<const float*>(depth.Bytes.data() + y * depth.RowPitch);
                for (UINT x = 0; x < scene.Width; ++x)
                {
                    if (depths[x] > 0)
                    {
                        continue;
                    }
                    ++skyPixels;
                    for (UINT channel = 0; channel < 3; ++channel)
                    {
                        const float actual = RenderCapture::HalfToFloat(pixels[x * 4 + channel]);
                        finite &= std::isfinite(actual) && actual >= 0;
                        skyDifference += fabs(actual - RenderCapture::HalfToFloat(reference[x * 4 + channel]));
                    }
                }
            }
            Check(finite && skyPixels > 0 && skyDifference / (std::max)(skyPixels, 1u) > 0.00001,
                  "cloud shadows modulate visible shafts against the physical sky");
        }
        Check(RenderCapture::SaveScenePng(frame == 359 ? L"bin/validation/cloud-shafts-shadowed.png"
                                                       : L"bin/validation/cloud-shafts-unshadowed.png"),
              "capture cloud shaft comparison");
        return;
    }
    RenderCapture::TextureData cloud;
    const bool read = RenderCapture::ReadTexture(CloudRenderer::GetCloudResource(g_RecordedFrameIndex), cloud);
    Check(read && cloud.Format == DXGI_FORMAT_R16G16B16A16_FLOAT, "read scattering/transmittance buffer");
    if (!read)
    {
        return;
    }
    const auto& settings = CloudRenderer::GetSettings();
    Check(cloud.Width ==
                  max(1u, static_cast<UINT>(ceilf(GraphicsDevice::GetSceneWidth() * settings.ResolutionScale))) &&
              cloud.Height ==
                  max(1u, static_cast<UINT>(ceilf(GraphicsDevice::GetSceneHeight() * settings.ResolutionScale))),
          "cloud extent follows scene resize and resolution scale");
    bool valid = true;
    double opacity = 0;
    double radiance = 0;
    for (UINT y = 0; y < cloud.Height; ++y)
    {
        const auto* pixels = reinterpret_cast<const uint16_t*>(cloud.Bytes.data() + y * cloud.RowPitch);
        for (UINT x = 0; x < cloud.Width; ++x)
        {
            for (UINT channel = 0; channel < 4; ++channel)
            {
                const float value = RenderCapture::HalfToFloat(pixels[x * 4 + channel]);
                valid &= isfinite(value) && value >= 0;
                if (channel == 3)
                {
                    valid &= value <= 1;
                    opacity += 1 - value;
                }
                else
                {
                    radiance += value;
                }
            }
        }
    }
    Check(valid, "finite nonnegative scattering and transmittance in [0,1]");
    if (frame >= 316)
    {
        const UINT layerScenario = static_cast<UINT>((frame - 316) / 4);
        if (layerScenario == 0)
        {
            g_LowerLayerOpacity = opacity;
            Check(opacity > 1, "lower layer remains visible with upper layer disabled");
        }
        else if (layerScenario == 1)
        {
            g_UpperLayerOpacity = opacity;
            Check(opacity > 1, "upper layer renders independently with lower layer disabled");
        }
        else if (layerScenario == 2)
        {
            g_TwoLayerOpacity = opacity;
            Check(opacity > g_LowerLayerOpacity && opacity > g_UpperLayerOpacity,
                  "two separated layers both contribute optical depth");
        }
        else if (layerScenario == 3)
        {
            Check(opacity == 0 && radiance == 0, "all disabled layers transmit scene exactly");
        }
        else if (layerScenario == 4)
        {
            bool clearGap = true;
            for (UINT y = cloud.Height / 2 - 1; y <= cloud.Height / 2; ++y)
            {
                const auto* pixels = reinterpret_cast<const uint16_t*>(cloud.Bytes.data() + y * cloud.RowPitch);
                for (UINT x = 0; x < cloud.Width; ++x)
                {
                    clearGap &= RenderCapture::HalfToFloat(pixels[x * 4 + 3]) == 1;
                }
            }
            Check(clearGap, "horizontal rays in gap between layers stay clear");
        }
        else if (layerScenario == 5)
        {
            Check(opacity > 1, "unsorted layers render from above");
        }
        else if (layerScenario == 6)
        {
            Check(opacity > 0, "isolated extremely thin upper layer is sampled");
        }
        else if (layerScenario == 7)
        {
            Check(opacity > g_TwoLayerOpacity, "four layers including overlaps contribute density");
        }
        if (layerScenario >= 8)
        {
            RenderCapture::TextureData scene;
            RenderCapture::TextureData material;
            const bool read =
                RenderCapture::ReadTexture(RenderTargets::GetSceneResource(), scene) &&
                RenderCapture::ReadTexture(RenderTargets::GetGBufferResource(GBufferType::MATERIAL), material);
            const bool compatible = read && scene.Format == DXGI_FORMAT_R16G16B16A16_FLOAT &&
                                    material.Format == DXGI_FORMAT_R16G16B16A16_FLOAT &&
                                    scene.Width == material.Width && scene.Height == material.Height;
            Check(compatible, "read HDR surface receivers for upper-layer shadow comparison");
            double receiverRadiance = 0;
            if (compatible)
            {
                for (UINT y = 0; y < scene.Height; ++y)
                {
                    const auto* pixels = reinterpret_cast<const uint16_t*>(scene.Bytes.data() + y * scene.RowPitch);
                    const auto* materials =
                        reinterpret_cast<const uint16_t*>(material.Bytes.data() + y * material.RowPitch);
                    for (UINT x = 0; x < scene.Width; ++x)
                    {
                        if (RenderCapture::HalfToFloat(materials[x * 4 + 3]) < -0.5f)
                        {
                            continue;
                        }
                        for (UINT channel = 0; channel < 3; ++channel)
                        {
                            receiverRadiance += RenderCapture::HalfToFloat(pixels[x * 4 + channel]);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            if (layerScenario == 8)
            {
                g_ShadowedReceiverRadiance = receiverRadiance;
                g_ShadowedCloudOpacity = opacity;
            }
            else
            {
                Check(receiverRadiance > g_ShadowedReceiverRadiance + 0.01,
                      "upper layer alone casts shadows on surface receivers");
                Check(opacity == g_ShadowedCloudOpacity, "upper-layer shadow toggle preserves cloud optical depth");
            }
        }
        if (layerScenario == 2 || layerScenario == 5 || layerScenario == 7)
        {
            wchar_t path[128]{};
            swprintf_s(path, L"bin/validation/cloud-layers-%u.png", layerScenario);
            Check(RenderCapture::SaveScenePng(path), "capture layered clouds");
        }
        return;
    }
    if (frame >= 308)
    {
        Check(opacity > 1 && radiance > 0, "celestial lighting produces visible cloud scattering");
        if (frame == 311 || frame == 315)
        {
            const wchar_t* path = frame == 311 ? L"bin/validation/cloud-sunset.png" : L"bin/validation/cloud-moon.png";
            Check(RenderCapture::SaveScenePng(path), "capture sunset or moonlit clouds");
        }
        if (frame == 315)
        {
            Check(DayNightCycle::GetSunDirection().y < 0, "moonlit clouds render with sun below horizon");
        }
        return;
    }
    if (frame >= 292)
    {
        if (frame == 295)
        {
            g_ConnectedSunCloud = cloud;
            g_ConnectedSunRadiance = radiance;
            ValidateSceneOcclusion(cloud);
        }
        if (frame == 299 || frame == 303)
        {
            bool identical = cloud.Width == g_ConnectedSunCloud.Width && cloud.Height == g_ConnectedSunCloud.Height;
            if (identical)
            {
                for (UINT y = 0; y < cloud.Height; ++y)
                {
                    identical &= memcmp(cloud.Bytes.data() + y * cloud.RowPitch,
                                        g_ConnectedSunCloud.Bytes.data() + y * g_ConnectedSunCloud.RowPitch,
                                        cloud.Width * 8) == 0;
                }
            }
            Check(identical, frame == 299 ? "shadow toggle preserves cloud scattering"
                                          : "bright unrelated directional light does not replace the virtual sun");
            if (frame == 299)
            {
                ValidateCompositeForeground();
            }
        }
        if (frame == 307)
        {
            Check(radiance < g_ConnectedSunRadiance,
                  "inactive sun removes direct cloud scattering despite unrelated light");
        }
        return;
    }
    if (frame >= 264)
    {
        Check(settings.Debug != CloudDebug::Normal, "runtime diagnostic view renders without shader recompile");
        return;
    }
    const UINT scenario = static_cast<UINT>(frame / 4);
    if (scenario == 0)
    {
        Check(opacity > 1 && radiance > 0, "volume is visible and lit");
        g_InitialOpacity = opacity;
        g_InitialRadiance = radiance;
        ValidateSceneOcclusion(cloud);
        g_NoiseHash = NoiseHash();
        Check(g_NoiseHash != 0, "GPU base noise readback");
    }
    if (scenario == 1 || scenario == 2 || scenario == 8)
    {
        Check(opacity == 0 && radiance == 0, "clear/zero-density/nonintersecting rays transmit scene exactly");
    }
    if (scenario == 1)
    {
        ValidateCompositeForeground();
    }
    if (scenario == 11)
    {
        Check(radiance < g_InitialRadiance, "zero sun intensity reduces cloud scattering");
    }
    if (scenario == 5)
    {
        bool horizontalClear = true;
        for (UINT y = cloud.Height / 2 - 1; y <= cloud.Height / 2; ++y)
        {
            const auto* pixels = reinterpret_cast<const uint16_t*>(cloud.Bytes.data() + y * cloud.RowPitch);
            for (UINT x = 0; x < cloud.Width; ++x)
            {
                horizontalClear &= RenderCapture::HalfToFloat(pixels[x * 4 + 3]) == 1;
            }
        }
        Check(horizontalClear, "horizontal rays below layer remain clear");
    }
    if (scenario == 17)
    {
        Check(NoiseHash() != g_NoiseHash, "different seed changes GPU noise");
    }
    if (scenario == 18)
    {
        Check(NoiseHash() == g_NoiseHash, "same seed regenerates identical GPU noise");
        Check(abs(opacity - g_InitialOpacity) < 0.01, "returning camera and seed restores world-space cloud");
        Check(CloudRenderer::GetNoiseGenerationCount() == 3, "noise generated only at startup and seed changes");
    }
    if (scenario == 0 || scenario == 3 || scenario == 4 || scenario == 6 || scenario == 20)
    {
        wchar_t path[128]{};
        swprintf_s(path, L"bin/validation/cloud-%02u.png", scenario);
        Check(RenderCapture::SaveScenePng(path), "capture cloud scenario");
    }
}

bool CloudValidation::Finish()
{
    Check(g_LastFrame >= 363, "complete cloud validation including cloud shafts");
    Check(g_SawGpuTiming, "cloud GPU timestamps available");
    const char* qualityNames[] = {"Low", "Medium", "High"};
    array<double, 3> medians{};
    for (UINT quality = 0; quality < 3; ++quality)
    {
        auto& samples = g_BenchmarkMs[quality];
        Check(samples.size() >= 30, "warmed 1920x1080 GPU samples for quality preset");
        if (samples.empty())
        {
            continue;
        }
        sort(samples.begin(), samples.end());
        medians[quality] = samples[samples.size() / 2];
        WriteGraphicsLog("Cloud benchmark: 1920x1080 %s samples=%zu median=%.3f ms p95=%.3f ms\n",
                         qualityNames[quality], samples.size(), medians[quality],
                         samples[static_cast<size_t>((samples.size() - 1) * 0.95)]);
    }
    Check(medians[0] < medians[1] && medians[1] < medians[2], "quality presets change measured GPU load");
    g_Failures += RenderCapture::ReportGraphicsErrors();
    ComPtr<ID3D12InfoQueue> info;
    if (SUCCEEDED(GraphicsDevice::GetDevice()->QueryInterface(IID_PPV_ARGS(&info))))
    {
        UINT warnings = 0;
        UINT legacyWarnings = 0;
        UINT trackingLimitations = 0;
        for (UINT64 index = 0; index < info->GetNumStoredMessagesAllowedByRetrievalFilter(); ++index)
        {
            SIZE_T bytes = 0;
            info->GetMessage(index, nullptr, &bytes);
            vector<BYTE> storage(bytes);
            auto* message = reinterpret_cast<D3D12_MESSAGE*>(storage.data());
            if (SUCCEEDED(info->GetMessage(index, message, &bytes)) &&
                message->Severity == D3D12_MESSAGE_SEVERITY_WARNING)
            {
                // 既存の太陽照明テストで、雲を無効にしても再現する。
                // 既存の間接 VB/IB/ルート更新が GBV を制限するため、別に報告する。
                if (message->ID == D3D12_MESSAGE_ID_GPU_BASED_VALIDATION_RESOURCE_STATE_IMPRECISE)
                {
                    ++trackingLimitations;
                    continue;
                }
                // 既存の読み戻しヘルパーは読み戻しバッファに COPY_DEST を使い、
                // 従来のシーンパスは最適化クリア値と異なる値でクリアする。
                // 雲のパスはそれらのバッファを作成せず、クリアも発行しない。
                if (message->ID == D3D12_MESSAGE_ID_CREATERESOURCE_STATE_IGNORED ||
                    message->ID == D3D12_MESSAGE_ID_CLEARRENDERTARGETVIEW_MISMATCHINGCLEARVALUE)
                {
                    ++legacyWarnings;
                    continue;
                }
                ++warnings;
                WriteGraphicsLog("Cloud validation D3D12 warning id=%u: %s\n", static_cast<UINT>(message->ID),
                                 message->pDescription);
            }
        }
        WriteGraphicsLog("Cloud validation: existing readback/scene-clear warnings = %u\n", legacyWarnings);
        WriteGraphicsLog("Cloud validation: existing GBV tracking limitations = %u\n", trackingLimitations);
        Check(warnings == 0, "no additional D3D12 resource/descriptor/barrier warnings");
    }
    WriteGraphicsLog("Validation: cloud failures = %u\n", g_Failures);
    return g_Failures == 0;
}

===== FILE: source\rendering\cloud\cloudvalidation.h =====
#pragma once
#include <cstdint>

class CloudValidation
{
  public:
    static bool Enabled();
    static void BeforeFrame(uint64_t frame);
    static void AfterFrame(uint64_t frame);
    static bool Finish();
};

===== FILE: source\rendering\colormanagement.cpp =====
#include "pch.h"
#include "colormanagement.h"
#include "graphicslog.h"

#if RENDERINGPROJECT_USE_OCIO
#include <OpenColorIO/OpenColorIO.h>
namespace OCIO = OCIO_NAMESPACE;
#endif

#include <algorithm>
#include <cmath>
#include <stdexcept>

namespace ColorManagement
{

    ColorManager& ColorManager::Get()
    {
        static ColorManager instance;
        return instance;
    }

    ColorManager::~ColorManager()
    {
        Shutdown();
    }

    bool ColorManager::Initialize(const ColorSpaceConfig& config)
    {
        Shutdown();
        if (!config.enableOCIO)
        {
            return false;
        }

        // Initialize built-in color spaces
        m_builtinSpaces = {
            {"ACES - ACEScg", "scene_linear", true},
            {"ACES2065-1", "scene_linear", true},
            {"ACEScg", "scene_linear", true},
            {"ACEScc", "scene_linear", false},
            {"ACEScct", "scene_linear", false},
            {"ARRI LogC3", "scene_linear", false},
            {"ARRI LogC4", "scene_linear", false},
            {"Blackmagic Design Film", "scene_linear", false},
            {"Canon Log", "scene_linear", false},
            {"Canon Log 2", "scene_linear", false},
            {"Canon Log 3", "scene_linear", false},
            {"DCI-P3", "display_linear", false},
            {"Display P3", "display_linear", false},
            {"ERIMM RGB", "scene_linear", true},
            {"FilmLight E-Gamut", "scene_linear", false},
            {"ITU-R BT.2020", "display_linear", false},
            {"ITU-R BT.709", "display_linear", false},
            {"Linear sRGB", "display_linear", false},
            {"Log3G10", "scene_linear", false},
            {"Log3G12", "scene_linear", false},
            {"Panasonic V-Log", "scene_linear", false},
            {"REDLog3G10", "scene_linear", false},
            {"REDLogFilm", "scene_linear", false},
            {"Rec.2020", "display_linear", false},
            {"Rec.709", "display_linear", false},
            {"sRGB", "display_linear", false},
            {"Sony S-Log", "scene_linear", false},
            {"Sony S-Log2", "scene_linear", false},
            {"Sony S-Log3", "scene_linear", false},
            {"Utility - Linear - sRGB", "display_linear", false},
            {"Utility - Raw", "scene_linear", true},
            {"Utility - sRGB - Texture", "display_linear", false},
        };

#if RENDERINGPROJECT_USE_OCIO
        try
        {
            OCIO::ConstConfigRcPtr loadedConfig;

            if (!config.configPath.empty())
            {
                loadedConfig = OCIO::Config::CreateFromFile(config.configPath.c_str());
            }
            else
            {
                // Try to find OCIO config from environment
                const char* ocioEnv = std::getenv("OCIO");
                if (ocioEnv && *ocioEnv)
                {
                    loadedConfig = OCIO::Config::CreateFromFile(ocioEnv);
                }
                else
                {
                    // Config::Create() is empty and has no scene_linear role or displays.
                    loadedConfig = OCIO::Config::CreateFromBuiltinConfig("cg-config-v2.1.0_aces-v1.3_ocio-v2.3");
                }
            }

            if (!loadedConfig)
            {
                Debug::Log("WARNING: Failed to load OCIO config, using built-in transforms\n");
            }
            else
            {
                m_config = loadedConfig;

                loadedConfig->validate();
                std::string workingSpace = config.workingSpace;
                if (workingSpace.empty())
                {
                    workingSpace = OCIO::ROLE_SCENE_LINEAR;
                }
                if (!m_config->getColorSpace(workingSpace.c_str()))
                {
                    throw std::runtime_error("Working color space not found in OCIO config: " + workingSpace);
                }

                std::string display = config.displayDevice;
                if (display.empty())
                {
                    display = m_config->getDefaultDisplay();
                }
                std::string view = config.viewTransform;
                if (view.empty())
                {
                    view = m_config->getDefaultView(display.c_str());
                }

                // Build display processor
                if (!display.empty() && !view.empty())
                {
                    // v2.3 API: Use DisplayViewHelpers::GetProcessor for display/view
                    OCIO::ConstProcessorRcPtr processor = OCIO::DisplayViewHelpers::GetProcessor(
                        m_config, workingSpace.c_str(), display.c_str(), view.c_str(),
                        OCIO::ConstMatrixTransformRcPtr(), // no channel view
                        OCIO::TRANSFORM_DIR_FORWARD);

                    // Apply look transform if specified
                    if (!config.lookTransform.empty())
                    {
                        OCIO::LookTransformRcPtr lookTransform = OCIO::LookTransform::Create();
                        lookTransform->setLooks(config.lookTransform.c_str());
                        lookTransform->setDirection(OCIO::TRANSFORM_DIR_FORWARD);

                        // Chain with display processor using GroupTransform
                        OCIO::GroupTransformRcPtr groupTransform = OCIO::GroupTransform::Create();
                        groupTransform->appendTransform(processor->createGroupTransform());
                        groupTransform->appendTransform(lookTransform);

                        m_displayProcessor = m_config->getProcessor(groupTransform);
                    }
                    else
                    {
                        m_displayProcessor = processor;
                    }

                    // Apply exposure/gamma if needed (v2.3: use ExposureContrastTransform)
                    if (config.exposure != 0.0f || config.gamma != 2.2f)
                    {
                        // Create exposure/gamma transform
                        OCIO::ExposureContrastTransformRcPtr ecTransform = OCIO::ExposureContrastTransform::Create();
                        ecTransform->setExposure(config.exposure);
                        ecTransform->setGamma(config.gamma);
                        ecTransform->setStyle(OCIO::EXPOSURE_CONTRAST_VIDEO);

                        // Chain with display processor using GroupTransform
                        OCIO::GroupTransformRcPtr groupTransform = OCIO::GroupTransform::Create();
                        if (config.lookTransform.empty())
                        {
                            groupTransform->appendTransform(m_displayProcessor->createGroupTransform());
                        }
                        else
                        {
                            groupTransform->appendTransform(m_displayProcessor->createGroupTransform());
                        }
                        groupTransform->appendTransform(ecTransform);

                        m_displayProcessor = m_config->getProcessor(groupTransform);
                    }

                    // Working to display processor
                    m_workingToDisplayProcessor = OCIO::DisplayViewHelpers::GetProcessor(
                        m_config, workingSpace.c_str(), display.c_str(), view.c_str(),
                        OCIO::ConstMatrixTransformRcPtr(), OCIO::TRANSFORM_DIR_FORWARD);
                }

                if (!m_displayProcessor)
                {
                    throw std::runtime_error("OCIO config has no usable display/view");
                }
                m_enabled = true;
                Debug::Log("OpenColorIO initialized successfully\n");
                WriteGraphicsLog("OpenColorIO initialized: config=%s working=%s display=%s view=%s\n",
                                 m_config->getName(), workingSpace.c_str(), display.c_str(), view.c_str());
                return true;
            }
        }
        catch (const OCIO::Exception& e)
        {
            WriteGraphicsLog("OCIO initialization error: %s\n", e.what());
            Debug::Log("OCIO initialization error: ");
            Debug::Log("%s", e.what());
            Debug::Log("\n");
        }
        catch (const std::exception& e)
        {
            WriteGraphicsLog("OCIO initialization error: %s\n", e.what());
            Debug::Log("OCIO initialization error: ");
            Debug::Log("%s", e.what());
            Debug::Log("\n");
        }
#endif

        Shutdown();
        // Fallback: enable built-in transforms even without OCIO
        if (config.enableOCIO)
        {
            m_enabled = true;
            Debug::Log("Color management enabled with built-in transforms (OCIO not available)\n");
            WriteGraphicsLog("Color management enabled with built-in transforms (OCIO not available)\n");
            return true;
        }

        return false;
    }

    void ColorManager::Shutdown()
    {
#if RENDERINGPROJECT_USE_OCIO
        m_displayProcessor.reset();
        m_workingToDisplayProcessor.reset();
        m_config.reset();
#endif
        m_enabled = false;
    }

bool ColorManager::IsOCIOAvailable() const
{
#if RENDERINGPROJECT_USE_OCIO
    return m_config != nullptr;
#else
    return false;
#endif
}

bool ColorManager::ConvertColorSpace(
    const float* src, float* dst,
    int width, int height, int channels,
    const std::string& fromSpace, const std::string& toSpace) const
{
    if (!src || !dst || width <= 0 || height <= 0 || channels <= 0)
        return false;

    if (fromSpace == toSpace)
    {
        if (src != dst)
        {
            std::memcpy(dst, src, size_t(width) * height * channels * sizeof(float));
        }
        return true;
    }

    const int pixelCount = width * height;
    const int stride = channels;

#if RENDERINGPROJECT_USE_OCIO
    if (m_config && m_workingToDisplayProcessor)
    {
        try
        {
            OCIO::ConstProcessorRcPtr processor = m_config->getProcessor(
                fromSpace.c_str(), toSpace.c_str());

            if (processor)
            {
                // v2.3 API: Use CPUProcessor for apply with PackedImageDesc
                OCIO::ConstCPUProcessorRcPtr cpuProcessor = processor->getDefaultCPUProcessor();
                if (cpuProcessor)
                {
                    OCIO::PackedImageDesc srcImgDesc(const_cast<float*>(src), width, height, channels);
                    OCIO::PackedImageDesc dstImgDesc(dst, width, height, channels);

                    cpuProcessor->apply(srcImgDesc, dstImgDesc);
                    return true;
                }
            }
        }
        catch (const OCIO::Exception&)
        {
            // Fall through to built-in
        }
    }
#endif

    // Built-in conversions
    if (fromSpace == "Linear sRGB" || fromSpace == "sRGB" || fromSpace == "Rec.709")
    {
        if (toSpace == "Linear sRGB" || toSpace == "Linear" || toSpace == "scene_linear")
        {
            // sRGB to Linear
            for (int i = 0; i < pixelCount; ++i)
            {
                const float* s = src + i * stride;
                float* d = dst + i * stride;
                SRGBToLinear(s, d, std::min(channels, 3));
                if (channels == 4) d[3] = s[3];
            }
            return true;
        }
    }
    else if (fromSpace == "Linear" || fromSpace == "scene_linear" || fromSpace == "Linear sRGB")
    {
        if (toSpace == "sRGB" || toSpace == "Rec.709" || toSpace == "Display")
        {
            // Linear to sRGB
            for (int i = 0; i < pixelCount; ++i)
            {
                const float* s = src + i * stride;
                float* d = dst + i * stride;
                LinearToSRGB(s, d, std::min(channels, 3));
                if (channels == 4) d[3] = s[3];
            }
            return true;
        }
    }

    // Default: copy
    if (src != dst)
    {
        std::memcpy(dst, src, size_t(pixelCount) * stride * sizeof(float));
    }
    return true;
}

bool ColorManager::ApplyDisplayTransform(
    const float* src, float* dst,
    int width, int height,
    const DisplayConfig& displayConfig) const
{
    if (!src || !dst || width <= 0 || height <= 0)
        return false;

    const int pixelCount = width * height;
    const int channels = 4;

#if RENDERINGPROJECT_USE_OCIO
    if (m_displayProcessor)
    {
        try
        {
            // v2.3 API: Use CPUProcessor for apply with PackedImageDesc
            OCIO::ConstCPUProcessorRcPtr cpuProcessor = m_displayProcessor->getDefaultCPUProcessor();
            if (cpuProcessor)
            {
                OCIO::PackedImageDesc srcImgDesc(const_cast<float*>(src), width, height, channels);
                OCIO::PackedImageDesc dstImgDesc(dst, width, height, channels);
                cpuProcessor->apply(srcImgDesc, dstImgDesc);
                return true;
            }
        }
        catch (const OCIO::Exception&)
        {
            // Fall through to built-in
        }
    }
#endif

    // Built-in display transform: Linear -> sRGB with optional exposure/gamma
    DisplayConfig config = displayConfig;
    if (config.gamma <= 0.0f) config.gamma = 2.2f;

    for (int i = 0; i < pixelCount; ++i)
    {
        const float* s = src + i * channels;
        float* d = dst + i * channels;

        // Apply exposure
        float r = s[0], g = s[1], b = s[2];
        if (config.exposure != 0.0f)
        {
            float expScale = std::exp2(config.exposure);
            r *= expScale;
            g *= expScale;
            b *= expScale;
        }

        // Linear to sRGB (approximate)
        auto toSRGB = [](float x) -> float
        {
            x = std::max(0.0f, x);
            return (x <= 0.0031308f) ? (12.92f * x) : (1.055f * std::pow(x, 1.0f / 2.4f) - 0.055f);
        };

        d[0] = toSRGB(r);
        d[1] = toSRGB(g);
        d[2] = toSRGB(b);
        d[3] = s[3];
    }

    return true;
}

std::vector<std::string> ColorManager::GetColorSpaces() const
{
    std::vector<std::string> spaces;

#if RENDERINGPROJECT_USE_OCIO
    if (m_config)
    {
        int numSpaces = m_config->getNumColorSpaces();
        for (int i = 0; i < numSpaces; ++i)
        {
            spaces.push_back(m_config->getColorSpaceNameByIndex(i));
        }
        return spaces;
    }
#endif

    // Built-in spaces
    for (const auto& space : m_builtinSpaces)
    {
        spaces.push_back(space.name);
    }
    return spaces;
}

std::vector<std::string> ColorManager::GetDisplays() const
{
    std::vector<std::string> displays;

#if RENDERINGPROJECT_USE_OCIO
    if (m_config)
    {
        int numDisplays = m_config->getNumDisplays();
        for (int i = 0; i < numDisplays; ++i)
        {
            displays.push_back(m_config->getDisplay(i));
        }
        return displays;
    }
#endif

    // Default displays
    displays = {"sRGB", "Rec.709", "DCI-P3", "Display P3", "Rec.2020"};
    return displays;
}

std::vector<std::string> ColorManager::GetViews(const std::string& display) const
{
    std::vector<std::string> views;

#if RENDERINGPROJECT_USE_OCIO
    if (m_config)
    {
        int numViews = m_config->getNumViews(display.c_str());
        for (int i = 0; i < numViews; ++i)
        {
            views.push_back(m_config->getView(display.c_str(), i));
        }
        return views;
    }
#endif

    // Default views
    views = {"sRGB", "Rec.709", "DCI-P3", "Display P3", "Rec.2020", "Raw"};
    return views;
}

std::vector<std::string> ColorManager::GetLooks(const std::string& display) const
{
    std::vector<std::string> looks;

#if RENDERINGPROJECT_USE_OCIO
    if (m_config)
    {
        int numLooks = m_config->getNumLooks();
        for (int i = 0; i < numLooks; ++i)
        {
            looks.push_back(m_config->getLookNameByIndex(i));
        }
        return looks;
    }
#endif

    // Default looks
    looks = {"None", "Filmic", "ACES", "Filmic Log", "Kodak2383", "Fuji3510"};
    return looks;
}

bool ColorManager::BuildGPUProcessor(
    const std::string& fromSpace, const std::string& toSpace,
    GPUProcessor& outProcessor) const
{
    outProcessor = GPUProcessor();

#if RENDERINGPROJECT_USE_OCIO
    if (m_config)
    {
        try
        {
            OCIO::ConstProcessorRcPtr processor = m_config->getProcessor(
                fromSpace.c_str(), toSpace.c_str());

            if (processor)
            {
                // v2.3 API: Use GPUProcessor and GpuShaderDesc to extract LUTs
                OCIO::ConstGPUProcessorRcPtr gpuProcessor = processor->getDefaultGPUProcessor();
                if (gpuProcessor)
                {
                    OCIO::GpuShaderDescRcPtr shaderDesc = OCIO::GpuShaderDesc::CreateShaderDesc();
                    gpuProcessor->extractGpuShaderInfo(shaderDesc);

                    // Extract 3D LUT
                    unsigned num3DTextures = shaderDesc->getNum3DTextures();
                    if (num3DTextures > 0)
                    {
                        const char* textureName;
                        const char* samplerName;
                        unsigned edgelen;
                        OCIO::Interpolation interpolation;
                        shaderDesc->get3DTexture(0, textureName, samplerName, edgelen, interpolation);
                        const float* values;
                        shaderDesc->get3DTextureValues(0, values);
                        outProcessor.lutSize = edgelen;
                        int numValues = edgelen * edgelen * edgelen * 4; // RGBA
                        outProcessor.lut3D.assign(values, values + numValues);
                        outProcessor.hasLut3D = true;
                    }

                    // Extract 1D LUTs
                    unsigned numTextures = shaderDesc->getNumTextures();
                    if (numTextures >= 3)
                    {
                        for (unsigned i = 0; i < 3 && i < numTextures; ++i)
                        {
                            const char* textureName;
                            const char* samplerName;
                            unsigned width, height;
                            OCIO::GpuShaderDesc::TextureType channel;
                            OCIO::GpuShaderDesc::TextureDimensions dimensions;
                            OCIO::Interpolation interpolation;
                            shaderDesc->getTexture(i, textureName, samplerName, width, height, channel, dimensions, interpolation);
                            const float* values;
                            shaderDesc->getTextureValues(i, values);
                            if (i == 0)
                            {
                                outProcessor.lut1DSize = width;
                                outProcessor.lut1D_R.assign(values, values + width);
                            }
                            else if (i == 1)
                            {
                                outProcessor.lut1D_G.assign(values, values + width);
                            }
                            else if (i == 2)
                            {
                                outProcessor.lut1D_B.assign(values, values + width);
                            }
                        }
                    }

                    return outProcessor.hasLut3D || outProcessor.lut1DSize > 0;
                }
            }
        }
        catch (const OCIO::Exception&)
        {
        }
    }
#endif

    return false;
}

bool ColorManager::BuildDisplayGPUProcessor(const DisplayConfig& displayConfig, GPUProcessor& outProcessor) const
{
    outProcessor = GPUProcessor();

#if RENDERINGPROJECT_USE_OCIO
    if (m_displayProcessor)
    {
        try
        {
            // v2.3 API: Use GPUProcessor and GpuShaderDesc to extract LUTs
            OCIO::ConstGPUProcessorRcPtr gpuProcessor = m_displayProcessor->getDefaultGPUProcessor();
            if (gpuProcessor)
            {
                OCIO::GpuShaderDescRcPtr shaderDesc = OCIO::GpuShaderDesc::CreateShaderDesc();
                gpuProcessor->extractGpuShaderInfo(shaderDesc);

                // Extract 3D LUT
                unsigned num3DTextures = shaderDesc->getNum3DTextures();
                if (num3DTextures > 0)
                {
                    const char* textureName;
                    const char* samplerName;
                    unsigned edgelen;
                    OCIO::Interpolation interpolation;
                    shaderDesc->get3DTexture(0, textureName, samplerName, edgelen, interpolation);
                    const float* values;
                    shaderDesc->get3DTextureValues(0, values);
                    outProcessor.lutSize = edgelen;
                    int numValues = edgelen * edgelen * edgelen * 4; // RGBA
                    outProcessor.lut3D.assign(values, values + numValues);
                    outProcessor.hasLut3D = true;
                }

                // Extract 1D LUTs
                unsigned numTextures = shaderDesc->getNumTextures();
                if (numTextures >= 3)
                {
                    for (unsigned i = 0; i < 3 && i < numTextures; ++i)
                    {
                        const char* textureName;
                        const char* samplerName;
                        unsigned width, height;
                        OCIO::GpuShaderDesc::TextureType channel;
                        OCIO::GpuShaderDesc::TextureDimensions dimensions;
                        OCIO::Interpolation interpolation;
                        shaderDesc->getTexture(i, textureName, samplerName, width, height, channel, dimensions, interpolation);
                        const float* values;
                        shaderDesc->getTextureValues(i, values);
                        if (i == 0)
                        {
                            outProcessor.lut1DSize = width;
                            outProcessor.lut1D_R.assign(values, values + width);
                        }
                        else if (i == 1)
                        {
                            outProcessor.lut1D_G.assign(values, values + width);
                        }
                        else if (i == 2)
                        {
                            outProcessor.lut1D_B.assign(values, values + width);
                        }
                    }
                }

                return outProcessor.hasLut3D || outProcessor.lut1DSize > 0;
            }
        }
        catch (const OCIO::Exception&)
        {
        }
    }
#endif

    return false;
}

// Static built-in transform implementations

void ColorManager::LinearToSRGB(const float* src, float* dst, int count)
{
    for (int i = 0; i < count; ++i)
    {
        float x = std::max(0.0f, src[i]);
        dst[i] = (x <= 0.0031308f) ? (12.92f * x) : (1.055f * std::pow(x, 1.0f / 2.4f) - 0.055f);
    }
}

void ColorManager::SRGBToLinear(const float* src, float* dst, int count)
{
    for (int i = 0; i < count; ++i)
    {
        float x = std::max(0.0f, src[i]);
        dst[i] = (x <= 0.04045f) ? (x / 12.92f) : std::pow((x + 0.055f) / 1.055f, 2.4f);
    }
}

void ColorManager::LinearToRec709(const float* src, float* dst, int count)
{
    // Rec.709 is very similar to sRGB
    LinearToSRGB(src, dst, count);
}

void ColorManager::ApplyExposure(const float* src, float* dst, int count, float exposure)
{
    float scale = std::exp2(exposure);
    for (int i = 0; i < count; ++i)
    {
        dst[i] = src[i] * scale;
    }
}

void ColorManager::ApplyGamma(const float* src, float* dst, int count, float gamma)
{
    float invGamma = 1.0f / gamma;
    for (int i = 0; i < count; ++i)
    {
        float x = std::max(0.0f, src[i]);
        dst[i] = std::pow(x, invGamma);
    }
}

void ColorManager::ApplyACESFilm(const float* src, float* dst, int count, float exposure)
{
    // Simplified ACES filmic tone mapping
    // Reference: https://github.com/TheRealMJP/BakingLab/blob/master/BakingLab/ACES.hlsl
    float expScale = std::exp2(exposure);

    // ACES input matrix (approx)
    const float ACESInputMat[3][3] = {
        { 0.59719f, 0.35458f, 0.04823f },
        { 0.07600f, 0.90834f, 0.01566f },
        { 0.02840f, 0.13383f, 0.83777f }
    };

    // ACES output matrix (approx)
    const float ACESOutputMat[3][3] = {
        {  1.60475f, -0.53108f, -0.07367f },
        { -0.10208f,  1.10813f, -0.00605f },
        { -0.00327f, -0.07276f,  1.07602f }
    };

    // RRT+ODT simplified
    auto RRTAndODTFit = [](float v) -> float
    {
        float a = v * (v + 0.0245786f) - 0.000090537f;
        float b = v * (0.983729f * v + 0.4329510f) + 0.238081f;
        return std::max(0.0f, a / b);
    };

    for (int i = 0; i < count; i += 3)
    {
        float r = src[i + 0] * expScale;
        float g = src[i + 1] * expScale;
        float b = src[i + 2] * expScale;

        // ACES input transform
        float r2 = ACESInputMat[0][0] * r + ACESInputMat[0][1] * g + ACESInputMat[0][2] * b;
        float g2 = ACESInputMat[1][0] * r + ACESInputMat[1][1] * g + ACESInputMat[1][2] * b;
        float b2 = ACESInputMat[2][0] * r + ACESInputMat[2][1] * g + ACESInputMat[2][2] * b;

        // RRT+ODT
        r2 = RRTAndODTFit(r2);
        g2 = RRTAndODTFit(g2);
        b2 = RRTAndODTFit(b2);

        // ACES output transform
        dst[i + 0] = ACESOutputMat[0][0] * r2 + ACESOutputMat[0][1] * g2 + ACESOutputMat[0][2] * b2;
        dst[i + 1] = ACESOutputMat[1][0] * r2 + ACESOutputMat[1][1] * g2 + ACESOutputMat[1][2] * b2;
        dst[i + 2] = ACESOutputMat[2][0] * r2 + ACESOutputMat[2][1] * g2 + ACESOutputMat[2][2] * b2;
    }
}

} // namespace ColorManagement

===== FILE: source\rendering\colormanagement.h =====
#pragma once

#include "rendererstate.h"
#include <string>
#include <vector>
#include <memory>

// Forward declare OCIO types for when OCIO is not available
#if RENDERINGPROJECT_USE_OCIO
#include <OpenColorIO/OpenColorIO.h>
namespace OCIO = OCIO_NAMESPACE;
#else
namespace OCIO
{
    class ConstConfigRcPtr;
    class ConstProcessorRcPtr;
}
#endif

namespace ColorManagement
{
    struct ColorSpaceConfig
    {
        std::string configPath;
        std::string workingSpace = "ACEScg";
        // Empty display/view selects the defaults of the loaded OCIO config.
        std::string displayDevice;
        std::string viewTransform;
        std::string lookTransform = "";
        float exposure = 0.0f;
        float gamma = 2.2f;
        bool enableOCIO = true;
    };

    struct DisplayConfig
    {
        std::string displayDevice;
        std::string viewTransform;
        std::string lookTransform;
        float exposure = 0.0f;
        float gamma = 2.2f;
    };

    class ColorManager
    {
    public:
        static ColorManager& Get();

        bool Initialize(const ColorSpaceConfig& config);
        void Shutdown();

        bool IsEnabled() const { return m_enabled; }
        bool IsOCIOAvailable() const;

        // Color space conversions
        bool ConvertColorSpace(
            const float* src, float* dst,
            int width, int height, int channels,
            const std::string& fromSpace, const std::string& toSpace) const;

        // Display transform for final output
        bool ApplyDisplayTransform(
            const float* src, float* dst,
            int width, int height,
            const DisplayConfig& displayConfig = {}) const;

        // Get available color spaces
        std::vector<std::string> GetColorSpaces() const;
        std::vector<std::string> GetDisplays() const;
        std::vector<std::string> GetViews(const std::string& display) const;
        std::vector<std::string> GetLooks(const std::string& display) const;

        // Built-in transforms (no OCIO required)
        static void LinearToSRGB(const float* src, float* dst, int count);
        static void SRGBToLinear(const float* src, float* dst, int count);
        static void LinearToRec709(const float* src, float* dst, int count);
        static void ApplyExposure(const float* src, float* dst, int count, float exposure);
        static void ApplyGamma(const float* src, float* dst, int count, float gamma);
        static void ApplyACESFilm(const float* src, float* dst, int count, float exposure = 0.0f);

        // Shader processor for GPU transforms
        struct GPUProcessor
        {
            std::vector<float> lut3D;  // 3D LUT data (R,G,B,R,G,B...)
            uint32_t lutSize = 0;      // LUT dimension (e.g., 32, 64)
            bool hasLut3D = false;

            // 1D LUTs for each channel
            std::vector<float> lut1D_R;
            std::vector<float> lut1D_G;
            std::vector<float> lut1D_B;
            uint32_t lut1DSize = 0;
        };

        bool BuildGPUProcessor(const std::string& fromSpace, const std::string& toSpace, GPUProcessor& outProcessor) const;
        bool BuildDisplayGPUProcessor(const DisplayConfig& displayConfig, GPUProcessor& outProcessor) const;

    private:
        ColorManager() = default;
        ~ColorManager();

        bool m_enabled = false;

#if RENDERINGPROJECT_USE_OCIO
        OCIO::ConstConfigRcPtr m_config;
        OCIO::ConstProcessorRcPtr m_displayProcessor;
        OCIO::ConstProcessorRcPtr m_workingToDisplayProcessor;
#else
        void* m_config = nullptr;
        void* m_displayProcessor = nullptr;
        void* m_workingToDisplayProcessor = nullptr;
#endif

        // Built-in color space data
        struct BuiltinColorSpace
        {
            std::string name;
            std::string referenceSpace; // "scene_linear", "display_linear", etc.
            bool isSceneLinear = false;
        };
        std::vector<BuiltinColorSpace> m_builtinSpaces;
    };

    // Global accessor
    inline ColorManager& GetColorManager() { return ColorManager::Get(); }

    // Convenience functions
    inline bool IsColorManagementEnabled() { return ColorManager::Get().IsEnabled(); }
    inline bool ConvertToDisplaySpace(const float* src, float* dst, int width, int height, int channels = 4)
    {
        return ColorManager::Get().ApplyDisplayTransform(src, dst, width, height);
    }
}

===== FILE: source\rendering\cpuculling.h =====
#pragma once
// =============================================================================================
// RenderCulling : カリングと負荷削減の設定（ヘッダーのみ。.vcxproj への追加不要）
//   ※ オブジェクトの可視判定は GPU（GpuObjectCulling / GpuInstanceCullLodCS / GPU Driven）へ移した。
//     ここの IsEntityVisible は描画経路からは使わない。設定値（視錐台・画面サイズ・描画距離）は GPU 側が参照する。
//   ・オブジェクト：視錐台カリング（ワールド AABB × 6 平面）、画面サイズカリング（投影半径が小さいもの）、
//     描画距離カリング。結果はフレームごとにエンティティ単位でキャッシュ（同じフレームの複数パスで再計算しない）
//   ・ライト：視錐台カリング（球 × 6 平面）、距離・画面サイズによるライトの LOD（境界でフェードして飛ばない）
//   ・GPU 駆動の経路（GPUVisibility）はもともと GPU で視錐台 / オクルージョン / LOD を行う。
//     ここは GPU 駆動で扱えない物（半透明・Forward・スプライト・GPU 駆動オフ時）と Velocity・ライトが対象
// =============================================================================================
#include "pch.h"
#include "rendering/scenedepth.h"
#include "camera.h"
#include "componentmanager.h"
#include "graphicsdevice.h"
#include <algorithm>
#include <cmath>
#include <vector>

class RenderCulling final
{
  public:
    struct Settings
    {
        bool ObjectFrustumCulling = true;
        bool ObjectSizeCulling = true;
        float MinObjectPixels = 1.5f; // 投影した境界球の半径（ピクセル）がこれ未満なら描かない
        float MaxDrawDistance = 0.0f; // 0 = 無制限
        bool StaticVelocitySkip =
            true; // 動いていない物は Velocity のジオメトリパスを省く（カメラの動きは全画面パスで出ている）
        bool AutoLod =
            false; // LOD コンポーネントの無いモデルにも自動生成 LOD を使う（GPU 駆動）。悪化の切り分け中のため既定 OFF
        bool SharePrimitiveGeometry = false; // 同じ形のプリミティブで頂点 / LOD を共有。悪化の切り分け中のため既定 OFF
        // ライト
        bool LightFrustumCulling = true;
        bool LightDistanceCulling = true;
        float LightMaxDistance = 250.0f;     // これより遠いローカルライトは使わない（手前 15% でフェード）
        float LightMinPixels = 2.0f;         // 影響範囲の投影半径（ピクセル）がこれ未満のローカルライトは使わない
        bool LightOcclusionCulling = true;   // MegaLights の GPU 結果で、見えている面に届かないライトを後回しにする
        bool SkipRayTracedShadowMaps = true; // DXR 影モードでは使われないローカルライトのシャドウマップを描かない
        // GPU（反射 / GI）
        float ReflectionRoughnessCutoff = 0.5f; // これより粗い面は遮蔽確認のみ行い、見えている空で近似
        int RayHitLights = 32;
        bool ReflectionCheckerboard = true; // 反射レイを半分のピクセルだけ飛ばし NRD で復元（NRD 使用時） // 反射 / GI
                                            // のヒット点で評価するライト数（カメラに近い順）
    };

    struct Stats
    {
        UINT ObjectsTested = 0, ObjectsFrustumCulled = 0, ObjectsSizeCulled = 0;
        UINT VelocitySkipped = 0;
        UINT LightsTested = 0, LightsFrustumCulled = 0, LightsDistanceCulled = 0, LightsOccluded = 0;
        UINT ShadowMapsSkipped = 0;
    };

    static Settings& GetSettings()
    {
        return s_Settings;
    }

    static const Stats& GetStats()
    {
        return s_LastStats;
    }

    static Stats& MutableStats()
    {
        return s_Stats;
    }

    // フレームの最初（カメラ確定後）に 1 回。2 回目以降は同じフレームなら何もしない
    static void BeginFrame(uint64_t frameSerial)
    {
        if (s_HasFrame && frameSerial == s_FrameSerial)
        {
            return;
        }
        s_HasFrame = true;
        s_FrameSerial = frameSerial;
        ++s_Stamp;
        s_LastStats = s_Stats;
        s_Stats = {};
        XMMATRIX view = XMMatrixIdentity(), projection = XMMatrixIdentity();
        Camera::GetCameraMatrices(Camera::GetCameraEntity(), view, projection);
        XMFLOAT4X4 p;
        XMStoreFloat4x4(&p, projection);
        const XMMATRIX inverseView = XMMatrixInverse(nullptr, view);
        XMStoreFloat3(&s_CameraPosition, inverseView.r[3]);
        ExtractPlanes(view * projection);
        // 投影半径（ピクセル）= radius * scale / distance
        const float height = static_cast<float>((std::max)(GraphicsDevice::GetSceneHeight(), 1u));
        s_PixelScale = 0.5f * height * fabsf(p._22);
    }

    // ローカル AABB（center / extents）とワールド行列 → 見えるか（フレーム内キャッシュ）
    static bool IsObjectVisible(EntityID entity, const XMFLOAT4X4& world, const XMFLOAT3& center,
                                const XMFLOAT3& extents)
    {
        if (entity >= s_ObjectStamp.size())
        {
            s_ObjectStamp.resize(static_cast<size_t>(entity) + 1, 0);
            s_ObjectVisible.resize(static_cast<size_t>(entity) + 1, 1);
        }
        if (s_ObjectStamp[entity] == s_Stamp)
        {
            return s_ObjectVisible[entity] != 0;
        }
        s_ObjectStamp[entity] = s_Stamp;
        const bool visible = TestObject(world, center, extents);
        s_ObjectVisible[entity] = visible ? 1 : 0;
        return visible;
    }

    // メッシュ / スプライトの境界（MeshComponent のローカル境界 → AABBComponent → 無ければ常に可視）
    static bool IsEntityVisible(EntityID entity)
    {
        if (!ComponentManager::HasComponent<TransformComponent>(entity))
        {
            return true;
        }
        const auto& transform = ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<TransformComponent>(entity);
        if (ComponentManager::HasComponent<MeshComponent>(entity))
        {
            const auto& mesh = ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<MeshComponent>(entity);
            if (mesh.HasLocalBounds)
            {
                return IsObjectVisible(entity, transform.WorldMatrix, mesh.LocalBoundsCenter, mesh.LocalBoundsExtents);
            }
        }
        if (ComponentManager::HasComponent<AABBComponent>(entity))
        {
            const auto& bounds = ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<AABBComponent>(entity);
            if (bounds.Extents.x > 0.0f || bounds.Extents.y > 0.0f || bounds.Extents.z > 0.0f)
            {
                return IsObjectVisible(entity, transform.WorldMatrix, bounds.Center, bounds.Extents);
            }
        }
        return true;
    }

    // ライト：0 = 使わない、(0, 1] = 強度に掛ける係数（距離フェード）
    static float LightWeight(const XMFLOAT3& position, float range, bool directional)
    {
        if (directional)
        {
            return 1.0f;
        }
        ++s_Stats.LightsTested;
        const float radius = (std::max)(range, 0.01f);
        const XMVECTOR center = XMLoadFloat3(&position);
        if (s_Settings.LightFrustumCulling)
        {
            for (const XMFLOAT4& plane : s_Planes)
            {
                if (XMVectorGetX(XMPlaneDotCoord(XMLoadFloat4(&plane), center)) < -radius)
                {
                    ++s_Stats.LightsFrustumCulled;
                    return 0.0f;
                }
            }
        }
        if (!s_Settings.LightDistanceCulling)
        {
            return 1.0f;
        }
        const float distance = XMVectorGetX(XMVector3Length(XMVectorSubtract(center, XMLoadFloat3(&s_CameraPosition))));
        const float surface = (std::max)(distance - radius, 0.0f); // 影響範囲の表面までの距離
        if (surface > 0.0f && radius * s_PixelScale / (std::max)(distance, 0.01f) < s_Settings.LightMinPixels)
        {
            ++s_Stats.LightsDistanceCulled;
            return 0.0f;
        }
        const float maxDistance = s_Settings.LightMaxDistance;
        if (maxDistance <= 0.0f)
        {
            return 1.0f;
        }
        if (surface >= maxDistance)
        {
            ++s_Stats.LightsDistanceCulled;
            return 0.0f;
        }
        const float fadeStart = maxDistance * 0.85f;
        return surface <= fadeStart ? 1.0f : 1.0f - (surface - fadeStart) / (maxDistance - fadeStart);
    }

    // LightingResources::BeginFrame ごとに増える。GpuObjectCulling のフレーム判定に使う。
    static uint64_t FrameSerial()
    {
        return s_FrameSerial;
    }

    static const XMFLOAT3& CameraPosition()
    {
        return s_CameraPosition;
    }

  private:
    static void ExtractPlanes(const XMMATRIX& viewProjection)
    {
        XMFLOAT4X4 m;
        XMStoreFloat4x4(&m, viewProjection);
        // 行ベクトル（DirectXMath）用の Gribb-Hartmann。z は 0..1（逆 Z でも near / far の順が入れ替わるだけ）
        const XMFLOAT4 planes[6] = {{m._14 + m._11, m._24 + m._21, m._34 + m._31, m._44 + m._41},
                                    {m._14 - m._11, m._24 - m._21, m._34 - m._31, m._44 - m._41},
                                    {m._14 + m._12, m._24 + m._22, m._34 + m._32, m._44 + m._42},
                                    {m._14 - m._12, m._24 - m._22, m._34 - m._32, m._44 - m._42},
                                    {m._13, m._23, m._33, m._43},
                                    {m._14 - m._13, m._24 - m._23, m._34 - m._33, m._44 - m._43}};
        for (int index = 0; index < 6; ++index)
        {
            XMStoreFloat4(&s_Planes[index], SceneDepth::NormalizeFrustumPlane(XMLoadFloat4(&planes[index])));
        }
    }

    static bool TestObject(const XMFLOAT4X4& worldMatrix, const XMFLOAT3& center, const XMFLOAT3& extents)
    {
        ++s_Stats.ObjectsTested;
        // ローカル AABB → ワールド AABB（中心と |M| × extents）
        const XMMATRIX world = XMLoadFloat4x4(&worldMatrix);
        const XMVECTOR worldCenter = XMVector3TransformCoord(XMLoadFloat3(&center), world);
        XMFLOAT4X4 m;
        XMStoreFloat4x4(&m, world);
        const XMFLOAT3 e = extents;
        const XMFLOAT3 worldExtents = {fabsf(m._11) * e.x + fabsf(m._21) * e.y + fabsf(m._31) * e.z,
                                       fabsf(m._12) * e.x + fabsf(m._22) * e.y + fabsf(m._32) * e.z,
                                       fabsf(m._13) * e.x + fabsf(m._23) * e.y + fabsf(m._33) * e.z};
        if (s_Settings.ObjectFrustumCulling)
        {
            for (const XMFLOAT4& plane : s_Planes)
            {
                const float distance = XMVectorGetX(XMPlaneDotCoord(XMLoadFloat4(&plane), worldCenter));
                const float projected =
                    fabsf(plane.x) * worldExtents.x + fabsf(plane.y) * worldExtents.y + fabsf(plane.z) * worldExtents.z;
                if (distance < -projected)
                {
                    ++s_Stats.ObjectsFrustumCulled;
                    return false;
                }
            }
        }
        if (s_Settings.ObjectSizeCulling || s_Settings.MaxDrawDistance > 0.0f)
        {
            const float radius = sqrtf(worldExtents.x * worldExtents.x + worldExtents.y * worldExtents.y +
                                       worldExtents.z * worldExtents.z);
            const float distance =
                XMVectorGetX(XMVector3Length(XMVectorSubtract(worldCenter, XMLoadFloat3(&s_CameraPosition))));
            if (distance > radius)
            {
                if (s_Settings.MaxDrawDistance > 0.0f && distance - radius > s_Settings.MaxDrawDistance)
                {
                    ++s_Stats.ObjectsSizeCulled;
                    return false;
                }
                if (s_Settings.ObjectSizeCulling && radius * s_PixelScale / distance < s_Settings.MinObjectPixels)
                {
                    ++s_Stats.ObjectsSizeCulled;
                    return false;
                }
            }
        }
        return true;
    }

    static inline Settings s_Settings{};
    static inline Stats s_Stats{}, s_LastStats{};
    static inline XMFLOAT4 s_Planes[6]{};
    static inline XMFLOAT3 s_CameraPosition{};
    static inline float s_PixelScale = 500.0f;
    static inline uint32_t s_Stamp = 0;
    static inline uint64_t s_FrameSerial = 0;
    static inline bool s_HasFrame = false;
    static inline std::vector<uint32_t> s_ObjectStamp;
    static inline std::vector<uint8_t> s_ObjectVisible;
};


===== FILE: source\rendering\dlssupscaler.cpp =====
#include "pch.h"
#include "dlssupscaler.h"
#include "graphicsdevice.h"
#include "graphicslog.h"
#include "rendererstate.h"
#include "renderconfiguration.h"
#include "renderersettings.h"
#include "imguimanager.h"
#include "temporalhistorycontext.h"
#include <filesystem>

#ifdef RENDERINGPROJECT_USE_DLSS
#include <nvsdk_ngx.h>
#include <nvsdk_ngx_helpers_d3d.h>
#endif

namespace
{
    constexpr UINT kFrameCount = RendererState::g_kFRAME_COUNT;
    constexpr UINT kDescriptorStart =
        RendererState::g_kHIZ_MIP_SRV_START_INDEX + 2 * RendererState::g_kHIZ_MAX_MIPS + 2 * kFrameCount + 1;
    constexpr UINT kDescriptorsPerFrame = 3;
    static_assert(kDescriptorStart + kDescriptorsPerFrame * kFrameCount <= RendererState::g_kENGINE_DESCRIPTOR_END,
                  "DLSS descriptors exceed the reserved engine heap");

    ID3D12Device* g_Device = nullptr;
    ID3D12DescriptorHeap* g_Heap = nullptr;
    UINT g_Increment = 0;
    bool g_Available = false;
    bool g_Active = false;
    bool g_Prepared = false;
    bool g_ResetHistory = true;
    bool g_LoggedEvaluation = false;
    UINT g_JitterFrame = 0;
    EntityID g_Camera = g_kINVALID_ENTITY;
    XMFLOAT2 g_Jitter{};
    uint64_t g_CameraCutGeneration = 0;
    string g_Status = "NGX SDK is not installed";

#ifdef RENDERINGPROJECT_USE_DLSS
    NVSDK_NGX_Parameter* g_Parameters = nullptr;
    NVSDK_NGX_Handle* g_Feature = nullptr;
    bool g_Initialized = false;
    UINT g_InputWidth = 0;
    UINT g_InputHeight = 0;
    UINT g_OutputWidth = 0;
    UINT g_OutputHeight = 0;
    bool g_FeatureHdr = false;
    ComPtr<ID3D12RootSignature> g_Root;
    ComPtr<ID3D12PipelineState> g_PreparePipeline;
    ComPtr<ID3D12PipelineState> g_CopyPipeline;

    struct FrameResources
    {
        ComPtr<ID3D12Resource> Color;
        ComPtr<ID3D12Resource> Motion;
        ComPtr<ID3D12Resource> Output;
    };

    array<FrameResources, kFrameCount> g_Frames;

    D3D12_CPU_DESCRIPTOR_HANDLE CpuHandle(UINT index)
    {
        return CD3DX12_CPU_DESCRIPTOR_HANDLE(g_Heap->GetCPUDescriptorHandleForHeapStart(), index, g_Increment);
    }

    D3D12_GPU_DESCRIPTOR_HANDLE GpuHandle(UINT index)
    {
        return CD3DX12_GPU_DESCRIPTOR_HANDLE(g_Heap->GetGPUDescriptorHandleForHeapStart(), index, g_Increment);
    }

    bool CreateHelperPipelines()
    {
        CD3DX12_DESCRIPTOR_RANGE ranges[4];
        CD3DX12_ROOT_PARAMETER parameters[4];
        for (UINT index = 0; index < 4; ++index)
        {
            const auto type = index < 2 ? D3D12_DESCRIPTOR_RANGE_TYPE_SRV : D3D12_DESCRIPTOR_RANGE_TYPE_UAV;
            ranges[index].Init(type, 1, index % 2);
            parameters[index].InitAsDescriptorTable(1, &ranges[index]);
        }
        const CD3DX12_ROOT_SIGNATURE_DESC description(4, parameters);
        ComPtr<ID3DBlob> serialized;
        if (FAILED(D3D12SerializeRootSignature(&description, D3D_ROOT_SIGNATURE_VERSION_1, &serialized, nullptr)) ||
            FAILED(g_Device->CreateRootSignature(0, serialized->GetBufferPointer(), serialized->GetBufferSize(),
                                                 IID_PPV_ARGS(&g_Root))))
        {
            return false;
        }
        auto createPipeline = [](const wchar_t* path, ComPtr<ID3D12PipelineState>& pipeline) {
            ComPtr<ID3DBlob> shader;
            if (FAILED(D3DReadFileToBlob(path, &shader)))
            {
                return false;
            }
            D3D12_COMPUTE_PIPELINE_STATE_DESC description{};
            description.pRootSignature = g_Root.Get();
            description.CS = {shader->GetBufferPointer(), shader->GetBufferSize()};
            return SUCCEEDED(g_Device->CreateComputePipelineState(&description, IID_PPV_ARGS(&pipeline)));
        };
        return createPipeline(L"shader/hlsl/build/DlssPrepareCS.cso", g_PreparePipeline) &&
               createPipeline(L"shader/hlsl/build/DlssCopyCS.cso", g_CopyPipeline);
    }

    bool CreateTexture(UINT width, UINT height, DXGI_FORMAT format, const wchar_t* name,
                       ComPtr<ID3D12Resource>& texture)
    {
        const auto heap = CD3DX12_HEAP_PROPERTIES(D3D12_HEAP_TYPE_DEFAULT);
        const auto description =
            CD3DX12_RESOURCE_DESC::Tex2D(format, width, height, 1, 1, 1, 0, D3D12_RESOURCE_FLAG_ALLOW_UNORDERED_ACCESS);
        if (FAILED(g_Device->CreateCommittedResource(&heap, D3D12_HEAP_FLAG_NONE, &description,
                                                     D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_NON_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE, nullptr,
                                                     IID_PPV_ARGS(&texture))))
        {
            return false;
        }
        texture->SetName(name);
        return true;
    }

    bool EnsureFeature(ID3D12GraphicsCommandList* commands, UINT width, UINT height, UINT outputWidth,
                       UINT outputHeight)
    {
        const bool hdrInput = ImGuiManager::IsHdrEnabled() && !ImGuiManager::IsToneMapEnabled();
        if (g_Feature && g_InputWidth == width && g_InputHeight == height && g_OutputWidth == outputWidth &&
            g_OutputHeight == outputHeight && g_FeatureHdr == hdrInput)
        {
            return true;
        }
        if (!GraphicsDevice::WaitForGpuIdle())
        {
            return false;
        }
        if (g_Feature)
        {
            NVSDK_NGX_D3D12_ReleaseFeature(g_Feature);
            g_Feature = nullptr;
        }
        g_Frames = {};
        for (UINT index = 0; index < kFrameCount; ++index)
        {
            auto& frame = g_Frames[index];
            if (!CreateTexture(width, height, DXGI_FORMAT_R16G16B16A16_FLOAT, L"DLSS Input Color", frame.Color) ||
                !CreateTexture(width, height, DXGI_FORMAT_R16G16_FLOAT, L"DLSS Motion Vectors", frame.Motion) ||
                !CreateTexture(outputWidth, outputHeight, DXGI_FORMAT_R16G16B16A16_FLOAT, L"DLSS Output", frame.Output))
            {
                return false;
            }
            const UINT first = kDescriptorStart + index * kDescriptorsPerFrame;
            D3D12_UNORDERED_ACCESS_VIEW_DESC view{};
            view.ViewDimension = D3D12_UAV_DIMENSION_TEXTURE2D;
            view.Format = DXGI_FORMAT_R16G16_FLOAT;
            g_Device->CreateUnorderedAccessView(frame.Motion.Get(), nullptr, &view, CpuHandle(first));
            view.Format = DXGI_FORMAT_R16G16B16A16_FLOAT;
            g_Device->CreateUnorderedAccessView(frame.Color.Get(), nullptr, &view, CpuHandle(first + 1));
            D3D12_SHADER_RESOURCE_VIEW_DESC outputView{};
            outputView.Format = DXGI_FORMAT_R16G16B16A16_FLOAT;
            outputView.ViewDimension = D3D12_SRV_DIMENSION_TEXTURE2D;
            outputView.Shader4ComponentMapping = D3D12_DEFAULT_SHADER_4_COMPONENT_MAPPING;
            outputView.Texture2D.MipLevels = 1;
            g_Device->CreateShaderResourceView(frame.Output.Get(), &outputView, CpuHandle(first + 2));
        }
        NVSDK_NGX_DLSS_Create_Params parameters{};
        parameters.Feature.InWidth = width;
