namespace
{
    vector<EntityID> fixtures;
    int modelID = -1;
    uint32_t failures = 0;
    uint64_t frames = 0;
    vector<RenderCapture::TextureData> reference;
    vector<double> cpuTimes, gpuTimes;

    bool GpuValidation()
    {
        char value[8]{};
        return GetEnvironmentVariableA("DX12_GPU_BASED_VALIDATION", value, sizeof(value)) && atoi(value) != 0;
    }

    void Check(bool result, const char* name)
    {
        WriteGraphicsLog("GPU Driven validation: %s %s\n", result ? "PASS" : "FAIL", name);
        if (!result)
        {
            ++failures;
        }
    }

    EntityID Create(size_t index)
    {
        Entity entity = World::CreateEntity();
        if (!entity.IsValid())
        {
            Check(false, "fixture capacity");
            return g_kINVALID_ENTITY;
        }
        entity.Add<TransformComponent>().Add<StaticModelComponent>().Add<MaterialComponent>();
        entity.Add<ShaderComponent>().Add<NameComponent>().Add<ProceduralMotionComponent>();
        entity.Get<NameComponent>().Name = "GPU fixture";
        entity.Get<ProceduralMotionComponent>().Enabled = false;
        entity.Get<StaticModelComponent>().ModelId = modelID;
        auto& transform = entity.Get<TransformComponent>();
        transform.Position = {float(index % 100) * 0.08f - 4, float((index / 100) % 100) * 0.08f - 4,
                              float(index / 10000) * 0.2f};
        transform.Scale = {0.035f, 0.035f, 0.035f};
        auto& material = entity.Get<MaterialComponent>();
        material.ShaderClassMode = MaterialMode::Manual;
        material.ShaderClass = ShaderClass::PBR;
        material.UseTexture = true;
        material.TextureID =
            index % 2 ? TextureManager::GetDefaultTextureIndex() : TextureManager::GetErrorTextureIndex();
        material.Metallic = float(index % 5) * 0.2f;
        material.Roughness = 0.2f + float(index % 4) * 0.15f;
        return entity.GetID();
    }

    void Grow(size_t count)
    {
        while (fixtures.size() < count)
        {
            fixtures.push_back(Create(fixtures.size()));
        }
    }

    void Capture(bool compare)
    {
        vector<RenderCapture::TextureData> images(5);
        bool read = true;
        for (uint32_t i = 0; i < 5; ++i)
        {
            read &=
                RenderCapture::ReadTexture(RenderTargets::GetGBufferResource(static_cast<GBufferType>(i)), images[i]);
        }
        Check(read, "capture GBuffer");
        if (!read)
        {
            return;
        }
        if (!compare)
        {
            reference = move(images);
            return;
        }
        bool match = reference.size() == images.size();
        uint64_t compared = 0, different = 0, covered = 0;
        for (size_t i = 0; i < images.size() && match; ++i)
        {
            const auto& a = reference[i];
            const auto& b = images[i];
            match &= a.Width == b.Width && a.Height == b.Height && a.Format == b.Format;
            if (!match)
            {
                break;
            }
            const uint32_t pixelBytes = i == 3 ? 8 : 4;
            for (uint32_t y = 0; y < a.Height; ++y)
            {
                for (uint32_t x = 0; x < a.Width; ++x)
                {
                    const auto* pa = a.Bytes.data() + y * a.RowPitch + x * pixelBytes;
                    const auto* pb = b.Bytes.data() + y * b.RowPitch + x * pixelBytes;
                    if (i == 2)
                    {
                        float da, db;
                        memcpy(&da, pa, 4);
                        memcpy(&db, pb, 4);
                        different += abs(da - db) > 0.00001f;
                        covered += da <= 1.0f && da > 0.0f;
                    }
                    else
                    {
                        different += memcmp(pa, pb, pixelBytes) != 0;
                    }
                    ++compared;
                }
            }
        }
        WriteGraphicsLog("GPU Driven GBuffer comparison: different=%llu pixels=%llu covered=%llu\n", different,
                         compared, covered);
        Check(match && different == 0 && covered > 0, "CPU/GPU transform/material/texture/normal GBuffer match");
    }

    void ValidateCommands()
    {
        const auto& stats = GpuScene::Statistics();
        vector<uint8_t> counts, visibility, commands, geometry;
        bool read = RenderCapture::ReadBuffer(GPUDrivenRenderer::CountBuffer(), D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_INDIRECT_ARGUMENT,
                                              4, counts);
        read &= RenderCapture::ReadBuffer(GpuScene::VisibilityBuffer(), D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_NON_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE,
                                          uint64_t(stats.InstanceSlots) * 4, visibility);
        read &= RenderCapture::ReadBuffer(GPUDrivenRenderer::GeometryBuffer(),
                                          D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_NON_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE,
                                          uint64_t(stats.Meshes) * sizeof(GPUDrivenGeometryData), geometry);
        Check(read, "read debug count/visibility/geometry");
        if (!read)
        {
            return;
        }
        uint32_t count = 0;
        memcpy(&count, counts.data(), 4);
        unordered_set<uint32_t> expected;
        const auto* flags = reinterpret_cast<const uint32_t*>(visibility.data());
        for (EntityID entity : fixtures)
        {
            for (auto id : GpuScene::GetEntityInstances(entity))
            {
                const auto* instance = GpuScene::GetInstance(id);
                if (instance && (instance->Flags & 5u) == 5u && flags[id])
                {
                    expected.insert(id);
                }
            }
        }
        Check(count == expected.size() && count <= GPUDrivenRenderer::CommandCapacity(),
              "GPU count equals compact visible instances without overflow");
        if (count > GPUDrivenRenderer::CommandCapacity())
        {
            return;
        }
        if (count)
        {
            read = RenderCapture::ReadBuffer(GPUDrivenRenderer::CommandBuffer(), D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_INDIRECT_ARGUMENT,
                                             uint64_t(count) * sizeof(GPUIndirectDrawCommand), commands);
        }
        bool valid = read;
        const auto* meshes = reinterpret_cast<const GPUDrivenGeometryData*>(geometry.data());
        for (uint32_t i = 0; i < count && valid; ++i)
        {
            GPUIndirectDrawCommand command{};
            memcpy(&command, commands.data() + size_t(i) * sizeof(command), sizeof(command));
            const auto* instance = GpuScene::GetInstance(command.InstanceID);
            valid &= instance && expected.erase(command.InstanceID) == 1;
            if (!valid)
            {
                break;
            }
            const auto& mesh = meshes[instance->MeshIndex];
            valid &= command.Draw.IndexCountPerInstance == mesh.IndexCount &&
                     command.Draw.StartIndexLocation == mesh.StartIndex &&
                     command.Draw.BaseVertexLocation == mesh.BaseVertex && command.Draw.InstanceCount == 1 &&
                     command.Draw.StartInstanceLocation == 0;
        }
        Check(valid && expected.empty(), "GPU commands have unique live Instance IDs and exact mesh arguments");
        Check(GPUDrivenRenderer::ExecuteCalls() == 1, "Opaque submission uses one ExecuteIndirect");
        WriteGraphicsLog("GPU Driven frame: fixtures=%zu visible=%u commands=%u capacity=%u submission=%.4f ms\n",
                         fixtures.size(), count, count, GPUDrivenRenderer::CommandCapacity(),
                         GPUDrivenRenderer::SubmissionMilliseconds());
    }
} // 名前空間

bool GPUDrivenValidation::Enabled()
{
    char value[8]{};
    return GetEnvironmentVariableA("DX12_GPU_DRIVEN_STRESS_TEST", value, sizeof(value)) && atoi(value) != 0;
}

void GPUDrivenValidation::Trace(const char* stage)
{
    if (frames == 1 && IsGpuValidationRun())
    {
        WriteGraphicsLog("GPU Driven GBV stage: %s\n", stage);
    }
}

bool GPUDrivenValidation::IsGpuValidationRun()
{
    static const bool enabled = (Enabled() || GPUVisibilityValidation::Enabled()) && GpuValidation();
    return enabled;
}

void GPUDrivenValidation::BeforeFrame(uint64_t frame)
{
    GPUVisibility::GetSettings().Occlusion = false;
    GPUVisibility::GetSettings().LOD = false;
    frames = frame + 1;
    if (frame == 0)
    {
        vector<EntityID> remove;
        for (uint32_t i = 0; i < Registry::GetEntities().size(); ++i)
        {
            if (Registry::IsAlive(i) && !ComponentManager::HasComponent<CameraComponent>(i))
            {
                remove.push_back(i);
            }
        }
        for (auto id : remove)
        {
            World::DestroyEntity(Entity(id));
        }
        filesystem::create_directories("build/gpudriven");
        ofstream obj("build/gpudriven/fixture.obj");
        obj << "v -1 -1 0\nv 0 1 0\nv 1 -1 0\nvt 0 0\nvt 0.5 1\nvt 1 0\nvn 0 0 -1\nf 1/1/1 2/2/1 3/3/1\n";
        obj.close();
        modelID = ModelManager::LoadStaticModel("build/gpudriven/fixture.obj", false);
        Check(modelID >= 0, "load indexed static fixture");
        Trace("create fixtures begin");
        Grow(100);
        Trace("create fixtures end");
        World::SetVSyncEnabled(false);
    }
    RenderConfiguration::SetRenderMode(RenderMode::DEFERRED);
    Trace("set deferred mode end");
    RendererSettings::SetComputeGBufferEnabled(false);
    RendererSettings::SetMeshShadersEnabled(false);
    RendererSettings::SetTwoPhaseOcclusionEnabled(false);
    RendererSettings::SetUpscaleMode(UpscaleMode::Bilateral);
    Trace("set raster GBuffer mode end");
    Raytracing::GetSettings().Enabled = false;
    DayNightCycle::GetSettings().Running = false;
    auto& camera = ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<CameraComponent>(Camera::GetCameraEntity());
    auto& transform = ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<TransformComponent>(Camera::GetCameraEntity());
    transform.Position = {0, 0, -12};
    transform.IsDirty = true;
    camera.Target = {0, 0, 0};
    camera.AllowUserControl = false;
    camera.LockOnTarget = g_kINVALID_ENTITY;
    if (frame >= 32 && frame < 48)
    {
        transform.Position.x = (frame % 2) ? 20.0f : -2.0f;
        camera.Target = {transform.Position.x, 0, 0};
    }
    GPUDrivenRenderer::SetEnabled(GpuValidation() ||
                                  !(frame < 2 || (frame >= 10 && frame < 12) || (frame >= 16 && frame < 24) ||
                                    frame == 55 || frame == 57 || frame == 61 || frame == 74 || frame == 75));
    if (frame == 4)
    {
        Grow(1000);
    }
    if (frame == 8)
    {
        Grow(10000);
    }
    if (frame >= 48 && frame < 54)
    {
        if (frame % 2 == 0)
        {
            for (size_t i = 0; i < 500; ++i)
            {
                World::DestroyEntity(Entity(fixtures.back()));
                fixtures.pop_back();
            }
        }
        else
        {
            Grow(10000);
        }
    }
    if (frame == 58 && !fixtures.empty())
    {
        Entity(fixtures[0]).Get<ProceduralMotionComponent>().Enabled = false;
        auto& moving = Entity(fixtures[0]).Get<TransformComponent>();
        moving.Position.x += 0.15f;
        moving.Scale.x *= -1;
        moving.IsDirty = true;
        Entity(fixtures[0]).Get<MaterialComponent>().Roughness = 0.83f;
    }
    if (frame == 64)
    {
        for (auto entity : fixtures)
        {
            World::DestroyEntity(Entity(entity));
        }
        fixtures.clear();
    }
    if (frame == 65)
    {
        Grow(1000);
    }
    if (!GpuValidation())
    {
        if (frame == 54)
        {
            Entity(fixtures[0]).Get<ShaderComponent>().PsPath = "shader/hlsl/build/modelshaderPS_MRT.cso";
        }
        if (frame == 56)
        {
            Entity(fixtures[0]).Get<ShaderComponent>().PsPath.clear();
            auto& motion = Entity(fixtures[0]).Get<ProceduralMotionComponent>();
            motion.Target = Procedural::MotionTarget::MeshVertices;
            motion.Speed = 0;
            motion.Time = 0;
            motion.Enabled = true;
        }
        if (frame == 60)
        {
            Entity(fixtures[0]).Get<NameComponent>().Name = "Sky";
        }
        if (frame == 62)
        {
            Entity(fixtures[0]).Get<NameComponent>().Name = "GPU fixture";
        }
    }
    if (frame == 66 && !GpuValidation())
    {
        Entity(fixtures[0]).Get<ShaderComponent>().VsPath = "shader/hlsl/build/colorshader3dVS.cso";
    }
    if (frame == 67)
    {
        Entity(fixtures[0]).Get<ShaderComponent>().VsPath.clear();
    }
    if (frame == 68 && !GpuValidation())
    {
        auto& motion = Entity(fixtures[0]).Get<ProceduralMotionComponent>();
        motion.Target = Procedural::MotionTarget::MeshVertices;
        motion.Enabled = true;
    }
    if (frame == 69)
    {
        Entity(fixtures[0]).Get<ProceduralMotionComponent>().Enabled = false;
    }
    if (frame == 70 && !GpuValidation())
    {
        Entity(fixtures[0]).Get<NameComponent>().Name = "Sky";
    }
    if (frame == 71)
    {
        Entity(fixtures[0]).Get<NameComponent>().Name = "GPU fixture";
    }
    if (frame == 72)
    {
        // 5つのマテリアル区画を持つ1万エンティティで、5万の静的メッシュインスタンスを検証する。
        // 既存の ECS の16384エンティティ制限は変更しない。
        Grow(10000);
        ofstream obj("build/gpudriven/fixture-sections.obj");
        ofstream mtl("build/gpudriven/fixture-sections.mtl");
        obj << "mtllib fixture-sections.mtl\n";
        for (uint32_t i = 0; i < 5; ++i)
        {
            mtl << "newmtl Section" << i << "\nKd " << (0.2f + i * 0.15f) << " 1 1\n";
            // 区画と隣接エンティティは重ならないようにする。同一平面でマテリアルが重なると、
            // 未ソートの不透明描画の順序が結果に現れてしまう。
            const float x = -0.7f + float(i) * 0.35f;
            obj << "v " << x - 0.12f << " -0.8 0\nv " << x << " 0.8 0\nv " << x + 0.12f << " -0.8 0\n";
            obj << "usemtl Section" << i << "\nf " << i * 3 + 1 << ' ' << i * 3 + 2 << ' ' << i * 3 + 3 << '\n';
        }
        obj.close();
        mtl.close();
        auto* model = ModelManager::GetStaticModel(modelID);
        Check(model &&
                  model->LoadAssimpModel("build/gpudriven/fixture-sections.obj", GraphicsDevice::GetDevice(), false) &&
                  model->GetMeshCount() == 5,
              "reload fixture with five indexed static mesh sections");
        for (auto entity : fixtures)
        {
            GpuSceneChanges::Notify(entity, GpuSceneDirtyFlags::All);
        }
    }
    Trace("BeforeFrame end");
}

void GPUDrivenValidation::AfterFrame(uint64_t frame)
{
    if (!GpuValidation() && (frame == 1 || frame == 11 || frame == 54 || frame == 56 || frame == 60 || frame == 75))
    {
        Capture(false);
    }
    if (!GpuValidation() && (frame == 2 || frame == 12 || frame == 55 || frame == 57 || frame == 61 || frame == 76))
    {
        Capture(true);
    }
    if (frame == 2 || frame == 5 || frame == 9 || (frame >= 32 && frame < 54) || frame == 64 || frame == 65 ||
        frame == 73 || frame == 83)
    {
        ValidateCommands();
    }
    const auto& snapshot = RenderProfiler::GetLatest();
    for (const auto& pass : snapshot.Passes)
    {
        if (pass.Name == "GBuffer / Opaque")
        {
            // GetLatest はフレームスロット分遅れるため、各区間内で安定したサンプルだけを使う。
            if (frame >= 20 && frame < 24)
            {
                cpuTimes.push_back(pass.CpuMs);
            }
            if (frame >= 28 && frame < 32)
            {
                gpuTimes.push_back(pass.CpuMs);
            }
        }
    }
    if (frame == 31 && !GpuValidation())
    {
        auto average = [](const vector<double>& values) {
            double sum = 0;
            for (double value : values)
            {
                sum += value;
            }
            return values.empty() ? 0 : sum / values.size();
        };
        const double cpu = average(cpuTimes), gpu = average(gpuTimes);
        WriteGraphicsLog("GPU Driven CPU submission comparison (10000): CPU=%.4f ms GPU=%.4f ms\n", cpu, gpu);
        Check(cpu > 0 && gpu > 0 && gpu < cpu, "10000 GPU opaque submission costs less than CPU fallback");
    }
    if (frame == 83)
    {
        for (const auto& pass : snapshot.Passes)
        {
            if (pass.Name == "Generate Indirect Commands" || pass.Name == "Opaque ExecuteIndirect" ||
                pass.Name == "GPU Scene Culling")
            {
                WriteGraphicsLog("GPU Driven profiler: %s GPU %.4f ms CPU %.4f ms\n", pass.Name.c_str(), pass.GpuMs,
                                 pass.CpuMs);
            }
        }
    }
    if (frame == 58 && !fixtures.empty())
    {
        const auto* instance = GpuScene::GetInstance(Entity(fixtures[0]).GetGPUInstanceID());
        Check(instance && memcmp(&instance->World, &instance->PreviousWorld, sizeof(instance->World)) != 0,
              "GPU driven instance preserves previous transform during motion");
    }
    if (frame == 59 && !fixtures.empty())
    {
        const auto* instance = GpuScene::GetInstance(Entity(fixtures[0]).GetGPUInstanceID());
        Check(instance && memcmp(&instance->World, &instance->PreviousWorld, sizeof(instance->World)) == 0,
              "GPU driven previous transform settles on stationary frame");
    }
    if (frame >= 66 && frame <= 71 && !GpuValidation())
    {
        const bool expectedGpu = frame % 2 != 0;
        const auto& fallback = GpuScene::CpuOpaqueStaticEntities();
        const bool found = find(fallback.begin(), fallback.end(), fixtures[0]) != fallback.end();
        Check(GPUDrivenRenderer::HandlesEntity(fixtures[0]) == expectedGpu && found != expectedGpu,
              "component API edits transfer ownership between GPU and CPU fallback");
    }
    if (frame == 73)
    {
        Check(GpuScene::Statistics().ActiveInstances == 50000 && GPUDrivenRenderer::CommandCapacity() >= 50000,
              "50000 static mesh instances fit grown command capacity");
    }
}

bool GPUDrivenValidation::Finish()
{
    GraphicsDevice::WaitForGpuIdle();
    Check(frames >= 84, "complete GPU driven stress sequence");
    failures += RenderCapture::ReportGraphicsErrors();
    WriteGraphicsLog("GPU Driven validation failures = %u\n", failures);
    return failures == 0;
}

===== FILE: source\rendering\gpudriven\indirectcommand.h =====
#pragma once
#include <d3d12.h>
#include <cstdint>
#include <cstddef>
#include <stdexcept>

struct GPUIndirectDrawCommand
{
    uint32_t InstanceID;
    D3D12_DRAW_INDEXED_ARGUMENTS Draw;
};

static_assert(sizeof(GPUIndirectDrawCommand) == 24);
static_assert(offsetof(GPUIndirectDrawCommand, Draw) == 4);
static_assert(offsetof(GPUIndirectDrawCommand, Draw.BaseVertexLocation) == 16);

// フェーズ2のメッシュレコードとは分け、既存のジオメトリアドレスを有効に保つ。
struct GPUDrivenGeometryData
{
    uint32_t StartIndex = 0;
    uint32_t IndexCount = 0;
    int32_t BaseVertex = 0;
    uint32_t Ready = 0;
};

static_assert(sizeof(GPUDrivenGeometryData) == 16);

inline uint32_t GpuDrivenCapacity(uint32_t current, uint32_t required)
{
    uint32_t capacity = current > 1024 ? current : 1024;
    while (capacity < required)
    {
        if (capacity > UINT32_MAX / 2)
        {
            throw std::overflow_error("GPU driven capacity overflow");
        }
        capacity *= 2;
    }
    return capacity;
}

inline GPUDrivenGeometryData ReserveGpuDrivenGeometry(uint64_t vertices, uint64_t indices, uint32_t vertexCount,
                                                      uint32_t indexCount)
{
    // IA ビューのバイト数は UINT。頂点形式は既存の48バイトの StaticModelVertex。
    if ((vertices + vertexCount) * 48 > UINT32_MAX || (indices + indexCount) * 4 > UINT32_MAX ||
        vertices + vertexCount > INT32_MAX || indices + indexCount > UINT32_MAX)
    {
        throw std::overflow_error("GPU driven geometry arena exceeds IA limits");
    }
    return {static_cast<uint32_t>(indices), indexCount, static_cast<int32_t>(vertices), 1};
}

===== FILE: source\rendering\gpudrivenindirect.h =====
#pragma once
#include "gpuscene/gpuscene.h"
#include "gpuscene/gpuscenevalidation.h"

#include "pch.h"
#include "graphicsdevice.h"
#include "rendererstate.h"
#include "shaderpipelines.h"
#include "animationmodel.h"
#include "staticmodel.h"
#include "occlusionculling.h"
#include "renderersettings.h"
#include <unordered_map>
#include <vector>
#include "shaderdescription.h"

class GpuDrivenIndirectDrawCache
{
  private:
    static constexpr UINT g_kMAX_CULL_DISPATCHES_PER_FRAME = 16384;

    struct ShadowCommand
    {
        D3D12_VERTEX_BUFFER_VIEW VertexBuffer{};
        D3D12_INDEX_BUFFER_VIEW IndexBuffer{};
        D3D12_DRAW_INDEXED_ARGUMENTS Draw{};
    };

    struct VelocityCommand
    {
        D3D12_VERTEX_BUFFER_VIEW CurrentVertexBuffer{};
        D3D12_VERTEX_BUFFER_VIEW PreviousVertexBuffer{};
        D3D12_INDEX_BUFFER_VIEW IndexBuffer{};
        D3D12_DRAW_INDEXED_ARGUMENTS Draw{};
    };

    struct alignas(256) CullConstants
    {
        XMFLOAT4X4 World{};
        XMFLOAT4X4 ViewProjection{};
        XMFLOAT4 LocalCenter{};
        XMFLOAT4 LocalExtents{};
        UINT CommandStrideBytes = 0;
        UINT CandidateCount = 0;
        UINT EnableFrustumCulling = 0;
        UINT Phase = 0;
        UINT EnableOcclusion = 0;
        UINT HiZWidth = 0;
        UINT HiZHeight = 0;
        UINT HiZMipCount = 0;
        UINT PreviousHiZValid = 0;
        UINT CurrentHiZValid = 0;
        UINT SceneInstanceId = InvalidGPUInstanceID;
        UINT Padding[13]{};
    };

    static_assert(sizeof(CullConstants) == 256);

    struct IndirectBatch
    {
        ComPtr<ID3D12Resource> CandidateBuffer{};
        ComPtr<ID3D12Resource> VisibleBuffer{};
        ComPtr<ID3D12Resource> CountBuffer{};
        UINT CommandCount = 0;
        UINT SourceMeshCount = 0;
        UINT CommandStride = 0;
        bool Initialized = false;
    };

    struct PrimaryBatch
    {
        struct Group
        {
            int TextureIndex = -1;
            IndirectBatch Commands{};
        };

        vector<Group> Groups{};
        UINT SourceMeshCount = 0;
    };

    ComPtr<ID3D12CommandSignature> m_ShadowSignature{};
    ComPtr<ID3D12CommandSignature> m_VelocitySignature{};
    ComPtr<ID3D12RootSignature> m_CullRootSignature{};
    ComPtr<ID3D12PipelineState> m_CullPipelineState{};
    ComPtr<ID3D12Resource> m_ZeroCounterUpload{};
    ComPtr<ID3D12Resource> m_CullConstantsUpload{};
    UINT8* m_MappedCullConstants = nullptr;
    UINT m_CullConstantFrameIndex = UINT_MAX;
    UINT m_CullConstantCursor = 0;
    bool m_InitializationAttempted = false;

    unordered_map<const AnimationModelResource*, IndirectBatch> m_AnimatedShadowBatches{};
    unordered_map<const StaticModelResource*, IndirectBatch> m_StaticShadowBatches{};
    unordered_map<const AnimationModelResource*, IndirectBatch> m_AnimatedVelocityBatches{};
    unordered_map<const StaticModelResource*, IndirectBatch> m_StaticVelocityBatches{};
    unordered_map<const AnimationModelResource*, PrimaryBatch> m_AnimatedPrimaryBatches{};
    unordered_map<const StaticModelResource*, PrimaryBatch> m_StaticPrimaryBatches{};

    static D3D12_DRAW_INDEXED_ARGUMENTS MakeDrawArguments(UINT indexCount)
    {
        D3D12_DRAW_INDEXED_ARGUMENTS draw{};
        draw.IndexCountPerInstance = indexCount;
        draw.InstanceCount = 1;
        return draw;
    }

    static bool CreateUploadBuffer(const void* data, UINT64 sizeInBytes, ComPtr<ID3D12Resource>& output)
    {
        ID3D12Device* device = GraphicsDevice::GetDevice();
        if (!device || sizeInBytes == 0)
        {
            return false;
        }

        const auto heap = CD3DX12_HEAP_PROPERTIES(D3D12_HEAP_TYPE_UPLOAD);
        const auto description = CD3DX12_RESOURCE_DESC::Buffer(sizeInBytes);
        HRESULT result =
            device->CreateCommittedResource(&heap, D3D12_HEAP_FLAG_NONE, &description,
                                            D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_GENERIC_READ, nullptr, IID_PPV_ARGS(&output));
        if (FAILED(result))
        {
            return false;
        }

        if (data)
        {
            void* mapped = nullptr;
            const D3D12_RANGE noRead{0, 0};
            result = output->Map(0, &noRead, &mapped);
            if (FAILED(result) || !mapped)
            {
                output.Reset();
                return false;
            }
            memcpy(mapped, data, static_cast<size_t>(sizeInBytes));
            output->Unmap(0, nullptr);
        }
        return true;
    }

    static bool CreateUavBuffer(UINT64 sizeInBytes, ComPtr<ID3D12Resource>& output)
    {
        ID3D12Device* device = GraphicsDevice::GetDevice();
        if (!device || sizeInBytes == 0)
        {
            return false;
        }

        const auto heap = CD3DX12_HEAP_PROPERTIES(D3D12_HEAP_TYPE_DEFAULT);
        const auto description = CD3DX12_RESOURCE_DESC::Buffer(sizeInBytes, D3D12_RESOURCE_FLAG_ALLOW_UNORDERED_ACCESS);
        return SUCCEEDED(device->CreateCommittedResource(&heap, D3D12_HEAP_FLAG_NONE, &description,
                                                         D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_COMMON, nullptr, IID_PPV_ARGS(&output)));
    }

    bool CreateCullPipeline()
    {
        ID3D12Device* device = GraphicsDevice::GetDevice();
        if (!device)
        {
            return false;
        }

        CD3DX12_DESCRIPTOR_RANGE hiZRanges[2]{};
        hiZRanges[0].Init(D3D12_DESCRIPTOR_RANGE_TYPE_SRV, 1, 1);
        hiZRanges[1].Init(D3D12_DESCRIPTOR_RANGE_TYPE_SRV, 1, 2);
        CD3DX12_ROOT_PARAMETER parameters[7]{};
        parameters[0].InitAsShaderResourceView(0, 0);
        parameters[1].InitAsUnorderedAccessView(0, 0);
        parameters[2].InitAsUnorderedAccessView(1, 0);
        parameters[3].InitAsConstantBufferView(0, 0);
        parameters[4].InitAsDescriptorTable(1, &hiZRanges[0]);
        parameters[5].InitAsDescriptorTable(1, &hiZRanges[1]);
        parameters[6].InitAsShaderResourceView(3, 0);
        CD3DX12_STATIC_SAMPLER_DESC hiZSampler(0, D3D12_FILTER_MIN_MAG_MIP_POINT, D3D12_TEXTURE_ADDRESS_MODE_CLAMP,
                                               D3D12_TEXTURE_ADDRESS_MODE_CLAMP, D3D12_TEXTURE_ADDRESS_MODE_CLAMP);

        CD3DX12_ROOT_SIGNATURE_DESC rootDescription{};
        rootDescription.Init(_countof(parameters), parameters, 1, &hiZSampler, D3D12_ROOT_SIGNATURE_FLAG_NONE);

        ComPtr<ID3DBlob> serialized;
        ComPtr<ID3DBlob> errors;
        HRESULT result =
            D3D12SerializeRootSignature(&rootDescription, D3D_ROOT_SIGNATURE_VERSION_1, &serialized, &errors);
        if (FAILED(result))
        {
            if (errors)
            {
                Debug::Log("%s\n", static_cast<const char*>(errors->GetBufferPointer()));
            }
            return false;
        }

        result = device->CreateRootSignature(0, serialized->GetBufferPointer(), serialized->GetBufferSize(),
                                             IID_PPV_ARGS(&m_CullRootSignature));
        if (FAILED(result))
        {
            return false;
        }

        ComPtr<ID3DBlob> computeShader;
        ShaderDescription shaderResource{};
        shaderResource.csoPath = "shader/hlsl/build/GpuDrivenCullCS.cso";
        shaderResource.ppBlob = computeShader.GetAddressOf();
        if (!ShaderPipelines::LoadShaderBlob(shaderResource))
        {
            Debug::Log("GPU culling shader load failed: %s\n", shaderResource.csoPath);
            return false;
        }

        D3D12_COMPUTE_PIPELINE_STATE_DESC pipelineDescription{};
        pipelineDescription.pRootSignature = m_CullRootSignature.Get();
        pipelineDescription.CS = {computeShader->GetBufferPointer(), computeShader->GetBufferSize()};
        if (FAILED(device->CreateComputePipelineState(&pipelineDescription, IID_PPV_ARGS(&m_CullPipelineState))))
        {
            return false;
        }

        const UINT zero = 0;
        if (!CreateUploadBuffer(&zero, sizeof(zero), m_ZeroCounterUpload))
        {
            return false;
        }

        const UINT64 constantsSize = static_cast<UINT64>(RendererState::g_kFRAME_COUNT) *
                                     g_kMAX_CULL_DISPATCHES_PER_FRAME * sizeof(CullConstants);
        if (!CreateUploadBuffer(nullptr, constantsSize, m_CullConstantsUpload))
        {
            return false;
        }
        const D3D12_RANGE noRead{0, 0};
        return SUCCEEDED(m_CullConstantsUpload->Map(0, &noRead, reinterpret_cast<void**>(&m_MappedCullConstants)));
    }

    bool EnsureInitialized()
    {
        if (m_ShadowSignature && m_VelocitySignature && m_CullPipelineState)
        {
            return true;
        }
        if (m_InitializationAttempted)
        {
            return false;
        }
        m_InitializationAttempted = true;

        ID3D12Device* device = GraphicsDevice::GetDevice();
        if (!device || !CreateCullPipeline())
        {
            return false;
        }

        D3D12_INDIRECT_ARGUMENT_DESC shadowArguments[3]{};
        shadowArguments[0].Type = D3D12_INDIRECT_ARGUMENT_TYPE_VERTEX_BUFFER_VIEW;
        shadowArguments[0].VertexBuffer.Slot = 0;
        shadowArguments[1].Type = D3D12_INDIRECT_ARGUMENT_TYPE_INDEX_BUFFER_VIEW;
        shadowArguments[2].Type = D3D12_INDIRECT_ARGUMENT_TYPE_DRAW_INDEXED;
        D3D12_COMMAND_SIGNATURE_DESC shadowDescription{};
        shadowDescription.ByteStride = sizeof(ShadowCommand);
        shadowDescription.NumArgumentDescs = _countof(shadowArguments);
        shadowDescription.pArgumentDescs = shadowArguments;
        if (FAILED(device->CreateCommandSignature(&shadowDescription, nullptr, IID_PPV_ARGS(&m_ShadowSignature))))
        {
            return false;
        }

        D3D12_INDIRECT_ARGUMENT_DESC velocityArguments[4]{};
        velocityArguments[0].Type = D3D12_INDIRECT_ARGUMENT_TYPE_VERTEX_BUFFER_VIEW;
        velocityArguments[0].VertexBuffer.Slot = 0;
        velocityArguments[1].Type = D3D12_INDIRECT_ARGUMENT_TYPE_VERTEX_BUFFER_VIEW;
        velocityArguments[1].VertexBuffer.Slot = 1;
        velocityArguments[2].Type = D3D12_INDIRECT_ARGUMENT_TYPE_INDEX_BUFFER_VIEW;
        velocityArguments[3].Type = D3D12_INDIRECT_ARGUMENT_TYPE_DRAW_INDEXED;
        D3D12_COMMAND_SIGNATURE_DESC velocityDescription{};
        velocityDescription.ByteStride = sizeof(VelocityCommand);
        velocityDescription.NumArgumentDescs = _countof(velocityArguments);
        velocityDescription.pArgumentDescs = velocityArguments;
        return SUCCEEDED(
            device->CreateCommandSignature(&velocityDescription, nullptr, IID_PPV_ARGS(&m_VelocitySignature)));
    }

    template <typename Command>
    static bool FinalizeBatch(const vector<Command>& commands, UINT sourceMeshCount, IndirectBatch& batch)
    {
        if (commands.empty())
        {
            return false;
        }

        const UINT64 byteSize = static_cast<UINT64>(commands.size()) * sizeof(Command);
        batch = {};
        batch.CommandCount = static_cast<UINT>(commands.size());
        batch.SourceMeshCount = sourceMeshCount;
        batch.CommandStride = sizeof(Command);
        return CreateUploadBuffer(commands.data(), byteSize, batch.CandidateBuffer) &&
               CreateUavBuffer(byteSize, batch.VisibleBuffer) && CreateUavBuffer(sizeof(UINT), batch.CountBuffer);
    }

    static bool BuildAnimatedShadowBatch(const AnimationModelResource* model, IndirectBatch& batch)
    {
        vector<ShadowCommand> commands;
        commands.reserve(model->GetMeshCount());
        for (UINT index = 0; index < model->GetMeshCount(); ++index)
        {
            const MeshData& mesh = model->GetMeshData(index);
            if (mesh.VertexBuffer && mesh.IndexBuffer && mesh.IndexCount > 0)
            {
                commands.push_back({mesh.VertexBufferView, mesh.IndexBufferView, MakeDrawArguments(mesh.IndexCount)});
            }
        }
        return FinalizeBatch(commands, model->GetMeshCount(), batch);
    }

    static bool BuildStaticShadowBatch(const StaticModelResource* model, IndirectBatch& batch)
    {
        vector<ShadowCommand> commands;
        commands.reserve(model->GetMeshCount());
        for (UINT index = 0; index < model->GetMeshCount(); ++index)
        {
            const StaticMeshData& mesh = model->GetMeshData(index);
            if (mesh.VertexBuffer && mesh.IndexBuffer && mesh.IndexCount > 0)
            {
                commands.push_back({mesh.VertexBufferView, mesh.IndexBufferView, MakeDrawArguments(mesh.IndexCount)});
            }
        }
        return FinalizeBatch(commands, model->GetMeshCount(), batch);
    }

    static bool BuildAnimatedVelocityBatch(const AnimationModelResource* model, IndirectBatch& batch)
    {
        vector<VelocityCommand> commands;
        commands.reserve(model->GetMeshCount());
        for (UINT index = 0; index < model->GetMeshCount(); ++index)
        {
            const MeshData& mesh = model->GetMeshData(index);
            if (mesh.VertexBuffer && mesh.PreviousVertexBuffer && mesh.IndexBuffer && mesh.PreviousVertexValid &&
                mesh.IndexCount > 0)
            {
                commands.push_back({mesh.VertexBufferView, mesh.PreviousVertexBufferView, mesh.IndexBufferView,
                                    MakeDrawArguments(mesh.IndexCount)});
            }
        }
        return FinalizeBatch(commands, model->GetMeshCount(), batch);
    }

    static bool BuildStaticVelocityBatch(const StaticModelResource* model, IndirectBatch& batch)
    {
        vector<VelocityCommand> commands;
        commands.reserve(model->GetMeshCount());
        for (UINT index = 0; index < model->GetMeshCount(); ++index)
        {
            const StaticMeshData& mesh = model->GetMeshData(index);
            if (mesh.VertexBuffer && mesh.IndexBuffer && mesh.IndexCount > 0)
            {
                commands.push_back({mesh.VertexBufferView, mesh.VertexBufferView, mesh.IndexBufferView,
                                    MakeDrawArguments(mesh.IndexCount)});
            }
        }
        return FinalizeBatch(commands, model->GetMeshCount(), batch);
    }

    template <typename Model, typename Mesh> static bool BuildPrimaryBatch(const Model* model, PrimaryBatch& batch)
    {
        batch = {};
        batch.SourceMeshCount = model->GetMeshCount();
        vector<pair<int, vector<ShadowCommand>>> groupedCommands;
        for (UINT index = 0; index < model->GetMeshCount(); ++index)
        {
            const Mesh& mesh = model->GetMeshData(index);
            if (!mesh.VertexBuffer || !mesh.IndexBuffer || mesh.IndexCount == 0)
            {
                continue;
            }

            auto group = find_if(groupedCommands.begin(), groupedCommands.end(), [&](const auto& candidate) {
                return candidate.first == mesh.TextureIndex;
            });
            if (group == groupedCommands.end())
            {
                groupedCommands.emplace_back(mesh.TextureIndex, vector<ShadowCommand>{});
                group = prev(groupedCommands.end());
            }
            group->second.push_back({mesh.VertexBufferView, mesh.IndexBufferView, MakeDrawArguments(mesh.IndexCount)});
        }

        for (auto& [textureIndex, commands] : groupedCommands)
        {
            PrimaryBatch::Group group{};
            group.TextureIndex = textureIndex;
            if (!FinalizeBatch(commands, model->GetMeshCount(), group.Commands))
            {
                return false;
            }
            batch.Groups.push_back(move(group));
        }
        return !batch.Groups.empty();
    }

    template <typename Model, typename Map, typename Mesh>
    static PrimaryBatch* FindOrBuildPrimary(const Model* model, Map& map)
    {
        PrimaryBatch& batch = map[model];
        if (batch.Groups.empty() || batch.SourceMeshCount != model->GetMeshCount())
        {
            if (!BuildPrimaryBatch<Model, Mesh>(model, batch))
            {
                return nullptr;
            }
        }
        return &batch;
    }

    template <typename Model, typename Map, typename Builder>
    static IndirectBatch* FindOrBuild(const Model* model, Map& map, Builder&& builder)
    {
        IndirectBatch& batch = map[model];
        if (!batch.CandidateBuffer || batch.SourceMeshCount != model->GetMeshCount())
        {
            if (!builder(model, batch))
            {
                return nullptr;
            }
        }
        return &batch;
    }

    bool CullAndExecute(ID3D12GraphicsCommandList* commandList, ID3D12CommandSignature* signature, IndirectBatch& batch,
                        EntityID entity, const XMMATRIX& world, const XMMATRIX& viewProjection,
                        const XMFLOAT3& localCenter, const XMFLOAT3& localExtents, bool enableFrustumCulling,
                        ID3D12PipelineState* graphicsPipelineState, bool enableOcclusion = false)
    {
        if (!commandList || !signature || !graphicsPipelineState || entity >= g_kMAX_ENTITIES || !m_MappedCullConstants)
        {
            return false;
        }

        D3D12_RESOURCE_STATES previousState;
        if (batch.Initialized)
        {
            previousState = D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_UNORDERED_ACCESS;
        }
        else
        {
            previousState = D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_COMMON;
        }
        D3D12_RESOURCE_BARRIER countToCopy = CD3DX12_RESOURCE_BARRIER::Transition(
            batch.CountBuffer.Get(), previousState, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_COPY_DEST);
        commandList->ResourceBarrier(1, &countToCopy);
        commandList->CopyBufferRegion(batch.CountBuffer.Get(), 0, m_ZeroCounterUpload.Get(), 0, sizeof(UINT));
        D3D12_RESOURCE_BARRIER countToUav = CD3DX12_RESOURCE_BARRIER::Transition(
            batch.CountBuffer.Get(), D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_COPY_DEST, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_UNORDERED_ACCESS);
        commandList->ResourceBarrier(1, &countToUav);

        const UINT frameIndex = GraphicsDevice::GetFrameIndex() % RendererState::g_kFRAME_COUNT;
        if (m_CullConstantFrameIndex != frameIndex)
        {
            m_CullConstantFrameIndex = frameIndex;
            m_CullConstantCursor = 0;
        }
        if (m_CullConstantCursor >= g_kMAX_CULL_DISPATCHES_PER_FRAME)
        {
            Debug::Log("GPU culling constant ring exhausted for frame %u\n", frameIndex);
            return false;
        }
        const UINT64 constantIndex =
            static_cast<UINT64>(frameIndex) * g_kMAX_CULL_DISPATCHES_PER_FRAME + m_CullConstantCursor++;
        CullConstants constants{};
        constants.SceneInstanceId =
            GpuSceneValidation::UseLegacyCulling() ? InvalidGPUInstanceID : GpuScene::GetEntityInstance(entity);
        GpuSceneValidation::RecordModelCull(constants.SceneInstanceId != InvalidGPUInstanceID);
        if (constants.SceneInstanceId == InvalidGPUInstanceID)
        {
            XMStoreFloat4x4(&constants.World, world);
            constants.LocalCenter = XMFLOAT4(localCenter.x, localCenter.y, localCenter.z, 1.0f);
            constants.LocalExtents = XMFLOAT4(localExtents.x, localExtents.y, localExtents.z, 0.0f);
        }
        XMStoreFloat4x4(&constants.ViewProjection, viewProjection);
        constants.CommandStrideBytes = batch.CommandStride;
        constants.CandidateCount = batch.CommandCount;
        constants.EnableFrustumCulling = static_cast<UINT>(enableFrustumCulling);
        constants.Phase = OcclusionCulling::GetPhase();
        constants.EnableOcclusion =
            static_cast<UINT>(enableOcclusion && RendererSettings::GetTwoPhaseOcclusionEnabled());
        constants.HiZWidth = OcclusionCulling::GetWidth();
        constants.HiZHeight = OcclusionCulling::GetHeight();
        constants.HiZMipCount = OcclusionCulling::GetMipCount();
        constants.PreviousHiZValid = static_cast<UINT>(OcclusionCulling::HasPrevious());
        constants.CurrentHiZValid = static_cast<UINT>(OcclusionCulling::HasCurrent());
        memcpy(m_MappedCullConstants + constantIndex * sizeof(CullConstants), &constants, sizeof(constants));

        commandList->SetComputeRootSignature(m_CullRootSignature.Get());
        commandList->SetPipelineState(m_CullPipelineState.Get());
        commandList->SetComputeRootShaderResourceView(0, batch.CandidateBuffer->GetGPUVirtualAddress());
        commandList->SetComputeRootUnorderedAccessView(1, batch.VisibleBuffer->GetGPUVirtualAddress());
        commandList->SetComputeRootUnorderedAccessView(2, batch.CountBuffer->GetGPUVirtualAddress());
        commandList->SetComputeRootConstantBufferView(3, m_CullConstantsUpload->GetGPUVirtualAddress() +
                                                             constantIndex * sizeof(CullConstants));
        commandList->SetComputeRootDescriptorTable(4, OcclusionCulling::GetPreviousSrv());
        commandList->SetComputeRootDescriptorTable(5, OcclusionCulling::GetCurrentSrv());
        commandList->SetComputeRootShaderResourceView(6, GpuScene::InstanceBuffer()->GetGPUVirtualAddress());
        commandList->Dispatch((batch.CommandCount + 63) / 64, 1, 1);

        D3D12_RESOURCE_BARRIER uavBarriers[2] = {CD3DX12_RESOURCE_BARRIER::UAV(batch.VisibleBuffer.Get()),
                                                 CD3DX12_RESOURCE_BARRIER::UAV(batch.CountBuffer.Get())};
        commandList->ResourceBarrier(_countof(uavBarriers), uavBarriers);

        D3D12_RESOURCE_BARRIER toIndirect[2] = {
            CD3DX12_RESOURCE_BARRIER::Transition(batch.VisibleBuffer.Get(), D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_UNORDERED_ACCESS,
                                                 D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_INDIRECT_ARGUMENT),
            CD3DX12_RESOURCE_BARRIER::Transition(batch.CountBuffer.Get(), D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_UNORDERED_ACCESS,
                                                 D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_INDIRECT_ARGUMENT)};
        commandList->ResourceBarrier(_countof(toIndirect), toIndirect);

        commandList->SetPipelineState(graphicsPipelineState);
        commandList->IASetPrimitiveTopology(D3D_PRIMITIVE_TOPOLOGY_TRIANGLELIST);
        commandList->ExecuteIndirect(signature, batch.CommandCount, batch.VisibleBuffer.Get(), 0,
                                     batch.CountBuffer.Get(), 0);

        D3D12_RESOURCE_BARRIER toUav[2] = {
            CD3DX12_RESOURCE_BARRIER::Transition(batch.VisibleBuffer.Get(), D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_INDIRECT_ARGUMENT,
                                                 D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_UNORDERED_ACCESS),
            CD3DX12_RESOURCE_BARRIER::Transition(batch.CountBuffer.Get(), D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_INDIRECT_ARGUMENT,
                                                 D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_UNORDERED_ACCESS)};
        commandList->ResourceBarrier(_countof(toUav), toUav);
        batch.Initialized = true;
        return true;
    }

    static bool ExecuteCandidatesDirect(ID3D12GraphicsCommandList* commandList, ID3D12CommandSignature* signature,
                                        const IndirectBatch& batch, ID3D12PipelineState* graphicsPipelineState)
    {
        if (!commandList || !signature || !batch.CandidateBuffer || batch.CommandCount == 0 || !graphicsPipelineState)
        {
            return false;
        }

        commandList->SetPipelineState(graphicsPipelineState);
        commandList->IASetPrimitiveTopology(D3D_PRIMITIVE_TOPOLOGY_TRIANGLELIST);
        commandList->ExecuteIndirect(signature, batch.CommandCount, batch.CandidateBuffer.Get(), 0, nullptr, 0);
        return true;
    }

  public:
    template <typename Model, typename Mesh, typename Map>
    bool ExecutePrimaryImpl(ID3D12GraphicsCommandList* commandList, const Model* model, Map& map, EntityID entity,
                            const XMMATRIX& world, const XMMATRIX& viewProjection, int fallbackTextureIndex,
                            D3D12_GPU_DESCRIPTOR_HANDLE descriptorHeapStart, UINT descriptorIncrement,
                            ID3D12PipelineState* graphicsPipelineState)
    {
        if (!EnsureInitialized() || !model)
        {
            return false;
        }
        PrimaryBatch* batch = FindOrBuildPrimary<Model, Map, Mesh>(model, map);
        if (!batch)
        {
            return false;
        }

        bool submitted = false;
        for (auto& group : batch->Groups)
        {
            int textureIndex;
            if (group.TextureIndex >= 0)
            {
                textureIndex = group.TextureIndex;
            }
            else
            {
                textureIndex = fallbackTextureIndex;
            }
            commandList->SetGraphicsRootDescriptorTable(
                1, CD3DX12_GPU_DESCRIPTOR_HANDLE(descriptorHeapStart, textureIndex, descriptorIncrement));
            submitted |=
                CullAndExecute(commandList, m_ShadowSignature.Get(), group.Commands, entity, world, viewProjection,
                               model->GetAabbCenter(), model->GetAabbExtents(), true, graphicsPipelineState, true);
        }
        return submitted;
    }

    bool ExecutePrimary(ID3D12GraphicsCommandList* commandList, const AnimationModelResource* model, EntityID entity,
                        const XMMATRIX& world, const XMMATRIX& viewProjection, int fallbackTextureIndex,
                        D3D12_GPU_DESCRIPTOR_HANDLE descriptorHeapStart, UINT descriptorIncrement,
                        ID3D12PipelineState* graphicsPipelineState)
    {
        return ExecutePrimaryImpl<AnimationModelResource, MeshData>(
            commandList, model, m_AnimatedPrimaryBatches, entity, world, viewProjection, fallbackTextureIndex,
            descriptorHeapStart, descriptorIncrement, graphicsPipelineState);
    }

    bool ExecutePrimary(ID3D12GraphicsCommandList* commandList, const StaticModelResource* model, EntityID entity,
                        const XMMATRIX& world, const XMMATRIX& viewProjection, int fallbackTextureIndex,
                        D3D12_GPU_DESCRIPTOR_HANDLE descriptorHeapStart, UINT descriptorIncrement,
                        ID3D12PipelineState* graphicsPipelineState)
    {
        return ExecutePrimaryImpl<StaticModelResource, StaticMeshData>(
            commandList, model, m_StaticPrimaryBatches, entity, world, viewProjection, fallbackTextureIndex,
            descriptorHeapStart, descriptorIncrement, graphicsPipelineState);
    }

    bool ExecuteShadow(ID3D12GraphicsCommandList* commandList, const AnimationModelResource* model, EntityID entity,
                       const XMMATRIX& world, const XMMATRIX& lightViewProjection,
                       ID3D12PipelineState* graphicsPipelineState, bool cpuCulledVirtualPage)
    {
        if (!EnsureInitialized() || !model)
        {
            return false;
        }
        IndirectBatch* batch = FindOrBuild(model, m_AnimatedShadowBatches, BuildAnimatedShadowBatch);
        if (!batch)
        {
            return false;
        }
        if (cpuCulledVirtualPage)
        {
            return ExecuteCandidatesDirect(commandList, m_ShadowSignature.Get(), *batch, graphicsPipelineState);
        }
        return CullAndExecute(commandList, m_ShadowSignature.Get(), *batch, entity, world, lightViewProjection,
                              model->GetAabbCenter(), model->GetAabbExtents(), true, graphicsPipelineState);
    }

    bool ExecuteShadow(ID3D12GraphicsCommandList* commandList, const StaticModelResource* model, EntityID entity,
                       const XMMATRIX& world, const XMMATRIX& lightViewProjection,
                       ID3D12PipelineState* graphicsPipelineState, bool cpuCulledVirtualPage)
    {
        if (!EnsureInitialized() || !model)
        {
            return false;
        }
        IndirectBatch* batch = FindOrBuild(model, m_StaticShadowBatches, BuildStaticShadowBatch);
        if (!batch)
        {
            return false;
        }
        if (cpuCulledVirtualPage)
        {
            return ExecuteCandidatesDirect(commandList, m_ShadowSignature.Get(), *batch, graphicsPipelineState);
        }
        return CullAndExecute(commandList, m_ShadowSignature.Get(), *batch, entity, world, lightViewProjection,
                              model->GetAabbCenter(), model->GetAabbExtents(), true, graphicsPipelineState);
    }

    bool ExecuteVelocity(ID3D12GraphicsCommandList* commandList, const AnimationModelResource* model, EntityID entity,
                         const XMMATRIX& world, const XMMATRIX& viewProjection,
                         ID3D12PipelineState* graphicsPipelineState)
    {
        if (!EnsureInitialized() || !model)
        {
            return false;
        }
        IndirectBatch* batch = FindOrBuild(model, m_AnimatedVelocityBatches, BuildAnimatedVelocityBatch);
        return batch && CullAndExecute(commandList, m_VelocitySignature.Get(), *batch, entity, world, viewProjection,
                                       model->GetAabbCenter(), model->GetAabbExtents(), true, graphicsPipelineState);
    }

    bool ExecuteVelocity(ID3D12GraphicsCommandList* commandList, const StaticModelResource* model, EntityID entity,
                         const XMMATRIX& world, const XMMATRIX& viewProjection,
                         ID3D12PipelineState* graphicsPipelineState)
    {
        if (!EnsureInitialized() || !model)
        {
            return false;
        }
        IndirectBatch* batch = FindOrBuild(model, m_StaticVelocityBatches, BuildStaticVelocityBatch);
        return batch && CullAndExecute(commandList, m_VelocitySignature.Get(), *batch, entity, world, viewProjection,
                                       model->GetAabbCenter(), model->GetAabbExtents(), true, graphicsPipelineState);
    }

    void Reset()
    {
        if (m_CullConstantsUpload && m_MappedCullConstants)
        {
            m_CullConstantsUpload->Unmap(0, nullptr);
        }
        m_MappedCullConstants = nullptr;
        m_CullConstantFrameIndex = UINT_MAX;
        m_CullConstantCursor = 0;
        m_AnimatedShadowBatches.clear();
        m_StaticShadowBatches.clear();
        m_AnimatedVelocityBatches.clear();
        m_StaticVelocityBatches.clear();
        m_AnimatedPrimaryBatches.clear();
        m_StaticPrimaryBatches.clear();
        m_ShadowSignature.Reset();
        m_VelocitySignature.Reset();
        m_CullRootSignature.Reset();
        m_CullPipelineState.Reset();
        m_ZeroCounterUpload.Reset();
        m_CullConstantsUpload.Reset();
        m_InitializationAttempted = false;
    }
};

===== FILE: source\rendering\gpumarkers.h =====
#pragma once
#include <windows.h>
#include <d3d12.h>
#include <cstring>

#if defined(_DEBUG) && (defined(_M_X64) || defined(_M_ARM64))
#define RENDERINGPROJECT_PIX_GPU_MARKERS 1
#include "../../External/PIXEvents/include/pix3.h"
#else
#define RENDERINGPROJECT_PIX_GPU_MARKERS 0
#endif

namespace GpuMarkers
{
#if RENDERINGPROJECT_PIX_GPU_MARKERS
    struct Record
    {
        UINT64 Words[PixEventsLegacy::PIXEventsGraphicsRecordSpaceQwords]{};
        UINT Bytes = 0;
    };

    inline Record Encode(const char* name)
    {
        Record record;
        if (!name || !name[0])
        {
            return record;
        }
        // Use the pinned GPU-only encoder. The public PIX API also emits CPU events
        // on Windows and would require an additional runtime DLL.
        const UINT64* end = PixEventsLegacy::EncodeSetMarkerForContext(record.Words, UINT64(0), name);
        record.Bytes = static_cast<UINT>((end - record.Words) * sizeof(UINT64));
        return record;
    }
#endif

    inline void Write(ID3D12GraphicsCommandList* commands, const char* name)
    {
        if (!commands || !name || !name[0])
        {
            return;
        }
#if RENDERINGPROJECT_PIX_GPU_MARKERS
        const Record record = Encode(name);
        commands->SetMarker(D3D12_EVENT_METADATA, record.Words, record.Bytes);
#else
        // Basic annotations: metadata 1 is ANSI, and the size includes the NUL.
        commands->SetMarker(1, name, static_cast<UINT>(std::strlen(name) + 1));
#endif
    }
}

#undef RENDERINGPROJECT_PIX_GPU_MARKERS

===== FILE: source\rendering\gpumemorybudget.h =====
#pragma once
#include <d3d12.h>
#include <algorithm>
#include <cstdint>
#include <dxgi1_4.h>
#include <wrl/client.h>

// Updated before recording each frame. Budgets describe this process, not total GPU usage.
namespace GpuMemoryBudget
{
    struct Settings
    {
        bool Enabled = true;
        uint32_t TextureMiB = 512;
        uint32_t TargetPercent = 85;
        uint32_t IdleTextureFrames = 300;
        uint32_t UploadMiBPerFrame = 8;
        uint32_t ShadowResolution = 1024;
        bool ReleaseInactive = true;
        bool TransientAliasing = true;
    };

    struct Statistics
    {
        uint64_t Usage = 0;
        uint64_t Budget = 0;
        uint64_t Target = 0;
        uint64_t TextureBytes = 0;
        uint64_t TextureBudget = 0;
        uint64_t EvictedBytes = 0;
        uint64_t CompressedReplacements = 0;
        bool Valid = false;
    };

    inline Settings Options;
    inline Statistics Stats;
    inline Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<IDXGIAdapter3> Adapter;

    inline void Initialize(ID3D12Device* device)
    {
        Adapter.Reset();
        Stats = {};
        Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<IDXGIFactory4> factory;
        if (device && SUCCEEDED(CreateDXGIFactory1(IID_PPV_ARGS(&factory))))
        {
            factory->EnumAdapterByLuid(device->GetAdapterLuid(), IID_PPV_ARGS(&Adapter));
        }
    }

    inline void Update()
    {
        DXGI_QUERY_VIDEO_MEMORY_INFO info{};
        Stats.Valid = Adapter && SUCCEEDED(Adapter->QueryVideoMemoryInfo(0, DXGI_MEMORY_SEGMENT_GROUP_LOCAL, &info));
        Stats.Usage = info.CurrentUsage;
        Stats.Budget = info.Budget;
        Stats.Target = info.Budget * std::clamp(Options.TargetPercent, 50u, 95u) / 100;
        const uint64_t limit = uint64_t(std::clamp(Options.TextureMiB, 32u, 4096u)) * 1024 * 1024;
        Stats.TextureBudget = limit;
        if (Options.Enabled && Stats.Valid)
        {
            const uint64_t other = Stats.Usage > Stats.TextureBytes ? Stats.Usage - Stats.TextureBytes : 0;
            const uint64_t available = Stats.Target > other ? Stats.Target - other : 0;
            Stats.TextureBudget = (std::min)(limit, available);
        }
    }

    inline bool UnderPressure()
    {
        return Options.Enabled && Stats.Valid && Stats.Usage > Stats.Target;
    }
}

===== FILE: source\rendering\gpuobjectculling.h =====
#pragma once
// =============================================================================================
// GpuObjectCulling : エンティティ単位の可視判定を GPU で行う（ヘッダーのみ。.vcxproj への追加不要）
//
//   CPU の個別描画経路（3D スプライト・メッシュ・影・Velocity）で使っていた CPU の視錐台 / 画面サイズ /
//   描画距離カリングを置き換える。CPU は境界（ワールド行列とローカル AABB・影用の境界球）を並べて
//   アップロードするだけで、見えるかどうかは判定しない。
//
//   ・ビュー（メイン カメラ / 各シャドウパス）ごとに GpuObjectCullCS を1回実行し、エンティティごとの
//     述語（uint64、0 = 描かない）を書く。同じフレーム・同じ行列のビューは再利用する。
//   ・描画側は Begin(entity) / End() で SetPredication を張り、GPU が 0 を書いた物の描画・ディスパッチを
//     GPU 側で破棄する（CPU は結果を待たない）。
//   ・アニメーションの更新間引き（CPU が知る必要がある物）は、メイン カメラの結果を読み戻した値を使う
//     （数フレーム遅れ。結果が無いときは可視扱い）。
// =============================================================================================
#include "pch.h"
#include "rendering/scenedepth.h"
#include "cpuculling.h"
#include "camera.h"
#include "componentmanager.h"
#include "graphicsdevice.h"
#include "lightingresources.h"
#include "modelmanager.h"
#include "staticmodel.h"
#include "animationmodel.h"
#include "vertexdeformation.h"
#include "world.h"
#include "shaderpipelines.h"
#include "shaderdescription.h"
#include <cstring>
#include <vector>

class GpuObjectCulling final
{
  public:
    static constexpr int kNoView = -1;

    // メイン カメラのビュー。必ず PSO を設定する前に呼ぶ（初回はコンピュートを実行するため）。
    static int CameraView(ID3D12GraphicsCommandList* commandList)
    {
        XMMATRIX view = XMMatrixIdentity(), projection = XMMatrixIdentity();
        Camera::GetCameraMatrices(Camera::GetCameraEntity(), view, projection);
        const XMMATRIX viewProjection = view * projection;
        XMFLOAT4X4 p;
        XMStoreFloat4x4(&p, projection);
        XMFLOAT3 cameraPosition{};
        XMStoreFloat3(&cameraPosition, XMMatrixInverse(nullptr, view).r[3]);
        const float height = static_cast<float>((std::max)(GraphicsDevice::GetSceneHeight(), 1u));

        ViewConstants constants{};
        ExtractPlanes(viewProjection, constants.Planes);
        constants.CameraPositionPixelScale = {cameraPosition.x, cameraPosition.y, cameraPosition.z,
                                              0.5f * height * fabsf(p._22)};
        constants.Mode = 0;
        const auto& settings = RenderCulling::GetSettings();
        constants.Flags = (settings.ObjectFrustumCulling ? 1u : 0u) | (settings.ObjectSizeCulling ? 2u : 0u);
        constants.MinPixels = settings.MinObjectPixels;
        constants.MaxDistance = settings.MaxDrawDistance;
        return AcquireView(commandList, constants, true);
    }

    // 現在のシャドウパスのビュー（パス外・カリング不要なら kNoView）。PSO を設定する前に呼ぶ。
    static int ShadowView(ID3D12GraphicsCommandList* commandList)
    {
        XMMATRIX transposedViewProjection{};
        if (!LightingResources::GetCurrentShadowCullMatrix(transposedViewProjection))
        {
            return kNoView;
        }
        ViewConstants constants{};
        // 転置行列の各行 = 元の行列の各列（clip = v * M）。IsShadowCasterVisible と同じ平面。
        const XMVECTOR c0 = transposedViewProjection.r[0];
        const XMVECTOR c1 = transposedViewProjection.r[1];
        const XMVECTOR c2 = transposedViewProjection.r[2];
        const XMVECTOR c3 = transposedViewProjection.r[3];
        const XMVECTOR planes[6] = {
            XMVectorAdd(c3, c0),     XMVectorSubtract(c3, c0), XMVectorAdd(c3, c1), XMVectorSubtract(c3, c1), c2,
            XMVectorSubtract(c3, c2)};
        for (int i = 0; i < 6; ++i)
        {
            XMStoreFloat4(&constants.Planes[i], SceneDepth::NormalizeFrustumPlane(planes[i]));
        }
        constants.Mode = 1;
        constants.Flags = 1;
        return AcquireView(commandList, constants, false);
    }

    // entity の描画を GPU の判定結果で条件付きにする。End() まで有効。
    static void Begin(ID3D12GraphicsCommandList* commandList, int view, EntityID entity)
    {
        auto& s = S();
        if (view < 0 || !commandList || !s.Predicates || entity >= s.ObjectCount ||
            static_cast<uint32_t>(view) >= s.Views.size() || s.ViewFrame != CurrentFrame())
        {
            return;
        }
        EnsurePredicationState(commandList);
        const UINT64 offset = (static_cast<UINT64>(s.Views[view].Offset) + entity) * sizeof(uint64_t);
        commandList->SetPredication(s.Predicates.Get(), offset, D3D12_PREDICATION_OP_EQUAL_ZERO);
        s.PredicationActive = true;
    }

    static void End(ID3D12GraphicsCommandList* commandList)
    {
        auto& s = S();
        if (s.PredicationActive && commandList)
        {
            commandList->SetPredication(nullptr, 0, D3D12_PREDICATION_OP_EQUAL_ZERO);
        }
        s.PredicationActive = false;
    }

    // CPU 側で可視性が必要な処理（アニメーションの更新間引き）用。GPU の結果を読み戻した値で、
    // 数フレーム遅れる。結果が無い・範囲外は可視扱い。
    static bool WasVisibleOnGpu(EntityID entity)
    {
        auto& s = S();
        RefreshReadback();
        if (entity >= s.CpuVisible.size())
        {
            return true;
        }
        return s.CpuVisible[entity] != 0;
    }

    static void Shutdown()
    {
        auto& s = S();
        for (auto& frame : s.Frames)
        {
            if (frame.Upload && frame.Mapped)
            {
                frame.Upload->Unmap(0, nullptr);
            }
            frame.Mapped = nullptr;
            frame.Upload.Reset();
            frame.Readback.Reset();
            frame.ReadbackFence = 0;
        }
        s.Predicates.Reset();
        s.Root.Reset();
        s.Pipeline.Reset();
        s.Tried = false;
        s.Ready = false;
        s.Views.clear();
        s.CpuVisible.clear();
    }

  private:
    static constexpr uint32_t kMaxEntities = g_kMAX_ENTITIES;
    static constexpr UINT64 kPredicateBytes = 8ull * 1024ull * 1024ull; // 全ビュー分（8 MB）

    struct ObjectRecord
    {
        XMFLOAT4X4 World{};
        XMFLOAT4 LocalCenter{}; // w: asfloat(フラグ)
        XMFLOAT4 LocalExtents{};
        XMFLOAT4 ShadowSphere{};
    };

    static_assert(sizeof(ObjectRecord) == 112);

    struct ViewConstants
    {
        XMFLOAT4 Planes[6]{};
        XMFLOAT4 CameraPositionPixelScale{};
        uint32_t ObjectCount = 0;
        uint32_t OutputOffset = 0;
        uint32_t Mode = 0;
        uint32_t Flags = 0;
        float MinPixels = 0.0f;
        float MaxDistance = 0.0f;
        float Padding[2]{};
    };

    static_assert(sizeof(ViewConstants) == 144);

    struct ViewEntry
    {
        ViewConstants Constants{};
        uint32_t Offset = 0; // uint2 単位
    };

    struct FrameResources
    {
        ComPtr<ID3D12Resource> Upload;
        ObjectRecord* Mapped = nullptr;
        ComPtr<ID3D12Resource> Readback;
        UINT64 ReadbackFence = 0;
        uint32_t ReadbackCount = 0;
    };

    struct State
    {
        bool Tried = false;
        bool Ready = false;
        ComPtr<ID3D12RootSignature> Root;
        ComPtr<ID3D12PipelineState> Pipeline;
        ComPtr<ID3D12Resource> Predicates;
        D3D12_RESOURCE_STATES PredicateState = D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_COMMON;
        UINT64 PredicateStateFence = 0; // この値の送信までは PredicateState が有効（送信後は COMMON に戻る）
        array<FrameResources, RendererState::g_kFRAME_COUNT> Frames;
        uint64_t ViewFrame = UINT64_MAX;
        uint32_t ObjectCount = 0;
        uint32_t Stride = 0; // ビュー1つの要素数（uint2）
        vector<ViewEntry> Views;
        bool PredicationActive = false;
        bool CameraReadbackQueued = false;
        UINT64 LatestReadbackFence = 0;
        vector<uint8_t> CpuVisible;
    };

    static State& S()
    {
        static State state;
        return state;
    }

    static uint64_t CurrentFrame()
    {
        return RenderCulling::FrameSerial();
    }

    static void ExtractPlanes(const XMMATRIX& viewProjection, XMFLOAT4* outPlanes)
    {
        XMFLOAT4X4 m;
        XMStoreFloat4x4(&m, viewProjection);
        const XMFLOAT4 planes[6] = {{m._14 + m._11, m._24 + m._21, m._34 + m._31, m._44 + m._41},
                                    {m._14 - m._11, m._24 - m._21, m._34 - m._31, m._44 - m._41},
                                    {m._14 + m._12, m._24 + m._22, m._34 + m._32, m._44 + m._42},
                                    {m._14 - m._12, m._24 - m._22, m._34 - m._32, m._44 - m._42},
                                    {m._13, m._23, m._33, m._43},
                                    {m._14 - m._13, m._24 - m._23, m._34 - m._33, m._44 - m._43}};
        for (int index = 0; index < 6; ++index)
        {
            XMStoreFloat4(&outPlanes[index], SceneDepth::NormalizeFrustumPlane(XMLoadFloat4(&planes[index])));
        }
    }

    static bool EnsureResources()
    {
        auto& s = S();
        if (s.Tried)
        {
            return s.Ready;
        }
        s.Tried = true;
        ID3D12Device* device = GraphicsDevice::GetDevice();
        if (!device)
        {
            return false;
        }
        ComPtr<ID3DBlob> errors;
        CD3DX12_ROOT_PARAMETER parameters[3]{};
        parameters[0].InitAsShaderResourceView(0);
        parameters[1].InitAsUnorderedAccessView(0);
        parameters[2].InitAsConstants(sizeof(ViewConstants) / 4, 0);
        CD3DX12_ROOT_SIGNATURE_DESC rootDescription{};
        rootDescription.Init(_countof(parameters), parameters, 0, nullptr, D3D12_ROOT_SIGNATURE_FLAG_NONE);
        ComPtr<ID3DBlob> serialized;
        if (FAILED(D3D12SerializeRootSignature(&rootDescription, D3D_ROOT_SIGNATURE_VERSION_1, &serialized, &errors)) ||
            FAILED(device->CreateRootSignature(0, serialized->GetBufferPointer(), serialized->GetBufferSize(),
                                               IID_PPV_ARGS(&s.Root))))
        {
            return false;
        }
        ComPtr<ID3DBlob> shader;
        ShaderDescription shaderDescription{};
        shaderDescription.csoPath = "shader/hlsl/build/GpuObjectCullCS.cso";
        shaderDescription.ppBlob = shader.GetAddressOf();
        if (!ShaderPipelines::LoadShaderBlob(shaderDescription))
        {
            return false;
        }
        D3D12_COMPUTE_PIPELINE_STATE_DESC pipeline{};
        pipeline.pRootSignature = s.Root.Get();
        pipeline.CS = CD3DX12_SHADER_BYTECODE(shader.Get());
        if (FAILED(device->CreateComputePipelineState(&pipeline, IID_PPV_ARGS(&s.Pipeline))))
        {
            return false;
        }
        const auto defaultHeap = CD3DX12_HEAP_PROPERTIES(D3D12_HEAP_TYPE_DEFAULT);
        const auto predicateDescription =
            CD3DX12_RESOURCE_DESC::Buffer(kPredicateBytes, D3D12_RESOURCE_FLAG_ALLOW_UNORDERED_ACCESS);
        if (FAILED(device->CreateCommittedResource(&defaultHeap, D3D12_HEAP_FLAG_NONE, &predicateDescription,
                                                   D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_COMMON, nullptr, IID_PPV_ARGS(&s.Predicates))))
        {
            return false;
        }
        s.Predicates->SetName(L"GPU Object Culling Predicates");

        const auto uploadHeap = CD3DX12_HEAP_PROPERTIES(D3D12_HEAP_TYPE_UPLOAD);
        const auto readbackHeap = CD3DX12_HEAP_PROPERTIES(D3D12_HEAP_TYPE_READBACK);
        const auto uploadDescription = CD3DX12_RESOURCE_DESC::Buffer(sizeof(ObjectRecord) * kMaxEntities);
        const auto readbackDescription = CD3DX12_RESOURCE_DESC::Buffer(sizeof(uint64_t) * kMaxEntities);
        const D3D12_RANGE noRead{0, 0};
        for (auto& frame : s.Frames)
        {
            if (FAILED(device->CreateCommittedResource(&uploadHeap, D3D12_HEAP_FLAG_NONE, &uploadDescription,
                                                       D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_GENERIC_READ, nullptr,
                                                       IID_PPV_ARGS(&frame.Upload))) ||
                FAILED(frame.Upload->Map(0, &noRead, reinterpret_cast<void**>(&frame.Mapped))) ||
                FAILED(device->CreateCommittedResource(&readbackHeap, D3D12_HEAP_FLAG_NONE, &readbackDescription,
                                                       D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_COPY_DEST, nullptr,
                                                       IID_PPV_ARGS(&frame.Readback))))
            {
                return false;
            }
        }
        s.Ready = true;
        return true;
    }

    // バッファの状態は ExecuteCommandLists の終わりに COMMON へ戻る（バッファの減衰）。
    // 送信をまたいだら COMMON とみなす。
    static D3D12_RESOURCE_STATES CurrentPredicateState()
    {
        auto& s = S();
        if (s.PredicateStateFence != GraphicsDevice::GetPendingSubmissionFence())
        {
            s.PredicateState = D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_COMMON;
            s.PredicateStateFence = GraphicsDevice::GetPendingSubmissionFence();
        }
        return s.PredicateState;
    }

    static void TransitionPredicates(ID3D12GraphicsCommandList* commandList, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATES after)
    {
        auto& s = S();
        const D3D12_RESOURCE_STATES before = CurrentPredicateState();
        if (before == after)
        {
            if (after == D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_UNORDERED_ACCESS)
            {
                const auto uav = CD3DX12_RESOURCE_BARRIER::UAV(s.Predicates.Get());
                commandList->ResourceBarrier(1, &uav);
            }
            return;
        }
        const auto barrier = CD3DX12_RESOURCE_BARRIER::Transition(s.Predicates.Get(), before, after);
        commandList->ResourceBarrier(1, &barrier);
        s.PredicateState = after;
    }

    static void EnsurePredicationState(ID3D12GraphicsCommandList* commandList)
    {
        if (CurrentPredicateState() != D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_PREDICATION)
        {
            TransitionPredicates(commandList, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_PREDICATION);
        }
    }

    // フレームの最初のビュー要求で、全エンティティの境界をアップロードする（判定はしない）。
    static void BeginFrameIfNeeded()
    {
        auto& s = S();
        const uint64_t frame = CurrentFrame();
        if (s.ViewFrame == frame)
        {
            return;
        }
        s.ViewFrame = frame;
        s.Views.clear();
        s.CameraReadbackQueued = false;

        FrameResources& resources = s.Frames[GraphicsDevice::GetFrameIndex() % RendererState::g_kFRAME_COUNT];
        uint32_t count = 0;
        for (EntityID entity : World::GetView<TransformComponent>())
        {
            count = (std::max)(count, static_cast<uint32_t>(entity) + 1u);
        }
        count = (std::min)(count, kMaxEntities);
        s.ObjectCount = count;
        s.Stride = (std::max)(count, 1u);
        if (count == 0)
        {
            return;
        }
        memset(resources.Mapped, 0, sizeof(ObjectRecord) * count);
        for (EntityID entity : World::GetView<TransformComponent>())
        {
            if (entity >= count)
            {
                continue;
            }
            WriteRecord(entity, resources.Mapped[entity]);
        }
    }

    static void WriteRecord(EntityID entity, ObjectRecord& record)
    {
        const auto& transform = ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<TransformComponent>(entity);
        record.World = transform.WorldMatrix;
        uint32_t flags = 0;

        // カメラ用のローカル境界（以前の RenderCulling / InstancingSystem と同じ優先順位）。
        XMFLOAT3 center{}, extents{};
        bool hasBounds = false;
        const bool cullingDisabled =
            ComponentManager::HasComponent<InstancingComponent>(entity) &&
            !ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<InstancingComponent>(entity).EnableFrustumCulling;
        if (!cullingDisabled)
        {
            if (VertexDeformation::TryGetLocalBounds(entity, center, extents))
            {
                hasBounds = true;
            }
            else if (ComponentManager::HasComponent<MeshComponent>(entity) &&
                     ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<MeshComponent>(entity).HasLocalBounds)
            {
                const auto& mesh = ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<MeshComponent>(entity);
                center = mesh.LocalBoundsCenter;
                extents = mesh.LocalBoundsExtents;
                hasBounds = true;
            }
            else if (ComponentManager::HasComponent<AABBComponent>(entity))
            {
                const auto& bounds = ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<AABBComponent>(entity);
                if (bounds.Extents.x > 0.0f || bounds.Extents.y > 0.0f || bounds.Extents.z > 0.0f)
                {
                    center = bounds.Center;
                    extents = bounds.Extents;
                    hasBounds = true;
                }
            }
            if (!hasBounds && ComponentManager::HasComponent<StaticModelComponent>(entity))
            {
                if (StaticModelResource* model = ModelManager::GetStaticModel(
                        ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<StaticModelComponent>(entity).ModelId))
                {
                    center = model->GetAabbCenter();
                    extents = model->GetAabbExtents();
                    hasBounds = true;
                }
            }
            if (!hasBounds && ComponentManager::HasComponent<AnimationModelComponent>(entity))
            {
                if (AnimationModelResource* model = ModelManager::GetAnimModel(
                        ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<AnimationModelComponent>(entity).ModelId))
                {
                    center = model->GetAabbCenter();
                    extents = model->GetAabbExtents();
                    hasBounds = true;
                }
            }
            if (!hasBounds && ComponentManager::HasComponent<SpriteComponent>(entity))
            {
                const auto& sprite = ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<SpriteComponent>(entity);
                if (sprite.Is3D && sprite.HasLocalBounds)
                {
                    center = sprite.LocalBoundsCenter;
                    extents = sprite.LocalBoundsExtents;
                    hasBounds = true;
                }
            }
        }
        if (hasBounds)
        {
            flags |= 1u;
            record.LocalCenter = {center.x, center.y, center.z, 0.0f};
            record.LocalExtents = {extents.x, extents.y, extents.z, 0.0f};
        }
        XMFLOAT4 sphere{};
        if (LightingResources::GetShadowCasterSphere(entity, sphere))
        {
            flags |= 2u;
            record.ShadowSphere = sphere;
        }
        memcpy(&record.LocalCenter.w, &flags, sizeof(flags));
    }

    static int AcquireView(ID3D12GraphicsCommandList* commandList, ViewConstants constants, bool camera)
    {
        auto& s = S();
        if (!commandList || !EnsureResources())
        {
            return kNoView;
        }
        BeginFrameIfNeeded();
        if (s.ObjectCount == 0)
        {
            return kNoView;
        }
        constants.ObjectCount = s.ObjectCount;
        for (size_t i = 0; i < s.Views.size(); ++i)
        {
            ViewConstants cached = s.Views[i].Constants;
            cached.OutputOffset = constants.OutputOffset;
            if (memcmp(&cached, &constants, sizeof(constants)) == 0)
            {
                return static_cast<int>(i);
            }
        }
        const UINT64 capacity = kPredicateBytes / sizeof(uint64_t);
        const UINT64 offset = static_cast<UINT64>(s.Views.size()) * s.Stride;
        if (offset + s.Stride > capacity)
        {
            return kNoView; // ビュー数が多すぎる：このビューは判定なし（すべて描く）
        }
        constants.OutputOffset = static_cast<uint32_t>(offset);
        if (s.PredicationActive)
        {
            End(commandList);
        }

        FrameResources& resources = s.Frames[GraphicsDevice::GetFrameIndex() % RendererState::g_kFRAME_COUNT];
        TransitionPredicates(commandList, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_UNORDERED_ACCESS);
        commandList->SetComputeRootSignature(s.Root.Get());
        commandList->SetPipelineState(s.Pipeline.Get());
        commandList->SetComputeRootShaderResourceView(0, resources.Upload->GetGPUVirtualAddress());
        commandList->SetComputeRootUnorderedAccessView(1, s.Predicates->GetGPUVirtualAddress());
        commandList->SetComputeRoot32BitConstants(2, sizeof(ViewConstants) / 4, &constants, 0);
        commandList->Dispatch((s.ObjectCount + 63) / 64, 1, 1);

        // メイン カメラの結果を CPU 用に読み戻す（アニメーションの更新間引き用）。
        if (camera && !s.CameraReadbackQueued && resources.Readback)
        {
            TransitionPredicates(commandList, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_COPY_SOURCE);
            commandList->CopyBufferRegion(resources.Readback.Get(), 0, s.Predicates.Get(), offset * sizeof(uint64_t),
                                          static_cast<UINT64>(s.ObjectCount) * sizeof(uint64_t));
            resources.ReadbackFence = GraphicsDevice::GetPendingSubmissionFence();
            resources.ReadbackCount = s.ObjectCount;
            s.CameraReadbackQueued = true;
        }
        TransitionPredicates(commandList, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_PREDICATION);

        ViewEntry entry{};
        entry.Constants = constants;
        entry.Offset = constants.OutputOffset;
        s.Views.push_back(entry);
        return static_cast<int>(s.Views.size() - 1);
    }

    static void RefreshReadback()
    {
        auto& s = S();
        if (!s.Ready)
        {
            return;
        }
        const UINT64 completed = GraphicsDevice::GetCompletedFence();
        FrameResources* newest = nullptr;
        for (auto& frame : s.Frames)
        {
            if (frame.ReadbackFence != 0 && frame.ReadbackFence <= completed &&
                frame.ReadbackFence > s.LatestReadbackFence && (!newest || frame.ReadbackFence > newest->ReadbackFence))
            {
                newest = &frame;
            }
        }
        if (!newest)
        {
            return;
        }
        const D3D12_RANGE range{0, static_cast<SIZE_T>(newest->ReadbackCount) * sizeof(uint64_t)};
        void* mapped = nullptr;
        if (FAILED(newest->Readback->Map(0, &range, &mapped)))
        {
            return;
        }
        const auto* values = static_cast<const uint64_t*>(mapped);
        s.CpuVisible.assign(newest->ReadbackCount, 1);
        for (uint32_t i = 0; i < newest->ReadbackCount; ++i)
        {
            s.CpuVisible[i] = values[i] != 0 ? 1 : 0;
        }
        const D3D12_RANGE noWrite{0, 0};
        newest->Readback->Unmap(0, &noWrite);
        s.LatestReadbackFence = newest->ReadbackFence;
    }
};

#include "pch.h"
