            const auto& transform = ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<TransformComponent>(entity);
            const auto& aabb = ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<AABBComponent>(entity);
            const XMFLOAT3 center = {transform.Position.x + aabb.Center.x * transform.Scale.x,
                                     transform.Position.y + aabb.Center.y * transform.Scale.y,
                                     transform.Position.z + aabb.Center.z * transform.Scale.z};
            const XMFLOAT3 extents = {max(fabsf(aabb.Extents.x * transform.Scale.x), 0.02f),
                                      max(fabsf(aabb.Extents.y * transform.Scale.y), 0.02f),
                                      max(fabsf(aabb.Extents.z * transform.Scale.z), 0.02f)};
            constants.DistanceFieldData0[distanceFieldCount] = XMFLOAT4(center.x, center.y, center.z, 1.0f);
            constants.DistanceFieldData1[distanceFieldCount] = XMFLOAT4(extents.x, extents.y, extents.z, 0.0f);
            ++distanceFieldCount;
        }
    }
    float distanceFieldLightCount;
    if (RendererSettings::GetDistanceFieldShadowsEnabled())
    {
        distanceFieldLightCount = static_cast<float>(distanceFieldCount);
    }
    else
    {
        distanceFieldLightCount = 0.0f;
    }
    constants.DistanceFieldGlobal =
        XMFLOAT4(distanceFieldLightCount, RendererSettings::GetDistanceFieldShadowDistance(),
                 static_cast<float>(RendererSettings::GetDistanceFieldShadowSteps()), 0.0f);
    const auto& localFogVolumes = LocalHeightFog::GetVolumes();
    const UINT localFogCount =
        min(static_cast<UINT>(localFogVolumes.size()), RendererState::g_kMAX_LOCAL_HEIGHT_FOG_VOLUMES);
    for (UINT i = 0; i < localFogCount; ++i)
    {
        const auto& volume = localFogVolumes[i];
        constants.LocalFogData0[i] =
            XMFLOAT4(volume.Position.x, volume.Position.y, volume.Position.z, max(volume.Radius, 0.01f));
        constants.LocalFogData1[i] = XMFLOAT4(max(volume.HeightFalloff, 0.0f), max(volume.Density, 0.0f),
                                              static_cast<float>(volume.Shape), static_cast<float>(volume.Enabled));
        constants.LocalFogColors[i] = XMFLOAT4(volume.Color.x, volume.Color.y, volume.Color.z, 1.0f);
    }
    constants.LocalFogGlobal = XMFLOAT4(static_cast<float>(localFogCount), 0.0f, 0.0f, 0.0f);
    if (runtimeLight.HasLight)
    {
        const LightComponent& lightComponent = runtimeLight.Component;
        XMFLOAT3 lightDirection = NormalizeFloat3(lightComponent.Direction, {0.0f, 1.0f, -1.0f});
        XMFLOAT4 lightColor = lightComponent.Color;
        lightColor.w = deferredLightStrength * lightComponent.Intensity;

        constants.LightDirection = XMFLOAT4(lightDirection.x, lightDirection.y, lightDirection.z, lightComponent.Range);
        constants.LightColor = lightColor;
        constants.LightPositionType = XMFLOAT4(runtimeLight.Position.x, runtimeLight.Position.y,
                                               runtimeLight.Position.z, static_cast<float>(lightComponent.Type));
        constants.LightExtra = PackLightExtra(lightComponent);
    }
    else
    {
        constants.LightDirection = XMFLOAT4(0.0f, 1.0f, -1.0f, 12.0f);
        constants.LightColor = XMFLOAT4(1.0f, 1.0f, 1.0f, 0.0f);
        constants.LightPositionType = XMFLOAT4(0.0f, 0.0f, 0.0f, static_cast<float>(LightType::Directional));
        constants.LightExtra = XMFLOAT4(cosf(18.0f * XM_PI / 180.0f), cosf(32.0f * XM_PI / 180.0f), 0.35f, 0.0f);
    }

    profileStep.emplace("Lights: Collect / Sort", profileList);

    struct VisibleLightCandidate
    {
        EntityID Entity = g_kINVALID_ENTITY;
        LightComponent Light{};
        XMFLOAT3 Position{};
        UINT MinTileX = 0;
        UINT MinTileY = 0;
        UINT MaxTileX = 0;
        UINT MaxTileY = 0;
        float Score = 0.0f;
        bool Directional = false;
    };

    g_LightGridStats = {};
    const UINT sceneWidth = max(m_SceneWidth, 1u);
    const UINT sceneHeight = max(m_SceneHeight, 1u);
    const UINT tileCountX = (sceneWidth + g_kLIGHT_TILE_SIZE - 1) / g_kLIGHT_TILE_SIZE;
    const UINT tileCountY = (sceneHeight + g_kLIGHT_TILE_SIZE - 1) / g_kLIGHT_TILE_SIZE;
    g_LightGridStats.TileCountX = tileCountX;
    g_LightGridStats.TileCountY = tileCountY;

    XMMATRIX cameraView = XMMatrixIdentity();
    XMMATRIX cameraProjection = XMMatrixIdentity();
    Camera::GetCameraMatrices(Camera::GetCameraEntity(), cameraView, cameraProjection);
    const float projectionX = fabsf(XMVectorGetX(cameraProjection.r[0]));
    const float projectionY = fabsf(XMVectorGetY(cameraProjection.r[1]));
    const bool orthographic = fabsf(XMVectorGetW(cameraProjection.r[3])) > 0.5f;

    auto calculateTileBounds = [&](const LightComponent& light, const XMFLOAT3& position, UINT& minTileX,
                                   UINT& minTileY, UINT& maxTileX, UINT& maxTileY) -> bool {
        if (light.Type == LightType::Directional)
        {
            minTileX = 0;
            minTileY = 0;
            maxTileX = tileCountX - 1;
            maxTileY = tileCountY - 1;
            return true;
        }

        XMFLOAT3 viewPosition{};
        XMStoreFloat3(&viewPosition, XMVector3TransformCoord(XMLoadFloat3(&position), cameraView));
        const float radius = LightInfluenceRadius(light);
        if (viewPosition.z + radius <= 0.1f)
        {
            return false;
        }

        if (viewPosition.z <= radius + 0.1f)
        {
            minTileX = 0;
            minTileY = 0;
            maxTileX = tileCountX - 1;
            maxTileY = tileCountY - 1;
            return true;
        }

        const float reciprocalDepth = orthographic ? 1.0f : 1.0f / max(viewPosition.z, 0.1f);
        const float radiusDepth = orthographic ? 1.0f : 1.0f / max(viewPosition.z - radius, 0.1f);
        const float centerNdcX = viewPosition.x * projectionX * reciprocalDepth +
                                 (orthographic ? XMVectorGetX(cameraProjection.r[3]) : 0.0f);
        const float centerNdcY = viewPosition.y * projectionY * reciprocalDepth +
                                 (orthographic ? XMVectorGetY(cameraProjection.r[3]) : 0.0f);
        const float radiusNdcX = radius * projectionX * radiusDepth;
        const float radiusNdcY = radius * projectionY * radiusDepth;
        const float centerPixelX = (centerNdcX * 0.5f + 0.5f) * sceneWidth;
        const float centerPixelY = (-centerNdcY * 0.5f + 0.5f) * sceneHeight;
        const float radiusPixelX = radiusNdcX * 0.5f * sceneWidth;
        const float radiusPixelY = radiusNdcY * 0.5f * sceneHeight;
        const int minPixelX = static_cast<int>(floorf(centerPixelX - radiusPixelX));
        const int minPixelY = static_cast<int>(floorf(centerPixelY - radiusPixelY));
        const int maxPixelX = static_cast<int>(ceilf(centerPixelX + radiusPixelX));
        const int maxPixelY = static_cast<int>(ceilf(centerPixelY + radiusPixelY));
        if (maxPixelX < 0 || maxPixelY < 0 || minPixelX >= static_cast<int>(sceneWidth) ||
            minPixelY >= static_cast<int>(sceneHeight))
        {
            return false;
        }

        const UINT clampedMinX = static_cast<UINT>(clamp(minPixelX, 0, static_cast<int>(sceneWidth) - 1));
        const UINT clampedMinY = static_cast<UINT>(clamp(minPixelY, 0, static_cast<int>(sceneHeight) - 1));
        const UINT clampedMaxX = static_cast<UINT>(clamp(maxPixelX, 0, static_cast<int>(sceneWidth) - 1));
        const UINT clampedMaxY = static_cast<UINT>(clamp(maxPixelY, 0, static_cast<int>(sceneHeight) - 1));
        minTileX = clampedMinX / g_kLIGHT_TILE_SIZE;
        minTileY = clampedMinY / g_kLIGHT_TILE_SIZE;
        maxTileX = clampedMaxX / g_kLIGHT_TILE_SIZE;
        maxTileY = clampedMaxY / g_kLIGHT_TILE_SIZE;
        return true;
    };

    // 毎フレームの確保をなくすため使い回す（ライト更新はメインスレッドのみ）。
    static vector<VisibleLightCandidate> candidates;
    candidates.clear();
    for (EntityID entity : World::GetView<LightComponent, TransformComponent>())
    {
        ++g_LightGridStats.AuthoredLights;
        const auto& light = ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<LightComponent>(entity);
        if (!light.IsActive || light.RenderMode == LightRenderMode::EmissionOnly)
        {
            continue;
        }
        if (light.RenderMode == LightRenderMode::Physical)
        {
            ++g_LightGridStats.ActivePhysicalLights;
        }
        else
        {
            ++g_LightGridStats.ActiveDecalLights;
        }

        const auto& transform = ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<TransformComponent>(entity);
        // 負荷削減：ライトの視錐台カリング（球 × 6 平面）と距離・画面サイズの LOD（境界でフェード）
        const float cullWeight =
            RenderCulling::LightWeight(transform.Position, LightInfluenceRadius(light),
                                      light.Type == LightType::Directional);
        if (cullWeight <= 0.0f)
        {
            continue;
        }
        VisibleLightCandidate candidate{};
        candidate.Entity = entity;
        candidate.Light = light;
        candidate.Light.Intensity *= cullWeight;
        candidate.Position = transform.Position;
        candidate.Directional = light.Type == LightType::Directional;
        if (!calculateTileBounds(light, transform.Position, candidate.MinTileX, candidate.MinTileY, candidate.MaxTileX,
                                 candidate.MaxTileY))
        {
            continue;
        }
        ++g_LightGridStats.OnScreenLights;
        if (light.AffectsVolumetrics && light.VolumeDensity > 0.0001f)
        {
            ++g_LightGridStats.VolumetricLights;
        }
        if (light.CastShadow)
        {
            ++g_LightGridStats.ShadowedLights;
        }
        const float tileCoverage = static_cast<float>((candidate.MaxTileX - candidate.MinTileX + 1) *
                                                      (candidate.MaxTileY - candidate.MinTileY + 1)) /
                                   max(static_cast<float>(tileCountX * tileCountY), 1.0f);
        const float luminance = max(light.Color.x * 0.299f + light.Color.y * 0.587f + light.Color.z * 0.114f, 0.0f);
        candidate.Score = light.Priority * 1000.0f + max(light.Intensity, 0.0f) * luminance * (0.25f + tileCoverage);
        candidates.push_back(candidate);
    }

    // 比較の最後でEntityを使うため順序は一意。stable_sortは不要。
    sort(candidates.begin(), candidates.end(), [](const VisibleLightCandidate& lhs, const VisibleLightCandidate& rhs) {
        if (lhs.Light.RenderMode != rhs.Light.RenderMode)
        {
            return lhs.Light.RenderMode == LightRenderMode::Physical;
        }
        if (lhs.Directional != rhs.Directional)
        {
            return lhs.Directional;
        }
        if (lhs.Light.AffectsVolumetrics != rhs.Light.AffectsVolumetrics)
        {
            return lhs.Light.AffectsVolumetrics;
        }
        if (fabsf(lhs.Score - rhs.Score) > 0.000001f)
        {
            return lhs.Score > rhs.Score;
        }
        return lhs.Entity < rhs.Entity;
    });

    profileStep.emplace("Lights: MegaLights Upload", profileList);
    // ---- MegaLights：画面内のローカルライトをクラスターグリッド用のバッファへ（予算・160 灯の制限なし）
    //   ・シャドウマップを持つライト / ディレクショナル / Volume / Decal は従来の経路
    //   ・グリッドに載せたライトは、定数バッファ側で LightFlags.x = 2（不透明面はグリッドが評価）にする
    //   ・同じフレームで 2 回目の呼び出し（強度違いなど）では振り分けを変えない
    static vector<uint8_t> megaLightEntities(g_kMAX_ENTITIES, 0);
    static vector<EntityID> megaLightMarked;
    if (MegaLights::BeginFrame(GraphicsDevice::GetFrameIndex(), g_FrameSerial))
    {
        for (EntityID entity : megaLightMarked)
        {
            megaLightEntities[entity] = 0;
        }
        megaLightMarked.clear();
        if (MegaLights::IsEnabled())
        {
            for (const VisibleLightCandidate& candidate : candidates)
            {
                const LightComponent& light = candidate.Light;
                const bool local =
                    light.Type == LightType::Point || light.Type == LightType::Spot || light.Type == LightType::Rect;
                if (!local || !light.AllowMegaLights || !light.AffectsOpaque ||
                    light.RenderMode != LightRenderMode::Physical || light.Intensity <= 0.0f ||
                    candidate.Entity >= g_kMAX_ENTITIES || FindShadowLightIndex(candidate.Entity) >= 0)
                {
                    continue;
                }
                const XMFLOAT3 direction = NormalizeFloat3(light.Direction, {0.0f, 1.0f, -1.0f});

                MegaLights::GpuLight gpuLight{};
                gpuLight.PositionType = XMFLOAT4(candidate.Position.x, candidate.Position.y, candidate.Position.z,
                                                 static_cast<float>(light.Type));
                gpuLight.DirectionRange = XMFLOAT4(direction.x, direction.y, direction.z, light.Range);
                gpuLight.Color =
                    XMFLOAT4(light.Color.x, light.Color.y, light.Color.z, deferredLightStrength * light.Intensity);
                gpuLight.Extra = PackLightExtra(light);
                const float sourceRadius =
                    light.Type == LightType::Rect ? 0.0f : clamp(light.SourceRadius, 0.0f, max(light.Range, 0.0f));
                // x：bit0 影を落とす / bit1 Forward（半透明）に影響（M7）
                const float lightBits = (light.CastShadow ? 1.0f : 0.0f) + (light.AffectsForward ? 2.0f : 0.0f);
                gpuLight.Flags = XMFLOAT4(lightBits, sourceRadius, 0.0f, 0.0f);
                gpuLight.IesProfile = GetIesProfileParameters(light);
                // M7：Rect のテクスチャ（Extra.w = テクスチャ番号 + 1。番号はエンジンのテクスチャ SRV の先頭から）
                if (light.Type == LightType::Rect && !light.AreaTexturePath.empty())
                {
                    static unordered_map<string, int> areaTextureCache;
                    auto found = areaTextureCache.find(light.AreaTexturePath);
                    if (found == areaTextureCache.end())
                    {
                        found = areaTextureCache
                                    .emplace(light.AreaTexturePath,
                                             TextureManager::LoadTexture(light.AreaTexturePath.c_str()))
                                    .first;
                    }
                    const int relative = found->second - static_cast<int>(FrameConstants::g_kTEXTURE_SRV_START_INDEX);
                    if (relative >= 0 && relative < static_cast<int>(FrameConstants::g_kMAX_SRVS))
                    {
                        gpuLight.Extra.w = static_cast<float>(relative + 1);
                    }
                }
                const uint32_t entityKey = static_cast<uint32_t>(candidate.Entity);
                memcpy(&gpuLight.Flags.z, &entityKey,
                       sizeof(entityKey));                     // M4：可視ライトハッシュのキー（フレーム間で不変）
                gpuLight.Flags.w = max(light.Intensity, 0.0f); // M6：フォグ用（ディファードの強度係数を掛けない強度）
                if (!MegaLights::AddLight(candidate.Entity, gpuLight))
                {
                    continue;
                }
                megaLightEntities[candidate.Entity] = 1;
                megaLightMarked.push_back(candidate.Entity);
            }
        }
    }

    profileStep.emplace("Lights: Constant Buffer / Tile Grid", profileList);
    const UINT screenLightBudget =
        min(static_cast<UINT>(RendererSettings::GetScreenLightBudget()), g_kMAX_SHADER_LIGHTS);
    const UINT physicalTileLightBudget =
        min(static_cast<UINT>(RendererSettings::GetTileLightBudget()), g_kMAX_LIGHTS_PER_TILE);
    const UINT decalLightBudget =
        min(static_cast<UINT>(RendererSettings::GetDecalLightBudget()), g_kMAX_SHADER_LIGHTS - screenLightBudget);
    const UINT decalTileLightBudget = min(static_cast<UINT>(RendererSettings::GetDecalTileLightBudget()),
                                          g_kMAX_LIGHTS_PER_TILE - physicalTileLightBudget);
    const UINT volumetricLightBudget = min(static_cast<UINT>(RendererSettings::GetVolumetricLightBudget()), 5u);
    static vector<VisibleLightCandidate> selectedCandidates;
    selectedCandidates.clear();
    selectedCandidates.reserve(screenLightBudget + decalLightBudget);
    UINT selectedPhysicalLights = 0;
    UINT selectedDecalLights = 0;
    UINT occludedSkipped = 0;
    for (const VisibleLightCandidate& candidate : candidates)
    {
        // 負荷削減：グリッドに載っていて、見えている面に届かない（GPU 判定）ライトは定数バッファの枠を使わない
        // （グリッドは毎フレーム全ライトで作り直すので、見えるようになれば次の読み戻しで戻る）
        if (RenderCulling::GetSettings().LightOcclusionCulling && !candidate.Light.AffectsVolumetrics &&
            candidate.Entity < g_kMAX_ENTITIES && megaLightEntities[candidate.Entity] != 0 &&
            MegaLights::IsLightOccluded(candidate.Entity))
        {
            ++occludedSkipped;
            continue;
        }
        if (candidate.Light.RenderMode == LightRenderMode::Physical)
        {
            if (selectedPhysicalLights >= screenLightBudget)
            {
                continue;
            }
            ++selectedPhysicalLights;
        }
        else
        {
            if (selectedDecalLights >= decalLightBudget)
            {
                continue;
            }
            ++selectedDecalLights;
        }
        selectedCandidates.push_back(candidate);
    }
    RenderCulling::MutableStats().LightsOccluded = occludedSkipped;
    const UINT lightCount = static_cast<UINT>(selectedCandidates.size());
    g_LightGridStats.GpuVisibleLights = lightCount;
    g_LightGridStats.GpuPhysicalLights = selectedPhysicalLights;
    g_LightGridStats.GpuDecalLights = selectedDecalLights;
    const auto suns = World::GetView<SunComponent, LightComponent>();
    UINT enabledVolumetricLights = 0;
    static vector<LightInstanceBuilder::Input> lightInstances;
    lightInstances.clear();
    lightInstances.reserve(lightCount);
    for (UINT lightIndex = 0; lightIndex < lightCount; ++lightIndex)
    {
        const VisibleLightCandidate& candidate = selectedCandidates[lightIndex];
        const LightComponent& light = candidate.Light;
        const XMFLOAT3 direction = NormalizeFloat3(light.Direction, {0.0f, 1.0f, -1.0f});
        XMFLOAT4 color = light.Color;
        color.w = deferredLightStrength * light.Intensity;

        constants.LightDirections[lightIndex] = XMFLOAT4(direction.x, direction.y, direction.z, light.Range);
        constants.LightColors[lightIndex] = color;
        if (!suns.empty() && candidate.Entity == *suns.begin() && light.Type == LightType::Directional &&
            light.RenderMode == LightRenderMode::Physical)
        {
            constants.SkySunDirection = {direction.x, direction.y, direction.z, static_cast<float>(lightIndex + 1)};
        }

        constants.LightPositionTypes[lightIndex] =
            XMFLOAT4(candidate.Position.x, candidate.Position.y, candidate.Position.z, static_cast<float>(light.Type));
        constants.LightIesProfiles[lightIndex] = GetIesProfileParameters(light);
        constants.LightExtras[lightIndex] = PackLightExtra(light);
        const bool enableVolumetrics = light.Type != LightType::Capsule &&
                                       light.RenderMode == LightRenderMode::Physical && light.AffectsVolumetrics &&
                                       light.VolumeDensity > 0.0001f && enabledVolumetricLights < volumetricLightBudget;
        if (enableVolumetrics)
        {
            ++enabledVolumetricLights;
        }
        const bool decal = light.RenderMode == LightRenderMode::Decal;
        const bool inMegaLightGrid = candidate.Entity < g_kMAX_ENTITIES && megaLightEntities[candidate.Entity] != 0;
        UINT slotBegin;
        if (decal)
        {
            slotBegin = physicalTileLightBudget;
        }
        else
        {
            slotBegin = 0u;
        }
        UINT slotEnd;
        if (decal)
        {
            slotEnd = physicalTileLightBudget + decalTileLightBudget;
        }
        else
        {
            slotEnd = physicalTileLightBudget;
        }
        // グリッドが不透明面を受け持ち、Forward にも影響しないライトはタイルの枠を使わない（他のライトに枠を譲る）
        // M7 で半透明 / Forward もグリッドで評価するなら、グリッドのライトは 2D タイルに入れない
        // （以前は Forward に影響する全ライトをタイルへ詰めており、2000 灯でタイル構築が GPU 約 1.7ms）
        if (inMegaLightGrid && (!light.AffectsForward || MegaLights::GetSettings().Translucency))
        {
            slotEnd = slotBegin;
        }
        if (light.AffectsOpaque || light.AffectsForward || enableVolumetrics)
        {
            LightInstanceBuilder::Input instance{};
            instance.TileBounds =
                XMUINT4(candidate.MinTileX, candidate.MinTileY, candidate.MaxTileX, candidate.MaxTileY);
            instance.Metadata = XMUINT4(lightIndex, slotBegin, slotEnd, static_cast<UINT>(enableVolumetrics));
            lightInstances.push_back(instance);
        }
        float opaqueLightMode = 0.0f;
        if (light.AffectsOpaque)
        {
            opaqueLightMode = 1.0f;
            if (inMegaLightGrid)
            {
                opaqueLightMode = 2.0f;
            }
        }
        constants.LightFlags[lightIndex] =
            XMFLOAT4(opaqueLightMode, static_cast<float>(light.AffectsForward), static_cast<float>(enableVolumetrics),
                     static_cast<float>(light.RenderMode));

        constants.LightShadowData[lightIndex] = XMFLOAT4(-1.0f, 0.0f, 0.0f, 0.0f);
        Raytracing::SetLightShadowFlag(lightIndex, light.CastShadow && light.Type != LightType::Capsule &&
                                                     light.RenderMode == LightRenderMode::Physical);
        const int shadowIndex = FindShadowLightIndex(candidate.Entity);
        if (shadowIndex >= 0)
        {
            constants.LightViewProjections[lightIndex] = g_ShadowLightViewProjections[shadowIndex];
            float gridWidth;
            if ((candidate.Entity == g_VirtualShadowLightEntity))
            {
                gridWidth = -max(g_ShadowMapParams[shadowIndex].z, 0.0000001f);
            }
            else
            {
                gridWidth = g_ShadowMapParams[shadowIndex].z;
            }
            constants.LightShadowData[lightIndex] =
                XMFLOAT4(static_cast<float>(shadowIndex), g_ShadowMapParams[shadowIndex].x,
                         g_ShadowMapParams[shadowIndex].y, gridWidth);
        }
    }

    const UINT slotsPerTile = physicalTileLightBudget + decalTileLightBudget;
    bool lightGridAvailable =
        tileCountX * tileCountY <= g_kMAX_LIGHT_TILE_COUNT && slotsPerTile > 0 &&
        LightInstanceBuilder::Build(GraphicsDevice::GetCommandList(), GraphicsDevice::GetFrameIndex(), lightInstances,
                                    tileCountX, tileCountY, slotsPerTile);
    if (lightGridAvailable)
    {
        g_LightGridStats.MaxLightsPerTile = slotsPerTile;
    }
    constants.LocalFogGlobal.y = static_cast<float>(enabledVolumetricLights);

    float gridHeight;
    if (lightGridAvailable)
    {
        gridHeight = static_cast<float>(tileCountX);
    }
    else
    {
        gridHeight = 0.0f;
    }
    float gridLightCount;
    if (lightGridAvailable)
    {
        gridLightCount = static_cast<float>(tileCountY);
    }
    else
    {
        gridLightCount = 0.0f;
    }
    float shader6;
    if (lightGridAvailable)
    {
        shader6 = static_cast<float>(slotsPerTile);
    }
    else
    {
        shader6 = 0.0f;
    }
    constants.LightCount = XMFLOAT4(static_cast<float>(lightCount), gridHeight, gridLightCount, shader6);
    auto* lightDst =
        static_cast<UINT8*>(m_pLightCbvDataBegin) + GraphicsDevice::GetFrameIndex() * g_kLIGHT_CB_ALIGNED_SIZE;
    memcpy(lightDst, &constants, sizeof(constants));

    MaterialBindings::UpdateDeferredLightingMaterial();

    g_LightConstantsSerial = g_FrameSerial;
    g_LightConstantsStrength = deferredLightStrength;
}

void LightingResources::UpdateShadowConstantBuffer()
{
    if (!m_pShadowCbvDataBegin)
    {
        return;
    }
    if (!g_LightCacheValid)
    {
        RebuildLightCache();
    }
    if (g_CurrentShadowPassIndex >= g_ShadowRenderPassCount)
    {
        return;
    }
    if (g_ShadowConstantsSerial == g_FrameSerial && g_ShadowConstantsPassIndex == g_CurrentShadowPassIndex &&
        g_ShadowConstantsTransmissionEnabled == TransmittanceShadows::HasCasters())
    {
        return;
    }

    ShadowConstants constants{};
    constants.LightViewProjection = g_ShadowRenderPasses[g_CurrentShadowPassIndex].ViewProjection;
    constants.ShadowMapParams = g_ShadowRenderPasses[g_CurrentShadowPassIndex].Params;
    constants.ShadowFilterParams.x = static_cast<float>(RendererSettings::GetShadowFilterRadius());
    constants.ShadowFilterParams.y = TransmittanceShadows::HasCasters() ? 1.0f : 0.0f;
    auto* dst = static_cast<UINT8*>(m_pShadowCbvDataBegin) +
                GetShadowConstantBufferSlot(g_CurrentShadowPassIndex) * g_kSHADOW_CB_ALIGNED_SIZE;
    memcpy(dst, &constants, sizeof(constants));
    g_ShadowConstantsSerial = g_FrameSerial;
    g_ShadowConstantsPassIndex = g_CurrentShadowPassIndex;
    g_ShadowConstantsTransmissionEnabled = TransmittanceShadows::HasCasters();
}

bool LightingResources::ShouldRenderShadowPass(UINT shadowIndex)
{
    if (!g_LightCacheValid)
    {
        RebuildLightCache();
    }
    if (shadowIndex >= g_ShadowRenderPassCount)
    {
        return false;
    }
    const ShadowRenderPass& pass = g_ShadowRenderPasses[shadowIndex];
    return !pass.VirtualPage || pass.NeedsRender;
}

bool LightingResources::ShouldDrawEntityInCurrentShadowPass(EntityID entity)
{
    if (!g_LightCacheValid)
    {
        RebuildLightCache();
    }
    if (g_ShadowCasterSubset != ShadowCasterSubset::All &&
        IsMovingShadowCaster(entity) != (g_ShadowCasterSubset == ShadowCasterSubset::Moving))
    {
        return false;
    }
    if (g_CurrentShadowPassIndex >= g_ShadowRenderPassCount)
    {
        return true;
    }
    const ShadowRenderPass& pass = g_ShadowRenderPasses[g_CurrentShadowPassIndex];
    return IsShadowCasterVisible(entity, pass.ViewProjection);
}

bool LightingResources::ShouldDrawEntityInCurrentShadowSubset(EntityID entity)
{
    if (!g_LightCacheValid)
    {
        RebuildLightCache();
    }
    return g_ShadowCasterSubset == ShadowCasterSubset::All ||
           IsMovingShadowCaster(entity) == (g_ShadowCasterSubset == ShadowCasterSubset::Moving);
}

bool LightingResources::GetCurrentShadowCullMatrix(XMMATRIX& transposedViewProjection)
{
    if (!g_LightCacheValid)
    {
        RebuildLightCache();
    }
    if (g_CurrentShadowPassIndex >= g_ShadowRenderPassCount)
    {
        return false;
    }
    transposedViewProjection = g_ShadowRenderPasses[g_CurrentShadowPassIndex].ViewProjection;
    return true;
}

bool LightingResources::GetShadowCasterSphere(EntityID entity, XMFLOAT4& sphere)
{
    if (!ComponentManager::HasComponent<TransformComponent>(entity))
    {
        return false;
    }
    const ShadowBoundsCache& bounds = GetShadowBounds(entity);
    if (!bounds.Caster)
    {
        return false;
    }
    sphere = {bounds.Center.x, bounds.Center.y, bounds.Center.z, bounds.Radius};
    return true;
}

void LightingResources::SetShadowCasterSubset(ShadowCasterSubset subset)
{
    g_ShadowCasterSubset = subset;
}

void LightingResources::SetStaticShadowCacheAvailable(bool available)
{
    if (g_StaticShadowCacheAvailable != available)
    {
        for (auto& pass : g_ShadowRenderPasses)
        {
            pass.StaticNeedsRender = true;
        }
        for (auto& level : g_VirtualShadowPageCache)
        {
            for (auto& row : level)
            {
                for (auto& page : row)
                {
                    page.StaticValid = false;
                }
            }
        }
    }
    g_StaticShadowCacheAvailable = available;
}

bool LightingResources::UseStaticShadowCache(UINT index)
{
    return g_StaticShadowCacheAvailable && index < g_ShadowRenderPassCount && g_ShadowRenderPasses[index].VirtualPage;
}

bool LightingResources::ShouldRenderStaticShadowPass(UINT index)
{
    return index < g_ShadowRenderPassCount && g_ShadowRenderPasses[index].StaticNeedsRender;
}

bool LightingResources::IsCurrentShadowPassVirtualPage()
{
    if (!g_LightCacheValid)
    {
        RebuildLightCache();
    }
    return g_CurrentShadowPassIndex < g_ShadowRenderPassCount &&
           g_ShadowRenderPasses[g_CurrentShadowPassIndex].VirtualPage;
}

UINT LightingResources::GetCurrentShadowLodBias()
{

    return 0;
}

bool LightingResources::IsVirtualShadowCacheHit()
{
    if (!g_LightCacheValid)
    {
        RebuildLightCache();
    }
    return g_VirtualShadowCacheHit;
}

bool LightingResources::GetShadowPassInfo(UINT shadowIndex, UINT& layer, D3D12_VIEWPORT& viewport, D3D12_RECT& scissor,
                                          bool& clearLayer)
{
    if (!g_LightCacheValid)
    {
        RebuildLightCache();
    }
    if (shadowIndex >= g_ShadowRenderPassCount)
    {
        return false;
    }
    const ShadowRenderPass& pass = g_ShadowRenderPasses[shadowIndex];
    layer = pass.Layer;
    viewport = {};
    viewport.TopLeftX = static_cast<float>(pass.X);
    viewport.TopLeftY = static_cast<float>(pass.Y);
    viewport.Width = static_cast<float>(pass.Width);
    viewport.Height = static_cast<float>(pass.Height);
    viewport.MinDepth = 0.0f;
    viewport.MaxDepth = 1.0f;
    scissor = {static_cast<LONG>(pass.X), static_cast<LONG>(pass.Y), static_cast<LONG>(pass.X + pass.Width),
               static_cast<LONG>(pass.Y + pass.Height)};
    clearLayer = pass.ClearLayer;
    return true;
}

===== FILE: source\rendering\lightinstancebuilder.cpp =====
#include "pch.h"
#include "lightinstancebuilder.h"
#include "rendererstate.h"
#include "renderprofiler.h"

static ComPtr<ID3D12Device> g_Device;
static ComPtr<ID3D12RootSignature> g_RootSignature;
static ComPtr<ID3D12PipelineState> g_PipelineState;
static ComPtr<ID3D12Resource> g_Input[RendererState::g_kFRAME_COUNT];
static ComPtr<ID3D12Resource> g_TileIndices[RendererState::g_kFRAME_COUNT];
static ComPtr<ID3D12Resource> g_VolumetricIndices[RendererState::g_kFRAME_COUNT];
static ComPtr<ID3D12Resource> g_Counters[RendererState::g_kFRAME_COUNT];
LightInstanceBuilder::Input* g_MappedInput[RendererState::g_kFRAME_COUNT]{};
static bool g_OutputInShaderRead[RendererState::g_kFRAME_COUNT]{};

bool CreateBuffer(UINT64 size, D3D12_HEAP_TYPE heapType, D3D12_RESOURCE_FLAGS flags, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATES state,
                  ComPtr<ID3D12Resource>& output)
{
    auto heap = CD3DX12_HEAP_PROPERTIES(heapType);
    auto desc = CD3DX12_RESOURCE_DESC::Buffer(size, flags);
    return SUCCEEDED(
        g_Device->CreateCommittedResource(&heap, D3D12_HEAP_FLAG_NONE, &desc, state, nullptr, IID_PPV_ARGS(&output)));
}

bool LightInstanceBuilder::Initialize(ID3D12Device* device)
{
    Shutdown();
    if (!device)
    {
        return false;
    }
    g_Device = device;
    CD3DX12_ROOT_PARAMETER parameters[5];
    parameters[0].InitAsShaderResourceView(0);
    parameters[1].InitAsUnorderedAccessView(0);
    parameters[2].InitAsUnorderedAccessView(1);
    parameters[3].InitAsUnorderedAccessView(2);
    parameters[4].InitAsConstants(8, 0);
    CD3DX12_ROOT_SIGNATURE_DESC rootDesc(_countof(parameters), parameters, 0, nullptr, D3D12_ROOT_SIGNATURE_FLAG_NONE);
    ComPtr<ID3DBlob> serialized;
    ComPtr<ID3DBlob> errors;
    if (FAILED(D3D12SerializeRootSignature(&rootDesc, D3D_ROOT_SIGNATURE_VERSION_1, &serialized, &errors)) ||
        FAILED(device->CreateRootSignature(0, serialized->GetBufferPointer(), serialized->GetBufferSize(),
                                           IID_PPV_ARGS(&g_RootSignature))))
    {
        return false;
    }
    ComPtr<ID3DBlob> shader;
    if (FAILED(D3DReadFileToBlob(L"shader/hlsl/build/LightInstanceBuilderCS.cso", &shader)))
    {
        return false;
    }
    D3D12_COMPUTE_PIPELINE_STATE_DESC pso{};
    pso.pRootSignature = g_RootSignature.Get();
    pso.CS = CD3DX12_SHADER_BYTECODE(shader.Get());
    if (FAILED(device->CreateComputePipelineState(&pso, IID_PPV_ARGS(&g_PipelineState))))
    {
        return false;
    }

    const UINT64 inputSize = sizeof(Input) * RendererState::g_kMAX_SHADER_LIGHTS;
    const UINT64 tileSize = static_cast<UINT64>(RendererState::g_kMAX_LIGHT_TILE_COUNT) *
                            RendererState::g_kMAX_LIGHTS_PER_TILE * sizeof(uint32_t);
    const UINT64 volumetricSize = RendererState::g_kMAX_SHADER_LIGHTS * sizeof(uint32_t);
    for (UINT frame = 0; frame < RendererState::g_kFRAME_COUNT; ++frame)
    {
        if (!CreateBuffer(inputSize, D3D12_HEAP_TYPE_UPLOAD, D3D12_RESOURCE_FLAG_NONE,
                          D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_GENERIC_READ, g_Input[frame]) ||
            !CreateBuffer(tileSize, D3D12_HEAP_TYPE_DEFAULT, D3D12_RESOURCE_FLAG_ALLOW_UNORDERED_ACCESS,
                          D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_COMMON, g_TileIndices[frame]) ||
            !CreateBuffer(volumetricSize, D3D12_HEAP_TYPE_DEFAULT, D3D12_RESOURCE_FLAG_ALLOW_UNORDERED_ACCESS,
                          D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_COMMON, g_VolumetricIndices[frame]) ||
            !CreateBuffer(sizeof(uint32_t), D3D12_HEAP_TYPE_DEFAULT, D3D12_RESOURCE_FLAG_ALLOW_UNORDERED_ACCESS,
                          D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_COMMON, g_Counters[frame]))
        {
            return false;
        }
        CD3DX12_RANGE noRead(0, 0);
        if (FAILED(g_Input[frame]->Map(0, &noRead, reinterpret_cast<void**>(&g_MappedInput[frame]))))
        {
            return false;
        }
    }
    return true;
}

void LightInstanceBuilder::Shutdown()
{
    for (UINT frame = 0; frame < RendererState::g_kFRAME_COUNT; ++frame)
    {
        if (g_Input[frame] && g_MappedInput[frame])
        {
            g_Input[frame]->Unmap(0, nullptr);
        }
        g_MappedInput[frame] = nullptr;
        g_Input[frame].Reset();
        g_TileIndices[frame].Reset();
        g_VolumetricIndices[frame].Reset();
        g_Counters[frame].Reset();
        g_OutputInShaderRead[frame] = false;
    }
    g_PipelineState.Reset();
    g_RootSignature.Reset();
    g_Device.Reset();
}

bool LightInstanceBuilder::IsAvailable()
{
    return g_Device && g_RootSignature && g_PipelineState;
}

bool LightInstanceBuilder::Build(ID3D12GraphicsCommandList* commandList, UINT frameIndex, const vector<Input>& inputs,
                                 UINT tileCountX, UINT tileCountY, UINT slotsPerTile)
{
    if (!commandList || !IsAvailable() || tileCountX == 0 || tileCountY == 0 ||
        tileCountX * tileCountY > RendererState::g_kMAX_LIGHT_TILE_COUNT)
    {
        return false;
    }
    frameIndex %= RendererState::g_kFRAME_COUNT;
    const UINT lightCount = min(static_cast<UINT>(inputs.size()), RendererState::g_kMAX_SHADER_LIGHTS);
    if (lightCount > 0)
    {
        memcpy(g_MappedInput[frameIndex], inputs.data(), lightCount * sizeof(Input));
    }
    if (g_OutputInShaderRead[frameIndex])
    {
        D3D12_RESOURCE_BARRIER barriers[2] = {
            CD3DX12_RESOURCE_BARRIER::Transition(g_TileIndices[frameIndex].Get(),
                                                 D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE,
                                                 D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_UNORDERED_ACCESS),
            CD3DX12_RESOURCE_BARRIER::Transition(g_VolumetricIndices[frameIndex].Get(),
                                                 D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE,
                                                 D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_UNORDERED_ACCESS)};
        commandList->ResourceBarrier(2, barriers);
    }
    commandList->SetComputeRootSignature(g_RootSignature.Get());
    commandList->SetPipelineState(g_PipelineState.Get());
    commandList->SetComputeRootShaderResourceView(0, g_Input[frameIndex]->GetGPUVirtualAddress());
    commandList->SetComputeRootUnorderedAccessView(1, g_TileIndices[frameIndex]->GetGPUVirtualAddress());
    commandList->SetComputeRootUnorderedAccessView(2, g_VolumetricIndices[frameIndex]->GetGPUVirtualAddress());
    commandList->SetComputeRootUnorderedAccessView(3, g_Counters[frameIndex]->GetGPUVirtualAddress());
    const UINT clearConstants[8] = {lightCount,
                                    tileCountX,
                                    tileCountY,
                                    slotsPerTile,
                                    0u,
                                    RendererState::g_kMAX_SHADER_LIGHTS,
                                    RendererState::g_kMAX_LIGHTS_PER_TILE,
                                    0u};
    commandList->SetComputeRoot32BitConstants(4, 8, clearConstants, 0);
    const UINT clearCount =
        max(tileCountX * tileCountY * RendererState::g_kMAX_LIGHTS_PER_TILE, RendererState::g_kMAX_SHADER_LIGHTS);
    commandList->Dispatch((clearCount + 63u) / 64u, 1, 1);
    D3D12_RESOURCE_BARRIER uavBarriers[3] = {CD3DX12_RESOURCE_BARRIER::UAV(g_TileIndices[frameIndex].Get()),
                                             CD3DX12_RESOURCE_BARRIER::UAV(g_VolumetricIndices[frameIndex].Get()),
                                             CD3DX12_RESOURCE_BARRIER::UAV(g_Counters[frameIndex].Get())};
    commandList->ResourceBarrier(3, uavBarriers);
    UINT buildConstants[8];
    memcpy(buildConstants, clearConstants, sizeof(buildConstants));
    buildConstants[4] = 1u;
    commandList->SetComputeRoot32BitConstants(4, 8, buildConstants, 0);
    if (lightCount > 0)
    {
        commandList->Dispatch((lightCount + 63u) / 64u, 1, 1);
    }
    D3D12_RESOURCE_BARRIER toRead[2] = {
        CD3DX12_RESOURCE_BARRIER::Transition(g_TileIndices[frameIndex].Get(), D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_UNORDERED_ACCESS,
                                             D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE),
        CD3DX12_RESOURCE_BARRIER::Transition(g_VolumetricIndices[frameIndex].Get(),
                                             D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_UNORDERED_ACCESS,
                                             D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE)};
    commandList->ResourceBarrier(2, toRead);
    g_OutputInShaderRead[frameIndex] = true;
    return true;
}

D3D12_GPU_VIRTUAL_ADDRESS LightInstanceBuilder::GetTileIndexAddress(UINT frameIndex)
{
    frameIndex %= RendererState::g_kFRAME_COUNT;
    if (g_TileIndices[frameIndex])
    {
        return g_TileIndices[frameIndex]->GetGPUVirtualAddress();
    }
    return 0;
}

D3D12_GPU_VIRTUAL_ADDRESS LightInstanceBuilder::GetVolumetricIndexAddress(UINT frameIndex)
{
    frameIndex %= RendererState::g_kFRAME_COUNT;
    if (g_VolumetricIndices[frameIndex])
    {
        return g_VolumetricIndices[frameIndex]->GetGPUVirtualAddress();
    }
    return 0;
}

===== FILE: source\rendering\livetoonstyle.h =====
#pragma once
#include <string>
#include <unordered_map>
#include "texturemanager.h"
#include "rendererstate.h"

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
// ライブ用トゥーンスタイル（学マスのライブシーン風）
//
// CEDEC2024「学園アイドルマスター」講演で紹介された構成を、このエンジンのトゥーン経路に合わせて
// 再構成したもの（実装は独自。パラメーター名・初期値は本エンジン用の目安）：
//   1. トゥーン陰影用メインライト  … 平行光源だけがセル陰影の境界を作る。影領域は「乗算色」で制御
//   2. 加算ライト                  … 点 / スポット / 矩形は陰影の境界を作らず、距離減衰した明るさだけを足す
//   3. リムライト                  … ふわっと広いリム + 輪郭を締める強いリム（ライト色を拾う）
//   4. スペキュラ（ランプ）         … 段のついたハイライト。髪は天使の輪（異方性バンド）
//   5. 環境スペキュラ               … IBL（環境マップ）からの縁の映り込み
//   6. 落ち影の濃さ                 … セルフシャドウ / 落ち影の濃さを陰影と独立に調整
//
// Deferred のフルスクリーンパスは他エンティティのマテリアルを参照できないため、これはシーン全体の
// 設定として LightParams（b1）の末尾 4 個の float4 で渡す（ルートシグネチャは変更しない）。
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
struct LiveToonStyleSettings
{
    float Blend = 1.0f;              // 0 = 従来のトゥーン、1 = ライブスタイル
    float ShadowTintStrength = 1.0f; // 影の乗算色の効き
    float AdditiveSoftness = 0.65f;  // 加算ライトの回り込み（大きいほど面の向きに依存しない）
    float AdditiveGain = 1.0f;       // 加算ライトの強さ

    XMFLOAT3 ShadowTint = {0.78f, 0.72f, 0.90f}; // 影の乗算色（わずかに青紫へ寄せると映える）
    float SkinWarmth = 0.65f;                    // 肌の影を暖色へ寄せる量（血色）

    float RimSoft = 0.35f;      // ふわっとしたリム
    float RimHard = 0.55f;      // 輪郭を締める強いリム（逆光・ステージライト）
    float RimWidth = 0.38f;     // リム幅
    float RimLightTint = 0.75f; // リムがライト色を拾う量

    float RampSpecular = 0.30f;      // 段付きスペキュラ（ランプ）
    float HairAngelRing = 0.40f;     // 髪の天使の輪
    float EnvSpecular = 0.20f;       // 環境マップの縁の映り込み
    float CastShadowDensity = 0.85f; // 落ち影の濃さ

    // 陰影ランプ（シーン全体・1 枚）。横軸 = 影(左)→光(右)、上半分 = 肌、下半分 = 肌以外。
    std::string ShadowRampPath;
    float ShadowRampStrength = 1.0f;
};

// マテリアル・ランプ用のテクスチャ解決。パス → ディスクリプタ番号をキャッシュし、
// 毎フレームの定数構築では文字列マップの検索だけで済ませる。
namespace LiveToonTextures
{
    inline int ResolveDescriptor(const std::string& path)
    {
        if (path.empty())
        {
            return -1;
        }
        static std::unordered_map<std::string, int> cache;
        auto it = cache.find(path);
        if (it != cache.end())
        {
            return it->second;
        }
        // LoadTexture(const char*) は UTF-8 パスを受け取り、読み込み済みなら同じ番号を返す。
        int descriptor = TextureManager::LoadTexture(path.c_str());
        if (descriptor == TextureManager::GetErrorTextureIndex())
        {
            descriptor = -1;
        }
        cache.emplace(path, descriptor);
        return descriptor;
    }

    // シェーダーのテクスチャ表（t0 space1 / t0 space5）内の番号。無効なら UINT32_MAX。
    inline uint32_t ResolveHeapOffset(const std::string& path)
    {
        const int descriptor = ResolveDescriptor(path);
        if (descriptor < static_cast<int>(RendererState::g_kTEXTURE_SRV_START_INDEX))
        {
            return UINT32_MAX;
        }
        const uint32_t offset = static_cast<uint32_t>(descriptor) - RendererState::g_kTEXTURE_SRV_START_INDEX;
        return offset < 512u ? offset : UINT32_MAX;
    }
} // namespace LiveToonTextures

namespace LiveToonStyle
{
    inline LiveToonStyleSettings& Get()
    {
        static LiveToonStyleSettings settings{};
        return settings;
    }

    inline void Reset()
    {
        Get() = LiveToonStyleSettings{};
    }

    // LightParams.LiveToonStyle0..4 と同じ並び。
    inline void Write(XMFLOAT4 (&out)[5])
    {
        const LiveToonStyleSettings& s = Get();
        out[0] = {s.Blend, s.ShadowTintStrength, s.AdditiveSoftness, s.AdditiveGain};
        out[1] = {s.ShadowTint.x, s.ShadowTint.y, s.ShadowTint.z, s.SkinWarmth};
        out[2] = {s.RimSoft, s.RimHard, s.RimWidth, s.RimLightTint};
        out[3] = {s.RampSpecular, s.HairAngelRing, s.EnvSpecular, s.CastShadowDensity};
        const uint32_t ramp = LiveToonTextures::ResolveHeapOffset(s.ShadowRampPath);
        out[4] = {ramp == UINT32_MAX ? -1.0f : static_cast<float>(ramp), s.ShadowRampStrength, 0.0f, 0.0f};
    }
} // namespace LiveToonStyle

===== FILE: source\rendering\localheightfog.h =====
#pragma once

#include <DirectXMath.h>
#include <algorithm>
#include <vector>

enum class LocalFogShape : int
{
    Height = 0,
    Sphere = 1
};

struct LocalHeightFogVolume
{
    bool Enabled = true;
    LocalFogShape Shape = LocalFogShape::Height;
    DirectX::XMFLOAT3 Position = {0.0f, 1.0f, 0.0f};
    float Radius = 8.0f;
    float HeightFalloff = 1.0f;
    float Density = 0.25f;
    DirectX::XMFLOAT3 Color = {0.72f, 0.80f, 0.92f};
};

class LocalHeightFog
{
  public:
    static constexpr size_t MaxVolumes = 16;

    static const vector<LocalHeightFogVolume>& GetVolumes()
    {
        return s_Volumes;
    }

    static vector<LocalHeightFogVolume>& GetMutableVolumes()
    {
        return s_Volumes;
    }

    static bool Add(LocalFogShape shape = LocalFogShape::Height)
    {
        if (s_Volumes.size() >= MaxVolumes)
        {
            return false;
        }
        LocalHeightFogVolume volume{};
        volume.Shape = shape;
        s_Volumes.push_back(volume);
        return true;
    }

    static void Remove(size_t index)
    {
        if (index < s_Volumes.size())
        {
            s_Volumes.erase(s_Volumes.begin() + index);
        }
    }

    static void Clear()
    {
        s_Volumes.clear();
    }

  private:
    inline static vector<LocalHeightFogVolume> s_Volumes{};
};

===== FILE: source\rendering\ltctables.h =====
#pragma once
// =============================================================================================
// LTC tables for isotropic GGX (height-correlated Smith G2), 64 x 64.
// Fitted offline for this engine with the method of Heitz, Dupuy, Hill & Neubelt 2016
// ("Real-Time Polygonal-Light Shading with Linearly Transformed Cosines"):
// Nelder-Mead minimisation of the MIS-weighted L3 error between the LTC and the BRDF.
//   index  = roughnessIndex * 64 + thetaIndex
//   roughness = roughnessIndex / 63 (perceptual, alpha = roughness^2)
//   theta     : sqrt(1 - NdotV) = thetaIndex / 63
//   g_kLtcMatrix : inverse LTC matrix normalised by m11: (m00, m02, m20, m22),
//                  M^-1 = [[m00, 0, m02], [0, 1, 0], [m20, 0, m22]] in the frame (T1, T2, N)
//                  with V = (sin, 0, cos).
//   g_kLtcAmplitude : (integral of BRDF*cos, integral of BRDF*cos*(1 - V.H)^5)
//                     = split-sum DFG: Fss*Ess = F0 * (x - y) + y.
// =============================================================================================
namespace LtcTables
{
constexpr unsigned g_kSize = 64;
inline constexpr float g_kLtcMatrix[16384] =
{
	0.999839f, 1.32825e-08f, -2.3946e-24f, 0.000199987f, 0.997615f, 0.0223986f, -4.48223e-06f, 0.000199636f,
	0.998063f, 0.0448426f, -8.96866e-06f, 0.000199616f, 0.99547f, 0.0671527f, -1.34304e-05f, 0.000199093f,
	0.992232f, 0.0893642f, -1.78575e-05f, 0.000198276f, 0.987431f, 0.111355f, -2.22712e-05f, 0.000197488f,
	0.981865f, 0.133152f, -2.66319e-05f, 0.000196384f, 0.978089f, 0.155132f, -3.09765e-05f, 0.000195303f,
	0.968055f, 0.175981f, -3.5195e-05f, 0.000193604f, 0.959524f, 0.196879f, -3.93767e-05f, 0.000191909f,
	0.95107f, 0.217629f, -4.35061e-05f, 0.000190128f, 0.939657f, 0.237491f, -4.75085e-05f, 0.000187972f,
	0.929503f, 0.257443f, -5.14553e-05f, 0.000185781f, 0.916748f, 0.276435f, -5.52804e-05f, 0.000183328f,
	0.899635f, 0.29372f, -5.88538e-05f, 0.000180263f, 0.889682f, 0.313042f, -6.26146e-05f, 0.000177954f,
	0.874663f, 0.330349f, -6.60954e-05f, 0.000175f, 0.859679f, 0.347328f, -6.94631e-05f, 0.00017193f,
	0.843062f, 0.363279f, -7.26686e-05f, 0.000168642f, 0.827361f, 0.379254f, -7.57933e-05f, 0.000165346f,

#ifndef LUMEN_CACHE_MATH_H

// HLSL と CPU 回帰テストで共有し、平行な層と裏面を除外する。
#ifdef __cplusplus
namespace Lumen
{
#endif
    bool AcceptSurfaceSample(float planeDistance, float tangentDistance, float normalCosine, float texelSize)
    {
        float planeTolerance = texelSize * 0.04f + 0.001f;
        return normalCosine > 0.95f && planeDistance < planeTolerance && tangentDistance < texelSize * 1.5f;
    }

===== FILE: source\rendering\lumenscheduler.h =====
#pragma once
#include <algorithm>
#include <cstdint>
#include <vector>

namespace Lumen
{
    constexpr uint32_t InvalidSlot = ~0u;

    inline bool LightingChangeRequiresReset(bool changed, uint32_t quietFrames)
    {
        return changed && quietFrames >= 8;
    }

    inline bool HasFreshLighting(uint32_t sequence, uint32_t lastUpdate, uint32_t maximumAge)
    {
        return sequence - lastUpdate <= maximumAge;
    }

    inline bool CanReuseSurfaceLighting(uint32_t sequence, uint32_t lastUpdate, uint32_t lastSceneChange,
                                        bool changingScene)
    {
        return changingScene ? HasFreshLighting(sequence, lastUpdate, 8)
                             : sequence - lastUpdate <= sequence - lastSceneChange;
    }

    struct Input
    {
        uint64_t Owner = 0;
        uint64_t Revision = 0;
        float Distance = 0;
    };

    struct Work
    {
        uint32_t Instance = 0;
        uint32_t Slot = 0;
    };

    struct Schedule
    {
        std::vector<uint32_t> Slots;
        std::vector<Work> Captures;
        std::vector<Work> Updates;
    };

    // 所有関係は TLAS の並べ替え後も維持する。検索マップには取得済みタイルだけを載せる。
    class Scheduler
    {
      public:
        explicit Scheduler(uint32_t capacity = 128) : m_Entries(capacity) {}

        Schedule Prepare(const std::vector<Input>& inputs, uint32_t captureBudget, uint32_t lightingBudget)
        {
            Schedule result;
            result.Slots.assign(inputs.size(), InvalidSlot);
            std::vector<uint32_t> desired;
            for (uint32_t i = 0; i < inputs.size(); ++i)
            {
                if (inputs[i].Owner != 0)
                {
                    desired.push_back(i);
                }
            }
            std::stable_sort(desired.begin(), desired.end(), [&](uint32_t a, uint32_t b) {
                return inputs[a].Distance < inputs[b].Distance;
            });
            desired.resize((std::min)(desired.size(), m_Entries.size()));
            for (auto& entry : m_Entries)
            {
                entry.Instance = InvalidSlot;
                const auto found = std::find_if(desired.begin(), desired.end(), [&](uint32_t i) {
                    return inputs[i].Owner == entry.Owner;
                });
                if (found == desired.end())
                {
                    entry = {};
                }
            }
            for (uint32_t instance : desired)
            {
                const auto& input = inputs[instance];
                auto found = std::find_if(m_Entries.begin(), m_Entries.end(), [&](const Entry& entry) {
                    return entry.Owner == input.Owner;
                });
                if (found == m_Entries.end())
                {
                    found = std::find_if(m_Entries.begin(), m_Entries.end(), [](const Entry& entry) {
                        return entry.Owner == 0;
                    });
                }
                if (found == m_Entries.end())
                {
                    continue;
                }
                const uint32_t slot = static_cast<uint32_t>(found - m_Entries.begin());
                if (found->Owner != input.Owner || found->Revision != input.Revision)
                {
                    found->Ready = false;
                }
                found->Owner = input.Owner;
                found->Revision = input.Revision;
                found->Instance = instance;
                if (!found->Ready && result.Captures.size() < captureBudget)
                {
                    result.Captures.push_back({instance, slot});
                    found->Ready = true;
                }
                if (found->Ready)
                {
                    result.Slots[instance] = slot;
                }
            }
            for (uint32_t scanned = 0; scanned < m_Entries.size() && result.Updates.size() < lightingBudget; ++scanned)
            {
                const uint32_t slot = m_Next++ % static_cast<uint32_t>(m_Entries.size());
                const auto& entry = m_Entries[slot];
                const bool alreadyUpdated = std::any_of(result.Updates.begin(), result.Updates.end(), [&](Work work) {
                    return work.Slot == slot;
                });
                if (entry.Ready && entry.Instance != InvalidSlot && !alreadyUpdated)
                {
                    result.Updates.push_back({entry.Instance, slot});
                }
            }
            return result;
        }

      private:
        struct Entry
        {
            uint64_t Owner = 0;
            uint64_t Revision = 0;
            uint32_t Instance = InvalidSlot;
            bool Ready = false;
        };

        std::vector<Entry> m_Entries;
        uint32_t m_Next = 0;
    };
} // 名前空間 Lumen

===== FILE: source\rendering\lumensurfacecache.cpp =====
#include "pch.h"
#include "rendererstate.h"
#include "lumensurfacecache.h"
#include "graphicsdevice.h"
#include "envflags.h"

namespace
{
    bool CreateBuffer(ID3D12Device* device, ComPtr<ID3D12Resource>& resource, UINT64 bytes, bool upload)
    {
        const auto heap = CD3DX12_HEAP_PROPERTIES(upload ? D3D12_HEAP_TYPE_UPLOAD : D3D12_HEAP_TYPE_DEFAULT);
        const auto desc = CD3DX12_RESOURCE_DESC::Buffer(
            (std::max)(bytes, 256ull), upload ? D3D12_RESOURCE_FLAG_NONE : D3D12_RESOURCE_FLAG_ALLOW_UNORDERED_ACCESS);
        return SUCCEEDED(device->CreateCommittedResource(&heap, D3D12_HEAP_FLAG_NONE, &desc,
                                                         upload ? D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_GENERIC_READ
                                                                : D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_UNORDERED_ACCESS,
                                                         nullptr, IID_PPV_ARGS(resource.ReleaseAndGetAddressOf())));
    }

    bool Upload(ID3D12Resource* buffer, const void* source, size_t bytes)
    {
        void* mapped = nullptr;
        D3D12_RANGE noRead{};
        if (FAILED(buffer->Map(0, &noRead, &mapped)))
        {
            return false;
        }
        if (bytes != 0)
        {
            memcpy(mapped, source, bytes);
        }
        buffer->Unmap(0, nullptr);
        return true;
    }

    void Hash(uint64_t& hash, const void* data, size_t size)
    {
        const auto* bytes = static_cast<const unsigned char*>(data);
        for (size_t i = 0; i < size; ++i)
        {
            hash = (hash ^ bytes[i]) * 1099511628211ull;
        }
    }
}

bool LumenSurfaceCache::Prepare(ID3D12Device* device, UINT frame, const vector<RaytracingGeometry>& geometry,
                                const XMFLOAT3& camera, UINT width, UINT height, UINT spacing, UINT captureBudget,
                                UINT lightingBudget, UINT debugView, bool resetLighting, UINT sequence,
                                bool changingScene)
{
    if (!m_Atlases[0])
    {
        const auto heap = CD3DX12_HEAP_PROPERTIES(D3D12_HEAP_TYPE_DEFAULT);
        for (UINT i = 0; i < m_Atlases.size(); ++i)
        {
            const auto desc = CD3DX12_RESOURCE_DESC::Tex2D(
                i == 0 ? DXGI_FORMAT_R32G32B32A32_FLOAT : DXGI_FORMAT_R16G16B16A16_FLOAT, AtlasWidth, AtlasHeight, 1, 1,
                1, 0, D3D12_RESOURCE_FLAG_ALLOW_UNORDERED_ACCESS);
            if (FAILED(device->CreateCommittedResource(&heap, D3D12_HEAP_FLAG_NONE, &desc,
                                                       D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_UNORDERED_ACCESS, nullptr,
                                                       IID_PPV_ARGS(&m_Atlases[i]))))
            {
                Reset();
                return false;
            }
            m_Atlases[i]->SetName(L"Lumen Surface Atlas");
        }
        if (!CreateBuffer(device, m_Bounds, Capacity * 32ull, false))
        {
            Reset();
            return false;
        }
    }
    const UINT columns = (width + spacing - 1) / spacing;
    const UINT rows = (height + spacing - 1) / spacing;
    const UINT count = columns * rows;
    if (count != m_ProbeCount)
    {
        if (m_Probes && !GraphicsDevice::WaitForGpuIdle())
        {
            return false;
        }
        // 4 x float4 のレコードとガイドを2フレーム分保持する（現在と再投影履歴）。
        if (!CreateBuffer(device, m_Probes, UINT64(count) * 2 * 4 * 16, false) ||
            !CreateBuffer(device, m_ProbeGuides, UINT64(count) * 2 * 32, false))
        {
            return false;
        }
        m_ProbeCount = count;
        m_ProbeHistory = false;
        m_Probes->SetName(L"Lumen Screen Probe Radiance");
        m_ProbeGuides->SetName(L"Lumen Screen Probe Guides");
    }
    vector<Lumen::Input> inputs;
    inputs.reserve(geometry.size());
    for (const auto& mesh : geometry)
    {
        uint64_t revision = 14695981039346656037ull;
        Hash(revision, &mesh.World, sizeof(mesh.World));
        Hash(revision, &mesh.VertexView, sizeof(mesh.VertexView));
        Hash(revision, &mesh.IndexView, sizeof(mesh.IndexView));
        Hash(revision, &mesh.BaseColor, sizeof(mesh.BaseColor));
        Hash(revision, mesh.Noise.data(), sizeof(mesh.Noise));
        Hash(revision, &mesh.NoiseNormalScale, sizeof(mesh.NoiseNormalScale));
        Hash(revision, &mesh.Emission, sizeof(mesh.Emission));
        Hash(revision, &mesh.Metallic, sizeof(mesh.Metallic));
        Hash(revision, &mesh.UsesAssetMaterial, sizeof(mesh.UsesAssetMaterial));
        const auto texture = mesh.Texture.Get(), emission = mesh.EmissionTexture.Get();
        Hash(revision, &texture, sizeof(texture));
        Hash(revision, &emission, sizeof(emission));
        Hash(revision, &mesh.TextureResidentMip, sizeof(mesh.TextureResidentMip));
        Hash(revision, &mesh.EmissionResidentMip, sizeof(mesh.EmissionResidentMip));
        const XMFLOAT3 offset{mesh.World._41 - camera.x, mesh.World._42 - camera.y, mesh.World._43 - camera.z};
        const float distance = offset.x * offset.x + offset.y * offset.y + offset.z * offset.z;
        inputs.push_back({!mesh.Deforming && mesh.Transmission <= 0.001f ? mesh.SurfaceOwner : 0, revision, distance});
    }
    // アップロード成功後だけ所有関係を公開し、失敗したフレームは再試行時に再取得する。
    auto scheduler = m_Scheduler;
    m_Schedule = scheduler.Prepare(inputs, captureBudget, lightingBudget);
    vector<UINT> lookupSlots = m_Schedule.Slots;
    for (auto& slot : lookupSlots)
    {
        if (slot != Lumen::InvalidSlot &&
            !Lumen::CanReuseSurfaceLighting(sequence, m_LastUpdate[slot], m_LastSceneChange, changingScene))
        {
            slot = Lumen::InvalidSlot;
        }
    }
    for (const auto work : m_Schedule.Updates)
    {
        m_LastUpdate[work.Slot] = sequence;
    }
    auto& uploads = m_Frames[frame];
    const UINT64 mapBytes = (std::max)(256ull, UINT64(inputs.size()) * 4);
    if (!uploads.Map || uploads.Map->GetDesc().Width < mapBytes)
    {
        if (!CreateBuffer(device, uploads.Map, mapBytes, true))
        {
            return false;
        }
    }
    if (!uploads.Work && !CreateBuffer(device, uploads.Work, Capacity * 2ull * 16, true))
    {
        return false;
    }
    if (!uploads.Parameters && !CreateBuffer(device, uploads.Parameters, 256, true))
    {
        return false;
    }
    vector<XMUINT4> work;
    const auto append = [&](const vector<Lumen::Work>& list) {
        for (const auto entry : list)
        {
            const auto& mesh = geometry[entry.Instance];
            work.push_back({entry.Instance, entry.Slot,
                            mesh.VertexView.SizeInBytes / (std::max)(mesh.VertexView.StrideInBytes, 1u), 0});
        }
    };
    append(m_Schedule.Captures);
    append(m_Schedule.Updates);
    m_Clear = m_Clear || resetLighting;
    const bool gridStable = columns == m_ProbeColumns && rows == m_ProbeRows && spacing == m_ProbeSpacing;
    const bool probeHistory = m_ProbeHistory && gridStable && !resetLighting;
    const UINT parity = m_ProbeParity ^ 1u;
    m_Constants.Counts = {1, static_cast<UINT>(m_Schedule.Captures.size()),
                          static_cast<UINT>(m_Schedule.Updates.size()), parity | (probeHistory ? 2u : 0u)};
    m_Constants.Grid = {columns, rows, spacing, Capacity};
    static const bool singleBounce = ReadEnvironmentFlagOnce("DX12_LUMEN_SINGLE_BOUNCE");
    // 既定は深度バッファによる再接続判定。DX12_LUMEN_RAY_VISIBILITY で TLAS のレイ判定に戻す。
    static const bool rayVisibility = ReadEnvironmentFlagOnce("DX12_LUMEN_RAY_VISIBILITY");
    m_Constants.Settings = {changingScene ? 2.f : 16.f, static_cast<float>(debugView), rayVisibility ? 1.f : 0.f,
                            singleBounce ? 0.f : 1.f};
    if (!Upload(uploads.Map.Get(), lookupSlots.data(), lookupSlots.size() * 4) ||
        !Upload(uploads.Work.Get(), work.data(), work.size() * sizeof(XMUINT4)) ||
        !Upload(uploads.Parameters.Get(), &m_Constants, sizeof(m_Constants)))
    {
        return false;
    }
    m_Scheduler = std::move(scheduler);
    m_ProbeParity = parity;
    m_ProbeColumns = columns;
    m_ProbeRows = rows;
    m_ProbeSpacing = spacing;
    m_ProbeHistory = true;
    return true;
}

void LumenSurfaceCache::WriteDescriptors(ID3D12Device* device, UINT frame, D3D12_CPU_DESCRIPTOR_HANDLE start,
                                         UINT increment)
{
    auto target = [&](UINT index) {
        return CD3DX12_CPU_DESCRIPTOR_HANDLE(start, index, increment);
    };
    for (UINT i = 0; i < 3; ++i)
    {
        D3D12_SHADER_RESOURCE_VIEW_DESC desc{};
        desc.ViewDimension = D3D12_SRV_DIMENSION_BUFFER;
        desc.Shader4ComponentMapping = D3D12_DEFAULT_SHADER_4_COMPONENT_MAPPING;
        desc.Buffer.StructureByteStride = i == 0 ? 4 : 16;
        auto* resource = i == 0 ? m_Frames[frame].Map.Get() : m_Frames[frame].Work.Get();
        desc.Buffer.NumElements =
            resource ? static_cast<UINT>(resource->GetDesc().Width / desc.Buffer.StructureByteStride) : 1;
        device->CreateShaderResourceView(resource, &desc, target(i));
    }
    for (UINT i = 0; i < 11; ++i)
    {
        D3D12_UNORDERED_ACCESS_VIEW_DESC desc{};
        ID3D12Resource* resource = nullptr;
        if (i < 8)
        {
            UINT atlas = i;
            if (i >= 4 && i < 6)
            {
                atlas = 4 + (m_Read ^ (i - 4));
            }
            else if (i >= 6)
            {
                atlas = 6 + (m_Read ^ (i - 6));
            }
            resource = m_Atlases[atlas].Get();
            desc.ViewDimension = D3D12_UAV_DIMENSION_TEXTURE2D;
            desc.Format = i == 0 ? DXGI_FORMAT_R32G32B32A32_FLOAT : DXGI_FORMAT_R16G16B16A16_FLOAT;
        }
        else
        {
            switch (i)
            {
                case 8:
                    resource = m_Bounds.Get();
                    break;
                case 9:
                    resource = m_Probes.Get();
                    break;
                default:
                    resource = m_ProbeGuides.Get();
                    break;
            }
            desc.ViewDimension = D3D12_UAV_DIMENSION_BUFFER;
            desc.Buffer.StructureByteStride = i == 9 ? 16 : 32;
            desc.Buffer.NumElements =
                resource ? static_cast<UINT>(resource->GetDesc().Width / desc.Buffer.StructureByteStride) : 1;
        }
        device->CreateUnorderedAccessView(resource, nullptr, &desc, target(3 + i));
    }
}

D3D12_GPU_VIRTUAL_ADDRESS LumenSurfaceCache::ConstantsAddress(UINT frame) const
{
    return m_Frames[frame].Parameters->GetGPUVirtualAddress();
}

void LumenSurfaceCache::Barrier(ID3D12GraphicsCommandList* commands) const
{
    // 全キャッシュ段階はグラフィックスキューの UAV を使う。取得、照明、利用側の順序を保証する。
    const auto barrier = CD3DX12_RESOURCE_BARRIER::UAV(nullptr);
    commands->ResourceBarrier(1, &barrier);
}

void LumenSurfaceCache::BeginLighting(ID3D12GraphicsCommandList* commands)
{
    // このフレームに書き込みがなければ、現在の読み取りアトラスを保持し、コピーも交換もしない。
    if (m_Constants.Counts.z == 0)
    {
        return;
    }
    // クリアと取得は両方のアトラスに書くため、交換後の書き込みアトラスで不足するのは
    // 前回の照明パスで更新したスロットだけ。毎フレームの 2 x 3 MiB コピーを避け、その行だけコピーする。
    if (m_Clear)
    {
        m_FullCopy = false;
        m_DirtySlots.clear();
    }
    const bool full = m_FullCopy;
    if (!full && m_DirtySlots.empty())
    {
        return;
    }
    vector<D3D12_RESOURCE_BARRIER> before, after;
    for (UINT base : {4u, 6u})
    {
        auto* source = m_Atlases[base + m_Read].Get();
        auto* destination = m_Atlases[base + (m_Read ^ 1u)].Get();
        before.push_back(CD3DX12_RESOURCE_BARRIER::Transition(source, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_UNORDERED_ACCESS,
                                                              D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_COPY_SOURCE));
        before.push_back(CD3DX12_RESOURCE_BARRIER::Transition(destination, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_UNORDERED_ACCESS,
                                                              D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_COPY_DEST));
        after.push_back(CD3DX12_RESOURCE_BARRIER::Transition(source, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_COPY_SOURCE,
                                                             D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_UNORDERED_ACCESS));
        after.push_back(CD3DX12_RESOURCE_BARRIER::Transition(destination, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_COPY_DEST,
                                                             D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_UNORDERED_ACCESS));
    }
    commands->ResourceBarrier(static_cast<UINT>(before.size()), before.data());
    for (UINT base : {4u, 6u})
    {
        auto* source = m_Atlases[base + m_Read].Get();
        auto* destination = m_Atlases[base + (m_Read ^ 1u)].Get();
        if (full)
        {
            commands->CopyResource(destination, source);
            continue;
        }
        const CD3DX12_TEXTURE_COPY_LOCATION dst(destination, 0), src(source, 0);
        for (UINT slot : m_DirtySlots)
        {
            const D3D12_BOX box{0, slot * CardSize, 0, AtlasWidth, (slot + 1) * CardSize, 1};
            commands->CopyTextureRegion(&dst, 0, slot * CardSize, 0, &src, &box);
        }
    }
    commands->ResourceBarrier(static_cast<UINT>(after.size()), after.data());
    m_FullCopy = false;
}

void LumenSurfaceCache::EndLighting(ID3D12GraphicsCommandList* commands)
{
    Barrier(commands);
    m_Clear = false;
    if (m_Constants.Counts.z == 0)
    {
        return;
    }
    // 現在のフレームは前のアトラスを読み、次のフレームで更新済みの内容を使う。
    m_Read ^= 1u;
    m_DirtySlots.clear();
    for (const auto work : m_Schedule.Updates)
    {
        m_DirtySlots.push_back(work.Slot);
    }
}

UINT LumenSurfaceCache::ResidentMeshes() const
{
    return static_cast<UINT>(std::count_if(m_Schedule.Slots.begin(), m_Schedule.Slots.end(), [](UINT slot) {
        return slot != Lumen::InvalidSlot;
    }));
}

UINT64 LumenSurfaceCache::MemoryBytes() const
{
    return m_Atlases[0] ? UINT64(AtlasWidth) * AtlasHeight * (16 + 7 * 8) + Capacity * 32ull +
                              UINT64(m_ProbeCount) * 2 * (64 + 32)
                        : 0;
}

void LumenSurfaceCache::Reset()
{
    *this = LumenSurfaceCache{};
}

#pragma once
#include "lumenscheduler.h"
#include "rendererstate.h"
#include "raytracingscene.h"

// 永続的なサーフェスアトラス。フレームごとのアップロードは描画側のスロットフェンスに従う。
class LumenSurfaceCache
{
  public:
    static constexpr UINT Capacity = 256, CardSize = 16, AtlasWidth = CardSize * 6;
    static constexpr UINT AtlasHeight = CardSize * Capacity;
    static constexpr UINT DescriptorCount = 14;

    struct Constants
    {
        XMUINT4 Counts{};    // 有効、取得数、照明更新数、予約領域
        XMUINT4 Grid{};      // プローブの列数、行数、間隔、容量
        XMFLOAT4 Settings{}; // 履歴上限、デバッグ表示、レイ可視性、複数バウンス
    };

    bool Prepare(ID3D12Device* device, UINT frame, const vector<RaytracingGeometry>& geometry, const XMFLOAT3& camera,
                 UINT width, UINT height, UINT spacing, UINT captureBudget, UINT lightingBudget, UINT debugView,
                 bool resetLighting, UINT sequence, bool changingScene);
    void WriteDescriptors(ID3D12Device* device, UINT frame, D3D12_CPU_DESCRIPTOR_HANDLE start, UINT increment);
    D3D12_GPU_VIRTUAL_ADDRESS ConstantsAddress(UINT frame) const;
    void BeginLighting(ID3D12GraphicsCommandList* commands);
    void Barrier(ID3D12GraphicsCommandList* commands) const;
    void EndLighting(ID3D12GraphicsCommandList* commands);

    void NotifySceneChanged(UINT sequence)
    {
        m_LastSceneChange = sequence;
    }

    const Constants& GetConstants() const
    {
        return m_Constants;
    }

    bool NeedsLightingClear() const
    {
        return m_Clear;
    }

    UINT ResidentMeshes() const;
    UINT64 MemoryBytes() const;

    ID3D12Resource* LightingResource() const
    {
        return m_Atlases[4 + m_Read].Get();
    }

    void Reset();

  private:
    struct Uploads
    {
        ComPtr<ID3D12Resource> Map, Work, Parameters;
    };

    Lumen::Scheduler m_Scheduler{Capacity};
    Lumen::Schedule m_Schedule;
    array<Uploads, RendererState::g_kFRAME_COUNT> m_Frames;
    // 位置、法線、制限済みアルベド、発光、合計 E A/B、間接 E A/B
    array<ComPtr<ID3D12Resource>, 8> m_Atlases;
    ComPtr<ID3D12Resource> m_Bounds, m_Probes, m_ProbeGuides;
    Constants m_Constants;
    UINT m_ProbeCount = 0, m_Read = 0;
    array<UINT, Capacity> m_LastUpdate{};
    UINT m_LastSceneChange = 0;
    bool m_Clear = true;
    // 前フレームで書き込みアトラスに書いたスロット。交換後に差があるのはこれらの行だけ。
    vector<UINT> m_DirtySlots;
    // 画面プローブの履歴は二重バッファで保持し、グリッド変更または照明リセット時に無効化する。
    UINT m_ProbeParity = 0, m_ProbeColumns = 0, m_ProbeRows = 0, m_ProbeSpacing = 0;
    bool m_ProbeHistory = false;
    bool m_FullCopy = true;
};

    uint64_t HashGeometry(const void* data, size_t size)
    {
        uint64_t hash = 1469598103934665603ull;
        const auto* bytes = static_cast<const uint8_t*>(data);
        for (size_t i = 0; i < size; ++i)
        {
            hash ^= bytes[i];
            hash *= 1099511628211ull;
        }
        return hash;
    }

    struct MaterialPartShaderConstants
    {
        XMFLOAT4 Basic{};
        XMFLOAT4 Base{};

        XMFLOAT4 Transparent0 = {1.50f, 0.98f, 0.02f, 0.035f};

        XMFLOAT4 AssetEmission{};
        XMUINT4 AssetTextures{UINT32_MAX, UINT32_MAX, UINT32_MAX, 0}; // MR、AO、発光、サーフェスとカリングのフラグ。
        XMFLOAT4 AssetParallax{0, 32, -1, 0};

        XMUINT4 LiveToonTextures{UINT32_MAX, UINT32_MAX, UINT32_MAX, 0}; // Def、顔陰影反転、質感ランプ
        XMFLOAT4 LiveToonMaterialParams{1, 1, 1, 0};

    static_assert(sizeof(PBRConstants) <= GpuSceneMaterialParameterVectors * sizeof(XMFLOAT4));
