    void WriteMaterialPartConstants(PBRConstants& constants, int index, const MaterialPartParams& params)
    {
        if (index < 0 || index >= kMaterialPartParamCount)
        {
            return;
        }

        constants.PartParams[index].Basic =
            XMFLOAT4(params.Metallic, params.Roughness, params.Fresnel, params.NormalBlend);
        constants.PartParams[index].Base =
            XMFLOAT4(params.NormalBias, params.BaseSaturation, params.BaseBrightness, params.KawaiiBlend);
        constants.PartParams[index].Shadow0 =
            XMFLOAT4(params.ShadowThreshold, params.ShadowSoftness, params.ShadowStrength, params.MidStrength);
        constants.PartParams[index].Shadow1 =
            XMFLOAT4(params.LitStrength, params.CastShadowThreshold, params.CastShadowSoftness, 0.0f);
        constants.PartParams[index].Highlight =
            XMFLOAT4(params.RimStrength, params.RimThreshold, params.SpecularStrength, params.SpecularThreshold);
        constants.PartParams[index].RimStyle =
            XMFLOAT4(params.RimSoftness, params.RimPower, params.RimAlbedoBlend, params.RimLightBlend);
        constants.PartParams[index].RimLight = XMFLOAT4(params.RimColor.x, params.RimColor.y, params.RimColor.z, 1.0f);
        constants.PartParams[index].Skin0 = XMFLOAT4(params.SkinScatterStrength, params.SkinScatterWrap,
                                                     params.SkinBacklightStrength, params.SkinRimScatterStrength);
        constants.PartParams[index].Skin1 =
            XMFLOAT4(params.SkinOilSpecularStrength, params.SkinShadowScatter, 0.0f, 0.0f);
    }

    PBRConstants BuildPBRConstantsFromMaterial(const MaterialComponent& material)
    {
        if (material.Noise[0].Width != 0)
        {
            NoiseCacheBindings::Request();
        }
        PBRConstants constants{};
        constants.Metallic = material.Metallic;
        constants.Roughness = material.Roughness;
        constants.Fresnel = material.Fresnel;
        constants.NormalBlend = material.NormalBlend;
        constants.NormalBias = material.NormalBias;
        constants.BaseSaturation = material.BaseSaturation;
        constants.BaseBrightness = material.BaseBrightness;
        constants.ShadowThreshold = material.ShadowThreshold;
        constants.ShadowSoftness = material.ShadowSoftness;
        constants.ShadowStrength = material.ShadowStrength;
        constants.MidStrength = material.MidStrength;
        constants.LitStrength = material.LitStrength;
        constants.RimStrength = material.RimStrength;
        constants.RimThreshold = material.RimThreshold;
        constants.RimSoftness = material.RimSoftness;
        constants.RimPower = material.RimPower;
        constants.RimColor = material.RimColor;
        constants.RimAlbedoBlend = material.RimAlbedoBlend;
        constants.RimLightBlend = material.RimLightBlend;
        constants.SpecularStrength = material.SpecularStrength;
        constants.SpecularThreshold = material.SpecularThreshold;
        constants.KawaiiBlend = material.KawaiiBlend;
        constants.SkinScatterStrength = material.SkinScatterStrength;
        constants.SkinScatterWrap = material.SkinScatterWrap;
        constants.SkinBacklightStrength = material.SkinBacklightStrength;
        constants.SkinRimScatterStrength = material.SkinRimScatterStrength;
        constants.SkinOilSpecularStrength = material.SkinOilSpecularStrength;
        constants.SkinShadowScatter = material.SkinShadowScatter;
        constants.CastShadowThreshold = material.CastShadowThreshold;
        constants.CastShadowSoftness = material.CastShadowSoftness;
        constants.Padding[1] = static_cast<float>(MaterialSystem::ResolveShadowMode(material));
        constants.Padding[2] = material.ShadowCutoff;
        constants.Transparent0 =
            XMFLOAT4(max(material.IOR, 1.0f), clamp(material.Transmission, 0.0f, 1.0f),
                     clamp(material.TransmissionRoughness, 0.0f, 1.0f), max(material.RefractionStrength, 0.0f));
        constants.Transparent1 =
            XMFLOAT4(max(material.Thickness, 0.0f), max(material.AbsorptionCoefficient.x, 0.0f),
                     max(material.AbsorptionCoefficient.y, 0.0f), max(material.AbsorptionCoefficient.z, 0.0f));
        for (int i = 0; i < kMaterialPartParamCount; ++i)
        {
            WriteMaterialPartConstants(constants, i, material.PartParams[i]);
        }
        constants.AssetNoise = material.Noise;
        constants.AssetBaseColor = material.BaseColor;
        constants.AssetSurface = {material.NormalScale, material.AOStrength, 0, material.AlphaCutoff};
        if (material.RuntimeHandle != 0 || material.LiveSurfaceOverride)
        {
            constants.AssetSurface.z = 1.0f;
        }
        constants.AssetEmission = {material.EmissiveColor.x, material.EmissiveColor.y, material.EmissiveColor.z,
                                   material.EmissiveIntensity};
        auto textureOffset = [](int descriptor) {
            if (descriptor < static_cast<int>(FrameConstants::g_kTEXTURE_SRV_START_INDEX))
            {
                return UINT32_MAX;
            }
            return static_cast<uint32_t>(descriptor) - FrameConstants::g_kTEXTURE_SRV_START_INDEX;
        };
        const uint32_t heightIndex = textureOffset(material.HeightTextureID);
        constants.AssetParallax = {material.ParallaxDepth, material.ParallaxSteps,
                                   heightIndex < 512u ? static_cast<float>(heightIndex) : -1.0f,
                                   static_cast<float>(FrameConstants::g_kTEXTURE_SRV_START_INDEX)};
        constants.AssetTextures = {
            textureOffset(material.MetallicRoughnessID), textureOffset(material.AOTextureID),
            textureOffset(material.EmissiveTextureID),
            static_cast<uint32_t>(material.AssetSurface) |
                (static_cast<uint32_t>(material.DoubleSided ? MaterialCull::None : material.AssetCull) << 2) |
                // 拡張シェーディングモデル（MaterialSurface.hlsli:
                // EncodeShadingModel）：ビット4～6がモデル、8～15が強度。
                ((min(material.ShadingModel, 7u) & 7u) << 4) |
                (static_cast<uint32_t>(clamp(material.ShadingStrength, 0.0f, 1.0f) * 255.0f + 0.5f) << 8)};
        constants.LiveToonTextures = {LiveToonTextures::ResolveHeapOffset(material.LiveToonDefPath),
                                      LiveToonTextures::ResolveHeapOffset(material.LiveToonFacePath),
                                      LiveToonTextures::ResolveHeapOffset(material.LiveToonTextureRampPath), 0u};
        constants.LiveToonMaterialParams = {material.LiveToonDefStrength, material.LiveToonFaceStrength,
                                            material.LiveToonTextureRampMultiply, material.LiveToonTextureRampAdd};
        return constants;
    }

    const MaterialComponent& GetDeferredLightingMaterial()
    {
        static MaterialComponent defaultMaterial{};
        EntityID fallbackEntity = g_kINVALID_ENTITY;
        EntityID litEntity = g_kINVALID_ENTITY;
        EntityID selfShadowEntity = g_kINVALID_ENTITY;
        EntityID toonEntity = g_kINVALID_ENTITY;

        for (EntityID entity : World::GetView<MaterialComponent>())
        {
            const auto& material = ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<MaterialComponent>(entity);
            if (material.ShaderClassMode != MaterialMode::Manual)
            {
                continue;
            }

            if (fallbackEntity == g_kINVALID_ENTITY)
            {
                fallbackEntity = entity;
            }
            if (material.ShaderClass == ShaderClass::Lit && litEntity == g_kINVALID_ENTITY)
            {
                litEntity = entity;
            }
            if (material.ShaderClass == ShaderClass::SelfShadow && selfShadowEntity == g_kINVALID_ENTITY)
            {
                selfShadowEntity = entity;
            }
            if (material.ShaderClass == ShaderClass::Toon && toonEntity == g_kINVALID_ENTITY)
            {
                toonEntity = entity;
            }
        }

        if (litEntity != g_kINVALID_ENTITY)
        {
            return ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<MaterialComponent>(litEntity);
        }

        if (selfShadowEntity != g_kINVALID_ENTITY)
        {
            return ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<MaterialComponent>(selfShadowEntity);
        }

        if (toonEntity != g_kINVALID_ENTITY)
        {
            return ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<MaterialComponent>(toonEntity);
        }

        if (fallbackEntity != g_kINVALID_ENTITY)
        {
            return ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<MaterialComponent>(fallbackEntity);
        }

        return defaultMaterial;
    }

} // 名前空間

GPUMaterialData MaterialBindings::BuildGpuSceneMaterial(const MaterialComponent& material)
{
    GPUMaterialData result{};
    result.BaseColor = material.BaseColor;
    result.BaseColor.w *= material.Alpha;
    result.Surface = XMFLOAT4(material.Metallic, material.Roughness, material.Fresnel, material.NormalBlend);
    result.AlbedoTextureIndex = material.TextureID >= 0 ? static_cast<uint32_t>(material.TextureID) : UINT32_MAX;
    result.NormalTextureIndex = material.NormalMapID >= 0 ? static_cast<uint32_t>(material.NormalMapID) : UINT32_MAX;
    result.Flags = (material.UseTexture ? 1u : 0u) | (MaterialSystem::IsTransparentMaterial(material) ? 2u : 0u) |
                   (material.DoubleSided ? 4u : 0u);
    result.ShaderClass = static_cast<uint32_t>(material.ShaderClass);
    result.ShaderMode = static_cast<uint32_t>(material.ShaderClassMode);
    const auto constants = BuildPBRConstantsFromMaterial(material);
    static_assert(sizeof(constants) <= sizeof(result.ShadingParameters));
    result.ParameterVectorCount = (sizeof(constants) + 15) / 16;
    memcpy(result.ShadingParameters.data(), &constants, sizeof(constants));
    return result;
}

D3D12_GPU_VIRTUAL_ADDRESS MaterialBindings::GetPBRConstantBufferAddress(UINT slot)
{
    if (!m_PBRConstantBuffer)
    {
        return 0;
    }
    UINT safeSlot;
    if (slot < g_kPBR_CB_SLOT_COUNT)
    {
        safeSlot = slot;
    }
    else
    {
        safeSlot = 0;
    }
    const UINT frameSlot = GraphicsDevice::GetFrameIndex() * g_kPBR_CB_SLOT_COUNT + safeSlot;
    return m_PBRConstantBuffer->GetGPUVirtualAddress() + frameSlot * g_kPBR_CB_ALIGNED_SIZE;
}

void MaterialBindings::SetMaterial(const EntityID entityID, const MaterialComponent& material)
{
    if (!m_pPBRCbvDataBegin || !m_PBRConstantBuffer || !m_CommandList)
    {
        return;
    }

    UINT slot;
    if (entityID < g_kMAX_ENTITIES)
    {
        slot = entityID + 1;
    }
    else
    {
        slot = 0;
    }
    PBRConstants constants = BuildPBRConstantsFromMaterial(material);
    static_assert(sizeof(constants) <= g_kPBR_CB_ALIGNED_SIZE,
                  "Material constants must fit within one per-entity frame slot");
    static_assert(offsetof(PBRConstants, AssetBaseColor) == 146 * 16);
    const auto textureHeap = FrameConstants::GetCbvHeap();
    if (textureHeap)
    {
        m_CommandList->SetGraphicsRootDescriptorTable(
            18, CD3DX12_GPU_DESCRIPTOR_HANDLE(textureHeap->GetGPUDescriptorHandleForHeapStart(),
                                              FrameConstants::g_kTEXTURE_SRV_START_INDEX,
                                              FrameConstants::GetCbvIncrementSize()));
    }
    if (material.RuntimeHandle != 0)
    {
        auto& runtime = MaterialManager::GetRuntime(material.RuntimeHandle);
        if (!runtime.Constants)
        {
            const auto heap = CD3DX12_HEAP_PROPERTIES(D3D12_HEAP_TYPE_UPLOAD);
            const auto description = CD3DX12_RESOURCE_DESC::Buffer(g_kPBR_CB_ALIGNED_SIZE * g_kFRAME_COUNT);
            if (FAILED(m_Device->CreateCommittedResource(&heap, D3D12_HEAP_FLAG_NONE, &description,
                                                         D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_GENERIC_READ, nullptr,
                                                         IID_PPV_ARGS(&runtime.Constants))) ||
                FAILED(runtime.Constants->Map(0, nullptr, reinterpret_cast<void**>(&runtime.MappedConstants))))
            {
                runtime.Error = "Failed to create material constant buffer";
                runtime.Constants.Reset();
                return;
            }
        }
        const auto frame = GraphicsDevice::GetFrameIndex();
        if (runtime.UploadedRevision[frame] != runtime.Revision)
        {
            memcpy(runtime.MappedConstants + frame * g_kPBR_CB_ALIGNED_SIZE, &constants, sizeof(constants));
            runtime.UploadedRevision[frame] = runtime.Revision;
        }
        m_CommandList->SetGraphicsRootConstantBufferView(3, runtime.Constants->GetGPUVirtualAddress() +
                                                                frame * g_kPBR_CB_ALIGNED_SIZE);
        return;
    }

    const UINT frameSlot = GraphicsDevice::GetFrameIndex() * g_kPBR_CB_SLOT_COUNT + slot;
    auto* dst = static_cast<UINT8*>(m_pPBRCbvDataBegin) + frameSlot * g_kPBR_CB_ALIGNED_SIZE;
    memcpy(dst, &constants, sizeof(constants));
    m_CommandList->SetGraphicsRootConstantBufferView(3, GetPBRConstantBufferAddress(slot));
}

bool MaterialBindings::SetPreviewMaterial(const MaterialComponent& material, ID3D12Resource* buffer, UINT textureBase,
                                          UINT partIndex, UINT partsPerFrame)
{
    if (!buffer)
    {
        return false;
    }
    auto constants = BuildPBRConstantsFromMaterial(material);
    constants.AssetSurface.z = 1.0f;
    auto offset = [textureBase](int descriptor) {
        return descriptor >= static_cast<int>(textureBase) ? static_cast<uint32_t>(descriptor) - textureBase
                                                           : UINT32_MAX;
    };
    constants.AssetTextures.x = offset(material.MetallicRoughnessID);
    constants.AssetTextures.y = offset(material.AOTextureID);
    constants.AssetTextures.z = offset(material.EmissiveTextureID);
    const uint32_t heightIndex = offset(material.HeightTextureID);
    constants.AssetParallax.z = heightIndex < 512u ? static_cast<float>(heightIndex) : -1.0f;
    constants.AssetParallax.w = static_cast<float>(textureBase);
    constants.LiveToonTextures = {UINT32_MAX, UINT32_MAX, UINT32_MAX, 0u}; // プレビューはテクスチャ基点が異なる
    uint8_t* mapped = nullptr;
    if (FAILED(buffer->Map(0, nullptr, reinterpret_cast<void**>(&mapped))))
    {
        return false;
    }
    const auto frameOffset = (GraphicsDevice::GetFrameIndex() * partsPerFrame + partIndex) * g_kPBR_CB_ALIGNED_SIZE;
    memcpy(mapped + frameOffset, &constants, sizeof(constants));
    buffer->Unmap(0, nullptr);
    m_CommandList->SetGraphicsRootConstantBufferView(3, buffer->GetGPUVirtualAddress() + frameOffset);
    m_CommandList->SetGraphicsRootDescriptorTable(
        18, CD3DX12_GPU_DESCRIPTOR_HANDLE(FrameConstants::GetCbvHeap()->GetGPUDescriptorHandleForHeapStart(),
                                          textureBase, FrameConstants::GetCbvIncrementSize()));
    return true;
}

uint64_t MaterialBindings::GetMaterialBatchHash(const MaterialComponent& material)
{
    const PBRConstants constants = BuildPBRConstantsFromMaterial(material);
    uint64_t hash = HashGeometry(&constants, sizeof(constants));

    struct BatchMaterialState
    {
        int ShaderMode = 0;
        int ShaderClassValue = 0;
        float Alpha = 1.0f;
        UINT IsTransparent = 0;
        UINT UseTexture = 0;
        UINT UseNormalMap = 0;
    } state{};

    state.ShaderMode = static_cast<int>(material.ShaderClassMode);
    state.ShaderClassValue = static_cast<int>(material.ShaderClass);
    state.Alpha = material.Alpha;
    state.IsTransparent = static_cast<UINT>(material.IsTransparent);
    state.UseTexture = static_cast<UINT>(material.UseTexture);
    state.UseNormalMap = static_cast<UINT>(material.NormalMapID >= 0);
    const uint64_t stateHash = HashGeometry(&state, sizeof(state));

    hash ^= stateHash + 0x9e3779b97f4a7c15ull + (hash << 6) + (hash >> 2);
    return hash;
}

void MaterialBindings::BindAssetSlot(EntityID entity, const MaterialComponent& material, int modelTexture)
{
    ConstantBuffer3D constants;
    memcpy(&constants, FrameConstants::GetConstantBufferPtr() + entity * FrameConstants::g_kCB_ALIGNED_SIZE,
           sizeof(constants));
    constants.UseTexture = static_cast<int>(material.UseTexture);
    const bool useModelTexture = material.RuntimeHandle == 0 && !material.LiveSurfaceOverride && modelTexture >= 0;
    if (useModelTexture)
    {
        constants.UseTexture = 1;
    }
    constants.UseNormalMap = static_cast<int>(material.NormalMapID >= 0);
    constants.MaterialMode = static_cast<int>(material.ShaderClassMode);
    constants.ShaderClass = static_cast<int>(material.ShaderClass);
    constants.MaterialMetallic = material.Metallic;
    constants.MaterialRoughness = material.Roughness;
    constants.MaterialFresnel = material.Fresnel;
    constants.MaterialAlpha = material.Alpha;
    constants.MaterialIsTransparent = static_cast<int>(material.IsTransparent);
    if (TransmittanceShadows::IsActive())
    {
        bool thinSheet = false;
        if (ComponentManager::HasComponent<SpriteComponent>(entity))
        {
            thinSheet = ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<SpriteComponent>(entity).Is3D;
        }
        if (ComponentManager::HasComponent<MeshComponent>(entity))
        {
            const auto& mesh = ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<MeshComponent>(entity);
            const auto& extents = mesh.LocalBoundsExtents;
            thinSheet |= mesh.HasLocalBounds && min(extents.x, min(extents.y, extents.z)) < 0.000001f;
        }
        if (thinSheet)
        {
            constants.MaterialIsTransparent |= 2;
        }
    }
    m_CommandList->SetGraphicsRootDescriptorTable(0, FrameConstants::AllocateTransientConstantBuffer(constants));
    SetMaterial(entity, material);
    int base = TextureManager::GetDefaultTextureIndex();
    int normal = base;
    if (material.TextureID >= 0)
    {
        base = material.TextureID;
    }
    if (useModelTexture)
    {
        base = modelTexture;
    }
    if (material.NormalMapID >= 0)
    {
        normal = material.NormalMapID;
    }
    const auto heap = FrameConstants::GetCbvHeap()->GetGPUDescriptorHandleForHeapStart();
    m_CommandList->SetGraphicsRootDescriptorTable(
        1, CD3DX12_GPU_DESCRIPTOR_HANDLE(heap, base, FrameConstants::GetCbvIncrementSize()));
    m_CommandList->SetGraphicsRootDescriptorTable(
        6, CD3DX12_GPU_DESCRIPTOR_HANDLE(heap, normal, FrameConstants::GetCbvIncrementSize()));
    for (int descriptor : {base, normal, material.MetallicRoughnessID, material.AOTextureID, material.EmissiveTextureID,
                           material.HeightTextureID})
    {
        if (descriptor >= 0)
        {
            TextureManager::TouchTexture(descriptor);
        }
    }
}

void MaterialBindings::UpdateDeferredLightingMaterial()
{
    if (m_pPBRCbvDataBegin)
    {
        PBRConstants pbrConstants = BuildPBRConstantsFromMaterial(GetDeferredLightingMaterial());
        auto* pbrDst = static_cast<UINT8*>(m_pPBRCbvDataBegin) +
                       GraphicsDevice::GetFrameIndex() * g_kPBR_CB_SLOT_COUNT * g_kPBR_CB_ALIGNED_SIZE;
        memcpy(pbrDst, &pbrConstants, sizeof(pbrConstants));
    }
}

#include "pch.h"
#include "materialgraphshader.h"
#include "dxccompiler.h"
#include <mutex>

namespace
{
    std::mutex graphCompilerMutex;

    std::string PreviewSource(const MaterialGraphProgram& program)
    {
        std::string source = program.Hlsl;
        source += R"hlsl(
#line 1 "material_preview"
cbuffer GraphPreviewView : register(b1) { float PreviewTime; uint PreviewResolution; uint PreviewShape; uint PreviewNormal; };
struct GraphPreviewInput { float4 Position : SV_Position; float2 UV : TEXCOORD0; };
GraphPreviewInput GraphPreviewVS(uint vertex : SV_VertexID)
{
    GraphPreviewInput result;
    result.UV = float2((vertex << 1) & 2, vertex & 2);
    result.Position = float4(result.UV * float2(2,-2) + float2(-1,1),0,1);
    return result;
}
float4 GraphPreviewPS(GraphPreviewInput input) : SV_Target
{
    MaterialGraphContext context;
    context.UV = input.UV;
    context.WorldPosition = float3(input.UV * float2(2,-2) + float2(-1,1),0);
    context.WorldNormal = float3(0,0,1);
    context.CameraVector = float3(0,0,1);
    context.Time = PreviewTime;
    if (PreviewShape != 0)
    {
        float radius = dot(context.WorldPosition.xy,context.WorldPosition.xy);
        if (radius > 1) return float4(0,0,0,0);
        context.WorldPosition.z = sqrt(saturate(1-radius));
        context.WorldNormal = normalize(context.WorldPosition);
    }
    context.Tangent = normalize(cross(abs(context.WorldNormal.y) < 0.99 ? float3(0,1,0) : float3(1,0,0), context.WorldNormal));
    context.Bitangent = -cross(context.WorldNormal, context.Tangent);
)hlsl";
        if (program.MaterialOutput)
        {
            source += R"hlsl(
    GeneratedMaterial material = EvaluateMaterialGraph(context);
    float3 normal = context.WorldNormal;
    float3 tangent = normalize(cross(abs(normal.y) < 0.99 ? float3(0,1,0) : float3(1,0,0),normal));
    float3 bitangent = cross(normal,tangent);
    float2 scaledNormal = material.Normal.xy * max(material.NormalIntensity, 0.0);
    normal = normalize(tangent * scaledNormal.x + bitangent * scaledNormal.y + normal * material.Normal.z);
    float3 light = normalize(float3(-0.4,0.6,0.8));
    float3 view = float3(0,0,1);
    float3 halfVector = normalize(light + view);
    float nDotL = saturate(dot(normal,light));
    float nDotV = max(saturate(dot(normal,view)),0.001);
    float nDotH = saturate(dot(normal,halfVector));
    float vDotH = saturate(dot(view,halfVector));
    float roughness = clamp(material.Roughness,0.04,1);
    float alpha = roughness * roughness;
    float alpha2 = alpha * alpha;
    float denominator = nDotH*nDotH*(alpha2-1)+1;
    float distribution = alpha2 / max(3.14159265*denominator*denominator,0.0001);
    float k = (roughness+1)*(roughness+1)/8;
    float geometry = (nDotV / (nDotV*(1-k)+k)) * (nDotL / max(nDotL*(1-k)+k,0.001));
    float metallic = saturate(material.Metallic);
    float3 f0 = lerp(0.04.xxx,material.BaseColor.rgb,metallic);
    float3 fresnel = f0 + (1-f0)*pow(1-vDotH,5);
    float3 specular = distribution * geometry * fresnel / max(4*nDotL*nDotV,0.001);
    float3 diffuse = (1-fresnel)*(1-metallic)*material.BaseColor.rgb/3.14159265;
    float3 color = (diffuse+specular)*nDotL*3 + material.BaseColor.rgb*0.08*saturate(material.AO)+material.Emissive;
    color = pow(saturate(color/(1+max(color,0))),1.0/2.2);
    float opacity = saturate(material.BaseColor.a * material.Opacity);
    opacity *= step(0.5,material.OpacityMask);
    float checker = fmod(floor(input.UV.x*12)+floor(input.UV.y*12),2);
    return float4(lerp(lerp(0.12.xxx,0.25.xxx,checker),color,opacity),1);
)hlsl";
        }
        else
        {
            source += R"hlsl(
    float4 color = EvaluateMaterialNode(context);
    if (PreviewNormal != 0) color.rgb = color.rgb * 0.5 + 0.5;
    float checker = fmod(floor(input.UV.x*12)+floor(input.UV.y*12),2);
    color.rgb = lerp(lerp(0.12.xxx,0.25.xxx,checker),color.rgb,saturate(color.a));
    return float4(color.rgb,1);
)hlsl";
        }
        source += "}\n";
        return source;
    }
}

MaterialGraphShader MaterialGraphShaderCompiler::Compile(const MaterialGraphProgram& program)
{
    // Keep the existing atomic cache writers single-owner for identical graph variants.
    std::lock_guard lock(graphCompilerMutex);
    MaterialGraphShader shader;
    if (!program.Success)
    {
        shader.Error = program.Error;
        return shader;
    }
    const auto source = PreviewSource(program);
    shader.Hash = 14695981039346656037ull;
    for (const unsigned char value : source)
    {
        shader.Hash = (shader.Hash ^ value) * 1099511628211ull;
    }
    const auto directory = std::filesystem::path("EditorCache/MaterialGraphs/Shaders");
    std::error_code error;
    std::filesystem::create_directories(directory, error);
    if (error)
    {
        shader.Error = error.message();
        return shader;
    }
    const auto path = directory / (std::to_string(shader.Hash) + ".hlsl");
    if (!WriteAssetFile(path, source, shader.Error))
    {
        return shader;
    }
    const auto compile = [&](const char* entry, const char* profile, ComPtr<ID3DBlob>& output) {
        ComPtr<ID3DBlob> diagnostics;
        const auto result = DxcCompileFromFileCompat(
            path.c_str(), nullptr, D3D_COMPILE_STANDARD_FILE_INCLUDE, entry, profile,
            D3DCOMPILE_ENABLE_STRICTNESS | D3DCOMPILE_OPTIMIZATION_LEVEL3, 0, &output, &diagnostics);
        if (FAILED(result))
        {
            if (diagnostics)
            {
                shader.Error.assign(static_cast<const char*>(diagnostics->GetBufferPointer()),
                                    diagnostics->GetBufferSize());
            }
            else
            {
                shader.Error = "DXC failed (HRESULT " + std::to_string(static_cast<unsigned>(result)) + ").";
            }
            return false;
        }
        return true;
    };
    if (compile("GraphPreviewVS", "vs_6_0", shader.Vertex))
    {
        compile("GraphPreviewPS", "ps_6_0", shader.Pixel);
    }
    return shader;
}

#include "pch.h"

                                                 SrvIndex, FrameConstants::GetCbvIncrementSize());
        }

    PreviewState preview;

    StaticModelVertex Vertex(float x, float y, float z, float nx, float ny, float nz, float u, float v)
    {
        return {{x, y, z}, {nx, ny, nz}, {u, v}, {1, 1, 1, 11}};
    }

    void Triangle(vector<StaticModelVertex>& vertices, StaticModelVertex first, StaticModelVertex second,
                  StaticModelVertex third)
    {
        const auto edge1 = XMVectorSubtract(XMLoadFloat3(&second.Position), XMLoadFloat3(&first.Position));
        const auto edge2 = XMVectorSubtract(XMLoadFloat3(&third.Position), XMLoadFloat3(&first.Position));
        if (XMVectorGetX(XMVector3Dot(XMVector3Cross(edge1, edge2), XMLoadFloat3(&first.Normal))) < 0)
        {
            swap(second, third);
        }
        vertices.push_back(first);
        vertices.push_back(second);
        vertices.push_back(third);
    }

    vector<StaticModelVertex> MakeGeometry(int shape)
    {
        vector<StaticModelVertex> vertices;
        if (shape == 0)
        {
            auto sphereVertex = [](int latitude, int longitude) {
                const float u = longitude / 32.0f;
                const float v = latitude / 16.0f;
                const float angle = u * XM_2PI;
                const float polar = v * XM_PI;
                const float x = sinf(polar) * cosf(angle);
                const float y = cosf(polar);
                const float z = sinf(polar) * sinf(angle);
                return Vertex(x, y, z, x, y, z, u, v);
            };
            for (int latitude = 0; latitude < 16; ++latitude)
            {
                for (int longitude = 0; longitude < 32; ++longitude)
                {
                    const auto first = sphereVertex(latitude, longitude);
                    const auto second = sphereVertex(latitude + 1, longitude);
                    const auto third = sphereVertex(latitude + 1, longitude + 1);
                    const auto fourth = sphereVertex(latitude, longitude + 1);
                    Triangle(vertices, first, second, third);
                    Triangle(vertices, first, third, fourth);
                }
            }
        }
        else
        {
            const int faces = 6;
            for (int face = 0; face < faces; ++face)
            {
                if (shape == 2 && face != 4)
                {
                    continue;
                }
                const int axis = face / 2;
                float direction = -1.0f;
                if ((face & 1) != 0)
                {
                    direction = 1.0f;
                }
                array<StaticModelVertex, 4> corners;
                for (int corner = 0; corner < 4; ++corner)
                {
                    float position[3]{};
                    float normal[3]{};
                    position[axis] = direction;
                    normal[axis] = direction;
                    position[(axis + 1) % 3] = ((corner & 1) != 0) ? 1.0f : -1.0f;
                    position[(axis + 2) % 3] = ((corner & 2) != 0) ? 1.0f : -1.0f;
                    if (shape == 2)
                    {
                        position[axis] = 0;
                    }
                    // Image UVs start at the top left when looking at the outside of a face.
                    // Derive them from a face-local right/up frame, not the corner bit order.
                    float horizontal;
                    float vertical;
                    if (axis == 1)
                    {
                        horizontal = position[0];
                        vertical = direction * position[2];
                    }
                    else
                    {
                        horizontal = -normal[2] * position[0] + normal[0] * position[2];
                        vertical = position[1];
                    }
                    const float u = (horizontal + 1.0f) * 0.5f;
                    const float v = (1.0f - vertical) * 0.5f;
                    corners[corner] = Vertex(position[0], position[1], position[2], normal[0], normal[1], normal[2],
                                             u, v);
                }
                Triangle(vertices, corners[0], corners[1], corners[2]);
                Triangle(vertices, corners[1], corners[3], corners[2]);
            }
        }
        return vertices;
    }

    bool PreviewState::Initialize()
    {
        if (Target)
        {
            return true;
        }
        auto* device = GraphicsDevice::GetDevice();
        if (!device)
        {
            return false;
        }
        const auto defaultHeap = CD3DX12_HEAP_PROPERTIES(D3D12_HEAP_TYPE_DEFAULT);
        auto target = CD3DX12_RESOURCE_DESC::Tex2D(GetSceneColorFormat(), Size, Size, 1, 1, 1, 0,
                                                   D3D12_RESOURCE_FLAG_ALLOW_RENDER_TARGET);
        D3D12_CLEAR_VALUE clear{};
        clear.Format = target.Format;
        clear.Color[0] = 0.12f;
        clear.Color[1] = 0.13f;
        clear.Color[2] = 0.16f;
        clear.Color[3] = 1;
        if (FAILED(device->CreateCommittedResource(&defaultHeap, D3D12_HEAP_FLAG_NONE, &target,
                                                   D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE, &clear,
                                                   IID_PPV_ARGS(&Target))))
        {
            Error = "Failed to create material preview target";
            return false;
        }
        target.Format = DXGI_FORMAT_D32_FLOAT;
        target.Flags = D3D12_RESOURCE_FLAG_ALLOW_DEPTH_STENCIL;
        clear.Format = target.Format;
        clear.DepthStencil.Depth = 0.0f;
        if (FAILED(device->CreateCommittedResource(&defaultHeap, D3D12_HEAP_FLAG_NONE, &target,
                                                   D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_DEPTH_WRITE, &clear, IID_PPV_ARGS(&Depth))))
        {
            Error = "Failed to create preview depth";
            Target.Reset();
            return false;
        }
        D3D12_DESCRIPTOR_HEAP_DESC heap{};
        heap.NumDescriptors = 1;
        heap.Type = D3D12_DESCRIPTOR_HEAP_TYPE_RTV;
        if (FAILED(device->CreateDescriptorHeap(&heap, IID_PPV_ARGS(&RTVHeap))))
        {
            Target.Reset();
            return false;
        }
        heap.Type = D3D12_DESCRIPTOR_HEAP_TYPE_DSV;
        if (FAILED(device->CreateDescriptorHeap(&heap, IID_PPV_ARGS(&DSVHeap))))
        {
            Target.Reset();
            return false;
        }
        device->CreateRenderTargetView(Target.Get(), nullptr, RTVHeap->GetCPUDescriptorHandleForHeapStart());
        device->CreateDepthStencilView(Depth.Get(), nullptr, DSVHeap->GetCPUDescriptorHandleForHeapStart());
        D3D12_SHADER_RESOURCE_VIEW_DESC srv{};
        srv.Format = Target->GetDesc().Format;
        srv.ViewDimension = D3D12_SRV_DIMENSION_TEXTURE2D;
        srv.Shader4ComponentMapping = D3D12_DEFAULT_SHADER_4_COMPONENT_MAPPING;
        srv.Texture2D.MipLevels = 1;
        device->CreateShaderResourceView(Target.Get(), &srv, CpuSrv());
        const auto uploadHeap = CD3DX12_HEAP_PROPERTIES(D3D12_HEAP_TYPE_UPLOAD);
        const auto lightDescription = CD3DX12_RESOURCE_DESC::Buffer(constantBytes * g_kFRAME_COUNT);
        if (FAILED(device->CreateCommittedResource(&uploadHeap, D3D12_HEAP_FLAG_NONE, &lightDescription,
                                                   D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_GENERIC_READ, nullptr,
                                                   IID_PPV_ARGS(&Lights))) ||
            FAILED(Lights->Map(0, nullptr, reinterpret_cast<void**>(&MappedLights))))
        {
            Error = "Failed to create preview lighting constants";
            Target.Reset();
            return false;
        }
        memset(MappedLights, 0, constantBytes * g_kFRAME_COUNT);
        // b5 はフラグ、パラメーター、160個のライトフラグを含む。2592バイトを2816バイトに整列する。
        const auto opticsDescription = CD3DX12_RESOURCE_DESC::Buffer(2816 * g_kFRAME_COUNT);
        if (FAILED(device->CreateCommittedResource(&uploadHeap, D3D12_HEAP_FLAG_NONE, &opticsDescription,
                                                   D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_GENERIC_READ, nullptr,
                                                   IID_PPV_ARGS(&OpticsGlobals))) ||
            FAILED(OpticsGlobals->Map(0, nullptr, reinterpret_cast<void**>(&MappedOpticsGlobals))))
        {
            Error = "Failed to create material optics preview constants";
            Target.Reset();
            return false;
        }
        memset(MappedOpticsGlobals, 0, 2816 * g_kFRAME_COUNT);
        const int shapeCount = SrvIndex == g_kMATERIAL_PREVIEW_SRV_INDEX ? 3 : 1;
        for (int shape = 0; shape < shapeCount; ++shape)
        {
            const auto vertices = MakeGeometry(shape);
            const UINT bytes = static_cast<UINT>(vertices.size() * sizeof(StaticModelVertex));
            const auto description = CD3DX12_RESOURCE_DESC::Buffer(bytes);
            if (FAILED(device->CreateCommittedResource(&uploadHeap, D3D12_HEAP_FLAG_NONE, &description,
                                                       D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_GENERIC_READ, nullptr,
                                                       IID_PPV_ARGS(&Vertices[shape]))))
            {
                Error = "Failed to create preview mesh";
                Target.Reset();
                return false;
            }
            void* mapped = nullptr;
            if (FAILED(Vertices[shape]->Map(0, nullptr, &mapped)))
            {
                Target.Reset();
                return false;
            }
            memcpy(mapped, vertices.data(), bytes);
            Vertices[shape]->Unmap(0, nullptr);
            Counts[shape] = static_cast<UINT>(vertices.size());
            Views[shape] = {Vertices[shape]->GetGPUVirtualAddress(), bytes, sizeof(StaticModelVertex)};
        }
        return true;
    }

    ID3D12PipelineState* PreviewState::Pipeline(const MaterialComponent& material)
    {
        size_t index = static_cast<size_t>(material.AssetCull);
        if (!material.AssetDepthWrite || material.IsTransparent)
        {
            index += 3;
        }
        if (material.IsTransparent)
        {
            index += 6;
        }
        if (SrvIndex == g_kMATERIAL_PREVIEW_SRV_INDEX && material.Transmission > 0.0f)
        {
            index += 12;
        }
        if (Pipelines[index])
        {
            return Pipelines[index].Get();
        }
        // Thumbnail targets have independent constants, but share identical pipeline states.
        const bool thumbnail = SrvIndex != g_kMATERIAL_PREVIEW_SRV_INDEX;
        std::unique_lock cacheLock(thumbnailPipelineMutex, std::defer_lock);
        if (thumbnail)
        {
            cacheLock.lock();
            const auto format = Target->GetDesc().Format;
            if (thumbnailPipelineFormat != format)
            {
                thumbnailPipelines = {};
                thumbnailPipelineFormat = format;
            }
            if (thumbnailPipelines[index])
            {
                Pipelines[index] = thumbnailPipelines[index];
                return Pipelines[index].Get();
            }
        }
        ComPtr<ID3DBlob> vertex;
        ComPtr<ID3DBlob> pixel;
        ShaderDescription shader;
        shader.csoPath = "shader/hlsl/build/modelshaderVS.cso";
        shader.ppBlob = vertex.GetAddressOf();
        if (!ShaderPipelines::LoadShaderBlob(shader))
        {
            Error = "Preview failed to load production vertex shader";
            return nullptr;
        }
        shader.csoPath = "shader/hlsl/build/modelshaderPS.cso";
        shader.ppBlob = pixel.GetAddressOf();
        if (!ShaderPipelines::LoadShaderBlob(shader))
        {
            Error = "Preview failed to load production PBR shader";
            return nullptr;
        }
        D3D12_GRAPHICS_PIPELINE_STATE_DESC description{};
        description.pRootSignature = ShaderPipelines::GetModelRootSignature();
        description.VS = CD3DX12_SHADER_BYTECODE(vertex.Get());
        description.PS = CD3DX12_SHADER_BYTECODE(pixel.Get());
        description.RasterizerState = CD3DX12_RASTERIZER_DESC(D3D12_DEFAULT);
        if (material.AssetCull == MaterialCull::None)
        {
            description.RasterizerState.CullMode = D3D12_CULL_MODE_NONE;
        }
        else if (material.AssetCull == MaterialCull::Front)
        {
            description.RasterizerState.CullMode = D3D12_CULL_MODE_FRONT;
        }
        description.DepthStencilState = CD3DX12_DEPTH_STENCIL_DESC(D3D12_DEFAULT);
        description.DepthStencilState.DepthFunc = D3D12_COMPARISON_FUNC_GREATER;
        if (!material.AssetDepthWrite || material.IsTransparent)
        {
            description.DepthStencilState.DepthWriteMask = D3D12_DEPTH_WRITE_MASK_ZERO;
        }
        if (SrvIndex == g_kMATERIAL_PREVIEW_SRV_INDEX && material.Transmission > 0.0f)
        {
            description.RasterizerState.CullMode = D3D12_CULL_MODE_BACK;
            description.DepthStencilState.DepthWriteMask = D3D12_DEPTH_WRITE_MASK_ALL;
        }
        description.BlendState = CD3DX12_BLEND_DESC(D3D12_DEFAULT);
        if (material.IsTransparent)
        {
            auto& blend = description.BlendState.RenderTarget[0];
            blend.BlendEnable = TRUE;
            blend.SrcBlend = D3D12_BLEND_ONE;
            blend.DestBlend = D3D12_BLEND_INV_SRC_ALPHA;
            blend.SrcBlendAlpha = D3D12_BLEND_ONE;
            blend.DestBlendAlpha = D3D12_BLEND_INV_SRC_ALPHA;
        }
        description.SampleMask = UINT_MAX;
        description.PrimitiveTopologyType = D3D12_PRIMITIVE_TOPOLOGY_TYPE_TRIANGLE;
        description.NumRenderTargets = 1;
        description.RTVFormats[0] = Target->GetDesc().Format;
        description.DSVFormat = DXGI_FORMAT_D32_FLOAT;
        description.SampleDesc.Count = 1;
        const D3D12_INPUT_ELEMENT_DESC layout[] = {
            {"POSITION", 0, DXGI_FORMAT_R32G32B32_FLOAT, 0, 0, D3D12_INPUT_CLASSIFICATION_PER_VERTEX_DATA, 0},
            {"NORMAL", 0, DXGI_FORMAT_R32G32B32_FLOAT, 0, 12, D3D12_INPUT_CLASSIFICATION_PER_VERTEX_DATA, 0},
            {"TEXCOORD", 0, DXGI_FORMAT_R32G32_FLOAT, 0, 24, D3D12_INPUT_CLASSIFICATION_PER_VERTEX_DATA, 0},
            {"COLOR", 0, DXGI_FORMAT_R32G32B32A32_FLOAT, 0, 32, D3D12_INPUT_CLASSIFICATION_PER_VERTEX_DATA, 0}};
        description.InputLayout = {layout, 4};
        if (FAILED(GraphicsDevice::GetDevice()->CreateGraphicsPipelineState(&description,
                                                                            IID_PPV_ARGS(&Pipelines[index]))))
        {
            Error = "Failed to create production preview PSO";
            return nullptr;
        }
        if (thumbnail)
        {
            thumbnailPipelines[index] = Pipelines[index];
        }
        return Pipelines[index].Get();
    }
} // 名前空間

void MaterialPreview::SetVisible(bool visible)
{
    preview.Visible = visible;
}

void MaterialPreview::DrawControls()
{
    // 形状：球 / キューブ / 平面 のセグメントボタン（UE のプレビューツールバーと同じ並び）
    static const char* kShapes[] = {"球", "キューブ", "平面"};
    const float available = ImGui::GetContentRegionAvail().x;
    const float spacing = 1.0f;
    const float buttonWidth = (std::max)(40.0f, (std::min)(80.0f, (available - spacing * 2.0f) / 3.0f));
    for (int i = 0; i < 3; ++i)
    {
        if (i > 0)
        {
            ImGui::SameLine(0.0f, spacing);
        }
        const bool active = preview.Shape == i;
        if (active)
        {
            ImGui::PushStyleColor(ImGuiCol_Button, ImGui::GetStyleColorVec4(ImGuiCol_HeaderActive));
            ImGui::PushStyleColor(ImGuiCol_ButtonHovered, ImGui::GetStyleColorVec4(ImGuiCol_HeaderActive));
        }
        ImGui::PushID(i);
        if (ImGui::Button(kShapes[i], ImVec2(buttonWidth, 0.0f)))
        {
            preview.Shape = i;
        }
        ImGui::PopID();
        if (active)
        {
            ImGui::PopStyleColor(2);
        }
    }

    const bool glassMaterial =
        preview.Material != 0 && MaterialManager::GetRuntime(preview.Material).Binding.Transmission > 0.0f;
    ImGui::BeginDisabled(glassMaterial);
    ImGui::Checkbox("IBL（シーン環境光）", &preview.SceneEnvironment);
    ImGui::EndDisabled();
    if (glassMaterial)
    {
        ImGui::SetItemTooltip(
            "IBL is disabled for transmissive glass. Direct lighting and refracted background remain enabled.");
    }
    else
    {
        ImGui::SetItemTooltip("シーンの空 / 環境マップで照らします（反射・金属の見え方を確認できます）");
    }
    ImGui::SetNextItemWidth((std::max)(80.0f, ImGui::GetContentRegionAvail().x * 0.6f));
    ImGui::SliderFloat("ライト", &preview.LightIntensity, 0, 5);
    if (ImGui::Button("カメラをリセット"))
    {
        preview.Yaw = 0.45f;
        preview.Pitch = 0.2f;
        preview.Distance = 4.5f;
    }
    ImGui::SameLine();
    ImGui::TextDisabled("ドラッグ: 回転 / ホイール: ズーム");
}

void MaterialPreview::DrawImage(AssetHandle material)
{
    preview.Material = material;
    preview.Visible = true;
    if (!preview.Initialize())
    {
        ImGui::TextWrapped("%s", preview.Error.c_str());
        return;
    }
    const auto available = ImGui::GetContentRegionAvail();
    const float side = min(available.x, available.y);
    ImGui::PushStyleVar(ImGuiStyleVar_FramePadding, ImVec2(0, 0));
    ImGui::ImageButton("##PreviewOrbit", static_cast<ImTextureID>(preview.GpuSrv().ptr), ImVec2(side, side),
                       ImVec2(0, 0), ImVec2(1, 1), ImVec4(0, 0, 0, 0));
    ImGui::PopStyleVar();
    const auto imageMinimum = ImGui::GetItemRectMin();
    const auto imageMaximum = ImGui::GetItemRectMax();
    MaterialValidation::CaptureDropTarget("Preview", imageMinimum.x, imageMinimum.y, imageMaximum.x, imageMaximum.y);
    if (ImGui::IsItemActive() && ImGui::IsMouseDragging(ImGuiMouseButton_Left))
    {
        const auto& input = ImGui::GetIO();
        preview.Yaw += input.MouseDelta.x * 0.01f;
        preview.Pitch = clamp(preview.Pitch + input.MouseDelta.y * 0.01f, -1.4f, 1.4f);
    }
    if (ImGui::IsItemHovered())
    {
        auto& input = ImGui::GetIO();
        preview.Distance = clamp(preview.Distance - input.MouseWheel * 0.25f, 1.5f, 12.0f);
    }
    if (!preview.Error.empty())
    {
        ImGui::TextWrapped("%s", preview.Error.c_str());
    }
}

namespace
{
    bool RenderPreview(PreviewState& preview, const MaterialComponent& material, UINT firstVertex = 0,
                       UINT vertexCount = 0, UINT partIndex = 0, UINT partCount = 1, const MeshData* mesh = nullptr)
    {
        auto* pipeline = preview.Pipeline(material);
        if (!pipeline)
        {
            return false;
        }
        auto* commands = GraphicsDevice::GetCommandList();
        auto barrier = CD3DX12_RESOURCE_BARRIER::Transition(
            preview.Target.Get(), D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_RENDER_TARGET);
        if (partIndex == 0)
        {
            commands->ResourceBarrier(1, &barrier);
        }
        const auto rtv = preview.RTVHeap->GetCPUDescriptorHandleForHeapStart();
        const auto dsv = preview.DSVHeap->GetCPUDescriptorHandleForHeapStart();
        const float background[4] = {0.12f, 0.13f, 0.16f, 1};
        if (partIndex == 0)
        {
            commands->ClearRenderTargetView(rtv, background, 0, nullptr);
            commands->ClearDepthStencilView(dsv, D3D12_CLEAR_FLAG_DEPTH, 0.0f, 0, 0, nullptr);
        }
        commands->OMSetRenderTargets(1, &rtv, FALSE, &dsv);
        const D3D12_VIEWPORT viewport = {0, 0, static_cast<float>(preview.Size), static_cast<float>(preview.Size),
                                         0, 1};
        const D3D12_RECT scissor = {0, 0, static_cast<LONG>(preview.Size), static_cast<LONG>(preview.Size)};
        commands->RSSetViewports(1, &viewport);
        commands->RSSetScissorRects(1, &scissor);
        ScenePasses::BeginPass(ShaderPipelines::GetModelRootSignature(), D3D_PRIMITIVE_TOPOLOGY_TRIANGLELIST);
        commands->SetPipelineState(pipeline);
        auto* lights =
            reinterpret_cast<XMFLOAT4*>(preview.MappedLights + GraphicsDevice::GetFrameIndex() * constantBytes);
        memset(lights, 0, constantBytes);
        lights[0] = {-0.5f, 0.7f, -0.8f, 0};
        lights[1] = {1.0f, 0.96f, 0.9f, preview.LightIntensity};
        lights[4] = {1, 0, 0, 0};
        lights[5] = lights[0];
        lights[5 + RendererState::g_kMAX_SHADER_LIGHTS] = lights[1];
        // common.hlsl の LightParams と同じく、4つのベクトル配列の後に行列配列を置く。
        constexpr size_t shadowDataOffset = 5 + 8 * RendererState::g_kMAX_SHADER_LIGHTS;
        constexpr size_t flagsOffset = shadowDataOffset + RendererState::g_kMAX_SHADER_LIGHTS;
        lights[shadowDataOffset] = {-1, 0, 0, 0}; // スタジオライトにはシーンのシャドウマップがない。
        lights[flagsOffset] = {1, 1, 0, 0};       // 不透明パスとフォワードパスで物理ライティングを有効にする。
        commands->SetGraphicsRootConstantBufferView(2, preview.Lights->GetGPUVirtualAddress() +
                                                           GraphicsDevice::GetFrameIndex() * constantBytes);
        // 独立したプレビューシーンのため、影とレイのフラグをゼロにする。
        const auto zeroAddress = preview.Lights->GetGPUVirtualAddress() +
                                 GraphicsDevice::GetFrameIndex() * constantBytes + constantBytes - 256;
        commands->SetGraphicsRootConstantBufferView(5, zeroAddress);
        auto* optics =
            reinterpret_cast<XMFLOAT4*>(preview.MappedOpticsGlobals + GraphicsDevice::GetFrameIndex() * 2816);
        memset(optics, 0, 2816);
        if (preview.SrvIndex == RendererState::g_kMATERIAL_PREVIEW_SRV_INDEX)
        {
            optics[1] = {preview.SceneEnvironment && material.Transmission <= 0.0f ? 1.0f : 0.0f,
                         preview.LightIntensity, static_cast<float>(preview.Shape + 1), 1.0f};
            if (MaterialValidation::Enabled() && ImGui::GetFrameCount() <= 4)
            {
                WriteGraphicsLog("Material preview draw: frame=%d light=%.3f environment=%d material=%llu\n",
                                 ImGui::GetFrameCount(), preview.LightIntensity, preview.SceneEnvironment,
                                 material.RuntimeHandle);
            }
        }
        commands->SetGraphicsRootConstantBufferView(17, preview.OpticsGlobals->GetGPUVirtualAddress() +
                                                            GraphicsDevice::GetFrameIndex() * 2816);
        commands->SetGraphicsRootConstantBufferView(26, zeroAddress);
        commands->SetGraphicsRootConstantBufferView(27, zeroAddress);
        const XMFLOAT3 eye = {sinf(preview.Yaw) * cosf(preview.Pitch) * preview.Distance + preview.Center.x,
                              sinf(preview.Pitch) * preview.Distance + preview.Center.y,
                              -cosf(preview.Yaw) * cosf(preview.Pitch) * preview.Distance + preview.Center.z};
        ConstantBuffer3D constants;
        constants.World = XMMatrixIdentity();
        constants.View = XMMatrixTranspose(
            XMMatrixLookAtLH(XMLoadFloat3(&eye), XMLoadFloat3(&preview.Center), XMVectorSet(0, 1, 0, 0)));
        constants.Projection = XMMatrixTranspose(SceneDepth::InfiniteReverseZPerspectiveLH(XM_PIDIV4, 1, preview.Near));
        constants.CameraPos = eye;
        constants.UseTexture = material.UseTexture;
        constants.UseNormalMap = material.NormalMapID >= 0;
        constants.MaterialMode = 1;
        constants.ShaderClass = static_cast<int>(ShaderClass::PBR);
        constants.MaterialMetallic = material.Metallic;
        constants.MaterialRoughness = material.Roughness;
        constants.MaterialFresnel = material.Fresnel;
        constants.MaterialAlpha = material.Alpha;
        constants.ViewportSize = {static_cast<float>(preview.Size), static_cast<float>(preview.Size)};
        constants.MaterialIsTransparent = material.IsTransparent;
        const auto drawConstants = FrameConstants::AllocateTransientConstantBuffer(constants);
        if (!drawConstants.ptr)
        {
            preview.Error = "Preview frame constant budget exhausted";
            const auto restore = CD3DX12_RESOURCE_BARRIER::Transition(
                preview.Target.Get(), D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_RENDER_TARGET, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE);
            commands->ResourceBarrier(1, &restore);
            return false;
        }
        commands->SetGraphicsRootDescriptorTable(0, drawConstants);
        if (preview.PreviewConstants)
        {
            if (!MaterialBindings::SetPreviewMaterial(material, preview.PreviewConstants.Get(), preview.TextureBase,
                                                      partIndex, partCount))
            {
                const auto restore =
                    CD3DX12_RESOURCE_BARRIER::Transition(preview.Target.Get(), D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_RENDER_TARGET,
                                                         D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE);
                commands->ResourceBarrier(1, &restore);
                return false;
            }
        }
        else
        {
            MaterialBindings::SetMaterial(g_kINVALID_ENTITY, material);
        }
        const auto heap = FrameConstants::GetCbvHeap()->GetGPUDescriptorHandleForHeapStart();
        const auto increment = FrameConstants::GetCbvIncrementSize();
        int albedo = TextureManager::GetDefaultTextureIndex();
        int normal = albedo;
        if (material.TextureID >= 0)
        {
            albedo = material.TextureID;
        }
        if (material.NormalMapID >= 0)
        {
            normal = material.NormalMapID;
        }
        commands->SetGraphicsRootDescriptorTable(1, CD3DX12_GPU_DESCRIPTOR_HANDLE(heap, albedo, increment));
        commands->SetGraphicsRootDescriptorTable(6, CD3DX12_GPU_DESCRIPTOR_HANDLE(heap, normal, increment));
        if (!preview.SceneEnvironment || material.Transmission > 0.0f)
        {
            commands->SetGraphicsRootDescriptorTable(
                7, CD3DX12_GPU_DESCRIPTOR_HANDLE(heap, TextureManager::GetDefaultTextureIndex(), increment));
        }
        if (mesh)
        {
            commands->IASetVertexBuffers(0, 1, &mesh->VertexBufferView);
            commands->IASetIndexBuffer(&mesh->IndexBufferView);
            commands->DrawIndexedInstanced(mesh->IndexCount, 1, 0, 0, 0);
        }
        else
        {
            commands->IASetVertexBuffers(0, 1, &preview.Views[preview.Shape]);
            commands->IASetIndexBuffer(nullptr);
            commands->DrawInstanced(vertexCount ? vertexCount : preview.Counts[preview.Shape], 1, firstVertex, 0);
        }
        barrier = CD3DX12_RESOURCE_BARRIER::Transition(preview.Target.Get(), D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_RENDER_TARGET,
                                                       D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE);
        if (partIndex + 1 == partCount)
        {
            commands->ResourceBarrier(1, &barrier);
        }
        return true;
    }

} // 名前空間

void MaterialPreview::Render()
{
    if (!preview.Visible || !preview.Material || !preview.Initialize())
    {
        return;
    }
    auto& runtime = MaterialManager::GetRuntime(preview.Material);
    for (int texture : runtime.TextureDescriptors)
    {
        if (texture >= 0)
        {
            TextureManager::TouchTexture(texture);
        }
    }
    RenderPreview(preview, runtime.Binding);
}

void MaterialPreview::Shutdown()
{
    preview = PreviewState{};
    std::lock_guard lock(thumbnailPipelineMutex);
    thumbnailPipelines = {};
    thumbnailPipelineFormat = DXGI_FORMAT_UNKNOWN;
}

ID3D12Resource* MaterialPreview::GetTarget()
{
    return preview.Target.Get();
}

void MaterialPreview::SetMesh(Mesh mesh)
{
    preview.Shape = static_cast<int>(mesh);
}

void MaterialPreview::SetLightIntensity(float intensity)
{
    preview.LightIntensity = clamp(intensity, 0.0f, 5.0f);
}

struct ThumbnailPreviewContext::Impl
{
    PreviewState State;
    bool GeometryUploaded = false;
    UINT MaterialSlots = 1;
};

struct AnimationPreviewContext::Impl
{
    PreviewState State;
    UINT MaterialCount = 1;
    float Radius = 1.0f;
};

AnimationPreviewContext::AnimationPreviewContext() : m_Impl(make_unique<Impl>()) {}

AnimationPreviewContext::~AnimationPreviewContext() = default;

bool AnimationPreviewContext::Initialize(UINT size, UINT descriptorIndex, UINT materialCount)
{
    auto& state = m_Impl->State;
    state.Size = size;
    state.SrvIndex = descriptorIndex;
    state.TextureBase = FrameConstants::g_kTEXTURE_SRV_START_INDEX;
    if (!state.Initialize())
    {
        return false;
    }
    m_Impl->MaterialCount = max(1u, materialCount);
    const auto heap = CD3DX12_HEAP_PROPERTIES(D3D12_HEAP_TYPE_UPLOAD);
    const auto description =
        CD3DX12_RESOURCE_DESC::Buffer(RendererState::g_kPBR_CB_ALIGNED_SIZE * RendererState::g_kFRAME_COUNT *
                                      static_cast<UINT64>(m_Impl->MaterialCount));
    if (FAILED(GraphicsDevice::GetDevice()->CreateCommittedResource(&heap, D3D12_HEAP_FLAG_NONE, &description,
                                                                    D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_GENERIC_READ, nullptr,
                                                                    IID_PPV_ARGS(&state.PreviewConstants))))
    {
        state.Error = "アニメーションプレビューのマテリアルバッファを作成できません";
        return false;
    }
    return true;
}

void AnimationPreviewContext::FrameModel(const XMFLOAT3& center, const XMFLOAT3& extents)
{
    auto& state = m_Impl->State;
    state.Center = center;
    m_Impl->Radius = max(0.01f, sqrtf(extents.x * extents.x + extents.y * extents.y + extents.z * extents.z));
    const auto fit = FitThumbnailCamera(m_Impl->Radius);
    state.Distance = fit.Distance;
    state.Near = fit.Near;
    state.Far = fit.Far;
    state.Yaw = 0.0f;
    state.Pitch = 0.12f;
}

void AnimationPreviewContext::Orbit(float yaw, float pitch, float zoom)
{
    auto& state = m_Impl->State;
    state.Yaw += yaw;
    state.Pitch = clamp(state.Pitch + pitch, -1.4f, 1.4f);
    state.Distance = clamp(state.Distance * expf(-zoom * 0.15f), m_Impl->Radius * 0.25f, m_Impl->Radius * 30.0f);
}

const string& AnimationPreviewContext::Error() const
{
    return m_Impl->State.Error;
}

bool AnimationPreviewContext::Render(AnimationModelResource& model, const vector<MaterialComponent>& materials)
{
    auto& state = m_Impl->State;
    if (!state.Target || materials.size() != model.GetMeshCount() || materials.size() > m_Impl->MaterialCount)
    {
        return false;
    }
    vector<UINT> meshes;
    for (UINT index = 0; index < model.GetMeshCount(); ++index)
    {
        const auto& mesh = model.GetMeshData(index);
        if (mesh.IndexCount == 0 || !mesh.VertexBuffer || !mesh.IndexBuffer)
        {
            continue;
        }
        if (!state.Pipeline(materials[index]))
        {
            return false;
        }
        meshes.push_back(index);
    }
    if (meshes.empty())
    {
        state.Error = "プレビューできるメッシュがありません";
        return false;
    }
    auto* commands = GraphicsDevice::GetCommandList();
    model.DispatchGpuSkinning(commands);
    for (UINT part = 0; part < meshes.size(); ++part)
    {
        const UINT index = meshes[part];
        const auto& mesh = model.GetMeshData(index);
        const auto& material = materials[index];
        for (int texture : {material.TextureID, material.NormalMapID, material.MetallicRoughnessID,
                            material.AOTextureID, material.EmissiveTextureID, material.HeightTextureID})
        {
            if (texture >= 0)
            {
                TextureManager::TouchTexture(texture);
            }
        }
        auto transition =
            CD3DX12_RESOURCE_BARRIER::Transition(mesh.VertexBuffer.Get(), D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_UNORDERED_ACCESS,
                                                 D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_VERTEX_AND_CONSTANT_BUFFER);
        commands->ResourceBarrier(1, &transition);
        const bool rendered = RenderPreview(state, material, 0, 0, part, static_cast<UINT>(meshes.size()), &mesh);
        transition = CD3DX12_RESOURCE_BARRIER::Transition(mesh.VertexBuffer.Get(),
                                                          D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_VERTEX_AND_CONSTANT_BUFFER,
                                                          D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_UNORDERED_ACCESS);
        commands->ResourceBarrier(1, &transition);
        if (!rendered)
        {
            return false;
        }
    }
    return true;
}

ThumbnailPreviewContext::ThumbnailPreviewContext() : m_Impl(std::make_unique<Impl>()) {}

ThumbnailPreviewContext::~ThumbnailPreviewContext() = default;

bool ThumbnailPreviewContext::Initialize(UINT size, UINT descriptorIndex)
{
    auto& state = m_Impl->State;
    state.Size = size;
    state.SrvIndex = descriptorIndex;
    state.SceneEnvironment = false;
    const auto sphereFit = FitThumbnailCamera(1.0f);
    state.Distance = sphereFit.Distance;
    state.Near = sphereFit.Near;
    state.Far = sphereFit.Far;
    if (!state.Initialize())
    {
        return false;
    }
    const auto heap = CD3DX12_HEAP_PROPERTIES(D3D12_HEAP_TYPE_UPLOAD);
    const auto description =
        CD3DX12_RESOURCE_DESC::Buffer(RendererState::g_kPBR_CB_ALIGNED_SIZE * RendererState::g_kFRAME_COUNT);
    return SUCCEEDED(GraphicsDevice::GetDevice()->CreateCommittedResource(&heap, D3D12_HEAP_FLAG_NONE, &description,
                                                                          D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_GENERIC_READ, nullptr,
                                                                          IID_PPV_ARGS(&state.PreviewConstants)));
}

bool ThumbnailPreviewContext::PreparePipelines(const MaterialComponent& material,
                                               const std::vector<ThumbnailPreviewPart>& parts)
{
    auto& state = m_Impl->State;
    if (parts.empty())
    {
        return state.Pipeline(material) != nullptr;
    }
    for (const auto& part : parts)
    {
        if (!state.Pipeline(part.Material))
        {
            return false;
        }
    }
    return true;
}

bool ThumbnailPreviewContext::Render(const MaterialComponent& material, const std::vector<StaticModelVertex>& geometry,
                                     const std::vector<ThumbnailPreviewPart>& parts)
{
    auto& state = m_Impl->State;
    if (!geometry.empty() && !m_Impl->GeometryUploaded)
    {
        XMFLOAT3 low = geometry.front().Position;
        XMFLOAT3 high = low;
        for (const auto& vertex : geometry)
        {
            const auto p = vertex.Position;
            if (!std::isfinite(p.x) || !std::isfinite(p.y) || !std::isfinite(p.z))
            {
                return false;
            }
            low = {std::min(low.x, p.x), std::min(low.y, p.y), std::min(low.z, p.z)};
            high = {std::max(high.x, p.x), std::max(high.y, p.y), std::max(high.z, p.z)};
        }
        state.Center = {(low.x + high.x) * 0.5f, (low.y + high.y) * 0.5f, (low.z + high.z) * 0.5f};
        const float x = (high.x - low.x) * 0.5f, y = (high.y - low.y) * 0.5f, z = (high.z - low.z) * 0.5f;
        const auto fit = FitThumbnailCamera(std::sqrt(x * x + y * y + z * z));
        if (!fit.Valid || geometry.size() > UINT_MAX / sizeof(StaticModelVertex))
        {
            return false;
        }
        state.Distance = fit.Distance;
        state.Near = fit.Near;
        state.Far = fit.Far;
        const UINT bytes = static_cast<UINT>(geometry.size() * sizeof(StaticModelVertex));
        const auto heap = CD3DX12_HEAP_PROPERTIES(D3D12_HEAP_TYPE_UPLOAD);
        const auto description = CD3DX12_RESOURCE_DESC::Buffer(bytes);
        state.Vertices[0].Reset();
        if (FAILED(GraphicsDevice::GetDevice()->CreateCommittedResource(&heap, D3D12_HEAP_FLAG_NONE, &description,
                                                                        D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_GENERIC_READ, nullptr,
                                                                        IID_PPV_ARGS(&state.Vertices[0]))))
        {
            return false;
        }
        void* mapped = nullptr;
        if (FAILED(state.Vertices[0]->Map(0, nullptr, &mapped)))
        {
            return false;
        }
        memcpy(mapped, geometry.data(), bytes);
        state.Vertices[0]->Unmap(0, nullptr);
        state.Views[0] = {state.Vertices[0]->GetGPUVirtualAddress(), bytes, sizeof(StaticModelVertex)};
        state.Counts[0] = static_cast<UINT>(geometry.size());
        m_Impl->GeometryUploaded = true;
    }
    if (parts.empty())
    {
        return RenderPreview(state, material);
    }
    const UINT count = static_cast<UINT>(parts.size());
    if (m_Impl->MaterialSlots != count)
    {
        const auto heap = CD3DX12_HEAP_PROPERTIES(D3D12_HEAP_TYPE_UPLOAD);
        const auto description = CD3DX12_RESOURCE_DESC::Buffer(
            RendererState::g_kPBR_CB_ALIGNED_SIZE * RendererState::g_kFRAME_COUNT * static_cast<UINT64>(count));
        state.PreviewConstants.Reset();
        if (FAILED(GraphicsDevice::GetDevice()->CreateCommittedResource(&heap, D3D12_HEAP_FLAG_NONE, &description,
                                                                        D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_GENERIC_READ, nullptr,
                                                                        IID_PPV_ARGS(&state.PreviewConstants))))
        {
            return false;
        }
        m_Impl->MaterialSlots = count;
    }
    // パス記録前にパイプラインを解決し、マテリアル失敗時にターゲットが描画途中で残るのを防ぐ。
    for (const auto& part : parts)
    {
        if (!state.Pipeline(part.Material))
        {
            return false;
        }
    }
    for (UINT index = 0; index < count; ++index)
    {
        const auto& part = parts[index];
        if (!RenderPreview(state, part.Material, part.FirstVertex, part.VertexCount, index, count))
        {
            return false;
        }
    }
    return true;
}

ID3D12Resource* ThumbnailPreviewContext::GetTarget() const
{
    return m_Impl->State.Target.Get();
}

uint64_t ThumbnailPreviewContext::MemoryBytes() const
{
    const auto& state = m_Impl->State;
    uint64_t bytes = 0;
    const auto add = [&bytes](const ComPtr<ID3D12Resource>& resource) {
        if (!resource)
        {
            return;
        }
        const auto description = resource->GetDesc();
        bytes += GraphicsDevice::GetDevice()->GetResourceAllocationInfo(0, 1, &description).SizeInBytes;
    };
    add(state.Target);
    add(state.Depth);
    add(state.Lights);
    add(state.OpticsGlobals);
    add(state.PreviewConstants);
    for (const auto& buffer : state.Vertices)
    {
        add(buffer);
    }
    return bytes;
}

===== FILE: source\rendering\megalights.h =====
#pragma once
// =============================================================================================
// 多数のライトを処理する描画機能（MegaLights）
//   M1：ライトバッファ + クラスター（フロクセル）ライトグリッド（ML0 / ML1）
//   M2：確率的ライトサンプリング（ML3）+ 影レイ（ML5）。シェーディング（ML6）は DeferredLightingPS
//       ・検証用：リファレンスモード（全ライト × 面上の複数点の影レイ）、静止時の累積平均、RMSE
//   M3：デノイズ（ML8）。MegaLightsShadePS が ML6 の結果をデモジュレートして書き、
//       時間方向（リプロジェクト + モーメント）→ À-Trous（分散で輝度の許容を決める）→ ディファードで掛け戻す
//   M4：可視ライトハッシュによるガイド（ML7）。8x8 タイルごとに「前フレームに影レイが通ったライト」の
//       128bit ブルームフィルタを持ち、載っていないライトの選択確率を下げる（確率に入れるので不偏のまま）
//   M5：タイル分類（ML2）+ コンパクション + スクリーントレース（ML4）
//       サンプリングは対象タイルだけを間接ディスパッチ、影レイは「必要なサンプルだけ」を詰めたリストで間接ディスパッチ。
//       ワールドトレースの前に深度バッファを短くマーチし、遮蔽が見つかったサンプルはレイを飛ばさない
//   M6：NRD（REBLUR_DIFFUSE）でのデノイズ（自前の SVGF と切り替え）、フロクセルフォグの MegaLights 化
//       フォグはグリッドを「視錐台の手前側も含めて」構築し、フロクセルごとにセルのライトから確率的に選ぶ（上限 32
//       灯を撤廃）
//   M7：Forward / 半透明（OIT 含む）からのグリッド参照、テクスチャ付き矩形ライト
//   半解像度サンプリング：サンプル空間を画面の 1/2 にし、各サンプルは 2x2 の代表ピクセル（毎フレーム回転）で作る。
//       ディファードは近傍 2x2 のサンプルを深度・法線で重み付けして使う（近似）
//   設計書: MegaLights_Design.md / MegaLights_M2_Design.md
//   ・ローカルライト（Point / Spot / Rect）を StructuredBuffer に載せる（最大 4096 灯）
//   ・16px タイル × 32 スライスのセルごとにライトリストを GPU で構築
//   ・シャドウマップを持つライト / ディレクショナル / Decal / Volume は従来の経路のまま
//   ヘッダーのみ（.vcxproj への追加不要）。シェーダーは実行時に DXC でコンパイルする。
// =============================================================================================
#include "pch.h"
#include "graphicslog.h"
#include "rendererstate.h"
#include "renderprofiler.h"
#include "raytracing.h"
#include "nrddenoiser.h"
#include "psomanager.h"
#include <memory>
#include "camera.h"
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>

class MegaLights final
{
  public:
    enum class Mode : int
    {
        Deterministic = 0, // M1：セル内の全ライトを評価
        Stochastic = 1,    // M2：N 個のサンプル + 影レイ（PBR 面のみ。DXR が必要）
        Reference = 2,     // 検証：全ライト × 面上の複数点の影レイ（PBR 面のみ。DXR が必要）
        Rtxdi = 3,         // RTXDI SDK の RIS と時間・空間リザーバー再利用
    };

    struct Settings
    {
        bool Enabled = false; // ディファード時のローカルライトをクラスターグリッドで評価する
        int DebugView = 0;    // 0: なし, 1: セルのライト数, 2: 奥行きスライス, 3: 選ばれたライト, 4: 可視率, 5: 1/p, 6:
                              // 累積平均, 7: リファレンスとの差
        float SliceFar = 500.0f; // スライス分割の奥行き上限（m）。これより奥は最後のスライスにまとめる
        int HeatmapMax = 32;     // ライト数ヒートマップの上限
        // ---- M2段階
        int EvaluationMode = static_cast<int>(Mode::Deterministic);
        int SamplesPerPixel = 2;     // 1 / 2 / 4（解像度に応じて自動で下げる）
        int RtxdiCandidates = 8;     // リザーバーごとの一様初期候補数
        bool HalfResolution = false; // 半解像度サンプリング（サンプル数・影レイが 1/4）
        // ---- M7段階
        bool Translucency = true; // Forward / 半透明もグリッドで評価する（グリッドを視錐台全体で構築）
        float UniformMix = 0.1f;  // 一様選択の混合率 α（見積もりが外れても確率を 0 にしない）
        int ReferenceRays = 16;   // リファレンスの影レイ数（面光源・球ライト）
        float InvPdfDisplayMax = 64.0f;
        bool Accumulate = false; // 静止時の累積平均（検証用）
        // ---- M4（可視ライトハッシュ）
        bool Guide = true;
        float GuideMinWeight =
            0.1f;                 // ハッシュに載っていないライトの重み（0 より大きく。遮られがちなライトも時々調べる）
        float GuideKeep = 0.875f; // 前フレームのハッシュのビットを残す確率（1 - 減衰）
        // ---- M5（スクリーントレース）
        // ---- M6段階
        int Denoiser = 0;          // 0: 自前（SVGF）, 1: NRD（REBLUR）。NRD が使えなければ自前に戻す
        bool VolumetricFog = true; // フロクセルフォグのローカルライトを MegaLights で評価する
        int FogSamples = 2;        // フロクセルあたりのライトサンプル数（1〜4）
        bool ScreenTrace = true;
        int ScreenTraceSteps = 12;
        float ScreenTraceMaxPixels = 64.0f; // マーチする最大距離（ピクセル）
        float ScreenTraceThickness = 0.25f; // 深度バッファの面の厚みの仮定（m）
        float ScreenTraceSelfPixels = 1.5f; // 始点からこのピクセル数以内は調べない（自己遮蔽よけ）
        // ---- M3（デノイズ）
        bool Denoise = true;
        int DenoiseIterations = 3; // À-Trous の回数（間隔 1, 2, 4, ...）
        int MaxHistory = 32;       // 時間方向の履歴の上限（フレーム）
        int AntiLagHistory = 4;    // ライトが変わったフレームの履歴の上限
        bool FireflySuppression = true;
        bool HistoryFeedback = true; // À-Trous の 1 回目を履歴へ書き戻す
        float AlphaMin = 0.05f;
        float MomentsAlphaMin = 0.2f;
        float DepthTolerance = 0.1f;
        float NormalThreshold = 0.9f;
        float PhiNormal = 64.0f;
        float PhiLuminance = 4.0f;
        float PhiPlane = 2.0f;
    };

    struct Stats
    {
        UINT SubmittedLights = 0; // グリッドに載せたライト
        UINT DroppedLights = 0;   // 上限（4096）を超えて載せられなかったライト
        UINT TilesX = 0, TilesY = 0, Slices = 0;
        UINT CoarseIndices = 0, FineIndices = 0; // 数フレーム前の GPU 実測
        UINT OverflowCells = 0, MaxLightsPerCell = 0;
        bool Built = false;
        bool RtxdiActive = false;
        bool RtxdiHistoryValid = false;
        double RtxdiBufferMB = 0.0;
        // ---- M2段階
        Mode ActiveMode = Mode::Deterministic; // このフレームに実際に使った評価方式
        const char* FallbackReason = nullptr;  // 要求した方式が使えなかった理由
        UINT SamplesPerPixel = 0;
        double SampleBufferMB = 0.0;
        UINT AccumulatedFrames = 0;
        bool HasReference = false;
        bool ErrorValid = false;
        double RelativeRmse = 0.0; // sqrt(Σ(acc - ref)² / Σref²)（輝度）
        UINT ErrorFrames = 0;      // RMSE を測ったときの累積フレーム数
        // ---- M3段階
        bool Denoised = false;
        bool AntiLag = false;
        bool HistoryReset = false;
        double DenoiseBufferMB = 0.0;
        const char* DenoiseFallback = nullptr;
        // ---- M4段階
        bool Guided = false;    // このフレームのサンプリングでハッシュを使った
        bool HashValid = false; // 前フレームのハッシュが使える
        UINT HashTilesX = 0, HashTilesY = 0;
        // ---- M5（数フレーム前の GPU 実測）
        UINT ActiveTiles = 0, TotalTiles = 0;
        UINT TraceRequests = 0; // 影レイが必要だったサンプル
        UINT ScreenHits = 0;    // スクリーントレースで遮蔽が見つかった（ワールドトレース不要）
        UINT WorldTraces = 0;   // ワールドトレースしたサンプル
        bool TraceStatsValid = false;
        // ---- M6段階
        const char* DenoiserUsed = nullptr; // このフレームに使ったデノイザー
        const char* NrdFallback = nullptr;
        bool VolumetricGrid = false; // フォグ用にグリッドを視錐台全体で構築した
        // ---- M7 / 半解像度
        bool ForwardGrid = false; // Forward / 半透明がグリッドを使う
        UINT SampleWidth = 0, SampleHeight = 0, SampleScale = 1;
    };

    // HLSL の MegaLightData と同じ並び（96 byte）
    struct GpuLight
    {
        XMFLOAT4 PositionType;
        XMFLOAT4 DirectionRange;
        XMFLOAT4 Color;
        XMFLOAT4 Extra;
        XMFLOAT4 Flags; // x: 影を落とす, y: ソース半径, z: Entity ID（uint のビット。可視ライトハッシュのキー）
        XMFLOAT4 IesProfile;
    };

    static_assert(sizeof(GpuLight) == 96, "MegaLightData layout mismatch");

    static constexpr UINT kMaxLights = 4096;
    static constexpr UINT kTileSize = 16;
    static constexpr UINT kSlices = 32;
    static constexpr UINT kCoarseTiles = 4;
    static constexpr UINT kCoarseSlices = 4;
    static constexpr UINT kCoarseCapacity = 1u << 20; // 粗リスト（uint）: 4 MB
    static constexpr UINT kFineCapacity = 1u << 22;   // 細リスト（uint）: 16 MB
    static constexpr UINT kMaxSamplesPerPixel = 4;
    static constexpr UINT64 kSampleBudgetBytes = 160ull << 20; // サンプルバッファの上限（N を自動で下げる）
    static constexpr UINT kFrames = RendererState::g_kFRAME_COUNT;

    static Settings& GetSettings()
    {
        return s_Settings;
    }

    static const Stats& GetStats()
    {
        return s_Stats;
    }

    static Mode GetRequestedMode()
    {
        // Process-local override keeps saved settings identical for A/B measurements.
        static const int overrideMode = []() {
            char value[32]{};
            GetEnvironmentVariableA("DX12_DIRECT_LIGHTING", value, sizeof(value));
            if (strcmp(value, "rtxdi") == 0)
            {
                return 3;
            }
            if (strcmp(value, "megalights") == 0)
            {
                return 1;
            }
            if (strcmp(value, "deterministic") == 0)
            {
                return 0;
            }
            return -1;
        }();
        if (overrideMode >= 0)
        {
            return static_cast<Mode>(overrideMode);
        }
        return static_cast<Mode>(std::clamp(s_Settings.EvaluationMode, 0, 3));
    }

    static bool IsAvailable()
    {
        return s_Available;
    }

    static bool IsStochasticAvailable()
    {
        return s_Available && s_SampleAvailable;
    }

    // CPU 側でライトをグリッドへ振り分けるか（このフレームの判断）
    static bool IsEnabled()
    {
        return s_Available && s_Settings.Enabled;
    }

    // 検証の操作（UI から）
    static void RequestAccumulationReset()
    {
        s_ResetRequested = true;
    }

    static void RequestSaveReference()
    {
        s_SaveReferenceRequested = true;
    }

    static void ClearReference()
    {
        s_HasReference = false;
        s_Stats.HasReference = false;
        s_Stats.ErrorValid = false;
    }

    static void RequestHistoryReset()
    {
        s_DenoiseResetRequested = true;
        s_HashResetRequested = true;
    }

    static void RequestHashReset()
    {
        s_HashResetRequested = true;
    }

    static bool IsDenoiseAvailable()
    {
        return s_Available && s_DenoiseAvailable && !s_ShadeFailed;
    }

    static bool Initialize(ID3D12Device* device)
    {
        Shutdown();
        if (!device)
        {
            return false;
        }
        s_Device = device;

        // 定数バッファは最初に作る（グラフィックス側は常にこれを b10 にバインドするため、
        // シェーダーのコンパイルに失敗しても「無効」の定数を読ませられるようにする）
        if (!CreateBuffer(s_Constants, kConstantStride * kFrames, D3D12_HEAP_TYPE_UPLOAD, D3D12_RESOURCE_FLAG_NONE,
                          D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_GENERIC_READ, L"MegaLights Constants") ||
            !CreateBuffer(s_LightUpload, kLightStride * kFrames, D3D12_HEAP_TYPE_UPLOAD, D3D12_RESOURCE_FLAG_NONE,
                          D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_GENERIC_READ, L"MegaLights Lights") ||
            !CreateBuffer(s_Dummy, 256, D3D12_HEAP_TYPE_DEFAULT, D3D12_RESOURCE_FLAG_ALLOW_UNORDERED_ACCESS,
                          D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_COMMON, L"MegaLights Dummy UAV"))
        {
            WriteGraphicsLog("MegaLights: upload buffers failed\n");
            Shutdown();
            return false;
        }
        const CD3DX12_RANGE noRead(0, 0);
        if (FAILED(s_Constants->Map(0, &noRead, reinterpret_cast<void**>(&s_MappedConstants))) ||
            FAILED(s_LightUpload->Map(0, &noRead, reinterpret_cast<void**>(&s_MappedLights))))
        {
            Shutdown();
            return false;
        }
        memset(s_MappedConstants, 0, kConstantStride * kFrames);

        if (!CreateGridPipelines(device))
        {
            return false;
        }

        const auto uav = D3D12_RESOURCE_FLAG_ALLOW_UNORDERED_ACCESS;
        if (!CreateBuffer(s_CoarseIndices, sizeof(UINT) * kCoarseCapacity, D3D12_HEAP_TYPE_DEFAULT, uav,
                          D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_COMMON, L"MegaLights Coarse Indices") ||
            !CreateBuffer(s_FineIndices, sizeof(UINT) * kFineCapacity, D3D12_HEAP_TYPE_DEFAULT, uav,
                          D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_COMMON, L"MegaLights Fine Indices") ||
            !CreateBuffer(s_Counters, 16, D3D12_HEAP_TYPE_DEFAULT, uav, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_COMMON,
                          L"MegaLights Counters") ||
            !CreateBuffer(s_LightVisible, kLightVisibleBytes, D3D12_HEAP_TYPE_DEFAULT, uav, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_COMMON,
                          L"MegaLights Light Visibility") ||
            !CreateBuffer(s_Readback, kReadbackStride * kFrames, D3D12_HEAP_TYPE_READBACK, D3D12_RESOURCE_FLAG_NONE,
                          D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_COPY_DEST, L"MegaLights Readback"))
        {
            WriteGraphicsLog("MegaLights: grid buffers failed\n");
            ShutdownPipelines();
            return false;
        }
        s_CoarseIndicesState = s_FineIndicesState = s_CountersState = D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_COMMON;
        s_Available = true;
        // M2 / M3 は失敗しても M1 は使える
        s_SampleAvailable = CreateSamplePipelines(device);
        s_DenoiseAvailable = s_SampleAvailable && CreateDenoisePipelines(device);
        s_NrdAvailable = s_DenoiseAvailable && NrdDenoiser::IsCompiled() && CreateNrdPipelines(device);
        WriteGraphicsLog("MegaLights: initialized (clustered light grid, max %u lights, stochastic=%d)\n", kMaxLights,
                         s_SampleAvailable ? 1 : 0);
        return true;
    }

    static void Shutdown()
    {
        ShutdownPipelines();
        if (s_Constants && s_MappedConstants)
        {
            s_Constants->Unmap(0, nullptr);
        }
        if (s_LightUpload && s_MappedLights)
        {
            s_LightUpload->Unmap(0, nullptr);
        }
        s_MappedConstants = nullptr;
        s_MappedLights = nullptr;
        s_Constants.Reset();
        s_LightUpload.Reset();
        s_Dummy.Reset();
        s_ShadePso.Reset();
        s_ShadeFailed = false;
        s_Device.Reset();
    }

    // ---- CPU：ライトの収集（LightingResources::UpdateLightConstantBuffer から 1 フレーム 1 回）
    // 戻り値 false の場合、このフレームはすでに収集済み（同じフレームで再度呼ばれた）
    static bool BeginFrame(UINT frameIndex, uint64_t frameSerial)
    {
        if (frameSerial == s_LastSerial && s_HasSerial)
        {
            return false;
        }
        s_HasSerial = true;
        s_LastSerial = frameSerial;
        s_Slot = frameIndex % kFrames;
        if (s_MappedLights)
        {
            memset(s_MappedLights + s_Slot * kLightStride + kLightDataBytes, 0xff, g_kMAX_ENTITIES * sizeof(UINT));
        }
        ++s_FrameCounter;
        RetireTick();
        ReadStats();
        s_LightCount = 0;
        s_LightHash = 1469598103934665603ull;
        for (EntityID entity : s_EntityMarked)
        {
            if (entity < s_EntityInGrid.size())
            {
                s_EntityInGrid[entity] = 0;
            }
        }
        s_EntityMarked.clear();
        s_Stats.SubmittedLights = 0;
        s_Stats.DroppedLights = 0;
        s_Stats.Built = false;
        s_SlotBuilt[s_Slot] = false;
        s_SlotForward[s_Slot] = false;
        s_SampleWidth = s_SampleHeight = 0;
        s_SampleScale = 1;
        WriteConstants(false, {}, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0);
        WriteForwardDescriptors(s_Slot, false);
        return true;
    }

    // 追加できたら true（このライトの不透明面ライティングはグリッドが受け持つ）
    // ライトのオクルージョン（GPU の判定を読み戻した結果）：数フレーム続けて「見えている不透明面に届かない」ライト
    static bool IsLightOccluded(EntityID entity)
    {
        return entity < s_OccludedFrames.size() && s_OccludedFrames[entity] >= kOcclusionFrames;
    }

    static UINT GetOccludedLightCount()
    {
        return s_OccludedCount;
    }

    static bool IsEntityInGrid(EntityID entity)
    {
        return s_HasSerial && entity < s_EntityInGrid.size() && s_EntityInGrid[entity] != 0;
    }

    static bool AddLight(EntityID entity, const GpuLight& light)
    {
        if (!s_MappedLights || !IsEnabled())
        {
            return false;
        }
        if (s_LightCount >= kMaxLights)
        {
            ++s_Stats.DroppedLights;
            return false;
        }
        memcpy(s_MappedLights + s_Slot * kLightStride + s_LightCount * sizeof(GpuLight), &light, sizeof(GpuLight));
        if (entity < g_kMAX_ENTITIES)
        {
            memcpy(s_MappedLights + s_Slot * kLightStride + kLightDataBytes + entity * sizeof(UINT),
                   &s_LightCount, sizeof(s_LightCount));
        }
        HashBytes(s_LightHash, &light, sizeof(light)); // 累積のリセット判定用（アップロードヒープは読み戻さない）
        if (entity >= s_EntityInGrid.size())
        {
            s_EntityInGrid.resize(static_cast<size_t>(entity) + 1, 0);
        }
        s_EntityInGrid[entity] = 1;
        s_EntityMarked.push_back(entity);
        ++s_LightCount;
        s_Stats.SubmittedLights = s_LightCount;
        return true;
    }

    // ---- GPU：グリッドの構築 + M2 のサンプリング（GBuffer 完成後・TLAS 構築後・ディファードライティングの前）
    //   Gバッファー：基本色、法線、深度、材質、影、速度（PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE
    //   で渡す。終了時に同じ状態へ戻す） gbufferTable: ポストプロセスと同じ GBuffer の SRV テーブル（BaseColor から 8
