void Raytracing::BeginGlassRead(ID3D12GraphicsCommandList* commands)
{
    auto& frame = g_Frames[GraphicsDevice::GetFrameIndex() % kFrameCount];
    if (!commands || !g_Active || !frame.GlassReady || frame.GlassReading)
    {
        return;
    }
    frame.GlassRestore.clear();
    frame.GlassSkinnedVertices.clear();
    vector<D3D12_RESOURCE_BARRIER> before;
    map<ID3D12Resource*, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATES> resources;
    for (const auto& g : frame.SceneGeometry)
    {
        if (g.Vertices)
        {
            resources.emplace(g.Vertices.Get(), g.VertexState);
        }
        if (g.Indices)
        {
            resources.emplace(g.Indices.Get(), g.IndexState);
        }
    }
    for (const auto& [resource, originalState] : resources)
    {
        if ((originalState & D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE) != 0)
        {
            continue;
        }
        auto readState = static_cast<D3D12_RESOURCE_STATES>(originalState | D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE);
        if (originalState == D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_UNORDERED_ACCESS)
        {
            // UAV 書き込みとシェーダー読み取りは同時にできない。このパスが終わるまで、スキニング済み頂点を
            // ラスタライズとガラスの両方から読み取れる状態に保つ。
            readState = D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_VERTEX_AND_CONSTANT_BUFFER | D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE;
            frame.GlassSkinnedVertices.insert(resource);
        }
        before.push_back(CD3DX12_RESOURCE_BARRIER::Transition(resource, originalState, readState));
        frame.GlassRestore.push_back(CD3DX12_RESOURCE_BARRIER::Transition(resource, readState, originalState));
    }
    if (!before.empty())
    {
        commands->ResourceBarrier(static_cast<UINT>(before.size()), before.data());
    }
    frame.GlassReading = true;
}

bool Raytracing::IsReadingSkinnedVerticesForGlass(ID3D12Resource* resource)
{
    const auto& frame = g_Frames[GraphicsDevice::GetFrameIndex() % kFrameCount];
    return frame.GlassReading && frame.GlassSkinnedVertices.contains(resource);
}

void Raytracing::EndGlassRead(ID3D12GraphicsCommandList* commands)
{
    auto& frame = g_Frames[GraphicsDevice::GetFrameIndex() % kFrameCount];
    if (!commands || !frame.GlassReading)
    {
        return;
    }
    if (!frame.GlassRestore.empty())
    {
        commands->ResourceBarrier(static_cast<UINT>(frame.GlassRestore.size()), frame.GlassRestore.data());
    }
    frame.GlassRestore.clear();
    frame.GlassSkinnedVertices.clear();
    frame.GlassReading = false;
}

void Raytracing::BindLighting(ID3D12GraphicsCommandList* commands, UINT sceneIndex, UINT constantsIndex)
{
    if (!commands || !g_LightingConstants)
    {
        return;
    }
    const UINT slot = GraphicsDevice::GetFrameIndex() % kFrameCount;
    commands->SetGraphicsRootShaderResourceView(
        sceneIndex, g_Frames[slot].TopLevel ? g_Frames[slot].TopLevel->GetGPUVirtualAddress() : 0);
    commands->SetGraphicsRootConstantBufferView(constantsIndex,
                                                g_LightingConstants->GetGPUVirtualAddress() + slot * kLightingStride);
}

ID3D12Resource* Raytracing::GetResultResource()
{
    if (!g_Active)
    {
        return nullptr;
    }
    return g_Frames[g_FrameIndex].Result.Get();
}

bool Raytracing::IsGiActive()
{
    return g_GiActive;
}

D3D12_GPU_DESCRIPTOR_HANDLE Raytracing::GetGiSrv()
{
    return RayReflections::GetGiSrv(g_FrameIndex);
}

===== FILE: source\rendering\raytracing.h =====
#pragma once

#include "pch.h"
#include "nrddenoiser.h"

class Raytracing
{
  public:
    enum class Mode
    {
        ReflectionsOnly,
        Full
    };
    enum class DenoiserType
    {
        Nrd,
        Optix
    };

    struct Settings
    {
        Mode RenderMode = Mode::ReflectionsOnly;
        bool Enabled = true;
        bool Shadows = true;
        bool AmbientOcclusion = true;
        bool Reflections = true;
        bool Denoise = true;
        bool StableNrdProfile = true;
        bool StableSampling = true;
        DenoiserType RadianceDenoiser = DenoiserType::Nrd;
        int Samples = 2;
        float ShadowDistance = 500.0f;
        float AmbientRadius = 1.5f;
        float NormalBias = 0.015f;
        float SunAngularRadius = 0.00465f;
        // BLAS: 静的 BLAS をビルド後に圧縮（コンパクション）し、VRAM を削減する。
        bool CompactStaticBlas = true;
        // BLAS: 変形 BLAS は通常リフィット（更新）し、この回数ごとにフルビルドで BVH 品質を回復する。0 で無効。
        int DeformingBlasRebuildInterval = 32;
        // 1 フレームあたりの変形 BLAS フルビルド数の上限（スパイク分散）。
        int DeformingBlasRebuildsPerFrame = 2;
        // BLAS 入力頂点を R16G16B16A16_SNORM へ量子化する（バウンディングボックス正規化 + Transform3x4 で復元）。
        bool QuantizeBlasVertices = true;
        // 量子化誤差（ワールド空間）の許容上限。これを超えるメッシュは 32bit 頂点のまま構築する。
        float BlasQuantizationMaxError = 0.0005f;
    };

    struct BlasStatistics
    {
        UINT BottomLevels = 0;
        UINT Compacted = 0;
        UINT Quantized = 0;
        UINT RefitsThisFrame = 0;
        UINT RebuildsThisFrame = 0;
        UINT64 ResultBytes = 0;
        UINT64 CompactionSavedBytes = 0;
    };

    static bool Initialize(ID3D12Device* device, ID3D12DescriptorHeap* heap, UINT increment);
    static void Shutdown();
    static void ReleaseInactiveResources();
    static void Execute(ID3D12GraphicsCommandList* commandList, ID3D12Resource* depth, ID3D12Resource* normal,
                        D3D12_GPU_DESCRIPTOR_HANDLE depthSrv, D3D12_GPU_DESCRIPTOR_HANDLE normalSrv, UINT frameIndex);
    static bool IsAvailable();
    // RT 反射を実行するか（レイトレーシング ON かつ 反射 ON）
    static bool ReflectionsRequested();
    // DXR GI（Realtime / Lumen / SHaRC）は「レイトレーシング」の ON/OFF に関係なく動かす。
    // 以前は RT を OFF にしていると GI モードを選んでも何も起きなかった。
    static bool RadianceRequested();
    static bool UsesRaytracedShadows();
    static bool UsesRaytracedAmbientOcclusion();
    static bool IsActive();
    static const char* GetStatus();
    static Settings& GetSettings();
    static D3D12_GPU_DESCRIPTOR_HANDLE GetResultSrv();
    static ID3D12Resource* GetResultResource();
    static XMFLOAT4 GetSunDirection();
    static UINT GetInstanceCount();
    static BlasStatistics GetBlasStatistics();
    static UINT GetDenoiserDispatchCount();
    static UINT GetAmbientDenoiserDispatchCount();
    static bool AreReflectionsActive();
    static bool IsGiActive();
    static D3D12_GPU_DESCRIPTOR_HANDLE GetGiSrv();
    static D3D12_GPU_DESCRIPTOR_HANDLE GetReflectionSrv();
    static D3D12_GPU_VIRTUAL_ADDRESS GetLightingConstantsAddress(UINT frameIndex);
    // このフレームの Execute() が構築した TLAS（レイトレーシング未実行時は0）。
    static D3D12_GPU_VIRTUAL_ADDRESS GetSceneAddress();
    // NRD の共有ガイド（Motion / NormalRoughness / ViewZ。PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE）とカメラ情報。
    // serial は最後にガイドを書いた Execute の番号（同じフレームのものかを呼び出し側で判定する）
    static bool GetNrdGuides(ID3D12Resource* guides[3], NrdFrame& frame, uint64_t& serial);
    static void BeginLightList();
    static void SetLightShadowFlag(UINT index, bool castShadow);
    static void BindGlass(ID3D12GraphicsCommandList* commandList);
    static void BeginGlassRead(ID3D12GraphicsCommandList* commandList);
    static bool IsReadingSkinnedVerticesForGlass(ID3D12Resource* resource);
    static void EndGlassRead(ID3D12GraphicsCommandList* commandList);
    static void BindLighting(ID3D12GraphicsCommandList* commandList, UINT sceneRootIndex, UINT constantsRootIndex);
};

===== FILE: source\rendering\raytracingscene.cpp =====
#include "pch.h"
#include "envflags.h"
#include "camera.h"
#include "temporalhistorycontext.h"
#include <type_traits>
#include <map>
#include "materialmanager.h"
#include "raytracingscene.h"
#include "materialsystem.h"
#include "world.h"
#include "modelmanager.h"
#include "sun.h"
#include "vertexdeformation.h"
#include "texturemanager.h"

namespace
{
    void SetMaterial(RaytracingGeometry& geometry, EntityID entity, int modelTexture = -1, size_t slot = 0)
    {
        geometry.MediumID = static_cast<UINT>(entity);
        if (ComponentManager::HasComponent<MaterialComponent>(entity))
        {
            const auto& material =
                MaterialManager::Resolve(ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<MaterialComponent>(entity), slot);
            if (material.RuntimeHandle != 0)
            {
                geometry.Noise = material.Noise;
                geometry.NoiseNormalScale = material.NormalScale;
                geometry.BaseColor = material.BaseColor;
                geometry.Emission = {material.EmissiveColor.x, material.EmissiveColor.y, material.EmissiveColor.z,
                                     material.EmissiveIntensity};
                geometry.EmissionTexture = TextureManager::GetTextureResource(material.EmissiveTextureID);
                if (geometry.EmissionTexture)
                {
                    TextureManager::TouchTexture(material.EmissiveTextureID);
                    geometry.EmissionResidentMip = TextureManager::GetTextureResidentMip(material.EmissiveTextureID);
                }
                // ラスターの POM と同じ条件（不透明・深さ > 0・高さマップあり）。
                if (material.ParallaxDepth > 0.0f && (material.HeightTextureID >= 0 || material.Noise[2].Width != 0) &&
                    material.AssetSurface == MaterialSurface::Opaque &&
                    !MaterialSystem::IsTransparentMaterial(material))
                {
                    geometry.HeightTexture = TextureManager::GetTextureResource(material.HeightTextureID);
                    if (geometry.HeightTexture || material.Noise[2].Width != 0)
                    {
                        TextureManager::TouchTexture(material.HeightTextureID);
                        geometry.HeightResidentMip = TextureManager::GetTextureResidentMip(material.HeightTextureID);
                        geometry.ParallaxDepth = (std::min)(material.ParallaxDepth, 0.2f);
                    }
                }
            }
            geometry.IOR = material.IOR;
            geometry.Transmission = MaterialSystem::IsTransparentMaterial(material) ? material.Transmission : 0.0f;
            geometry.Absorption = material.AbsorptionCoefficient;
            geometry.Thickness = material.Thickness;
            geometry.TransmissionRoughness = material.TransmissionRoughness;
            geometry.Fresnel = material.Fresnel;
            geometry.Emission = material.RuntimeHandle != 0
                                    ? XMFLOAT4{material.EmissiveColor.x, material.EmissiveColor.y,
                                               material.EmissiveColor.z, material.EmissiveIntensity}
                                    : XMFLOAT4{0, 0, 0, 0};
            // ラスタ描画は、マテリアルアセットではプリミティブ頂点色を、従来の頂点色描画では
            // AssetBaseColor を無視する。その規則を維持する。
            geometry.UsesAssetMaterial = material.RuntimeHandle != 0;
            geometry.BaseColor = geometry.UsesAssetMaterial ? material.BaseColor : XMFLOAT4{1, 1, 1, 1};
            geometry.BaseColor.w *= material.Alpha;
            geometry.Roughness = material.Roughness;
            geometry.Metallic = material.Metallic;
            geometry.CastShadow = MaterialSystem::CastsShadow(material);
            if (material.UseTexture)
            {
                geometry.TextureIndex = material.TextureID;
                if (material.RuntimeHandle == 0 && modelTexture >= 0)
                {
                    geometry.TextureIndex = modelTexture;
                }
            }
        }
        else
        {
            geometry.TextureIndex = modelTexture;
        }
        geometry.Texture = TextureManager::GetTextureResource(geometry.TextureIndex);
        if (geometry.Texture)
        {
            TextureManager::TouchTexture(geometry.TextureIndex);
            geometry.TextureResidentMip = TextureManager::GetTextureResidentMip(geometry.TextureIndex);
        }
    }

    bool IsRayGeometryVisible(const MaterialComponent& material)
    {
        float opacity = material.Alpha;
        if (material.RuntimeHandle != 0)
        {
            opacity *= material.BaseColor.w;
        }
        return opacity > 0.0f && (!MaterialSystem::IsTransparentMaterial(material) ||
                                  MaterialSystem::CastsShadow(material) || material.Transmission > 0.001f);
    }

    bool IsOpaqueCaster(EntityID entity)
    {
        if (ComponentManager::HasComponent<MeshComponent>(entity) &&
            ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<MeshComponent>(entity).IsEnvironment)
        {
            return false;
        }
        if (ComponentManager::HasComponent<SunComponent>(entity) ||
            ComponentManager::HasComponent<SpriteComponent>(entity) ||
            ComponentManager::HasComponent<CameraComponent>(entity))
        {
            return false;
        }
        if (ComponentManager::HasComponent<MaterialComponent>(entity))
        {
            const auto& source = ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<MaterialComponent>(entity);
            const size_t count = max(size_t(1), source.MaterialSlots.size());
            for (size_t slot = 0; slot < count; ++slot)
            {
                if (IsRayGeometryVisible(MaterialManager::Resolve(source, slot)))
                {
                    return true;
                }
            }
            return false;
        }
        return true;
    }

    template <typename Model>
    void AppendModel(vector<RaytracingGeometry>& geometry, EntityID entity, Model* model, bool deforming)
    {
        if (!model || !IsOpaqueCaster(entity))
        {
            return;
        }
        const auto& transform = ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<TransformComponent>(entity);
        for (UINT meshIndex = 0; meshIndex < model->GetMeshCount(); ++meshIndex)
        {
            const auto& mesh = model->GetMeshData(meshIndex);
            if (ComponentManager::HasComponent<MaterialComponent>(entity) &&
                !IsRayGeometryVisible(MaterialManager::Resolve(
                    ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<MaterialComponent>(entity), meshIndex)))
            {
                continue;
            }
            if (!mesh.VertexBuffer || !mesh.IndexBuffer || mesh.IndexCount < 3)
            {
                continue;
            }
            RaytracingGeometry entry;
            entry.SurfaceOwner = (static_cast<uint64_t>(entity) << 32) | (uint64_t(meshIndex) + 1);
            entry.Vertices = mesh.VertexBuffer;
            entry.Indices = mesh.IndexBuffer;
            entry.VertexView = mesh.VertexBufferView;
            entry.IndexView = mesh.IndexBufferView;
            entry.IndexCount = mesh.IndexCount;
            entry.Deforming = deforming;
            entry.Skinned = deforming;
            if constexpr (std::is_same_v<std::decay_t<decltype(mesh)>, StaticMeshData>)
            {
                if (mesh.RayRadius > 0.0f)
                {
                    // AABB 中心から最遠頂点までの距離 <= RayRadius なので、量子化範囲の上限として使える。
                    entry.ObjectRadius = mesh.RayRadius;
                }
            }
            entry.VertexState = D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_VERTEX_AND_CONSTANT_BUFFER;
            if (deforming)
            {
                // ModelSystem は各描画パスの後にスキニング出力を UAV へ戻す。
                entry.VertexState = D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_UNORDERED_ACCESS;
            }
            entry.IndexState = D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_INDEX_BUFFER;
            D3D12_HEAP_PROPERTIES heapProperties{};
            if (SUCCEEDED(entry.Vertices->GetHeapProperties(&heapProperties, nullptr)) &&
                heapProperties.Type == D3D12_HEAP_TYPE_UPLOAD)
            {
                entry.VertexState = D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_GENERIC_READ;
            }
            if (SUCCEEDED(entry.Indices->GetHeapProperties(&heapProperties, nullptr)) &&
                heapProperties.Type == D3D12_HEAP_TYPE_UPLOAD)
            {
                entry.IndexState = D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_GENERIC_READ;
            }
            entry.World = transform.WorldMatrix;
            SetMaterial(entry, entity, mesh.TextureIndex, meshIndex);
            VertexDeformationView deformation;
            if (!deforming && VertexDeformation::TryResolveStaticMesh(entity, meshIndex, deformation))
            {
                entry.Vertices = deformation.CurrentResource;
                entry.VertexView = deformation.CurrentView;
                entry.VertexState = D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_VERTEX_AND_CONSTANT_BUFFER;
                entry.Deforming = true;
            }
            if constexpr (std::is_same_v<std::decay_t<decltype(mesh)>, StaticMeshData>)
            {
                static const bool rayLod = ReadEnvironmentFlagOnce("DX12_DXR_LOD"),
                                  rayProxy = ReadEnvironmentFlagOnce("DX12_DXR_PROXY");
                const auto camera = Camera::GetCameraEntity();
                if (entry.Transmission <= 0.001f && !entry.Deforming && (rayLod || rayProxy) &&
                    ComponentManager::HasComponent<TransformComponent>(camera))
                {
                    const auto& eye = ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<TransformComponent>(camera).Position;
                    const XMMATRIX world = XMLoadFloat4x4(&entry.World);
                    const float distance = XMVectorGetX(XMVector3Length(
                        XMVector3TransformCoord(XMLoadFloat3(&mesh.RayCenter), world) - XMLoadFloat3(&eye)));
                    const float scale = (std::max)({XMVectorGetX(XMVector3Length(world.r[0])),
                                                    XMVectorGetX(XMVector3Length(world.r[1])),
                                                    XMVectorGetX(XMVector3Length(world.r[2]))});
                    const bool important = entry.Roughness < .2f || entry.Emission.w > .001f ||
                                           mesh.RayRadius * scale / (std::max)(distance, 1.f) > .08f;
                    UINT lod = 0;
                    if (rayLod)
                    {
                        if (distance > 140)
                        {
                            lod = 3;
                        }
                        else if (distance > 70)
                        {
                            lod = 2;
                        }
                        else if (distance > 35)
                        {
                            lod = 1;
                        }
                    }
                    if (important)
                    {
                        lod = 0;
                    }
                    using Key = tuple<EntityID, UINT, UINT64>;
                    static map<Key, UINT> previous;
                    const Key key(entity, meshIndex, mesh.VertexBufferView.BufferLocation);
                    const auto old = previous.find(key);
                    if (!important && old != previous.end() && old->second <= 3 && old->second != lod)
                    {
                        const UINT level = (std::max)(lod, old->second);
                        if (level)
                        {
                            const float boundary = 35.f * float(1u << (level - 1));
                            if (abs(distance - boundary) < boundary * .12f)
                            {
                                lod = old->second;
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    UINT selected = 0;
                    if (rayProxy && !important && distance > 200 && mesh.RayProxyVertices && mesh.RayProxyIndices)
                    {
                        entry.Vertices = mesh.RayProxyVertices;
                        entry.Indices = mesh.RayProxyIndices;
                        entry.VertexView = mesh.RayProxyVertexView;
                        entry.IndexView = mesh.RayProxyIndexView;
                        entry.VertexState = D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_VERTEX_AND_CONSTANT_BUFFER;
                        entry.IndexState = D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_INDEX_BUFFER;
                        entry.IndexCount = 36;
                        entry.Texture.Reset();
                        entry.TextureIndex = -1;
                        entry.EmissionTexture.Reset();
                        selected = 4;
                    }
                    else if (lod && mesh.RayLodBuffers[lod - 1])
                    {
                        entry.Indices = mesh.RayLodBuffers[lod - 1];
                        entry.IndexView = mesh.RayLodViews[lod - 1];
                        entry.IndexCount = mesh.RayLodCounts[lod - 1];
                        entry.IndexState = D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_INDEX_BUFFER;
                        selected = lod;
                    }
                    if (old != previous.end() && old->second != selected)
                    {
                        TemporalHistory::Context::NotifyLodChanged();
                    }
                    if (previous.size() > 65536)
                    {
                        previous.clear();
                    }
                    previous[key] = selected;
                }
            }
            geometry.push_back(move(entry));
        }
    }
} // 名前空間

vector<RaytracingGeometry> GatherRaytracingGeometry()
{
    vector<RaytracingGeometry> geometry;
    geometry.reserve(World::GetView<MeshComponent>().size());
    for (EntityID entity : World::GetView<MeshComponent, TransformComponent>())
    {
        if (!IsOpaqueCaster(entity))
        {
            continue;
        }
        const auto& mesh = ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<MeshComponent>(entity);
        if (!mesh.VertexBuffer || mesh.VertexCount < 3)
        {
            continue;
        }
        RaytracingGeometry entry;
        entry.SurfaceOwner = (static_cast<uint64_t>(entity) << 32) | 0x80000000ull;
        entry.Vertices = mesh.VertexBuffer;
        entry.VertexView = mesh.VertexBufferView;
        entry.World = ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<TransformComponent>(entity).WorldMatrix;
        SetMaterial(entry, entity);
        VertexDeformationView deformation;
        if (VertexDeformation::TryResolveMesh(entity, deformation))
        {
            entry.Vertices = deformation.CurrentResource;
            entry.VertexView = deformation.CurrentView;
            entry.VertexState = D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_VERTEX_AND_CONSTANT_BUFFER;
            entry.Deforming = true;
        }
        geometry.push_back(move(entry));
    }
    for (EntityID entity : World::GetView<StaticModelComponent, TransformComponent>())
    {
        const auto& component = ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<StaticModelComponent>(entity);
        AppendModel(geometry, entity, ModelManager::GetStaticModel(component.ModelId), false);
    }
    for (EntityID entity : World::GetView<AnimationModelComponent, TransformComponent>())
    {
        const auto& component = ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<AnimationModelComponent>(entity);
        AppendModel(geometry, entity, ModelManager::GetAnimModel(component.ModelId), true);
    }
    return geometry;
}

bool RenderCapture::ReadBuffer(ID3D12Resource* source, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATES state, UINT64 bytes,
                               vector<uint8_t>& output)
{
    auto* device = GraphicsDevice::GetDevice();
    if (!device || !source || !bytes || source->GetDesc().Dimension != D3D12_RESOURCE_DIMENSION_BUFFER ||
        bytes > source->GetDesc().Width || !GraphicsDevice::WaitForGpuIdle())
    {
        return false;
    }
    ComPtr<ID3D12Resource> readback;
    ComPtr<ID3D12CommandAllocator> allocator;
    ComPtr<ID3D12GraphicsCommandList> commands;
    const auto heap = CD3DX12_HEAP_PROPERTIES(D3D12_HEAP_TYPE_READBACK);
    const auto description = CD3DX12_RESOURCE_DESC::Buffer(bytes);
    if (FAILED(device->CreateCommittedResource(&heap, D3D12_HEAP_FLAG_NONE, &description,
                                               D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_COPY_DEST, nullptr, IID_PPV_ARGS(&readback))) ||
        FAILED(device->CreateCommandAllocator(D3D12_COMMAND_LIST_TYPE_DIRECT, IID_PPV_ARGS(&allocator))) ||
        FAILED(device->CreateCommandList(0, D3D12_COMMAND_LIST_TYPE_DIRECT, allocator.Get(), nullptr,
                                         IID_PPV_ARGS(&commands))))
    {
        return false;
    }
    auto barrier = CD3DX12_RESOURCE_BARRIER::Transition(source, state, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_COPY_SOURCE);
    commands->ResourceBarrier(1, &barrier);
    commands->CopyBufferRegion(readback.Get(), 0, source, 0, bytes);
    barrier = CD3DX12_RESOURCE_BARRIER::Transition(source, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_COPY_SOURCE, state);
    commands->ResourceBarrier(1, &barrier);
    if (FAILED(commands->Close()))
    {
        return false;
    }
    ID3D12CommandList* lists[] = {commands.Get()};
    GraphicsDevice::GetCommandQueue()->ExecuteCommandLists(1, lists);
    if (!GraphicsDevice::WaitForGpuIdle())
    {
        return false;
    }
    void* mapped = nullptr;
    const CD3DX12_RANGE range(0, static_cast<SIZE_T>(bytes));
    if (FAILED(readback->Map(0, &range, &mapped)))
    {
        return false;
    }
    output.resize(static_cast<size_t>(bytes));
    memcpy(output.data(), mapped, output.size());
    const CD3DX12_RANGE noWrite(0, 0);
    readback->Unmap(0, &noWrite);
    return true;
}

bool RenderCapture::ReadTexture(ID3D12Resource* texture, TextureData& output)
{
    return ReadTextureMip(texture, output, 0, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE);
}

static bool ReadTextureSubresource(ID3D12Resource* texture, RenderCapture::TextureData& output, UINT mip,
                                   D3D12_RESOURCE_STATES state)
{
    ID3D12Device* device = GraphicsDevice::GetDevice();
    if (!device || !texture || !GraphicsDevice::WaitForGpuIdle())
    {
        return false;
    }
    const auto description = texture->GetDesc();
    if (mip >= description.MipLevels * description.DepthOrArraySize)
    {
        return false;
    }
    D3D12_PLACED_SUBRESOURCE_FOOTPRINT footprint{};
    UINT64 bytes = 0;
    device->GetCopyableFootprints(&description, mip, 1, 0, &footprint, nullptr, nullptr, &bytes);
    ComPtr<ID3D12Resource> readback;
    const auto heap = CD3DX12_HEAP_PROPERTIES(D3D12_HEAP_TYPE_READBACK);
    const auto buffer = CD3DX12_RESOURCE_DESC::Buffer(bytes);
    ComPtr<ID3D12CommandAllocator> allocator;
    ComPtr<ID3D12GraphicsCommandList> commands;
    if (FAILED(device->CreateCommittedResource(&heap, D3D12_HEAP_FLAG_NONE, &buffer, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_COPY_DEST,
                                               nullptr, IID_PPV_ARGS(&readback))) ||
        FAILED(device->CreateCommandAllocator(D3D12_COMMAND_LIST_TYPE_DIRECT, IID_PPV_ARGS(&allocator))) ||
        FAILED(device->CreateCommandList(0, D3D12_COMMAND_LIST_TYPE_DIRECT, allocator.Get(), nullptr,
                                         IID_PPV_ARGS(&commands))))
    {
        return false;
    }
    auto barrier = CD3DX12_RESOURCE_BARRIER::Transition(texture, state, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_COPY_SOURCE, mip);
    commands->ResourceBarrier(1, &barrier);
    const CD3DX12_TEXTURE_COPY_LOCATION destination(readback.Get(), footprint);
    const CD3DX12_TEXTURE_COPY_LOCATION source(texture, mip);
    commands->CopyTextureRegion(&destination, 0, 0, 0, &source, nullptr);
    barrier = CD3DX12_RESOURCE_BARRIER::Transition(texture, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_COPY_SOURCE, state, mip);
    commands->ResourceBarrier(1, &barrier);
    if (FAILED(commands->Close()))
    {
        return false;
    }
    ID3D12CommandList* lists[] = {commands.Get()};
    GraphicsDevice::GetCommandQueue()->ExecuteCommandLists(1, lists);
    if (!GraphicsDevice::WaitForGpuIdle())
    {
        return false;
    }
    void* mapped = nullptr;
    const CD3DX12_RANGE readRange(0, static_cast<SIZE_T>(bytes));
    if (FAILED(readback->Map(0, &readRange, &mapped)))
    {
        return false;
    }
    output.Width = footprint.Footprint.Width;
    output.Height = footprint.Footprint.Height;
    output.RowPitch = footprint.Footprint.RowPitch;
    output.Format = description.Format;
    output.Bytes.resize(static_cast<size_t>(bytes));
    memcpy(output.Bytes.data(), mapped, static_cast<size_t>(bytes));
    const CD3DX12_RANGE noWrite(0, 0);
    readback->Unmap(0, &noWrite);
    return true;
}

bool RenderCapture::ReadTextureMip(ID3D12Resource* texture, TextureData& output, UINT mip, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATES state)
{
    return texture && mip < texture->GetDesc().MipLevels && ReadTextureSubresource(texture, output, mip, state);
}

bool RenderCapture::ReadTextureSlice(ID3D12Resource* texture, TextureData& output, UINT slice)
{
    return texture && slice < texture->GetDesc().DepthOrArraySize &&
           ReadTextureSubresource(texture, output, slice * texture->GetDesc().MipLevels,
                                  D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE);
}

float RenderCapture::HalfToFloat(uint16_t value)
{
    const float sign = (value & 0x8000u) != 0 ? -1.0f : 1.0f;
    const int exponent = (value >> 10) & 31;
    const int mantissa = value & 1023;
    if (exponent == 0)
    {
        return sign * ldexp(static_cast<float>(mantissa), -24);
    }
    if (exponent == 31)
    {
        return numeric_limits<float>::infinity();
    }
    return sign * ldexp(static_cast<float>(mantissa + 1024), exponent - 25);
}

bool RenderCapture::SaveScenePng(const wchar_t* path)
{
    return SaveTexturePng(RenderTargets::GetEditorSceneResource(), path);
}

bool RenderCapture::SaveTexturePng(ID3D12Resource* resource, const wchar_t* path)
{
    TextureData texture;
    if (!ReadTexture(resource, texture) ||
        (texture.Format != DXGI_FORMAT_R8G8B8A8_UNORM && texture.Format != DXGI_FORMAT_R16G16B16A16_FLOAT))
    {
        return false;
    }
    vector<BYTE> pixels(static_cast<size_t>(texture.Width) * texture.Height * 4);
    for (UINT row = 0; row < texture.Height; ++row)
    {
        for (UINT column = 0; column < texture.Width; ++column)
        {
            BYTE* destination = pixels.data() + (static_cast<size_t>(row) * texture.Width + column) * 4;
            const BYTE* source = texture.Bytes.data() + static_cast<size_t>(row) * texture.RowPitch;
            if (texture.Format == DXGI_FORMAT_R8G8B8A8_UNORM)
            {
                source += column * 4;
                destination[0] = source[2];
                destination[1] = source[1];
                destination[2] = source[0];
            }
            else
            {
                const auto* components = reinterpret_cast<const uint16_t*>(source) + column * 4;
                for (UINT channel = 0; channel < 3; ++channel)
                {
                    const float color = HalfToFloat(components[2 - channel]);
                    if (!isfinite(color))
                    {
                        return false;
                    }
                    destination[channel] = static_cast<BYTE>(clamp(color, 0.0f, 1.0f) * 255.0f + 0.5f);
                }
            }
            destination[3] = 255;
        }
    }
    const HRESULT apartmentResult = CoInitializeEx(nullptr, COINIT_MULTITHREADED);
    ComPtr<IWICImagingFactory> factory;
    ComPtr<IWICStream> stream;
    ComPtr<IWICBitmapEncoder> encoder;
    ComPtr<IWICBitmapFrameEncode> frame;
    WICPixelFormatGUID format = GUID_WICPixelFormat32bppBGRA;
    const bool saved =
        SUCCEEDED(CoCreateInstance(CLSID_WICImagingFactory, nullptr, CLSCTX_INPROC_SERVER, IID_PPV_ARGS(&factory))) &&
        SUCCEEDED(factory->CreateStream(&stream)) && SUCCEEDED(stream->InitializeFromFilename(path, GENERIC_WRITE)) &&
        SUCCEEDED(factory->CreateEncoder(GUID_ContainerFormatPng, nullptr, &encoder)) &&
        SUCCEEDED(encoder->Initialize(stream.Get(), WICBitmapEncoderNoCache)) &&
        SUCCEEDED(encoder->CreateNewFrame(&frame, nullptr)) && SUCCEEDED(frame->Initialize(nullptr)) &&
        SUCCEEDED(frame->SetSize(texture.Width, texture.Height)) && SUCCEEDED(frame->SetPixelFormat(&format)) &&
        SUCCEEDED(
            frame->WritePixels(texture.Height, texture.Width * 4, static_cast<UINT>(pixels.size()), pixels.data())) &&
        SUCCEEDED(frame->Commit()) && SUCCEEDED(encoder->Commit());
    frame.Reset();
    encoder.Reset();
    stream.Reset();
    factory.Reset();
    if (SUCCEEDED(apartmentResult))
    {
        CoUninitialize();
    }
    return saved;
}

UINT RenderCapture::ReportGraphicsErrors()
{
    ComPtr<ID3D12InfoQueue> info;
    if (FAILED(GraphicsDevice::GetDevice()->QueryInterface(IID_PPV_ARGS(&info))))
    {
        WriteGraphicsLog("Validation: D3D12 debug queue unavailable\n");
        return 0;
    }
    UINT errorCount = 0;
    for (UINT64 index = 0; index < info->GetNumStoredMessagesAllowedByRetrievalFilter(); ++index)
    {
        SIZE_T bytes = 0;
        info->GetMessage(index, nullptr, &bytes);
        vector<BYTE> storage(bytes);
        auto* message = reinterpret_cast<D3D12_MESSAGE*>(storage.data());
        if (FAILED(info->GetMessage(index, message, &bytes)))
        {
            continue;
        }
        if (message->ID == D3D12_MESSAGE_ID_GPU_BASED_VALIDATION_RESOURCE_STATE_IMPRECISE)
        {
            WriteGraphicsLog("D3D12 validation tracking limitation id=%u: %s\n", static_cast<UINT>(message->ID),
                             message->pDescription);
        }
        if (message->Severity == D3D12_MESSAGE_SEVERITY_ERROR || message->Severity == D3D12_MESSAGE_SEVERITY_CORRUPTION)
        {
            ++errorCount;
            WriteGraphicsLog("D3D12 validation error: %s\n", message->pDescription);
        }
    }
    WriteGraphicsLog("Validation: D3D12 errors = %u\n", errorCount);
    return errorCount;
}

#include "pch.h"
#include "renderconfiguration.h"
#include "graphicslog.h"
#include "graphicsdevice.h"
#include "rendertargets.h"
#include "componentmanager.h"
#include "world.h"
#include "psomanager.h"

void RenderConfiguration::Resize(UINT width, UINT height)
{
    if (!m_SwapChain || !m_Device)
    {
        return;
    }
    if (width == 0 || height == 0)
    {
        return;
    }
    if (width == m_Width && height == m_Height)
    {
        return;
    }
    if (!GraphicsDevice::CheckDeviceHealth(S_OK, "Resize begin"))
    {
        PostMessage(m_Hwnd, WM_CLOSE, 0, 0);
        return;
    }

    if (m_CommandQueue && m_Fence && m_FenceEvent)
    {
        m_CurrentFenceValue++;
        const HRESULT signalHr = m_CommandQueue->Signal(m_Fence.Get(), m_CurrentFenceValue);
        if (!GraphicsDevice::CheckDeviceHealth(signalHr, "Resize fence signal"))
        {
            PostMessage(m_Hwnd, WM_CLOSE, 0, 0);
            return;
        }
        if (m_Fence->GetCompletedValue() < m_CurrentFenceValue)
        {
            m_Fence->SetEventOnCompletion(m_CurrentFenceValue, m_FenceEvent);
            WaitForSingleObject(m_FenceEvent, INFINITE);
        }

        for (UINT i = 0; i < g_kFRAME_COUNT; ++i)
        {
            m_FenceValues[i] = m_CurrentFenceValue;
        }
    }

    for (UINT n = 0; n < g_kFRAME_COUNT; n++)
    {
        m_RenderTargets[n].Reset();
    }

    m_DepthStencilBuffer.Reset();

    UINT tearingFlag;
    if (m_AllowTearing)
    {
        tearingFlag = DXGI_SWAP_CHAIN_FLAG_ALLOW_TEARING;
    }
    else
    {
        tearingFlag = 0;
    }
    HRESULT hr = m_SwapChain->ResizeBuffers(g_kFRAME_COUNT, width, height, DXGI_FORMAT_R8G8B8A8_UNORM,
                                            DXGI_SWAP_CHAIN_FLAG_FRAME_LATENCY_WAITABLE_OBJECT | (tearingFlag));
    if (FAILED(hr))
    {
        WriteGraphicsLog("ERROR: ResizeBuffers failed\n");
        GraphicsDevice::CheckDeviceHealth(hr, "ResizeBuffers");
        return;
    }

    m_FrameIndex = m_SwapChain->GetCurrentBackBufferIndex();

    UINT rtvSize = m_Device->GetDescriptorHandleIncrementSize(D3D12_DESCRIPTOR_HEAP_TYPE_RTV);
    CD3DX12_CPU_DESCRIPTOR_HANDLE rtvHandle(m_RtvHeap->GetCPUDescriptorHandleForHeapStart());
    for (UINT n = 0; n < g_kFRAME_COUNT; n++)
    {
        m_SwapChain->GetBuffer(n, IID_PPV_ARGS(&m_RenderTargets[n]));
        m_Device->CreateRenderTargetView(m_RenderTargets[n].Get(), nullptr, rtvHandle);
        rtvHandle.Offset(1, rtvSize);
    }

    UINT sceneWidth = max((UINT)roundf(width * m_ResolutionScale), 1u);
    UINT sceneHeight = max((UINT)roundf(height * m_ResolutionScale), 1u);
    D3D12_RESOURCE_DESC depthDesc{};
    depthDesc.Dimension = D3D12_RESOURCE_DIMENSION_TEXTURE2D;
    depthDesc.Width = width;
    depthDesc.Height = height;
    depthDesc.DepthOrArraySize = 1;
    depthDesc.MipLevels = 1;
    depthDesc.Format = DXGI_FORMAT_R32_TYPELESS;
    depthDesc.SampleDesc.Count = 1;
    depthDesc.Flags = D3D12_RESOURCE_FLAG_ALLOW_DEPTH_STENCIL;

    D3D12_CLEAR_VALUE clearValue{};
    clearValue.Format = DXGI_FORMAT_D32_FLOAT;
    clearValue.DepthStencil.Depth = 0.0f;
    clearValue.DepthStencil.Stencil = 0;

    auto heapProps = CD3DX12_HEAP_PROPERTIES(D3D12_HEAP_TYPE_DEFAULT);
    hr = m_Device->CreateCommittedResource(&heapProps, D3D12_HEAP_FLAG_NONE, &depthDesc,
                                           D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE, &clearValue,
                                           IID_PPV_ARGS(&m_DepthStencilBuffer));
    if (FAILED(hr))
    {
        WriteGraphicsLog("ERROR: Resize CreateCommittedResource(Depth) failed\n");
        return;
    }

    D3D12_DEPTH_STENCIL_VIEW_DESC dsvDesc{};
    dsvDesc.Format = DXGI_FORMAT_D32_FLOAT;
    dsvDesc.ViewDimension = D3D12_DSV_DIMENSION_TEXTURE2D;
    m_Device->CreateDepthStencilView(m_DepthStencilBuffer.Get(), &dsvDesc,
                                     m_DsvHeap->GetCPUDescriptorHandleForHeapStart());
    dsvDesc.Flags = D3D12_DSV_FLAG_READ_ONLY_DEPTH;
    m_Device->CreateDepthStencilView(
        m_DepthStencilBuffer.Get(), &dsvDesc,
        CD3DX12_CPU_DESCRIPTOR_HANDLE(m_DsvHeap->GetCPUDescriptorHandleForHeapStart(), g_kFULL_DEPTH_READ_DSV_INDEX,
                                      m_Device->GetDescriptorHandleIncrementSize(D3D12_DESCRIPTOR_HEAP_TYPE_DSV)));
    m_DepthStencilState = D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE;

    // リサイズで深度リソースが置き換わるため、シェーダービューも更新する。
    // ネイティブジオメトリの第2パスで、Hi-Z がこの記述子を読む。
    D3D12_SHADER_RESOURCE_VIEW_DESC depthSrvDesc{};
    depthSrvDesc.Shader4ComponentMapping = D3D12_DEFAULT_SHADER_4_COMPONENT_MAPPING;
    depthSrvDesc.Format = DXGI_FORMAT_R32_FLOAT;
    depthSrvDesc.ViewDimension = D3D12_SRV_DIMENSION_TEXTURE2D;
    depthSrvDesc.Texture2D.MipLevels = 1;
    const UINT srvIncrement = m_Device->GetDescriptorHandleIncrementSize(D3D12_DESCRIPTOR_HEAP_TYPE_CBV_SRV_UAV);
    m_Device->CreateShaderResourceView(m_DepthStencilBuffer.Get(), &depthSrvDesc,
                                       CD3DX12_CPU_DESCRIPTOR_HANDLE(m_CbvHeap->GetCPUDescriptorHandleForHeapStart(),
                                                                     g_kDEPTH_SRV_INDEX, srvIncrement));

    m_Width = width;
    m_Height = height;
    m_SceneWidth = sceneWidth;
    m_SceneHeight = sceneHeight;

    m_Viewport = CD3DX12_VIEWPORT(0.0f, 0.0f, (float)m_SceneWidth, (float)m_SceneHeight);
    m_ScissorRect = CD3DX12_RECT(0, 0, m_SceneWidth, m_SceneHeight);
    m_FullViewport = CD3DX12_VIEWPORT(0.0f, 0.0f, (float)m_Width, (float)m_Height);
    m_FullScissorRect = CD3DX12_RECT(0, 0, m_Width, m_Height);

    RenderTargets::CreateSceneRenderTarget();
}

void RenderConfiguration::ApplyPendingRenderMode()
{
    m_PendingRenderMode = RenderMode::DEFERRED;
    if (!m_HasPendingRenderMode || m_RenderMode == m_PendingRenderMode)
    {
        m_HasPendingRenderMode = false;
        m_RenderMode = RenderMode::DEFERRED;
        return;
    }

    if (m_CommandQueue && m_Fence && m_FenceEvent)
    {
        m_CurrentFenceValue++;
        m_CommandQueue->Signal(m_Fence.Get(), m_CurrentFenceValue);
        if (m_Fence->GetCompletedValue() < m_CurrentFenceValue)
        {
            m_Fence->SetEventOnCompletion(m_CurrentFenceValue, m_FenceEvent);
            WaitForSingleObject(m_FenceEvent, INFINITE);
        }

        for (UINT i = 0; i < g_kFRAME_COUNT; ++i)
        {
            m_FenceValues[i] = m_CurrentFenceValue;
        }
    }

    m_RenderMode = m_PendingRenderMode;
    m_HasPendingRenderMode = false;

    for (EntityID entity : World::GetView<ShaderComponent>())
    {
        ComponentManager::GetComponent<ShaderComponent>(entity).Pso.Reset();
    }
    m_PsoCache.clear();

    if (m_Device && m_SceneWidth > 0 && m_SceneHeight > 0)
    {
        RenderTargets::CreateSceneRenderTarget();
    }
}

void RenderConfiguration::SetRenderMode(RenderMode mode)
{
    (void)mode;
    if (GetRequestedRenderMode() == RenderMode::DEFERRED)
    {
        return;
    }

    m_PendingRenderMode = RenderMode::DEFERRED;
    m_HasPendingRenderMode = true;
}

void RenderConfiguration::InvalidateScenePipelineCache()
{
    m_PsoCache.clear();
    for (EntityID entity : World::GetView<ShaderComponent>())
    {
        ComponentManager::GetComponent<ShaderComponent>(entity).Pso.Reset();
    }
}

void RenderConfiguration::SetHdr(bool enabled)
{
    DXGI_FORMAT targetFormat;
    if (enabled)
    {
        targetFormat = DXGI_FORMAT_R16G16B16A16_FLOAT;
    }
    else
    {
        targetFormat = DXGI_FORMAT_R8G8B8A8_UNORM;
    }
    if (m_SceneColorFormat == targetFormat)
    {
        return;
    }
    m_PendingHdr = enabled;
    m_HasPendingHdr = true;
}

void RenderConfiguration::SetResolutionScale(float scale)
{
    const float clampedScale = clamp(scale, 0.20f, 1.0f); // FSR / NIS（多段）とも 20% まで
    if (fabsf(GetResolutionScale() - clampedScale) < 0.0001f)
    {
        return;
    }
    m_PendingResolutionScale = clampedScale;
    m_HasPendingResolutionScale = true;
}

void RenderConfiguration::ApplyPendingResolutionScale()
{
    if (!m_HasPendingResolutionScale)
    {
        return;
    }

    const UINT sceneWidth = max((UINT)roundf(m_Width * m_PendingResolutionScale), 1u);
    const UINT sceneHeight = max((UINT)roundf(m_Height * m_PendingResolutionScale), 1u);
    if (sceneWidth == m_SceneWidth && sceneHeight == m_SceneHeight)
    {
        m_ResolutionScale = m_PendingResolutionScale;
        m_HasPendingResolutionScale = false;
        return;
    }

    if (m_CommandQueue && m_Fence && m_FenceEvent)
    {
        m_CurrentFenceValue++;
        m_CommandQueue->Signal(m_Fence.Get(), m_CurrentFenceValue);
        if (m_Fence->GetCompletedValue() < m_CurrentFenceValue)
        {
            m_Fence->SetEventOnCompletion(m_CurrentFenceValue, m_FenceEvent);
            WaitForSingleObject(m_FenceEvent, INFINITE);
        }
        for (UINT i = 0; i < g_kFRAME_COUNT; ++i)
        {
            m_FenceValues[i] = m_CurrentFenceValue;
        }
    }

    m_ResolutionScale = m_PendingResolutionScale;
    m_HasPendingResolutionScale = false;
    m_SceneWidth = sceneWidth;
    m_SceneHeight = sceneHeight;
    m_Viewport = CD3DX12_VIEWPORT(0.0f, 0.0f, (float)m_SceneWidth, (float)m_SceneHeight);
    m_ScissorRect = CD3DX12_RECT(0, 0, m_SceneWidth, m_SceneHeight);
    RenderTargets::CreateSceneRenderTarget();
}

void RenderConfiguration::ApplyPendingHdr()
{
    DXGI_FORMAT requestedFormat = DXGI_FORMAT_R8G8B8A8_UNORM;
    if (m_PendingHdr)
    {
        requestedFormat = DXGI_FORMAT_R16G16B16A16_FLOAT;
    }
    if (!m_HasPendingHdr || m_SceneColorFormat == requestedFormat)
    {
        m_HasPendingHdr = false;
        return;
    }

    if (m_CommandQueue && m_Fence && m_FenceEvent)
    {
        m_CurrentFenceValue++;
        m_CommandQueue->Signal(m_Fence.Get(), m_CurrentFenceValue);
        if (m_Fence->GetCompletedValue() < m_CurrentFenceValue)
        {
            m_Fence->SetEventOnCompletion(m_CurrentFenceValue, m_FenceEvent);
            WaitForSingleObject(m_FenceEvent, INFINITE);
        }

        for (UINT i = 0; i < g_kFRAME_COUNT; ++i)
        {
            m_FenceValues[i] = m_CurrentFenceValue;
        }
    }

    if (m_PendingHdr)
    {
        m_SceneColorFormat = DXGI_FORMAT_R16G16B16A16_FLOAT;
    }
    else
    {
        m_SceneColorFormat = DXGI_FORMAT_R8G8B8A8_UNORM;
    }
    m_HasPendingHdr = false;

    m_PsoCache.clear();
    m_PostProcessPsoMap.clear();
    m_DeferredLightingPso.Reset();
    m_DeferredLightingRasterPso.Reset();
    m_AtmospherePso.Reset();

    for (EntityID entity : World::GetView<ShaderComponent>())
    {
        ComponentManager::GetComponent<ShaderComponent>(entity).Pso.Reset();
    }

    if (m_Device && m_SceneWidth > 0 && m_SceneHeight > 0)
    {
        RenderTargets::CreateSceneRenderTarget();
    }

    PsoManager::CreatePostProcessPipelines();
    PsoManager::CreateDeferredLightingPipeline();
    PsoManager::CreateAtmospherePso();

    m_UpscaleBilateralPso.Reset();
    PsoManager::CreateUpscalePso();
    m_UpscaleDepthPso.Reset();
    PsoManager::CreateUpscaleDepthPso();
    m_VelocityPso.Reset();
    PsoManager::CreateVelocityPso();
    m_VelocityGeometryPso.Reset();
    PsoManager::CreateVelocityGeometryPso();

    m_FxaaPso.Reset();
    m_TaaBlendPso.Reset();
    PsoManager::CreateAaPsos();
}

  private:
    inline static bool s_IesProfilesEnabled = true;
    template <typename T> static void SetValue(T& destination, const T& value)
    {
        if (destination != value)
        {
            destination = value;
            ++s_Revision;
        }

    static constexpr uint32_t g_kFRAME_COUNT = 3;

    static constexpr UINT g_kMAX_SHADER_LIGHTS = 160;
    static constexpr UINT g_kLIGHT_TILE_SIZE = 16;
    static constexpr UINT g_kMAX_LIGHTS_PER_TILE = 8;

    static constexpr UINT g_kGEOMETRY_GBUFFER_BITS_PER_PIXEL = 192;
    static_assert(g_kGEOMETRY_GBUFFER_BITS_PER_PIXEL <= 256,
                  "Stage renderer GBuffer must stay within the 256-bit bandwidth budget");
    static constexpr UINT g_kMAX_LIGHT_GRID_WIDTH = 7680;
    static constexpr UINT g_kMAX_LIGHT_GRID_HEIGHT = 4320;

        ((g_kMAX_LIGHT_GRID_WIDTH + g_kLIGHT_TILE_SIZE - 1) / g_kLIGHT_TILE_SIZE) *
        ((g_kMAX_LIGHT_GRID_HEIGHT + g_kLIGHT_TILE_SIZE - 1) / g_kLIGHT_TILE_SIZE);

    static constexpr UINT g_kMAX_SHADOW_LIGHTS = 8;
    static constexpr UINT g_kFULL_DEPTH_READ_DSV_INDEX = g_kMAX_SHADOW_LIGHTS + 2;
    static constexpr UINT g_kLOW_DEPTH_READ_DSV_INDEX = g_kFULL_DEPTH_READ_DSV_INDEX + 1;

    static constexpr UINT g_kMAX_SHADOW_PASSES = g_kMAX_VIRTUAL_SHADOW_LEVELS *
                                                     g_kVIRTUAL_SHADOW_RESIDENT_PAGES_PER_DIMENSION *

    static CD3DX12_VIEWPORT m_Viewport;
    static CD3DX12_VIEWPORT m_FullViewport;

    static CD3DX12_RECT m_ScissorRect;

  public:
    static AntiAliasingMode m_AntiAliasingMode;
    static XMFLOAT4X4 m_PrevViewMatrix;
    static XMFLOAT4X4 m_PrevProjMatrix;
    static UINT m_TaaFrameIndex;
    static ComPtr<ID3D12RootSignature> m_AaRootSignature;

    static CD3DX12_CPU_DESCRIPTOR_HANDLE m_AaRtvHandle;
    static CD3DX12_GPU_DESCRIPTOR_HANDLE m_AaSrvHandle;

    static constexpr float m_kSceneClearColor[4] = {0.1f, 0.2f, 0.4f, 1.0f};
    static constexpr DXGI_FORMAT m_kDeferredRtvFormats[g_kGBUFFER_COUNT] = {
        // Normal alpha stores the negative POM displacement along the camera ray.
        // Signed floating point keeps the mesh shadow receiver independent of the displaced depth.
        DXGI_FORMAT_R8G8B8A8_UNORM,     DXGI_FORMAT_R16G16B16A16_FLOAT, DXGI_FORMAT_R32_FLOAT,
        DXGI_FORMAT_R16G16B16A16_FLOAT, DXGI_FORMAT_R8G8B8A8_UNORM,
        DXGI_FORMAT_R16G16B16A16_FLOAT, // 発光 RGB とマテリアル AO。
        DXGI_FORMAT_R16G16B16A16_FLOAT, DXGI_FORMAT_R16G16B16A16_FLOAT, DXGI_FORMAT_R32G32B32A32_UINT,
        DXGI_FORMAT_R16G16B16A16_FLOAT};

  public:
    static constexpr uint32_t g_kSCREEN_WIDTH = 800;
    static constexpr uint32_t g_kSCREEN_HEIGHT = 600;
    static constexpr float g_kNEAR_CLIP = 0.1f;
    static constexpr float g_kFAR_CLIP = 100.0f;
    static constexpr float g_kDEFAULT_RESOLUTION_SCALE = 0.5f;

    static constexpr UINT g_kCB_ALIGNED_SIZE = (sizeof(ConstantBuffer3D) + 255) & ~255;
    // カメラと HDR の56個の float、および品質設定の11個の float4（renderquality.h）。
    static constexpr UINT g_kPP_CB_ALIGNED_SIZE = (sizeof(float) * (56 + 44) + 255) & ~255;
    static constexpr UINT g_kPP_CB_SLOTS_PER_FRAME = 32;

    static UINT GetPostProcessFrameOffset()
    {
        return m_FrameIndex * g_kPP_CB_SLOTS_PER_FRAME * g_kPP_CB_ALIGNED_SIZE;
    }

    static constexpr UINT g_kMAX_LOCAL_HEIGHT_FOG_VOLUMES = 16;
    static constexpr UINT g_kMAX_DISTANCE_FIELD_SHADOW_OBJECTS = 16;
    static constexpr UINT g_kLIGHT_CB_FLOAT4_COUNT = 10 + g_kMAX_SHADER_LIGHTS * 10 + g_kMAX_VIRTUAL_SHADOW_LEVELS * 6 +
                                                     16 + 3 + g_kMAX_DISTANCE_FIELD_SHADOW_OBJECTS * 2 + 1 +
                                                     g_kMAX_LOCAL_HEIGHT_FOG_VOLUMES * 3 + 1 + 2 + g_kMAX_SHADER_LIGHTS +
                                                     5 /* LiveToonStyle */;
    static constexpr UINT g_kLIGHT_CB_ALIGNED_SIZE = (sizeof(float) * 4 * g_kLIGHT_CB_FLOAT4_COUNT + 255) & ~255;
    // 現在のマテリアルは15個のパーツ上書きを含み、2048バイトを超える。
    static constexpr UINT g_kPBR_CB_ALIGNED_SIZE = (sizeof(float) * 768 + 255) & ~255;
    static constexpr UINT g_kPBR_CB_SLOT_COUNT = g_kMAX_ENTITIES + 1;
    static constexpr UINT g_kPBR_CB_TOTAL_SLOT_COUNT = g_kPBR_CB_SLOT_COUNT * g_kFRAME_COUNT;
    static constexpr UINT g_kSHADOW_CB_ALIGNED_SIZE = (sizeof(XMMATRIX) + sizeof(float) * 8 + 255) & ~255;
    static constexpr UINT g_kSHADOW_CB_SLOT_COUNT = g_kFRAME_COUNT * g_kMAX_SHADOW_PASSES;

    static constexpr UINT g_kSHADOW_MAP_SIZE = 2048;
    inline static UINT m_ShadowMapSize = g_kSHADOW_MAP_SIZE;

    static UINT GetShadowMapSize()
    {
        return m_ShadowMapSize;
    }

    static constexpr UINT g_kSHADOW_MAP_SIZE_SMALL = 1024;
    static constexpr UINT g_kVIRTUAL_SHADOW_PAGE_SIZE = 128;
    static constexpr UINT g_kVIRTUAL_SHADOW_PAGES_PER_DIMENSION = g_kSHADOW_MAP_SIZE / g_kVIRTUAL_SHADOW_PAGE_SIZE;
    static_assert((g_kVIRTUAL_SHADOW_PAGES_PER_DIMENSION & (g_kVIRTUAL_SHADOW_PAGES_PER_DIMENSION - 1)) == 0,
                  "VSM ring addressing requires a power-of-two physical page grid");
    // 速度パスと輪郭線パスは、各エンティティに個別のコピーを必要とする場合がある。
    // メインパスのアップロードは、描画を記録した後に上書きしてはならない。
    static constexpr UINT g_kTRANSIENT_CB_SLOT_COUNT = g_kMAX_ENTITIES * 2 + 2048;
    static constexpr UINT g_kTRANSIENT_CB_START_INDEX = g_kMAX_ENTITIES;
    static constexpr UINT g_kCBV_PER_FRAME_COUNT = g_kMAX_ENTITIES + g_kTRANSIENT_CB_SLOT_COUNT;
    static constexpr UINT g_kCBV_COUNT = g_kCBV_PER_FRAME_COUNT * g_kFRAME_COUNT;
    static constexpr uint32_t g_kMAX_SRVS = 512;
    static constexpr UINT g_kTEXTURE_SRV_START_INDEX = g_kCBV_COUNT;
    static constexpr UINT g_kSCENE_SRV_INDEX = g_kTEXTURE_SRV_START_INDEX + g_kMAX_SRVS;
    static constexpr UINT g_kEDITOR_SCENE_SRV_INDEX = g_kSCENE_SRV_INDEX + 1;
    static constexpr UINT g_kGBUFFER_SRV_START_INDEX = g_kEDITOR_SCENE_SRV_INDEX + 1;
    static constexpr UINT g_kIMGUI_SRV_INDEX = g_kGBUFFER_SRV_START_INDEX + g_kGBUFFER_COUNT;
    static constexpr UINT g_kSHADOW_SRV_INDEX = g_kIMGUI_SRV_INDEX + 1;
    static constexpr UINT g_kAA_SRV_INDEX = g_kSHADOW_SRV_INDEX + 1;
    static constexpr UINT g_kAA_HISTORY_SRV_INDEX = g_kAA_SRV_INDEX + 1;
    static constexpr UINT g_kTRANSPARENT_SCENE_SRV_INDEX = g_kAA_HISTORY_SRV_INDEX + 1;

===== FILE: source\rendering\renderfeature.h =====
#pragma once

#include <cmath>
#include <cstdint>

// ハードウェア対応の有無だけを示す。GPU コマンドを記録する前に各機能でシェーダーの可用性と
// 実行時リソースの準備完了を確認する必要がある。
namespace RenderFeature
{
    struct Capabilities
    {
        bool MeshShader = false;
        bool Raytracing = false;
        bool SamplerFeedback = false;
        bool ReservedResources = false;
        bool BindlessResources = false;
        // SM6.2 のネイティブ 16bit 演算（-enable-16bit-types）。Requirements には含めない（各シェーダーが自動で退避）。
        bool Native16BitShaderOps = false;
    };

    struct Requirements
    {
        bool MeshShader = false;
        bool Raytracing = false;
        bool SamplerFeedback = false;
        bool ReservedResources = false;
    };

    struct Budget
    {
        // ゼロは設定上の上限なしを表すが、確保失敗を無視する意味ではない。
        uint64_t GpuMemoryBytes = 0;
        uint64_t UploadBytesPerFrame = 0;
        double GpuTimeMs = 0.0;
    };

    struct Usage
    {
        uint64_t GpuMemoryBytes = 0;
        uint64_t UploadBytes = 0;
        double GpuTimeMs = 0.0;
    };

    enum class Status
    {
        Disabled,
        Ready,
        UnsupportedHardware,
        BudgetExceeded,
        InvalidMeasurement
    };

    inline Status Evaluate(bool enabled, const Capabilities& caps, const Requirements& requirements,
                           const Budget& budget, const Usage& usage)
    {
        if (!enabled)
        {
            return Status::Disabled;
        }
        if ((requirements.MeshShader && !caps.MeshShader) || (requirements.Raytracing && !caps.Raytracing) ||
            (requirements.SamplerFeedback && !caps.SamplerFeedback) ||
            (requirements.ReservedResources && !caps.ReservedResources))
        {
            return Status::UnsupportedHardware;
        }
        if (!std::isfinite(usage.GpuTimeMs) || usage.GpuTimeMs < 0.0 || !std::isfinite(budget.GpuTimeMs) ||
            budget.GpuTimeMs < 0.0)
        {
            return Status::InvalidMeasurement;
        }
        if ((budget.GpuMemoryBytes != 0 && usage.GpuMemoryBytes > budget.GpuMemoryBytes) ||
            (budget.UploadBytesPerFrame != 0 && usage.UploadBytes > budget.UploadBytesPerFrame) ||
            (budget.GpuTimeMs > 0.0 && usage.GpuTimeMs > budget.GpuTimeMs))
        {
            return Status::BudgetExceeded;
        }
        return Status::Ready;
    }
} // 名前空間 RenderFeature

#include "pch.h"
#include "materialpreview.h"

void RenderFrame::BeginDraw()
{
    TemporalHistory::Context::BeginFrame(m_Width, m_Height);
    if (m_FrameLatencyWaitableObject)
    {
        WaitForSingleObjectEx(m_FrameLatencyWaitableObject, 1000, TRUE);
    }
    GpuMemoryBudget::Update();
    ModelManager::CollectRetiredAnimModels();
    RenderTargets::UpdateMemoryPolicy();
    Raytracing::ReleaseInactiveResources();
    RayReflections::ReleaseInactiveResources();
    AdvancedEffects::ReleaseInactiveResources();

    m_CommandAllocator[m_FrameIndex]->Reset();
    m_CommandList->Reset(m_CommandAllocator[m_FrameIndex].Get(), nullptr);
    RenderProfiler::BeginFrame(m_Device.Get(), m_CommandQueue.Get(), m_CommandList.Get(), m_FrameIndex);
    TextureManager::UpdateStreaming(m_CommandList.Get());
    NoiseCacheBindings::BeginFrame(m_CommandList.Get());

    m_CommandList->RSSetViewports(1, &m_Viewport);
    m_CommandList->RSSetScissorRects(1, &m_ScissorRect);

    D3D12_RESOURCE_BARRIER barrier{};
    barrier.Type = D3D12_RESOURCE_BARRIER_TYPE_TRANSITION;
    barrier.Transition.pResource = m_RenderTargets[m_FrameIndex].Get();
    barrier.Transition.StateBefore = D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_PRESENT;
    barrier.Transition.StateAfter = D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_RENDER_TARGET;
    m_CommandList->ResourceBarrier(1, &barrier);

    CD3DX12_CPU_DESCRIPTOR_HANDLE rtvHandle(m_RtvHeap->GetCPUDescriptorHandleForHeapStart(), m_FrameIndex,
                                            m_Device->GetDescriptorHandleIncrementSize(D3D12_DESCRIPTOR_HEAP_TYPE_RTV));
    CD3DX12_CPU_DESCRIPTOR_HANDLE dsvHandle(m_DsvHeap->GetCPUDescriptorHandleForHeapStart());

    m_CommandList->ClearRenderTargetView(rtvHandle, m_kSceneClearColor, 0, nullptr);
    m_CommandList->OMSetRenderTargets(1, &rtvHandle, FALSE, &dsvHandle);

    m_DynamicVertexOffset = 0;

    SetDescriptorHeap();
    static uint64_t editorFrame = 0;
    AssetThumbnailManager::BeginFrame(++editorFrame);
    ImGuiManager::Update();

    // UI でシーンを読み替えるとライトの EntityID も変わるため、更新後のシーンからキャッシュを作る。
    LightingResources::BeginFrame();
    // このフレームの空 LUT は直ちに非同期コンピュートキューへ記録・送信し、前フレームの
    // グラフィックス処理と重ねる。グラフィックスキューは GPU 上で完了を待つ。
    AtmosphereLut::Update(m_CommandList.Get(), m_CommandQueue.Get(), m_FrameIndex);
}

void RenderFrame::EndDraw()
{
    AnimationPreviewWindow::Render();
    MaterialPreview::Render();
    AssetThumbnailManager::ProcessGenerationBudget();
    {
        RenderProfiler::ScopedEvent profile("Procedural Color Tile Update", m_CommandList.Get());
        NoiseCacheBindings::FinishFrame(m_CommandList.Get());
    }
    m_CommandList->RSSetViewports(1, &m_Viewport);
    m_CommandList->RSSetScissorRects(1, &m_ScissorRect);
    if (m_CommandList)
    {
        CD3DX12_CPU_DESCRIPTOR_HANDLE rtvHandle(
            m_RtvHeap->GetCPUDescriptorHandleForHeapStart(), m_FrameIndex,
            m_Device->GetDescriptorHandleIncrementSize(D3D12_DESCRIPTOR_HEAP_TYPE_RTV));
        CD3DX12_CPU_DESCRIPTOR_HANDLE dsvHandle(m_DsvHeap->GetCPUDescriptorHandleForHeapStart());
        m_CommandList->OMSetRenderTargets(1, &rtvHandle, FALSE, nullptr);
        ImGuiManager::Draw(m_CommandList.Get());
    }

    if (m_DepthStencilState != D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE)
    {
        D3D12_RESOURCE_BARRIER depthBarrier = CD3DX12_RESOURCE_BARRIER::Transition(
            m_DepthStencilBuffer.Get(), m_DepthStencilState, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE);
        m_CommandList->ResourceBarrier(1, &depthBarrier);
        m_DepthStencilState = D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE;
    }

    D3D12_RESOURCE_BARRIER barrier{};
    barrier.Type = D3D12_RESOURCE_BARRIER_TYPE_TRANSITION;
    barrier.Transition.pResource = m_RenderTargets[m_FrameIndex].Get();
    barrier.Transition.StateBefore = D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_RENDER_TARGET;
    barrier.Transition.StateAfter = D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_PRESENT;

    m_CommandList->ResourceBarrier(1, &barrier);

    RenderProfiler::EndFrame(m_CommandList.Get());
    const HRESULT closeHr = m_CommandList->Close();
    if (!GraphicsDevice::CheckDeviceHealth(closeHr, "Command list close"))
    {
        PostMessage(m_Hwnd, WM_CLOSE, 0, 0);
        return;
    }

    ID3D12CommandList* ppCommandLists[] = {m_CommandList.Get()};
    m_CommandQueue->ExecuteCommandLists(_countof(ppCommandLists), ppCommandLists);

    const UINT syncInterval = static_cast<UINT>(World::IsVSyncEnabled());
    UINT presentFlags;
    if ((syncInterval == 0 && m_AllowTearing))
    {
        presentFlags = DXGI_PRESENT_ALLOW_TEARING;
    }
    else
    {
        presentFlags = 0u;
    }
    const HRESULT presentHr = m_SwapChain->Present(syncInterval, presentFlags);
    if (!GraphicsDevice::CheckDeviceHealth(presentHr, "Present"))
    {
        PostMessage(m_Hwnd, WM_CLOSE, 0, 0);
        return;
    }

    m_CurrentFenceValue++;
    m_FenceValues[m_FrameIndex] = m_CurrentFenceValue;
    const HRESULT signalHr = m_CommandQueue->Signal(m_Fence.Get(), m_CurrentFenceValue);
    if (!GraphicsDevice::CheckDeviceHealth(signalHr, "Frame fence signal"))
    {
        PostMessage(m_Hwnd, WM_CLOSE, 0, 0);
        return;
    }

    TextureManager::OnFrameSubmitted(m_CurrentFenceValue);
    GPUDrivenRenderer::EndFrame();
    m_FrameIndex = m_SwapChain->GetCurrentBackBufferIndex();

    if (m_Fence->GetCompletedValue() < m_FenceValues[m_FrameIndex])
    {
        m_Fence->SetEventOnCompletion(m_FenceValues[m_FrameIndex], m_FenceEvent);
        WaitForSingleObject(m_FenceEvent, INFINITE);
    }

    World::WaitForFrameLimit();
}

void RenderFrame::SetDescriptorHeap()
{
    ID3D12DescriptorHeap* heaps[] = {m_CbvHeap.Get()};
    m_CommandList->SetDescriptorHeaps(_countof(heaps), heaps);
}
