===== FILE: source\rendering\rendergraph.cpp =====
#include "pch.h"
#include "rendergraph.h"

#include <limits>
#include <queue>

namespace
{
    bool IsWriteAccess(RenderGraph::Access access)
    {
        return access == RenderGraph::Access::Write || access == RenderGraph::Access::ReadWrite;
    }

    RenderGraph::Access MergeAccess(RenderGraph::Access left, RenderGraph::Access right)
    {
        if (left == right)
        {
            return left;
        }
        return RenderGraph::Access::ReadWrite;
    }

    void AddUniqueDependency(vector<uint32_t>& dependencies, uint32_t dependency)
    {
        if (find(dependencies.begin(), dependencies.end(), dependency) == dependencies.end())
        {
            dependencies.push_back(dependency);
        }
    }
} // 名前空間

RenderGraph::PassBuilder& RenderGraph::PassBuilder::Read(ResourceHandle resource, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATES state)
{
    return Use(resource, state, Access::Read);
}

RenderGraph::PassBuilder& RenderGraph::PassBuilder::Write(ResourceHandle resource, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATES state)
{
    return Use(resource, state, Access::Write);
}

RenderGraph::PassBuilder& RenderGraph::PassBuilder::ReadWrite(ResourceHandle resource, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATES state)
{
    return Use(resource, state, Access::ReadWrite);
}

RenderGraph::PassBuilder& RenderGraph::PassBuilder::Use(ResourceHandle resource, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATES state,
                                                        Access access)
{
    m_Graph.AddUsage(m_PassIndex, resource, state, access);
    return *this;
}

RenderGraph::ResourceHandle RenderGraph::CreateLogicalResource(const char* name)
{
    ImportedResource resource{};
    resource.Name = name;
    resource.AutomaticBarriers = false;
    return ImportResource(resource);
}

RenderGraph::ResourceHandle RenderGraph::ImportResource(const ImportedResource& resource)
{
    ResourceRecord record{};
    if (resource.Name)
    {
        record.Name = resource.Name;
    }
    else
    {
        record.Name = "Unnamed Resource";
    }
    record.Resource = resource.Resource;
    record.InitialState = resource.InitialState;
    record.FinalState = resource.FinalState;
    record.HasFinalState = resource.HasFinalState;
    record.AutomaticBarriers = resource.AutomaticBarriers && resource.Resource != nullptr;
    record.Subresource = resource.Subresource;

    const ResourceHandle handle{static_cast<uint32_t>(m_Resources.size())};
    m_Resources.push_back(move(record));
    m_IsCompiled = false;
    return handle;
}

RenderGraph::ResourceHandle RenderGraph::FindImportedResource(ID3D12Resource* resource) const
{
    if (!resource)
    {
        return {};
    }
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < m_Resources.size(); ++i)
    {
        if (m_Resources[i].Resource == resource &&
            m_Resources[i].Subresource == D3D12_RESOURCE_BARRIER_ALL_SUBRESOURCES)
        {
            return {i};
        }
    }
    return {};
}

void RenderGraph::AddPass(const char* name, const SetupCallback& setup, const ExecuteCallback& execute)
{
    PassRecord pass{};
    if (name)
    {
        pass.Name = name;
    }
    else
    {
        pass.Name = "Unnamed Pass";
    }
    pass.Execute = execute;

    const uint32_t passIndex = static_cast<uint32_t>(m_Passes.size());
    m_Passes.push_back(move(pass));
    m_IsCompiled = false;

    if (setup)
    {
        PassBuilder builder(*this, passIndex);
        setup(builder);
    }
}

void RenderGraph::AddUsage(uint32_t passIndex, ResourceHandle resource, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATES state, Access access)
{
    if (passIndex >= m_Passes.size())
    {
        Fail("RenderGraph pass builder referenced an invalid pass.");
        return;
    }
    if (!resource.IsValid() || resource.Index >= m_Resources.size())
    {
        Fail("RenderGraph pass '" + m_Passes[passIndex].Name + "' referenced an invalid resource.");
        return;
    }

    auto& usages = m_Passes[passIndex].Usages;
    auto existing = find_if(usages.begin(), usages.end(), [resource](const Usage& usage) {
        return usage.Resource.Index == resource.Index;
    });
    if (existing != usages.end())
    {
        if (existing->State != state)
        {
            Fail("RenderGraph pass '" + m_Passes[passIndex].Name + "' uses resource '" +
                 m_Resources[resource.Index].Name + "' in multiple states.");
            return;
        }
        existing->AccessMode = MergeAccess(existing->AccessMode, access);
        return;
    }

    usages.push_back({resource, state, access});
}

bool RenderGraph::Compile()
{
    if (!m_LastError.empty())
    {
        return false;
    }

    m_ExecutionOrder.clear();
    for (auto& pass : m_Passes)
    {
        pass.Dependencies.clear();
        if (!pass.Execute)
        {
            return Fail("RenderGraph pass '" + pass.Name + "' has no execute callback.");
        }
    }

    const uint32_t invalidPass = numeric_limits<uint32_t>::max();
    vector<uint32_t> lastWriter(m_Resources.size(), invalidPass);
    vector<vector<uint32_t>> readers(m_Resources.size());

    for (uint32_t passIndex = 0; passIndex < m_Passes.size(); ++passIndex)
    {
        auto& pass = m_Passes[passIndex];
        for (const Usage& usage : pass.Usages)
        {
            const uint32_t resourceIndex = usage.Resource.Index;
            if (resourceIndex >= m_Resources.size())
            {
                return Fail("RenderGraph contains an invalid resource handle.");
            }

            if (lastWriter[resourceIndex] != invalidPass)
            {
                AddUniqueDependency(pass.Dependencies, lastWriter[resourceIndex]);
            }

            if (IsWriteAccess(usage.AccessMode))
            {
                for (const uint32_t reader : readers[resourceIndex])
                {
                    AddUniqueDependency(pass.Dependencies, reader);
                }
                readers[resourceIndex].clear();
                lastWriter[resourceIndex] = passIndex;
            }
            else
            {
                readers[resourceIndex].push_back(passIndex);
            }
        }
    }

    vector<uint32_t> indegree(m_Passes.size(), 0);
    vector<vector<uint32_t>> outgoing(m_Passes.size());
    for (uint32_t passIndex = 0; passIndex < m_Passes.size(); ++passIndex)
    {
        indegree[passIndex] = static_cast<uint32_t>(m_Passes[passIndex].Dependencies.size());
        for (const uint32_t dependency : m_Passes[passIndex].Dependencies)
        {
            if (dependency >= m_Passes.size() || dependency == passIndex)
            {
                return Fail("RenderGraph generated an invalid pass dependency.");
            }
            outgoing[dependency].push_back(passIndex);
        }
    }

    priority_queue<uint32_t, vector<uint32_t>, greater<uint32_t>> ready;
    for (uint32_t passIndex = 0; passIndex < m_Passes.size(); ++passIndex)
    {
        if (indegree[passIndex] == 0)
        {
            ready.push(passIndex);
        }
    }

    while (!ready.empty())
    {
        const uint32_t passIndex = ready.top();
        ready.pop();
        m_ExecutionOrder.push_back(passIndex);
        for (const uint32_t dependent : outgoing[passIndex])
        {
            if (--indegree[dependent] == 0)
            {
                ready.push(dependent);
            }
        }
    }

    if (m_ExecutionOrder.size() != m_Passes.size())
    {
        return Fail("RenderGraph contains a dependency cycle.");
    }

    m_IsCompiled = true;
    return true;
}

bool RenderGraph::Execute(ID3D12GraphicsCommandList* commandList)
{
    if (!m_IsCompiled)
    {
        return Fail("RenderGraph::Execute called before a successful Compile.");
    }

    bool needsCommandList = false;
    for (const ResourceRecord& resource : m_Resources)
    {
        needsCommandList = needsCommandList || (resource.Resource != nullptr && resource.AutomaticBarriers);
    }
    if (needsCommandList && !commandList)
    {
        return Fail("RenderGraph automatic barriers require a command list.");
    }

    vector<D3D12_RESOURCE_STATES> states;
    states.reserve(m_Resources.size());
    for (const ResourceRecord& resource : m_Resources)
    {
        states.push_back(resource.InitialState);
    }
    vector<bool> previousUavAccess(m_Resources.size(), false);
    vector<bool> previousUavWrite(m_Resources.size(), false);

    for (const uint32_t passIndex : m_ExecutionOrder)
    {
        PassRecord& pass = m_Passes[passIndex];
        if (m_Arena)
        {
            for (const auto& usage : pass.Usages)
            {
                const auto& resource = m_Resources[usage.Resource.Index];
                if (resource.Transient)
                {
                    m_Arena->Activate(resource.ArenaIndex, commandList);
                }
            }
        }
        vector<D3D12_RESOURCE_BARRIER> barriers;
        barriers.reserve(pass.Usages.size());

        for (const Usage& usage : pass.Usages)
        {
            const uint32_t resourceIndex = usage.Resource.Index;
            const ResourceRecord& resource = m_Resources[resourceIndex];
            if (!resource.Resource || !resource.AutomaticBarriers)
            {
                continue;
            }

            if (states[resourceIndex] != usage.State)
            {
                barriers.push_back(CD3DX12_RESOURCE_BARRIER::Transition(resource.Resource, states[resourceIndex],
                                                                        usage.State, resource.Subresource));
                states[resourceIndex] = usage.State;
                previousUavAccess[resourceIndex] = false;
                previousUavWrite[resourceIndex] = false;
            }
            else if (previousUavAccess[resourceIndex] &&
                     (previousUavWrite[resourceIndex] || IsWriteAccess(usage.AccessMode)) &&
                     (usage.State & D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_UNORDERED_ACCESS) != 0)
            {
                barriers.push_back(CD3DX12_RESOURCE_BARRIER::UAV(resource.Resource));
                previousUavAccess[resourceIndex] = false;
                previousUavWrite[resourceIndex] = false;
            }
        }

        if (!barriers.empty())
        {
            commandList->ResourceBarrier(static_cast<UINT>(barriers.size()), barriers.data());
        }

        pass.Execute(commandList);

        for (const Usage& usage : pass.Usages)
        {
            const uint32_t resourceIndex = usage.Resource.Index;
            const ResourceRecord& resource = m_Resources[resourceIndex];
            if (!resource.Resource || !resource.AutomaticBarriers)
            {
                continue;
            }
            previousUavAccess[resourceIndex] = (usage.State & D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_UNORDERED_ACCESS) != 0;
            previousUavWrite[resourceIndex] = previousUavAccess[resourceIndex] && IsWriteAccess(usage.AccessMode);
        }
    }

    vector<D3D12_RESOURCE_BARRIER> finalBarriers;
    finalBarriers.reserve(m_Resources.size());
    for (uint32_t resourceIndex = 0; resourceIndex < m_Resources.size(); ++resourceIndex)
    {
        const ResourceRecord& resource = m_Resources[resourceIndex];
        if (!resource.Resource || !resource.AutomaticBarriers || !resource.HasFinalState ||
            states[resourceIndex] == resource.FinalState)
        {
            continue;
        }
        finalBarriers.push_back(CD3DX12_RESOURCE_BARRIER::Transition(resource.Resource, states[resourceIndex],
                                                                     resource.FinalState, resource.Subresource));
    }
    if (!finalBarriers.empty())
    {
        commandList->ResourceBarrier(static_cast<UINT>(finalBarriers.size()), finalBarriers.data());
    }

    return true;
}

void RenderGraph::Reset()
{
    m_Arena = nullptr;
    m_Resources.clear();
    m_Passes.clear();
    m_ExecutionOrder.clear();
    m_LastError.clear();
    m_IsCompiled = false;
}

bool RenderGraph::Fail(const string& message)
{
    m_LastError = message;
    m_IsCompiled = false;
    Debug::Log("ERROR: %s\n", message.c_str());
    return false;
}

RenderGraph::ResourceHandle RenderGraph::CreateTransientResource(const char* name, const D3D12_RESOURCE_DESC& desc,
                                                                 D3D12_RESOURCE_STATES initial)
{
    auto handle = CreateLogicalResource(name);
    auto& resource = m_Resources[handle.Index];
    resource.Transient = true;
    resource.AutomaticBarriers = true;
    resource.Desc = desc;
    resource.InitialState = initial;
    return handle;
}

bool RenderGraph::AllocateTransients(ID3D12Device* device, TransientArena& arena)
{
    if (!m_IsCompiled)
    {
        return Fail("Compile before allocating transients");
    }
    std::vector<TransientArena::Request> requests;
    for (auto& resource : m_Resources)
    {
        resource.ArenaIndex = UINT_MAX;
    }
    for (UINT resourceIndex = 0; resourceIndex < m_Resources.size(); ++resourceIndex)
    {
        auto& resource = m_Resources[resourceIndex];
        if (!resource.Transient)
        {
            continue;
        }
        UINT first = UINT_MAX, last = 0;
        bool initialized = false;
        for (UINT order = 0; order < m_ExecutionOrder.size(); ++order)
        {
            for (const auto& usage : m_Passes[m_ExecutionOrder[order]].Usages)
            {
                if (usage.Resource.Index == resourceIndex)
                {
                    if (first == UINT_MAX)
                    {
                        first = order;
                        initialized = usage.AccessMode != Access::Read;
                    }
                    last = order;
                }
            }
        }
        if (first == UINT_MAX)
        {
            continue;
        }
        if (!initialized)
        {
            return Fail("Transient resource must be written before reading: " + resource.Name);
        }
        resource.ArenaIndex = UINT(requests.size());
        requests.push_back({resource.Desc, resource.InitialState, first, last});
    }
    if (!arena.Build(device, requests))
    {
        return Fail("Transient arena allocation failed");
    }
    for (auto& resource : m_Resources)
    {
        if (resource.Transient && resource.ArenaIndex != UINT_MAX)
        {
            resource.Resource = arena.Get(resource.ArenaIndex);
        }
    }
    m_Arena = &arena;
    return true;
}

===== FILE: source\rendering\rendergraph.h =====
#pragma once

#include <d3d12.h>
#include "transientarena.h"
#include <cstdint>
#include <functional>
#include <string>
#include <vector>

class RenderGraph
{
  public:
    enum class Queue
    {
        Graphics,
        Compute
    };

    struct ResourceHandle
    {
        static constexpr uint32_t InvalidIndex = UINT32_MAX;
        uint32_t Index = InvalidIndex;

        bool IsValid() const
        {
            return Index != InvalidIndex;
        }
    };

    enum class Access : uint8_t
    {
        Read,
        Write,
        ReadWrite
    };

    struct ImportedResource
    {
        const char* Name = nullptr;
        ID3D12Resource* Resource = nullptr;
        D3D12_RESOURCE_STATES InitialState = D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_COMMON;
        D3D12_RESOURCE_STATES FinalState = D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_COMMON;
        bool HasFinalState = false;
        bool AutomaticBarriers = true;
        UINT Subresource = D3D12_RESOURCE_BARRIER_ALL_SUBRESOURCES;
    };

    class PassBuilder
    {
      public:
        PassBuilder& Read(ResourceHandle resource, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATES state = D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_COMMON);
        PassBuilder& Write(ResourceHandle resource, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATES state = D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_COMMON);
        PassBuilder& ReadWrite(ResourceHandle resource, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATES state = D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_COMMON);

      private:
        friend class RenderGraph;

        PassBuilder(RenderGraph& graph, uint32_t passIndex) : m_Graph(graph), m_PassIndex(passIndex) {}

        PassBuilder& Use(ResourceHandle resource, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATES state, Access access);

        RenderGraph& m_Graph;
        uint32_t m_PassIndex;
    };

    using SetupCallback = function<void(PassBuilder&)>;
    using ExecuteCallback = function<void(ID3D12GraphicsCommandList*)>;

    ResourceHandle CreateLogicalResource(const char* name);

    ResourceHandle ImportResource(const ImportedResource& resource);
    ResourceHandle FindImportedResource(ID3D12Resource* resource) const;

    void AddPass(const char* name, const SetupCallback& setup, const ExecuteCallback& execute);

    void SetLastPassQueue(Queue queue)
    {
        if (!m_Passes.empty())
        {
            m_Passes.back().QueueType = queue;
        }
    }

    ResourceHandle CreateTransientResource(const char* name, const D3D12_RESOURCE_DESC& desc,
                                           D3D12_RESOURCE_STATES initial = D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_COMMON);
    bool AllocateTransients(ID3D12Device* device, TransientArena& arena);

    ID3D12Resource* GetResource(ResourceHandle handle) const
    {
        return handle.Index < m_Resources.size() ? m_Resources[handle.Index].Resource : nullptr;
    }

    bool Compile();
    bool Execute(ID3D12GraphicsCommandList* commandList);
    void Reset();

    const string& GetLastError() const
    {
        return m_LastError;
    }

    size_t GetPassCount() const
    {
        return m_Passes.size();
    }

    const vector<uint32_t>& GetExecutionOrder() const
    {
        return m_ExecutionOrder;
    }

  private:
    friend class RenderGraphQueueExecutor;
    TransientArena* m_Arena = nullptr;

    struct Usage
    {
        ResourceHandle Resource;
        D3D12_RESOURCE_STATES State = D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_COMMON;
        Access AccessMode = Access::Read;
    };

    struct ResourceRecord
    {
        bool Transient = false;
        D3D12_RESOURCE_DESC Desc{};
        UINT ArenaIndex = UINT_MAX;
        string Name;
        ID3D12Resource* Resource = nullptr;
        D3D12_RESOURCE_STATES InitialState = D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_COMMON;
        D3D12_RESOURCE_STATES FinalState = D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_COMMON;
        bool HasFinalState = false;
        bool AutomaticBarriers = true;
        UINT Subresource = D3D12_RESOURCE_BARRIER_ALL_SUBRESOURCES;
    };

    struct PassRecord
    {
        Queue QueueType = Queue::Graphics;
        string Name;
        vector<Usage> Usages;
        vector<uint32_t> Dependencies;
        ExecuteCallback Execute;
    };

    void AddUsage(uint32_t passIndex, ResourceHandle resource, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATES state, Access access);
    bool Fail(const string& message);

    vector<ResourceRecord> m_Resources;
    vector<PassRecord> m_Passes;
    vector<uint32_t> m_ExecutionOrder;
    string m_LastError;
    bool m_IsCompiled = false;
};

===== FILE: source\rendering\rendergraphqueueexecutor.h =====
#pragma once
#include "pch.h"
#include "rendergraph.h"

// 保守的な複数キュー実行器。グラフのトポロジカル順にパスを実行し、COMMON 状態で所有権を
// 渡して GPU フェンスで待つ。依存の有無にかかわらずパスは意図的に直列化しており、
// GPU 処理の並列実行を保証するものではない。
class RenderGraphQueueExecutor final
{
    struct Batch
    {
        ComPtr<ID3D12CommandAllocator> Allocator;
        ComPtr<ID3D12GraphicsCommandList> List;
        bool Compute = false;
    };

    struct Frame
    {
        std::vector<Batch> Batches;
        UINT64 Fence = 0;
    };

  public:
    bool Initialize(ID3D12Device* device, ID3D12CommandQueue* graphics)
    {
        Shutdown();
        if (!device || !graphics)
        {
            return false;
        }
        m_Device = device;
        m_Graphics = graphics;
        D3D12_COMMAND_QUEUE_DESC desc{};
        desc.Type = D3D12_COMMAND_LIST_TYPE_COMPUTE;
        device->CreateCommandQueue(&desc, IID_PPV_ARGS(&m_Compute));
        if (FAILED(device->CreateFence(0, D3D12_FENCE_FLAG_NONE, IID_PPV_ARGS(&m_Fence))))
        {
            return false;
        }
        m_Event = CreateEvent(nullptr, FALSE, FALSE, nullptr);
        return m_Event != nullptr;
    }

    void WaitIdle()
    {
        if (m_Fence && m_Last && m_Fence->GetCompletedValue() < m_Last && m_Event &&
            SUCCEEDED(m_Fence->SetEventOnCompletion(m_Last, m_Event)))
        {
            WaitForSingleObject(m_Event, INFINITE);
        }
    }

    void Shutdown()
    {
        WaitIdle();
        for (auto& f : m_Frames)
        {
            f = {};
        }
        m_Compute.Reset();
        m_Graphics.Reset();
        m_Fence.Reset();
        m_Device.Reset();
        if (m_Event)
        {
            CloseHandle(m_Event);
        }
        m_Event = nullptr;
        m_Last = 0;
    }

    ~RenderGraphQueueExecutor()
    {
        Shutdown();
    }

    bool Execute(RenderGraph& graph, UINT slot)
    {
        if (!m_Device || !m_Fence || !graph.m_IsCompiled)
        {
            return false;
        }
        auto& frame = m_Frames[slot % 3];
        if (frame.Fence && m_Fence->GetCompletedValue() < frame.Fence)
        {
            if (FAILED(m_Fence->SetEventOnCompletion(frame.Fence, m_Event)))
            {
                return false;
            }
            WaitForSingleObject(m_Event, INFINITE);
        }
        frame.Batches.clear();
        auto record = [&](bool compute, const std::function<void(ID3D12GraphicsCommandList*)>& callback) {
            Batch batch;
            batch.Compute = compute && bool(m_Compute);
            const auto type = batch.Compute ? D3D12_COMMAND_LIST_TYPE_COMPUTE : D3D12_COMMAND_LIST_TYPE_DIRECT;
            if (FAILED(m_Device->CreateCommandAllocator(type, IID_PPV_ARGS(&batch.Allocator))) ||
                FAILED(m_Device->CreateCommandList(0, type, batch.Allocator.Get(), nullptr, IID_PPV_ARGS(&batch.List))))
            {
                return false;
            }
            callback(batch.List.Get());
            if (FAILED(batch.List->Close()))
            {
                return false;
            }
            frame.Batches.push_back(std::move(batch));
            return true;
        };
        auto transition = [](ID3D12GraphicsCommandList* list, const RenderGraph::ResourceRecord& resource,
                             D3D12_RESOURCE_STATES before, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATES after) {
            if (resource.Resource && resource.AutomaticBarriers && before != after)
            {
                const auto b =
                    CD3DX12_RESOURCE_BARRIER::Transition(resource.Resource, before, after, resource.Subresource);
                list->ResourceBarrier(1, &b);
            }
        };
        // バッチの記録・送信前に制約を検査する。
        for (const auto& resource : graph.m_Resources)
        {
            if (resource.Resource && resource.AutomaticBarriers && resource.HasFinalState &&
                resource.Resource->GetDesc().Dimension == D3D12_RESOURCE_DIMENSION_BUFFER &&
                resource.FinalState != D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_COMMON)
            {
                return false;
            }
        }
        constexpr UINT forbidden = D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_RENDER_TARGET | D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_DEPTH_WRITE |
                                   D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_DEPTH_READ | D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE |
                                   D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_PRESENT;
        for (const auto& pass : graph.m_Passes)
        {
            if (pass.QueueType == RenderGraph::Queue::Compute && m_Compute)
            {
                for (const auto& usage : pass.Usages)
                {
                    if (UINT(usage.State) & forbidden)
                    {
                        return false;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        if (!record(false, [&](auto* list) {
                for (const auto& resource : graph.m_Resources)
                {
                    transition(list, resource, resource.InitialState, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_COMMON);
                }
            }))
        {
            return false;
        }
        for (UINT index : graph.m_ExecutionOrder)
        {
            auto& pass = graph.m_Passes[index];
            if (!record(pass.QueueType == RenderGraph::Queue::Compute, [&](auto* list) {
                    for (const auto& usage : pass.Usages)
                    {
                        const auto& resource = graph.m_Resources[usage.Resource.Index];
                        if (resource.Transient && graph.m_Arena)
                        {
                            graph.m_Arena->Activate(resource.ArenaIndex, list);
                        }
                        transition(list, resource, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_COMMON, usage.State);
                    }
                    pass.Execute(list);
                    for (const auto& usage : pass.Usages)
                    {
                        transition(list, graph.m_Resources[usage.Resource.Index], usage.State,
                                   D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_COMMON);
                    }
                }))
            {
                return false;
            }
        }
        if (!record(false, [&](auto* list) {
                for (const auto& resource : graph.m_Resources)
                {
                    if (resource.HasFinalState)
                    {
                        transition(list, resource, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_COMMON, resource.FinalState);
                    }
                }
            }))
        {
            return false;
        }
        // すべて記録してから送信する。最初の ExecuteCommandLists 後の失敗はフレームにとって致命的であり、
        // 同じ処理を二重に実行してはならない。
        for (auto& batch : frame.Batches)
        {
            auto* queue = batch.Compute ? m_Compute.Get() : m_Graphics.Get();
            if (m_Last && FAILED(queue->Wait(m_Fence.Get(), m_Last)))
            {
                return false;
            }
            ID3D12CommandList* lists[] = {batch.List.Get()};
            queue->ExecuteCommandLists(1, lists);
            ++m_Last;
            if (FAILED(queue->Signal(m_Fence.Get(), m_Last)))
            {
                return false;
            }
            frame.Fence = m_Last;
        }
        return SUCCEEDED(m_Graphics->Wait(m_Fence.Get(), m_Last));
    }

  private:
    ComPtr<ID3D12Device> m_Device;
    ComPtr<ID3D12CommandQueue> m_Graphics, m_Compute;
    ComPtr<ID3D12Fence> m_Fence;
    std::array<Frame, 3> m_Frames;
    HANDLE m_Event = nullptr;
    UINT64 m_Last = 0;
};

===== FILE: source\rendering\rendermeasurement.h =====
#pragma once

#include <algorithm>
#include <cmath>
#include <cstddef>
#include <cstdint>
#include <functional>
#include <limits>
#include <optional>
#include <unordered_set>
#include <utility>
#include <vector>

namespace RenderMeasurement
{
    inline constexpr uint32_t NoParent = UINT32_MAX;

    inline bool IsGpuTimingComplete(uint32_t events, uint32_t resolvedEvents, uint32_t droppedEvents)
    {
        return events != 0 && resolvedEvents == events && droppedEvents == 0;
    }

    inline uint32_t TraceStorageWidth(uint32_t width, bool checkerboard)
    {
        return checkerboard ? width / 2 + width % 2 : width;
    }

    // RayReflectionsCS.hlsl の BLACK チェッカーボード配置に合わせる。
    // 奇数幅の画像の最終列は範囲外に対応する可能性があるため、除外する。
    inline uint32_t TracePixelX(uint32_t storageX, uint32_t y, uint32_t sequence, bool checkerboard)
    {
        return checkerboard ? storageX * 2 + ((y ^ sequence) & 1u) : storageX;
    }

    struct Sample
    {
        uint64_t Serial = 0;
        double FrameMs = 0.0;
        double CpuMs = 0.0;
        double GpuMs = 0.0;
        bool GpuValid = false;
    };

    struct Summary
    {
        size_t FrameSamples = 0;
        size_t CpuSamples = 0;
        size_t GpuSamples = 0;
        size_t DuplicateSamples = 0;
        std::optional<double> FrameMeanMs;
        std::optional<double> CpuMeanMs;
        std::optional<double> GpuMeanMs;
        std::optional<double> LowOnePercentFps;
    };

    inline Summary Summarize(const std::vector<Sample>& samples)
    {
        Summary result;
        std::unordered_set<uint64_t> serials;
        std::vector<double> frameTimes;
        long double frameTotal = 0.0;
        long double cpuTotal = 0.0;
        long double gpuTotal = 0.0;
        for (const Sample& sample : samples)
        {
            if (!serials.insert(sample.Serial).second)
            {
                ++result.DuplicateSamples;
                continue;
            }
            if (std::isfinite(sample.FrameMs) && sample.FrameMs > 0.0)
            {
                frameTimes.push_back(sample.FrameMs);
                frameTotal += sample.FrameMs;
            }
            if (std::isfinite(sample.CpuMs) && sample.CpuMs >= 0.0)
            {
                cpuTotal += sample.CpuMs;
                ++result.CpuSamples;
            }
            if (sample.GpuValid && std::isfinite(sample.GpuMs) && sample.GpuMs >= 0.0)
            {
                gpuTotal += sample.GpuMs;
                ++result.GpuSamples;
            }
        }
        result.FrameSamples = frameTimes.size();
        if (!frameTimes.empty())
        {
            result.FrameMeanMs = static_cast<double>(frameTotal / frameTimes.size());
            std::sort(frameTimes.begin(), frameTimes.end(), std::greater<double>());
            const size_t slowCount = frameTimes.size() / 100 + (frameTimes.size() % 100 != 0 ? 1 : 0);
            long double slowTotal = 0.0;
            for (size_t index = 0; index < slowCount; ++index)
            {
                slowTotal += frameTimes[index];
            }
            result.LowOnePercentFps = static_cast<double>(1000.0L * slowCount / slowTotal);
        }
        if (result.CpuSamples != 0)
        {
            result.CpuMeanMs = static_cast<double>(cpuTotal / result.CpuSamples);
        }
        if (result.GpuSamples != 0)
        {
            result.GpuMeanMs = static_cast<double>(gpuTotal / result.GpuSamples);
        }
        return result;
    }

    struct EventInterval
    {
        uint32_t Id = 0;
        uint32_t ParentId = NoParent;
        uint32_t QueueId = 0;
        uint64_t Begin = 0;
        uint64_t End = 0;
        bool Valid = false;
    };

    // 排他的な時間は同じキュー内だけで定義する。子の区間を統合してから差し引き、
    // 重なる兄弟や孫の時間を二重に計上しないようにする。
    inline double ExclusiveTicks(const EventInterval& parent, const std::vector<EventInterval>& events)
    {
        const double unavailable = std::numeric_limits<double>::quiet_NaN();
        if (!parent.Valid || parent.End < parent.Begin)
        {
            return unavailable;
        }

        std::vector<std::pair<uint64_t, uint64_t>> children;
        for (const EventInterval& event : events)
        {
            if (event.ParentId != parent.Id || event.QueueId != parent.QueueId)
            {
                continue;
            }
            if (!event.Valid || event.End < event.Begin)
            {
                return unavailable;
            }
            const uint64_t begin = (std::max)(parent.Begin, event.Begin);
            const uint64_t end = (std::min)(parent.End, event.End);
            if (end > begin)
            {
                children.emplace_back(begin, end);
            }
        }
        std::sort(children.begin(), children.end());
        uint64_t covered = 0;
        uint64_t rangeBegin = 0;
        uint64_t rangeEnd = 0;
        for (const auto& child : children)
        {
            if (child.first > rangeEnd)
            {
                covered += rangeEnd - rangeBegin;
                rangeBegin = child.first;
                rangeEnd = child.second;
            }
            else
            {
                rangeEnd = (std::max)(rangeEnd, child.second);
            }
        }
        covered += rangeEnd - rangeBegin;
        return static_cast<double>(parent.End - parent.Begin - covered);
    }
} // 名前空間 RenderMeasurement

===== FILE: source\rendering\rendermeasurementwindow.h =====
#pragma once
#include "rendermeasurement.h"

namespace RenderMeasurement
{
    // GPU の完了フレームは遅れて、または順不同で届くことがある。取得した CPU 値を同じフレーム記録に
    // 保持し、読み戻しを行ったフレームの時間は使わない。
    class Window final
    {
      public:
        Window(uint64_t firstSerial, uint32_t warmupFrames, uint32_t measuredFrames)
            : m_FirstSerial(firstSerial), m_Warmup(warmupFrames), m_Samples(measuredFrames)
        {
        }

        bool Record(const Sample& sample)
        {
            if (sample.Serial < m_FirstSerial)
            {
                return false;
            }
            const uint64_t relative = sample.Serial - m_FirstSerial;
            if (relative < m_Warmup)
            {
                return false;
            }
            const uint64_t index = relative - m_Warmup;
            if (index >= m_Samples.size() || m_Samples[static_cast<size_t>(index)])
            {
                return false;
            }
            m_Samples[static_cast<size_t>(index)] = sample;
            ++m_Recorded;
            return true;
        }

        bool Complete() const
        {
            return m_Recorded == m_Samples.size();
        }

        std::vector<Sample> Samples() const
        {
            std::vector<Sample> samples;
            samples.reserve(m_Recorded);
            for (const auto& sample : m_Samples)
            {
                if (sample)
                {
                    samples.push_back(*sample);
                }
            }
            return samples;
        }

      private:
        uint64_t m_FirstSerial;
        uint32_t m_Warmup;
        size_t m_Recorded = 0;
        std::vector<std::optional<Sample>> m_Samples;
    };
} // 名前空間 RenderMeasurement
