bool ShaderPipelines::CreateModelPipeline()
{
    m_ModelRootSignature = m_RootSignature;

    m_ModelPipelineState = nullptr;

    return true;
}

bool ShaderPipelines::CreateSkinningPipeline()
{
    CD3DX12_DESCRIPTOR_RANGE ranges[4];
    ranges[0].Init(D3D12_DESCRIPTOR_RANGE_TYPE_SRV, 1, 0);
    ranges[1].Init(D3D12_DESCRIPTOR_RANGE_TYPE_SRV, 1, 1);
    ranges[2].Init(D3D12_DESCRIPTOR_RANGE_TYPE_UAV, 1, 0);
    ranges[3].Init(D3D12_DESCRIPTOR_RANGE_TYPE_CBV, 1, 0, 1);

    CD3DX12_ROOT_PARAMETER rootParams[4];
    rootParams[0].InitAsDescriptorTable(1, &ranges[0], D3D12_SHADER_VISIBILITY_ALL);
    rootParams[1].InitAsDescriptorTable(1, &ranges[1], D3D12_SHADER_VISIBILITY_ALL);
    rootParams[2].InitAsDescriptorTable(1, &ranges[2], D3D12_SHADER_VISIBILITY_ALL);
    rootParams[3].InitAsDescriptorTable(1, &ranges[3], D3D12_SHADER_VISIBILITY_ALL);

    CD3DX12_ROOT_SIGNATURE_DESC rsDesc;
    rsDesc.Init(_countof(rootParams), rootParams, 0, nullptr, D3D12_ROOT_SIGNATURE_FLAG_NONE);

    ComPtr<ID3DBlob> signature;
    ComPtr<ID3DBlob> error;
    HRESULT hr = D3D12SerializeRootSignature(&rsDesc, D3D_ROOT_SIGNATURE_VERSION_1, &signature, &error);
    if (FAILED(hr))
    {
        Debug::Log("ERROR: D3D12SerializeRootSignature(Skinning) failed\n");
        if (error)
        {
            Debug::Log("%s\n", (char*)error->GetBufferPointer());
        }
        return false;
    }
    hr = m_Device->CreateRootSignature(0, signature->GetBufferPointer(), signature->GetBufferSize(),
                                       IID_PPV_ARGS(&m_SkinningRootSignature));
    if (FAILED(hr))
    {
        Debug::Log("ERROR: CreateRootSignature(Skinning) failed\n");
        return false;
    }
    return PsoManager::CreateSkinningPso();
}

bool ShaderPipelines::LoadShaderBlob(const ShaderDescription& resource, bool allowRaytracing)
{
    const char* csoPath = resource.csoPath;
    ID3DBlob** ppBlob = resource.ppBlob;

    if (!csoPath || !ppBlob)
    {
        return false;
    }
    *ppBlob = nullptr;
    string key = csoPath;
    replace(key.begin(), key.end(), '\\', '/');
    const string leaf = filesystem::path(key).filename().string();
    const bool raytracing = allowRaytracing && Raytracing::IsAvailable();
    const bool modernShaders = raytracing || g_BindlessShaderSettings.Enabled;
    const bool scenePixelShader = leaf.find("PS") != string::npos && modernShaders;
    const bool sceneVertexShader = leaf.find("VS") != string::npos && modernShaders;
    const bool sceneGeometryShader = leaf.find("GS") != string::npos && modernShaders;
    const bool compileModern = scenePixelShader || sceneVertexShader || sceneGeometryShader;
    const string cacheKey = key + (compileModern ? ":DXIL" : "") + (raytracing ? ":DXR" : "") +
                            (g_BindlessShaderSettings.Enabled ? ":Bindless" : "");

    {
        std::lock_guard lock(g_ShaderBlobCacheMutex);
        auto cached = g_ShaderBlobCache.find(cacheKey);
        if (cached != g_ShaderBlobCache.end())
        {
            *ppBlob = cached->second.Get();
            (*ppBlob)->AddRef();
            return true;
        }
    }

    int len = MultiByteToWideChar(CP_UTF8, 0, csoPath, -1, NULL, 0);
    wstring wPath(len, 0);
    MultiByteToWideChar(CP_UTF8, 0, csoPath, -1, &wPath[0], len);

    HRESULT hr = E_FAIL;
    if (compileModern)
    {
        string source = key;
        const auto buildFolder = source.find("/build/");
        if (buildFolder != string::npos)
        {
            source.erase(buildFolder, 6);
        }
        source = filesystem::path(source).replace_extension(".hlsl").string();
        // MeshletOpaquePS is built from the shared GPU-driven material shader.
        if (leaf == "MeshletOpaquePS.cso")
        {
            source = "shader/hlsl/GPUDrivenOpaquePS.hlsl";
        }
        if (filesystem::exists(source))
        {
            const auto sourcePath = filesystem::path(source).wstring();
            const D3D_SHADER_MACRO defines[] = {{"SHADER_RAYTRACING", "1"}, {}};
            ComPtr<ID3DBlob> errors;
            hr = D3DCompileFromFile(sourcePath.c_str(), raytracing ? defines : nullptr,
                                    D3D_COMPILE_STANDARD_FILE_INCLUDE, "main",
                                    scenePixelShader    ? "ps_6_5"
                                    : sceneVertexShader ? "vs_6_5"
                                                        : "gs_6_5",
                                    D3DCOMPILE_OPTIMIZATION_LEVEL3, 0, ppBlob, &errors);
            if (FAILED(hr))
            {
                WriteGraphicsLog("Scene shader compile failed: %s %s\n", source.c_str(),
                                 errors ? static_cast<const char*>(errors->GetBufferPointer()) : "");
                return false;
            }
        }
    }
    if (FAILED(hr))
    {
        hr = D3DReadFileToBlob(wPath.c_str(), ppBlob);
    }
    if (FAILED(hr))
    {
        // .cso が無い（vcxproj に未登録の新規シェーダーなど）場合は、同名の .hlsl を実行時にコンパイルする。
        string source = key;
        const auto buildFolder = source.find("/build/");
        if (buildFolder != string::npos)
        {
            source.erase(buildFolder, 6);
        }
        source = filesystem::path(source).replace_extension(".hlsl").string();
        const size_t psAt = leaf.rfind("PS");
        const size_t vsAt = leaf.rfind("VS");
        const size_t csAt = leaf.rfind("CS");
        const char* target = nullptr;
        size_t best = 0;
        auto consider = [&](size_t at, const char* stage) {
            if (at != string::npos && (!target || at > best))
            {
                best = at;
                target = stage;
            }
        };
        consider(psAt, "ps_6_5");
        consider(vsAt, "vs_6_5");
        consider(csAt, "cs_6_5");
        if (target && filesystem::exists(source))
        {
            ComPtr<ID3DBlob> errors;
            hr = D3DCompileFromFile(filesystem::path(source).wstring().c_str(), nullptr,
                                    D3D_COMPILE_STANDARD_FILE_INCLUDE, "main", target, D3DCOMPILE_OPTIMIZATION_LEVEL3,
                                    0, ppBlob, &errors);
            if (FAILED(hr))
            {
                WriteGraphicsLog("Runtime shader compile failed: %s %s\n", source.c_str(),
                                 errors ? static_cast<const char*>(errors->GetBufferPointer()) : "");
            }
        }
    }
    if (FAILED(hr))
    {
        char buf[256];
        sprintf_s(buf, "ERROR: Failed to load shader: %s (HRESULT: 0x%08X)\n", csoPath, hr);
        Debug::Log("%s", buf);
        return false;
    }

    {
        std::lock_guard lock(g_ShaderBlobCacheMutex);
        g_ShaderBlobCache.emplace(cacheKey, *ppBlob);
    }
    return true;
}

bool ShaderPipelines::CreateVertexShader(const ShaderDescription& resource)
{
    ShaderDescription shaderResource = resource;
    shaderResource.csoPath = resource.vsPath;
    return LoadShaderBlob(shaderResource);
}

bool ShaderPipelines::CreatePixelShader(const ShaderDescription& resource)
{
    ShaderDescription shaderResource = resource;
    shaderResource.csoPath = resource.psPath;
    return LoadShaderBlob(shaderResource);
}

static void ShaderLogToFile(const char* msg)
{
    FILE* fp = nullptr;
    fopen_s(&fp, "init_log.txt", "a");
    if (fp)
    {
        fprintf(fp, "%s", msg);
        fclose(fp);
    }
}

bool ShaderPipelines::CreatePostProcessPipeline()
{
    ShaderLogToFile("PP: setup ranges\n");
    CD3DX12_DESCRIPTOR_RANGE ranges[19];
    ranges[0].Init(D3D12_DESCRIPTOR_RANGE_TYPE_SRV, 5, 0);
    ranges[1].Init(D3D12_DESCRIPTOR_RANGE_TYPE_SRV, 1, 6);
    ranges[2].Init(D3D12_DESCRIPTOR_RANGE_TYPE_SRV, 1, 7);
    ranges[3].Init(D3D12_DESCRIPTOR_RANGE_TYPE_SRV, 1, 8);
    ranges[4].Init(D3D12_DESCRIPTOR_RANGE_TYPE_SRV, 1, 9);
    ranges[5].Init(D3D12_DESCRIPTOR_RANGE_TYPE_SRV, 1, 10);
    ranges[6].Init(D3D12_DESCRIPTOR_RANGE_TYPE_SRV, 1, 12);
    ranges[7].Init(D3D12_DESCRIPTOR_RANGE_TYPE_SRV, 1, 13);
    ranges[8].Init(D3D12_DESCRIPTOR_RANGE_TYPE_SRV, 1, 14);
    ranges[9].Init(D3D12_DESCRIPTOR_RANGE_TYPE_SRV, 1, 15);
    ranges[10].Init(D3D12_DESCRIPTOR_RANGE_TYPE_SRV, 1, 16);
    ranges[11].Init(D3D12_DESCRIPTOR_RANGE_TYPE_SRV, 1, 17);

    ranges[12].Init(D3D12_DESCRIPTOR_RANGE_TYPE_SRV, 1, 31);
    ranges[13].Init(D3D12_DESCRIPTOR_RANGE_TYPE_SRV, 1, 32);
    ranges[14].Init(D3D12_DESCRIPTOR_RANGE_TYPE_SRV, 1, 33);
    ranges[15].Init(D3D12_DESCRIPTOR_RANGE_TYPE_SRV, 1, 35);
    ranges[16].Init(D3D12_DESCRIPTOR_RANGE_TYPE_SRV, 1, 36);
    ranges[17].Init(D3D12_DESCRIPTOR_RANGE_TYPE_SRV, 2, 40); // 大気のスカイビュー LUT（散乱、透過率）
    ranges[18].Init(D3D12_DESCRIPTOR_RANGE_TYPE_SRV, 2, 42); // LTC 行列、LTC 振幅 / DFG
    // 38：MegaLights M7 のライトのテクスチャ（エンジンのテクスチャ SRV 512 個、t0 space5）
    CD3DX12_DESCRIPTOR_RANGE megaLightTextures;
    megaLightTextures.Init(D3D12_DESCRIPTOR_RANGE_TYPE_SRV, 512, 0, 5);
    CD3DX12_ROOT_PARAMETER params[39];
    params[0].InitAsDescriptorTable(1, &ranges[0], D3D12_SHADER_VISIBILITY_PIXEL);
    params[1].InitAsConstantBufferView(0, 0, D3D12_SHADER_VISIBILITY_PIXEL);
    params[2].InitAsConstantBufferView(1, 0, D3D12_SHADER_VISIBILITY_PIXEL);
    params[3].InitAsDescriptorTable(1, &ranges[1], D3D12_SHADER_VISIBILITY_PIXEL);
    params[4].InitAsDescriptorTable(1, &ranges[2], D3D12_SHADER_VISIBILITY_PIXEL);
    params[5].InitAsConstantBufferView(3, 0, D3D12_SHADER_VISIBILITY_PIXEL);
    params[6].InitAsConstantBufferView(2, 0, D3D12_SHADER_VISIBILITY_PIXEL);
    params[7].InitAsDescriptorTable(1, &ranges[3], D3D12_SHADER_VISIBILITY_PIXEL);
    params[8].InitAsDescriptorTable(1, &ranges[4], D3D12_SHADER_VISIBILITY_PIXEL);
    params[9].InitAsDescriptorTable(1, &ranges[5], D3D12_SHADER_VISIBILITY_PIXEL);
    params[10].InitAsShaderResourceView(11, 0, D3D12_SHADER_VISIBILITY_PIXEL);
    params[11].InitAsDescriptorTable(1, &ranges[6], D3D12_SHADER_VISIBILITY_PIXEL);
    params[12].InitAsDescriptorTable(1, &ranges[7], D3D12_SHADER_VISIBILITY_PIXEL);
    params[13].InitAsDescriptorTable(1, &ranges[8], D3D12_SHADER_VISIBILITY_PIXEL);
    params[14].InitAsShaderResourceView(24, 0, D3D12_SHADER_VISIBILITY_PIXEL);
    params[15].InitAsDescriptorTable(1, &ranges[9], D3D12_SHADER_VISIBILITY_PIXEL);
    params[16].InitAsDescriptorTable(1, &ranges[10], D3D12_SHADER_VISIBILITY_PIXEL);
    params[17].InitAsShaderResourceView(25, 0, D3D12_SHADER_VISIBILITY_PIXEL);
    params[18].InitAsConstantBufferView(5, 0, D3D12_SHADER_VISIBILITY_PIXEL);
    params[19].InitAsDescriptorTable(1, &ranges[11], D3D12_SHADER_VISIBILITY_PIXEL);

    params[20].InitAsDescriptorTable(1, &ranges[12], D3D12_SHADER_VISIBILITY_PIXEL);
    params[21].InitAsDescriptorTable(1, &ranges[13], D3D12_SHADER_VISIBILITY_PIXEL);
    params[22].InitAsConstantBufferView(9, 0, D3D12_SHADER_VISIBILITY_PIXEL);
    params[23].InitAsDescriptorTable(1, &ranges[14], D3D12_SHADER_VISIBILITY_PIXEL);
    params[24].InitAsDescriptorTable(1, &ranges[15], D3D12_SHADER_VISIBILITY_PIXEL);
    params[25].InitAsDescriptorTable(1, &ranges[16], D3D12_SHADER_VISIBILITY_PIXEL);
    params[26].InitAsDescriptorTable(1, &ranges[17], D3D12_SHADER_VISIBILITY_PIXEL);
    params[27].InitAsDescriptorTable(1, &ranges[18], D3D12_SHADER_VISIBILITY_PIXEL);
    // 多数のライトの遅延描画（MegaLights、DeferredLightingPS）
    //   M1: ライトバッファ / セル / セル内ライト / グリッド定数
    params[28].InitAsShaderResourceView(44, 0, D3D12_SHADER_VISIBILITY_PIXEL);
    params[29].InitAsShaderResourceView(45, 0, D3D12_SHADER_VISIBILITY_PIXEL);
    params[30].InitAsShaderResourceView(46, 0, D3D12_SHADER_VISIBILITY_PIXEL);
    params[31].InitAsConstantBufferView(10, 0, D3D12_SHADER_VISIBILITY_PIXEL);
    //   M2: サンプル / 累積（検証・ピクセルシェーダーから書く）/ リファレンス（検証）
    params[32].InitAsShaderResourceView(47, 0, D3D12_SHADER_VISIBILITY_PIXEL);
    params[33].InitAsUnorderedAccessView(1, 0, D3D12_SHADER_VISIBILITY_PIXEL);
    params[34].InitAsShaderResourceView(48, 0, D3D12_SHADER_VISIBILITY_PIXEL);
    //   M3: ML6 の生の結果（MegaLightsShadePS が書く）/ デノイズ済み
    params[35].InitAsUnorderedAccessView(2, 0, D3D12_SHADER_VISIBILITY_PIXEL);
    params[36].InitAsShaderResourceView(49, 0, D3D12_SHADER_VISIBILITY_PIXEL);
    //   M4: 可視ライトハッシュ（デバッグ表示用）
    params[37].InitAsShaderResourceView(50, 0, D3D12_SHADER_VISIBILITY_PIXEL);
    params[38].InitAsDescriptorTable(1, &megaLightTextures, D3D12_SHADER_VISIBILITY_PIXEL);
    CD3DX12_STATIC_SAMPLER_DESC samplers[4]{};
    samplers[0] = CD3DX12_STATIC_SAMPLER_DESC(0, D3D12_FILTER_MIN_MAG_MIP_LINEAR);

    samplers[1] = CD3DX12_STATIC_SAMPLER_DESC(1, D3D12_FILTER_COMPARISON_MIN_MAG_LINEAR_MIP_POINT,
                                              D3D12_TEXTURE_ADDRESS_MODE_BORDER, D3D12_TEXTURE_ADDRESS_MODE_BORDER,
                                              D3D12_TEXTURE_ADDRESS_MODE_BORDER, 0.0f, 1,
                                              D3D12_COMPARISON_FUNC_LESS_EQUAL, D3D12_STATIC_BORDER_COLOR_OPAQUE_WHITE);
    samplers[2] = CD3DX12_STATIC_SAMPLER_DESC(3, D3D12_FILTER_MIN_MAG_MIP_LINEAR, D3D12_TEXTURE_ADDRESS_MODE_WRAP,
                                              D3D12_TEXTURE_ADDRESS_MODE_WRAP, D3D12_TEXTURE_ADDRESS_MODE_WRAP);
    samplers[2].ShaderVisibility = D3D12_SHADER_VISIBILITY_PIXEL;
    samplers[3] = CD3DX12_STATIC_SAMPLER_DESC(4, D3D12_FILTER_MIN_MAG_MIP_LINEAR, D3D12_TEXTURE_ADDRESS_MODE_CLAMP,
                                              D3D12_TEXTURE_ADDRESS_MODE_CLAMP, D3D12_TEXTURE_ADDRESS_MODE_CLAMP);
    samplers[3].ShaderVisibility = D3D12_SHADER_VISIBILITY_PIXEL;
    CD3DX12_ROOT_SIGNATURE_DESC rsDesc(_countof(params), params, _countof(samplers), samplers,
                                       D3D12_ROOT_SIGNATURE_FLAG_ALLOW_INPUT_ASSEMBLER_INPUT_LAYOUT);

    ComPtr<ID3DBlob> rsBlob, errBlob;
    ShaderLogToFile("PP: serialize root sig\n");
    HRESULT hr = D3D12SerializeRootSignature(&rsDesc, D3D_ROOT_SIGNATURE_VERSION_1, &rsBlob, &errBlob);
    if (FAILED(hr))
    {
        ShaderLogToFile("PP: FAIL SerializeRootSig\n");
        if (errBlob)
        {
            ShaderLogToFile((const char*)errBlob->GetBufferPointer());
        }
        return false;
    }
    ShaderLogToFile("PP: create root sig\n");
    hr = m_Device->CreateRootSignature(0, rsBlob->GetBufferPointer(), rsBlob->GetBufferSize(),
                                       IID_PPV_ARGS(&m_PostProcessRootSignature));
    if (FAILED(hr))
    {
        ShaderLogToFile("PP: FAIL CreateRootSig\n");
        return false;
    }

    auto cbHeapProps = CD3DX12_HEAP_PROPERTIES(D3D12_HEAP_TYPE_UPLOAD);
    auto cbDesc = CD3DX12_RESOURCE_DESC::Buffer(g_kPP_CB_ALIGNED_SIZE * g_kPP_CB_SLOTS_PER_FRAME * g_kFRAME_COUNT);
    ShaderLogToFile("PP: create PP CB\n");
    hr = m_Device->CreateCommittedResource(&cbHeapProps, D3D12_HEAP_FLAG_NONE, &cbDesc,
                                           D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_GENERIC_READ, nullptr,
                                           IID_PPV_ARGS(&m_PostProcessConstantBuffer));
    if (FAILED(hr))
    {
        ShaderLogToFile("PP: FAIL PP CB\n");
        return false;
    }
    m_PostProcessConstantBuffer->Map(0, nullptr, reinterpret_cast<void**>(&m_pPostProcessCbvDataBegin));

    auto lightCbDesc = CD3DX12_RESOURCE_DESC::Buffer(g_kLIGHT_CB_ALIGNED_SIZE * g_kFRAME_COUNT);
    ShaderLogToFile("PP: create Light CB\n");
    hr = m_Device->CreateCommittedResource(&cbHeapProps, D3D12_HEAP_FLAG_NONE, &lightCbDesc,
                                           D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_GENERIC_READ, nullptr,
                                           IID_PPV_ARGS(&m_LightConstantBuffer));
    if (FAILED(hr))
    {
        ShaderLogToFile("PP: FAIL Light CB\n");
        return false;
    }
    m_LightConstantBuffer->Map(0, nullptr, &m_pLightCbvDataBegin);

    auto pbrCbDesc = CD3DX12_RESOURCE_DESC::Buffer(g_kPBR_CB_ALIGNED_SIZE * g_kPBR_CB_TOTAL_SLOT_COUNT);
    ShaderLogToFile("PP: create PBR CB\n");
    hr = m_Device->CreateCommittedResource(&cbHeapProps, D3D12_HEAP_FLAG_NONE, &pbrCbDesc,
                                           D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_GENERIC_READ, nullptr,
                                           IID_PPV_ARGS(&m_PBRConstantBuffer));
    if (FAILED(hr))
    {
        ShaderLogToFile("PP: FAIL PBR CB\n");
        return false;
    }
    m_PBRConstantBuffer->Map(0, nullptr, &m_pPBRCbvDataBegin);

    ShaderLogToFile("PP: create upscale root sig\n");
    {
        CD3DX12_DESCRIPTOR_RANGE upscaleRange[2];
        upscaleRange[0].Init(D3D12_DESCRIPTOR_RANGE_TYPE_SRV, 1, 0);
        upscaleRange[1].Init(D3D12_DESCRIPTOR_RANGE_TYPE_SRV, 1, 1);

        CD3DX12_ROOT_PARAMETER upscaleParams[3];
        upscaleParams[0].InitAsDescriptorTable(1, &upscaleRange[0], D3D12_SHADER_VISIBILITY_PIXEL);
        upscaleParams[1].InitAsDescriptorTable(1, &upscaleRange[1], D3D12_SHADER_VISIBILITY_PIXEL);
        upscaleParams[2].InitAsConstantBufferView(0, 0, D3D12_SHADER_VISIBILITY_PIXEL);

        CD3DX12_STATIC_SAMPLER_DESC upscaleSampler(0, D3D12_FILTER_MIN_MAG_MIP_LINEAR);
        CD3DX12_ROOT_SIGNATURE_DESC upscaleRsDesc(_countof(upscaleParams), upscaleParams, 1, &upscaleSampler,
                                                  D3D12_ROOT_SIGNATURE_FLAG_ALLOW_INPUT_ASSEMBLER_INPUT_LAYOUT);

        ComPtr<ID3DBlob> rsBlob, errBlob;
        HRESULT hr = D3D12SerializeRootSignature(&upscaleRsDesc, D3D_ROOT_SIGNATURE_VERSION_1, &rsBlob, &errBlob);
        if (FAILED(hr))
        {
            ShaderLogToFile("PP: FAIL SerializeUpscaleRootSig\n");
            if (errBlob)
            {
                ShaderLogToFile((const char*)errBlob->GetBufferPointer());
            }
            return false;
        }
        hr = m_Device->CreateRootSignature(0, rsBlob->GetBufferPointer(), rsBlob->GetBufferSize(),
                                           IID_PPV_ARGS(&m_UpscaleRootSignature));
        if (FAILED(hr))
        {
            ShaderLogToFile("PP: FAIL CreateUpscaleRootSig\n");
            return false;
        }
    }

    ShaderLogToFile("PP: create AA root sig\n");
    {
        CD3DX12_DESCRIPTOR_RANGE aaRange[4];
        aaRange[0].Init(D3D12_DESCRIPTOR_RANGE_TYPE_SRV, 1, 0);
        aaRange[1].Init(D3D12_DESCRIPTOR_RANGE_TYPE_SRV, 1, 1);
        aaRange[2].Init(D3D12_DESCRIPTOR_RANGE_TYPE_SRV, 1, 2);
        aaRange[3].Init(D3D12_DESCRIPTOR_RANGE_TYPE_SRV, 1, 3);

        CD3DX12_ROOT_PARAMETER aaParams[6];
        aaParams[0].InitAsConstantBufferView(0, 0, D3D12_SHADER_VISIBILITY_PIXEL);
        aaParams[1].InitAsDescriptorTable(1, &aaRange[0], D3D12_SHADER_VISIBILITY_PIXEL);
        aaParams[2].InitAsDescriptorTable(1, &aaRange[1], D3D12_SHADER_VISIBILITY_PIXEL);
        aaParams[3].InitAsDescriptorTable(1, &aaRange[2], D3D12_SHADER_VISIBILITY_PIXEL);
        aaParams[4].InitAsConstants(20, 4, 0, D3D12_SHADER_VISIBILITY_PIXEL);
        aaParams[5].InitAsDescriptorTable(1, &aaRange[3], D3D12_SHADER_VISIBILITY_PIXEL);

        CD3DX12_STATIC_SAMPLER_DESC aaSampler(0, D3D12_FILTER_MIN_MAG_MIP_LINEAR);
        CD3DX12_ROOT_SIGNATURE_DESC aaRsDesc(_countof(aaParams), aaParams, 1, &aaSampler,
                                             D3D12_ROOT_SIGNATURE_FLAG_ALLOW_INPUT_ASSEMBLER_INPUT_LAYOUT);

        ComPtr<ID3DBlob> rsBlob, errBlob;
        HRESULT hr = D3D12SerializeRootSignature(&aaRsDesc, D3D_ROOT_SIGNATURE_VERSION_1, &rsBlob, &errBlob);
        if (FAILED(hr))
        {
            ShaderLogToFile("PP: FAIL SerializeAaRootSig\n");
            if (errBlob)
            {
                ShaderLogToFile((const char*)errBlob->GetBufferPointer());
            }
            return false;
        }
        hr = m_Device->CreateRootSignature(0, rsBlob->GetBufferPointer(), rsBlob->GetBufferSize(),
                                           IID_PPV_ARGS(&m_AaRootSignature));
        if (FAILED(hr))
        {
            ShaderLogToFile("PP: FAIL CreateAaRootSig\n");
            return false;
        }
    }

    ShaderLogToFile("PP: create PSOs\n");
    if (!PsoManager::CreatePostProcessPipelines())
    {
        ShaderLogToFile("PP: FAIL CreatePostProcessPipelines\n");
        return false;
    }
    if (!PsoManager::CreateAtmospherePso())
    {
        ShaderLogToFile("PP: FAIL CreateAtmospherePso\n");
        return false;
    }
    if (!PsoManager::CreateUpscalePso())
    {
        ShaderLogToFile("PP: FAIL CreateUpscalePso\n");
        return false;
    }
    if (!PsoManager::CreateUpscaleDepthPso())
    {
        ShaderLogToFile("PP: FAIL CreateUpscaleDepthPso\n");
        return false;
    }
    if (!PsoManager::CreateAaPsos())
    {
        ShaderLogToFile("PP: FAIL CreateAaPsos\n");
        return false;
    }
    if (!PsoManager::CreateVelocityPso())
    {
        ShaderLogToFile("PP: FAIL CreateVelocityPso\n");
        return false;
    }
    if (!PsoManager::CreateVelocityGeometryPso())
    {
        ShaderLogToFile("PP: FAIL CreateVelocityGeometryPso\n");
        return false;
    }
    ShaderLogToFile("PP: done\n");
    return true;
}

===== FILE: source\rendering\shadowpageregions.h =====
#pragma once
#include <cstddef>
#include <vector>
#include <cstdint>

namespace ShadowPages
{
    inline bool NeedsStaticRefresh(bool cacheEnabled, bool mappingMatches, bool staticContentMatches)
    {
        return !cacheEnabled || !mappingMatches || !staticContentMatches;
    }

    inline bool UpdateDue(uint64_t frame, unsigned level)
    {
        const uint64_t period = uint64_t(1) << level;
        return frame % period == period / 2;
    }

    struct Tile
    {
        unsigned X, Y;
        int LogicalX, LogicalY;
        unsigned Pass;
    };

    struct Region
    {
        Tile First;
        unsigned Width, Height;
    };

    inline std::vector<Region> Merge(const std::vector<Tile>& tiles)
    {
        std::vector<Region> regions;
        std::vector<bool> used(tiles.size(), false);
        for (std::size_t i = 0; i < tiles.size(); ++i)
        {
            if (used[i])
            {
                continue;
            }
            const auto& first = tiles[i];
            auto find = [&](unsigned x, unsigned y) {
                for (std::size_t j = 0; j < tiles.size(); ++j)
                {
                    if (!used[j] && tiles[j].X == first.X + x && tiles[j].Y == first.Y + y &&
                        tiles[j].LogicalX == first.LogicalX + int(x) && tiles[j].LogicalY == first.LogicalY + int(y))
                    {
                        return j;
                    }
                }
                return tiles.size();
            };
            unsigned width = 1, height = 1;
            while (find(width, 0) != tiles.size())
            {
                ++width;
            }
            for (;; ++height)
            {
                bool complete = true;
                for (unsigned x = 0; x < width; ++x)
                {
                    if (find(x, height) == tiles.size())
                    {
                        complete = false;
                        break;
                    }
                }
                if (!complete)
                {
                    break;
                }
            }
            for (unsigned y = 0; y < height; ++y)
            {
                for (unsigned x = 0; x < width; ++x)
                {
                    used[find(x, y)] = true;
                }
            }
            regions.push_back({first, width, height});
        }
        return regions;
    }
} // 名前空間 ShadowPages

===== FILE: source\rendering\spatialupscaler.cpp =====
#include "pch.h"
#include "spatialupscaler.h"
#include "rendererstate.h"
#include "renderprofiler.h"

#include <cstddef>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>

#define A_CPU 1
#include "../../External/FidelityFX-FSR/ffx_a.h"
#include "../../External/FidelityFX-FSR/ffx_fsr1.h"
#include "../../External/NVIDIAImageScaling/NIS_Config.h"

static ComPtr<ID3D12Device> g_Device;
static ComPtr<ID3D12DescriptorHeap> g_DescriptorHeap;
static UINT g_DescriptorIncrement = 0;
static ComPtr<ID3D12RootSignature> g_RootSignature;
static ComPtr<ID3D12PipelineState> g_FsrEasuPso;
static ComPtr<ID3D12PipelineState> g_FsrRcasPso;
static ComPtr<ID3D12PipelineState> g_NisPso;
static ComPtr<ID3D12Resource> g_FsrScratch;
static ComPtr<ID3D12Resource> g_NisScaleCoefficients;
static ComPtr<ID3D12Resource> g_NisUsmCoefficients;
static UINT g_OutputWidth = 0;
static UINT g_OutputHeight = 0;
DXGI_FORMAT g_OutputFormat = DXGI_FORMAT_UNKNOWN;

struct FsrConstants
{
    uint32_t Const0[4]{};
    uint32_t Const1[4]{};
    uint32_t Const2[4]{};
    uint32_t Const3[4]{};
    uint32_t DispatchInfo[4]{};
};

static_assert(sizeof(FsrConstants) == sizeof(uint32_t) * 20);

constexpr UINT kNisConfigDwordCount =
    static_cast<UINT>((offsetof(NISConfig, reserved1) + sizeof(NISConfig::reserved1)) / sizeof(uint32_t));
static_assert(kNisConfigDwordCount == 28);
static_assert(kNisConfigDwordCount <= 32);

D3D12_CPU_DESCRIPTOR_HANDLE SpatialUpscaler::CpuHandle(UINT index)
{
    return CD3DX12_CPU_DESCRIPTOR_HANDLE(g_DescriptorHeap->GetCPUDescriptorHandleForHeapStart(), index,
                                         g_DescriptorIncrement);
}

D3D12_GPU_DESCRIPTOR_HANDLE SpatialUpscaler::GpuHandle(UINT index)
{
    return CD3DX12_GPU_DESCRIPTOR_HANDLE(g_DescriptorHeap->GetGPUDescriptorHandleForHeapStart(), index,
                                         g_DescriptorIncrement);
}

bool SpatialUpscaler::CreateRootSignature()
{
    CD3DX12_DESCRIPTOR_RANGE ranges[4];
    ranges[0].Init(D3D12_DESCRIPTOR_RANGE_TYPE_SRV, 1, 0);
    ranges[1].Init(D3D12_DESCRIPTOR_RANGE_TYPE_UAV, 1, 0);
    ranges[2].Init(D3D12_DESCRIPTOR_RANGE_TYPE_SRV, 1, 1);
    ranges[3].Init(D3D12_DESCRIPTOR_RANGE_TYPE_SRV, 1, 2);

    CD3DX12_ROOT_PARAMETER parameters[5];
    for (UINT i = 0; i < 4; ++i)
    {
        parameters[i].InitAsDescriptorTable(1, &ranges[i], D3D12_SHADER_VISIBILITY_ALL);
    }
    parameters[4].InitAsConstants(32, 0, 0, D3D12_SHADER_VISIBILITY_ALL);

    CD3DX12_STATIC_SAMPLER_DESC sampler(0, D3D12_FILTER_MIN_MAG_MIP_LINEAR, D3D12_TEXTURE_ADDRESS_MODE_CLAMP,
                                        D3D12_TEXTURE_ADDRESS_MODE_CLAMP, D3D12_TEXTURE_ADDRESS_MODE_CLAMP);
    CD3DX12_ROOT_SIGNATURE_DESC desc(_countof(parameters), parameters, 1, &sampler, D3D12_ROOT_SIGNATURE_FLAG_NONE);

    ComPtr<ID3DBlob> serialized;
    ComPtr<ID3DBlob> errors;
    HRESULT hr = D3D12SerializeRootSignature(&desc, D3D_ROOT_SIGNATURE_VERSION_1, &serialized, &errors);
    if (FAILED(hr))
    {
        if (errors)
        {
            Debug::Log("Spatial upscaler root signature: %s\n", static_cast<const char*>(errors->GetBufferPointer()));
        }
        return false;
    }
    return SUCCEEDED(g_Device->CreateRootSignature(0, serialized->GetBufferPointer(), serialized->GetBufferSize(),
                                                   IID_PPV_ARGS(&g_RootSignature)));
}

bool SpatialUpscaler::CreatePipeline(const wchar_t* path, ComPtr<ID3D12PipelineState>& output)
{
    ComPtr<ID3DBlob> shader;
    HRESULT hr = D3DReadFileToBlob(path, &shader);
    if (FAILED(hr))
    {
        Debug::Log("Spatial upscaler shader is missing (HRESULT 0x%08X).\n", hr);
        return false;
    }
    D3D12_COMPUTE_PIPELINE_STATE_DESC desc{};
    desc.pRootSignature = g_RootSignature.Get();
    desc.CS = CD3DX12_SHADER_BYTECODE(shader.Get());
    hr = g_Device->CreateComputePipelineState(&desc, IID_PPV_ARGS(&output));
    return SUCCEEDED(hr);
}

bool SpatialUpscaler::CreateNisCoefficientBuffers()
{
    auto createBuffer = [](const float* coefficients, ComPtr<ID3D12Resource>& resource, UINT descriptorIndex) {
        const UINT elementCount = static_cast<UINT>(kPhaseCount * 2);
        const UINT byteSize = elementCount * sizeof(float) * 4;
        auto heapProperties = CD3DX12_HEAP_PROPERTIES(D3D12_HEAP_TYPE_UPLOAD);
        auto desc = CD3DX12_RESOURCE_DESC::Buffer(byteSize);
        HRESULT hr =
            g_Device->CreateCommittedResource(&heapProperties, D3D12_HEAP_FLAG_NONE, &desc,
                                              D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_GENERIC_READ, nullptr, IID_PPV_ARGS(&resource));
        if (FAILED(hr))
        {
            return false;
        }

        void* mapped = nullptr;
        CD3DX12_RANGE readRange(0, 0);
        if (FAILED(resource->Map(0, &readRange, &mapped)))
        {
            return false;
        }
        memcpy(mapped, coefficients, byteSize);
        resource->Unmap(0, nullptr);

        D3D12_SHADER_RESOURCE_VIEW_DESC srv{};
        srv.Shader4ComponentMapping = D3D12_DEFAULT_SHADER_4_COMPONENT_MAPPING;
        srv.Format = DXGI_FORMAT_R32_TYPELESS;
        srv.ViewDimension = D3D12_SRV_DIMENSION_BUFFER;
        srv.Buffer.NumElements = byteSize / sizeof(uint32_t);
        srv.Buffer.StructureByteStride = 0;
        srv.Buffer.Flags = D3D12_BUFFER_SRV_FLAG_RAW;
        g_Device->CreateShaderResourceView(resource.Get(), &srv, SpatialUpscaler::CpuHandle(descriptorIndex));
        return true;
    };

    return createBuffer(&coef_scale[0][0], g_NisScaleCoefficients, RendererState::g_kNIS_COEF_SCALE_SRV_INDEX) &&
           createBuffer(&coef_usm[0][0], g_NisUsmCoefficients, RendererState::g_kNIS_COEF_USM_SRV_INDEX);
}

bool SpatialUpscaler::Initialize(ID3D12Device* device, ID3D12DescriptorHeap* descriptorHeap, UINT descriptorIncrement)
{
    Shutdown();
    if (!device || !descriptorHeap || descriptorIncrement == 0)
    {
        return false;
    }
    g_Device = device;
    g_DescriptorHeap = descriptorHeap;
    g_DescriptorIncrement = descriptorIncrement;
    if (!CreateRootSignature())
    {
        return false;
    }

    const bool fsrReady = CreatePipeline(L"shader/hlsl/build/FsrEasuCS.cso", g_FsrEasuPso) &&
                          CreatePipeline(L"shader/hlsl/build/FsrRcasCS.cso", g_FsrRcasPso);
    const bool nisReady =
        CreatePipeline(L"shader/hlsl/build/NisScalerCS.cso", g_NisPso) && CreateNisCoefficientBuffers();
    if (!fsrReady)
    {
        Debug::Log("FidelityFX FSR 1 is unavailable; bilateral fallback remains active.\n");
    }
    if (!nisReady)
    {
        Debug::Log("NVIDIA Image Scaling is unavailable; bilateral fallback remains active.\n");
    }
    return fsrReady || nisReady;
}

bool SpatialUpscaler::Resize(UINT outputWidth, UINT outputHeight, DXGI_FORMAT format)
{
    if (!g_Device || outputWidth == 0 || outputHeight == 0)
    {
        return false;
    }
    if (g_FsrScratch && g_OutputWidth == outputWidth && g_OutputHeight == outputHeight && g_OutputFormat == format)
    {
        return true;
    }
    g_FsrScratch.Reset();
    g_OutputWidth = outputWidth;
    g_OutputHeight = outputHeight;
    g_OutputFormat = format;

    auto heapProperties = CD3DX12_HEAP_PROPERTIES(D3D12_HEAP_TYPE_DEFAULT);
    auto desc = CD3DX12_RESOURCE_DESC::Tex2D(format, outputWidth, outputHeight, 1, 1, 1, 0,
                                             D3D12_RESOURCE_FLAG_ALLOW_UNORDERED_ACCESS);
    HRESULT hr = g_Device->CreateCommittedResource(&heapProperties, D3D12_HEAP_FLAG_NONE, &desc,
                                                   D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_NON_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE, nullptr,
                                                   IID_PPV_ARGS(&g_FsrScratch));
    if (FAILED(hr))
    {
        return false;
    }
    g_FsrScratch->SetName(L"FSR EASU Output");

    D3D12_SHADER_RESOURCE_VIEW_DESC srv{};
    srv.Shader4ComponentMapping = D3D12_DEFAULT_SHADER_4_COMPONENT_MAPPING;
    srv.Format = format;
    srv.ViewDimension = D3D12_SRV_DIMENSION_TEXTURE2D;
    srv.Texture2D.MipLevels = 1;
    g_Device->CreateShaderResourceView(g_FsrScratch.Get(), &srv, CpuHandle(RendererState::g_kFSR_SCRATCH_SRV_INDEX));

    D3D12_UNORDERED_ACCESS_VIEW_DESC uav{};
    uav.Format = format;
    uav.ViewDimension = D3D12_UAV_DIMENSION_TEXTURE2D;
    g_Device->CreateUnorderedAccessView(g_FsrScratch.Get(), nullptr, &uav,
                                        CpuHandle(RendererState::g_kFSR_SCRATCH_UAV_INDEX));
    return true;
}

void SpatialUpscaler::Shutdown()
{
    g_FsrScratch.Reset();
    g_NisScaleCoefficients.Reset();
    g_NisUsmCoefficients.Reset();
    g_FsrEasuPso.Reset();
    g_FsrRcasPso.Reset();
    g_NisPso.Reset();
    g_RootSignature.Reset();
    g_DescriptorHeap.Reset();
    g_Device.Reset();
    g_DescriptorIncrement = 0;
    g_OutputWidth = 0;
    g_OutputHeight = 0;
    g_OutputFormat = DXGI_FORMAT_UNKNOWN;
}

bool SpatialUpscaler::IsAvailable(UpscaleMode mode)
{
    switch (mode)
    {
        case UpscaleMode::Fsr1:
            return g_FsrEasuPso && g_FsrRcasPso && g_FsrScratch;
        case UpscaleMode::Nis:
            return g_NisPso && g_NisScaleCoefficients && g_NisUsmCoefficients;
        default:
            return true;
    }
}

bool SpatialUpscaler::IsScaleSupported(UpscaleMode mode, UINT inputWidth, UINT inputHeight, UINT outputWidth,
                                       UINT outputHeight)
{
    if (inputWidth == 0 || inputHeight == 0 || outputWidth == 0 || outputHeight == 0)
    {
        return false;
    }
    if (mode != UpscaleMode::Nis)
    {
        return true;
    }

    // NIS 1 段は最大 2 倍。それ以上（内部解像度 50% 未満）は 2 倍以下の段を重ねる（最大 3 段 = 8 倍 → 20% まで対応）
    return inputWidth <= outputWidth && inputHeight <= outputHeight &&
           NisPassCount(inputWidth, inputHeight, outputWidth, outputHeight) <= 3;
}

UINT SpatialUpscaler::NisPassCount(UINT inputWidth, UINT inputHeight, UINT outputWidth, UINT outputHeight)
{
    if (inputWidth == 0 || inputHeight == 0)
    {
        return 0;
    }
    const double ratio =
        (std::max)(static_cast<double>(outputWidth) / inputWidth, static_cast<double>(outputHeight) / inputHeight);
    if (ratio <= 2.0)
    {
        return 1;
    }
    return static_cast<UINT>(ceil(log2(ratio) - 1.0e-6));
}

bool SpatialUpscaler::Execute(ID3D12GraphicsCommandList* commandList, D3D12_GPU_DESCRIPTOR_HANDLE inputSrv,
                              ID3D12Resource* output, D3D12_GPU_DESCRIPTOR_HANDLE outputUav, UINT inputWidth,
                              UINT inputHeight, UINT outputWidth, UINT outputHeight, UpscaleMode mode,
                              ID3D12Resource* input, D3D12_GPU_DESCRIPTOR_HANDLE outputSrv)
{
    // 入力テクスチャの実サイズ（ビューポートより大きいことがある。正しい UV 計算に必要）
    UINT inputTextureWidth = inputWidth, inputTextureHeight = inputHeight;
    if (input)
    {
        const auto inputDesc = input->GetDesc();
        inputTextureWidth = (std::max)(static_cast<UINT>(inputDesc.Width), inputWidth);
        inputTextureHeight = (std::max)(inputDesc.Height, inputHeight);
    }
    const auto outputDesc = output ? output->GetDesc() : D3D12_RESOURCE_DESC{};
    const UINT outputTextureWidth = (std::max)(static_cast<UINT>(outputDesc.Width), outputWidth);
    const UINT outputTextureHeight = (std::max)(outputDesc.Height, outputHeight);
    if (!commandList || !output || !g_RootSignature || !IsAvailable(mode) ||
        !IsScaleSupported(mode, inputWidth, inputHeight, outputWidth, outputHeight))
    {
        return false;
    }
    ID3D12DescriptorHeap* heaps[] = {g_DescriptorHeap.Get()};
    commandList->SetDescriptorHeaps(_countof(heaps), heaps);
    commandList->SetComputeRootSignature(g_RootSignature.Get());

    if (mode == UpscaleMode::Fsr1)
    {
        FsrConstants constants{};
        FsrEasuCon(constants.Const0, constants.Const1, constants.Const2, constants.Const3,
                   static_cast<float>(inputWidth), static_cast<float>(inputHeight),
                   static_cast<float>(inputTextureWidth), static_cast<float>(inputTextureHeight),
                   static_cast<float>(outputWidth), static_cast<float>(outputHeight));
        constants.DispatchInfo[0] = outputWidth;
        constants.DispatchInfo[1] = outputHeight;

        D3D12_RESOURCE_BARRIER scratchToUav = CD3DX12_RESOURCE_BARRIER::Transition(
            g_FsrScratch.Get(), D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_NON_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_UNORDERED_ACCESS);
        commandList->ResourceBarrier(1, &scratchToUav);
        commandList->SetPipelineState(g_FsrEasuPso.Get());
        commandList->SetComputeRootDescriptorTable(0, inputSrv);
        commandList->SetComputeRootDescriptorTable(1, GpuHandle(RendererState::g_kFSR_SCRATCH_UAV_INDEX));
        commandList->SetComputeRoot32BitConstants(4, 20, &constants, 0);
        commandList->Dispatch((outputWidth + 15u) / 16u, (outputHeight + 15u) / 16u, 1);

        D3D12_RESOURCE_BARRIER scratchToSrv = CD3DX12_RESOURCE_BARRIER::Transition(
            g_FsrScratch.Get(), D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_UNORDERED_ACCESS, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_NON_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE);
        commandList->ResourceBarrier(1, &scratchToSrv);

        FsrConstants rcasConstants{};
        FsrRcasCon(rcasConstants.Const0, RendererSettings::GetFsrSharpness());
        rcasConstants.DispatchInfo[0] = outputWidth;
        rcasConstants.DispatchInfo[1] = outputHeight;
        commandList->SetPipelineState(g_FsrRcasPso.Get());
        commandList->SetComputeRootDescriptorTable(0, GpuHandle(RendererState::g_kFSR_SCRATCH_SRV_INDEX));
        commandList->SetComputeRootDescriptorTable(1, outputUav);
        commandList->SetComputeRoot32BitConstants(4, 20, &rcasConstants, 0);
        commandList->Dispatch((outputWidth + 15u) / 16u, (outputHeight + 15u) / 16u, 1);
        return true;
    }

    if (mode == UpscaleMode::Nis)
    {
        // NIS は 1 段最大 2 倍。50% 未満は段を重ねる（各段の倍率を等しく = r^(1/n)。偏った 2 倍 +
        // 端数よりにじみが少ない）
        //   ・シャープネスは最後の段だけ（途中で掛けるとハロー・リンギングが段ごとに増幅される）
        //   ・低解像度ほど元の情報が少ないので、最後の段のシャープネスを少し強める（上限 1）
        //   ・中間は FSR のスクラッチ（出力サイズ）と出力そのものを交互に使う（ビューポートで範囲を指定）
        const UINT passes = NisPassCount(inputWidth, inputHeight, outputWidth, outputHeight);
        if (passes == 0 || passes > 3 || (passes == 3 && outputSrv.ptr == 0))
        {
            return false;
        }
        const float userSharpness = RendererSettings::GetNisSharpness();
        const double ratioX = static_cast<double>(outputWidth) / inputWidth;
        const double ratioY = static_cast<double>(outputHeight) / inputHeight;
        const float scaleBoost = static_cast<float>((std::min)(ratioX, ratioY));
        const float finalSharpness =
            (std::min)(1.0f, userSharpness * (passes > 1 ? 1.0f + 0.1f * (scaleBoost - 2.0f) : 1.0f));

        commandList->SetPipelineState(g_NisPso.Get());
        commandList->SetComputeRootDescriptorTable(2, GpuHandle(RendererState::g_kNIS_COEF_SCALE_SRV_INDEX));
        commandList->SetComputeRootDescriptorTable(3, GpuHandle(RendererState::g_kNIS_COEF_USM_SRV_INDEX));

        struct Surface
        {
            D3D12_GPU_DESCRIPTOR_HANDLE Srv, Uav;
            UINT TextureWidth, TextureHeight;
            ID3D12Resource* Resource;
        };

        const Surface source{inputSrv, {}, inputTextureWidth, inputTextureHeight, input};
        const Surface scratch{GpuHandle(RendererState::g_kFSR_SCRATCH_SRV_INDEX),
                              GpuHandle(RendererState::g_kFSR_SCRATCH_UAV_INDEX), g_OutputWidth, g_OutputHeight,
                              g_FsrScratch.Get()};
        const Surface target{outputSrv, outputUav, outputTextureWidth, outputTextureHeight, output};
        if (passes > 1 && (!g_FsrScratch || g_OutputWidth < outputWidth || g_OutputHeight < outputHeight))
        {
            return false;
        }
        // 最後が出力になるように逆算：3 段 = 出力 → スクラッチ → 出力、2 段 = スクラッチ → 出力
        const Surface* chain[4] = {&source, nullptr, nullptr, nullptr};
        if (passes == 2)
        {
            chain[1] = &scratch;
            chain[2] = &target;
        }
        else if (passes == 3)
        {
            chain[1] = &target;
            chain[2] = &scratch;
            chain[3] = &target;
        }
        else
        {
            chain[1] = &target;
        }

        D3D12_RESOURCE_STATES outputState = D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_UNORDERED_ACCESS;
        D3D12_RESOURCE_STATES scratchState = D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_NON_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE;
        auto setState = [&](ID3D12Resource* resource, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATES target) {
            D3D12_RESOURCE_STATES* current = resource == output                             ? &outputState
                                             : (resource && resource == g_FsrScratch.Get()) ? &scratchState
                                                                                            : nullptr;
            if (!current)
            {
                return; // 入力は呼び出し側が管理
            }
            if (*current == target)
            {
                if (target == D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_UNORDERED_ACCESS)
                {
                    D3D12_RESOURCE_BARRIER barrier = CD3DX12_RESOURCE_BARRIER::UAV(resource);
                    commandList->ResourceBarrier(1, &barrier);
                }
                return;
            }
            D3D12_RESOURCE_BARRIER barrier = CD3DX12_RESOURCE_BARRIER::Transition(resource, *current, target);
            commandList->ResourceBarrier(1, &barrier);
            *current = target;
        };
        UINT currentWidth = inputWidth, currentHeight = inputHeight;
        for (UINT pass = 0; pass < passes; ++pass)
        {
            const bool last = pass + 1 == passes;
            const double t = static_cast<double>(pass + 1) / passes;
            const UINT nextWidth =
                last ? outputWidth : (std::min)(outputWidth, static_cast<UINT>(ceil(inputWidth * pow(ratioX, t))));
            const UINT nextHeight =
                last ? outputHeight : (std::min)(outputHeight, static_cast<UINT>(ceil(inputHeight * pow(ratioY, t))));
            const Surface& from = *chain[pass];
            const Surface& to = *chain[pass + 1];
            NISConfig config{};
            if (!NVScalerUpdateConfig(config, last ? finalSharpness : 0.0f, 0, 0, currentWidth, currentHeight,
                                      from.TextureWidth, from.TextureHeight, 0, 0, nextWidth, nextHeight,
                                      to.TextureWidth, to.TextureHeight, NISHDRMode::None))
            {
                return false;
            }
            // 状態：入力 = NON_PIXEL（呼び出し側）、出力 = UAV（呼び出し側）、スクラッチ = NON_PIXEL（FSR
            // と共通の前提）
            //   読む側を NON_PIXEL、書く側を UAV にそろえる
            setState(from.Resource, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_NON_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE);
            setState(to.Resource, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_UNORDERED_ACCESS);
            commandList->SetComputeRootDescriptorTable(0, from.Srv);
            commandList->SetComputeRootDescriptorTable(1, to.Uav);
            commandList->SetComputeRoot32BitConstants(4, kNisConfigDwordCount, &config, 0);
            commandList->Dispatch((nextWidth + 31u) / 32u, (nextHeight + 23u) / 24u, 1);
            currentWidth = nextWidth;
            currentHeight = nextHeight;
        }
        // 呼び出し時の状態に戻す（出力 = UAV、スクラッチ = NON_PIXEL）
        setState(output, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_UNORDERED_ACCESS);
        setState(g_FsrScratch.Get(), D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_NON_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE);
        return true;
    }
    return false;
}

===== FILE: source\rendering\spatialupscaler.h =====
#pragma once

#include "pch.h"
#include "renderersettings.h"

class SpatialUpscaler
{
  public:
    static bool Initialize(ID3D12Device* device, ID3D12DescriptorHeap* descriptorHeap, UINT descriptorIncrement);
    static bool Resize(UINT outputWidth, UINT outputHeight, DXGI_FORMAT format);
    static void Shutdown();

    static bool IsAvailable(UpscaleMode mode);
    static bool IsScaleSupported(UpscaleMode mode, UINT inputWidth, UINT inputHeight, UINT outputWidth,
                                 UINT outputHeight);
    static bool Execute(ID3D12GraphicsCommandList* commandList, D3D12_GPU_DESCRIPTOR_HANDLE inputSrv,
                        ID3D12Resource* output, D3D12_GPU_DESCRIPTOR_HANDLE outputUav, UINT inputWidth,
                        UINT inputHeight, UINT outputWidth, UINT outputHeight, UpscaleMode mode,
                        ID3D12Resource* input = nullptr, // 入力テクスチャ（実サイズを NIS / FSR に渡すため）
                        D3D12_GPU_DESCRIPTOR_HANDLE outputSrv =
                            D3D12_GPU_DESCRIPTOR_HANDLE{}); // 出力の SRV（NIS の 3 段以上で中間に使う）

    // NIS の段数（1 段は最大 2 倍まで）
    static UINT NisPassCount(UINT inputWidth, UINT inputHeight, UINT outputWidth, UINT outputHeight);

  private:
    static bool CreateRootSignature();
    static bool CreatePipeline(const wchar_t* path, ComPtr<ID3D12PipelineState>& output);
    static bool CreateNisCoefficientBuffers();
    static D3D12_CPU_DESCRIPTOR_HANDLE CpuHandle(UINT index);
    static D3D12_GPU_DESCRIPTOR_HANDLE GpuHandle(UINT index);
};

===== FILE: source\rendering\stablesampling.h =====
#pragma once
#ifdef __cplusplus
#include <cmath>
#include <cstdint>
namespace StableSampling
{
    using SampleUint = std::uint32_t;
#else
typedef uint SampleUint;
#endif

    struct SamplePair
    {
        float x;
        float y;
    };

    inline SampleUint SampleHash(SampleUint value)
    {
        value ^= value >> 16;
        value *= 0x7feb352du;
        value ^= value >> 15;
        value *= 0x846ca68bu;
        return value ^ (value >> 16);
    }

    inline float SampleFraction(float value)
    {
#ifdef __cplusplus
        return value - std::floor(value);
#else
    return frac(value);
#endif
    }

    // 実時間に依存しない、画面上で安定したスクランブルと範囲内の R2/R4 系列。
    // R4 は発光体の選択と三角形座標を1つの積分領域にまとめる。
    inline SamplePair SampleSequence(SampleUint x, SampleUint y, SampleUint index, SampleUint domain)
    {
        SampleUint scramble = SampleHash(x ^ SampleHash(y + domain * 0x9e3779b9u));
        float phase = float((index & 4095u) + 1u);
        float frequencyX = .754877666f, frequencyY = .569840291f;
        // 発光体・三角形の選択と重心座標は、単一の4次元積分問題である。
        // スクランブルだけをずらした R2 ペアを再利用すると、選択した三角形と
        // その表面のサンプル位置の間に相関が生じる。
        if (domain == 1u)
        {
            frequencyX = .856674884f;
            frequencyY = .733891856f;
        }
        if (domain == 2u)
        {
            frequencyX = .628706722f;
            frequencyY = .538597257f;
        }
        SamplePair result;
        result.x = SampleFraction(float(scramble & 65535u) / 65536.0f + phase * frequencyX);
        result.y = SampleFraction(float(scramble >> 16) / 65536.0f + phase * frequencyY);
        return result;
    }

    inline SampleUint PixelSampleIndex(SampleUint frame, bool checkerboard)
    {
        // チェッカーボードのピクセルは1フレームおきに追跡する。frame を直接使うと
        // 低食い違い系列の半分を飛ばしてしまう。
        return checkerboard ? frame >> 1 : frame;
    }
#ifdef __cplusplus
}
#endif

===== FILE: source\rendering\stbn.h =====
#pragma once
#include "pch.h"
#include "graphicslog.h"
#include <cstdint>
#include <fstream>

// One immutable GPU buffer shared by shadow/AO and radiance passes. Root SRVs
// avoid reserving another slot in either engine or per-frame descriptor heaps.
class Stbn final
{
  public:
    static bool Initialize(ID3D12Device* device, ID3D12CommandQueue* queue)
    {
        Shutdown();
        constexpr size_t payloadBytes = 128 * 128 * 64 * 2;
        std::vector<uint32_t> data(1 + payloadBytes / sizeof(uint32_t), 0);
        char option[16]{};
        const bool disabled = GetEnvironmentVariableA("DX12_STBN", option, sizeof(option)) && option[0] == '0';
        if (!disabled)
        {
            std::ifstream input("asset/Noise/stbn-vec2-128x128x64.rg8", std::ios::binary | std::ios::ate);
            if (input && input.tellg() == static_cast<std::streamoff>(payloadBytes))
            {
                input.seekg(0);
                if (input.read(reinterpret_cast<char*>(data.data() + 1), payloadBytes))
                {
                    data[0] = 1;
                }
            }
        }
        const bool available = data[0] != 0;
        if (!available)
        {
            data.resize(1); // A valid bound buffer also serves the R2 fallback.
        }
        const UINT64 bytes = data.size() * sizeof(uint32_t);
        const auto description = CD3DX12_RESOURCE_DESC::Buffer(bytes);
        const auto defaultHeap = CD3DX12_HEAP_PROPERTIES(D3D12_HEAP_TYPE_DEFAULT);
        const auto uploadHeap = CD3DX12_HEAP_PROPERTIES(D3D12_HEAP_TYPE_UPLOAD);
        ComPtr<ID3D12Resource> upload;
        if (!device || !queue ||
            FAILED(device->CreateCommittedResource(&defaultHeap, D3D12_HEAP_FLAG_NONE, &description,
                D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_COPY_DEST, nullptr, IID_PPV_ARGS(&s_Buffer))) ||
            FAILED(device->CreateCommittedResource(&uploadHeap, D3D12_HEAP_FLAG_NONE, &description,
                D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_GENERIC_READ, nullptr, IID_PPV_ARGS(&upload))))
        {
            return false;
        }
        void* mapped = nullptr;
        const D3D12_RANGE noRead{0, 0};
        if (FAILED(upload->Map(0, &noRead, &mapped)))
        {
            return false;
        }
        memcpy(mapped, data.data(), static_cast<size_t>(bytes));
        upload->Unmap(0, nullptr);
        s_Buffer->SetName(L"STBN uniform Float2 RG8");

        ComPtr<ID3D12CommandAllocator> allocator;
        ComPtr<ID3D12GraphicsCommandList> list;
        ComPtr<ID3D12Fence> fence;
        if (FAILED(device->CreateCommandAllocator(D3D12_COMMAND_LIST_TYPE_DIRECT, IID_PPV_ARGS(&allocator))) ||
            FAILED(device->CreateCommandList(0, D3D12_COMMAND_LIST_TYPE_DIRECT, allocator.Get(), nullptr,
                IID_PPV_ARGS(&list))) ||
            FAILED(device->CreateFence(0, D3D12_FENCE_FLAG_NONE, IID_PPV_ARGS(&fence))))
        {
            return false;
        }
        list->CopyBufferRegion(s_Buffer.Get(), 0, upload.Get(), 0, bytes);
        const auto barrier = CD3DX12_RESOURCE_BARRIER::Transition(s_Buffer.Get(), D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_COPY_DEST,
            D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_NON_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE);
        list->ResourceBarrier(1, &barrier);
        if (FAILED(list->Close()))
        {
            return false;
        }
        HANDLE event = CreateEvent(nullptr, FALSE, FALSE, nullptr);
        if (!event)
        {
            return false;
        }
        ID3D12CommandList* lists[] = {list.Get()};
        queue->ExecuteCommandLists(1, lists);
        const HRESULT signal = queue->Signal(fence.Get(), 1);
        const HRESULT completion = fence->SetEventOnCompletion(1, event);
        bool complete = false;
        if (SUCCEEDED(signal) && SUCCEEDED(completion))
        {
            complete = WaitForSingleObject(event, INFINITE) == WAIT_OBJECT_0;
        }
        CloseHandle(event);
        WriteGraphicsLog("STBN: %s (%llu GPU buffer bytes)\n",
            available ? "uniform Float2 128x128x64" : "R2 fallback (disabled or asset missing/invalid)", bytes);
        return complete;
    }

    static void Bind(ID3D12GraphicsCommandList* commands, UINT root)
    {
        commands->SetComputeRootShaderResourceView(root, s_Buffer->GetGPUVirtualAddress());
    }

    static void Shutdown()
    {
        s_Buffer.Reset();
    }

  private:
    inline static ComPtr<ID3D12Resource> s_Buffer;
};

===== FILE: source\rendering\temporalhistory.h =====
#pragma once

#include <cmath>
#include <cstdint>
#include <limits>

namespace TemporalHistory
{
    enum Reason : uint32_t
    {
        None = 0,
        FirstFrame = 1u << 0,
        FrameGap = 1u << 1,
        CameraChanged = 1u << 2,
        ResolutionChanged = 1u << 3,
        SceneChanged = 1u << 4,
        LightingChanged = 1u << 5,
        LodChanged = 1u << 6,
        ExposureChanged = 1u << 7,
        ConfigurationChanged = 1u << 8,
        SignalChanged = 1u << 9
    };

    struct State
    {
        uint64_t Serial = 0;
        uint64_t CameraId = 0;
        uint64_t CameraCutGeneration = 0;
        uint64_t SceneGeneration = 0;
        uint64_t LightingGeneration = 0;
        uint64_t LodGeneration = 0;
        uint64_t ConfigurationKey = 0;
        uint32_t InputWidth = 0;
        uint32_t InputHeight = 0;
        uint32_t OutputWidth = 0;
        uint32_t OutputHeight = 0;
        double Exposure = 1.0;
        bool CameraCut = false;
    };

    struct Decision
    {
        uint32_t Reasons = None;
        bool CanReuse = false;
    };

    // 補正されない露出変更やトポロジー変更では、信号全体を無効化する。
    // 通常のカメラや物体の移動は呼び出し側が再投影するため、世代を増やさない。
    // 局所的な履歴の棄却には、別途ピクセルごとの検査が必要。
    inline Decision Evaluate(const State& previous, const State& current, bool valid)
    {
        uint32_t reasons = valid ? None : FirstFrame;
        if (valid &&
            (previous.Serial == (std::numeric_limits<uint64_t>::max)() || current.Serial != previous.Serial + 1))
        {
            reasons |= FrameGap;
        }
        if (previous.CameraId != current.CameraId || current.CameraCut ||
            previous.CameraCutGeneration != current.CameraCutGeneration)
        {
            reasons |= CameraChanged;
        }
        if (current.InputWidth == 0 || current.InputHeight == 0 || current.OutputWidth == 0 ||
            current.OutputHeight == 0 || previous.InputWidth != current.InputWidth ||
            previous.InputHeight != current.InputHeight || previous.OutputWidth != current.OutputWidth ||
            previous.OutputHeight != current.OutputHeight)
        {
            reasons |= ResolutionChanged;
        }
        if (previous.SceneGeneration != current.SceneGeneration)
        {
            reasons |= SceneChanged;
        }
        if (previous.LightingGeneration != current.LightingGeneration)
        {
            reasons |= LightingChanged;
        }
        if (previous.LodGeneration != current.LodGeneration)
        {
            reasons |= LodChanged;
        }
        if (!std::isfinite(previous.Exposure) || !std::isfinite(current.Exposure) || previous.Exposure <= 0.0 ||
            current.Exposure <= 0.0 || previous.Exposure != current.Exposure)
        {
            reasons |= ExposureChanged;
        }
        if (previous.ConfigurationKey != current.ConfigurationKey)
        {
            reasons |= ConfigurationChanged;
        }
        return {reasons, reasons == None};
    }
} // 名前空間 TemporalHistory

===== FILE: source\rendering\temporalhistorycontext.h =====
#pragma once
#include "temporalhistory.h"

namespace TemporalHistory
{
    // 描画スレッドのコンテキスト。世代は永続的で、エフェクトによって消費されないため、
    // TAA、反射、GI が同じ変更をそれぞれ独立して認識できる。
    class Context final
    {
      public:
        static void BeginFrame(uint32_t outputWidth, uint32_t outputHeight)
        {
            ++s_Frame.Serial;
            s_Frame.OutputWidth = outputWidth;
            s_Frame.OutputHeight = outputHeight;
        }

        static uint64_t GetFrameSerial()
        {
            return s_Frame.Serial;
        }

        static State Capture(uint64_t cameraId, uint32_t inputWidth, uint32_t inputHeight, uint64_t configurationKey,
                             double exposure = 1.0)
        {
            State state = s_Frame;
            state.CameraId = cameraId;
            state.InputWidth = inputWidth;
            state.InputHeight = inputHeight;
            state.ConfigurationKey = configurationKey;
            state.Exposure = exposure;
            return state;
        }

        static void NotifySceneChanged()
        {
            ++s_Frame.SceneGeneration;
        }

        static void NotifyLightingChanged()
        {
            ++s_Frame.LightingGeneration;
        }

        static void NotifyLodChanged()
        {
            ++s_Frame.LodGeneration;
        }

        static void NotifyCameraCut()
        {
            ++s_Frame.CameraCutGeneration;
        }

      private:
        static inline State s_Frame;
    };
} // 名前空間 TemporalHistory

===== FILE: source\rendering\temporalupscaler.h =====
#pragma once
#include "pch.h"
#include "graphicsdevice.h"
#include "camera.h"
#include "renderersettings.h"
#include "temporalhistorycontext.h"
#include "persistentpsocache.h"
#include "renderprofiler.h"
#include "graphicslog.h"

class TemporalUpscaler final
{
  public:
    static bool IsRequested()
    {
        return RendererSettings::GetUpscaleMode() == UpscaleMode::Tsr;
    }

    static bool HasValidHistory()
    {
        return s_Valid;
    }

    static bool IsSubpixelAAEnabled()
    {
        return s_SubpixelAA;
    }

    static bool IsInputTaaEnabled()
    {
        return s_InputTaa;
    }

    static bool IsDetailStabilityEnabled()
    {
        return s_DetailStability;
    }

    static bool IsPlanarDepthEnabled()
    {
        return s_PlanarDepth;
    }

    static bool IsThinGeometryEnabled()
    {
        return s_ThinGeometry;
    }

    static void SetThinGeometryEnabled(bool enabled)
    {
        if (s_ThinGeometry != enabled)
        {
            Invalidate();
        }
        s_ThinGeometry = enabled;
    }

    static void SetPlanarDepthEnabled(bool enabled)
    {
        if (s_PlanarDepth != enabled)
        {
            Invalidate();
        }
        s_PlanarDepth = enabled;
    }

    static void SetDetailStabilityEnabled(bool enabled)
    {
        if (s_DetailStability != enabled)
        {
            Invalidate();
        }
        s_DetailStability = enabled;
    }

    static void SetInputTaaEnabled(bool enabled)
    {
        if (s_InputTaa != enabled)
        {
            Invalidate();
        }
        s_InputTaa = enabled;
    }

    static void SetSubpixelAAEnabled(bool enabled)
    {
        if (s_SubpixelAA != enabled)
        {
            Invalidate();
        }
        s_SubpixelAA = enabled;
    }

    static XMFLOAT2 Jitter()
    {
        auto halton = [](UINT i, UINT base) {
            float r = 0, f = 1;
            while (i)
            {
                f /= base;
                r += f * (i % base);
                i /= base;
            }
            return r;
        };
        const float scale =
            (std::max)(1.f, float(GraphicsDevice::GetWidth()) / (std::max)(1u, GraphicsDevice::GetSceneWidth()));
        const UINT phase =
            RendererState::m_TaaFrameIndex % static_cast<UINT>(std::clamp(8.f * scale * scale, 8.f, 128.f)) + 1;
        return {halton(phase, 2) - .5f, halton(phase, 3) - .5f};
    }

    static void Invalidate()
    {
        s_Valid = false;
    }

    static void Shutdown()
    {
        for (auto& color : s_Color)
        {
            color.Reset();
        }
        for (auto& depth : s_Depth)
        {
            depth.Reset();
        }
        for (auto& detail : s_Detail)
        {
            detail.Reset();
        }
        s_Heap.Reset();
        s_Constants.Reset();
        s_Root.Reset();
        s_Pso.Reset();
        s_Width = s_Height = 0;
        s_Valid = false;
    }

    static bool Execute(ID3D12GraphicsCommandList* list, UINT slot, ID3D12Resource* color, ID3D12Resource* depth,
                        ID3D12Resource* velocity, ID3D12Resource* reveal, ID3D12Resource* output, double exposure)
    {
        if (!list || !color || !depth || !velocity || !output)
        {
            Invalidate();
            return false;
        }
        auto* device = GraphicsDevice::GetDevice();
        const auto in = color->GetDesc(), out = output->GetDesc();
        if (!Initialize(device) || !EnsureTargets(device, UINT(out.Width), out.Height, out.Format))
        {
            Invalidate();
            return false;
        }
        RenderProfiler::ScopedEvent profile("Custom TSR", list);
        slot %= RendererState::g_kFRAME_COUNT;
        const UINT write = s_Write, history = write ^ 1u, base = slot * 10,
                   inc = device->GetDescriptorHandleIncrementSize(D3D12_DESCRIPTOR_HEAP_TYPE_CBV_SRV_UAV);
        auto cpu = [&](UINT i) {
            return CD3DX12_CPU_DESCRIPTOR_HANDLE(s_Heap->GetCPUDescriptorHandleForHeapStart(), base + i, inc);
        };
        auto gpu = [&](UINT i) {
            return CD3DX12_GPU_DESCRIPTOR_HANDLE(s_Heap->GetGPUDescriptorHandleForHeapStart(), base + i, inc);
        };
        auto srv = [&](UINT i, ID3D12Resource* resource, DXGI_FORMAT format) {
            D3D12_SHADER_RESOURCE_VIEW_DESC d{};
            d.Format = format;
            d.ViewDimension = D3D12_SRV_DIMENSION_TEXTURE2D;
            d.Shader4ComponentMapping = D3D12_DEFAULT_SHADER_4_COMPONENT_MAPPING;
            d.Texture2D.MipLevels = 1;
            device->CreateShaderResourceView(resource, &d, cpu(i));
        };
        srv(0, color, in.Format);
        srv(1, depth, DXGI_FORMAT_R32_FLOAT);
        srv(2, velocity, velocity->GetDesc().Format);
        srv(3, s_Color[history].Get(), out.Format);
        srv(4, s_Depth[history].Get(), DXGI_FORMAT_R32_FLOAT);
        srv(5, reveal, reveal ? reveal->GetDesc().Format : DXGI_FORMAT_R16_FLOAT);
        srv(6, s_Detail[history].Get(), DXGI_FORMAT_R16G16_FLOAT);
        for (UINT i = 0; i < 2; ++i)
        {
            D3D12_UNORDERED_ACCESS_VIEW_DESC d{};
            d.Format = i ? DXGI_FORMAT_R32_FLOAT : out.Format;
            d.ViewDimension = D3D12_UAV_DIMENSION_TEXTURE2D;
            device->CreateUnorderedAccessView(i ? s_Depth[write].Get() : s_Color[write].Get(), nullptr, &d, cpu(7 + i));
        }
        D3D12_UNORDERED_ACCESS_VIEW_DESC detailUav{};
        detailUav.Format = DXGI_FORMAT_R16G16_FLOAT;
        detailUav.ViewDimension = D3D12_UAV_DIMENSION_TEXTURE2D;
        device->CreateUnorderedAccessView(s_Detail[write].Get(), nullptr, &detailUav, cpu(9));

        struct alignas(16) Constants
        {
            XMFLOAT4 Extent, Jitter, Parameters;
            XMFLOAT4X4 InvCurrent, Previous;
            XMFLOAT4 Reconstruction;
        } constants{};

        static_assert(sizeof(Constants) <= 256);
        constants.Extent = {float(in.Width), float(in.Height), float(out.Width), float(out.Height)};
        const auto jitter = Jitter();
        constants.Jitter = {jitter.x / in.Width, jitter.y / in.Height, s_PreviousJitter.x, s_PreviousJitter.y};
        const auto state = TemporalHistory::Context::Capture(
            Camera::GetCameraEntity(), UINT(in.Width), in.Height,
            (uint64_t(out.Width) << 32) ^ out.Height ^ uint64_t(out.Format), exposure);
        XMMATRIX view, projection;
        Camera::GetCameraMatrices(Camera::GetCameraEntity(), view, projection);
        XMFLOAT4X4 currentView{};
        XMStoreFloat4x4(&currentView, view);
        float delta = 0;
        for (UINT r = 0; r < 4; ++r)
        {
            for (UINT c = 0; c < 4; ++c)
            {
                const float d = currentView.m[r][c] - s_PreviousView.m[r][c];
                delta += d * d;
            }
        }
        const bool reuse = TemporalHistory::Evaluate(s_State, state, s_Valid).CanReuse && delta < 16;
        constants.Parameters = {reuse ? 1.f : 0.f, reveal ? 1.f : 0.f, s_SubpixelAA ? 1.f : 0.f,
                                s_DetailStability ? 1.f : 0.f};
        constants.Reconstruction.x = s_PlanarDepth ? 1.f : 0.f;
        constants.Reconstruction.y = s_ThinGeometry ? 1.f : 0.f;
        XMStoreFloat4x4(&constants.InvCurrent, XMMatrixTranspose(XMMatrixInverse(nullptr, view * projection)));
        XMStoreFloat4x4(&constants.Previous,
                        XMMatrixTranspose(XMLoadFloat4x4(&GraphicsDevice::GetPreviousViewMatrix()) *
                                          XMLoadFloat4x4(&GraphicsDevice::GetPreviousProjectionMatrix())));
        void* mapped = nullptr;
        const D3D12_RANGE noRead{0, 0};
        if (FAILED(s_Constants->Map(0, &noRead, &mapped)))
        {
            Invalidate();
            return false;
        }
        memcpy(static_cast<BYTE*>(mapped) + slot * 256, &constants, sizeof(constants));
        s_Constants->Unmap(0, nullptr);
        constexpr auto read = D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_NON_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE;
        auto transition = [&](ID3D12Resource* resource, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATES before, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATES after) {
            const auto b = CD3DX12_RESOURCE_BARRIER::Transition(resource, before, after);
            list->ResourceBarrier(1, &b);
        };
        for (auto* resource : {color, depth, velocity})
        {
            transition(resource, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE, read);
        }
        if (reveal)
        {
            transition(reveal, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE, read);
        }
        transition(s_Color[write].Get(), read, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_UNORDERED_ACCESS);
        transition(s_Depth[write].Get(), read, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_UNORDERED_ACCESS);
        transition(s_Detail[write].Get(), read, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_UNORDERED_ACCESS);
        ID3D12DescriptorHeap* heaps[] = {s_Heap.Get()};
        list->SetDescriptorHeaps(1, heaps);
        list->SetComputeRootSignature(s_Root.Get());
        list->SetPipelineState(s_Pso.Get());
        list->SetComputeRootConstantBufferView(0, s_Constants->GetGPUVirtualAddress() + slot * 256);
        list->SetComputeRootDescriptorTable(1, gpu(0));
        list->SetComputeRootDescriptorTable(2, gpu(7));
        list->Dispatch((s_Width + 7) / 8, (s_Height + 7) / 8, 1);
        transition(s_Depth[write].Get(), D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_UNORDERED_ACCESS, read);
        transition(s_Color[write].Get(), D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_UNORDERED_ACCESS, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_COPY_SOURCE);
        transition(s_Detail[write].Get(), D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_UNORDERED_ACCESS, read);
        transition(output, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_COPY_DEST);
        list->CopyResource(output, s_Color[write].Get());
        transition(output, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_COPY_DEST, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE);
        transition(s_Color[write].Get(), D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_COPY_SOURCE, read);
        for (auto* resource : {color, depth, velocity})
        {
            transition(resource, read, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE);
        }
        if (reveal)
        {
            transition(reveal, read, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE);
        }
        s_Write ^= 1;
        s_Valid = true;
        s_State = state;
        s_PreviousJitter = {constants.Jitter.x, constants.Jitter.y};
        s_PreviousView = currentView;
        return true;
    }

  private:
    static bool Initialize(ID3D12Device* device)
    {
        if (s_Pso && s_Heap && s_Constants)
        {
            return true;
        }
        CD3DX12_DESCRIPTOR_RANGE ranges[2];
        ranges[0].Init(D3D12_DESCRIPTOR_RANGE_TYPE_SRV, 7, 0);
        ranges[1].Init(D3D12_DESCRIPTOR_RANGE_TYPE_UAV, 3, 0);
        CD3DX12_ROOT_PARAMETER parameters[3];
        parameters[0].InitAsConstantBufferView(0);
        parameters[1].InitAsDescriptorTable(1, &ranges[0]);
        parameters[2].InitAsDescriptorTable(1, &ranges[1]);
        CD3DX12_STATIC_SAMPLER_DESC sampler(0, D3D12_FILTER_MIN_MAG_MIP_LINEAR, D3D12_TEXTURE_ADDRESS_MODE_CLAMP,
                                            D3D12_TEXTURE_ADDRESS_MODE_CLAMP, D3D12_TEXTURE_ADDRESS_MODE_CLAMP);
        CD3DX12_ROOT_SIGNATURE_DESC root(3, parameters, 1, &sampler);
        ComPtr<ID3DBlob> blob, error;
        if (FAILED(D3D12SerializeRootSignature(&root, D3D_ROOT_SIGNATURE_VERSION_1, &blob, &error)) ||
            FAILED(
                device->CreateRootSignature(0, blob->GetBufferPointer(), blob->GetBufferSize(), IID_PPV_ARGS(&s_Root))))
        {
            return false;
        }
        if (FAILED(D3DCompileFromFile(L"shader/hlsl/TemporalUpscaleCS.hlsl", nullptr, D3D_COMPILE_STANDARD_FILE_INCLUDE,
                                      "main", "cs_6_5", D3DCOMPILE_OPTIMIZATION_LEVEL3, 0, &blob, &error)))
        {
            if (error)
            {
                WriteGraphicsLog("Custom TSR: %s\n", static_cast<const char*>(error->GetBufferPointer()));
            }
            return false;
        }
        D3D12_COMPUTE_PIPELINE_STATE_DESC p{};
        p.pRootSignature = s_Root.Get();
        p.CS = {blob->GetBufferPointer(), blob->GetBufferSize()};
        if (FAILED(PersistentPsoCache::Compute(device, p, s_Pso)))
        {
            return false;
        }
        D3D12_DESCRIPTOR_HEAP_DESC heap{};
        heap.Type = D3D12_DESCRIPTOR_HEAP_TYPE_CBV_SRV_UAV;
        heap.NumDescriptors = 10 * RendererState::g_kFRAME_COUNT;
        heap.Flags = D3D12_DESCRIPTOR_HEAP_FLAG_SHADER_VISIBLE;
        const auto upload = CD3DX12_HEAP_PROPERTIES(D3D12_HEAP_TYPE_UPLOAD), unused = upload;
        const auto buffer = CD3DX12_RESOURCE_DESC::Buffer(256 * RendererState::g_kFRAME_COUNT);
        return SUCCEEDED(device->CreateDescriptorHeap(&heap, IID_PPV_ARGS(&s_Heap))) &&
               SUCCEEDED(device->CreateCommittedResource(&upload, D3D12_HEAP_FLAG_NONE, &buffer,
                                                         D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_GENERIC_READ, nullptr,
                                                         IID_PPV_ARGS(&s_Constants)));
    }

    static bool EnsureTargets(ID3D12Device* device, UINT width, UINT height, DXGI_FORMAT format)
    {
        if (width == s_Width && height == s_Height && format == s_Format && s_Color[0] && s_Color[1] && s_Detail[0] &&
            s_Detail[1])
        {
            return true;
        }
        if (!width || !height || !GraphicsDevice::WaitForGpuIdle())
        {
            return false;
        }

        const auto heap = CD3DX12_HEAP_PROPERTIES(D3D12_HEAP_TYPE_DEFAULT);
        std::array<ComPtr<ID3D12Resource>, 2> colors, depths, details;
        const auto createHistory = [&](DXGI_FORMAT historyFormat, ComPtr<ID3D12Resource>& resource) {
            const auto description = CD3DX12_RESOURCE_DESC::Tex2D(historyFormat, width, height, 1, 1, 1, 0,
                                                                  D3D12_RESOURCE_FLAG_ALLOW_UNORDERED_ACCESS);
            return SUCCEEDED(device->CreateCommittedResource(&heap, D3D12_HEAP_FLAG_NONE, &description,
                                                             D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_NON_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE, nullptr,
                                                             IID_PPV_ARGS(&resource)));
        };
        for (UINT i = 0; i < 2; ++i)
        {
            if (!createHistory(format, colors[i]) || !createHistory(DXGI_FORMAT_R32_FLOAT, depths[i]) ||
                !createHistory(DXGI_FORMAT_R16G16_FLOAT, details[i]))
            {
                return false;
            }
        }
        s_Color = colors;
        s_Depth = depths;
        s_Detail = details;
        s_Width = width;
        s_Height = height;
        s_Format = format;
        s_Write = 0;
        s_Valid = false;
        return true;
    }

    static inline ComPtr<ID3D12RootSignature> s_Root;
    static inline ComPtr<ID3D12PipelineState> s_Pso;
    static inline ComPtr<ID3D12DescriptorHeap> s_Heap;
    static inline ComPtr<ID3D12Resource> s_Constants;
    static inline std::array<ComPtr<ID3D12Resource>, 2> s_Color, s_Depth, s_Detail;
    static inline UINT s_Width = 0, s_Height = 0, s_Write = 0;
    static inline DXGI_FORMAT s_Format = DXGI_FORMAT_UNKNOWN;
    static inline bool s_Valid = false;
    static inline XMFLOAT2 s_PreviousJitter{};
    static inline XMFLOAT4X4 s_PreviousView{};
    static inline TemporalHistory::State s_State;
    static inline bool s_SubpixelAA = true;
    static inline bool s_InputTaa = false;
    static inline bool s_DetailStability = true;
    static inline bool s_PlanarDepth = true;
    static inline bool s_ThinGeometry = true;
};

===== FILE: source\rendering\thumbnailmeshio.h =====
#pragma once
#include <cfileio.h>
#include <filesystem>
#include <algorithm>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstdint>
#include <limits>
#include <memory>
#include <vector>
#include <string>

// Debug と Release では STL の配置が異なるため、DLL 境界は C のデータだけで渡す。
class ThumbnailMeshIO
{
  public:
    explicit ThumbnailMeshIO(std::vector<std::filesystem::path>& files) : m_Files(files) {}

    aiFileIO Callbacks()
    {
        aiFileIO callbacks{};
        callbacks.UserData = reinterpret_cast<char*>(this);
        callbacks.OpenProc = [](aiFileIO* io, const char* path, const char* mode) -> aiFile* {
            if (!path || !mode || mode[0] != 'r')
            {
                return nullptr;
            }
            try
            {
                return reinterpret_cast<ThumbnailMeshIO*>(io->UserData)->Open(path);
            }
            catch (...)
            {
                return nullptr;
            }
        };
        callbacks.CloseProc = [](aiFileIO*, aiFile* file) {
            if (!file)
            {
                return;
            }
            std::fclose(reinterpret_cast<FILE*>(file->UserData));
            delete file;
        };
        return callbacks;
    }

  private:
    aiFile* Open(const char* path)
    {
        const std::string bytes(path);
        const std::u8string utf8(bytes.begin(), bytes.end());
        const auto name = std::filesystem::absolute(std::filesystem::path(utf8)).lexically_normal();
        if (std::find(m_Files.begin(), m_Files.end(), name) == m_Files.end())
        {
            m_Files.push_back(name);
        }
        auto file = std::make_unique<aiFile>();
        FILE* stream = nullptr;
        if (_wfopen_s(&stream, name.c_str(), L"rb") != 0)
        {
            return nullptr;
        }
        file->UserData = reinterpret_cast<char*>(stream);
        file->ReadProc = [](aiFile* file, char* output, size_t size, size_t count) {
            return std::fread(output, size, count, reinterpret_cast<FILE*>(file->UserData));
        };
        file->WriteProc = [](aiFile*, const char*, size_t, size_t) -> size_t {
            return 0;
        };
        file->TellProc = [](aiFile* file) -> size_t {
            return static_cast<size_t>(_ftelli64(reinterpret_cast<FILE*>(file->UserData)));
        };
        file->FileSizeProc = [](aiFile* file) -> size_t {
            auto* stream = reinterpret_cast<FILE*>(file->UserData);
            const auto position = _ftelli64(stream);
            _fseeki64(stream, 0, SEEK_END);
            const auto bytes = _ftelli64(stream);
            _fseeki64(stream, position, SEEK_SET);
            return bytes >= 0 ? static_cast<size_t>(bytes) : 0;
        };
        file->SeekProc = [](aiFile* file, size_t offset, aiOrigin origin) {
            if (offset > static_cast<size_t>(std::numeric_limits<int64_t>::max()))
            {
                return aiReturn_FAILURE;
            }
            int anchor = SEEK_END;
            if (origin == aiOrigin_SET)
            {
                anchor = SEEK_SET;
            }
            else if (origin == aiOrigin_CUR)
            {
                anchor = SEEK_CUR;
            }
            const auto displacement =
                origin == aiOrigin_END ? -static_cast<int64_t>(offset) : static_cast<int64_t>(offset);
            return _fseeki64(reinterpret_cast<FILE*>(file->UserData), displacement, anchor) == 0 ? aiReturn_SUCCESS
                                                                                                 : aiReturn_FAILURE;
        };
        file->FlushProc = [](aiFile*) {
        };
        return file.release();
    }

    std::vector<std::filesystem::path>& m_Files;
};

#include "pch.h"
#include "thumbnailrenderer.h"
