static UINT s_MeshShaderDraws = 0;

void RenderSystem::Draw(RenderPass renderPass, bool receivingPostProcessOnly)
{
    const bool occlusionPhaseTwo = renderPass == RenderPass::OcclusionPhase2;
    if (occlusionPhaseTwo && !MeshShaderPipeline::IsSupported())
    {
        return;
    }
    if (renderPass == RenderPass::ShadowMap || renderPass == RenderPass::TransmittanceShadow)
    {
        ID3D12GraphicsCommandList* pCommandList = GraphicsDevice::GetCommandList();
        const bool transmission = renderPass == RenderPass::TransmittanceShadow;
        ID3D12PipelineState* shadowPso =
            transmission ? TransmittanceShadows::GetPipelineState() : PsoManager::GetOrCreateShadowMapPso();
        UINT8* pCbvDataBegin = FrameConstants::GetConstantBufferPtr();
        ID3D12DescriptorHeap* cbvHeap = FrameConstants::GetCbvHeap();
        if (!pCommandList || !shadowPso || !pCbvDataBegin || !cbvHeap)
        {
            return;
        }

        // 影パスの可視判定は GPU（GpuObjectCullCS）。PSO を設定する前に取得する。
        const int cullView = GpuObjectCulling::ShadowView(pCommandList);
        pCommandList->SetPipelineState(shadowPso);
        auto writeShadowCb = [&](EntityID entity) {
            XMMATRIX world =
                XMLoadFloat4x4(&ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<TransformComponent>(entity).WorldMatrix);
            ConstantBuffer3D cb{};
            cb.World = XMMatrixTranspose(world);
            cb.UseTexture = 0;
            memcpy(pCbvDataBegin + (entity * FrameConstants::g_kCB_ALIGNED_SIZE), &cb, sizeof(cb));
            pCommandList->SetGraphicsRootDescriptorTable(0, FrameConstants::GetConstantBufferHandle(entity));
            const auto& material =
                MaterialManager::Resolve(ComponentManager::HasComponent<MaterialComponent>(entity)
                                             ? ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<MaterialComponent>(entity)
                                             : DefaultMaterial());
            MaterialBindings::BindAssetSlot(entity, material);
        };

        for (EntityID i : World::GetView<SpriteComponent>())
        {
            const auto& sprite = ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<SpriteComponent>(i);
            if (!sprite.Is3D || sprite.VertexBufferView.BufferLocation == 0 ||
                !Registry::HasComponent(i, ComponentType::TRANSFORM) || !ShouldCastShadow(i, transmission) ||
                !LightingResources::ShouldDrawEntityInCurrentShadowSubset(i) || InstancingSystem::CanInstance(i))
            {
                continue;
            }

            writeShadowCb(i);
            pCommandList->IASetVertexBuffers(0, 1, &sprite.VertexBufferView);
            GpuObjectCulling::Begin(pCommandList, cullView, i);
            pCommandList->DrawInstanced(sprite.VertexCount, 1, 0, 0);
            GpuObjectCulling::End(pCommandList);
        }

        for (EntityID i : World::GetView<MeshComponent>())
        {
            if (Registry::HasComponent(i, ComponentType::STATIC_MODEL) ||
                Registry::HasComponent(i, ComponentType::ANIMATION_MODEL))
            {
                continue;
            }

            const auto& mesh = ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<MeshComponent>(i);
            if (mesh.VertexBufferView.BufferLocation == 0 || !Registry::HasComponent(i, ComponentType::TRANSFORM) ||
                !ShouldCastShadow(i, transmission) || !LightingResources::ShouldDrawEntityInCurrentShadowSubset(i) ||
                InstancingSystem::CanInstance(i))
            {
                continue;
            }

            writeShadowCb(i);
            VertexDeformationView deformation;
            const auto vertexView =
                VertexDeformation::TryResolveMesh(i, deformation) ? deformation.CurrentView : mesh.VertexBufferView;
            pCommandList->IASetVertexBuffers(0, 1, &vertexView);
            GpuObjectCulling::Begin(pCommandList, cullView, i);
            pCommandList->DrawInstanced(mesh.VertexCount, 1, 0, 0);
            GpuObjectCulling::End(pCommandList);
        }
        return;
    }

    if (renderPass == RenderPass::Velocity)
    {
        if (RenderConfiguration::GetRenderMode() != RenderMode::DEFERRED)
        {
            return;
        }
        ID3D12GraphicsCommandList* commandList = GraphicsDevice::GetCommandList();
        ID3D12PipelineState* pso = PsoManager::GetVelocityGeometryPso();
        if (!commandList || !pso)
        {
            return;
        }
        XMMATRIX view = XMMatrixIdentity(), projection = XMMatrixIdentity();
        Camera::GetCameraMatrices(Camera::GetCameraEntity(), view, projection);
        XMMATRIX previousViewProjection = XMLoadFloat4x4(&GraphicsDevice::GetPreviousViewMatrix()) *
                                          XMLoadFloat4x4(&GraphicsDevice::GetPreviousProjectionMatrix());
        commandList->SetGraphicsRootSignature(ShaderPipelines::GetModelRootSignature());
        NoiseCacheBindings::BindMain(commandList);
        // 可視判定は GPU（GpuObjectCullCS）。PSO を設定する前に取得する。
        const int cullView = GpuObjectCulling::CameraView(commandList);
        commandList->SetPipelineState(pso);
        commandList->IASetPrimitiveTopology(D3D_PRIMITIVE_TOPOLOGY_TRIANGLELIST);

        auto draw = [&](EntityID entity, const D3D12_VERTEX_BUFFER_VIEW& vbv, UINT vertexCount) {
            if (!ComponentManager::HasComponent<TransformComponent>(entity) || vbv.BufferLocation == 0)
            {
                return;
            }
            const auto& transform = ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<TransformComponent>(entity);
            // 負荷削減：動いていない物は全画面のカメラ Velocity と同じ値になるので描かない
            // （安い判定を先に。マテリアル解決・インスタンシング判定は残った物だけ）
            if (RenderCulling::GetSettings().StaticVelocitySkip && transform.HasPreviousWorld &&
                memcmp(&transform.WorldMatrix, &transform.PreviousWorldMatrix, sizeof(transform.WorldMatrix)) == 0 &&
                !VertexDeformation::IsRequested(entity))
            {
                ++RenderCulling::MutableStats().VelocitySkipped;
                return;
            }
            if (MaterialSystem::IsTransparent(entity))
            {
                return;
            }
            ConstantBuffer3D cb{};
            cb.World = XMMatrixTranspose(XMLoadFloat4x4(&transform.WorldMatrix));
            cb.View = XMMatrixTranspose(view);
            cb.Projection = XMMatrixTranspose(projection);
            cb.PreviousWorld = XMMatrixTranspose(XMLoadFloat4x4(&transform.PreviousWorldMatrix));
            cb.PreviousViewProjection = XMMatrixTranspose(previousViewProjection);
            commandList->SetGraphicsRootDescriptorTable(0, FrameConstants::AllocateTransientConstantBuffer(cb));
            D3D12_VERTEX_BUFFER_VIEW views[2] = {vbv, vbv};
            VertexDeformationView deformation;
            if (VertexDeformation::TryResolveMesh(entity, deformation))
            {
                views[0] = deformation.CurrentView;
                views[1] = deformation.PreviousView;
            }
            commandList->IASetVertexBuffers(0, 2, views);
            commandList->IASetIndexBuffer(nullptr);
            GpuObjectCulling::Begin(commandList, cullView, entity);
            commandList->DrawInstanced(vertexCount, 1, 0, 0);
            GpuObjectCulling::End(commandList);
        };

        for (EntityID entity : World::GetView<SpriteComponent>())
        {
            const auto& sprite = ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<SpriteComponent>(entity);
            if (sprite.Is3D)
            {
                draw(entity, sprite.VertexBufferView, sprite.VertexCount);
            }
        }
        for (EntityID entity : World::GetView<MeshComponent>())
        {
            if (Registry::HasComponent(entity, ComponentType::STATIC_MODEL) ||
                Registry::HasComponent(entity, ComponentType::ANIMATION_MODEL))
            {
                continue;
            }
            if (MeshShaderRenderer::IsActive() && GPUDrivenRenderer::HandlesEntity(entity))
            {
                continue;
            }
            const auto& mesh = ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<MeshComponent>(entity);
            draw(entity, mesh.VertexBufferView, mesh.VertexCount);
        }
        return;
    }

    const bool drawTransparent = renderPass == RenderPass::OverlayScene || renderPass == RenderPass::TransparentScene;
    const bool drawDeferredOpaque = RenderConfiguration::GetRenderMode() == RenderMode::DEFERRED &&
                                    (renderPass == RenderPass::PrimaryScene || occlusionPhaseTwo);
    ID3D12GraphicsCommandList* pCommandList = GraphicsDevice::GetCommandList();
    if (!pCommandList)
    {
        return;
    }

    ID3D12DescriptorHeap* pCbvHeap = FrameConstants::GetCbvHeap();
    if (!pCbvHeap)
    {
        return;
    }

    ScenePasses::BeginSpritePass();
    // 内訳の計測：収集（マテリアル解決・PSO 検索・定数書き込み）と提出（コマンド記録）
    std::optional<RenderProfiler::ScopedEvent> collectProfile;
    collectProfile.emplace(drawDeferredOpaque ? "RenderSystem: Collect (opaque)" : "RenderSystem: Collect",
                           pCommandList);

    UINT8* pCbvDataBegin = FrameConstants::GetConstantBufferPtr();
    if (!pCbvDataBegin)
    {
        return;
    }

    UINT descriptorIncrement = FrameConstants::GetCbvIncrementSize();

    auto spriteEntities = World::GetView<SpriteComponent>();
    const size_t spriteCapacity = Registry::GetActiveEntities(ComponentType::SPRITE).size();
    const size_t modelCapacity = Registry::GetActiveEntities(ComponentType::MESH).size();
    m_SpriteDrawCalls.clear();
    m_ModelDrawCalls.clear();
    m_SpriteDrawCalls.reserve(spriteCapacity);
    m_ModelDrawCalls.reserve(modelCapacity);

    XMMATRIX viewMat = XMMatrixIdentity();
    XMMATRIX projMat = XMMatrixIdentity();
    Camera::GetCameraMatrices(Camera::GetCameraEntity(), viewMat, projMat);
    const XMMATRIX transposedView = XMMatrixTranspose(viewMat);
    const XMMATRIX transposedProj = XMMatrixTranspose(projMat);
    const float sceneAspectRatio = GraphicsDevice::GetSceneAspectRatio();
    const int defaultTextureIndex = TextureManager::GetDefaultTextureIndex();
    XMFLOAT3 cameraPosition = {0.0f, 0.0f, 5.0f};
    if (Registry::HasComponent(Camera::GetCameraEntity(), ComponentType::TRANSFORM))
    {
        cameraPosition =
            ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<TransformComponent>(Camera::GetCameraEntity()).Position;
    }
    const int defaultNormalIndex = TextureManager::GetDefaultTextureIndex();

    for (EntityID i : spriteEntities)
    {
        auto& sprite = ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<SpriteComponent>(i);
        if ((renderPass == RenderPass::TransparentScene && !sprite.Is3D) ||
            (renderPass == RenderPass::OverlayScene && sprite.Is3D))
        {
            continue;
        }
        bool isReceiving = MaterialSystem::IsReceivingPostProcess(i);
        const MaterialComponent* material;
        if (Registry::HasComponent(i, ComponentType::MATERIAL))
        {
            material = &MaterialManager::Resolve(ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<MaterialComponent>(i));
        }
        else
        {
            material = nullptr;
        }
        bool isTransparent = material && MaterialSystem::IsTransparentMaterial(*material);
        if (isTransparent != drawTransparent)
        {
            continue;
        }
        if (!drawTransparent && !drawDeferredOpaque && isReceiving != receivingPostProcessOnly)
        {
            continue;
        }

        if (sprite.VertexBufferView.BufferLocation != 0)
        {
            if (sprite.Is3D)
            {
                if (!Registry::HasComponent(i, ComponentType::TRANSFORM))
                {
                    continue;
                }
                if (InstancingSystem::CanInstance(i))
                {
                    continue;
                }
                // 視錐台・画面サイズの判定は GPU（描画時に SetPredication で破棄）。

                ShaderDescription psoResource{};
                psoResource.vsPath = GetSpriteVsPath(i, true);
                psoResource.psPath = GetSpritePsPath(i, true);
                if (material && material->ShaderClassMode == MaterialMode::Manual &&
                    material->ShaderClass == ShaderClass::PBR)
                {
                    psoResource.psPath = "shader/hlsl/build/modelshaderPS.cso";
                }
                psoResource.isModel = true;
                psoResource.enableAlphaBlend = drawTransparent;
                if (material && material->RuntimeHandle != 0)
                {
                    if (material->AssetCull == MaterialCull::None)
                    {
                        psoResource.cullMode = D3D12_CULL_MODE_NONE;
                    }
                    else if (material->AssetCull == MaterialCull::Front)
                    {
                        psoResource.cullMode = D3D12_CULL_MODE_FRONT;
                    }
                    psoResource.depthWrite = material->AssetDepthWrite;
                }

                ID3D12PipelineState* pso = PsoManager::GetOrCreateGraphicsPso(psoResource);
                if (!pso)
                {
                    continue;
                }

                XMMATRIX world =
                    XMLoadFloat4x4(&ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<TransformComponent>(i).WorldMatrix);

                ConstantBuffer3D cb3D{};
                cb3D.World = XMMatrixTranspose(world);
                cb3D.View = transposedView;
                cb3D.Projection = transposedProj;
                cb3D.UseTexture = 0;

                cb3D.CameraPos = cameraPosition;

                int srvIndex = defaultTextureIndex;
                int normalSrvIndex = defaultNormalIndex;
                if (material)
                {
                    const auto& mat = *material;
                    cb3D.UseTexture = static_cast<int>(mat.UseTexture);
                    cb3D.MaterialMetallic = mat.Metallic;
                    cb3D.MaterialRoughness = mat.Roughness;
                    cb3D.MaterialFresnel = mat.Fresnel;
                    cb3D.MaterialAlpha = mat.Alpha;
                    cb3D.MaterialIsTransparent = static_cast<int>(mat.IsTransparent);
                    cb3D.MaterialMode = static_cast<int>(mat.ShaderClassMode);
                    cb3D.ShaderClass = static_cast<int>(mat.ShaderClass);
                    cb3D.ToonOutlineWidth = mat.ToonOutlineWidth;
                    if (cb3D.UseTexture != 0 && mat.TextureID >= 0)
                    {
                        srvIndex = mat.TextureID;
                    }
                    if (mat.NormalMapID >= 0)
                    {
                        cb3D.UseNormalMap = 1;
                        normalSrvIndex = mat.NormalMapID;
                    }
                }
                if (srvIndex >= FrameConstants::g_kTEXTURE_SRV_START_INDEX + FrameConstants::g_kMAX_SRVS)
                {
                    continue;
                }

                memcpy(pCbvDataBegin + (i * FrameConstants::g_kCB_ALIGNED_SIZE), &cb3D, sizeof(cb3D));
                float cameraDepth;
                if (drawTransparent)
                {
                    cameraDepth = GetCameraDepth(i, viewMat);
                }
                else
                {
                    cameraDepth = 0.0f;
                }
                m_ModelDrawCalls.push_back(DrawCall{i, pso, srvIndex, normalSrvIndex, sprite.VertexBufferView,
                                                    sprite.VertexCount, true, material, cameraDepth});
                continue;
            }

            ShaderDescription psoResource{};
            psoResource.vsPath = GetSpriteVsPath(i, false);
            psoResource.psPath = GetSpritePsPath(i, false);
            psoResource.isModel = false;
            psoResource.enableAlphaBlend = drawTransparent;
            if (material && material->RuntimeHandle != 0)
            {
                if (material->AssetCull == MaterialCull::None)
                {
                    psoResource.cullMode = D3D12_CULL_MODE_NONE;
                }
                else if (material->AssetCull == MaterialCull::Front)
                {
                    psoResource.cullMode = D3D12_CULL_MODE_FRONT;
                }
                psoResource.depthWrite = material->AssetDepthWrite;
            }

            ID3D12PipelineState* pso = PsoManager::GetOrCreateGraphicsPso(psoResource);
            if (!pso)
            {
                continue;
            }

            struct CbData
            {
                float x;
                float y;
                int UseTexture;
                float AspectRatio;
                float ScaleX;
                float ScaleY;
                int UseNormalMap;
                int MaterialMode;
                int ShaderClass;
                float MaterialAlpha;
                float Pad0;
                float Pad1;
            } cbData = {0, 0, 0, 1.0f, 1.0f, 1.0f, 0, 0, 10, 1.0f, 0, 0};

            if (Registry::HasComponent(i, ComponentType::TRANSFORM))
            {
                auto& t = ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<TransformComponent>(i);
                cbData.x = t.Position.x;
                cbData.y = t.Position.y;
                cbData.ScaleX = t.Scale.x;
                cbData.ScaleY = t.Scale.y;
            }
            cbData.AspectRatio = sceneAspectRatio;

            int srvIndex = defaultTextureIndex;
            int normalSrvIndex = defaultNormalIndex;
            if (material)
            {
                const auto& mat = *material;
                cbData.UseTexture = static_cast<int>(mat.UseTexture);
                cbData.MaterialMode = static_cast<int>(mat.ShaderClassMode);
                cbData.ShaderClass = static_cast<int>(mat.ShaderClass);
                cbData.MaterialAlpha = mat.Alpha;
                if (cbData.UseTexture != 0 && mat.TextureID >= 0)
                {
                    srvIndex = mat.TextureID;
                }
                if (mat.NormalMapID >= 0)
                {
                    cbData.UseNormalMap = 1;
                    normalSrvIndex = mat.NormalMapID;
                }
            }
            if (srvIndex >= FrameConstants::g_kTEXTURE_SRV_START_INDEX + FrameConstants::g_kMAX_SRVS)
            {
                continue;
            }

            auto* pCb = reinterpret_cast<CbData*>(pCbvDataBegin + (i * FrameConstants::g_kCB_ALIGNED_SIZE));
            *pCb = cbData;

            float cameraDepth;
            if (drawTransparent)
            {
                cameraDepth = GetCameraDepth(i, viewMat);
            }
            else
            {
                cameraDepth = 0.0f;
            }
            m_SpriteDrawCalls.push_back(DrawCall{i, pso, srvIndex, normalSrvIndex, sprite.VertexBufferView,
                                                 sprite.VertexCount, false, material, cameraDepth});
        }
    }

    for (EntityID i : World::GetView<MeshComponent>())
    {
        if (!drawTransparent && drawDeferredOpaque && GPUDrivenRenderer::HandlesEntity(i))
        {
            continue;
        }
        if (Registry::HasComponent(i, ComponentType::STATIC_MODEL) ||
            Registry::HasComponent(i, ComponentType::ANIMATION_MODEL))
        {
            continue;
        }

        auto& mesh = ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<MeshComponent>(i);
        if (mesh.VertexBufferView.BufferLocation == 0)
        {
            continue;
        }
        if (renderPass == RenderPass::OverlayScene)
        {
            continue;
        }
        if (!Registry::HasComponent(i, ComponentType::TRANSFORM))
        {
            continue;
        }
        if (InstancingSystem::CanInstance(i))
        {
            continue;
        }
        // 視錐台・画面サイズの判定は GPU（描画時に SetPredication で破棄）。

        bool isReceiving = MaterialSystem::IsReceivingPostProcess(i);
        const MaterialComponent* material;
        if (Registry::HasComponent(i, ComponentType::MATERIAL))
        {
            material = &MaterialManager::Resolve(ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<MaterialComponent>(i));
        }
        else
        {
            material = nullptr;
        }
        bool isTransparent = material && MaterialSystem::IsTransparentMaterial(*material);
        if (isTransparent != drawTransparent)
        {
            continue;
        }
        if (!drawTransparent && !drawDeferredOpaque && isReceiving != receivingPostProcessOnly)
        {
            continue;
        }

        ShaderDescription psoResource{};
        psoResource.vsPath = GetMeshVsPath(i);
        psoResource.psPath = GetMeshPsPath(i);
        psoResource.isModel = true;
        psoResource.enableAlphaBlend = drawTransparent;
        if (material && material->RuntimeHandle != 0)
        {
            if (material->AssetCull == MaterialCull::None)
            {
                psoResource.cullMode = D3D12_CULL_MODE_NONE;
            }
            else if (material->AssetCull == MaterialCull::Front)
            {
                psoResource.cullMode = D3D12_CULL_MODE_FRONT;
            }
            psoResource.depthWrite = material->AssetDepthWrite;
        }

        ID3D12PipelineState* pso = PsoManager::GetOrCreateGraphicsPso(psoResource);
        if (!pso)
        {
            continue;
        }

        XMMATRIX world = XMLoadFloat4x4(&ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<TransformComponent>(i).WorldMatrix);

        ConstantBuffer3D cb3D{};
        cb3D.World = XMMatrixTranspose(world);
        cb3D.View = transposedView;
        cb3D.Projection = transposedProj;
        cb3D.UseTexture = 0;

        cb3D.CameraPos = cameraPosition;

        int srvIndex = defaultTextureIndex;
        int normalSrvIndex = defaultNormalIndex;
        if (material)
        {
            const auto& mat = *material;
            cb3D.UseTexture = static_cast<int>(mat.UseTexture);
            cb3D.MaterialMetallic = mat.Metallic;
            cb3D.MaterialRoughness = mat.Roughness;
            cb3D.MaterialFresnel = mat.Fresnel;
            cb3D.MaterialAlpha = mat.Alpha;
            cb3D.MaterialIsTransparent = static_cast<int>(mat.IsTransparent);
            cb3D.MaterialMode = static_cast<int>(mat.ShaderClassMode);
            cb3D.ShaderClass = static_cast<int>(mat.ShaderClass);
            cb3D.ToonOutlineWidth = mat.ToonOutlineWidth;
            if (cb3D.UseTexture != 0 && mat.TextureID >= 0)
            {
                srvIndex = mat.TextureID;
            }
            if (mat.NormalMapID >= 0)
            {
                cb3D.UseNormalMap = 1;
                normalSrvIndex = mat.NormalMapID;
            }
        }
        if (srvIndex >= FrameConstants::g_kTEXTURE_SRV_START_INDEX + FrameConstants::g_kMAX_SRVS)
        {
            continue;
        }

        memcpy(pCbvDataBegin + (i * FrameConstants::g_kCB_ALIGNED_SIZE), &cb3D, sizeof(cb3D));
        float cameraDepth;
        if (drawTransparent)
        {
            cameraDepth = GetCameraDepth(i, viewMat);
        }
        else
        {
            cameraDepth = 0.0f;
        }
        VertexDeformationView deformation;
        const auto vertexView =
            VertexDeformation::TryResolveMesh(i, deformation) ? deformation.CurrentView : mesh.VertexBufferView;
        m_ModelDrawCalls.push_back(
            DrawCall{i, pso, srvIndex, normalSrvIndex, vertexView, mesh.VertexCount, true, material, cameraDepth});
    }

    auto sortDrawCalls = [drawTransparent](vector<DrawCall>& drawCalls) {
        sort(drawCalls.begin(), drawCalls.end(), [drawTransparent](const DrawCall& a, const DrawCall& b) {
            if (drawTransparent)
            {
                if (fabsf(a.cameraDepth - b.cameraDepth) > 0.0001f)
                {
                    return a.cameraDepth > b.cameraDepth;
                }
            }
            else
            {
                if (fabsf(a.cameraDepth - b.cameraDepth) > 0.0001f)
                {
                    return a.cameraDepth < b.cameraDepth;
                }
            }
            if (a.pso != b.pso)
            {
                return a.pso < b.pso;
            }
            if (a.srvIndex != b.srvIndex)
            {
                return a.srvIndex < b.srvIndex;
            }
            return a.normalSrvIndex < b.normalSrvIndex;
        });
    };

    sortDrawCalls(m_SpriteDrawCalls);
    sortDrawCalls(m_ModelDrawCalls);
    collectProfile.reset();
    RenderProfiler::ScopedEvent submitProfile(
        drawDeferredOpaque ? "RenderSystem: Submit (opaque)" : "RenderSystem: Submit", pCommandList);

    auto heapStart = pCbvHeap->GetGPUDescriptorHandleForHeapStart();
    // 可視判定は GPU（GpuObjectCullCS）。PSO を設定する前に取得する。
    const int cullView = (m_SpriteDrawCalls.empty() && m_ModelDrawCalls.empty())
                             ? GpuObjectCulling::kNoView
                             : GpuObjectCulling::CameraView(pCommandList);

    auto submitDrawCalls = [&](const vector<DrawCall>& drawCalls) {
        ID3D12PipelineState* lastPso = nullptr;
        ID3D12PipelineState* outlinePso = PsoManager::GetOrCreateToonOutlinePso(drawTransparent);
        int lastSrvIndex = -1;
        int lastNormalSrvIndex = -1;

        for (const auto& dc : drawCalls)
        {
            if (occlusionPhaseTwo && (!dc.is3D || !ComponentManager::HasComponent<MeshComponent>(dc.EntityID)))
            {
                continue;
            }
            const MaterialComponent* materialSelection = nullptr;
            if (dc.material)
            {
                materialSelection = &(*dc.material);
            }
            else
            {
                materialSelection = &(DefaultMaterial());
            }
            const MaterialComponent& material = *materialSelection;
            MaterialBindings::SetMaterial(dc.EntityID, material);
            if (InstancingSystem::CanInstance(dc.EntityID))
            {
                continue;
            }

            if (dc.pso != lastPso)
            {
                pCommandList->SetPipelineState(dc.pso);
                lastPso = dc.pso;
            }

            pCommandList->SetGraphicsRootDescriptorTable(0, FrameConstants::GetConstantBufferHandle(dc.EntityID));

            if (dc.srvIndex != lastSrvIndex)
            {
                TextureManager::TouchTexture(dc.srvIndex);
                CD3DX12_GPU_DESCRIPTOR_HANDLE srvHandle(heapStart, dc.srvIndex, descriptorIncrement);
                pCommandList->SetGraphicsRootDescriptorTable(1, srvHandle);
                lastSrvIndex = dc.srvIndex;
            }
            if (dc.normalSrvIndex != lastNormalSrvIndex)
            {
                TextureManager::TouchTexture(dc.normalSrvIndex);
                CD3DX12_GPU_DESCRIPTOR_HANDLE normalSrvHandle(heapStart, dc.normalSrvIndex, descriptorIncrement);
                pCommandList->SetGraphicsRootDescriptorTable(6, normalSrvHandle);
                lastNormalSrvIndex = dc.normalSrvIndex;
            }

            pCommandList->IASetVertexBuffers(0, 1, &dc.vbv);
            if (dc.is3D)
            {
                GpuObjectCulling::Begin(pCommandList, cullView, dc.EntityID);
            }
            bool meshShaderDrawn = false;
            if (material.RuntimeHandle == 0 && drawDeferredOpaque && dc.is3D &&
                ComponentManager::HasComponent<MeshComponent>(dc.EntityID))
            {
                const auto& mesh = ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<MeshComponent>(dc.EntityID);
                VertexDeformationView deformation;
                MeshShaderPipeline::Geometry geometry;
                geometry.Vertices = VertexDeformation::TryResolveMesh(dc.EntityID, deformation)
                                        ? deformation.CurrentResource
                                        : mesh.VertexBuffer.Get();
                geometry.VertexState = deformation.CurrentResource ? D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_VERTEX_AND_CONSTANT_BUFFER
                                                                   : D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_GENERIC_READ;
                geometry.VertexView = dc.vbv;
                geometry.ElementCount = dc.vertexCount;
                XMFLOAT3 center = mesh.LocalBoundsCenter, extents = mesh.LocalBoundsExtents;
                VertexDeformation::TryGetLocalBounds(dc.EntityID, center, extents);
                meshShaderDrawn = MeshShaderPipeline::Draw(pCommandList, geometry, center, extents);
                ++s_MeshShaderDraws;
            }
            if (meshShaderDrawn)
            {
                lastPso = nullptr;
            }
            else if (!occlusionPhaseTwo)
            {
                pCommandList->DrawInstanced(dc.vertexCount, 1, 0, 0);
            }

            if (!occlusionPhaseTwo && dc.is3D && outlinePso && ShouldDrawToonOutline(dc.EntityID))
            {
                pCommandList->SetPipelineState(outlinePso);
                pCommandList->DrawInstanced(dc.vertexCount, 1, 0, 0);
                lastPso = outlinePso;
            }
            GpuObjectCulling::End(pCommandList);
        }
    };

    if (!m_SpriteDrawCalls.empty())
    {
        ScenePasses::BeginSpritePass();
        submitDrawCalls(m_SpriteDrawCalls);
    }

    if (!m_ModelDrawCalls.empty())
    {
        ScenePasses::BeginModelPass();
        submitDrawCalls(m_ModelDrawCalls);
    }
    // 何件がこの CPU 経路に来ているか（GPU 駆動が受け持てていない物の数）。ログに 1 秒ごと
    static auto lastLog = chrono::steady_clock::now();
    if (drawDeferredOpaque && chrono::steady_clock::now() - lastLog > chrono::seconds(1))
    {
        lastLog = chrono::steady_clock::now();
        WriteGraphicsLog("RenderSystem(CPU path): sprites=%zu models=%zu meshShaderDraws=%u gpuDriven=%d\n",
                         m_SpriteDrawCalls.size(), m_ModelDrawCalls.size(), s_MeshShaderDraws,
                         GPUDrivenRenderer::IsActive() ? 1 : 0);
    }
    s_MeshShaderDraws = 0;
}

#include "proceduralsystem.h"

bool SystemManager::Init()
{

    auto addSystem = [](unique_ptr<SystemBase> system) {
        SystemBase* rawPtr = system.get();
        m_Systems.push_back(move(system));
        m_SystemMap[type_index(typeid(*rawPtr))] = rawPtr;
    };

    addSystem(make_unique<InputSystem>());
    addSystem(make_unique<MovementSystem>());
    addSystem(make_unique<CameraControlSystem>());
    addSystem(make_unique<PostProcessInputSystem>());
    addSystem(make_unique<TimeLineSystem>());
    addSystem(make_unique<AnimationSystem>());

    addSystem(make_unique<ProceduralSystem>());
    addSystem(make_unique<PhysicsSystem>());
    addSystem(make_unique<MaterialSystem>());
    addSystem(make_unique<LightSystem>());
    addSystem(make_unique<CameraSystem>());
    addSystem(make_unique<TransformSystem>());
    addSystem(make_unique<LookAtSystem>());

    addSystem(make_unique<GridSystem>());
    addSystem(make_unique<RenderSystem>());
    addSystem(make_unique<ModelSystem>());
    addSystem(make_unique<InstancingSystem>());
    addSystem(make_unique<DebugSystem>());

    // 再生中だけ動かすシステムの判定は、毎フレームRTTIで比較せず初期化時に1回だけ行う
    m_PlayOnly.clear();
    m_PlayOnly.reserve(m_Systems.size());
    for (auto& system : m_Systems)
    {
        const type_index systemType(typeid(*system));
        const bool playOnlySystem =
            systemType == type_index(typeid(InputSystem)) || systemType == type_index(typeid(MovementSystem)) ||
            systemType == type_index(typeid(CameraControlSystem)) ||
            systemType == type_index(typeid(PostProcessInputSystem)) ||
            systemType == type_index(typeid(TimeLineSystem)) || systemType == type_index(typeid(AnimationSystem));
        m_PlayOnly.push_back(playOnlySystem ? 1u : 0u);
    }

    for (auto& system : m_Systems)
    {
        system->Init();
    }
    return true;
}

void SystemManager::Uninit()
{
    for (auto& system : m_Systems)
    {
        system->Uninit();
    }
    m_Systems.clear();
    m_SystemMap.clear();
    m_PlayOnly.clear();
}

void SystemManager::UpdateSystem()
{
    ComponentManager::ForEachComponent<TransformComponent>([](EntityID, TransformComponent& transform) {
        if (transform.HasPreviousWorld)
        {
            transform.PreviousWorldMatrix = transform.WorldMatrix;
        }
    });

    for (size_t index = 0; index < m_Systems.size(); ++index)
    {
        // 状態はシステムの途中で変わりうるので毎回読む（インライン比較なので軽い）
        if (m_PlayOnly[index] && !ProjectManager::IsSimulationRunning())
        {
            continue;
        }
        m_Systems[index]->Update();
    }

    ComponentManager::ForEachComponent<TransformComponent>([](EntityID, TransformComponent& transform) {
        if (!transform.HasPreviousWorld)
        {
            transform.PreviousWorldMatrix = transform.WorldMatrix;
            transform.HasPreviousWorld = true;
        }
    });
}

void SystemManager::DrawSystem(RenderPass renderPass, bool receivingPostProcessOnly)
{
    for (auto& system : m_Systems)
    {
        system->Draw(renderPass, receivingPostProcessOnly);
    }
}

void SystemManager::RenderFlow()
{
    FramePipeline::Execute();
}

#pragma once

#include <vector>
#include <unordered_map>
#include <typeindex>
#include <typeinfo>
#include <memory>
#include "ecs.h"
#include "systembase.h"

class SystemManager
{
  private:
    inline static vector<unique_ptr<SystemBase>> m_Systems;
    inline static unordered_map<type_index, SystemBase*> m_SystemMap;
    inline static vector<uint8_t> m_PlayOnly; // m_Systemsと同じ並び。Init時に1回だけ判定

  public:
    static bool Init();
    static void Uninit();

    template <typename T> static T* GetSystem()
    {
        auto it = m_SystemMap.find(type_index(typeid(T)));
        if (it == m_SystemMap.end())
        {
            return nullptr;
        }
        return static_cast<T*>(it->second);
    }

    static void UpdateSystem();
    static void DrawSystem(RenderPass renderPass, bool receivingPostProcessOnly);
    static void RenderFlow();
};

===== FILE: source\systems\timelinesystem.cpp =====
#include "pch.h"
#include "timelinesystem.h"
#include "timelinecurve.h"
#include "world.h"
#include "componentmanager.h"
#include "projectmanager.h"
#include "animator.h"
#include "camera.h"
#include "materialmanager.h"
#include "modelmanager.h"
#include "texturemanager.h"
#include "localheightfog.h"
#include "gpuscene/gpuscenechanges.h"
#include <filesystem>
#include "../audio/xaudiomusicplayer.h"
#include "../audio/livemusicclock.h"
#include <algorithm>

namespace
{
    struct MusicPlayback
    {
        LiveMusic::XAudioMusicPlayer Player;
        string Path;
        uint64_t Session = 0;
        bool Playing = false;
        float Offset = 0.0f;
    };

    unordered_map<EntityID, unique_ptr<MusicPlayback>> g_Music;

    bool AudioError(TimelineComponent& timeline, const char* operation)
    {
        timeline.PlaybackError = string("XAudio2: ") + operation + ": " + timeline.MusicPath;
        timeline.IsPlaying = false;
        timeline.SeekRequested = false;
        return false;
    }

    bool UpdateMusic(EntityID entity, TimelineComponent& timeline)
    {
        auto& entry = g_Music[entity];
        const uint64_t session = ProjectManager::GetPlaySession();
        if (entry && (entry->Path != timeline.MusicPath || entry->Session != session))
        {
            entry.reset();
        }
        if (!entry)
        {
            entry = make_unique<MusicPlayback>();
            entry->Path = timeline.MusicPath;
            entry->Session = session;
            if (!entry->Player.OpenWav(timeline.MusicPath))
            {
                entry.reset();
                return AudioError(timeline, "Cannot open PCM16 / float32 WAV or audio device");
            }
            timeline.SeekRequested = true;
        }
        auto& music = *entry;
        music.Player.SetVolume(timeline.MusicVolume);
        timeline.MusicDuration = static_cast<float>(music.Player.DurationSeconds());
        const float end = min(timeline.Duration, max(0.0f, timeline.MusicDuration - timeline.MusicOffset));
        if (timeline.SeekRequested || music.Offset != timeline.MusicOffset)
        {
            music.Player.Pause();
            music.Playing = false;
            if (!music.Player.Seek(timeline.CurrentTime + timeline.MusicOffset))
            {
                return AudioError(timeline, "Seek failed");
            }
            timeline.SeekRequested = false;
            music.Offset = timeline.MusicOffset;
        }
        timeline.CurrentTime = clamp(static_cast<float>(music.Player.TimeSeconds()) - timeline.MusicOffset, 0.0f, end);
        if (timeline.IsPlaying && timeline.CurrentTime >= end)
        {
            music.Player.Pause();
            music.Playing = false;
            if (timeline.Loop && end > 0.0f)
            {
                Camera::NotifyCut();
                if (!music.Player.Seek(timeline.MusicOffset))
                {
                    return AudioError(timeline, "Loop seek failed");
                }
                timeline.CurrentTime = 0.0f;
            }
            else
            {
                timeline.IsPlaying = false;
            }
        }
        if (timeline.IsPlaying != music.Playing)
        {
            if (timeline.IsPlaying)
            {
                if (!music.Player.Play())
                {
                    return AudioError(timeline, "Playback failed");
                }
            }
            else
            {
                music.Player.Pause();
            }
            music.Playing = timeline.IsPlaying;
        }
        timeline.PlaybackError.clear();
        return true;
    }
}

// キー補間・クリップ評価は TimelineCurve（timelinecurve.h）に集約。Sequencer の曲線表示も同じ実装を使う。

void ApplyProperty(EntityID target, TimelineProperty property, const XMFLOAT4& value, int fogVolume)
{
    if (!Registry::IsAlive(target))
    {
        return;
    }
    if (property <= TimelineProperty::TransformScale && ComponentManager::HasComponent<TransformComponent>(target))
    {
        auto& transform = ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<TransformComponent>(target);
        XMFLOAT3* destination;
        if (property == TimelineProperty::TransformPosition)
        {
            destination = &transform.Position;
        }
        else
        {
            if (property == TimelineProperty::TransformRotation)
            {
                destination = &transform.Rotation;
            }
            else
            {
                destination = &transform.Scale;
            }
        }
        *destination = {value.x, value.y, value.z};
        transform.IsDirty = true;
        return;
    }
    if (property >= TimelineProperty::CameraTarget && property <= TimelineProperty::CameraLockOnOffset &&
        ComponentManager::HasComponent<CameraComponent>(target))
    {
        auto& camera = ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<CameraComponent>(target);
        switch (property)
        {
            case TimelineProperty::CameraTarget:
                camera.Target = {value.x, value.y, value.z};
                break;
            case TimelineProperty::CameraFov:
                camera.Fov = clamp(value.x, XMConvertToRadians(1.0f), XMConvertToRadians(179.0f));
                break;
            case TimelineProperty::CameraNearClip:
                camera.NearClip = max(0.001f, value.x);
                break;
            case TimelineProperty::CameraFarClip:
                camera.FarClip = max(camera.NearClip + 0.001f, value.x);
                break;
            case TimelineProperty::CameraLockOnOffset:
                camera.LockOnOffset = {value.x, value.y, value.z};
                break;
            default:
                break;
        }
        return;
    }
    if (property == TimelineProperty::PostProcessIntensity &&
        ComponentManager::HasComponent<PostProcessComponent>(target))
    {
        ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<PostProcessComponent>(target).Intensity = clamp(value.x, 0.0f, 1.0f);
    }
    if (property >= TimelineProperty::LightIntensity && property <= TimelineProperty::LightBeamDensity &&
        ComponentManager::HasComponent<LightComponent>(target))
    {
        auto& light = ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<LightComponent>(target);
        switch (property)
        {
            case TimelineProperty::LightIntensity:
                light.Intensity = max(0.0f, value.x);
                break;
            case TimelineProperty::LightColor:
                light.Color = value;
                break;
            case TimelineProperty::LightDirection:
                if (XMVectorGetX(XMVector3LengthSq(XMLoadFloat4(&value))) > 0.000001f)
                {
                    XMStoreFloat3(&light.Direction, XMVector3Normalize(XMLoadFloat4(&value)));
                }
                break;
            case TimelineProperty::LightRange:
                light.Range = max(0.001f, value.x);
                break;
            case TimelineProperty::LightBeamDensity:
                light.VolumeDensity = max(0.0f, value.x);
                light.AffectsVolumetrics = light.VolumeDensity > 0.0f;
                break;
        }
    }
    if ((property == TimelineProperty::LightInnerAngle || property == TimelineProperty::LightOuterAngle) &&
        ComponentManager::HasComponent<LightComponent>(target))
    {
        // インスペクターと同じ範囲（度）。外角は内角より大きく保つ。
        auto& light = ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<LightComponent>(target);
        if (property == TimelineProperty::LightInnerAngle)
        {
            light.InnerAngle = clamp(value.x, 0.1f, 89.0f);
            light.OuterAngle = max(light.OuterAngle, light.InnerAngle + 0.1f);
        }
        else
        {
            light.OuterAngle = clamp(value.x, light.InnerAngle + 0.1f, 89.5f);
        }
    }
    if (property >= TimelineProperty::BloomThreshold && property <= TimelineProperty::BloomRadius &&
        ComponentManager::HasComponent<PostProcessComponent>(target))
    {
        auto& post = ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<PostProcessComponent>(target);
        if (property == TimelineProperty::BloomThreshold)
        {
            post.BloomThreshold = max(0.0f, value.x);
        }
        if (property == TimelineProperty::BloomSoftKnee)
        {
            post.BloomSoftKnee = clamp(value.x, 0.0f, 1.0f);
        }
        if (property == TimelineProperty::BloomRadius)
        {
            post.BloomRadius = max(0.0f, value.x);
        }
    }
    auto& fog = LocalHeightFog::GetMutableVolumes();
    if (fogVolume >= 0 && static_cast<size_t>(fogVolume) < fog.size())
    {
        if (property == TimelineProperty::FogDensity)
        {
            fog[fogVolume].Density = max(0.0f, value.x);
        }
        if (property == TimelineProperty::FogColor)
        {
            fog[fogVolume].Color = {value.x, value.y, value.z};
        }
    }
    if (property == TimelineProperty::AnimationTime)
    {
        if (ComponentManager::HasComponent<AnimationModelComponent>(target))
        {
            auto& animation = ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<AnimationModelComponent>(target);
            if (animation.CurrentAnimation.empty() && !animation.Animations.empty())
            {
                Animator::Play(animation, animation.Animations.front());
            }
            animation.TimelineDriven = true;
            animation.CurrentTime = animation.NextTime = max(0.0f, value.x);
            for (auto& layer : animation.ActiveAnimationLayers)
            {
                layer.CurrentTime = animation.CurrentTime;
            }
            if (!ProjectManager::IsSimulationRunning())
            {
                if (auto* model = ModelManager::GetAnimModel(animation.ModelId))
                {
                    if (animation.ActiveAnimationLayers.size() > 1)
                    {
                        model->UpdateBoneMatrices(animation.ActiveAnimationLayers);
                    }
                    else if (!animation.CurrentAnimation.empty())
                    {
                        model->UpdateBoneMatrices(animation.CurrentAnimation.c_str(), animation.CurrentTime,
                                                  animation.CurrentAnimation.c_str(), animation.CurrentTime, 0.0f);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        if (ComponentManager::HasComponent<CameraComponent>(target) &&
            ComponentManager::HasComponent<TransformComponent>(target))
        {
            auto& camera = ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<CameraComponent>(target);
            if (!camera.Animation.Path.empty() &&
                (!camera.Animation.Clip || camera.Animation.LoadedPath != camera.Animation.Path))
            {
                Animator::Play(camera, false);
            }
            camera.Animation.TimelineDriven = true;
            camera.Animation.CurrentTime = max(0.0f, value.x);
            Animator::Update(camera, ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<TransformComponent>(target), 0.0f);
        }
    }
    if ((property == TimelineProperty::EmissiveIntensity || property == TimelineProperty::EmissiveColor) &&
        ComponentManager::HasComponent<MaterialComponent>(target))
    {
        auto& material = ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<MaterialComponent>(target);
        if (!material.MaterialSlots.empty() || material.RuntimeHandle)
        {
            MaterialComponent binding = MaterialManager::Resolve(material);
            binding.MaterialSlots.clear();
            binding.RuntimeHandle = 0;
            material = move(binding);
        }
        if (property == TimelineProperty::EmissiveIntensity)
        {
            material.EmissiveIntensity = max(0.0f, value.x);
        }
        else
        {
            material.EmissiveColor = {value.x, value.y, value.z};
        }
        material.LiveSurfaceOverride = true;
        GpuSceneChanges::Notify(target, GpuSceneDirtyFlags::Material);
    }
}

vector<unique_ptr<TimeLineDirector>> TimeLineSystem::m_Directors;

void TimeLineSystem::Update()
{
    ComponentManager::ForEachComponent<AnimationModelComponent>([](EntityID, auto& animation) {
        animation.TimelineDriven = false;
    });
    ComponentManager::ForEachComponent<CameraComponent>([](EntityID, auto& camera) {
        camera.Animation.TimelineDriven = false;
    });
    const float deltaTime = World::GetDeltaTime();
    for (auto& director : m_Directors)
    {
        if (director)
        {
            director->Update(deltaTime);
        }
    }

    for (auto it = g_Music.begin(); it != g_Music.end();)
    {
        if (!Registry::IsAlive(it->first) || !ComponentManager::HasComponent<TimelineComponent>(it->first) ||
            ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<TimelineComponent>(it->first).MusicPath.empty())
        {
            it = g_Music.erase(it);
        }
        else
        {
            ++it;
        }
    }
    ComponentManager::ForEachComponent<TimelineComponent>([&](EntityID entity, TimelineComponent& timeline) {
        const uint64_t session = ProjectManager::GetPlaySession();
        if (timeline.LastPlaySession != session)
        {
            timeline.LastPlaySession = session;
            timeline.CurrentTime = 0.0f;
            timeline.IsPlaying = timeline.PlayOnAwake;
            timeline.PlaybackError.clear();
        }
        AdvanceComponent(entity, timeline, deltaTime);
    });
}

void TimeLineSystem::AdvanceComponent(EntityID entity, TimelineComponent& timeline, float deltaTime)
{
    if (!timeline.MusicPath.empty())
    {
        if (timeline.PlaybackError.empty() || timeline.IsPlaying || timeline.SeekRequested)
        {
            UpdateMusic(entity, timeline);
        }
    }
    else if (timeline.IsPlaying)
    {
        timeline.CurrentTime += deltaTime * timeline.Speed;
        if (timeline.CurrentTime >= timeline.Duration || timeline.CurrentTime < 0.0f)
        {
            if (timeline.Loop && timeline.Duration > 0.0f)
            {
                Camera::NotifyCut();
                timeline.CurrentTime =
                    fmodf(fmodf(timeline.CurrentTime, timeline.Duration) + timeline.Duration, timeline.Duration);
            }
            else
            {
                timeline.CurrentTime = clamp(timeline.CurrentTime, 0.0f, timeline.Duration);
                timeline.IsPlaying = false;
            }
        }
    }
    EvaluateComponent(timeline);
}

void TimeLineSystem::Uninit()
{
    Clear();
}

TimeLineDirector& TimeLineSystem::CreateDirector()
{
    auto director = make_unique<TimeLineDirector>();
    TimeLineDirector& ref = *director;
    m_Directors.push_back(move(director));
    return ref;
}

void TimeLineSystem::Clear()
{
    SuspendAudio(true);
    m_Directors.clear();
}

void TimeLineSystem::SuspendAudio(bool close)
{
    if (close)
    {
        g_Music.clear();
        return;
    }
    for (auto& [entity, music] : g_Music)
    {
        if (music && music->Playing)
        {
            music->Player.Pause();
            music->Playing = false;
        }
    }
}

XMFLOAT4 TimeLineSystem::ReadProperty(EntityID target, TimelineProperty property, bool* valid, int fogVolume)
{
    if (valid)
    {
        *valid = false;
    }
    if (!Registry::IsAlive(target))
    {
        return {};
    }
    if (property <= TimelineProperty::TransformScale && ComponentManager::HasComponent<TransformComponent>(target))
    {
        const auto& transform = ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<TransformComponent>(target);
        const XMFLOAT3* valueSelection = nullptr;
        if (property == TimelineProperty::TransformPosition)
        {
            valueSelection = &(transform.Position);
        }
        else if (property == TimelineProperty::TransformRotation)
        {
            valueSelection = &transform.Rotation;
        }
        else
        {
            valueSelection = &transform.Scale;
        }
        const XMFLOAT3& value = *valueSelection;
        if (valid)
        {
            *valid = true;
        }
        return {value.x, value.y, value.z, 0.0f};
    }
    if (property >= TimelineProperty::CameraTarget && property <= TimelineProperty::CameraLockOnOffset &&
        ComponentManager::HasComponent<CameraComponent>(target))
    {
        const auto& camera = ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<CameraComponent>(target);
        if (valid)
        {
            *valid = true;
        }
        switch (property)
        {
            case TimelineProperty::CameraTarget:
                return {camera.Target.x, camera.Target.y, camera.Target.z, 0};
            case TimelineProperty::CameraFov:
                return {camera.Fov, 0, 0, 0};
            case TimelineProperty::CameraNearClip:
                return {camera.NearClip, 0, 0, 0};
            case TimelineProperty::CameraFarClip:
                return {camera.FarClip, 0, 0, 0};
            case TimelineProperty::CameraLockOnOffset:
                return {camera.LockOnOffset.x, camera.LockOnOffset.y, camera.LockOnOffset.z, 0};
            default:
                break;
        }
    }
    if (property == TimelineProperty::PostProcessIntensity &&
        ComponentManager::HasComponent<PostProcessComponent>(target))
    {
        if (valid)
        {
            *valid = true;
        }
        return {ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<PostProcessComponent>(target).Intensity, 0, 0, 0};
    }
    XMFLOAT4 result{};
    bool found = false;
    if (property >= TimelineProperty::LightIntensity && property <= TimelineProperty::LightBeamDensity &&
        ComponentManager::HasComponent<LightComponent>(target))
    {
        const auto& light = ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<LightComponent>(target);
        found = true;
        switch (property)
        {
            case TimelineProperty::LightIntensity:
                result.x = light.Intensity;
                break;
            case TimelineProperty::LightColor:
                result = light.Color;
                break;
            case TimelineProperty::LightDirection:
                result = {light.Direction.x, light.Direction.y, light.Direction.z, 0};
                break;
            case TimelineProperty::LightRange:
                result.x = light.Range;
                break;
            case TimelineProperty::LightBeamDensity:
                result.x = light.VolumeDensity;
                break;
        }
    }
    if ((property == TimelineProperty::LightInnerAngle || property == TimelineProperty::LightOuterAngle) &&
        ComponentManager::HasComponent<LightComponent>(target))
    {
        const auto& light = ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<LightComponent>(target);
        found = true;
        result.x = property == TimelineProperty::LightInnerAngle ? light.InnerAngle : light.OuterAngle;
    }
    if (property == TimelineProperty::CameraCut && ComponentManager::HasComponent<CameraComponent>(target))
    {
        found = true;
    }
    if (property >= TimelineProperty::BloomThreshold && property <= TimelineProperty::BloomRadius &&
        ComponentManager::HasComponent<PostProcessComponent>(target))
    {
        const auto& post = ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<PostProcessComponent>(target);
        found = true;
        if (property == TimelineProperty::BloomThreshold)
        {
            result.x = post.BloomThreshold;
        }
        if (property == TimelineProperty::BloomSoftKnee)
        {
            result.x = post.BloomSoftKnee;
        }
        if (property == TimelineProperty::BloomRadius)
        {
            result.x = post.BloomRadius;
        }
    }
    const auto& fog = LocalHeightFog::GetVolumes();
    if ((property == TimelineProperty::FogDensity || property == TimelineProperty::FogColor) && fogVolume >= 0 &&
        static_cast<size_t>(fogVolume) < fog.size())
    {
        found = true;
        const auto& volume = fog[fogVolume];
        result = property == TimelineProperty::FogDensity ? XMFLOAT4{volume.Density, 0, 0, 0}
                                                          : XMFLOAT4{volume.Color.x, volume.Color.y, volume.Color.z, 1};
    }
    if (property == TimelineProperty::AnimationTime)
    {
        if (ComponentManager::HasComponent<AnimationModelComponent>(target))
        {
            found = true;
            result.x = ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<AnimationModelComponent>(target).CurrentTime;
        }
        else if (ComponentManager::HasComponent<CameraComponent>(target))
        {
            found = true;
            result.x = ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<CameraComponent>(target).Animation.CurrentTime;
        }
    }
    if ((property == TimelineProperty::EmissiveIntensity || property == TimelineProperty::EmissiveColor) &&
        ComponentManager::HasComponent<MaterialComponent>(target))
    {
        const auto& material =
            MaterialManager::Resolve(ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<MaterialComponent>(target));
        found = true;
        result = property == TimelineProperty::EmissiveIntensity
                     ? XMFLOAT4{material.EmissiveIntensity, 0, 0, 0}
                     : XMFLOAT4{material.EmissiveColor.x, material.EmissiveColor.y, material.EmissiveColor.z, 1};
    }
    if (valid)
    {
        *valid = found;
    }
    return result;
}

bool TimeLineSystem::PrepareTrackAnimations(TimelineTrackData& track)
{
    if (track.AnimationPaths.empty())
    {
        if (ComponentManager::HasComponent<AnimationModelComponent>(track.Target))
        {
            auto& animation = ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<AnimationModelComponent>(track.Target);
            if (!track.PreviousAnimationNames.empty())
            {
                Animator::Play(animation, track.PreviousAnimationNames, false);
            }
        }
        track.PreviousAnimationNames.clear();
        track.LoadedAnimationPaths.clear();
        track.LoadedAnimationNames.clear();
        track.LoadedAnimationModelId = -1;
        track.AnimationError.clear();
        return true;
    }
    if (!ComponentManager::HasComponent<AnimationModelComponent>(track.Target))
    {
        track.LoadedAnimationModelId = -1;
        track.AnimationError = "アニメーションモデルを対象Entityに指定してください。";
        return false;
    }
    auto& animation = ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<AnimationModelComponent>(track.Target);
    if (animation.ModelId < 0)
    {
        track.LoadedAnimationModelId = -1;
        track.AnimationError = "対象のモデルが読み込まれていません。";
        return false;
    }
    if (track.PreviousAnimationNames.empty())
    {
        for (const auto& layer : animation.ActiveAnimationLayers)
        {
            track.PreviousAnimationNames.push_back(layer.AnimationName);
        }
        if (track.PreviousAnimationNames.empty() && !animation.CurrentAnimation.empty())
        {
            track.PreviousAnimationNames.push_back(animation.CurrentAnimation);
        }
    }
    if (track.LoadedAnimationModelId != animation.ModelId || track.LoadedAnimationPaths != track.AnimationPaths)
    {
        track.LoadedAnimationModelId = animation.ModelId;
        track.LoadedAnimationPaths = track.AnimationPaths;
        track.LoadedAnimationNames.clear();
        track.AnimationError.clear();
        for (const auto& path : track.AnimationPaths)
        {
            // Reuse registered names so saving the selected animation remains reloadable.
            // New files use the full path to avoid collisions between equal filenames.
            string name = "timeline:" + path;
            bool registered = false;
            const size_t count = min(animation.AnimationPaths.size(), animation.Animations.size());
            for (size_t index = 0; index < count; ++index)
            {
                if (filesystem::u8path(animation.AnimationPaths[index]).lexically_normal() ==
                    filesystem::u8path(path).lexically_normal())
                {
                    name = animation.Animations[index];
                    registered = true;
                    break;
                }
            }
            if (!ModelManager::LoadAnimation(animation.ModelId, path.c_str(), name.c_str()))
            {
                track.AnimationError = "アニメーションを読み込めません: " + path;
                break;
            }
            if (!registered)
            {
                animation.AnimationPaths.push_back(path);
                animation.Animations.push_back(name);
            }
            track.LoadedAnimationNames.push_back(name);
        }
    }
    if (!track.AnimationError.empty())
    {
        return false;
    }
    Animator::Play(animation, track.LoadedAnimationNames, false);
    return true;
}

void TimeLineSystem::EvaluateComponent(TimelineComponent& timeline)
{
    const LiveMusic::TempoMap tempo(max(1.0f, timeline.BeatsPerMinute));
    const float beat = static_cast<float>(tempo.SecondsToBeats(timeline.CurrentTime - timeline.BeatOffset));
    for (const auto& group : timeline.LightGroups)
    {
        if (!group.Enabled)
        {
            continue;
        }
        for (const auto& fixture : group.Fixtures)
        {
            if (!ComponentManager::HasComponent<LightComponent>(fixture.Target))
            {
                continue;
            }
            auto& light = ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<LightComponent>(fixture.Target);
            const float phase = beat / max(0.001f, group.SweepBeats) + fixture.Phase;
            const float pan = group.Pan + sinf(phase * XM_2PI) * group.PanSweep;
            const float tilt = group.Tilt + cosf(phase * XM_2PI) * group.TiltSweep;
            XMVECTOR direction = XMVectorSet(sinf(pan) * cosf(tilt), -sinf(tilt), cosf(pan) * cosf(tilt), 0);
            if (ComponentManager::HasComponent<TransformComponent>(fixture.Target))
            {
                const auto& rotation =
                    ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<TransformComponent>(fixture.Target).Rotation;
                direction = XMVector3TransformNormal(direction,
                                                     XMMatrixRotationRollPitchYaw(rotation.x, rotation.y, rotation.z));
            }
            XMStoreFloat3(&light.Direction, XMVector3Normalize(direction));
            const float flash = beat * max(0.0f, group.StrobesPerBeat) + fixture.Phase;
            const bool illuminated =
                group.StrobesPerBeat <= 0.0f || flash - floorf(flash) < clamp(group.StrobeDuty, 0.0f, 1.0f);
            light.Intensity = illuminated ? max(0.0f, group.Intensity) : 0.0f;
            const bool alternate = group.AlternateOnBeat && static_cast<int>(floorf(beat + fixture.Phase)) % 2 != 0;
            light.Color = alternate ? group.AlternateColor : group.Color;
            light.VolumeDensity = max(0.0f, group.BeamDensity);
            light.AffectsVolumetrics = group.BeamDensity > 0.0f;
        }
    }
    for (const auto& monitor : timeline.Monitors)
    {
        size_t frame = 0;
        if (!ComponentManager::HasComponent<MaterialComponent>(monitor.Target) ||
            !TimelineCurve::MonitorFrame(monitor, timeline.CurrentTime, frame))
        {
            continue;
        }
        const string& path = monitor.Frames[frame];
        const int texture = TextureManager::LoadTexture(filesystem::u8path(path));
        if (texture < 0)
        {
            continue;
        }
        auto& material = ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<MaterialComponent>(monitor.Target);
        if (!material.MaterialSlots.empty() || material.RuntimeHandle)
        {
            MaterialComponent binding = MaterialManager::Resolve(material);
            binding.MaterialSlots.clear();
            binding.RuntimeHandle = 0;
            material = move(binding);
        }
        material.TextureID = material.EmissiveTextureID = texture;
        material.LiveSurfaceOverride = true;
        material.UseTexture = true;
        material.TexturePath = path;
        material.EmissiveColor = {1, 1, 1};
        material.EmissiveIntensity = max(0.0f, monitor.EmissiveIntensity);
        GpuSceneChanges::Notify(monitor.Target, GpuSceneDirtyFlags::Material);
        if (ComponentManager::HasComponent<LightComponent>(monitor.SurroundLight))
        {
            auto& light = ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<LightComponent>(monitor.SurroundLight);
            if (light.Type == LightType::Rect)
            {
                light.AreaTexturePath = path;
                light.Intensity = max(0.0f, monitor.LightIntensity);
            }
        }
    }
    for (auto& track : timeline.Tracks)
    {
        if (!track.Enabled || !Registry::IsAlive(track.Target) || track.Property == TimelineProperty::CameraCut)
        {
            continue;
        }
        XMFLOAT4 value{};
        const auto sample = TimelineCurve::EvaluateTrack(track, timeline.CurrentTime, value);
        if (sample == TimelineCurve::TrackSample::None)
        {
            continue;
        }
        if (track.Property == TimelineProperty::AnimationTime && !PrepareTrackAnimations(track))
        {
            continue;
        }
        ApplyProperty(track.Target, track.Property, value, track.FogVolumeIndex);
    }
    // カメラカット：再生中（Play / 一時停止）のみ、メインのゲームカメラを切り替える。
    // 編集中に切り替えるとシーンの IsMainGameCamera が変わり保存内容に影響するため適用しない。
    if (ProjectManager::IsPlaying())
    {
        const EntityID cut = TimelineCurve::FindCameraCut(timeline, timeline.CurrentTime);
        if (cut != g_kINVALID_ENTITY && Registry::IsAlive(cut) && ComponentManager::HasComponent<CameraComponent>(cut) &&
            Camera::GetGameCameraEntity() != cut)
        {
            Camera::SetMainGameCamera(cut);
            Camera::NotifyCut();
        }
    }
}
