===== FILE: source\virtualgeometry\virtualgeometryhierarchy.cpp =====
#include "virtualgeometryinternal.h"
#include "../../External/meshoptimizer/src/meshoptimizer.h"
#include <algorithm>
#include <bit>
#include <cmath>
#include <unordered_map>
#include <unordered_set>

namespace VirtualGeometryInternal
{
    namespace
    {
        uint64_t EdgeKey(uint32_t first, uint32_t second)
        {
            return uint64_t(std::min(first, second)) << 32 | std::max(first, second);
        }

        struct EdgeUse
        {
            uint32_t Count = 0;
            uint32_t Partition = 0;
            bool Shared = false;
        };

        using EdgeTable = std::unordered_map<uint64_t, EdgeUse>;
        using EdgeCounts = std::unordered_map<uint64_t, uint32_t>;

        struct VertexKey
        {
            std::array<uint32_t, 12> Components{};

            explicit VertexKey(const VirtualGeometryVertex& vertex)
            {
                auto values = VertexComponents(vertex);
                for (size_t component = 0; component < values.size(); ++component)
                {
                    Components[component] = values[component] == 0 ? 0 : std::bit_cast<uint32_t>(values[component]);
                }
            }

            bool operator==(const VertexKey&) const = default;
        };

        struct VertexHash
        {
            size_t operator()(const VertexKey& vertex) const
            {
                size_t hash = 0;
                for (uint32_t component : vertex.Components)
                {
                    hash = hash * 16777619u ^ component;
                }
                return hash;
            }
        };

        struct LevelGeometry
        {
            std::vector<std::array<float, 3>> Positions;
            std::vector<uint32_t> PositionRemap;
            std::vector<uint32_t> VertexOffsets;
            std::vector<std::vector<uint32_t>> Partitions; // 現在のクラスターへのインデックス。
            EdgeTable Edges;
        };

        LevelGeometry PartitionLevel(const VirtualGeometryAsset& asset, const std::vector<uint32_t>& current)
        {
            LevelGeometry geometry;
            std::vector<uint32_t> counts;
            for (uint32_t clusterIndex : current)
            {
                const auto& cluster = asset.Clusters[clusterIndex];
                geometry.VertexOffsets.push_back(CheckedIndex(geometry.Positions.size()));
                counts.push_back(cluster.VertexCount);
                for (uint32_t vertex = 0; vertex < cluster.VertexCount; ++vertex)
                {
                    const auto& position = asset.Vertices[cluster.VertexOffset + vertex].Position;
                    geometry.Positions.push_back({position[0] == 0 ? 0 : position[0],
                                                  position[1] == 0 ? 0 : position[1],
                                                  position[2] == 0 ? 0 : position[2]});
                }
            }
            CheckedIndex(geometry.Positions.size());
            geometry.PositionRemap.resize(geometry.Positions.size());
            meshopt_generatePositionRemap(geometry.PositionRemap.data(), geometry.Positions[0].data(),
                                          geometry.Positions.size(), sizeof(geometry.Positions[0]));
            std::vector<uint32_t> partitionIds(current.size());
            size_t count = meshopt_partitionClusters(
                partitionIds.data(), geometry.PositionRemap.data(), geometry.PositionRemap.size(), counts.data(),
                current.size(), geometry.Positions[0].data(), geometry.Positions.size(), sizeof(geometry.Positions[0]),
                asset.Config.TargetClustersPerGroup);
            geometry.Partitions.resize(count);
            for (uint32_t currentIndex = 0; currentIndex < current.size(); ++currentIndex)
            {
                uint32_t partition = partitionIds[currentIndex];
                geometry.Partitions[partition].push_back(currentIndex);
                const auto& cluster = asset.Clusters[current[currentIndex]];
                uint32_t offset = geometry.VertexOffsets[currentIndex];
                for (uint32_t triangle = 0; triangle < cluster.TriangleCount; ++triangle)
                {
                    for (uint32_t corner = 0; corner < 3; ++corner)
                    {
                        uint32_t first = asset.TriangleIndices[cluster.TriangleOffset + triangle * 3 + corner];
                        uint32_t second =
                            asset.TriangleIndices[cluster.TriangleOffset + triangle * 3 + (corner + 1) % 3];
                        auto& edge = geometry.Edges[EdgeKey(geometry.PositionRemap[offset + first],
                                                            geometry.PositionRemap[offset + second])];
                        if (edge.Count == 0)
                        {
                            edge.Partition = partition;
                        }
                        edge.Shared |= edge.Partition != partition;
                        ++edge.Count;
                    }
                }
            }
            return geometry;
        }

        struct GroupGeometry
        {
            std::vector<VirtualGeometryVertex> Vertices;
            std::vector<uint32_t> Indices;
            std::vector<uint32_t> PositionIds;
        };

        GroupGeometry MergeGroup(const VirtualGeometryAsset& asset, const std::vector<uint32_t>& current,
                                 const LevelGeometry& level, const std::vector<uint32_t>& partition)
        {
            GroupGeometry mesh;
            std::unordered_map<VertexKey, uint32_t, VertexHash> vertices;
            for (uint32_t currentIndex : partition)
            {
                const auto& cluster = asset.Clusters[current[currentIndex]];
                std::vector<uint32_t> localRemap(cluster.VertexCount);
                for (uint32_t vertexIndex = 0; vertexIndex < cluster.VertexCount; ++vertexIndex)
                {
                    const auto& vertex = asset.Vertices[cluster.VertexOffset + vertexIndex];
                    uint32_t destination = CheckedIndex(mesh.Vertices.size());
                    auto [entry, inserted] = vertices.emplace(VertexKey(vertex), destination);
                    if (inserted)
                    {
                        mesh.Vertices.push_back(vertex);
                        mesh.PositionIds.push_back(
                            level.PositionRemap[level.VertexOffsets[currentIndex] + vertexIndex]);
                    }
                    localRemap[vertexIndex] = entry->second;
                }
                for (uint32_t index = 0; index < cluster.TriangleCount * 3; ++index)
                {
                    mesh.Indices.push_back(localRemap[asset.TriangleIndices[cluster.TriangleOffset + index]]);
                }
            }
            return mesh;
        }

        EdgeCounts CountEdges(const GroupGeometry& mesh, std::span<const uint32_t> indices)
        {
            EdgeCounts edges;
            edges.reserve(indices.size());
            for (size_t triangle = 0; triangle < indices.size(); triangle += 3)
            {
                for (size_t corner = 0; corner < 3; ++corner)
                {
                    ++edges[EdgeKey(mesh.PositionIds[indices[triangle + corner]],
                                    mesh.PositionIds[indices[triangle + (corner + 1) % 3]])];
                }
            }
            return edges;
        }

        std::vector<unsigned char> LockBoundary(const GroupGeometry& mesh, const LevelGeometry& level,
                                                EdgeCounts& protectedEdges)
        {
            auto counts = CountEdges(mesh, mesh.Indices);
            std::unordered_set<uint32_t> lockedPositions;
            for (const auto& [key, count] : counts)
            {
                const auto& global = level.Edges.at(key);
                if (count != 2 || global.Shared || global.Count != 2)
                {
                    protectedEdges.emplace(key, count);
                    lockedPositions.insert(static_cast<uint32_t>(key >> 32));
                    lockedPositions.insert(static_cast<uint32_t>(key));
                }
            }
            std::vector<unsigned char> locks(mesh.Vertices.size());
            for (size_t vertex = 0; vertex < mesh.Vertices.size(); ++vertex)
            {
                if (lockedPositions.contains(mesh.PositionIds[vertex]))
                {
                    // この位置を共有する継ぎ目の複製頂点をすべて固定する。
                    locks[vertex] = meshopt_SimplifyVertex_Lock;
                }
            }
            return locks;
        }

        void ValidateBoundary(const GroupGeometry& mesh, std::span<const uint32_t> simplified,
                              const EdgeCounts& protectedEdges)
        {
            auto after = CountEdges(mesh, simplified);
            for (const auto& [key, count] : protectedEdges)
            {
                auto entry = after.find(key);
                if (entry == after.end() || entry->second != count)
                {
                    throw std::runtime_error("Simplification changed a protected boundary edge");
                }
            }
            for (const auto& [key, count] : after)
            {
                if (count != 2 && !protectedEdges.contains(key))
                {
                    throw std::runtime_error("Simplification introduced a new geometric boundary");
                }
            }
            // simplifyWithAttributes は元の頂点インデックスを返すため、位置を移動できない。
            // 上の辺位置の厳密比較は、微小誤差を許容する位置判定より強い条件になる。
        }

        VirtualGeometrySphere GroupBounds(const VirtualGeometryAsset& asset, const std::vector<uint32_t>& children)
        {
            std::vector<VirtualGeometrySphere> spheres;
            spheres.reserve(children.size());
            for (uint32_t index : children)
            {
                const auto& child = asset.Clusters[index];
                const auto& sphere = child.GeneratingGroupIndex == VirtualGeometryConfig::InvalidIndex
                                         ? child.Bounds
                                         : asset.Groups[child.GeneratingGroupIndex].Bounds;
                spheres.push_back(sphere);
            }
            auto bounds =
                meshopt_computeSphereBounds(spheres[0].Center.data(), spheres.size(), sizeof(VirtualGeometrySphere),
                                            &spheres[0].Radius, sizeof(VirtualGeometrySphere));
            VirtualGeometrySphere result;
            std::copy_n(bounds.center, 3, result.Center.begin());
            double radius = 0;
            for (const auto& sphere : spheres)
            {
                double distanceSquared = 0;
                for (size_t axis = 0; axis < 3; ++axis)
                {
                    double difference = double(result.Center[axis]) - sphere.Center[axis];
                    distanceSquared += difference * difference;
                }
                radius = std::max(radius, std::sqrt(distanceSquared) + sphere.Radius);
            }
            result.Radius = std::nextafter(static_cast<float>(radius), std::numeric_limits<float>::infinity());
            return result;
        }

        std::vector<uint32_t> SimplifyGroup(VirtualGeometryAsset& asset, const std::vector<uint32_t>& current,
                                            const LevelGeometry& level, const std::vector<uint32_t>& partition)
        {
            if (partition.size() < 2)
            {
                return {};
            }
            GroupGeometry mesh = MergeGroup(asset, current, level, partition);
            EdgeCounts protectedEdges;
            auto locks = LockBoundary(mesh, level, protectedEdges);
            std::vector<std::array<float, 9>> attributes;
            attributes.reserve(mesh.Vertices.size());
            for (const auto& vertex : mesh.Vertices)
            {
                attributes.push_back({vertex.Normal[0], vertex.Normal[1], vertex.Normal[2], vertex.TexCoord[0],
                                      vertex.TexCoord[1], vertex.Diffuse[0], vertex.Diffuse[1], vertex.Diffuse[2],
                                      vertex.Diffuse[3]});
            }
            const auto& config = asset.Config;
            const float weights[] = {config.NormalWeight,   config.NormalWeight,   config.NormalWeight,
                                     config.TexCoordWeight, config.TexCoordWeight, config.ColorWeight,
                                     config.ColorWeight,    config.ColorWeight,    config.ColorWeight};
            size_t target = std::max(size_t(1), static_cast<size_t>((mesh.Indices.size() / 3) *
                                                                    double(config.SimplificationRatio))) *
                            3;
            std::vector<uint32_t> simplified(mesh.Indices.size());
            float relativeError = 0;
            size_t count = meshopt_simplifyWithAttributes(
                simplified.data(), mesh.Indices.data(), mesh.Indices.size(), mesh.Vertices[0].Position,
                mesh.Vertices.size(), sizeof(VirtualGeometryVertex), attributes[0].data(), sizeof(attributes[0]),
                weights, std::size(weights), locks.data(), target, config.TargetRelativeError, 0, &relativeError);
            if (count == 0 || count >= mesh.Indices.size())
            {
                return {};
            }
            simplified.resize(count);
            ValidateBoundary(mesh, simplified, protectedEdges);
            float absoluteError = relativeError * meshopt_simplifyScale(mesh.Vertices[0].Position, mesh.Vertices.size(),
                                                                        sizeof(VirtualGeometryVertex));
            if (!std::isfinite(absoluteError) || absoluteError < 0)
            {
                throw std::runtime_error("Invalid simplification error");
            }
            std::vector<uint32_t> children;
            float childError = 0;
            for (uint32_t currentIndex : partition)
            {
                uint32_t index = current[currentIndex];
                children.push_back(index);
                childError = std::max(childError, asset.Clusters[index].LodError);
            }
            uint32_t childLevel = asset.Clusters[children[0]].Level;
            size_t vertexStart = asset.Vertices.size();
            size_t triangleStart = asset.TriangleIndices.size();
            size_t clusterStart = asset.Clusters.size();
            float parentError = std::max(childError, absoluteError);
            auto parents = AppendClusters(asset, mesh.Vertices, simplified, childLevel + 1, parentError);
            if (parents.empty() || parents.size() >= children.size())
            {
                asset.Vertices.resize(vertexStart);
                asset.TriangleIndices.resize(triangleStart);
                asset.Clusters.resize(clusterStart);
                return {};
            }
            uint32_t groupIndex = CheckedIndex(asset.Groups.size());
            VirtualGeometryClusterGroup group;
            group.Level = childLevel;
            group.FirstChild = CheckedIndex(asset.HierarchyIndices.size());
            group.ChildCount = CheckedIndex(children.size());
            group.Bounds = GroupBounds(asset, children);
            group.MinError = childError;
            group.MaxError = parentError;
            asset.HierarchyIndices.insert(asset.HierarchyIndices.end(), children.begin(), children.end());
            group.FirstParent = CheckedIndex(asset.HierarchyIndices.size());
            group.ParentCount = CheckedIndex(parents.size());
            CheckedIndex(asset.HierarchyIndices.size() + parents.size());
            asset.HierarchyIndices.insert(asset.HierarchyIndices.end(), parents.begin(), parents.end());
            asset.Groups.push_back(group);
            for (uint32_t child : children)
            {
                asset.Clusters[child].GroupIndex = groupIndex;
            }
            for (uint32_t parent : parents)
            {
                asset.Clusters[parent].GeneratingGroupIndex = groupIndex;
            }
            return parents;
        }
    }

    void BuildHierarchy(VirtualGeometryAsset& asset, std::vector<uint32_t> current)
    {
        for (uint32_t level = 0; level + 1 < asset.Config.MaxHierarchyLevels && current.size() > 1; ++level)
        {
            auto geometry = PartitionLevel(asset, current);
            std::vector<uint32_t> next;
            for (const auto& partition : geometry.Partitions)
            {
                auto parents = SimplifyGroup(asset, current, geometry, partition);
                if (parents.empty())
                {
                    for (uint32_t currentIndex : partition)
                    {
                        asset.RootClusters.push_back(current[currentIndex]);
                    }
                }
                else
                {
                    next.insert(next.end(), parents.begin(), parents.end());
                }
            }
            if (next.empty())
            {
                current.clear();
                break;
            }
            if (next.size() >= current.size())
            {
                current = std::move(next);
                break;
            }
            current = std::move(next);
        }
        asset.RootClusters.insert(asset.RootClusters.end(), current.begin(), current.end());
        std::sort(asset.RootClusters.begin(), asset.RootClusters.end());
    }
} // 名前空間 VirtualGeometryInternal の終わり。

===== FILE: source\virtualgeometry\virtualgeometryimport.cpp =====
#include "virtualgeometryimport.h"
#include <algorithm>
#include <cmath>
#include <fstream>
#include <iomanip>
#include <sstream>
#ifdef _WIN32
#ifndef NOMINMAX
#define NOMINMAX
#endif
#include <windows.h>
#endif

VirtualGeometryBuildConfig VGImportSettings::BuildConfig() const
{
    auto config = Quality == VGQuality::Custom ? Custom : VGSettings::Production();
    switch (Quality)
    {
        case VGQuality::Low:
            config.TargetRelativeError = 0.1f;
            break;
        case VGQuality::Medium:
            config.TargetRelativeError = 0.05f;
            break;
        case VGQuality::High:
            config.TargetRelativeError = 0.02f;
            break;
        default:
            break;
    }
    if (LODError > 0)
    {
        config.TargetRelativeError = LODError;
    }
    // すべてのプリセットで、実行環境の Mesh Shader 出力上限を守る。
    config.MaxClusterVertices = std::min(config.MaxClusterVertices, 64u);
    config.MaxClusterTriangles = std::min(config.MaxClusterTriangles, 124u);
    return config;
}

VGCompressionSettings VGImportSettings::Compression(float sourceExtent) const
{
    VGCompressionSettings settings;
    settings.MaxPositionError =
        PositionError > 0 ? PositionError : std::clamp(sourceExtent * 0.00001f, 0.000001f, 0.001f);
    return settings;
}

namespace VirtualGeometryImport
{
    namespace
    {
        std::filesystem::path Sidecar(const std::filesystem::path& source)
        {
            auto path = source;
            path += ".vgsettings";
            return path;
        }

        std::string Encode(const VGImportSettings& settings)
        {
            std::ostringstream output;
            output.imbue(std::locale::classic());
            output << std::setprecision(9) << "VGSETTINGS 1\n"
                   << settings.Enabled << ' ' << settings.BackgroundBuild << ' '
                   << static_cast<uint32_t>(settings.Quality) << ' ' << settings.PositionError << ' '
                   << settings.LODError << ' ' << settings.StreamingPriority << '\n';
            const auto& c = settings.Custom;
            output << c.MaxClusterTriangles << ' ' << c.MaxClusterVertices << ' ' << c.TargetClustersPerGroup << ' '
                   << c.MaxHierarchyLevels << ' ' << c.SimplificationRatio << ' ' << c.ConeWeight << ' '
                   << c.NormalWeight << ' ' << c.TexCoordWeight << ' ' << c.ColorWeight << ' ' << c.TargetRelativeError
                   << ' ' << c.BoundaryEpsilon << '\n';
            return output.str();
        }

        bool Valid(const VGImportSettings& settings, std::string& error)
        {
            if (settings.Quality > VGQuality::Custom || settings.StreamingPriority > 2 ||
                !std::isfinite(settings.PositionError) || settings.PositionError < 0 ||
                !std::isfinite(settings.LODError) || settings.LODError < 0)
            {
                error = "Invalid VirtualGeometry import settings";
                return false;
            }
            return ValidateVirtualGeometryConfig(settings.BuildConfig(), error);
        }
    }

    bool Load(const std::filesystem::path& source, VGImportSettings& settings, std::string& error)
    {
        error.clear();
        std::error_code ec;
        const auto path = Sidecar(source);
        if (!std::filesystem::exists(path, ec) && !ec)
        {
            settings = {};
            return true;
        }
        std::ifstream input(path);
        input.imbue(std::locale::classic());
        VGImportSettings parsed;
        std::string magic;
        uint32_t version = 0;
        uint32_t quality = 0;
        auto& c = parsed.Custom;
        if (!(input >> magic >> version) || magic != "VGSETTINGS" || version != 1 ||
            !(input >> parsed.Enabled >> parsed.BackgroundBuild >> quality >> parsed.PositionError >> parsed.LODError >>
              parsed.StreamingPriority >> c.MaxClusterTriangles >> c.MaxClusterVertices >> c.TargetClustersPerGroup >>
              c.MaxHierarchyLevels >> c.SimplificationRatio >> c.ConeWeight >> c.NormalWeight >> c.TexCoordWeight >>
              c.ColorWeight >> c.TargetRelativeError >> c.BoundaryEpsilon))
        {
            error = "Invalid or truncated VirtualGeometry settings: " + path.generic_string();
            return false;
        }
        parsed.Quality = static_cast<VGQuality>(quality);
        if (!Valid(parsed, error))
        {
            return false;
        }
        settings = parsed;
        return true;
    }

    bool Save(const std::filesystem::path& source, const VGImportSettings& settings, std::string& error)
    {
        error.clear();
        if (!Valid(settings, error))
        {
            return false;
        }
        const auto target = Sidecar(source);
        auto temporary = target;
        temporary += ".tmp";
        {
            std::ofstream output(temporary, std::ios::binary | std::ios::trunc);
            output << Encode(settings);
            output.flush();
            if (!output)
            {
                error = "Cannot write VirtualGeometry settings";
                return false;
            }
        }
#ifdef _WIN32
        if (!MoveFileExW(temporary.c_str(), target.c_str(), MOVEFILE_REPLACE_EXISTING | MOVEFILE_WRITE_THROUGH))
        {
            error = "Cannot publish VirtualGeometry settings";
            return false;
        }
#else
        std::error_code ec;
        std::filesystem::rename(temporary, target, ec);
        if (ec)
        {
            error = ec.message();
            return false;
        }
#endif
        return true;
    }

    uint64_t SettingsKey(const VGImportSettings& settings)
    {
        uint64_t hash = 14695981039346656037ull;
        for (const unsigned char byte : Encode(settings))
        {
            hash = (hash ^ byte) * 1099511628211ull;
        }
        return hash;
    }
} // 名前空間 VirtualGeometryImport の終わり。

    {
        if (value >= VirtualGeometryConfig::InvalidIndex)
        {

    }

    {

===== FILE: source\virtualgeometry\virtualgeometrypagecache.cpp =====
#include "virtualgeometrypagecache.h"
#include "virtualgeometryserializationinternal.h"
#include "virtualgeometryserializer.h"
#include <atomic>
#include <algorithm>
#include <bit>
#include <fstream>
#include <limits>
#ifdef _WIN32
#ifndef NOMINMAX
#define NOMINMAX
#endif
#include <windows.h>
#endif

namespace VirtualGeometryPageCache
{
    namespace
    {
        using VirtualGeometrySerialization::Reader;
        using VirtualGeometrySerialization::Writer;
        constexpr uint32_t Magic = 0x32504756; // ページ形式の識別子（VGP2）
        constexpr uint32_t HeaderBytes = 64;
        constexpr uint64_t MaxMetadataBytes = 512ull * 1024 * 1024;

        void WriteValue(Writer& writer, uint32_t value)
        {
            writer.U32(value);
        }

        void ReadValue(Reader& reader, uint32_t& value)
        {
            value = reader.U32();
        }

        void WriteValue(Writer& writer, const VirtualGeometryGPUCluster& value)
        {
            writer.U32(value.VertexOffset);
            writer.U32(value.VertexCount);
            writer.U32(value.TriangleOffset);
            writer.U32(value.TriangleCount);
            writer.U32(value.Level);
            writer.U32(value.GroupIndex);
            writer.U32(value.GeneratingGroupIndex);
            writer.U32(value.MaterialId);
            for (float component : value.Bounds)
            {
                writer.F32(component);
            }
            for (float component : value.Cone)
            {
                writer.F32(component);
            }
            writer.F32(value.LodError);
            writer.U32(value.PageIndex);
            writer.U32(value.Flags);
            writer.U32(value.Padding);
            for (float component : value.ConeApex)
            {
                writer.F32(component);
            }
        }

        void ReadValue(Reader& reader, VirtualGeometryGPUCluster& value)
        {
            value.VertexOffset = reader.U32();
            value.VertexCount = reader.U32();
            value.TriangleOffset = reader.U32();
            value.TriangleCount = reader.U32();
            value.Level = reader.U32();
            value.GroupIndex = reader.U32();
            value.GeneratingGroupIndex = reader.U32();
            value.MaterialId = reader.U32();
            for (float& component : value.Bounds)
            {
                component = reader.F32();
            }
            for (float& component : value.Cone)
            {
                component = reader.F32();
            }
            value.LodError = reader.F32();
            value.PageIndex = reader.U32();
            value.Flags = reader.U32();
            value.Padding = reader.U32();
            for (float& component : value.ConeApex)
            {
                component = reader.F32();
            }
        }

        void WriteValue(Writer& writer, const VirtualGeometryGPUGroup& value)
        {
            writer.U32(value.FirstChild);
            writer.U32(value.ChildCount);
            writer.U32(value.FirstParent);
            writer.U32(value.ParentCount);
            for (float component : value.Bounds)
            {
                writer.F32(component);
            }
            writer.F32(value.MinError);
            writer.F32(value.MaxError);
            writer.U32(value.PageIndex);
            writer.U32(value.Flags);
            writer.U32(value.Level);
            for (uint32_t component : value.Padding)
            {
                writer.U32(component);
            }
        }

        void ReadValue(Reader& reader, VirtualGeometryGPUGroup& value)
        {
            value.FirstChild = reader.U32();
            value.ChildCount = reader.U32();
            value.FirstParent = reader.U32();
            value.ParentCount = reader.U32();
            for (float& component : value.Bounds)
            {
                component = reader.F32();
            }
            value.MinError = reader.F32();
            value.MaxError = reader.F32();
            value.PageIndex = reader.U32();
            value.Flags = reader.U32();
            value.Level = reader.U32();
            for (uint32_t& component : value.Padding)
            {
                component = reader.U32();
            }
        }

        template <class T> void WriteRecords(Writer& writer, const std::vector<T>& values)
        {
            for (const auto& value : values)
            {
                WriteValue(writer, value);
            }
        }

        template <class T> void ReadRecords(Reader& reader, std::vector<T>& values, uint32_t count, uint32_t wireStride)
        {
            auto source = reader.Take(size_t(count) * wireStride);
            Reader records(source);
            values.resize(count);
            for (auto& value : values)
            {
                ReadValue(records, value);
            }
            records.RequireEnd();
        }

        void WriteMetrics(Writer& writer, const VirtualGeometryCompression::Metrics& value)
        {
            writer.U64(value.EncodedBytes);
            writer.U64(value.RawBytes);
            writer.U64(value.FallbackCount);
            writer.U64(value.PositionQuantized);
            writer.U64(value.HalfUV);
            writer.U64(value.Index8Clusters);
            writer.U64(value.Index16Clusters);
        }

        void ReadMetrics(Reader& reader, VirtualGeometryCompression::Metrics& value)
        {
            value.EncodedBytes = reader.U64();
            value.RawBytes = reader.U64();
            value.FallbackCount = reader.U64();
            value.PositionQuantized = reader.U64();
            value.HalfUV = reader.U64();
            value.Index8Clusters = reader.U64();
            value.Index16Clusters = reader.U64();
        }

        void ReadExact(std::ifstream& file, std::span<uint8_t> bytes)
        {
            if (!file.read(reinterpret_cast<char*>(bytes.data()), std::streamsize(bytes.size())))
            {
                throw std::runtime_error("Truncated Page cache");
            }
        }
    }

    bool WriteGenerated(const std::filesystem::path& path, const VirtualGeometryGPU::PackedAsset& geometry,
                        std::span<const uint8_t> pinned, const PageGenerator& generate, std::string& error,
                        const VirtualGeometryCompression::Metrics& compression, uint64_t sourceTriangles,
                        uint64_t sourceVertices)
    {
        static std::atomic<uint64_t> sequence{0};
        auto temporary = path;
#ifdef _WIN32
        temporary += ".tmp." + std::to_string(GetCurrentProcessId()) + "." + std::to_string(++sequence);
#else
        temporary += ".tmp." + std::to_string(++sequence);
#endif
        try
        {
            if (!VirtualGeometryPages::Validate(geometry, pinned, error))
            {
                return false;
            }
            Writer metadata;
            metadata.U32(uint32_t(geometry.Clusters.size()));
            metadata.U32(uint32_t(geometry.Groups.size()));
            metadata.U32(uint32_t(geometry.HierarchyIndices.size()));
            metadata.U32(uint32_t(geometry.Roots.size()));
            WriteRecords(metadata, geometry.Clusters);
            WriteRecords(metadata, geometry.Groups);
            WriteRecords(metadata, geometry.HierarchyIndices);
            WriteRecords(metadata, geometry.Roots);
            bool encoded = std::any_of(geometry.Clusters.begin(), geometry.Clusters.end(), [](const auto& cluster) {
                return (cluster.Flags & VirtualGeometryCompression::ClusterFlag) != 0;
            });
            if (sourceTriangles == 0 || sourceVertices == 0)
            {
                uint64_t triangles = 0;
                uint64_t vertices = 0;
                for (const auto& cluster : geometry.Clusters)
                {
                    if (cluster.Level == 0)
                    {
                        triangles += cluster.TriangleCount;
                        vertices += cluster.VertexCount;
                    }
                }
                if (sourceTriangles == 0)
                {
                    sourceTriangles = triangles;
                }
                if (sourceVertices == 0)
                {
                    sourceVertices = vertices;
                }
            }
            bool extended = true; // 製品用コンテナーは常に指標とバージョンのメタデータを持つ。
            if (extended)
            {
                WriteMetrics(metadata, compression);
            }
            uint64_t offset = HeaderBytes + metadata.Bytes.size() + pinned.size() * 24ull;
            std::vector<uint8_t> payload(VirtualGeometryPages::PageBytes);
            std::vector<uint64_t> checksums;
            for (uint32_t page = 0; page < pinned.size(); ++page)
            {
                if (!generate(page, payload, error))
                {
                    throw std::runtime_error(error);
                }
                metadata.U64(offset);
                metadata.U32(VirtualGeometryPages::PageBytes);
                metadata.U32(pinned[page]);
                checksums.push_back(VirtualGeometrySerializer::Hash(payload));
                metadata.U64(checksums.back());
                offset += VirtualGeometryPages::PageBytes;
            }
            if (metadata.Bytes.size() > MaxMetadataBytes)
            {
                throw std::runtime_error("Page metadata budget exceeded");
            }
            Writer header;
            header.U32(Magic);
            header.U32(uint32_t(FormatVersion::Production));
            header.U32(VirtualGeometryPages::PageBytes);
            header.U32(uint32_t(pinned.size()));
            header.U64(offset);
            header.U64(metadata.Bytes.size());
            header.U64(VirtualGeometrySerializer::Hash(metadata.Bytes));
            header.U32(VirtualGeometryConfig::BuilderVersion);
            header.U32(encoded ? VirtualGeometryCompression::CompressionVersion : 0);
            header.U64(sourceTriangles);
            header.U64(sourceVertices);
            header.Bytes.resize(HeaderBytes, 0);
            if (!path.parent_path().empty())
            {
                std::filesystem::create_directories(path.parent_path());
            }
            std::ofstream file(temporary, std::ios::binary | std::ios::trunc);
            file.exceptions(std::ios::badbit | std::ios::failbit);
            file.write(reinterpret_cast<const char*>(header.Bytes.data()), header.Bytes.size());
            file.write(reinterpret_cast<const char*>(metadata.Bytes.data()), metadata.Bytes.size());
            for (uint32_t page = 0; page < pinned.size(); ++page)
            {
                if (!generate(page, payload, error) || VirtualGeometrySerializer::Hash(payload) != checksums[page])
                {
                    throw std::runtime_error("Page generator failed or changed between passes: " + error);
                }
                file.write(reinterpret_cast<const char*>(payload.data()), payload.size());
            }
            file.flush();
            file.close();
#ifdef _WIN32
            if (!MoveFileExW(temporary.c_str(), path.c_str(), MOVEFILE_REPLACE_EXISTING | MOVEFILE_WRITE_THROUGH))
            {
                throw std::runtime_error("Atomic Page cache replacement failed, Win32=" +
                                         std::to_string(GetLastError()));
            }
#else
            std::filesystem::rename(temporary, path);
#endif
            error.clear();
            return true;
        }
        catch (const std::exception& exception)
        {
            std::error_code ignored;
            std::filesystem::remove(temporary, ignored);
            error = exception.what();
            return false;
        }
    }

    bool WriteAtomic(const std::filesystem::path& path, const VirtualGeometryPages::PagedAsset& asset,
                     std::string& error)
    {
        if (asset.Payloads.size() != asset.PinnedPages.size())
        {
            error = "Page payload/directory count mismatch";
            return false;
        }
        return WriteGenerated(
            path, asset.Metadata, asset.PinnedPages,
            [&](uint32_t page, std::span<uint8_t> payload, std::string& message) {
                if (asset.Payloads[page].size() != payload.size())
                {
                    message = "Invalid Page payload size";
                    return false;
                }
                std::copy(asset.Payloads[page].begin(), asset.Payloads[page].end(), payload.begin());
                return true;
            },
            error, asset.Compression, asset.SourceTriangles, asset.SourceVertices);
    }

    bool Open(const std::filesystem::path& path, PageManifest& output, std::string& error)
    {
        output = {};
        try
        {
            uint64_t fileBytes = std::filesystem::file_size(path);
            std::ifstream file(path, std::ios::binary);
            std::array<uint8_t, HeaderBytes> headerBytes{};
            ReadExact(file, headerBytes);
            Reader header(headerBytes);
            if (header.U32() != Magic)
            {
                throw std::runtime_error("Invalid VGMesh Page magic");
            }
            uint32_t version = header.U32();
            if (version < uint32_t(FormatVersion::Streaming) || version > uint32_t(FormatVersion::Production))
            {
                throw std::runtime_error("Unsupported VGMesh format version");
            }
            if (header.U32() != VirtualGeometryPages::PageBytes)
            {
                throw std::runtime_error("Invalid VGMesh Streaming Page size");
            }
            uint32_t pageCount = header.U32();
            uint64_t declaredFileBytes = header.U64();
            uint64_t metadataBytes = header.U64();
            uint64_t identity = header.U64();
            const uint32_t builderVersion = header.U32();
            const uint32_t compressionVersion = header.U32();
            const uint64_t sourceTriangles = header.U64();
            const uint64_t sourceVertices = header.U64();
            if (version == uint32_t(FormatVersion::Production) &&
                (builderVersion != VirtualGeometryConfig::BuilderVersion ||
                 compressionVersion > VirtualGeometryCompression::CompressionVersion))
            {
                throw std::runtime_error("VGMesh builder/codec version requires asset rebuild");
            }
            if (!pageCount || declaredFileBytes != fileBytes || fileBytes < HeaderBytes || metadataBytes < 16 ||
                metadataBytes > MaxMetadataBytes || metadataBytes > fileBytes - HeaderBytes ||
                uint64_t(pageCount) * 24 > metadataBytes ||
                uint64_t(pageCount) * VirtualGeometryPages::PageBytes != fileBytes - HeaderBytes - metadataBytes)
            {
                throw std::runtime_error("Invalid Page cache size/directory");
            }
            std::vector<uint8_t> bytes(size_t(metadataBytes), 0);
            ReadExact(file, bytes);
            if (VirtualGeometrySerializer::Hash(bytes) != identity)
            {
                throw std::runtime_error("Page metadata checksum mismatch");
            }
            Reader metadata(bytes);
            uint32_t clusters = metadata.U32();
            uint32_t groups = metadata.U32();
            uint32_t hierarchy = metadata.U32();
            uint32_t roots = metadata.U32();
            PageManifest result;
            result.Version = FormatVersion(version);
            result.BuilderVersion = builderVersion;
            result.CompressionVersion = compressionVersion;
            result.SourceTriangles = sourceTriangles;
            result.SourceVertices = sourceVertices;
            result.Path = path;
            result.Identity = identity;
            result.FileBytes = fileBytes;
            ReadRecords(metadata, result.Metadata.Clusters, clusters, 96);
            ReadRecords(metadata, result.Metadata.Groups, groups, 64);
            ReadRecords(metadata, result.Metadata.HierarchyIndices, hierarchy, 4);
            ReadRecords(metadata, result.Metadata.Roots, roots, 4);
            if (version >= uint32_t(FormatVersion::GeometryCompression))
            {
                ReadMetrics(metadata, result.Compression);
            }
            result.Pages.resize(pageCount);
            result.PinnedPages.resize(pageCount);
            uint64_t offset = HeaderBytes + metadataBytes;
            for (uint32_t page = 0; page < pageCount; ++page)
            {
                auto& entry = result.Pages[page];
                entry.Offset = metadata.U64();
                entry.Size = metadata.U32();
                uint32_t pinned = metadata.U32();
                entry.Checksum = metadata.U64();
                if (entry.Offset != offset || entry.Size != VirtualGeometryPages::PageBytes || pinned > 1)
                {
                    throw std::runtime_error("Invalid Page directory entry");
                }
                result.PinnedPages[page] = uint8_t(pinned);
                offset += entry.Size;
            }
            metadata.RequireEnd();
            if (!VirtualGeometryPages::Validate(result.Metadata, result.PinnedPages, error))
            {
                return false;
            }
            result.PageClusters.resize(pageCount);
            for (uint32_t index = 0; index < result.Metadata.Clusters.size(); ++index)
            {
                const auto& cluster = result.Metadata.Clusters[index];
                if (version == uint32_t(FormatVersion::Production) &&
                    (cluster.Flags & VirtualGeometryCompression::ClusterFlag) &&
                    compressionVersion != VirtualGeometryCompression::CompressionVersion)
                {
                    throw std::runtime_error("Compressed VGMesh requires matching codec version");
                }
                if (version == uint32_t(FormatVersion::Streaming) &&
                    (cluster.Flags & VirtualGeometryCompression::ClusterFlag))
                {
                    throw std::runtime_error("Compressed cluster in legacy Page format");
                }
                result.PageClusters[cluster.PageIndex].push_back(index);
            }
            output = std::move(result);
            error.clear();
            return true;
        }
        catch (const std::exception& exception)
        {
            error = exception.what();
            return false;
        }
    }

    bool ReadPage(const PageManifest& manifest, uint32_t page, std::span<uint8_t> bytes, std::string& error)
    {
        try
        {
            if (page >= manifest.Pages.size() || bytes.size() != VirtualGeometryPages::PageBytes)
            {
                throw std::runtime_error("Invalid Page read range");
            }
            const auto& entry = manifest.Pages[page];
            if (entry.Size != bytes.size() || entry.Offset > manifest.FileBytes ||
                entry.Size > manifest.FileBytes - entry.Offset ||
                entry.Offset > uint64_t(std::numeric_limits<std::streamoff>::max()))
            {
                throw std::runtime_error("Page file offset overflow");
            }
            std::ifstream file(manifest.Path, std::ios::binary);
            file.seekg(std::streamoff(entry.Offset));
            ReadExact(file, bytes);
            if (VirtualGeometrySerializer::Hash(bytes) != entry.Checksum)
            {
                throw std::runtime_error("Page payload checksum mismatch");
            }
            if (manifest.PageClusters.size() != manifest.Pages.size())
            {
                throw std::runtime_error("Missing validated Page cluster directory");
            }
            for (uint32_t index : manifest.PageClusters[page])
            {
                const auto& cluster = manifest.Metadata.Clusters.at(index);
                if ((cluster.Flags & VirtualGeometryCompression::ClusterFlag) != 0)
                {
                    if (cluster.VertexOffset > bytes.size() || cluster.Padding > bytes.size() - cluster.VertexOffset ||
                        !VirtualGeometryCompression::Validate(bytes.subspan(cluster.VertexOffset, cluster.Padding),
                                                              cluster.VertexCount, cluster.TriangleCount, error))
                    {
                        throw std::runtime_error(manifest.Path.string() + " cluster " + std::to_string(index) + ": " +
                                                 error);
                    }
                }
            }
            error.clear();
            return true;
        }
        catch (const std::exception& exception)
        {
            error = exception.what();
            return false;
        }
    }
} // 名前空間 VirtualGeometryPageCache の終わり。

===== FILE: source\virtualgeometry\virtualgeometrypageio.cpp =====
#include "virtualgeometrypageio.h"
#include <algorithm>

namespace VirtualGeometryStreaming
{
    PageIo::PageIo(Reader reader) : m_Read(std::move(reader))
    {
        try
        {
            m_Workers.reserve(4);
            m_Active.reserve(4);
            m_Completed.reserve(1024);
            m_Cancelled.reserve(1024);
            for (uint32_t worker = 0; worker < 4; ++worker)
            {
                m_Workers.emplace_back([this] {
                    Work();
                });
            }
        }
        catch (...)
        {
            Shutdown();
            throw;
        }
    }

    PageIo::~PageIo()
    {
        Shutdown();
    }

    bool PageIo::Submit(std::shared_ptr<const VirtualGeometryPageCache::PageManifest> manifest, LoadTicket ticket,
                        uint32_t localPage)
    {
        std::lock_guard lock(m_Mutex);
        if (m_Stopping || !manifest || localPage >= manifest->Pages.size() ||
            m_ReservedBytes + 65536 > 64ull * 1024 * 1024)
        {
            return false;
        }
        m_Jobs.push_back({std::move(manifest), ticket, localPage});
        m_ReservedBytes += 65536;
        m_Ready.notify_one();
        return true;
    }

    void PageIo::Cancel(LoadTicket ticket)
    {
        std::lock_guard lock(m_Mutex);
        for (auto& result : m_Completed)
        {
            if (result.Ticket == ticket)
            {
                result.Error = "Page read cancelled";
                result.Payload.clear();
                return;
            }
        }
        bool active = std::find(m_Active.begin(), m_Active.end(), ticket) != m_Active.end();
        bool queued = std::any_of(m_Jobs.begin(), m_Jobs.end(), [&](const Job& job) {
            return job.Ticket == ticket;
        });
        if ((active || queued) && std::find(m_Cancelled.begin(), m_Cancelled.end(), ticket) == m_Cancelled.end())
        {
            m_Cancelled.push_back(ticket);
        }
    }

    uint64_t PageIo::StagingBytes() const
    {
        std::lock_guard lock(m_Mutex);
        return m_ReservedBytes;
    }

    std::vector<PageIoCompletion> PageIo::Poll()
    {
        std::lock_guard lock(m_Mutex);
        std::vector<PageIoCompletion> result;
        result.swap(m_Completed);
        m_ReservedBytes -= result.size() * 65536ull;
        return result;
    }

    void PageIo::Work()
    {
        while (true)
        {
            Job job;
            {
                std::unique_lock lock(m_Mutex);
                m_Ready.wait(lock, [&] {
                    return m_Stopping || !m_Jobs.empty();
                });
                if (m_Jobs.empty())
                {
                    return;
                }
                job = std::move(m_Jobs.front());
                m_Jobs.pop_front();
                m_Active.push_back(job.Ticket);
            }
            PageIoCompletion result;
            result.Ticket = job.Ticket;
            auto begin = std::chrono::steady_clock::now();
            try
            {
                result.Payload.resize(65536);
                if (m_Read(*job.Manifest, job.LocalPage, result.Payload, result.Error))
                {
                    result.ReadBytes = 65536;
                }
                else if (result.Error.empty())
                {
                    result.Error = "Page read failed";
                }
            }
            catch (const std::exception& exception)
            {
                result.Error = exception.what();
            }
            result.Milliseconds =
                std::chrono::duration<double, std::milli>(std::chrono::steady_clock::now() - begin).count();
            {
                std::lock_guard lock(m_Mutex);
                auto active = std::find(m_Active.begin(), m_Active.end(), job.Ticket);
                m_Active.erase(active);
                auto cancelled = std::find(m_Cancelled.begin(), m_Cancelled.end(), job.Ticket);
                if (cancelled != m_Cancelled.end())
                {
                    result.Error = "Page read cancelled";
                    m_Cancelled.erase(cancelled);
                }
                if (!result.Error.empty())
                {
                    result.Payload.clear();
                }
                m_Completed.push_back(std::move(result));
            }
        }
    }

    void PageIo::Shutdown()
    {
        {
            std::lock_guard lock(m_Mutex);
            m_Stopping = true;
        }
        m_Ready.notify_all();
        for (auto& worker : m_Workers)
        {
            if (worker.joinable())
            {
                worker.join();
            }
        }
        m_Workers.clear();
    }
} // 名前空間 VirtualGeometryStreaming の終わり。

    class PageIo

        ~PageIo();

      private:

        {

            LoadTicket Ticket;
            uint32_t LocalPage = 0;
        };

        void Work();
        Reader m_Read;
        mutable std::mutex m_Mutex;

        std::vector<LoadTicket> m_Active;

===== FILE: source\virtualgeometry\virtualgeometrypagepool.cpp =====
#include "virtualgeometrypagepool.h"
#include <cstring>
#include <stdexcept>
#include <chrono>
#include <thread>

namespace VirtualGeometryStreaming
{
    namespace
    {
        void Check(HRESULT result)
        {
            if (FAILED(result))
            {
                throw std::runtime_error("Geometry Page Copy Queue operation failed");
            }
        }

        Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<ID3D12Resource> Buffer(ID3D12Device* device, D3D12_HEAP_TYPE type,
                                                      D3D12_RESOURCE_STATES state)
        {
            D3D12_HEAP_PROPERTIES heap{};
            heap.Type = type;
            heap.CreationNodeMask = heap.VisibleNodeMask = 1;
            D3D12_RESOURCE_DESC description{};
            description.Dimension = D3D12_RESOURCE_DIMENSION_BUFFER;
            description.Width = 65536;
            description.Height = description.DepthOrArraySize = description.MipLevels = 1;
            description.SampleDesc.Count = 1;
            description.Layout = D3D12_TEXTURE_LAYOUT_ROW_MAJOR;
            Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<ID3D12Resource> resource;
            Check(device->CreateCommittedResource(&heap, D3D12_HEAP_FLAG_NONE, &description, state, nullptr,
                                                  IID_PPV_ARGS(&resource)));
            return resource;
        }
    }

    void PagePool::Initialize(ID3D12Device* device, D3D12_CPU_DESCRIPTOR_HANDLE descriptors, uint32_t increment)
    {
        if (m_Device)
        {
            return;
        }
        m_Device = device;
        m_Descriptors = descriptors;
        m_Increment = increment;
        D3D12_COMMAND_QUEUE_DESC description{};
        description.Type = D3D12_COMMAND_LIST_TYPE_COPY;
        Check(device->CreateCommandQueue(&description, IID_PPV_ARGS(&m_Queue)));
        Check(device->CreateFence(0, D3D12_FENCE_FLAG_NONE, IID_PPV_ARGS(&m_Fence)));
    }

    uint64_t PagePool::Submit(LoadTicket ticket, std::span<const uint8_t> payload)
    {
        if (!m_Device || payload.size() != 65536 || ticket.Slot >= 16384 || ticket.Generation > UINT32_MAX)
        {
            throw std::runtime_error("Invalid Geometry Page transfer");
        }
        // 常駐状態とフェンスに基づく受付判定は呼び出し元が管理する。
        // シェーダー読み取り中のリソースへコピーせず、リソースを交換してキューの所有権を分離する。
        auto page = Buffer(m_Device.Get(), D3D12_HEAP_TYPE_DEFAULT, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_COMMON);
        Transfer transfer;
        transfer.Upload = Buffer(m_Device.Get(), D3D12_HEAP_TYPE_UPLOAD, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_GENERIC_READ);
        void* mapped = nullptr;
        D3D12_RANGE noRead{0, 0};
        Check(transfer.Upload->Map(0, &noRead, &mapped));
        std::memcpy(mapped, payload.data(), payload.size());
        transfer.Upload->Unmap(0, nullptr);
        Check(m_Device->CreateCommandAllocator(D3D12_COMMAND_LIST_TYPE_COPY, IID_PPV_ARGS(&transfer.Allocator)));
        Check(m_Device->CreateCommandList(0, D3D12_COMMAND_LIST_TYPE_COPY, transfer.Allocator.Get(), nullptr,
                                          IID_PPV_ARGS(&transfer.Commands)));
        transfer.Commands->CopyBufferRegion(page.Get(), 0, transfer.Upload.Get(), 0, 65536);
        Check(transfer.Commands->Close());
        transfer.Fence = ++m_Submitted;
        if (m_Pages.size() <= ticket.Slot)
        {
            m_Pages.resize(size_t(ticket.Slot) + 1);
        }
        m_Pages[ticket.Slot] = page;
        // Signal が失敗する場合も含め、送信前にすべてを保持する。
        m_Transfers.push_back(std::move(transfer));
        ID3D12CommandList* list = m_Transfers.back().Commands.Get();
        m_Queue->ExecuteCommandLists(1, &list);
        Check(m_Queue->Signal(m_Fence.Get(), m_Submitted));
        D3D12_SHADER_RESOURCE_VIEW_DESC view{};
        view.ViewDimension = D3D12_SRV_DIMENSION_BUFFER;
        view.Format = DXGI_FORMAT_R32_TYPELESS;
        view.Shader4ComponentMapping = D3D12_DEFAULT_SHADER_4_COMPONENT_MAPPING;
        view.Buffer.NumElements = 65536 / 4;
        view.Buffer.Flags = D3D12_BUFFER_SRV_FLAG_RAW;
        D3D12_CPU_DESCRIPTOR_HANDLE descriptor{m_Descriptors.ptr + SIZE_T(ticket.Slot) * m_Increment};
        m_Device->CreateShaderResourceView(page.Get(), &view, descriptor);
        return m_Submitted;
    }

    uint64_t PagePool::CompletedCopyFence() const
    {
        if (!m_Fence)
        {
            return 0;
        }
        uint64_t completed = m_Fence->GetCompletedValue();
        if (completed == UINT64_MAX)
        {
            throw std::runtime_error("Geometry Page Copy device removed");
        }
        return completed;
    }

    void PagePool::Collect()
    {
        uint64_t completed = CompletedCopyFence();
        while (!m_Transfers.empty() && m_Transfers.front().Fence <= completed)
        {
            m_Transfers.pop_front();
        }
    }

    ID3D12Resource* PagePool::Resource(uint32_t slot) const
    {
        if (slot >= m_Pages.size())
        {
            return nullptr;
        }
        return m_Pages[slot].Get();
    }

    void PagePool::Shutdown()
    {
        if (m_Fence && m_Submitted && m_Fence->GetCompletedValue() < m_Submitted)
        {
            HANDLE event = CreateEventW(nullptr, FALSE, FALSE, nullptr);
            bool waitingOnEvent = event && SUCCEEDED(m_Fence->SetEventOnCompletion(m_Submitted, event));
            while (m_Fence->GetCompletedValue() < m_Submitted && SUCCEEDED(m_Device->GetDeviceRemovedReason()))
            {
                if (waitingOnEvent)
                {
                    WaitForSingleObject(event, 500);
                }
                else
                {
                    std::this_thread::sleep_for(std::chrono::milliseconds(1));
                }
            }
            if (event)
            {
                CloseHandle(event);
            }
        }
        m_Transfers.clear();
        m_Pages.clear();
        m_Queue.Reset();
        m_Fence.Reset();
        m_Device.Reset();
        m_Submitted = 0;
    }

    void PagePool::Release(uint32_t slot)
    {
        if (slot < m_Pages.size())
        {
            m_Pages[slot].Reset();
        }
    }

    uint64_t PagePool::MemoryBytes() const
    {
        uint64_t bytes = 0;
        for (const auto& page : m_Pages)
        {
            if (page)
            {
                bytes += 65536;
            }
        }
        return bytes;
    }

    PagePool::~PagePool()
    {
        Shutdown();
    }
} // 名前空間 VirtualGeometryStreaming の終わり。

#pragma once

#include <span>

namespace VirtualGeometryStreaming
{
    class PagePool
    {
      public:
        void Initialize(ID3D12Device* device, D3D12_CPU_DESCRIPTOR_HANDLE descriptors, uint32_t increment);
        uint64_t Submit(LoadTicket ticket, std::span<const uint8_t> payload);

            Ptr<ID3D12GraphicsCommandList> Commands;
            Ptr<ID3D12Resource> Upload;

        };

        Ptr<ID3D12Device> m_Device;
        Ptr<ID3D12CommandQueue> m_Queue;
        Ptr<ID3D12Fence> m_Fence;
        std::vector<Ptr<ID3D12Resource>> m_Pages;
        std::deque<Transfer> m_Transfers;

===== FILE: source\virtualgeometry\virtualgeometrypages.cpp =====
#include "virtualgeometrypages.h"
#include "virtualgeometryserializationinternal.h"
#include <algorithm>
#include <cmath>
#include <cstring>
#include <numeric>
#include <limits>
#include <iostream>
#include <stdexcept>

namespace VirtualGeometryPages
{
    bool Validate(const VirtualGeometryGPU::PackedAsset& metadata, std::span<const uint8_t> pinned, std::string& error)
    {
        auto fail = [&](const char* message) {
            error = message;
            return false;
        };
        if (metadata.Clusters.empty() || metadata.Roots.empty() || pinned.empty())
        {
            return fail("Empty paged hierarchy");
        }
        std::vector<uint32_t> consumers(metadata.Clusters.size(), UINT32_MAX);
        std::vector<uint32_t> producers(metadata.Clusters.size(), UINT32_MAX);
        std::vector<uint8_t> roots(metadata.Clusters.size());
        for (uint32_t root : metadata.Roots)
        {
            if (root >= roots.size() || roots[root])
            {
                return fail("Invalid paged root");
            }
            roots[root] = 1;
        }
        for (uint32_t index = 0; index < metadata.Groups.size(); ++index)
        {
            const auto& group = metadata.Groups[index];
            bool finiteBounds = group.Bounds[3] >= 0;
            for (float component : group.Bounds)
            {
                finiteBounds &= std::isfinite(component);
            }
            if (group.Level >= 31 || !group.ChildCount || !group.ParentCount ||
                uint64_t(group.FirstChild) + group.ChildCount > metadata.HierarchyIndices.size() ||
                uint64_t(group.FirstParent) + group.ParentCount > metadata.HierarchyIndices.size() || !finiteBounds ||
                !std::isfinite(group.MaxError) || !std::isfinite(group.MinError) || group.MinError < 0 ||
                group.MaxError < group.MinError)
            {
                return fail("Invalid paged group range/error");
            }
            for (uint32_t child = 0; child < group.ChildCount; ++child)
            {
                uint32_t cluster = metadata.HierarchyIndices[group.FirstChild + child];
                if (cluster >= consumers.size() || consumers[cluster] != UINT32_MAX ||
                    metadata.Clusters[cluster].Level != group.Level)
                {
                    return fail("Invalid paged child link");
                }
                consumers[cluster] = index;
            }
            for (uint32_t parent = 0; parent < group.ParentCount; ++parent)
            {
                uint32_t cluster = metadata.HierarchyIndices[group.FirstParent + parent];
                if (cluster >= producers.size() || producers[cluster] != UINT32_MAX ||
                    metadata.Clusters[cluster].Level != group.Level + 1)
                {
                    return fail("Invalid paged parent link");
                }
                producers[cluster] = index;
            }
        }
        for (size_t index = 0; index < metadata.Clusters.size(); ++index)
        {
            const auto& cluster = metadata.Clusters[index];
            bool finiteBounds = cluster.Bounds[3] >= 0 && std::isfinite(cluster.LodError) && cluster.LodError >= 0;
            for (float component : cluster.Bounds)
            {
                finiteBounds &= std::isfinite(component);
            }
            for (float component : cluster.Cone)
            {
                finiteBounds &= std::isfinite(component);
            }
            for (float component : cluster.ConeApex)
            {
                finiteBounds &= std::isfinite(component);
            }
            bool encoded = (cluster.Flags & VirtualGeometryCompression::ClusterFlag) != 0;
            uint64_t vertexEnd = uint64_t(cluster.VertexOffset) + uint64_t(cluster.VertexCount) * 48;
            uint64_t triangleEnd =
                (uint64_t(cluster.TriangleOffset) + uint64_t(cluster.TriangleCount) * 3 + 3) & ~uint64_t(3);
            bool invalidLayout = vertexEnd > PageBytes || triangleEnd > PageBytes || cluster.TriangleOffset < vertexEnd;
            if (encoded)
            {
                uint64_t end = uint64_t(cluster.VertexOffset) + cluster.Padding;
                invalidLayout =
                    cluster.Padding < VirtualGeometryCompression::HeaderBytes || cluster.Padding % 4 ||
                    end > PageBytes ||
                    cluster.TriangleOffset < cluster.VertexOffset + VirtualGeometryCompression::HeaderBytes ||
                    cluster.TriangleOffset >= end;
            }
            if (!cluster.VertexCount || cluster.VertexCount > 64 || !cluster.TriangleCount ||
                cluster.TriangleCount > 124 || cluster.PageIndex >= pinned.size() || cluster.VertexOffset % 4 ||
                cluster.TriangleOffset % 4 || invalidLayout || !finiteBounds || cluster.Level >= 32 ||
                cluster.GroupIndex != consumers[index] || cluster.GeneratingGroupIndex != producers[index] ||
                bool(roots[index]) != (consumers[index] == UINT32_MAX) ||
                (cluster.Level != 0 && producers[index] == UINT32_MAX) || (roots[index] && !pinned[cluster.PageIndex]))
            {
                return fail("Invalid paged cluster layout/link");
            }
        }
        error.clear();
        return true;
    }

    bool Build(const VirtualGeometryAsset& asset, PagedAsset& output, std::string& error)
    {
        return Build(asset, VGCompressionSettings{}, output, error);
    }

    bool Build(const VirtualGeometryAsset& asset, const VGCompressionSettings& settings, PagedAsset& output,
               std::string& error)
    {
        return Build(asset, VirtualGeometryCompression::Input{}, settings, output, error);
    }

    bool Build(const VirtualGeometryAsset& asset, const VirtualGeometryCompression::Input& attributes,
               const VGCompressionSettings& settings, PagedAsset& output, std::string& error)
    {
        output = {};
        try
        {
            PagedAsset result;
            result.SourceTriangles = asset.Stats.SourceTriangles;
            result.SourceVertices = asset.Stats.SourceVertices;
            if (!VirtualGeometryGPU::Pack(asset, result.Metadata, error))
            {
                return false;
            }
            VirtualGeometryCompression::Input input = attributes;
            input.Vertices = asset.Vertices;
            VirtualGeometryCompression::Plan plan;
            if (settings.Enabled && !VirtualGeometryCompression::Select(input, settings, plan, error))
            {
                error = asset.DebugName + ": " + error;
                return false;
            }
            result.CompressionFallbacks = plan.FallbackReasons;
            for (const auto& reason : plan.FallbackReasons)
            {
                std::clog << "Geometry compression " << asset.DebugName << ": " << reason << '\n';
            }
            result.Compression.FallbackCount = plan.FallbackReasons.size();
            for (const auto& stream : plan.Streams)
            {
                result.Compression.PositionQuantized += stream.Encoding == VirtualGeometryCompression::Codec::UNorm16x3;
                result.Compression.HalfUV += stream.Encoding == VirtualGeometryCompression::Codec::Float16x2;
            }
            std::vector<uint8_t> roots(asset.Clusters.size());
            for (uint32_t root : asset.RootClusters)
            {
                roots[root] = 1;
            }
            std::vector<uint32_t> order(asset.Clusters.size());
            std::iota(order.begin(), order.end(), 0u);
            std::stable_sort(order.begin(), order.end(), [&](uint32_t first, uint32_t second) {
                return roots[first] > roots[second];
            });
            uint32_t rawStride = 48;
            if (settings.Enabled)
            {
                rawStride = 0;
                for (const auto& stream : plan.Streams)
                {
                    if (stream.Attribute >= VirtualGeometryCompression::Texcoord0)
                    {
                        rawStride += 8;
                    }
                    else if (stream.Attribute == VirtualGeometryCompression::Tangent ||
                             stream.Attribute == VirtualGeometryCompression::Color)
                    {
                        rawStride += 16;
                    }
                    else
                    {
                        rawStride += 12;
                    }
                }
            }
            uint32_t used = PageBytes;
            bool previousPinned = true;
            for (uint32_t index : order)
            {
                const auto& source = asset.Clusters[index];
                auto& target = result.Metadata.Clusters[index];
                std::vector<uint32_t> indices;
                indices.reserve(source.TriangleCount * 3);
                for (uint32_t triangle = 0; triangle < source.TriangleCount * 3; ++triangle)
                {
                    indices.push_back(asset.TriangleIndices[source.TriangleOffset + triangle]);
                }
                std::vector<uint8_t> payload;
                if (settings.Enabled &&
                    !VirtualGeometryCompression::EncodeCluster(input, plan, source.VertexOffset, source.VertexCount,
                                                               indices, payload, error))
                {
                    error = asset.DebugName + " cluster " + std::to_string(index) + ": " + error;
                    return false;
                }
                if (!settings.Enabled)
                {
                    VirtualGeometrySerialization::Writer writer;
                    for (uint32_t vertex = 0; vertex < source.VertexCount; ++vertex)
                    {
                        const auto& value = asset.Vertices[source.VertexOffset + vertex];
                        for (float component : value.Position)
                        {
                            writer.F32(component);
                        }
                        for (float component : value.Normal)
                        {
                            writer.F32(component);
                        }
                        for (float component : value.TexCoord)
                        {
                            writer.F32(component);
                        }
                        for (float component : value.Diffuse)
                        {
                            writer.F32(component);
                        }
                    }
                    for (uint32_t index : indices)
                    {
                        writer.Bytes.push_back(uint8_t(index));
                    }
                    writer.Bytes.resize((writer.Bytes.size() + 3) & ~size_t(3), 0);
                    payload = std::move(writer.Bytes);
                }
                uint32_t total = uint32_t(payload.size());
                bool pinned = roots[index] != 0;
                if (total > PageBytes - used || pinned != previousPinned)
                {
                    if (result.Payloads.size() >= UINT32_MAX)
                    {
                        throw std::runtime_error("Geometry Page ID overflow");
                    }
                    result.Payloads.emplace_back(PageBytes, 0);
                    result.PinnedPages.push_back(uint8_t(pinned));
                    used = 0;
                }
                previousPinned = pinned;
                target.PageIndex = uint32_t(result.Payloads.size() - 1);
                target.VertexOffset = used;
                // ヘッダーはメッシュ全体の量子化メタデータも兼ねる。内部オフセットはクラスター相対。
                uint32_t indexOffset = source.VertexCount * 48;
                if (settings.Enabled)
                {
                    indexOffset = uint32_t(payload[24]) | (uint32_t(payload[25]) << 8) | (uint32_t(payload[26]) << 16) |
                                  (uint32_t(payload[27]) << 24);
                    target.Flags |= VirtualGeometryCompression::ClusterFlag;
                    target.Padding = total;
                }
                target.TriangleOffset = used + indexOffset;
                // 中心を変えず、復号した位置を使って球の半径を合わせ直す。
                // 量子化で三角形の法線が変わるため、頂点のテストも含めて古いコーンを無効化する。
                double radius = target.Bounds[3];
                for (uint32_t vertex = 0; settings.Enabled && vertex < source.VertexCount; ++vertex)
                {
                    auto decoded = VirtualGeometryCompression::DecodeVertexCPU(payload, vertex);
                    double squared = 0;
                    for (uint32_t axis = 0; axis < 3; ++axis)
                    {
                        double delta = double(decoded.Position[axis]) - target.Bounds[axis];
                        squared += delta * delta;
                    }
                    radius = std::max(radius, std::sqrt(squared));
                }
                if (settings.Enabled)
                {
                    target.Bounds[3] = std::nextafter(float(radius), std::numeric_limits<float>::infinity());
                }
                if (plan.PositionError > 0)
                {
                    target.Cone[3] = 1;
                    target.LodError =
                        std::nextafter(target.LodError + plan.PositionError, std::numeric_limits<float>::infinity());
                }
                result.Compression.RawBytes +=
                    uint64_t(source.VertexCount) * rawStride + uint64_t(source.TriangleCount) * 3;
                result.Compression.EncodedBytes += total;
                if (!settings.Enabled || (settings.AllowIndex8 && source.VertexCount <= 256))
                {
                    ++result.Compression.Index8Clusters;
                }
                else
                {
                    ++result.Compression.Index16Clusters;
                }
                auto& bytes = result.Payloads.back();
                std::copy(payload.begin(), payload.end(), bytes.begin() + used);
                used += total;
            }
            for (auto& group : result.Metadata.Groups)
            {
                // グループの球は、すでにすべての子孫の元頂点を覆っている。
                if (plan.PositionError > 0)
                {
                    group.Bounds[3] =
                        std::nextafter(group.Bounds[3] + plan.PositionError, std::numeric_limits<float>::infinity());
                    group.MaxError =
                        std::nextafter(group.MaxError + plan.PositionError, std::numeric_limits<float>::infinity());
                }
            }
            result.Metadata.Vertices = {};
            result.Metadata.Triangles = {};
            if (!Validate(result.Metadata, result.PinnedPages, error))
            {
                return false;
            }
            output = std::move(result);
            error.clear();
            return true;
        }
        catch (const std::exception& exception)
        {
            error = exception.what();
            return false;
        }
    }
} // 名前空間 VirtualGeometryPages の終わり。

===== FILE: source\virtualgeometry\virtualgeometrypagestress.cpp =====
#include "virtualgeometrypagestress.h"
#include <algorithm>
#include <cmath>
#include <cstring>
#include <numeric>

namespace VirtualGeometryPageStress
{
    bool Create(const std::filesystem::path& path, uint32_t leafCount, VirtualGeometryPageCache::PageManifest& manifest,
                std::string& error)
    {
        // 各部分木は同じ平面上の連続した帯になる。その粗い格子は、
        // 8 つの子を合わせたものとまったく同じ矩形を覆う。
        uint32_t power = 1;
        while (power < leafCount && power <= LeavesPerAsset / 8)
        {
            power *= 8;
        }
        if (power != leafCount || leafCount < 8 || leafCount > LeavesPerAsset)
        {
            error = "Stress asset leaf count must be a power of eight, 8..32768";
            return false;
        }

        struct Strip
        {
            uint32_t First;
            uint32_t Count;
        };

        VirtualGeometryGPU::PackedAsset metadata;
        std::vector<Strip> strips;
        auto appendCluster = [&](Strip strip, uint32_t level) {
            VirtualGeometryGPUCluster cluster;
            cluster.VertexCount = 36;
            cluster.TriangleCount = 50;
            cluster.Level = level;
            float first = -4 + 8 * (float(strip.First) / leafCount);
            float width = 8 * (float(strip.Count) / leafCount);
            cluster.Bounds = {first + width * 0.5f, 0, 0, std::sqrt(16 + width * width * 0.25f)};
            cluster.Cone = {0, 0, -1, 1};
            cluster.LodError = float(level);
            metadata.Clusters.push_back(cluster);
            strips.push_back(strip);
        };
        std::vector<uint32_t> current;
        for (uint32_t leaf = 0; leaf < leafCount; ++leaf)
        {
            appendCluster({leaf, 1}, 0);
            current.push_back(leaf);
        }
        uint32_t level = 0;
        while (current.size() > 1)
        {
            std::vector<uint32_t> parents;
            for (size_t begin = 0; begin < current.size(); begin += 8)
            {
                uint32_t groupIndex = uint32_t(metadata.Groups.size());
                VirtualGeometryGPUGroup group;
                group.Level = level;
                group.FirstChild = uint32_t(metadata.HierarchyIndices.size());
                group.ChildCount = 8;
                for (uint32_t offset = 0; offset < 8; ++offset)
                {
                    uint32_t child = current[begin + offset];
                    metadata.Clusters[child].GroupIndex = groupIndex;
                    metadata.HierarchyIndices.push_back(child);
                }
                uint32_t parent = uint32_t(metadata.Clusters.size());
                auto strip = strips[current[begin]];
                strip.Count *= 8;
                appendCluster(strip, level + 1);
                metadata.Clusters.back().GeneratingGroupIndex = groupIndex;
                group.FirstParent = uint32_t(metadata.HierarchyIndices.size());
                group.ParentCount = 1;
                group.Bounds = metadata.Clusters.back().Bounds;
                group.MaxError = float(level + 1);
                metadata.HierarchyIndices.push_back(parent);
                metadata.Groups.push_back(group);
                parents.push_back(parent);
            }
            current = std::move(parents);
            ++level;
        }
        metadata.Roots = current;
        std::vector<uint32_t> order(metadata.Clusters.size());
        std::iota(order.begin(), order.end(), 0u);
        std::reverse(order.begin(), order.end());
        std::vector<std::vector<uint32_t>> pageClusters;
        std::vector<uint8_t> pinned;
        uint32_t used = 65536;
        bool wasPinned = true;
        for (uint32_t index : order)
        {
            bool root = index == current[0];
            if (1880 > 65536 - used || root != wasPinned)
            {
                pageClusters.emplace_back();
                pinned.push_back(uint8_t(root));
                used = 0;
            }
            wasPinned = root;
            auto& cluster = metadata.Clusters[index];
            cluster.PageIndex = uint32_t(pageClusters.size() - 1);
            cluster.VertexOffset = used;
            cluster.TriangleOffset = used + 36 * 48;
            pageClusters.back().push_back(index);
            used += 1880;
        }
        bool saved = VirtualGeometryPageCache::WriteGenerated(
            path, metadata, pinned,
            [&](uint32_t page, std::span<uint8_t> payload, std::string&) {
                std::fill(payload.begin(), payload.end(), 0);
                for (uint32_t index : pageClusters[page])
                {
                    const auto& cluster = metadata.Clusters[index];
                    auto strip = strips[index];
                    float first = -4 + 8 * (float(strip.First) / leafCount);
                    float width = 8 * (float(strip.Count) / leafCount);
                    for (uint32_t y = 0; y < 6; ++y)
                    {
                        for (uint32_t x = 0; x < 6; ++x)
                        {
                            VirtualGeometryVertex vertex;
                            vertex.Position[0] = first + width * (float(x) / 5);
                            vertex.Position[1] = -4 + 8 * (float(y) / 5);
                            vertex.Normal[2] = -1;
                            std::fill(std::begin(vertex.Diffuse), std::end(vertex.Diffuse), 1.0f);
                            std::memcpy(payload.data() + cluster.VertexOffset + (y * 6 + x) * 48, &vertex, 48);
                        }
                    }
                    uint32_t triangle = cluster.TriangleOffset;
                    for (uint8_t y = 0; y < 5; ++y)
                    {
                        for (uint8_t x = 0; x < 5; ++x)
                        {
                            uint8_t firstVertex = uint8_t(y * 6 + x);
                            const uint8_t indices[] = {firstVertex,
                                                       uint8_t(firstVertex + 6),
                                                       uint8_t(firstVertex + 1),
                                                       uint8_t(firstVertex + 1),
                                                       uint8_t(firstVertex + 6),
                                                       uint8_t(firstVertex + 7)};
                            std::memcpy(payload.data() + triangle, indices, 6);
                            triangle += 6;
                        }
                    }
                }
                return true;
            },
            error);
        return saved && VirtualGeometryPageCache::Open(path, manifest, error);
    }
} // 名前空間 VirtualGeometryPageStress の終わり。

#include "pch.h"

namespace VirtualGeometryProduction

        std::ofstream benchmark;

            GBufferType::BASE_COLOR, GBufferType::NORMAL, GBufferType::MATERIAL,   GBufferType::DEPTH,
            GBufferType::VELOCITY,   GBufferType::SHADOW, GBufferType::EMISSION_AO};

        void Check(bool condition, const char* label)
        {
            WriteGraphicsLog("VG production: %s %s\n", condition ? "PASS" : "FAIL", label);
            if (!condition)
            {
                ++failures;
