        std::string Hardware(std::ofstream& report)
        {
            ComPtr<IDXGIFactory4> factory;
            ComPtr<IDXGIAdapter1> adapter;
            const auto luid = GraphicsDevice::GetDevice()->GetAdapterLuid();
            if (FAILED(CreateDXGIFactory1(IID_PPV_ARGS(&factory))) ||
                FAILED(factory->EnumAdapterByLuid(luid, IID_PPV_ARGS(&adapter))))
            {
                return {};
            }
            DXGI_ADAPTER_DESC1 desc{};
            if (FAILED(adapter->GetDesc1(&desc)))
            {
                return {};
            }
            LARGE_INTEGER driver{};
            adapter->CheckInterfaceSupport(__uuidof(IDXGIDevice), &driver);
            std::ostringstream key;
            key << std::hex << desc.VendorId << '-' << desc.DeviceId << '-' << desc.SubSysId << '-' << desc.Revision
                << '-' << driver.QuadPart;
            char gpu[512]{};
            WideCharToMultiByte(CP_UTF8, 0, desc.Description, -1, gpu, sizeof(gpu), nullptr, nullptr);
            char cpu[49]{};
            int registers[4]{};
            __cpuid(registers, static_cast<int>(0x80000000u));
            if (static_cast<uint32_t>(registers[0]) >= 0x80000004u)
            {
                for (uint32_t index = 0; index < 3; ++index)
                {
                    __cpuid(registers, static_cast<int>(0x80000002u + index));
                    memcpy(cpu + index * 16, registers, 16);
                }
            }
            report << "VirtualGeometry Final Benchmark\nGPU: " << gpu << "\nCPU: " << cpu
                   << "\nHardware key: " << key.str() << "\nDedicated VRAM bytes: " << desc.DedicatedVideoMemory
                   << "\nDriver identifier: " << driver.QuadPart
                   << "\nGPU timestamps are blank when unavailable. Decode is included in mesh raster timing."
                   << "\nPage counters are delayed fence-completed samples; upload bandwidth is wall-time averaged.\n";
            uint64_t cpuHash = 14695981039346656037ull;
            for (const unsigned char byte : cpu)
            {
                cpuHash = (cpuHash ^ byte) * 1099511628211ull;
            }
            MEMORYSTATUSEX ram{};
            ram.dwLength = sizeof(ram);
            GlobalMemoryStatusEx(&ram);
            key << '-' << cpuHash << '-' << ram.ullTotalPhys;
            report << "RAM bytes: " << ram.ullTotalPhys << "\nComplete reference key: " << key.str() << '\n';
            return key.str();
        }

        bool Compare(const RenderCapture::TextureData& a, const RenderCapture::TextureData& b, double absoluteTolerance,
                     double maximumChangedFraction)
        {
            if (!a.Width || !a.Height || a.Width != b.Width || a.Height != b.Height || a.Format != b.Format)
            {
                return false;
            }
            uint32_t channels = 0;
            uint32_t bytes = 0;
            bool half = false, normalized = false, packedNormal = false;
            switch (a.Format)
            {
                case DXGI_FORMAT_R32_FLOAT:
                case DXGI_FORMAT_D32_FLOAT:
                case DXGI_FORMAT_R32_TYPELESS:
                    channels = 1;
                    bytes = 4;
                    break;
                case DXGI_FORMAT_R32G32_FLOAT:
                    channels = 2;
                    bytes = 4;
                    break;
                case DXGI_FORMAT_R16G16_FLOAT:
                    channels = 2;
                    bytes = 2;
                    half = true;
                    break;
                case DXGI_FORMAT_R16G16B16A16_FLOAT:
                    channels = 4;
                    bytes = 2;
                    half = true;
                    break;
                case DXGI_FORMAT_R8G8B8A8_UNORM:
                case DXGI_FORMAT_R8G8B8A8_UNORM_SRGB:
                    channels = 4;
                    bytes = 1;
                    normalized = true;
                    break;
                case DXGI_FORMAT_R10G10B10A2_UNORM:
                    channels = 4;
                    bytes = 1;
                    packedNormal = true;
                    break;
                default:
                    return false;
            }
            const size_t rowBytes = size_t(a.Width) * channels * bytes;
            if (a.RowPitch < rowBytes || b.RowPitch < rowBytes || uint64_t(a.RowPitch) * a.Height > a.Bytes.size() ||
                uint64_t(b.RowPitch) * b.Height > b.Bytes.size())
            {
                return false;
            }
            uint64_t changed = 0;
            uint64_t count = uint64_t(a.Width) * a.Height * channels;
            auto scalar = [half, normalized, packedNormal](const uint8_t* address, uint32_t component) {
                if (packedNormal)
                {
                    uint32_t value;
                    memcpy(&value, address, sizeof(value));
                    const uint32_t mask = component == 3 ? 3u : 1023u;
                    return double((value >> (component * 10)) & mask) / mask;
                }
                if (normalized)
                {
                    return double(*address) / 255;
                }
                if (half)
                {
                    uint16_t value;
                    memcpy(&value, address, sizeof(value));
                    return double(RenderCapture::HalfToFloat(value));
                }
                float value;
                memcpy(&value, address, sizeof(value));
                return double(value);
            };
            for (uint32_t row = 0; row < a.Height; ++row)
            {
                for (size_t column = 0; column < size_t(a.Width) * channels; ++column)
                {
                    const size_t offset = packedNormal ? (column / 4) * 4 : column * bytes;
                    const double x = scalar(a.Bytes.data() + size_t(row) * a.RowPitch + offset,
                                            static_cast<uint32_t>(column % channels));
                    const double y = scalar(b.Bytes.data() + size_t(row) * b.RowPitch + offset,
                                            static_cast<uint32_t>(column % channels));
                    if (!std::isfinite(x) || !std::isfinite(y))
                    {
                        return false;
                    }
                    changed += std::abs(x - y) > absoluteTolerance;
                }
            }
            WriteGraphicsLog("VG reference comparison changed=%llu components=%llu tolerance=%g\n", changed, count,
                             absoluteTolerance);
            return double(changed) <= double(count) * maximumChangedFraction;
        }

        bool HasVisibleMovingGeometry(const RenderCapture::TextureData& depth,
                                      const RenderCapture::TextureData& velocity)
        {
            if (depth.Format != DXGI_FORMAT_R32_FLOAT || velocity.Format != DXGI_FORMAT_R16G16B16A16_FLOAT ||
                !depth.Width || depth.Width != velocity.Width || depth.Height != velocity.Height ||
                depth.RowPitch < uint64_t(depth.Width) * 4 || velocity.RowPitch < uint64_t(velocity.Width) * 8 ||
                uint64_t(depth.RowPitch) * depth.Height > depth.Bytes.size() ||
                uint64_t(velocity.RowPitch) * velocity.Height > velocity.Bytes.size())
            {
                return false;
            }
            uint64_t visible = 0;
            uint64_t moving = 0;
            for (uint32_t y = 0; y < depth.Height; ++y)
            {
                for (uint32_t x = 0; x < depth.Width; ++x)
                {
                    float z;
                    memcpy(&z, depth.Bytes.data() + size_t(y) * depth.RowPitch + size_t(x) * 4, 4);
                    if (!std::isfinite(z))
                    {
                        return false;
                    }
                    if (z <= 0 || z >= 1)
                    {
                        continue;
                    }
                    ++visible;
                    uint16_t values[2];
                    memcpy(values, velocity.Bytes.data() + size_t(y) * velocity.RowPitch + size_t(x) * 8 + 4, 4);
                    const float vx = RenderCapture::HalfToFloat(values[0]);
                    const float vy = RenderCapture::HalfToFloat(values[1]);
                    if (!std::isfinite(vx) || !std::isfinite(vy))
                    {
                        return false;
                    }
                    moving += std::abs(vx) > 0.00001f || std::abs(vy) > 0.00001f;
                }
            }
            return visible > 64 && moving > 64;
        }

        std::vector<RenderCapture::TextureData> Capture()
        {
            std::vector<RenderCapture::TextureData> result;
            for (const auto target : targets)
            {
                RenderCapture::TextureData texture;
                Check(RenderCapture::ReadTexture(RenderTargets::GetGBufferResource(target), texture),
                      "GBuffer reference readback");
                result.push_back(std::move(texture));
            }
            if (auto* shadow = LightingResources::GetShadowMapResource())
            {
                std::vector<uint32_t> layers;
                for (uint32_t pass = 0; pass < LightingResources::GetShadowLightCount(); ++pass)
                {
                    UINT layer = 0;
                    D3D12_VIEWPORT viewport{};
                    D3D12_RECT scissor{};
                    bool clear = false;
                    if (LightingResources::GetShadowPassInfo(pass, layer, viewport, scissor, clear) &&
                        layer < shadow->GetDesc().DepthOrArraySize)
                    {
                        layers.push_back(layer);
                    }
                }
                std::sort(layers.begin(), layers.end());
                layers.erase(std::unique(layers.begin(), layers.end()), layers.end());
                Check(!layers.empty(), "shadow attachments contain active light layers");
                for (const uint32_t slice : layers)
                {
                    RenderCapture::TextureData texture;
                    Check(RenderCapture::ReadTextureSlice(shadow, texture, slice), "light shadow slice readback");
                    result.push_back(std::move(texture));
                }
            }
            return result;
        }

        void Setup()
        {
            outputDirectory = "build/virtualgeometry-phase11";
            std::filesystem::create_directories(outputDirectory);
            std::vector<uint32_t> remove;
            for (auto entity : World::GetView<TransformComponent>())
            {
                if (!ComponentManager::HasComponent<CameraComponent>(entity))
                {
                    remove.push_back(entity);
                }
            }
            for (const auto entity : remove)
            {
                World::DestroyEntity(Entity(entity));
            }
            const auto path = outputDirectory / "production-fixture.obj";
            {
                std::ofstream mesh(path);
                mesh << "# regression session " << GetTickCount64() << '\n';
                constexpr uint32_t size = 64;
                mesh << "vn 0 0 -1\n";
                for (uint32_t y = 0; y <= size; ++y)
                {
                    for (uint32_t x = 0; x <= size; ++x)
                    {
                        const float px = float(x) / 8 - 4;
                        const float py = float(y) / 8 - 4;
                        mesh << "v " << px << ' ' << py << ' ' << 0.1f * std::sin(px) * std::cos(py) << '\n';
                    }
                }
                for (uint32_t y = 0; y < size; ++y)
                {
                    for (uint32_t x = 0; x < size; ++x)
                    {
                        const uint32_t a = y * (size + 1) + x + 1;
                        const uint32_t c = a + size + 1;
                        mesh << "f " << a << "//1 " << c << "//1 " << a + 1 << "//1\nf " << a + 1 << "//1 " << c
                             << "//1 " << c + 1 << "//1\n";
                    }
                }
            }
            Entity entity = World::CreateEntity();
            entity.Add<TransformComponent>()
                .Add<StaticModelComponent>()
                .Add<MaterialComponent>()
                .Add<NameComponent>()
                .Add<ShaderComponent>();
            fixture = entity.GetID();
            entity.Get<NameComponent>().Name = "VG Production Regression";
            entity.Get<StaticModelComponent>().ModelId = ModelManager::LoadStaticModel(path.string().c_str(), false);
            auto& material = entity.Get<MaterialComponent>();
            material.ShaderClassMode = MaterialMode::Manual;
            material.ShaderClass = ShaderClass::PBR;
            material.UseTexture = false;
            for (auto type : {LightType::Directional, LightType::Spot, LightType::Point})
            {
                auto light = World::CreateEntity();
                light.Add<TransformComponent>().Add<LightComponent>();
                auto& component = light.Get<LightComponent>();
                component.Type = type;
                component.CastShadow = true;
                component.Position = {1, 3, -5};
                component.Direction = {0, -0.3f, 1};
                component.Range = 30;
                component.Intensity = 4;
                component.InnerAngle = 20;
                component.OuterAngle = 45;
                light.Get<TransformComponent>().Position = component.Position;
                light.Get<TransformComponent>().IsDirty = true;
            }
            auto cameraId = Camera::GetCameraEntity();
            auto& transform = ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<TransformComponent>(cameraId);
            transform.Position = {0, 0, -12};
            transform.IsDirty = true;
            auto& camera = ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<CameraComponent>(cameraId);
            camera.Target = {0, 0, 0};
            camera.AllowUserControl = false;
            camera.LockOnTarget = UINT32_MAX;
            DayNightCycle::GetSettings().Running = false;
            DayNightCycle::GetSettings().TimeDriven = false;
            DayNightCycle::GetSettings().AutomaticLighting = false;
            RenderConfiguration::SetRenderMode(RenderMode::DEFERRED);
            RendererSettings::SetComputeGBufferEnabled(false);
            RendererSettings::SetMeshShadersEnabled(false);
            RendererSettings::SetUpscaleMode(UpscaleMode::Bilateral);
            RendererSettings::SetShadowMapMethod(ShadowMapMethod::ShadowMap);
            Raytracing::GetSettings().Enabled = false;
            World::SetVSyncEnabled(false);
            auto& traversal = VirtualGeometryTraversal::GetSettings();
            traversal.ForceHierarchyLevel = 0;
            traversal.View = VirtualGeometryTraversal::DebugView::None;
            traversal.LevelColors = false;
            traversal.OcclusionCulling = false;
            GPUVisibility::GetSettings().LOD = false;
            GPUVisibility::GetSettings().Occlusion = false;
            GPUDrivenRenderer::SetEnabled(true);
            MeshShaderRenderer::GetSettings().Enabled = true;
            Check(BeginBenchmark(outputDirectory, lastError), "benchmark output opened");
        }
    }

    bool BeginBenchmark(const std::filesystem::path& directory, std::string& error)
    {
        EndBenchmark();
        error.clear();
        try
        {
            std::filesystem::create_directories(directory);
            std::ofstream hardware(directory / "hardware.tmp");
            hardwareKey = Hardware(hardware);
            hardware.close();
            if (hardwareKey.empty())
            {
                throw std::runtime_error("Cannot identify reference GPU");
            }
            const auto hardwarePath = directory / ("hardware-" + hardwareKey + ".txt");
            std::filesystem::copy_file(directory / "hardware.tmp", hardwarePath,
                                       std::filesystem::copy_options::overwrite_existing);
            std::filesystem::remove(directory / "hardware.tmp");
            const auto session = std::to_string(GetTickCount64());
            benchmark.open(directory / ("VirtualGeometry-Final-Benchmark-" + hardwareKey + "-" + session + ".csv"));
            passBenchmark.open(directory / ("VirtualGeometry-GPU-Passes-" + hardwareKey + "-" + session + ".csv"));
            passBenchmark << "frame,pass,cpu_ms,gpu_ms,draws\n";
            if (!benchmark || !passBenchmark)
            {
                throw std::runtime_error("Cannot write VirtualGeometry benchmark");
            }
            benchmark
                << "session,frame,mode,frame_ms,fps,cpu_ms,gpu_ms,process_ram_bytes,vg_pool_bytes,vg_budget_bytes,"
                   "instances,clusters_registered,clusters_visible,triangles_visible,resident_pages,upload_bytes_per_second,draws,indirect_calls,"
                   "source_triangles,instanced_source_triangles,local_vram_bytes,visibility_sample_serial\n";
            lastSerial = 0;
            previousUpload = GetVGStatistics().SubmittedBytes;
            previousTime = std::chrono::steady_clock::now();
            lastError.clear();
            return true;
        }
        catch (const std::exception& exception)
        {
            error = exception.what();
            lastError = error;
            EndBenchmark();
            return false;
        }
    }

    void EndBenchmark()
    {
        benchmark.close();
        benchmark.clear();
        passBenchmark.close();
        passBenchmark.clear();
    }

    bool Recording()
    {
        return benchmark.is_open();
    }

    const std::string& LastError()
    {
        return lastError;
    }

    void RecordBenchmark()
    {
        static bool checkedEnvironment = false;
        if (!checkedEnvironment)
        {
            checkedEnvironment = true;
            char flag[8]{};
            if (!Recording() && GetEnvironmentVariableA("DX12_VG_BENCHMARK", flag, sizeof(flag)) && atoi(flag) != 0)
            {
                std::string error;
                BeginBenchmark("build/virtualgeometry-phase11", error);
            }
        }
        if (!Recording() || !RenderProfiler::HasLatest())
        {
            return;
        }
        const auto& frame = RenderProfiler::GetLatest();
        if (frame.Serial == lastSerial)
        {
            return;
        }
        lastSerial = frame.Serial;
        const auto stats = GetVGStatistics();
        PROCESS_MEMORY_COUNTERS_EX process{};
        process.cb = sizeof(process);
        const bool haveMemory =
            GetProcessMemoryInfo(GetCurrentProcess(), reinterpret_cast<PROCESS_MEMORY_COUNTERS*>(&process),
                                 sizeof(process)) != FALSE;
        const auto now = std::chrono::steady_clock::now();
        const double elapsed = std::chrono::duration<double>(now - previousTime).count();
        const uint64_t upload = stats.SubmittedBytes >= previousUpload ? stats.SubmittedBytes - previousUpload : 0;
        previousTime = now;
        previousUpload = stats.SubmittedBytes;
        benchmark << std::setprecision(9) << hardwareKey << ',' << frame.Serial << ',' << frame.GeometryMode << ','
                  << World::GetFrameTimeMs() << ','
                  << (World::GetFrameTimeMs() > 0 ? 1000 / World::GetFrameTimeMs() : 0) << ',' << frame.CpuRenderMs
                  << ',';
        if (frame.GpuTimingValid)
        {
            benchmark << frame.GpuRenderMs;
        }
        benchmark << ',';
        if (haveMemory)
        {
            benchmark << process.WorkingSetSize;
        }
        benchmark << ',' << stats.ResidentAllocationBytes << ',' << stats.BudgetBytes << ','
                  << GpuScene::Statistics().ActiveInstances << ',' << stats.RegisteredClusters << ',';
        if (stats.HasVisibilitySample)
        {
            benchmark << stats.FirstVisibleClusters + stats.SecondVisibleClusters;
        }
        benchmark << ',';
        if (stats.HasVisibilitySample)
        {
            benchmark << VirtualGeometryTraversal::DebugCounters()[6];
        }
        benchmark << ',' << stats.ResidentPages << ',' << (elapsed > 0 ? upload / elapsed : 0) << ','
                  << frame.Calls.DrawCalls << ',' << frame.Calls.ExecuteIndirectCalls << ',' << stats.SourceTriangles
                  << ',' << stats.InstancedSourceTriangles << ',';
        ComPtr<IDXGIFactory4> factory;
        ComPtr<IDXGIAdapter3> adapter;
        DXGI_QUERY_VIDEO_MEMORY_INFO memory{};
        if (SUCCEEDED(CreateDXGIFactory1(IID_PPV_ARGS(&factory))) &&
            SUCCEEDED(
                factory->EnumAdapterByLuid(GraphicsDevice::GetDevice()->GetAdapterLuid(), IID_PPV_ARGS(&adapter))) &&
            SUCCEEDED(adapter->QueryVideoMemoryInfo(0, DXGI_MEMORY_SEGMENT_GROUP_LOCAL, &memory)))
        {
            benchmark << memory.CurrentUsage;
        }
        benchmark << ',' << stats.VisibilitySampleSerial << '\n';
        for (const auto& pass : frame.Passes)
        {
            passBenchmark << frame.Serial << ',' << std::quoted(pass.Name) << ',' << pass.CpuMs << ',';
            if (frame.GpuTimingValid)
            {
                passBenchmark << pass.GpuMs;
            }
            passBenchmark << ',' << pass.DrawCalls << '\n';
        }
        if (frame.Serial % 30 == 0)
        {
            benchmark.flush();
            passBenchmark.flush();
        }
        if (!benchmark || !passBenchmark)
        {
            lastError = "VirtualGeometry benchmark write failed";
            EndBenchmark();
        }
    }

    bool ValidationEnabled()
    {
        char flag[8]{};
        return GetEnvironmentVariableA("DX12_VG_FINAL_VALIDATION", flag, sizeof(flag)) && atoi(flag) != 0;
    }

    void BeforeFrame(uint64_t frame)
    {
        if (!ValidationEnabled())
        {
            return;
        }
        if (frame == 0)
        {
            Setup();
        }
        const auto& streaming = VirtualGeometryStreaming::GetStatistics();
        if (readyFrame == UINT64_MAX && streaming.Resident > 0 &&
            streaming.Resident == VirtualGeometryStreaming::PageCount())
        {
            readyFrame = frame;
        }
        const uint64_t phase = readyFrame == UINT64_MAX ? 0 : frame - readyFrame;
        GetGeometryRenderingMode() = phase < 8 ? GeometryRenderingMode::VirtualGeometry : GeometryRenderingMode::Legacy;
        if (phase == 2 || phase == 10 || phase == 3 || phase == 11)
        {
            auto& transform = ComponentManager::GetComponentUnchecked<TransformComponent>(fixture);
            transform.Position.x = phase % 8 == 3 ? 0.25f : 0;
            transform.IsDirty = true;
            GpuSceneChanges::Notify(fixture, GpuSceneDirtyFlags::Transform);
        }
    }

    void AfterFrame(uint64_t frame)
    {
        if (!ValidationEnabled())
        {
            return;
        }
        if (readyFrame == UINT64_MAX)
        {
            return;
        }
        const uint64_t phase = frame - readyFrame;
        if (phase == 3)
        {
            Check(VirtualGeometryTraversal::Active(), "production hierarchy render active");
            Check(VirtualGeometryBinning::Active(), "production material binning active");
            const auto native = MeshShaderRenderer::CaptureNativeRouting();
            Check(native.Error.empty() && native.SuccessfulInstances > 0, "native routing completed without fallback");
            for (const auto instance : GpuScene::GetEntityInstances(fixture))
            {
                const auto generation = GpuScene::InstanceHistoryGeneration(instance);
                Check(GpuScene::ResolveEntity(instance, generation) == fixture,
                      "native Object ID resolves original Entity");
                Check(GpuScene::ResolveEntity(instance, generation + 1) == UINT32_MAX, "stale picking sample rejected");
            }
            reference = Capture();
            Check(HasVisibleMovingGeometry(reference[3], reference[4]),
                  "native reference contains visible moving geometry");
            const auto diagnostics = GetVGStatistics();
            Check(diagnostics.VisibleInstanceOverflow == 0 && diagnostics.InvalidIndirectCommands == 0 &&
                      diagnostics.BinningRejectedClusters == 0,
                  "no instance/indirect/bin output loss");
            Check(RenderCapture::SaveScenePng((outputDirectory / "virtualgeometry.png").c_str()),
                  "save VG reference image");
        }
        if (phase == 11)
        {
            auto legacy = Capture();
            Check(HasVisibleMovingGeometry(legacy[3], legacy[4]), "legacy reference contains visible moving geometry");
            Check(reference.size() == legacy.size() && !reference.empty(), "same reference attachments");
            for (size_t index = 0; index < std::min(reference.size(), legacy.size()); ++index)
            {
                Check(Compare(reference[index], legacy[index], index == 3 ? 0.0001 : 0.003, 0.005),
                      "VG/Legacy geometry material shadow depth velocity parity");
            }
            Check(RenderCapture::SaveScenePng((outputDirectory / "legacy.png").c_str()), "save legacy reference image");
            Check(LightingResources::GetShadowLightCount() > 0, "regular light shadow pipeline participates");
            std::array<bool, 3> lightTypes{};
            for (uint32_t pass = 0; pass < LightingResources::GetShadowLightCount(); ++pass)
            {
                LightingResources::SetCurrentShadowPassIndex(pass);
                XMFLOAT4 positionType, direction;
                LightingResources::GetCurrentShadowLight(positionType, direction);
                const int type = static_cast<int>(positionType.w);
                if (type >= 0 && type < 3)
                {
                    lightTypes[static_cast<size_t>(type)] = true;
                }
            }
            LightingResources::SetCurrentShadowPassIndex(0);
            Check(lightTypes[0] && lightTypes[1] && lightTypes[2], "directional / point / spot shadow passes present");
            Check(RenderCapture::ReportGraphicsErrors() == 0, "D3D12 validation errors");
            compared = true;
        }
        if (phase == 7)
        {
            StaticModelResource warm;
            Check(warm.LoadDerivedVirtualGeometry((outputDirectory / "production-fixture.obj").string().c_str(),
                                                  GraphicsDevice::GetDevice(), false) &&
                      warm.UsesDerivedVirtualGeometry(),
                  "source imports through persistent derived index");
        }
    }

    bool Finish()
    {
        if (!ValidationEnabled())
        {
            return true;
        }
        Check(GraphicsDevice::WaitForGpuIdle(), "final GPU work completed");
        Check(GraphicsDevice::GpuBasedValidationEnabled(), "GPU Based Validation actually enabled");
        ComPtr<ID3D12InfoQueue> debugQueue;
        Check(SUCCEEDED(GraphicsDevice::GetDevice()->QueryInterface(IID_PPV_ARGS(&debugQueue))),
              "D3D12 debug layer available (absence cannot count as zero errors)");
        Check(compared, "reference sequence completed before frame limit");
        Check(RenderCapture::ReportGraphicsErrors() == 0, "final D3D12 validation errors");
        EndBenchmark();
        std::ofstream report(outputDirectory / "VirtualGeometry-Final-Validation.txt");
        report << "failures=" << failures << "\ncompared=" << compared << '\n';
        return failures == 0 && bool(report);
    }
} // 名前空間 VirtualGeometryProduction の終わり。

#include "virtualgeometryreport.h"
#include <fstream>
#include <sstream>
#include <locale>

std::string VirtualGeometryReport::Text(const VirtualGeometryAsset& asset)
{
    std::ostringstream output;
    output.imbue(std::locale::classic());
    const auto& stats = asset.Stats;
    output << "Nanite-like Virtualized Geometry Phase 1\n"
           << "Name: " << asset.DebugName << "\nVersion: " << asset.Version
           << "\nMaterial section: " << asset.SourceMaterialId << "\nMaterialPartId: " << asset.SourceMaterialPartId
           << "\nSource vertices: " << stats.SourceVertices << "\nSource triangles: " << stats.SourceTriangles
           << "\nRemoved degenerate triangles: " << stats.RemovedDegenerateTriangles
           << "\nRemoved duplicate triangles: " << stats.RemovedDuplicateTriangles
           << "\nFinal leaf triangles: " << stats.FinalLeafTriangles << "\nLeaf clusters: " << stats.LeafClusters
           << "\nTotal clusters: " << stats.TotalClusters << "\nTotal groups: " << stats.TotalGroups
           << "\nHierarchy levels: " << stats.HierarchyLevels << "\nRoots: " << asset.RootClusters.size()
           << "\nAverage triangles/cluster: " << stats.AverageTrianglesPerCluster
           << "\nAverage vertices/cluster: " << stats.AverageVerticesPerCluster
           << "\nMaximum triangles/cluster: " << stats.MaximumTrianglesPerCluster
           << "\nMaximum vertices/cluster: " << stats.MaximumVerticesPerCluster
           << "\nSource memory bytes: " << stats.SourceMemoryBytes
           << "\nRaw geometry memory bytes: " << stats.RawMemoryBytes
           << "\nBuild milliseconds (0 after reload): " << stats.BuildMilliseconds << '\n';
    for (size_t level = 0; level < asset.Levels.size(); ++level)
    {
        const auto& data = asset.Levels[level];
        output << "Level " << level << ": clusters=" << data.Clusters << " triangles=" << data.Triangles
               << " vertices=" << data.Vertices << '\n';
    }
    for (size_t index = 0; index < asset.Groups.size(); ++index)
    {
        const auto& group = asset.Groups[index];
        output << "Group " << index << " level=" << group.Level << " errors=" << group.MinError << ',' << group.MaxError
               << " children:";
        for (uint32_t child = 0; child < group.ChildCount; ++child)
        {
            output << ' ' << asset.HierarchyIndices.at(size_t(group.FirstChild) + child);
        }
        output << " parents:";
        for (uint32_t parent = 0; parent < group.ParentCount; ++parent)
        {
            output << ' ' << asset.HierarchyIndices.at(size_t(group.FirstParent) + parent);
        }
        output << '\n';
    }
    output << "Root clusters:";
    for (uint32_t root : asset.RootClusters)
    {
        output << ' ' << root;
    }
    output << '\n';
    return output.str();
}

bool VirtualGeometryReport::Save(const std::filesystem::path& path, const VirtualGeometryAsset& asset,
                                 std::string& error)
{
    error.clear();
    try
    {
        std::ofstream output(path);
        output.exceptions(std::ios::badbit | std::ios::failbit);
        output << Text(asset);
        output.close();
        return true;
    }
    catch (const std::exception& exception)
    {
        error = exception.what();
        return false;
    }
}

===== FILE: source\virtualgeometry\virtualgeometryresidency.cpp =====
#include "virtualgeometryresidency.h"
#include <algorithm>
#include <tuple>

namespace VirtualGeometryStreaming
{
    namespace
    {
        constexpr uint64_t PageBytes = 65536;
        constexpr uint64_t MaximumBudget = 1024ull * 1024 * 1024;
    }

    bool ResidencyManager::CanAddPages(std::span<const uint8_t> pinned, uint64_t budget) const
    {
        budget = std::min(budget, MaximumBudget);
        uint64_t pinnedCount = m_PinnedPages + std::count(pinned.begin(), pinned.end(), uint8_t(1));
        if (pinnedCount > budget / PageBytes || pinned.size() > 0x7fffffffull - m_Pages.size() ||
            std::any_of(pinned.begin(), pinned.end(), [](uint8_t value) {
                return value > 1;
            }))
        {
            return false;
        }
        return true;
    }

    bool ResidencyManager::AddPages(std::span<const uint8_t> pinned, uint64_t budget, uint32_t priority)
    {
        if (!CanAddPages(pinned, budget))
        {
            return false;
        }
        // 外部から見える登録状態を変える前に、すべての vector の容量を確保する。
        size_t count = m_Pages.size() + pinned.size();
        m_Pages.reserve(count);
        m_Snapshot.reserve(count);
        for (uint8_t value : pinned)
        {
            PageRecord page;
            page.Pinned = value != 0;
            page.Priority = std::min(2u, priority);
            m_PinnedPages += page.Pinned;
            m_Pages.push_back(page);
            m_Snapshot.emplace_back();
        }
        SetBudget(budget);
        return true;
    }

    void ResidencyManager::SetBudget(uint64_t bytes)
    {
        m_Budget = std::min(bytes, MaximumBudget) / PageBytes * PageBytes;
    }

    uint64_t ResidencyManager::ReservedBytes() const
    {
        return m_ReservedPages * PageBytes;
    }

    void ResidencyManager::Request(PageId page, uint64_t frame)
    {
        if (page >= m_Pages.size())
        {
            return;
        }
        auto& record = m_Pages[page];
        record.LastUsed = std::max(record.LastUsed, frame);
        if (record.State == PageState::Evicted && !record.Retiring)
        {
            record.State = PageState::Requested;
        }
    }

    std::optional<LoadTicket> ResidencyManager::BeginLoad(PageId page)
    {
        if (page >= m_Pages.size() || m_Pages[page].State != PageState::Requested || m_Pages[page].Retiring ||
            ReservedBytes() + PageBytes > m_Budget)
        {
            return std::nullopt;
        }
        // まだ読み込みが始まっていない常駐固定ページの予算を残す。
        if (!m_Pages[page].Pinned)
        {
            uint64_t unallocatedPinned = m_PinnedPages - m_AllocatedPinnedPages;
            if (ReservedBytes() + (unallocatedPinned + 1) * PageBytes > m_Budget)
            {
                return std::nullopt;
            }
        }
        uint32_t slot = 0;
        while (slot < m_Slots.size() && (m_Slots[slot] != UINT32_MAX || m_Generations[slot] >= UINT32_MAX))
        {
            ++slot;
        }
        if (slot == m_Slots.size())
        {
            if (slot >= MaximumBudget / PageBytes)
            {
                return std::nullopt;
            }
            m_Slots.reserve(m_Slots.size() + 1);
            m_Generations.reserve(m_Generations.size() + 1);
            m_Slots.push_back(UINT32_MAX);
            m_Generations.push_back(0);
        }
        auto& record = m_Pages[page];
        record.Slot = slot;
        record.Generation = ++m_Generations[slot];
        record.CopyFence = 0;
        record.GraphicsFence = 0;
        record.State = PageState::Loading;
        m_Slots[slot] = page;
        ++m_ReservedPages;
        m_AllocatedPinnedPages += record.Pinned;
        return LoadTicket{page, slot, record.Generation};
    }

    bool ResidencyManager::Matches(const LoadTicket& ticket) const
    {
        return ticket.Page < m_Pages.size() && m_Pages[ticket.Page].Slot == ticket.Slot &&
               m_Pages[ticket.Page].Generation == ticket.Generation && !m_Pages[ticket.Page].Retiring &&
               m_Pages[ticket.Page].State == PageState::Loading;
    }

    void ResidencyManager::CompleteCopy(const LoadTicket& ticket, uint64_t fence)
    {
        if (Matches(ticket) && fence)
        {
            m_Pages[ticket.Page].CopyFence = fence;
        }
    }

    void ResidencyManager::Publish(uint64_t completedCopy, uint64_t frame)
    {
        for (PageId index = 0; index < m_Pages.size(); ++index)
        {
            auto& record = m_Pages[index];
            if (record.State == PageState::Loading && !record.Retiring && record.CopyFence &&
                record.CopyFence <= completedCopy)
            {
                record.State = PageState::Resident;
                record.LastUsed = std::max(record.LastUsed, frame);
                m_Snapshot[index] = {record.Slot, uint32_t(record.Generation), 1, 0};
            }
        }
    }

    void ResidencyManager::MarkSnapshotUsed(uint64_t graphicsFence)
    {
        for (auto& record : m_Pages)
        {
            if (record.State == PageState::Resident)
            {
                record.GraphicsFence = std::max(record.GraphicsFence, graphicsFence);
            }
        }
    }

    void ResidencyManager::MarkUsed(PageId page, uint64_t frame)
    {
        if (page < m_Pages.size())
        {
            m_Pages[page].LastUsed = std::max(m_Pages[page].LastUsed, frame);
        }
    }

    bool ResidencyManager::Retire(PageId page, uint64_t graphicsFence)
    {
        if (page >= m_Pages.size())
        {
            return false;
        }
        auto& record = m_Pages[page];
        if (record.Pinned || record.Retiring || record.State != PageState::Resident)
        {
            return false;
        }
        record.Retiring = true;
        record.State = PageState::Evicted;
        record.GraphicsFence = std::max(record.GraphicsFence, graphicsFence);
        m_Snapshot[page] = {};
        return true;
    }

    void ResidencyManager::Cancel(const LoadTicket& ticket, uint64_t copyFence)
    {
        if (Matches(ticket))
        {
            auto& record = m_Pages[ticket.Page];
            record.CopyFence = std::max(record.CopyFence, copyFence);
            record.Retiring = true;
            record.State = PageState::Evicted;
            m_Snapshot[ticket.Page] = {};
        }
    }

    void ResidencyManager::Collect(uint64_t completedGraphics, uint64_t completedCopy)
    {
        for (auto& record : m_Pages)
        {
            if (record.Retiring && record.GraphicsFence <= completedGraphics && record.CopyFence <= completedCopy)
            {
                m_Slots[record.Slot] = UINT32_MAX;
                --m_ReservedPages;
                m_AllocatedPinnedPages -= record.Pinned;
                record.Slot = UINT32_MAX;
                record.Retiring = false;
                record.CopyFence = 0;
                record.GraphicsFence = 0;
            }
        }
    }

    std::optional<PageId> ResidencyManager::OldestEvictable(uint64_t olderThanFrame) const
    {
        std::optional<PageId> oldest;
        auto evictionOrder = [](const PageRecord& record) {
            return std::tuple{!record.Predicted, record.Priority, record.LastUsed};
        };
        for (PageId page = 0; page < m_Pages.size(); ++page)
        {
            const auto& record = m_Pages[page];
            if (!record.Pinned && !record.Retiring && record.State == PageState::Resident &&
                record.LastUsed < olderThanFrame &&
                (!oldest || evictionOrder(record) < evictionOrder(m_Pages[*oldest])))
            {
                oldest = page;
            }
        }
        return oldest;
    }

    void ResidencyManager::MarkPredicted(PageId page, bool predicted)
    {
        if (page < m_Pages.size())
        {
            m_Pages[page].Predicted = predicted;
        }
    }
} // 名前空間 VirtualGeometryStreaming の終わり。

===== FILE: source\virtualgeometry\virtualgeometryresidency.h =====
#pragma once
#include <cstdint>
#include <optional>
#include <span>
#include <vector>

namespace VirtualGeometryStreaming
{
    using PageId = uint32_t;

    struct LoadTicket
    {
        PageId Page = UINT32_MAX;
        uint32_t Slot = UINT32_MAX;
        uint64_t Generation = 0;
        bool operator==(const LoadTicket&) const = default;
    };
    enum class PageState : uint8_t
    {
        Evicted,
        Requested,
        Loading,
        Resident
    };

    struct ResidencyEntry
    {
        uint32_t Slot = UINT32_MAX;
        uint32_t Generation = 0;
        uint32_t Flags = 0;
        uint32_t Padding = 0;
    };

    static_assert(sizeof(ResidencyEntry) == 16);

    struct PageRecord
    {
        PageState State = PageState::Evicted;
        bool Pinned = false;
        bool Retiring = false;
        bool Predicted = false;
        uint32_t Slot = UINT32_MAX;
        uint64_t Generation = 0;
        uint64_t LastUsed = 0;
        uint32_t Priority = 1;
        uint64_t GraphicsFence = 0;
        uint64_t CopyFence = 0;
    };

    class ResidencyManager
    {
      public:
        bool AddPages(std::span<const uint8_t> pinned, uint64_t budget, uint32_t priority = 1);
        bool CanAddPages(std::span<const uint8_t> pinned, uint64_t budget) const;
        void SetBudget(uint64_t bytes);
        void Request(PageId page, uint64_t frame);
        std::optional<LoadTicket> BeginLoad(PageId page);
        void CompleteCopy(const LoadTicket& ticket, uint64_t fence);
        void Publish(uint64_t completedCopy, uint64_t frame = 0);
        bool Retire(PageId page, uint64_t graphicsFence);
        void Cancel(const LoadTicket& ticket, uint64_t copyFence = 0);
        void Collect(uint64_t completedGraphics, uint64_t completedCopy);
        void MarkSnapshotUsed(uint64_t graphicsFence);
        void MarkUsed(PageId page, uint64_t frame);
        void MarkPredicted(PageId page, bool predicted);
        std::optional<PageId> OldestEvictable(uint64_t olderThanFrame = UINT64_MAX) const;
        bool Matches(const LoadTicket& ticket) const;

        const std::vector<ResidencyEntry>& Snapshot() const
        {
            return m_Snapshot;
        }

        const std::vector<PageRecord>& Pages() const
        {
            return m_Pages;
        }

        uint32_t PageCount() const
        {
            return uint32_t(m_Pages.size());
        }

        uint64_t ReservedBytes() const;

        uint64_t Budget() const
        {
            return m_Budget;
        }

      private:
        std::vector<PageRecord> m_Pages;
        std::vector<ResidencyEntry> m_Snapshot;
        std::vector<PageId> m_Slots;
        std::vector<uint64_t> m_Generations;
        uint64_t m_Budget = 256ull * 1024 * 1024;
        uint64_t m_ReservedPages = 0;
        uint64_t m_PinnedPages = 0;
        uint64_t m_AllocatedPinnedPages = 0;
    };
} // 名前空間 VirtualGeometryStreaming の終わり。

===== FILE: source\virtualgeometry\virtualgeometryresources.cpp =====
#include "pch.h"
#include "virtualgeometryresources.h"
#include "graphicsdevice.h"
#include "graphicslog.h"
#include "virtualgeometrystreaming.h"
#include "virtualgeometryruntime.h"
#include "materialmanager.h"
#include <future>
#include <numeric>

namespace VirtualGeometryResources
{
    namespace
    {
        struct State
        {
            struct Prepared
            {
                std::shared_ptr<VirtualGeometryPageCache::PageManifest> Manifest;
                std::string Error;
            };

            struct Pending
            {
                std::shared_ptr<const VirtualGeometryRuntime::RuntimeAsset> Owner;
                std::future<Prepared> Work;
                bool Finished = false;
            };

            VirtualGeometryGPU::PackedAsset Geometry;
            std::vector<VirtualGeometryGPUAsset> Table;
            std::vector<uint64_t> SourceTriangles;
            std::vector<std::shared_ptr<const VirtualGeometryPageCache::PageManifest>> Manifests;
            std::vector<Pending> PendingAssets;
            std::unordered_map<const VirtualGeometryRuntime::RuntimeAsset*, uint32_t> Ids;
            GpuSceneBuffer Clusters, Groups, Hierarchy, Roots, Vertices, Triangles, Assets;
            bool Dirty = true;
        };

        State& Data()
        {
            static State state;
            return state;
        }

        bool Install(uint32_t id, std::shared_ptr<const VirtualGeometryPageCache::PageManifest> manifest)
        {
            auto& state = Data();
            VirtualGeometryGPUAsset table;
            std::string error;
            if (!manifest || !VirtualGeometryStreaming::CanRegister(*manifest))
            {
                WriteGraphicsLog("Geometry Page registration refused before metadata append\n");
                return false;
            }
            const std::array<size_t, 4> original = {state.Geometry.Clusters.size(), state.Geometry.Groups.size(),
                                                    state.Geometry.HierarchyIndices.size(),
                                                    state.Geometry.Roots.size()};
            if (!VirtualGeometryPages::Validate(manifest->Metadata, manifest->PinnedPages, error) ||
                !VirtualGeometryGPU::Append(manifest->Metadata, state.Geometry, table, error))
            {
                WriteGraphicsLog("Geometry Page metadata registration failed: %s\n", error.c_str());
                return false;
            }
            const auto& owner = state.PendingAssets.at(id).Owner;
            const uint32_t priority = owner ? owner->ImportSettings.StreamingPriority : manifest->StreamingPriority;
            uint32_t pageBase = VirtualGeometryStreaming::Register(manifest, priority);
            if (pageBase == UINT32_MAX)
            {
                WriteGraphicsLog("Geometry Page admission failed: pinned pages exceed budget or device unsupported\n");
                state.Geometry.Clusters.resize(original[0]);
                state.Geometry.Groups.resize(original[1]);
                state.Geometry.HierarchyIndices.resize(original[2]);
                state.Geometry.Roots.resize(original[3]);
                return false;
            }
            // フラグ 2 では、従来のジオメトリオフセットを Page の先頭位置・件数として扱う。
            table.VertexOffset = pageBase;
            table.TriangleOffset = uint32_t(manifest->Pages.size());
            table.Flags = (table.Flags | 2u) & ~1u;
            table.Flags |= std::min(2u, priority) << 16;
            state.Table[id] = table;
            state.SourceTriangles.resize(state.Table.size());
            state.SourceTriangles[id] = 0;
            for (const auto& cluster : manifest->Metadata.Clusters)
            {
                if (cluster.Level == 0)
                {
                    state.SourceTriangles[id] += cluster.TriangleCount;
                }
            }
            state.Manifests[id] = std::move(manifest);
            if (state.Manifests[id]->SourceTriangles)
            {
                state.SourceTriangles[id] = state.Manifests[id]->SourceTriangles;
            }
            std::string registryError;
            MaterialManager::Registry().Register(state.Manifests[id]->Path, AssetType::Mesh, registryError);
            state.Dirty = true;
            return true;
        }

        void PollPreparation()
        {
            auto& state = Data();
            uint32_t running = 0;
            for (uint32_t id = 0; id < state.PendingAssets.size(); ++id)
            {
                auto& pending = state.PendingAssets[id];
                if (!pending.Work.valid())
                {
                    continue;
                }
                if (pending.Work.wait_for(std::chrono::seconds(0)) != std::future_status::ready)
                {
                    ++running;
                    continue;
                }
                auto result = pending.Work.get();
                pending.Finished = true;
                if (result.Manifest)
                {
                    Install(id, std::move(result.Manifest));
                }
                else
                {
                    WriteGraphicsLog("Geometry Page preparation fallback: %s\n", result.Error.c_str());
                }
            }
            for (uint32_t id = 0; id < state.PendingAssets.size() && running < 2; ++id)
            {
                auto& pending = state.PendingAssets[id];
                if (pending.Finished || pending.Work.valid() || !pending.Owner)
                {
                    continue;
                }
                if (pending.Owner->Pages)
                {
                    Install(id, pending.Owner->Pages);
                    pending.Finished = true;
                    continue;
                }
                auto asset = pending.Owner;
                auto compressionSettings = asset->CompressionSettings;
                char rawMode[8]{};
                if (GetEnvironmentVariableA("DX12_VG_COMPRESSION_RAW", rawMode, sizeof(rawMode)))
                {
                    compressionSettings.Enabled = atoi(rawMode) == 0;
                }
                pending.Work = std::async(std::launch::async, [asset, compressionSettings] {
                    State::Prepared result;
                    try
                    {
                        auto path = asset->CachePath;
                        if (path.empty())
                        {
                            path = std::filesystem::path("asset/virtualgeometry-cache") / std::to_string(asset->Key);
                        }
                        // 内容キーで識別する安定した符号化キャッシュ。従来の CPU 参照アセットは上書きしない。
                        path += "." + std::to_string(VirtualGeometryCompression::SettingsKey(compressionSettings));
                        if (compressionSettings.Enabled)
                        {
                            path += ".encoded.vgmesh";
                        }
                        else
                        {
                            path += ".raw.vgmesh";
                        }
                        auto manifest = std::make_shared<VirtualGeometryPageCache::PageManifest>();
                        manifest->StreamingPriority = asset->ImportSettings.StreamingPriority;
                        if (VirtualGeometryPageCache::Open(path, *manifest, result.Error) &&
                            manifest->Version == VirtualGeometryPageCache::FormatVersion::Production)
                        {
                            manifest->StreamingPriority = asset->ImportSettings.StreamingPriority;
                            result.Manifest = std::move(manifest);
                            return result;
                        }
                        VirtualGeometryPages::PagedAsset packed;
                        if (!VirtualGeometryPages::Build(asset->Hierarchy, compressionSettings, packed, result.Error) ||
                            !VirtualGeometryPageCache::WriteAtomic(path, packed, result.Error))
                        {
                            return result;
                        }
                        for (const auto& reason : packed.CompressionFallbacks)
                        {
                            WriteGraphicsLog("Geometry compression %s: %s\n", asset->Hierarchy.DebugName.c_str(),
                                             reason.c_str());
                        }
                        if (VirtualGeometryPageCache::Open(path, *manifest, result.Error))
                        {
                            manifest->StreamingPriority = asset->ImportSettings.StreamingPriority;
                            result.Manifest = std::move(manifest);
                        }
                    }
                    catch (const std::exception& exception)
                    {
                        result.Error = exception.what();
                    }
                    return result;
                });
                ++running;
            }
        }
    }

    uint32_t Register(std::shared_ptr<const VirtualGeometryRuntime::RuntimeAsset> asset)
    {
        auto& state = Data();
        if (!asset || !asset->Error.empty() || state.Table.size() >= UINT32_MAX)
        {
            return UINT32_MAX;
        }
        auto found = state.Ids.find(asset.get());
        if (found != state.Ids.end())
        {
            return found->second;
        }
        uint32_t id = uint32_t(state.Table.size());
        state.Table.emplace_back();
        state.Manifests.emplace_back();
        state.PendingAssets.emplace_back();
        state.PendingAssets.back().Owner = asset;
        state.Ids.emplace(asset.get(), id);
        state.Dirty = true;
        return id;
    }

    const std::vector<uint64_t>& SourceTriangleCounts()
    {
        return Data().SourceTriangles;
    }

    std::shared_ptr<const VirtualGeometryPageCache::PageManifest> ManifestFor(
        const VirtualGeometryRuntime::RuntimeAsset* asset)
    {
        const auto& state = Data();
        const auto found = state.Ids.find(asset);
        return found == state.Ids.end() ? nullptr : state.Manifests.at(found->second);
    }

    uint32_t RegisterManifest(std::shared_ptr<const VirtualGeometryPageCache::PageManifest> manifest)
    {
        auto& state = Data();
        uint32_t id = uint32_t(state.Table.size());
        state.Table.emplace_back();
        state.Manifests.emplace_back();
        state.PendingAssets.emplace_back();
        state.PendingAssets.back().Finished = true;
        if (!Install(id, std::move(manifest)))
        {
            state.Table.pop_back();
            state.Manifests.pop_back();
            state.PendingAssets.pop_back();
            return UINT32_MAX;
        }
        return id;
    }

    void Prepare(RenderGraph& graph)
    {
        auto& state = Data();
        const uint32_t frame = GraphicsDevice::GetFrameIndex();
        PollPreparation();
        VirtualGeometryStreaming::Prepare(graph);
        for (uint32_t id = 0; id < state.Table.size(); ++id)
        {
            if (state.Manifests[id] && (state.Table[id].Flags & 1u) == 0 &&
                VirtualGeometryStreaming::RootsReady(state.Table[id].VertexOffset, *state.Manifests[id]))
            {
                state.Table[id].Flags |= 1u;
                state.Dirty = true;
            }
        }
        const auto& geometry = state.Geometry;
        auto upload = [&](GpuSceneBuffer& buffer, const auto& values, const char* name) {
            using Element = typename std::decay_t<decltype(values)>::value_type;
            buffer.BeginFrame(frame);
            const bool resized = buffer.Ensure(GraphicsDevice::GetDevice(), uint32_t(values.size()), sizeof(Element),
                                               frame, L"Native VirtualGeometry asset");
            std::vector<uint32_t> changes;
            if (state.Dirty || resized)
            {
                changes.resize(values.size());
                std::iota(changes.begin(), changes.end(), 0u);
            }
            uint64_t bytes =
                buffer.Stage(GraphicsDevice::GetDevice(), frame, values.data(), uint32_t(values.size()), changes);
            RenderGraph::ImportedResource input{};
            input.Name = name;
            input.Resource = buffer.Resource();
            input.InitialState = buffer.State;
            input.HasFinalState = true;
            input.FinalState = D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_NON_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE;
            buffer.State = input.FinalState;
            auto handle = graph.ImportResource(input);
            if (bytes)
            {
                auto* target = &buffer;
                graph.AddPass(
                    name,
                    [=](RenderGraph::PassBuilder& builder) {
                        builder.Write(handle, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_COPY_DEST);
                    },
                    [=](ID3D12GraphicsCommandList* list) {
                        target->Copy(list, frame);
                    });
            }
        };
        upload(state.Clusters, geometry.Clusters, "Nanite Cluster Upload");
        upload(state.Groups, geometry.Groups, "Nanite Group Upload");
        upload(state.Hierarchy, geometry.HierarchyIndices, "Nanite Hierarchy Upload");
        upload(state.Roots, geometry.Roots, "Nanite Root Upload");
        upload(state.Vertices, geometry.Vertices, "Nanite Vertex Upload");
        upload(state.Triangles, geometry.Triangles, "Nanite Triangle Upload");
        upload(state.Assets, state.Table, "Nanite Asset Upload");
        state.Dirty = false;
        VirtualGeometryStreaming::RecordMetadataBytes(MemoryBytes());
    }

    bool Ready(uint32_t asset)
    {
        return asset < Data().Table.size() && (Data().Table[asset].Flags & 1u) != 0;
    }

    VirtualGeometryCompression::Metrics CompressionMetrics()
    {
        VirtualGeometryCompression::Metrics total;
        for (const auto& manifest : Data().Manifests)
        {
            if (!manifest)
            {
                continue;
            }
            const auto& metrics = manifest->Compression;
            total.EncodedBytes += metrics.EncodedBytes;
            total.RawBytes += metrics.RawBytes;
            total.FallbackCount += metrics.FallbackCount;
            total.PositionQuantized += metrics.PositionQuantized;
            total.HalfUV += metrics.HalfUV;
            total.Index8Clusters += metrics.Index8Clusters;
            total.Index16Clusters += metrics.Index16Clusters;
        }
        return total;
    }

#include "virtualgeometryruntime.h"
#include "virtualgeometrybuilder.h"
#include "virtualgeometryserializer.h"
#include "virtualgeometrypagecache.h"
#include "virtualgeometryvalidator.h"
#include <algorithm>
#include <chrono>
#include <cmath>
#include <cstring>
#include <mutex>
#include <numeric>
#include <sstream>
#include <unordered_map>
#include <stdexcept>
#include <condition_variable>
#include <deque>
#include <thread>
#include <cstdlib>

namespace VirtualGeometryRuntime
{
    namespace
    {
        using VertexKey = std::array<uint32_t, 12>;

        VertexKey KeyOf(const VirtualGeometryVertex& vertex)
        {
            VertexKey key;
            std::memcpy(key.data(), &vertex, sizeof(vertex));
            return key;
        }

        struct VertexHash
        {
            size_t operator()(const VertexKey& key) const
            {
                uint64_t hash = 14695981039346656037ull;
                for (auto component : key)
                {
                    hash ^= component;
                    hash *= 1099511628211ull;
                }
                return static_cast<size_t>(hash);
            }
        };

        struct State
        {
            std::mutex Mutex;
            Statistics Stats;
            std::unordered_map<std::string, std::weak_ptr<const RuntimeAsset>> Assets;
        };

        State& Data()
        {
            static State state;
            return state;
        }

        uint64_t GeometryKey(std::span<const VirtualGeometryVertex> vertices, std::span<const uint32_t> indices,
                             uint32_t material, float part, const VGImportSettings& settings)
        {
            uint64_t hash = 14695981039346656037ull;
            auto consume = [&](const void* data, size_t size) {
                const auto* bytes = static_cast<const uint8_t*>(data);
                for (size_t i = 0; i < size; ++i)
                {
                    hash ^= bytes[i];
                    hash *= 1099511628211ull;
                }
            };
            // 固定ビルド設定や再マップの契約を変えたら、統合バージョンを更新する。
            const uint32_t header[] = {VirtualGeometryConfig::AssetVersion, VirtualGeometryConfig::BuilderVersion,
                                       material};
            consume(header, sizeof(header));
            // フィールドを明示的にハッシュ化し、コンパイラのパディングが派生データの識別に影響しないようにする。
            const auto config = settings.BuildConfig();
            const uint64_t settingsKey = VirtualGeometryImport::SettingsKey(settings);
            consume(&settingsKey, sizeof(settingsKey));
            const uint32_t limits[] = {config.MaxClusterVertices, config.MaxClusterTriangles,
                                       config.TargetClustersPerGroup, config.MaxHierarchyLevels};
            consume(limits, sizeof(limits));
            const float parameters[] = {config.SimplificationRatio, config.ConeWeight,  config.NormalWeight,
                                        config.TexCoordWeight,      config.ColorWeight, config.TargetRelativeError,
                                        config.BoundaryEpsilon};
            consume(parameters, sizeof(parameters));
            consume(&part, sizeof(part));
            const uint64_t counts[] = {vertices.size(), indices.size()};
            consume(counts, sizeof(counts));
            consume(vertices.data(), vertices.size_bytes());
            consume(indices.data(), indices.size_bytes());
            return hash;
        }

        Meshlets::Asset ConvertLeaves(const VirtualGeometryAsset& hierarchy,
                                      std::span<const VirtualGeometryVertex> source)
        {
            std::unordered_map<VertexKey, uint32_t, VertexHash> original;
            original.reserve(source.size());
            for (uint32_t i = 0; i < source.size(); ++i)
            {
                original.try_emplace(KeyOf(source[i]), i);
            }
            Meshlets::Asset output;
            output.Config = {64, 124, 32};
            for (const auto& cluster : hierarchy.Clusters)
            {
                if (cluster.Level != 0)
                {
                    continue; // 親には簡略化によって新しく生成された頂点が含まれる。
                }
                if (cluster.VertexCount > 64 || cluster.TriangleCount > 126)
                {
                    throw std::runtime_error("VirtualGeometry cluster exceeds Mesh Shader limits");
                }
                Meshlets::Meshlet meshlet{static_cast<uint32_t>(output.Vertices.size()), cluster.VertexCount,
                                          static_cast<uint32_t>(output.Primitives.size()), cluster.TriangleCount};
                for (uint32_t i = 0; i < cluster.VertexCount; ++i)
                {
                    const auto found = original.find(KeyOf(hierarchy.Vertices.at(cluster.VertexOffset + i)));
                    if (found == original.end())
                    {
                        throw std::runtime_error("VirtualGeometry leaf vertex does not match source attributes");
                    }
                    output.Vertices.push_back(found->second);
                }
                for (uint32_t i = 0; i < cluster.TriangleCount; ++i)
                {
                    const size_t start = size_t(cluster.TriangleOffset) + size_t(i) * 3;
                    uint32_t packed = 0;
                    for (uint32_t j = 0; j < 3; ++j)
                    {
                        packed |= uint32_t(hierarchy.TriangleIndices.at(start + j)) << (8 * j);
                    }
                    output.Primitives.push_back(packed);
                }
                output.Meshlets.push_back(meshlet);
                output.Bounds.push_back({{cluster.Bounds.Center[0], cluster.Bounds.Center[1], cluster.Bounds.Center[2]},
                                         cluster.Bounds.Radius,
                                         {cluster.Cone.Axis[0], cluster.Cone.Axis[1], cluster.Cone.Axis[2]},
                                         cluster.Cone.Cutoff});
            }
            std::vector<Meshlets::Position> positions;
            positions.reserve(source.size());
            for (const auto& vertex : source)
            {
                positions.push_back({vertex.Position[0], vertex.Position[1], vertex.Position[2]});
            }
            // VirtualGeometry のクラスタリングを保持しつつ、境界とコーンは現在の GPU カリングと
            // 同じ float 演算および球中心を基準とした規約で計算する。
            Meshlets::RefreshMeshletBounds(output, positions);
            // 子の球の AABB の和集合を使い、クラスターの球が保守的な境界を保つようにする。
            for (uint32_t first = 0; first < output.Meshlets.size(); first += 32)
            {
                const uint32_t count = std::min(32u, static_cast<uint32_t>(output.Meshlets.size()) - first);
                float lower[3] = {INFINITY, INFINITY, INFINITY};
                float upper[3] = {-INFINITY, -INFINITY, -INFINITY};
                for (uint32_t i = first; i < first + count; ++i)
                {
                    const auto& bounds = output.Bounds[i];
                    const float center[] = {bounds.Center.X, bounds.Center.Y, bounds.Center.Z};
                    for (uint32_t axis = 0; axis < 3; ++axis)
                    {
                        lower[axis] = std::min(lower[axis], center[axis] - bounds.Radius);
                        upper[axis] = std::max(upper[axis], center[axis] + bounds.Radius);
                    }
                }
                Meshlets::Cluster cluster;
                cluster.MeshletOffset = first;
                cluster.MeshletCount = count;
                cluster.Bounds.Center = {(lower[0] + upper[0]) * 0.5f, (lower[1] + upper[1]) * 0.5f,
                                         (lower[2] + upper[2]) * 0.5f};
                const float x = (upper[0] - lower[0]) * 0.5f;
                const float y = (upper[1] - lower[1]) * 0.5f;
                const float z = (upper[2] - lower[2]) * 0.5f;
                cluster.Bounds.Radius = std::sqrt(x * x + y * y + z * z) + 1e-5f;
                output.Clusters.push_back(cluster);
            }
            std::string error;
            if (!Meshlets::Validate(output, positions, error))
            {
                throw std::runtime_error(error);
            }
            return output;
        }
    }

    std::shared_ptr<const RuntimeAsset> Acquire(std::span<const VirtualGeometryVertex> vertices,
                                                std::span<const uint32_t> indices, uint32_t materialId,
                                                float materialPartId, const std::filesystem::path& cacheDirectory,
                                                const VGImportSettings& settings)
    {
        auto& state = Data();
        std::unique_lock lock(state.Mutex);
        auto asset = std::make_shared<RuntimeAsset>();
        asset->ImportSettings = settings;
        asset->Key = GeometryKey(vertices, indices, materialId, materialPartId, settings);
        std::ostringstream name;
        name << std::hex << asset->Key << ".vgmesh";
        asset->CachePath = cacheDirectory / name.str();
        const std::string identity = asset->CachePath.generic_string();
        if (auto found = state.Assets.find(identity); found != state.Assets.end())
        {
            if (auto shared = found->second.lock())
            {
                ++state.Stats.SharedHits;
                return shared;
            }
        }
        const auto begin = std::chrono::steady_clock::now();
        lock.unlock(); // 長い CPU ビルドで Inspector や統計の読み取りをブロックしない。
        try
        {
            if (!settings.Enabled)
            {
                throw std::runtime_error("VirtualGeometry is disabled for this asset");
            }
            auto config = settings.BuildConfig();
            float lower[3] = {INFINITY, INFINITY, INFINITY};
            float upper[3] = {-INFINITY, -INFINITY, -INFINITY};
            for (const auto& vertex : vertices)
            {
                for (uint32_t axis = 0; axis < 3; ++axis)
                {
                    lower[axis] = std::min(lower[axis], vertex.Position[axis]);
                    upper[axis] = std::max(upper[axis], vertex.Position[axis]);
                }
            }
            const float extent = std::max({upper[0] - lower[0], upper[1] - lower[1], upper[2] - lower[2]});
            asset->CompressionSettings = settings.Compression(std::isfinite(extent) ? extent : 1.0f);
            std::string error;
            asset->CacheHit = VirtualGeometrySerializer::Load(asset->CachePath, asset->Hierarchy, error);
            if (asset->CacheHit)
            {
                const auto& loaded = asset->Hierarchy;
                asset->CacheHit = loaded.Config.MaxClusterVertices == config.MaxClusterVertices &&
                                  loaded.Config.MaxClusterTriangles == config.MaxClusterTriangles &&
                                  loaded.DebugName == name.str() && loaded.SourceMaterialId == materialId &&
                                  loaded.SourceMaterialPartId == materialPartId &&
                                  loaded.Stats.SourceVertices == vertices.size() &&
                                  loaded.Stats.SourceTriangles == indices.size() / 3;
                // キャッシュしたアセットを採用する前に、リーフとソースの対応を検証する。
                if (asset->CacheHit)
                {
                    try
                    {
                        asset->Meshlets = ConvertLeaves(loaded, vertices);
                    }
                    catch (const std::exception&)
                    {
                        asset->CacheHit = false;
                    }
                }
            }
            if (!asset->CacheHit)
            {
                auto result = VirtualGeometryBuilder::Build(vertices, indices, config, materialId);
                if (!result)
                {
                    // インポートした境界や継ぎ目の接続構造によっては、安全に簡略化できない。
                    // その場合も Nanite を拒否せず、正確な最詳細クラスターを登録する。
                    asset->HierarchyWarning = result.Error;
                    config.MaxHierarchyLevels = 1;
                    result = VirtualGeometryBuilder::Build(vertices, indices, config, materialId);
                }
                if (!result)
                {
                    throw std::runtime_error(result.Error);
                }
                asset->Hierarchy = std::move(result.Asset);
                asset->Hierarchy.DebugName = name.str();
                asset->Hierarchy.SourceMaterialPartId = materialPartId;
                asset->Meshlets = ConvertLeaves(asset->Hierarchy, vertices);
                // キャッシュの失敗は致命的ではない。検証済みのメモリ内アセットは描画可能なままにする。
                std::error_code directoryError;
                std::filesystem::create_directories(cacheDirectory, directoryError);
                if (!directoryError)
                {
                    VirtualGeometrySerializer::Save(asset->CachePath, asset->Hierarchy, error);
                }
            }
            else
            {
                if (asset->Hierarchy.Config.MaxHierarchyLevels == 1)
                {
                    asset->HierarchyWarning =
                        "Cached leaf-only hierarchy; protected boundaries prevented simplification";
                }
            }
            // まだシーンにインスタンスがなくても、インポート結果を完成させる。
            auto compression = asset->CompressionSettings;
            if (const char* raw = std::getenv("DX12_VG_COMPRESSION_RAW"))
            {
                compression.Enabled = std::atoi(raw) == 0;
            }
            auto pagePath = asset->CachePath;
            pagePath += "." + std::to_string(VirtualGeometryCompression::SettingsKey(compression));
            pagePath += compression.Enabled ? ".encoded.vgmesh" : ".raw.vgmesh";
            auto manifest = std::make_shared<VirtualGeometryPageCache::PageManifest>();
            if (!VirtualGeometryPageCache::Open(pagePath, *manifest, error) ||
                manifest->Version != VirtualGeometryPageCache::FormatVersion::Production)
            {
                if (!VirtualGeometrySerializer::SaveEncoded(pagePath, asset->Hierarchy, error, compression) ||
                    !VirtualGeometryPageCache::Open(pagePath, *manifest, error))
                {
                    // ディスク容量やページ符号化を利用できない場合は、検証済みの非圧縮ジオメトリを保持する。
                    asset->HierarchyWarning += " Page preparation deferred: " + error;
                    manifest.reset();
                }
            }
            if (manifest)
            {
                manifest->StreamingPriority = settings.StreamingPriority;
                asset->Pages = std::move(manifest);
            }
        }
        catch (const std::exception& error)
        {
            asset->Error = error.what();
            asset->Meshlets = {};
        }
        asset->BuildMilliseconds =
            std::chrono::duration<double, std::milli>(std::chrono::steady_clock::now() - begin).count();
        lock.lock();
        if (!asset->Error.empty())
        {
            ++state.Stats.Failures;
        }
        else if (asset->CacheHit)
        {
            ++state.Stats.CacheHits;
        }
        else
        {
            ++state.Stats.Builds;
        }
        state.Stats.BuildMilliseconds += asset->BuildMilliseconds;
        for (auto entry = state.Assets.begin(); entry != state.Assets.end();)
        {
            if (entry->second.expired())
            {
                entry = state.Assets.erase(entry);
            }
            else
            {
                ++entry;
            }
        }
        state.Assets[identity] = asset;
        return asset;
    }

    std::shared_future<std::shared_ptr<const RuntimeAsset>> AcquireAsync(std::vector<VirtualGeometryVertex> vertices,
                                                                         std::vector<uint32_t> indices,
                                                                         uint32_t materialId, float materialPartId,
                                                                         const VGImportSettings& settings)
    {
        // 単一ワーカーで、インポートやページ符号化との CPU・メモリ競合を抑える。
        struct BuildQueue
        {
            struct Job
            {
                uint64_t Bytes = 0;
                std::packaged_task<std::shared_ptr<const RuntimeAsset>()> Work;
            };

            std::mutex Mutex;
            std::condition_variable Wake;
            std::deque<Job> Jobs;
            uint64_t Bytes = 0;
            bool Stopping = false;
            std::thread Worker;

            BuildQueue()
                : Worker([this] {
                      for (;;)
                      {
                          std::unique_lock guard(Mutex);
                          Wake.wait(guard, [this] {
                              return Stopping || !Jobs.empty();
                          });
                          if (Jobs.empty())
                          {
                              return;
                          }
                          auto job = std::move(Jobs.front());
                          Jobs.pop_front();
                          guard.unlock();
                          job.Work();
                          guard.lock();
                          Bytes -= job.Bytes;
                      }
                  })
            {
            }

            ~BuildQueue()
            {
                {
                    std::lock_guard guard(Mutex);
                    Stopping = true;
                    Jobs.clear(); // 破棄された promise は、メインスレッドの公開処理で扱う。
                }
                Wake.notify_one();
                Worker.join();
            }
        };

        Data(); // プロセス終了時も、実行時の状態はワーカーより長く生存させる。
        static BuildQueue queue;
        const uint64_t bytes = uint64_t(vertices.size()) * sizeof(VirtualGeometryVertex) + uint64_t(indices.size()) * 4;
        std::unique_lock guard(queue.Mutex);
        constexpr uint64_t queueBudget = 512ull * 1024 * 1024;
        if (bytes > queueBudget || queue.Bytes > queueBudget - bytes)
        {
            std::promise<std::shared_ptr<const RuntimeAsset>> rejected;
            auto asset = std::make_shared<RuntimeAsset>();
            asset->Error = "VirtualGeometry background queue memory budget exceeded; legacy rendering retained";
            rejected.set_value(asset);
            return rejected.get_future().share();
        }
        BuildQueue::Job job;
        job.Bytes = bytes;
        job.Work = std::packaged_task<std::shared_ptr<const RuntimeAsset>()>(
            [vertices = std::move(vertices), indices = std::move(indices), materialId, materialPartId, settings] {
                return Acquire(vertices, indices, materialId, materialPartId, "asset/virtualgeometry-cache", settings);
            });
        auto future = job.Work.get_future().share();
        queue.Bytes += bytes;
        queue.Jobs.push_back(std::move(job));
        guard.unlock();
        queue.Wake.notify_one();
        return future;
    }

    Statistics GetStatistics()
    {
        auto& state = Data();
        std::lock_guard lock(state.Mutex);
        return state.Stats;
    }

    std::vector<std::shared_ptr<const RuntimeAsset>> LiveAssets()
    {
        auto& state = Data();
        std::lock_guard lock(state.Mutex);
        std::vector<std::shared_ptr<const RuntimeAsset>> result;
        for (const auto& [key, entry] : state.Assets)
        {
            if (auto asset = entry.lock())
            {
                result.push_back(std::move(asset));
            }
        }
        std::sort(result.begin(), result.end(), [](const auto& a, const auto& b) {
            return a->Key < b->Key;
        });
        return result;
    }
} // 名前空間 VirtualGeometryRuntime の終わり。
