===== FILE: source\virtualgeometry\virtualgeometryvalidator.cpp =====
#include "virtualgeometryvalidator.h"
#include "virtualgeometryinternal.h"
#include <algorithm>
#include <bit>
#include <cmath>
#include <unordered_map>

namespace
{
    using namespace VirtualGeometryInternal;

    bool Finite(const std::array<float, 3>& values)
    {
        return std::all_of(values.begin(), values.end(), [](float value) {
            return std::isfinite(value);
        });
    }

    bool ValidSphere(const VirtualGeometrySphere& sphere)
    {
        return Finite(sphere.Center) && std::isfinite(sphere.Radius) && sphere.Radius >= 0;
    }

    bool Contains(const VirtualGeometrySphere& outer, const VirtualGeometrySphere& inner, float epsilon)
    {
        double distanceSquared = 0;
        for (size_t axis = 0; axis < 3; ++axis)
        {
            double difference = double(outer.Center[axis]) - inner.Center[axis];
            distanceSquared += difference * difference;
        }
        double tolerance = std::max(double(epsilon), double(outer.Radius) * 1e-5);
        return std::sqrt(distanceSquared) + inner.Radius <= outer.Radius + tolerance;
    }

    struct PositionKey
    {
        std::array<uint32_t, 3> Bits{};

        explicit PositionKey(const VirtualGeometryVertex& vertex)
        {
            for (size_t axis = 0; axis < 3; ++axis)
            {
                Bits[axis] = vertex.Position[axis] == 0 ? 0 : std::bit_cast<uint32_t>(vertex.Position[axis]);
            }
        }

        bool operator==(const PositionKey&) const = default;
    };

    struct PositionHash
    {
        size_t operator()(const PositionKey& position) const
        {
            size_t hash = 0;
            for (uint32_t bits : position.Bits)
            {
                hash = hash * 16777619u ^ bits;
            }
            return hash;
        }
    };

    using EdgeCounts = std::unordered_map<uint64_t, uint32_t>;

    void AddEdges(const VirtualGeometryAsset& asset, uint32_t clusterIndex, const std::vector<uint32_t>& positionIds,
                  EdgeCounts& counts)
    {
        const auto& cluster = asset.Clusters[clusterIndex];
        for (uint32_t triangle = 0; triangle < cluster.TriangleCount; ++triangle)
        {
            for (uint32_t corner = 0; corner < 3; ++corner)
            {
                uint32_t first = positionIds[cluster.VertexOffset +
                                             asset.TriangleIndices[cluster.TriangleOffset + triangle * 3 + corner]];
                uint32_t second =
                    positionIds[cluster.VertexOffset +
                                asset.TriangleIndices[cluster.TriangleOffset + triangle * 3 + (corner + 1) % 3]];
                ++counts[uint64_t(std::min(first, second)) << 32 | std::max(first, second)];
            }
        }
    }

    bool ValidateGroupBoundaries(const VirtualGeometryAsset& asset, std::string& error)
    {
        std::unordered_map<PositionKey, uint32_t, PositionHash> positions;
        std::vector<uint32_t> positionIds;
        positionIds.reserve(asset.Vertices.size());
        for (const auto& vertex : asset.Vertices)
        {
            auto [entry, inserted] = positions.emplace(PositionKey(vertex), CheckedIndex(positions.size()));
            positionIds.push_back(entry->second);
        }

        // 階層ごとに位置に基づく辺の接続表を一度だけ作る。クラスターの総当たり比較は行わない。
        struct Incidence
        {
            uint32_t Count = 0;
            uint32_t Group = VirtualGeometryConfig::InvalidIndex;
            bool Shared = false;
        };

        std::vector<std::unordered_map<uint64_t, Incidence>> levelEdges(asset.Levels.size());
        for (uint32_t index = 0; index < asset.Clusters.size(); ++index)
        {
            const auto& cluster = asset.Clusters[index];
            EdgeCounts edges;
            AddEdges(asset, index, positionIds, edges);
            for (const auto& [key, count] : edges)
            {
                auto& incidence = levelEdges[cluster.Level][key];
                if (incidence.Count == 0)
                {
                    incidence.Group = cluster.GroupIndex;
                }
                incidence.Shared |= incidence.Group != cluster.GroupIndex;
                incidence.Count += count;
            }
        }
        for (const auto& group : asset.Groups)
        {
            EdgeCounts before;
            EdgeCounts after;
            for (uint32_t child = 0; child < group.ChildCount; ++child)
            {
                AddEdges(asset, asset.HierarchyIndices[group.FirstChild + child], positionIds, before);
            }
            for (uint32_t parent = 0; parent < group.ParentCount; ++parent)
            {
                AddEdges(asset, asset.HierarchyIndices[group.FirstParent + parent], positionIds, after);
            }
            for (const auto& [key, count] : before)
            {
                const auto& incidence = levelEdges[group.Level].at(key);
                bool protectedEdge = count != 2 || incidence.Shared || incidence.Count != 2;
                if (protectedEdge && (!after.contains(key) || after.at(key) != count))
                {
                    error = "Group boundary geometry changed across LOD";
                    return false;
                }
            }
            for (const auto& [key, count] : after)
            {
                if (count != 2 && (!before.contains(key) || before.at(key) != count))
                {
                    error = "Parent geometry introduces a boundary/non-manifold edge";
                    return false;
                }
            }
        }
        return true;
    }

    bool ValidateData(const VirtualGeometryAsset& asset, std::string& error)
    {
        auto fail = [&error](const char* message) {
            error = message;
            return false;
        };
        if (asset.Version != VirtualGeometryConfig::AssetVersion || !ValidateVirtualGeometryConfig(asset.Config, error))
        {
            return fail("Unsupported asset version or invalid build config");
        }
        if (asset.Clusters.empty() || asset.RootClusters.empty() || asset.Levels.empty() ||
            asset.Levels.size() > asset.Config.MaxHierarchyLevels || !std::isfinite(asset.SourceMaterialPartId))
        {
            return fail("Empty or invalid virtual geometry asset");
        }
        if (asset.Vertices.size() >= VirtualGeometryConfig::InvalidIndex ||
            asset.TriangleIndices.size() >= VirtualGeometryConfig::InvalidIndex ||
            asset.Clusters.size() >= VirtualGeometryConfig::InvalidIndex ||
            asset.Groups.size() >= VirtualGeometryConfig::InvalidIndex ||
            asset.HierarchyIndices.size() >= VirtualGeometryConfig::InvalidIndex)
        {
            return fail("Asset exceeds 32-bit addressing");
        }
        for (const auto& vertex : asset.Vertices)
        {
            if (!IsFiniteVertex(vertex))
            {
                return fail("Non-finite asset vertex");
            }
        }
        std::vector<VirtualGeometryLevelStats> measured(asset.Levels.size());
        uint64_t vertexEnd = 0;
        uint64_t triangleEnd = 0;
        uint32_t maximumTriangles = 0;
        uint32_t maximumVertices = 0;
        for (const auto& cluster : asset.Clusters)
        {
            if (cluster.VertexCount == 0 || cluster.VertexCount > asset.Config.MaxClusterVertices ||
                cluster.TriangleCount == 0 || cluster.TriangleCount > asset.Config.MaxClusterTriangles ||
                cluster.Level >= asset.Levels.size() || cluster.MaterialId != asset.SourceMaterialId ||
                !RangeFits(cluster.VertexOffset, cluster.VertexCount, asset.Vertices.size()) ||
                !RangeFits(cluster.TriangleOffset, uint64_t(cluster.TriangleCount) * 3, asset.TriangleIndices.size()) ||
                cluster.VertexOffset != vertexEnd || cluster.TriangleOffset != triangleEnd)
            {
                return fail("Invalid cluster ranges, limits, level, or material");
            }
            vertexEnd += cluster.VertexCount;
            triangleEnd += uint64_t(cluster.TriangleCount) * 3;
            if (!ValidSphere(cluster.Bounds) || !Finite(cluster.Aabb.Min) || !Finite(cluster.Aabb.Max) ||
                !Finite(cluster.Cone.Axis) || !Finite(cluster.Cone.Apex) || !std::isfinite(cluster.Cone.Cutoff) ||
                cluster.Cone.Cutoff < 0 || cluster.Cone.Cutoff > 1 || !std::isfinite(cluster.LodError) ||
                cluster.LodError < 0 || (cluster.Level == 0 && cluster.LodError != 0))
            {
                return fail("Invalid cluster bounds/cone/error");
            }
            for (size_t axis = 0; axis < 3; ++axis)
            {
                if (cluster.Aabb.Min[axis] > cluster.Aabb.Max[axis])
                {
                    return fail("Inverted AABB");
                }
            }
            for (uint32_t vertexIndex = 0; vertexIndex < cluster.VertexCount; ++vertexIndex)
            {
                const auto& vertex = asset.Vertices[cluster.VertexOffset + vertexIndex];
                VirtualGeometrySphere point;
                std::copy_n(vertex.Position, 3, point.Center.begin());
                if (!Contains(cluster.Bounds, point, asset.Config.BoundaryEpsilon))
                {
                    return fail("Cluster sphere does not cover geometry");
                }
                for (size_t axis = 0; axis < 3; ++axis)
                {
                    if (vertex.Position[axis] < cluster.Aabb.Min[axis] ||
                        vertex.Position[axis] > cluster.Aabb.Max[axis])
                    {
                        return fail("Cluster AABB does not cover geometry");
                    }
                }
            }
            for (uint32_t index = 0; index < cluster.TriangleCount * 3; ++index)
            {
                if (asset.TriangleIndices[cluster.TriangleOffset + index] >= cluster.VertexCount)
                {
                    return fail("Cluster-local triangle index out of bounds");
                }
            }
            auto& level = measured[cluster.Level];
            ++level.Clusters;
            level.Triangles += cluster.TriangleCount;
            level.Vertices += cluster.VertexCount;
            maximumTriangles = std::max(maximumTriangles, cluster.TriangleCount);
            maximumVertices = std::max(maximumVertices, cluster.VertexCount);
        }
        if (vertexEnd != asset.Vertices.size() || triangleEnd != asset.TriangleIndices.size())
        {
            return fail("Unreferenced geometry payload");
        }
        std::vector<uint32_t> consumers(asset.Clusters.size(), VirtualGeometryConfig::InvalidIndex);
        std::vector<uint32_t> producers(asset.Clusters.size(), VirtualGeometryConfig::InvalidIndex);
        uint64_t hierarchyEnd = 0;
        for (uint32_t index = 0; index < asset.Groups.size(); ++index)
        {
            const auto& group = asset.Groups[index];
            if (group.ChildCount == 0 || group.ParentCount == 0 || group.ParentCount >= group.ChildCount ||
                !RangeFits(group.FirstChild, group.ChildCount, asset.HierarchyIndices.size()) ||
                !RangeFits(group.FirstParent, group.ParentCount, asset.HierarchyIndices.size()) ||
                group.FirstChild != hierarchyEnd || uint64_t(group.FirstParent) != hierarchyEnd + group.ChildCount ||
                !ValidSphere(group.Bounds) || !std::isfinite(group.MinError) || !std::isfinite(group.MaxError) ||
                group.MinError < 0 || group.MaxError < group.MinError)
            {
                return fail("Invalid cluster group ranges/bounds/error");
            }
            hierarchyEnd += uint64_t(group.ChildCount) + group.ParentCount;
            float maximumChildError = 0;
            uint64_t childTriangles = 0;
            uint64_t parentTriangles = 0;
            for (uint32_t child = 0; child < group.ChildCount; ++child)
            {
                uint32_t childIndex = asset.HierarchyIndices[group.FirstChild + child];
                if (childIndex >= asset.Clusters.size() || consumers[childIndex] != VirtualGeometryConfig::InvalidIndex)
                {
                    return fail("Invalid or duplicate group child");
                }
                consumers[childIndex] = index;
                const auto& cluster = asset.Clusters[childIndex];
                if (cluster.Level != group.Level || cluster.GroupIndex != index)
                {
                    return fail("Child level/group mismatch");
                }
                const auto& descendantBounds = cluster.GeneratingGroupIndex == VirtualGeometryConfig::InvalidIndex
                                                   ? cluster.Bounds
                                                   : asset.Groups.at(cluster.GeneratingGroupIndex).Bounds;
                if (!Contains(group.Bounds, descendantBounds, asset.Config.BoundaryEpsilon))
                {
                    return fail("Group sphere does not cover descendants");
                }
                maximumChildError = std::max(maximumChildError, cluster.LodError);
                childTriangles += cluster.TriangleCount;
            }
            if (group.MinError != maximumChildError)
            {
                return fail("Group minimum error does not match its children");
            }
            for (uint32_t parent = 0; parent < group.ParentCount; ++parent)
            {
                uint32_t parentIndex = asset.HierarchyIndices[group.FirstParent + parent];
                if (parentIndex >= asset.Clusters.size() ||
                    producers[parentIndex] != VirtualGeometryConfig::InvalidIndex)
                {
                    return fail("Invalid or duplicate group parent");
                }
                producers[parentIndex] = index;
                const auto& cluster = asset.Clusters[parentIndex];
                // 階層レベルが厳密に増加することから、再帰スタックを使わずに閉路がないと証明する。
                if (uint64_t(cluster.Level) != uint64_t(group.Level) + 1 || cluster.GeneratingGroupIndex != index ||
                    cluster.LodError < maximumChildError || cluster.LodError != group.MaxError)
                {
                    return fail("Hierarchy cycle/level/parent error mismatch");
                }
                parentTriangles += cluster.TriangleCount;
            }
            if (parentTriangles >= childTriangles)
            {
                return fail("Non-reducing hierarchy group");
            }
        }
        if (hierarchyEnd != asset.HierarchyIndices.size())
        {
            return fail("Unreferenced hierarchy payload");
        }
        std::vector<bool> roots(asset.Clusters.size());
        for (uint32_t root : asset.RootClusters)
        {
            if (root >= asset.Clusters.size() || roots[root] || consumers[root] != VirtualGeometryConfig::InvalidIndex)
            {
                return fail("Invalid, duplicate, or consumed root");
            }
            roots[root] = true;
        }
        for (size_t index = 0; index < asset.Clusters.size(); ++index)
        {
            const auto& cluster = asset.Clusters[index];
            bool isRoot = consumers[index] == VirtualGeometryConfig::InvalidIndex;
            bool isLeaf = cluster.Level == 0;
            if (roots[index] != isRoot || cluster.GroupIndex != consumers[index] ||
                cluster.GeneratingGroupIndex != producers[index] ||
                isLeaf != (producers[index] == VirtualGeometryConfig::InvalidIndex))
            {
                return fail("Orphan cluster or inconsistent producer/consumer/root metadata");
            }
        }
        const auto& stats = asset.Stats;
        if (stats.SourceVertices == 0 || stats.SourceVertices >= VirtualGeometryConfig::InvalidIndex ||
            stats.SourceTriangles == 0 || stats.SourceTriangles >= VirtualGeometryConfig::InvalidIndex / 3 ||
            stats.RemovedDegenerateTriangles > stats.SourceTriangles ||
            stats.RemovedDuplicateTriangles > stats.SourceTriangles - stats.RemovedDegenerateTriangles ||
            stats.FinalLeafTriangles !=
                stats.SourceTriangles - stats.RemovedDegenerateTriangles - stats.RemovedDuplicateTriangles ||
            stats.FinalLeafTriangles != measured[0].Triangles || stats.LeafClusters != measured[0].Clusters ||
            stats.TotalClusters != asset.Clusters.size() || stats.TotalGroups != asset.Groups.size() ||
            stats.HierarchyLevels != asset.Levels.size() || stats.MaximumTrianglesPerCluster != maximumTriangles ||
            stats.MaximumVerticesPerCluster != maximumVertices || !std::isfinite(stats.BuildMilliseconds) ||
            stats.BuildMilliseconds < 0)
        {
            return fail("Invalid source/leaf/asset statistics");
        }
        uint64_t allTriangles = 0;
        uint64_t allVertices = 0;
        for (size_t level = 0; level < measured.size(); ++level)
        {
            const auto& expected = asset.Levels[level];
            const auto& actual = measured[level];
            if (actual.Clusters == 0 || expected.Clusters != actual.Clusters ||
                expected.Triangles != actual.Triangles || expected.Vertices != actual.Vertices)
            {
                return fail("Invalid per-level statistics");
            }
            allTriangles += actual.Triangles;
            allVertices += actual.Vertices;
        }
        uint64_t rawBytes = uint64_t(asset.Vertices.size()) * sizeof(VirtualGeometryVertex) +
                            asset.TriangleIndices.size() +
                            uint64_t(asset.Clusters.size()) * sizeof(VirtualGeometryCluster) +
                            uint64_t(asset.Groups.size()) * sizeof(VirtualGeometryClusterGroup) +
                            uint64_t(asset.HierarchyIndices.size() + asset.RootClusters.size()) * sizeof(uint32_t) +
                            uint64_t(asset.Levels.size()) * sizeof(VirtualGeometryLevelStats);
        if (stats.AverageTrianglesPerCluster != double(allTriangles) / asset.Clusters.size() ||
            stats.AverageVerticesPerCluster != double(allVertices) / asset.Clusters.size() ||
            stats.RawMemoryBytes != rawBytes ||
            stats.SourceMemoryBytes !=
                stats.SourceVertices * sizeof(VirtualGeometryVertex) + stats.SourceTriangles * 3 * sizeof(uint32_t))
        {
            return fail("Invalid memory/average statistics");
        }
        return ValidateGroupBoundaries(asset, error);
    }
}

bool VirtualGeometryValidator::Validate(const VirtualGeometryAsset& asset, std::string& error)
{
    error.clear();
    try
    {
        return ValidateData(asset, error);
    }
    catch (const std::exception& exception)
    {
        error = exception.what();
        return false;
    }
}

static const float kPi = 3.14159265f;
static const uint kHistogramBins = 64;

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
// 補助関数
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
float Hash(uint value)
{
    value ^= value >> 16;
    value *= 0x7feb352du;
    value ^= value >> 15;
    value *= 0x846ca68bu;
    value ^= value >> 16;
    return (value >> 8) / 16777216.0f;
}

float3 ViewRay(float2 uv)
{
    return CameraRayDirection(uv, InvViewProjection);
}

float3 WorldFromDepth(float2 uv, float depth)
{
    float4 world = mul(float4(uv.x * 2 - 1, 1 - uv.y * 2, depth, 1), InvViewProjection);
    return world.xyz / world.w;
}

float SliceToDistance(float slice)
{
    return FogDepth.x * exp2(slice / FroxelExtent.z * FogDepth.z);
}

float DistanceToSliceCoordinate(float dist)
{
    return saturate(log2(max(dist, FogDepth.x) / FogDepth.x) / FogDepth.z);
}

float HenyeyGreenstein(float cosine, float g)
{
    g = clamp(g, -0.95f, 0.95f);
    float g2 = g * g;
    float denominator = max(1 + g2 - 2 * g * cosine, 0.0001f);
    return (1 - g2) / (4 * kPi * denominator * sqrt(denominator));
}

float TraceVisibility(float3 origin, float3 direction, float dist)
{
    if (FogMieColor.w < 0.5f)
    {
        return 1;
    }
    RayDesc ray;
    ray.Origin = origin;
    ray.Direction = direction;
    ray.TMin = 0.02f;
    ray.TMax = max(dist, 0.03f);
    RayQuery<RAY_FLAG_ACCEPT_FIRST_HIT_AND_END_SEARCH | RAY_FLAG_FORCE_OPAQUE> query;
    query.TraceRayInline(ShadowScene, RAY_FLAG_NONE, 0x01, ray);
    while (query.Proceed())
    {
    }
    return query.CommittedStatus() == COMMITTED_NOTHING ? 1 : 0;
}

// ワールド位置の媒質：rgb = ローカルフォグの入射散乱による発光、a = 消散（1/m）。
void EvaluateMedium(float3 position, out float globalDensity, out float3 localEmission, out float extinction)
{
    globalDensity = FogMedium0.x * exp(-max(position.y, 0) * FogMedium0.y);
    extinction = FogMedium0.z * globalDensity * FogMedium0.w;
    localEmission = 0;
    [loop] for (uint index = 0; index < FroxelExtent.w; ++index)
    {
        float4 data0 = LocalFogData0[index];
        float4 data1 = LocalFogData1[index];
        if (data1.w < 0.5f || data1.y <= 0.00001f)
        {
            continue;
        }
        float3 delta = position - data0.xyz;
        float radius = max(data0.w, 0.01f);
        float weight = data1.z >= 0.5f
                           ? saturate(1 - length(delta) / radius)
                           : saturate(1 - length(delta.xz) / radius) * exp(-abs(delta.y) * max(data1.x, 0.0001f));
        // 以前のレイマーチ式ローカルフォグと同じ光学的厚さのスケール（0.08）。
        float sigma = weight * data1.y * 0.08f;
        extinction += sigma;
        localEmission += LocalFogColor[index].rgb * sigma;
    }
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
// MegaLights M6：フロクセルのローカルライト
//   セル（16px タイル × スライス）のライトから、影なしの寄与（輝度）に比例して N 個選び、
//   影を落とすライトだけ影レイを飛ばして 1/p で重み付けする（不偏）。ノイズはフロクセルの時間方向の履歴で減る。
//   従来の FogLights（上限 32）にはグリッドに載っていないライト（太陽・シャドウマップ持ち・Volume など）だけが入る。
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
float3 MegaLightFogContribution(MegaLightData light, float3 position, float3 viewToCamera, float globalDensity,
                                float3 scatterAlbedo, float3 mieAlbedo, out float3 toLight, out float lightDistance)
{
    float3 offset = light.PositionType.xyz - position;
    lightDistance = length(offset);
    toLight = offset / max(lightDistance, 0.0001f);
    float attenuation = StageRangeAttenuation(lightDistance, light.DirectionRange.w, light.Extra.z);
    if ((int)round(light.PositionType.w) == 2)
    {
        float spotCosine = dot(-toLight, normalize(light.DirectionRange.xyz));
        attenuation *= smoothstep(light.Extra.y, light.Extra.x, spotCosine);
    }
    if (attenuation <= 0.00001f)
    {
        return 0;
    }
    float cosine = dot(-toLight, viewToCamera);
    float3 phase =
        scatterAlbedo * (0.0596831f * (1 + cosine * cosine)) + mieAlbedo * HenyeyGreenstein(cosine, FogMedium1.z);
    // FogInject の従来ライトと同じ式（大気の媒質 + ライト自身のボリューム密度）
    float3 response = phase * globalDensity * FogMedium0.w + 0.16f * StageVolumeDensity(light.Extra.z) * 0.0795775f;
    float ies = SampleIesProfile(light.IesProfile, light.DirectionRange.xyz, position - light.PositionType.xyz);
    return response * max(light.Color.rgb, 0.0f) * max(light.Flags.w, 0.0f) * attenuation * ies;
}

float3 MegaLightsFogScattering(uint3 id, float3 position, float3 viewToCamera, float globalDensity,
                               float3 scatterAlbedo, float3 mieAlbedo)
{
    if (MegaLightsFog.x == 0u || !MLGridActive())
    {
        return 0;
    }
    float3 view = mul(float4(position, 1.0f), MLWorldToView).xyz;
    if (view.z <= MLDepth.z)
    {
        return 0;
    }
    float2 pixel = MLViewToPixel(view);
    if (any(pixel < 0.0f) || any(pixel >= float2(MLScreen.xy)))
    {
        return 0;
    }
    uint2 tile = min(uint2(pixel) / ML_TILE_SIZE, MLGrid.xy - 1u);
    uint2 cell = FogMegaLightCells[MLCellIndex(tile, MLSliceFromViewZ(view.z))];
    if (cell.y == 0u)
    {
        return 0;
    }

    const uint sampleCount = clamp(MegaLightsFog.y, 1u, 4u);
    const uint seed = MLSeed(id.xy + uint2(0u, id.z * 4099u), Extent.z, 0x464f47u);
    uint picks[4] = {0xffffffffu, 0xffffffffu, 0xffffffffu, 0xffffffffu};
    float pickWeights[4] = {0, 0, 0, 0};
    float weightSum = 0;
    [loop] for (uint i = 0u; i < cell.y; ++i)
    {
        const uint lightIndex = FogMegaLightIndices[cell.x + i];
        float3 toLight;
        float lightDistance;
        const float w = dot(MegaLightFogContribution(FogMegaLights[lightIndex], position, viewToCamera, globalDensity,
                                                     scatterAlbedo, mieAlbedo, toLight, lightDistance),
                            float3(0.2126f, 0.7152f, 0.0722f));
        if (w <= 0.0f)
        {
            continue;
        }
        weightSum += w;
        [unroll] for (uint k = 0u; k < 4u; ++k)
        {
            if (k >= sampleCount)
            {
                break;
            }
            if (MLRandom(seed + k * 0x9e3779b9u + i * 0x85ebca6bu) * weightSum < w)
            {
                picks[k] = lightIndex;
                pickWeights[k] = w;
            }
        }
    }
    if (weightSum <= 0.0f)
    {
        return 0;
    }
    float3 result = 0;
    [unroll] for (uint k = 0u; k < 4u; ++k)
    {
        if (k >= sampleCount || picks[k] == 0xffffffffu)
        {
            continue;
        }
        const MegaLightData light = FogMegaLights[picks[k]];
        float3 toLight;
        float lightDistance;
        float3 contribution = MegaLightFogContribution(light, position, viewToCamera, globalDensity, scatterAlbedo,
                                                       mieAlbedo, toLight, lightDistance);
        float visibility = MLLightCastsShadow(light) ? TraceVisibility(position, toLight, lightDistance - 0.05f) : 1.0f;
        // p = w / Σw（寄与が 0 のライトは選ばれないが、そもそも寄与 0 なので不偏）
        result += contribution * visibility * (weightSum / pickWeights[k]);
    }
    return result / (float)sampleCount;
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
// 1. フロクセルへの注入：媒質と照明をフロクセルごとに計算し、時間方向へ再投影する。
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
[numthreads(8, 8, 1)] void FogInject(uint3 id : SV_DispatchThreadID) {
    if (any(id >= FroxelExtent.xyz))
    {
        return;
    }
    uint frame = Extent.z;
    // セル内でフロクセルごとにジッターを加え（深度方向は R2 列）、履歴で解消する。
    float jitter = FogDepth.w > 0 ? frac(0.5f + frame * 0.618034f + Hash(id.x + id.y * 977u) * 0.25f) : 0.5f;
    float2 uv = (id.xy + 0.5f) / FroxelExtent.xy;
    float3 rayDirection = ViewRay(uv);
    float dist = SliceToDistance(id.z + jitter);
    float3 position = CameraRayOrigin(uv, CameraPosition.xyz, InvViewProjection) + rayDirection * dist;

    float globalDensity;
    float3 localEmission;
    float extinction;
    EvaluateMedium(position, globalDensity, localEmission, extinction);

    float3 scattering = localEmission;
    float3 viewToCamera = -rayDirection;
    float3 scatterAlbedo = FogRayleighColor.rgb * FogMedium1.x;
    float3 mieAlbedo = FogMieColor.rgb * FogMedium1.y;
    uint shadowedLocal = 0;
    [loop] for (uint lightIndex = 0; lightIndex < Extent.w; ++lightIndex)
    {
        FogLight light = FogLights[lightIndex];
        int type = (int)round(light.PositionType.w);
        float3 toLight;
        float attenuation = 1;
        float lightDistance = 200.0f;
        if (type == 0)
        {
            toLight = normalize(light.DirectionRange.xyz);
        }
        else
        {
            float3 offset = light.PositionType.xyz - position;
            lightDistance = length(offset);
            toLight = offset / max(lightDistance, 0.0001f);
            attenuation = StageRangeAttenuation(lightDistance, light.DirectionRange.w, light.Color.w);
            if (type == 2 || type == 3)
            {
                float spotCosine = dot(-toLight, normalize(light.DirectionRange.xyz));
                attenuation *= smoothstep(light.Extras.y, light.Extras.x, spotCosine);
            }
        }
        if (attenuation <= 0.00001f)
        {
            continue;
        }
        // 入射光とカメラへ向かう散乱光が揃うとき、正の g が前方散乱を強める。
        float cosine = dot(-toLight, viewToCamera);
        float3 phase =
            scatterAlbedo * (0.0596831f * (1 + cosine * cosine)) + mieAlbedo * HenyeyGreenstein(cosine, FogMedium1.z);
        // 大気媒質にライト固有の設定済みボリューム密度を加える（光芒）。
        float3 response =
            phase * globalDensity * FogMedium0.w + (type == 0 ? 0.025f : 0.16f) *
                StageVolumeDensity(light.Color.w) * 0.0795775f;
        float3 incident =
            light.Color.rgb * attenuation *
            SampleIesProfile(light.IesProfile, light.DirectionRange.xyz, position - light.PositionType.xyz);
        if (all(response * incident < 0.0000001f))
        {
            continue;
        }
        float visibility = 1;
        bool castShadow = light.Extras.z > 0.5f;
        if (castShadow && (type == 0 || shadowedLocal < 4))
        {
            visibility = TraceVisibility(position, toLight, type == 0 ? 200.0f : lightDistance - 0.05f);
            shadowedLocal += type == 0 ? 0 : 1;
        }
        if (light.Extras.w > 0.5f && CloudTrace.z > 0.5f && CloudTrace.w > 0.5f)
        {
            visibility *= toLight.y > 0 ? CloudLightTransmittance(position, toLight) : 0;
        }
        scattering += response * incident * visibility * FogMedium1.w;
    }
    scattering +=
        MegaLightsFogScattering(id, position, viewToCamera, globalDensity, scatterAlbedo, mieAlbedo) * FogMedium1.w;
    // 低コストの多重散乱と空の環境光で、影の中のフォグが真っ黒になるのを防ぐ。
    scattering += FogAmbientColor.rgb * FogRayleighColor.w * globalDensity * FogMedium0.w;

    float4 current = float4(scattering, extinction);
    if (PrevCameraPosition.w > 0.5f)
    {
        float4 previousClip = mul(float4(position, 1), PrevViewProjection);
        if (previousClip.w > 0.0001f)
        {
            float2 previousUv = float2(previousClip.x, -previousClip.y) / previousClip.w * 0.5f + 0.5f;
            float previousDistance = length(position - PrevCameraPosition.xyz);
            float3 previousW = float3(PrevViewProjection[0][3], PrevViewProjection[1][3], PrevViewProjection[2][3]);
            if (dot(previousW, previousW) < 1e-12f)
            {
                float3 previousZ = normalize(float3(PrevViewProjection[0][2], PrevViewProjection[1][2],
                                                     PrevViewProjection[2][2]));
                previousDistance = abs(dot(position - PrevCameraPosition.xyz, previousZ));
            }
            float previousSlice = DistanceToSliceCoordinate(previousDistance);
            if (all(previousUv > 0) && all(previousUv < 1))
            {
                float4 history = FroxelHistory.SampleLevel(LinearClamp, float3(previousUv, previousSlice), 0);
                current = lerp(current, history, FogDepth.w);
            }
        }
    }
    FroxelOut[id] = current;
}

    // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    // 2. 手前から奥へ積分する（エネルギー保存、Hillaire 2015）。
    // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    [numthreads(8, 8, 1)] void FogIntegrate(uint3 id : SV_DispatchThreadID)
{
    if (any(id.xy >= FroxelExtent.xy))
    {
        return;
    }
    float3 accumulated = 0;
    float transmittance = 1;
    float previousDistance = 0;
    [loop] for (uint slice = 0; slice < FroxelExtent.z; ++slice)
    {
        float dist = SliceToDistance(slice + 1);
        float thickness = dist - previousDistance;
        previousDistance = dist;
        float4 medium = FroxelCurrent[uint3(id.xy, slice)];
        float extinction = max(medium.a, 0.0000001f);
        float sliceTransmittance = exp(-extinction * thickness);
        accumulated += transmittance * medium.rgb * (1 - sliceTransmittance) / extinction;
        transmittance *= sliceTransmittance;
        IntegratedOut[uint3(id.xy, slice)] = float4(accumulated, transmittance);
    }
}

float4 SampleIntegratedFog(float2 uv, float dist)
{
    float coordinate = DistanceToSliceCoordinate(dist) * FroxelExtent.z; // スライス単位
    // スライス z は奥の境界（z + 1）までの積分値を格納する。
    float4 fog =
        FroxelIntegrated.SampleLevel(LinearClamp, float3(uv, saturate((coordinate - 0.5f) / FroxelExtent.z)), 0);
    if (coordinate < 1)
    {
        fog = lerp(float4(0, 0, 0, 1), fog, saturate(coordinate));
    }
    return fog;
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
// 3. 合成：シーン → PostA（フォグ）。背景にはボリュームの最遠端を使う。
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
[numthreads(8, 8, 1)] void Composite(uint3 id : SV_DispatchThreadID) {
    if (any(id.xy >= Extent.xy))
    {
        return;
    }
    float4 color = SceneColor[id.xy];
    float depth = SceneDepth[id.xy];
    bool physicalSkyPixel = depth <= 0.0f && (Features.x & 2u) != 0 && (Features.x & 4u) == 0;
    if ((Features.x & 1u) != 0 && !physicalSkyPixel)
    {
        float2 uv = (id.xy + 0.5f) / Extent.xy;
        float dist = depth <= 0.0f ? FogDepth.y
                                   : length(WorldFromDepth(uv, depth) - CameraRayOrigin(uv, CameraPosition.xyz, InvViewProjection));
        // 画面空間の小さなディザーで、フロクセルの三線形補間の形状を目立たなくする。
        uint sampleFrame = FogDepth.w > 0 ? Extent.z : 0;
        float dither = (Hash(id.x + id.y * 4099u + sampleFrame * 7919u) - 0.5f) / Extent.x;
        float4 fog = SampleIntegratedFog(uv + dither, dist);
        color.rgb = color.rgb * fog.a + fog.rgb;
    }
    PostAOut[id.xy] = color;
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
// 4. 自動露出：対数輝度ヒストグラム → パーセンタイル平均 → 時間方向の順応。
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
groupshared uint SharedHistogram[kHistogramBins];

[numthreads(64, 1, 1)] void HistogramClear(uint3 id : SV_DispatchThreadID) {
    if (id.x < kHistogramBins)
    {
        Histogram[id.x] = 0;
    }
}

    [numthreads(16, 16, 1)] void HistogramBuild(uint3 id : SV_DispatchThreadID, uint index : SV_GroupIndex)
{
    if (index < kHistogramBins)
    {
        SharedHistogram[index] = 0;
    }
    GroupMemoryBarrierWithGroupSync();
    // 平均の計算には半解像度で十分で、アトミック演算の回数も半減する。
    uint2 pixel = id.xy * 2;
    if (all(pixel < Extent.xy))
    {
        float luminance = dot(PostA[pixel].rgb, float3(0.2126f, 0.7152f, 0.0722f));
        uint bin = 0;
        if (luminance > 0.000001f)
        {
            float normalized = saturate((log2(luminance) - ExposureParams.x) / ExposureParams.y);
            bin = 1 + (uint)(normalized * (kHistogramBins - 2));
        }
        InterlockedAdd(SharedHistogram[bin], 1);
    }
    GroupMemoryBarrierWithGroupSync();
    if (index < kHistogramBins && SharedHistogram[index] != 0)
    {
        InterlockedAdd(Histogram[index], SharedHistogram[index]);
    }
}

[numthreads(64, 1, 1)] void ExposureAdapt(uint3 id : SV_DispatchThreadID, uint index : SV_GroupIndex) {
    SharedHistogram[index] = Histogram[index];
    GroupMemoryBarrierWithGroupSync();
    if (index != 0)
    {
        return;
    }
    // 黒いピクセル（ビン 0）を除き、下位と上位のパーセンタイル間で平均する。
    uint total = 0;
    [loop] for (uint bin = 1; bin < kHistogramBins; ++bin)
    {
        total += SharedHistogram[bin];
    }
    float low = total * ExposureLimits.z;
    float high = total * ExposureLimits.w;
    float sum = 0;
    float weight = 0;
    float cumulative = 0;
    [loop] for (uint bucket = 1; bucket < kHistogramBins; ++bucket)
    {
        float count = SharedHistogram[bucket];
        float begin = cumulative;
        cumulative += count;
        float used = max(min(cumulative, high) - max(begin, low), 0);
        float log2Luminance = ExposureParams.x + (bucket - 0.5f) / (kHistogramBins - 2) * ExposureParams.y;
        sum += log2Luminance * used;
        weight += used;
    }
    float averageLuminance = weight > 0 ? exp2(sum / weight) : 0.18f;
    float target = 0.18f * exp2(ExposureParams.z) / max(averageLuminance, 0.0001f);
    target = clamp(target, ExposureLimits.x, ExposureLimits.y);
    float previous = ExposureState[0];
    bool initialized =
        FogAmbientColor.w < 0.5f && ExposureState[2] > 0.5f && previous > 0 && !isnan(previous) && !isinf(previous);
    // 対数空間で順応させる。目と同様、明るくなる速度は暗くなる速度より遅い。
    float speed = ExposureParams.w * (target > previous ? 0.6f : 1.0f);
    float blend = 1 - exp(-CameraPosition.w * speed);
    float exposure = initialized ? exp2(lerp(log2(previous), log2(target), blend)) : target;
    ExposureState[0] = exposure;
    ExposureState[1] = averageLuminance;
    ExposureState[2] = 1;
}

float CurrentExposure()
{
    return Features.y != 0 ? max(ExposureState[0], 0.000001f) : 1;
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
// 5. 解決：モーションブラーと露出、PostA → PostB。
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
float4 ResolvePixel(uint3 id)
{
    if (any(id.xy >= Extent.xy))
    {
        return 0;
    }
    float4 center = PostA[id.xy];
    float3 color = center.rgb;
    if (Features.z != 0)
    {
        float2 velocity = SceneVelocity[id.xy].zw * Extent.xy * MotionBlurParams.x; // ピクセル単位
        float velocityLength = sqrt(dot(velocity, velocity));
        if (velocityLength > 0.5f)
        {
            velocity *= min(velocityLength, MotionBlurParams.y) / velocityLength;
            float centerDepth = SceneDepth[id.xy];
            uint samples = (uint)MotionBlurParams.z;
            float offset = Hash(id.x * 3u + id.y * 7919u + Extent.z) - 0.5f;
            float3 sum = color;
            float weightSum = 1;
            [loop] for (uint index = 0; index < samples; ++index)
            {
                float t = ((index + 0.5f + offset) / samples) - 0.5f;
                int2 samplePixel = clamp(int2(id.xy + velocity * t), 0, int2(Extent.xy) - 1);
                float sampleDepth = SceneDepth[samplePixel];
                float2 sampleVelocity = SceneVelocity[samplePixel].zw * Extent.xy * MotionBlurParams.x;
                // 背景のサンプルは常に加算する。前景のサンプルはこのピクセルに届くほど
                // 移動した場合だけ加算し、静止した前景が引き伸ばされるのを防ぐ。
                bool behind = sampleDepth <= centerDepth + 0.00002f;
                float reach = sqrt(dot(sampleVelocity, sampleVelocity)) * 0.5f;
                float dist = abs(t) * velocityLength;
                float weight = behind ? 1 : saturate(reach - dist + 1);
                sum += PostA[samplePixel].rgb * weight;
                weightSum += weight;
            }
            color = sum / weightSum;
        }
    }
    return float4(color * CurrentExposure(), center.a);
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
// 6. 被写界深度（散布を収集で近似、黄金角の円盤）、PostB → PostA。
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
float CircleOfConfusion(float2 uv, float depth)
{
    float dist = depth <= 0.0f ? 100000.0f
                               : length(WorldFromDepth(uv, depth) - CameraRayOrigin(uv, CameraPosition.xyz, InvViewProjection));
    float focus = max(DofParams.x, 0.05f);
    float blur = saturate((abs(dist - focus) - DofParams.y * 0.5f) / focus);
    return blur * DofParams.z; // ピクセル単位
}

Texture2D<float4> HalfResolveInput : register(t0, space11);
Texture2D<float4> HalfDofInput : register(t1, space11);
RWTexture2D<float4> HalfResolveOutput : register(u0, space11);
RWTexture2D<float4> HalfDofOutput : register(u1, space11);

cbuffer HalfLensConstants : register(b2)
{
    uint HalfWidth, HalfHeight, HalfHasDof, HalfPadding;
};

static bool UseHalfDofSource = false;

float4 DofSource(int2 pixel)
{
    if (UseHalfDofSource)
    {
        return HalfResolveInput.Load(int3(clamp(pixel / 2, 0, int2(HalfWidth, HalfHeight) - 1), 0));
    }
    return PostB.Load(int3(pixel, 0));
}

float4 DepthOfFieldPixel(uint3 id)
{
    if (any(id.xy >= Extent.xy))
    {
        return 0;
    }
    float2 uv = (id.xy + 0.5f) / Extent.xy;
    float centerDepth = SceneDepth[id.xy];
    float centerCoc = CircleOfConfusion(uv, centerDepth);
    float4 center = DofSource(int2(id.xy));
    float searchRadius = DofParams.z;
    float centerWeight = 1 / max(centerCoc * centerCoc, 1);
    float3 sum = center.rgb * centerWeight;
    float weightSum = centerWeight;
    const uint kSamples = 32;
    float rotation = Hash(id.x + id.y * 7919u) * 6.2831853f;
    [loop] for (uint index = 0; index < kSamples; ++index)
    {
        float radius = sqrt((index + 0.5f) / kSamples) * searchRadius;
        float angle = index * 2.39996323f + rotation;
        float2 offset = float2(cos(angle), sin(angle)) * radius;
        int2 samplePixel = clamp(int2(id.xy + offset), 0, int2(Extent.xy) - 1);
        float sampleDepth = SceneDepth[samplePixel];
        float sampleCoc = CircleOfConfusion((samplePixel + 0.5f) / Extent.xy, sampleDepth);
        // サンプル自身のぼけ円盤がこのピクセルを覆う場合に寄与する。中心より奥のサンプルは
        // 中心のぼけ量で制限し、合焦した前景の鮮明さを保つ。
        float coverage = sampleDepth < centerDepth ? min(sampleCoc, centerCoc) : sampleCoc;
        float weight = saturate(coverage - radius + 1) / max(coverage * coverage, 1);
        sum += DofSource(samplePixel).rgb * weight;
        weightSum += weight;
    }
    return float4(sum / weightSum, center.a);
}

[numthreads(8, 8, 1)] void Resolve(uint3 id : SV_DispatchThreadID) {
    if (all(id.xy < uint2(Extent.xy)))
    {
        PostBOut[id.xy] = ResolvePixel(id);
    }
}

    [numthreads(8, 8, 1)] void DepthOfField(uint3 id : SV_DispatchThreadID)
{
    if (all(id.xy < uint2(Extent.xy)))
    {
        PostAOut[id.xy] = DepthOfFieldPixel(id);
    }
}

[numthreads(8, 8, 1)] void ResolveHalf(uint3 id : SV_DispatchThreadID) {
    if (id.x >= HalfWidth || id.y >= HalfHeight)
    {
        return;
    }
    HalfResolveOutput[id.xy] = ResolvePixel(uint3(min(id.xy * 2 + 1, uint2(Extent.xy) - 1), 0));
}[numthreads(8, 8, 1)] void DofHalf(uint3 id : SV_DispatchThreadID)
{
    if (id.x >= HalfWidth || id.y >= HalfHeight)
    {
        return;
    }
    UseHalfDofSource = true;
    HalfDofOutput[id.xy] = DepthOfFieldPixel(uint3(min(id.xy * 2 + 1, uint2(Extent.xy) - 1), 0));
}
[numthreads(8, 8, 1)] void UpsampleLens(uint3 id : SV_DispatchThreadID) {
    if (any(id.xy >= uint2(Extent.xy)))
    {
        return;
    }
    float depth = SceneDepth[id.xy];
    float2 position = (float2(id.xy) - 1) * .5;
    int2 base = int2(floor(position));
    float2 fraction = frac(position);
    float4 sum = 0;
    float weights = 0;
    [unroll] for (uint y = 0; y < 2; ++y)
    {
        [unroll] for (uint x = 0; x < 2; ++x)
        {
            int2 low = clamp(base + int2(x, y), 0, int2(HalfWidth, HalfHeight) - 1);
            uint2 full = min(uint2(low) * 2 + 1, uint2(Extent.xy) - 1);
            float geometry = exp2(-abs(SceneDepth[full] - depth) / max(2e-5, abs(depth) * .02));
            float2 spatial = lerp(1 - fraction, fraction, float2(x, y));
            float weight = spatial.x * spatial.y * geometry;
            float4 color = HalfHasDof != 0 ? HalfDofInput.Load(int3(low, 0)) : HalfResolveInput.Load(int3(low, 0));
            sum += color * weight;
            weights += weight;
        }
    }
    float4 full = PostA.Load(int3(id.xy, 0));
    full.rgb *= CurrentExposure();
    float motion = Features.z != 0 ? length(SceneVelocity[id.xy].zw * Extent.xy * MotionBlurParams.x) : 0;
    float coc = HalfHasDof != 0 ? CircleOfConfusion((id.xy + .5) / Extent.xy, depth) : 0;
    float blend = saturate(max(motion, coc) - .5);
    PostBOut[id.xy] = weights > 1e-5 ? lerp(full, sum / weights, blend) : full;
}

===== FILE: shader\hlsl\AtmosphereGBufferPS.hlsl =====
#define SHADER_POSTPROCESS
#define SHADER_3D
#include "common.hlsl"
#include "CloudMedium.hlsli"

Texture2D<float4> BaseColorTexture : register(t0);
Texture2D<float4> NormalTexture : register(t1);
Texture2D<float> DepthTexture : register(t2);
Texture2D<float4> MaterialTexture : register(t3);
Texture2D<float4> EnvironmentTexture : register(t6);
Texture2DArray<float> ShadowMapTexture : register(t7);

SamplerState TextureSampler : register(s0);
SamplerComparisonState ShadowSampler : register(s1);

struct LocalFogRayResult
{
    float3 Scattering;
    float Transmittance;
};

int GetAtmosphereStepCount(float viewDistance)
{

    float scale = clamp(Flags.w, 0.25f, 1.0f);
    float lowResolutionWeight = saturate((1.0f - scale) / 0.75f);
    int maxSteps = (int)round(lerp(28.0f, 36.0f, lowResolutionWeight));
    int distanceSteps = (int)ceil(viewDistance / 2.5f);
    return clamp(distanceSteps, 12, maxSteps);
}

float SampleAtmosphereShadowFast(float3 worldPos, Texture2DArray<float> shadowMap, SamplerComparisonState shadowSampler,
                                 float4x4 lightViewProjection, float4 shadowMapParams, float shadowLayer)
{
    float4 lightClip = mul(float4(worldPos, 1.0f), lightViewProjection);
    if (lightClip.w <= 0.000001f)
    {
        return 1.0f;
    }

    float3 lightNdc = lightClip.xyz / lightClip.w;
    float2 shadowUv = float2(lightNdc.x * 0.5f + 0.5f, -lightNdc.y * 0.5f + 0.5f);

    if (any(shadowUv < 0.0f) || any(shadowUv > 1.0f) || lightNdc.z < 0.0f || lightNdc.z > 1.0f)
    {
        return 1.0f;
    }

    float bias = max(shadowMapParams.y, shadowMapParams.z);
    float currentDepth = lightNdc.z - bias;
    float texelSize = shadowMapParams.x * (1.0f + saturate(AtmosphereCamera.w) * 2.0f);

    const float2 offsets[4] = {float2(-0.5f, -0.5f), float2(0.5f, -0.5f), float2(-0.5f, 0.5f), float2(0.5f, 0.5f)};

    float visibility = 0.0f;
    [unroll] for (int tap = 0; tap < 4; ++tap)
    {
        visibility += shadowMap.SampleCmpLevelZero(
            shadowSampler, float3(shadowUv + offsets[tap] * texelSize, shadowLayer), currentDepth);
    }

    visibility *= 0.25f;
    return lerp(1.0f, visibility, saturate(abs(shadowMapParams.w)));
}

float ComputeAtmosphereShadow(float3 samplePos, float3 lightDir, float4 lightPositionTypeData,
                              float4x4 lightViewProjection, float4 shadowParams, float shadowLayer, bool hasShadow,
                              bool directionalMultiLevel, Texture2DArray<float> shadowMap,
                              SamplerComparisonState shadowSampler)
{
    if (!hasShadow)
    {
        return 1.0f;
    }
#ifdef SHADER_RAYTRACING
    if (SceneRayFlags.x > 0.5f)
    {
        float range = lightPositionTypeData.w < 0.5f
                          ? SceneRayParameters.x
                          : min(length(lightPositionTypeData.xyz - samplePos), SceneRayParameters.x);
        return TraceSceneShadow(samplePos, lightDir, lightDir, range);
    }
#endif

    bool directional = lightPositionTypeData.w < 0.5f;

    if (directional && directionalMultiLevel && VirtualShadowGlobal.x > 0.5f && VirtualShadowGlobal.x < 1.5f)
    {
        return SampleVirtualAtmosphereShadowMapCommon(samplePos, shadowMap, shadowSampler);
    }

    if (directional && directionalMultiLevel && VirtualShadowGlobal.x > 1.5f)
    {
        return SampleCascadedAtmosphereShadowMapCommon(samplePos, shadowMap, shadowSampler);
    }

    return SampleAtmosphereShadowFast(samplePos, shadowMap, shadowSampler, lightViewProjection, shadowParams,
                                      shadowLayer);
}

float3 EvaluateAtmosphereLight(float3 viewToCamera, float sampleDensity, float3 singleDir, float singleAttenuation,
                               float singleVolume, float4 lightColorData, float4 lightPositionTypeData,
                               float shadowVisibility)
{
    float3 rawSingleColor = max(lightColorData.rgb, float3(0.0f, 0.0f, 0.0f)) * max(lightColorData.a, 0.0f);
    float3 singleColor = rawSingleColor * singleAttenuation;

    float3 shadowedColor = singleColor * shadowVisibility;
    float localLight = step(0.5f, lightPositionTypeData.w);
    float volumeVisibility = lerp(shadowVisibility, max(shadowVisibility, 0.45f), localLight);
    float3 volumeColor = rawSingleColor * sqrt(saturate(singleAttenuation)) * volumeVisibility;

    float volumeLight = step(2.5f, lightPositionTypeData.w) * step(lightPositionTypeData.w, 3.5f);

    float localVolumeStepBoost = lerp(1.0f, 0.35f / max(AtmosphereParams1.w, 0.0001f), localLight);

    float cosTheta = clamp(dot(-singleDir, viewToCamera), -1.0f, 1.0f);
    float rayleighPhase = RayleighPhaseCommon(cosTheta);
    float miePhase = HenyeyGreensteinCommon(cosTheta, AtmosphereParams1.z);
    float phase = saturate(miePhase * 6.0f);

    float shaftBoost = lerp(0.55f, 1.75f, phase) * lerp(1.0f, 2.35f, volumeLight);

    float3 atmospherePhase = AtmosphereColor0.rgb * max(AtmosphereParams0.y, 0.0f) * rayleighPhase +
                             AtmosphereColor1.rgb * max(AtmosphereParams0.z, 0.0f) * miePhase;
    float3 result = atmospherePhase * sampleDensity * shadowedColor * lerp(1.0f, 0.45f, volumeLight);

    float volumeMediumDensity = lerp(sampleDensity, max(AtmosphereParams0.w, 0.0001f), localLight);

    result += volumeColor * singleVolume * volumeMediumDensity * shaftBoost * localVolumeStepBoost *
              lerp(0.22f, lerp(0.82f, 1.05f, volumeLight), localLight);

    return result;
}

bool IntersectRaySphereSegment(float3 rayOrigin, float3 rayDirection, float maxDistance, float3 sphereCenter,
                               float sphereRadius, out float segmentStart, out float segmentEnd)
{
    float3 offset = rayOrigin - sphereCenter;
    float projected = dot(offset, rayDirection);
    float discriminant = projected * projected - (dot(offset, offset) - sphereRadius * sphereRadius);

    if (discriminant <= 0.0f)
    {
        segmentStart = 0.0f;
        segmentEnd = 0.0f;
        return false;
    }

    float root = sqrt(discriminant);
    segmentStart = max(-projected - root, 0.0f);
    segmentEnd = min(-projected + root, maxDistance);
    return segmentEnd > segmentStart + 0.0001f;
}

bool IntersectRayHorizontalCylinderSegment(float3 rayOrigin, float3 rayDirection, float maxDistance,
                                           float3 cylinderCenter, float cylinderRadius, out float segmentStart,
                                           out float segmentEnd)
{
    float2 offset = rayOrigin.xz - cylinderCenter.xz;
    float2 direction = rayDirection.xz;
    float a = dot(direction, direction);
    float c = dot(offset, offset) - cylinderRadius * cylinderRadius;

    if (a <= 0.000001f)
    {
        segmentStart = 0.0f;
        segmentEnd = c <= 0.0f ? maxDistance : 0.0f;
        return segmentEnd > segmentStart + 0.0001f;
    }

    float b = dot(offset, direction);
    float discriminant = b * b - a * c;
    if (discriminant <= 0.0f)
    {
        segmentStart = 0.0f;
        segmentEnd = 0.0f;
        return false;
    }

    float root = sqrt(discriminant);
    segmentStart = max((-b - root) / a, 0.0f);
    segmentEnd = min((-b + root) / a, maxDistance);
    return segmentEnd > segmentStart + 0.0001f;
}

bool ClipRayToQuadraticInterior(float quadraticA, float quadraticB, float quadraticC, inout float segmentStart,
                                inout float segmentEnd)
{
    const float epsilon = 0.000001f;

    if (abs(quadraticA) <= epsilon)
    {
        if (abs(quadraticB) <= epsilon)
        {
            return quadraticC <= 0.0f;
        }

        float root = -quadraticC / quadraticB;
        if (quadraticB > 0.0f)
        {
            segmentEnd = min(segmentEnd, root);
        }
        else
        {
            segmentStart = max(segmentStart, root);
        }
        return segmentEnd > segmentStart + 0.0001f;
    }

    float discriminant = quadraticB * quadraticB - 4.0f * quadraticA * quadraticC;
    if (discriminant < 0.0f)
    {
        float midpoint = (segmentStart + segmentEnd) * 0.5f;
        float midpointValue = (quadraticA * midpoint + quadraticB) * midpoint + quadraticC;
        return midpointValue <= 0.0f;
    }

    float rootTerm = sqrt(max(discriminant, 0.0f));
    float reciprocalDenominator = 0.5f / quadraticA;
    float root0 = (-quadraticB - rootTerm) * reciprocalDenominator;
    float root1 = (-quadraticB + rootTerm) * reciprocalDenominator;
    if (root0 > root1)
    {
        float swapRoot = root0;
        root0 = root1;
        root1 = swapRoot;
    }

    if (quadraticA > 0.0f)
    {
        segmentStart = max(segmentStart, root0);
        segmentEnd = min(segmentEnd, root1);
        return segmentEnd > segmentStart + 0.0001f;
    }

    if (segmentEnd <= root0 || segmentStart >= root1)
    {
        return true;
    }
    if (segmentStart < root0)
    {
        segmentEnd = min(segmentEnd, root0);
    }
    else if (segmentEnd > root1)
    {
        segmentStart = max(segmentStart, root1);
    }
    else
    {
        return false;
    }
    return segmentEnd > segmentStart + 0.0001f;
}

bool IntersectRayFiniteConeSegment(float3 rayOrigin, float3 rayDirection, float maxDistance, float3 coneOrigin,
                                   float3 coneAxis, float coneLength, float rootRadius, float endRadius,
                                   out float segmentStart, out float segmentEnd)
{
    float3 offset = rayOrigin - coneOrigin;
    float originAxial = dot(offset, coneAxis);
    float directionAxial = dot(rayDirection, coneAxis);

    segmentStart = 0.0f;
    segmentEnd = maxDistance;

    if (abs(directionAxial) <= 0.000001f)
    {
        if (originAxial < 0.0f || originAxial > coneLength)
        {
            return false;
        }
    }
    else
    {
        float cap0 = -originAxial / directionAxial;
        float cap1 = (coneLength - originAxial) / directionAxial;
        float axialStart = min(cap0, cap1);
        float axialEnd = max(cap0, cap1);
        segmentStart = max(segmentStart, axialStart);
        segmentEnd = min(segmentEnd, axialEnd);
        if (segmentEnd <= segmentStart + 0.0001f)
        {
            return false;
        }
    }

    float radiusSlope = (endRadius - rootRadius) / max(coneLength, 0.0001f);
    float radiusAtRayOrigin = rootRadius + radiusSlope * originAxial;
    float radiusAlongRay = radiusSlope * directionAxial;
    float3 offsetRadial = offset - coneAxis * originAxial;
    float3 directionRadial = rayDirection - coneAxis * directionAxial;

    float quadraticA = dot(directionRadial, directionRadial) - radiusAlongRay * radiusAlongRay;
    float quadraticB = 2.0f * (dot(offsetRadial, directionRadial) - radiusAtRayOrigin * radiusAlongRay);
    float quadraticC = dot(offsetRadial, offsetRadial) - radiusAtRayOrigin * radiusAtRayOrigin;

    return ClipRayToQuadraticInterior(quadraticA, quadraticB, quadraticC, segmentStart, segmentEnd);
}

float3 IntegrateVolumeLightRay(float3 rayOrigin, float3 rayDirection, float maxDistance, float4 lightDirectionData,
                               float4 lightColorData, float4 lightPositionTypeData, float4 lightExtraData,
                               float4x4 lightViewProjection, float4 shadowParams, float shadowLayer, bool hasShadow,
                               Texture2DArray<float> shadowMap, SamplerComparisonState shadowSampler)
{
    if ((int)round(lightPositionTypeData.w) != 3 || StageVolumeDensity(lightExtraData.z) <= 0.0001f ||
        lightColorData.a <= 0.0001f)
    {
        return float3(0.0f, 0.0f, 0.0f);
    }

    float lightRange = max(lightDirectionData.w, 0.01f);
    float3 lightForward = SafeNormalizeCommon(lightDirectionData.xyz, float3(0.0f, -1.0f, 0.0f));
    float outerCos = clamp(lightExtraData.y, 0.001f, 0.999f);
    float outerTan = sqrt(saturate(1.0f - outerCos * outerCos)) / outerCos;
    float coneEndRadius = lightRange * outerTan;
    float coneRootRadius = max(coneEndRadius * 0.04f, 0.05f);
    float cylinderRadius = coneEndRadius * 0.45f;
    bool cylinderVolume = lightExtraData.w >= 0.5f;
    float volumeRootRadius = cylinderVolume ? cylinderRadius : coneRootRadius;
    float volumeEndRadius = cylinderVolume ? cylinderRadius : coneEndRadius;

    float segmentStart;
    float segmentEnd;
    if (!IntersectRayFiniteConeSegment(rayOrigin, rayDirection, maxDistance, lightPositionTypeData.xyz, lightForward,
                                       lightRange, volumeRootRadius, volumeEndRadius, segmentStart, segmentEnd))
    {
        return float3(0.0f, 0.0f, 0.0f);
    }
    const int stepCount = 64;
    float segmentLength = segmentEnd - segmentStart;
    float stepLength = segmentLength / (float)stepCount;
    float scaledStep = stepLength * max(AtmosphereParams1.w, 0.0001f);
    float3 viewToCamera = -rayDirection;
    float3 integratedScatter = float3(0.0f, 0.0f, 0.0f);
    float3 sampleStep = rayDirection * stepLength;
    float3 samplePos = rayOrigin + rayDirection * (segmentStart + 0.5f * stepLength);

    [loop] for (int stepIndex = 0; stepIndex < stepCount; ++stepIndex)
    {
        float sampleDistance = segmentStart + ((float)stepIndex + 0.5f) * stepLength;

        float3 singleDir;
        float singleAttenuation;
        float singleVolume;
        ResolveSingleLightCommon(samplePos, lightDirectionData, lightPositionTypeData, lightExtraData, singleDir,
                                 singleAttenuation, singleVolume);

        if (singleVolume <= 0.000001f && singleAttenuation <= 0.000001f)
        {
            continue;
        }

        float shadowVisibility =
            ComputeAtmosphereShadow(samplePos, singleDir, lightPositionTypeData, lightViewProjection, shadowParams,
                                    shadowLayer, hasShadow, false, shadowMap, shadowSampler);
        float sampleDensity = AtmosphereDensityCommon(samplePos);
        float viewTransmittance =
            exp(-max(AtmosphereParams1.y, 0.0f) * sampleDensity * sampleDistance * max(AtmosphereParams1.w, 0.0001f));

        integratedScatter +=
            EvaluateAtmosphereLight(viewToCamera, sampleDensity, singleDir, singleAttenuation, singleVolume,
                                    lightColorData, lightPositionTypeData, shadowVisibility) *
            viewTransmittance * scaledStep;

        samplePos += sampleStep;
    }

    return integratedScatter;
}

float3 RayMarchAtmosphereViewFixed(float3 worldPos, Texture2DArray<float> shadowMap,
                                   SamplerComparisonState shadowSampler, float4x4 lightViewProjection,
                                   float4 shadowMapParams)
{
    [branch] if (AtmosphereParams0.x < 0.5f || AtmosphereColor0.a <= 0.0001f || AtmosphereParams0.w <= 0.0001f)
    {
        return float3(0.0f, 0.0f, 0.0f);
    }

    float3 cameraPos = ReconstructPostProcessCameraOriginCommon(worldPos, AtmosphereCamera.xyz);
    float3 viewDelta = worldPos - cameraPos;
    float rawViewDistance = length(viewDelta);

    if (rawViewDistance <= 0.0001f)
    {
        return float3(0.0f, 0.0f, 0.0f);
    }

    float viewDistance = min(rawViewDistance, 100.0f);
    int stepCount = GetAtmosphereStepCount(viewDistance);
    float3 viewDir = viewDelta / rawViewDistance;
    float3 viewToCamera = -viewDir;
    float stepLength = viewDistance / (float)stepCount;
    float scaledStep = stepLength * max(AtmosphereParams1.w, 0.0001f);

    float transmittance = 1.0f;
    float3 result = float3(0.0f, 0.0f, 0.0f);
    int count = min((int)round(LocalFogGlobal.y), 5);
    float3 sampleStep = viewDir * stepLength;
    float3 samplePos = cameraPos + sampleStep * 0.5f;

    float cachedShadowVisibility[5];
    [unroll] for (int cacheIndex = 0; cacheIndex < 5; ++cacheIndex)
    {
        cachedShadowVisibility[cacheIndex] = 1.0f;
    }

    float legacyShadowVisibility = 1.0f;
    float cachedCloudVisibility = 1.0f;

    [loop] for (int stepIndex = 0; stepIndex < stepCount; ++stepIndex)
    {
        float3 stepScatter = float3(0.0f, 0.0f, 0.0f);
        float sampleDensity = AtmosphereDensityCommon(samplePos);

        bool updateShadow = (stepIndex & 3) == 0;

        [loop] for (int instanceIndex = 0; instanceIndex < count; ++instanceIndex)
        {
            int lightIndex = (int)VolumetricLightIndices[instanceIndex];
            if (LightFlags[lightIndex].z < 0.5f || LightFlags[lightIndex].w >= 0.5f)
            {
                continue;
            }

            if ((int)round(LightPositionTypes[lightIndex].w) == 3)
            {
                continue;
            }

            float3 singleDir;
            float singleAttenuation;
            float singleVolume;
            ResolveSingleLightCommon(samplePos, LightDirections[lightIndex], LightPositionTypes[lightIndex],
                                     LightExtras[lightIndex], singleDir, singleAttenuation, singleVolume);

            if (updateShadow)
            {
                bool hasShadow = SceneLightCastsShadowCommon(lightIndex, LightShadowData[lightIndex].x >= -0.5f);
                bool directionalMultiLevel = LightShadowData[lightIndex].w < 0.0f;

                float4 perLightShadowParams = float4(LightShadowData[lightIndex].y, LightShadowData[lightIndex].z,
                                                     LightShadowData[lightIndex].w, 1.0f);

                cachedShadowVisibility[lightIndex] = ComputeAtmosphereShadow(
                    samplePos, singleDir, LightPositionTypes[lightIndex], LightViewProjections[lightIndex],
                    perLightShadowParams, LightShadowData[lightIndex].x, hasShadow, directionalMultiLevel, shadowMap,
                    shadowSampler);
            }

            float visibility = cachedShadowVisibility[lightIndex];
            if (lightIndex == CloudSunIndex())
            {
                if (updateShadow)
                {
                    cachedCloudVisibility = CloudSunVisibility(samplePos);
                }
                visibility *= cachedCloudVisibility;
            }
            stepScatter +=
                EvaluateAtmosphereLight(viewToCamera, sampleDensity, singleDir, singleAttenuation, singleVolume,
                                        LightColors[lightIndex], LightPositionTypes[lightIndex], visibility);
        }

        if (count <= 0 && (int)round(LightPositionType.w) != 3)
        {
            float3 singleDir;
            float singleAttenuation;
            float singleVolume;
            ResolveSingleLightCommon(samplePos, LightDirection, LightPositionType, LightExtra, singleDir,
                                     singleAttenuation, singleVolume);

            if (updateShadow)
            {
                legacyShadowVisibility =
                    ComputeAtmosphereShadow(samplePos, singleDir, LightPositionType, lightViewProjection,
                                            shadowMapParams, 0.0f, true, false, shadowMap, shadowSampler);
            }

            stepScatter += EvaluateAtmosphereLight(viewToCamera, sampleDensity, singleDir, singleAttenuation,
                                                   singleVolume, LightColor, LightPositionType, legacyShadowVisibility);
        }

        result += stepScatter * transmittance * scaledStep;

        transmittance *= exp(-max(AtmosphereParams1.y, 0.0f) * sampleDensity * scaledStep);

        if (transmittance <= 0.01f)
        {
            break;
        }

        samplePos += sampleStep;
    }

    [loop] for (int instanceIndex = 0; instanceIndex < count; ++instanceIndex)
    {
        int volumeIndex = (int)VolumetricLightIndices[instanceIndex];
        if (LightFlags[volumeIndex].z < 0.5f || LightFlags[volumeIndex].w >= 0.5f ||
            (int)round(LightPositionTypes[volumeIndex].w) != 3)
        {
            continue;
        }

        float4 perLightShadowParams = float4(LightShadowData[volumeIndex].y, LightShadowData[volumeIndex].z,
                                             LightShadowData[volumeIndex].w, 1.0f);
        result += IntegrateVolumeLightRay(
            cameraPos, viewDir, viewDistance, LightDirections[volumeIndex], LightColors[volumeIndex],
            LightPositionTypes[volumeIndex], LightExtras[volumeIndex], LightViewProjections[volumeIndex],
            perLightShadowParams, LightShadowData[volumeIndex].x,
            SceneLightCastsShadowCommon(volumeIndex, LightShadowData[volumeIndex].x >= -0.5f), shadowMap,
            shadowSampler);
    }

    if (count <= 0 && (int)round(LightPositionType.w) == 3)
    {
        result += IntegrateVolumeLightRay(cameraPos, viewDir, viewDistance, LightDirection, LightColor,
                                          LightPositionType, LightExtra, lightViewProjection, shadowMapParams, 0.0f,
                                          true, shadowMap, shadowSampler);
    }

    return result * max(AtmosphereColor0.a, 0.0f);
}

LocalFogRayResult IntegrateLocalFogRay(float3 rayEnd)
{
    LocalFogRayResult result;
    result.Scattering = float3(0.0f, 0.0f, 0.0f);
    result.Transmittance = 1.0f;

    int fogCount = min((int)round(LocalFogGlobal.x), 16);
    if (fogCount <= 0)
    {
        return result;
    }

    float3 cameraPos = ReconstructPostProcessCameraOriginCommon(rayEnd, PPCameraPos.xyz);
    float3 viewDelta = rayEnd - cameraPos;
    float rawDistance = length(viewDelta);

    if (rawDistance <= 0.0001f)
    {
        return result;
    }

    float viewDistance = min(rawDistance, 100.0f);
    float3 viewDir = viewDelta / rawDistance;

    float totalOpticalDepth = 0.0f;
    float3 opticalDepthColor = float3(0.0f, 0.0f, 0.0f);

    [loop] for (int fogIndex = 0; fogIndex < fogCount; ++fogIndex)
    {
        float4 data0 = LocalFogData0[fogIndex];
        float4 data1 = LocalFogData1[fogIndex];
        if (data1.w < 0.5f || data1.y <= 0.00001f)
        {
            continue;
        }

        float radius = max(data0.w, 0.01f);
        bool sphereFog = data1.z >= 0.5f;
        float segmentStart;
        float segmentEnd;
        bool intersects = sphereFog ? IntersectRaySphereSegment(cameraPos, viewDir, viewDistance, data0.xyz, radius,
                                                                segmentStart, segmentEnd)
                                    : IntersectRayHorizontalCylinderSegment(cameraPos, viewDir, viewDistance, data0.xyz,
                                                                            radius, segmentStart, segmentEnd);

        if (!intersects)
        {
            continue;
        }

        const int stepCount = 24;
        float segmentLength = segmentEnd - segmentStart;
        float stepLength = segmentLength / (float)stepCount;
        float densityIntegral = 0.0f;
        float3 sampleStep = viewDir * stepLength;
        float3 samplePos = cameraPos + viewDir * (segmentStart + 0.5f * stepLength);

        [loop] for (int stepIndex = 0; stepIndex < stepCount; ++stepIndex)
        {
            float3 delta = samplePos - data0.xyz;
            float horizontal = saturate(1.0f - length(delta.xz) / radius);
            float heightWeight = exp(-abs(delta.y) * max(data1.x, 0.0001f));
            float sphereWeight = saturate(1.0f - length(delta) / radius);
            float volumeWeight = sphereFog ? sphereWeight : horizontal * heightWeight;

            densityIntegral += volumeWeight * max(data1.y, 0.0f) * stepLength;

            samplePos += sampleStep;
        }

        float opticalDepth = densityIntegral * 0.08f;
        totalOpticalDepth += opticalDepth;
        opticalDepthColor += LocalFogColors[fogIndex].rgb * opticalDepth;
    }

    result.Transmittance = exp(-totalOpticalDepth);
    if (totalOpticalDepth > 0.00001f)
    {
        float3 fogColor = opticalDepthColor / totalOpticalDepth;
        result.Scattering = fogColor * (1.0f - result.Transmittance);
    }

    return result;
}

float4 main(PSInputPostProcess input) : SV_Target
{
    float depth = DepthTexture.SampleLevel(TextureSampler, input.TexCoord, 0);
    float4 material = MaterialTexture.SampleLevel(TextureSampler, input.TexCoord, 0);

    bool background = material.a < -0.5f || depth <= 0.0f;

    float3 viewRay = ReconstructPostProcessViewRayCommon(input.TexCoord);
    float3 rayEnd = background ? CameraRayOrigin(input.TexCoord, PPCameraPos.xyz, PPInvViewProjection) + viewRay * 100.0f
                               : ReconstructPostProcessWorldPositionCommon(input.TexCoord, depth);

    float3 scatter =
        RayMarchAtmosphereViewFixed(rayEnd, ShadowMapTexture, ShadowSampler, LightViewProjection, ShadowMapParams);

    LocalFogRayResult localFog = IntegrateLocalFogRay(rayEnd);

    float3 participatingMedia = scatter * localFog.Transmittance + localFog.Scattering;
    return float4(participatingMedia, localFog.Transmittance);
}

===== FILE: shader\hlsl\AtmosphereLutCommon.hlsli =====
#ifndef ATMOSPHERE_LUT_COMMON_HLSLI
#define ATMOSPHERE_LUT_COMMON_HLSLI
// 大気 LUT の共通パラメーター化（Hillaire 2020、論文「A Scalable and Production
// Ready Sky and Atmosphere Rendering Technique」）。構築側の AtmosphereLutCS.hlsl と
// 参照側の SkyAtmosphere.hlsli が使うため、両者で同一に保つ。

static const float kLutGroundRadius = 6360000.0f;
static const float kLutAtmosphereRadius = 6460000.0f;
static const float kLutPi = 3.14159265f;
static const uint2 kTransmittanceLutSize = uint2(256, 64);
static const uint2 kMultiScatterLutSize = uint2(32, 32);
static const uint2 kSkyViewLutSize = uint2(192, 108);

// --- 透過率（光学的厚さ）LUT：Bruneton の (r, mu) マッピング ---
float2 TransmittanceLutUv(float radius, float mu)
{
    float H = sqrt(kLutAtmosphereRadius * kLutAtmosphereRadius - kLutGroundRadius * kLutGroundRadius);
    float rho = sqrt(max(radius * radius - kLutGroundRadius * kLutGroundRadius, 0.0f));
    float discriminant = radius * radius * (mu * mu - 1.0f) + kLutAtmosphereRadius * kLutAtmosphereRadius;
    float d = max(-radius * mu + sqrt(max(discriminant, 0.0f)), 0.0f);
    float dMin = kLutAtmosphereRadius - radius;
    float dMax = rho + H;
    float xMu = (d - dMin) / max(dMax - dMin, 1.0f);
    float xR = rho / H;
    return float2(xMu, xR);
}

void TransmittanceLutParameters(float2 uv, out float radius, out float mu)
{
    float H = sqrt(kLutAtmosphereRadius * kLutAtmosphereRadius - kLutGroundRadius * kLutGroundRadius);
    float rho = H * uv.y;
    radius = sqrt(rho * rho + kLutGroundRadius * kLutGroundRadius);
    float dMin = kLutAtmosphereRadius - radius;
    float dMax = rho + H;
    float d = dMin + uv.x * (dMax - dMin);
    mu = d == 0.0f ? 1.0f : (H * H - rho * rho - d * d) / (2.0f * radius * d);
    mu = clamp(mu, -1.0f, 1.0f);
}

// --- 空の表示 LUT：（太陽の相対方位角の平方根、地平線付近の非線形な天頂角）---
void SkyViewHorizon(float viewHeight, out float beta, out float zenithHorizonAngle)
{
    float vHorizon = sqrt(max(viewHeight * viewHeight - kLutGroundRadius * kLutGroundRadius, 0.0f));
    beta = acos(clamp(vHorizon / viewHeight, -1.0f, 1.0f));
    zenithHorizonAngle = kLutPi - beta;
}

float2 SkyViewLutUv(float3 direction, float3 sun, float viewHeight)
{
    float beta, zenithHorizonAngle;
    SkyViewHorizon(viewHeight, beta, zenithHorizonAngle);
    float viewZenith = acos(clamp(direction.y, -1.0f, 1.0f));
    float v;
    if (viewZenith < zenithHorizonAngle)
    {
        float coord = 1.0f - sqrt(max(1.0f - viewZenith / zenithHorizonAngle, 0.0f));
        v = coord * 0.5f;
    }
    else
    {
        v = sqrt(saturate((viewZenith - zenithHorizonAngle) / max(beta, 0.00001f))) * 0.5f + 0.5f;
    }
    float2 view = direction.xz;
    float2 light = sun.xz;
    float viewLength = length(view);
    float lightLength = length(light);
    float cosAzimuth =
        viewLength > 0.00001f && lightLength > 0.00001f ? dot(view / viewLength, light / lightLength) : 1.0f;
    float u = sqrt(acos(clamp(cosAzimuth, -1.0f, 1.0f)) / kLutPi);
    // [0,1] が最初から最後のテクセル中心を覆うように再マッピングする。
    float2 size = float2(kSkyViewLutSize);
    return (float2(u, v) * (size - 1.0f) + 0.5f) / size;
}

float3 SkyViewLutDirection(float2 texel, float3 sun, float viewHeight)
{
    float2 size = float2(kSkyViewLutSize);
    float2 uv = texel / (size - 1.0f); // テクセル番号 → テクセル中心における [0,1]
    float beta, zenithHorizonAngle;
    SkyViewHorizon(viewHeight, beta, zenithHorizonAngle);
    float viewZenith;
    if (uv.y < 0.5f)
    {
        float coord = 1.0f - 2.0f * uv.y;
        viewZenith = zenithHorizonAngle * (1.0f - coord * coord);
    }
    else
    {
        float coord = uv.y * 2.0f - 1.0f;
        viewZenith = zenithHorizonAngle + beta * coord * coord;
    }
    float relativeAzimuth = uv.x * uv.x * kLutPi;
    float sunAzimuth = length(sun.xz) > 0.00001f ? atan2(sun.z, sun.x) : 0.0f;
    float azimuth = sunAzimuth + relativeAzimuth;
    float sinZenith = sin(viewZenith);
    return float3(sinZenith * cos(azimuth), cos(viewZenith), sinZenith * sin(azimuth));
}

// --- 多重散乱 LUT：（太陽天頂角の cos、高度）---
float2 MultiScatterLutUv(float radius, float sunCosZenith)
{
    float2 uv = float2(sunCosZenith * 0.5f + 0.5f,
                       saturate((radius - kLutGroundRadius) / (kLutAtmosphereRadius - kLutGroundRadius)));
    float2 size = float2(kMultiScatterLutSize);
    return (uv * (size - 1.0f) + 0.5f) / size;
}

#endif

===== FILE: shader\hlsl\AtmosphereLutCS.hlsl =====
// =============================================================================================
// AtmosphereLutCS.hlsl - 物理的な空の LUT（利用可能なら非同期コンピュートキューで実行）
// TransmittanceLut：(r, mu) から大気上端までの光学的厚さ（レイリー、ミー）。
// 惑星の形状だけに依存するため、一度だけ構築する。
// MultiScatterLut：Hillaire 2020 の等方的な多重散乱伝達 Psi_ms(h, mu_s)。
// 大気の係数が変化したときに再構築する。
// SkyViewLut：このフレームのカメラ高度と太陽方向に対する入射散乱の放射輝度（rgb）と
// 視線方向の透過率（rgb）。毎フレーム構築する。
// 密度モデルと係数は EvaluatePhysicalSky（SkyAtmosphere.hlsli）と同一。
// =============================================================================================
#include "AtmosphereLutCommon.hlsli"

cbuffer AtmosphereLutConstants : register(b0)
{
    float4 SunDirection; // xyz = 正規化済み
    float4 Coefficients; // x = レイリー散乱の強度、y = ミー散乱の強度、z = 密度、w = ミー散乱の g
    float4 Parameters;   // x = カメラ高度（m）、y = 多重散乱の強度、z = 地表のアルベド
};

Texture2D<float2> TransmittanceLut : register(t0);
Texture2D<float4> MultiScatterLut : register(t1);
RWTexture2D<float4> Output0 : register(u0);
RWTexture2D<float4> Output1 : register(u1);
RWTexture2D<float2> OutputDepth : register(u2);
SamplerState LinearClamp : register(s0);

float2 RaySphere(float3 origin, float3 direction, float radius)
{
    float projected = dot(origin, direction);
    float discriminant = projected * projected - dot(origin, origin) + radius * radius;
    if (discriminant < 0.0f)
    {
        return float2(-1, -1);
    }
    float root = sqrt(discriminant);
    return float2(-projected - root, -projected + root);
}

float2 Density(float3 position)
{
    float altitude = max(length(position) - kLutGroundRadius, 0.0f);
    return exp(-altitude / float2(8000.0f, 1200.0f));
}

void Betas(out float3 betaRayleigh, out float3 betaMie)
{
    float densityScale = max(Coefficients.z, 0.0f) / 0.36f;
    betaRayleigh = float3(5.8e-6f, 13.5e-6f, 33.1e-6f) * max(Coefficients.x, 0.0f) / 0.42f * densityScale;
    betaMie = 21e-6f * max(Coefficients.y, 0.0f) / 0.075f * densityScale;
}

float2 SunOpticalDepth(float3 position, float3 sun)
{
    float radius = length(position);
    float mu = dot(position / radius, sun);
    return TransmittanceLut.SampleLevel(LinearClamp, TransmittanceLutUv(radius, mu), 0);
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
[numthreads(8, 8, 1)] void BuildTransmittance(uint3 id : SV_DispatchThreadID) {
    if (any(id.xy >= kTransmittanceLutSize))
    {
        return;
    }
    float radius, mu;
    TransmittanceLutParameters((id.xy + 0.5f) / float2(kTransmittanceLutSize), radius, mu);
    float3 origin = float3(0, radius, 0);
    float3 direction = float3(sqrt(saturate(1 - mu * mu)), mu, 0);
    float distance = max(RaySphere(origin, direction, kLutAtmosphereRadius).y, 0.0f);
    const int steps = 64;
    float stepLength = distance / steps;
    float2 depth = 0;
    [loop] for (int index = 0; index < steps; ++index)
    {
        depth += Density(origin + direction * ((index + 0.5f) * stepLength)) * stepLength;
    }
    OutputDepth[id.xy] = depth;
}

    // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    [numthreads(8, 8, 1)] void BuildMultiScatter(uint3 id : SV_DispatchThreadID)
{
    if (any(id.xy >= kMultiScatterLutSize))
    {
        return;
    }
    float2 uv = id.xy / (float2(kMultiScatterLutSize) - 1.0f);
    float sunCos = uv.x * 2 - 1;
    float radius = kLutGroundRadius + max(uv.y * (kLutAtmosphereRadius - kLutGroundRadius), 10.0f);
    float3 origin = float3(0, radius, 0);
    float3 sun = float3(sqrt(saturate(1 - sunCos * sunCos)), sunCos, 0);
    float3 betaRayleigh, betaMie;
    Betas(betaRayleigh, betaMie);
    const float isotropicPhase = 1.0f / (4.0f * kLutPi);
    const uint directionsPerAxis = 8;
    const int steps = 20;
    float3 secondOrder = 0;
    float3 transfer = 0;
    [loop] for (uint sample = 0; sample < directionsPerAxis * directionsPerAxis; ++sample)
    {
        // 球面方向を一様に層別サンプリングする。
        float2 cell = (float2(sample % directionsPerAxis, sample / directionsPerAxis) + 0.5f) / directionsPerAxis;
        float cosTheta = 1 - 2 * cell.y;
        float sinTheta = sqrt(saturate(1 - cosTheta * cosTheta));
        float phi = 2 * kLutPi * cell.x;
        float3 direction = float3(sinTheta * cos(phi), cosTheta, sinTheta * sin(phi));
        float groundDistance = RaySphere(origin, direction, kLutGroundRadius).x;
        bool hitsGround = groundDistance > 0;
        float distance = hitsGround ? groundDistance : max(RaySphere(origin, direction, kLutAtmosphereRadius).y, 0.0f);
        float stepLength = distance / steps;
        float3 throughput = 1;
        float3 luminance = 0;
        float3 multiScatterAsOne = 0;
        [loop] for (int index = 0; index < steps; ++index)
        {
            float3 position = origin + direction * ((index + 0.5f) * stepLength);
            float2 density = Density(position);
            float3 scattering = betaRayleigh * density.x + betaMie * density.y;
            float3 extinction = max(scattering, 1e-9f);
            float3 stepTransmittance = exp(-extinction * stepLength);
            float3 sunTransmittance = 0;
            if (RaySphere(position, sun, kLutGroundRadius).x <= 0)
            {
                float2 sunDepth = SunOpticalDepth(position, sun);
                sunTransmittance = exp(-betaRayleigh * sunDepth.x - betaMie * sunDepth.y);
            }
            float3 source = sunTransmittance * scattering * isotropicPhase;
            float3 integrated = (source - source * stepTransmittance) / extinction;
            luminance += throughput * integrated;
            multiScatterAsOne += throughput * (scattering - scattering * stepTransmittance) / extinction;
            throughput *= stepTransmittance;
        }
        if (hitsGround)
        {
            float3 groundPoint = origin + direction * groundDistance;
            float3 groundNormal = normalize(groundPoint);
            float2 sunDepth = SunOpticalDepth(groundPoint, sun);
            float3 sunTransmittance = exp(-betaRayleigh * sunDepth.x - betaMie * sunDepth.y);
            luminance += throughput * sunTransmittance * saturate(dot(groundNormal, sun)) * Parameters.z / kLutPi;
        }
        secondOrder += luminance;
        transfer += multiScatterAsOne;
    }
    const float sampleWeight = 4.0f * kLutPi / (directionsPerAxis * directionsPerAxis);
    float3 inScattered = secondOrder * sampleWeight * isotropicPhase;
    float3 multiScatterAs1 = transfer * sampleWeight * isotropicPhase;
    float3 psi = inScattered / max(1.0f - multiScatterAs1, 0.001f);
    Output0[id.xy] = float4(psi, 1);
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
