[numthreads(8, 8, 1)] void BuildSkyView(uint3 id : SV_DispatchThreadID) {
    if (any(id.xy >= kSkyViewLutSize))
    {
        return;
    }
    float altitude = max(Parameters.x, 2.0f);
    float3 origin = float3(0, kLutGroundRadius + altitude, 0);
    float3 sun = normalize(SunDirection.xyz);
    float3 direction = SkyViewLutDirection(float2(id.xy), sun, origin.y);
    float endDistance = max(RaySphere(origin, direction, kLutAtmosphereRadius).y, 0.0f);
    float groundDistance = RaySphere(origin, direction, kLutGroundRadius).x;
    if (groundDistance > 0)
    {
        endDistance = min(endDistance, groundDistance);
    }
    float3 betaRayleigh, betaMie;
    Betas(betaRayleigh, betaMie);

    const int steps = 32;
    float stepDistance = endDistance / steps;
    float2 viewDepth = 0;
    float3 rayleigh = 0;
    float3 mie = 0;
    float3 multiple = 0;
    [loop] for (int index = 0; index < steps; ++index)
    {
        float3 position = origin + direction * ((index + 0.5f) * stepDistance);
        float2 localDepth = Density(position) * stepDistance;
        viewDepth += localDepth * 0.5f;
        float3 viewTransmission = exp(-betaRayleigh * viewDepth.x - betaMie * viewDepth.y);
        float radius = length(position);
        if (RaySphere(position, sun, kLutGroundRadius).x <= 0)
        {
            float2 sunDepth = SunOpticalDepth(position, sun);
            float2 totalDepth = viewDepth + sunDepth;
            float3 transmission = exp(-betaRayleigh * totalDepth.x - betaMie * totalDepth.y);
            rayleigh += localDepth.x * transmission;
            mie += localDepth.y * transmission;
        }
        // 多重散乱は全方向から到来するため、惑星による影を適用しない。
        float3 psi =
            MultiScatterLut.SampleLevel(LinearClamp, MultiScatterLutUv(radius, dot(position / radius, sun)), 0).rgb;
        multiple += (betaRayleigh * localDepth.x + betaMie * localDepth.y) * psi * viewTransmission;
        viewDepth += localDepth * 0.5f;
    }
    float cosine = dot(direction, sun);
    float rayleighPhase = 3.0f / (16.0f * kLutPi) * (1.0f + cosine * cosine);
    float g = clamp(Coefficients.w, -0.95f, 0.95f);
    float g2 = g * g;
    float denominator = max(1.0f + g2 - 2.0f * g * cosine, 0.0001f);
    float miePhase = (1.0f - g2) / (4.0f * kLutPi * denominator * sqrt(denominator));
    float3 scatter =
        rayleigh * betaRayleigh * rayleighPhase + mie * betaMie * miePhase + multiple * max(Parameters.y, 0.0f);
    Output0[id.xy] = float4(scatter, 1);
    Output1[id.xy] = float4(exp(-betaRayleigh * viewDepth.x - betaMie * viewDepth.y), 1);
}

===== FILE: shader\hlsl\BlasQuantizeCS.hlsl =====
// =============================================================================================
// BlasQuantizeCS.hlsl - DXR BLAS 入力頂点を R16G16B16A16_SNORM へ量子化する。
// 1 グループ（256 スレッド）が 1 頂点ソースを担当し、
//   1) 位置の AABB をグループ共有メモリでリダクション
//   2) AABB 中心・半径で正規化して 16bit SNORM に書き出し
//   3) 復元用の 3x4 行列（行優先）を先頭 48 バイトに書き出す
// BLAS 構築時は Triangles.Transform3x4 にこの行列を指定するため、BLAS 空間は元のオブジェクト空間の
// まま（TLAS のインスタンス行列・ヒット位置・法線計算は変更不要）。
// 出力レイアウト: [0..47] float3x4 / [48..63] float4(最小値, 最大値の x) 予約 / [64..] 頂点 8 バイト
// =============================================================================================
cbuffer QuantizeConstants : register(b0)
{
    uint VertexCount;
    uint Stride;
    uint Reserved0;
    uint Reserved1;
};

ByteAddressBuffer SourceVertices : register(t0);
RWByteAddressBuffer PackedVertices : register(u0);

static const uint kThreads = 256;
static const uint kPositionOffset = 64;

groupshared float3 s_Min[kThreads];
groupshared float3 s_Max[kThreads];

bool IsFinitePosition(float3 p)
{
    return all(abs(p) < 3.0e38f); // NaN は比較が偽になるため除外される
}

int Snorm16(float value)
{
    return (int)round(clamp(value, -1.0f, 1.0f) * 32767.0f);
}

[numthreads(kThreads, 1, 1)] void main(uint groupIndex : SV_GroupIndex)
{
    float3 lo = 3.0e38f;
    float3 hi = -3.0e38f;
    for (uint v = groupIndex; v < VertexCount; v += kThreads)
    {
        float3 p = asfloat(SourceVertices.Load3(v * Stride));
        if (IsFinitePosition(p))
        {
            lo = min(lo, p);
            hi = max(hi, p);
        }
    }
    s_Min[groupIndex] = lo;
    s_Max[groupIndex] = hi;
    GroupMemoryBarrierWithGroupSync();
    [unroll] for (uint step = kThreads / 2; step > 0; step >>= 1)
    {
        if (groupIndex < step)
        {
            s_Min[groupIndex] = min(s_Min[groupIndex], s_Min[groupIndex + step]);
            s_Max[groupIndex] = max(s_Max[groupIndex], s_Max[groupIndex + step]);
        }
        GroupMemoryBarrierWithGroupSync();
    }
    lo = s_Min[0];
    hi = s_Max[0];
    if (any(lo > hi))
    {
        lo = 0.0f;
        hi = 0.0f;
    }
    const float3 center = (lo + hi) * 0.5f;
    // ゼロ幅の軸でも 0 除算しない。
    const float3 halfExtent = max((hi - lo) * 0.5f, 1.0e-6f);
    const float3 inverse = 1.0f / halfExtent;
    if (groupIndex == 0)
    {
        // 行優先 3x4: x' = halfExtent.x * q.x + center.x（DXR の Transform3x4 と同じ並び）
        PackedVertices.Store4(0, asuint(float4(halfExtent.x, 0.0f, 0.0f, center.x)));
        PackedVertices.Store4(16, asuint(float4(0.0f, halfExtent.y, 0.0f, center.y)));
        PackedVertices.Store4(32, asuint(float4(0.0f, 0.0f, halfExtent.z, center.z)));
        PackedVertices.Store4(48, asuint(float4(lo.x, lo.y, lo.z, hi.x)));
    }
    for (uint v = groupIndex; v < VertexCount; v += kThreads)
    {
        float3 p = asfloat(SourceVertices.Load3(v * Stride));
        // 非有限値は中心へ寄せる（元の BLAS では非アクティブ三角形になる頂点）。
        p = IsFinitePosition(p) ? p : center;
        const int3 q = int3(Snorm16((p.x - center.x) * inverse.x), Snorm16((p.y - center.y) * inverse.y),
                            Snorm16((p.z - center.z) * inverse.z));
        PackedVertices.Store2(kPositionOffset + v * 8,
                              uint2((uint(q.x) & 0xffffu) | (uint(q.y) << 16), uint(q.z) & 0xffffu));
    }
}

===== FILE: shader\hlsl\BloomCS.hlsl =====
#include "noise.hlsl"

// =============================================================================================
// BloomCS.hlsl - 物理ベースのブルーム（二重フィルターのミップチェーン）、レンズフレア、画面空間の
// 雨と雪。AdvancedEffects 内でトーンマッピング前の線形 HDR シーンへ適用する。
// BloomDownsample：13 タップのフィルター（Jimenez 2014、CoD:AW）。レベル 0 ではソフトなしきい値と
// Karis 平均を加えて輝点ノイズを抑える。
// BloomUpsample：3x3 テント、up[i] = down[i] + tent(up[i+1]) * radius
// BloomCombine：エネルギー保存の合成 + レンズフレア（Chapman のゴーストとハロー）+ 天候。
// =============================================================================================
cbuffer BloomConstants : register(b0)
{
    uint2 DestinationSize;
    uint2 SourceSize;
    float Threshold;     // 0 = しきい値なし
    float Radius;        // アップサンプリングの散布量
    float Intensity;     // 最終的な合成量
    float Normalization; // 1 / (1 + r + r^2 + ...)
    float FlareIntensity;
    float FlareHalo;
    float RainIntensity;
    float SnowIntensity;
    float Time;
    float WindX;
    uint FirstLevel;
    uint Flags; // bit0 = ブルーム、bit1 = フレア、bit2 = 雨、bit3 = 雪、bit4 = 太陽のレンズフレア
};

// 太陽のレンズフレア（AdvancedEffects::SunFlareConstants と同じ並び）
cbuffer SunFlareConstants : register(b1)
{
    float2 SunUv;      // 太陽の画面 UV（画面外のこともある）
    float SunVisible;  // 画面内 / 高度によるフェード
    float SunAspect;   // 幅 / 高さ
    float3 SunColor;   // 太陽光の色 × 強度（線形 HDR）
    float SunFlareIntensity;
    float SunGlare;
    float SunStarburst;
    float SunGhosts;
    float SunHalo;
    float SunAnamorphic;
    float SunBlades;
    float SunRotation;
    float SunUnused;
};

Texture2D<float4> Source0 : register(t0);
Texture2D<float4> Source1 : register(t1);
Texture2D<float4> Source2 : register(t2);
Texture2D<float> SceneDepth : register(t3);
RWTexture2D<float4> Destination : register(u0);
SamplerState LinearClamp : register(s0);

#include "Half16.hlsli"

static const float3 kLuma = float3(0.2126f, 0.7152f, 0.0722f);

// ダウン/アップサンプルのフィルター演算は 16bit（対応 GPU）で行う。加算は重み付きで逐次行い、
// 中間値が入力の最大値を超えないようにして FP16 のオーバーフローを避ける。
// 明るい画素の重みは FP16 の非正規化数域（< 6.1e-5）に入るため、重みと正規化は float で行う。
float KarisWeight(hfloat3 color)
{
    return 1.0f / (1.0f + dot((float3)color, kLuma));
}

hfloat3 SoftThreshold(hfloat3 color)
{
    if (Threshold <= 0.0f)
    {
        return color;
    }
    // しきい値の計算はスカラー 1 回なので float で行い、係数だけ 16bit に戻す。
    float brightness = max(color.r, max(color.g, color.b));
    float knee = Threshold * 0.5f;
    float soft = clamp(brightness - Threshold + knee, 0.0f, 2.0f * knee);
    soft = soft * soft / (4.0f * knee + 0.00001f);
    float contribution = max(soft, brightness - Threshold) / max(brightness, 0.00001f);
    return color * (hfloat)contribution;
}

hfloat3 SampleSource0(float2 uv)
{
    return ToHalf3(Source0.SampleLevel(LinearClamp, uv, 0).rgb);
}

hfloat3 SampleSource1(float2 uv)
{
    return ToHalf3(Source1.SampleLevel(LinearClamp, uv, 0).rgb);
}

// 4 値の平均（逐次加算でオーバーフローしない）
hfloat3 Average4(hfloat3 a, hfloat3 b, hfloat3 c, hfloat3 d)
{
    const hfloat quarter = (hfloat)0.25f;
    return a * quarter + b * quarter + c * quarter + d * quarter;
}

[numthreads(8, 8, 1)] void BloomDownsample(uint3 id : SV_DispatchThreadID) {
    if (any(id.xy >= DestinationSize))
    {
        return;
    }
    float2 uv = (id.xy + 0.5f) / DestinationSize;
    float2 t = 1.0f / SourceSize;
    hfloat3 a = SampleSource0(uv + t * float2(-2, -2));
    hfloat3 b = SampleSource0(uv + t * float2(0, -2));
    hfloat3 c = SampleSource0(uv + t * float2(2, -2));
    hfloat3 d = SampleSource0(uv + t * float2(-2, 0));
    hfloat3 e = SampleSource0(uv);
    hfloat3 f = SampleSource0(uv + t * float2(2, 0));
    hfloat3 g = SampleSource0(uv + t * float2(-2, 2));
    hfloat3 h = SampleSource0(uv + t * float2(0, 2));
    hfloat3 i = SampleSource0(uv + t * float2(2, 2));
    hfloat3 j = SampleSource0(uv + t * float2(-1, -1));
    hfloat3 k = SampleSource0(uv + t * float2(1, -1));
    hfloat3 l = SampleSource0(uv + t * float2(-1, 1));
    hfloat3 m = SampleSource0(uv + t * float2(1, 1));
    hfloat3 result;
    if (FirstLevel != 0)
    {
        // 2x2 グループごとの Karis 平均で、チェーン全体から単独ピクセルの輝点ノイズを除く。
        hfloat3 g0 = Average4(j, k, l, m);
        hfloat3 g1 = Average4(a, b, d, e);
        hfloat3 g2 = Average4(b, c, e, f);
        hfloat3 g3 = Average4(d, e, g, h);
        hfloat3 g4 = Average4(e, f, h, i);
        float w0 = KarisWeight(g0) * 0.5f;
        float w1 = KarisWeight(g1) * 0.125f;
        float w2 = KarisWeight(g2) * 0.125f;
        float w3 = KarisWeight(g3) * 0.125f;
        float w4 = KarisWeight(g4) * 0.125f;
        float3 weighted = (float3)g0 * w0 + (float3)g1 * w1 + (float3)g2 * w2 + (float3)g3 * w3 + (float3)g4 * w4;
        result = ToHalf3(weighted / max(w0 + w1 + w2 + w3 + w4, 0.0001f));
        result = SoftThreshold(result);
    }
    else
    {
        // 重みの総和は 1。逐次加算で中間値が最大値を超えない。
        const hfloat corner = (hfloat)0.03125f, edge = (hfloat)0.0625f, inner = (hfloat)0.125f;
        result = e * inner;
        result += a * corner + c * corner + g * corner + i * corner;
        result += b * edge + d * edge + f * edge + h * edge;
        result += j * inner + k * inner + l * inner + m * inner;
    }
    Destination[id.xy] = float4(max((float3)result, 0.0f), 1.0f);
}

    [numthreads(8, 8, 1)] void BloomUpsample(uint3 id : SV_DispatchThreadID)
{
    if (any(id.xy >= DestinationSize))
    {
        return;
    }
    float2 uv = (id.xy + 0.5f) / DestinationSize;
    float2 t = 1.0f / SourceSize; // 下位の粗いレベルのサイズ
    // 3x3 テント（重み 4/16, 2/16, 1/16）。重みを先に掛けて加算する。
    const hfloat centerWeight = (hfloat)0.25f, edgeWeight = (hfloat)0.125f, cornerWeight = (hfloat)0.0625f;
    hfloat3 tent = SampleSource1(uv) * centerWeight;
    tent += SampleSource1(uv + t * float2(-1, 0)) * edgeWeight + SampleSource1(uv + t * float2(1, 0)) * edgeWeight +
            SampleSource1(uv + t * float2(0, -1)) * edgeWeight + SampleSource1(uv + t * float2(0, 1)) * edgeWeight;
    tent += SampleSource1(uv + t * float2(-1, -1)) * cornerWeight +
            SampleSource1(uv + t * float2(1, -1)) * cornerWeight +
            SampleSource1(uv + t * float2(-1, 1)) * cornerWeight + SampleSource1(uv + t * float2(1, 1)) * cornerWeight;
    // 最後の合成は float（current + tent * Radius は FP16 の範囲を超え得る）。
    float3 current = Source0.SampleLevel(LinearClamp, uv, 0).rgb;
    Destination[id.xy] = float4(current + (float3)tent * Radius, 1.0f);
}



float3 LensFlare(float2 uv)
{
    float2 flipped = 1.0f - uv;
    float2 ghostVector = (0.5f - flipped) * 0.37f;
    float3 result = 0.0f;
    [unroll] for (int ghost = 0; ghost < 5; ++ghost)
    {
        float2 offset = frac(flipped + ghostVector * ghost);
        float weight = pow(saturate(1.0f - length(0.5f - offset) / 0.7071f), 8.0f);
        // 色収差：各チャンネルをゴーストの軸に沿って少しずらす。
        float2 shift = normalize(ghostVector + 0.00001f) * 0.006f;
        float3 sample =
            float3(Source2.SampleLevel(LinearClamp, offset + shift, 0).r, Source2.SampleLevel(LinearClamp, offset, 0).g,
                   Source2.SampleLevel(LinearClamp, offset - shift, 0).b);
        result += max(sample - 1.0f, 0.0f) * weight * (ghost == 0 ? 0.5f : 1.0f);
    }
    float2 haloVector = normalize(ghostVector + 0.00001f) * 0.42f;
    float2 haloUv = frac(flipped + haloVector);
    float haloWeight = pow(saturate(1.0f - length(0.5f - haloUv) / 0.7071f), 5.0f);
    result += max(Source2.SampleLevel(LinearClamp, haloUv, 0).rgb - 1.0f, 0.0f) * haloWeight * FlareHalo * 4.0f;
    // コーティングされた光学系に似た分光的な色調（中心は暖色、端は寒色）。
    float radial = length(uv - 0.5f) * 1.4f;
    return result * lerp(float3(1.0f, 0.85f, 0.7f), float3(0.6f, 0.75f, 1.0f), saturate(radial));
}

// 視差の異なる 3 層の落下する筋。シーンが照らされている場所ほど明るい。
float RainLayer(float2 uv, float scale, float speed, float slant, float seed)
{
    float2 p = float2(uv.x * scale + uv.y * slant * scale, uv.y * scale * 0.12f - Time * speed);
    float2 cell = floor(p);
    float2 local = frac(p);
    float random = Hash21(cell + seed);
    if (random > 0.35f)
    {
        return 0.0f;
    }
    float x = abs(local.x - frac(0.2f + random * 1.6f));
    float streak = saturate(1.0f - x * scale * 0.9f);
    float y = frac(local.y + random * 7.0f);
    float lengthMask = smoothstep(0.0f, 0.15f, y) * smoothstep(0.75f, 0.35f, y);
    return streak * streak * lengthMask;
}

float SnowLayer(float2 uv, float scale, float speed, float seed, float aspect)
{
    float2 p = float2(uv.x * aspect, uv.y) * scale;
    p.y -= Time * speed;
    p.x += sin(Time * 0.7f + p.y * 0.8f + seed) * 0.35f + Time * WindX * 0.5f;
    float2 cell = floor(p);
    float2 local = frac(p) - 0.5f;
    float random = Hash21(cell + seed);
    if (random > 0.45f)
    {
        return 0.0f;
    }
    float2 center = (float2(Hash21(cell + 3.1f + seed), Hash21(cell + 7.7f + seed)) - 0.5f) * 0.6f;
    float radius = 0.06f + random * 0.08f;
    return smoothstep(radius, radius * 0.4f, length(local - center));
}

// =============================================================================================
// 太陽のレンズフレア（大気シミュレーションの太陽から生成。参照：実写の逆光）
//  ・グレア     : 太陽の周りの明るいにじみ（ベーリンググレア）
//  ・光芒       : 絞り羽根の回折による放射状の光条（羽根の枚数 × 2 本）と細かい筋
//  ・ゴースト   : 太陽 → 画面中心 → 反対側の軸上に並ぶ、絞りの形（多角形）の反射像。縁は色収差で虹色
//  ・ハロー     : 太陽を囲む淡い虹色のリング
//  ・ストリーク : アナモルフィックレンズ風の横長の光（任意）
//  遮蔽は 8x8 グループ単位で、太陽の円盤の周りの深度 64 点を調べて空の割合を求める（建物・木の裏で消える）
// =============================================================================================
groupshared float gs_SunOcclusion[64];

float SunFlareHash(float x)
{
    return frac(sin(x * 127.1f) * 43758.5453f);
}

// 正 N 角形（中心からの距離を多角形の内接円で正規化）。N が大きいほど円に近い
float PolygonDistance(float2 p, float blades, float rotation)
{
    const float sector = 6.28318530718f / blades;
    float angle = atan2(p.y, p.x) + rotation;
    float local = fmod(angle + 31.4159265f * blades, sector) - sector * 0.5f; // 正の剰余
    return length(p) * cos(local) / cos(sector * 0.5f);
}

// 1 つのゴースト。R/G/B で半径を少し変えて縁に色収差を出す
float3 SunGhost(float2 p, float2 center, float radius, float3 tint, float ringWeight)
{
    float3 result;
    [unroll] for (int channel = 0; channel < 3; ++channel)
    {
        const float r = radius * (1.0f + (channel - 1) * 0.035f);
        const float d = PolygonDistance(p - center, SunBlades, SunRotation * 2.0f) / r;
        const float body = smoothstep(1.0f, 0.82f, d); // 内側は塗り、縁はやわらかく
        const float ring = exp(-pow((d - 0.94f) * 14.0f, 2.0f));
        result[channel] = body * (0.55f + 0.45f * d) + ring * ringWeight;
    }
    return result * tint;
}

float SunOcclusionTap(uint index)
{
    // 太陽の円盤（視直径 約 0.5 度）より少し広い範囲を、黄金角のらせんで 64 点
    const float t = (index + 0.5f) / 64.0f;
    const float angle = index * 2.39996323f;
    const float radius = sqrt(t) * 0.012f;
    float2 uv = SunUv + float2(cos(angle) / max(SunAspect, 0.01f), sin(angle)) * radius;
    if (any(uv < 0.0f) || any(uv > 1.0f))
    {
        return 1.0f; // 画面外の部分は遮蔽物が分からないので見えているとみなす
    }
    // 逆 Z：空（何も描かれていない）は深度 0
    return SceneDepth.SampleLevel(LinearClamp, uv, 0) <= 0.0f ? 1.0f : 0.0f;
}

float3 SunLensFlare(float2 uv, float visibility)
{
    // アスペクト補正した画面中心基準の座標
    const float2 aspect = float2(SunAspect, 1.0f);
    const float2 p = (uv - 0.5f) * aspect;
    const float2 sun = (SunUv - 0.5f) * aspect;
    const float2 toSun = p - sun;
    const float distance = length(toSun);
    const float3 sunLight = SunColor * (SunFlareIntensity * visibility);
    float3 result = 0.0f;

    // ---- グレア：芯の明るい点 + 広いにじみ（距離の逆二乗で減衰）
    const float core = 1.0f / (1.0f + pow(distance * 90.0f, 2.0f));
    const float veil = 1.0f / (1.0f + pow(distance * 9.0f, 2.0f));
    result += (core * 2.0f + veil * 0.12f) * SunGlare;

    // ---- 光芒：羽根の数 × 2 本の主光条 + ハッシュで揺らした細い筋
    {
        const float angle = atan2(toSun.y, toSun.x) - SunRotation;
        const float rays = pow(abs(cos(angle * SunBlades * 0.5f)), 220.0f);
        const float fine = SunFlareHash(floor((angle + 3.14159265f) * 60.0f));
        const float streaks = pow(abs(cos(angle * 37.0f + fine * 6.28f)), 60.0f) * fine;
        const float falloff = 1.0f / (1.0f + distance * 7.0f) * exp(-distance * 2.2f);
        result += (rays * 0.9f + streaks * 0.35f) * falloff * 0.6f * SunStarburst;
    }

    // ---- ゴースト：太陽と画面中心を結ぶ軸上（反対側へ伸びる）
    if (SunGhosts > 0.0f)
    {
        // 太陽が画面中心に近いほどゴーストが重なって明るい
        const float centered = saturate(1.0f - length(sun) * 0.9f);
        // 位置（軸上の比率：1 = 太陽、0 = 中心、負 = 反対側）、半径、色
        static const float3 kGhosts[8] = {float3(0.62f, 0.016f, 0.0f), float3(0.35f, 0.035f, 1.0f),
                                          float3(0.12f, 0.010f, 2.0f), float3(-0.18f, 0.060f, 3.0f),
                                          float3(-0.42f, 0.022f, 4.0f), float3(-0.70f, 0.105f, 5.0f),
                                          float3(-1.05f, 0.040f, 6.0f), float3(-1.40f, 0.150f, 7.0f)};
        static const float3 kTints[8] = {float3(1.0f, 0.65f, 0.30f), float3(0.35f, 1.0f, 0.55f),
                                         float3(1.0f, 0.85f, 0.45f), float3(0.55f, 0.35f, 1.0f),
                                         float3(0.40f, 0.95f, 0.65f), float3(0.70f, 0.40f, 0.95f),
                                         float3(1.0f, 0.55f, 0.35f), float3(0.45f, 0.65f, 1.0f)};
        float3 ghosts = 0.0f;
        [unroll] for (int ghost = 0; ghost < 8; ++ghost)
        {
            const float2 center = sun * kGhosts[ghost].x;
            const float radius = kGhosts[ghost].y * (1.0f + length(sun) * 0.6f);
            // 小さいゴーストは明るく、大きいものは淡く（同じ光量が広がる）
            const float brightness = 0.02f / (radius + 0.02f);
            ghosts += SunGhost(p, center, radius, kTints[ghost], 0.6f) * brightness;
        }
        result += ghosts * 0.04f * (0.35f + 0.65f * centered) * SunGhosts;
    }

    // ---- ハロー：太陽を囲む虹色のリング（波長ごとに半径を変える）
    if (SunHalo > 0.0f)
    {
        float3 halo;
        [unroll] for (int channel = 0; channel < 3; ++channel)
        {
            const float radius = 0.30f + channel * 0.012f;
            halo[channel] = exp(-pow((distance - radius) * 38.0f, 2.0f));
        }
        result += halo * 0.012f * SunHalo;
    }

    // ---- アナモルフィック・ストリーク
    if (SunAnamorphic > 0.0f)
    {
        const float streak = exp(-abs(toSun.y) * 260.0f) * exp(-abs(toSun.x) * 1.6f);
        result += streak * float3(0.55f, 0.75f, 1.0f) * 0.08f * SunAnamorphic;
    }
    return result * sunLight;
}

[numthreads(8, 8, 1)] void BloomCombine(uint3 id : SV_DispatchThreadID, uint groupIndex : SV_GroupIndex) {
    // 太陽の遮蔽（グループ全体で 64 点を分担）。早期 return より前に行う（バリアを全スレッドで通過させる）
    float sunVisibility = 0.0f;
    if ((Flags & 16u) != 0)
    {
        gs_SunOcclusion[groupIndex] = SunOcclusionTap(groupIndex);
        GroupMemoryBarrierWithGroupSync();
        [unroll] for (uint stride = 32; stride > 0; stride >>= 1)
        {
            if (groupIndex < stride)
            {
                gs_SunOcclusion[groupIndex] += gs_SunOcclusion[groupIndex + stride];
            }
            GroupMemoryBarrierWithGroupSync();
        }
        // 一部が隠れると急に暗くなる（実際のフレアも絞りに入る光量にほぼ比例）
        sunVisibility = (gs_SunOcclusion[0] / 64.0f) * SunVisible;
    }
    if (any(id.xy >= DestinationSize))
    {
        return;
    }
    float2 uv = (id.xy + 0.5f) / DestinationSize;
    float3 color = Source0[id.xy].rgb;
    float3 bloom = 0.0f;
    if ((Flags & 1u) != 0)
    {
        bloom = Source1.SampleLevel(LinearClamp, uv, 0).rgb * Normalization;
        // エネルギー保存：ブルームは光を追加せず、再分配する。
        color = lerp(color, bloom, Intensity);
    }
    if ((Flags & 2u) != 0)
    {
        color += LensFlare(uv) * FlareIntensity * 0.05f;
    }
    if ((Flags & 16u) != 0 && sunVisibility > 0.0001f)
    {
        color += SunLensFlare(uv, sunVisibility);
    }
    float ambient = dot(bloom, kLuma) + 0.02f;
    if ((Flags & 4u) != 0)
    {
        float aspect = DestinationSize.x / (float)DestinationSize.y;
        float2 rainUv = float2(uv.x * aspect, uv.y);
        float rain = RainLayer(rainUv, 70.0f, 2.6f, WindX * 0.25f, 1.0f) * 0.5f +
                     RainLayer(rainUv, 45.0f, 2.0f, WindX * 0.22f, 2.0f) * 0.35f +
                     RainLayer(rainUv, 28.0f, 1.5f, WindX * 0.2f, 3.0f) * 0.25f;
        color += rain * RainIntensity * (0.03f + ambient * 0.6f);
    }
    if ((Flags & 8u) != 0)
    {
        float aspect = DestinationSize.x / (float)DestinationSize.y;
        float snow = SnowLayer(uv, 26.0f, 0.10f, 1.0f, aspect) * 0.6f + SnowLayer(uv, 14.0f, 0.06f, 5.0f, aspect) +
                     SnowLayer(uv, 8.0f, 0.04f, 9.0f, aspect) * 1.2f;
        color = lerp(color, max(color, (0.35f + ambient * 2.0f).xxx), saturate(snow * SnowIntensity));
    }
    Destination[id.xy] = float4(color, 1.0f);
}

#include "MeshletCullingCommon.hlsli"

[numthreads(64, 1, 1)] void Reset(uint3 id : SV_DispatchThreadID) {
    if (id.x < 16)
    {
        Statistics.Store(id.x * 4, 0);
    }
}[numthreads(1, 1, 1)] void main()
{
    uint count = min(Statistics.Load(4), Capacity);
    uint x = min(count, 65535u);
    uint y = count ? (count + x - 1) / x : 1;
    Arguments.Store3(0, uint3(x, y, 1));
}

===== FILE: shader\hlsl\CameraProjection.hlsli =====
#ifndef CAMERA_PROJECTION_HLSLI
#define CAMERA_PROJECTION_HLSLI

bool CameraProjectionIsOrthographic(float4x4 inverseViewProjection)
{
    return abs(inverseViewProjection[2][3]) < 1e-6f;
}

float3 CameraRayDirection(float2 uv, float4x4 inverseViewProjection)
{
    float2 ndc = uv * float2(2, -2) + float2(-1, 1);
    float4 nearPoint = mul(float4(ndc, 1, 1), inverseViewProjection);
    float4 farPoint = mul(float4(ndc, 0, 1), inverseViewProjection);
    // Homogeneous subtraction works for both finite orthographic points and
    // the perspective direction at infinity (farPoint.w == 0).
    return normalize(farPoint.xyz * nearPoint.w - nearPoint.xyz * farPoint.w);
}

float3 CameraRayOriginFromWorld(float3 worldPosition, float3 cameraPosition, float4x4 inverseViewProjection)
{
    if (!CameraProjectionIsOrthographic(inverseViewProjection))
    {
        return cameraPosition;
    }
    float3 direction = CameraRayDirection(float2(0.5, 0.5), inverseViewProjection);
    return worldPosition - direction * dot(worldPosition - cameraPosition, direction);
}

float3 CameraRayOrigin(float2 uv, float3 cameraPosition, float4x4 inverseViewProjection)
{
    float2 ndc = uv * float2(2, -2) + float2(-1, 1);
    float4 nearPoint = mul(float4(ndc, 1, 1), inverseViewProjection);
    return CameraRayOriginFromWorld(nearPoint.xyz / nearPoint.w, cameraPosition, inverseViewProjection);
}

float3 CameraViewDirection(float3 worldPosition, float3 cameraPosition, float4x4 inverseViewProjection)
{
    return CameraProjectionIsOrthographic(inverseViewProjection)
               ? -CameraRayDirection(float2(0.5, 0.5), inverseViewProjection)
               : normalize(cameraPosition - worldPosition + 1e-20f);
}

#endif

===== FILE: shader\hlsl\CelestialLighting.hlsli =====
#ifndef CELESTIAL_LIGHTING
#define CELESTIAL_LIGHTING

// 仮想の満月は太陽と逆の軌道をたどる。全パスで共有する。
float3 VirtualMoonDirection()
{
    const float lengthSquared = dot(SkySunDirection.xyz, SkySunDirection.xyz);
    if (lengthSquared < 0.00000001f)
    {
        // 独立したマテリアルプレビューには天体の光源方向がない。
        return float3(0.0f, -1.0f, 0.0f);
    }
    return -SkySunDirection.xyz * rsqrt(lengthSquared);
}

float3 VirtualMoonIrradiance()
{
    float visibility = smoothstep(0.0, 0.08, VirtualMoonDirection().y);
    return float3(0.55, 0.65, 0.80) * visibility * SkyParameters.x;
}

// 球状の大気。浅い角度のレイでは受光点付近を密にサンプリングする。
float3 CelestialAtmosphereTransmission(float altitude, float3 direction)
{
    const float radius = 6360000.0;
    float3 origin = float3(0, radius + max(altitude, 2.0), 0);
    float projection = dot(origin, direction);
    float groundDiscriminant = projection * projection - dot(origin, origin) + radius * radius;
    if (groundDiscriminant >= 0 && -projection - sqrt(groundDiscriminant) > 0)
    {
        return 0;
    }
    float distance = -projection + sqrt(max(projection * projection - dot(origin, origin) + 6460000.0 * 6460000.0, 0));
    float2 depth = 0;
    [unroll] for (uint i = 0; i < 8; ++i)
    {
        float a = float(i) / 8.0;
        float b = float(i + 1) / 8.0;
        float height = max(length(origin + direction * (0.5 * (a * a + b * b) * distance)) - radius, 0);
        depth += exp(-height / float2(8000, 1200)) * ((b * b - a * a) * distance);
    }
    float scale = max(AtmosphereParams0.w, 0) / 0.36;
    float3 rayleigh = float3(5.8e-6, 13.5e-6, 33.1e-6) * max(AtmosphereParams0.y, 0) / 0.42 * scale;
    float mie = 21e-6 * max(AtmosphereParams0.z, 0) / 0.075 * scale;
    return exp(-rayleigh * depth.x - mie * depth.y);
}
#endif

===== FILE: shader\hlsl\CloudCommon.hlsli =====
#ifndef CLOUD_COMMON
#define CLOUD_COMMON
#define SHADER_POSTPROCESS
#include "common.hlsl"
#include "CelestialLighting.hlsli"

Texture2D<float> CloudSceneDepth : register(t30);
Texture2D<float4> CloudScatteringTransmittance : register(t33);
Texture2D<float2> CloudDepth : register(t34);
Texture2D<float4> CloudSceneMaterial : register(t35);
#include "CloudMedium.hlsli"

float SceneRayDistance(float2 uv)
{
    uint2 pixel = min(uint2(uv * CloudExtent.xy), uint2(CloudExtent.xy) - 1);
    // DeferredLightingPS と合わせ、空と環境のメッシュは遮蔽物ではなく背景として扱う。
    if (CloudSceneMaterial.Load(int3(pixel, 0)).a < -0.5)
    {
        return CloudTrace.x;
    }
    float depth = CloudSceneDepth.Load(int3(pixel, 0));
    if (depth <= 0.0f)
    {
        return CloudTrace.x;
    }
    float3 origin = CameraRayOrigin(uv, PPCameraPos.xyz, PPInvViewProjection);
    return min(length(ReconstructPostProcessWorldPositionCommon(uv, depth) - origin), CloudTrace.x);
}

struct CloudOutput
{
    float4 Color : SV_Target0; // RGB = 散乱、A = 透過率。不透明度ではない。
    float2 Depth : SV_Target1; // シーンのレイ距離、不透明度で重み付けした雲のレイ距離。
};

CloudOutput MarchCloud(float2 uv, float2 pixel)
{
    CloudOutput output;
    output.Color = float4(0, 0, 0, 1);
    if (CloudQuality.z > 0)
    {
        output.Color = float4(0, 0, 0, 0);
    }
    if (CloudQuality.z == 2 || CloudQuality.z == 4)
    {
        output.Color.rgb = 1;
    }
    float sceneDistance = SceneRayDistance(uv);
    output.Depth = float2(sceneDistance, CloudTrace.x);
    if (CloudQuality.z >= 6)
    {
        float3 noiseUv = float3(uv, CloudTrace.y);
        float noise = CloudQuality.z == 6 ? CloudBaseNoise.SampleLevel(CloudWrap, noiseUv, 0)
                                          : CloudDetailNoise.SampleLevel(CloudWrap, noiseUv, 0);
        output.Color = float4(noise.xxx, 0);
        return output;
    }
    float3 ray = ReconstructPostProcessViewRayCommon(uv);
    float3 origin = CameraRayOrigin(uv, PPCameraPos.xyz, PPInvViewProjection);
    float2 intervals[4];
    uint intervalCount = CloudIntervals(origin, ray, sceneDistance, intervals);
    if (intervalCount == 0)
    {
        return output;
    }
    float2 heightBounds = CloudHeightBounds();
    float3 sunDirection = SafeNormalizeCommon(SkySunDirection.xyz, float3(0, 1, 0));
    float3 sunRadiance = 0;
    int sunIndex = CloudSunIndex();
    if (sunIndex >= 0)
    {
        sunRadiance = max(LightColors[sunIndex].rgb * LightColors[sunIndex].w, 0);
    }
    float3 moonDirection = VirtualMoonDirection();
    float3 moonRadiance = VirtualMoonIrradiance() * CelestialAtmosphereTransmission(heightBounds.x, moonDirection);
    const float sunCosine = dot(ray, sunDirection);
    const float moonCosine = dot(ray, moonDirection);
    float3 solarBottom = sunRadiance * CelestialAtmosphereTransmission(heightBounds.x, sunDirection);
    float3 solarTop = sunRadiance * CelestialAtmosphereTransmission(heightBounds.y, sunDirection);
    const bool sunLit = any(solarTop > 0) && sunDirection.y > -0.02;
    const bool moonLit = any(moonRadiance > 0) && moonDirection.y > 0;
    float twilight = smoothstep(-0.12, 0.04, sunDirection.y) * (1 - smoothstep(0.04, 0.30, sunDirection.y));
    float3 ambientColor = lerp(float3(0.006, 0.009, 0.016),
                               max(AtmosphereColor0.rgb, 0) * max(SkyParameters.z, 0) * 0.05, SkyParameters.y);
    ambientColor = lerp(ambientColor, float3(0.12, 0.035, 0.018) * max(SkyParameters.z, 0) * 0.05, twilight);
    float3 ambient = ambientColor * CloudLighting.y;
    // 光マーチの長さ：雲の厚みに比例（数 km の全区間ではなく、自己遮蔽に効く範囲）
    const float layerThickness = max(heightBounds.y - heightBounds.x, 1.0);
    const float lightMarchLength = clamp(layerThickness * 0.6, 50.0, 3000.0);
    // ピクセルごとに安定した IGN。時間方向の再投影がないため、フレームごとに乱数を変えない。
    float jitter = frac(52.9829189 * frac(dot(pixel, float2(0.06711056, 0.00583715))));
    float offset = lerp(0.5, jitter, CloudLighting.w);
    float transmittance = 1;
    float3 scattering = 0;
    float3 debugLighting = 0;
    float densityIntegral = 0;
    float depthWeight = 0;
    float weightedDepth = 0;
    uint steps = 0;
    float occupiedDistance = 0;
    const float extinction = max(CloudShape.w, 0.000001);
    [loop] for (uint interval = 0; interval < intervalCount; ++interval)
    {
        float intervalStart = intervals[interval].x;
        float intervalLength = intervals[interval].y - intervalStart;
        occupiedDistance += intervalLength;
        // 最適化：空白は 4 倍の粗いステップ（基本形状のみ）で進み、雲に当たったら 1 ステップ戻って細かく進む。
        // 細かいステップは従来と同じ長さ（区間 / ステップ数）なので、密な部分の品質は落ちない。
        const float fineStep = intervalLength / max((float)CloudQuality.x, 1.0);
        const float coarseStep = fineStep * 4.0;
        float distance = intervalStart + offset * fineStep;
        bool fine = false;
        uint emptyRun = 0;
        const uint maxIterations = CloudQuality.x * 3u + 8u;
        [loop] for (uint iteration = 0; iteration < maxIterations && distance < intervals[interval].y; ++iteration)
        {
            float3 position = origin + ray * distance;
            if (!fine)
            {
                // 粗い探索
                ++steps;
                if (CloudDensityLod(position, false) < 0.00001 && CloudQuality.z != 3)
                {
                    distance += coarseStep;
                    continue;
                }
                // 雲に入った：1 粗ステップ分戻って細かいステップへ
                fine = true;
                emptyRun = 0;
                distance = max(intervalStart + offset * fineStep, distance - coarseStep + fineStep);
                continue;
            }
            ++steps;
            float density = CloudDensity(position);
            if (density < 0.00001 && CloudQuality.z != 3)
            {
                // 連続して空なら粗い探索へ戻る
                if (++emptyRun >= 6)
                {
                    fine = false;
                }
                distance += fineStep;
                continue;
            }
            emptyRun = 0;
            float heightFraction = saturate((position.y - heightBounds.x) / layerThickness);
            float3 solarIncident = lerp(solarBottom, solarTop, heightFraction);

            // ---- 光の透過（指数間隔の光マーチ）
            float sunDepth = sunLit ? CloudMarchOpticalDepth(position, sunDirection, lightMarchLength) : 0;
            float moonDepth = moonLit ? CloudMarchOpticalDepth(position, moonDirection, lightMarchLength) : 0;

            // ---- 多重散乱の近似（Wrenninge 2013 のオクターブ法）
            //  オクターブごとに消散 a^n、寄与 b^n、位相の異方性 c^n を下げる。
            //  厚い雲の内部が真っ黒にならず、明るい縁と柔らかな陰影になる。
            float3 sunLight = 0;
            float3 moonLight = 0;
            float contribution = 1;
            float attenuation = 1;
            float anisotropy = 1;
            [unroll] for (uint octave = 0; octave < 3; ++octave)
            {
                float g = CloudLighting.x * anisotropy;
                sunLight += contribution * exp(-sunDepth * extinction * attenuation) * CloudDualPhase(sunCosine, g);
                moonLight += contribution * exp(-moonDepth * extinction * attenuation) * CloudDualPhase(moonCosine, g);
                contribution *= 0.5;
                attenuation *= 0.4;
                anisotropy *= 0.5;
            }
            // 3 オクターブの合計（1 + 0.5 + 0.25）で正規化し、薄い雲の明るさは従来と揃える
            sunLight *= 1.0 / 1.75;
            moonLight *= 1.0 / 1.75;
            float powder = 1 + CloudLighting.z * (1 - exp(-2 * density)); // 従来と同じパウダー効果
            // 環境光：雲の上部ほど空に開けていて明るい
            float3 ambientSample = ambient * lerp(0.45, 1.25, heightFraction);
            float3 lighting = (solarIncident * sunLight * (sunLit ? 1 : 0) + moonRadiance * moonLight * (moonLit ? 1 : 0)) *
                                  powder +
                              ambientSample;

            // ---- ステップ内の解析積分（散乱アルベド 1）：ステップ長が変わっても明るさが変わらない
            float sampleT = exp(-density * extinction * fineStep);
            float weight = transmittance * (1 - sampleT);
            scattering += weight * lighting;
            debugLighting += lighting;
            densityIntegral += density * fineStep;
            weightedDepth += distance * weight;
            depthWeight += weight;
            transmittance *= sampleT;
            distance += fineStep;
            if (transmittance < 0.01)
            {
                break;
            }
        }
        if (transmittance < 0.01)
        {
            break;
        }
    }
    output.Color = float4(scattering, transmittance);
    output.Depth.y = depthWeight > 0.000001 ? weightedDepth / depthWeight : CloudTrace.x;
    if (CloudQuality.z == 1)
    {
        output.Color = float4(saturate(densityIntegral / max(occupiedDistance, 0.0001)).xxx, 0);
    }
    if (CloudQuality.z == 2)
    {
        output.Color = float4(transmittance.xxx, 0);
    }
    if (CloudQuality.z == 3)
    {
        output.Color = float4(debugLighting / max((float)steps, 1), 0);
    }
    if (CloudQuality.z == 4)
    {
        output.Color = float4((output.Depth.y / CloudTrace.x).xxx, 0);
    }
    if (CloudQuality.z == 5)
    {
        output.Color = float4(saturate(float(steps) / (CloudQuality.x * intervalCount)).xxx, 0);
    }
    return output;
}
#endif

===== FILE: shader\hlsl\CloudCompositePS.hlsl =====
#include "CloudCommon.hlsli"

float4 main(PSInputPostProcess input) : SV_Target0
{
    float distance = SceneRayDistance(input.TexCoord);
    float2 position = input.TexCoord * CloudExtent.zw - 0.5;
    int2 origin = int2(floor(position));
    float2 fraction = frac(position);
    float4 cloud = 0;
    float totalWeight = 0;
    [unroll] for (int y = 0; y < 2; ++y)
    {
        [unroll] for (int x = 0; x < 2; ++x)
        {
            int2 coord = clamp(origin + int2(x, y), int2(0, 0), int2(CloudExtent.zw) - 1);
            float sceneDistance = CloudDepth.Load(int3(coord, 0)).x;
            float difference = abs(sceneDistance - distance);
            float tolerance = max(0.1, distance * 0.02);
            float depthWeight = exp(-difference / tolerance);
            // 前景と背景の互換性のないサンプルを完全に除外する。
            if (difference > tolerance * 4)
            {
                depthWeight = 0;
            }
            float2 bilinear = lerp(1 - fraction, fraction, float2(x, y));
            float weight = bilinear.x * bilinear.y * depthWeight;
            cloud += CloudScatteringTransmittance.Load(int3(coord, 0)) * weight;
            totalWeight += weight;
        }
    }
    if (totalWeight < 0.0001)
    {
        return MarchCloud(input.TexCoord, input.Position.xy).Color;
    }
    return cloud / totalWeight;
}

===== FILE: shader\hlsl\CloudMedium.hlsli =====
#ifndef CLOUD_MEDIUM
#define CLOUD_MEDIUM
Texture3D<float> CloudBaseNoise : register(t31);
Texture3D<float> CloudDetailNoise : register(t32);
SamplerState CloudWrap : register(s3);

struct CloudLayerParameters
{
    float4 Layer;
    float4 Shape;
    float4 Wind;
};

// 明示的な float4/uint4 の組で CloudRenderer::Constants と 16 バイトのパッキングに合わせる。
cbuffer CloudParameters : register(b9)
{
    float4 CloudLayer;    // 下端、上端、被覆率、密度の倍率
    float4 CloudShape;    // 基本スケール、詳細スケール、浸食、消散
    float4 CloudLighting; // 位相関数の g、環境光の強度、パウダー効果、ジッター
    float4 CloudWind;     // ラップ済みの基本 UV オフセット（xy）、詳細 UV オフセット（zw）
    uint4 CloudQuality;   // 視線のステップ数、光のステップ数、デバッグモード、レイヤー数
    float4 CloudExtent;   // 全体の幅と高さ、雲の幅と高さ
    float4 CloudTrace;    // 最大距離、ノイズスライス、有効フラグ、影の有効フラグ
    CloudLayerParameters CloudAdditionalLayers[3];
};

CloudLayerParameters GetCloudLayer(uint index)
{
    CloudLayerParameters layer;
    if (index == 0)
    {
        layer.Layer = CloudLayer;
        layer.Shape = CloudShape;
        layer.Wind = CloudWind;
    }
    else
    {
        layer = CloudAdditionalLayers[index - 1];
    }
    return layer;
}

float2 CloudHeightBounds()
{
    [branch] if (CloudQuality.w <= 1)
    {
        return CloudLayer.xy;
    }
    float2 bounds = float2(20000, -10000);
    [loop] for (uint index = 0; index < CloudQuality.w; ++index)
    {
        float4 layer = GetCloudLayer(index).Layer;
        if (layer.z > 0 && layer.w > 0)
        {
            bounds.x = min(bounds.x, layer.x);
            bounds.y = max(bounds.y, layer.y);
        }
    }
    return bounds;
}

void SortCloudIntervalPair(inout float2 nearInterval, inout float2 farInterval)
{
    if (nearInterval.x > farInterval.x)
    {
        float2 previousNear = nearInterval;
        nearInterval = farInterval;
        farInterval = previousNear;
    }
}

// 占有区間をソートして結合し、空の隙間を飛ばして重複部分は一度だけ積分する。
uint CloudIntervals(float3 origin, float3 direction, float limit, out float2 intervals[4])
{
    uint count = 0;
    [unroll] for (uint clearIndex = 0; clearIndex < 4; ++clearIndex)
    {
        // 空の区間は、開始位置が limit より小さい全占有区間の後に並べる。
        intervals[clearIndex] = float2(limit, limit);
    }
    [loop] for (uint index = 0; index < CloudQuality.w; ++index)
    {
        float4 layer = GetCloudLayer(index).Layer;
        if (layer.z <= 0 || layer.w <= 0)
        {
            continue;
        }
        float start = 0;
        float end = limit;
        if (abs(direction.y) < 0.000001)
        {
            if (origin.y < layer.x || origin.y > layer.y)
            {
                continue;
            }
        }
        else
        {
            float2 slab = (layer.xy - origin.y) / direction.y;
            start = max(0, min(slab.x, slab.y));
            end = min(limit, max(slab.x, slab.y));
        }
        if (end > start)
        {
            intervals[index] = float2(start, end);
            ++count;
        }
    }
    [branch] if (CloudQuality.w <= 1)
    {
        return count;
    }
    // 固定の 4 入力ソートネットワークで、FXC の動的インデックス付き挿入ループを避ける。
    SortCloudIntervalPair(intervals[0], intervals[1]);
    SortCloudIntervalPair(intervals[2], intervals[3]);
    SortCloudIntervalPair(intervals[0], intervals[2]);
    SortCloudIntervalPair(intervals[1], intervals[3]);
    SortCloudIntervalPair(intervals[1], intervals[2]);
    uint mergedCount = 0;
    [loop] for (uint interval = 0; interval < count; ++interval)
    {
        float2 current = intervals[interval];
        if (mergedCount > 0)
        {
            if (current.x <= intervals[mergedCount - 1].y)
            {
                intervals[mergedCount - 1].y = max(intervals[mergedCount - 1].y, current.y);
                continue;
            }
        }
        intervals[mergedCount] = current;
        ++mergedCount;
    }
    return mergedCount;
}

// detail = false は基本形状だけを返す（詳細ノイズの 3D サンプルを省く）。
// 空白のスキップと、遠い光のサンプルで使う。浸食は輪郭を削るだけなので、基本形状は上限として安全。
float CloudLayerDensityLod(float3 worldPosition, CloudLayerParameters layer, uint index, bool detail)
{
    if (layer.Layer.z <= 0 || layer.Layer.w <= 0)
    {
        return 0;
    }
    float height = (worldPosition.y - layer.Layer.x) / max(layer.Layer.y - layer.Layer.x, 0.01);
    if (height <= 0 || height >= 1)
    {
        return 0;
    }
    float gradient = smoothstep(0, 0.15, height) * (1 - smoothstep(0.7, 1, height));
    // スロットごとの固定オフセットで、ノイズボリュームを増やさずレイヤー間の相関を除く。
    float3 noiseOffset = float3(0.173, 0.367, 0.619) * index;
    float3 baseUv = worldPosition * layer.Shape.x + noiseOffset;
    baseUv.xz -= layer.Wind.xy;
    float baseNoise = CloudBaseNoise.SampleLevel(CloudWrap, baseUv, 0);
    baseNoise = saturate((baseNoise - 0.2) / 0.6);
    float shape = saturate((baseNoise - (1 - layer.Layer.z)) / max(layer.Layer.z, 0.00001));
    if (shape * gradient < 0.00001)
    {
        return 0;
    }
    // 上部ほど丸く（積雲のカリフラワー状）、下部ほど平らになる高さ依存の形状
    float coverageShape = shape * gradient;
    if (!detail)
    {
        return saturate(coverageShape) * layer.Layer.w;
    }
    float3 detailUv = worldPosition * layer.Shape.y + noiseOffset;
    detailUv.xz -= layer.Wind.zw;
    float detailNoise = CloudDetailNoise.SampleLevel(CloudWrap, detailUv, 0);
    // 下側は細かく（ちぎれた雲底）、上側はふくらんだ（反転した）詳細で浸食する
    float detailModifier = lerp(detailNoise, 1 - detailNoise, saturate(height * 4.0));
    return saturate(coverageShape - detailModifier * layer.Shape.z * (1 - coverageShape)) * layer.Layer.w;
}

float CloudLayerDensity(float3 worldPosition, CloudLayerParameters layer, uint index)
{
    return CloudLayerDensityLod(worldPosition, layer, index, true);
}

float CloudDensity(float3 worldPosition)
{
    float density = CloudLayerDensity(worldPosition, GetCloudLayer(0), 0);
    [branch] if (CloudQuality.w <= 1)
    {
        return density;
    }
    [loop] for (uint index = 1; index < CloudQuality.w; ++index)
    {
        density += CloudLayerDensity(worldPosition, GetCloudLayer(index), index);
    }
    return density;
}

float CloudDensityLod(float3 worldPosition, bool detail)
{
    float density = CloudLayerDensityLod(worldPosition, GetCloudLayer(0), 0, detail);
    [branch] if (CloudQuality.w <= 1)
    {
        return density;
    }
    [loop] for (uint index = 1; index < CloudQuality.w; ++index)
    {
        density += CloudLayerDensityLod(worldPosition, GetCloudLayer(index), index, detail);
    }
    return density;
}

// 雲の内部の照明用の光マーチ。地表の影用（CloudLightTransmittance）とは別。
//  ・距離を指数的に伸ばす（近くは細かく、遠くは粗く）。全区間（数 km）を等分していた従来より、
//    自己遮蔽の細部が出て、サンプル数も少なくて済む
//  ・最初の 2 サンプル以外は基本形状のみ（詳細ノイズを省く）
//  ・最後に長いサンプルを 1 つ追加して、遠くの雲の塊による遮蔽も拾う
float CloudMarchOpticalDepth(float3 position, float3 towardLight, float maxDistance)
{
    const uint stepCount = clamp(CloudQuality.y, 2u, 16u);
    float opticalDepth = 0;
    float previous = 0;
    // 1 + r + r^2 + ... = maxDistance になる公比 r = 1.6 の等比数列
    const float ratio = 1.6;
    float first = maxDistance * (ratio - 1) / (pow(ratio, (float)stepCount) - 1);
    float segment = first;
    [loop] for (uint i = 0; i < stepCount; ++i)
    {
        float distance = previous + segment * 0.5;
        float density = CloudDensityLod(position + towardLight * distance, i < 2);
        opticalDepth += density * segment;
        previous += segment;
        segment *= ratio;
        if (opticalDepth * CloudShape.w > 9.21)
        {
            return opticalDepth;
        }
    }
    // 遠方の塊：光線方向に maxDistance の 3 倍先を 1 サンプル
    opticalDepth += CloudDensityLod(position + towardLight * (maxDistance * 2.5), false) * maxDistance * 2.0;
    return opticalDepth;
}

float CloudHG(float cosine)
{
    float g = CloudLighting.x;
    return (1 - g * g) / (12.566370614 * pow(max(1 + g * g - 2 * g * cosine, 0.001), 1.5));
}

float CloudHGg(float cosine, float g)
{
    return (1 - g * g) / (12.566370614 * pow(max(1 + g * g - 2 * g * cosine, 0.001), 1.5));
}

// 二重ローブ（前方の銀の縁 + 弱い後方散乱）。設定の g を前方ローブに使う
float CloudDualPhase(float cosine, float g)
{
    return lerp(CloudHGg(cosine, -0.25 * saturate(g / 0.85)), CloudHGg(cosine, g), 0.75);
}

float CloudLightTransmittance(float3 position, float3 towardSun)
{
    float2 intervals[4];
    uint count = CloudIntervals(position, towardSun, CloudTrace.x, intervals);
    float opticalDepth = 0;
    [loop] for (uint interval = 0; interval < count; ++interval)
    {
        float stepLength = (intervals[interval].y - intervals[interval].x) / max(CloudQuality.y, 1u);
        [loop] for (uint sample = 0; sample < CloudQuality.y; ++sample)
        {
            float distance = intervals[interval].x + (sample + 0.5) * stepLength;
            opticalDepth += CloudDensity(position + towardSun * distance) * stepLength;
            if (opticalDepth * CloudShape.w > 9.21)
            {
                return 0;
            }
        }
    }
    return exp(-opticalDepth * CloudShape.w);
}

// 太陽円盤の等面積サンプル 4 個を平均する（角半径は約 0.266 度）。
// 雲の内部と受光面で同じ入射光モデルを使う。
float CloudSolarTransmittance(float3 position, float3 towardSun)
{
    float3 tangent = normalize(cross(abs(towardSun.y) < 0.99 ? float3(0, 1, 0) : float3(1, 0, 0), towardSun));
    float3 bitangent = cross(towardSun, tangent);
    const float discOffset = 0.00465 * 0.5;
    float transmission = 0;
    [unroll] for (uint sample = 0; sample < 4; ++sample)
    {
        float2 offset = float2((sample & 1) ? 1 : -1, (sample & 2) ? 1 : -1) * discOffset;
        float3 direction = normalize(towardSun + tangent * offset.x + bitangent * offset.y);
        if (direction.y > 0)
        {
            transmission += CloudLightTransmittance(position, direction);
        }
    }
    return transmission * 0.25;
}

#ifndef CLOUD_MEDIUM_NO_SCENE_LIGHTS
// 空と同じ Sun エンティティについて、CPU が Index+1 を書き込む。
int CloudSunIndex()
{
    int index = (int)round(SkySunDirection.w) - 1;
    return index >= 0 && index < min((int)LightCount.x, 160) ? index : -1;
}

float CloudSunVisibility(float3 position)
{
    if (CloudTrace.z < 0.5 || CloudTrace.w < 0.5 || CloudSunIndex() < 0)
    {
        return 1;
    }
    float3 towardSun = SafeNormalizeCommon(SkySunDirection.xyz, float3(0, 1, 0));
    if (towardSun.y <= 0)
    {
        return 0; // 不透明な惑星が地平線より下からの太陽光を遮る。
    }
    return CloudSolarTransmittance(position, towardSun);
}
#endif

#endif

===== FILE: shader\hlsl\CloudRaymarchPS.hlsl =====

CloudOutput main(PSInputPostProcess input)
{
    return MarchCloud(input.TexCoord, input.Position.xy);
}

===== FILE: shader\hlsl\ClusterCullingCS.hlsl =====
#include "MeshletCullingCommon.hlsli"
groupshared uint Allocation;
groupshared uint Accepted;
[numthreads(64, 1, 1)] void main(uint3 group : SV_GroupID, uint lane : SV_GroupIndex) {
    uint object = group.x + group.y * 65535u;
    if (object >= min(ObjectCount.Load(0), ObjectCapacity))
    {
        return;
    }
    uint commandOffset = object * 24;
    if (lane == 0)
    {
        Accepted = 0;
        FallbackCommands.Store4(commandOffset, OriginalCommands.Load4(commandOffset));
        FallbackCommands.Store2(commandOffset + 16, OriginalCommands.Load2(commandOffset + 16));
        if (NativeSuccess[object] != 0)
        {
            FallbackCommands.Store(commandOffset + 4, 0);
        }
    }
    uint4 selected = Objects[object];
    uint4 range = selected.y < MeshCount ? Ranges[selected.y] : uint4(0, 0, 0, 0);
    if (lane == 0 && NativeSuccess[object] == 0 && range.y != 0 && range.w != 0)
    {
        uint first = Statistics.Load(0), observed;
        [allow_uav_condition] while (true)
        {
            if (range.y > Capacity || first > Capacity - range.y)
            {
                Stat(36);
                break;
            }
            Statistics.InterlockedCompareExchange(0, first, first + range.y, observed);
            if (first == observed)
            {
                Accepted = 1;
                Allocation = first;
                break;
            }
            first = observed;
        }
        // オブジェクト全体の割り当てに成功した。Hi-Z 用の元のコマンドは保持し、
        // メインの不透明フォールバックリストだけがこのオブジェクトを飛ばす。
        if (Accepted != 0)
        {
            FallbackCommands.Store(commandOffset + 4, 0);
        }
    }
    GroupMemoryBarrierWithGroupSync();
    if (Accepted == 0)
    {
        return;
    }
    GPUInstanceData instance = Instances[selected.x];
    [loop] for (uint clusterIndex = lane; clusterIndex < range.w; clusterIndex += 64)
    {
        ClusterRecord cluster = Clusters[range.z + clusterIndex];
        Stat(8);
        float4 sphere = SphereWorld(cluster.Bounds, instance);
        bool culled = EnableClusters != 0 && ((EnableFrustum != 0 && FrustumCull(sphere)) ||
                                              (EnableCone != 0 && ConeCull(cluster.Bounds, sphere, instance)) ||
                                              OcclusionCull(sphere, instance));
        if (!culled)
        {
            Stat(12);
            Stat(44, cluster.Count);
        }
        else
        {
            Stat(40, cluster.Count);
        }
        [loop] for (uint child = 0; child < cluster.Count; ++child)
        {
            uint meshlet = cluster.Offset + child;
            // カリング済みクラスターは子を調べず、番兵値を初期化する。
            Candidates[Allocation + meshlet - range.x] =
                uint4(selected.x, meshlet, culled ? 2u : 0u, range.z + clusterIndex);
        }
    }
}

// ColorManagement.hlsl - Shared constants and structures for color management shaders
#pragma once

// Display transform types (must match CPU-side ColorManagement::DisplayConfig)
#define DISPLAY_TRANSFORM_NONE     0
#define DISPLAY_TRANSFORM_OCIO_LUT 1
#define DISPLAY_TRANSFORM_SRGB     2
#define DISPLAY_TRANSFORM_ACES     3
#define DISPLAY_TRANSFORM_CUSTOM   4

// ColorManagementConstants buffer layout (register b0)
// uint4 TextureSize;        // x=width, y=height, z=mipLevel(0), w=unused
// uint4 DisplayConfig;      // x=displayTransformType, y=srgb, z=exposure*1000, w=gamma*1000
// float4 ExposureGamma;     // x=exposure, y=gamma, z=unused, w=unused
// float3 Lut3DSize;         // x=lutSize, y=1/lutSize, z=unused
// float4 Lut3DScaleOffset;  // x=scale, y=offset, z=unused, w=unused

// Resource bindings:
// Texture2D<float4> g_InputTexture : register(t0);
// Texture3D<float4> g_Lut3D : register(t1);
// Texture1D<float> g_Lut1D_R : register(t2);
// Texture1D<float> g_Lut1D_G : register(t3);
// Texture1D<float> g_Lut1D_B : register(t4);

===== FILE: shader\hlsl\ColorManagementCS.hlsl =====
#include "Common.hlsl"
#include "ColorManagement.hlsl"

RWTexture2D<float4> g_OutputTexture : register(u0);
Texture2D<float4> g_InputTexture : register(t0);

cbuffer ColorManagementConstants : register(b0)
{
    uint4 TextureSize;        // x=width, y=height, z=mipLevel(0), w=unused
    uint4 DisplayConfig;      // x=displayTransformType, y=srgb, z=exposure*1000, w=gamma*1000
    float4 ExposureGamma;     // x=exposure, y=gamma, z=unused, w=unused
    float3 Lut3DSize;         // x=lutSize, y=1/lutSize, z=unused
    float4 Lut3DScaleOffset;  // x=scale, y=offset, z=unused, w=unused
};

Texture3D<float4> g_Lut3D : register(t1);
Texture1D<float> g_Lut1D_R : register(t2);
Texture1D<float> g_Lut1D_G : register(t3);
Texture1D<float> g_Lut1D_B : register(t4);

SamplerState g_SamplerLinearClamp : register(s0);
SamplerState g_SamplerPointClamp : register(s1);

#define DISPLAY_TRANSFORM_NONE     0
#define DISPLAY_TRANSFORM_OCIO_LUT 1
#define DISPLAY_TRANSFORM_SRGB     2
#define DISPLAY_TRANSFORM_ACES     3
#define DISPLAY_TRANSFORM_CUSTOM   4

// Helper function for ACES RRT + ODT fit
float RRTAndODTFit(float v)
{
    float a = v * (v + 0.0245786f) - 0.000090537f;
    float b = v * (0.983729f * v + 0.4329510f) + 0.238081f;
    return max(0.0f, a / b);
}

[numthreads(16, 16, 1)]
void main(uint3 dispatchId : SV_DispatchThreadID)
{
    if (dispatchId.x >= TextureSize.x || dispatchId.y >= TextureSize.y)
    {
        return;
    }

    float4 color = g_InputTexture.Load(uint3(dispatchId.x, dispatchId.y, 0));

    uint transformType = DisplayConfig.x;
    bool srgb = DisplayConfig.y != 0;
    float exposure = DisplayConfig.z * 0.001f;
    float gamma = DisplayConfig.w * 0.001f;

    // Apply exposure
    if (exposure != 0.0f)
    {
        float expScale = exp2(exposure);
        color.rgb *= expScale;
    }

    float3 result = color.rgb;

    [branch]
    if (transformType == DISPLAY_TRANSFORM_OCIO_LUT)
    {
        // Apply 3D LUT from OCIO
        if (Lut3DSize.x > 0)
        {
            float3 lutCoord = result * Lut3DScaleOffset.x + Lut3DScaleOffset.y;
            lutCoord = clamp(lutCoord, 0.0f, 1.0f);
            result = g_Lut3D[lutCoord].rgb;
        }
        else if (Lut3DSize.x > 0)
        {
            // Fallback to 1D LUTs
            result.r = g_Lut1D_R[clamp(uint(result.r * (Lut3DSize.x - 1)), 0u, Lut3DSize.x - 1)];
            result.g = g_Lut1D_G[clamp(uint(result.g * (Lut3DSize.x - 1)), 0u, Lut3DSize.x - 1)];
            result.b = g_Lut1D_B[clamp(uint(result.b * (Lut3DSize.x - 1)), 0u, Lut3DSize.x - 1)];
        }
    }
    else if (transformType == DISPLAY_TRANSFORM_SRGB)
    {
        // sRGB OETF
        result.r = (result.r <= 0.0031308f) ? (12.92f * result.r) : (1.055f * pow(result.r, 1.0f / 2.4f) - 0.055f);
        result.g = (result.g <= 0.0031308f) ? (12.92f * result.g) : (1.055f * pow(result.g, 1.0f / 2.4f) - 0.055f);
        result.b = (result.b <= 0.0031308f) ? (12.92f * result.b) : (1.055f * pow(result.b, 1.0f / 2.4f) - 0.055f);
    }
    else if (transformType == DISPLAY_TRANSFORM_ACES)
    {
        // ACES Filmic tone mapping (simplified)
        float3 acesInputMat[3] = {
            float3(0.59719f, 0.35458f, 0.04823f),
            float3(0.07600f, 0.90834f, 0.01566f),
            float3(0.02840f, 0.13383f, 0.83777f)
        };

        float3 acesOutputMat[3] = {
            float3(1.60475f, -0.53108f, -0.07367f),
            float3(-0.10208f, 1.10813f, -0.00605f),
            float3(-0.00327f, -0.07276f, 1.07602f)
        };

        // Apply exposure
        float3 colorExp = result * exp2(ExposureGamma.x);

        // ACES input transform
        float3 acesColor;
        acesColor.r = dot(acesInputMat[0], colorExp);
        acesColor.g = dot(acesInputMat[1], colorExp);
        acesColor.b = dot(acesInputMat[2], colorExp);

        // RRT + ODT (simplified)
        acesColor.r = RRTAndODTFit(acesColor.r);
        acesColor.g = RRTAndODTFit(acesColor.g);
        acesColor.b = RRTAndODTFit(acesColor.b);

        // ACES output transform
        result.r = dot(acesOutputMat[0], acesColor);
        result.g = dot(acesOutputMat[1], acesColor);
        result.b = dot(acesOutputMat[2], acesColor);
    }

    // Apply gamma correction if not using sRGB/ACES
    if (transformType != DISPLAY_TRANSFORM_SRGB && transformType != DISPLAY_TRANSFORM_ACES && gamma > 0.0f)
    {
        float invGamma = 1.0f / gamma;
        result.r = pow(max(0.0f, result.r), invGamma);
        result.g = pow(max(0.0f, result.g), invGamma);
        result.b = pow(max(0.0f, result.b), invGamma);
    }

    // Clamp to valid range
    result = saturate(result);

    g_OutputTexture[dispatchId.xy] = float4(result, color.a);
}

===== FILE: shader\hlsl\colorshader3dPS.hlsl =====
#define SHADER_3D
#include "common.hlsl"
#include "NormalMapDecode.hlsli"

Texture2D g_Texture : register(t0);
Texture2D g_NormalTexture : register(t2);
SamplerState g_SamplerState : register(s0);

void main(in PSInput3D In, out float4 outDiffuse : SV_Target)
{
    float4 baseColor = In.Diffuse;
    float3 normal = normalize(In.Normal.xyz);
    if (UseNormalMap != 0)
    {
        float3 tangentNormal = DecodeTangentNormalSample(g_NormalTexture.Sample(g_SamplerState, In.TexCoord));
        float3 tangent = SafeNormalizeCommon(mul(float3(1.0f, 0.0f, 0.0f), (float3x3)World), float3(1.0f, 0.0f, 0.0f));
        float3 bitangent =
            SafeNormalizeCommon(mul(float3(0.0f, -1.0f, 0.0f), (float3x3)World), float3(0.0f, 0.0f, 1.0f));
        normal = SafeNormalizeCommon(tangentNormal.x * tangent + tangentNormal.y * bitangent + tangentNormal.z * normal,
                                     normal);
    }

    float3 lightDirection;
    float3 lightColor;
    float lightAttenuation;
    float volumeScatter;
    float rangeBlend;
    ResolveLightAggregate(In.WorldPos, In.Position.xy, lightDirection, lightColor, lightAttenuation, volumeScatter,
                          rangeBlend);
    float lightIntensity = 1.0f;

    if (UseTexture)
    {
        baseColor *= g_Texture.Sample(g_SamplerState, In.TexCoord);
    }
    baseColor.a *= saturate(MaterialAlpha);
    clip(baseColor.a - (1.0f / 255.0f));

    float lighting = saturate(dot(normal, lightDirection));
    float shadowVisibility = SampleShadowMap(In.WorldPos, normal, lightDirection);
    float castShadow = saturate(1.0f - shadowVisibility);
    float shadowMask = 1.0f - castShadow * ShadowStrength * lightAttenuation;
    float toonLit = smoothstep(ShadowThreshold - ShadowSoftness, ShadowThreshold + ShadowSoftness, lighting);
    float directLight = lerp(0.35f, 1.0f, toonLit) * shadowMask;
    float3 lit = baseColor.rgb * (0.18f + lightColor * directLight * lightIntensity);
    lit += lightColor * volumeScatter;
    outDiffuse = float4(lit * baseColor.a, baseColor.a);
}

===== FILE: shader\hlsl\colorshader3dPS_MRT.hlsl =====
#define SHADER_3D
#include "common.hlsl"
#include "NormalMapDecode.hlsli"

Texture2D g_Texture : register(t0);
Texture2D g_NormalTexture : register(t2);
SamplerState g_SamplerState : register(s0);

GBufferOutput main(in PSInput3D In)
{
    float materialPartId = (MaterialMode == 1) ? (float)ShaderClass : 10.0f;
    float4 baseColor = In.Diffuse;
    float3 normal = -In.Normal.xyz;
    float3 worldPos = In.WorldPos;
    float3 position = In.Position.xyz / In.Position.w;
    if (UseNormalMap != 0)
    {
        float3 tangentNormal = DecodeTangentNormalSample(g_NormalTexture.Sample(g_SamplerState, In.TexCoord));
        float3 tangent = SafeNormalizeCommon(mul(float3(1.0f, 0.0f, 0.0f), (float3x3)World), float3(1.0f, 0.0f, 0.0f));
        float3 bitangent =
            SafeNormalizeCommon(mul(float3(0.0f, -1.0f, 0.0f), (float3x3)World), float3(0.0f, 0.0f, 1.0f));
        normal = SafeNormalizeCommon(tangentNormal.x * tangent + tangentNormal.y * bitangent + tangentNormal.z * normal,
                                     normal);
    }

    if (UseTexture)
    {
        baseColor *= g_Texture.Sample(g_SamplerState, In.TexCoord);
    }

    clip(baseColor.a - 0.01f);

    GBufferOutput output;
    output.EmissionAO = float4(0, 0, 0, 1);
    output.Color = baseColor;
    output.Normal = MakeGBufferNormal(normal);
    output.Depth = saturate(In.Position.z);
    MaterialPartShaderParams partParams = ResolveMaterialPartParams(materialPartId);
    bool usePartParams = MaterialMode != 1;
    output.Material.r = usePartParams ? partParams.Basic.x : mMetallic;
    output.Material.g = usePartParams ? partParams.Basic.y : mRoughness;
    output.Material.b = usePartParams ? partParams.Basic.z : mFresnel;
    output.Material.a = materialPartId;
    output.Shadow = usePartParams ? float4(partParams.Shadow0.x, partParams.Shadow0.y, partParams.Shadow0.z, 0.0f)
                                  : float4(ShadowThreshold, ShadowSoftness, ShadowStrength, 0.0f);

    return output;
}

#define SHADER_2D
#include "common.hlsl"
#include "NormalMapDecode.hlsli"
Texture2D InputTexture : register(t0);
Texture2D NormalTexture : register(t2);
SamplerState InputSampler : register(s0);

float4 main(PSInput2D input) : SV_Target
{
    float4 color = input.Color;
    if (UseTexture != 0)
    {
        color *= InputTexture.Sample(InputSampler, input.TexCoord);
    }
    color.a *= saturate(MaterialAlpha2D);

    float3 normal = input.Normal;
    if (UseNormalMap != 0)
    {
        float3 tangentNormal = DecodeTangentNormalSample(NormalTexture.Sample(InputSampler, input.TexCoord));
        float3 tangent = float3(1.0f, 0.0f, 0.0f);
        float3 bitangent = float3(0.0f, -1.0f, 0.0f);
        normal = SafeNormalizeCommon(tangentNormal.x * tangent + tangentNormal.y * bitangent + tangentNormal.z * normal,
                                     normal);
    }

    float3 lightDir = normalize(float3(-0.35f, 0.45f, -1.0f));
    float lighting = saturate(dot(normalize(normal), lightDir));
    color.rgb *= lerp(0.35f, 1.0f, lighting);

    color.rgb *= color.a;
    return color;
}

float3 SurfaceViewDirectionCommon(float3 worldPosition, float3 cameraPosition)
{
    return abs(Projection[3][3]) > 0.5f
               ? -normalize(float3(View[0][2], View[1][2], View[2][2]))
               : normalize(cameraPosition - worldPosition + 1e-20f);
}

float3 SurfaceCameraOriginCommon(float3 worldPosition, float3 cameraPosition)
{
    if (abs(Projection[3][3]) < 0.5f)
    {
        return cameraPosition;
    }
    float3 direction = -SurfaceViewDirectionCommon(worldPosition, cameraPosition);
    return worldPosition - direction * dot(worldPosition - cameraPosition, direction);
}

#ifndef SHADER_POSTPROCESS
float SampleShadowMapPcf9(float2 shadowUv, float shadowLayer, float texelSize, float currentDepth, int filterRadius)
{
    const float2 kernel[9] = {float2(0.0f, 0.0f),
                              float2(1.0f, 0.0f),
                              float2(-1.0f, 0.0f),
                              float2(0.0f, 1.0f),
                              float2(0.0f, -1.0f),
                              float2(0.7071068f, 0.7071068f),
                              float2(-0.7071068f, 0.7071068f),
                              float2(0.7071068f, -0.7071068f),
                              float2(-0.7071068f, -0.7071068f)};
    int tapCount = filterRadius <= 0 ? 1 : 9;
    float visibility = 0.0f;
    [unroll] for (int tap = 0; tap < 9; ++tap)
    {
        if (tap >= tapCount)
        {
            break;
        }
        float2 offset = kernel[tap] * (float)max(filterRadius, 1) * texelSize;
        visibility +=
            g_ShadowMap.SampleCmpLevelZero(g_ShadowSampler, float3(shadowUv + offset, shadowLayer), currentDepth);
    }
    return visibility / (float)tapCount;
}

float SampleShadowMap(float3 worldPos, float3 normal, float3 lightDir)
{
#ifdef SHADER_RAYTRACING
    // フォワードライティングでは、寄与するライトごとにシーンの可視性を適用する。
    if (SceneRayFlags.x > 0.5f)
    {
        return 1.0f;
    }
#endif
    float normalLenSq = dot(normal, normal);
    float lightLenSq = dot(lightDir, lightDir);
    float3 n = (normalLenSq > 0.000001f) ? normal * rsqrt(normalLenSq) : float3(0.0f, 1.0f, 0.0f);
    float3 l = (lightLenSq > 0.000001f) ? lightDir * rsqrt(lightLenSq) : float3(0.0f, 1.0f, 0.0f);

    float4 lightClip = mul(float4(worldPos, 1.0f), LightViewProjection);
    float safeW = max(lightClip.w, 0.000001f);
    float3 lightNdc = lightClip.xyz / safeW;
    float2 shadowUv = float2(lightNdc.x * 0.5f + 0.5f, -lightNdc.y * 0.5f + 0.5f);

    float inBounds = (lightClip.w > 0.0f && shadowUv.x >= 0.0f && shadowUv.x <= 1.0f && shadowUv.y >= 0.0f &&
                      shadowUv.y <= 1.0f && lightNdc.z >= 0.0f && lightNdc.z <= 1.0f)
                         ? 1.0f
                         : 0.0f;

    float texelSize = ShadowMapParams.x;
    float nDotL = saturate(dot(n, l));
    float bias = max(ShadowMapParams.y * (1.0f - nDotL), ShadowMapParams.z);
    float currentDepth = lightNdc.z - bias;

    int filterRadius = clamp((int)round(ShadowFilterParams.x), 0, 3);
    float visibility = SampleShadowMapPcf9(shadowUv, 0.0f, texelSize, currentDepth, filterRadius);
    float shadowStrength = saturate(abs(ShadowMapParams.w));
    float outOfBoundsVisibility = 1.0f;
    return lerp(1.0f, lerp(outOfBoundsVisibility, visibility, inBounds), shadowStrength);
}
#endif

struct Light
{
    float3 Position;
    float3 Color;
    float3 Direction;
    float Intensity;
};

#endif

#if defined(SHADER_3D) || defined(SHADER_POSTPROCESS)

    // ライブ用トゥーンスタイル（source/rendering/livetoonstyle.h と同じ並び）

    float4 LiveToonStyle3; // x: ランプスペキュラ, y: 天使の輪, z: 環境スペキュラ, w: 落ち影の濃さ
    float4 LiveToonStyle4; // x: 陰影ランプのテクスチャ番号（<0 で無効）, y: 陰影ランプの強さ
};

StructuredBuffer<uint> LightTileIndices : register(t11);
