bool SceneLightCastsShadowCommon(uint index, bool legacyHasShadow)
{
#ifdef SHADER_RAYTRACING
    if (SceneRayFlags.x > 0.5f)
    {
        return index < MAX_SHADER_LIGHTS && SceneShadowLights[index].x != 0;
    }
#endif
    return legacyHasShadow;
}

float SceneShadowForLightCommon(uint index, float3 worldPos, float3 normal, float3 lightDir)
{
#ifdef SHADER_RAYTRACING
    if (SceneRayFlags.x > 0.5f)
    {
        if (index >= 160u || SceneShadowLights[index].x == 0u)
        {
            return 1.0f;
        }
        float maximumDistance = LightPositionTypes[index].w < 0.5f
                                    ? SceneRayParameters.x
                                    : min(length(LightPositionTypes[index].xyz - worldPos), SceneRayParameters.x);
        return TraceSceneShadow(worldPos, normal, lightDir, maximumDistance);
    }
#endif
    return 1.0f;
}

bool HasLightTileGridCommon()
{
    return LightCount.y >= 1.0f && LightCount.z >= 1.0f && LightCount.w >= 1.0f;
}

uint LightTileBaseCommon(float2 pixelPosition)
{
    uint tileCountX = max((uint)round(LightCount.y), 1u);
    uint tileCountY = max((uint)round(LightCount.z), 1u);
    uint2 tile =
        min((uint2)max(pixelPosition, float2(0.0f, 0.0f)) / LIGHT_TILE_SIZE, uint2(tileCountX - 1u, tileCountY - 1u));
    return (tile.y * tileCountX + tile.x) * MAX_LIGHTS_PER_TILE;
}

uint VirtualShadowResidencyRowCommon(int level, int row)
{
    uint4 packedRows = VirtualShadowResidency[level * 4 + (row >> 2)];
    return packedRows[row & 3];
}

bool VirtualShadowPageResidentCommon(int level, int2 localPage)
{
    int pageGrid = max((int)round(VirtualShadowPageOrigins[level].z), 1);
    if (level < 0 || level >= 4 || localPage.x < 0 || localPage.x >= pageGrid || localPage.y < 0 ||
        localPage.y >= pageGrid)
    {
        return false;
    }
    uint rowMask = VirtualShadowResidencyRowCommon(level, localPage.y);
    return (rowMask & (1u << localPage.x)) != 0u;
}

int VirtualShadowPositiveModuloCommon(int value, int modulus)
{

    return value & (modulus - 1);
}

float2 VirtualShadowMapUvCommon(int level, float2 virtualUv, out bool resident, out int2 localPage)
{
    int pageGrid = max((int)round(VirtualShadowPageOrigins[level].z), 1);
    float2 pagePosition = virtualUv * (float)pageGrid;
    localPage = (int2)floor(pagePosition);
    resident = all(virtualUv >= 0.0f) && all(virtualUv < 1.0f) && VirtualShadowPageResidentCommon(level, localPage);
    if (!resident)
    {
        return float2(0.0f, 0.0f);
    }

    int2 globalPage = (int2)round(VirtualShadowPageOrigins[level].xy) + localPage;
    int2 physicalPage = int2(VirtualShadowPositiveModuloCommon(globalPage.x, pageGrid),
                             VirtualShadowPositiveModuloCommon(globalPage.y, pageGrid));
    float2 inPageUv = frac(pagePosition);
    float halfLocalTexel = VirtualShadowParams[level].y * (float)pageGrid * 0.5f;
    inPageUv =
        clamp(inPageUv, float2(halfLocalTexel, halfLocalTexel), float2(1.0f - halfLocalTexel, 1.0f - halfLocalTexel));
    return ((float2)physicalPage + inPageUv) / (float)pageGrid;
}

float VirtualShadowLevelInteriorCommon(int level, float2 virtualUv, float3 worldPos)
{
    float pageGrid = max(VirtualShadowPageOrigins[level].z, 1.0f);
    float residentGrid = max(ShadowDebugGlobal.z, 1.0f);
    float firstResident = (pageGrid - residentGrid) * 0.5f;
    float2 pagePosition = virtualUv * pageGrid;
    float2 edgeDistance = min(pagePosition - firstResident, firstResident + residentGrid - pagePosition);

    float overlapPages = max(residentGrid * 0.5f * clamp(VirtualShadowGlobal.w, 0.05f, 0.40f), 0.25f);
    return smoothstep(0.0f, overlapPages, min(edgeDistance.x, edgeDistance.y));
}

float CascadedShadowLevelInteriorCommon(int level, float2 shadowUv, float3 worldPos)
{
    float2 edgeDistance = min(shadowUv, 1.0f - shadowUv);
    float overlapUv = max(0.5f * clamp(VirtualShadowGlobal.w, 0.05f, 0.40f), 2.0f / 2048.0f);
    return smoothstep(0.0f, overlapUv, min(edgeDistance.x, edgeDistance.y));
}

float ShadowWorldFilterScaleCommon(int level)
{
    float finestWorldTexel = max(VirtualShadowPageOrigins[0].w, 0.000001f);
    float levelWorldTexel = max(VirtualShadowPageOrigins[level].w, finestWorldTexel);
    return clamp(finestWorldTexel / levelWorldTexel, 0.125f, 1.0f);
}

float3 SafeNormalizeCommon(float3 value, float3 fallback)
{
    float lenSq = dot(value, value);
    return (lenSq > 0.000001f) ? value * rsqrt(lenSq) : fallback;
}

float3 ApplyNormalMapCommon(float3 meshNormal, float3 worldPos, float2 texCoord, float3 tangentNormal)
{
    float3 n = SafeNormalizeCommon(meshNormal, float3(0.0f, 1.0f, 0.0f));
#ifdef SHADER_VISIBILITY_RESOLVE
    float3 dp1 = VisibilityWorldDx;
    float3 dp2 = VisibilityWorldDy;
    float2 duv1 = VisibilityUvDx;
    float2 duv2 = VisibilityUvDy;
#else
    float3 dp1 = ddx(worldPos);
    float3 dp2 = ddy(worldPos);
    float2 duv1 = ddx(texCoord);
    float2 duv2 = ddy(texCoord);
#endif

    float det = duv1.x * duv2.y - duv1.y * duv2.x;
    float useTbn = (abs(det) >= 0.000000000000000001f) ? 1.0f : 0.0f;
    float invDet = rcp(lerp(1.0f, det, useTbn));
    float3 tangent = (dp1 * duv2.y - dp2 * duv1.y) * invDet;
    tangent = SafeNormalizeCommon(tangent - n * dot(n, tangent), float3(1.0f, 0.0f, 0.0f));
    float3 uvBitangent = (dp2 * duv1.x - dp1 * duv2.x) * invDet;
    float3 bitangent = SafeNormalizeCommon(cross(n, tangent), float3(0.0f, 0.0f, 1.0f));
    // 反転 UV や反射変換でも接空間の左右の向きを保つ。
    if (dot(bitangent, uvBitangent) < 0.0f)
    {
        bitangent = -bitangent;
    }
    float3 mappedNormal =
        SafeNormalizeCommon(tangentNormal.x * tangent + tangentNormal.y * bitangent + tangentNormal.z * n, n);
    return SafeNormalizeCommon(lerp(n, mappedNormal, useTbn), n);
}

float RayleighPhaseCommon(float cosTheta)
{
    return 0.0596831f * (1.0f + cosTheta * cosTheta);
}

float HenyeyGreensteinCommon(float cosTheta, float g)
{
    g = clamp(g, -0.95f, 0.95f);
    float g2 = g * g;
    float denom = max(1.0f + g2 - 2.0f * g * cosTheta, 0.0001f);

    float invSqrtDenom = rsqrt(denom);
    return 0.0795775f * (1.0f - g2) * invSqrtDenom * invSqrtDenom * invSqrtDenom;
}

float AtmosphereDensityCommon(float3 worldPos)
{
    float density = max(AtmosphereParams0.w, 0.0f);
    float heightFalloff = max(AtmosphereParams1.x, 0.0f);
    float heightDensity = exp(-max(worldPos.y, 0.0f) * heightFalloff);
    return density * heightDensity;
}

float3 ApplyAtmosphereToLightCommon(float3 worldPos, float3 lightDir, float3 lightColor, inout float volumeScatter)
{
    [branch] if (AtmosphereParams0.x < 0.5f)
    {
        return lightColor;
    }

#ifdef SHADER_POSTPROCESS
    float3 origin = ReconstructPostProcessCameraOriginCommon(worldPos, AtmosphereCamera.xyz);
#else
    float3 origin = SurfaceCameraOriginCommon(worldPos, AtmosphereCamera.xyz);
#endif
    float3 toCamera = origin - worldPos;
    float viewDistance = length(toCamera);
    float3 viewToCamera = SafeNormalizeCommon(toCamera, -lightDir);
    float3 toLight = SafeNormalizeCommon(lightDir, float3(0.0f, 1.0f, 0.0f));
    // 修正：位相関数の角度は「光の進行方向（-toLight）」と「カメラへ向かう散乱方向」の内積。
    // 以前は符号が逆で、Mie の前方散乱ピークが太陽の反対側（地面の下の「月」の位置）に出ていた。
    float cosTheta = clamp(dot(-toLight, viewToCamera), -1.0f, 1.0f);

    float opticalDepth =
        AtmosphereDensityCommon(worldPos) * (1.0f - exp(-viewDistance * max(AtmosphereParams1.w, 0.0001f)));
    float transmittance = exp(-max(AtmosphereParams1.y, 0.0f) * opticalDepth);

    float rayleighPhase = RayleighPhaseCommon(cosTheta);
    float miePhase = HenyeyGreensteinCommon(cosTheta, AtmosphereParams1.z);
    float3 rayleigh = AtmosphereColor0.rgb * max(AtmosphereParams0.y, 0.0f) * rayleighPhase;
    float3 mie = AtmosphereColor1.rgb * max(AtmosphereParams0.z, 0.0f) * miePhase;
    float3 inScatter = (rayleigh + mie) * opticalDepth * lightColor;

    float shaftStrength = max(AtmosphereColor0.a, 0.0f);
    volumeScatter += dot((rayleigh + mie) * opticalDepth, float3(0.299f, 0.587f, 0.114f)) * shaftStrength;
    return lightColor * transmittance + inScatter;
}

float3 AtmosphereAmbientCommon(float3 worldPos, float3 lightDir)
{
    float atmosphereEnabled = step(0.5f, AtmosphereParams0.x);
    float upScatter = saturate(SafeNormalizeCommon(lightDir, float3(0.0f, 1.0f, 0.0f)).y * 0.5f + 0.5f);
    float density = AtmosphereDensityCommon(worldPos);
    return AtmosphereColor0.rgb * AtmosphereColor1.a * density * lerp(0.35f, 1.0f, upScatter) * atmosphereEnabled;
}

void ResolveSingleLightCommon(float3 worldPos, float4 lightDirectionData, float4 lightPositionTypeData,
                              float4 lightExtraData, out float3 lightDir, out float attenuation,
                              out float volumeScatter);

float3 AtmosphereSingleScatterFromDensityCommon(float sampleDensity, float3 viewToCamera, float3 lightDir,
                                                float3 lightColor)
{
    float3 toLight = SafeNormalizeCommon(lightDir, float3(0.0f, 1.0f, 0.0f));
    // 修正：位相関数の角度は「光の進行方向（-toLight）」と「カメラへ向かう散乱方向」の内積。
    // 以前は符号が逆で、Mie の前方散乱ピークが太陽の反対側（地面の下の「月」の位置）に出ていた。
    float cosTheta = clamp(dot(-toLight, viewToCamera), -1.0f, 1.0f);
    float rayleighPhase = RayleighPhaseCommon(cosTheta);
    float miePhase = HenyeyGreensteinCommon(cosTheta, AtmosphereParams1.z);
    float3 rayleigh = AtmosphereColor0.rgb * max(AtmosphereParams0.y, 0.0f) * rayleighPhase;
    float3 mie = AtmosphereColor1.rgb * max(AtmosphereParams0.z, 0.0f) * miePhase;
    return (rayleigh + mie) * sampleDensity * lightColor;
}

float3 AtmosphereSingleScatterCommon(float3 samplePos, float3 viewToCamera, float3 lightDir, float3 lightColor)
{
    return AtmosphereSingleScatterFromDensityCommon(AtmosphereDensityCommon(samplePos), viewToCamera, lightDir,
                                                    lightColor);
}

float SampleAtmosphereShadowMap(float3 worldPos, float3 lightDir, Texture2DArray<float> shadowMap,
                                SamplerComparisonState shadowSampler, float4x4 lightViewProjection,
                                float4 shadowMapParams, float shadowLayer)
{
#ifdef SHADER_RAYTRACING
    if (SceneRayFlags.x > 0.5f)
    {
        return 1.0f;
    }
#endif
    float3 l = SafeNormalizeCommon(lightDir, float3(0.0f, 1.0f, 0.0f));

    float4 lightClip = mul(float4(worldPos, 1.0f), lightViewProjection);
    float safeW = max(lightClip.w, 0.000001f);
    float3 lightNdc = lightClip.xyz / safeW;
    float2 shadowUv = float2(lightNdc.x * 0.5f + 0.5f, -lightNdc.y * 0.5f + 0.5f);

    float inBounds = (lightClip.w > 0.0f && shadowUv.x >= 0.0f && shadowUv.x <= 1.0f && shadowUv.y >= 0.0f &&
                      shadowUv.y <= 1.0f && lightNdc.z >= 0.0f && lightNdc.z <= 1.0f)
                         ? 1.0f
                         : 0.0f;

    float blur = saturate(AtmosphereCamera.w);
    float texelSize = shadowMapParams.x * (1.0f + blur * 4.0f);
    float bias = max(shadowMapParams.y, shadowMapParams.z);
    float currentDepth = lightNdc.z - bias;

    float visibility = 0.0f;
    [unroll] for (int y = -2; y <= 2; ++y)
    {
        [unroll] for (int x = -2; x <= 2; ++x)
        {
            float2 offset = float2((float)x, (float)y) * texelSize;
            visibility +=
                shadowMap.SampleCmpLevelZero(shadowSampler, float3(shadowUv + offset, shadowLayer), currentDepth);
        }
    }

    visibility /= 25.0f;
    float shadowStrength = saturate(abs(shadowMapParams.w));
    float outOfBoundsVisibility = 1.0f;
    return lerp(1.0f, lerp(outOfBoundsVisibility, visibility, inBounds), shadowStrength);
}

float SampleVirtualAtmosphereShadowMapCommon(float3 worldPos, Texture2DArray<float> shadowMap,
                                             SamplerComparisonState shadowSampler)
{
    int levelCount = clamp((int)round(VirtualShadowGlobal.y), 1, 4);
    float fineVisibility = 1.0f;
    float fineInterior = 1.0f;
    bool hasFine = false;
    [unroll] for (int level = 0; level < 4; ++level)
    {
        if (level >= levelCount)
        {
            break;
        }
        float4 clip = mul(float4(worldPos, 1.0f), VirtualShadowViewProjections[level]);
        if (clip.w <= 0.000001f)
        {
            continue;
        }
        float3 ndc = clip.xyz / clip.w;
        if (ndc.z < 0.0f || ndc.z > 1.0f)
        {
            continue;
        }
        float2 virtualUv = float2(ndc.x * 0.5f + 0.5f, -ndc.y * 0.5f + 0.5f);
        bool resident;
        int2 localPage;
        float2 physicalUv = VirtualShadowMapUvCommon(level, virtualUv, resident, localPage);
        if (!resident)
        {
            continue;
        }

        float4 params = VirtualShadowParams[level];
        float currentDepth = ndc.z - max(params.z, params.w) * (1.0f + level * 0.45f);
        float levelVisibility =
            shadowMap.SampleCmpLevelZero(shadowSampler, float3(physicalUv, max(params.x, 0.0f)), currentDepth);
        float levelInterior = VirtualShadowLevelInteriorCommon(level, virtualUv, worldPos);
        if (!hasFine)
        {
            fineVisibility = levelVisibility;
            fineInterior = levelInterior;
            hasFine = true;
            if (fineInterior >= 0.999f || level == levelCount - 1)
            {
                return fineVisibility;
            }
            continue;
        }
        return lerp(levelVisibility, fineVisibility, fineInterior);
    }
    return hasFine ? fineVisibility : 1.0f;
}

float SampleCascadedAtmosphereShadowMapCommon(float3 worldPos, Texture2DArray<float> shadowMap,
                                              SamplerComparisonState shadowSampler)
{
    int levelCount = clamp((int)round(VirtualShadowGlobal.y), 1, 4);
    float fineVisibility = 1.0f;
    float fineInterior = 1.0f;
    bool hasFine = false;
    [unroll] for (int level = 0; level < 4; ++level)
    {
        if (level >= levelCount)
        {
            break;
        }
        float4 clip = mul(float4(worldPos, 1.0f), VirtualShadowViewProjections[level]);
        if (clip.w <= 0.000001f)
        {
            continue;
        }
        float3 ndc = clip.xyz / clip.w;
        float2 uv = float2(ndc.x * 0.5f + 0.5f, -ndc.y * 0.5f + 0.5f);
        if (any(uv < 0.0f) || any(uv > 1.0f) || ndc.z < 0.0f || ndc.z > 1.0f)
        {
            continue;
        }

        float4 params = VirtualShadowParams[level];
        float levelVisibility = SampleAtmosphereShadowMap(
            worldPos, float3(0.0f, 1.0f, 0.0f), shadowMap, shadowSampler, VirtualShadowViewProjections[level],
            float4(params.y * ShadowWorldFilterScaleCommon(level), params.z, params.w, 1.0f), params.x);
        float levelInterior = CascadedShadowLevelInteriorCommon(level, uv, worldPos);
        if (!hasFine)
        {
            fineVisibility = levelVisibility;
            fineInterior = levelInterior;
            hasFine = true;
            if (fineInterior >= 0.999f || level == levelCount - 1)
            {
                return fineVisibility;
            }
            continue;
        }
        return lerp(levelVisibility, fineVisibility, fineInterior);
    }
    return hasFine ? fineVisibility : 1.0f;
}

float3 WorldToScreenUV(float3 worldPos);
float3 ReconstructPostProcessViewRayCommon(float2 uv);
float3 ReconstructPostProcessWorldPositionCommon(float2 uv, float depth);
bool ProjectWorldToScreenCommon(float3 worldPos, out float2 screenUv);
void ResolveSingleLightCommon(float3 worldPos, float4 lightDirectionData, float4 lightPositionTypeData,
                              float4 lightExtraData, out float3 lightDir, out float attenuation,
                              out float volumeScatter);

float ScreenSpaceShaftVisibilityCommon(float2 screenUv, float2 lightUv, Texture2D<float> depthTexture,
                                       SamplerState depthSampler)
{
    const int stepCount = 8;
    float occlusion = 0.0f;
    float weightSum = 0.0f;
    float blurScale = lerp(0.70f, 1.35f, saturate(AtmosphereCamera.w));
    float2 rayToLight = lightUv - screenUv;
    [unroll] for (int stepIndex = 0; stepIndex < stepCount; ++stepIndex)
    {
        float t = ((float)stepIndex + 1.0f) / ((float)stepCount + 1.0f);
        float sampleT = saturate(t * blurScale);
        float sampleDepth = depthTexture.SampleLevel(depthSampler, screenUv + rayToLight * sampleT, 0);
        float skyVisibility = (sampleDepth <= 0.0f ? 1.0f : 0.0f);
        float weight = 1.0f - sampleT * 0.55f;
        occlusion += skyVisibility * weight;
        weightSum += weight;
    }

    return lerp(0.35f, 1.0f, occlusion / max(weightSum, 0.0001f));
}

float3 RayMarchAtmosphereViewCommon(float3 worldPos, Texture2DArray<float> shadowMap,
                                    SamplerComparisonState shadowSampler, float4x4 lightViewProjection,
                                    float4 shadowMapParams)
{
    float atmosphereActive =
        step(0.5f, AtmosphereParams0.x) * step(0.0001f, AtmosphereColor0.a) * step(0.0001f, AtmosphereParams0.w);
#ifdef SHADER_POSTPROCESS
    float3 cameraPos = ReconstructPostProcessCameraOriginCommon(worldPos, AtmosphereCamera.xyz);
#else
    float3 cameraPos = SurfaceCameraOriginCommon(worldPos, AtmosphereCamera.xyz);
#endif
    float3 viewDelta = worldPos - cameraPos;
    float rawViewDistance = length(viewDelta);
    float validDistance = step(0.0001f, rawViewDistance);
    float viewDistance = clamp(rawViewDistance, 0.0001f, 80.0f);

    int stepCount = 50;
    float3 viewDir = viewDelta / max(rawViewDistance, 0.0001f);
    float3 viewToCamera = -viewDir;
    float stepLength = viewDistance / (float)max(stepCount, 1);
    float scaledStep = stepLength * max(AtmosphereParams1.w, 0.0001f);
    float transmittance = 1.0f;
    float3 result = float3(0.0f, 0.0f, 0.0f);
    int count = min((int)round(LightCount.x), 5);

    [loop] for (int stepIndex = 0; stepIndex < stepCount; ++stepIndex)
    {
        float t = ((float)stepIndex + 0.5f) / (float)stepCount;
        float3 samplePos = cameraPos + viewDir * viewDistance * t;
        float3 stepScatter = float3(0.0f, 0.0f, 0.0f);
        float sampleDensity = AtmosphereDensityCommon(samplePos);

        [loop] for (int lightIndex = 0; lightIndex < count; ++lightIndex)
        {
            float3 singleDir;
            float singleAttenuation;
            float singleVolume;
            ResolveSingleLightCommon(samplePos, LightDirections[lightIndex], LightPositionTypes[lightIndex],
                                     LightExtras[lightIndex], singleDir, singleAttenuation, singleVolume);
            float3 rawSingleColor =
                max(LightColors[lightIndex].rgb, float3(0.0f, 0.0f, 0.0f)) * max(LightColors[lightIndex].a, 0.0f);
            float3 singleColor = rawSingleColor * singleAttenuation;
            float shadowVisibility = 1.0f;
            if (LightShadowData[lightIndex].x >= -0.5f)
            {
                float4 perLightShadowParams = float4(LightShadowData[lightIndex].y, LightShadowData[lightIndex].z,
                                                     LightShadowData[lightIndex].w, 1.0f);
                shadowVisibility = SampleAtmosphereShadowMap(samplePos, singleDir, shadowMap, shadowSampler,
                                                             LightViewProjections[lightIndex], perLightShadowParams,
                                                             LightShadowData[lightIndex].x);
            }
#ifdef SHADER_RAYTRACING
            if (SceneRayFlags.x > 0.5f)
            {
                shadowVisibility = SceneShadowForLightCommon(lightIndex, samplePos, singleDir, singleDir);
            }
#endif
            float3 shadowedColor = singleColor * shadowVisibility;
            float localLight = step(0.5f, LightPositionTypes[lightIndex].w);
            float volumeVisibility = lerp(shadowVisibility, max(shadowVisibility, 0.45f), localLight);
            float3 volumeColor = rawSingleColor * sqrt(saturate(singleAttenuation)) * volumeVisibility;
            float volumeLight =
                step(2.5f, LightPositionTypes[lightIndex].w) * step(LightPositionTypes[lightIndex].w, 3.5f);
            float localVolumeStepBoost = lerp(1.0f, 0.35f / max(AtmosphereParams1.w, 0.0001f), localLight);
            float phase = saturate(
                HenyeyGreensteinCommon(clamp(dot(-singleDir, viewToCamera), -1.0f, 1.0f), AtmosphereParams1.z) * 6.0f);
            float shaftBoost = lerp(0.55f, 1.75f, phase) * lerp(1.0f, 2.35f, volumeLight);
            float3 singleAtmosphere =
                AtmosphereSingleScatterFromDensityCommon(sampleDensity, viewToCamera, singleDir, shadowedColor);
            stepScatter += singleAtmosphere * lerp(1.0f, 0.45f, volumeLight);
            stepScatter += volumeColor * singleVolume * sampleDensity * shaftBoost * localVolumeStepBoost *
                           lerp(0.22f, lerp(0.82f, 1.05f, volumeLight), localLight);
        }

        if (count <= 0)
        {
            float3 singleDir;
            float singleAttenuation;
            float singleVolume;
            ResolveSingleLightCommon(samplePos, LightDirection, LightPositionType, LightExtra, singleDir,
                                     singleAttenuation, singleVolume);
            float3 rawSingleColor = max(LightColor.rgb, float3(0.0f, 0.0f, 0.0f)) * max(LightColor.a, 0.0f);
            float3 singleColor = rawSingleColor * singleAttenuation;
            float shadowVisibility = SampleAtmosphereShadowMap(samplePos, singleDir, shadowMap, shadowSampler,
                                                               lightViewProjection, shadowMapParams, 0.0f);
            float3 shadowedColor = singleColor * shadowVisibility;
            float localLight = step(0.5f, LightPositionType.w);
            float volumeVisibility = lerp(shadowVisibility, max(shadowVisibility, 0.45f), localLight);
            float3 volumeColor = rawSingleColor * sqrt(saturate(singleAttenuation)) * volumeVisibility;
            float volumeLight = step(2.5f, LightPositionType.w) * step(LightPositionType.w, 3.5f);
            float localVolumeStepBoost = lerp(1.0f, 0.35f / max(AtmosphereParams1.w, 0.0001f), localLight);
            float phase = saturate(
                HenyeyGreensteinCommon(clamp(dot(-singleDir, viewToCamera), -1.0f, 1.0f), AtmosphereParams1.z) * 6.0f);
            float shaftBoost = lerp(0.55f, 1.75f, phase) * lerp(1.0f, 2.35f, volumeLight);
            float3 singleAtmosphere =
                AtmosphereSingleScatterFromDensityCommon(sampleDensity, viewToCamera, singleDir, shadowedColor);
            stepScatter += singleAtmosphere * lerp(1.0f, 0.45f, volumeLight);
            stepScatter += volumeColor * singleVolume * sampleDensity * shaftBoost * localVolumeStepBoost *
                           lerp(0.22f, lerp(0.82f, 1.05f, volumeLight), localLight);
        }

        result += stepScatter * transmittance * scaledStep;
        transmittance *= exp(-max(AtmosphereParams1.y, 0.0f) * sampleDensity * scaledStep);
        if (transmittance <= 0.01f)
        {
            break;
        }
    }

    return result * max(AtmosphereColor0.a, 0.0f) * atmosphereActive * validDistance;
}

float3 AtmosphereBackgroundCommon(float2 uv)
{
    float atmosphereEnabled = step(0.5f, AtmosphereParams0.x);
    float3 viewDir = SafeNormalizeCommon(float3((uv.x - 0.5f) * 1.45f, (0.5f - uv.y) * 0.9f + 0.25f, 1.0f),
                                         float3(0.0f, 0.2f, 1.0f));
    float3 lightDir = SafeNormalizeCommon(LightDirection.xyz, float3(0.0f, 1.0f, 0.0f));
    float3 lightColor = max(LightColor.rgb, float3(0.0f, 0.0f, 0.0f)) * max(LightColor.a, 0.0f);

    int count = min((int)round(LightCount.x), MAX_SHADER_LIGHTS);
    if (count > 0)
    {
        lightDir = SafeNormalizeCommon(LightDirections[0].xyz, lightDir);
        lightColor = max(LightColors[0].rgb, float3(0.0f, 0.0f, 0.0f)) * max(LightColors[0].a, 0.0f);
    }

    // 修正：AtmosphereGBufferPS / SkyAtmosphere と同じ向き（太陽の方向を見たときに前方散乱が最大）
    float cosTheta = clamp(dot(lightDir, viewDir), -1.0f, 1.0f);
    float rayleighPhase = RayleighPhaseCommon(cosTheta);
    float miePhase = HenyeyGreensteinCommon(cosTheta, AtmosphereParams1.z);
    float skyDensity = max(AtmosphereParams0.w, 0.0f) * lerp(1.15f, 0.35f, saturate(uv.y));
    float horizon = pow(saturate(1.0f - abs(uv.y - 0.55f) * 1.35f), 2.0f);
    float3 rayleigh = AtmosphereColor0.rgb * max(AtmosphereParams0.y, 0.0f) * rayleighPhase;
    float3 mie = AtmosphereColor1.rgb * max(AtmosphereParams0.z, 0.0f) * miePhase * (0.35f + horizon * 1.25f);
    return (rayleigh + mie) * lightColor * skyDensity * max(AtmosphereColor0.a, 0.0f) * atmosphereEnabled;
}

void ResolveSingleLightCommon(float3 worldPos, float4 lightDirectionData, float4 lightPositionTypeData,
                              float4 lightExtraData, out float3 lightDir, out float attenuation,
                              out float volumeScatter)
{
    int lightType = (int)round(lightPositionTypeData.w);
    float lightRange = max(lightDirectionData.w, 0.01f);
    lightDir = SafeNormalizeCommon(lightDirectionData.xyz, float3(0.0f, 1.0f, 0.0f));
    attenuation = 1.0f;
    volumeScatter = 0.0f;

    if (lightType == 0)
    {
        float density = StageVolumeDensity(lightExtraData.z);
        volumeScatter = density * 0.025f;
    }

    if (lightType == 1 || lightType == 2 || lightType == 3)
    {
        float3 toLight = lightPositionTypeData.xyz - worldPos;
        float distanceToLight = length(toLight);
        lightDir = SafeNormalizeCommon(toLight, lightDir);
        float rangeFade = saturate(1.0f - distanceToLight / lightRange);
        attenuation = StageRangeAttenuation(distanceToLight, lightRange, lightExtraData.z);
        float3 fromLight = SafeNormalizeCommon(worldPos - lightPositionTypeData.xyz, float3(0.0f, -1.0f, 0.0f));
        float3 spotForward = SafeNormalizeCommon(lightDirectionData.xyz, fromLight);
        float density = StageVolumeDensity(lightExtraData.z);

        if (lightType == 1)
        {
            float radialGlow = pow(rangeFade, 2.2f);
            volumeScatter = radialGlow * density * 0.16f;
        }

        if (lightType == 2 || lightType == 3)
        {
            float3 fromLightOffset = worldPos - lightPositionTypeData.xyz;
            float axialDistance = max(dot(fromLightOffset, spotForward), 0.0f);
            float radialDistance = length(fromLightOffset - spotForward * axialDistance);
            float outerCos = clamp(lightExtraData.y, 0.001f, 0.999f);
            float outerSin = sqrt(saturate(1.0f - outerCos * outerCos));
            float outerTan = outerSin / outerCos;
            float coneRadius = max(axialDistance * outerTan, 0.001f);
            float cylinderRadius = max(lightRange * outerTan * 0.35f, 0.001f);
            float spotCos = dot(fromLight, spotForward);
            float spotMask = smoothstep(lightExtraData.y, lightExtraData.x, spotCos);
            attenuation *= spotMask;

            float coneRadialAlpha = saturate(radialDistance / coneRadius);
            float axialAlpha = saturate(axialDistance / lightRange);
            float coneBodyMask = exp(-coneRadialAlpha * coneRadialAlpha * 2.0f) * exp(-axialAlpha * 2.5f) * spotMask *
                                 step(0.0f, axialDistance);

            if (lightType == 2)
            {
                volumeScatter = coneBodyMask * density * 0.32f;
            }
        }

        if (lightType == 3)
        {
            float volumeShape = saturate(lightExtraData.w);
            float3 fromLightOffset = worldPos - lightPositionTypeData.xyz;
            float axialDistance = dot(fromLightOffset, spotForward);
            float radialDistance = length(fromLightOffset - spotForward * axialDistance);
            float outerCos = clamp(lightExtraData.y, 0.001f, 0.999f);
            float outerSin = sqrt(saturate(1.0f - outerCos * outerCos));
            float outerTan = outerSin / outerCos;
            float coneEndRadius = max(lightRange * outerTan, 0.001f);
            float coneRootRadius = max(coneEndRadius * 0.04f, 0.05f);
            float coneRadiusSlope = max(coneEndRadius - coneRootRadius, 0.0f) / lightRange;
            float coneRadius = max(coneRootRadius + axialDistance * coneRadiusSlope, coneRootRadius);
            float cylinderRadius = max(coneEndRadius * 0.45f, 0.001f);

            float insideAxial = step(0.0f, axialDistance) * step(axialDistance, lightRange);
            float axialAlpha = saturate(axialDistance / lightRange);
            float coneRadialAlpha = radialDistance / coneRadius;
            float cylinderRadialAlpha = radialDistance / cylinderRadius;

            float coneEdge = 1.0f - smoothstep(0.78f, 1.0f, coneRadialAlpha);
            float cylinderEdge = 1.0f - smoothstep(0.78f, 1.0f, cylinderRadialAlpha);
            float endFade = 1.0f - smoothstep(0.72f, 1.0f, axialAlpha);

            float coneMask = exp(-coneRadialAlpha * coneRadialAlpha * 1.35f) * coneEdge * endFade * insideAxial;
            float cylinderMask =
                exp(-cylinderRadialAlpha * cylinderRadialAlpha * 1.7f) * cylinderEdge * endFade * insideAxial;

            float shapeMask = lerp(coneMask, cylinderMask, volumeShape);

            attenuation = StageRangeAttenuation(distanceToLight, lightRange, lightExtraData.z) * shapeMask;
            volumeScatter = shapeMask * density * 0.55f;
        }
    }

    if (lightType == 5)
    {
        float3 offset = worldPos - lightPositionTypeData.xyz;
        float axial = StageCapsuleAxial(dot(offset, lightDir), lightExtraData.x);
        float3 toSource = lightDir * axial - offset;
        float distanceToSource = max(length(toSource) - max(lightExtraData.y, 0.0f), 0.0f);
        lightDir = SafeNormalizeCommon(toSource, lightDir);
        attenuation = StageRangeAttenuation(distanceToSource, lightRange, lightExtraData.z);
    }

    if (lightType == 4)
    {
        // 矩形面光源：非 PBR パス、影、GI、フォグでは中心点で近似する。
        // PBR の面では LTC で矩形全体を評価する（SurfaceLighting.hlsli）。
        float3 toLight = lightPositionTypeData.xyz - worldPos;
        float distanceToLight = length(toLight);
        lightDir = SafeNormalizeCommon(toLight, lightDir);
        float3 emitNormal = SafeNormalizeCommon(lightDirectionData.xyz, float3(0.0f, -1.0f, 0.0f));
        float emitterCosine = saturate(dot(-lightDir, emitNormal));
        float area = max(lightExtraData.x, 0.01f) * max(lightExtraData.y, 0.01f);
        // 小さな光源は、総出力が同じ点光源として振る舞う。
        attenuation = StageRangeAttenuation(distanceToLight, lightRange, lightExtraData.z) * emitterCosine *
                      (lightExtraData.z < 0.0f ? 1.0f : saturate(area));
        volumeScatter = 0.0f;
    }
}

void ResolveLightCommon(float3 worldPos, out float3 lightDir, out float attenuation, out float volumeScatter)
{
    ResolveSingleLightCommon(worldPos, LightDirection, LightPositionType, LightExtra, lightDir, attenuation,
                             volumeScatter);
}

void ResolveLightAggregate(float3 worldPos, float2 pixelPosition, out float3 lightDir, out float3 lightColor,
                           out float attenuation, out float volumeScatter, out float rangeBlend)
{
    lightDir = SafeNormalizeCommon(LightDirection.xyz, float3(0.0f, 1.0f, 0.0f));
    lightColor = max(LightColor.rgb, float3(0.0f, 0.0f, 0.0f)) * max(LightColor.a, 0.0f);
    attenuation = 1.0f;
    volumeScatter = 0.0f;
    rangeBlend = saturate((max(LightDirection.w, 1.0f) - 1.0f) / 7.0f);

    int count = min((int)round(LightCount.x), MAX_SHADER_LIGHTS);
    float3 dirSum = float3(0.0f, 0.0f, 0.0f);
    float3 colorSum = float3(0.0f, 0.0f, 0.0f);
    float weightSum = 0.0f;
    float maxAttenuation = 0.0f;
    float volumeSum = 0.0f;
    float rangeSum = 0.0f;

    bool useLightGrid = HasLightTileGridCommon();
    uint tileBase = useLightGrid ? LightTileBaseCommon(pixelPosition) : 0u;
    int iterationCount = useLightGrid ? min(MAX_LIGHTS_PER_TILE, max((int)round(LightCount.w), 1)) : count;
    [loop] for (int iteration = 0; iteration < MAX_SHADER_LIGHTS; ++iteration)
    {
        if (iteration >= iterationCount)
        {
            break;
        }

        uint lightIndex = useLightGrid ? LightTileIndices[tileBase + (uint)iteration] : (uint)iteration;
        if (lightIndex == 0xffffffffu || lightIndex >= (uint)count || LightFlags[lightIndex].y < 0.5f ||
            LightFlags[lightIndex].w >= 0.5f)
        {
            continue;
        }

        int i = (int)lightIndex;

        float3 singleDir;
        float singleAttenuation;
        float singleVolume;
        ResolveSingleLightCommon(worldPos, LightDirections[i], LightPositionTypes[i], LightExtras[i], singleDir,
                                 singleAttenuation, singleVolume);

        float3 singleColor =
            max(LightColors[i].rgb, float3(0.0f, 0.0f, 0.0f)) * max(LightColors[i].a, 0.0f) * singleAttenuation;
        singleColor *= SceneShadowForLightCommon(lightIndex, worldPos, float3(0.0f, 0.0f, 0.0f), singleDir);
        singleColor = ApplyAtmosphereToLightCommon(worldPos, singleDir, singleColor, singleVolume);
        float weight = max(dot(singleColor, float3(0.299f, 0.587f, 0.114f)), 0.0001f) * singleAttenuation;
        dirSum += singleDir * weight;
        colorSum += singleColor;
        weightSum += weight;
        maxAttenuation = max(maxAttenuation, singleAttenuation);
        volumeSum += singleVolume * max(LightColors[i].a, 0.0f);
        rangeSum += saturate((max(LightDirections[i].w, 1.0f) - 1.0f) / 7.0f) * weight;
    }

    if (count <= 0)
    {
        float legacyVolume = 0.0f;
        ResolveLightCommon(worldPos, lightDir, attenuation, legacyVolume);
        lightColor = max(LightColor.rgb, float3(0.0f, 0.0f, 0.0f)) * max(LightColor.a, 0.0f) * attenuation;
        lightColor = ApplyAtmosphereToLightCommon(worldPos, lightDir, lightColor, legacyVolume);
        volumeScatter = legacyVolume * max(LightColor.a, 0.0f);
        rangeBlend = saturate((max(LightDirection.w, 1.0f) - 1.0f) / 7.0f);
        return;
    }

    if (weightSum <= 0.000001f)
    {
        lightColor = float3(0.0f, 0.0f, 0.0f);
        attenuation = 0.0f;
        volumeScatter = 0.0f;
        rangeBlend = 0.0f;
        return;
    }

    lightDir = SafeNormalizeCommon(dirSum, SafeNormalizeCommon(LightDirection.xyz, float3(0.0f, 1.0f, 0.0f)));
    lightColor = colorSum + AtmosphereAmbientCommon(worldPos, lightDir);
    attenuation = saturate(maxAttenuation);
    volumeScatter = volumeSum;
    rangeBlend = saturate(rangeSum / weightSum);
}

#ifdef SHADER_2D

float3 SafeNormalizeCommon(float3 value, float3 fallback)
{
    float lenSq = dot(value, value);
    return (lenSq > 0.000001f) ? value * rsqrt(lenSq) : fallback;
}

float3 ApplyNormalMapCommon(float3 meshNormal, float3 worldPos, float2 texCoord, float3 tangentNormal)
{
    float3 n = SafeNormalizeCommon(meshNormal, float3(0.0f, 0.0f, -1.0f));
#ifdef SHADER_VISIBILITY_RESOLVE
    float3 dp1 = VisibilityWorldDx;
    float3 dp2 = VisibilityWorldDy;
    float2 duv1 = VisibilityUvDx;
    float2 duv2 = VisibilityUvDy;
#else
    float3 dp1 = ddx(worldPos);
    float3 dp2 = ddy(worldPos);
    float2 duv1 = ddx(texCoord);
    float2 duv2 = ddy(texCoord);
#endif

    float det = duv1.x * duv2.y - duv1.y * duv2.x;
    float useTbn = (abs(det) >= 0.0000000000000000001f) ? 1.0f : 0.0f;
    float invDet = rcp(lerp(1.0f, det, useTbn));
    float3 tangent = (dp1 * duv2.y - dp2 * duv1.y) * invDet;
    tangent = SafeNormalizeCommon(tangent - n * dot(n, tangent), float3(1.0f, 0.0f, 0.0f));
    float3 bitangent = SafeNormalizeCommon(cross(n, tangent), float3(0.0f, 1.0f, 0.0f));
    float3 mappedNormal =
        SafeNormalizeCommon(tangentNormal.x * tangent + tangentNormal.y * bitangent + tangentNormal.z * n, n);
    return SafeNormalizeCommon(lerp(n, mappedNormal, useTbn), n);
}

float3 ACESToneMap(float3 color)
{
    float a = 2.51f;
    float b = 0.03f;
    float c = 2.43f;
    float d = 0.59f;
    float e = 0.14f;
    color = saturate((color * (a * color + b)) / (color * (c * color + d) + e));
    return color;
}

#ifdef SHADER_FORWARD_LIGHTING
cbuffer PostProcessParams : register(b6)
#else
cbuffer PostProcessParams : register(b0)
#endif
{
    float4 Flags;
    float4 PPCameraPos;
    float4 HdrFlags;
    float4 BloomParams;
    float4x4 PPInvViewProjection;
    float4x4 PPViewProjection;
    float4 RaytracingFlags;
    float4 RaytracingSunDirection;
    // 描画品質の設定（renderquality.h）
    float4 GradeParams0; // トーンマッパー、コントラスト、彩度、自然な彩度
    float4 GradeParams1; // 色温度、色かぶり、AgX のパンチ、未使用
    float4 GradeLift;
    float4 GradeGamma;
    float4 GradeGain;
    float4 LensParams0;    // ビネット、ビネットの滑らかさ、色収差（px）、フィルムグレイン
    float4 LensParams1;    // 時刻、フレーム、未使用、未使用
    float4 WeatherParams0; // 濡れ、水たまり、雪、雨
    float4 WeatherParams1; // 降雪、風の x、風の z、未使用
    float4 QualityFlags;   // エネルギー補償、面光源、OIT の有効フラグ、RT 屈折
    float4 QualityReserved;
};

float3 ReconstructPostProcessViewRayCommon(float2 uv)
{
    return CameraRayDirection(uv, PPInvViewProjection);
}

float3 ReconstructPostProcessCameraOriginCommon(float3 worldPosition, float3 cameraPosition)
{
    return CameraRayOriginFromWorld(worldPosition, cameraPosition, PPInvViewProjection);
}

#include "ToneMapping.hlsli"

// 露出 → シーン基準の色調整 → トーンマッパー → ディスプレイ基準の色調整。
// 出力は線形のまま（スワップチェーンと sRGB 変換は変更しない）。
float3 ApplyHdrOutput(float3 color)
{
    float exposure = Flags.x;
    float enableToneMap = HdrFlags.y;
    if (exposure > 0.001f)
    {
        color *= exposure;
    }
    color = GradeSceneLinear(max(color, 0.0f));
    if (enableToneMap > 0.5f)
    {
        color = ApplyToneMapper(color);
        color = GradeDisplay(color);
    }
    return color;
}

struct PSInputPostProcess
{
    float4 Position : SV_POSITION;
    float2 TexCoord : TEXCOORD0;
};

float3 WorldToScreenUV(float3 worldPos)
{
    float4 clipPos = mul(float4(worldPos, 1.0f), PPViewProjection);
    clipPos.xyz /= max(abs(clipPos.w), 0.000001f);
    float2 screenUV = float2(clipPos.x * 0.5f + 0.5f, -clipPos.y * 0.5f + 0.5f);
    return float3(screenUV, clipPos.z);
}

bool ProjectWorldToScreenCommon(float3 worldPos, out float2 screenUv)
{
    float4 clipPos = mul(float4(worldPos, 1.0f), PPViewProjection);
    if (clipPos.w <= 0.000001f)
    {
        screenUv = float2(0.0f, 0.0f);
        return false;
    }

    float3 ndc = clipPos.xyz / clipPos.w;
    screenUv = float2(ndc.x * 0.5f + 0.5f, -ndc.y * 0.5f + 0.5f);
    return ndc.z >= 0.0f && ndc.z <= 1.0f;
}

float3 ScreenSpaceRayMarch(float3 origin, float3 direction, Texture2D<float> depthTex, SamplerState depthSampler)
{
    const float maxDist = 15.0f;
    const int maxSteps = 64;
    const int refineSteps = 6;
    const float stepSize = maxDist / (float)maxSteps;

    float previousT = 0.0f;
    float previousDepthDiff = -1.0f;
    bool hasFrontSample = false;

    [loop] for (int i = 1; i <= maxSteps; ++i)
    {
        float currentT = stepSize * (float)i;
        float3 rayPos = origin + direction * currentT;
        float4 clipPos = mul(float4(rayPos, 1.0f), PPViewProjection);
        if (clipPos.w <= 0.000001f)
        {
            break;
        }

        float3 rayNdc = clipPos.xyz / clipPos.w;
        float3 rayUVZ = float3(rayNdc.x * 0.5f + 0.5f, -rayNdc.y * 0.5f + 0.5f, rayNdc.z);

        if (rayUVZ.x < 0.0f || rayUVZ.x > 1.0f || rayUVZ.y < 0.0f || rayUVZ.y > 1.0f)
        {
            break;
        }

        if (rayUVZ.z < 0.0f || rayUVZ.z > 1.0f)
        {
            break;
        }

        float sceneDepth = depthTex.SampleLevel(depthSampler, rayUVZ.xy, 0).r;
        if (sceneDepth <= 0.0f)
        {
            previousT = currentT;
            continue;
        }

        float depthDiff = sceneDepth - rayUVZ.z;
        if (depthDiff <= 0.0f)
        {
            hasFrontSample = true;
            previousT = currentT;
            previousDepthDiff = depthDiff;
            continue;
        }

        if (hasFrontSample && previousDepthDiff <= 0.0f)
        {
            float lowT = previousT;
            float highT = currentT;

            [unroll] for (int refine = 0; refine < refineSteps; ++refine)
            {
                float midT = (lowT + highT) * 0.5f;
                float3 midPos = origin + direction * midT;
                float4 midClip = mul(float4(midPos, 1.0f), PPViewProjection);
                float3 midNdc = midClip.xyz / max(midClip.w, 0.000001f);
                float2 midUv = float2(midNdc.x * 0.5f + 0.5f, -midNdc.y * 0.5f + 0.5f);
                float midSceneDepth = depthTex.SampleLevel(depthSampler, midUv, 0).r;

                if (midNdc.z < midSceneDepth)
                {
                    highT = midT;
                }
                else
                {
                    lowT = midT;
                }
            }

            float hitT = (lowT + highT) * 0.5f;
            float3 hitPos = origin + direction * hitT;
            float4 hitClip = mul(float4(hitPos, 1.0f), PPViewProjection);
            float3 hitNdc = hitClip.xyz / max(hitClip.w, 0.000001f);
            float2 hitUv = float2(hitNdc.x * 0.5f + 0.5f, -hitNdc.y * 0.5f + 0.5f);
            return float3(hitUv, hitT);
        }

        previousT = currentT;
        previousDepthDiff = depthDiff;
    }

    return float3(-1.0f, -1.0f, -1.0f);
}

float3 ReconstructPostProcessWorldPositionCommon(float2 uv, float depth)
{
    float2 ndc = uv * float2(2.0f, -2.0f) + float2(-1.0f, 1.0f);
    float4 world = mul(float4(ndc, depth, 1.0f), PPInvViewProjection);
    return world.xyz / max(abs(world.w), 1.0e-20f);
}

===== FILE: shader\hlsl\DeferredLightingPS.hlsl =====
Texture2D<float4> MaterialEmissionAO : register(t33);
#define SHADER_POSTPROCESS
#define SHADER_3D
#include "common.hlsl"
// 大気 LUT の物理的な空（ルート引数 26、t40/t41、クランプサンプラー s4 にバインド）。
#define SKY_LUT 1
#define SKY_LUT_SCATTER_REGISTER t40
#define SKY_LUT_TRANSMISSION_REGISTER t41
#define SKY_LUT_SAMPLER_REGISTER s4
#include "SkyAtmosphere.hlsli"
#include "CloudMedium.hlsli"
#pragma warning(disable : 4000)

Texture2D<float4> BaseColorTexture : register(t0);
Texture2D<float4> NormalTexture : register(t1);
Texture2D<float> DepthTexture : register(t2);
Texture2D<float4> MaterialTexture : register(t3);

Texture2D<float4> MonitorTexture : register(t12);

Texture2D<float4> DeinterleavedSSGI : register(t14);
Texture2D<float2> RaytracedVisibility : register(t16);
Texture2D<float4> RaytracedReflections : register(t17);

SamplerState TextureSampler : register(s0);
SamplerComparisonState ShadowSampler : register(s1);

// MegaLights（ルート引数 28〜34）
//   M1: t44 ライト / t45 セル / t46 セル内ライト / b10 定数
//   M2: t47 サンプル / u1 累積（検証）/ t48 リファレンス（検証）
//   M3: u2 ML6 の生の結果 / t49 デノイズ済み（ルート引数 35, 36）
#define MEGALIGHTS_GRID 1
#define MEGALIGHTS_CB_REGISTER b10
#include "MegaLightsCommon.hlsli"
StructuredBuffer<MegaLightData> MegaLightBuffer : register(t44);
StructuredBuffer<uint2> MegaLightCells : register(t45);
StructuredBuffer<uint> MegaLightIndices : register(t46);
StructuredBuffer<uint4> MegaLightSamples : register(t47);
RWStructuredBuffer<float4> MegaLightAccumulation : register(u1);
StructuredBuffer<float4> MegaLightReference : register(t48);
//   M3: u2 ML6 の結果（デモジュレート済み・MegaLightsShadePS が書く）/ t49 デノイズ済み
RWStructuredBuffer<float4> MegaLightRaw : register(u2);
StructuredBuffer<float4> MegaLightDenoised : register(t49);
//   M4: t50 可視ライトハッシュ（このフレームに作ったもの。デバッグ表示用。ルート引数 37）
StructuredBuffer<uint4> MegaLightHash : register(t50);
static uint g_MLCellIndex = ML_INVALID_CELL;

// リファレンス：ライト全体の平均可視率を、面上の層別点への影レイで求める（毎フレーム回転 → 累積で収束）
float MLReferenceVisibility(MegaLightData light, float3 worldPos, float3 normal, uint2 pixel, uint lightOrdinal)
{
    if (!MLLightCastsShadow(light))
    {
        return 1.0f;
    }
#ifdef SHADER_RAYTRACING
    const bool area = (int)round(light.PositionType.w) == 4 || light.Flags.y > 1.0e-4f;
    const uint requested = area ? clamp((uint)MLStochasticParams.w, 1u, 64u) : 1u;
    const uint side = max((uint)floor(sqrt((float)requested) + 0.001f), 1u);
    const uint seed = MLSeed(pixel, MLStochastic.z, 0x5245u + lightOrdinal * 7919u);
    const float2 jitter = float2(MLRandom(seed), MLRandom(seed ^ 0x9e3779b9u));
    float visible = 0.0f;
    [loop] for (uint index = 0u; index < side * side; ++index)
    {
        const float2 uv = (float2(index % side, index / side) + jitter) / (float)side;
        float3 shadowPosition = worldPos + MLViewDirection(worldPos) * max(-NormalTexture.Load(int3(pixel, 0)).a, 0.0f);
        visible += TraceSceneSegment(shadowPosition, normal, MLLightSamplePoint(light, worldPos, uv));
    }
    return visible / (float)(side * side);
#else
    return -1.0f;
#endif
}

// M7：テクスチャ付き矩形ライト（ルート引数 38：エンジンのテクスチャ SRV 512 個, t0 space5）
#define MEGALIGHTS_LIGHT_TEXTURES 1

// DFG / LTC テーブル（ルート引数 27：t42、t43）。
#define SURFACE_PBR_LUTS 1
#include "SurfaceLighting.hlsli"
#include "WeatherSurface.hlsli"

float4 ShadeDeferred(PSInputPostProcess input)
{

    const float PI = 3.14159265358979323846f;
    // ライティングは GBuffer の解像度で行う。整数座標の読み取りでマテリアルの
    // 分類を保ち、ピクセルごとの属性のフィルタリングを省く。
    const int3 gbufferPixel = int3(int2(input.Position.xy), 0);
    float4 material = MaterialTexture.Load(gbufferPixel);
    float shaderClass = material.a;
    bool background = shaderClass < -0.5f;
    bool transparent = IsMaterialClass(shaderClass, 0.0f);
    float4 baseColor = BaseColorTexture.Load(gbufferPixel);
    float3 giReflectance = baseColor.rgb * (1 - saturate(material.x));

    if (transparent)
    {
        return baseColor;
    }

    float4 atmosphereMedia = AtmosphereTexture.SampleLevel(TextureSampler, input.TexCoord, 0);
    float fogTransmittance = saturate(atmosphereMedia.a);
    if (background)
    {
        if (SkyParameters.x > 0.5f)
        {
            // 空の積分値には大気の消散と散乱がすでに含まれる。
            return float4(EvaluateSkyAtmosphere(ReconstructPostProcessViewRayCommon(input.TexCoord)), 1.0f);
        }
        baseColor.rgb =
            (baseColor.rgb + AtmosphereBackgroundCommon(input.TexCoord)) * fogTransmittance + atmosphereMedia.rgb;
        return baseColor;
    }

    bool toon = IsLiveToonClass(shaderClass);
    bool shadow = IsMaterialClass(shaderClass, 5.0f);
    bool lit = IsMaterialClass(shaderClass, 8.0f);
    bool pbr = IsMaterialClass(shaderClass, 11.0f);
    const int shadowDebugMode = (int)round(ShadowDebugGlobal.x);
    const bool needsDeferredLighting = toon || shadow || lit || pbr || shadowDebugMode > 0;
    [branch] if (!needsDeferredLighting)
    {
        baseColor.rgb = baseColor.rgb * fogTransmittance + atmosphereMedia.rgb;
        baseColor.a = 1.0f;
        return baseColor;
    }

    float4 normal = NormalTexture.Load(gbufferPixel);
    float depth = DepthTexture.Load(gbufferPixel);
    float3 position = ReconstructPostProcessWorldPositionCommon(input.TexCoord, depth);
    float3 positionDx = ddx(position);
    float3 positionDy = ddy(position);
    float4 shadowParams = ShadowGBufferTexture.Load(gbufferPixel);

    float shadowThreshold = shadowParams.r;
    float shadowSoftness = max(shadowParams.g, 0.0001f);
    float shadowStrength = saturate(shadowParams.b);

    float3 lightDir;
    float3 lightColor;
    float lightAttenuation;
    float volumeScatter;
    float rangeBlend;
    float aggregateShadowVisibility;
    float3 surfaceNormal = DecodeGBufferNormal(normal.xyz);
    if (toon)
    {
        g_PomSelfShadow = LiveToonPomVisibility(shadowParams.a);
        g_PomSelfShadowLight = LightPositionType.w < 0.5f
                                  ? SafeNormalizeCommon(LightDirection.xyz, float3(0.0f, 1.0f, 0.0f))
                                  : SafeNormalizeCommon(LightPositionType.xyz - position, float3(0.0f, 1.0f, 0.0f));
    }
    if (pbr)
    {
        // 拡張マテリアルモデル（影の GBuffer の alpha）と、PBR の面に適用する天候。
        g_ShadingModel = DecodeShadingModel(shadowParams.a);
        // POM セルフシャドウ（MaterialSurface.hlsli: WriteAssetParallaxSelfShadow）。r = 1 が印、b = 可視率。
        if (shadowParams.r > 0.999f)
        {
            g_PomSelfShadow = saturate(shadowParams.b);
            g_PomSelfShadowLight = LightPositionType.w < 0.5f
                                       ? SafeNormalizeCommon(LightDirection.xyz, float3(0.0f, 1.0f, 0.0f))
                                       : SafeNormalizeCommon(LightPositionType.xyz - position, float3(0.0f, 1.0f, 0.0f));
        }
        ApplyWeatherToSurface(position, surfaceNormal, baseColor.rgb, material.rgb);
    }
    float3 viewDir = CameraViewDirection(position, PPCameraPos.xyz, PPInvViewProjection);
    g_PomShadowOffset = viewDir * max(-normal.a, 0.0f);
    g_PomShadowOffsetDx = ddx(g_PomShadowOffset);
    g_PomShadowOffsetDy = ddy(g_PomShadowOffset);
    float3 pbrDirectLight;
    int materialShadowFilterRadius =
        pbr ? clamp((int)round(lerp(max(VirtualShadowGlobal.z, 1.0f), 3.0f, saturate(shadowSoftness * 2.0f))), 1, 3)
            : clamp((int)round(VirtualShadowGlobal.z), 0, 3);
    g_LiveToonClass = toon ? shaderClass : 0.0f;
    g_LiveToonShadow = float2(shadowThreshold, shadowStrength);
    ResolveSurfaceLightAggregateShadowed(position, positionDx, positionDy, surfaceNormal, input.Position.xy,
                                         materialShadowFilterRadius, pbr, viewDir, baseColor.rgb, material.rgb,
                                         shadowSoftness, pbrDirectLight, lightDir, lightColor, lightAttenuation,
                                         volumeScatter, rangeBlend, aggregateShadowVisibility);

    if (shadowDebugMode == 1 && VirtualShadowGlobal.x > 0.5f)
    {

        return float4(aggregateShadowVisibility.xxx, 1.0f);
    }
    if (shadowDebugMode > 1 && VirtualShadowGlobal.x > 0.5f && VirtualShadowGlobal.x < 1.5f)
    {
        int selectedLevel = max((int)round(VirtualShadowGlobal.y) - 1, 0);
        float2 selectedUv = float2(0.5f, 0.5f);
        [unroll] for (int level = 0; level < 4; ++level)
        {
            if (level >= (int)round(VirtualShadowGlobal.y))
            {
                break;
            }
            float4 clip = mul(float4(position.xyz, 1.0f), VirtualShadowViewProjections[level]);
            float3 ndc = clip.xyz / max(clip.w, 0.000001f);
            float2 uv = float2(ndc.x * 0.5f + 0.5f, -ndc.y * 0.5f + 0.5f);
            selectedUv = uv;
            float pageGrid = max(ShadowDebugGlobal.w, 1.0f);
            float residentGrid = max(ShadowDebugGlobal.z, 1.0f);
            float firstResident = (pageGrid - residentGrid) * 0.5f;
            float2 pageCoord = floor(saturate(uv) * pageGrid);
            if (all(uv >= 0.0f) && all(uv < 1.0f) && all(pageCoord >= firstResident) &&
                all(pageCoord < firstResident + residentGrid))
            {
                selectedLevel = level;
                break;
            }
        }
        if (shadowDebugMode == 2)
        {
            const float3 levelColors[4] = {float3(0.10f, 0.85f, 0.30f), float3(0.15f, 0.45f, 1.00f),
                                           float3(1.00f, 0.70f, 0.10f), float3(0.95f, 0.18f, 0.25f)};
            return float4(levelColors[selectedLevel], 1.0f);
        }
        float2 page = floor(saturate(selectedUv) * max(ShadowDebugGlobal.w, 1.0f));
        float pageHash = frac(dot(page, float2(0.06711056f, 0.00583715f)));
        float3 pageColor = frac(pageHash + float3(0.0f, 0.333f, 0.667f));
        return float4(pageColor, 1.0f);
    }
    if (toon)
    {
        float2 environmentUv = float2(frac(atan2(surfaceNormal.z, surfaceNormal.x) / (2.0f * PI) + 0.5f),
                                      acos(clamp(surfaceNormal.y, -1.0f, 1.0f)) / PI);
        float3 irradiance = EnvironmentTexture.SampleLevel(TextureSampler, environmentUv, 8.0f).rgb;
        const float3 toonAlbedo = baseColor.rgb;
        baseColor.rgb = pbrDirectLight + EvaluateLiveToonAmbientStyled(toonAlbedo, irradiance, shaderClass);
        [branch] if (LiveToonStyle3.z > 0.0f && LiveToonStyle0.x > 0.0f)
        {
            float3 reflected = reflect(-viewDir, surfaceNormal);
            float2 reflectedUv = float2(frac(atan2(reflected.z, reflected.x) / (2.0f * PI) + 0.5f),
                                        acos(clamp(reflected.y, -1.0f, 1.0f)) / PI);
            float3 environment = EnvironmentTexture.SampleLevel(TextureSampler, reflectedUv, 4.0f).rgb;
            baseColor.rgb += EvaluateLiveToonEnvironmentSpecular(toonAlbedo, surfaceNormal, viewDir, environment,
                                                                 shaderClass);
        }
    }
    [branch] if (shadow || lit)
    {
        float lightIntensity = LightColor.a;

        float Roughness = material.g;

        float3 NdotL = saturate(dot(surfaceNormal, lightDir));
        float3 environmentColor = EnvironmentTexture.SampleLevel(TextureSampler, input.TexCoord, Roughness * 10.0f).rgb;
        NdotL += lightIntensity;

        float3 diffuse = 0.0f;
        {
            float3 light = lightColor.rgb * saturate(dot(lightDir, surfaceNormal));

            float2 iblTexcoord;
            iblTexcoord.x = -atan2(surfaceNormal.x, surfaceNormal.z) / (PI * 2);
            iblTexcoord.y = asin(surfaceNormal.y) / PI;
            light += EnvironmentTexture.SampleLevel(TextureSampler, iblTexcoord, Roughness * 10.0f).rgb * 6;
            diffuse = light * baseColor.rgb / PI;
        }

        if (shadow)
        {
            float castShadow = saturate(1.0f - aggregateShadowVisibility);
            float lightLuminance = dot(lightColor.rgb, float3(0.299f, 0.587f, 0.114f));
            float lightShadowPower = saturate(lightLuminance / (lightLuminance + 1.0f));
            float shadowDensity = castShadow * shadowStrength * lerp(0.25f, 1.0f, lightShadowPower);
            float3 lightTint = (lightLuminance > 0.0001f) ? lightColor.rgb / lightLuminance : float3(1.0f, 1.0f, 1.0f);
            float3 shadowTint =
                saturate(float3(0.015f, 0.014f, 0.017f) + environmentColor * 0.16f + lightTint * 0.025f);
            float3 litColor = baseColor.rgb * (0.12f + NdotL * (0.22f + lightColor.rgb * 0.72f));
            baseColor.rgb = lerp(litColor, baseColor.rgb * shadowTint - 0.08f, shadowDensity);
        }

        if (lit)
        {
            float castShadow = saturate(1.0f - aggregateShadowVisibility);
            float lightLuminance = dot(lightColor.rgb, float3(0.299f, 0.587f, 0.114f));
            float lightShadowPower = saturate(lightLuminance / (lightLuminance + 1.0f));
            float shadowDensity = castShadow * shadowStrength * lerp(0.25f, 1.0f, lightShadowPower);
            float selfShadowMask =
                smoothstep(shadowThreshold - shadowSoftness, shadowThreshold + shadowSoftness, castShadow);
            shadowDensity =
                saturate(max(shadowDensity, selfShadowMask * shadowStrength * lerp(0.20f, 0.85f, lightShadowPower)));
            float3 lightTint = (lightLuminance > 0.0001f) ? lightColor.rgb / lightLuminance : float3(1.0f, 1.0f, 1.0f);
            float3 shadowTint = saturate(float3(0.018f, 0.016f, 0.020f) + environmentColor + lightTint * 0.025f);
            float3 litColor = baseColor.rgb * (lightColor.rgb * 0.72f + NdotL);
            baseColor.rgb = diffuse * lerp(litColor, litColor * shadowTint, shadowDensity);
        }
    }

    float4 authoredEmissionAO = MaterialEmissionAO.Load(gbufferPixel);
    if (toon)
    {
        baseColor.rgb *= authoredEmissionAO.a;
    }
    if (pbr)
    {
        SurfaceData surface = BuildLightingSurface(baseColor, surfaceNormal, material.rgb, authoredEmissionAO);
        // 発光は、この後の画面空間エフェクトを適用した後で加える。
        surface.Emissive = 0.0f;
        baseColor.rgb =
            EvaluateSurfaceEnvironment(surface, viewDir, position, input.TexCoord, shadowSoftness, pbrDirectLight);
    }

    baseColor.rgb = ApplySurfaceScreenEffects(baseColor.rgb, authoredEmissionAO.rgb, input.TexCoord, giReflectance);
    baseColor.a = 1.0f;
    return baseColor;
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
// MegaLights：セルの決定 → ライティング → 検証用の累積 → デバッグ表示
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
float MLDebugLuminance(float3 color)
{
    return dot(color, float3(0.2126f, 0.7152f, 0.0722f));
}

float4 main(PSInputPostProcess input) : SV_Target
{
    const uint2 pixel = uint2(input.Position.xy);
    // グリッド構築（MegaLightsGridCS）・M2 のサンプリングと同じ深度・同じ式でセルを決める
    g_MLCellIndex = MLCellIndexFromDepth(pixel, DepthTexture.Load(int3(pixel, 0)));
    float4 color = ShadeDeferred(input);
    [branch] if (!MLGridActive() || any(pixel >= MLScreen.xy))
    {
        return color;
    }

    // 検証：静止時の累積平均（前フレームまでの平均 + このフレーム）
    const uint linearIndex = pixel.y * MLScreen.x + pixel.x;
    float4 mean = color;
    [branch] if ((MLStochastic.x & ML_FLAG_ACCUMULATE) != 0u)
    {
        const float frames = (float)MLStochastic.w;
        const float4 previous = MegaLightAccumulation[linearIndex];
        mean = frames < 0.5f ? color : previous + (color - previous) / (frames + 1.0f);
        MegaLightAccumulation[linearIndex] = mean;
    }

    const uint debugView = MLCounts.y;
    [branch] if (debugView == 0u)
    {
        return color;
    }
    float3 debugColor = color.rgb;
    bool overlay = true;
    if (debugView == 1u || debugView == 2u)
    {
        if (g_MLCellIndex == ML_INVALID_CELL)
        {
            return color;
        }
        if (debugView == 1u)
        {
            const uint cellLights = MegaLightCells[g_MLCellIndex].y;
            debugColor =
                cellLights == 0u ? float3(0.02f, 0.02f, 0.04f) : MLHeatmap((float)cellLights / max(MLDepth2.z, 1.0f));
        }
        else
        {
            const uint slice = g_MLCellIndex / (MLGrid.x * MLGrid.y);
            debugColor = frac((float)slice * float3(0.61803f, 0.41421f, 0.27183f) + float3(0.1f, 0.4f, 0.7f));
        }
        const uint2 tilePixel = pixel % ML_TILE_SIZE;
        const float gridLine = (tilePixel.x == 0u || tilePixel.y == 0u) ? 0.35f : 0.0f;
        return float4(lerp(color.rgb, debugColor, 0.75f) * (1.0f - gridLine), color.a);
    }
    if (debugView >= 3u && debugView <= 5u)
    {
        // M2 のサンプル：3 = 選ばれたライト, 4 = 可視率, 5 = 1/p
        if (!MLStochasticActive())
        {
            return color;
        }
        const uint sampleBase = MLSampleBase(MLScreenToSample(pixel));
        uint valid = 0u;
        uint traced = 0u;
        uint visible = 0u;
        uint firstLight = 0xffffffffu;
        float maxInvPdf = 0.0f;
        for (uint k = 0u; k < MLStochastic.y; ++k)
        {
            const uint4 lightSample = MegaLightSamples[sampleBase + k];
            if ((lightSample.x & ML_SAMPLE_VALID) == 0u)
            {
                continue;
            }
            ++valid;
            if (firstLight == 0xffffffffu)
            {
                firstLight = lightSample.x & ML_SAMPLE_INDEX;
            }
            if ((lightSample.x & ML_SAMPLE_TRACE) != 0u)
            {
                ++traced;
                visible += (lightSample.x & ML_SAMPLE_VISIBLE) != 0u ? 1u : 0u;
            }
            maxInvPdf = max(maxInvPdf, asfloat(lightSample.y));
        }
        if (valid == 0u)
        {
            return color;
        }
        if (debugView == 3u)
        {
            debugColor = frac((float)MLHash(firstLight) * (1.0f / 4294967296.0f) * float3(1.0f, 7.0f, 31.0f) +
                              float3(0.1f, 0.35f, 0.6f));
        }
        else if (debugView == 4u)
        {
            debugColor = traced == 0u ? float3(0.2f, 0.4f, 1.0f) : ((float)visible / (float)traced).xxx;
        }
        else
        {
            debugColor = MLHeatmap(log2(max(maxInvPdf, 1.0f)) / log2(max(MLStochasticParams.z, 2.0f)));
        }
    }
    else if (debugView == 9u)
    {
        // M5：影レイの処理の内訳（緑 = スクリーントレースで遮蔽を確定, 橙 = ワールドトレース, 青 = 影レイ不要）
        if (!MLStochasticActive())
        {
            return color;
        }
        const uint sampleBase = MLSampleBase(MLScreenToSample(pixel));
        float3 mix = 0.0f;
        uint valid = 0u;
        for (uint k = 0u; k < MLStochastic.y; ++k)
        {
            const uint flags = MegaLightSamples[sampleBase + k].x;
            if ((flags & ML_SAMPLE_VALID) == 0u)
            {
                continue;
            }
            ++valid;
            if ((flags & ML_SAMPLE_SCREEN) != 0u)
            {
                mix += float3(0.15f, 0.95f, 0.3f);
            }
            else if ((flags & ML_SAMPLE_TRACE) != 0u)
            {
                mix += float3(1.0f, 0.55f, 0.1f);
            }
            else
            {
                mix += float3(0.2f, 0.4f, 1.0f);
            }
        }
        if (valid == 0u)
        {
            return color;
        }
        debugColor = mix / (float)valid;
    }
    else if (debugView == 8u)
    {
        // M4：可視ライトハッシュの埋まり具合（128bit 中の立っているビット数。8x8 タイル）
        if (!MLStochasticActive())
        {
            return color;
        }
        const uint occupancy = MLHashOccupancy(MegaLightHash[MLHashTileIndex(pixel)]);
        debugColor = occupancy == 0u ? float3(0.02f, 0.02f, 0.04f) : MLHeatmap((float)occupancy / 64.0f);
        const uint2 tilePixel = pixel % ML_HASH_TILE;
        if (tilePixel.x == 0u || tilePixel.y == 0u)
        {
            debugColor *= 0.6f;
        }
    }
    else if (debugView == 6u)
    {
        // 累積平均そのもの
        if ((MLStochastic.x & ML_FLAG_ACCUMULATE) == 0u)
        {
            return color;
        }
        return float4(mean.rgb, color.a);
    }
    else if (debugView == 7u)
    {
        // リファレンスとの差（輝度の相対誤差 × 10 をヒートマップ）
        if ((MLStochastic.x & ML_FLAG_HAS_REF) == 0u)
        {
            return color;
        }
        const float reference = MLDebugLuminance(MegaLightReference[linearIndex].rgb);
        const float difference = abs(MLDebugLuminance(mean.rgb) - reference);
        debugColor = MLHeatmap(10.0f * difference / max(reference, 0.05f));
        overlay = false;
    }
    else
    {
        return color;
    }
    return float4(overlay ? lerp(color.rgb, debugColor, 0.8f) : debugColor, color.a);
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
// MegaLights M3：ML6（サンプルのシェーディング）だけを行い、デモジュレートして MegaLightRaw に書く
//   ディファードライティングの直前に、同じルートシグネチャ・同じ定数で描画する（カラー書き込みなし）。
//   材質の準備（シェーディングモデル・天候）は ShadeDeferred と同じ順序で行うこと。
//   a = 1: デノイズ対象のピクセル（PBR 面でセルが有効）, a = 0: 対象外
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
float4 MegaLightsShadePS(PSInputPostProcess input) : SV_Target
{
    const uint2 pixel = uint2(input.Position.xy);
    if (!MLStochasticActive() || any(pixel >= MLScreen.xy))
    {
        return 0.0f;
    }
    const uint linearIndex = pixel.y * MLScreen.x + pixel.x;
    const int3 gbufferPixel = int3(pixel, 0);
    float4 material = MaterialTexture.Load(gbufferPixel);
    const float depth = DepthTexture.Load(gbufferPixel);
    g_MLCellIndex = MLCellIndexFromDepth(pixel, depth);
    float4 result = 0.0f;
    [branch] if (g_MLCellIndex != ML_INVALID_CELL && IsMaterialClass(material.a, 11.0f))
    {
        float4 baseColor = BaseColorTexture.Load(gbufferPixel);
        const float3 position = ReconstructPostProcessWorldPositionCommon(input.TexCoord, depth);
        float3 surfaceNormal = DecodeGBufferNormal(NormalTexture.Load(gbufferPixel).xyz);
        const float4 shadowParams = ShadowGBufferTexture.Load(gbufferPixel);
        g_ShadingModel = DecodeShadingModel(shadowParams.a);
        ApplyWeatherToSurface(position, surfaceNormal, baseColor.rgb, material.rgb);
        const float3 viewDir = CameraViewDirection(position, PPCameraPos.xyz, PPInvViewProjection);
        SurfaceLightAccumulator acc = (SurfaceLightAccumulator)0;
        MLAccumulateStochasticSamples(position, 0.0f, 0.0f, surfaceNormal, input.Position.xy, 1, viewDir, baseColor.rgb,
                                      material.rgb, max(shadowParams.g, 0.0001f), float3(1.0f, 1.0f, 1.0f), acc);
        const float3 lighting = acc.PbrDirect / MLRemodulation(surfaceNormal, viewDir, baseColor.rgb, material.rgb);
        // a = 1 + ヒット距離（最も近いサンプルのライトまで）。M3 は a >= 0.5 を対象の印に、M6 の NRD は距離に使う
        float hitDistance = 1.0e4f;
        const uint sampleBase = MLSampleBase(MLScreenToSample(pixel));
        for (uint k = 0u; k < MLStochastic.y; ++k)
        {
            const uint4 lightSample = MegaLightSamples[sampleBase + k];
            if ((lightSample.x & ML_SAMPLE_VALID) == 0u)
            {
                continue;
            }
            hitDistance =
                min(hitDistance, length(MegaLightBuffer[lightSample.x & ML_SAMPLE_INDEX].PositionType.xyz - position));
        }
        result = float4(all(isfinite(lighting)) ? lighting : 0.0f, 1.0f + hitDistance);
    }
    MegaLightRaw[linearIndex] = result;
    return 0.0f;
}



===== FILE: shader\hlsl\DeferredPS.hlsl =====
#ifndef GEOMETRIC_SPECULAR_AA
#define GEOMETRIC_SPECULAR_AA 0
#endif
#define SHADER_3D
#ifndef SHADER_VISIBILITY_RESOLVE
#define POM_PIXEL_DEPTH_OUTPUT
#endif
#include "common.hlsl"

#ifdef SHADER_GPU_DRIVEN
#include "GPUDrivenOpaque.hlsli"
#else
Texture2D g_Texture : register(t0);
Texture2D g_NormalTexture : register(t2);
#endif
SamplerState g_SamplerState : register(s0);

#include "MaterialSurface.hlsli"
#include "NormalMapDecode.hlsli"
#include "ToonLighting.hlsli"
#include "LiveToonMaterial.hlsli"
#if GEOMETRIC_SPECULAR_AA
#include "GeometricSpecularAA.hlsli"
#endif

GBufferOutput ShadeGBuffer(PSInput3D In, bool frontFace)
{
#if GEOMETRIC_SPECULAR_AA
    // Evaluate derivatives before any alpha/backface discard or material-dependent branch.
    // Geometry normals deliberately exclude normal-map and height-map frequencies.
#ifdef SHADER_VISIBILITY_RESOLVE
    float3 geometryNormalDx = VisibilityNormalDx;
    float3 geometryNormalDy = VisibilityNormalDy;
#else
    float3 geometryNormal = GeometricSpecularAA::GeometryNormal(In.Normal.xyz);
    float3 geometryNormalDx = ddx(geometryNormal);
    float3 geometryNormalDy = ddy(geometryNormal);
#endif
    float geometryGradientSquared = GeometricSpecularAA::FiniteGradientSquared(
        dot(geometryNormalDx, geometryNormalDx), dot(geometryNormalDy, geometryNormalDy));
#endif
#ifdef SHADER_GPU_DRIVEN
    uint materialID = gSceneInstances[In.InstanceID].MaterialIndex;
    uint address = materialID * GPU_SCENE_MATERIAL_STRIDE;
    uint4 metadata = gSceneMaterials.Load4(address + 32u);
    uint normalTextureIndex = metadata.y;
#ifndef SHADER_VISIBILITY_RESOLVE
    if ((metadata.z & 4u) == 0 && !frontFace)
    {
        discard;
    }
#endif
    int UseTexture = (metadata.z & 1u) != 0;
    int FlipNormal = 0;
    int ShaderClass = metadata.w;
    int MaterialMode = gSceneMaterials.Load(address + 52u);
    float4 surface = asfloat(gSceneMaterials.Load4(address + 16u));
    float mMetallic = surface.x;
    float mRoughness = surface.y;
    float mFresnel = surface.z;
    float ShadowThreshold = LoadSceneMaterialVector(gSceneMaterials, materialID, 1u).w;
    float ShadowSoftness = LoadSceneMaterialVector(gSceneMaterials, materialID, 2u).x;
    float ShadowStrength = LoadSceneMaterialVector(gSceneMaterials, materialID, 2u).y;
#endif
#ifdef SHADER_GPU_DRIVEN
    AssetMaterialParameters assetMaterial = LoadAssetMaterial(materialID);
#else
    AssetMaterialParameters assetMaterial = LoadAssetMaterial(0);
#endif
    AssetParallaxResult pom =
        ApplyAssetParallaxEx(assetMaterial, In.TexCoord, In.WorldPos, In.Normal, In.CameraPos, g_SamplerState);
    float2 materialUv = pom.Uv;
    float materialPartId = (MaterialMode == 1) ? (float)ShaderClass : max(In.Diffuse.a, 0.0f);
    float4 baseColor = float4(In.Diffuse.rgb, 1.0f);
    if (assetMaterial.Surface.z > 0.5f)
    {
        baseColor = float4(1, 1, 1, 1);
    }
    if (UseTexture != 0)
    {
#ifdef SHADER_GPU_DRIVEN
#ifdef SHADER_VISIBILITY_RESOLVE
        baseColor *= LoadMaterialTexture(SceneTextureIndex(metadata.x)).SampleGrad(
            g_SamplerState, materialUv, VisibilityUvDx, VisibilityUvDy);
#else
        baseColor *= LoadMaterialTexture(SceneTextureIndex(metadata.x)).Sample(g_SamplerState, materialUv);
#endif
#else
        baseColor *= g_Texture.Sample(g_SamplerState, materialUv);
#endif
    }

    float assetMetallic = mMetallic;
    float assetRoughness = mRoughness;
    float4 assetEmissionAO;
    ApplyAssetMaterial(assetMaterial, materialUv, g_SamplerState, baseColor, assetMetallic, assetRoughness,
                       assetEmissionAO);
#ifndef SHADER_VISIBILITY_RESOLVE
    clip(baseColor.a - 0.01f);
#endif

    float3 normal = In.Normal.xyz * ((FlipNormal != 0) ? -1.0f : 1.0f);

#ifdef SHADER_GPU_DRIVEN
    bool hasNormalMap = normalTextureIndex != 0xffffffffu && normalTextureIndex >= TextureBase &&
                        normalTextureIndex - TextureBase < 512u;

    // シーン既定のテクスチャは平坦な法線マップではないため、法線としてサンプリングしない。
    [branch] if (hasNormalMap)
    {
        uint textureIndex = SceneTextureIndex(normalTextureIndex);
#ifdef SHADER_VISIBILITY_RESOLVE
        float3 tangentNormal = DecodeTangentNormalSample(
            LoadMaterialTexture(textureIndex).SampleGrad(g_SamplerState, materialUv, VisibilityUvDx, VisibilityUvDy));
#else
        float3 tangentNormal = DecodeTangentNormalSample(
            LoadMaterialTexture(textureIndex).Sample(g_SamplerState, materialUv));
#endif
        normal = ApplyNormalMapCommon(normal, In.WorldPos, In.TexCoord, ScaleAssetNormal(tangentNormal, assetMaterial));
    }

#else
    if (UseNormalMap != 0)
    {
        float3 tangentNormal = DecodeTangentNormalSample(g_NormalTexture.Sample(g_SamplerState, materialUv));
        normal = ApplyNormalMapCommon(normal, In.WorldPos, In.TexCoord, ScaleAssetNormal(tangentNormal, assetMaterial));
    }
#endif
    // 法線マップが無いときは POM の高さマップから法線を作る（UV シフトだけでは見た目が変わらないため）。
#ifdef SHADER_GPU_DRIVEN
    if (!hasNormalMap)
#else
    if (UseNormalMap == 0)
#endif
    {
        normal = ApplyAssetHeightNormal(assetMaterial, normal, In.WorldPos, In.TexCoord, materialUv, g_SamplerState);
    }
    normal = SafeNormalizeCommon(normal, float3(0.0f, 1.0f, 0.0f));

    GBufferOutput output;
    output.EmissionAO = assetEmissionAO;
    output.Color = baseColor;
    output.Normal = MakeGBufferNormal(normal);
    output.Normal.a = -AssetParallaxRayDistance(pom);

    // ピクセル深度オフセット：GBuffer 深度（ライティング・影・SSAO・反射レイの始点）を凹凸の奥へ。
    output.Depth = AssetParallaxPixelDepth(pom, In.WorldPos, In.CameraPos, saturate(In.Position.z));

#ifdef SHADER_GPU_DRIVEN
    MaterialPartShaderParams partParams = LoadGpuDrivenPart(materialID, materialPartId);
#else
    MaterialPartShaderParams partParams = ResolveMaterialPartParams(materialPartId);
#endif
    bool usePartParams = MaterialMode != 1;
    output.Material.r = usePartParams ? partParams.Basic.x : assetMetallic;
    output.Material.g = usePartParams ? partParams.Basic.y : assetRoughness;
    output.Material.b = usePartParams ? partParams.Basic.z : mFresnel;
    output.Material.a = materialPartId;
#if GEOMETRIC_SPECULAR_AA
    output.Material.g = GeometricSpecularAA::FilterMaterialRoughness(
        output.Material.g, geometryGradientSquared, materialPartId);
#endif
    output.Shadow.r = usePartParams ? partParams.Shadow0.x : ShadowThreshold;
    output.Shadow.g = usePartParams ? partParams.Shadow0.y : ShadowSoftness;
    output.Shadow.b = usePartParams ? partParams.Shadow0.z : ShadowStrength;
    output.Shadow.a = EncodeShadingModel(assetMaterial, 0.0f);
    // ライブトゥーンのマテリアルテクスチャ（Def / 顔陰影反転 / 質感ランプ）
    // Visibility 解決（コンピュート）では暗黙微分の Sample が使えないので対象外。
#ifndef SHADER_VISIBILITY_RESOLVE
    {
#ifdef SHADER_GPU_DRIVEN
        uint4 liveToonTextures = asuint(LoadSceneMaterialVector(gSceneMaterials, materialID, 190u));
        float4 liveToonParams = LoadSceneMaterialVector(gSceneMaterials, materialID, 191u);
#else
        uint4 liveToonTextures = LiveToonTextures;
        float4 liveToonParams = LiveToonMaterialParams;
#endif
        LiveToonMaterialSurface toonSurface;
        toonSurface.Albedo = output.Color.rgb;
        toonSurface.ShadowThreshold = output.Shadow.r;
        toonSurface.ShadowSoftness = output.Shadow.g;
        ApplyLiveToonMaterialTextures(liveToonTextures, liveToonParams, materialUv, normal,
                                      SurfaceViewDirectionCommon(In.WorldPos, In.CameraPos), materialPartId,
                                      g_SamplerState, toonSurface);
        output.Color.rgb = toonSurface.Albedo;
        output.Shadow.r = toonSurface.ShadowThreshold;
        output.Shadow.g = toonSurface.ShadowSoftness;
    }
#endif
    // POM セルフシャドウ（主光源）。
    WriteAssetParallaxSelfShadow(pom, In.WorldPos, g_SamplerState, output.Shadow, output.Material.a);
    output.Color.a = 1.0f;
#ifdef SHADER_GPU_DRIVEN
    if (VisibilityDebugMode != 0)
    {
        uint4 visibility = gVisibilityDebug[In.InstanceID];
        const float3 palette[8] = {float3(0.1, 1, 0.2), float3(0.1, 0.5, 1),  float3(1, 0.8, 0.1),
                                   float3(1, 0.3, 0.1), float3(0.7, 0.2, 1),  float3(0.2, 1, 1),
                                   float3(1, 0.2, 0.7), float3(0.8, 0.8, 0.8)};
        output.Color.rgb = VisibilityDebugMode == 2 ? palette[min(visibility.z, 7u)] : float3(0.1, 1, 0.2);
    }
#endif
    return output;
}

#ifdef SHADER_VISIBILITY_RESOLVE
GBufferOutput main(PSInput3D In, bool frontFace : SV_IsFrontFace)
{
    return ShadeGBuffer(In, frontFace);
}
#else
GBufferDepthOutput main(PSInput3D In, bool frontFace : SV_IsFrontFace)
{
    GBufferOutput shaded = ShadeGBuffer(In, frontFace);
    GBufferDepthOutput output;
    output.Color = shaded.Color;
    output.Normal = shaded.Normal;
    output.Depth = shaded.Depth;
    output.Material = shaded.Material;
    output.Shadow = shaded.Shadow;
    output.EmissionAO = shaded.EmissionAO;
    output.HardwareDepth = min(shaded.Depth.x, In.Position.z);
    return output;
}
#endif
