cbuffer CullParameters : register(b0)
{
    row_major float4x4 VP;
    row_major float4x4 PreviousVP;
    float4 Camera;
    uint Capacity, ObjectCapacity, MeshCount, MaterialCount;
    uint EnableFrustum, EnableCone, EnableOcclusion, EnableClusters;
    float Bias;
    float2 HiZSize;
    uint HiZMips;
};

void Stat(uint offset, uint value = 1)
{
    uint unused;
    Statistics.InterlockedAdd(offset, value, unused);
}

float4 SphereWorld(MeshletBounds bounds, GPUInstanceData instance)
{
    float3 center = mul(float4(bounds.Center, 1), instance.World).xyz;
    // フロベニウスノルムは、せん断があっても最大特異値の上限になる。
    float scale =
        sqrt(dot(instance.World[0].xyz, instance.World[0].xyz) + dot(instance.World[1].xyz, instance.World[1].xyz) +
             dot(instance.World[2].xyz, instance.World[2].xyz));
    return float4(center, bounds.Radius * scale);
}

bool FrustumCull(float4 sphere)
{
    float4 c0 = float4(VP[0][0], VP[1][0], VP[2][0], VP[3][0]);
    float4 c1 = float4(VP[0][1], VP[1][1], VP[2][1], VP[3][1]);
    float4 c2 = float4(VP[0][2], VP[1][2], VP[2][2], VP[3][2]);
    float4 c3 = float4(VP[0][3], VP[1][3], VP[2][3], VP[3][3]);
    float4 planes[6] = {c3 + c0, c3 - c0, c3 + c1, c3 - c1, c2, c3 - c2};
    [unroll] for (uint i = 0; i < 6; ++i)
    {
        if (dot(float4(sphere.xyz, 1), planes[i]) < -sphere.w * length(planes[i].xyz))
        {
            return true;
        }
    }
    return false;
}

bool ConeCull(MeshletBounds bounds, float4 sphere, GPUInstanceData instance)
{
    if (bounds.ConeCutoff >= 1 || instance.MaterialIndex >= MaterialCount ||
        (Materials.Load(instance.MaterialIndex * GPU_SCENE_MATERIAL_STRIDE + 40) & 4u) != 0)
    {
        return false;
    }
    float3 a = instance.World[0].xyz;
    float3 b = instance.World[1].xyz;
    float3 c = instance.World[2].xyz;
    float3 lengths = float3(length(a), length(b), length(c));
    if (min(lengths.x, min(lengths.y, lengths.z)) < 1e-6 || dot(cross(a, b), c) <= 0)
    {
        return false;
    }
    a /= lengths.x;
    b /= lengths.y;
    c /= lengths.z;
    if (max(lengths.x, max(lengths.y, lengths.z)) - min(lengths.x, min(lengths.y, lengths.z)) > 1e-4 * lengths.x ||
        abs(dot(a, b)) + abs(dot(a, c)) + abs(dot(b, c)) > 1e-4)
    {
        return false;
    }
    float3 delta = sphere.xyz - Camera.xyz;
    float distance = length(delta);
    if (distance <= sphere.w + 1e-5)
    {
        return false;
    }
    float3 axis = normalize(mul(bounds.ConeAxis, (float3x3)instance.World));
    // 境界球で、全三角形にわたる透視投影の変化を考慮する。
    return dot(axis, delta / distance) > bounds.ConeCutoff + sphere.w / distance + 1e-5;
}

bool OcclusionCull(float4 sphere, GPUInstanceData instance)
{
    if (EnableOcclusion == 0 || (instance.Flags & 8u) != 0)
    {
        return false;
    }
    if (!all(instance.World[0] == instance.PreviousWorld[0]) || !all(instance.World[1] == instance.PreviousWorld[1]) ||
        !all(instance.World[2] == instance.PreviousWorld[2]) || !all(instance.World[3] == instance.PreviousWorld[3]))
    {
        return false;
    }
    float2 minimum = 1;
    float2 maximum = 0;
    float nearest = 0;
    [unroll] for (uint i = 0; i < 8; ++i)
    {
        float3 sign = float3((i & 1) ? 1 : -1, (i & 2) ? 1 : -1, (i & 4) ? 1 : -1);
        float4 clip = mul(float4(sphere.xyz + sign * sphere.w, 1), PreviousVP);
        if (!all(isfinite(clip)) || clip.w <= 1e-5 || clip.z <= 0 || clip.z >= clip.w)
        {
            return false;
        }
        float3 ndc = clip.xyz / clip.w;
        float2 uv = ndc.xy * float2(0.5, -0.5) + 0.5;
        minimum = min(minimum, uv);
        maximum = max(maximum, uv);
        nearest = max(nearest, ndc.z);
    }
    minimum -= 1 / HiZSize;
    maximum += 1 / HiZSize;
    if (any(minimum < 0) || any(maximum >= 1) || any(maximum < minimum))
    {
        return false;
    }
    uint width, height, mips, mip;
    uint2 first = 0;
    uint2 last = 0;
    [loop] for (mip = 0; mip < HiZMips; ++mip)
    {
        HiZ.GetDimensions(mip, width, height, mips);
        first = min((uint2)floor(minimum * float2(width, height)), uint2(width - 1, height - 1));
        last = min((uint2)floor(maximum * float2(width, height)), uint2(width - 1, height - 1));
        if (all(last - first <= 1))
        {
            break;
        }
    }
    if (mip == HiZMips)
    {
        return false;
    }
    float farthest = 1;
    [loop] for (uint y = first.y; y <= last.y; ++y)
    {
        [loop] for (uint x = first.x; x <= last.x; ++x)
        {
            float depth = HiZ.Load(int3(x, y, mip));
            if (!isfinite(depth))
            {
                return false;
            }
            farthest = min(farthest, depth);
        }
    }
    return nearest < farthest - max(Bias, 0);
}

===== FILE: shader\hlsl\MeshletCullingCS.hlsl =====
#include "MeshletCullingCommon.hlsli"
[numthreads(64, 1, 1)] void main(uint3 id : SV_DispatchThreadID) {
    uint index = id.x;
    if (index >= min(Statistics.Load(0), Capacity))
    {
        return;
    }
    uint4 item = Candidates[index];
    if (item.z == 2u)
    {
        return;
    }
    GPUInstanceData instance = Instances[item.x];
    MeshletBounds bounds = Bounds[item.y];
    float4 sphere = SphereWorld(bounds, instance);
    if (EnableFrustum != 0 && FrustumCull(sphere))
    {
        Stat(16);
        item.z = 3;
        Candidates[index] = item;
        return;
    }
    if (EnableCone != 0 && ConeCull(bounds, sphere, instance))
    {
        Stat(20);
        item.z = 4;
        Candidates[index] = item;
        return;
    }
    if (OcclusionCull(sphere, instance))
    {
        Stat(24);
        item.z = 5;
        Candidates[index] = item;
        return;
    }
    uint target;
    Statistics.InterlockedAdd(4, 1, target);
    if (target < Capacity)
    {
        Visible[target] = item.xy;
    }
    item.z = 1;
    Candidates[index] = item;
    MeshletRecord meshlet = Meshlets[item.y];
    Stat(28, meshlet.VertexCount);
    Stat(32, meshlet.PrimitiveCount);
}

===== FILE: shader\hlsl\MeshletMS.hlsl =====
#define SHADER_3D
#define SHADER_GPU_DRIVEN
#include "common.hlsl"
#include "MeshletCommon.hlsli"
StructuredBuffer<GPUInstanceData> Instances : register(t30);
ByteAddressBuffer Materials : register(t31);
StructuredBuffer<MeshletRecord> Meshlets : register(t33);
StructuredBuffer<uint> Remap : register(t34);
StructuredBuffer<uint> Primitives : register(t35);
ByteAddressBuffer Vertices : register(t36);
StructuredBuffer<uint2> Visible : register(t37);
ByteAddressBuffer Statistics : register(t38);

cbuffer MeshDebug : register(b6)
{
    uint MeshletColors;
}

struct PrimitiveOutput
{
    bool Cull : SV_CullPrimitive;
};
#ifdef MESHLET_VELOCITY
struct MeshVertex
{
    float4 Position : SV_POSITION;
    float4 CurrentClip : TEXCOORD0;
    float4 PreviousClip : TEXCOORD1;
    nointerpolation uint MaterialFlags : TEXCOORD2;
};
#else
#define MeshVertex PSInput3D
#endif
[outputtopology("triangle")][numthreads(64, 1, 1)] void main(uint3 group : SV_GroupID, uint lane : SV_GroupIndex,
                                                             out vertices MeshVertex outputVertices[64],
                                                             out indices uint3 outputTriangles[126],
                                                             out primitives PrimitiveOutput primitiveOutput[126]) {
    uint count = Statistics.Load(4);
    uint index = group.x + group.y * min(count, 65535u);
    MeshletRecord meshlet = (MeshletRecord)0;
    uint2 item = 0;
    if (index < count)
    {
        item = Visible[index];
        meshlet = Meshlets[item.y];
    }
    SetMeshOutputCounts(meshlet.VertexCount, meshlet.PrimitiveCount);
    GPUInstanceData instance = Instances[item.x];
    for (uint i = lane; i < meshlet.VertexCount; i += 64)
    {
        uint address = Remap[meshlet.VertexOffset + i] * 48;
        float3 position = asfloat(Vertices.Load3(address));
        float3 normal = asfloat(Vertices.Load3(address + 12));
        MeshVertex vertex = (MeshVertex)0;
        float4 world = mul(float4(position, 1), instance.World);
        float4 view = mul(world, View);
        vertex.Position = mul(view, Projection);
#ifdef MESHLET_VELOCITY
        vertex.CurrentClip = vertex.Position;
        vertex.MaterialFlags = Materials.Load(instance.MaterialIndex * GPU_SCENE_MATERIAL_STRIDE + 40);
        vertex.PreviousClip = mul(mul(float4(position, 1), instance.PreviousWorld), PreviousViewProjection);
#else
        vertex.Normal = normalize(mul(normal, (float3x3)instance.World));
        vertex.TexCoord = asfloat(Vertices.Load2(address + 24));
        vertex.Diffuse = asfloat(Vertices.Load4(address + 32));
        if (MeshletColors != 0)
        {
            vertex.Diffuse.rgb = 0.2 + 0.8 * frac(float3(0.618, 0.414, 0.732) * (item.y + 1));
        }
        vertex.WorldPos = world.xyz;
        vertex.ViewPos = view.xyz;
        vertex.CameraPos = CameraPos;
        vertex.InstanceID = item.x;
#endif
        outputVertices[i] = vertex;
    }
    for (uint p = lane; p < meshlet.PrimitiveCount; p += 64)
    {
        uint packed = Primitives[meshlet.PrimitiveOffset + p];
        outputTriangles[p] = uint3(packed & 255, (packed >> 8) & 255, (packed >> 16) & 255);
        float3 points[3];
        for (uint j = 0; j < 3; ++j)
        {
            float3 position = asfloat(Vertices.Load3(Remap[meshlet.VertexOffset + ((packed >> (j * 8)) & 255)] * 48));
            points[j] = mul(mul(float4(position, 1), instance.World), View).xyz;
        }
        bool doubleSided = (Materials.Load(instance.MaterialIndex * GPU_SCENE_MATERIAL_STRIDE + 40) & 4u) != 0;
        primitiveOutput[p].Cull =
            !doubleSided && dot(cross(points[1] - points[0], points[2] - points[0]), points[0]) >= 0;
    }
}

===== FILE: shader\hlsl\MeshVisibility.hlsl =====
#define SHADER_3D
#include "common.hlsl"

struct StaticVertex
{
    float3 Position;
    float3 Normal;
    float2 TexCoord;
    float4 Diffuse;
};

StructuredBuffer<StaticVertex> MeshVertices : register(t20);
ByteAddressBuffer MeshIndices : register(t21);
Texture2D<float> PreviousHiZ : register(t22);
Texture2D<float> CurrentHiZ : register(t23);
SamplerState HiZSampler : register(s2);

cbuffer MeshDispatchConstants : register(b4)
{
    uint MeshIndexCount;
    uint MeshIndexIs16Bit;
    uint OcclusionPhase;
    uint PreviousHiZValid;
    uint CurrentHiZValid;
    uint HiZWidth;
    uint HiZHeight;
    uint HiZMipCount;
    float4 MeshLocalCenter;
    float3 MeshLocalExtents;
    uint MeshletBase;
};

struct MeshPayload
{
    uint MeshletIndex;
};

groupshared MeshPayload AmplificationPayload;
groupshared float3 MeshletMinimum[64];
groupshared float3 MeshletMaximum[64];
groupshared uint MeshletVisible;

uint LoadMeshIndex(uint index)
{
    if (MeshIndexIs16Bit == 2u)
    {
        return index; // インデックスなしの手続き的な形状
    }
    if (MeshIndexIs16Bit != 0u)
    {
        uint packed = MeshIndices.Load((index >> 1u) * 4u);
        return (index & 1u) != 0u ? packed >> 16u : packed & 0xffffu;
    }
    return MeshIndices.Load(index * 4u);
}

bool MeshObjectOccluded(Texture2D<float> hierarchy, float2 uvMinimum, float2 uvMaximum, float nearestDepth)
{
    float2 extentPixels = max((uvMaximum - uvMinimum) * float2(HiZWidth, HiZHeight), 1.0f);
    float mip = clamp(floor(log2(max(extentPixels.x, extentPixels.y))), 0.0f, (float)max(HiZMipCount, 1u) - 1.0f);
    float2 center = (uvMinimum + uvMaximum) * 0.5f;
    float depth = hierarchy.SampleLevel(HiZSampler, center, mip);
    depth = min(depth, hierarchy.SampleLevel(HiZSampler, uvMinimum, mip));
    depth = min(depth, hierarchy.SampleLevel(HiZSampler, uvMaximum, mip));
    depth = min(depth, hierarchy.SampleLevel(HiZSampler, float2(uvMinimum.x, uvMaximum.y), mip));
    depth = min(depth, hierarchy.SampleLevel(HiZSampler, float2(uvMaximum.x, uvMinimum.y), mip));
    return depth > nearestDepth + 0.0015f;
}

bool MeshBoundsVisible(float3 center, float3 extents)
{
    bool outsideLeft = true;
    bool outsideRight = true;
    bool outsideBottom = true;
    bool outsideTop = true;
    bool outsideNear = true;
    bool outsideFar = true;
    bool crossesNearPlane = false;
    float2 uvMinimum = 1.0f;
    float2 uvMaximum = 0.0f;
    float nearestDepth = 0.0f;
    [unroll] for (uint corner = 0u; corner < 8u; ++corner)
    {
        float3 signValue =
            float3((corner & 1u) ? 1.0f : -1.0f, (corner & 2u) ? 1.0f : -1.0f, (corner & 4u) ? 1.0f : -1.0f);
        float3 localPosition = center + extents * signValue;
        float4 worldPosition = mul(float4(localPosition, 1.0f), World);
        float4 viewPosition = mul(worldPosition, View);
        float4 clipPosition = mul(viewPosition, Projection);
        outsideLeft = outsideLeft && clipPosition.x < -clipPosition.w;
        outsideRight = outsideRight && clipPosition.x > clipPosition.w;
        outsideBottom = outsideBottom && clipPosition.y < -clipPosition.w;
        outsideTop = outsideTop && clipPosition.y > clipPosition.w;
        outsideNear = outsideNear && clipPosition.z < 0.0f;
        outsideFar = outsideFar && clipPosition.z > clipPosition.w;
        crossesNearPlane = crossesNearPlane || clipPosition.w <= 0.0f || clipPosition.z >= clipPosition.w;
        float3 ndc = clipPosition.xyz / max(abs(clipPosition.w), 1.0e-5f);
        float2 uv = ndc.xy * float2(0.5f, -0.5f) + 0.5f;
        uvMinimum = min(uvMinimum, uv);
        uvMaximum = max(uvMaximum, uv);
        nearestDepth = max(nearestDepth, ndc.z);
    }
    if (outsideLeft || outsideRight || outsideBottom || outsideTop || outsideNear || outsideFar)
    {
        return false;
    }
    if (OcclusionPhase == 0u || crossesNearPlane)
    {
        return true;
    }
    uvMinimum = saturate(uvMinimum);
    uvMaximum = saturate(uvMaximum);
    nearestDepth = saturate(nearestDepth);
    if (OcclusionPhase == 1u)
    {
        return PreviousHiZValid == 0u || !MeshObjectOccluded(PreviousHiZ, uvMinimum, uvMaximum, nearestDepth);
    }
    if (PreviousHiZValid == 0u)
    {
        return false;
    }
    if (!MeshObjectOccluded(PreviousHiZ, uvMinimum, uvMaximum, nearestDepth))
    {
        return false;
    }
    return CurrentHiZValid == 0u || !MeshObjectOccluded(CurrentHiZ, uvMinimum, uvMaximum, nearestDepth);
}

[numthreads(64, 1, 1)] void ASMain(uint3 groupId : SV_GroupID, uint threadIndex : SV_GroupIndex) {
    uint meshlet = MeshletBase + groupId.x;
    uint firstIndex = meshlet * 192u + threadIndex * 3u;
    float3 low = 3.402823e+38f;
    float3 high = -3.402823e+38f;
    if (firstIndex + 2u < MeshIndexCount)
    {
        [unroll] for (uint corner = 0; corner < 3; ++corner)
        {
            float3 position = MeshVertices[LoadMeshIndex(firstIndex + corner)].Position;
            low = min(low, position);
            high = max(high, position);
        }
    }
    MeshletMinimum[threadIndex] = low;
    MeshletMaximum[threadIndex] = high;
    GroupMemoryBarrierWithGroupSync();
    [unroll] for (uint stride = 32; stride > 0; stride >>= 1)
    {
        if (threadIndex < stride)
        {
            MeshletMinimum[threadIndex] = min(MeshletMinimum[threadIndex], MeshletMinimum[threadIndex + stride]);
            MeshletMaximum[threadIndex] = max(MeshletMaximum[threadIndex], MeshletMaximum[threadIndex + stride]);
        }
        GroupMemoryBarrierWithGroupSync();
    }
    if (threadIndex == 0)
    {
        AmplificationPayload.MeshletIndex = meshlet;
        float3 center = (MeshletMinimum[0] + MeshletMaximum[0]) * 0.5f;
        float3 extents = max((MeshletMaximum[0] - MeshletMinimum[0]) * 0.5f, 0.0001f);
        MeshletVisible = MeshBoundsVisible(center, extents) ? 1u : 0u;
    }
    GroupMemoryBarrierWithGroupSync();
    DispatchMesh(MeshletVisible, 1u, 1u, AmplificationPayload);
}

PSInput3D BuildMeshVertex(uint index)
{
    StaticVertex input = MeshVertices[index];
    PSInput3D output;
    float4 worldPosition = mul(float4(input.Position, 1.0f), World);
    float4 viewPosition = mul(worldPosition, View);
    output.Position = mul(viewPosition, Projection);
    output.Normal = normalize(mul(input.Normal, (float3x3)World));
    output.TexCoord = input.TexCoord;
    output.Diffuse = input.Diffuse;
    output.WorldPos = worldPosition.xyz;
    output.ViewPos = viewPosition.xyz;
    output.CameraPos = CameraPos;
    return output;
}

[outputtopology("triangle")][numthreads(64, 1, 1)] void MSMain(in payload MeshPayload payload,
                                                               uint threadIndex : SV_GroupIndex,
                                                               out vertices PSInput3D outputVertices[192],
                                                               out indices uint3 outputTriangles[64]) {
    const uint firstIndex = payload.MeshletIndex * 192u;
    const uint remainingIndices = firstIndex < MeshIndexCount ? MeshIndexCount - firstIndex : 0u;
    const uint primitiveCount = min(remainingIndices / 3u, 64u);
    SetMeshOutputCounts(primitiveCount * 3u, primitiveCount);
    if (threadIndex >= primitiveCount)
    {
        return;
    }
    const uint outputBase = threadIndex * 3u;
    outputVertices[outputBase + 0u] = BuildMeshVertex(LoadMeshIndex(firstIndex + outputBase + 0u));
    outputVertices[outputBase + 1u] = BuildMeshVertex(LoadMeshIndex(firstIndex + outputBase + 1u));
    outputVertices[outputBase + 2u] = BuildMeshVertex(LoadMeshIndex(firstIndex + outputBase + 2u));
    outputTriangles[threadIndex] = uint3(outputBase, outputBase + 1u, outputBase + 2u);
}

===== FILE: shader\hlsl\MeshVisibilityPS.hlsl =====
#define SHADER_3D
#include "common.hlsl"
#include "VisibilityCommon.hlsl"
#include "NormalMapDecode.hlsli"

Texture2D g_Texture : register(t0);
Texture2D g_NormalTexture : register(t2);
SamplerState g_SamplerState : register(s0);

uint4 PSMain(PSInput3D input) : SV_Target0
{
    float materialPartId = MaterialMode == 1 ? (float)ShaderClass : max(input.Diffuse.a, 0.0f);
    float4 baseColor = float4(input.Diffuse.rgb, 1.0f);
    float3 normal = input.Normal * (FlipNormal != 0 ? -1.0f : 1.0f);
    if (UseNormalMap != 0)
    {
        float3 tangentNormal = DecodeTangentNormalSample(g_NormalTexture.Sample(g_SamplerState, input.TexCoord));
        float3 tangent = normalize(mul(float3(1.0f, 0.0f, 0.0f), (float3x3)World));
        float3 bitangent = normalize(mul(float3(0.0f, -1.0f, 0.0f), (float3x3)World));
        normal = normalize(tangentNormal.x * tangent + tangentNormal.y * bitangent + tangentNormal.z * normal);
    }
    if (UseTexture != 0)
    {
        baseColor *= g_Texture.Sample(g_SamplerState, input.TexCoord);
    }
    clip(baseColor.a - 0.01f);
    MaterialPartShaderParams part = ResolveMaterialPartParams(materialPartId);
    bool usePart = MaterialMode != 1;
    return PackVisibilityPayload(baseColor.rgb, normal, saturate(input.Position.z), usePart ? part.Basic.x : mMetallic,
                                 usePart ? part.Basic.y : mRoughness, usePart ? part.Basic.z : mFresnel, materialPartId,
                                 usePart ? part.Shadow0.x : ShadowThreshold, usePart ? part.Shadow0.y : ShadowSoftness,
                                 usePart ? part.Shadow0.z : ShadowStrength);
}

===== FILE: shader\hlsl\modellighingspeculerPS.hlsl =====
#define SHADER_3D
#include "common.hlsl"
#include "NormalMapDecode.hlsli"

Texture2D g_Texture : register(t0);
Texture2D g_NormalTexture : register(t2);
SamplerState g_SamplerState : register(s0);

float3 SafeNormalize(float3 value, float3 fallback)
{
    float lenSq = dot(value, value);
    return (lenSq > 0.000001f) ? value * rsqrt(lenSq) : fallback;
}

float Luminance(float3 color)
{
    return dot(color, float3(0.299f, 0.587f, 0.114f));
}

float3 AdjustSaturation(float3 color, float saturation)
{
    float luma = Luminance(color);
    return lerp(float3(luma, luma, luma), color, saturation);
}

float ToonStep(float value, float threshold, float softness)
{
    return smoothstep(threshold - softness, threshold + softness, value);
}

float Colorfulness(float3 color)
{
    float maxChannel = max(color.r, max(color.g, color.b));
    float minChannel = min(color.r, min(color.g, color.b));
    return maxChannel - minChannel;
}

float SkinMask(float3 albedo)
{
    float warm = saturate((albedo.r - albedo.b) * 2.7f + (albedo.g - albedo.b) * 0.8f);
    float lumaMask = saturate((Luminance(albedo) - 0.35f) * 2.5f);
    return warm * lumaMask;
}

float HairMask(float3 albedo)
{
    float blonde = saturate((albedo.r + albedo.g - albedo.b * 1.55f - 0.45f) * 1.7f);
    float notWhite = 1.0f - saturate((Luminance(albedo) - 0.82f) * 4.0f);
    return blonde * notWhite;
}

float BlueMask(float3 albedo)
{
    return saturate((albedo.b - albedo.r) * 2.4f + (albedo.g - albedo.r) * 0.9f);
}

float WhiteMask(float3 albedo)
{
    float lowChroma = 1.0f - saturate(Colorfulness(albedo) * 5.0f);
    float bright = saturate((Luminance(albedo) - 0.58f) * 3.0f);
    return lowChroma * bright;
}

float DarkMask(float3 albedo)
{
    return saturate((0.38f - Luminance(albedo)) * 3.5f);
}

float3 BuildShadowColor(float3 albedo, float rangeBlend)
{
    float skin = SkinMask(albedo);
    float hair = HairMask(albedo) * (1.0f - skin * 0.55f);
    float blue = BlueMask(albedo);
    float white = WhiteMask(albedo);
    float dark = DarkMask(albedo);

    float3 tint = float3(0.78f, 0.74f, 0.94f);
    tint = lerp(tint, float3(1.08f, 0.73f, 0.68f), skin);
    tint = lerp(tint, float3(1.08f, 0.76f, 0.50f), hair);
    tint = lerp(tint, float3(0.55f, 0.69f, 1.12f), blue);
    tint = lerp(tint, float3(0.78f, 0.76f, 0.96f), white);
    tint = lerp(tint, float3(0.30f, 0.28f, 0.48f), dark);
    tint = lerp(tint, float3(0.88f, 0.84f, 1.0f), rangeBlend * 0.22f);

    return saturate(albedo * tint + float3(0.035f, 0.025f, 0.055f));
}

float3 BuildMidColor(float3 albedo, float rangeBlend)
{
    float skin = SkinMask(albedo);
    float hair = HairMask(albedo) * (1.0f - skin * 0.55f);
    float blue = BlueMask(albedo);
    float white = WhiteMask(albedo);
    float dark = DarkMask(albedo);

    float3 tint = float3(0.98f, 0.98f, 1.06f);
    tint = lerp(tint, float3(1.13f, 0.98f, 0.90f), skin);
    tint = lerp(tint, float3(1.16f, 0.95f, 0.72f), hair);
    tint = lerp(tint, float3(0.80f, 0.96f, 1.30f), blue);
    tint = lerp(tint, float3(1.02f, 1.00f, 1.12f), white);
    tint = lerp(tint, float3(0.52f, 0.48f, 0.74f), dark);

    return saturate(albedo * lerp(tint, float3(1.06f, 1.05f, 1.10f), rangeBlend * 0.16f));
}

float3 BuildLitColor(float3 albedo)
{
    float skin = SkinMask(albedo);
    float hair = HairMask(albedo) * (1.0f - skin * 0.55f);
    float blue = BlueMask(albedo);
    float white = WhiteMask(albedo);
    float dark = DarkMask(albedo);

    float3 tint = float3(1.08f, 1.08f, 1.08f);
    tint = lerp(tint, float3(1.22f, 1.04f, 0.94f), skin);
    tint = lerp(tint, float3(1.24f, 0.98f, 0.70f), hair);
    tint = lerp(tint, float3(0.75f, 0.94f, 1.42f), blue);
    tint = lerp(tint, float3(1.08f, 1.04f, 1.18f), white);
    tint = lerp(tint, float3(0.60f, 0.56f, 0.92f), dark);

    return saturate(albedo * tint + white * float3(0.06f, 0.05f, 0.10f));
}

float3 BuildSpecularColor(float3 albedo, float metallic)
{
    float blue = BlueMask(albedo);
    float white = WhiteMask(albedo);
    float skin = SkinMask(albedo);
    float3 nonMetalSpec = lerp(float3(0.98f, 0.96f, 1.0f), float3(0.72f, 0.90f, 1.0f), blue);
    nonMetalSpec = lerp(nonMetalSpec, float3(1.0f, 0.82f, 0.76f), skin * 0.35f);
    nonMetalSpec = lerp(nonMetalSpec, float3(1.0f, 0.98f, 1.0f), white);
    return lerp(nonMetalSpec, albedo, metallic);
}

float4 main(in PSInput3D In) : SV_Target
{
    float4 baseColor = In.Diffuse;
    if (UseTexture != 0)
    {
        baseColor *= g_Texture.Sample(g_SamplerState, In.TexCoord);
    }
    baseColor.a *= saturate(MaterialAlpha);

    clip(baseColor.a - 0.01f);

    float3 albedo = saturate(baseColor.rgb);
    float kawaiiBlend = saturate(KawaiiBlend);
    albedo = saturate(AdjustSaturation(albedo, BaseSaturation) * BaseBrightness);

    float3 viewDir = SafeNormalize(CameraPos - In.WorldPos, float3(0.0f, 0.0f, -1.0f));
    float normalBlend = saturate(NormalBlend);
    float normalBias = clamp(NormalBias, -1.0f, 1.0f);
    float3 meshNormal = SafeNormalize(In.Normal * ((FlipNormal != 0) ? -1.0f : 1.0f), float3(0.0f, 1.0f, 0.0f));
    if (UseNormalMap != 0)
    {
        float3 tangentNormal = DecodeTangentNormalSample(g_NormalTexture.Sample(g_SamplerState, In.TexCoord));
        meshNormal = ApplyNormalMapCommon(meshNormal, In.WorldPos, In.TexCoord, tangentNormal);
    }
    float3 roundedNormal = SafeNormalize(meshNormal + viewDir, meshNormal);
    float3 normal = SafeNormalize(lerp(meshNormal, roundedNormal, normalBlend), meshNormal);

    float3 lightDir;
    float3 lightColor;
    float lightAttenuation;
    float volumeScatter;
    float rangeBlend;
    ResolveLightAggregate(In.WorldPos, In.Position.xy, lightDir, lightColor, lightAttenuation, volumeScatter,
                          rangeBlend);
    float3 halfDir = SafeNormalize(lightDir + viewDir, normal);

    float lightIntensity = 1.0f;

    float rawNDotL = dot(normal, lightDir) + normalBias;
    float halfLambert = saturate(rawNDotL * lerp(0.5f, 0.32f, rangeBlend) + lerp(0.5f, 0.68f, rangeBlend));

    float shadowThreshold = lerp(ShadowThreshold, ShadowThreshold * 0.62f, rangeBlend);
    float midThreshold = saturate(shadowThreshold + lerp(0.24f, 0.18f, rangeBlend));
    float softness = lerp(ShadowSoftness, ShadowSoftness * 1.8f, rangeBlend);

    float shadowMask = ToonStep(halfLambert, shadowThreshold, softness);
    float midMask = ToonStep(halfLambert, midThreshold, softness * 1.3f);

    float3 neutralShadow = albedo * float3(0.62f, 0.64f, 0.72f);
    float3 neutralMid = albedo * float3(0.92f, 0.94f, 1.0f);
    float3 neutralLit = albedo * float3(1.10f, 1.08f, 1.04f);
    float3 shadowColor = lerp(neutralShadow, BuildShadowColor(albedo, rangeBlend), kawaiiBlend) * ShadowStrength;
    float3 midColor = lerp(neutralMid, BuildMidColor(albedo, rangeBlend), kawaiiBlend) * MidStrength;
    float3 litColor = lerp(neutralLit, BuildLitColor(albedo), kawaiiBlend) * LitStrength;

    float3 toonDiffuse = lerp(shadowColor, midColor, shadowMask);
    toonDiffuse = lerp(toonDiffuse, litColor, midMask);
    toonDiffuse *= lerp(float3(1.0f, 1.0f, 1.0f), lightColor, 0.55f) * lightIntensity * lightAttenuation;

    float nDotH = saturate(dot(normal, halfDir));
    float specRaw = pow(nDotH, lerp(96.0f, 18.0f, saturate(mRoughness)));
    float specMask = ToonStep(specRaw, SpecularThreshold, 0.018f);
    float3 specular = BuildSpecularColor(albedo, saturate(mMetallic)) * specMask * SpecularStrength;

    float rim = 1.0f - saturate(dot(normal, viewDir));
    float rimMask = ToonStep(rim, lerp(RimThreshold, RimThreshold * 0.78f, rangeBlend), 0.055f);
    rimMask *= ToonStep(rawNDotL, -0.25f, 0.35f);
    float3 rimColor = rimMask * lerp(float3(0.38f, 0.48f, 0.80f), albedo * 0.45f, 0.20f) * RimStrength;

    float3 ambient = BuildShadowColor(albedo, rangeBlend) * lerp(0.22f, 0.30f, rangeBlend);
    float3 color = ambient + toonDiffuse + specular + rimColor;
    color += lightColor * volumeScatter * lightIntensity * 0.35f;

    color = AdjustSaturation(color, 1.16f);
    color = lerp(color, sqrt(saturate(color)), 0.12f);
    return float4(saturate(color) * baseColor.a, baseColor.a);
}

{

}

===== FILE: shader\hlsl\modelshaderPS.hlsl =====
#define SHADER_3D
#define SHADER_FORWARD_LIGHTING
#define SHADER_MATERIAL_OPTICS_PREVIEW
#define POM_PIXEL_DEPTH_OUTPUT
#include "common.hlsl"

Texture2D g_Texture : register(t0);
Texture2D g_NormalTexture : register(t2);
Texture2D<float4> SceneColorTexture : register(t3);
Texture2D<float4> EnvironmentTexture : register(t6);
SamplerState g_SamplerState : register(s0);

float IsMaterialClassForward(float value, float target)
{
    return abs(value - target) < 0.5f;
}

float3 SampleEnvironmentLatLong(float3 dir, float roughness)
{
    const float PI = 3.14159265358979323846f;
    dir = SafeNormalizeCommon(dir, float3(0.0f, 1.0f, 0.0f));
    float2 uv = float2(frac(atan2(dir.z, dir.x) / (2.0f * PI) + 0.5f), acos(clamp(dir.y, -1.0f, 1.0f)) / PI);
    return EnvironmentTexture.SampleLevel(g_SamplerState, uv, roughness * 8.0f).rgb;
}

#include "MaterialSurface.hlsli"
#include "SkyAtmosphere.hlsli"
#include "CloudMedium.hlsli"

Texture2D<float4> ForwardBaseColor : register(t26);
Texture2D<float> DepthTexture : register(t27);
Texture2D<float4> MonitorTexture : register(t12);
Texture2D<float2> RaytracedVisibility : register(t16);
Texture2D<float4> RaytracedReflections : register(t17);
Texture2D<float> VisibilityBitmaskAO : register(t13);
Texture2D<float4> DeinterleavedSSGI : register(t14);
Texture2D<float4> AtmosphereTexture : register(t28);
SamplerState LightingSampler : register(s4);
#define BaseColorTexture ForwardBaseColor
#define ShadowMapTexture g_ShadowMap
#define ShadowSampler g_ShadowSampler
#define TextureSampler LightingSampler
// MegaLights M7：Forward / 半透明もクラスターライトグリッドで評価（ルート引数 34：t44〜t46 +
// b10、35：ライトのテクスチャ）
#define MEGALIGHTS_GRID 1
#define MEGALIGHTS_FORWARD 1
#define MEGALIGHTS_LIGHT_TEXTURES 1
#define MEGALIGHTS_CB_REGISTER b10
#include "MegaLightsCommon.hlsli"
StructuredBuffer<MegaLightData> MegaLightBuffer : register(t44);

float SampleForwardDeferredShadowMap(float3 worldPos, float3 normal, float3 lightDir)
{
    float3 directLight;
    float3 aggregateDirection;
    float3 aggregateColor;
    float attenuation;
    float volume;
    float rangeBlend;
    float visibility;
    g_MLCellIndex = MLCellIndexFromWorld(worldPos);
    ResolveSurfaceLightAggregateShadowed(
        worldPos, ddx(worldPos), ddy(worldPos), normal, WorldToScreenUV(worldPos).xy * ViewportSize,
        clamp((int)round(VirtualShadowGlobal.z), 0, 3), false, normal, 0.0f, 0.0f, 0.0f, directLight,
        aggregateDirection, aggregateColor, attenuation, volume, rangeBlend, visibility);
    return visibility;
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
// 屈折（RenderQuality: RaytracedRefraction）。屈折レイをシーンの
// TLAS に対して追跡し（インライン RayQuery）、透明物体の奥の面を求める。その色は、
// 投影したヒット位置の不透明シーンのコピー（t3）から取得する。DXR がない場合、ヒット距離を
// 不透明深度バッファーから推定する。
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
float3 ReconstructForwardWorld(float2 uv, float depth)
{
    float4 world = mul(float4(uv.x * 2.0f - 1.0f, 1.0f - uv.y * 2.0f, depth, 1.0f), PPInvViewProjection);
    float safeW = world.w;
    if (!(abs(world.w) > 1e-6f))
    {
        safeW = 1e-6f;
        if (world.w < 0)
        {
            safeW = -1e-6f;
        }
    }
    return world.xyz / safeW;
}

// 深度で検証する画面空間のフォールバック。不透明シーンのコピーは、
// 隠れた面、画面外の面、追加の透明レイヤーを表現できない。
float3 SampleGlassBackground(float2 uv, float roughness)
{
    uint sceneWidth, sceneHeight;
    SceneColorTexture.GetDimensions(sceneWidth, sceneHeight);
    float2 texel = 1.0f / float2(max(sceneWidth, 1u), max(sceneHeight, 1u));
    float2 radius = texel * (saturate(roughness) * saturate(roughness) * 24.0f);
    float2 lo = texel * 0.5f;
    float2 hi = 1.0f - lo;
    float3 c = SceneColorTexture.SampleLevel(g_SamplerState, clamp(uv, lo, hi), 0).rgb * 0.5f;
    c += SceneColorTexture.SampleLevel(g_SamplerState, clamp(uv + float2(radius.x, 0), lo, hi), 0).rgb * 0.125f;
    c += SceneColorTexture.SampleLevel(g_SamplerState, clamp(uv - float2(radius.x, 0), lo, hi), 0).rgb * 0.125f;
    c += SceneColorTexture.SampleLevel(g_SamplerState, clamp(uv + float2(0, radius.y), lo, hi), 0).rgb * 0.125f;
    c += SceneColorTexture.SampleLevel(g_SamplerState, clamp(uv - float2(0, radius.y), lo, hi), 0).rgb * 0.125f;
    return c;
}

// シーンに描画済みの可視の空や背景は、IBL の照明項ではない。
// このレイが背景深度へ投影される場合だけ再利用する。
// 画面外でヒットしなかった場合は黒を保ち、環境マップで代用しない。
float3 SampleGlassVisibleBackgroundAt(float2 uv)
{
    if (any(uv <= 0) || any(uv >= 1))
    {
        return 0.0f;
    }
    uint width, height, depthWidth, depthHeight;
    SceneColorTexture.GetDimensions(width, height);
    DepthTexture.GetDimensions(depthWidth, depthHeight);
    float2 extent = float2(max(width, 1u), max(height, 1u));
    float2 pixel = uv * extent - 0.5f;
    int2 base = (int2)floor(pixel);
    float2 fraction = frac(pixel);
    float3 sum = 0;
    float weightSum = 0;
    [unroll] for (uint y = 0; y < 2; ++y)
    {
        [unroll] for (uint x = 0; x < 2; ++x)
        {
            int2 p = clamp(base + int2(x, y), int2(0, 0), int2(width, height) - 1);
            float2 tapUv = (float2(p) + 0.5f) / extent;
            int2 dp =
                clamp((int2)(tapUv * float2(depthWidth, depthHeight)), int2(0, 0), int2(depthWidth, depthHeight) - 1);
            float depth = DepthTexture.Load(int3(dp, 0));
            float weight = (x == 0 ? 1 - fraction.x : fraction.x) * (y == 0 ? 1 - fraction.y : fraction.y);
            if (depth <= 0.0f)
            {
                sum += SceneColorTexture.Load(int3(p, 0)).rgb * weight;
                weightSum += weight;
            }
        }
    }
    return weightSum > 1e-5f ? sum / weightSum : 0.0f;
}

// 透過ラフネスで背景（空）もぼかす。半径は SampleGlassBackground と同じ（roughness² × 24 px）。
float3 SampleGlassVisibleBackground(float3 origin, float3 direction, float roughness)
{
    float2 uv;
    if (!ProjectWorldToScreenCommon(origin + direction * 2000.0f, uv) || any(uv <= 0) || any(uv >= 1))
    {
        return 0.0f;
    }
    float3 c = SampleGlassVisibleBackgroundAt(uv);
    [branch] if (roughness > 0.01f)
    {
        uint width, height;
        SceneColorTexture.GetDimensions(width, height);
        float2 radius = saturate(roughness) * saturate(roughness) * 24.0f / float2(max(width, 1u), max(height, 1u));
        c = c * 0.5f + (SampleGlassVisibleBackgroundAt(uv + float2(radius.x, 0)) +
                        SampleGlassVisibleBackgroundAt(uv - float2(radius.x, 0)) +
                        SampleGlassVisibleBackgroundAt(uv + float2(0, radius.y)) +
                        SampleGlassVisibleBackgroundAt(uv - float2(0, radius.y))) * 0.125f;
    }
    return c;
}

float3 ComputeRefraction(SurfaceData surface, float3 position, float3 normal, float3 viewDir, float2 screenUv,
                         out float pathLength)
{
    float3 N = dot(normal, viewDir) >= 0.0f ? normal : -normal;
    float eta = 1.0f / max(surface.IOR, 1.0f);
    float3 incident = -viewDir;
    float3 entering = refract(incident, N, eta);
    if (dot(entering, entering) < 1e-8f)
    {
        pathLength = 0;
        return 0.0f;
    }
    entering = normalize(entering);
    float thickness = max(surface.Thickness, 0.0f);
    pathLength = thickness / max(abs(dot(entering, N)), 1e-4f);
    // 2 番目の界面は最初の界面と平行。両方の界面で屈折すると、
    // 横方向の変位を残して入射方向へ戻る。
    float3 exitPosition = position + entering * pathLength;
    float3 exitDirection = refract(entering, N, max(surface.IOR, 1.0f));
    exitDirection = SafeNormalizeCommon(exitDirection, incident);
    float roughness = saturate(Transparent0.z);
#ifdef SHADER_RAYTRACING
    if (QualityFlags.w > 0.5f && SceneRayFlags.z > 0.5f)
    {
        RayDesc ray;
        ray.Origin = exitPosition + exitDirection * 0.001f;
        ray.Direction = exitDirection;
        ray.TMin = 0.001f;
        ray.TMax = 200.0f;
        RayQuery<RAY_FLAG_FORCE_OPAQUE> query;
        query.TraceRayInline(LightingScene, RAY_FLAG_NONE, 0x03, ray);
        while (query.Proceed())
        {
        }
        if (query.CommittedStatus() != COMMITTED_NOTHING)
        {
            float3 hit = ray.Origin + exitDirection * query.CommittedRayT();
            float2 uv;
            if (ProjectWorldToScreenCommon(hit, uv) && all(uv > 0) && all(uv < 1))
            {
                float d = DepthTexture.SampleLevel(g_SamplerState, uv, 0);
                float3 visible = ReconstructForwardWorld(uv, d);
                if (d > 0.0f && length(visible - hit) < max(0.05f, length(hit - SurfaceCameraOriginCommon(hit, CameraPos)) * 0.01f))
                {
                    return SampleGlassBackground(uv, roughness);
                }
            }
        }
    }
#endif
    float previous = 0.0f;
    [loop] for (uint step = 0; step < 32; ++step)
    {
        float distance = 0.025f * (exp2((step + 1) * 0.40f) - 1.0f);
        float3 p = exitPosition + exitDirection * distance;
        float2 uv;
        if (!ProjectWorldToScreenCommon(p, uv) || any(uv <= 0) || any(uv >= 1))
        {
            break;
        }
        float depth = DepthTexture.SampleLevel(g_SamplerState, uv, 0);
        if (depth > 0.0f)
        {
            float3 opaque = ReconstructForwardWorld(uv, depth);
            float delta = length(p - SurfaceCameraOriginCommon(p, CameraPos)) - length(opaque - SurfaceCameraOriginCommon(opaque, CameraPos));
            if (delta >= 0.0f)
            {
                float low = previous;
                float high = distance;
                [unroll] for (uint j = 0; j < 5; ++j)
                {
                    float mid = (low + high) * 0.5f;
                    float3 q = exitPosition + exitDirection * mid;
                    float2 quv;
                    if (!ProjectWorldToScreenCommon(q, quv) || any(quv <= 0) || any(quv >= 1))
                    {
                        high = mid;
                        continue;
                    }
                    float qd = DepthTexture.SampleLevel(g_SamplerState, quv, 0);
                    float3 qw = ReconstructForwardWorld(quv, qd);
                    if (qd > 0.0f && length(q - SurfaceCameraOriginCommon(q, CameraPos)) >= length(qw - SurfaceCameraOriginCommon(qw, CameraPos)))
                    {
                        high = mid;
                    }
                    else
                    {
                        low = mid;
                    }
                }
                float3 hit = exitPosition + exitDirection * high;
                float2 huv;
                if (ProjectWorldToScreenCommon(hit, huv) && all(huv > 0) && all(huv < 1))
                {
                    float hd = DepthTexture.SampleLevel(g_SamplerState, huv, 0);
                    float3 hw = ReconstructForwardWorld(huv, hd);
                    if (hd > 0.0f && length(hw - hit) < max(0.1f, length(hit - SurfaceCameraOriginCommon(hit, CameraPos)) * 0.02f))
                    {
                        return SampleGlassBackground(huv, roughness);
                    }
                }
                break;
            }
        }
        previous = distance;
    }
    return SampleGlassVisibleBackground(exitPosition, exitDirection, roughness);
}

#include "GeometryGlass.hlsli"
#include "MaterialOpticsPreview.hlsli"
#include "NormalMapDecode.hlsli"
#include "LiveToonMaterial.hlsli"

static float g_PomForwardDepth = 0.0f;

float4 ShadeForward(in PSInput3D In)
{
    float3 glassIncident = -SurfaceViewDirectionCommon(In.WorldPos, CameraPos);
    float3 glassRayDx = ddx(glassIncident);
    float3 glassRayDy = ddy(glassIncident);
    float3 glassOrigin = SurfaceCameraOriginCommon(In.WorldPos, CameraPos);
    float3 glassOriginDx = ddx(glassOrigin);
    float3 glassOriginDy = ddy(glassOrigin);
    const float PI = 3.14159265358979323846f;

    AssetMaterialParameters assetMaterial = LoadAssetMaterial(0);
    AssetParallaxResult pom =
        ApplyAssetParallaxEx(assetMaterial, In.TexCoord, In.WorldPos, In.Normal, In.CameraPos, g_SamplerState);
    float2 materialUv = pom.Uv;
    // ピクセル深度オフセットと POM セルフシャドウ（主光源）。
    g_PomForwardDepth = AssetParallaxPixelDepth(pom, In.WorldPos, In.CameraPos, saturate(In.Position.z));
#ifdef IMPOSTOR_FORWARD
    g_PomForwardDepth = g_ImpostorDepth; // インポスター：アトラスから復元した表面の深度
#endif
#ifdef POM_HAS_MAIN_LIGHT
    if (pom.Active)
    {
        g_PomSelfShadowLight = PomMainLightDirection(In.WorldPos);
        g_PomSelfShadow = AssetParallaxSelfShadow(pom, g_PomSelfShadowLight, g_SamplerState);
    }
#endif
    float materialPartId = (MaterialMode == 1) ? (float)ShaderClass : max(In.Diffuse.a, 0.0f);
    // 手動モードへ切り替えた後も、モデル色の alpha にマテリアルの分類が残る場合がある。
    float4 baseColor = float4(In.Diffuse.rgb, 1.0f);
    if (assetMaterial.Surface.z > 0.5f)
    {
        baseColor = float4(1, 1, 1, 1);
    }
    if (UseTexture != 0)
    {
        baseColor *= g_Texture.Sample(g_SamplerState, materialUv);
    }
    float assetMetallic = mMetallic;
    float assetRoughness = mRoughness;
    float4 assetEmissionAO;
    ApplyAssetMaterial(assetMaterial, materialUv, g_SamplerState, baseColor, assetMetallic, assetRoughness,
                       assetEmissionAO);
#ifdef IMPOSTOR_FORWARD
    baseColor = float4(g_ImpostorAlbedo, 1.0f); // インポスター：被覆率は呼び出し側で切り抜き済み
#endif
    baseColor.a = saturate(baseColor.a * MaterialAlpha);
    clip(baseColor.a - (1.0f / 255.0f));

    float3 surfaceNormal = In.Normal * ((FlipNormal != 0) ? -1.0f : 1.0f);
    if (UseNormalMap != 0)
    {
        float3 tangentNormal = DecodeTangentNormalSample(g_NormalTexture.Sample(g_SamplerState, materialUv));
        surfaceNormal = ApplyNormalMapCommon(surfaceNormal, In.WorldPos, In.TexCoord,
                                             ScaleAssetNormal(tangentNormal, assetMaterial));
    }
    else
    {
        // 法線マップが無いときは POM の高さマップから法線を作る。
        surfaceNormal = ApplyAssetHeightNormal(assetMaterial, surfaceNormal, In.WorldPos, In.TexCoord, materialUv,
                                               g_SamplerState);
    }
    surfaceNormal = SafeNormalizeCommon(surfaceNormal, float3(0.0f, 1.0f, 0.0f));
#ifdef IMPOSTOR_FORWARD
    surfaceNormal = g_ImpostorNormal;
#endif

    MaterialPartShaderParams partParams = ResolveMaterialPartParams(materialPartId);
    bool usePartParams = MaterialMode != 1;
    float4 material =
        float4(usePartParams ? partParams.Basic.x : assetMetallic, usePartParams ? partParams.Basic.y : assetRoughness,
               usePartParams ? partParams.Basic.z : mFresnel, materialPartId);
    float4 shadowParams = usePartParams ? float4(partParams.Shadow0.x, partParams.Shadow0.y, partParams.Shadow0.z, 0.0f)
                                        : float4(ShadowThreshold, ShadowSoftness, ShadowStrength, 0.0f);

    float shaderClass = material.a;
    bool transparent = IsMaterialClassForward(shaderClass, 0.0f) || MaterialIsTransparent != 0;
    bool shadow = IsMaterialClassForward(shaderClass, 5.0f);
    bool lit = IsMaterialClassForward(shaderClass, 8.0f);
    bool pbr = IsMaterialClassForward(shaderClass, 11.0f);
    bool brdf = IsMaterialClassForward(shaderClass, 12.0f);
    bool btdf = IsMaterialClassForward(shaderClass, 13.0f);
    bool bsdf = IsMaterialClassForward(shaderClass, 14.0f);

    float shadowThreshold = shadowParams.r;
    float shadowSoftness = max(shadowParams.g, 0.0001f);
    float shadowStrength = saturate(shadowParams.b);
#ifndef IMPOSTOR_FORWARD
    // ライブトゥーンのマテリアルテクスチャ（Def / 顔陰影反転 / 質感ランプ）。Deferred と同じ処理。
    {
        LiveToonMaterialSurface toonSurface;
        toonSurface.Albedo = baseColor.rgb;
        toonSurface.ShadowThreshold = shadowThreshold;
        toonSurface.ShadowSoftness = shadowSoftness;
        ApplyLiveToonMaterialTextures(LiveToonTextures, LiveToonMaterialParams, materialUv, surfaceNormal,
                                      SurfaceViewDirectionCommon(In.WorldPos, CameraPos), shaderClass,
                                      g_SamplerState, toonSurface);
        baseColor.rgb = toonSurface.Albedo;
        shadowThreshold = toonSurface.ShadowThreshold;
        shadowSoftness = max(toonSurface.ShadowSoftness, 0.0001f);
    }
#endif

    if (IsLiveToonClass(shaderClass) && !transparent)
    {
        float3 toonDirection, toonColor, directLight;
        float attenuation, volume, range, visibility;
        float3 toonView = SurfaceViewDirectionCommon(In.WorldPos, CameraPos);
        g_MLCellIndex = MLCellIndexFromWorld(In.WorldPos);
        g_LiveToonClass = shaderClass;
        g_LiveToonShadow = float2(shadowThreshold, shadowStrength);
        ResolveSurfaceLightAggregateShadowed(
            In.WorldPos, ddx(In.WorldPos), ddy(In.WorldPos), surfaceNormal, In.Position.xy,
            clamp((int)round(VirtualShadowGlobal.z), 0, 3), false, toonView, baseColor.rgb,
            material.rgb, shadowSoftness, directLight, toonDirection, toonColor,
            attenuation, volume, range, visibility);
        float3 irradiance = SampleEnvironmentLatLong(surfaceNormal, 1.0f);
        float3 color = directLight + EvaluateLiveToonAmbientStyled(baseColor.rgb, irradiance, shaderClass);
        [branch] if (LiveToonStyle3.z > 0.0f && LiveToonStyle0.x > 0.0f)
        {
            float3 environment = SampleEnvironmentLatLong(reflect(-toonView, surfaceNormal), 0.5f);
            color += EvaluateLiveToonEnvironmentSpecular(baseColor.rgb, surfaceNormal, toonView, environment,
                                                         shaderClass);
        }
        color *= assetEmissionAO.a;
        // Reuse the same GI/fog/emission composition as Deferred.
        float2 screenUv = In.Position.xy / max(ViewportSize, float2(1.0f, 1.0f));
        color = ApplySurfaceScreenEffects(color, assetEmissionAO.rgb, screenUv,
                                           baseColor.rgb * (1.0f - saturate(material.r)));
        return float4(color * baseColor.a, baseColor.a);
    }

    float3 lightDir;
    float3 lightColor;
    float lightAttenuation;
    float volumeScatter;
    float rangeBlend;
    ResolveLightAggregate(In.WorldPos, In.Position.xy, lightDir, lightColor, lightAttenuation, volumeScatter,
                          rangeBlend);
    float lightIntensity = LightColor.a;

    float metallicParam = material.r;
    float roughnessParam = material.g;
    float f0 = material.b;
    float3 NdotL = saturate(dot(surfaceNormal, lightDir));
    float3 environmentColor = 0.0f;
    if (Transparent0.y <= 0.0f)
    {
        environmentColor = EnvironmentTexture.SampleLevel(g_SamplerState, materialUv, roughnessParam * 10.0f).rgb;
    }
    NdotL += lightIntensity;

    float3 diffuse = 0.0f;
    {
        float3 light = lightColor.rgb * saturate(dot(lightDir, surfaceNormal));
        float2 iblTexcoord;
        iblTexcoord.x = -atan2(surfaceNormal.x, surfaceNormal.z) / (PI * 2);
        iblTexcoord.y = asin(surfaceNormal.y) / PI;
        if (Transparent0.y <= 0.0f)
        {
            light += EnvironmentTexture.SampleLevel(g_SamplerState, iblTexcoord, roughnessParam * 10.0f).rgb * 6;
        }
        diffuse = light * baseColor.rgb / PI;
    }

    // 分類ごとにライトループ全体をインライン展開せず、従来の可視性クエリーを共有する。
    float legacyShadowVisibility = 1.0f;
    bool useLegacyBrdf = brdf && !(pbr || transparent || btdf || bsdf);
    if (shadow || lit || useLegacyBrdf)
    {
        float3 shadowNormal = useLegacyBrdf ? normalize(surfaceNormal + 0.00001f) : surfaceNormal;
        legacyShadowVisibility = SampleForwardDeferredShadowMap(In.WorldPos, shadowNormal, lightDir);
    }

    if (shadow)
    {
        float shadowVisibility = legacyShadowVisibility;
        float castShadow = saturate(1.0f - shadowVisibility);
        float lightLuminance = dot(lightColor.rgb, float3(0.299f, 0.587f, 0.114f));
        float lightShadowPower = saturate(lightLuminance / (lightLuminance + 1.0f));
        float shadowDensity = castShadow * shadowStrength * lerp(0.25f, 1.0f, lightShadowPower);
        float3 lightTint = (lightLuminance > 0.0001f) ? lightColor.rgb / lightLuminance : float3(1.0f, 1.0f, 1.0f);
        float3 shadowTint = saturate(float3(0.015f, 0.014f, 0.017f) + environmentColor * 0.16f + lightTint * 0.025f);
        float3 litColor = baseColor.rgb * (0.12f + NdotL * (0.22f + lightColor.rgb * 0.72f));
        baseColor.rgb = lerp(litColor, baseColor.rgb * shadowTint - 0.08f, shadowDensity);
    }

    if (lit)
    {
        float shadowVisibility = legacyShadowVisibility;
        float castShadow = saturate(1.0f - shadowVisibility);
        float lightLuminance = dot(lightColor.rgb, float3(0.299f, 0.587f, 0.114f));
        float lightShadowPower = saturate(lightLuminance / (lightLuminance + 1.0f));
        float shadowDensity = castShadow * shadowStrength * lerp(0.25f, 1.0f, lightShadowPower);
        float selfShadowMask =
            smoothstep(shadowThreshold - shadowSoftness, shadowThreshold + shadowSoftness, castShadow);
        shadowDensity =
            saturate(max(shadowDensity, selfShadowMask * shadowStrength * lerp(0.20f, 0.85f, lightShadowPower)));
        float3 lightTint = (lightLuminance > 0.0001f) ? lightColor.rgb / lightLuminance : float3(1.0f, 1.0f, 1.0f);
        float3 shadowTint = saturate(float3(0.018f, 0.016f, 0.020f) + environmentColor + lightTint * 0.025f);
        float3 litColor = baseColor.rgb * (lightColor.rgb * 0.72f + NdotL);
        baseColor.rgb = diffuse * lerp(litColor, litColor * shadowTint, shadowDensity);
    }

    if (pbr || transparent || btdf || bsdf)
    {
        SurfaceData surface = BuildLightingSurface(baseColor, surfaceNormal, material.rgb, assetEmissionAO);
        surface.Transmission = saturate(Transparent0.y);
        surface.IOR = max(Transparent0.x, 1.0f);
        surface.Thickness = max(Transparent1.x, 0.0f);
        surface.AbsorptionColor = max(Transparent1.yzw, 0.0f);
        if (surface.Transmission > 0.0f)
        {
            float ratio = (surface.IOR - 1.0f) / (surface.IOR + 1.0f);
            surface.F0 = ratio * ratio;
            material.b = surface.F0;
        }
        float3 viewDir = SurfaceViewDirectionCommon(In.WorldPos, CameraPos);
        if (SceneRayParameters.w > 0.5f && (surface.Transmission > 0.0f || g_ShadingModel.Model == 0u))
        {
            float3 previewColor = EvaluateMaterialOpticsPreview(surface, In.WorldPos, viewDir);
            return float4(previewColor * surface.Opacity, surface.Opacity);
        }
        float3 directLight;
        float visibility;
        int filterRadius =
            clamp((int)round(lerp(max(VirtualShadowGlobal.z, 1.0f), 3.0f, saturate(shadowSoftness * 2.0f))), 1, 3);
        g_MLCellIndex = MLCellIndexFromWorld(In.WorldPos);
        ResolveSurfaceLightAggregateShadowed(In.WorldPos, ddx(In.WorldPos), ddy(In.WorldPos), surfaceNormal,
                                             In.Position.xy, filterRadius, true, viewDir, surface.BaseColor,
                                             material.rgb, shadowSoftness, directLight, lightDir, lightColor,
                                             lightAttenuation, volumeScatter, rangeBlend, visibility);
        uint width;
        uint height;
        SceneColorTexture.GetDimensions(width, height);
        float2 screenUv = In.Position.xy / float2(max(width, 1u), max(height, 1u));
        // ガラスは直接光だけを受ける。基本ローブに環境照明、
        // 画面空間 GI、反射プローブの寄与を加えない。
        const bool glassMaterial = surface.Transmission > 0.0f;
        float3 color;
        if (glassMaterial)
        {
            color = directLight + surface.Emissive;
        }
        else
        {
            color = EvaluateSurfaceEnvironment(surface, viewDir, In.WorldPos, screenUv, shadowSoftness, directLight);
            color = ApplySurfaceScreenEffects(color - surface.Emissive, surface.Emissive, screenUv,
                                              surface.BaseColor * (1 - surface.Metallic));
        }
        float3 premultiplied = color * surface.Opacity;
        float coverage = surface.Opacity;
        // 透過率は BSDF ローブの重みであり、(1-alpha) ではない。alpha は
        // 幾何的な被覆率なので、全面を覆うガラスでも alpha=1 を使える。
        float glassWeight = surface.Transmission * (1.0f - saturate(surface.Metallic));
        if (glassWeight > 0.001f)
        {
#ifdef SHADER_RAYTRACING
            float3 geometryRadiance;
            bool ownsPixel;
            if (TraceGeometryGlass(In.WorldPos, viewDir, glassRayDx, glassRayDy, glassOriginDx, glassOriginDy,
                                   geometryRadiance, ownsPixel))
            {
                // 最も手前のラスターレイヤーだけが、追跡した経路全体を担当する。
                if (!ownsPixel)
                {
                    clip(-1.0f);
                }
                return float4(geometryRadiance * surface.Opacity, surface.Opacity);
            }
#endif
            float3 N = dot(surfaceNormal, viewDir) >= 0 ? surfaceNormal : -surfaceNormal;
            float pathLength;
            float3 background = ComputeRefraction(surface, In.WorldPos, N, viewDir, screenUv, pathLength);
            float F = GlassFresnel(dot(N, viewDir), 1.0f, surface.IOR);
            float3 beer = GlassBeer(surface.BaseColor, surface.AbsorptionColor, surface.Thickness, pathLength);
            float3 R, T;
            GlassSlabWeights(F, beer, R, T);
            // フレネル項によって、透過光から反射分のエネルギーを引き続き除く。
            // ガラスの環境反射は意図的に無効にしている。
            // 既存のクラスター化された直接光の鏡面反射経路を、
            // 拡散アルベド 0 と IOR から導く誘電体の F0 で評価する。
            float f0 = pow((surface.IOR - 1.0f) / (surface.IOR + 1.0f), 2.0f);
            float3 specularDirect, glassLightDir, glassLightColor;
            float glassAttenuation, glassVolume, glassRange, glassVisibility;
            ResolveSurfaceLightAggregateShadowed(In.WorldPos, ddx(In.WorldPos), ddy(In.WorldPos), N, In.Position.xy,
                                                 filterRadius, true, viewDir, 0.0f, float3(0.0f, surface.Roughness, f0),
                                                 shadowSoftness, specularDirect, glassLightDir, glassLightColor,
                                                 glassAttenuation, glassVolume, glassRange, glassVisibility);
            float3 glassColor = specularDirect + T * background + surface.Emissive;
            premultiplied = lerp(color, glassColor, glassWeight) * surface.Opacity;
        }
        return float4(premultiplied, saturate(coverage));
    }

    if (brdf)
    {
        float3 N = normalize(surfaceNormal + 0.00001f);
        float3 L = normalize(lightDir + 0.00001f);
        float3 V = SurfaceViewDirectionCommon(In.WorldPos, CameraPos);
        float3 H = normalize(L + V + 0.00001f);
        float NdotLScalar = saturate(dot(N, L));
        float NdotV = saturate(dot(N, V));
        float NdotH = saturate(dot(N, H));
        float VdotH = saturate(dot(V, H));
        float metallic = saturate(material.r);
        float roughness = clamp(material.g, 0.04f, 1.0f);
        float specularF0 = max(material.b, 0.04f);
        float3 albedo = baseColor.rgb;
        float3 F0 = lerp(float3(specularF0, specularF0, specularF0), albedo, metallic);
        float a = roughness * roughness;
        float a2 = a * a;
        float d = NdotH * NdotH * (a2 - 1.0f) + 1.0f;
        float D = a2 / max(PI * d * d, 0.00001f);
        float k = ((roughness + 1.0f) * (roughness + 1.0f)) / 8.0f;
        float G_L = NdotLScalar / max(NdotLScalar * (1.0f - k) + k, 0.00001f);
        float G_V = NdotV / max(NdotV * (1.0f - k) + k, 0.00001f);
        float G = G_L * G_V;
        float FPower = pow(1.0f - VdotH, 5.0f);
        float3 F = F0 + (1.0f - F0) * FPower;
        float3 specularBRDF = (D * G * F) / max(4.0f * NdotLScalar * NdotV, 0.00001f);
        float3 diffuseBRDF = (1.0f - F) * (1.0f - metallic) * albedo / PI;
        float shadowVisibility = legacyShadowVisibility;
        float3 directReflection =
            (diffuseBRDF + specularBRDF) * lightColor.rgb * lightIntensity * NdotLScalar * shadowVisibility;
        float3 envReflection = SampleEnvironmentLatLong(normalize(reflect(-V, N)), roughness) * F;
        baseColor.rgb = directReflection + envReflection;
    }

    baseColor.rgb = baseColor.rgb * assetEmissionAO.a + assetEmissionAO.rgb;
    baseColor.rgb *= baseColor.a;
    return baseColor;
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
// 出力：SV_Target0 は乗算済みの色（通常の全パス）。
// OIT の透明パスでは、PSO がターゲット 0 をマスクし、SV_Target1/2 を
// 重み付きブレンド OIT の蓄積先と透過残量のターゲットへ合成する（McGuire & Bavoil 2013）。
// レンダーターゲットが 1 つのパスでは SV_Target1/2 を無視する。
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
struct ForwardOutput
{
    float4 Color : SV_Target0;
    float4 Accumulation : SV_Target1;
    float4 Revealage : SV_Target2;
    float HardwareDepth : SV_DepthLessEqual; // POM のピクセル深度オフセット（常に補間深度以下）
};

// MODEL_SHADER_NO_ENTRY：ShadeForward だけを再利用するシェーダー（MekakurePS など）用。
#if !defined(IMPOSTOR_FORWARD) && !defined(MODEL_SHADER_NO_ENTRY)
ForwardOutput main(in PSInput3D In)
{
    float4 premultiplied = ShadeForward(In);
    ForwardOutput output;
    output.Color = premultiplied;
    float alpha = saturate(premultiplied.a);
    float viewDistance = length(In.WorldPos - SurfaceCameraOriginCommon(In.WorldPos, CameraPos));
    // 式 (7)：距離に基づく重み。0.1 .. 500 m で安定する。
    float weight = alpha * clamp(0.03f / (0.00001f + pow(viewDistance / 200.0f, 4.0f)), 0.01f, 3000.0f);
    output.Accumulation = float4(premultiplied.rgb, alpha) * weight;
    output.Revealage = alpha.xxxx;
    output.HardwareDepth = min(g_PomForwardDepth, In.Position.z);
    return output;
}
#endif



===== FILE: shader\hlsl\modelshaderPS_MRT.hlsl =====
#define SHADER_3D
#define POM_PIXEL_DEPTH_OUTPUT
#include "common.hlsl"
Texture2D g_Texture : register(t0);
Texture2D g_NormalTexture : register(t2);
SamplerState g_SamplerState : register(s0);

#include "MaterialSurface.hlsli"
#include "NormalMapDecode.hlsli"

GBufferDepthOutput main(in PSInput3D In)
{
#ifdef SHADER_GPU_DRIVEN
    AssetMaterialParameters assetMaterial = LoadAssetMaterial(materialID);
#else
    AssetMaterialParameters assetMaterial = LoadAssetMaterial(0);
#endif
    AssetParallaxResult pom =
        ApplyAssetParallaxEx(assetMaterial, In.TexCoord, In.WorldPos, In.Normal, In.CameraPos, g_SamplerState);
    float2 materialUv = pom.Uv;
    float materialPartId = (MaterialMode == 1) ? (float)ShaderClass : max(In.Diffuse.a, 0.0f);
    float4 baseColor = float4(In.Diffuse.rgb, 1.0f);
    if (assetMaterial.Surface.z > 0.5f)
    {
        baseColor = float4(1, 1, 1, 1);
    }
    if (UseTexture)
    {
        baseColor *= g_Texture.Sample(g_SamplerState, materialUv);
    }

    float assetMetallic = mMetallic;
    float assetRoughness = mRoughness;
    float4 assetEmissionAO;
    ApplyAssetMaterial(assetMaterial, materialUv, g_SamplerState, baseColor, assetMetallic, assetRoughness,
                       assetEmissionAO);
    clip(baseColor.a - 0.01f);

    float3 normal = In.Normal;
    if (UseNormalMap != 0)
    {
        float3 tangentNormal = DecodeTangentNormalSample(g_NormalTexture.Sample(g_SamplerState, materialUv));
        normal = ApplyNormalMapCommon(normal, In.WorldPos, In.TexCoord, ScaleAssetNormal(tangentNormal, assetMaterial));
    }
    else
    {
        // 法線マップが無いときは POM の高さマップから法線を作る。
        normal = ApplyAssetHeightNormal(assetMaterial, normal, In.WorldPos, In.TexCoord, materialUv, g_SamplerState);
    }

    GBufferDepthOutput output;
    output.EmissionAO = assetEmissionAO;
    output.Color = baseColor;
    output.Normal = MakeGBufferNormal(normal);
    // DeferredPS / GeometryPS と同じく、POM で潜った距離を法線の alpha に入れる（影の受け位置を元のメッシュへ戻す）。
    output.Normal.a = -AssetParallaxRayDistance(pom);

    output.Depth = AssetParallaxPixelDepth(pom, In.WorldPos, In.CameraPos, saturate(In.Position.z));
    output.HardwareDepth = min(output.Depth.x, In.Position.z);
    MaterialPartShaderParams partParams = ResolveMaterialPartParams(materialPartId);
    bool usePartParams = MaterialMode != 1;
    output.Material.r = usePartParams ? partParams.Basic.x : assetMetallic;
    output.Material.g = usePartParams ? partParams.Basic.y : assetRoughness;
    output.Material.b = usePartParams ? partParams.Basic.z : mFresnel;
    output.Material.a = materialPartId;
    output.Shadow = usePartParams ? float4(partParams.Shadow0.x, partParams.Shadow0.y, partParams.Shadow0.z, 0.0f)
                                  : float4(ShadowThreshold, ShadowSoftness, ShadowStrength, 0.0f);
    output.Shadow.a = EncodeShadingModel(assetMaterial, 0.0f);
    WriteAssetParallaxSelfShadow(pom, In.WorldPos, g_SamplerState, output.Shadow, output.Material.a);
    return output;
}


===== FILE: shader\hlsl\modelshaderVS.hlsl =====
#define SHADER_3D
#include "common.hlsl"

PSInput3D main(VSInput3D input)
{
    PSInput3D output;
    float4 worldPos = mul(float4(input.Position, 1.0f), World);
    float4 viewPos = mul(worldPos, View);
    output.Position = mul(viewPos, Projection);
    output.Normal = normalize(mul(input.Normal, (float3x3)World));
    output.TexCoord = input.TexCoord;
    output.Diffuse = input.Diffuse;
    output.WorldPos = worldPos.xyz;
    output.ViewPos = viewPos.xyz;
    output.CameraPos = CameraPos;
    return output;
}

===== FILE: shader\hlsl\noise.hlsl =====
#ifndef RENDER_NOISE_HLSL
#define RENDER_NOISE_HLSL

// Include-only noise library. No shader entry point or resource bindings.
// File-global, compile-time constants shared by all noise hash implementations.
// Preserve these exact values: changing them changes generated noise patterns.
namespace NoiseHashConstants
{
    static const uint MixMultiplierA = 0x7feb352du;
    static const uint MixMultiplierB = 0x846ca68bu;
    static const uint CoordinateMultiplierX = 0x8da6b343u;
    static const uint CoordinateMultiplierY = 0xd8163841u;
    static const uint CoordinateMultiplierZ = 0xcb1ab31fu;
    static const uint FeatureSeedY = 0x68bc21ebu;
    static const uint FeatureSeedZ = 0x02e5be93u;
    static const uint CellValueSeed = 0xb5297a4du;
    static const uint SequenceMultiplier = 0x9e3779b9u;
    static const uint FeatureRadiusSeed = 0x1b56c4e9u;
    static const uint FeaturePhaseSeed = 0x967a889bu;
    static const uint DeformationMultiplierY = 0x85ebca6bu;
    static const uint CloudMultiplierX = 1597334677u;
    static const uint CloudMultiplierY = 3812015801u;
    static const uint CloudMultiplierZ = 2798796415u;
    static const uint SpectralWaveStride = 1013u;
    static const uint SpectralPhaseStride = 7919u;
    static const uint VectorOffsetY = 17u;
    static const uint VectorOffsetZ = 31u;
    static const uint MixShiftFirst = 16u;
    static const uint MixShiftSecond = 15u;
    static const uint FractionShift = 8u;
    static const float HashToUnitScale = 16777216.0;
    static const float HashToUnit32Scale = 4294967296.0;
    static const float HashFloatMultiplier = 0.1031f;
    static const float HashFloatOffset = 33.33f;
    static const float ContactShadowMultiplier = 52.9829189f;
    static const float ContactShadowDotX = 0.06711056f;
    static const float ContactShadowDotY = 0.00583715f;
}


namespace TextureNoise
{
    static const uint BasisPerlin = 0;
    static const uint BasisValue = 1;
    static const uint BasisWorley = 2;
    static const uint BasisCellEdge = 3;
    static const uint BasisWhite = 4;
    static const uint BasisSimplex = 5;
    static const uint BasisVoronoi = 6;
    static const uint BasisCell = 7;
    static const uint BasisGabor = 8;
    static const uint BasisWavelet = 9;
    static const uint BasisCurl = 10;
    static const uint BasisValueGradient = 11;
    static const uint BasisSparseConvolution = 12;
    static const uint BasisSpot = 13;
    static const uint BasisLocalRandom = 14;
    static const uint BasisChevron = 15;
    static const uint BasisLatticeFree = 16;
    static const uint BasisPhasor = 17;
    static const uint BasisAnisotropicGabor = 18;
    static const uint BasisHarmonic = 19;
    static const uint BasisFlow = 20;
    static const uint BasisRidged = 21;
    static const uint FractalFBm = 0, FractalRidged = 1, FractalBillow = 2;
    static const uint FractalTurbulence = 3, FractalHybrid = 4, FractalDomainWarp = 5;
    static const uint FractalNone = 6, FractalMultifractal = 7, FractalHeterogeneous = 8;

    struct NoiseSettings
    {
        float Frequency;
        int Octaves;
        float Lacunarity;
        float Gain;
        float WarpStrength;
        float RidgeOffset;
        uint Tileable;
        float Direction, Anisotropy, KernelFrequency, Phase;
    };

    uint Hash(uint value)
    {
        value ^= value >> NoiseHashConstants::MixShiftFirst;
        value *= NoiseHashConstants::MixMultiplierA;
        value ^= value >> NoiseHashConstants::MixShiftSecond;
        value *= NoiseHashConstants::MixMultiplierB;
        return value ^ (value >> NoiseHashConstants::MixShiftFirst);
    }

    uint Hash3(int3 cell, uint seed)
    {
        return Hash((uint) cell.x * NoiseHashConstants::CoordinateMultiplierX ^
                    Hash((uint) cell.y * NoiseHashConstants::CoordinateMultiplierY ^ Hash((uint) cell.z * NoiseHashConstants::CoordinateMultiplierZ ^ seed)));
    }

    float Unit(uint h)
    {
        return (h >> NoiseHashConstants::FractionShift) / NoiseHashConstants::HashToUnitScale;
    }

    int Wrap(int value, int period)
    {
        if (period <= 0)
        {
            return value;
        }
        int remainder = value % period;
        return remainder < 0 ? remainder + period : remainder;
    }

    int3 WrapCell(int3 cell, int period)
    {
        return int3(Wrap(cell.x, period), Wrap(cell.y, period), Wrap(cell.z, period));
    }

    float Smooth(float a, float b, float value)
    {
        float t = saturate((value - a) / max(b - a, 1e-6));
        return t * t * (3 - 2 * t);
    }

    float GradientDot(uint h, float3 p)
    {
        switch (h % 12)
        {
            case 0:
                return p.x + p.y;
            case 1:
                return -p.x + p.y;
            case 2:
                return p.x - p.y;
            case 3:
                return -p.x - p.y;
            case 4:
                return p.x + p.z;
            case 5:
                return -p.x + p.z;
            case 6:
                return p.x - p.z;
            case 7:
                return -p.x - p.z;
            case 8:
                return p.y + p.z;
            case 9:
                return -p.y + p.z;
            case 10:
                return p.y - p.z;
            default:
                return -p.y - p.z;
        }
    }

    float2 Worley(float3 p, uint seed, int period)
    {
        int3 cell = (int3) floor(p);
        float2 distances = 1e9;
        [loop]
        for (int z = -1; z <= 1; ++z)
        {
            [loop]
            for (int y = -1; y <= 1; ++y)
            {
                [loop]
                for (int x = -1; x <= 1; ++x)
                {
                    int3 neighbor = cell + int3(x, y, z);
                    uint h = Hash3(WrapCell(neighbor, period), seed);
                    float3 featurePosition =
                        neighbor + float3(Unit(h), Unit(Hash(h ^ NoiseHashConstants::FeatureSeedY)), Unit(Hash(h ^ NoiseHashConstants::FeatureSeedZ)));
                    float distance = dot(featurePosition - p, featurePosition - p);
                    if (distance < distances.x)
                    {
                        distances.y = distances.x;
                        distances.x = distance;
                    }
                    else if (distance < distances.y)
                    {
                        distances.y = distance;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        return sqrt(distances);
    }

    float LatticeBasisNoise(uint basis, float3 p, uint seed, int period)
    {
        if (basis == BasisWorley || basis == BasisCellEdge)
        {
            float2 distances = Worley(p, seed, period);
            float value =
                basis == BasisWorley ? saturate(distances.x * 1.2) : saturate((distances.y - distances.x) * 2);
            return value * 2 - 1;
        }
        int3 cell = (int3) floor(p);
        float3 local = p - cell;
        float3 fade = local * local * local * (local * (local * 6 - 15) + 10);
        float corners[8];
        [unroll]
        for (int index = 0; index < 8; ++index)
        {
            int3 offset = int3(index & 1, (index >> 1) & 1, (index >> 2) & 1);
            uint h = Hash3(WrapCell(cell + offset, period), seed);
            corners[index] = basis == BasisValue ? Unit(h) * 2 - 1 : GradientDot(h, local - offset);
        }
        float a = lerp(lerp(corners[0], corners[1], fade.x), lerp(corners[2], corners[3], fade.x), fade.y);
        float b = lerp(lerp(corners[4], corners[5], fade.x), lerp(corners[6], corners[7], fade.x), fade.y);
        float value = lerp(a, b, fade.z);
        return basis == BasisValue ? value : clamp(value * 0.95, -1, 1);
    }

    float Fade(float t)
    {
        return t * t * t * (t * (t * 6 - 15) + 10);
    }

    uint HashXYZ(int x, int y, int z, uint seed)
    {
        return Hash3(int3(x, y, z), seed);
    }

    float Perlin(float x, float y, float z, uint seed, int period)
    {
        return LatticeBasisNoise(BasisPerlin, float3(x, y, z), seed, period);
    }

    float ValueNoise(float x, float y, float z, uint seed, int period)
    {
        return LatticeBasisNoise(BasisValue, float3(x, y, z), seed, period);
    }

    // Compact kernels share a bounded neighborhood and wrapped *hashes*, not wrapped
    // offsets: this is essential to preserve both continuity and tileability.
    float SimplexRaw(float x, float y, float z, uint seed)
    {
        const float skew = (x + y + z) / 3.0f;
        const int i = int(floor(x + skew));
        const int j = int(floor(y + skew));
        const int k = int(floor(z + skew));
        const float unskew = (i + j + k) / 6.0f;
        const float a = x - (i - unskew), b = y - (j - unskew), c = z - (k - unskew);
        const int ix = a >= b && a >= c ? 1 : 0;
        const int iy = b > a && b >= c ? 1 : 0;
        const int iz = c > a && c > b ? 1 : 0;
        const int jx = a >= b || a >= c ? 1 : 0;
        const int jy = b > a || b >= c ? 1 : 0;
        const int jz = c > a || c > b ? 1 : 0;
        float sum = 0;
        [loop]
        for (int corner = 0; corner < 4; ++corner)
        {
            const int dx = corner == 0 ? 0 : (corner == 1 ? ix : (corner == 2 ? jx : 1));
            const int dy = corner == 0 ? 0 : (corner == 1 ? iy : (corner == 2 ? jy : 1));
            const int dz = corner == 0 ? 0 : (corner == 1 ? iz : (corner == 2 ? jz : 1));
            const float px = a - dx + corner / 6.0f;
            const float py = b - dy + corner / 6.0f;
            const float pz = c - dz + corner / 6.0f;
            const float t = max(0.0f, 0.6f - px * px - py * py - pz * pz);
            sum += t * t * t * t * GradientDot(HashXYZ(i + dx, j + dy, k + dz, seed), float3(px, py, pz));
        }
        return clamp(32.0f * sum, -1.0f, 1.0f);
    }

    float Simplex(float x, float y, float z, uint seed, int period)
    {
        if (period <= 0)
        {
            return SimplexRaw(x, y, z, seed);
        }
        // Blend translated simplex fields with quintic weights. Skewed simplex
        // lattice coordinates cannot be wrapped as Cartesian lattice cells.
        const float px = x - floor(x / period) * period;
        const float py = y - floor(y / period) * period;
        const float pz = z - floor(z / period) * period;
        const float u = Fade(px / period), v = Fade(py / period), w = Fade(pz / period);
        float sum = 0;
        [loop]
        for (int dz = 0; dz < 2; ++dz)
        {
            [loop]
            for (int dy = 0; dy < 2; ++dy)
            {
                [loop]
                for (int dx = 0; dx < 2; ++dx)
                {
                    sum += SimplexRaw(px - dx * period, py - dy * period, pz - dz * period, seed) *
                           (dx == 0 ? 1 - u : u) * (dy == 0 ? 1 - v : v) * (dz == 0 ? 1 - w : w);
                }
            }
        }
        return sum;
    }

    float VoronoiCell(float x, float y, float z, uint seed, int period)
    {
        const int ix = int(floor(x)), iy = int(floor(y));
        const int iz = int(floor(z));
        uint nearestHash = HashXYZ(Wrap(ix, period), Wrap(iy, period), Wrap(iz, period), seed);
        const float centerX = ix + Unit(nearestHash) - x;
        const float centerY = iy + Unit(Hash(nearestHash ^ NoiseHashConstants::FeatureSeedY)) - y;
        const float centerZ = iz + Unit(Hash(nearestHash ^ NoiseHashConstants::FeatureSeedZ)) - z;
        float nearest = centerX * centerX + centerY * centerY + centerZ * centerZ;
        int nearestOrder = 62; // Center of the original 5x5x5 traversal; preserve ties.
        // Keep the radius-two search, but reject cells whose entire box is farther
        // than an already known feature. No UV quantization or baked image is used.
        [loop]
        for (int dz = -2; dz <= 2; ++dz)
        {
            const float lowerZ = max(0.0f, max(iz + dz - z, z - (iz + dz + 1)));
            const float distanceZ = lowerZ * lowerZ;
            // A small conservative margin keeps rounded distance bounds from rejecting ties.
            [branch]
            if (distanceZ > nearest + 1e-6f)
            {
                continue;
            }
            const int wrappedZ = Wrap(iz + dz, period);
            const uint zHash = Hash((uint) wrappedZ * NoiseHashConstants::CoordinateMultiplierZ ^ seed);
            [loop]
            for (int dy = -2; dy <= 2; ++dy)
            {
                const float lowerY = max(0.0f, max(iy + dy - y, y - (iy + dy + 1)));
                const float distanceYZ = lowerY * lowerY + distanceZ;
                [branch]
                if (distanceYZ > nearest + 1e-6f)
                {
                    continue;
                }
                const int wrappedY = Wrap(iy + dy, period);
                const uint yzHash = Hash((uint) wrappedY * NoiseHashConstants::CoordinateMultiplierY ^ zHash);
                [loop]
                for (int dx = -2; dx <= 2; ++dx)
                {
                    const float lowerX = max(0.0f, max(ix + dx - x, x - (ix + dx + 1)));
                    [branch]
                    if (lowerX * lowerX + distanceYZ > nearest + 1e-6f)
                    {
                        continue;
                    }
                    // The Y/Z hash is fixed for this row; reuse it for every X cell.
                    const uint h = Hash((uint) Wrap(ix + dx, period) * NoiseHashConstants::CoordinateMultiplierX ^ yzHash);
                    const float a = ix + dx + Unit(h) - x;
                    const float b = iy + dy + Unit(Hash(h ^ NoiseHashConstants::FeatureSeedY)) - y;
                    const float c = iz + dz + Unit(Hash(h ^ NoiseHashConstants::FeatureSeedZ)) - z;
                    const float d = a * a + b * b + c * c;
                    const int order = (dz + 2) * 25 + (dy + 2) * 5 + dx + 2;
                    if (d < nearest || (d == nearest && order < nearestOrder))
                    {
                        nearest = d;
                        nearestHash = h;
                        nearestOrder = order;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        return Unit(Hash(nearestHash ^ NoiseHashConstants::CellValueSeed)) * 2 - 1;
    }

    float Flow(float x, float y, float z, uint seed, int period, float phase)
    {
        const int ix = int(floor(x)), iy = int(floor(y));
        const int iz = int(floor(z));
        const float a = x - ix, b = y - iy, c = z - iz;
        const float u = Fade(a), v = Fade(b), w = Fade(c);
        const float co = cos(phase), si = sin(phase);
        float sum = 0;
        [loop]
        for (int dz = 0; dz < 2; ++dz)
        {
            [loop]
            for (int dy = 0; dy < 2; ++dy)
            {
                [loop]
                for (int dx = 0; dx < 2; ++dx)
                {
                    const uint h = HashXYZ(Wrap(ix + dx, period), Wrap(iy + dy, period), Wrap(iz + dz, period), seed);
                    // Rotate each lattice gradient, rather than translating the field.
                    const float px = a - dx, py = b - dy, pz = c - dz;
                    const float g = GradientDot(h, float3(co * px + si * py, -si * px + co * py, pz));
                    sum += g * (dx == 0 ? 1 - u : u) * (dy == 0 ? 1 - v : v) * (dz == 0 ? 1 - w : w);
                }
            }
        }
        return clamp(sum * 0.95f, -1.0f, 1.0f);
    }

    float3 CurlVector(float x, float y, float z, uint seed, int period)
    {
        // Curl of three independent scalar potentials; do not normalize the
        // vector, since doing so would destroy its divergence-free property.
        const float e = 0.002f;
        const uint sy = seed ^ NoiseHashConstants::FeatureSeedY, sz = seed ^ NoiseHashConstants::FeatureSeedZ;
        const float cx = (Perlin(x, y + e, z, sz, period) - Perlin(x, y - e, z, sz, period) -
                          Perlin(x, y, z + e, sy, period) + Perlin(x, y, z - e, sy, period)) /
                         (2 * e);
        const float cy = (Perlin(x, y, z + e, seed, period) - Perlin(x, y, z - e, seed, period) -
                          Perlin(x + e, y, z, sz, period) + Perlin(x - e, y, z, sz, period)) /
                         (2 * e);
        const float cz = (Perlin(x + e, y, z, sy, period) - Perlin(x - e, y, z, sy, period) -
                          Perlin(x, y + e, z, seed, period) + Perlin(x, y - e, z, seed, period)) /
                         (2 * e);
        return float3(cx, cy, cz);
    }

    float Spectral(float x, float y, float z, uint seed, int period, bool harmonic)
    {
        const float tau = 6.28318530718f;
        float sum = 0, norm = 0;
        // No spatial lattice. Integer wavevectors for periodic synthesis, random
        // continuous wavevectors otherwise. Harmonic uses one fundamental + overtones.
        const uint fundamental = Hash(seed);
        [loop]
        for (int wave = 0; wave < 16; ++wave)
        {
            const uint h = harmonic ? fundamental : Hash(seed + uint(wave) * NoiseHashConstants::SpectralWaveStride);
            float a = Unit(h) * 2 - 1;
            float b = Unit(Hash(h ^ NoiseHashConstants::FeatureSeedY)) * 2 - 1;
            float c = Unit(Hash(h ^ NoiseHashConstants::FeatureSeedZ)) * 2 - 1;
            if (period > 0)
            {
                a = floor(a * period + 0.5f) / period;
                b = floor(b * period + 0.5f) / period;
                c = floor(c * period + 0.5f) / period;
                if (a == 0 && b == 0 && c == 0)
                {
                    a = 1.0f / period;
                }
            }
            const float multiple = harmonic ? float(wave + 1) : 1.0f;
            const float amplitude = harmonic ? 1.0f / (multiple * multiple) : 1.0f;
            const float phase = tau * Unit(Hash(seed + uint(wave) * NoiseHashConstants::SpectralPhaseStride));
            sum += sin(tau * multiple * (a * x + b * y + c * z) + phase) * amplitude;
            norm += amplitude;
        }
        return sum / norm;
    }

    float CompactWavelet(float r2)
    {
        // Laplacian of the compact radial bump (1-r^2)^5 in 3D, rescaled.
        // Its integral is zero; both value and slope vanish at the support boundary.
        const float t = max(0.0f, 1.0f - r2);
        return t * t * t * (1.0f - (11.0f / 3.0f) * r2);
    }

    float KernelNoise(uint basis, float x, float y, float z, uint seed, int period, float direction, float anisotropy,
                      float kernelFrequency, float phase)
    {
        const float tau = 6.28318530718f;
        const int ix = int(floor(x)), iy = int(floor(y));
        const int iz = int(floor(z));
        float real = 0, imaginary = 0, spots = 0;
        const float stretch = clamp(anisotropy, 1.0f, 8.0f);
        const float frequency = clamp(kernelFrequency, 0.25f, 8.0f);
        [loop]
        for (int dz = -1; dz <= 1; ++dz)
        {
            [loop]
            for (int dy = -1; dy <= 1; ++dy)
            {
                [loop]
                for (int dx = -1; dx <= 1; ++dx)
                {
                    const uint cellHash =
                        HashXYZ(Wrap(ix + dx, period), Wrap(iy + dy, period), Wrap(iz + dz, period), seed);
