                    // Two stratified random impulses per cell: bounded work and no empty support holes.
                    [loop]
                    for (int impulse = 0; impulse < 2; ++impulse)
                    {
                        const uint h = Hash(cellHash + uint(impulse) * NoiseHashConstants::SequenceMultiplier);
                        const float a = x - (ix + dx + Unit(h));
                        const float b = y - (iy + dy + Unit(Hash(h ^ NoiseHashConstants::FeatureSeedY)));
                        const float c = z - (iz + dz + Unit(Hash(h ^ NoiseHashConstants::FeatureSeedZ)));
                        const float r2 = a * a + b * b + c * c;
                        if (r2 >= 1.0f)
                        {
                            continue;
                        }
                        const float t = 1 - r2;
                        const float weight = Unit(Hash(h ^ NoiseHashConstants::CellValueSeed)) * 2 - 1;
                        if (basis == BasisWavelet)
                        {
                            real += weight * CompactWavelet(r2);
                            continue;
                        }
                        if (basis == BasisSparseConvolution)
                        {
                            real += weight * t * t * t;
                            continue;
                        }
                        if (basis == BasisSpot)
                        {
                            const float radius = 0.2f + 0.35f * Unit(Hash(h ^ NoiseHashConstants::FeatureRadiusSeed));
                            spots = max(spots, 1.0f - Smooth(radius * 0.6f, radius, sqrt(r2)));
                            continue;
                        }
                        const bool directed = basis == BasisAnisotropicGabor || basis == BasisPhasor;
                        const float angle = directed ? direction : tau * Unit(Hash(h ^ NoiseHashConstants::FeatureRadiusSeed));
                        const float along = a * cos(angle) + b * sin(angle);
                        const float across = -a * sin(angle) + b * cos(angle);
                        const float envelope =
                            exp(-4.0f * (along * along + across * across * (directed ? stretch : 1.0f) + c * c)) * t *
                            t;
                        const float theta = tau * frequency * along + phase + tau * Unit(Hash(h ^ NoiseHashConstants::FeaturePhaseSeed));
                        if (basis == BasisLocalRandom)
                        {
                            // Local random-phase synthesis with multiple independent frequencies.
                            real += envelope * (cos(theta) + 0.5f * cos(theta * 1.93f + h % 17u));
                        }
                        else
                        {
                            real += envelope * cos(theta);
                            imaginary += envelope * sin(theta);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        if (basis == BasisSpot)
        {
            return spots * 2 - 1;
        }
        if (basis == BasisPhasor)
        {
            return real / sqrt(max(real * real + imaginary * imaginary, 1e-12f));
        }
        return real / (1.0f + abs(real));
    }

    float BasisNoiseConfigured(uint basis, float x, float y, float z, uint seed, int period, float direction,
                               float anisotropy, float kernelFrequency, float phase)
    {
        switch (basis)
        {
            case BasisValue:
                return ValueNoise(x, y, z, seed, period);
            case BasisWorley:
            case BasisCellEdge:
                return LatticeBasisNoise(basis, float3(x, y, z), seed, period);
            case BasisWhite:{
                    const int ix = int(floor(x)), iy = int(floor(y));
                    const int iz = int(floor(z));
                    const uint cell = HashXYZ(Wrap(ix, period), Wrap(iy, period), Wrap(iz, period), seed);
                    return Unit(HashXYZ(int((x - ix) * 256), int((y - iy) * 256), int((z - iz) * 256), cell)) * 2 - 1;
                }
            case BasisSimplex:
                return Simplex(x, y, z, seed, period);
            case BasisVoronoi:
                return VoronoiCell(x, y, z, seed, period);
            case BasisCell:
                return Unit(HashXYZ(Wrap(int(floor(x)), period), Wrap(int(floor(y)), period),
                                    Wrap(int(floor(z)), period), seed)) *
                           2 -
                       1;
            case BasisGabor:
            case BasisAnisotropicGabor:
            case BasisWavelet:
            case BasisSparseConvolution:
            case BasisSpot:
            case BasisLocalRandom:
            case BasisPhasor:
                return KernelNoise(basis, x, y, z, seed, period, direction, anisotropy, kernelFrequency, phase);
            case BasisCurl:{
                    const float3 curl = CurlVector(x, y, z, seed, period);
                    return curl[2] / (1.0f + abs(curl[2]));
                }
            case BasisValueGradient:
                return 0.5f * (ValueNoise(x, y, z, seed, period) + Perlin(x, y, z, seed, period));
            case BasisChevron:{
                    const float tau = 6.28318530718f;
                    const float offset = Unit(Hash(seed));
                    const float v = y + offset;
                    const float chevronWave = abs((v - floor(v)) * 2 - 1);
                    return sin(tau * (x + chevronWave + offset + phase / tau));
                }
            case BasisLatticeFree:
            case BasisHarmonic:
                return Spectral(x, y, z, seed, period, basis == BasisHarmonic);
            case BasisFlow:
                return Flow(x, y, z, seed, period, phase);
            case BasisRidged:
                return 1.0f - 2.0f * abs(Perlin(x, y, z, seed, period));
            default:
                return Perlin(x, y, z, seed, period);
        }
    }

    float BasisNoise(uint basis, float3 p, uint seed, int period)
    {
        return BasisNoiseConfigured(basis, p.x, p.y, p.z, seed, period, 0, 4, 2, 0);
    }

    float FractalSum(float3 p, uint basis, uint fractal, uint seed, bool tileable, NoiseSettings settings)
    {
        float frequency = max(settings.Frequency, 0.001);
        // CPU round uses half-away-from-zero; tile frequencies are positive.
        float lacunarity = tileable ? max(1.0, floor(settings.Lacunarity + 0.5)) : settings.Lacunarity;
        float amplitude = 1;
        float sum = 0;
        float norm = 0;
        float weight = 1;
        // Keep the full basis evaluator at one call site, including unfractalized noise.
        int octaveCount = fractal == FractalNone ? 1 : clamp(settings.Octaves, 1, 12);
        [loop]
        for (int octave = 0; octave < octaveCount; ++octave)
        {
            int period = tileable ? max(1, (int) floor(frequency + 0.5)) : 0;
            float scale = tileable ? (float) period : frequency;
            float n =
                BasisNoiseConfigured(basis, p.x * scale, p.y * scale, p.z * scale, Hash(seed + octave * int(NoiseHashConstants::SpectralWaveStride)), period,
                                     settings.Direction, settings.Anisotropy, settings.KernelFrequency, settings.Phase);
            switch (fractal)
            {
                case FractalRidged:
                    n = settings.RidgeOffset - abs(n);
                    n *= n * weight;
                    weight = saturate(n * 2);
                    sum += n * amplitude;
                    break;
                case FractalMultifractal:
                    weight *= 1.0 + n * amplitude;
                    sum = weight - 1.0;
                    break;
                case FractalHeterogeneous:{
                        float signal = (n + settings.RidgeOffset) * amplitude;
                        sum += octave == 0 ? signal : signal * sum;
                        break;
                    }
                case FractalBillow:
                    sum += (abs(n) * 2 - 1) * amplitude;
                    break;
                case FractalTurbulence:
                    sum += abs(n) * amplitude;
                    break;
                case FractalHybrid:{
                        float signal = (n + settings.RidgeOffset * 0.7) * amplitude;
                        sum += octave == 0 ? signal : signal * min(weight, 1.0);
                        weight = min(weight * signal * 2, 1.0);
                        break;
                    }
                default:
                    sum += n * amplitude;
                    break;
            }
            norm += amplitude;
            amplitude *= settings.Gain;
            frequency *= lacunarity;
        }
        if (fractal == FractalNone)
        {
            return saturate(sum * 0.5 + 0.5);
        }
        float value = sum / max(norm, 1e-5);
        switch (fractal)
        {
            case FractalRidged:
                return saturate(value / max(settings.RidgeOffset * settings.RidgeOffset, 0.25));
            case FractalTurbulence:
                return saturate(value * 1.6);
            case FractalHybrid:
                return saturate(value * 0.8);
            case FractalMultifractal:
                return saturate(0.5 + 0.5 * sum / (1.0 + abs(sum)));
            case FractalHeterogeneous:
                return saturate(sum / (1.0 + abs(sum)));
            default:
                return saturate(value * 0.8 + 0.5);
        }
    }

    float Noise(float3 p, uint basis, uint fractal, uint seed, NoiseSettings settings)
    {
        bool tileable = settings.Tileable != 0;
        bool domainWarp = fractal == FractalDomainWarp;
        int sampleCount = domainWarp ? 3 : 1;
        float2 warp = 0;
        float result = 0;
        // Share the basis evaluator across the two warp samples and the final sample.
        [loop]
        for (int sampleIndex = 0; sampleIndex < sampleCount; ++sampleIndex)
        {
            float3 position = p;
            uint sampleSeed = seed;
            uint sampleFractal = fractal;
            if (domainWarp)
            {
                sampleFractal = FractalFBm;
                if (sampleIndex == 0)
                {
                    position += float3(5.2, 1.3, 2.7);
                }
                else if (sampleIndex == 1)
                {
                    position += float3(1.7, 9.2, 4.1);
                    sampleSeed ^= NoiseHashConstants::SequenceMultiplier;
                }
                else
                {
                    float scale = settings.WarpStrength / max(settings.Frequency, 0.001);
                    position += float3(warp.x, warp.y, (warp.x - warp.y) * 0.5) * scale;
                }
            }
            result = FractalSum(position, basis, sampleFractal, sampleSeed, tileable, settings);
            if (sampleIndex == 0)
            {
                warp.x = result * 2 - 1;
            }
            if (sampleIndex == 1)
            {
                warp.y = result * 2 - 1;
            }
        }
        return result;
    }

}

// 2D gradient noise used by vertex deformation.
namespace DeformationNoise
{
    uint NoiseHash(int2 cell, uint seed)
    {
        uint value = uint(cell.x) * NoiseHashConstants::SequenceMultiplier ^ uint(cell.y) * NoiseHashConstants::DeformationMultiplierY ^ seed;
        value ^= value >> NoiseHashConstants::MixShiftFirst;
        value *= NoiseHashConstants::MixMultiplierA;
        value ^= value >> NoiseHashConstants::MixShiftSecond;
        value *= NoiseHashConstants::MixMultiplierB;
        return value ^ (value >> NoiseHashConstants::MixShiftFirst);
    }

    float Gradient(int2 cell, float2 delta, uint seed)
    {
        switch (NoiseHash(cell, seed) & 7u)
        {
            case 0:
                return delta.x;
            case 1:
                return -delta.x;
            case 2:
                return delta.y;
            case 3:
                return -delta.y;
            case 4:
                return (delta.x + delta.y) * 0.70710678118f;
            case 5:
                return (delta.x - delta.y) * 0.70710678118f;
            case 6:
                return (-delta.x + delta.y) * 0.70710678118f;
            default:
                return (-delta.x - delta.y) * 0.70710678118f;
        }
    }

    float Perlin(float2 position, float frequency, uint seed)
    {
        position = clamp(position * clamp(frequency, 0.0001f, 2.0f), -10000.0f, 10000.0f);
        int2 cell = int2(floor(position));
        float2 local = position - cell;
        float2 weight = local * local * local * (local * (local * 6.0f - 15.0f) + 10.0f);
        float low =
            lerp(Gradient(cell, local, seed), Gradient(cell + int2(1, 0), local - float2(1, 0), seed), weight.x);
        float high = lerp(Gradient(cell + int2(0, 1), local - float2(0, 1), seed),
                          Gradient(cell + int2(1, 1), local - 1.0f, seed), weight.x);
        return clamp(lerp(low, high, weight.y) * 1.41421356237f, -1.0f, 1.0f);
    }

}

// Periodic cloud volume noise.
// 格子ハッシュは整数座標をラップするため、テクスチャは周期的になる。
uint CloudHash(uint value)
{
    value ^= value >> NoiseHashConstants::MixShiftFirst;
    value *= NoiseHashConstants::MixMultiplierA;
    value ^= value >> NoiseHashConstants::MixShiftSecond;
    value *= NoiseHashConstants::MixMultiplierB;
    return value ^ (value >> NoiseHashConstants::MixShiftFirst);
}

uint LatticeHash(int3 cell, int period, uint seed)
{
    // 負の格子セルを含め、全オクターブの周期は 2 のべき乗。
    uint3 wrapped = uint3(cell) & uint(period - 1);
    return CloudHash(wrapped.x * NoiseHashConstants::CloudMultiplierX ^ wrapped.y * NoiseHashConstants::CloudMultiplierY ^ wrapped.z * NoiseHashConstants::CloudMultiplierZ ^ seed);
}

float3 HashVector(uint value)
{
    return float3(CloudHash(value), CloudHash(value + NoiseHashConstants::VectorOffsetY), CloudHash(value + NoiseHashConstants::VectorOffsetZ)) / NoiseHashConstants::HashToUnit32Scale;
}

float PeriodicPerlin(float3 uv, int period, uint seed)
{
    float3 p = uv * period;
    int3 cell = int3(floor(p));
    float3 f = frac(p);
    float3 blend = f * f * f * (f * (f * 6 - 15) + 10);
    float result = 0;
    [unroll]
    for (int z = 0; z < 2; ++z)
    {
        [unroll]
        for (int y = 0; y < 2; ++y)
        {
            [unroll]
            for (int x = 0; x < 2; ++x)
            {
                int3 corner = int3(x, y, z);
                float3 gradient = HashVector(LatticeHash(cell + corner, period, seed)) * 2 - 1;
                gradient *= rsqrt(max(dot(gradient, gradient), 0.0001));
                float3 weight = lerp(1 - blend, blend, float3(corner));
                result += dot(gradient, f - corner) * weight.x * weight.y * weight.z;
            }
        }
    }
    return saturate(result * 0.75 + 0.5);
}

float PeriodicWorley(float3 uv, int period, uint seed)
{
    float3 p = uv * period;
    int3 cell = int3(floor(p));
    float nearest = 3;
    [loop]
    for (int z = -1; z <= 1; ++z)
    {
        [loop]
        for (int y = -1; y <= 1; ++y)
        {
            [loop]
            for (int x = -1; x <= 1; ++x)
            {
                int3 neighbor = cell + int3(x, y, z);
                float3 offset = neighbor + HashVector(LatticeHash(neighbor, period, seed)) - p;
                nearest = min(nearest, dot(offset, offset));
            }
        }
    }
    return saturate(sqrt(nearest));
}

float WorleyFbm(float3 uv, uint seed)
{
    return PeriodicWorley(uv, 4, seed) * 0.625 + PeriodicWorley(uv, 8, seed + 1) * 0.25 +
           PeriodicWorley(uv, 16, seed + 2) * 0.125;
}

float Hash13Common(float3 p)
{
    p = frac(p * NoiseHashConstants::HashFloatMultiplier);
    p += dot(p, p.yzx + NoiseHashConstants::HashFloatOffset);
    return frac((p.x + p.y) * p.z);
}

float ValueNoiseCommon(float3 p)
{
    float3 i = floor(p);
    float3 f = frac(p);
    f = f * f * (3.0f - 2.0f * f);

    float n000 = Hash13Common(i + float3(0.0f, 0.0f, 0.0f));
    float n100 = Hash13Common(i + float3(1.0f, 0.0f, 0.0f));
    float n010 = Hash13Common(i + float3(0.0f, 1.0f, 0.0f));
    float n110 = Hash13Common(i + float3(1.0f, 1.0f, 0.0f));
    float n001 = Hash13Common(i + float3(0.0f, 0.0f, 1.0f));
    float n101 = Hash13Common(i + float3(1.0f, 0.0f, 1.0f));
    float n011 = Hash13Common(i + float3(0.0f, 1.0f, 1.0f));
    float n111 = Hash13Common(i + float3(1.0f, 1.0f, 1.0f));

    float nx00 = lerp(n000, n100, f.x);
    float nx10 = lerp(n010, n110, f.x);
    float nx01 = lerp(n001, n101, f.x);
    float nx11 = lerp(n011, n111, f.x);
    float nxy0 = lerp(nx00, nx10, f.y);
    float nxy1 = lerp(nx01, nx11, f.y);
    return lerp(nxy0, nxy1, f.z);
}

// Screen-space hashes for weather, lens effects and contact shadow sampling.
float Hash21(float2 p)
{
    float3 p3 = frac(float3(p.xyx) * NoiseHashConstants::HashFloatMultiplier);
    p3 += dot(p3, p3.yzx + NoiseHashConstants::HashFloatOffset);
    return frac((p3.x + p3.y) * p3.z);
}

float ContactShadowPixelNoise(float2 pixelPosition)
{
    return frac(NoiseHashConstants::ContactShadowMultiplier * frac(dot(pixelPosition, float2(NoiseHashConstants::ContactShadowDotX, NoiseHashConstants::ContactShadowDotY))));
}

float WeatherValueNoise(float2 p)
{
    float2 i = floor(p);
    float2 f = frac(p);
    float2 u = f * f * (3.0f - 2.0f * f);
    return lerp(lerp(Hash21(i), Hash21(i + float2(1, 0)), u.x),
                lerp(Hash21(i + float2(0, 1)), Hash21(i + float2(1, 1)), u.x), u.y);
}

float WeatherFbm(float2 p)
{
    return WeatherValueNoise(p) * 0.55f + WeatherValueNoise(p * 2.03f + 7.1f) * 0.3f +
           WeatherValueNoise(p * 4.11f + 3.7f) * 0.15f;
}

#endif

===== FILE: shader\hlsl\NoiseCacheCS.hlsl =====
#include "ProceduralTexture.hlsli"
RWByteAddressBuffer Cache : register(u1, space15);
cbuffer CacheFrame : register(b0, space15)
{
    uint Clear;
    uint Frame;
};

groupshared ProceduralTexture::Parameters TileDefinition;
groupshared NoiseCacheKey TileKey;
groupshared uint DestinationPage;

[numthreads(64, 1, 1)]
void main(uint3 group : SV_GroupID, uint lane : SV_GroupIndex)
{
    uint bucket = group.x;
    if (bucket >= NoiseCacheBucketCount)
    {
        return;
    }
    uint requestAddress = bucket * NoiseCacheRequestBytes;
    uint firstPage = bucket * NoiseCacheWays;
    if (Clear != 0u)
    {
        if (lane < NoiseCacheWays)
        {
            uint address = NoiseCacheHeaderBytes + (firstPage + lane) * NoiseCacheEntryBytes;
            Cache.Store4(address, 0u);
            Cache.Store4(address + 16u, 0u);
        }
        if (lane == 0u)
        {
            ProceduralNoiseRequests.Store(requestAddress + NoiseCacheRequestStateOffset, 0u);
            if (bucket == 0u)
            {
                Cache.Store4(0u, uint4(1u, 0u, 0u, 0u));
                Cache.Store4(16u, 0u);
            }
        }
        return;
    }
    // Rendering has completed and only this group can reset this bucket.
    // Empty buckets avoid shared-memory synchronization.
    if (ProceduralNoiseRequests.Load(requestAddress + NoiseCacheRequestStateOffset) == 0u)
    {
        return;
    }
    if (lane == 0u)
    {
        TileKey.Words = ProceduralNoiseRequests.Load4(requestAddress);
        TileKey.TileY = ProceduralNoiseRequests.Load(requestAddress + 16u);
        TileDefinition = ProceduralNoiseRequests.Load<ProceduralTexture::Parameters>(requestAddress + 32u);
        DestinationPage = firstPage;
        uint oldest = 0xffffffffu;
        [unroll] for (uint way = 0u; way < NoiseCacheWays; ++way)
        {
            uint page = firstPage + way;
            uint address = NoiseCacheHeaderBytes + page * NoiseCacheEntryBytes;
            uint4 previous = Cache.Load4(address);
            if ((all(previous == TileKey.Words) && Cache.Load(address + 16u) == TileKey.TileY) ||
                all(previous.xy == 0u))
            {
                DestinationPage = page;
                break;
            }
            uint age = Cache.Load(address + 20u);
            if (age < oldest)
            {
                oldest = age;
                DestinationPage = page;
            }
        }
    }
    GroupMemoryBarrierWithGroupSync();
    int2 levels = int2(TileKey.Words.z & 255u, (TileKey.Words.z >> 8u) & 255u) - 128;
    float2 step = exp2(float2(levels));
    int2 tile = int2(asint(TileKey.Words.w), asint(TileKey.TileY));
    [loop] for (uint sampleIndex = lane; sampleIndex < 256u; sampleIndex += 64u)
    {
        uint2 vertex = uint2(sampleIndex % NoiseCacheVerticesPerSide, sampleIndex / NoiseCacheVerticesPerSide);
        float2 uv = float2(tile * int(NoiseCacheCellsPerSide) + int2(vertex)) * step;
        float3 color = ProceduralTexture::Color(TileDefinition, ProceduralTexture::Scalar(TileDefinition, uv));
        uint2 packed = uint2(f32tof16(color.x) | (f32tof16(color.y) << 16u), f32tof16(color.z));
        Cache.Store2(NoiseCacheTexelAddress(DestinationPage, vertex), packed);
    }
    // Publish metadata after this group's texels. The frame-end UAV barrier
    // publishes the completed pages to subsequent rendering dispatches.
    DeviceMemoryBarrierWithGroupSync();
    if (lane == 0u)
    {
        uint address = NoiseCacheHeaderBytes + DestinationPage * NoiseCacheEntryBytes;
        Cache.Store4(address, TileKey.Words);
        Cache.Store4(address + 16u, uint4(TileKey.TileY, Frame, 0u, 0u));
        ProceduralNoiseRequests.Store(requestAddress + NoiseCacheRequestStateOffset, 0u);
    }
}

===== FILE: shader\hlsl\NoiseCacheLayout.hlsli =====
#ifndef NOISE_CACHE_LAYOUT_INCLUDED
#define NOISE_CACHE_LAYOUT_INCLUDED
// Keep these constants in sync with ProcStudio::NoiseSampleCache.
static const uint NoiseCacheBucketCount = 8192u;
static const uint NoiseCacheWays = 4u;
static const uint NoiseCacheEntryBytes = 32u;
static const uint NoiseCacheHeaderBytes = 32u;
static const uint NoiseCacheRequestBytes = 256u;
static const uint NoiseCacheRequestStateOffset = 252u;
static const uint NoiseCacheVerticesPerSide = 16u;
static const uint NoiseCacheCellsPerSide = 15u;
static const uint NoiseCacheTexelBase = NoiseCacheHeaderBytes + NoiseCacheBucketCount * NoiseCacheWays * NoiseCacheEntryBytes;

struct NoiseCacheKey
{
    uint4 Words;
    uint TileY;
};

uint NoiseCacheHash(NoiseCacheKey key)
{
    uint h = key.Words.x ^ (key.Words.y * 0x9e3779b9u) ^ (key.Words.z * 0x85ebca6bu) ^
             (key.Words.w * 0xc2b2ae35u) ^ (key.TileY * 0x27d4eb2fu);
    h ^= h >> 16;
    h *= 0x7feb352du;
    h ^= h >> 15;
    h *= 0x846ca68bu;
    return (h ^ (h >> 16)) & (NoiseCacheBucketCount - 1u);
}

uint NoiseCacheTexelAddress(uint page, uint2 vertex)
{
    return NoiseCacheTexelBase + (page * 256u + vertex.y * NoiseCacheVerticesPerSide + vertex.x) * 8u;
}

float3 NoiseCacheUnpackColor(uint2 packed)
{
    return float3(f16tof32(packed.x & 0xffffu), f16tof32(packed.x >> 16u), f16tof32(packed.y & 0xffffu));
}
#endif

===== FILE: shader\hlsl\NormalMapDecode.hlsli =====
// =============================================================================================
// NormalMapDecode.hlsli - タンジェント空間法線マップのデコード。
// 法線マップは取り込み時に BC5（RG の 2ch）へ圧縮される。BC5 のサンプル結果は B=0 になるため、
// その場合は Z を sqrt(1 - x^2 - y^2) で再構成する。非圧縮・BC7 の RGB 法線マップ（B は通常 0.5 以上）は
// 従来どおり xyz * 2 - 1 で復元するので、既存アセットの見た目は変わらない。
// =============================================================================================
#ifndef NORMAL_MAP_DECODE_HLSLI
#define NORMAL_MAP_DECODE_HLSLI

float3 DecodeTangentNormalSample(float4 encoded)
{
    float3 normal = encoded.xyz * 2.0f - 1.0f;
    [flatten] if (encoded.z <= 0.0f)
    {
        normal.z = sqrt(saturate(1.0f - dot(normal.xy, normal.xy)));
    }
    return normal;
}

#endif // NORMAL_MAP_DECODE_HLSLI

===== FILE: shader\hlsl\OitCompositePS.hlsl =====
// 重み付きブレンド OIT の解決（McGuire & Bavoil 2013）。transparencyeffects.h が実行時にコンパイルする。
Texture2D<float4> OitAccumulation : register(t0);
Texture2D<float> OitRevealage : register(t1);

struct FullscreenOutput
{
    float4 Position : SV_POSITION;
};

FullscreenOutput FullscreenVS(uint vertexId : SV_VertexID)
{
    FullscreenOutput output;
    float2 uv = float2((vertexId << 1) & 2, vertexId & 2);
    output.Position = float4(uv * float2(2, -2) + float2(-1, 1), 0, 1);
    return output;
}

// 出力：rgb = 透明色の平均、a = 総被覆率（1 - 透過残量）。
// 合成式：src * a + dst * (1 - a)。
float4 CompositePS(FullscreenOutput input) : SV_Target
{
    int2 pixel = int2(input.Position.xy);
    float revealage = OitRevealage.Load(int3(pixel, 0));
    if (revealage >= 0.9999f)
    {
        discard;
    }
    float4 accumulation = OitAccumulation.Load(int3(pixel, 0));
    // fp16 の蓄積値のオーバーフローを抑える。
    if (any(isinf(accumulation.rgb)))
    {
        accumulation.rgb = accumulation.aaa;
    }
    float3 average = accumulation.rgb / max(accumulation.a, 0.00001f);
    return float4(average, 1.0f - revealage);
}

===== FILE: shader\hlsl\OptixDenoiserCS.hlsl =====
Texture2D<float4> NoisyRadiance : register(t0);
Texture2D<float> SceneDepth : register(t1);
Texture2D<float4> SceneNormal : register(t2);
StructuredBuffer<float4> SharedInput : register(t3);
RWStructuredBuffer<float4> SharedOutput : register(u0);
RWTexture2D<float4> Result : register(u1);

cbuffer OptixConstants : register(b0)
{
    float4x4 WorldToView;
    uint4 ExtentFlags; // 幅、高さ、NRD の YCoCg 入力、反射ヒット距離の保持
    float4 Parameters; // 出力強度、予約領域
};

[numthreads(8, 8, 1)] void Pack(uint3 id : SV_DispatchThreadID) {
    if (any(id.xy >= ExtentFlags.xy))
    {
        return;
    }
    uint index = id.x + id.y * ExtentFlags.x;
    uint plane = ExtentFlags.x * ExtentFlags.y;
    bool surface = SceneDepth.Load(int3(id.xy, 0)) > 0.0f;
    float3 radiance = NoisyRadiance.Load(int3(id.xy, 0)).rgb;
    if (ExtentFlags.z != 0)
    {
        float y = radiance.x;
        float co = radiance.y;
        float cg = radiance.z;
        radiance = float3(y + co - cg, y + cg, y - co - cg);
    }
    if (!all(isfinite(radiance)) || !surface)
    {
        radiance = 0;
    }
    float3 normal = SceneNormal.Load(int3(id.xy, 0)).xyz * 2 - 1;
    if (!surface || dot(normal, normal) < 0.000001f)
    {
        normal = float3(0, 0, -1);
    }
    normal = mul(float4(normalize(normal), 0), WorldToView).xyz;
    normal.z = -normal.z; // D3D の左手系ビューから、OptiX のカメラ空間ガイドへ変換する。
    SharedOutput[index] = float4(max(radiance, 0), 1);
    SharedOutput[plane + index] = float4(normal, 0);
    // これらの信号は、受光側マテリアルの変調前の入射放射輝度と放射照度。
    // 中立なアルベドで、受光側のテクスチャが GI に焼き付くのを避ける。
    float albedo = surface ? 1.0f : 0.0f;
    SharedOutput[2 * plane + index] = float4(albedo, albedo, albedo, 1);
}

    [numthreads(8, 8, 1)] void Unpack(uint3 id : SV_DispatchThreadID)
{
    if (any(id.xy >= ExtentFlags.xy))
    {
        return;
    }
    uint plane = ExtentFlags.x * ExtentFlags.y;
    uint index = id.x + id.y * ExtentFlags.x;
    float3 radiance = SharedInput[3 * plane + index].rgb;
    if (SceneDepth.Load(int3(id.xy, 0)) <= 0.0f || !all(isfinite(radiance)))
    {
        radiance = 0;
    }
    float alpha = 1;
    if (ExtentFlags.w != 0)
    {
        alpha = Result[id.xy].a;
    }
    Result[id.xy] = float4(min(max(radiance * Parameters.x, 0), 65504), alpha);
}

===== FILE: shader\hlsl\PhysicalGlass.hlsli =====
// 誘電体の界面と、均質な平行板内の光輸送。
// 方向は光の伝播方向を指す。厚みはワールド単位。
#ifndef PHYSICAL_GLASS_INCLUDED
#define PHYSICAL_GLASS_INCLUDED

float GlassFresnel(float cosI, float etaI, float etaT)
{
    cosI = saturate(abs(cosI));
    float eta = etaI / max(etaT, 1e-6f);
    float sinT2 = eta * eta * max(0.0f, 1.0f - cosI * cosI);
    if (sinT2 >= 1.0f)
    {
        return 1.0f;
    }
    float cosT = sqrt(max(0.0f, 1.0f - sinT2));
    float rs = (etaI * cosI - etaT * cosT) / max(etaI * cosI + etaT * cosT, 1e-6f);
    float rp = (etaT * cosI - etaI * cosT) / max(etaT * cosI + etaI * cosT, 1e-6f);
    return saturate(0.5f * (rs * rs + rp * rp));
}

float3 GlassBeer(float3 tint, float3 sigma, float thickness, float path)
{
    float3 tintSigma = -log(clamp(tint, 1e-4f, 1.0f)) / max(thickness, 1e-4f);
    return exp(-min((max(sigma, 0.0f) + tintSigma) * max(path, 0.0f), 80.0f));
}

void GlassSlabWeights(float F, float3 beer, out float3 R, out float3 T)
{
    float3 denominator = max(1.0f - F * F * beer * beer, 1e-5f);
    T = (1.0f - F) * (1.0f - F) * beer / denominator;
    R = F + (1.0f - F) * (1.0f - F) * F * beer * beer / denominator;
    R = saturate(R);
    T = min(saturate(T), 1.0f - R);
}
#endif

===== FILE: shader\hlsl\postProcessBloomPS.hlsl =====
#define SHADER_POSTPROCESS
#include "common.hlsl"

Texture2D<float4> SceneTexture : register(t0);
Texture2D<float4> BloomTexture : register(t15);
SamplerState TextureSampler : register(s0);

float3 ExtractBloom(float3 color)
{
    const float brightness = dot(color, float3(0.2126f, 0.7152f, 0.0722f));
    const float threshold = BloomParams.y;
    const float knee = threshold * saturate(BloomParams.z);
    const float soft = brightness - threshold + knee;
    const float softContribution = clamp(soft, 0.0f, 2.0f * knee);
    const float softPart = softContribution * softContribution / (4.0f * knee);
    const float hardPart = max(brightness - threshold, 0.0f);

    const float contribution = max(softPart, hardPart) / brightness;
    return color * contribution;
}

float3 SampleBlurredBloom(float2 uv)
{
    float width;
    float height;

    SceneTexture.GetDimensions(width, height);

    const float radius = max(BloomParams.w, 0.01f);
    const float2 texel = radius / float2(width, height);
    float3 bloom = 0.0f;

    bloom += ExtractBloom(SceneTexture.Sample(TextureSampler, uv).rgb) * 0.20f;
    bloom += ExtractBloom(SceneTexture.Sample(TextureSampler, uv + float2(texel.x, 0.0f)).rgb) * 0.12f;
    bloom += ExtractBloom(SceneTexture.Sample(TextureSampler, uv - float2(texel.x, 0.0f)).rgb) * 0.12f;
    bloom += ExtractBloom(SceneTexture.Sample(TextureSampler, uv + float2(0.0f, texel.y)).rgb) * 0.12f;
    bloom += ExtractBloom(SceneTexture.Sample(TextureSampler, uv - float2(0.0f, texel.y)).rgb) * 0.12f;
    bloom += ExtractBloom(SceneTexture.Sample(TextureSampler, uv + texel).rgb) * 0.08f;
    bloom += ExtractBloom(SceneTexture.Sample(TextureSampler, uv + float2(texel.x, -texel.y)).rgb) * 0.08f;
    bloom += ExtractBloom(SceneTexture.Sample(TextureSampler, uv + float2(-texel.x, texel.y)).rgb) * 0.08f;
    bloom += ExtractBloom(SceneTexture.Sample(TextureSampler, uv - texel).rgb) * 0.08f;

    return bloom;
}

float4 main(PSInputPostProcess input) : SV_TARGET
{
    const float3 scene = SampleWithChromaticAberration(SceneTexture, TextureSampler, input.TexCoord);

    const float3 bloom = SampleBlurredBloom(input.TexCoord);

    const float intensity = max(Flags.y, 0.0f);

    const float3 result = scene + bloom * intensity;

    return float4(ApplyLensOutput(ApplyHdrOutput(result), input.TexCoord, input.Position.xy), 1.0f);
}

===== FILE: shader\hlsl\postProcessBlurPS.hlsl =====
#define SHADER_POSTPROCESS
#include "common.hlsl"

Texture2D<float4> SceneTexture : register(t0);
SamplerState TextureSampler : register(s0);

float4 main(PSInputPostProcess input) : SV_TARGET
{
    float4 originalColor = SceneTexture.Sample(TextureSampler, input.TexCoord);
    if (Flags.y <= 0.001f)
    {
        originalColor.rgb = ApplyHdrOutput(originalColor.rgb);
        originalColor.a = 1.0f;
        return originalColor;
    }

    float width, height;
    SceneTexture.GetDimensions(width, height);
    float2 texelSize = 1.0f / float2(width, height);

    float4 blurColor = 0;

    [unroll] for (int y = -1; y <= 1; y++)
    {
        [unroll] for (int x = -1; x <= 1; x++)
        {
            float2 offset = float2(x, y) * texelSize;
            blurColor += SceneTexture.Sample(TextureSampler, input.TexCoord + offset);
        }
    }
    blurColor *= (1.0f / 9.0f);

    float4 result = lerp(originalColor, blurColor, Flags.y);
    result.rgb = ApplyHdrOutput(result.rgb);
    result.a = 1.0f;
    return result;
}

===== FILE: shader\hlsl\ProceduralTexture.hlsli =====
#ifndef PROCEDURAL_TEXTURE_INCLUDED
#define PROCEDURAL_TEXTURE_INCLUDED
#include "noise.hlsl"
#include "NoiseCacheLayout.hlsli"
ByteAddressBuffer ProceduralNoiseSamples : register(t0, space15);
RWByteAddressBuffer ProceduralNoiseRequests : register(u0, space15);

namespace ProceduralTexture
{
struct Parameters
{
    uint Width, Height, Kind, Output;
    uint BasisType, Fractal, Seed, Tileable;
    float Frequency;
    int Octaves;
    float Lacunarity, Gain;
    float WarpStrength, RidgeOffset, Contrast, Bias;
    float4 ColorA, ColorB, ColorC;
    float Turbulence, RingCount, Mortar, Time;
    int BricksX, BricksY, Pattern, RepeatX;
    int RepeatY;
    float PatternSize, PatternSoftness, NormalStrength;
    float Choppiness, Coverage, CloudSoftness, Padding;
    uint PreviewSize, Tiles, Padding1, Padding2;
    float Direction, Anisotropy, KernelFrequency, Phase;
};

// Enum values mirror proceduralstudio.h; GPU parity tests exercise every supported value.
static const uint TextureMarble = 1, TextureWood = 2, TextureGranite = 3, TextureVoronoi = 4;
static const uint TextureBrick = 5, TextureChecker = 6, TextureWater = 7, TextureCloud = 8;
static const uint TextureGeometric = 11;
static const uint OutputColor = 0;
static const int PatternStripes = 0, PatternGrid = 1, PatternDots = 2;
static const int PatternDiamonds = 3, PatternHexagons = 4, PatternTriangles = 5;

static const float Pi = 3.14159265358979323846;

float GeometricMask(Parameters params, float2 uv)
{
    float2 local = frac(uv * clamp(int2(params.RepeatX, params.RepeatY), 1, 128)) - 0.5;
    float size = clamp(params.PatternSize, 0.05, 0.95);
    float softness = clamp(params.PatternSoftness, 0.001, 0.15);
    float distance = 0;
    switch (params.Pattern)
    {
        case PatternStripes:
            distance = abs(local.x) - size * 0.5;
            break;
        case PatternGrid:
            distance = min(0.5 - abs(local.x), 0.5 - abs(local.y)) - size * 0.5;
            break;
        case PatternDots:
            distance = length(local) - size * 0.5;
            break;
        case PatternDiamonds:
            distance = (abs(local.x) + abs(local.y) - size * 0.5) / sqrt(2.0);
            break;
        case PatternHexagons:
            distance = max(abs(local.x) * 0.8660254 + abs(local.y) * 0.5, abs(local.y)) - size * 0.4330127;
            break;
        case PatternTriangles:
            distance = 1;
            [unroll]
            for (int y = -1; y <= 1; ++y)
            {
                [unroll]
                for (int x = -1; x <= 1; ++x)
                {
                    float2 triangleLocal = local + int2(x, y);
                    distance = min(distance, max(abs(triangleLocal.x) * 0.8660254 + triangleLocal.y * 0.5, -triangleLocal.y) - size * 0.25);
                }
            }
            break;
        default:
            return 0;
    }
    return 1 - TextureNoise::Smooth(-softness * 0.5, softness * 0.5, distance);
}

float Scalar(Parameters params, float2 uv)
{
    float3 p = float3(uv, 0);
    float2 noiseValues = 0;
    int noiseCount = (params.Kind == TextureVoronoi || params.Kind == TextureChecker || params.Kind == TextureGeometric) ? 0 : 1;
    if (params.Kind == TextureGranite || params.Kind == TextureWater || params.Kind == TextureCloud)
    {
        noiseCount = 2;
    }
    TextureNoise::NoiseSettings noiseSettings = {
        params.Frequency, params.Octaves, params.Lacunarity, params.Gain, params.WarpStrength, params.RidgeOffset, params.Tileable,
        params.Direction, params.Anisotropy, params.KernelFrequency, params.Phase
    };
    // A shared call site keeps the GPU program small instead of inlining the full
    // fractal evaluator separately into every material branch.

    for (int sampleIndex = 0; sampleIndex < noiseCount; ++sampleIndex)
    {
        float3 position = p;
        uint basis = params.BasisType;
        uint fractal = params.Fractal;
        uint seed = params.Seed;
        if (params.Kind == TextureGranite)
        {
            if (sampleIndex == 0)
            {
                basis = TextureNoise::BasisWorley;
                fractal = TextureNoise::FractalFBm;
            }
            else
            {
                position *= 4;
            }
        }
        else if (params.Kind == TextureWater)
        {
            float time = params.Time * 0.15;
            fractal = sampleIndex == 0 ? TextureNoise::FractalFBm : TextureNoise::FractalRidged;
            position += sampleIndex == 0 ? float3(time, time * 0.6, time * 0.3)
                                        : float3(-time * 0.7, time * 0.4, -time * 0.2);
            if (sampleIndex == 1)
            {
                seed ^= 0x51ed27;
            }
        }
        else if (params.Kind == TextureCloud)
        {
            fractal = TextureNoise::FractalFBm;
            if (sampleIndex == 1)
            {
                basis = TextureNoise::BasisWorley;
                seed ^= 0x7f4a7c15;
            }
        }
        noiseValues[sampleIndex] = TextureNoise::Noise(position, basis, fractal, seed, noiseSettings);
    }
    float value = 0;
    switch (params.Kind)
    {
        case TextureGeometric:
            value = GeometricMask(params, uv);
            break;
        case TextureMarble:
            value = 0.5 + 0.5 * sin((uv.x * floor(params.RingCount + 0.5) + noiseValues.x * params.Turbulence) * 2 * Pi);
            value = pow(value, 0.6);
            break;
        case TextureWood:
        {
            float radius = length(uv - 0.5) * params.RingCount * 2 + noiseValues.x * params.Turbulence * 0.5;
            value = frac(radius);
            value = TextureNoise::Smooth(0, 0.8, value) * (1 - TextureNoise::Smooth(0.85, 1, value));
            break;
        }
        case TextureGranite:
            value = saturate(noiseValues.x * 0.6 + noiseValues.y * 0.4);
            value = value > 0.62 ? 1 : value < 0.3 ? 0 : value;
            break;
        case TextureVoronoi:
        {
            int period = params.Tileable != 0 ? max(1, (int)floor(params.Frequency + 0.5)) : 0;
            float scale = params.Tileable != 0 ? (float)period : params.Frequency;
            float2 distances = TextureNoise::Worley(p * scale, params.Seed, period);
            value = saturate((distances.y - distances.x) * 3);
            break;
        }
        case TextureBrick:
        {
            float2 brick = uv * int2(params.BricksX, params.BricksY);
            int row = (int)floor(brick.y);
            float shifted = brick.x + (row & 1) * 0.5;
            float2 local = float2(frac(shifted), frac(brick.y));
            float edge = min(TextureNoise::Smooth(0, params.Mortar * params.BricksX * 0.5, min(local.x, 1 - local.x)),
                             TextureNoise::Smooth(0, params.Mortar * params.BricksY * 0.5, min(local.y, 1 - local.y)));
            float variation = TextureNoise::Unit(TextureNoise::Hash3(int3(TextureNoise::Wrap((int)floor(shifted), max(params.BricksX, 1)), TextureNoise::Wrap(row, max(params.BricksY, 1)), 0), params.Seed));
            value = edge * (0.6 + 0.4 * variation) * (0.85 + 0.15 * noiseValues.x);
            break;
        }
        case TextureChecker:
            value = (((int)floor(uv.x * params.BricksX) + (int)floor(uv.y * params.BricksX)) & 1) != 0 ? 1 : 0;
            break;
        case TextureWater:
        {
            value = saturate(lerp(noiseValues.x, noiseValues.y, params.Choppiness));
            break;
        }
        case TextureCloud:
        {
            float shape = noiseValues.x * 0.65 + (1 - noiseValues.y) * 0.35;
            value = TextureNoise::Smooth(1 - params.Coverage - params.CloudSoftness * 0.5, 1 - params.Coverage + params.CloudSoftness * 0.5, shape);
            break;
        }
        default:
            value = noiseValues.x;
            break;
    }
    return saturate((value - 0.5) * params.Contrast + 0.5 + params.Bias);
}

float3 Color(Parameters params, float value)
{
    switch (params.Kind)
    {
        case TextureGeometric:
            return lerp(params.ColorA.rgb, params.ColorB.rgb, value);
        case TextureBrick:
            return lerp(params.ColorB.rgb, params.ColorC.rgb * (0.6 + 0.6 * value), saturate(value * 4));
        case TextureWater:
        {
            float3 water = lerp(float3(0.01, 0.07, 0.13), float3(0.04, 0.32, 0.42), TextureNoise::Smooth(0.2, 0.75, value));
            return lerp(water, float3(0.92, 0.95, 0.98), TextureNoise::Smooth(0.72, 0.92, value) * params.Choppiness);
        }
        case TextureCloud:
            return lerp(float3(0.32, 0.52, 0.86), lerp(params.ColorB.rgb, 1.0, 0.5), value);
        default:
            return value < 0.5 ? lerp(params.ColorA.rgb, params.ColorB.rgb, value * 2) : lerp(params.ColorB.rgb, params.ColorC.rgb, (value - 0.5) * 2);
    }
}

// Rendering reads completed pages only. Each miss bucket has one request owner;
// frame-end barriers make the entire definition available to the merge dispatch.
bool CacheCoordinates(Parameters params, float2 uv, float2 footprint,
                      out NoiseCacheKey key, out uint2 vertex, out float2 blend)
{
    key = (NoiseCacheKey)0;
    vertex = 0;
    blend = 0;
    if (!any(uint2(params.Padding1, params.Padding2) != 0u) ||
        !all(isfinite(uv)) || !all(isfinite(footprint)) || any(abs(footprint) == 0))
    {
        return false;
    }
    float2 levels = floor(log2(abs(footprint)));
    if (any(levels < -120) || any(levels > 120))
    {
        return false;
    }
    float2 scaled = uv / exp2(levels);
    // Keep integer lattice arithmetic exact and leave room for the border vertex.
    // Beyond this range float UVs cannot describe every neighboring grid vertex.
    if (!all(isfinite(scaled)) || any(abs(scaled) > 8388590.0))
    {
        return false;
    }
    float2 cell = floor(scaled);
    int2 integerCell = int2(cell);
    // Signed integer division truncates toward zero; compensate to floor negatives.
    int2 negativeAdjustment = int2(integerCell.x < 0 ? 14 : 0, integerCell.y < 0 ? 14 : 0);
    int2 tile = (integerCell - negativeAdjustment) / int(NoiseCacheCellsPerSide);
    int2 localVertex = integerCell - tile * int(NoiseCacheCellsPerSide);
    if (any(localVertex < 0) || any(localVertex >= int(NoiseCacheCellsPerSide)))
    {
        return false;
    }
    float2 firstVertex = float2(tile) * float(NoiseCacheCellsPerSide);
    if (!all(isfinite(firstVertex * exp2(levels))) ||
        !all(isfinite((firstVertex + float(NoiseCacheCellsPerSide)) * exp2(levels))))
    {
        return false;
    }
    vertex = uint2(localVertex);
    blend = scaled - cell;
    uint2 packedLevels = uint2(int2(levels) + 128);
    key.Words = uint4(params.Padding1, params.Padding2,
                      packedLevels.x | (packedLevels.y << 8u), asuint(tile.x));
    key.TileY = asuint(tile.y);
    return true;
}

bool FindCachePage(NoiseCacheKey key, uint2 vertex, float2 blend, out float3 color)
{
    color = 0;
    if (ProceduralNoiseSamples.Load(0u) == 0u)
    {
        return false;
    }
    uint firstPage = NoiseCacheHash(key) * NoiseCacheWays;
    [unroll] for (uint way = 0; way < NoiseCacheWays; ++way)
    {
        uint page = firstPage + way;
        uint address = NoiseCacheHeaderBytes + page * NoiseCacheEntryBytes;
        [branch] if (all(ProceduralNoiseSamples.Load4(address) == key.Words) &&
                     ProceduralNoiseSamples.Load(address + 16u) == key.TileY)
        {
            float3 c00 = NoiseCacheUnpackColor(ProceduralNoiseSamples.Load2(NoiseCacheTexelAddress(page, vertex)));
            float3 c10 = NoiseCacheUnpackColor(ProceduralNoiseSamples.Load2(NoiseCacheTexelAddress(page, vertex + uint2(1, 0))));
            float3 c01 = NoiseCacheUnpackColor(ProceduralNoiseSamples.Load2(NoiseCacheTexelAddress(page, vertex + uint2(0, 1))));
            float3 c11 = NoiseCacheUnpackColor(ProceduralNoiseSamples.Load2(NoiseCacheTexelAddress(page, vertex + uint2(1, 1))));
            color = lerp(lerp(c00, c10, blend.x), lerp(c01, c11, blend.x), blend.y);
            return true;
        }
    }
    return false;
}

bool FindCachedColor(Parameters params, float2 uv, float2 footprint, out float3 color)
{
    NoiseCacheKey key;
    uint2 vertex;
    float2 blend;
    color = 0;
    if (!CacheCoordinates(params, uv, footprint, key, vertex, blend))
    {
        return false;
    }
    return FindCachePage(key, vertex, blend, color);
}

float3 CachedColor(Parameters params, float2 uv, float2 footprint)
{
    NoiseCacheKey key;
    uint2 vertex;
    float2 blend;
    bool cacheable = CacheCoordinates(params, uv, footprint, key, vertex, blend) &&
                     ProceduralNoiseSamples.Load(0u) != 0u;
    float3 color;
    if (cacheable)
    {
        [branch] if (FindCachePage(key, vertex, blend, color))
        {
            return color;
        }
    }
    color = Color(params, Scalar(params, uv));
    if (cacheable)
    {
        uint address = NoiseCacheHash(key) * NoiseCacheRequestBytes;
        uint previous;
        ProceduralNoiseRequests.InterlockedCompareExchange(address + NoiseCacheRequestStateOffset, 0u, 1u, previous);
        if (previous == 0u)
        {
            ProceduralNoiseRequests.Store4(address, key.Words);
            ProceduralNoiseRequests.Store(address + 16u, key.TileY);
            // Explicit vectors keep this shared include compatible with FXC SM5.
            uint definitionAddress = address + 32u;
            ProceduralNoiseRequests.Store4(definitionAddress, uint4(params.Width, params.Height, params.Kind, params.Output));
            ProceduralNoiseRequests.Store4(definitionAddress + 16u, uint4(params.BasisType, params.Fractal, params.Seed, params.Tileable));
            ProceduralNoiseRequests.Store4(definitionAddress + 32u, uint4(asuint(params.Frequency), asuint(params.Octaves), asuint(params.Lacunarity), asuint(params.Gain)));
            ProceduralNoiseRequests.Store4(definitionAddress + 48u, asuint(float4(params.WarpStrength, params.RidgeOffset, params.Contrast, params.Bias)));
            ProceduralNoiseRequests.Store4(definitionAddress + 64u, asuint(params.ColorA));
            ProceduralNoiseRequests.Store4(definitionAddress + 80u, asuint(params.ColorB));
            ProceduralNoiseRequests.Store4(definitionAddress + 96u, asuint(params.ColorC));
            ProceduralNoiseRequests.Store4(definitionAddress + 112u, asuint(float4(params.Turbulence, params.RingCount, params.Mortar, params.Time)));
            ProceduralNoiseRequests.Store4(definitionAddress + 128u, asuint(int4(params.BricksX, params.BricksY, params.Pattern, params.RepeatX)));
            ProceduralNoiseRequests.Store4(definitionAddress + 144u, uint4(asuint(params.RepeatY), asuint(params.PatternSize), asuint(params.PatternSoftness), asuint(params.NormalStrength)));
            ProceduralNoiseRequests.Store4(definitionAddress + 160u, asuint(float4(params.Choppiness, params.Coverage, params.CloudSoftness, params.Padding)));
            ProceduralNoiseRequests.Store4(definitionAddress + 176u, uint4(params.PreviewSize, params.Tiles, params.Padding1, params.Padding2));
            ProceduralNoiseRequests.Store4(definitionAddress + 192u, asuint(float4(params.Direction, params.Anisotropy, params.KernelFrequency, params.Phase)));
        }
    }
    return color;
}

// Secondary rays may reuse visible tiles, but do not request entire new pages
// for sparse random hits. Their misses remain analytical.
float3 CachedColorReadOnly(Parameters params, float2 uv, float2 footprint)
{
    float3 color;
    [branch] if (FindCachedColor(params, uv, footprint, color))
    {
        return color;
    }
    return Color(params, Scalar(params, uv));
}

// Callers without a reliable footprint retain the exact analytical result.
float3 CachedColor(Parameters params, float2 uv)
{
    return Color(params, Scalar(params, uv));
}

// Return a tangent-space normal, with the same V-axis convention as studio image export.
float3 Normal(Parameters params, float2 uv, float2 footprint)
{
    float2 e = max(abs(footprint), 0.00001.xx);
    float4 samples = 0;
    [loop] for (uint i = 0; i < 4; ++i)
    {
        float2 offset = i < 2 ? float2((i == 0 ? -1 : 1) * e.x, 0) :
                               float2(0, (i == 2 ? -1 : 1) * e.y);
        samples[i] = Scalar(params, uv + offset);
    }
    float2 slope = float2(samples.y - samples.x, samples.w - samples.z) / (2 * e);
    // Match NormalStrength at the studio's 512-pixel reference view, independently of export resolution.
    slope *= params.NormalStrength / 256.0;
    return normalize(float3(-slope.x, slope.y, 1));
}
}
#endif

===== FILE: shader\hlsl\ProceduralTextureCS.hlsl =====
#include "ProceduralTexture.hlsli"

// Pixel-independent procedural work. Escape fractals retain the CPU double-precision path.
cbuffer TextureParameters : register(b0)
{
    ProceduralTexture::Parameters Params;
};

RWStructuredBuffer<float4> Generated : register(u0);
StructuredBuffer<float4> ImagePixels : register(t0);
RWByteAddressBuffer PreviewPixels : register(u1);
float HeightAt(int2 pixel)
{
    int2 wrapped = int2(TextureNoise::Wrap(pixel.x, Params.Width), TextureNoise::Wrap(pixel.y, Params.Height));
    return ImagePixels[wrapped.y * Params.Width + wrapped.x].x;
}

[numthreads(8, 8, 1)]
void Generate(uint3 thread : SV_DispatchThreadID)
{
    if (thread.x >= Params.Width || thread.y >= Params.Height)
    {
        return;
    }
    float value = ProceduralTexture::Scalar(Params, (thread.xy + 0.5) / float2(Params.Width, Params.Height));
    if (Params.Kind == ProceduralTexture::TextureChecker)
    {
        // Integer cell addressing avoids reciprocal rounding at hard checker boundaries.
        uint cellX = ((thread.x * 2 + 1) * (uint)Params.BricksX) / (Params.Width * 2);
        uint cellY = ((thread.y * 2 + 1) * (uint)Params.BricksX) / (Params.Height * 2);
        value = saturate((((cellX + cellY) & 1) - 0.5) * Params.Contrast + 0.5 + Params.Bias);
    }
    float3 color = Params.Output == ProceduralTexture::OutputColor ? ProceduralTexture::Color(Params, value) : value.xxx;
    Generated[thread.y * Params.Width + thread.x] = float4(color, 1);
}

[numthreads(8, 8, 1)]
void Normals(uint3 thread : SV_DispatchThreadID)
{
    if (thread.x >= Params.Width || thread.y >= Params.Height)
    {
        return;
    }
    int2 pixel = int2(thread.xy);
    float dx = (HeightAt(pixel + int2(1, 0)) - HeightAt(pixel - int2(1, 0))) * Params.NormalStrength;
    float dy = (HeightAt(pixel + int2(0, 1)) - HeightAt(pixel - int2(0, 1))) * Params.NormalStrength;
    float3 normal = normalize(float3(-dx, dy, 1));
    Generated[thread.y * Params.Width + thread.x] = float4(normal * 0.5 + 0.5, 1);
}

float4 Pixel(int2 pixel)
{
    return ImagePixels[TextureNoise::Wrap(pixel.y, Params.Height) * Params.Width + TextureNoise::Wrap(pixel.x, Params.Width)];
}

[numthreads(8, 8, 1)]
void Preview(uint3 thread : SV_DispatchThreadID)
{
    if (thread.x >= Params.PreviewSize || thread.y >= Params.PreviewSize)
    {
        return;
    }
    float2 uv = (thread.xy + 0.5) / (float)Params.PreviewSize * Params.Tiles;
    float2 pixel = frac(uv) * float2(Params.Width, Params.Height) - 0.5;
    int2 start = (int2)floor(pixel);
    float2 blend = frac(pixel);
    float3 color = lerp(lerp(Pixel(start), Pixel(start + int2(1, 0)), blend.x),
                        lerp(Pixel(start + int2(0, 1)), Pixel(start + int2(1, 1)), blend.x), blend.y).rgb;
    if (Params.Output == ProceduralTexture::OutputColor)
    {
        color = saturate(color);
        color = float3(color.r <= 0.0031308 ? color.r * 12.92 : 1.055 * pow(color.r, 1.0 / 2.4) - 0.055,
                       color.g <= 0.0031308 ? color.g * 12.92 : 1.055 * pow(color.g, 1.0 / 2.4) - 0.055,
                       color.b <= 0.0031308 ? color.b * 12.92 : 1.055 * pow(color.b, 1.0 / 2.4) - 0.055);
    }
    uint3 packed = (uint3)(saturate(color) * 255 + 0.5);
    uint rowPitch = (Params.PreviewSize * 4 + 255) & ~255;
    PreviewPixels.Store(thread.y * rowPitch + thread.x * 4, packed.x | (packed.y << 8) | (packed.z << 16) | 0xff000000);
}

===== FILE: shader\hlsl\RayBinningCS.hlsl =====
Texture2DArray<float> DeinterleavedDepth : register(t0);
Texture2DArray<float4> DeinterleavedNormal : register(t1);
RWStructuredBuffer<uint> RayOrder : register(u0);

cbuffer ScreenSpaceConstants : register(b0)
{
    float4x4 InvViewProjection;
    uint2 FullExtent;
    uint2 DeinterleavedExtent;
    float4 EffectParams;
    uint4 FeatureFlags;
};

groupshared uint BinCounts[16];
groupshared uint BinOffsets[16];
groupshared uint BinCursor[16];
groupshared uint LocalBins[64];
groupshared uint ValidCount;
groupshared uint InvalidCursor;

uint Part1By1(uint x)
{
    x &= 0x000000ffu;
    x = (x | (x << 4u)) & 0x00000f0fu;
    x = (x | (x << 2u)) & 0x00003333u;
    x = (x | (x << 1u)) & 0x00005555u;
    return x;
}

uint Morton2D(uint2 value)
{
    return Part1By1(value.x) | (Part1By1(value.y) << 1u);
}

float2 OctEncode(float3 n)
{
    n /= max(abs(n.x) + abs(n.y) + abs(n.z), 1.0e-5f);
    float2 oct = n.xy;
    if (n.z < 0.0f)
    {
        oct = (1.0f - abs(oct.yx)) * (oct >= 0.0f ? 1.0f : -1.0f);
    }
    return oct * 0.5f + 0.5f;
}

[numthreads(64, 1, 1)] void main(uint3 groupId : SV_GroupID, uint lane : SV_GroupIndex) {
    uint tilesX = (FullExtent.x + 7u) / 8u;
    uint tileIndex = groupId.x;
    uint2 tile = uint2(tileIndex % tilesX, tileIndex / tilesX);
    uint2 local = uint2(lane & 7u, lane >> 3u);
    uint2 pixel = tile * 8u + local;

    if (FeatureFlags.x == 0u)
    {
        RayOrder[tileIndex * 64u + lane] = all(pixel < FullExtent) ? (pixel.y * FullExtent.x + pixel.x) : 0xffffffffu;
        return;
    }

    if (lane < 16u)
    {
        BinCounts[lane] = 0u;
        BinOffsets[lane] = 0u;
        BinCursor[lane] = 0u;
    }
    if (lane == 0u)
    {
        ValidCount = 0u;
        InvalidCursor = 0u;
    }
    GroupMemoryBarrierWithGroupSync();

    bool valid = all(pixel < FullExtent);
    uint bin = 0u;
    if (valid)
    {
        uint slice = (pixel.x & 3u) | ((pixel.y & 3u) << 2u);
        uint2 dePixel = pixel >> 2u;
        float3 normal = normalize(DeinterleavedNormal.Load(int4(dePixel, slice, 0)).xyz * 2.0f - 1.0f);
        float depth = DeinterleavedDepth.Load(int4(dePixel, slice, 0));
        float hash = frac(dot(float2(pixel), float2(0.06711056f, 0.00583715f)) + depth * 7.13f);
        float angle = hash * 6.28318530718f;
        float3 tangent = normalize(abs(normal.y) < 0.98f ? cross(float3(0.0f, 1.0f, 0.0f), normal)
                                                         : cross(float3(1.0f, 0.0f, 0.0f), normal));
        float3 bitangent = cross(normal, tangent);
        float3 ray = normalize(normal * 0.55f + tangent * cos(angle) + bitangent * sin(angle));
        uint2 oct = min((uint2)(saturate(OctEncode(ray)) * 15.0f), 15u);
        bin = (Morton2D(oct) ^ ((uint)(depth * 65535.0f) >> 6u)) & 15u;
        InterlockedAdd(BinCounts[bin], 1u);
    }
    LocalBins[lane] = bin;
    GroupMemoryBarrierWithGroupSync();

    if (lane < 16u)
    {
        uint prefix = 0u;
        [unroll] for (uint i = 0u; i < 16u; ++i)
        {
            if (i < lane)
            {
                prefix += BinCounts[i];
            }
        }
        BinOffsets[lane] = prefix;
    }
    if (lane == 0u)
    {
        uint total = 0u;
        [unroll] for (uint i = 0u; i < 16u; ++i)
        {
            total += BinCounts[i];
        }
        ValidCount = total;
    }
    GroupMemoryBarrierWithGroupSync();

    uint destination;
    if (valid)
    {
        uint localOffset;
        InterlockedAdd(BinCursor[LocalBins[lane]], 1u, localOffset);
        destination = BinOffsets[LocalBins[lane]] + localOffset;
    }
    else
    {
        uint invalidOffset;
        InterlockedAdd(InvalidCursor, 1u, invalidOffset);
        destination = ValidCount + invalidOffset;
    }
    RayOrder[tileIndex * 64u + destination] = valid ? (pixel.y * FullExtent.x + pixel.x) : 0xffffffffu;
}

Texture2D<float4> AdaptiveRadiance : register(t0, space10);
