    const float maxDistance = max(DistanceFieldGlobal.y, 0.1f);
    float travel = 0.12f;
    const float3 origin = worldPos + normal * 0.04f;
    [loop] for (int stepIndex = 0; stepIndex < stepCount && travel < maxDistance; ++stepIndex)
    {
        const float3 samplePosition = origin + lightDir * travel;
        float closestDistance = maxDistance;
        [loop] for (int objectIndex = 0; objectIndex < objectCount; ++objectIndex)
        {
            const float3 center = DistanceFieldData0[objectIndex].xyz;
            const float3 extents = DistanceFieldData1[objectIndex].xyz;
            const bool receiverObject = all(abs(worldPos - center) <= extents + 0.02f);
            if (!receiverObject)
            {
                closestDistance = min(closestDistance, DistanceToBoxSdf(samplePosition, center, extents));
            }
        }
        if (closestDistance < 0.025f)
        {
            return 0.45f;
        }
        travel += max(closestDistance, 0.05f);
    }
    return 1.0f;
}

// 放射輝度には、このライトの強度、減衰、可視性がすでに含まれる。
// =============================================================================================
// 描画品質の拡張
//   ・DFG参照テーブルとGGXの多重散乱によるエネルギー補償（Fdez-Aguera 2019、Kulla-Conty）
//   ・拡張マテリアルモデル：クリアコート、布の光沢、肌、髪、異方性GGX
//   ・LTCによる長方形の面光源（Heitzほか、2016）
// =============================================================================================
#ifdef SURFACE_PBR_LUTS
Texture2D<float4> LtcMatrixLut : register(t42);
Texture2D<float2> LtcAmplitudeLut : register(t43);
#ifdef SKY_LUT
#define PbrLutSampler SkyLutSampler // 同じクランプサンプラー（s4）
#else
SamplerState PbrLutSampler : register(s4);
#endif
#endif

static const uint kShadingStandard = 0u;
static const uint kShadingClearCoat = 1u;
static const uint kShadingSheen = 2u;
static const uint kShadingSkin = 3u;
static const uint kShadingHair = 4u;
static const uint kShadingAnisotropic = 5u;

struct ShadingModelData
{
    uint Model;
    float Strength;
};

// ディファードライティングパスがピクセルごとに設定する（影の GBuffer の alpha から復号）。
static ShadingModelData g_ShadingModel = {0u, 0.0f};

// POM セルフシャドウ：GBuffer（フォワードではその場）で主光源に対して求めた可視率と、その光源の方向。
// AccumulateSurfaceLight で同じ方向のライトの影に掛ける。既定値 1 で無効。
static float g_PomSelfShadow = 1.0f;
static float3 g_PomSelfShadowLight = float3(0.0f, 0.0f, 0.0f);
// POM の見た目の位置から、影を生成する元のメッシュまでの差分。
static float3 g_PomShadowOffset = 0.0f;
static float3 g_PomShadowOffsetDx = 0.0f;
static float3 g_PomShadowOffsetDy = 0.0f;

ShadingModelData DecodeShadingModel(float encoded)
{
    uint value = (uint)round(saturate(encoded) * 255.0f);
    ShadingModelData data;
    data.Model = value >> 5u;
    data.Strength = (value & 31u) / 31.0f;
    return data;
}

bool QualityEnergyCompensation()
{
    return QualityFlags.x > 0.5f;
}

float2 PbrLutUv(float NdotV, float roughness)
{
    return (float2(sqrt(saturate(1.0f - NdotV)), saturate(roughness)) * 63.0f + 0.5f) / 64.0f;
}

// 分割和 DFG：(A, B) を返し、Fss*Ess = F0 * A + B、Ess = A + B を満たす。
float2 SampleDfg(float NdotV, float roughness)
{
#ifdef SURFACE_PBR_LUTS
    float2 amplitude = LtcAmplitudeLut.SampleLevel(PbrLutSampler, PbrLutUv(NdotV, roughness), 0);
    return float2(amplitude.x - amplitude.y, amplitude.y);
#else
    // Karis 2014 の解析的な近似（フォワード描画または LUT なしの場合）。
    const float4 c0 = float4(-1.0f, -0.0275f, -0.572f, 0.022f);
    const float4 c1 = float4(1.0f, 0.0425f, 1.04f, -0.04f);
    float4 r = roughness * c0 + c1;
    float a004 = min(r.x * r.x, exp2(-9.28f * NdotV)) * r.x + r.y;
    return float2(-1.04f, 1.04f) * a004 + r.zw;
#endif
}

// 単一散乱のマイクロファセットモデルで失われるエネルギーを回復する倍率。
float3 SpecularEnergyCompensation(float3 F0, float NdotV, float roughness)
{
    if (!QualityEnergyCompensation())
    {
        return 1.0f;
    }
    float2 dfg = SampleDfg(NdotV, roughness);
    float Ess = max(dfg.x + dfg.y, 0.05f);
    return 1.0f + F0 * (1.0f / Ess - 1.0f);
}

float3 SurfaceTangent(float3 N)
{
    // 毛束やブラシの方向は、ワールドの上軸を面へ投影した方向に沿う。
    float3 up = abs(N.y) < 0.99f ? float3(0.0f, 1.0f, 0.0f) : float3(1.0f, 0.0f, 0.0f);
    return SafeNormalizeCommon(up - N * dot(N, up), float3(1.0f, 0.0f, 0.0f));
}

float DistributionCharlie(float NdotH, float roughness)
{
    float alpha = max(roughness * roughness, 0.0001f);
    float invAlpha = 1.0f / alpha;
    float sin2 = max(1.0f - NdotH * NdotH, 0.0078125f);
    return (2.0f + invAlpha) * pow(sin2, invAlpha * 0.5f) / (2.0f * 3.14159265f);
}

float KajiyaKaySpecular(float3 T, float3 H, float exponent)
{
    float TdotH = dot(T, H);
    float sinTH = sqrt(max(1.0f - TdotH * TdotH, 0.0f));
    return smoothstep(-1.0f, 0.0f, TdotH) * pow(sinTH, exponent);
}

float3 EvaluatePbrDirectLight(float3 N, float3 V, float3 L, float3 radiance, float3 albedo, float3 materialData,
                              float shadowSoftness)
{
    const float PI = 3.14159265359f;
    float3 H = SafeNormalizeCommon(L + V, N);

    float rawNdotL = dot(N, L);
    float NdotLScalar = saturate(rawNdotL);
    float NdotV = saturate(dot(N, V));
    float NdotH = saturate(dot(N, H));
    float VdotH = saturate(dot(V, H));

    float metallic = saturate(materialData.r);
    float roughness = clamp(materialData.g, 0.04f, 1.0f);
    float specularF0 = saturate(materialData.b);

    float3 F0 = lerp(float3(specularF0, specularF0, specularF0), albedo, metallic);

    float a = roughness * roughness;
    float a2 = a * a;

    float d = NdotH * NdotH * (a2 - 1.0f) + 1.0f;
    float D = a2 / max(PI * d * d, 0.00001f);

    float r = roughness + 1.0f;
    float k = (r * r) / 8.0f;

    float G_L = NdotLScalar / max(NdotLScalar * (1.0f - k) + k, 0.00001f);
    float G_V = NdotV / max(NdotV * (1.0f - k) + k, 0.00001f);
    float G = G_L * G_V;

    float oneMinusVdotH = 1.0f - VdotH;
    float oneMinusVdotH2 = oneMinusVdotH * oneMinusVdotH;
    float oneMinusVdotH5 = oneMinusVdotH2 * oneMinusVdotH2 * oneMinusVdotH;

    float3 F = F0 + (1.0f - F0) * oneMinusVdotH5;

    const uint model = g_ShadingModel.Model;
    const float strength = g_ShadingModel.Strength;
    if (model == kShadingAnisotropic && strength > 0.0f)
    {
        // 面の接線方向の異方性 GGX（Burley 2012）。
        float3 T = SurfaceTangent(N);
        float3 B = cross(N, T);
        float aspect = sqrt(1.0f - 0.9f * strength);
        float at = max(a / aspect, 0.002f);
        float ab = max(a * aspect, 0.002f);
        float TdotH = dot(T, H);
        float BdotH = dot(B, H);
        float denominator = TdotH * TdotH / (at * at) + BdotH * BdotH / (ab * ab) + NdotH * NdotH;
        D = 1.0f / max(PI * at * ab * denominator * denominator, 0.00001f);
    }
    if (model == kShadingSkin && strength > 0.0f)
    {
        // 2 ローブの皮膚の鏡面反射（Jimenez / d'Eon）：鋭い油膜層と広い表皮。
        float roughA = max(roughness * 0.75f, 0.04f);
        float roughB = min(roughness * 1.35f, 1.0f);
        float aA = roughA * roughA;
        float aB = roughB * roughB;
        float dA = NdotH * NdotH * (aA * aA - 1.0f) + 1.0f;
        float dB = NdotH * NdotH * (aB * aB - 1.0f) + 1.0f;
        float twoLobe = 0.85f * aA * aA / max(PI * dA * dA, 0.00001f) + 0.15f * aB * aB / max(PI * dB * dB, 0.00001f);
        D = lerp(D, twoLobe, strength);
    }

    float3 specularBRDF = D * G * F;
    specularBRDF /= max(4.0f * NdotLScalar * NdotV, 0.00001f);
    specularBRDF *= SpecularEnergyCompensation(F0, NdotV, roughness);

    float3 kS = F;
    float3 kD = 1.0f - kS;
    kD *= 1.0f - metallic;

    float3 diffuseBRDF = kD * albedo / PI;

    float terminatorWidth = lerp(0.08f, 0.45f, saturate(shadowSoftness * 2.0f));
    float wrappedNdotL = saturate((rawNdotL + terminatorWidth) / (1.0f + terminatorWidth));

    wrappedNdotL = wrappedNdotL * wrappedNdotL * (3.0f - 2.0f * wrappedNdotL);

    float3 diffuseTerm = diffuseBRDF * wrappedNdotL;
    float3 specularTerm = specularBRDF * NdotLScalar;
    float3 extra = 0.0f;

    if (model == kShadingSkin && strength > 0.0f)
    {
        // 事前積分形式の散乱：チャンネル別のラップ（赤が最も遠くまで散乱）で
        // 明暗境界を柔らかい赤みへ変え、正規化して総エネルギーを保つ。
        float3 wrap = float3(0.55f, 0.22f, 0.16f) * strength;
        float3 scattered = saturate((rawNdotL + wrap) / (1.0f + wrap)) / (1.0f + wrap);
        diffuseTerm = diffuseBRDF * lerp(wrappedNdotL.xxx, scattered, strength);
        // 耳や指などの薄い部分：裏から透過する光。
        float3 transmitDirection = SafeNormalizeCommon(L + N * 0.35f, L);
        float transmission = pow(saturate(dot(V, -transmitDirection)), 4.0f) * saturate(-rawNdotL + 0.3f);
        extra += albedo * float3(1.0f, 0.35f, 0.22f) * transmission * strength * 0.35f;
    }
    else if (model == kShadingHair && strength > 0.0f)
    {
        // ずらした 2 ローブの Kajiya-Kay（Scheuermann 2004）：白い一次成分と色付きの二次成分。
        float3 T = SurfaceTangent(N);
        float exponent = clamp(2.0f / max(a * a, 0.0004f), 4.0f, 512.0f);
        float primary = KajiyaKaySpecular(SafeNormalizeCommon(T + N * -0.08f, T), H, exponent);
        float secondary = KajiyaKaySpecular(SafeNormalizeCommon(T + N * 0.12f, T), H, exponent * 0.25f);
        float3 hairSpecular = (F * primary + albedo * secondary * 0.6f) * NdotLScalar * 0.25f;
        specularTerm = lerp(specularTerm, hairSpecular, strength);
        // 毛束は明暗境界の周囲へ光を散乱する。
        diffuseTerm = lerp(diffuseTerm, albedo / PI * saturate(rawNdotL * 0.75f + 0.25f) * (1.0f - metallic), strength);
    }
    else if (model == kShadingSheen && strength > 0.0f)
    {
        // 布のシーン反射：Charlie 分布と Neubelt の可視性項。
        float sheenVisibility = 1.0f / max(4.0f * (NdotLScalar + NdotV - NdotLScalar * NdotV), 0.00001f);
        float3 sheenColor = lerp(float3(1.0f, 1.0f, 1.0f), albedo, 0.5f) * strength;
        extra += sheenColor * DistributionCharlie(NdotH, roughness) * sheenVisibility * NdotLScalar;
        diffuseTerm *= 1.0f - 0.25f * strength;
    }
    else if (model == kShadingClearCoat && strength > 0.0f)
    {
        // クリアコート：ポリウレタン層、IOR 1.5、固定の低い粗さ、Kelemen の可視性。
        const float coatAlpha = 0.06f * 0.06f;
        float dc = NdotH * NdotH * (coatAlpha * coatAlpha - 1.0f) + 1.0f;
        float coatD = coatAlpha * coatAlpha / max(PI * dc * dc, 0.00001f);
        float coatV = 0.25f / max(VdotH * VdotH, 0.0001f);
        float coatF = (0.04f + 0.96f * oneMinusVdotH5) * strength;
        diffuseTerm *= 1.0f - coatF;
        specularTerm *= 1.0f - coatF;
        extra += (coatD * coatV * coatF * NdotLScalar).xxx;
    }

    return (diffuseTerm + specularTerm + extra) * radiance;
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
// 矩形面光源の LTC（Heitz 2016）。地平線クリッピングと Hill の辺積分。
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
void RectLightBasis(float3 emitNormal, out float3 right, out float3 up)
{
    float3 axis = abs(emitNormal.y) > 0.99f ? float3(1.0f, 0.0f, 0.0f) : float3(0.0f, 1.0f, 0.0f);
    right = normalize(cross(axis, emitNormal));
    up = cross(emitNormal, right);
}

float3 LtcIntegrateEdgeVector(float3 v1, float3 v2)
{
    float x = dot(v1, v2);
    float y = abs(x);
    float a = 0.8543985f + (0.4965155f + 0.0145206f * y) * y;
    float b = 3.4175940f + (4.1616724f + y) * y;
    float v = a / b;
    float thetaOverSin = x > 0.0f ? v : 0.5f * rsqrt(max(1.0f - x * x, 1e-7f)) - v;
    return cross(v1, v2) * thetaOverSin;
}

void LtcClipQuadToHorizon(inout float3 L[5], out int n)
{
    int config = 0;
    if (L[0].z > 0.0f)
    {
        config += 1;
    }
    if (L[1].z > 0.0f)
    {
        config += 2;
    }
    if (L[2].z > 0.0f)
    {
        config += 4;
    }
    if (L[3].z > 0.0f)
    {
        config += 8;
    }
    n = 0;
    if (config == 1)
    {
        n = 3;
        L[1] = -L[1].z * L[0] + L[0].z * L[1];
        L[2] = -L[3].z * L[0] + L[0].z * L[3];
    }
    else if (config == 2)
    {
        n = 3;
        L[0] = -L[0].z * L[1] + L[1].z * L[0];
        L[2] = -L[2].z * L[1] + L[1].z * L[2];
    }
    else if (config == 3)
    {
        n = 4;
        L[2] = -L[2].z * L[1] + L[1].z * L[2];
        L[3] = -L[3].z * L[0] + L[0].z * L[3];
    }
    else if (config == 4)
    {
        n = 3;
        L[0] = -L[3].z * L[2] + L[2].z * L[3];
        L[1] = -L[1].z * L[2] + L[2].z * L[1];
    }
    else if (config == 6)
    {
        n = 4;
        L[0] = -L[0].z * L[1] + L[1].z * L[0];
        L[3] = -L[3].z * L[2] + L[2].z * L[3];
    }
    else if (config == 7)
    {
        n = 5;
        L[4] = -L[3].z * L[0] + L[0].z * L[3];
        L[3] = -L[3].z * L[2] + L[2].z * L[3];
    }
    else if (config == 8)
    {
        n = 3;
        L[0] = -L[0].z * L[3] + L[3].z * L[0];
        L[1] = -L[2].z * L[3] + L[3].z * L[2];
        L[2] = L[3];
    }
    else if (config == 9)
    {
        n = 4;
        L[1] = -L[1].z * L[0] + L[0].z * L[1];
        L[2] = -L[2].z * L[3] + L[3].z * L[2];
    }
    else if (config == 11)
    {
        n = 5;
        L[4] = L[3];
        L[3] = -L[2].z * L[3] + L[3].z * L[2];
        L[2] = -L[2].z * L[1] + L[1].z * L[2];
    }
    else if (config == 12)
    {
        n = 4;
        L[1] = -L[1].z * L[2] + L[2].z * L[1];
        L[0] = -L[0].z * L[3] + L[3].z * L[0];
    }
    else if (config == 13)
    {
        n = 5;
        L[4] = L[3];
        L[3] = L[2];
        L[2] = -L[1].z * L[2] + L[2].z * L[1];
        L[1] = -L[1].z * L[0] + L[0].z * L[1];
    }
    else if (config == 14)
    {
        n = 5;
        L[4] = -L[0].z * L[3] + L[3].z * L[0];
        L[0] = -L[0].z * L[1] + L[1].z * L[0];
    }
    else if (config == 15)
    {
        n = 4;
    }
    if (n == 3)
    {
        L[3] = L[0];
    }
    if (n == 4)
    {
        L[4] = L[0];
    }
}

// minv で変換した四角形のコサイン重み付き積分（形態係数）。
float LtcEvaluateQuad(float3 N, float3 V, float3 P, float3x3 minv, float3 corners[4])
{
    float3 T1 = SafeNormalizeCommon(V - N * dot(V, N), SurfaceTangent(N));
    float3 T2 = cross(N, T1);
    float3x3 transform = mul(minv, float3x3(T1, T2, N));
    float3 L[5];
    L[0] = mul(transform, corners[0] - P);
    L[1] = mul(transform, corners[1] - P);
    L[2] = mul(transform, corners[2] - P);
    L[3] = mul(transform, corners[3] - P);
    L[4] = L[3];
    int n;
    LtcClipQuadToHorizon(L, n);
    if (n == 0)
    {
        return 0.0f;
    }
    L[0] = normalize(L[0]);
    L[1] = normalize(L[1]);
    L[2] = normalize(L[2]);
    L[3] = normalize(L[3]);
    L[4] = normalize(L[4]);
    float sum = LtcIntegrateEdgeVector(L[0], L[1]).z + LtcIntegrateEdgeVector(L[1], L[2]).z +
                LtcIntegrateEdgeVector(L[2], L[3]).z;
    if (n >= 4)
    {
        sum += LtcIntegrateEdgeVector(L[3], L[4]).z;
    }
    if (n == 5)
    {
        sum += LtcIntegrateEdgeVector(L[4], L[0]).z;
    }
    return abs(sum) / (2.0f * 3.14159265f);
}

// 発光体の放射輝度 1 に対する出射放射輝度を返す（拡散と鏡面反射、標準 GGX）。
float3 EvaluateRectLightLtcTinted(float3 N, float3 V, float3 P, float3 center, float3 emitNormal, float width,
                                  float height, float3 albedo, float3 materialData, float3 diffuseTint,
                                  float3 specularTint)
{
    if (dot(P - center, emitNormal) <= 0.0f)
    {
        return 0.0f; // 片面の発光体
    }
    float3 right, up;
    RectLightBasis(emitNormal, right, up);
    right *= width * 0.5f;
    up *= height * 0.5f;
    float3 corners[4] = {center + right + up, center + right - up, center - right - up, center - right + up};
    float metallic = saturate(materialData.r);
    float roughness = clamp(materialData.g, 0.04f, 1.0f);
    float specularF0 = saturate(materialData.b);
    float3 F0 = lerp(specularF0.xxx, albedo, metallic);
    float NdotV = saturate(dot(N, V));
    float diffuse = LtcEvaluateQuad(N, V, P, float3x3(1, 0, 0, 0, 1, 0, 0, 0, 1), corners);
    float3 specular = 0.0f;
#ifdef SURFACE_PBR_LUTS
    float2 uv = PbrLutUv(NdotV, roughness);
    float4 t1 = LtcMatrixLut.SampleLevel(PbrLutSampler, uv, 0);
    float2 t2 = LtcAmplitudeLut.SampleLevel(PbrLutSampler, uv, 0);
    float3x3 minv = float3x3(t1.x, 0.0f, t1.y, 0.0f, 1.0f, 0.0f, t1.z, 0.0f, t1.w);
    float3 FssEss = F0 * (t2.x - t2.y) + t2.y;
    specular = LtcEvaluateQuad(N, V, P, minv, corners) * FssEss * SpecularEnergyCompensation(F0, NdotV, roughness);
#endif
    float3 kD = (1.0f - F0) * (1.0f - metallic);
    return albedo * kD * diffuse * diffuseTint + specular * specularTint;
}

float3 EvaluateRectLightLtc(float3 N, float3 V, float3 P, float3 center, float3 emitNormal, float width, float height,
                            float3 albedo, float3 materialData)
{
    return EvaluateRectLightLtcTinted(N, V, P, center, emitNormal, width, height, albedo, materialData, 1.0f, 1.0f);
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
// MegaLights M7：テクスチャ付き矩形ライト
//   Rect の Extra.w = テクスチャ番号 + 1（エンジンのテクスチャ SRV の並び。0 = なし）
//   LTC の解析解に掛ける色を、拡散は法線方向・鏡面は反射方向が発光面と交わる点のテクスチャで近似する
//   （Heitz 2016 の textured LTC の簡易版。ミップは距離と粗さから決める）
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
#ifdef MEGALIGHTS_LIGHT_TEXTURES
Texture2D<float4> MegaLightTextures[512] : register(t0, space5);
#define IES_TEXTURE_HEAP MegaLightTextures
#include "IesProfileSampling.hlsli"

float3 MLSampleRectTexture(uint textureIndex, float3 center, float3 emitNormal, float width, float height,
                           float3 origin, float3 direction, float footprint)
{
    float3 right, up;
    RectLightBasis(emitNormal, right, up);
    // 発光面との交点（交わらないときは面への最近点）
    const float denominator = dot(direction, -emitNormal);
    float3 hit = origin + direction * max(dot(origin - center, emitNormal) / max(denominator, 1.0e-4f), 0.0f);
    if (denominator <= 1.0e-4f)
    {
        hit = origin - emitNormal * dot(origin - center, emitNormal);
    }
    const float2 uv = saturate(
        float2(dot(hit - center, right) / max(width, 1.0e-3f), -dot(hit - center, up) / max(height, 1.0e-3f)) + 0.5f);
    uint textureWidth, textureHeight, mipCount;
    MegaLightTextures[NonUniformResourceIndex(textureIndex)].GetDimensions(0, textureWidth, textureHeight, mipCount);
    const float texels = footprint / max(max(width, height), 1.0e-3f) * (float)max(textureWidth, textureHeight);
    const float lod = clamp(log2(max(texels, 1.0f)), 0.0f, (float)max(mipCount, 1u) - 1.0f);
    return MegaLightTextures[NonUniformResourceIndex(textureIndex)].SampleLevel(TextureSampler, uv, lod).rgb;
}

float3 MLRectTextureMean(uint textureIndex)
{
    uint textureWidth, textureHeight, mipCount;
    MegaLightTextures[NonUniformResourceIndex(textureIndex)].GetDimensions(0, textureWidth, textureHeight, mipCount);
    return MegaLightTextures[NonUniformResourceIndex(textureIndex)]
        .SampleLevel(TextureSampler, float2(0.5f, 0.5f), (float)max(mipCount, 1u) - 1.0f)
        .rgb;
}
#endif
// ライブトゥーン：陰影ランプをエンジンのテクスチャ表（MegaLightTextures）から読むため、その宣言の後に置く。
#include "LiveToonStyle.hlsli"
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
// 1 ライト分の評価（従来のライトループの本体を関数化。結果は acc に加算）
//   cbIndex >= 0 : LightParams 配列のライト。シャドウマップ / VSM / DXR 影 / コンタクト影 / 雲影は従来どおり
//   cbIndex <  0 : MegaLights グリッドのローカルライト
//   sampleWeight      : 寄与に掛ける重み（M2 では 1/(N·p)。それ以外は 1）
//   visibilityOverride: >= 0 なら影の計算をせずこの可視率を使う（M2 の影レイ / リファレンス）
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
struct SurfaceLightAccumulator
{
    float3 PbrDirect;
    float3 DirSum;
    float3 ColorSum;
    float WeightSum;
    float MaxAttenuation;
    float VolumeSum;
    float RangeSum;
    float ShadowSum;
};

void AccumulateSurfaceLight(int cbIndex, float4 lightDirection, float4 lightPositionType, float4 lightExtra,
                            float4 lightColorData, bool decalLight, bool gridCastShadow, float sampleWeight,
                            float visibilityOverride, float3 worldPos, float3 worldPosDx, float3 worldPosDy,
                            float3 normal, float2 pixelPosition, int shadowFilterRadius, bool evaluatePbr,
                            float3 viewDir, float3 albedo, float3 materialData, float shadowSoftness,
                            float3 monitorColor, float4 iesProfile, inout SurfaceLightAccumulator acc)
{
    float3 singleDir;
    float singleAttenuation;
    float singleVolume;
    ResolveSingleLightCommon(worldPos, lightDirection, lightPositionType, lightExtra, singleDir, singleAttenuation,
                             singleVolume);

    float lightIntensityValue = max(lightColorData.a, 0.0f);
    [branch] if (singleAttenuation <= 0.000001f || lightIntensityValue <= 0.000001f)
    {
        return;
    }

    float3 shadowVisibility = 1.0f;
    [branch] if (visibilityOverride >= 0.0f)
    {
        // MegaLights M2 / リファレンス：影レイの結果（可視率）が与えられている
        shadowVisibility = visibilityOverride;
    }
    else if (cbIndex >= 0)
    {
        const int i = cbIndex;
        const bool directionalShadow =
            LightPositionTypes[i].w < 0.5f && SceneLightCastsShadowCommon(i, LightShadowData[i].x >= -0.5f);
        const bool useRayShadow = !decalLight && directionalShadow && RaytracingFlags.x > 0.5f &&
                                  RaytracingFlags.z > 0.5f && RaytracingSunDirection.w > 0.5f &&
                                  dot(singleDir, RaytracingSunDirection.xyz) > 0.999f;
        // 主太陽光にはデノイズ済みの可視性テクスチャがある。
        // 直後に結果を上書きするインラインレイは発行しない。
        shadowVisibility = decalLight || useRayShadow ? 1.0f
                                                      : SampleSurfaceShadowMap(i, worldPos + g_PomShadowOffset,
                                                                               worldPosDx + g_PomShadowOffsetDx,
                                                                               worldPosDy + g_PomShadowOffsetDy,
                                                                               normal, singleDir, shadowFilterRadius);

        float contactVisibility =
            !decalLight && directionalShadow ? SampleContactShadow(worldPos + g_PomShadowOffset, normal, singleDir) : 1.0f;
#ifdef SHADER_RAYTRACING
        if (SceneRayFlags.x > 0.5f)
        {
            contactVisibility = 1.0f;
        }
#endif
        shadowVisibility *= lerp(1.0f, contactVisibility, 0.45f);
        if (useRayShadow)
        {
            uint rayWidth;
            uint rayHeight;
            RaytracedVisibility.GetDimensions(rayWidth, rayHeight);
            shadowVisibility =
                RaytracedVisibility.SampleLevel(TextureSampler, pixelPosition / float2(rayWidth, rayHeight), 0).r;
        }
        bool useLegacyDistanceShadow = !useRayShadow && !decalLight && directionalShadow;
#ifdef SHADER_RAYTRACING
        useLegacyDistanceShadow = useLegacyDistanceShadow && SceneRayFlags.x < 0.5f;
#endif
        if (useLegacyDistanceShadow)
        {
            shadowVisibility *= SampleDistanceFieldShadow(worldPos + g_PomShadowOffset, normal, singleDir);
        }
        // ラスターと DXR の可視性の後に適用し、どちらの経路も雲の消散を上書きしないようにする。
        if (!decalLight && i == CloudSunIndex())
        {
            shadowVisibility *= CloudSunVisibility(worldPos);
        }
        // POM の凹凸が自分に落とす影（ラスター／DXR どちらの可視性にも掛ける）。
        if (!decalLight && g_PomSelfShadow < 1.0f && dot(singleDir, g_PomSelfShadowLight) > 0.995f)
        {
            shadowVisibility *= g_PomSelfShadow;
        }
    }
#ifdef SHADER_RAYTRACING
    else if (gridCastShadow && SceneRayFlags.x > 0.5f && SceneRayFlags.z > 0.5f)
    {
        // MegaLights M1 グリッドのライト：DXR 影モードならライト中心へ影のレイを 1 本
        const float maximumDistance = min(length(lightPositionType.xyz - worldPos), SceneRayParameters.x);
        // 最適化：点 / スポット光で N・L < -0.6 なら、ラップ照明（最大 0.55）を含めても寄与が 0 なので
        // 影レイを省く（矩形 / カプセル / ボリュームは中心方向と寄与が一致しないので対象外）
        shadowVisibility = lightPositionType.w < 2.5f && dot(normal, singleDir) < -0.6f
                               ? 0.0f
                               : TraceSceneShadow(worldPos + g_PomShadowOffset, normal, singleDir, maximumDistance);
    }
#endif
    float3 authoredLightColor = max(lightColorData.rgb, float3(0.0f, 0.0f, 0.0f));
#ifdef MEGALIGHTS_LIGHT_TEXTURES
    if (!decalLight && lightPositionType.w > 0.5f)
    {
        authoredLightColor *= SampleIesProfile(iesProfile, lightDirection.xyz, worldPos - lightPositionType.xyz);
    }
    // M7：テクスチャ付き矩形ライト。非 PBR の陰影・平均ライトにはテクスチャの平均色を使う
    const uint lightTexture = (cbIndex < 0 && abs(lightPositionType.w - 4.0f) < 0.5f) ? (uint)round(lightExtra.w) : 0u;
    float3 textureMean = 1.0f;
    if (lightTexture != 0u)
    {
        textureMean = max(MLRectTextureMean(lightTexture - 1u), 1.0e-4f);
        authoredLightColor *= textureMean;
    }
#endif
    if (decalLight)
    {

        authoredLightColor *= monitorColor;
    }
    float3 singleColor = authoredLightColor * lightIntensityValue * singleAttenuation * shadowVisibility;
    if (!decalLight)
    {
        singleColor = ApplyAtmosphereToLightCommon(worldPos, singleDir, singleColor, singleVolume);
    }

    if (evaluatePbr)
    {
#ifdef SURFACE_PBR_LUTS
        const bool rectLight = lightExtra.z >= 0.0f && !decalLight &&
                               abs(lightPositionType.w - 4.0f) < 0.5f && QualityFlags.y > 0.5f;
#else
        const bool rectLight = false;
#endif
        [branch] if (rectLight)
        {
            float3 toCenter = lightPositionType.xyz - worldPos;
            float rangeFade = saturate(1.0f - length(toCenter) / max(lightDirection.w, 0.01f));
            float3 emitterRadiance =
                authoredLightColor * lightIntensityValue * shadowVisibility * rangeFade * rangeFade;
            const float3 emitNormal = SafeNormalizeCommon(lightDirection.xyz, float3(0.0f, -1.0f, 0.0f));
            float3 diffuseTint = 1.0f;
            float3 specularTint = 1.0f;
#ifdef MEGALIGHTS_LIGHT_TEXTURES
            if (lightTexture != 0u)
            {
                // 平均色は emitterRadiance に入っているので、ここでは平均との比を掛ける
                const float distance = length(toCenter);
                const float roughness = clamp(materialData.g, 0.04f, 1.0f);
                diffuseTint = MLSampleRectTexture(lightTexture - 1u, lightPositionType.xyz, emitNormal, lightExtra.x,
                                                  lightExtra.y, worldPos, normal, distance * 2.0f) /
                              textureMean;
                specularTint = MLSampleRectTexture(lightTexture - 1u, lightPositionType.xyz, emitNormal, lightExtra.x,
                                                   lightExtra.y, worldPos, reflect(-viewDir, normal),
                                                   distance * roughness * roughness * 2.0f) /
                               textureMean;
            }
#endif
            acc.PbrDirect +=
                sampleWeight *
                EvaluateRectLightLtcTinted(normal, viewDir, worldPos, lightPositionType.xyz, emitNormal, lightExtra.x,
                                           lightExtra.y, albedo, materialData, diffuseTint, specularTint) *
                emitterRadiance;
        }
        else
        {
            acc.PbrDirect += sampleWeight * EvaluatePbrDirectLight(normal, viewDir, singleDir, singleColor, albedo,
                                                                   materialData, shadowSoftness);
        }
    }

    [branch] if (IsLiveToonClass(g_LiveToonClass))
    {
        // ライブスタイルは影を陰影の乗算色にまとめるため、影なしの放射輝度と可視率を分けて渡す。
        // 大気の適用は lightColor に線形なので、singleColor = toonRadiance * shadowVisibility と一致する。
        float3 toonRadiance = authoredLightColor * lightIntensityValue * singleAttenuation;
        if (!decalLight)
        {
            float toonVolume = 0.0f;
            toonRadiance = ApplyAtmosphereToLightCommon(worldPos, singleDir, toonRadiance, toonVolume);
        }
        acc.PbrDirect += sampleWeight * EvaluateLiveToonLightStyled(
            albedo, normal, viewDir, singleDir, toonRadiance, shadowVisibility, decalLight ? 1.0f : lightPositionType.w,
            g_LiveToonClass, materialData.g, g_LiveToonShadow.x, shadowSoftness, g_LiveToonShadow.y);
    }

    float weight = max(dot(authoredLightColor * lightIntensityValue, float3(0.299f, 0.587f, 0.114f)), 0.0001f) *
                   singleAttenuation * sampleWeight;
    acc.DirSum += singleDir * weight;
    acc.ColorSum += singleColor * sampleWeight;
    acc.WeightSum += weight;
    acc.MaxAttenuation = max(acc.MaxAttenuation, singleAttenuation);
    float visibilityLuminance = dot(shadowVisibility, float3(0.2126f, 0.7152f, 0.0722f));
    acc.VolumeSum += singleVolume * lightIntensityValue * visibilityLuminance;
    acc.RangeSum += saturate((max(lightDirection.w, 1.0f) - 1.0f) / 7.0f) * weight;
    acc.ShadowSum += visibilityLuminance * weight;
}

#if defined(MEGALIGHTS_GRID) && !defined(MEGALIGHTS_FORWARD)
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
// MegaLights M2 / M3（ディファードのみ）
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
void MLAccumulateSampleSet(uint2 samplePixel, float weight, float3 worldPos, float3 worldPosDx, float3 worldPosDy,
                           float3 normal, float2 pixelPosition, int shadowFilterRadius, float3 viewDir, float3 albedo,
                           float3 materialData, float shadowSoftness, float3 monitorColor,
                           inout SurfaceLightAccumulator acc)
{
    const uint sampleCount = MLStochastic.y;
    const uint sampleBase = MLSampleBase(samplePixel);
    const float scale = weight / (float)max(sampleCount, 1u);
    [loop] for (uint sampleIndex = 0u; sampleIndex < sampleCount; ++sampleIndex)
    {
        const uint4 lightSample = MegaLightSamples[sampleBase + sampleIndex];
        if ((lightSample.x & ML_SAMPLE_VALID) == 0u)
        {
            continue;
        }
        const MegaLightData sampledLight = MegaLightBuffer[lightSample.x & ML_SAMPLE_INDEX];
        const float visibility = (lightSample.x & ML_SAMPLE_VISIBLE) != 0u ? 1.0f : 0.0f;
        AccumulateSurfaceLight(-1, sampledLight.DirectionRange, sampledLight.PositionType, sampledLight.Extra,
                               sampledLight.Color, false, false, asfloat(lightSample.y) * scale, visibility, worldPos,
                               worldPosDx, worldPosDy, normal, pixelPosition, shadowFilterRadius, true, viewDir, albedo,
                               materialData, shadowSoftness, monitorColor, sampledLight.IesProfile, acc);
    }
}

// N 個のサンプルを 1/(N·p) の重みと影レイの可視率で評価（ML6）
//   半解像度：このピクセルを囲む 2x2 のサンプル空間のピクセルを、深度・法線が近いものだけ重み付きで使う。
//   各サンプルはこのピクセルの位置・法線・材質で評価し直す（選択確率と可視率は代表ピクセルのもの = 近似）
void MLAccumulateStochasticSamples(float3 worldPos, float3 worldPosDx, float3 worldPosDy, float3 normal,
                                   float2 pixelPosition, int shadowFilterRadius, float3 viewDir, float3 albedo,
                                   float3 materialData, float shadowSoftness, float3 monitorColor,
                                   inout SurfaceLightAccumulator acc)
{
    const uint2 pixel = uint2(pixelPosition);
    if (MLSampleScale() == 1u)
    {
        MLAccumulateSampleSet(pixel, 1.0f, worldPos, worldPosDx, worldPosDy, normal, pixelPosition, shadowFilterRadius,
                              viewDir, albedo, materialData, shadowSoftness, monitorColor, acc);
        return;
    }
    const float viewZ = mul(float4(worldPos, 1.0f), MLWorldToView).z;
    // サンプルの代表ピクセルを基準にした双線形の位置
    const uint2 offsets[4] = {uint2(0u, 0u), uint2(1u, 1u), uint2(1u, 0u), uint2(0u, 1u)};
    const float2 position = (float2(pixel) - float2(offsets[MLSampleGrid.w & 3u])) * 0.5f;
    const int2 base = int2(floor(position));
    const float2 f = position - float2(base);
    float weights[4];
    uint2 candidates[4];
    float weightSum = 0.0f;
    [unroll] for (uint index = 0u; index < 4u; ++index)
    {
        const int2 c = base + int2(index & 1u, index >> 1u);
        weights[index] = 0.0f;
        candidates[index] = uint2(clamp(c, int2(0, 0), int2(MLSampleGrid.xy) - 1));
        if (any(c < 0) || any(c >= int2(MLSampleGrid.xy)))
        {
            continue;
        }
        const uint2 q = MLSampleToScreen(candidates[index]);
        const float qDepth = DepthTexture.Load(int3(q, 0));
        if (!MLIsGeometryDepth(qDepth))
        {
            continue;
        }
        const float relative = abs(MLViewZFromDepth(qDepth) - viewZ) / max(viewZ, 1.0e-3f);
        const float3 qNormal = DecodeGBufferNormal(NormalTexture.Load(int3(q, 0)).xyz);
        const float bilinear = ((index & 1u) ? f.x : 1.0f - f.x) * ((index >> 1u) ? f.y : 1.0f - f.y);
        weights[index] =
            (bilinear + 1.0e-3f) * saturate(1.0f - relative / 0.05f) * pow(saturate(dot(qNormal, normal)), 16.0f);
        weightSum += weights[index];
    }
    if (weightSum <= 1.0e-5f)
    {
        // 近いサンプルが無い（細い物体・境界）：このピクセルを含むサンプルだけを使う
        MLAccumulateSampleSet(MLScreenToSample(pixel), 1.0f, worldPos, worldPosDx, worldPosDy, normal, pixelPosition,
                              shadowFilterRadius, viewDir, albedo, materialData, shadowSoftness, monitorColor, acc);
        return;
    }
    [loop] for (uint candidate = 0u; candidate < 4u; ++candidate)
    {
        if (weights[candidate] <= 0.0f)
        {
            continue;
        }
        MLAccumulateSampleSet(candidates[candidate], weights[candidate] / weightSum, worldPos, worldPosDx, worldPosDy,
                              normal, pixelPosition, shadowFilterRadius, viewDir, albedo, materialData, shadowSoftness,
                              monitorColor, acc);
    }
}

// デモジュレーション係数：拡散アルベド + 鏡面の方向アルベド（DFG の split sum）
//   デノイズはこれで割った値（照明だけ）をぼかし、ディファードで掛け戻す → テクスチャの模様がぼけない
float3 MLRemodulation(float3 N, float3 V, float3 albedo, float3 materialData)
{
    const float metallic = saturate(materialData.r);
    const float roughness = clamp(materialData.g, 0.04f, 1.0f);
    const float3 F0 = lerp(saturate(materialData.b).xxx, albedo, metallic);
    const float2 dfg = SampleDfg(saturate(dot(N, V)), roughness);
    const float3 reflectance = albedo * (1.0f - metallic) + F0 * dfg.x + dfg.y;
    return max(reflectance, 0.02f);
}
#endif // MEGALIGHTS_GRID && !MEGALIGHTS_FORWARD

void ResolveSurfaceLightAggregateShadowed(float3 worldPos, float3 worldPosDx, float3 worldPosDy, float3 normal,
                                          float2 pixelPosition, int shadowFilterRadius, bool evaluatePbr,
                                          float3 viewDir, float3 albedo, float3 materialData, float shadowSoftness,
                                          out float3 pbrDirectLight, out float3 lightDir, out float3 lightColor,
                                          out float attenuation, out float volumeScatter, out float rangeBlend,
                                          out float aggregateShadowVisibility)
{
    pbrDirectLight = 0.0f;
    lightDir = SafeNormalizeCommon(LightDirection.xyz, float3(0.0f, 1.0f, 0.0f));
    lightColor = max(LightColor.rgb, float3(0.0f, 0.0f, 0.0f)) * max(LightColor.a, 0.0f);
    attenuation = 1.0f;
    volumeScatter = 0.0f;
    rangeBlend = saturate((max(LightDirection.w, 1.0f) - 1.0f) / 7.0f);
    aggregateShadowVisibility = 1.0f;

    int count = min((int)round(LightCount.x), MAX_SHADER_LIGHTS);
    SurfaceLightAccumulator acc = (SurfaceLightAccumulator)0;
#ifdef MEGALIGHTS_GRID
#ifdef MEGALIGHTS_FORWARD
    // M7：Forward / 半透明（グリッドが Forward 用に構築されたフレームだけ）
    const bool gridActive = MLForwardGridActive() && g_MLCellIndex != ML_INVALID_CELL;
#else
    const bool gridActive = MLGridActive() && g_MLCellIndex != ML_INVALID_CELL;
#endif
#endif

    bool useLightGrid = HasLightTileGridCommon();
    uint tileBase = useLightGrid ? LightTileBaseCommon(pixelPosition) : 0u;
    int iterationCount = useLightGrid ? min(MAX_LIGHTS_PER_TILE, max((int)round(LightCount.w), 1)) : count;
    uint lightingWidth;
    uint lightingHeight;
    BaseColorTexture.GetDimensions(lightingWidth, lightingHeight);
    const float2 monitorUv = pixelPosition / float2(max(lightingWidth, 1u), max(lightingHeight, 1u));
    const float3 monitorColor = MonitorTexture.SampleLevel(TextureSampler, monitorUv, 0).rgb;
    [loop] for (int iteration = 0; iteration < MAX_SHADER_LIGHTS; ++iteration)
    {
        if (iteration >= iterationCount)
        {
            break;
        }
        uint lightIndex = useLightGrid ? LightTileIndices[tileBase + (uint)iteration] : (uint)iteration;
        if (lightIndex == 0xffffffffu || lightIndex >= (uint)count || LightFlags[lightIndex].x < 0.5f ||
            LightFlags[lightIndex].w >= 1.5f)
        {
            continue;
        }
#ifdef MEGALIGHTS_GRID
        // LightFlags.x == 2 : 不透明面はグリッドが受け持つ（グリッドが有効なフレームだけ二重評価を避ける）
        if (gridActive && LightFlags[lightIndex].x > 1.5f)
        {
            continue;
        }
#endif

        AccumulateSurfaceLight((int)lightIndex, LightDirections[lightIndex], LightPositionTypes[lightIndex],
                               LightExtras[lightIndex], LightColors[lightIndex], LightFlags[lightIndex].w >= 0.5f,
                               false, 1.0f, -1.0f, worldPos, worldPosDx, worldPosDy, normal, pixelPosition,
                               shadowFilterRadius, evaluatePbr, viewDir, albedo, materialData, shadowSoftness,
                               monitorColor, LightIesProfiles[lightIndex], acc);
    }

    uint gridLightCount = 0u;
#ifdef MEGALIGHTS_GRID
    [branch] if (gridActive)
    {
        const uint2 cell = MegaLightCells[g_MLCellIndex];
        gridLightCount = cell.y;
#ifndef MEGALIGHTS_FORWARD
        [branch] if (evaluatePbr && MLDenoisedActive())
        {
            // MegaLights M3：ML6 の結果（デモジュレート済み）をデノイズしたものに、材質の反射率を掛け戻す
            const uint2 denoisePixel = min(uint2(pixelPosition), MLScreen.xy - 1u);
            const float4 denoised = MegaLightDenoised[denoisePixel.y * MLScreen.x + denoisePixel.x];
            acc.PbrDirect += max(denoised.rgb, 0.0f) * MLRemodulation(normal, viewDir, albedo, materialData);
        }
        else if (evaluatePbr && MLStochasticActive())
        {
            // MegaLights M2（ML6）：ML3 で選んだ N 個のサンプルだけを 1/(N·p) の重みで評価する（不偏推定）
            MLAccumulateStochasticSamples(worldPos, worldPosDx, worldPosDy, normal, pixelPosition, shadowFilterRadius,
                                          viewDir, albedo, materialData, shadowSoftness, monitorColor, acc);
        }
        else
#endif
        {
            // MegaLights M1：このピクセルのセル（16px タイル × 奥行きスライス）に入っているローカルライトを全評価
            // （M7 の Forward / 半透明もここ。Forward に影響しないライトは飛ばす）
#ifdef MEGALIGHTS_FORWARD
            const bool reference = false;
#else
            const bool reference = evaluatePbr && MLReferenceActive();
#endif
            [loop] for (uint gridIteration = 0u; gridIteration < cell.y; ++gridIteration)
            {
                const MegaLightData gridLight = MegaLightBuffer[MegaLightIndices[cell.x + gridIteration]];
#ifdef MEGALIGHTS_FORWARD
                if (!MLLightAffectsForward(gridLight))
                {
                    continue;
                }
                const float visibility = -1.0f;
#else
                const float visibility =
                    reference ? MLReferenceVisibility(gridLight, worldPos, normal, uint2(pixelPosition), gridIteration)
                              : -1.0f;
#endif
                AccumulateSurfaceLight(-1, gridLight.DirectionRange, gridLight.PositionType, gridLight.Extra,
                                       gridLight.Color, false, MLLightCastsShadow(gridLight), 1.0f, visibility,
                                       worldPos, worldPosDx, worldPosDy, normal, pixelPosition, shadowFilterRadius,
                                       evaluatePbr, viewDir, albedo, materialData, shadowSoftness, monitorColor,
                                       gridLight.IesProfile, acc);
            }
        }
    }
#endif
    pbrDirectLight = acc.PbrDirect;
    const float3 dirSum = acc.DirSum;
    const float3 colorSum = acc.ColorSum;
    const float weightSum = acc.WeightSum;
    const float maxAttenuation = acc.MaxAttenuation;
    const float volumeSum = acc.VolumeSum;
    const float rangeSum = acc.RangeSum;
    const float shadowSum = acc.ShadowSum;

    if (count <= 0 && gridLightCount == 0u)
    {
        float legacyVolume = 0.0f;
        ResolveLightCommon(worldPos, lightDir, attenuation, legacyVolume);
        lightColor = max(LightColor.rgb, float3(0.0f, 0.0f, 0.0f)) * max(LightColor.a, 0.0f) * attenuation;
        lightColor = ApplyAtmosphereToLightCommon(worldPos, lightDir, lightColor, legacyVolume);
        if (evaluatePbr)
        {
            pbrDirectLight =
                EvaluatePbrDirectLight(normal, viewDir, lightDir, lightColor, albedo, materialData, shadowSoftness);
        }
        if (IsLiveToonClass(g_LiveToonClass))
        {
            pbrDirectLight = EvaluateLiveToonLightStyled(
                albedo, normal, viewDir, lightDir, lightColor, float3(1.0f, 1.0f, 1.0f), LightPositionType.w,
                g_LiveToonClass, materialData.g, g_LiveToonShadow.x, shadowSoftness, g_LiveToonShadow.y);
        }
        volumeScatter = legacyVolume * max(LightColor.a, 0.0f);
        rangeBlend = saturate((max(LightDirection.w, 1.0f) - 1.0f) / 7.0f);
        return;
    }

    if (weightSum <= 0.000001f)
    {
        lightColor = float3(0.0f, 0.0f, 0.0f);
        attenuation = 0.0f;
        volumeScatter = 0.0f;
        rangeBlend = 0.0f;
        aggregateShadowVisibility = 1.0f;
        return;
    }

    lightDir = SafeNormalizeCommon(dirSum, SafeNormalizeCommon(LightDirection.xyz, float3(0.0f, 1.0f, 0.0f)));
    lightColor = colorSum + AtmosphereAmbientCommon(worldPos, lightDir);
    attenuation = saturate(maxAttenuation);
    volumeScatter = volumeSum;
    rangeBlend = saturate(rangeSum / weightSum);
    aggregateShadowVisibility = saturate(shadowSum / weightSum);
}

float VirtualMoonSurfaceVisibility(float3 worldPosition, float3 normal, float3 direction)
{
#ifdef SHADER_RAYTRACING
    if (SceneRayFlags.y > .5f && SceneRayFlags.z > .5f)
    {
        return TraceSceneShadow(worldPosition + g_PomShadowOffset, normal, direction, SceneRayParameters.x);
    }
#endif
    // 仮想の月には設定済みのシャドウマップがない。有効な可視性の提供元が
    // なければ、遮蔽のない面光源としては扱わず、空の円盤のままにする。
    return 0;
}

float3 EvaluateSurfaceEnvironment(SurfaceData surface, float3 viewDir, float3 worldPosition, float2 screenUv,
                                  float shadowSoftness, float3 pbrDirectLight)
{
    const float PI = 3.14159265359f;
    float3 N = surface.NormalWS;
    float3 V = viewDir;
    float NdotV = saturate(dot(N, V));
    float metallic = saturate(surface.Metallic);
    float roughness = clamp(surface.Roughness, 0.04f, 1.0f);
    float specularF0 = saturate(surface.F0);
    float3 albedo = surface.BaseColor;
    float3 F0 = lerp(float3(specularF0, specularF0, specularF0), albedo, metallic);

    float3 R = reflect(-V, N);
    R = normalize(R);

    float2 reflectionUV;
    reflectionUV.x = frac(atan2(R.z, R.x) / (2.0f * PI) + 0.5f);
    reflectionUV.y = acos(clamp(R.y, -1.0f, 1.0f)) / PI;

    float2 normalUV;
    normalUV.x = frac(atan2(N.z, N.x) / (2.0f * PI) + 0.5f);
    normalUV.y = acos(clamp(N.y, -1.0f, 1.0f)) / PI;

    float maxMip = 8.0f;

    float3 envSpecular = EnvironmentTexture.SampleLevel(TextureSampler, reflectionUV, roughness * maxMip).rgb;
#ifdef SHADER_RAYTRACING
    if (SceneRayFlags.x > 0.5f || RaytracingFlags.w > 0.5f)
    {
        envSpecular = RaytracingFlags.w > 0.5f ? RaytracedReflections.SampleLevel(TextureSampler, screenUv, 0).rgb : 0;
    }
#endif

    float3 irradiance = EnvironmentTexture.SampleLevel(TextureSampler, normalUV, maxMip).rgb;

    float oneMinusNdotV = 1.0f - NdotV;
    float oneMinusNdotV2 = oneMinusNdotV * oneMinusNdotV;
    float oneMinusNdotV5 = oneMinusNdotV2 * oneMinusNdotV2 * oneMinusNdotV;

    float3 roughnessF0Max = max(float3(1.0f - roughness, 1.0f - roughness, 1.0f - roughness), F0);

    float3 F_IBL = F0 + (roughnessF0Max - F0) * oneMinusNdotV5;
    float3 specularWeight = F_IBL;
    float3 ambientKD = 1.0f - F_IBL;
    if (QualityEnergyCompensation())
    {
        // 分割和 DFG と多重散乱（Fdez-Aguera 2019）：粗い面で多重散乱光の
        // エネルギーを失わず、拡散光には残りのエネルギーを正確に割り当てる。
        float2 dfg = SampleDfg(NdotV, roughness);
        float3 FssEss = F0 * dfg.x + dfg.y;
        float Ess = dfg.x + dfg.y;
        float Ems = 1.0f - Ess;
        float3 Favg = F0 + (1.0f - F0) / 21.0f;
        float3 Fms = FssEss * Favg / max(1.0f - Ems * Favg, 0.0001f);
        specularWeight = FssEss + Fms * Ems;
        ambientKD = 1.0f - specularWeight;
    }
    ambientKD *= 1.0f - metallic;

    float3 ambientDiffuse = ambientKD * albedo * irradiance / (0.5f * PI);
    if (HdrFlags.w > 1.5f && Flags.w > 0)
    {
        ambientDiffuse = 0;
    }
    // 鏡面反射のオクルージョン（Lagarde & de Rousiers 2014）：AO を一様に適用せず、
    // マテリアルの AO、粗さ、視線角から反射ローブの遮蔽を求める。
    // 粗い面では AO に収束し、滑らかな面の浅い視線角では反射を保つ。
    float materialAo = saturate(surface.AO);
    float specularOcclusion =
        saturate(pow(max(NdotV + materialAo, 0.0f), exp2(-16.0f * roughness - 1.0f)) - 1.0f + materialAo);
    float3 ambientSpecular = envSpecular * specularWeight;
    const uint model = g_ShadingModel.Model;
    const float modelStrength = g_ShadingModel.Strength;
    if (model == kShadingClearCoat && modelStrength > 0.0f)
    {
        float coatF = (0.04f + 0.96f * oneMinusNdotV5) * modelStrength;
        float3 coatEnvironment = EnvironmentTexture.SampleLevel(TextureSampler, reflectionUV, 0.06f * maxMip).rgb;
#ifdef SHADER_RAYTRACING
        if (RaytracingFlags.w > 0.5f)
        {
            coatEnvironment = envSpecular;
        }
#endif
        ambientDiffuse *= 1.0f - coatF;
        ambientSpecular = ambientSpecular * (1.0f - coatF) + coatEnvironment * coatF;
    }
    else if (model == kShadingSheen && modelStrength > 0.0f)
    {
        // Charlie のシーン反射ローブの方向アルベドを近似する。
        float sheenAlbedo = lerp(0.12f, 0.35f, roughness) * (1.0f - NdotV * 0.5f);
        ambientSpecular += irradiance * lerp(1.0f, albedo, 0.5f) * sheenAlbedo * modelStrength;
    }

    float3 ambient = ambientDiffuse * materialAo + ambientSpecular * specularOcclusion;

    if (SkyParameters.x > 0.5f)
    {
        ambient *= lerp(0.025f, 1.0f, SkyParameters.y);
    }
    float3 moonDirection = VirtualMoonDirection();
    float moonVisibility =
        CloudTrace.z > 0.5 && CloudTrace.w > 0.5 ? CloudSolarTransmittance(worldPosition, moonDirection) : 1;
    float3 moonRadiance =
        VirtualMoonIrradiance() * moonVisibility * CelestialAtmosphereTransmission(worldPosition.y, moonDirection);
    [branch] if (any(moonRadiance > 1e-6))
    {
        moonRadiance *= VirtualMoonSurfaceVisibility(worldPosition, N, moonDirection);
        pbrDirectLight +=
            EvaluatePbrDirectLight(N, V, moonDirection, moonRadiance, albedo,
                                   float3(surface.Metallic, surface.Roughness, surface.F0), shadowSoftness);
    }
    return pbrDirectLight + ambient + surface.Emissive;
}

float3 ApplySurfaceScreenEffects(float3 color, float3 emissive, float2 screenUv, float3 diffuseReflectance)
{
    // 独立したプレビューやフォワード専用のシーンには、画面空間の照明履歴がない。
    if (Flags.w <= 0.0f)
    {
        return color + emissive;
    }
    float ambientVisibility = 1.0f;
    if (HdrFlags.z > 0.5f)
    {
        ambientVisibility = VisibilityBitmaskAO.SampleLevel(TextureSampler, screenUv, 0);
    }

    float3 screenIndirect = 0.0f;
    if (HdrFlags.w > 0.5f)
    {
        screenIndirect = DeinterleavedSSGI.SampleLevel(TextureSampler, screenUv, 0).rgb;
    }
    color *= lerp(0.38f, 1.0f, ambientVisibility);
    float rayAmbientFactor = 1.0f;
    if (RaytracingFlags.x > 0.5f && RaytracingFlags.y > 0.5f)
    {
        float rayAmbient = RaytracedVisibility.SampleLevel(TextureSampler, screenUv, 0).g;
        rayAmbientFactor = lerp(0.45f, 1.0f, rayAmbient);
    }
    if (HdrFlags.w > 1.5f)
    {
        // レイトレーシング GI は、各反射レイがシーンで遮蔽されるため、独自の可視性を持つ。
        // さらに AO を適用すると、反射光を受けるはずの場所が暗くなっていた。
        // 例えば、照らされた床の上に置かれた物体の下面が該当する。
        color *= rayAmbientFactor;
        color += screenIndirect * max(diffuseReflectance, 0) / 3.14159265f;
    }
    else
    {
        color += screenIndirect * saturate(color + 0.18f);
        color *= rayAmbientFactor;
    }

    color += emissive;
    float4 atmosphereMedia = AtmosphereTexture.SampleLevel(TextureSampler, screenUv, 0);
    color = color * saturate(atmosphereMedia.a) + atmosphereMedia.rgb;
    return color;
}
#endif



===== FILE: shader\hlsl\TAA_BlendPS.hlsl =====
#define SHADER_POSTPROCESS
#include "common.hlsl"

// =============================================================================================
// TAA（ちらつき対策版）
//   ・動きベクトルは 3x3 で最も手前の深度のピクセルのものを使う（細い物・輪郭の取りこぼしによる履歴の引きずり防止）
//   ・履歴は Catmull-Rom（5
//   タップ）で読む（双線形で読むたびに履歴がぼけ、ぼけを補うシャープ処理でちらつく、の悪循環を断つ） ・近傍は YCoCg
//   の平均 ± γσ（分散クリップ）。min/max の箱でクランプすると、遠くの 1px 未満の物が
//     ジッターのたびに箱の外へ出て履歴が捨てられ、点滅する。分散クリップは平均へ向けて線分で切るので安定
//   ・静止していて履歴とよく合うピクセルほど γ を広げ、履歴を長く使う（遠景のちらつき対策の本体）
//   ・輝度による重み付け（Karis）：明るい 1px が履歴を支配して明滅するのを抑える
//   定数・ルート引数は従来と同じ
// =============================================================================================
Texture2D<float4> CurrentColor : register(t0);
Texture2D<float4> HistoryColor : register(t1);
Texture2D<float> DepthBuffer : register(t2);
Texture2D<float4> VelocityBuffer : register(t3);
SamplerState LinearSampler : register(s0);

cbuffer AaConstants : register(b4)
{
    float4x4 PrevViewProj;
    float BlendFactor;
    float2 RcpFrame;
    float HistoryValid;
};

float3 RgbToYCoCg(float3 c)
{
    return float3(0.25f * c.r + 0.5f * c.g + 0.25f * c.b, 0.5f * c.r - 0.5f * c.b,
                  -0.25f * c.r + 0.5f * c.g - 0.25f * c.b);
}

float3 YCoCgToRgb(float3 c)
{
    return float3(c.x + c.y - c.z, c.x + c.z, c.x - c.y - c.z);
}

// 輝度の逆数で重み付け（HDR の明るい点の支配を抑える）
float LumaWeight(float3 ycocg)
{
    return 1.0f / (1.0f + max(ycocg.x, 0.0f));
}

// Catmull-Rom を双線形 5 回で（Jimenez 2016）
float3 SampleHistoryCatmullRom(float2 uv, float2 textureSize)
{
    const float2 position = uv * textureSize;
    const float2 center = floor(position - 0.5f) + 0.5f;
    const float2 f = position - center;
    const float2 f2 = f * f;
    const float2 f3 = f2 * f;
    const float2 w0 = -0.5f * f3 + f2 - 0.5f * f;
    const float2 w1 = 1.5f * f3 - 2.5f * f2 + 1.0f;
    const float2 w2 = -1.5f * f3 + 2.0f * f2 + 0.5f * f;
    const float2 w3 = 0.5f * f3 - 0.5f * f2;
    const float2 w12 = w1 + w2;
    const float2 texel = 1.0f / textureSize;
    const float2 uv0 = (center - 1.0f) * texel;
    const float2 uv3 = (center + 2.0f) * texel;
    const float2 uv12 = (center + w2 / w12) * texel;
    float3 result = 0.0f;
    float weight = 0.0f;
    float w;
    w = w12.x * w0.y;
    result += HistoryColor.SampleLevel(LinearSampler, float2(uv12.x, uv0.y), 0).rgb * w;
    weight += w;
    w = w0.x * w12.y;
    result += HistoryColor.SampleLevel(LinearSampler, float2(uv0.x, uv12.y), 0).rgb * w;
    weight += w;
    w = w12.x * w12.y;
    result += HistoryColor.SampleLevel(LinearSampler, float2(uv12.x, uv12.y), 0).rgb * w;
    weight += w;
    w = w3.x * w12.y;
    result += HistoryColor.SampleLevel(LinearSampler, float2(uv3.x, uv12.y), 0).rgb * w;
    weight += w;
    w = w12.x * w3.y;
    result += HistoryColor.SampleLevel(LinearSampler, float2(uv12.x, uv3.y), 0).rgb * w;
    weight += w;
    return max(result / max(weight, 1.0e-4f), 0.0f);
}

// 平均へ向かう線分で AABB にクリップ（クランプより色ずれが少ない）
float3 ClipToAabb(float3 history, float3 center, float3 extents)
{
    const float3 offset = history - center;
    const float3 unit = abs(offset / max(extents, 1.0e-4f));
    const float maxUnit = max(unit.x, max(unit.y, unit.z));
    return maxUnit > 1.0f ? center + offset / maxUnit : history;
}

float4 main(PSInputPostProcess input) : SV_TARGET
{
    const int2 pixel = int2(input.Position.xy);
    const float2 uv = input.TexCoord;
    const float2 textureSize = 1.0f / max(RcpFrame, 1.0e-6f);
    const int2 maxPixel = int2(textureSize) - 1;

    // ---- 近傍の統計（YCoCg・輝度重み付き）と、最も手前のピクセル
    const float3 currentRgb = CurrentColor.Load(int3(pixel, 0)).rgb;
    const float3 current = RgbToYCoCg(currentRgb);
    float3 moment1 = 0.0f;
    float3 moment2 = 0.0f;
    float closestDepth = -1.0f;
    int2 closestPixel = pixel;
    [unroll] for (int y = -1; y <= 1; ++y)
    {
        [unroll] for (int x = -1; x <= 1; ++x)
        {
            const int2 neighbor = clamp(pixel + int2(x, y), int2(0, 0), maxPixel);
            const float3 sampleColor = RgbToYCoCg(CurrentColor.Load(int3(neighbor, 0)).rgb);
            moment1 += sampleColor;
            moment2 += sampleColor * sampleColor;
            const float depth = DepthBuffer.Load(int3(neighbor, 0));
            if (depth > closestDepth)
            {
                closestDepth = depth;
                closestPixel = neighbor;
            }
        }
    }
    const float3 mean = moment1 / 9.0f;
    const float3 sigma = sqrt(max(moment2 / 9.0f - mean * mean, 0.0f));

    // ---- 履歴
    const float2 velocity = VelocityBuffer.Load(int3(closestPixel, 0)).ba;
    const float2 historyUv = uv - velocity;
    const bool historyInBounds = all(historyUv >= 0.0f) && all(historyUv <= 1.0f);
    float3 history = RgbToYCoCg(SampleHistoryCatmullRom(historyUv, textureSize));

    // 動きが小さい（静止に近い）ほど、クリップの幅 γ を広げて履歴を長く保つ
    const float motionPixels = length(velocity * textureSize);
    const float stillness = saturate(1.0f - motionPixels / 2.0f);
    const float gamma = lerp(1.0f, 1.75f, stillness);
    const float3 boxMin = min(mean - gamma * sigma, current);
    const float3 boxMax = max(mean + gamma * sigma, current);
    const float3 clipped = ClipToAabb(history, (boxMin + boxMax) * 0.5f, (boxMax - boxMin) * 0.5f);
    // クリップで大きく動いた（= 履歴が合っていない）ほど、今のフレームを強く使う
    const float rejection = saturate(length(clipped - history) / max(clipped.x + 0.05f, 0.05f));
    history = clipped;

    // ---- 混合率：基本は BlendFactor。静止なら長い履歴（最大 0.96）、速い動きや不一致では短く
    const float motionConfidence = saturate(1.0f - motionPixels / 32.0f);
    float historyWeight = lerp(BlendFactor, 0.96f, stillness) * motionConfidence * (1.0f - 0.5f * rejection);
    historyWeight *= HistoryValid * (historyInBounds ? 1.0f : 0.0f);

    // 輝度重み付きで混ぜる（明るい点の明滅を抑える）
    const float currentWeight = (1.0f - historyWeight) * LumaWeight(current);
    const float historyWeightL = historyWeight * LumaWeight(history);
    const float3 resolved =
        (current * currentWeight + history * historyWeightL) / max(currentWeight + historyWeightL, 1.0e-5f);

    float3 rgb = YCoCgToRgb(resolved);
    rgb = all(isfinite(rgb)) ? max(rgb, 0.0f) : currentRgb;
    return float4(rgb, 1.0f);
}

===== FILE: shader\hlsl\TemporalUpscaleCS.hlsl =====
Texture2D<float4> Color : register(t0);
Texture2D<float> Depth : register(t1);
Texture2D<float4> Velocity : register(t2);
Texture2D<float4> History : register(t3);
Texture2D<float> HistoryDepth : register(t4);
Texture2D<float> Revealage : register(t5);
Texture2D<float2> DetailHistory : register(t6);
RWTexture2D<float4> Output : register(u0);
RWTexture2D<float> OutputDepth : register(u1);
RWTexture2D<float2> OutputDetail : register(u2);
SamplerState LinearClamp : register(s0);

cbuffer Constants : register(b0)
{
    float4 Extent;     // 入力 xy、出力 zw。
    float4 Jitter;     // 現在 xy、前回 zw。正規化 UV の +Y は下向き。
    float4 Parameters; // 履歴の有効フラグ、透過残量の有効フラグ、サブピクセル AA、細部の安定性。
    float4x4 InvCurrent, Previous;
    float4 Reconstruction; // 平面の深度、薄い形状、zw は予約領域。
};
#ifndef TSR_USE_SHARED_TILE
#define TSR_USE_SHARED_TILE 1
#endif
#define TSR_TILE_WIDTH 12
#if TSR_USE_SHARED_TILE
groupshared float4 CurrentTileColor[TSR_TILE_WIDTH * TSR_TILE_WIDTH];
groupshared float CurrentTileDepth[TSR_TILE_WIDTH * TSR_TILE_WIDTH];
groupshared int2 CurrentTileOrigin;

int CurrentTileStart(float first, float inputSize)
{
    return clamp((int)floor(first - .5) - 1, 0, (int)inputSize - 1);
}

int CurrentTileEnd(float last, float inputSize)
{
    return clamp((int)floor(last - .5) + 2, 0, (int)inputSize - 1);
}

void PrepareCurrentTile(uint2 group, uint lane)
{
    // 8x8 の出力ピクセルには、バイキュービックと 3x3 の周辺領域を含めて
    // 最大 12x12 の入力テクセルが必要。縮小時は元の直接読み取り経路を維持する。
    if (all(Extent.xy <= Extent.zw))
    {
        float2 first = ((float2(group * 8) + .5) / Extent.zw + Jitter.xy) * Extent.xy;
        float2 last = ((float2(group * 8 + 7) + .5) / Extent.zw + Jitter.xy) * Extent.xy;
        int2 origin = int2(CurrentTileStart(first.x, Extent.x), CurrentTileStart(first.y, Extent.y));
        int2 end = int2(CurrentTileEnd(last.x, Extent.x), CurrentTileEnd(last.y, Extent.y));
        uint2 size = uint2(end - origin + 1);
        if (lane == 0)
        {
            CurrentTileOrigin = origin;
        }
        for (uint index = lane; index < size.x * size.y; index += 64)
        {
            uint2 local = uint2(index % size.x, index / size.x);
            int2 pixel = origin + int2(local);
            uint slot = local.y * TSR_TILE_WIDTH + local.x;
            CurrentTileColor[slot] = Color.Load(int3(pixel, 0));
            CurrentTileDepth[slot] = Depth.Load(int3(pixel, 0));
        }
        // このグループ内で一様なバリアは、不完全なグループの return より前に置く。
        GroupMemoryBarrierWithGroupSync();
    }
}
#endif
float4 LoadCurrentColor(int2 pixel)
{
#if TSR_USE_SHARED_TILE
    if (all(Extent.xy <= Extent.zw))
    {
        int2 local = pixel - CurrentTileOrigin;
        return CurrentTileColor[local.y * TSR_TILE_WIDTH + local.x];
    }
#endif
    return Color.Load(int3(pixel, 0));
}

float LoadCurrentDepth(int2 pixel)
{
#if TSR_USE_SHARED_TILE
    if (all(Extent.xy <= Extent.zw))
    {
        int2 local = pixel - CurrentTileOrigin;
        return CurrentTileDepth[local.y * TSR_TILE_WIDTH + local.x];
    }
#endif
    return Depth.Load(int3(pixel, 0));
}

float3 ToY(float3 c)
{
    return float3(dot(c, float3(.25, .5, .25)), c.r - c.b, c.g - (c.r + c.b) * .5);
}

float3 FromY(float3 c)
{
    return float3(c.x + c.y * .5 - c.z * .5, c.x + c.z * .5, c.x - c.y * .5 - c.z * .5);
}

float Cubic(float x)
{
    x = abs(x);
    if (x < 1)
    {
        return (1.5 * x - 2.5) * x * x + 1;
    }
    if (x < 2)
    {
        return ((-.5 * x + 2.5) * x - 4) * x + 2;
    }
    return 0;
}

float4 Reconstruct(float2 uv)
{
    float2 position = uv * Extent.xy - .5;
    int2 base = int2(floor(position));
    float2 fraction = frac(position);
    float4 sum = 0;
    float weights = 0;
    [unroll] for (int y = -1; y <= 2; ++y)
    {
        [unroll] for (int x = -1; x <= 2; ++x)
        {
            float weight = Cubic(x - fraction.x) * Cubic(y - fraction.y);
            int2 pixel = clamp(base + int2(x, y), 0, int2(Extent.xy) - 1);
            sum += LoadCurrentColor(pixel) * weight;
            weights += weight;
        }
    }
    return max(sum / max(weights, 1e-5), 0);
}

float4 ReconstructHistory(float2 uv)
{
    // 履歴を毎フレーム線形補間すると、移動中に再構築した細部が失われる。
    // Catmull-Rom の中央 2 タップをまとめ、9 回の読み取りで補間する。
    float2 position = uv * Extent.zw - .5;
    float2 base = floor(position);
    float2 fraction = position - base;
    float2 weight0 = -.5 * fraction + fraction * fraction - .5 * fraction * fraction * fraction;
    float2 weight1 = 1 - 2.5 * fraction * fraction + 1.5 * fraction * fraction * fraction;
    float2 weight2 = .5 * fraction + 2 * fraction * fraction - 1.5 * fraction * fraction * fraction;
    float2 weight3 = -.5 * fraction * fraction + .5 * fraction * fraction * fraction;
    float2 middleWeight = weight1 + weight2;
    float2 middlePosition = base + weight2 / middleWeight;
    float2 coordinatesX = float2(base.x - 1, base.x + 2);
    float2 coordinatesY = float2(base.y - 1, base.y + 2);
    float4 reconstructed = 0;
    [unroll] for (int y = 0; y < 3; ++y)
    {
        float sampleY = middlePosition.y;
        float weightY = middleWeight.y;
        if (y != 1)
        {
            sampleY = coordinatesY[y / 2];
            weightY = y == 0 ? weight0.y : weight3.y;
        }
        [unroll] for (int x = 0; x < 3; ++x)
        {
            float sampleX = middlePosition.x;
            float weightX = middleWeight.x;
            if (x != 1)
            {
                sampleX = coordinatesX[x / 2];
                weightX = x == 0 ? weight0.x : weight3.x;
            }
            float2 sampleUv = (float2(sampleX, sampleY) + .5) / Extent.zw;
            reconstructed += History.SampleLevel(LinearClamp, sampleUv, 0) * weightX * weightY;
        }
    }
    return max(reconstructed, 0);
}

bool HistoryDepthMatches(float2 uv, float expectedDepth, float footprintTolerance)
{
    // 履歴深度はポイントサンプリングする。前景と空を補間すると架空の面が生まれ、
    // 輪郭の AA に必要なサブピクセルの被覆が除外されてしまう。
    // 被覆がジッターに伴って移動するため、入力サンプル 1 個分の投影範囲を覆う。
    const float tolerance = max(max(.0002, abs(expectedDepth) * .01), footprintTolerance);
    const int2 maximumPixel = int2(Extent.zw) - 1;
    const int2 center = clamp(int2(uv * Extent.zw), 0, maximumPixel);
    float difference = abs(HistoryDepth.Load(int3(center, 0)) - expectedDepth);
    [unroll] for (int y = -1; y <= 1; y += 2)
    {
        [unroll] for (int x = -1; x <= 1; x += 2)
        {
            const float2 sampleUv = uv + float2(x, y) / Extent.xy;
            const int2 samplePixel = clamp(int2(sampleUv * Extent.zw), 0, maximumPixel);
            difference = min(difference, abs(HistoryDepth.Load(int3(samplePixel, 0)) - expectedDepth));
        }
    }
    return difference <= tolerance;
}
[numthreads(8, 8, 1)] void main(uint3 id : SV_DispatchThreadID, uint3 group : SV_GroupID, uint lane : SV_GroupIndex) {
#if TSR_USE_SHARED_TILE
    PrepareCurrentTile(group.xy, lane);
#endif
    if (any(id.xy >= uint2(Extent.zw)))
    {
        return;
    }
    float2 uv = (id.xy + .5) / Extent.zw;
    float2 source = uv + Jitter.xy;
    int2 pixel = clamp(int2(source * Extent.xy), 0, int2(Extent.xy) - 1);
    float4 current = Reconstruct(source);
    float currentLuma = dot(current.rgb, float3(.2126, .7152, .0722));
    float depth = LoadCurrentDepth(pixel);
    OutputDepth[id.xy] = depth;
    OutputDetail[id.xy] = float2(currentLuma, 0);
    // 以下の全ての除外経路で、空間再構築をフォールバックとして保つ。
    Output[id.xy] = current;
    if (Parameters.x < .5)
    {
        return;
    }

    int2 velocityPixel = pixel;
    float nearest = depth;
    float3 minimumColor = 1e20;
    float3 maximumColor = -1e20;
    float3 mean = 0;
    float3 square = 0;
    float4 cardinalLuma = 0; // 3x3 のタップから再利用する左、右、上、下。
    float4 cardinalDepth = depth;
    [unroll] for (int y = -1; y <= 1; ++y)
    {
        [unroll] for (int x = -1; x <= 1; ++x)
        {
            int2 neighbor = clamp(pixel + int2(x, y), 0, int2(Extent.xy) - 1);
            float neighborDepth = LoadCurrentDepth(neighbor);
            if (x == -1 && y == 0)
            {
                cardinalDepth.x = neighborDepth;
            }
            if (x == 1 && y == 0)
            {
                cardinalDepth.y = neighborDepth;
            }
            if (x == 0 && y == -1)
            {
                cardinalDepth.z = neighborDepth;
            }
            if (x == 0 && y == 1)
            {
                cardinalDepth.w = neighborDepth;
            }
            if (neighborDepth > nearest)
            {
                nearest = neighborDepth;
                velocityPixel = neighbor;
            }
            float3 color = ToY(LoadCurrentColor(neighbor).rgb);
            if (x == -1 && y == 0)
            {
                cardinalLuma.x = color.x;
            }
            if (x == 1 && y == 0)
            {
                cardinalLuma.y = color.x;
            }
            if (x == 0 && y == -1)
            {
                cardinalLuma.z = color.x;
            }
            if (x == 0 && y == 1)
            {
                cardinalLuma.w = color.x;
            }
            minimumColor = min(minimumColor, color);
            maximumColor = max(maximumColor, color);
            mean += color;
            square += color * color;
        }
    }
    mean /= 9;
    float3 sigma = sqrt(max(square / 9 - mean * mean, 0));
    minimumColor = max(minimumColor, mean - 1.5 * sigma);
    maximumColor = min(maximumColor, mean + 1.5 * sigma);

    // 速度には投影ジッターを含め、履歴はジッターなしで保存する。
    float2 motion = Velocity.Load(int3(velocityPixel, 0)).zw;
    float2 oldUv = uv - motion + Jitter.xy - Jitter.zw;
    if (!all(isfinite(motion)) || any(oldUv <= 0) || any(oldUv >= 1))
    {
        return;
    }
    float reactive = Parameters.y > .5 ? 1 - saturate(Revealage.Load(int3(pixel, 0))) : 0;
    float motionPixels = length((motion - Jitter.xy + Jitter.zw) * Extent.zw);
    float separation = max(1e-6, abs(depth) * .02);
    bool thinDepthRidge =
        depth > 0.0f && ((cardinalDepth.x < depth - separation && cardinalDepth.y < depth - separation) ||
                         (cardinalDepth.z < depth - separation && cardinalDepth.w < depth - separation));
    bool observedThinGeometry =
        Reconstruction.y > .5 && Parameters.w > .5 && thinDepthRidge && motionPixels < .25 && reactive == 0;
    // 色の履歴を再利用できない、新しく現れたサンプルでも初期値を与える。
    if (observedThinGeometry)
    {
        OutputDetail[id.xy] = float2(currentLuma, 1.8);
    }
    float4 world = mul(float4(source * float2(2, -2) + float2(-1, 1), depth, 1), InvCurrent);
    if (depth > 0.0f)
    {
        if (world.w <= 0.0f)
        {
            return;
        }
        world /= world.w;
    }
    // 背景は w = 0 の方向のまま再投影し、カメラ移動による視差を与えない。
    float4 previous = mul(world, Previous);
    float expected = previous.z / max(previous.w, 1e-8);
    bool subpixelAA = Parameters.z > .5;
    float footprintTolerance = 0;
    if (Reconstruction.x > .5 && depth > 0.0f)
    {
        // 透視投影の NDC 深度は平面上でアフィンとなる。対称で連続した
        // 深度勾配だけが入力サンプルの投影範囲を広げられる。
        // 輪郭や幅の狭い前景物体では、厳密な除外を保つ。
        float2 curvature = abs(cardinalDepth.xz + cardinalDepth.yw - 2 * depth);
        float2 slope = .5 * abs(cardinalDepth.yw - cardinalDepth.xz);
        float planarityTolerance = max(2e-6, abs(depth) * .0005);
        bool planar = all(curvature < planarityTolerance) && all(cardinalDepth > 0.0f);
        if (planar && all(slope < abs(depth) * .1))
        {
            footprintTolerance = slope.x + slope.y + planarityTolerance;
        }
    }
    bool depthMatches;
    if (subpixelAA)
    {
        depthMatches = HistoryDepthMatches(oldUv, expected, footprintTolerance);
    }
    else
    {
        float oldDepth = HistoryDepth.SampleLevel(LinearClamp, oldUv, 0);
        depthMatches = abs(oldDepth - expected) <= max(.0002, abs(expected) * .01);
    }
    if (previous.w <= 0)
    {
        return;
    }
    if (Reconstruction.y > .5 && Parameters.w > .5 && motionPixels < .25 && reactive == 0)
    {
        int2 historyPixel = clamp(int2(oldUv * Extent.zw), 0, int2(Extent.zw) - 1);
        float2 previousDetail = DetailHistory.Load(int3(historyPixel, 0));
        // [-1,1] を超える値は、過去に観測した深度の稜線を示す。
        // 観測がないたびに小数部分の信頼度を減衰させ、速度が同じまま
        // 実際の細い物体が消えた場合に、保持期間を制限する。
        float confidence = max(abs(previousDetail.y) - 1, 0);
        float oldDepth = HistoryDepth.Load(int3(historyPixel, 0));
        if (confidence > .1 && oldDepth > depth + separation && nearest <= oldDepth + separation)
        {
            float4 retained = History.SampleLevel(LinearClamp, oldUv, 0);
            if (all(isfinite(retained)))
            {
                Output[id.xy] = float4(lerp(current.rgb, retained.rgb, .8), current.a);
                OutputDepth[id.xy] = oldDepth;
                OutputDetail[id.xy] = float2(currentLuma, sign(previousDetail.y) * (1 + confidence * .6));
                return;
            }
        }
        // 新しく観測したサブピクセルの稜線は、最大の明るさで再開せず、
        // 以前の背景の上へ被覆を蓄積する必要がある。
        if (observedThinGeometry && oldDepth < depth - separation)
        {
            depthMatches = true;
        }
    }
    if (!depthMatches)
    {
        return;
    }
    float4 history = ReconstructHistory(oldUv);
    if (!all(isfinite(history)))
    {
        return;
    }
    float detailProtection = 0;
    float detailLock = 0;
    if (subpixelAA && Parameters.w > .5)
    {
        // 符号付きの不安定度に最後の変化方向を保持する。符号反転の反復は
        // サンプリング不足の細部を示し、一方向に続く変化はロックを減衰させる。
        float2 previousDetail = DetailHistory.SampleLevel(LinearClamp, oldUv, 0);
        if (abs(previousDetail.y) > 1)
        {
            previousDetail.y = sign(previousDetail.y) * (abs(previousDetail.y) - 1);
        }
        float change = currentLuma - previousDetail.x;
        float relativeChange = abs(change) / max(max(currentLuma, previousDetail.x), .05);
        float instability = abs(previousDetail.y) * .93;
        float direction = sign(previousDetail.y);
        if (relativeChange > .05)
        {
            float centerLuma = ToY(LoadCurrentColor(pixel).rgb).x;
            float horizontalRidge = (centerLuma - cardinalLuma.x) * (centerLuma - cardinalLuma.y);
            float verticalRidge = (centerLuma - cardinalLuma.z) * (centerLuma - cardinalLuma.w);
            // 局所コントラストを使い、影の中の細線にも明るい細線と同じロックを与える。
            // 下限値により、ほぼ平坦な領域の量子化誤差を増幅しない。
            float contrast = max(maximumColor.x - minimumColor.x, .01);
            float thinFeature = saturate(max(horizontalRidge, verticalRidge) / (contrast * contrast));
            bool reverses = change * previousDetail.y < 0 && abs(previousDetail.y) > .05;
            instability =
                reverses ? min(abs(previousDetail.y) + .45, 1) : max(.2 * thinFeature, abs(previousDetail.y) * .85);
            direction = sign(change);
        }
        float stabilityEligibility = saturate(1 - motionPixels) * (1 - reactive);
        OutputDetail[id.xy] = float2(currentLuma, direction * instability * stabilityEligibility);
        if (observedThinGeometry)
        {
            OutputDetail[id.xy] = float2(currentLuma, (direction == 0 ? 1 : direction) * 1.8);
        }
        // 近傍が平坦な色へ変わるとき、消えかけた細線を保護する。
        // 十分にサンプリングされた輪郭では、元の鮮明な解決を維持する。
        float flatNeighborhood = saturate(1 - sigma.x * 8);
        detailLock = saturate((instability - .15) / .5) * stabilityEligibility;
        detailProtection = detailLock * flatNeighborhood;
    }
    // ジッター付きの輪郭と蓄積した被覆が異なること自体は正常。
    // 現在の近傍色の範囲外だけを、説明できない変化と見なす。
    bool stablePlane = subpixelAA && Parameters.w > .5 && footprintTolerance > 0 && motionPixels < .25 &&
                       reactive == 0 && sigma.x < max(abs(mean.x), .05) * .15;
    if (stablePlane)
    {
        // 平坦な近傍には空間的な分散がほとんどない。その幅 0 の範囲へクリップすると、
        // 弱い GI ノイズが蓄積されず、そのまま出力されてしまう。
        // 検証済みの静止平面では、小さな絶対・相対許容差を認める。
        // 大きな照明変化は、引き続き現在フレームの範囲で制限する。
        float3 noiseAllowance = float3(.001, .002, .002) + .003 * abs(mean);
        minimumColor -= noiseAllowance;
        maximumColor += noiseAllowance;
    }
    float3 clippedHistory = clamp(ToY(history.rgb), minimumColor, maximumColor);
    clippedHistory = lerp(clippedHistory, ToY(history.rgb), detailProtection);
    float neighborhoodReaction = saturate(abs(ToY(history.rgb).x - clippedHistory.x) / max(abs(clippedHistory.x), .05));
    float historyLuma = dot(history.rgb, float3(.2126, .7152, .0722));
    float legacyReaction = saturate(abs(currentLuma - historyLuma) / max(max(currentLuma, historyLuma), .05));
    reactive = max(reactive, subpixelAA ? neighborhoodReaction : legacyReaction);
    float stillness = subpixelAA ? exp2(-motionPixels * .25) * (1 - reactive) : 0;
    // 入力解像度が低い場合、元のサンプルが出力ピクセル数個分離れることがある。
    // 毎フレーム 5 倍に拡大したキュービックの輪郭を平均せず、実際の位置を蓄積する。
    // 移動したピクセルと除外したピクセルでは、空間再構築を維持する。
    float2 sampleDistance = ((float2(pixel) + .5) / Extent.xy - source) * Extent.zw;
    float sampleConfidence = exp2(-.5 * dot(sampleDistance, sampleDistance));
    // 5 倍拡大時、遠いサンプルにも固定の重みを与えると、輪郭に低解像度の
    // 階段が混ざる。静止中は実際のサンプル位置の近くで主に被覆を更新する。
    float currentWeight = lerp(.08, .0001 + .12 * sampleConfidence, stillness);
    if (stablePlane)
    {
        currentWeight *= .5;
    }
    currentWeight *= lerp(1, .25, detailLock);
    float weight = (1 - currentWeight) * (1 - reactive) * exp2(-motionPixels * .04);
    float3 temporalSample = lerp(current.rgb, LoadCurrentColor(pixel).rgb, stillness);
    Output[id.xy] = float4(lerp(temporalSample, FromY(clippedHistory), weight), current.a);
}

===== FILE: shader\hlsl\ToneMapping.hlsli =====
#include "noise.hlsl"

#ifndef TONE_MAPPING_HLSLI
#define TONE_MAPPING_HLSLI
// common.hlsl の PostProcessParams（GradeParams0/1、GradeLift/Gamma/Gain）が必要。
// 全関数は線形 Rec.709 の値を受け取り、同じ形式で返す。

static const float3 kLumaWeights = float3(0.2126f, 0.7152f, 0.0722f);

// --- AgX（Troy Sobotka）、既定コントラスト曲線の多項式近似 ---
float3 AgXContrastApprox(float3 x)
{
    float3 x2 = x * x;
    float3 x4 = x2 * x2;
    return 15.5f * x4 * x2 - 40.14f * x4 * x + 31.96f * x4 - 6.868f * x2 * x + 0.4298f * x2 + 0.1191f * x - 0.00232f;
}

float3 AgXToneMap(float3 color, bool punchy)
{
    // 入力側の行列（列）。
    const float3 c0 = float3(0.842479062253094f, 0.0423282422610123f, 0.0423756549057051f);
    const float3 c1 = float3(0.0784335999999992f, 0.878468636469772f, 0.0784336f);
    const float3 c2 = float3(0.0792237451477643f, 0.0791661274605434f, 0.879142973793104f);
    const float minEv = -12.47393f;
    const float maxEv = 4.026069f;
    color = c0 * color.r + c1 * color.g + c2 * color.b;
    color = clamp(log2(max(color, 1e-10f)), minEv, maxEv);
    color = (color - minEv) / (maxEv - minEv);
    color = AgXContrastApprox(color);
    if (punchy)
    {
        color = pow(max(color, 0.0f), 1.35f);
        float luma = dot(color, kLumaWeights);
        color = luma + 1.4f * (color - luma);
    }
    // 出力側の行列（列）。ディスプレイ符号化済み Rec.709 へ戻す。
    const float3 d0 = float3(1.19687900512017f, -0.0528968517574562f, -0.0529716355144438f);
    const float3 d1 = float3(-0.0980208811401368f, 1.15190312990417f, -0.0980434501171241f);
    const float3 d2 = float3(-0.0990297440797205f, -0.0989611768448433f, 1.15107367264116f);
    color = d0 * color.r + d1 * color.g + d2 * color.b;
    // 曲線は 2.2 のディスプレイを対象とする。既存の出力経路へ線形光を返す。
    return pow(saturate(color), 2.2f);
}

// --- ACES の近似（Stephen Hill）：sRGB の入出力行列を使う RRT + ODT ---
float3 AcesFittedToneMap(float3 color)
{
    const float3x3 inputMatrix =
        float3x3(0.59719f, 0.35458f, 0.04823f, 0.07600f, 0.90834f, 0.01566f, 0.02840f, 0.13383f, 0.83777f);
    const float3x3 outputMatrix =
        float3x3(1.60475f, -0.53108f, -0.07367f, -0.10208f, 1.10813f, -0.00605f, -0.00327f, -0.07276f, 1.07602f);
    color = mul(inputMatrix, color);
    float3 a = color * (color + 0.0245786f) - 0.000090537f;
    float3 b = color * (0.983729f * color + 0.4329510f) + 0.238081f;
    color = a / b;
    return saturate(mul(outputMatrix, color));
}

// --- Khronos PBR Neutral：基本色の色相と彩度を保つ（製品の可視化用）---
float3 PbrNeutralToneMap(float3 color)
{
    const float startCompression = 0.8f - 0.04f;
    const float desaturation = 0.15f;
    float x = min(color.r, min(color.g, color.b));
    float offset = x < 0.08f ? x - 6.25f * x * x : 0.04f;
    color -= offset;
    float peak = max(color.r, max(color.g, color.b));
    if (peak < startCompression)
    {
        return saturate(color);
    }
    float d = 1.0f - startCompression;
    float newPeak = 1.0f - d * d / (peak + d - startCompression);
    color *= newPeak / peak;
    float g = 1.0f - 1.0f / (desaturation * (peak - newPeak) + 1.0f);
    return saturate(lerp(color, newPeak.xxx, g));
}

float3 ApplyToneMapper(float3 color)
{
    int mode = (int)round(GradeParams0.x);
    if (mode == 1)
    {
        return AgXToneMap(color, GradeParams1.z > 0.5f);
    }
    if (mode == 2)
    {
        return AcesFittedToneMap(color);
    }
    if (mode == 3)
    {
        return PbrNeutralToneMap(color);
    }
    return ACESToneMap(color);
}

// シーン基準の色調整（トーンマッパー前）：ホワイトバランス、コントラスト、彩度、自然な彩度。
float3 GradeSceneLinear(float3 color)
{
    float temperature = GradeParams1.x;
    float tint = GradeParams1.y;
    // 簡易ホワイトバランス：青と黄の軸で暖色・寒色を、緑とマゼンタの軸で色かぶりを調整する。
    float3 balance = float3(1.0f + temperature * 0.10f, 1.0f - tint * 0.08f, 1.0f - temperature * 0.10f);
    color *= balance / dot(balance, kLumaWeights);
    float contrast = max(GradeParams0.y, 0.0f);
    if (abs(contrast - 1.0f) > 0.001f)
    {
        // 対数空間の中間グレーを中心にコントラストを変え、ハイライトと黒を安定させる。
        color = 0.18f * pow(max(color, 1e-6f) / 0.18f, contrast);
    }
    float luma = dot(color, kLumaWeights);
    float saturation = max(GradeParams0.z, 0.0f);
    color = max(luma + (color - luma) * saturation, 0.0f);
    float vibrance = GradeParams0.w;
    if (abs(vibrance) > 0.001f)
    {
        float maxChannel = max(color.r, max(color.g, color.b));
        float minChannel = min(color.r, min(color.g, color.b));
        float currentSaturation = (maxChannel - minChannel) / max(maxChannel, 1e-5f);
        luma = dot(color, kLumaWeights);
        color = max(luma + (color - luma) * (1.0f + vibrance * (1.0f - currentSaturation)), 0.0f);
    }
    return color;
}

// トーンマッピング済みの画像に、ディスプレイ基準のリフト・ガンマ・ゲイン（ASC CDL 形式）を適用する。
float3 GradeDisplay(float3 color)
{
    float3 encoded = pow(saturate(color), 1.0f / 2.2f);
    encoded = GradeGain.rgb * (encoded + GradeLift.rgb * (1.0f - encoded));
    encoded = pow(saturate(encoded), 1.0f / max(GradeGamma.rgb, 0.05f));
    return pow(encoded, 2.2f);
}

// --- レンズ効果 ---


// 倍率色収差：赤と青を、放射状にスケールした位置でサンプリングする。
float3 SampleWithChromaticAberration(Texture2D<float4> source, SamplerState linearSampler, float2 uv)
{
    float amount = LensParams0.z;
    float3 center = source.SampleLevel(linearSampler, uv, 0).rgb;
    if (amount <= 0.001f)
    {
        return center;
    }
    float width, height;
    source.GetDimensions(width, height);
    float2 fromCenter = uv - 0.5f;
    float2 offset = fromCenter * dot(fromCenter, fromCenter) * 4.0f * amount / float2(width, height);
    float red = source.SampleLevel(linearSampler, uv - offset, 0).r;
    float blue = source.SampleLevel(linearSampler, uv + offset, 0).b;
    return float3(red, center.g, blue);
}

// ディスプレイ空間のビネット（自然な cos^4 形式の減衰）と輝度依存のフィルムグレイン。
float3 ApplyLensOutput(float3 color, float2 uv, float2 pixel)
{
    float vignette = LensParams0.x;
    if (vignette > 0.001f)
    {
        float2 d = (uv - 0.5f) * float2(1.0f, 0.75f) * 2.0f;
        float falloff = saturate(1.0f - dot(d, d) * vignette * (1.0f - LensParams0.y * 0.5f));
        color *= lerp(1.0f, falloff * falloff, saturate(vignette * 2.0f));
    }
    float grain = LensParams0.w;
    if (grain > 0.001f)
    {
        float noise = Hash21(pixel + frac(LensParams1.y * 0.6180339f) * 1024.0f) - 0.5f;
        float luma = dot(color, kLumaWeights);
        // フィルム同様、グレインは中間調で最も強くする。
        float response = 4.0f * luma * (1.0f - saturate(luma));
        color = max(color + noise * grain * 0.12f * (0.25f + response), 0.0f);
    }
    return color;
}
